// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AnalogBoard.cpp

#include "AnalogBoard.h"

#include <cmath>

namespace AnalogBoard
{
namespace
{
    using Kind = ParamSpec::Kind;

    constexpr double twoPi = 2.0 * SonifyDsp::pi;

    void storeMax (std::atomic<float>& target, float value) noexcept
    {
        auto current = target.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

        while (value > current && ! target.compare_exchange_weak (current, value, std::memory_order_relaxed))
        {
        }
    }

    float dbGain (float db, float closedAt) noexcept
    {
        return db <= closedAt ? 0.0f : juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (db);
    }

    /** A circular delay line: tap (0) is the sample pushed last. */
    class DelayLine
    {
    public:
        void prepare (int longest)
        {
            const auto size = juce::nextPowerOfTwo (juce::jmax (8, longest + 4));
            data.assign (static_cast<size_t> (size), 0.0f);
            mask = size - 1;
            writeAt = 0;
        }

        void clear() noexcept                     { std::fill (data.begin(), data.end(), 0.0f); clearAt = -1; }
        int length() const noexcept               { return mask + 1; }

        /** Clearing it a little at a time (the audio thread, starting afresh): from the start... */
        void beginClear() noexcept                { clearAt = 0; }

        /** ...up to budget samples now (taken from the budget). True once it's all clear. */
        bool clearSome (int& budget) noexcept
        {
            if (clearAt < 0)
                return true;

            const auto now = juce::jmin (budget, length() - clearAt);
            std::fill (data.begin() + clearAt, data.begin() + clearAt + now, 0.0f);
            clearAt += now;
            budget -= now;

            if (clearAt < length())
                return false;

            clearAt = -1;
            return true;
        }

        void push (float sample) noexcept
        {
            data[static_cast<size_t> (writeAt)] = sample;
            writeAt = (writeAt + 1) & mask;
        }

        float tap (int delay) const noexcept
        {
            return data[static_cast<size_t> ((writeAt - 1 - delay) & mask)];
        }

        float tapFractional (float delay) const noexcept
        {
            const auto whole = static_cast<int> (delay);
            const auto fraction = delay - static_cast<float> (whole);
            const auto a = tap (whole);
            return a + (tap (whole + 1) - a) * fraction;
        }

    private:
        std::vector<float> data;
        int mask = 0, writeAt = 0, clearAt = -1;
    };

    /** A Schroeder allpass of a fixed length; its line can be tapped. */
    struct Allpass
    {
        DelayLine line;
        int length = 1;

        void prepare (int samples)                { length = juce::jmax (1, samples); line.prepare (length + 64); }

        float process (float input, float gain) noexcept
        {
            const auto delayed = line.tap (length - 1);
            const auto w = input + gain * delayed;
            line.push (w);
            return delayed - gain * w;
        }

        /** Its length moved by excursion samples (a modulated allpass). */
        float process (float input, float gain, float excursion) noexcept
        {
            const auto delayed = line.tapFractional (juce::jmax (0.0f, static_cast<float> (length - 1) + excursion));
            const auto w = input + gain * delayed;
            line.push (w);
            return delayed - gain * w;
        }
    };

    /** tanh, closely enough for saturation and far quicker: a rational curve, level at the
        bottom (slope 1) and flat from 3 on. */
    inline float softClip (float x) noexcept
    {
        x = juce::jlimit (-3.0f, 3.0f, x);
        const auto x2 = x * x;
        return x * (27.0f + x2) / (27.0f + 9.0f * x2);
    }

    /** softClip's slope at x. */
    inline float softClipSlope (float x) noexcept
    {
        const auto x2 = x * x, d = 27.0f + 9.0f * x2;
        return ((27.0f + 3.0f * x2) * d - x * (27.0f + x2) * 18.0f * x) / (d * d);
    }

    /** A slow sine (wow, flutter, a reverb's movement): worked out every 16 samples, in a line between. */
    struct Lfo
    {
        double phase = 0.0, step = 0.0;
        float value = 0.0f, slope = 0.0f;
        int left = 0;

        void setRate (double sampleRate, double hz, double startPhase = 0.0) noexcept
        {
            step = 2.0 * SonifyDsp::pi * hz / sampleRate;
            phase = startPhase;
            value = static_cast<float> (std::sin (phase));
            left = 0;
        }

        float next() noexcept
        {
            if (left == 0)
            {
                phase += 16.0 * step;

                if (phase >= 2.0 * SonifyDsp::pi)
                    phase -= 2.0 * SonifyDsp::pi;

                slope = (static_cast<float> (std::sin (phase)) - value) / 16.0f;
                left = 16;
            }

            --left;
            value += slope;
            return value;
        }
    };

    /** A one-pole low-pass: coefficient from a cutoff. */
    struct OnePole
    {
        float z = 0.0f, a = 0.0f;

        void setCutoff (double sampleRate, double hz) noexcept   { a = static_cast<float> (std::exp (-twoPi * hz / sampleRate)); }
        float lowPass (float x) noexcept                          { z = x + a * (z - x); return z; }
        float highPass (float x) noexcept                         { return x - lowPass (x); }
        void reset() noexcept                                     { z = 0.0f; }
    };

    /** A number with at most this many decimals, none trailing ("2.4", "16", "-3.5"). */
    juce::String number (float value, int decimals)
    {
        auto text = juce::String (value, decimals);

        if (text.containsChar ('.'))
            text = text.trimCharactersAtEnd ("0").trimCharactersAtEnd (".");

        return text == "-0" ? juce::String ("0") : text;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::StringArray ParamSpec::choiceNames() const
{
    return juce::StringArray::fromTokens (choices, "|", "");
}

float ParamSpec::clamp (float value) const noexcept
{
    if (! std::isfinite (value))
        value = defaultValue;

    value = juce::jlimit (minimum, maximum, value);

    if (kind == Kind::toggle || kind == Kind::choice)
        value = std::round (value);

    return value;
}

juce::String ParamSpec::text (float value) const
{
    value = clamp (value);
    const juce::String u (unit);
    const juce::String key (id);

    if (kind == Kind::toggle)
        return value >= 0.5f ? "On" : "Off";

    if (kind == Kind::choice)
    {
        const auto names = choiceNames();
        return names[juce::jlimit (0, names.size() - 1, static_cast<int> (value))];
    }

    if (key == "pan")
    {
        const auto amount = juce::roundToInt (std::abs (value) * 100.0f);
        return amount == 0 ? juce::String ("C") : (value < 0.0f ? "L" : "R") + juce::String (amount);
    }

    if (u == "dB")
    {
        if (kind == Kind::fader && value <= silentDb)
            return juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x88\x92\xe2\x88\x9e dB");   // −∞ dB

        if ((key.startsWith ("send") || key.endsWith ("Return")) && value <= offDb)
            return "Off";

        const auto shown = std::abs (value) < 0.05f ? 0.0f : value;
        return (shown > 0.0f && (key == "lf" || key == "lmf" || key == "hmf" || key == "hf" || key == "trim") ? "+" : "")
             + juce::String (shown, 1) + " dB";
    }

    if (u == "Hz")
    {
        if ((key == "hpf" || key == "widthBass") && value <= minimum + 0.5f)
            return "Off";

        return value >= 1000.0f ? number (value / 1000.0f, value >= 10000.0f ? 1 : 2) + " kHz" : juce::String (juce::roundToInt (value)) + " Hz";   // "2.4 kHz"
    }

    if (u == "ms")
        return (value < 10.0f ? number (value, 1) : juce::String (juce::roundToInt (value))) + " ms";

    if (u == "%")
        return juce::String (juce::roundToInt (value)) + "%";

    if (u == ":1")
        return number (value, 1) + ":1";

    return number (value, 2);
}

int stripIndexOf (const juce::String& id)
{
    const auto& specs = stripSpecs();

    for (size_t i = 0; i < specs.size(); ++i)
        if (id == specs[i].id)
            return static_cast<int> (i);

    return -1;
}

int masterIndexOf (const juce::String& id)
{
    const auto& specs = masterSpecs();

    for (size_t i = 0; i < specs.size(); ++i)
        if (id == specs[i].id)
            return static_cast<int> (i);

    return -1;
}

//==============================================================================
void Meter::measure (const float* left, const float* right, int numSamples, double sampleRate, float reductionDb) noexcept
{
    if (numSamples <= 0)
        return;

    double sumLeft = 0.0, sumRight = 0.0;
    float peakL = 0.0f, peakR = 0.0f;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        const auto l = left[i], r = right[i];
        sumLeft += static_cast<double> (l) * l;
        sumRight += static_cast<double> (r) * r;
        peakL = juce::jmax (peakL, std::abs (l));
        peakR = juce::jmax (peakR, std::abs (r));
    }

    // A VU's swing: about 300 ms to settle.
    const auto follow = 1.0 - std::exp (-static_cast<double> (numSamples) / (0.3 * juce::jmax (1.0, sampleRate)));
    powerLeft += (sumLeft / numSamples - powerLeft) * follow;
    powerRight += (sumRight / numSamples - powerRight) * follow;

    vuLeft.store (static_cast<float> (10.0 * std::log10 (juce::jmax (1.0e-10, powerLeft))), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    vuRight.store (static_cast<float> (10.0 * std::log10 (juce::jmax (1.0e-10, powerRight))), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    storeMax (peakLeft, peakL);
    storeMax (peakRight, peakR);
    reduction.store (reductionDb, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void Meter::clear() noexcept
{
    powerLeft = powerRight = 0.0;
    vuLeft.store (-100.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    vuRight.store (-100.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    reduction.store (0.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

//==============================================================================
Strip::Strip()
{
}

void Strip::prepare (double rate, int maxBlockSize)
{
    sampleRate = rate > 0.0 ? rate : 48000.0;

    for (auto* buffer : { &output, &scratch })
    {
        buffer->setSize (2, juce::jmax (4096, 2 * maxBlockSize), false, true, true);
        buffer->clear();
    }

    compressor.prepare (sampleRate);
    seenChanges = settings.getChanges() - 1;   // worked out again at the next block
    reset();
}

void Strip::reset() noexcept
{
    for (auto& side : states)
        side = {};

    compressor.reset();
    wasCompressing = false;
    fresh = true;   // the next block starts as the settings are, with no crossfade
    meter.clear();
}

Strip::Chain Strip::workOutChain() const noexcept
{
    const auto get = [this] (int index) { return static_cast<double> (settings.get (index)); };
    Chain next;

    next.trimGain = static_cast<float> (SonifyDsp::dbToGain (get (trim)) * (settings.isOn (phase) ? -1.0 : 1.0));

    // The preamp: a soft curve, a little lopsided (as a transformer and tubes are), level at the
    // bottom so only what's loud bends.
    const auto amount = get (drive) / 100.0;
    next.driving = amount > 0.0001;
    next.driveGain = static_cast<float> (1.0 + 12.0 * amount);
    next.driveBias = static_cast<float> (0.2 * amount);
    next.driveBiasOut = softClip (next.driveBias);
    next.driveNorm = 1.0f / (next.driveGain * softClipSlope (next.driveBias));

    next.hpfOn = get (hpf) > stripSpecs()[hpf].minimum + 0.5;
    next.eqOn = settings.isOn (eqOn);
    next.filters[0] = next.hpfOn ? SonifyDsp::Biquad::highPass (sampleRate, get (hpf), 0.707) : SonifyDsp::Biquad {};
    next.filters[1] = SonifyDsp::Biquad::lowShelf (sampleRate, get (lfFreq), get (lf));
    next.filters[2] = SonifyDsp::Biquad::peak (sampleRate, get (lmfFreq), 1.1, get (lmf));
    next.filters[3] = SonifyDsp::Biquad::peak (sampleRate, get (hmfFreq), 1.1, get (hmf));
    next.filters[4] = SonifyDsp::Biquad::highShelf (sampleRate, get (hfFreq), get (hf));
    return next;
}

float Strip::run (const Chain& chain, ChainState& state, float input) noexcept
{
    auto x = input * chain.trimGain;

    if (chain.driving)
    {
        x = (softClip (chain.driveGain * x + chain.driveBias) - chain.driveBiasOut) * chain.driveNorm;

        // The lopsided curve leaves a little DC: taken out at once.
        const auto y = static_cast<double> (x) - state.dcIn + 0.9995 * state.dcOut;
        state.dcIn = x;
        state.dcOut = y;
        x = static_cast<float> (y);
    }

    if (chain.hpfOn)
        x = state.filters[0].process (chain.filters[0], x);

    // Every band, a flat one too, so each keeps its memory up to date for when it moves.
    if (chain.eqOn)
        for (size_t f = 1; f < chain.filters.size(); ++f)
            x = state.filters[f].process (chain.filters[f], x);

    return x;
}

void Strip::process (const float* left, const float* right, int numSamples, Master& master, bool audible, bool settle) noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, output.getNumSamples(), master.getBlockSize());
    outputSamples = juce::jmax (0, numSamples);

    if (numSamples <= 0 || left == nullptr || right == nullptr)
        return;

    auto* outLeft = output.getWritePointer (0);
    auto* outRight = output.getWritePointer (1);
    bool crossfaded = false;

    // A change to the preamp or the filters plays both ways over this block, the old fading into
    // the new, so knobs and switches never click. A stage switched on starts from silence.
    if (settings.getChanges() != seenChanges)
    {
        seenChanges = settings.getChanges();
        const auto next = workOutChain();
        compressor.set (settings.get (threshold), settings.get (ratio), settings.isOn (fastAttack) ? 1.0f : 10.0f,
                        settings.get (release), 4.0f, settings.get (makeup));

        if (! fresh && ! settle)
        {
            const auto step = 1.0f / static_cast<float> (numSamples);

            for (int channel = 0; channel < 2; ++channel)
            {
                const auto* in = channel == 0 ? left : right;
                auto* out = channel == 0 ? outLeft : outRight;
                auto& oldState = states[static_cast<size_t> (channel)];
                auto newState = oldState;

                if (next.hpfOn && ! chain.hpfOn)
                    newState.filters[0].reset();

                if (next.eqOn && ! chain.eqOn)
                    for (size_t f = 1; f < newState.filters.size(); ++f)
                        newState.filters[f].reset();

                if (next.driving && ! chain.driving)
                    newState.dcIn = newState.dcOut = 0.0;

                for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
                {
                    const auto was = run (chain, oldState, in[i]);
                    const auto now = run (next, newState, in[i]);
                    out[i] = was + (now - was) * step * static_cast<float> (i + 1);
                }

                oldState = newState;
            }

            crossfaded = true;
        }

        chain = next;
    }

    fresh = false;

    if (! crossfaded)
    {
        for (int channel = 0; channel < 2; ++channel)
        {
            const auto* in = channel == 0 ? left : right;
            auto* out = channel == 0 ? outLeft : outRight;
            auto& state = states[static_cast<size_t> (channel)];

            for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
                out[i] = run (chain, state, in[i]);
        }
    }

    // The compressor; switched in or out, it crossfades over the block.
    const bool compressing = settings.isOn (compOn);

    if (compressing != wasCompressing)
    {
        auto* copyLeft = scratch.getWritePointer (0);
        auto* copyRight = scratch.getWritePointer (1);
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (copyLeft, outLeft, numSamples);
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (copyRight, outRight, numSamples);

        if (compressing)
        {
            compressor.reset();
            compressor.prime (copyLeft, copyRight, numSamples);
        }

        compressor.process (copyLeft, copyRight, numSamples);
        const auto step = 1.0f / static_cast<float> (numSamples);

        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
        {
            const auto g = compressing ? step * static_cast<float> (i + 1) : 1.0f - step * static_cast<float> (i + 1);
            outLeft[i] += (copyLeft[i] - outLeft[i]) * g;
            outRight[i] += (copyRight[i] - outRight[i]) * g;
        }
    }
    else if (compressing)
    {
        compressor.process (outLeft, outRight, numSamples);
    }

    wasCompressing = compressing;

    // Pan (a stereo source: the far side turns down, on a sine curve) and the fader.
    const auto faderGain = audible ? dbGain (settings.get (volume), silentDb) : 0.0f;
    const auto position = settings.get (pan);
    const auto curve = [] (float amount) { return static_cast<float> (std::cos (amount * SonifyDsp::pi * 0.5)); };
    const auto targetLeft = faderGain * (position > 0.0f ? curve (position) : 1.0f);
    const auto targetRight = faderGain * (position < 0.0f ? curve (-position) : 1.0f);
    const auto targetPlate = dbGain (settings.get (sendPlate), offDb);
    const auto targetEcho = dbGain (settings.get (sendEcho), offDb);

    if (settle)
    {
        lastLeftGain = targetLeft;
        lastRightGain = targetRight;
        lastPlate = targetPlate;
        lastEcho = targetEcho;
    }

    const auto count = static_cast<float> (numSamples);
    const auto stepLeft = (targetLeft - lastLeftGain) / count, stepRight = (targetRight - lastRightGain) / count;
    const auto stepPlate = (targetPlate - lastPlate) / count, stepEcho = (targetEcho - lastEcho) / count;
    const bool sendsPlate = targetPlate > 0.0f || lastPlate > 0.0f;
    const bool sendsEcho = targetEcho > 0.0f || lastEcho > 0.0f;

    auto* busLeft = master.bus (0);
    auto* busRight = master.bus (1);
    auto* plateLeft = master.plateSend (0);
    auto* plateRight = master.plateSend (1);
    auto* echoLeft = master.echoSend (0);
    auto* echoRight = master.echoSend (1);

    auto gainLeft = lastLeftGain, gainRight = lastRightGain, plate = lastPlate, echoGain = lastEcho;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        gainLeft += stepLeft;
        gainRight += stepRight;
        plate += stepPlate;
        echoGain += stepEcho;

        const auto l = outLeft[i] * gainLeft;
        const auto r = outRight[i] * gainRight;
        outLeft[i] = l;
        outRight[i] = r;
        busLeft[i] += l;
        busRight[i] += r;

        if (sendsPlate)
        {
            plateLeft[i] += l * plate;
            plateRight[i] += r * plate;
        }

        if (sendsEcho)
        {
            echoLeft[i] += l * echoGain;
            echoRight[i] += r * echoGain;
        }
    }

    lastLeftGain = targetLeft;
    lastRightGain = targetRight;
    lastPlate = targetPlate;
    lastEcho = targetEcho;

    meter.measure (outLeft, outRight, numSamples, sampleRate, compressing ? compressor.getReductionDb() : 0.0f);
}

//==============================================================================
/** The Plate: Jon Dattorro's plate reverb ("Effect Design, Part 1", 1997): a pre-delay, four
    diffusers, and a figure-eight tank of modulated allpasses, delays and damping, tapped seven
    times a side. Its lengths are the paper's, at 29761 Hz, scaled to the rate. */
class Master::Plate
{
public:
    void prepare (double rate)
    {
        sampleRate = rate;
        const auto scale = rate / 29761.0;
        const auto scaled = [scale] (int samples) { return juce::jmax (1, static_cast<int> (std::round (samples * scale))); };

        preDelay.prepare (static_cast<int> (0.11 * rate));
        diffusers[0].prepare (scaled (142));
        diffusers[1].prepare (scaled (107));
        diffusers[2].prepare (scaled (379));
        diffusers[3].prepare (scaled (277));

        excursion = static_cast<float> (16.0 * scale);
        leftModulated.prepare (scaled (672));
        rightModulated.prepare (scaled (908));
        leftModulated.line.prepare (scaled (672) + static_cast<int> (excursion) + 8);
        rightModulated.line.prepare (scaled (908) + static_cast<int> (excursion) + 8);
        leftDelay1.prepare (scaled (4453));
        leftDelay2.prepare (scaled (3720));
        rightDelay1.prepare (scaled (4217));
        rightDelay2.prepare (scaled (3163));
        leftDiffuser.prepare (scaled (1800));
        rightDiffuser.prepare (scaled (2656));
        lengths = { scaled (4453), scaled (3720), scaled (4217), scaled (3163) };

        const int taps[14] = { 266, 2974, 1913, 1996, 1990, 187, 1066, 353, 3627, 1228, 2673, 2111, 335, 121 };

        for (size_t i = 0; i < 14; ++i)
            tapAt[i] = scaled (taps[i]);

        inputCut.setCutoff (rate, 120.0);
        reset();
    }

    void reset() noexcept
    {
        for (auto* line : lines())
            line->clear();

        resetStates();
    }

    /** Starting afresh on the audio thread: the lines are cleared bit by bit (clearSome). */
    void beginClear() noexcept
    {
        for (auto* line : lines())
            line->beginClear();

        resetStates();
    }

    bool clearSome (int& budget) noexcept
    {
        bool done = true;

        for (auto* line : lines())
            done = line->clearSome (budget) && done;

        return done;
    }

    void resetStates() noexcept
    {
        bandwidthState = dampLeft = dampRight = 0.0f;
        leftOut = rightOut = 0.0f;
        inputCut.reset();
        lfoLeft.setRate (sampleRate, 1.0, 0.0);
        lfoRight.setRate (sampleRate, 1.0, 0.5 * SonifyDsp::pi);
    }

    void set (float decayPercent, float tonePercent, float preDelayMs) noexcept
    {
        decay = 0.2f + 0.75f * juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, decayPercent / 100.0f);
        const auto tone = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, tonePercent / 100.0f);
        damping = 0.0005f + 0.7f * std::pow (1.0f - tone, 1.5f);
        bandwidth = 0.55f + 0.4495f * tone;
        preDelaySamples = juce::jlimit (0, preDelay.length() - 8, static_cast<int> (preDelayMs * 0.001f * static_cast<float> (sampleRate)));
    }

    /** The sends (stereo, heard in mono as a plate is fed) into the plate's stereo sound. */
    void process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outL, float* outR, int numSamples) noexcept
    {
        const auto diffusion2 = juce::jlimit (0.25f, 0.5f, decay + 0.15f);

        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
        {
            const auto mono = inputCut.highPass (0.5f * (inLeft[i] + inRight[i]));

            const auto delayed = preDelay.tap (preDelaySamples);
            preDelay.push (mono);

            bandwidthState += bandwidth * (delayed - bandwidthState);
            auto x = diffusers[0].process (bandwidthState, 0.75f);
            x = diffusers[1].process (x, 0.75f);
            x = diffusers[2].process (x, 0.625f);
            x = diffusers[3].process (x, 0.625f);

            const auto modLeft = excursion * lfoLeft.next();
            const auto modRight = excursion * lfoRight.next();

            // The left half of the tank, fed by the right's end, and the right by the left's.
            const auto intoLeft = x + decay * rightOut;
            const auto intoRight = x + decay * leftOut;

            const auto a = leftModulated.process (intoLeft, -0.7f, modLeft);
            const auto b = leftDelay1.tap (lengths[0] - 1);
            leftDelay1.push (a);
            dampLeft = b + damping * (dampLeft - b);
            const auto c = leftDiffuser.process (dampLeft * decay, diffusion2);
            const auto newLeftOut = leftDelay2.tap (lengths[1] - 1);
            leftDelay2.push (c);

            const auto d = rightModulated.process (intoRight, -0.7f, modRight);
            const auto e = rightDelay1.tap (lengths[2] - 1);
            rightDelay1.push (d);
            dampRight = e + damping * (dampRight - e);
            const auto f = rightDiffuser.process (dampRight * decay, diffusion2);
            const auto newRightOut = rightDelay2.tap (lengths[3] - 1);
            rightDelay2.push (f);

            leftOut = newLeftOut;
            rightOut = newRightOut;

            const auto t = [this] (int n) { return tapAt[static_cast<size_t> (n)]; };

            outL[i] = 0.6f * (rightDelay1.tap (t (0)) + rightDelay1.tap (t (1)) - rightDiffuser.line.tap (t (2)) + rightDelay2.tap (t (3))
                              - leftDelay1.tap (t (4)) - leftDiffuser.line.tap (t (5)) - leftDelay2.tap (t (6)));
            outR[i] = 0.6f * (leftDelay1.tap (t (7)) + leftDelay1.tap (t (8)) - leftDiffuser.line.tap (t (9)) + leftDelay2.tap (t (10))
                              - rightDelay1.tap (t (11)) - rightDiffuser.line.tap (t (12)) - rightDelay2.tap (t (13)));
        }
    }

private:
    std::array<DelayLine*, 13> lines() noexcept
    {
        return { &preDelay, &diffusers[0].line, &diffusers[1].line, &diffusers[2].line, &diffusers[3].line,
                 &leftModulated.line, &rightModulated.line, &leftDiffuser.line, &rightDiffuser.line,
                 &leftDelay1, &leftDelay2, &rightDelay1, &rightDelay2 };
    }

    double sampleRate = 48000.0;
    DelayLine preDelay;
    std::array<Allpass, 4> diffusers;
    Allpass leftModulated, rightModulated, leftDiffuser, rightDiffuser;
    DelayLine leftDelay1, leftDelay2, rightDelay1, rightDelay2;
    std::array<int, 4> lengths {};
    std::array<int, 14> tapAt {};
    OnePole inputCut;
    float excursion = 16.0f;
    float decay = 0.6f, damping = 0.2f, bandwidth = 0.9f;
    int preDelaySamples = 0;
    float bandwidthState = 0.0f, dampLeft = 0.0f, dampRight = 0.0f, leftOut = 0.0f, rightOut = 0.0f;
    Lfo lfoLeft, lfoRight;
};

//==============================================================================
/** The Tape Echo: one tape loop, its repeats darker and rounder each time round, its speed
    wandering a little (wow and flutter), a little wider on the right. Time changes glide, as a
    tape's speed does. */
class Master::Echo
{
public:
    void prepare (double rate)
    {
        sampleRate = rate;
        line.prepare (static_cast<int> (3.1 * rate));
        spread = static_cast<float> (0.006 * rate);
        lowCut.setCutoff (rate, 120.0);
        smoothing = static_cast<float> (1.0 - std::exp (-1.0 / (0.12 * rate)));
        reset();
    }

    void reset() noexcept
    {
        line.clear();
        resetStates();
    }

    void beginClear() noexcept
    {
        line.beginClear();
        resetStates();
    }

    bool clearSome (int& budget) noexcept     { return line.clearSome (budget); }

    void resetStates() noexcept
    {
        lowCut.reset();
        highCut.reset();
        snap = true;
        wow.setRate (sampleRate, 0.6);
        flutter.setRate (sampleRate, 7.0);
    }

    void set (double seconds, float feedbackPercent, float tonePercent, float wowPercent) noexcept
    {
        target = static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (0.005, 3.0, seconds) * sampleRate);

        // A fresh loop starts at its time; afterwards the time glides.
        if (snap)
        {
            current = target;
            snap = false;
        }

        feedback = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 0.95f, feedbackPercent / 100.0f);
        highCut.setCutoff (sampleRate, 1500.0 * std::pow (8.0, juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, tonePercent / 100.0f)));
        const auto wander = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, wowPercent / 100.0f);
        wowDepth = static_cast<float> (0.003 * sampleRate) * wander;
        flutterDepth = static_cast<float> (0.0003 * sampleRate) * wander;
    }

    void process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outL, float* outR, int numSamples) noexcept
    {
        const auto longest = static_cast<float> (line.length() - 4) - spread - wowDepth - flutterDepth;

        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
        {
            current += (target - current) * smoothing;

            const auto wander = wowDepth * wow.next() + flutterDepth * flutter.next();
            const auto delay = juce::jlimit (2.0f, longest, current + wander);

            const auto repeat = line.tapFractional (delay - 1.0f);
            const auto wide = line.tapFractional (delay - 1.0f + spread);

            // Into the loop: the sends and the repeat, darker, without its lows, rounded off.
            auto w = 0.5f * (inLeft[i] + inRight[i]) + feedback * repeat;
            w = lowCut.highPass (highCut.lowPass (w));
            w = softClip (1.2f * w) / 1.2f;
            line.push (w);

            outL[i] = repeat;
            outR[i] = wide;
        }
    }

private:
    double sampleRate = 48000.0;
    DelayLine line;
    OnePole lowCut, highCut;
    float target = 0.0f, current = 0.0f, smoothing = 0.001f, spread = 0.0f;
    float feedback = 0.35f, wowDepth = 0.0f, flutterDepth = 0.0f;
    bool snap = true;
    Lfo wow, flutter;
};

//==============================================================================
/** The Tape Machine: the mix recorded to tape and played back. Driven harder, it rounds the
    peaks off (the highs first, as tape's emphasis makes them), with tape's low bump and its
    gentle top, its speed wandering a little, and its hiss when asked. */
class Master::Tape
{
public:
    void prepare (double rate)
    {
        sampleRate = rate;

        for (auto& line : lines)
            line.prepare (static_cast<int> (0.01 * rate));

        baseDelay = static_cast<float> (0.0015 * rate);
        glide = static_cast<float> (1.0 - std::exp (-1.0 / (0.01 * rate)));
        reset();
    }

    void reset() noexcept
    {
        for (auto& line : lines)
            line.clear();

        for (auto& side : states)
            for (auto& state : side)
                state.reset();

        snapGains = true;
        wow.setRate (sampleRate, 0.5);
        flutter.setRate (sampleRate, 6.3);
    }

    void set (float drivePercent, int speed, float wowPercent, bool withHiss) noexcept
    {
        const auto amount = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, drivePercent / 100.0f);
        const auto driveDb = 18.0 * amount;
        targetIn = static_cast<float> (SonifyDsp::dbToGain (driveDb));
        targetOut = static_cast<float> (SonifyDsp::dbToGain (-0.9 * driveDb));

        // A fresh tape starts at its drive; afterwards the drive glides (no zipper as its knob turns).
        if (snapGains)
        {
            inGain = targetIn;
            outGain = targetOut;
            snapGains = false;
        }

        const bool fast = speed > 0;
        filters[0] = SonifyDsp::Biquad::highShelf (sampleRate, 3000.0, 4.0);                     // emphasis
        filters[1] = SonifyDsp::Biquad::highShelf (sampleRate, 3000.0, -4.0);                    // and back
        filters[2] = SonifyDsp::Biquad::peak (sampleRate, fast ? 110.0 : 55.0, fast ? 1.0 : 1.1, fast ? 2.0 : 2.5);   // head bump
        filters[3] = SonifyDsp::Biquad::highPass (sampleRate, fast ? 35.0 : 22.0, 0.707);
        filters[4] = SonifyDsp::Biquad::lowPass (sampleRate, fast ? 21000.0 : 18000.0, 0.707);

        const auto wander = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, wowPercent / 100.0f);
        wowDepth = static_cast<float> (0.0008 * sampleRate) * wander;
        flutterDepth = static_cast<float> (0.00008 * sampleRate) * wander;
        hiss = withHiss;
    }

    void process (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
        {
            const auto delay = baseDelay + wowDepth * wow.next() + flutterDepth * flutter.next();
            inGain += (targetIn - inGain) * glide;
            outGain += (targetOut - outGain) * glide;

            for (int channel = 0; channel < 2; ++channel)
            {
                auto* data = channel == 0 ? left : right;
                auto& state = states[static_cast<size_t> (channel)];
                auto x = data[i] * inGain;

                x = state[0].process (filters[0], x);
                x = softClip (x);
                x = state[1].process (filters[1], x);
                x = state[2].process (filters[2], x);
                x = state[3].process (filters[3], x);
                x = state[4].process (filters[4], x);
                x *= outGain;

                auto& line = lines[static_cast<size_t> (channel)];
                line.push (x);
                auto played = line.tapFractional (delay);

                if (hiss)
                {
                    noise ^= noise << 13;
                    noise ^= noise >> 17;
                    noise ^= noise << 5;
                    played += 0.0006f * (static_cast<float> (noise) / 2147483648.0f - 1.0f);
                }

                data[i] = played;
            }
        }
    }

private:
    double sampleRate = 48000.0;
    std::array<DelayLine, 2> lines;
    std::array<SonifyDsp::Biquad, 5> filters {};
    std::array<std::array<SonifyDsp::BiquadState, 5>, 2> states {};
    float inGain = 1.0f, outGain = 1.0f, targetIn = 1.0f, targetOut = 1.0f, glide = 0.002f;
    float baseDelay = 64.0f, wowDepth = 0.0f, flutterDepth = 0.0f;
    bool snapGains = true;
    bool hiss = false;
    juce::uint32 noise = 0x9e3779b9u;
    Lfo wow, flutter;
};

//==============================================================================
Master::Master()
    : plate (std::make_unique<Plate>()), echo (std::make_unique<Echo>()), tape (std::make_unique<Tape>())
{
}

Master::~Master() = default;

void Master::prepare (double rate, int maxBlockSize)
{
    sampleRate = rate > 0.0 ? rate : 48000.0;
    const auto size = juce::jmax (4096, 2 * maxBlockSize);

    for (auto* buffer : { &busBuffer, &plateBuffer, &echoBuffer, &returnBuffer })
    {
        buffer->setSize (2, size, false, true, true);
        buffer->clear();
    }

    plate->prepare (sampleRate);
    echo->prepare (sampleRate);
    tape->prepare (sampleRate);
    busCompressor.prepare (sampleRate);
    seenChanges = settings.getChanges() - 1;
    reset();
}

void Master::reset() noexcept
{
    plate->reset();
    echo->reset();
    tape->reset();
    busCompressor.reset();
    clearing = false;
    busWasOn = settings.isOn (busOn);
    tapeWasOn = settings.isOn (tapeOn);
    meter.clear();
}

void Master::startFresh() noexcept
{
    plate->beginClear();
    echo->beginClear();
    tape->reset();              // its lines are a few milliseconds long
    busCompressor.reset();
    clearing = true;
    busWasOn = settings.isOn (busOn);
    tapeWasOn = settings.isOn (tapeOn);
    meter.clear();
}

template <typename Process>
void Master::crossfade (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, bool on, bool switching, Process&& process) noexcept
{
    auto* copyLeft = returnBuffer.getWritePointer (0);
    auto* copyRight = returnBuffer.getWritePointer (1);
    juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (copyLeft, left, numSamples);
    juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (copyRight, right, numSamples);
    process (copyLeft, copyRight);

    if (! switching)
        return;   // out, and staying out: only its memory moved on

    const auto step = 1.0f / static_cast<float> (numSamples);

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        const auto g = on ? step * static_cast<float> (i + 1) : 1.0f - step * static_cast<float> (i + 1);
        left[i] += (copyLeft[i] - left[i]) * g;
        right[i] += (copyRight[i] - right[i]) * g;
    }
}

void Master::begin (int numSamples) noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, busBuffer.getNumSamples());

    if (numSamples <= 0)
        return;

    for (auto* buffer : { &busBuffer, &plateBuffer, &echoBuffer })
        buffer->clear (0, numSamples);
}

void Master::refresh() noexcept
{
    seenChanges = settings.getChanges();
    const auto get = [this] (int index) { return settings.get (index); };

    plate->set (get (plateDecay), get (plateTone), get (platePredelay));

    SonifyDsp::Compressor::Settings glue;
    glue.thresholdDb = get (busThreshold);
    glue.ratio = std::array<float, 3> { 2.0f, 4.0f, 10.0f } [static_cast<size_t> (juce::jlimit (0, 2, static_cast<int> (get (busRatio))))];
    glue.attackMs = std::array<float, 6> { 0.1f, 0.3f, 1.0f, 3.0f, 10.0f, 30.0f } [static_cast<size_t> (juce::jlimit (0, 5, static_cast<int> (get (busAttack))))];

    // Auto: a slower, smoother release that follows the music (the RMS detector's own swing).
    const auto releaseChoice = juce::jlimit (0, 4, static_cast<int> (get (busRelease)));
    glue.releaseMs = std::array<float, 5> { 100.0f, 300.0f, 600.0f, 1200.0f, 400.0f } [static_cast<size_t> (releaseChoice)];
    glue.rms = releaseChoice == 4;
    glue.kneeDb = 3.0f;
    glue.makeupDb = get (busMakeup);
    glue.mix = get (busMix) / 100.0f;
    busCompressor.setSettings (glue);

    tape->set (get (tapeDrive), static_cast<int> (get (tapeSpeed)), get (tapeWow), settings.isOn (tapeHiss));
}

void Master::finish (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, double bpm, bool settle) noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, busBuffer.getNumSamples());

    if (numSamples <= 0 || left == nullptr || right == nullptr)
        return;

    if (settings.getChanges() != seenChanges)
        refresh();

    // The echo's time: a note at the song's tempo, or milliseconds.
    {
        static constexpr std::array<double, 11> quarters { 0.125, 1.0 / 6.0, 0.25, 0.375, 1.0 / 3.0, 0.5, 0.75, 2.0 / 3.0, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 };
        const auto note = quarters[static_cast<size_t> (juce::jlimit (0, 10, static_cast<int> (settings.get (echoNote))))];
        const auto tempo = juce::jlimit (20.0, 999.0, bpm > 0.0 ? bpm : 120.0);
        const auto seconds = settings.isOn (echoSync) ? note * 60.0 / tempo : settings.get (echoTime) / 1000.0;
        echo->set (seconds, settings.get (echoFeedback), settings.get (echoTone), settings.get (echoWow));
    }

    auto* busLeft = busBuffer.getWritePointer (0);
    auto* busRight = busBuffer.getWritePointer (1);
    auto* returnLeft = returnBuffer.getWritePointer (0);
    auto* returnRight = returnBuffer.getWritePointer (1);

    // The returns into the mix, each at its level.
    const auto addReturn = [&] (float target, float& last)
    {
        if (settle)
            last = target;

        const auto step = (target - last) / static_cast<float> (numSamples);
        auto gain = last;

        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
        {
            gain += step;
            busLeft[i] += returnLeft[i] * gain;
            busRight[i] += returnRight[i] * gain;
        }

        last = target;
    };

    // Starting afresh, the Plate and the Echo are silent until their memories are cleared (a
    // little each block, a few milliseconds in all).
    if (clearing)
    {
        int budget = 1 << 16;
        clearing = ! (plate->clearSome (budget) && echo->clearSome (budget));
    }
    else
    {
        plate->process (plateBuffer.getReadPointer (0), plateBuffer.getReadPointer (1), returnLeft, returnRight, numSamples);
        addReturn (dbGain (settings.get (plateReturn), offDb), lastPlateReturn);

        echo->process (echoBuffer.getReadPointer (0), echoBuffer.getReadPointer (1), returnLeft, returnRight, numSamples);
        addReturn (dbGain (settings.get (echoReturn), offDb), lastEchoReturn);
    }

    // The bus compressor, then the tape. Switched out, each still runs on a copy of the bus (and
    // isn't heard), so switching it in or out is a crossfade over the block between two sounds
    // already going: no click, no tail from long ago.
    const auto stage = [&] (bool on, bool& wasOn, auto&& process)
    {
        if (on && wasOn)
            process (busLeft, busRight);
        else
            crossfade (busLeft, busRight, numSamples, on, wasOn != on, process);

        wasOn = on;
    };

    const bool busCompressing = settings.isOn (busOn);
    stage (busCompressing, busWasOn, [this, numSamples] (float* l, float* r) { busCompressor.process (l, r, numSamples); });
    stage (settings.isOn (tapeOn), tapeWasOn, [this, numSamples] (float* l, float* r) { tape->process (l, r, numSamples); });

    // The master fader.
    const auto target = dbGain (settings.get (masterVolume), silentDb);

    if (settle)
        lastMasterGain = target;

    const auto step = (target - lastMasterGain) / static_cast<float> (numSamples);
    auto gain = lastMasterGain;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        gain += step;
        left[i] = busLeft[i] * gain;
        right[i] = busRight[i] * gain;
    }

    lastMasterGain = target;
    meter.measure (left, right, numSamples, sampleRate, busCompressing ? static_cast<float> (busCompressor.getReductionDb()) : 0.0f);
}
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AnalogBoard.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>

#include "SonifyDsp.h"

#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Analog Board (a tab of its own): a second mixer beside the Console, an analog desk's.
    When the song is mixed on it, every track's dry sound (its instrument, or its clips and
    input, before any insert) comes into a strip of the board instead of the Console: the
    Console's inserts, sends, FX channels, buses and Main are left out, and the board's own
    tools mix the song into Main's outputs:

      each strip   the preamp (Trim, Drive, phase), a high-pass filter, a four-band EQ, a
                   compressor, two sends (the Plate and the Tape Echo), pan, fader, mute, solo
      the master   the Plate (a plate reverb) and the Tape Echo, back into the mix, then the Bus
                   Compressor, the Tape Machine and the master fader

    Every setting is an atomic anyone may set at any time (the page, Sonify AI, MIDI Link); the
    audio thread reads them each block. A strip belongs to its track (Track::board), so it comes
    and goes with it; the master is the engine's.

    prepare() allocates; nothing else does.
*/
namespace AnalogBoard
{
    //==============================================================================
    /** A setting as the page, songs and Sonify AI know it. */
    struct ParamSpec
    {
        enum class Kind { knob, toggle, choice, fader };

        const char* id;              // "lmfFreq": songs and Sonify AI name it so
        const char* name;            // "LMF Freq": what the page shows
        const char* section;         // "Preamp", "EQ" ...
        Kind kind;
        float minimum, maximum, defaultValue;
        const char* unit;            // "dB", "Hz", "ms", "%", or ""
        const char* choices;         // a choice's names, "2:1|4:1|10:1"; otherwise ""

        juce::StringArray choiceNames() const;
        float clamp (float value) const noexcept;

        /** The value as the page shows it: "-3.5 dB", "2.4 kHz", "Off", "4:1". */
        juce::String text (float value) const;
    };

    //==============================================================================
    // A strip's settings, in this order.
    enum StripParam
    {
        trim, drive, phase,
        hpf,
        lf, lfFreq, lmf, lmfFreq, hmf, hmfFreq, hf, hfFreq, eqOn,
        compOn, threshold, ratio, release, fastAttack, makeup,
        sendPlate, sendEcho,
        pan, volume, mute, solo,
        numStripParams
    };

    // The master's.
    enum MasterParam
    {
        plateDecay, plateTone, platePredelay, plateReturn,
        echoSync, echoNote, echoTime, echoFeedback, echoTone, echoWow, echoReturn,
        busOn, busThreshold, busRatio, busAttack, busRelease, busMakeup, busMix,
        tapeOn, tapeDrive, tapeSpeed, tapeWow, tapeHiss,
        masterVolume,
        numMasterParams
    };

    const std::array<ParamSpec, numStripParams>& stripSpecs();
    const std::array<ParamSpec, numMasterParams>& masterSpecs();

    /** A setting's place by its id; -1 when there's none. */
    int stripIndexOf (const juce::String& id);
    int masterIndexOf (const juce::String& id);

    constexpr float offDb = -60.0f;     // a send or a return at or below this is off
    constexpr float silentDb = -72.0f;  // a fader at or below this is closed

    //==============================================================================
    /** Settings as atomics, with a count of changes the audio thread watches. */
    template <size_t count>
    class Settings
    {
    public:
        explicit Settings (const std::array<ParamSpec, count>& specList) : specs (specList)   { reset(); }

        float get (int index) const noexcept
        {
            return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (count)) ? values[static_cast<size_t> (index)].load (std::memory_order_relaxed) : 0.0f;
        }

        bool isOn (int index) const noexcept   { return get (index) >= 0.5f; }

        /** Returns the value used (clamped, choices and switches whole). */
        float set (int index, float value) noexcept
        {
            if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (count)))
                return 0.0f;

            const auto used = specs[static_cast<size_t> (index)].clamp (value);
            values[static_cast<size_t> (index)].store (used, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            changes.fetch_add (1, std::memory_order_release);
            return used;
        }

        /** Every setting back to where a new board starts. */
        void reset() noexcept
        {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                values[i].store (specs[i].defaultValue, std::memory_order_relaxed);

            changes.fetch_add (1, std::memory_order_release);
        }

        juce::uint32 getChanges() const noexcept   { return changes.load (std::memory_order_acquire); }

        /** { <id>: value }: every setting, or only those away from where they start (songs keep those). */
        juce::var toVar (bool all = false) const
        {
            auto* object = new juce::DynamicObject();

            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            {
                const auto value = values[i].load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

                if (all || std::abs (value - specs[i].defaultValue) > 1.0e-6f)
                    object->setProperty (specs[i].id, static_cast<double> (value));
            }

            return juce::var (object);
        }

        /** Settings from songs or Sonify AI by id: the ones named change, the rest stay as they are
            (or start where a new board starts, when asked). A value may be a number, true or false,
            a number as text, or a choice's name ("4:1"). Returns what was left out, each as
            "<id> (why)". */
        juce::StringArray fromVar (const juce::var& data, bool resetFirst)
        {
            if (resetFirst)
                reset();

            juce::StringArray leftOut;

            if (const auto* object = data.getDynamicObject())
            {
                for (const auto& [key, value] : object->getProperties())
                {
                    size_t index = 0;

                    while (index < count && key.toString() != specs[index].id)
                        ++index;

                    if (index == count)
                    {
                        leftOut.add (key.toString() + " (not a setting)");
                        continue;
                    }

                    const auto& spec = specs[index];
                    double number = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();

                    if (value.isInt() || value.isInt64() || value.isDouble() || value.isBool())
                    {
                        number = static_cast<double> (value);
                    }
                    else if (value.isString())
                    {
                        const auto text = value.toString().trim();
                        const auto names = spec.choiceNames();

                        if (const auto choice = names.indexOf (text, true); choice >= 0)
                            number = choice;
                        else if (text.equalsIgnoreCase ("on") || text.equalsIgnoreCase ("true"))
                            number = 1.0;
                        else if (text.equalsIgnoreCase ("off") || text.equalsIgnoreCase ("false"))
                            number = 0.0;
                        else if (text.isNotEmpty() && text.containsOnly ("0123456789.-+eE"))
                            number = text.getDoubleValue();
                    }

                    if (std::isfinite (number))
                    {
                        set (static_cast<int> (index), static_cast<float> (number));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        leftOut.add (key.toString() + (spec.kind == ParamSpec::Kind::choice
                                                           ? " (a choice: its number, or one of " + spec.choiceNames().joinIntoString (", ") + ")"
                                                           : juce::String (" (a number)")));
                    }
                }
            }

            return leftOut;
        }

        const std::array<ParamSpec, count>& specs;

    private:
        std::array<std::atomic<float>, count> values {};
        std::atomic<juce::uint32> changes { 0 };
    };

    //==============================================================================
    /** What the board's meters show, read on the message thread: a VU's level (dBFS, RMS with a
        VU's 300 ms swing), the peak since the last read, and the compressor's reduction. */
    struct Meter
    {
        std::atomic<float> vuLeft { -100.0f }, vuRight { -100.0f };
        std::atomic<float> peakLeft { 0.0f }, peakRight { 0.0f };
        std::atomic<float> reduction { 0.0f };

        void measure (const float* left, const float* right, int numSamples, double sampleRate, float reductionDb) noexcept;
        void clear() noexcept;

    private:
        double powerLeft = 0.0, powerRight = 0.0;   // audio thread
    };

    class Master;

    //==============================================================================
    /** A channel's compressor: a peak follower, its gain worked out every 16 samples and glided
        between (cheap enough for a strip on every track), with a soft knee. */
    class ChannelCompressor
    {
    public:
        void prepare (double rate) noexcept    { sampleRate = rate; reset(); }

        void reset() noexcept
        {
            envelope = 0.0f;
            gain = targetGain = makeup;
            step = 0.0f;
            count = 0;
            reductionDb = 0.0f;
        }

        void set (float thresholdDb, float ratio, float attackMs, float releaseMs, float kneeDb, float makeupDb) noexcept
        {
            const auto coefficient = [this] (float ms) { return static_cast<float> (std::exp (-1.0 / (juce::jmax (0.01, static_cast<double> (ms)) * 0.001 * sampleRate))); };
            threshold = thresholdDb;
            slope = ratio > 1.0f ? 1.0f - 1.0f / ratio : 0.0f;
            attack = coefficient (attackMs);
            release = coefficient (releaseMs);
            knee = juce::jmax (0.0f, kneeDb);
            makeup = juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (makeupDb);
        }

        void process (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
            {
                const auto peak = juce::jmax (std::abs (left[i]), std::abs (right[i]));
                envelope = peak + (peak > envelope ? attack : release) * (envelope - peak);

                if (count == 0)
                {
                    const auto over = reductionAt (envelope);
                    reductionDb = over;
                    targetGain = makeup * juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (-over);
                    step = (targetGain - gain) / 16.0f;
                    count = 16;
                }

                --count;
                gain += step;
                left[i] *= gain;
                right[i] *= gain;
            }
        }

        /** Switched in: it starts as if it had been listening all along (its follower at this
            block's peak, its gain where that puts it), not from rest. */
        void prime (const float* left, const float* right, int numSamples) noexcept
        {
            envelope = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
                envelope = juce::jmax (envelope, std::abs (left[i]), std::abs (right[i]));

            gain = targetGain = makeup * juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (-reductionAt (envelope));
            step = 0.0f;
            count = 16;
        }

        float getReductionDb() const noexcept   { return reductionDb; }

    private:
        float reductionAt (float level) const noexcept
        {
            const auto above = (level > 1.0e-6f ? 20.0f * std::log10 (level) : -120.0f) - threshold;

            if (2.0f * above <= -knee)
                return 0.0f;

            if (knee > 0.0f && 2.0f * std::abs (above) <= knee)
                return slope * (above + knee * 0.5f) * (above + knee * 0.5f) / (2.0f * knee);

            return slope * above;
        }

        double sampleRate = 48000.0;
        float threshold = 0.0f, slope = 0.0f, attack = 0.0f, release = 0.0f, knee = 4.0f, makeup = 1.0f;
        float envelope = 0.0f, gain = 1.0f, targetGain = 1.0f, step = 0.0f, reductionDb = 0.0f;
        int count = 0;
    };

    //==============================================================================
    /** One track's channel strip. */
    class Strip
    {
    public:
        Strip();

        Settings<numStripParams> settings { stripSpecs() };
        Meter meter;

        void prepare (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize);
        void reset() noexcept;

        /** The track's dry block through the strip: the result (after the fader) is kept as
            getOutput() gives it, mixed into the master's bus and sent to its Plate and Echo.
            audible: not muted, and not left out by another strip's solo. settle: the fader and
            sends start where they are, without a ramp (a mixdown's first block). */
        void process (const float* left, const float* right, int numSamples, Master& master, bool audible, bool settle) noexcept;

        const float* getOutput (int channel) const noexcept   { return output.getReadPointer (juce::jlimit (0, 1, channel)); }
        int getOutputSamples() const noexcept                 { return outputSamples; }

    private:
        /** The preamp and the filters as the settings make them. */
        struct Chain
        {
            float trimGain = 1.0f, driveGain = 1.0f, driveBias = 0.0f, driveBiasOut = 0.0f, driveNorm = 1.0f;
            bool driving = false, hpfOn = false, eqOn = true;
            std::array<SonifyDsp::Biquad, 5> filters {};           // high-pass, LF, LMF, HMF, HF
        };

        /** One side's memory along the chain. */
        struct ChainState
        {
            std::array<SonifyDsp::BiquadState, 5> filters {};
            double dcIn = 0.0, dcOut = 0.0;
        };

        Chain workOutChain() const noexcept;
        static float run (const Chain& chain, ChainState& state, float input) noexcept;

        double sampleRate = 48000.0;
        juce::uint32 seenChanges = 0xffffffffu;
        Chain chain;                                    // as it plays now; a change crossfades over a block
        std::array<ChainState, 2> states {};
        ChannelCompressor compressor;
        float lastLeftGain = 1.0f, lastRightGain = 1.0f, lastPlate = 0.0f, lastEcho = 0.0f;
        juce::AudioBuffer<float> output, scratch;
        int outputSamples = 0;
        bool wasCompressing = false, fresh = true;
    };

    //==============================================================================
    /** The master section: what the strips bring in, the Plate and the Tape Echo, the Bus
        Compressor, the Tape Machine and the master fader. */
    class Master
    {
    public:
        Master();
        ~Master();

        Settings<numMasterParams> settings { masterSpecs() };
        Meter meter;

        void prepare (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize);
        void reset() noexcept;

        /** As reset(), on the audio thread: the Plate's and the Echo's long memories are cleared
            a little each block (they're silent meanwhile, a few milliseconds), never all at once. */
        void startFresh() noexcept;

        /** Starts a block: the bus and the sends empty. */
        void begin (int numSamples) noexcept;

        // Where the strips mix in, this block.
        float* bus (int channel) noexcept         { return busBuffer.getWritePointer (channel); }
        float* plateSend (int channel) noexcept   { return plateBuffer.getWritePointer (channel); }
        float* echoSend (int channel) noexcept    { return echoBuffer.getWritePointer (channel); }
        int getBlockSize() const noexcept         { return busBuffer.getNumSamples(); }

        /** Ends the block: the returns, the bus compressor, the tape and the master fader, into
            left and right (which it writes, not adds). bpm times a synced echo. */
        void finish (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, double bpm, bool settle) noexcept;

    private:
        class Plate;
        class Echo;
        class Tape;

        void refresh() noexcept;

        /** A stage that's out (or switching): it runs on a copy of the bus; switching, the bus
            crossfades to it (switched in) or from it (switched out) over the block. */
        template <typename Process>
        void crossfade (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, bool on, bool switching, Process&& process) noexcept;

        double sampleRate = 48000.0;
        juce::uint32 seenChanges = 0xffffffffu;
        juce::AudioBuffer<float> busBuffer, plateBuffer, echoBuffer, returnBuffer;
        std::unique_ptr<Plate> plate;
        std::unique_ptr<Echo> echo;
        std::unique_ptr<Tape> tape;
        SonifyDsp::Compressor busCompressor;
        bool busWasOn = false, tapeWasOn = false, clearing = false;
        float lastMasterGain = 1.0f, lastPlateReturn = 1.0f, lastEchoReturn = 1.0f;
    };
}

namespace
{
    /** The same clips, exactly: ids, windows, notes, controller lines, audio and what it was made from. */
    bool sameClips (const std::vector<MidiClip>& a, const std::vector<MidiClip>& b)
    {
        const auto sameLine = [] (const std::vector<MidiControlPoint>& p, const std::vector<MidiControlPoint>& q)
        {
            return std::equal (p.begin(), p.end(), q.begin(), q.end(), [] (const MidiControlPoint& x, const MidiControlPoint& y)
                               { return x.value == y.value && juce::exactlyEqual (x.time, y.time); });
        };

        const auto sameNotes = [] (const std::vector<MidiNote>& p, const std::vector<MidiNote>& q)
        {
            return std::equal (p.begin(), p.end(), q.begin(), q.end(), [] (const MidiNote& x, const MidiNote& y)
                               {
                                   return x.pitch == y.pitch && juce::exactlyEqual (x.start, y.start)
                                       && juce::exactlyEqual (x.length, y.length) && juce::exactlyEqual (x.velocity, y.velocity);
                               });
        };

        return std::equal (a.begin(), a.end(), b.begin(), b.end(), [&] (const MidiClip& x, const MidiClip& y)
        {
            return x.id == y.id && juce::exactlyEqual (x.start, y.start) && juce::exactlyEqual (x.length, y.length)
                && juce::exactlyEqual (x.offset, y.offset) && sameNotes (x.notes, y.notes)
                && sameLine (x.pitchBend, y.pitchBend) && sameLine (x.aftertouch, y.aftertouch)
                && x.audioFile == y.audioFile && juce::exactlyEqual (x.audioOffset, y.audioOffset)
                && juce::exactlyEqual (x.audioLength, y.audioLength) && juce::exactlyEqual (x.audioGainDb, y.audioGainDb)
                && juce::exactlyEqual (x.fadeIn, y.fadeIn) && juce::exactlyEqual (x.fadeOut, y.fadeOut)
                && x.sourceFile == y.sourceFile && juce::exactlyEqual (x.sourceOffset, y.sourceOffset)
                && juce::exactlyEqual (x.sourceLength, y.sourceLength) && juce::exactlyEqual (x.sourceTempo, y.sourceTempo)
                && juce::exactlyEqual (x.pitch, y.pitch) && x.reversed == y.reversed && x.followTempo == y.followTempo;
        });
    }
}

//==============================================================================
// Mixdown
class AudioEngine::MixdownThread final : public juce::Thread
{
public:
    using Format = MixdownSettings::Format;

    MixdownThread (AudioEngine& e, MixdownSettings s, juce::int64 range, juce::int64 total, double rate, int block)
        : Thread ("Fanan mixdown"), engine (e), settings (std::move (s)), rangeSamples (range), totalSamples (total),
          sampleRate (rate), blockSize (block)
    {
    }

    void run() override
    {
        // What it writes: Main's mix and each stem. A WAV at the device's rate is written as it
        // renders; anything else (another format, another rate) is rendered to a float WAV
        // beside it first, then made from that.
        const bool convert = settings.outputRate > 0.0 && ! juce::approximatelyEqual (settings.outputRate, sampleRate);
        const bool direct = settings.format == Format::wav && ! convert;

        if (settings.file != juce::File())
            targets.push_back ({ settings.file, {}, -1, nullptr });

        for (size_t i = 0; i < settings.stems.size(); ++i)
            targets.push_back ({ settings.stems[i].file, {}, static_cast<int> (i), nullptr });

        if (settings.freezeTrackId != 0)
            targets.push_back ({ settings.freezeFile, {}, freezeTarget, nullptr });

        for (auto& target : targets)
        {
            target.render = direct ? target.file
                                   : target.file.getSiblingFile (target.file.getFileNameWithoutExtension() + ".rendering.wav");
            target.writer = makeWavWriter (target.render, sampleRate, direct ? settings.bits : 32);

            if (target.writer == nullptr)
            {
                result = juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + target.render.getFullPathName());
                removeAll();
                return;
            }
        }

        // The stems: each channel's sound as it leaves its fader, caught while the song renders.
        StemTaps taps;

        if (! settings.stems.empty())
        {
            taps.buffers.setSize (2 * static_cast<int> (settings.stems.size()), blockSize);

            for (const auto& stem : settings.stems)
            {
                taps.trackIds.push_back (stem.trackId);
                taps.lastGain.push_back (1.0f);
            }

            engine.stemTaps = &taps;
        }

        // A freeze: the track's own sound, before its fader; only it (and what it needs) plays.
        FreezeTap freeze;

        if (settings.freezeTrackId != 0)
        {
            freeze.trackId = settings.freezeTrackId;
            freeze.plays = settings.freezeSources;
            freeze.plays.push_back (settings.freezeTrackId);
            freeze.buffer.setSize (2, blockSize);
            engine.freezeTap = &freeze;
        }

        const auto renderShare = direct ? 1.0 : 0.6;
        juce::AudioBuffer<float> buffer (2, blockSize);
        juce::int64 done = 0;
        bool stopped = false;

        while (done < totalSamples)
        {
            if (threadShouldExit())
            {
                engine.stemTaps = nullptr;
                engine.freezeTap = nullptr;
                result = juce::Result::fail ("Cancelled");
                removeAll();
                return;
            }

            // The range ends exactly: the song stops there, and what still sounds rings out.
            if (! stopped && done >= rangeSamples)
            {
                engine.transport.setPlaying (false);
                stopped = true;
            }

            auto count = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (blockSize, totalSamples - done));

            if (! stopped)
                count = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (count, rangeSamples - done));

            taps.buffers.clear();
            freeze.buffer.clear();
            engine.renderBlock (nullptr, 0, buffer.getArrayOfWritePointers(), 2, count);

            for (auto& target : targets)
            {
                if (target.stem == freezeTarget)
                {
                    target.writer->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer (freeze.buffer, 0, count);
                }
                else if (target.stem < 0)
                {
                    target.writer->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer (buffer, 0, count);
                }
                else
                {
                    const float* channels[] = { taps.buffers.getReadPointer (2 * target.stem),
                                                taps.buffers.getReadPointer (2 * target.stem + 1) };
                    target.writer->writeFromFloatArrays (channels, 2, count);
                }
            }

            done += count;
            progress.store (static_cast<double> (done) / static_cast<double> (totalSamples) * renderShare);
        }

        engine.stemTaps = nullptr;
        engine.freezeTap = nullptr;

        for (auto& target : targets)
            target.writer.reset();   // each WAV finished

        // Each file in its format and rate, from its render.
        if (! direct)
        {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < targets.size(); ++i)
            {
                auto& target = targets[i];
                const auto made = makeFinal (target.render, target.file, [this, i, renderShare] (double part)
                {
                    progress.store (renderShare + (1.0 - renderShare) * (static_cast<double> (i) + part) / static_cast<double> (targets.size()));
                });

                target.render.deleteFile();
                target.made = made.wasOk();

                if (made.failed())
                {
                    result = threadShouldExit() ? juce::Result::fail ("Cancelled") : made;
                    removeAll();
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        progress.store (1.0);
        result = juce::Result::ok();
    }

    static std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatWriter> makeWavWriter (const juce::File& file, double rate, int bits)
    {
        file.deleteFile();
        std::unique_ptr<juce::OutputStream> stream = file.createOutputStream();

        if (stream == nullptr)
            return nullptr;

        return juce::WavAudioFormat().createWriterFor (stream, juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions{}
                                                                 .withSampleRate (rate)
                                                                 .withNumChannels (2)
                                                                 .withBitsPerSample (bits)
                                                                 .withSampleFormat (bits == 32 ? juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions::SampleFormat::floatingPoint
                                                                                               : juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions::SampleFormat::integral));
    }

    /** A writer for WAV, FLAC or OGG (MP3 goes through LAME instead). */
    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatWriter> makeWriter (const juce::File& file, double rate) const
    {
        if (settings.format == Format::wav)
            return makeWavWriter (file, rate, settings.bits);

        file.deleteFile();
        std::unique_ptr<juce::OutputStream> stream = file.createOutputStream();

        if (stream == nullptr)
            return nullptr;

        const auto options = juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions{}.withSampleRate (rate).withNumChannels (2);

        if (settings.format == Format::flac)
            return juce::FlacAudioFormat().createWriterFor (stream, options.withBitsPerSample (settings.bits == 16 ? 16 : 24)
                                                                           .withQualityOptionIndex (5));

        // OGG Vorbis: the quality whose bit rate is nearest to the one asked for.
        juce::OggVorbisAudioFormat ogg;
        const auto qualities = ogg.getQualityOptions();
        int best = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < qualities.size(); ++i)
            if (std::abs (qualities[i].getIntValue() - settings.kbps) < std::abs (qualities[best].getIntValue() - settings.kbps))
                best = i;

        return ogg.createWriterFor (stream, options.withBitsPerSample (32).withQualityOptionIndex (best));
    }

    /** The file in its format and at its rate, made from the float WAV the song rendered to. */
    juce::Result makeFinal (const juce::File& rendered, const juce::File& file, const std::function<void (double)>& report)
    {
        juce::AudioFormatManager formats;
        formats.registerBasicFormats();
        std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatReader> reader (formats.createReaderFor (rendered));

        if (reader == nullptr)
            return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't read the render of " + file.getFileName());

        const auto rate = settings.outputRate > 0.0 ? settings.outputRate : reader->sampleRate;
        const bool resample = ! juce::approximatelyEqual (rate, reader->sampleRate);

        std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatWriter> writer;
        Mp3Encoder mp3;

        if (settings.format == Format::mp3)
        {
            if (const auto opened = mp3.open (file, rate, settings.kbps); opened.failed())
                return opened;
        }
        else if ((writer = makeWriter (file, rate)) == nullptr)
        {
            file.deleteFile();   // the format turned it down (a rate it can't write): nothing left behind
            return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + file.getFullPathName());
        }

        juce::AudioFormatReaderSource source (reader.get(), false);
        juce::ResamplingAudioSource resampler (&source, false, 2);

        if (resample)
        {
            resampler.setResamplingRatio (reader->sampleRate / rate);
            resampler.prepareToPlay (blockSize, rate);
        }

        const auto total = resample ? static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (static_cast<double> (reader->lengthInSamples) * rate / reader->sampleRate))
                                    : reader->lengthInSamples;
        juce::AudioBuffer<float> block (2, blockSize);

        for (juce::int64 done = 0; done < total; done += blockSize)
        {
            if (threadShouldExit())
            {
                writer.reset();
                file.deleteFile();
                return juce::Result::fail ("Cancelled");
            }

            const auto count = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (blockSize, total - done));

            if (resample)
            {
                juce::AudioSourceChannelInfo info (&block, 0, count);
                resampler.getNextAudioBlock (info);
            }
            else
            {
                reader->read (&block, 0, count, done, true, true);
            }

            const auto wrote = writer != nullptr ? writer->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer (block, 0, count)
                                                 : mp3.write (block.getReadPointer (0), block.getReadPointer (1), count);

            if (! wrote)
            {
                writer.reset();
                file.deleteFile();
                return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + file.getFullPathName());
            }

            report (static_cast<double> (done + count) / static_cast<double> (juce::jmax<juce::int64> (1, total)));
        }

        if (resample)
            resampler.releaseResources();

        if (writer != nullptr)
        {
            writer.reset();
            return juce::Result::ok();
        }

        return mp3.close();
    }

    /** A render that didn't finish leaves nothing behind: no renders, no files half made. */
    void removeAll()
    {
        for (auto& target : targets)
        {
            target.writer.reset();
            target.render.deleteFile();

            if (target.made || target.render == target.file)
                target.file.deleteFile();
        }
    }

    static constexpr int freezeTarget = -2;

    struct Target
    {
        juce::File file, render;
        int stem = -1;   // -1: Main's mix; freezeTarget: a track's freeze
        std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatWriter> writer;
        bool made = false;
    };

    AudioEngine& engine;
    MixdownSettings settings;
    const juce::int64 rangeSamples, totalSamples;
    const double sampleRate;
    const int blockSize;
    std::vector<Target> targets;
    std::atomic<double> progress { 0.0 };
    juce::Result result = juce::Result::fail ("Not finished");
};

void AudioEngine::StemTaps::take (const Track& track, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, buffers.getNumSamples());

    for (size_t i = 0; i < trackIds.size(); ++i)
        if (trackIds[i] == track.id)
            track.sendInto (buffers.getWritePointer (2 * static_cast<int> (i)), buffers.getWritePointer (2 * static_cast<int> (i) + 1),
                            numSamples, 1.0f, lastGain[i]);
}

void AudioEngine::FreezeTap::take (const Track& track, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, buffer.getNumSamples(), track.getBlockSamples());

    if (numSamples > 0)
    {
        buffer.copyFrom (0, 0, track.getBlock (0), numSamples);
        buffer.copyFrom (1, 0, track.getBlock (1), numSamples);
    }
}

void AudioEngine::StemTaps::takeBoard (const Track& track, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, buffers.getNumSamples(), track.board.getOutputSamples());

    for (size_t i = 0; i < trackIds.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (trackIds[i] != track.id || numSamples <= 0)
            continue;

        const auto channel = 2 * static_cast<int> (i);
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (buffers.getWritePointer (channel), track.board.getOutput (0), numSamples);
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (buffers.getWritePointer (channel + 1), track.board.getOutput (1), numSamples);
    }
}

juce::String AudioEngine::extensionOf (MixdownSettings::Format format)
{
    switch (format)
    {
        case MixdownSettings::Format::flac: return ".flac";
        case MixdownSettings::Format::ogg:  return ".ogg";
        case MixdownSettings::Format::mp3:  return ".mp3";
        case MixdownSettings::Format::wav:  break;
    }

    return ".wav";
}


#include <cstring>
#include <iterator>

namespace
{
    constexpr int midiBufferBytes = 4096;
    constexpr int minimumMixSize = 4096;

    /** Every plugin: each track's instrument and inserts, then the Main inserts. */
    template <typename Tracks, typename Function>
    void forEachPlugin (const Tracks& tracks, const EffectChain& mainInserts, Function&& function)
    {
        for (const auto& track : tracks)
        {
            if (track->instrument != nullptr)
                function (*track->instrument);

            for (int i = 0; i < track->inserts.size(); ++i)
                if (auto* insert = track->inserts.at (i); insert->plugin != nullptr)
                    function (*insert->plugin);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < mainInserts.size(); ++i)
            if (auto* insert = mainInserts.at (i); insert->plugin != nullptr)
                function (*insert->plugin);
    }

    // Track colours, assigned in turn as tracks are created.
    constexpr juce::uint32 trackPalette[] = { 0xffe5484d, 0xfff08c2e, 0xffe9c93b, 0xff4cbf67,
                                              0xff3cc0c8, 0xff3e82f7, 0xff9b6cf2, 0xffe85aa8 };

    void storeMax (std::atomic<float>& target, float value) noexcept
    {
        auto current = target.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

        while (value > current
               && ! target.compare_exchange_weak (current, value, std::memory_order_relaxed))
        {
        }
    }

    /** What lets go of a sound: a note-off, a pedal up (sustain, sostenuto, hold 2), all notes
        off, all sound off. */
    bool isRelease (const juce::uint8* data, int numBytes) noexcept
    {
        if (numBytes < 3)
            return false;

        const auto type = data[0] & 0xf0;

        if (type == 0x80 || (type == 0x90 && data[2] == 0))
            return true;

        if (type == 0xb0)
        {
            const auto controller = data[1];
            return controller == 120 || controller == 123
                || ((controller == 64 || controller == 66 || controller == 69) && data[2] < 64);
        }

        return false;
    }

    /** Leaves only the releases in a buffer (scratch: room for it, so nothing is allocated). */
    void keepReleasesOnly (juce::MidiBuffer& buffer, juce::MidiBuffer& scratch) noexcept
    {
        if (buffer.isEmpty())
            return;

        scratch.clear();
        scratch.addEvents (buffer, 0, -1, 0);
        buffer.clear();

        for (const auto metadata : scratch)
            if (isRelease (metadata.data, metadata.numBytes))
                buffer.addEvent (metadata.data, metadata.numBytes, metadata.samplePosition);
    }
}

//==============================================================================
namespace
{
    /** A port's events as a route lets them through: its channels, without the kinds it keeps
        out. Channel mode messages (all notes off and the like) always pass. Audio thread. */
    void addRouted (juce::MidiBuffer& to, const juce::MidiBuffer& from, const Track::MidiRoute& route, int numSamples) noexcept
    {
        if (route.channels == 0xffff && route.blocked == 0)
        {
            to.addEvents (from, 0, numSamples, 0);
            return;
        }

        for (const auto metadata : from)
        {
            if (metadata.numBytes <= 0 || metadata.samplePosition >= numSamples)
                continue;

            const auto status = metadata.data[0];

            if (status < 0xf0)
            {
                if ((route.channels & (1u << (status & 0x0f))) == 0)
                    continue;

                const auto kind = status & 0xf0;

                if (((kind == 0xa0 || kind == 0xd0) && (route.blocked & Track::blockAftertouch) != 0)
                    || (kind == 0xc0 && (route.blocked & Track::blockProgramChange) != 0)
                    || (kind == 0xe0 && (route.blocked & Track::blockPitchBend) != 0)
                    || (kind == 0xb0 && (route.blocked & Track::blockControllers) != 0 && metadata.numBytes > 1 && metadata.data[1] < 120))
                    continue;
            }

            to.addEvent (metadata.data, metadata.numBytes, metadata.samplePosition);
        }
    }

    /** Tells an instrument an MPE controller plays it: the lower zone with all fifteen member
        channels (the MPE configuration message), and the members' pitch bend range. Audio thread. */
    void addMpeSetup (juce::MidiBuffer& to, int pitchRange) noexcept
    {
        const auto controller = [&to] (int channel, int number, int value)
        {
            const juce::uint8 bytes[] { static_cast<juce::uint8> (0xb0 | (channel - 1)), static_cast<juce::uint8> (number), static_cast<juce::uint8> (value) };
            to.addEvent (bytes, 3, 0);
        };

        controller (1, 101, 0);  controller (1, 100, 6);  controller (1, 6, 15);
        controller (1, 101, 127); controller (1, 100, 127);

        for (int channel = 2; channel <= 16; ++channel)
        {
