// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AudioToMidi.cpp

#include "AudioToMidi.h"

#if __has_include (<onnxruntime_c_api.h>)
 #include <onnxruntime_c_api.h>
 #define SONIFY_ONNXRUNTIME 1
#else
 #define SONIFY_ONNXRUNTIME 0
#endif

#if __has_include ("SonifyModelData.h")
 #include "SonifyModelData.h"
 #define SONIFY_BASIC_PITCH 1
#else
 #define SONIFY_BASIC_PITCH 0
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

namespace
{
    /** The clip's window as one mono signal at its file's rate. */
    std::vector<float> readMono (const AudioToMidi::Job& job, double& rate, juce::String& error)
    {
        juce::AudioFormatManager formats;
        formats.registerBasicFormats();
        std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatReader> reader (formats.createReaderFor (job.file));

        if (reader == nullptr || reader->sampleRate <= 0.0)
        {
            error = "The clip's audio can't be read: " + job.file.getFileName();
            return {};
        }

        rate = reader->sampleRate;
        const auto from = juce::jlimit<juce::int64> (0, reader->lengthInSamples, static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (job.offset * rate)));
        const auto seconds = juce::jmin (job.length, AudioToMidi::longest);
        const auto count = static_cast<int> (juce::jlimit<juce::int64> (0, reader->lengthInSamples - from, static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (seconds * rate))));

        if (count <= 0)
        {
            error = "There's no audio in the clip.";
            return {};
        }

        const auto channels = static_cast<int> (juce::jlimit (1u, 2u, reader->numChannels));
        juce::AudioBuffer<float> buffer (channels, count);
        reader->read (&buffer, 0, count, from, true, channels > 1);

        std::vector<float> mono (static_cast<size_t> (count));

        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            float sum = 0.0f;
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; ++c)
                sum += buffer.getSample (c, i);
            mono[static_cast<size_t> (i)] = sum / static_cast<float> (channels);
        }

        return mono;
    }

    /** A Blackman-windowed sinc resampler, its cutoff a little under the lower Nyquist, its kernel
        tabled finely (looked up between entries). Says how far it got now and then; stopped, it
        gives back nothing. */
    std::vector<float> resample (const std::vector<float>& x, double from, double to, const AudioToMidi::Report& report)
    {
        if (std::abs (from - to) < 1.0e-9)
            return x;

        const auto ratio = from / to;                                // input samples per output sample
        const auto cutoff = 0.95 * std::min (1.0, 1.0 / ratio);     // of the input's Nyquist
        constexpr int zeros = 12;
        constexpr int perUnit = 512;                                 // table entries a sample
        const auto reach = zeros / cutoff;
        const auto length = static_cast<int> (x.size());
        const auto outLength = static_cast<int> (std::floor (length / ratio));
        std::vector<float> out (static_cast<size_t> (std::max (0, outLength)));

        std::vector<float> table (static_cast<size_t> (std::ceil (reach * perUnit)) + 2, 0.0f);

        for (size_t i = 0; i < table.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto t = static_cast<double> (i) / perUnit;
            if (t >= reach) break;
            const auto s = t < 1.0e-9 ? 1.0 : std::sin (juce::MathConstants<double>::pi * cutoff * t) / (juce::MathConstants<double>::pi * cutoff * t);
            const auto w = 0.42 + 0.5 * std::cos (juce::MathConstants<double>::pi * t / reach) + 0.08 * std::cos (2.0 * juce::MathConstants<double>::pi * t / reach);
            table[i] = static_cast<float> (cutoff * s * w);
        }

        const auto kernel = [&table] (double t)
        {
            const auto at = std::abs (t) * perUnit;
            const auto i = static_cast<size_t> (at);
            if (i + 1 >= table.size()) return 0.0f;
            const auto frac = static_cast<float> (at - static_cast<double> (i));
            return table[i] + (table[i + 1] - table[i]) * frac;
        };

        for (int j = 0; j < outLength; ++j)
        {
            if (report != nullptr && (j & 16383) == 0 && ! report (0.05 + 0.05 * j / outLength))
                return {};

            const auto centre = j * ratio;
            const auto first = std::max (0, static_cast<int> (std::ceil (centre - reach)));
            const auto last = std::min (length - 1, static_cast<int> (std::floor (centre + reach)));
            float sum = 0.0f;

            for (int i = first; i <= last; ++i)
                sum += x[static_cast<size_t> (i)] * kernel (centre - i);

            out[static_cast<size_t> (j)] = sum;
        }

        return out;
    }

   #if SONIFY_ONNXRUNTIME
    /** ONNX Runtime, loaded once, when it's first needed (as Split into Stems loads it). */
    struct Runtime
    {
        Runtime()
        {
            const auto folder = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile).getParentDirectory();

           #if JUCE_WINDOWS
            const auto file = folder.getChildFile ("onnxruntime.dll");
           #elif JUCE_MAC
            const auto file = folder.getChildFile ("libonnxruntime.dylib");
           #else
            const auto file = folder.getChildFile ("libonnxruntime.so");
           #endif

            auto path = juce::SystemStats::getEnvironmentVariable ("SONIFY_ONNXRUNTIME", {});

            if (path.isEmpty())
            {
                if (! file.existsAsFile())
                {
                    problem = "ONNX Runtime (" + file.getFileName() + ") isn't next to Sonify: building Sonify puts it there.";
                    return;
                }

                path = file.getFullPathName();
            }

            if (! library.open (path))
            {
                problem = "ONNX Runtime (" + juce::File (path).getFileName() + ") couldn't be loaded.";
                return;
            }

            using GetApiBase = const OrtApiBase* (ORT_API_CALL*)();
            const auto getBase = reinterpret_cast<GetApiBase> (library.getFunction ("OrtGetApiBase"));
            const auto* base = getBase != nullptr ? getBase() : nullptr;
            api = base != nullptr ? base->GetApi (ORT_API_VERSION) : nullptr;

            if (api == nullptr)
                problem = "This ONNX Runtime is older than Sonify needs.";
        }

        juce::DynamicLibrary library;
        const OrtApi* api = nullptr;
        juce::String problem;
    };

    Runtime& runtime()
    {
        static Runtime instance;
        return instance;
    }

    juce::String errorOf (const OrtApi* api, OrtStatus* status)
    {
        if (status == nullptr)
            return {};

        juce::String message (api->GetErrorMessage (status));
        api->ReleaseStatus (status);
        return message.isNotEmpty() ? message : juce::String ("ONNX Runtime failed.");
    }

    /** Basic Pitch's model in a session: a 2-second window in, its notes' and onsets' activations out. */
    class Model
    {
    public:
        explicit Model (const OrtApi* a) : api (a) {}

        ~Model()
        {
            if (session != nullptr)  api->ReleaseSession (session);
            if (options != nullptr)  api->ReleaseSessionOptions (options);
            if (memory != nullptr)   api->ReleaseMemoryInfo (memory);
            if (env != nullptr)      api->ReleaseEnv (env);
        }

        juce::String open (const void* model, size_t bytes)
        {
            if (auto e = errorOf (api, api->CreateEnv (ORT_LOGGING_LEVEL_WARNING, "Sonify", &env)); e.isNotEmpty())                return e;
            if (auto e = errorOf (api, api->CreateSessionOptions (&options)); e.isNotEmpty())                                        return e;
            if (auto e = errorOf (api, api->SetIntraOpNumThreads (options, 2)); e.isNotEmpty())                                      return e;
            errorOf (api, api->AddSessionConfigEntry (options, "session.intra_op.allow_spinning", "0"));

            if (auto e = errorOf (api, api->CreateSessionFromArray (env, model, bytes, options, &session)); e.isNotEmpty())
                return "The note model couldn't be opened: " + e;

            return errorOf (api, api->CreateCpuMemoryInfo (OrtArenaAllocator, OrtMemTypeDefault, &memory));
        }

        /** One window (windowSamples): its frames' note and onset activations (framesPerWindow x 88 each). */
        juce::String run (std::vector<float>& window, std::vector<float>& notes, std::vector<float>& onsets, OrtRunOptions* runOptions)
        {
            const std::array<int64_t, 3> shape { 1, AudioToMidi::windowSamples, 1 };
            OrtValue* in = nullptr;
            OrtValue* out[2] = { nullptr, nullptr };

            auto e = errorOf (api, api->CreateTensorWithDataAsOrtValue (memory, window.data(), window.size() * sizeof (float), shape.data(), shape.size(),
                                                                       ONNX_TENSOR_ELEMENT_DATA_TYPE_FLOAT, &in));
            const char* inputNames[1] = { "serving_default_input_2:0" };
            const char* outputNames[2] = { "StatefulPartitionedCall:1", "StatefulPartitionedCall:2" };   // notes, onsets

            if (e.isEmpty())
                e = errorOf (api, api->Run (session, runOptions, inputNames, &in, 1, outputNames, 2, out));

            for (int i = 0; e.isEmpty() && i < 2; ++i)
            {
                OrtTensorTypeAndShapeInfo* info = nullptr;
                size_t count = 0;
                e = errorOf (api, api->GetTensorTypeAndShape (out[i], &info));

                if (e.isEmpty())
                {
                    errorOf (api, api->GetTensorShapeElementCount (info, &count));
                    api->ReleaseTensorTypeAndShapeInfo (info);
                }

                float* data = nullptr;

                if (e.isEmpty())
                    e = errorOf (api, api->GetTensorMutableData (out[i], reinterpret_cast<void**> (&data)));

                if (e.isEmpty())
                {
                    if (count != static_cast<size_t> (AudioToMidi::framesPerWindow * AudioToMidi::keys))
                        e = "That isn't the note model Sonify knows.";
                    else
                        (i == 0 ? notes : onsets).assign (data, data + count);
                }
            }

            if (in != nullptr) api->ReleaseValue (in);
            for (auto* v : out) if (v != nullptr) api->ReleaseValue (v);
            return e;
        }

    private:
        const OrtApi* api;
        OrtEnv* env = nullptr;
        OrtSessionOptions* options = nullptr;
        OrtSession* session = nullptr;
        OrtMemoryInfo* memory = nullptr;
    };
   #endif
}

//==============================================================================
AudioToMidi::AudioToMidi (Job j)
    : juce::Thread ("Sonify audio to MIDI"), job (std::move (j))
{
}

AudioToMidi::~AudioToMidi()
{
    cancel();
    stopThread (15000);
}

void AudioToMidi::cancel()
{
    // The model hears two seconds at a time, quickly: it stops after the one under way.
    signalThreadShouldExit();
}

void AudioToMidi::run()
{
    try
    {
        result = transcribe (job, [this] (double p)
        {
            progress.store (p);
            return ! threadShouldExit();
        });
    }
    catch (const std::bad_alloc&)
    {
        result = {};
        result.error = "There isn't enough memory to hear the clip.";
    }

    if (threadShouldExit() && ! result.ok)
        result.error = "Cancelled";

    done.store (true);
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String AudioToMidi::notesProblem()
{
   #if ! SONIFY_BASIC_PITCH
    return "This build of Sonify has no note model: build it again with its CMakeLists.txt.";
   #elif ! SONIFY_ONNXRUNTIME
    return "This build of Sonify has no ONNX Runtime: build it again with its CMakeLists.txt.";
   #else
    return runtime().problem;
   #endif
}

double AudioToMidi::frameTime (int frame)
{
    // As basic-pitch's model_frames_to_time: each window's frames are 2 s of 86 a second, less
    // the bit the window is short of that, and a measured alignment.
    const auto windowOffset = (fftHop / modelRate) * (framesPerWindow - windowSamples / static_cast<double> (fftHop)) + 0.0018;
    return frame * fftHop / modelRate - windowOffset * std::floor (frame / static_cast<double> (framesPerWindow));
}

//==============================================================================
std::vector<AudioToMidi::FrameNote> AudioToMidi::notesFromActivations (std::vector<float> frames, std::vector<float> onsets, int numFrames,
                                                                     float onsetThreshold, float frameThreshold, int minNoteFrames,
                                                                     bool inferOnsets, bool melodiaTrick, int energyTolerance)
{
    // output_to_notes_polyphonic, step by step.
    std::vector<FrameNote> notes;
    const auto at = [] (int t, int k) { return static_cast<size_t> (t * keys + k); };

    if (numFrames <= 0)
        return notes;

    if (inferOnsets)
    {
        // Onsets also where a key's frame activation jumps up (over one and two frames).
        constexpr int diffs = 2;
        std::vector<float> diff (frames.size(), 0.0f);
        float maxDiff = 0.0f, maxOnset = 0.0f;

        for (int t = 0; t < numFrames; ++t)
        {
            for (int k = 0; k < keys; ++k)
            {
                float smallest = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();

                for (int n = 1; n <= diffs; ++n)
                    smallest = std::min (smallest, frames[at (t, k)] - (t - n >= 0 ? frames[at (t - n, k)] : 0.0f));

                const auto d = t < diffs ? 0.0f : std::max (0.0f, smallest);
                diff[at (t, k)] = d;
                maxDiff = std::max (maxDiff, d);
                maxOnset = std::max (maxOnset, onsets[at (t, k)]);
            }
        }

        if (maxDiff > 0.0f)
            for (size_t i = 0; i < onsets.size(); ++i)
                onsets[i] = std::max (onsets[i], maxOnset * diff[i] / maxDiff);
    }

    // Peaks in time of each key's onsets, at least the threshold, latest first.
    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> starts;

    for (int t = 1; t + 1 < numFrames; ++t)
        for (int k = 0; k < keys; ++k)
        {
            const auto v = onsets[at (t, k)];
            if (v >= onsetThreshold && v > onsets[at (t - 1, k)] && v > onsets[at (t + 1, k)])
                starts.push_back ({ t, k });
        }

    std::sort (starts.begin(), starts.end(), [] (const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.first != b.first ? a.first > b.first : a.second > b.second; });

    auto remaining = frames;

    const auto clearAround = [&remaining, &at] (int t, int k)
    {
        remaining[at (t, k)] = 0.0f;
        if (k < keys - 1) remaining[at (t, k + 1)] = 0.0f;
        if (k > 0)        remaining[at (t, k - 1)] = 0.0f;
    };

    const auto mean = [&frames, &at] (int from, int to, int k)
    {
        double sum = 0.0;
        for (int t = from; t < to; ++t) sum += frames[at (t, k)];
        return static_cast<float> (to > from ? sum / (to - from) : 0.0);
    };

    for (const auto& [startFrame, key] : starts)
    {
        if (startFrame >= numFrames - 1)
            continue;

        // On until the key's activation has been under the frame threshold energyTolerance frames.
        int i = startFrame + 1, k = 0;

        while (i < numFrames - 1 && k < energyTolerance)
        {
            k = remaining[at (i, key)] < frameThreshold ? k + 1 : 0;
            ++i;
        }

        i -= k;

        if (i - startFrame <= minNoteFrames)
            continue;

        for (int t = startFrame; t < i; ++t)
            clearAround (t, key);

        notes.push_back ({ startFrame, i, key, mean (startFrame, i, key) });
    }

    if (melodiaTrick)
    {
        // Notes without onsets: from the strongest activation left, out both ways. The strongest
        // left is the strongest of the cells not yet cleared (values only ever go to zero).
        std::vector<std::pair<float, size_t>> cells;

        for (size_t c = 0; c < remaining.size(); ++c)
            if (remaining[c] > frameThreshold)
                cells.push_back ({ remaining[c], c });

        std::sort (cells.begin(), cells.end(), [] (const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.first > b.first; });

        for (const auto& [value, cell] : cells)
        {
            if (! (remaining[cell] > frameThreshold))
                continue;

            const auto middle = static_cast<int> (cell / keys), key = static_cast<int> (cell % keys);
            remaining[cell] = 0.0f;

            int i = middle + 1, k = 0;

            while (i < numFrames - 1 && k < energyTolerance)
            {
                k = remaining[at (i, key)] < frameThreshold ? k + 1 : 0;
                clearAround (i, key);
                ++i;
            }

            const auto end = i - 1 - k;
            i = middle - 1;
            k = 0;

            while (i > 0 && k < energyTolerance)
            {
                k = remaining[at (i, key)] < frameThreshold ? k + 1 : 0;
                clearAround (i, key);
                --i;
            }

            const auto start = i + 1 + k;

            if (end - start <= minNoteFrames)
                continue;

            notes.push_back ({ start, end, key, mean (start, end, key) });
        }
    }

    return notes;
}

//==============================================================================
std::vector<AudioToMidi::Note> AudioToMidi::drumHits (const std::vector<float>& mono, double rate)
{
    std::vector<Note> hits;

    if (mono.empty() || rate <= 0.0)
        return hits;

    // Three bands: the low end (kick), the body (snare), the top (hi-hat).
    juce::IIRFilter low, midLow, midHigh, high;
    low.setCoefficients (juce::IIRCoefficients::makeLowPass (rate, 150.0));
    midLow.setCoefficients (juce::IIRCoefficients::makeHighPass (rate, 180.0));
    midHigh.setCoefficients (juce::IIRCoefficients::makeLowPass (rate, 2500.0));
    high.setCoefficients (juce::IIRCoefficients::makeHighPass (rate, 6000.0));

    const auto hop = std::max (1, static_cast<int> (rate * 0.005));          // 5 ms frames
    const auto count = static_cast<int> (mono.size()) / hop;
    std::vector<std::array<float, 4>> energy (static_cast<size_t> (count));  // all, low, mid, high

    for (int f = 0; f < count; ++f)
    {
        std::array<float, 4> e {};

        for (int i = f * hop; i < (f + 1) * hop; ++i)
        {
            const auto x = mono[static_cast<size_t> (i)];
            const auto l = low.processSingleSampleRaw (x);
            const auto m = midHigh.processSingleSampleRaw (midLow.processSingleSampleRaw (x));
            const auto h = high.processSingleSampleRaw (x);
            e[0] += x * x; e[1] += l * l; e[2] += m * m; e[3] += h * h;
        }

        energy[static_cast<size_t> (f)] = e;
    }

    // Hits: where the level jumps (9 dB over the quietest of the last 20 ms), at its steepest,
    // 80 ms apart at least, and not lost in the quiet (45 dB under the loudest).
    std::vector<float> level (static_cast<size_t> (count));
    float loudest = -120.0f;

    for (int f = 0; f < count; ++f)
    {
        level[static_cast<size_t> (f)] = 10.0f * std::log10 (energy[static_cast<size_t> (f)][0] / static_cast<float> (hop) + 1.0e-12f);
        loudest = std::max (loudest, level[static_cast<size_t> (f)]);
    }

    const auto rise = [&level] (int f)
    {
        auto quietest = 0.0f;
        bool any = false;

        for (int g = f - 4; g < f; ++g)
        {
            const auto v = g < 0 ? -120.0f : level[static_cast<size_t> (g)];
            quietest = any ? std::min (quietest, v) : v;
            any = true;
        }

        return level[static_cast<size_t> (f)] - quietest;
    };

    int lastHit = -1000;

    for (int f = 0; f < count; ++f)
    {
        const auto r = rise (f);

        if (r < 9.0f || level[static_cast<size_t> (f)] < loudest - 45.0f || f - lastHit < 16)
            continue;

        if ((f > 0 && r < rise (f - 1)) || (f + 1 < count && r <= rise (f + 1)))
            continue;

        lastHit = f;

        // Where it starts, to the sample: the first that reaches a tenth of the hit's peak.
        const auto from = std::max (0, (f - 1) * hop), to = std::min (static_cast<int> (mono.size()), (f + 4) * hop);
        float peak = 0.0f;
        for (int i = from; i < to; ++i) peak = std::max (peak, std::abs (mono[static_cast<size_t> (i)]));
        int first = from;
        while (first < to && std::abs (mono[static_cast<size_t> (first)]) < 0.1f * peak) ++first;

        // What its first 40 ms hold, band by band: the low end a kick, only the top a hi-hat,
        // a body with it a snare.
        std::array<float, 4> sum {};
        for (int g = f; g < std::min (count, f + 8); ++g)
            for (size_t b = 0; b < 4; ++b)
                sum[b] += energy[static_cast<size_t> (g)][b];

        const auto total = sum[1] + sum[2] + sum[3] + 1.0e-12f;
        const auto pitch = sum[1] / total > 0.5f ? 36 : (sum[2] < 0.12f * sum[3] && sum[1] < 0.05f * total) ? 42 : 38;
        const auto db = 10.0f * std::log10 (sum[0] / (8.0f * static_cast<float> (hop)) + 1.0e-12f) - loudest;
        const auto velocity = juce::jlimit (1, 127, static_cast<int> (std::lround (120.0f + db * 2.0f)));
        hits.push_back ({ first / rate, 0.1, pitch, velocity });
    }

    return hits;
}

//==============================================================================
AudioToMidi::Result AudioToMidi::transcribe (const Job& job, const Report& report)
{
    Result result;
    const auto fail = [&result] (const juce::String& error) { result.error = error; return result; };

    if (job.mode == Mode::notes)
        if (const auto problem = notesProblem(); problem.isNotEmpty())
            return fail (problem);

    double rate = 0.0;
    juce::String error;
    auto mono = readMono (job, rate, error);

    if (mono.empty())
        return fail (error);

    if (report != nullptr && ! report (0.05))
        return fail ("Cancelled");

    if (job.mode == Mode::drums)
    {
        result.notes = drumHits (mono, rate);
        result.ok = true;
        return result;
    }

   #if SONIFY_BASIC_PITCH && SONIFY_ONNXRUNTIME
    // At the model's rate, with half the windows' overlap of silence before it.
    auto audio = resample (mono, rate, modelRate, report);
    mono.clear();

    if (audio.empty())
        return fail ("Cancelled");
    const auto originalLength = static_cast<int> (audio.size());
    constexpr int overlapSamples = overlapFrames * fftHop;
    constexpr int hopSamples = windowSamples - overlapSamples;
    audio.insert (audio.begin(), static_cast<size_t> (overlapSamples / 2), 0.0f);

    if (report != nullptr && ! report (0.1))
        return fail ("Cancelled");

    Model model (runtime().api);

    if (const auto e = model.open (SonifyModelData::nmp_onnx, static_cast<size_t> (SonifyModelData::nmp_onnxSize)); e.isNotEmpty())
        return fail (e);

    // Each window's frames, less half the overlap at each end, one after another.
    constexpr int keep = framesPerWindow - overlapFrames;
    const auto windows = static_cast<int> ((audio.size() + hopSamples - 1) / hopSamples);
    std::vector<float> frames, onsets, window (static_cast<size_t> (windowSamples)), noteOut, onsetOut;
    frames.reserve (static_cast<size_t> (windows * keep * keys));
    onsets.reserve (frames.capacity());

    for (int w = 0; w < windows; ++w)
    {
        const auto start = static_cast<size_t> (w) * hopSamples;
        std::fill (window.begin(), window.end(), 0.0f);

        for (size_t i = 0; i < window.size() && start + i < audio.size(); ++i)
            window[i] = audio[start + i];

        if (const auto e = model.run (window, noteOut, onsetOut, nullptr); e.isNotEmpty())
            return fail (e);

        const auto from = static_cast<size_t> ((overlapFrames / 2) * keys), to = static_cast<size_t> ((overlapFrames / 2 + keep) * keys);
        frames.insert (frames.end(), noteOut.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t> (from), noteOut.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t> (to));
        onsets.insert (onsets.end(), onsetOut.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t> (from), onsetOut.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t> (to));

        if (report != nullptr && ! report (0.1 + 0.8 * (w + 1) / windows))
            return fail ("Cancelled");
    }

    // Trimmed to the frames the audio itself covers.
    const auto numFrames = std::min (static_cast<int> (frames.size() / keys),
                                     static_cast<int> (static_cast<double> (originalLength) / hopSamples * keep));
    frames.resize (static_cast<size_t> (numFrames * keys));
    onsets.resize (frames.size());

    const auto minNoteFrames = static_cast<int> (std::lround (127.70 / 1000.0 * (modelRate / fftHop)));

    for (const auto& n : notesFromActivations (std::move (frames), std::move (onsets), numFrames, 0.5f, 0.3f, minNoteFrames))
    {
        const auto start = frameTime (n.start), end = frameTime (n.end);

        if (end <= start)
            continue;

        result.notes.push_back ({ std::max (0.0, start), end - start, lowestKey + n.key,
                                  juce::jlimit (1, 127, static_cast<int> (std::lround (n.amplitude * 127.0f))) });
    }

    std::sort (result.notes.begin(), result.notes.end(), [] (const Note& a, const Note& b) { return a.start != b.start ? a.start < b.start : a.pitch < b.pitch; });
    result.ok = true;
    return result;
   #else
    return fail (notesProblem());
   #endif
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AudioToMidi.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_formats/juce_audio_formats.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Audio > Audio to MIDI: the notes an audio clip plays, for a MIDI clip on a new track.

        Notes   any instrument or voice, chords too: Spotify's Basic Pitch model (Apache 2.0,
                built into Sonify) hears which of the 88 piano keys sound in each frame and where
                notes start; its own note-making step (ported from basic-pitch's note_creation.py)
                turns that into notes. Runs through ONNX Runtime, as Split into Stems does.
        Drums   each hit, as a kick (36), snare (38) or closed hi-hat (42) by where its energy
                lies, its strength the velocity. Needs no model.

    Works on a window of a file (what the clip plays), on a thread of its own; transcribe() does
    the work where it's called (tests). Times are seconds from the window's start.
*/
class AudioToMidi final : private juce::Thread
{
public:
    enum class Mode { notes, drums };

    struct Job
    {
        juce::File file;
        double offset = 0.0, length = 0.0;     // seconds of it
        Mode mode = Mode::notes;
    };

    struct Note
    {
        double start = 0.0, length = 0.0;      // seconds
        int pitch = 60;
        int velocity = 100;
    };

    struct Result
    {
        bool ok = false;
        juce::String error;                    // "Cancelled" when cancelled
        std::vector<Note> notes;               // by start
    };

    explicit AudioToMidi (Job job);
    ~AudioToMidi() override;

    void start()                                        { startThread (juce::Thread::Priority::low); }
    void cancel();
    bool isDone() const noexcept                        { return done.load(); }
    double getProgress() const noexcept                 { return progress.load(); }
    const Job& getJob() const noexcept                  { return job; }

    /** Once isDone(). */
    const Result& getResult() const noexcept            { return result; }

    //==============================================================================
    using Report = std::function<bool (double progress)>;

    static Result transcribe (const Job& job, const Report& report);

    /** Why Notes can't run in this build or on this computer ("" when it can). */
    static juce::String notesProblem();

    static constexpr double longest = 15.0 * 60.0;      // seconds heard at most

    //==============================================================================
    // Basic Pitch's own numbers (basic_pitch/constants.py, inference.py, note_creation.py).
    static constexpr double modelRate = 22050.0;
    static constexpr int fftHop = 256;
    static constexpr int framesPerWindow = 172;         // ANNOT_N_FRAMES: 2 s at 86 frames a second
    static constexpr int windowSamples = 22050 * 2 - fftHop;   // AUDIO_N_SAMPLES
    static constexpr int overlapFrames = 30;
    static constexpr int keys = 88;
    static constexpr int lowestKey = 21;                // MIDI_OFFSET: A0

    /** Basic Pitch's note-making from its frame and onset activations (frames x 88, by frame):
        notes as (first frame, end frame, key index, amplitude). */
    struct FrameNote
    {
        int start = 0, end = 0, key = 0;
        float amplitude = 0.0f;
    };

    static std::vector<FrameNote> notesFromActivations (std::vector<float> frames, std::vector<float> onsets, int numFrames,
                                                        float onsetThreshold = 0.5f, float frameThreshold = 0.3f,
                                                        int minNoteFrames = 11, bool inferOnsets = true, bool melodiaTrick = true,
                                                        int energyTolerance = 11);

    /** Where a frame of the unwrapped activations is, in seconds (model_frames_to_time). */
    static double frameTime (int frame);

    /** Hits in a mono signal: (seconds, pitch, velocity). */
    static std::vector<Note> drumHits (const std::vector<float>& mono, double rate);

private:
    void run() override;

    Job job;
    Result result;
    std::atomic<bool> done { false };
    std::atomic<double> progress { 0.0 };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (AudioToMidi)
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Automation.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Automation, as in Studio One: an envelope of points (song position in quarter
    notes, value) for something on a track, joined by straight lines. Before the first
    point the envelope holds the first value; after the last, the last.

    Values are in the target's own units: dB for volume, -1..+1 for pan, and the
    parameter's own range for a plugin parameter.
*/
struct AutomationPoint
{
    double ppq = 0.0;
    double value = 0.0;
};

struct AutomationTarget
{
    enum class Kind { volume, pan, parameter };

    Kind kind = Kind::volume;
    int slot = 0;             // parameter: 0 the instrument, otherwise an insert's id
    uint32_t paramId = 0;     // parameter: its stable id

    bool operator== (const AutomationTarget& other) const noexcept
    {
        return kind == other.kind && (kind != Kind::parameter || (slot == other.slot && paramId == other.paramId));
    }
};

struct AutomationLane
{
    AutomationTarget target;
    std::vector<AutomationPoint> points;   // by position
};

enum class AutomationMode { off, read };

namespace Automation
{
    /** The envelope's value at a song position. */
    inline double valueAt (const std::vector<AutomationPoint>& points, double ppq) noexcept
    {
        if (points.empty())
            return 0.0;

        if (ppq <= points.front().ppq)
            return points.front().value;

        if (ppq >= points.back().ppq)
            return points.back().value;

        const auto after = std::upper_bound (points.begin(), points.end(), ppq,
                                             [] (double position, const AutomationPoint& point) { return position < point.ppq; });
        const auto& b = *after;
        const auto& a = *(after - 1);
        const auto span = b.ppq - a.ppq;
        return span > 0.0 ? a.value + (b.value - a.value) * (ppq - a.ppq) / span : b.value;
    }

    /** Points sorted by position, with nonsense (non-finite) values dropped. */
    inline std::vector<AutomationPoint> tidy (std::vector<AutomationPoint> points)
    {
        points.erase (std::remove_if (points.begin(), points.end(), [] (const AutomationPoint& p)
                                      { return ! std::isfinite (p.ppq) || ! std::isfinite (p.value) || p.ppq < 0.0; }),
                      points.end());
        std::stable_sort (points.begin(), points.end(), [] (const AutomationPoint& a, const AutomationPoint& b) { return a.ppq < b.ppq; });
        return points;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
/**
    A track's automation for the audio thread: built on the message thread when the
    envelopes change, handed over whole, then only used by the audio thread (which
    keeps its own notes in it: the last value it sent, and where a parameter is).
*/
struct AutomationPlayback
{
    struct Entry
    {
        AutomationTarget target;
        std::vector<AutomationPoint> points;
        int parameterIndex = -1;    // audio thread: where the parameter was last found
        double lastValue = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
    };

    std::vector<Entry> entries;
};

# Base44 prompt: the Hub's AI (server side)

Paste everything below the line into Base44's AI chat, in the **Fanan Hub Cloud app** (the same app as the accounts). Then add your Anthropic API key as described after it.

---

Add an AI backend to this app. The Fanan Web Hub desktop app sends AI requests to a backend function; the function calls Anthropic's Claude API with a secret key that never leaves the server, and counts each user's monthly allowance.

**1. User field:** add `ai_plan` to users: text, `free` or `pro`, default `free`. Only admins can change it (users can't edit their own plan).

**2. Entity `AiUsage`** (one record per user per month):
- `user_email`: text
- `month`: text (`YYYY-MM`)
- `requests`: number
- `last_request_id`: text
- `calls_this_request`: number
- `input_tokens`: number
- `output_tokens`: number

Security: no access for regular users at all (the backend function uses the service role). Admins can read everything.

**3. Secret:** a secret named `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, used only by the function below.

**4. Backend function `aiChat`**, exactly this code:

```ts
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk';

// The Fanan Web Hub's AI: forwards the Hub's request to Claude as the signed-in user,
// within their plan's monthly allowance. The API key never leaves this server.
const MODEL = 'claude-sonnet-5';
const ALLOWANCE: Record<string, number> = { free: 30, pro: 1000 };
const MAX_CALLS_PER_REQUEST = 40;
const MAX_TOKENS = 8192;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Sign in to use the AI.' }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await req.json();
    const requestId = String(body.request_id || '');
    if (!requestId || !Array.isArray(body.messages))
      return Response.json({ error: 'That request was malformed.' }, { status: 400 });

    const plan = user.ai_plan === 'pro' ? 'pro' : 'free';
    const allowance = ALLOWANCE[plan];
    const month = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);
    const found = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AiUsage.filter({ user_email: user.email, month });
    const usage = found[0];
    const isNewRequest = !usage || usage.last_request_id !== requestId;
    const used = usage ? (usage.requests || 0) : 0;

    if (isNewRequest && used >= allowance)
      return Response.json({
        error: `You've used this month's ${allowance} AI requests.` + (plan === 'free' ? ' Upgrade for more.' : ''),
        fanan: { used, allowance, plan },
      }, { status: 429 });

    if (!isNewRequest && (usage.calls_this_request || 0) >= MAX_CALLS_PER_REQUEST)
      return Response.json({ error: 'This request took too many steps.', fanan: { used, allowance, plan } }, { status: 429 });

    const answer = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'x-api-key': Deno.env.get('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') ?? '',
        'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
        'content-type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: MODEL,
        max_tokens: Math.min(Number(body.max_tokens) || 4096, MAX_TOKENS),
        system: body.system,
        tools: body.tools,
        messages: body.messages,
      }),
    });
    const data = await answer.json();

    if (!answer.ok)
      return Response.json({ error: data?.error?.message || 'The AI service failed.', fanan: { used, allowance, plan } }, { status: 502 });

    // A new request counts once; every call adds its tokens.
    const fields = {
      user_email: user.email,
      month,
      requests: used + (isNewRequest ? 1 : 0),
      last_request_id: requestId,
      calls_this_request: isNewRequest ? 1 : (usage.calls_this_request || 0) + 1,
      input_tokens: (usage?.input_tokens || 0) + (data.usage?.input_tokens || 0)
        + (data.usage?.cache_read_input_tokens || 0) + (data.usage?.cache_creation_input_tokens || 0),
      output_tokens: (usage?.output_tokens || 0) + (data.usage?.output_tokens || 0),
    };

    if (usage) await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AiUsage.update(usage.id, fields);
    else await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AiUsage.create(fields);

    return Response.json({ ...data, fanan: { used: fields.requests, allowance, plan } });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: String((error as Error)?.message || error) }, { status: 500 });
  }
});
```

**5. Admin page "AI usage"** (admins only): this month's AiUsage records, newest first, with each user's plan, requests, and tokens; and a way to set a user's `ai_plan` by hand.

---

**Afterwards:**
- **Your Anthropic key:** create one at the Claude Console (platform.claude.com) under your Fanan organization, add a payment method there, then paste the key into the app's secret `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Anthropic bills Fanan for all usage.
- **Backend functions need Base44's Builder plan or higher.**
- **To test before payments exist:** set your own account's `ai_plan` to `pro` on the admin page.

**Security for FananContent**
- Read: everyone, including anonymous visitors (no sign-in needed).
- Create, update, delete: admins only.

**Admin page: "Publish content"** (admins only)
- A list of all FananContent records, newest first, with their published state.
- A form to add or edit an item: upload the file (public upload, `UploadFile`), which fills `file_url` and `size_bytes` automatically; optionally upload a preview; fill title, kind, description, tags, bpm, key, version and (for MIDI tools) tool_id; a Published switch.
- Replacing an item's file must also raise its version.

---

**Packaging a song:** zip the song's folder, the `.fsong` file together with its `Media` folder, and upload the zip as the item's file with kind `song`.

**Plugins:** only WCLAP files (`.wclap.tar.gz` or `.wasm`). The Hub installs nothing else.

**MIDI tools:** a Magenta model for Sonify's MIDI tab, kind `miditool`, its `tool_id` set. The file is either:
- a definition, `tool.json`: `{"id": "magenta.melody-rnn", "title": "Continue Melody", "description": "...", "model": "MusicRNN" | "MusicVAE" | "Coconet", "checkpoint": "https://.../basic_rnn", "actions": ["continue"], "live": "continue", "drums": false, "generator": false, "version": "2"}`. Sonify downloads the model from `checkpoint` (a folder holding `config.json`, `weights_manifest.json` and the weight files the manifest lists; Coconet has no `config.json`). Actions are `continue`, `generate`, `vary`, `morph`, `groove`, `drumify`, `improvise` and `harmonize`; `live` is what the tool does on a track's MIDI FX.
- or a package, a `.zip` holding that `tool.json` and a `model` folder with the model's files (no download from elsewhere).

A `tool_id` that is one of Sonify's built-in Magenta tools (`magenta.melody-rnn`, `magenta.drums-rnn`, `magenta.improvise`, `magenta.melody-vae`, `magenta.drums-vae`, `magenta.groove`, `magenta.drumify`, `magenta.harmonize`) with a higher `version` than `1` shows as an Update for that tool; any other id adds a new tool.

# Base44 prompt: Stella AI Cloud, Sonify AI

Open the **Stella AI Cloud** app on Base44 and paste everything below the line into its AI chat. It adds Sonify to the same accounts and credits as Stella AI Studio and fixes one thing in `stellaChat`; everything else Stella AI Studio uses stays as it is. Your `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` secret stays as it is.

---

Update this app. **Sonify**, Fanan's music studio (a DAW), now signs in to the same accounts as Stella AI Studio and spends the same credits. Sonify talks to `stellaAccount` exactly as Stella AI Studio does (its computers say `"app": "Sonify 0.2.0"` in `hello`) and signs in through the same `/link` page. Its AI requests go to a new function, `sonifyChat`. Everything users see from Sonify says "Sonify" or "Sonify AI" by Fanan; never name the AI service behind it on any page.

**1. New backend function `sonifyChat`**, exactly the code below. Make the same two small platform changes you made to `stellaChat` (the opening import line, and reading the AI service key from the app's secrets). It must work without a signed-in user (Sonify calls it).

The model is one setting, an optional secret named `SONIFY_AI_MODEL`, read the same way as the key. Don't create it and don't ask me for it: when it isn't set, the function uses `claude-opus-5-5`.

```ts
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk';

// Sonify AI: Sonify's requests come here. Sonify (Fanan's music studio) signs in to the same
// Fanan accounts as Stella AI Studio and spends the same credits. This function asks the AI
// service with Fanan's key (which never leaves the server), charges the account's credits, and
// answers in Fanan's own format: nothing names the service behind it.
//
// Sonify sends its own instructions and tool definitions. The tool calls run in Sonify, which
// sends their results back in the next request, until the answer is done.
//
// The model is one setting: the SONIFY_AI_MODEL secret when it's set, the default below when
// it isn't. When a new model comes out, try it for about a week, then set the secret to it.
const DEFAULT_MODEL = 'claude-opus-5-5';
const MAX_TOKENS = 12000;          // one step's answer at most (thinking included): keeps a step well under the time limit
const MAX_MESSAGES = 200;
const MAX_SYSTEM_CHARS = 60000;
const MAX_TOOLS = 64;
const OUTPUT_WEIGHT = 5;           // an output token costs about five input tokens
const CACHE_WRITE_WEIGHT = 1.25;
const CACHE_READ_WEIGHT = 0.1;     // the same as stellaChat (the service itself charges 0.05 for this model)
const TOKENS_PER_CREDIT = 10000;   // weighted tokens per credit: the same as stellaChat

const PERSONA = `You are Sonify AI, the assistant inside Sonify, a music studio (DAW) by Fanan.
You work in the user's song with Sonify's tools: tracks, instruments and effects, notes and clips, the mix and plugin settings.
Act first: when the user asks for something, do it right away with sensible choices, then say briefly what you did. Ask a question only when you truly can't go on without the answer. Keep replies short.
Don't discuss which AI model, company or service powers you. If asked, say you're Sonify AI, Fanan's assistant, and that you can't share details about the technology behind it. Never claim to be a different specific model.`;

const HEX64 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const CACHE = { type: 'ephemeral' };

async function sha256Hex(text: string): Promise<string> {
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(text));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

// Tool-call ids carry the AI service's own prefix; Sonify only ever sees neutral ones.
const toApp = (id: string) => String(id).replace(/^toolu_/, 'call_');
const toService = (id: string) => String(id).replace(/^call_/, 'toolu_');

const isThinking = (block: any) => block?.type === 'thinking' || block?.type === 'redacted_thinking';
const isBlankText = (block: any) => block?.type === 'text' && !String(block.text ?? '').trim();

// One of the user's own requests (not tool results): where a request begins.
function isRequest(message: any) {
  return message?.role === 'user'
    && (!Array.isArray(message.content) || !message.content.some((block: any) => block?.type === 'tool_result'));
}

// Fanan's persona first, then Sonify's own instructions, cached: they're the same every time.
function systemBlocks(given: unknown) {
  const blocks: any[] = [{ type: 'text', text: PERSONA }];
  const list: any[] = Array.isArray(given) ? given : given ? [{ type: 'text', text: String(given) }] : [];
  let room = MAX_SYSTEM_CHARS;

  for (const block of list.slice(0, 4)) {
    const text = String(block?.text ?? '').slice(0, room);
    if (!text.trim()) continue;
    blocks.push({ type: 'text', text });
    room -= text.length;
  }

  blocks[blocks.length - 1].cache_control = CACHE;
  return blocks;
}

function cleanTools(given: unknown) {
  if (!Array.isArray(given)) return [];

  const tools: any[] = given.slice(0, MAX_TOOLS)
    .filter((tool: any) => tool && typeof tool.name === 'string' && tool.input_schema && typeof tool.input_schema === 'object')
    .map((tool: any) => ({ name: tool.name, description: String(tool.description ?? ''), input_schema: tool.input_schema }));

  if (tools.length > 0) tools[tools.length - 1].cache_control = CACHE;
  return tools;
}

// The conversation as the AI service takes it. The request under way keeps its blocks exactly as
// they came (its thinking blocks must go back unchanged with the tool results); earlier requests
// lose their thinking blocks, which the service allows. Tool-call ids go back to the service's own.
function cleanMessages(given: any[]) {
  let messages = given.filter((message: any) => message && (message.role === 'user' || message.role === 'assistant'));

  if (messages.length > MAX_MESSAGES) {
    // Cut only before one of the user's own requests, so every tool call keeps its result.
    const newest = messages.slice(-MAX_MESSAGES);
    const start = newest.findIndex(isRequest);
    messages = start >= 0 ? newest.slice(start) : newest;
  }

  let current = 0;
  messages.forEach((message: any, index: number) => { if (isRequest(message)) current = index; });

  return messages.map((message: any, index: number) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(message.content))
      return { role: message.role, content: String(message.content ?? '') };

    let blocks = message.content.filter((block: any) => block && typeof block === 'object').map((block: any) => {
      const { cache_control, ...rest } = block;   // the cache marks are this function's to place
      return rest.type === 'tool_use' ? { ...rest, id: toService(rest.id) }
        : rest.type === 'tool_result' ? { ...rest, tool_use_id: toService(rest.tool_use_id) }
        : rest;
    });

    if (message.role === 'assistant' && index < current) {
      blocks = blocks.filter((block: any) => !isThinking(block) && !isBlankText(block));
      if (blocks.length === 0) blocks = [{ type: 'text', text: '(No reply.)' }];
    }

    return { role: message.role, content: blocks };
  });
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const body = await req.json();
    const token = String(body.token || '');

    if (!HEX64.test(token) || !Array.isArray(body.messages) || body.messages.length === 0)
      return Response.json({ ok: false, error: 'invalid', message: 'That request was malformed.' }, { status: 400 });

    const computers = base44.asServiceRole.entities.StellaAccount;
    const wallets = base44.asServiceRole.entities.StellaWallet;
    const computer = (await computers.filter({ token_hash: await sha256Hex(token) }))[0];

    if (!computer)
      return Response.json({ ok: false, error: 'unknown', message: "Fanan's server doesn't recognise this computer yet. Restart Sonify while online." }, { status: 401 });

    // Sonify AI is for signed-in accounts: it spends the account's credits.
    if (!computer.linked_email)
      return Response.json({ ok: false, error: 'sign_in', message: 'Sign in to use Sonify AI.' }, { status: 401 });

    const wallet = (await wallets.filter({ user_email: computer.linked_email }))[0];
    const balance = wallet ? (wallet.credits || 0) : 0;

    if (!wallet || balance <= 0)
      return Response.json({ ok: false, error: 'no_credits', message: "You're out of credits.", credits: 0 }, { status: 402 });

    const model = String(Deno.env.get('SONIFY_AI_MODEL') || DEFAULT_MODEL).trim();
    const priceWeight = model.includes('opus') ? 2 : 1;   // the strongest models cost twice the credits, as in Stella AI

    const request: Record<string, unknown> = {
      model,
      max_tokens: Math.max(1024, Math.min(MAX_TOKENS, Number(body.max_tokens) || MAX_TOKENS)),
      system: systemBlocks(body.system),
      messages: cleanMessages(body.messages),
      cache_control: CACHE,   // the conversation so far is cached as well: each step pays a fraction for what came before
    };

    const tools = cleanTools(body.tools);
    if (tools.length > 0) request.tools = tools;

    const answer = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'x-api-key': Deno.env.get('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') ?? '',
        'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
        'content-type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(request),
    });
    const data = await answer.json();

    if (!answer.ok) {
      console.error('AI service error', answer.status, JSON.stringify(data));   // in your logs only
      const busy = answer.status === 429 || answer.status === 529 || answer.status >= 500;
      const tooLong = answer.status === 400 && /too long|context window|too many tokens/i.test(String(data?.error?.message ?? ''));
      return Response.json({
        ok: false,
        error: busy ? 'busy' : tooLong ? 'too_long' : 'failed',
        message: busy ? 'Sonify AI is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.'
               : tooLong ? 'This conversation got too long. Press New chat, then ask again.'
               : "Sonify AI couldn't answer that. Please try again.",
      }, { status: 502 });
    }

    // A declined request isn't charged.
    const refused = data.stop_reason === 'refusal';
    const usage = data.usage || {};
    const weighted = ((usage.input_tokens || 0) + CACHE_WRITE_WEIGHT * (usage.cache_creation_input_tokens || 0)
                    + CACHE_READ_WEIGHT * (usage.cache_read_input_tokens || 0) + OUTPUT_WEIGHT * (usage.output_tokens || 0)) * priceWeight;
    const used = refused ? 0 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(weighted / TOKENS_PER_CREDIT));
    const inputTokens = usage.input_tokens || 0;
    const outputTokens = usage.output_tokens || 0;

    await computers.update(computer.id, {
      requests: (computer.requests || 0) + 1,
      input_tokens: (computer.input_tokens || 0) + inputTokens,
      output_tokens: (computer.output_tokens || 0) + outputTokens,
      last_seen: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    // The wallet as it is now: credits bought (or spent in Stella AI Studio) while this step ran are kept.
    const current = (await wallets.filter({ user_email: computer.linked_email }))[0] || wallet;
    const credits = Math.max(0, (current.credits || 0) - used);

    await wallets.update(current.id, {
      credits,
      requests: (current.requests || 0) + 1,
      input_tokens: (current.input_tokens || 0) + inputTokens,
      output_tokens: (current.output_tokens || 0) + outputTokens,
    });

    // What Sonify needs, in Fanan's own format. Thinking blocks go to Sonify exactly as they came:
    // it sends them back with its tool results.
    const content = refused ? [] : (data.content || []).flatMap((block: any) =>
      block.type === 'text' ? (isBlankText(block) ? [] : [{ type: 'text', text: block.text }])
      : block.type === 'tool_use' ? [{ type: 'tool_use', id: toApp(block.id), name: block.name, input: block.input }]
      : isThinking(block) ? [block]
      : []);
    const reply = content.filter((b: any) => b.type === 'text').map((b: any) => b.text).join('\n').trim();

    const stop = data.stop_reason === 'tool_use' ? 'tools'
               : data.stop_reason === 'max_tokens' || data.stop_reason === 'model_context_window_exceeded' ? 'cut'
               : refused ? 'refused'
               : 'done';

    return Response.json({ ok: true, reply, content, stop, used, credits });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return Response.json({ ok: false, error: 'failed', message: "Sonify AI couldn't answer that. Please try again." }, { status: 500 });
  }
});
```

**2. Page `/link`**, when its address has `app=sonify`:

- With `next=buy`, it goes on to `/buy?app=sonify`.

# Base44 prompt: Stella AI Cloud, Sonify voice control

Open the **Stella AI Cloud** app on Base44 and paste everything below the line into its AI chat. It adds one function for Sonify's voice control and changes nothing Stella AI Studio uses. It needs one new secret, `OPENAI_API_KEY`: when the chat asks for it, give it an API key from your OpenAI account.

---

Update this app. **Sonify**, Fanan's music studio (a DAW), now has voice control: a musician in the recording room talks to Sonify through their mic ("Sonify, record, over"). Sonify finds each phrase in the mic's sound and sends it to a new function, `sonifyListen`, which turns it into words with the speech service and answers with them. Sonify does the rest itself. Users never see which speech service is behind it, on any page.

**1. New backend function `sonifyListen`**, exactly the code below. Make the same two small platform changes you made to `sonifyChat` (the opening import line, and reading the service's key from the app's secrets); this one reads a new secret, `OPENAI_API_KEY`: ask me for it. It must work without a signed-in user (Sonify calls it).

The model is one setting, an optional secret named `SONIFY_LISTEN_MODEL`, read the same way as the key. Don't create it and don't ask me for it: when it isn't set, the function uses `gpt-transcribe`.

```ts
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk';

// Sonify's voice control: a musician in the recording room talks to Sonify through their mic
// ("Sonify, record, over"). Sonify finds each phrase in the mic's sound and sends it here, a
// short 16 kHz WAV; this function sends it to the speech service with Fanan's key (which never
// leaves the server) and answers with the words. Sonify itself listens for "Sonify ... over"
// and does the rest. This function keeps nothing: not the sound, not the words.
//
// Nothing is charged, but it's for signed-in accounts with credits, and each account has a
// daily limit of listening, so a mic left on all day can't run up the bill.
//
// The model is one setting: the SONIFY_LISTEN_MODEL secret when it's set, the default below when
// it isn't.
const DEFAULT_MODEL = 'gpt-transcribe';
const MIN_BYTES = 1000;
const MAX_BYTES = 2_000_000;           // about a minute of Sonify's sound; it sends 25 seconds at most
const DAILY_SECONDS = 3 * 60 * 60;     // of listening, per account and day (UTC)
const HEX64 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;

async function sha256Hex(text: string): Promise<string> {
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(text));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

function fromBase64(text: string): Uint8Array | null {
  try {
    const binary = atob(text);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return bytes;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// A plain WAV file (PCM), and how many seconds of sound it holds.
function wavSeconds(bytes: Uint8Array): number {
  if (bytes.length < 44) return -1;
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
  const tag = (at: number) => String.fromCharCode(bytes[at], bytes[at + 1], bytes[at + 2], bytes[at + 3]);
  if (tag(0) !== 'RIFF' || tag(8) !== 'WAVE' || tag(12) !== 'fmt ' || view.getUint16(20, true) !== 1) return -1;
  const bytesPerSecond = view.getUint32(28, true);
  return bytesPerSecond > 0 ? (bytes.length - 44) / bytesPerSecond : -1;
}

const fail = (status: number, error: string, message: string) => Response.json({ ok: false, error, message }, { status });

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const body = await req.json();
    const token = String(body.token || '');
    const audio = typeof body.audio === 'string' ? fromBase64(body.audio) : null;
    const seconds = audio ? wavSeconds(audio) : -1;

    if (!HEX64.test(token) || !audio || audio.length < MIN_BYTES || audio.length > MAX_BYTES || seconds <= 0)
      return fail(400, 'invalid', 'That recording was malformed.');

    const computers = base44.asServiceRole.entities.StellaAccount;
    const wallets = base44.asServiceRole.entities.StellaWallet;
    const computer = (await computers.filter({ token_hash: await sha256Hex(token) }))[0];

    if (!computer)
      return fail(401, 'unknown', "Fanan's server doesn't recognise this computer yet. Restart Sonify while online.");

    if (!computer.linked_email)
      return fail(401, 'sign_in', 'Sign in to use voice control.');

    const wallet = (await wallets.filter({ user_email: computer.linked_email }))[0];

    if (!wallet || (wallet.credits || 0) <= 0)
      return fail(402, 'no_credits', "You're out of credits.");

    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const heardToday = wallet.listen_day === today ? (wallet.listen_seconds || 0) : 0;

    if (heardToday + seconds > DAILY_SECONDS)
      return fail(429, 'listen_limit', "Voice control has reached today's limit for this account. It works again tomorrow.");

    const form = new FormData();
    form.append('file', new Blob([audio.buffer as ArrayBuffer], { type: 'audio/wav' }), 'speech.wav');   // the whole buffer: it holds just the file
    form.append('model', String(Deno.env.get('SONIFY_LISTEN_MODEL') || DEFAULT_MODEL).trim());

    const answer = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${Deno.env.get('OPENAI_API_KEY') ?? ''}` },
      body: form,
    });
    const data = await answer.json().catch(() => ({}));

    if (!answer.ok) {
      console.error('Speech service error', answer.status, JSON.stringify(data?.error ?? data));   // in your logs only
      const busy = answer.status === 429 || answer.status >= 500;
      return fail(502, busy ? 'busy' : 'failed',
                  busy ? 'Voice control is busy right now. Try again in a moment.' : "Voice control couldn't understand that right now.");
    }

    // Counted once it's heard. The wallet as it is now: what Sonify AI or Stella AI Studio wrote meanwhile stays.
    const current = (await wallets.filter({ user_email: computer.linked_email }))[0] || wallet;
    const before = current.listen_day === today ? (current.listen_seconds || 0) : 0;
    await wallets.update(current.id, { listen_day: today, listen_seconds: Math.round((before + seconds) * 10) / 10 });

    return Response.json({ ok: true, text: String(data?.text ?? '').trim() });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return fail(500, 'failed', "Voice control couldn't understand that right now.");
  }
});
```

**2. Entity `StellaWallet`:** add two fields, `listen_day` (text, a date such as 2026-10-08) and `listen_seconds` (number, default 0). They hold each account's voice control for the day (it has a daily limit); nothing else uses them, and no page shows them.

**3. Page `/link`**, when its address has `app=sonify`: its footer line now says "Sonify AI requests and voice control are processed by third-party AI service providers."

**4. Nothing else changes:** `sonifyChat`, `stellaChat`, `stellaAccount`, signing in, the credits, the packs, the prices and PayPal all stay exactly as they are.

**5. Test `sonifyListen` when you're done**, with this token (64 times the letter a):

1. With no `StellaAccount` for that hash: expect 401 with error `unknown`.
2. Make a test `StellaAccount` with that `token_hash` and an empty `linked_email`: expect 401 with error `sign_in`.
3. Set its `linked_email` to `sonify-test@example.com`, and make a `StellaWallet` for that email with 0 credits: expect 402 with error `no_credits`.
4. Give that wallet 50 credits: expect 200 with `ok: true` and a `text` (empty or nearly, for silence), the wallet's `listen_day` set to today's date (UTC) and its `listen_seconds` to 1, and its credits still 50.

# Base44 prompt: Stella AI Cloud, Sonify Remote

Open the **Stella AI Cloud** app on Base44 and paste into its AI chat:
- **Part 1** is done: it's in the app and tested. It's kept here for the record; don't paste it again.
- **Part 2**, the page, typing only: paste it now. It needs no new secret and adds no fees. On the phone, talking still works through the keyboard's own mic key.
- **Part 3**, a talk button on the page itself: later, only if you want it. It uses the paid speech service: paste `base44_sonify_listen_prompt.md` first (it adds the `OPENAI_API_KEY` secret), then Part 3.

Until Sonify has its **Phone remote** switch, the page just waits for Sonify.

---

## Part 1: done (already in the app, don't paste it again)

Update this app. Add **Sonify Remote**: a page for phones, `/sonify` (Part 2 builds it), where a musician in the recording room talks to Sonify AI, the AI inside Sonify (Fanan's music studio, a DAW) on their studio computer. They tap a button and speak, or type; their words go to the Sonify signed in to the same Fanan account; Sonify AI does it in the song, and its reply shows on the phone. Sonify talks to the server through a new function, `sonifyRemote`; the page through another, `sonifyRemotePage`. Users never see which AI or speech service is behind it, on any page.

**1. New entity `SonifyRemote`**: one record per studio computer that turned Sonify's Phone remote on. Fields:
- `token_hash` (text): the computer, as in `StellaAccount`
- `user_email` (text): the account the computer is signed in to
- `name` (text): the computer's name, as Sonify gives it
- `enabled` (boolean)
- `seen_at` (number): when Sonify last checked in, in milliseconds since 1970
- `state` (long text): Sonify AI's conversation, as JSON text that Sonify sends
- `state_at` (number)
- `request_id` (text), `request_kind` (text), `request_text` (text), `request_spoken` (boolean), `request_at` (number): what the phone asked for, waiting for Sonify

No user reads or changes it directly: only these two functions do, as the service role. Give it the same access rules as `StellaAccount`.

**2. New backend function `sonifyRemote`** (Sonify calls it), exactly the code below. Make the same platform change you made to `sonifyChat` (the opening import line). It must work without a signed-in user.

```ts
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk';

// Sonify Remote, the studio computer's side. With "Phone remote" on, Sonify (signed in to a
// Fanan account) opens its remote here, then checks in every second or two: it posts its
// Sonify AI conversation for the phone to show, and picks up what the phone asked for. The
// page /sonify, signed in to the same account on a phone, does the other half through
// sonifyRemotePage. Only these two functions touch SonifyRemote records.
//
// Actions (all with Sonify's token, as for sonifyChat):
//   open  { name }   the switch went on: the remote is ready, nothing waiting
//   poll  { state? } still here; the conversation when it changed (Sonify's own JSON, kept as
//                    text). Answers { request: { id, kind: "ask" | "stop", text, spoken } | null }:
//                    a request is handed over once, and dropped if it waited too long
//   close            the switch went off (or Sonify is closing)
const HEX64 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const MAX_STATE = 60000;          // characters of conversation the phone is shown
const SEEN_EVERY_MS = 5000;       // "still here" is written at most this often
const REQUEST_LIFE_MS = 30000;    // a request Sonify didn't pick up by then is dropped, not done late

const NOTHING_WAITING = { request_id: '', request_kind: '', request_text: '', request_spoken: false, request_at: 0 };

async function sha256Hex(text: string): Promise<string> {
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(text));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

const fail = (status: number, error: string, message: string) => Response.json({ ok: false, error, message }, { status });

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const body = await req.json();
    const token = String(body.token || '');
    const action = String(body.action || '');

    if (!HEX64.test(token) || !['open', 'poll', 'close'].includes(action))
      return fail(400, 'invalid', 'That request was malformed.');

    const computers = base44.asServiceRole.entities.StellaAccount;
    const remotes = base44.asServiceRole.entities.SonifyRemote;
    const tokenHash = await sha256Hex(token);
    const computer = (await computers.filter({ token_hash: tokenHash }))[0];

    if (!computer)
      return fail(401, 'unknown', "Fanan's server doesn't recognise this computer yet. Restart Sonify while online.");

    const remote = (await remotes.filter({ token_hash: tokenHash }))[0];
    const now = Date.now();

    if (action === 'close') {
      if (remote) await remotes.update(remote.id, { enabled: false, state: '', ...NOTHING_WAITING });
      return Response.json({ ok: true });
    }

    // The phone signs in to the same account, so the computer must be signed in.
    if (!computer.linked_email) {
      if (remote && remote.enabled) await remotes.update(remote.id, { enabled: false, state: '', ...NOTHING_WAITING });
      return fail(401, 'sign_in', 'Sign in to use Sonify Remote.');
    }

    if (action === 'open') {
      const fields = {
        user_email: computer.linked_email,
        name: String(body.name ?? '').trim().slice(0, 60) || 'Sonify',
        enabled: true,
        seen_at: now,
        state: '',
        state_at: now,
        ...NOTHING_WAITING,
      };

      if (remote) await remotes.update(remote.id, fields);
      else await remotes.create({ token_hash: tokenHash, ...fields });

      return Response.json({ ok: true });
    }

    // poll
    if (!remote || !remote.enabled)
      return fail(409, 'closed', 'Sonify Remote is off.');   // Sonify opens it again

    const fields: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    let request = null;

    if (remote.user_email !== computer.linked_email) {
      // The computer has signed in to another account since: the remote follows it, and what
      // the old account's phone asked for, or was shown, goes.
      Object.assign(fields, { user_email: computer.linked_email, state: '', state_at: now, ...NOTHING_WAITING });
    } else if (remote.request_id) {
      if (now - (remote.request_at || 0) <= REQUEST_LIFE_MS)
        request = { id: remote.request_id, kind: remote.request_kind === 'stop' ? 'stop' : 'ask', text: remote.request_text || '',
                    spoken: remote.request_spoken === true };

      Object.assign(fields, NOTHING_WAITING);   // handed over once, or too old to do now
    }

    if (typeof body.state === 'string') {
      fields.state = body.state.slice(0, MAX_STATE);
      fields.state_at = now;
    }

    if (now - (remote.seen_at || 0) >= SEEN_EVERY_MS)
      fields.seen_at = now;

    if (Object.keys(fields).length > 0)
      await remotes.update(remote.id, fields);

    return Response.json({ ok: true, request });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return fail(500, 'failed', "Fanan's server couldn't do that. Please try again.");
  }
});
```

**3. New backend function `sonifyRemotePage`** (the page calls it, with the user signed in), exactly the code below. Make the same platform changes you made to `sonifyListen` (the opening import line, and reading the `OPENAI_API_KEY` secret, which is already set; `SONIFY_LISTEN_MODEL` stays optional, as there).

```ts
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk';

// Sonify Remote, the phone's side: the page /sonify, signed in to the user's Fanan account,
// talks with the Sonify signed in to the same account on the studio computer (sonifyRemote is
// Sonify's side). The phone sends what to ask Sonify AI, and shows the conversation Sonify
// posts. It also turns what the user says into words, as sonifyListen does for Sonify (the
// same speech service, the same daily limit, nothing charged, nothing kept).
//
// Every answer is HTTP 200: { ok: true, ... }, or { ok: false, error, message } with a message
// the page shows as it is.
//   list                          the user's Sonify computers with Phone remote on, answering now
//   state  { remote, since? }     { name, online, pending, stateAt, state } (state: Sonify's conversation, or
//                                 null). With since = the stateAt last answered and nothing new: unchanged: true, no state
//   send   { remote, kind, text, spoken }   kind "ask" (with text) or "stop" (stop Sonify AI). Answers { id }
//   listen { audio }              a short 16-bit WAV (base64) of what the user said. Answers { text }
const ONLINE_MS = 15000;              // a Sonify heard from within this long is there
const REQUEST_LIFE_MS = 30000;        // as in sonifyRemote: a request not picked up by then is gone
const MAX_TEXT = 2000;
const DEFAULT_MODEL = 'gpt-transcribe';   // the SONIFY_LISTEN_MODEL secret, when it's set, as in sonifyListen
const MIN_BYTES = 1000;
const MAX_BYTES = 2_000_000;
const DAILY_SECONDS = 3 * 60 * 60;    // shared with Sonify's voice control: one limit per account and day (UTC)

const answer = (fields: Record<string, unknown>) => Response.json({ ok: true, ...fields });
const refuse = (error: string, message: string) => Response.json({ ok: false, error, message });

function fromBase64(text: string): Uint8Array | null {
  try {
    const binary = atob(text);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return bytes;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// A plain WAV file (PCM), and how many seconds of sound it holds.
function wavSeconds(bytes: Uint8Array): number {
  if (bytes.length < 44) return -1;
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
  const tag = (at: number) => String.fromCharCode(bytes[at], bytes[at + 1], bytes[at + 2], bytes[at + 3]);
  if (tag(0) !== 'RIFF' || tag(8) !== 'WAVE' || tag(12) !== 'fmt ' || view.getUint16(20, true) !== 1) return -1;
  const bytesPerSecond = view.getUint32(28, true);
  return bytesPerSecond > 0 ? (bytes.length - 44) / bytesPerSecond : -1;
}

function parseState(text: unknown) {
  if (typeof text !== 'string' || !text) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);

    let user: any = null;
    try {
      user = await base44.auth.me();
    } catch {
      user = null;
    }

    if (!user?.email)
      return refuse('sign_in', 'Sign in to use Sonify Remote.');

    const email = String(user.email);
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const action = String(body?.action || '');
    const remotes = base44.asServiceRole.entities.SonifyRemote;
    const now = Date.now();
    const isOnline = (r: any) => r.enabled === true && now - (r.seen_at || 0) < ONLINE_MS;
    const isWaiting = (r: any) => Boolean(r.request_id) && now - (r.request_at || 0) <= REQUEST_LIFE_MS;

    if (action === 'list') {
      const mine = await remotes.filter({ user_email: email });
      return answer({ remotes: mine.filter(isOnline).map((r: any) => ({ id: r.id, name: r.name || 'Sonify' })) });
    }

    if (action === 'state' || action === 'send') {
      // Only the user's own: a remote belongs to the account its computer is signed in to.
      const remote = (await remotes.filter({ user_email: email })).find((r: any) => r.id === String(body?.remote || ''));

      if (!remote)
        return refuse('not_found', "That Sonify isn't signed in to your account.");

      if (action === 'state') {
        const stateAt = remote.state_at || 0;
        const unchanged = stateAt > 0 && Number(body?.since) === stateAt;   // the phone has it already
        return answer({ name: remote.name || 'Sonify', online: isOnline(remote), pending: isWaiting(remote), stateAt,
                        ...(unchanged ? { unchanged: true } : { state: parseState(remote.state) }) });
      }

      if (!isOnline(remote))
        return refuse('offline', "Sonify isn't answering. Check that it's open and online, with Phone remote on.");

      const kind = body?.kind === 'stop' ? 'stop' : 'ask';
      const text = String(body?.text ?? '').trim().slice(0, MAX_TEXT);

      if (kind === 'ask' && !text)
        return refuse('invalid', 'Say or type something first.');

      if (kind === 'ask' && isWaiting(remote))
        return refuse('busy', "Sonify hasn't picked up the last request yet. Try again in a moment.");

      const id = crypto.randomUUID();
      await remotes.update(remote.id, { request_id: id, request_kind: kind, request_text: kind === 'ask' ? text : '',
                                        request_spoken: kind === 'ask' && body?.spoken === true, request_at: now });
      return answer({ id });
    }

    if (action === 'listen') {
      const audio = typeof body?.audio === 'string' ? fromBase64(body.audio) : null;
      const seconds = audio ? wavSeconds(audio) : -1;

      if (!audio || audio.length < MIN_BYTES || audio.length > MAX_BYTES || seconds <= 0)
        return refuse('invalid', "That recording didn't work. Please try again.");

      const wallets = base44.asServiceRole.entities.StellaWallet;
      const wallet = (await wallets.filter({ user_email: email }))[0];

      if (!wallet || (wallet.credits || 0) <= 0)
        return refuse('no_credits', "You're out of credits.");

      const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const heardToday = wallet.listen_day === today ? (wallet.listen_seconds || 0) : 0;

      if (heardToday + seconds > DAILY_SECONDS)
        return refuse('listen_limit', "Talking to Sonify has reached today's limit for this account. Type instead, or try again tomorrow.");

      const form = new FormData();
      form.append('file', new Blob([audio.buffer as ArrayBuffer], { type: 'audio/wav' }), 'speech.wav');   // the whole buffer: it holds just the file
      form.append('model', String(Deno.env.get('SONIFY_LISTEN_MODEL') || DEFAULT_MODEL).trim());

      const heard = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${Deno.env.get('OPENAI_API_KEY') ?? ''}` },
        body: form,
      });
      const data = await heard.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (!heard.ok) {
        console.error('Speech service error', heard.status, JSON.stringify(data?.error ?? data));   // in your logs only
        const busy = heard.status === 429 || heard.status >= 500;
        return refuse(busy ? 'busy' : 'failed', busy ? 'Too busy to listen right now. Try again in a moment.' : "Couldn't make out the words. Please try again.");
      }

      // Counted once it's heard, on the wallet as it is now.
      const current = (await wallets.filter({ user_email: email }))[0] || wallet;
      const before = current.listen_day === today ? (current.listen_seconds || 0) : 0;
      await wallets.update(current.id, { listen_day: today, listen_seconds: Math.round((before + seconds) * 10) / 10 });

      return answer({ text: String(data?.text ?? '').trim() });
    }

    return refuse('invalid', 'That request was malformed.');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return refuse('failed', "Fanan's server couldn't do that. Please try again.");
  }
});
```
