## Part 2: paste this now (typing only)

Build the **Sonify Remote** page, `/sonify`, for phones first. It uses the `sonifyRemotePage` function from Part 1, and one helper file. Typing only: no microphone button on the page, and it never calls `listen`.

**1. One helper file, exactly as below:** `components/sonify/replyText.js` (Sonify AI's replies, shown as Sonify shows them). Import it in the page.

```js
// Sonify Remote: Sonify AI's replies shown as Sonify shows them. Its marks never show:
// **bold** and *italic* become fonts, `code` plain words, "# " lines headings, "- " lines bullets,
// fenced code is left out, and ==a question or a task for the user== shows in yellow (when a
// reply marks nothing, its questions are found by their "?").
//
//   replyLines(text) -> [{ kind: '' | 'heading' | 'bullet', runs: [{ text, bold, italic, ask }] }]
//
// Each line is a block (a bullet gets a dot before it, a heading is bold); each run is a span.
// Give each line dir="auto", so Hebrew reads right to left.

const FENCE = '`'.repeat(3);   // a fenced code block's mark

export function replyLines(text) {
  const lines = [];
  let inCode = false;

  for (const line of String(text || '').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (line.trimStart().startsWith(FENCE)) inCode = !inCode;
    else if (!inCode) lines.push(line);
  }

  while (lines.length && !lines[lines.length - 1].trim()) lines.pop();

  const marked = String(text || '').includes('==');

  return lines.map((original) => {
    let line = original;
    const trimmed = line.trimStart();
    let kind = '';

    if (trimmed === '---' || trimmed === '***' || trimmed === '___') line = '';
    else if (trimmed.startsWith('#')) { line = trimmed.replace(/^#+\s*/, ''); kind = 'heading'; }
    else if (/^([-*]|•) /.test(trimmed)) { line = trimmed.slice(2); kind = 'bullet'; }
    else if (trimmed.startsWith('> ')) line = trimmed.slice(2);

    if (!marked) line = markQuestions(line);

    return { kind, runs: parseLine(line, kind === 'heading') };
  });
}

// A line's inline marks, each only when it's closed on the same line.
function parseLine(line, bold) {
  const runs = [];
  let italic = false, code = false, ask = false;
  let current = { text: '', bold, italic, ask };

  const flush = () => {
    if (current.text) runs.push(current);
    current = { text: '', bold, italic, ask };
  };
  const closedLater = (mark, from) => line.indexOf(mark, from) >= 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < line.length;) {
    const rest = line.slice(i);

    if (!code && rest.startsWith('**') && (bold || closedLater('**', i + 2))) {
      flush(); bold = !bold; current.bold = bold; i += 2;
    } else if (!code && rest.startsWith('==') && (ask || closedLater('==', i + 2))) {
      flush(); ask = !ask; current.ask = ask; i += 2;
    } else if (line[i] === '`' && (code || closedLater('`', i + 1))) {
      flush(); code = !code; i += 1;
    } else if (!code && line[i] === '*' && (italic || (i + 1 < line.length && line[i + 1] !== ' ' && closedLater('*', i + 1)))) {
      flush(); italic = !italic; current.italic = italic; i += 1;
    } else {
      current.text += line[i]; i += 1;
    }
  }

  flush();
  return runs;
}

// When a reply marks nothing for the user, its questions are found by their "?".
function markQuestions(line) {
  let result = '', sentence = '';

  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
    sentence += line[i];
    const end = line[i] === '.' || line[i] === '!' || line[i] === '?';

    if (end && (i + 1 === line.length || line[i + 1] === ' ')) {
      const trimmed = sentence.trim();
      result += line[i] === '?' && trimmed ? sentence.slice(0, sentence.length - trimmed.length) + '==' + trimmed + '==' : sentence;
      sentence = '';
    }
  }

  return result + sentence;
}
```

**2. The page `/sonify`:**
- **On its own:** none of the site's header, menu, footer or links, and no link to it anywhere else on the site. Its own look: dark (background #1b1c20, panels #2b2c30, text #eceded, quiet text #8e939a, green #25984d, the user's bubbles #275533, questions yellow #f2cf3c, problems #f0a7a9), "Sonify Remote" at the top with "by Fanan" under it, big touch targets, and it fills the phone's screen with the input bar at the bottom (above the keyboard while typing).
- **Signed out:** the site's sign-in, then back to `/sonify`.
- **Finding Sonify:** call `sonifyRemotePage` with `{"action": "list"}` every 3 seconds until there's one. None: "Turn on **Phone remote** in Sonify's AI panel, on your studio computer. It must be signed in as {the user's email}.", with this line under it in quiet text: "Your requests to Sonify AI are processed by third-party AI service providers." One: use it. Several: let the user pick by name, and remember the choice on this phone.
- **Connected:** call `{"action": "state", "remote": <its id>, "since": <the stateAt of the last answer>}` every 1.5 seconds while the page is in view (not while the phone is locked or the tab is hidden). An answer with `unchanged: true` has nothing new: keep what's shown. Show its `name` with a green dot. When `online` stays false for 10 seconds, go back to finding Sonify.
- **What `state` holds** (Sonify's conversation, or null until Sonify sends it): `{"busy": false, "credits": 120, "taken": "<the id of the last request Sonify picked up>", "entries": [...]}`, where each entry is `{"role": "user", "text": "...", "spoken": true}`, `{"role": "assistant", "text": "...", "steps": ["Added a reverb", ...]}` or `{"role": "notice", "text": "..."}`.
- **The conversation:** the entries in order, scrolled to the newest. `user` entries are right-aligned green bubbles, with a small mic icon when `spoken`. `assistant` entries are left-aligned panel bubbles: first their `steps`, each a small line with a green ✓, then their `text` drawn with `replyLines` from replyText.js (a block per line with `dir="auto"`, bullets with a dot before them, headings bold, and each run a span: bold, italic, and `ask` in the yellow). `notice` entries are small text in the problem colour. With no entries yet: "Tell Sonify AI what you want in your song., with this line under it in quiet text: "To talk instead of typing, tap the mic on your phone's keyboard." While `busy`: "Sonify AI is working…" under the last entry, and a **Stop** button that sends `{"action": "send", "remote": <id>, "kind": "stop"}`.
- **Credits:** `credits` (when it's there) as "N credits", in quiet text at the top.
- **The input bar:** a text box ("Ask Sonify AI…") and a big Send button. Send, or Enter, sends `{"action": "send", "remote": <id>, "kind": "ask", "text": <the box's text>}` and empties the box. While `busy`, or while `pending` is true, the box and Send are disabled.
- **A request on its way:** show it at once as a faded user bubble. It goes when Sonify has it: when `state.taken` equals the `id` that `send` answered (the real one is then in the entries). If that doesn't happen within 10 seconds: "Sonify didn't get that." with a Try again button that sends it again.
- **Problems:** every answer with `ok: false` has a `message`: show it as it is, in the problem colour, just above the input bar, until the next call that works. A call that gets no answer at all: "No connection. Trying again…", and keep trying.

**3. Nothing else changes.**

**4. Check it:** open `/sonify` on a phone-sized screen, signed in: it shows the "Turn on **Phone remote**…" message, with none of the site's header or menu, and no microphone button.

## Part 3: later, only for a talk button (paste `base44_sonify_listen_prompt.md` first)

Add tap-to-talk to the **Sonify Remote** page, `/sonify`. It uses the `listen` action of `sonifyRemotePage` (it reads the `OPENAI_API_KEY` secret, which is now set) and one more helper file.

**1. A new helper file, exactly as below:** `components/sonify/recorder.js` (tap-to-talk: records the user and makes the WAV that `listen` takes). Import it in the page.

```js
// Sonify Remote: tap-to-talk on the phone. Records what the user says and makes it a short WAV
// (16 kHz, 16-bit, mono, base64) for sonifyRemotePage's "listen", as Sonify's own voice control
// sends it.
//
//   const recording = await startRecording({ maxSeconds: 30, onLevel, onLimit });
//   ... later: const { audio, seconds } = await recording.stop();   (or recording.cancel())
//
// Call startRecording straight from the tap, with nothing awaited before it: phones only let a
// tap start sound. The first time, the browser asks the user to allow the microphone. It throws
// an Error whose message can be shown as it is. onLevel(0..1) follows the voice, to animate the
// button; onLimit() is called once when maxSeconds is reached (then call stop()).

const RATE = 16000;

export async function startRecording({ maxSeconds = 30, onLevel, onLimit } = {}) {
  const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;

  if (!AudioContextClass || !navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia)
    throw new Error("This browser can't record. Type instead.");

  // Made and started inside the tap, before anything is awaited.
  const context = new AudioContextClass();
  const resumed = context.resume();
  let stream;

  try {
    stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      audio: { channelCount: 1, echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    context.close();
    throw new Error(error && error.name === 'NotAllowedError'
      ? 'Allow the microphone for this site, then tap again.'
      : "The microphone couldn't start. Type instead.");
  }

  await resumed;

  const source = context.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
  const processor = context.createScriptProcessor(4096, 1, 1);
  const chunks = [];
  const limit = Math.round(maxSeconds * context.sampleRate);
  let total = 0, finished = false, limitTold = false;

  processor.onaudioprocess = (event) => {
    if (finished) return;

    const input = event.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0);
    chunks.push(new Float32Array(input));
    total += input.length;

    if (onLevel) {
      let sum = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) sum += input[i] * input[i];
      onLevel(Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(sum / input.length) * 4));
    }

    if (total >= limit && !limitTold) {
      limitTold = true;
      if (onLimit) onLimit();
    }
  };

  source.connect(processor);
  processor.connect(context.destination);   // some browsers only run it when it's connected; it plays nothing

  const finish = () => {
    finished = true;
    processor.onaudioprocess = null;
    processor.disconnect();
    source.disconnect();
    stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
    context.close();
  };

  return {
    async stop() {
      if (finished) throw new Error('That recording has already ended.');

      const inputRate = context.sampleRate;
      finish();

      const recorded = new Float32Array(Math.min(total, limit));
      let at = 0;
      for (const chunk of chunks) {
        const part = chunk.subarray(0, Math.min(chunk.length, recorded.length - at));
        recorded.set(part, at);
        at += part.length;
        if (at >= recorded.length) break;
      }

      const samples = resample(recorded, inputRate);
      return { audio: toBase64(toWav(samples)), seconds: samples.length / RATE };
    },

    cancel() {
      if (!finished) finish();
    },
  };
}

// To 16 kHz: below its Nyquist first (a fourth-order low-pass at 6.5 kHz), then linear interpolation.
function resample(samples, rate) {
  if (rate === RATE) return samples;

  const filtered = rate > RATE ? lowPass(lowPass(samples, rate, 6500, 0.5412), rate, 6500, 1.3066) : samples;
  const step = rate / RATE;
  const out = new Float32Array(filtered.length > 0 ? Math.floor((filtered.length - 1) / step) + 1 : 0);

  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
    const position = i * step, index = Math.floor(position), fraction = position - index;
    const a = filtered[index], b = index + 1 < filtered.length ? filtered[index + 1] : a;
    out[i] = a + (b - a) * fraction;
  }

  return out;
}

function lowPass(samples, rate, frequency, q) {
  const w0 = (2 * Math.PI * frequency) / rate, cos = Math.cos(w0), alpha = Math.sin(w0) / (2 * q), a0 = 1 + alpha;
  const b0 = (1 - cos) / 2 / a0, b1 = (1 - cos) / a0, b2 = b0, a1 = (-2 * cos) / a0, a2 = (1 - alpha) / a0;
  const out = new Float32Array(samples.length);
  let x1 = 0, x2 = 0, y1 = 0, y2 = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
    const x = samples[i];
    const y = b0 * x + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 - a1 * y1 - a2 * y2;
    x2 = x1; x1 = x; y2 = y1; y1 = y;
    out[i] = y;
  }

  return out;
}

// 16-bit WAV, its loudest sound brought up near full scale (by 30 dB at most).
function toWav(samples) {
  let peak = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(samples[i]));
  const gain = peak > 0 ? Math.min(0.7 / peak, 31.6) : 1;

  const bytes = new Uint8Array(44 + samples.length * 2);
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
  const text = (at, value) => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) bytes[at + i] = value.charCodeAt(i); };

  text(0, 'RIFF');
  view.setUint32(4, 36 + samples.length * 2, true);
  text(8, 'WAVE');
  text(12, 'fmt ');
  view.setUint32(16, 16, true);
  view.setUint16(20, 1, true);          // PCM
  view.setUint16(22, 1, true);          // mono
  view.setUint32(24, RATE, true);
  view.setUint32(28, RATE * 2, true);   // bytes a second
  view.setUint16(32, 2, true);          // bytes a sample
  view.setUint16(34, 16, true);
  text(36, 'data');
  view.setUint32(40, samples.length * 2, true);

  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++)
    view.setInt16(44 + i * 2, Math.max(-32767, Math.min(32767, Math.round(samples[i] * gain * 32767))), true);

  return bytes;
}

function toBase64(bytes) {
  let binary = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000)
    binary += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
  return btoa(binary);
}
```

Then delete `store_secrets.txt`, and never put it in git.
3. **Paste** everything below the line into the app's AI chat. Publish when it's done.

---

Update this app. Add **Sonify's store**: plugins and MIDI FX that Sonify users make in Sonify's Plugins Creator Studio (Sonify is Fanan's music studio, a DAW), posted by their makers from Sonify and open to every Sonify user. A product is free or has a price. A paid one is bought from inside Sonify: the buyer pays the seller's own PayPal account directly (Fanan takes no commission), and once PayPal says it's paid, this app signs a licence for the buyer's computer, which Sonify keeps and checks with Fanan's public key. The files (each version's package and its picture) are kept in Cloudflare R2 behind a worker; this app keeps the catalog and signs the addresses Sonify sends the files to.

**1. New entity `StoreProduct`**: one record per product in the store. Fields:
- `product` (text): the store's id for it, made here, never changes (licences name it)
- `seller_key` (text): the seller's own id for it in Sonify (a project's id), so a post from the same project finds it again
- `seller_email` (text): the seller's Fanan account
- `kind` (text): `instrument`, `effect`, `widget` or `midifx`
- `title` (text), `tagline` (text), `story` (long text), `features` (long text: a JSON array of short texts)
- `price` (number: 0 is free), `currency` (text), `paypal` (text: the seller's PayPal email, never shown to buyers)
- `vendor` (text): the maker's name as Sonify shows it
- `version` (number): the latest version listed (0: never listed)
- `package_key` (text), `picture_key` (text): that version's files in R2
- `package_size` (number), `package_sha256` (text)
- `protected` (boolean): built with its licence check
- `status` (text): `pending` (never listed yet), `listed`, `hidden` (taken out by its seller) or `removed` (by Fanan)
- `section` (text): empty for now; Fanan will sort products into sections later
- `downloads` (number), `published_at` (number: milliseconds since 1970)
- `pending_version` (number), `pending_at` (number): a post under way

**2. New entity `StorePurchase`**: one record per purchase. Fields:
- `product` (text), `buyer_email` (text), `seller_email` (text)
- `price` (number), `currency` (text), `paypal` (text): what was asked, and the seller's PayPal email at the time
- `order_id` (text): the PayPal order, `approve_url` (text): where the buyer pays it
- `status` (text): `created`, `pending` (PayPal holds it until the seller accepts), `completed` or `failed`
- `computers` (long text: a JSON array of the computers its licence is on, at most 3)
- `created_at` (number), `completed_at` (number), `capture_id` (text)

No user reads or changes these directly: only `sonifyStore` does, as the service role. Give both the same access rules as `StellaAccount`.

**3. `stellaAccount`'s `hello`:** Sonify sends `device` with every `hello` (the computer's device hash: 64 hex characters). `StellaAccount` must keep it: if it doesn't yet, add a field `device_hash` and write it on every `hello`. If it's already kept under another name, use that name in `sonifyStore` below (where it reads `computer?.device_hash`) and tell me. Change nothing else in `stellaAccount`.

**4. New backend function `sonifyStore`** (Sonify calls it; the payment page below calls its `capture` action), exactly the code below. Make the same platform change you made to `sonifyRemote` (the opening import line). It must work without a signed-in user. Fill in two things, and change nothing else:
- `SITE_URL`: this app's published site address (the one Sonify opens to sign in and buy credits), with no slash at the end.
- `paypalConfig()`: it must use the same PayPal REST app, credentials and live or sandbox setting as the credit packs. If their secrets are named differently from `PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID`, `PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET` and `PAYPAL_MODE`, change only that function's body, and tell me the names.

If the entity `filter` takes its sort and its limit differently from `filter(query, '-published_at', 1000)`, adapt that one call and keep its meaning (every listed product, newest first).

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk';

// Sonify's store: plugins and MIDI FX made in Sonify (Fanan's music studio, a DAW), posted by
// their makers from Sonify's Protection tab, open to every Sonify user. A paid one is bought
// from Sonify: the buyer pays the seller's own PayPal account directly (no commission), then
// this function signs a licence for the buyer's computer, which Sonify keeps and checks with
// Fanan's public key. The files (each version's package and picture) are kept in Cloudflare R2
// behind the sonify-store-files worker; this function signs the addresses Sonify sends them to.
//
// Actions (with Sonify's token, as for sonifyChat; "capture" is the PayPal return page's):
//   begin    { key, kind, title, price, currency, paypal, product? }   the seller, signed in: the
//            product's id (made the first time, by key), the next version and where to send its
//            files. Answers { product, version, uploads: { package, picture } }
//   publish  { product, version, title, tagline, story, features, price, currency, paypal, vendor,
//              protected, packageSize, packageSha256, pictureSize }   the files are there: listed
//   list     { kind?, section?, query?, page? }      anyone: { products: [...], page, pages, total }
//   get      { product }                             anyone: { product: {...} }
//   download { product }                             anyone: { url, version, size, sha256, store }
//   mine                                             the seller's own products, with their details
//   hide     { product, hidden }                     the seller takes one out of the store, or back
//   buy      { product }                             signed in: { owned: true }, or { order, approve }
//                                                    (Sonify opens approve in the browser)
//   licence  { product }                             signed in: { licence } for this computer once
//                                                    paid; else error waiting / pending / not_bought
//   owned                                            signed in: { products: [{ product, title, kind, version }] }
//   release  { product }                             signed in: this computer's place in the purchase back
//   capture  { order }                               the PayPal return page (no token): { title }
const HEX64 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const PRODUCT_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$/;
const KINDS = ['instrument', 'effect', 'widget', 'midifx'];
const CURRENCIES = ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'ILS', 'CAD', 'AUD'];
const MIN_PRICE = 0.99, MAX_PRICE = 999.99;
const MAX_TITLE = 80, MAX_TAGLINE = 140, MAX_STORY = 6000, MAX_FEATURES = 10, MAX_FEATURE = 120, MAX_VENDOR = 60;
const MAX_PACKAGE = 64 * 1024 * 1024, MAX_PICTURE = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_PRODUCTS_PER_SELLER = 200;
const MAX_COMPUTERS = 3;                         // computers one purchase plays fully on, at a time
const UPLOAD_LIFE_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;           // a signed file address works this long
const ORDER_LIFE_MS = 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000;        // an unpaid order is offered again for this long
const PAGE_SIZE = 40;
const SITE_URL = 'https://THIS-APP-ADDRESS';     // this app's published site, no slash at the end

const fail = (status: number, error: string, message: string) => Response.json({ ok: false, error, message }, { status });
const answer = (fields: Record<string, unknown>) => Response.json({ ok: true, ...fields });

const text = (value: unknown, max: number) => String(value ?? '').trim().slice(0, max).trim();
const isEmail = (value: string) => /^[^\s@,;<>"']{1,64}@[^\s@,;<>"']+\.[^\s@,;<>"']{2,}$/.test(value) && value.length <= 254;
const amountText = (price: number) => price.toFixed(2);

function secret(name: string): string {
  return String(Deno.env.get(name) || '').trim();
}

async function sha256Hex(value: string): Promise<string> {
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(value));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

async function hmacHex(key: string, value: string): Promise<string> {
  const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(key), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', k, new TextEncoder().encode(value));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(signature), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

function toBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let binary = '';
  for (const b of bytes) binary += String.fromCharCode(b);
  return btoa(binary);
}

function newProductId(): string {
  const letters = 'abcdefghijkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789';
  const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(10));
  return 'sp-' + Array.from(bytes, (b) => letters[b % letters.length]).join('');
}

function parseList(value: unknown): string[] {
  try {
    const list = JSON.parse(String(value || '[]'));
    return Array.isArray(list) ? list.map(String) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

// The store's files (the sonify-store-files worker).
function filesUrl(): string {
  return secret('STORE_FILES_URL').replace(/\/+$/, '');
}

function fileKey(product: string, version: number, name: 'package.zip' | 'picture.png'): string {
  return `products/${product}/v${version}/${name}`;
}

function publicUrl(key: string): string {
  return key ? `${filesUrl()}/files/${key}` : '';
}

async function uploadUrl(key: string, type: string, max: number): Promise<string> {
  const exp = Date.now() + UPLOAD_LIFE_MS;
  const sig = await hmacHex(secret('STORE_FILES_SECRET'), `PUT\n${key}\n${exp}\n${max}\n${type}`);
  return `${filesUrl()}/upload/${key}?exp=${exp}&max=${max}&type=${encodeURIComponent(type)}&sig=${sig}`;
}

/** A file as the worker keeps it: its size and SHA-256, or null when it isn't there. */
async function fileInfo(key: string): Promise<{ size: number; sha256: string } | null> {
  const response = await fetch(publicUrl(key), { method: 'HEAD' });
  if (response.status === 404) return null;
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`files HEAD ${response.status}`);
  return { size: Number(response.headers.get('content-length') || 0), sha256: String(response.headers.get('x-content-sha256') || '') };
}

//==============================================================================
// Licences: Ed25519, signed with Fanan's private key (the STORE_LICENCE_KEY secret, PKCS #8 in
// base64). Sonify holds the public key and checks the signature over the payload's exact text.
let signingKey: CryptoKey | null = null;

async function licenceFor(product: string, computer: string, account: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!signingKey) {
    const der = Uint8Array.from(atob(secret('STORE_LICENCE_KEY')), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
    signingKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('pkcs8', der, { name: 'Ed25519' }, false, ['sign']);
  }

  const payload = JSON.stringify({ product, computer, account, issued: new Date().toISOString() });
  const signature = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('Ed25519', signingKey, new TextEncoder().encode(payload)));
  return JSON.stringify({ payload, signature: toBase64(signature) });
}

//==============================================================================
// PayPal: the same REST app, credentials and live or sandbox setting as the credit packs.
function paypalConfig() {
  const live = secret('PAYPAL_MODE').toLowerCase() !== 'sandbox';
  return {
    base: live ? 'https://api-m.paypal.com' : 'https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com',
    id: secret('PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID'),
    secret: secret('PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET'),
  };
}

let paypalToken = { value: '', until: 0 };

async function paypal(path: string, init: { method?: string; body?: string; headers?: Record<string, string> } = {}) {
  const config = paypalConfig();

  if (!paypalToken.value || Date.now() > paypalToken.until) {
    const response = await fetch(`${config.base}/v1/oauth2/token`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { authorization: 'Basic ' + btoa(`${config.id}:${config.secret}`), 'content-type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: 'grant_type=client_credentials',
    });
    const token = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!response.ok || !token.access_token) throw new Error(`paypal token ${response.status}`);
    paypalToken = { value: token.access_token, until: Date.now() + Math.max(60, Number(token.expires_in || 0) - 120) * 1000 };
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${config.base}${path}`, {
    method: init.method || 'GET',
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${paypalToken.value}`, 'content-type': 'application/json', ...(init.headers || {}) },
    body: init.body,
  });

  return { status: response.status, data: await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as any };
}

/** Where a purchase stands with PayPal: captured once approved, and checked (the amount, the
    currency and the seller's account) before it counts as paid. */
async function settle(purchase: any, purchases: any): Promise<{ state: 'paid' | 'waiting' | 'pending' | 'failed'; message?: string }> {
  if (purchase.status === 'completed') return { state: 'paid' };
  if (purchase.status === 'failed') return { state: 'failed', message: 'That payment didn\'t go through. Buy it again.' };

  const id = encodeURIComponent(purchase.order_id);
  let order = await paypal(`/v2/checkout/orders/${id}`);

  if (order.status === 404) {
    await purchases.update(purchase.id, { status: 'failed' });
    return { state: 'failed', message: 'That payment didn\'t go through. Buy it again.' };
  }

  if (order.status !== 200) throw new Error(`paypal order ${order.status}`);

  if (order.data.status === 'APPROVED') {
    const captured = await paypal(`/v2/checkout/orders/${id}/capture`, {
      method: 'POST', body: '{}', headers: { 'PayPal-Request-Id': `sonify-capture-${purchase.order_id}` },
    });
    const issue = captured.data?.details?.[0]?.issue;

    if (captured.status === 200 || captured.status === 201) {
      order = captured;
    } else if (issue === 'ORDER_ALREADY_CAPTURED') {
      order = await paypal(`/v2/checkout/orders/${id}`);
    } else if (issue === 'INSTRUMENT_DECLINED' || issue === 'PAYER_ACTION_REQUIRED') {
      return { state: 'waiting', message: 'PayPal needs another way to pay: finish it in the browser.' };
    } else {
      throw new Error(`paypal capture ${captured.status} ${issue || ''}`);
    }
  }

  const status = order.data.status;

  if (status === 'COMPLETED') {
    const unit = order.data.purchase_units?.[0] || {};
    const capture = unit.payments?.captures?.[0] || {};
    const payee = String(unit.payee?.email_address || purchase.paypal || '').toLowerCase();

    if (String(capture.amount?.value) !== amountText(purchase.price) || capture.amount?.currency_code !== purchase.currency
        || payee !== String(purchase.paypal).toLowerCase()) {
      console.error('store: a capture that doesn\'t match its purchase', purchase.order_id, JSON.stringify(capture.amount), payee);
      await purchases.update(purchase.id, { status: 'failed' });
      return { state: 'failed', message: 'That payment didn\'t match the purchase. Contact Fanan.' };
    }

    if (capture.status === 'COMPLETED') {
      await purchases.update(purchase.id, { status: 'completed', completed_at: Date.now(), capture_id: String(capture.id || '') });
      return { state: 'paid' };
    }

    if (capture.status === 'PENDING') {
      if (purchase.status !== 'pending') await purchases.update(purchase.id, { status: 'pending' });
      return { state: 'pending', message: 'PayPal is holding the payment until the seller accepts it. The licence comes once they do.' };
    }

    await purchases.update(purchase.id, { status: 'failed' });
    return { state: 'failed', message: 'That payment didn\'t go through. Buy it again.' };
  }

  if (status === 'VOIDED') {
    await purchases.update(purchase.id, { status: 'failed' });
    return { state: 'failed', message: 'That payment was cancelled. Buy it again.' };
  }

  return { state: 'waiting', message: 'Waiting for the payment in your browser.' };
}

//==============================================================================
function publicProduct(p: any, owned: boolean) {
  return {
    product: p.product, kind: p.kind, title: p.title, tagline: p.tagline || '', story: p.story || '',
    features: parseList(p.features), price: p.price || 0, currency: p.currency || 'USD', vendor: p.vendor || '',
    version: p.version || 0, picture: publicUrl(p.picture_key), size: p.package_size || 0, downloads: p.downloads || 0,
    published: p.published_at || 0, section: p.section || '', protected: p.protected === true, owned,
  };
}

/** The products this account owns: what it bought (paid) and what it sells. */
async function ownedIds(email: string, products: any, purchases: any): Promise<Set<string>> {
  const owned = new Set<string>();
  if (!email) return owned;
  for (const p of await products.filter({ seller_email: email })) owned.add(p.product);
  for (const b of await purchases.filter({ buyer_email: email, status: 'completed' })) owned.add(b.product);
  return owned;
}

async function handle(base44: any, body: any): Promise<Response> {
  const action = String(body?.action || '');
  const products = base44.asServiceRole.entities.StoreProduct;
  const purchases = base44.asServiceRole.entities.StorePurchase;

  //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The PayPal return page: the order is captured at once (Sonify also does it when it asks
  // for the licence, so a page closed early loses nothing).
  if (action === 'capture') {
    const order = text(body?.order, 64);
    const purchase = order ? (await purchases.filter({ order_id: order }))[0] : null;
    if (!purchase) return fail(404, 'not_found', 'That purchase isn\'t known.');
    const settled = await settle(purchase, purchases);
    const product = (await products.filter({ product: purchase.product }))[0];
    if (settled.state !== 'paid') return fail(409, settled.state, settled.message || 'The payment isn\'t done yet.');
    return answer({ title: product?.title || '' });
  }

  //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Sonify: the computer, and its account when it's signed in.
  const token = String(body?.token || '');
  if (!HEX64.test(token)) return fail(400, 'invalid', 'That request was malformed.');

  const computer = (await base44.asServiceRole.entities.StellaAccount.filter({ token_hash: await sha256Hex(token) }))[0];
  const email = String(computer?.linked_email || '');
  const open = ['list', 'get', 'download'].includes(action);

  if (!open && !computer)
    return fail(401, 'unknown', 'Fanan\'s server doesn\'t recognise this computer yet. Restart Sonify while online.');

  if (!open && !email)
    return fail(401, 'sign_in', 'Sign in to your Fanan account first.');

  // The computer as its licences name it: the device hash stellaAccount's hello keeps.
  const device = String(computer?.device_hash || body?.device || '').toLowerCase();

  const findProduct = async (id: unknown) => {
    const productId = text(id, 80);
    return PRODUCT_ID.test(productId) ? (await products.filter({ product: productId }))[0] || null : null;
  };

  //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (action === 'begin') {
    const key = text(body?.key, 80);
    const kind = String(body?.kind || '');
    const title = text(body?.title, MAX_TITLE);
    const price = Math.round(Number(body?.price || 0) * 100) / 100;
    const currency = String(body?.currency || 'USD').toUpperCase();
    const paypalEmail = text(body?.paypal, 254).toLowerCase();

    if (!key || !KINDS.includes(kind) || !title)
      return fail(400, 'invalid', 'The store needs its key, kind and title.');

    if (!(price === 0 || (price >= MIN_PRICE && price <= MAX_PRICE)) || !CURRENCIES.includes(currency))
      return fail(400, 'invalid_price', `A price is free, or ${MIN_PRICE} to ${MAX_PRICE} in ${CURRENCIES.join(', ')}.`);

    if (price > 0 && !isEmail(paypalEmail))
      return fail(400, 'invalid_paypal', 'A paid product needs the PayPal email buyers pay.');

    let product = body?.product ? await findProduct(body.product) : null;

    if (body?.product && !product)
      return fail(404, 'not_found', 'The store doesn\'t know that product.');

    if (product && product.seller_email !== email)
      return fail(403, 'not_yours', 'That product is another seller\'s.');

    if (product && product.kind !== kind)
      return fail(400, 'invalid', 'A product keeps its kind.');

    if (!product)
      product = (await products.filter({ seller_email: email, seller_key: key }))[0] || null;   // posted before, from this project

    if (!product) {
      if ((await products.filter({ seller_email: email })).length >= MAX_PRODUCTS_PER_SELLER)
        return fail(409, 'too_many', `A seller can have up to ${MAX_PRODUCTS_PER_SELLER} products in the store.`);

      let id = newProductId();
      while ((await products.filter({ product: id })).length > 0) id = newProductId();

      product = await products.create({
        product: id, seller_key: key, seller_email: email, kind, title, tagline: '', story: '', features: '[]',
        price, currency, paypal: paypalEmail, vendor: '', version: 0, package_key: '', picture_key: '', package_size: 0,
        package_sha256: '', protected: price > 0, status: 'pending', section: '', downloads: 0, published_at: 0,
        pending_version: 0, pending_at: 0,
      });
    }

    const version = (product.version || 0) + 1;
    await products.update(product.id, { pending_version: version, pending_at: Date.now() });

    return answer({
      product: product.product,
      version,
      uploads: {
        package: await uploadUrl(fileKey(product.product, version, 'package.zip'), 'application/zip', MAX_PACKAGE),
        picture: await uploadUrl(fileKey(product.product, version, 'picture.png'), 'image/png', MAX_PICTURE),
      },
    });
  }

  //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (action === 'publish') {
    const product = await findProduct(body?.product);
    const version = Number(body?.version || 0);

    if (!product) return fail(404, 'not_found', 'The store doesn\'t know that product.');
    if (product.seller_email !== email) return fail(403, 'not_yours', 'That product is another seller\'s.');
    if (!version || version !== product.pending_version) return fail(409, 'stale', 'That post is out of date. Post again.');

    const title = text(body?.title, MAX_TITLE);
    const price = Math.round(Number(body?.price || 0) * 100) / 100;
    const currency = String(body?.currency || 'USD').toUpperCase();
    const paypalEmail = text(body?.paypal, 254).toLowerCase();
    const features = (Array.isArray(body?.features) ? body.features : []).map((f: unknown) => text(f, MAX_FEATURE)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, MAX_FEATURES);

    if (!title || !(price === 0 || (price >= MIN_PRICE && price <= MAX_PRICE)) || !CURRENCIES.includes(currency)
        || (price > 0 && !isEmail(paypalEmail)))
      return fail(400, 'invalid', 'The store\'s details aren\'t complete.');

    const packageKey = fileKey(product.product, version, 'package.zip');
    const pictureKey = fileKey(product.product, version, 'picture.png');
    const [packageFile, pictureFile] = await Promise.all([fileInfo(packageKey), fileInfo(pictureKey)]);

    if (!packageFile || !pictureFile)
      return fail(409, 'missing_files', 'The files didn\'t all arrive. Post again.');

    if (packageFile.size !== Number(body?.packageSize) || (body?.packageSha256 && packageFile.sha256 !== String(body.packageSha256).toLowerCase()))
      return fail(409, 'damaged', 'The package arrived damaged. Post again.');

    await products.update(product.id, {
      title, tagline: text(body?.tagline, MAX_TAGLINE), story: text(body?.story, MAX_STORY), features: JSON.stringify(features),
      price, currency, paypal: price > 0 ? paypalEmail : '', vendor: text(body?.vendor, MAX_VENDOR), version,
      package_key: packageKey, picture_key: pictureKey, package_size: packageFile.size, package_sha256: packageFile.sha256,
      protected: body?.protected === true, status: product.status === 'hidden' ? 'hidden' : 'listed',
      published_at: Date.now(), pending_version: 0, pending_at: 0,
    });

    return answer({ product: product.product, version });
  }

  //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (action === 'list') {
    const kind = String(body?.kind || '');
    const section = text(body?.section, 60);
    const query = text(body?.query, 80).toLowerCase();
    const owned = await ownedIds(email, products, purchases);

    let found = (await products.filter({ status: 'listed' }, '-published_at', 1000))
      .filter((p: any) => (!kind || p.kind === kind) && (!section || p.section === section))
      .filter((p: any) => !query || [p.title, p.tagline, p.vendor, p.story].some((t) => String(t || '').toLowerCase().includes(query)));

    found.sort((a: any, b: any) => (b.published_at || 0) - (a.published_at || 0));

    const total = found.length;
    const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE));
    const page = Math.min(pages, Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(body?.page || 1))));
    found = found.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE);

    return answer({ products: found.map((p: any) => publicProduct(p, owned.has(p.product))), page, pages, total });
  }

  if (action === 'get' || action === 'download') {
    const product = await findProduct(body?.product);

    if (!product || (product.status !== 'listed' && product.seller_email !== email) || !product.version)
      return fail(404, 'not_found', 'That isn\'t in the store.');

    const owned = (await ownedIds(email, products, purchases)).has(product.product);

    if (action === 'get')
      return answer({ product: publicProduct(product, owned) });

    await products.update(product.id, { downloads: (product.downloads || 0) + 1 });

    return answer({
      url: publicUrl(product.package_key), version: product.version, size: product.package_size, sha256: product.package_sha256,
      kind: product.kind, owned,
      store: { product: product.product, title: product.title, price: product.price || 0, currency: product.currency || 'USD' },
    });
  }

  //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (action === 'mine') {
    const mine = await products.filter({ seller_email: email });
    return answer({
      products: mine.filter((p: any) => p.status !== 'removed').map((p: any) => ({
        ...publicProduct(p, true), key: p.seller_key, paypal: p.paypal || '', status: p.status,
      })),
    });
  }

  if (action === 'hide') {
    const product = await findProduct(body?.product);
    if (!product || product.status === 'removed') return fail(404, 'not_found', 'The store doesn\'t know that product.');
    if (product.seller_email !== email) return fail(403, 'not_yours', 'That product is another seller\'s.');
    if (!product.version) return fail(409, 'not_posted', 'It hasn\'t been posted yet.');
    await products.update(product.id, { status: body?.hidden === true ? 'hidden' : 'listed' });
    return answer({ product: product.product, hidden: body?.hidden === true });
  }

  //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (action === 'buy' || action === 'licence' || action === 'release') {
    const product = await findProduct(body?.product);

    if (!product || product.status === 'removed' || !product.version)
      return fail(404, 'not_found', 'That isn\'t in the store.');

    if (!(product.price > 0))
      return fail(409, 'free', 'It\'s free: it needs no licence.');

    const mineToSell = product.seller_email === email;
    const all = (await purchases.filter({ product: product.product, buyer_email: email }))
      .sort((a: any, b: any) => (b.created_at || 0) - (a.created_at || 0));
    const paid = all.find((p: any) => p.status === 'completed');

    if (action === 'release') {
      if (paid) await purchases.update(paid.id, { computers: JSON.stringify(parseList(paid.computers).filter((c) => c !== device)) });
      return answer({ product: product.product });
    }

    if (action === 'buy') {
      if (mineToSell || paid) return answer({ owned: true });
      if (product.status !== 'listed') return fail(404, 'not_found', 'That isn\'t in the store.');

      // An order not paid yet is offered again for a while, if the price hasn't changed since.
      const waiting = all.find((p: any) => (p.status === 'created' || p.status === 'pending') && Date.now() - (p.created_at || 0) < ORDER_LIFE_MS
                                           && p.price === product.price && p.currency === product.currency && p.approve_url);
      if (waiting) return answer({ order: waiting.order_id, approve: waiting.approve_url });

      const purchase = await purchases.create({
        product: product.product, buyer_email: email, seller_email: product.seller_email, price: product.price,
        currency: product.currency, paypal: product.paypal, order_id: '', approve_url: '', status: 'created', computers: '[]',
        created_at: Date.now(), completed_at: 0, capture_id: '',
      });

      const created = await paypal('/v2/checkout/orders', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'PayPal-Request-Id': `sonify-order-${purchase.id}` },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          intent: 'CAPTURE',
          purchase_units: [{
            reference_id: product.product,
            custom_id: String(purchase.id),
            description: `${product.title} (Sonify store)`.slice(0, 127),
            amount: { currency_code: product.currency, value: amountText(product.price) },
            payee: { email_address: product.paypal },
          }],
          payment_source: { paypal: { experience_context: {
            brand_name: 'Sonify store', user_action: 'PAY_NOW', shipping_preference: 'NO_SHIPPING',
            return_url: `${SITE_URL}/store-paid`, cancel_url: `${SITE_URL}/store-cancelled`,
          } } },
        }),
      });

      const approve = (created.data?.links || []).find((l: any) => l.rel === 'payer-action' || l.rel === 'approve')?.href;

      if ((created.status !== 200 && created.status !== 201) || !created.data?.id || !approve) {
        console.error('store: PayPal order failed', created.status, JSON.stringify(created.data).slice(0, 2000));
        await purchases.update(purchase.id, { status: 'failed' });
        return fail(502, 'paypal', 'PayPal couldn\'t start the payment right now. Please try again.');
      }

      await purchases.update(purchase.id, { order_id: created.data.id, approve_url: approve });
      return answer({ order: created.data.id, approve });
    }

    // licence
    if (!HEX64.test(device))
      return fail(400, 'invalid', 'This computer can\'t be told apart. Restart Sonify while online.');

    let purchase = paid || null;

    if (!mineToSell && !purchase) {
      const open = all.find((p: any) => p.status === 'created' || p.status === 'pending');
      if (!open) return fail(404, 'not_bought', 'This account hasn\'t bought it.');

      const settled = await settle(open, purchases);
      if (settled.state !== 'paid') return fail(409, settled.state, settled.message || 'The payment isn\'t done yet.');
      purchase = (await purchases.filter({ order_id: open.order_id }))[0] || open;
    }

    if (purchase) {
      const computers = parseList(purchase.computers);

      if (!computers.includes(device)) {
        if (computers.length >= MAX_COMPUTERS)
          return fail(409, 'too_many_computers', `It's licensed on ${MAX_COMPUTERS} computers already. Release it on one of them first.`);

        computers.push(device);
        await purchases.update(purchase.id, { computers: JSON.stringify(computers) });
      }
    }

    return answer({ product: product.product, licence: await licenceFor(product.product, device, email) });
  }

  if (action === 'owned') {
    const owned = await ownedIds(email, products, purchases);
    const list: any[] = [];

    for (const id of owned) {
      const p = await findProduct(id);
      if (p && p.version && p.status !== 'removed') list.push({ product: p.product, title: p.title, kind: p.kind, version: p.version });
    }

    return answer({ products: list });
  }

  return fail(400, 'invalid', 'That request was malformed.');
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    return await handle(base44, body);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('store failed:', error);
    return fail(500, 'failed', 'The store couldn\'t do that right now. Please try again.');
  }
});

**5. Two small pages** in the site's style, with no sign-in needed:
- `/store-paid`: PayPal brings the buyer back here with `?token=<the order id>`. The page calls `sonifyStore` with `{ action: 'capture', order: <token> }`. On `ok`: "Paid: thank you! Go back to Sonify: your licence for <title> arrives by itself in a few seconds." Otherwise it shows the answer's `message`, and for `error` `waiting` or `pending` adds "You can close this page: Sonify checks again by itself."
- `/store-cancelled`: "The purchase was cancelled, and nothing was charged. You can buy it again in Sonify's store."

# D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\BasicPitch.cmake
#
# Audio > Audio to MIDI (Notes): Spotify's Basic Pitch model (Apache 2.0), nmp.onnx, 230 KB, built
# into Sonify as binary data and run through ONNX Runtime (OnnxRuntime.cmake), as Split into
# Stems runs its own.
#
# Downloaded once into <build>/deps from the basic-pitch repository at a pinned commit, checked
# against its SHA-256. As with Lame.cmake, a copy kept beside the project (deps\ next to
# CMakeLists.txt, copied there from a build folder) is used instead when it's this very file.
#
# Sets FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_MODEL (empty without it: Sonify builds, and says Audio to MIDI's Notes
# needs it; Drums still works).

include_guard(GLOBAL)

set(FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_COMMIT "fa5997af0a8210982619003269994a1be25eddf3")
set(FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_SHA256 "2c3c1d144bfa61ad236e92e169c13535c880469a12a047d4e73451f2c059a0ec")
set(FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_MODEL "")

if(NOT DEFINED FANAN_DEPS_DIR)
    set(FANAN_DEPS_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/deps")
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR)
    set(FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps")
endif()

set(_bp_name "basic-pitch-${FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_COMMIT}")
set(_bp_file "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/${_bp_name}/nmp.onnx")

# The copy kept beside the project, when it's this very file.
if(EXISTS "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_bp_name}/nmp.onnx")
    file(SHA256 "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_bp_name}/nmp.onnx" _bp_kept_hash)

    if(_bp_kept_hash STREQUAL FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_SHA256)
        set(_bp_file "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_bp_name}/nmp.onnx")
        message(STATUS "Using ${_bp_name} kept in ${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}")
    endif()
endif()

if(EXISTS "${_bp_file}")
    file(SHA256 "${_bp_file}" _bp_hash)

    if(NOT _bp_hash STREQUAL FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_SHA256)
        file(REMOVE "${_bp_file}")
    endif()
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${_bp_file}")
    message(STATUS "Downloading the Basic Pitch model")
    file(DOWNLOAD
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spotify/basic-pitch/${FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_COMMIT}/basic_pitch/saved_models/icassp_2022/nmp.onnx"
        "${_bp_file}.part"
        STATUS _bp_status
        TLS_VERIFY ON)
    list(GET _bp_status 0 _bp_code)

    # Checked here rather than by file(DOWNLOAD): anything but this very file (an error page
    # from a proxy, say) leaves Sonify building without it rather than stopping the build.
    set(_bp_got_hash "")

    if(_bp_code EQUAL 0)
        file(SHA256 "${_bp_file}.part" _bp_got_hash)
    endif()

    if(_bp_got_hash STREQUAL FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_SHA256)
        file(RENAME "${_bp_file}.part" "${_bp_file}")
    else()
        file(REMOVE "${_bp_file}.part")
        message(WARNING "Download of the Basic Pitch model failed (${_bp_status}): Sonify builds without Audio to MIDI's Notes.")
        return()
    endif()
endif()

set(FANAN_BASIC_PITCH_MODEL "${_bp_file}")

namespace

    constexpr int kRowH   = 24;

    void styleLabelFor (juce::Label& l)
    {
        l.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colour (0xffc0c0c4));

        s.setRange (min, max, interval);

//==============================================================================
void paintContourThumbnail (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<int> bounds,
                            const Contour& contour, bool highlighted)
{
    auto r = bounds.toFloat().reduced (3.0f);

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff1b1b1e));
    g.fillRect (bounds);

    // Filled under the curve, like Photoshop's: the area reads the shape faster
    // than a hairline does at this size.
    juce::Path fill;
    fill.startNewSubPath (r.getX(), r.getBottom());

    for (int px = 0; px <= (int) r.getWidth(); ++px)
    {
        const float x = (float) px / juce::jmax (1.0f, r.getWidth());
        fill.lineTo (r.getX() + x * r.getWidth(),
                     r.getBottom() - contour.at (x) * r.getHeight());
    }

    fill.lineTo (r.getRight(), r.getBottom());
    fill.closeSubPath();

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffd8d8dc));
    g.fillPath (fill);

    g.setColour (highlighted ? juce::Colour (0xff5a9fe0) : juce::Colour (0xff3a3a42));
    g.drawRect (bounds, highlighted ? 2 : 1);
}

//==============================================================================
namespace
{
    /** The drop-down grid of preset curves. */
    class ContourGrid final : public juce::Component
    {
    public:
        explicit ContourGrid (std::function<void (int)> callback) : pick (std::move (callback))
        {
            const int count = Contour::presetNames().size();
            rows = (count + kColumns - 1) / kColumns;

            setSize (kColumns * kCell + 8, rows * kCell + 8);
        }

        void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override
        {
            g.fillAll (juce::Colour (0xff2b2b30));

            const int count = Contour::presetNames().size();

            for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                paintContourThumbnail (g, cellBounds (i), Contour::preset (i), i == hover);
        }

        void mouseMove (const juce::MouseEvent& e) override
        {
            const int i = indexAt (e.getPosition());

            if (i != hover) { hover = i; repaint(); }
        }

        void mouseExit (const juce::MouseEvent&) override { hover = -1; repaint(); }

        void mouseUp (const juce::MouseEvent& e) override
        {
            const int i = indexAt (e.getPosition());

            if (i >= 0 && pick != nullptr)
                pick (i);

            if (auto* box = findParentComponentOfClass<juce::CallOutBox>())
                box->dismiss();
        }

    private:
        static constexpr int kColumns = 4;
        static constexpr int kCell    = 62;

        juce::Rectangle<int> cellBounds (int i) const
        {
            return { 4 + (i % kColumns) * kCell, 4 + (i / kColumns) * kCell, kCell - 4, kCell - 4 };
        }

        int indexAt (juce::Point<int> position) const
        {
            const int count = Contour::presetNames().size();

            for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                if (cellBounds (i).contains (position))
                    return i;

            return -1;
        }

        std::function<void (int)> pick;
        int rows = 1;
        int hover = -1;
    };
}

ContourPresetButton::ContourPresetButton() : juce::Button ("contour")
{
}

void ContourPresetButton::setContour (const Contour& c)
{
    contour = c;
    repaint();
}

void ContourPresetButton::paintButton (juce::Graphics& g, bool over, bool)
{
    paintContourThumbnail (g, getLocalBounds(), contour, over);

    // The little chevron, so it reads as something that opens.
    auto arrow = getLocalBounds().removeFromRight (12).withSizeKeepingCentre (7, 4).toFloat();

    juce::Path p;
    p.addTriangle (arrow.getX(), arrow.getY(),
                   arrow.getRight(), arrow.getY(),
                   arrow.getCentreX(), arrow.getBottom());

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff8a8a92));
    g.fillPath (p);
}

void ContourPresetButton::clicked()
{
    auto grid = std::make_unique<ContourGrid> ([this] (int index)
    {
        setContour (Contour::preset (index));

        if (onPick != nullptr)
            onPick (contour);
    });

    juce::CallOutBox::launchAsynchronously (std::move (grid), getScreenBounds(), nullptr);
}

//==============================================================================
void AngleDial::setAngle (float degrees)
{
    angle = degrees;
    repaint();
}

void AngleDial::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    auto r = getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (2.0f);
    const auto centre = r.getCentre();
    const float radius = juce::jmin (r.getWidth(), r.getHeight()) * 0.5f;

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff1b1b1e));
    g.fillEllipse (r);
    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff4a4a52));
    g.drawEllipse (r, 1.0f);

    // Screen space: y runs down, so the y term is negated to match the way the
    // renderer reads this same angle.
    const float a = angle * juce::MathConstants<float>::pi / 180.0f;
    const juce::Point<float> tip (centre.x + std::cos (a) * radius * 0.82f,
                                  centre.y - std::sin (a) * radius * 0.82f);

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffe8c020));
    g.drawLine (centre.x, centre.y, tip.x, tip.y, 1.6f);
    g.fillEllipse (tip.x - 2.5f, tip.y - 2.5f, 5.0f, 5.0f);
}

void AngleDial::mouseDown (const juce::MouseEvent& e) { setFromMouse (e); }
void AngleDial::mouseDrag (const juce::MouseEvent& e) { setFromMouse (e); }

void AngleDial::setFromMouse (const juce::MouseEvent& e)
{
    const auto centre = getLocalBounds().toFloat().getCentre();
    const float dx = e.position.x - centre.x;
    const float dy = centre.y - e.position.y;

    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 4.0f)
        return;

    angle = std::atan2 (dy, dx) * 180.0f / juce::MathConstants<float>::pi;
    repaint();

    if (onChange != nullptr)
        onChange();
}

//==============================================================================
void BevelPreview::setImage (juce::Image newImage)
{
    image = std::move (newImage);
    repaint();
}

void BevelPreview::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    auto r = getLocalBounds();

    // Checker, so an Outer Bevel painting outside the shape is readable rather
    // than sitting invisible on a flat background.
    constexpr int cell = 8;
    g.fillAll (juce::Colour (0xff2a2a2e));
    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff232327));

    for (int y = 0; y < r.getHeight(); y += cell)
        for (int x = 0; x < r.getWidth(); x += cell)
            if (((x / cell) + (y / cell)) % 2 == 0)
                g.fillRect (x, y, cell, cell);

    if (image.isValid())
    {
        g.setImageResamplingQuality (juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);
        g.drawImage (image, r.reduced (4).toFloat(),
                     juce::RectanglePlacement::centred);
    }

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff3a3a42));
    g.drawRect (r, 1);
}

//==============================================================================
ContourEditor::ContourEditor()
{
    setMouseCursor (juce::MouseCursor::CrosshairCursor);
}

void ContourEditor::setContour (const Contour& c)
{
    contour = c;
    repaint();
}

juce::Point<float> ContourEditor::toScreen (float x, float y) const
{
    auto r = getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (6.0f);

    return { r.getX() + x * r.getWidth(),
             r.getBottom() - y * r.getHeight() };
}

juce::Point<float> ContourEditor::toCurve (juce::Point<float> screen) const
{
    auto r = getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (6.0f);

    return { juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, (screen.x - r.getX()) / juce::jmax (1.0f, r.getWidth())),
             juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, (r.getBottom() - screen.y) / juce::jmax (1.0f, r.getHeight())) };
}

int ContourEditor::hitTest (juce::Point<float> position) const
{
    for (int i = 0; i < (int) contour.points.size(); ++i)
        if (toScreen (contour.points[(size_t) i].x, contour.points[(size_t) i].y)
                .getDistanceFrom (position) < 7.0f)
            return i;

    return -1;
}

void ContourEditor::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    auto r = getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (6.0f);

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff17171a));
    g.fillRect (getLocalBounds());

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff2e2e34));

    for (int i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
    {
        const float f = (float) i / 4.0f;
        g.drawHorizontalLine ((int) (r.getY() + f * r.getHeight()), r.getX(), r.getRight());
        g.drawVerticalLine   ((int) (r.getX() + f * r.getWidth()),  r.getY(), r.getBottom());
    }

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff3a3a42));
    g.drawRect (r, 1.0f);

    // The curve, sampled per pixel so a corner point reads as a genuine corner.
    juce::Path path;

    for (int px = 0; px <= (int) r.getWidth(); ++px)
    {
        const float x = (float) px / juce::jmax (1.0f, r.getWidth());
        const auto point = toScreen (x, contour.at (x));

        if (px == 0) path.startNewSubPath (point);
        else         path.lineTo (point);
    }

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffe8c020));
    g.strokePath (path, juce::PathStrokeType (1.6f));

    for (const auto& p : contour.points)
    {
        const auto c = toScreen (p.x, p.y);

        g.setColour (p.corner ? juce::Colour (0xffe8c020) : juce::Colour (0xff8fd0ff));

        // Corner points are drawn square, smooth ones round — so you can see
        // which is which without selecting anything.
        if (p.corner) g.fillRect (c.x - 3.5f, c.y - 3.5f, 7.0f, 7.0f);
        else          g.fillEllipse (c.x - 4.0f, c.y - 4.0f, 8.0f, 8.0f);
    }
}

void ContourEditor::mouseDown (const juce::MouseEvent& e)
{
    const auto position = e.position;
    const int index = hitTest (position);

    if (e.mods.isPopupMenu())
    {
        if (index > 0 && index < (int) contour.points.size() - 1)
        {
            contour.removePoint (index);
            repaint();

            if (onChange != nullptr)
                onChange();
        }

        return;
    }

    if (index >= 0)
    {
        dragging = index;
        return;
    }

    const auto c = toCurve (position);
    contour.addPoint (c.x, c.y);
    dragging = hitTest (position);
    repaint();

    if (onChange != nullptr)
        onChange();
}

void ContourEditor::mouseDrag (const juce::MouseEvent& e)
{
    if (dragging < 0 || dragging >= (int) contour.points.size())
        return;

    auto& p = contour.points[(size_t) dragging];
    const auto c = toCurve (e.position);

    p.y = c.y;

    // The two anchors stay pinned to 0 and 1 horizontally, or the curve would
    // have a range it cannot be evaluated over.
    if (dragging > 0 && dragging < (int) contour.points.size() - 1)
    {
        const float lo = contour.points[(size_t) dragging - 1].x + 0.01f;
        const float hi = contour.points[(size_t) dragging + 1].x - 0.01f;
        p.x = juce::jlimit (lo, juce::jmax (lo, hi), c.x);
    }

    repaint();

    if (onChange != nullptr)
        onChange();
}

void ContourEditor::mouseUp (const juce::MouseEvent&)
{
    dragging = -1;
}

void ContourEditor::mouseDoubleClick (const juce::MouseEvent& e)
{
    const int index = hitTest (e.position);

    if (index < 0)
        return;

    contour.points[(size_t) index].corner = ! contour.points[(size_t) index].corner;
    repaint();

    if (onChange != nullptr)
        onChange();
}

//==============================================================================
BevelDialog::BevelDialog (PrimitivePanel& owner) : panel (&owner)
{
    addAndMakeVisible (enableButton);
    enableButton.onClick = [this] { pull(); updateEnablement(); };

    for (auto* l : { &structureHeader, &shadingHeader })
    {
        styleHeader (*l);
        addAndMakeVisible (l);
    }

    for (auto* l : { &styleLabel, &techniqueLabel, &depthLabel, &sizeLabel, &softenLabel,
                     &directionLabel, &angleLabel, &altitudeLabel, &contourLabel,
                     &highlightLabel, &shadowLabel, &highlightOpacityLabel, &shadowOpacityLabel })
    {
        styleLabelFor (*l);
        addAndMakeVisible (l);
    }

    styleBox.addItemList (bevelStyleNames(), 1);
    techniqueBox.addItemList (bevelTechniqueNames(), 1);
    fillBlendModes (highlightModeBox);
    fillBlendModes (shadowModeBox);

    for (auto* c : { &styleBox, &techniqueBox, &highlightModeBox, &shadowModeBox })
    {
        c->onChange = [this] { pull(); };
        addAndMakeVisible (c);
    }

    styleHeader (contourHeader);
    addAndMakeVisible (contourHeader);

    styleLabelFor (rangeLabel);
    addAndMakeVisible (rangeLabel);

    contourEnableButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        // A contour that is still the default straight line maps every height to
        // itself, so ticking this would change nothing — the same trap the
        // Enabled toggle had. Seed a curve that visibly does something, but only
        // while the curve has never been touched.
        if (contourEnableButton.getToggleState()
              && bevelContourEditor.getContour().points.size() <= 2)
        {
            bevelContourEditor.setContour (Contour::preset (3));   // Half Round
            bevelContourPresetBox.setContour (Contour::preset (3));
        }

        pull();
    };
    addAndMakeVisible (contourEnableButton);

    bevelContourPresetBox.onPick = [this] (const Contour& c)
    {
        bevelContourEditor.setContour (c);
        pull();
    };
    addAndMakeVisible (bevelContourPresetBox);

    bevelContourEditor.onChange = [this] { pull(); };
    contourEditor.onChange = [this] { pull(); };
    addAndMakeVisible (bevelContourEditor);

    addAndMakeVisible (preview);

    contourPresetBox.onPick = [this] (const Contour& c)
    {
        contourEditor.setContour (c);
        pull();
    };
    addAndMakeVisible (contourPresetBox);

    antiAliasButton.onClick = [this] { pull(); };
    addAndMakeVisible (antiAliasButton);

    angleDial.onChange = [this]
    {
        angleSlider.setValue (angleDial.getAngle(), juce::dontSendNotification);
        pull();
    };
    addAndMakeVisible (angleDial);

    styleSlider (depthSlider,   1.0,  1000.0, 1.0);
    styleSlider (sizeSlider,    0.5,   100.0, 0.5);
    styleSlider (softenSlider,  0.0,    24.0, 0.5);
    styleSlider (angleSlider, -180.0,  180.0, 1.0);
    styleSlider (altitudeSlider, 0.0,   90.0, 1.0);
    styleSlider (rangeSlider, 1.0, 100.0, 1.0);
    styleSlider (highlightOpacitySlider, 0.0, 100.0, 1.0);
    styleSlider (shadowOpacitySlider,    0.0, 100.0, 1.0);

    for (auto* s : { &depthSlider, &sizeSlider, &softenSlider, &angleSlider, &altitudeSlider,
                     &rangeSlider, &highlightOpacitySlider, &shadowOpacitySlider })
    {
        s->onValueChange = [this] { pull(); };
        addAndMakeVisible (s);
    }

    // Radio pair: Direction is Up or Down, never neither.
    upButton.setRadioGroupId (7001);
    downButton.setRadioGroupId (7001);
    upButton.onClick   = [this] { pull(); };
    downButton.onClick = [this] { pull(); };
    addAndMakeVisible (upButton);
    addAndMakeVisible (downButton);

    globalLightButton.onClick = [this] { pull(); resized(); };
    addAndMakeVisible (globalLightButton);

    contourEditor.onChange = [this] { pull(); };
    addAndMakeVisible (contourEditor);

    highlightColourButton.onClick = [this] { openColour (highlightColourButton, true); };
    shadowColourButton.onClick    = [this] { openColour (shadowColourButton, false); };
    addAndMakeVisible (highlightColourButton);
    addAndMakeVisible (shadowColourButton);

    configurePanelControls (*this);

    // Two columns rather than one tall stack: with a second contour and a live
    // preview the single-column form ran to about 780px, which does not fit on
    // a laptop once the title bar is counted.
    setSize (764, 512);
    lastTarget = target();
    refresh();

    // The layer under us can change while this window is open — a different
    // selection, or the layer deleted outright. Poll rather than assume.
    startTimer (300);
}

BevelDialog::~BevelDialog()
{
    stopTimer();
    openWindow = nullptr;
}

//==============================================================================
void BevelDialog::launch (PrimitivePanel& owner)
{
    if (openWindow != nullptr)
    {
        openWindow->toFront (true);
        return;
    }

    juce::DialogWindow::LaunchOptions options;
    options.content.setOwned (new BevelDialog (owner));
    options.dialogTitle = "Bevel & Emboss";
    options.dialogBackgroundColour = juce::Colour (0xff262629);
    options.escapeKeyTriggersCloseButton = true;
    options.useNativeTitleBar = true;
    options.resizable = false;

    // Non-modal: the canvas keeps re-rendering behind it, so there is no need
    // for Photoshop's Preview checkbox.
    openWindow = options.launchAsync();
}

//==============================================================================
BevelSpec* BevelDialog::target() const
{
    if (auto* p = panel.getComponent())
        return p->getBevelTarget();

    return nullptr;
}

void BevelDialog::notifyChanged()
{
    if (auto* p = panel.getComponent())
        p->bevelChanged();
}

void BevelDialog::timerCallback()
{
    if (panel.getComponent() == nullptr)
    {
        setEnabled (false);
        return;
    }

    // Its own window, so a sensitivity change in the toolbar does not reach it
    // any other way. Cheap enough at this rate to just re-apply.
    configurePanelControls (*this);

    // Only re-read the document when the layer under us actually changed.
    // Doing it every tick fought any slider being dragged: setValue does not
    // update the Slider's internal drag anchor, so the next mouse event
    // snapped straight back to the value the timer had just written.
    auto* b = target();

    if (b != lastTarget)
    {
        lastTarget = b;
        refresh();
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void BevelDialog::refresh()
{
    auto* b = target();

    setEnabled (b != nullptr);

    if (b == nullptr)
        return;

    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<bool> guard (updating, true);

    enableButton.setToggleState (b->enabled, juce::dontSendNotification);
    styleBox.setSelectedId ((int) b->style + 1, juce::dontSendNotification);
    techniqueBox.setSelectedId ((int) b->technique + 1, juce::dontSendNotification);

    depthSlider.setValue (b->depth,   juce::dontSendNotification);
    sizeSlider.setValue (b->size,     juce::dontSendNotification);
    softenSlider.setValue (b->soften, juce::dontSendNotification);

    upButton.setToggleState (b->up, juce::dontSendNotification);
    downButton.setToggleState (! b->up, juce::dontSendNotification);

    globalLightButton.setToggleState (b->useGlobalLight, juce::dontSendNotification);
    angleSlider.setValue (b->angle,       juce::dontSendNotification);
    altitudeSlider.setValue (b->altitude, juce::dontSendNotification);

    contourEnableButton.setToggleState (b->contourEnabled, juce::dontSendNotification);
    bevelContourEditor.setContour (b->bevelContour);
    bevelContourPresetBox.setContour (b->bevelContour);
    rangeSlider.setValue (b->contourRange, juce::dontSendNotification);

    contourEditor.setContour (b->glossContour);
    contourPresetBox.setContour (b->glossContour);
    antiAliasButton.setToggleState (b->antiAliased, juce::dontSendNotification);
    angleDial.setAngle (b->angle);

    highlightModeBox.setSelectedId ((int) b->highlightMode + 1, juce::dontSendNotification);
    highlightColourButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, b->highlightColour);
    highlightColourButton.setButtonText (b->highlightColour.toDisplayString (true));
    highlightOpacitySlider.setValue (b->highlightOpacity, juce::dontSendNotification);

    shadowModeBox.setSelectedId ((int) b->shadowMode + 1, juce::dontSendNotification);
    shadowColourButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, b->shadowColour);
    shadowColourButton.setButtonText (b->shadowColour.toDisplayString (true));
    shadowOpacitySlider.setValue (b->shadowOpacity, juce::dontSendNotification);

    updateEnablement();
    refreshPreview();
}

void BevelDialog::refreshPreview()
{
    if (auto* p = panel.getComponent())
        if (p->makeLayerThumbnail != nullptr)
            preview.setImage (p->makeLayerThumbnail());
}

void BevelDialog::updateEnablement()
{
    // Nothing below the toggle does anything while the bevel is off, so nothing
    // below the toggle should look as though it might.
    const bool on = enableButton.getToggleState() && target() != nullptr;

    for (auto* child : getChildren())
        if (child != &enableButton)
            child->setEnabled (on);
}

void BevelDialog::pull()
{
    if (updating)
        return;

    auto* b = target();

    if (b == nullptr)
        return;

    b->enabled   = enableButton.getToggleState();
    b->style     = (BevelStyle) juce::jlimit (0, (int) BevelStyle::numStyles - 1,
                                              styleBox.getSelectedId() - 1);
    b->technique = (BevelTechnique) juce::jlimit (0, (int) BevelTechnique::numTechniques - 1,
                                                  techniqueBox.getSelectedId() - 1);

    b->depth  = (float) depthSlider.getValue();
    b->size   = (float) sizeSlider.getValue();
    b->soften = (float) softenSlider.getValue();
    b->up     = upButton.getToggleState();

    b->useGlobalLight = globalLightButton.getToggleState();
    b->angle    = (float) angleSlider.getValue();
    b->altitude = (float) altitudeSlider.getValue();

    b->contourEnabled = contourEnableButton.getToggleState();
    b->bevelContour   = bevelContourEditor.getContour();
    b->contourRange   = (float) rangeSlider.getValue();

    b->glossContour = contourEditor.getContour();
    b->antiAliased  = antiAliasButton.getToggleState();

    contourPresetBox.setContour (b->glossContour);
    bevelContourPresetBox.setContour (b->bevelContour);

    b->highlightMode    = (BlendMode) juce::jlimit (0, (int) BlendMode::numModes - 1,
                                                    highlightModeBox.getSelectedId() - 1);
    b->highlightOpacity = (float) highlightOpacitySlider.getValue();

    b->shadowMode    = (BlendMode) juce::jlimit (0, (int) BlendMode::numModes - 1,
                                                 shadowModeBox.getSelectedId() - 1);
    b->shadowOpacity = (float) shadowOpacitySlider.getValue();

    notifyChanged();
    refreshPreview();
}

//==============================================================================
void BevelDialog::openColour (juce::TextButton& button, bool highlight)
{
    if (target() == nullptr)
        return;

    editingHighlightColour = highlight;

    auto selector = std::make_unique<juce::ColourSelector> (
        juce::ColourSelector::showColourAtTop | juce::ColourSelector::showSliders
      | juce::ColourSelector::showColourspace | juce::ColourSelector::showAlphaChannel);

    selector->setCurrentColour (highlight ? target()->highlightColour : target()->shadowColour,
                                juce::dontSendNotification);
    selector->setSize (300, 380);
    selector->addChangeListener (this);

    juce::CallOutBox::launchAsynchronously (std::move (selector),
                                            button.getScreenBounds(), nullptr);
}

void BevelDialog::changeListenerCallback (juce::ChangeBroadcaster* source)
{
    auto* b = target();

    if (b == nullptr)
        return;

    if (auto* selector = dynamic_cast<juce::ColourSelector*> (source))
    {
        if (editingHighlightColour) b->highlightColour = selector->getCurrentColour();
        else                        b->shadowColour    = selector->getCurrentColour();

        refresh();
        notifyChanged();
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void BevelDialog::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (juce::Colour (0xff262629));
}

void BevelDialog::resized()
{
    auto area = getLocalBounds().reduced (kMargin);

    // Two columns. Structure and the bevel Contour on the left, everything to
    // do with light on the right, with the live thumbnail beside it.
    auto left  = area.removeFromLeft ((area.getWidth() - kMargin) / 2);
    area.removeFromLeft (kMargin);
    auto right = area;

    auto row = [] (juce::Rectangle<int>& column, int height)
    {
        auto r = column.removeFromTop (height);
        column.removeFromTop (4);
        return r;
    };

    auto labelled = [] (juce::Rectangle<int> r, juce::Component& label, juce::Component& control)
    {
        label.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (kLabelW));
        control.setBounds (r);
    };

    //--------------------------------------------------------------- left ----
    enableButton.setBounds (row (left, kRowH));
    left.removeFromTop (6);

    structureHeader.setBounds (row (left, 20));
    labelled (row (left, kRowH), styleLabel, styleBox);
    labelled (row (left, kRowH), techniqueLabel, techniqueBox);
    labelled (row (left, kRowH), depthLabel, depthSlider);

    {
        auto r = row (left, kRowH);
        directionLabel.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (kLabelW));
        upButton.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (70));
        r.removeFromLeft (8);
        downButton.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (80));
    }

    labelled (row (left, kRowH), sizeLabel, sizeSlider);
    labelled (row (left, kRowH), softenLabel, softenSlider);

    left.removeFromTop (8);
    contourHeader.setBounds (row (left, 20));

    {
        auto r = row (left, kRowH);
        contourEnableButton.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (kLabelW));
        bevelContourPresetBox.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (72));
    }

    bevelContourEditor.setBounds (left.removeFromTop (118));
    left.removeFromTop (4);

    labelled (row (left, kRowH), rangeLabel, rangeSlider);

    //-------------------------------------------------------------- right ----
    // The thumbnail sits at the top of the light column, where the eye already
    // is while pushing Angle and Altitude around.
    preview.setBounds (right.removeFromTop (118).removeFromLeft (118));
    right.removeFromTop (6);

    shadingHeader.setBounds (row (right, 20));

    {
        auto r = row (right, kRowH);
        r.removeFromLeft (kLabelW);
        globalLightButton.setBounds (r);
    }

    const bool custom = ! globalLightButton.getToggleState();

    angleLabel.setVisible (custom);
    angleSlider.setVisible (custom);
    angleDial.setVisible (custom);
    altitudeLabel.setVisible (custom);
    altitudeSlider.setVisible (custom);

    if (custom)
    {
        auto r = row (right, kRowH);
        angleLabel.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (kLabelW));
        angleDial.setBounds (r.removeFromRight (kRowH));
        r.removeFromRight (6);
        angleSlider.setBounds (r);

        labelled (row (right, kRowH), altitudeLabel, altitudeSlider);
    }

    {
        auto r = row (right, kRowH);
        contourLabel.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (kLabelW));
        contourPresetBox.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (72));
        r.removeFromLeft (10);
        antiAliasButton.setBounds (r);
    }

    contourEditor.setBounds (right.removeFromTop (96));
    right.removeFromTop (6);

    {
        auto r = row (right, kRowH);
        highlightLabel.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (kLabelW));
        highlightColourButton.setBounds (r.removeFromRight (92));
        r.removeFromRight (6);
        highlightModeBox.setBounds (r);
    }

    labelled (row (right, kRowH), highlightOpacityLabel, highlightOpacitySlider);

    {
        auto r = row (right, kRowH);
        shadowLabel.setBounds (r.removeFromLeft (kLabelW));
        shadowColourButton.setBounds (r.removeFromRight (92));
        r.removeFromRight (6);
        shadowModeBox.setBounds (r);
    }

    labelled (row (right, kRowH), shadowOpacityLabel, shadowOpacitySlider);
}

//==============================================================================
void fillBlendModes (juce::ComboBox& box)
{
    box.clear (juce::dontSendNotification);
    const auto names = blendModeNames();

    for (const auto mode : blendModeOrder())
    {
        if (mode == BlendMode::numModes)
            box.addSeparator();
        else
            box.addItem (names[(int) mode], (int) mode + 1);
    }
}
