// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\BlobMaker.cpp

#include "BlobMaker.h"

#include "stella_blob.h"

#include <juce_events/juce_events.h>

#include <map>

namespace
{
    //==========================================================================
    // Reading the SFZ.

    /** A region's opcodes, in order, each once (a later one replaces it where it was). */
    struct Opcodes
    {
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> list;

        void set (const std::string& key, const std::string& value)
        {
            for (auto& [k, v] : list)
            {
                if (k == key)
                {
                    v = value;
                    return;
                }
            }

            list.emplace_back (key, value);
        }

        const std::string* get (const std::string& key) const
        {
            for (const auto& [k, v] : list)
                if (k == key)
                    return &v;

            return nullptr;
        }

        bool has (const std::string& key) const    { return get (key) != nullptr; }
    };

    /** A key's number from a note name ("c4", "C#4", "db3": c4 is 60) or a number; -1 if neither. */
    int noteNumber (const juce::String& text)
    {
        const auto t = text.trim();

        if (t.isEmpty())
            return -1;

        if (juce::CharacterFunctions::isDigit (t[0]) || (t[0] == '-' && t.length() > 1 && juce::CharacterFunctions::isDigit (t[1])))
            return t.getIntValue();

        static const int semitones[] { 9, 11, 0, 2, 4, 5, 7 };   // a b c d e f g
        const auto letter = juce::CharacterFunctions::toLowerCase (t[0]);

        if (letter < 'a' || letter > 'g')
            return -1;

        auto semitone = semitones[letter - 'a'];
        auto rest = t.substring (1);

        if (rest.startsWithChar ('#'))       { ++semitone; rest = rest.substring (1); }
        else if (rest.startsWithChar ('b'))  { --semitone; rest = rest.substring (1); }

        if (rest.isEmpty() || ! (juce::CharacterFunctions::isDigit (rest[0]) || rest[0] == '-'))
            return -1;

        return (rest.getIntValue() + 1) * 12 + semitone;
    }

    bool isKeyOpcode (const std::string& key)
    {
        static const char* const keys[] { "lokey", "hikey", "pitch_keycenter", "sw_lokey", "sw_hikey", "sw_last", "sw_down",
                                          "sw_up", "sw_previous", "sw_default", "loprev", "hiprev" };

        for (const auto* k : keys)
            if (key == k)
                return true;

        return false;
    }

    /** The text with every #include put in its place (paths from the main SFZ's folder). */
    juce::String withIncludes (const juce::File& file, const juce::File& root, int depth, juce::StringArray& notes)
    {
        const auto text = file.loadFileAsString();

        if (depth > 8 || ! text.contains ("#include"))
            return text;

        juce::String out;

        for (const auto& line : juce::StringArray::fromLines (text))
        {
            const auto trimmed = line.trimStart();

            if (trimmed.startsWith ("#include"))
            {
                const auto name = trimmed.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("\"", false, false).upToFirstOccurrenceOf ("\"", false, false).replaceCharacter ('\\', '/');
                const auto included = root.getChildFile (name);

                if (name.isNotEmpty() && included.existsAsFile())
                    out << withIncludes (included, root, depth + 1, notes) << "\n";
                else
                    notes.addIfNotAlreadyThere ("#include \"" + name + "\" isn't there");

                continue;
            }

            out << line << "\n";
        }

        return out;
    }

    /** Comments gone: // to the line's end, and block comments. */
    juce::String withoutComments (const juce::String& text)
    {
        juce::String out;
        out.preallocateBytes (text.getNumBytesAsUTF8());
        auto p = text.getCharPointer();
        bool block = false;

        while (! p.isEmpty())
        {
            const auto c = *p;

            if (block)
            {
                if (c == '*' && *(p + 1) == '/')
                {
                    block = false;
                    p += 2;
                    continue;
                }

                if (c == '\n')
                    out << "\n";

                ++p;
                continue;
            }

            if (c == '/' && *(p + 1) == '*')
            {
                block = true;
                p += 2;
                continue;
            }

            if (c == '/' && *(p + 1) == '/')
            {
                while (! p.isEmpty() && *p != '\n')
                    ++p;

                continue;
            }

            out << juce::String::charToString (c);
            ++p;
        }

        return out;
    }

    struct Parsed
    {
        juce::String name;
        std::vector<Opcodes> regions;
        juce::StringArray notes;
    };

    Parsed parse (const juce::File& sfz)
    {
        Parsed parsed;
        const auto root = sfz.getParentDirectory();
        auto text = withIncludes (sfz, root, 0, parsed.notes);

        // The instrument's own name, as the Sampling Studio and Sampler Arena write it.
        for (const auto& line : juce::StringArray::fromLines (text))
        {
            if (line.trimStart().startsWith ("// Family:"))
            {
                parsed.name = line.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("// Family:", false, false).trim();
                break;
            }
        }

        if (parsed.name.isEmpty())
            parsed.name = sfz.getFileNameWithoutExtension();

        text = withoutComments (text);

        enum class Section { none, control, global, master, group, region, other };
        auto section = Section::none;
        Opcodes global, master, group, region;
        juce::String defaultPath;
        int noteOffset = 0, octaveOffset = 0;
        std::map<juce::String, juce::String> defines;

        const auto flush = [&]
        {
            if (section == Section::region)
                parsed.regions.push_back (region);
        };

        // A region: what its <global>, <master> and <group> said, then its own.
        const auto startRegion = [&]
        {
            region = global;

            for (const auto* level : { &master, &group })
                for (const auto& [k, v] : level->list)
                    region.set (k, v);
        };

        const auto apply = [&] (const juce::String& keyText, const juce::String& valueText)
        {
            const auto key = keyText.toLowerCase().toStdString();
            auto value = valueText.trim();

            if (section == Section::control)
            {
                if (key == "default_path")         defaultPath = value.replaceCharacter ('\\', '/');
                else if (key == "note_offset")     noteOffset = value.getIntValue();
                else if (key == "octave_offset")   octaveOffset = value.getIntValue();

                return;
            }

            auto* target = section == Section::global ? &global : section == Section::master ? &master
                         : section == Section::group ? &group : section == Section::region ? &region : nullptr;

            if (target == nullptr)
                return;

            if (key == "sample")
            {
                target->set ("sample", (value.startsWithChar ('*') ? value : defaultPath + value).toStdString());   // *sine: the player's own
                return;
            }

            const auto shifted = [&] (const juce::String& v) -> std::string
            {
                const auto n = noteNumber (v);
                return n >= 0 || v.trim().startsWithChar ('-') ? std::to_string (juce::jlimit (-1, 127, n + noteOffset + 12 * octaveOffset))
                                                                : v.toStdString();
            };

            if (key == "key")
            {
                const auto n = shifted (value);
                target->set ("lokey", n);
                target->set ("hikey", n);
                target->set ("pitch_keycenter", n);
                return;
            }

            if (key == "pitch_keycenter" && value.equalsIgnoreCase ("sample"))
            {
                target->set (key, "sample");
                return;
            }

            target->set (key, isKeyOpcode (key) ? shifted (value) : value.toStdString());
        };

        // An opcode's value runs to the next opcode (name=) or the line's end: a sample's name may
        // have spaces in it.
        const auto opcodes = [&] (const juce::String& line)
        {
            auto rest = line.trim();

            while (rest.isNotEmpty())
            {
                const auto equals = rest.indexOfChar ('=');

                if (equals <= 0)
                    break;

                const auto key = rest.substring (0, equals).trim();
                const auto valueAndMore = rest.substring (equals + 1);
                auto end = valueAndMore.length();

                for (int i = 0; i < valueAndMore.length(); ++i)
                {
                    if (! juce::CharacterFunctions::isWhitespace (valueAndMore[i]))
                        continue;

                    int j = i;

                    while (j < valueAndMore.length() && juce::CharacterFunctions::isWhitespace (valueAndMore[j]))
                        ++j;

                    int w = j;

                    while (w < valueAndMore.length() && (juce::CharacterFunctions::isLetterOrDigit (valueAndMore[w]) || valueAndMore[w] == '_'))
                        ++w;

                    if (w > j && w < valueAndMore.length() && valueAndMore[w] == '=')
                    {
                        end = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                apply (key, valueAndMore.substring (0, end).trim());
                rest = valueAndMore.substring (end).trim();
            }
        };

        for (auto line : juce::StringArray::fromLines (text))
        {
            line = line.trim();

            if (line.startsWith ("#define"))
            {
                const auto rest = line.substring (7).trim();
                const auto name = rest.upToFirstOccurrenceOf (" ", false, false).trim();

                if (name.startsWithChar ('$'))
                    defines[name] = rest.fromFirstOccurrenceOf (" ", false, false).trim();

                continue;
            }

            // $NAME: what its #define says.
            if (line.containsChar ('$') && ! defines.empty())
            {
                juce::String replaced;

                for (int i = 0; i < line.length();)
                {
                    if (line[i] == '$')
                    {
                        int j = i + 1;

                        while (j < line.length() && (juce::CharacterFunctions::isLetterOrDigit (line[j]) || line[j] == '_'))
                            ++j;

                        const auto name = line.substring (i, j);

                        if (const auto found = defines.find (name); found != defines.end())
                        {
                            replaced << found->second;
                            i = j;
                            continue;
                        }
                    }

                    replaced << juce::String::charToString (line[i]);
                    ++i;
                }

                line = replaced;
            }

            while (line.isNotEmpty())
            {
                const auto open = line.indexOfChar ('<');

                if (open != 0)
                {
                    opcodes (open < 0 ? line : line.substring (0, open));

                    if (open < 0)
                        break;

                    line = line.substring (open);
                }

                const auto close = line.indexOfChar ('>');

                if (close < 0)
                    break;

                const auto header = line.substring (1, close).trim().toLowerCase();
                line = line.substring (close + 1).trim();
                flush();

                // Each header starts the levels under it afresh.
                if (header == "control")       { section = Section::control; }
                else if (header == "global")   { section = Section::global; global = Opcodes(); master = Opcodes(); group = Opcodes(); }
                else if (header == "master")   { section = Section::master; master = Opcodes(); group = Opcodes(); }
                else if (header == "group")    { section = Section::group; group = Opcodes(); }
                else if (header == "region")   { section = Section::region; startRegion(); }
                else                           { section = Section::other; }
            }
        }

        flush();
        return parsed;
    }

    /** A sample by its path in the SFZ: from its folder, letters' case aside where the disk minds it. */
    juce::File sampleFile (const juce::File& root, const juce::String& path)
    {
        const auto native = path.replaceCharacter ('\\', '/').trim();

        if (native.isEmpty())
            return {};

        const auto direct = juce::File::isAbsolutePath (native) ? juce::File (native) : root.getChildFile (native);

        if (direct.existsAsFile() || juce::File::isAbsolutePath (native))
            return direct;

        // Walk it, a folder at a time, matching names whatever their case.
        auto folder = root;

        for (const auto& part : juce::StringArray::fromTokens (native, "/", {}))
        {
            if (part.isEmpty() || part == ".")
                continue;

            if (part == "..")
            {
                folder = folder.getParentDirectory();
                continue;
            }

            auto next = folder.getChildFile (part);

            if (! next.exists())
                for (const auto& child : folder.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFilesAndDirectories, false, "*"))
                    if (child.getFileName().equalsIgnoreCase (part))
                        next = child;

            folder = next;
        }

        return folder;
    }

    stella::blob::Format formatFor (const juce::AudioFormatReader& reader, BlobMaker::Samples wanted)
    {
        switch (wanted)
        {
            case BlobMaker::Samples::s16:       return stella::blob::Format::s16;
            case BlobMaker::Samples::s24:       return stella::blob::Format::s24;
            case BlobMaker::Samples::f32:       return stella::blob::Format::f32;
            case BlobMaker::Samples::asTheyAre: break;
        }

        // Lossy files are made 24-bit (their own floats would double their size for nothing).
        const auto kind = reader.getFormatName().toLowerCase();

        if (kind.contains ("ogg") || kind.contains ("mp3") || kind.contains ("vorbis"))
            return stella::blob::Format::s24;

        if (reader.usesFloatingPointData || reader.bitsPerSample > 24)
            return stella::blob::Format::f32;

        return reader.bitsPerSample <= 16 ? stella::blob::Format::s16 : stella::blob::Format::s24;
    }

    juce::String samplesText (int n)    { return juce::String (n) + (n == 1 ? " sample" : " samples"); }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String BlobMaker::nameOf (const juce::File& sfz)
{
    juce::FileInputStream in (sfz);

    for (int i = 0; i < 40 && in.openedOk() && ! in.isExhausted(); ++i)
    {
        const auto line = in.readNextLine();

        if (line.trimStart().startsWith ("// Family:"))
            if (const auto family = line.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("// Family:", false, false).trim(); family.isNotEmpty())
                return family;
    }

    return sfz.getFileNameWithoutExtension();
}

BlobMaker::Result BlobMaker::convert (const juce::File& sfz, const juce::File& blob, Samples wanted,
                                      const std::function<bool (double)>& progress)
{
    Result result;

    if (! sfz.existsAsFile())
    {
        result.problem = sfz.getFileName() + " isn't there any more.";
        return result;
    }

    auto parsed = parse (sfz);
    result.name = parsed.name;
    result.notes = parsed.notes;

    // The samples, each once; what they are.
    struct SampleInfo
    {
        juce::File file;
        stella::blob::SampleEntry entry;
        juce::int64 loopStart = -1, loopEnd = -1;
        int unityNote = -1;
    };

    juce::AudioFormatManager formats;
    formats.registerBasicFormats();

    const auto root = sfz.getParentDirectory();
    std::vector<SampleInfo> infos;
    std::map<juce::String, int> byPath;
    juce::StringArray missing, generated;
    std::vector<std::pair<int, Opcodes*>> used;   // each region kept: its sample

    for (auto& region : parsed.regions)
    {
        const auto* path = region.get ("sample");

        if (path == nullptr || path->empty())
            continue;

        const auto pathText = juce::String (juce::CharPointer_UTF8 (path->c_str()));

        if (pathText.startsWithChar ('*'))
        {
            generated.addIfNotAlreadyThere (pathText);   // *sine, *noise...: made by players, not a file
            continue;
        }

        const auto file = sampleFile (root, pathText);
        const auto key = file.getFullPathName();
        int index = -1;

        if (const auto found = byPath.find (key); found != byPath.end())
        {
            index = found->second;
        }
        else
        {
            std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatReader> reader (file.existsAsFile() ? formats.createReaderFor (file) : nullptr);

            if (reader == nullptr || reader->lengthInSamples <= 0 || reader->sampleRate < 1000.0 || reader->numChannels < 1)
            {
                missing.addIfNotAlreadyThere (pathText.replaceCharacter ('\\', '/').fromLastOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false));
                byPath[key] = -1;
                continue;
            }

            SampleInfo info;
            info.file = file;
            info.entry.name = file.getRelativePathFrom (root).replaceCharacter ('\\', '/').toStdString();
            info.entry.frames = reader->lengthInSamples;
            info.entry.rate = reader->sampleRate;
            info.entry.channels = reader->numChannels > 1 ? 2 : 1;
            info.entry.format = formatFor (*reader, wanted);

            const auto& meta = reader->metadataValues;

            if (meta.getValue ("NumSampleLoops", "0").getIntValue() > 0)
            {
                info.loopStart = meta.getValue ("Loop0Start", "-1").getLargeIntValue();
                info.loopEnd = meta.getValue ("Loop0End", "-1").getLargeIntValue();
            }

            if (meta.containsKey ("MidiUnityNote"))
                info.unityNote = meta.getValue ("MidiUnityNote", "60").getIntValue();

            index = (int) infos.size();
            byPath[key] = index;
            infos.push_back (std::move (info));
        }

        if (index >= 0)
            used.emplace_back (index, &region);
    }

    if (! missing.isEmpty())
        result.notes.add (samplesText (missing.size()) + " missing (" + missing.joinIntoString (", ").substring (0, 160) + ")");

    if (! generated.isEmpty())
        result.notes.add ("generated sounds left out (" + generated.joinIntoString (", ") + ")");

    if (used.empty())
    {
        result.problem = parsed.regions.empty() ? sfz.getFileName() + " has no regions."
                                                : "None of " + sfz.getFileName() + "'s samples can be read"
                                                      + (missing.isEmpty() ? juce::String (".") : " (" + missing.joinIntoString (", ").substring (0, 160) + ").");
        return result;
    }

    // The index: the samples, and every region with its opcodes (the WAV's own loop and key where
    // the SFZ says nothing of them).
    stella::blob::Index index;
    index.name = parsed.name.toStdString();
    juce::int64 totalFrames = 0;

    for (const auto& info : infos)
    {
        index.samples.push_back (info.entry);
        totalFrames += info.entry.frames;
    }

    for (const auto& [sampleIndex, region] : used)
    {
        const auto& info = infos[(size_t) sampleIndex];
        stella::blob::RegionEntry entry;
        entry.sample = sampleIndex;

        Opcodes opcodes = *region;

        if (info.loopEnd > info.loopStart && info.loopStart >= 0)
        {
            if (! opcodes.has ("loop_start") && ! opcodes.has ("loopstart") && ! opcodes.has ("loop_end") && ! opcodes.has ("loopend"))
            {
                opcodes.set ("loop_start", std::to_string (info.loopStart));
                opcodes.set ("loop_end", std::to_string (info.loopEnd));
            }

            if (! opcodes.has ("loop_mode") && ! opcodes.has ("loopmode"))
                opcodes.set ("loop_mode", "loop_continuous");
        }

        if (const auto* centre = opcodes.get ("pitch_keycenter"); centre != nullptr && *centre == "sample")
            opcodes.set ("pitch_keycenter", std::to_string (info.unityNote >= 0 ? info.unityNote : 60));

        for (const auto& [key, value] : opcodes.list)
            if (key != "sample")
                entry.opcodes.emplace_back (key, value);

        index.regions.push_back (std::move (entry));
    }

    // Written whole under another name first: a blob that's there is always complete.
    if (! blob.getParentDirectory().createDirectory())
    {
        result.problem = "Couldn't make the folder " + blob.getParentDirectory().getFullPathName();
        return result;
    }

    const auto part = blob.getSiblingFile (blob.getFileName() + ".part");
    stella::blob::Writer writer;
    std::string error;

    if (! writer.open (part.getFullPathName().toStdString(), index, error))
    {
        result.problem = juce::String (error);
        return result;
    }

    constexpr int chunk = 65536;
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> buffer (2, chunk);
    juce::int64 done = 0;

    for (const auto& info : infos)
    {
        std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatReader> reader (formats.createReaderFor (info.file));

        if (reader == nullptr)
        {
            writer.abandon();
            result.problem = info.file.getFileName() + " couldn't be read again.";
            return result;
        }

        const auto stereo = info.entry.channels > 1;

        for (juce::int64 position = 0; position < info.entry.frames; position += chunk)
        {
            const auto frames = (int) juce::jmin<juce::int64> (chunk, info.entry.frames - position);
            buffer.clear();
            reader->read (&buffer, 0, frames, position, true, stereo);

            if (! writer.write (buffer.getReadPointer (0), stereo ? buffer.getReadPointer (1) : nullptr, frames, error))
            {
                writer.abandon();
                result.problem = juce::String (error);
                return result;
            }

            done += frames;

            if (progress != nullptr && ! progress ((double) done / (double) juce::jmax ((juce::int64) 1, totalFrames)))
            {
                writer.abandon();
                result.problem = "Stopped.";
                return result;
            }
        }
    }

    if (! writer.finish (error))
    {
        part.deleteFile();
        result.problem = juce::String (error);
        return result;
    }

    if (blob.exists() && ! blob.deleteFile())
    {
        part.deleteFile();
        result.problem = "Couldn't replace " + blob.getFullPathName() + " (is it open somewhere?).";
        return result;
    }

    if (! part.moveFileTo (blob))
    {
        part.deleteFile();
        result.problem = "Couldn't write " + blob.getFullPathName();
        return result;
    }

    result.ok = true;
    result.regions = (int) index.regions.size();
    result.samples = (int) index.samples.size();
    result.bytes = blob.getSize();
    return result;
}

//==============================================================================
class BlobMaker::Worker final : public juce::Thread
{
public:
    explicit Worker (BlobMaker& m) : juce::Thread ("SFZ to Blob"), maker (m) {}

    void run() override
    {
        while (! threadShouldExit())
        {
            juce::File sfz, blob;
            Samples samples;
            int id = 0;

            {
                const juce::ScopedLock hold (maker.lock);

                for (auto& item : maker.items)
                {
                    if (item.state == Item::State::waiting)
                    {
                        item.state = Item::State::working;
                        item.progress = 0.0;
                        item.message.clear();
                        item.blob = maker.blobFor (item.sfz);
                        sfz = item.sfz;
                        blob = item.blob;
                        id = item.id;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                samples = maker.samples;
            }

            if (id == 0 || maker.stopping.load())
                break;

            maker.changed();
            auto lastReport = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter();

            const auto result = convert (sfz, blob, samples, [this, id, &lastReport] (double progress)
            {
                if (threadShouldExit() || maker.stopping.load())
                    return false;

                {
                    const juce::ScopedLock hold (maker.lock);

                    for (auto& item : maker.items)
                        if (item.id == id)
                            item.progress = progress;
                }

                if (const auto now = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter(); now - lastReport > 120)
                {
                    lastReport = now;
                    maker.changed();
                }

                return true;
            });

            {
                const juce::ScopedLock hold (maker.lock);

                for (auto& item : maker.items)
                {
                    if (item.id != id)
                        continue;

                    if (! result.ok && maker.stopping.load())
                    {
                        item.state = Item::State::waiting;   // stopped: it waits again
                        item.progress = 0.0;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        item.state = result.ok ? Item::State::done : Item::State::failed;
                        item.progress = result.ok ? 1.0 : 0.0;
                        item.message = result.ok ? result.notes.joinIntoString ("; ") : result.problem;
                        item.name = result.name.isNotEmpty() ? result.name : item.name;
                        item.regions = result.regions;
                        item.samples = result.samples;
                        item.bytes = result.bytes;
                    }
                }
            }

            maker.changed();
        }

        maker.running.store (false);
        maker.changed();
    }

private:
    BlobMaker& maker;
};

//==============================================================================
BlobMaker::BlobMaker (const juce::File& kept)
    : keptFile (kept)
{
    const auto saved = juce::JSON::parse (keptFile);

    if (saved.isObject())
    {
        beside = (bool) saved.getProperty ("beside", true);

        if (const auto path = saved.getProperty ("folder", {}).toString(); juce::File::isAbsolutePath (path))
            folder = juce::File (path);

        const auto kind = saved.getProperty ("samples", "keep").toString();
        samples = kind == "s16" ? Samples::s16 : kind == "s24" ? Samples::s24 : kind == "f32" ? Samples::f32 : Samples::asTheyAre;
    }
}

BlobMaker::~BlobMaker()
{
    alive->store (false);
    stopping.store (true);

    if (worker != nullptr)
        worker->stopThread (20000);
}

void BlobMaker::changed()
{
    if (changePending.exchange (true))
        return;

    juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([this, stillAlive = alive]
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        changePending.store (false);

        if (onChange != nullptr)
            onChange();
    });
}

void BlobMaker::keep() const
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr saved (new juce::DynamicObject());
    saved->setProperty ("beside", beside);
    saved->setProperty ("folder", folder.getFullPathName());
    saved->setProperty ("samples", samples == Samples::s16 ? "s16" : samples == Samples::s24 ? "s24" : samples == Samples::f32 ? "f32" : "keep");
    keptFile.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (saved.get())));
}

juce::File BlobMaker::blobFor (const juce::File& sfz) const
{
    const auto where = beside || ! folder.isDirectory() ? sfz.getParentDirectory() : folder;
    return where.getChildFile (sfz.getFileNameWithoutExtension() + stella::blob::fileExtension);
}

void BlobMaker::add (const juce::Array<juce::File>& files)
{
    juce::Array<juce::File> found;

    for (const auto& file : files)
    {
        if (file.isDirectory())
        {
            auto inside = file.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, true, "*.sfz");
            inside.sort();
            found.addArray (inside);
        }
        else if (file.hasFileExtension ("sfz"))
        {
            found.add (file);
        }
    }

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock hold (lock);

        for (const auto& sfz : found)
        {
            bool listed = false;

            for (auto& item : items)
            {
                if (item.sfz == sfz)
                {
                    listed = true;

                    if (item.state != Item::State::working)
                    {
                        item.state = Item::State::waiting;
                        item.progress = 0.0;
                        item.message.clear();
                    }
                }
            }

            if (! listed && items.size() < 2000)
            {
                Item item;
                item.id = nextId++;
                item.sfz = sfz;
                item.name = nameOf (sfz);
                items.push_back (item);
            }
        }
    }

    changed();
}

void BlobMaker::remove (int id)
{
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock hold (lock);
        items.erase (std::remove_if (items.begin(), items.end(),
                                     [id] (const Item& item) { return item.id == id && item.state != Item::State::working; }),
                     items.end());
    }

    changed();
}

void BlobMaker::clear()
{
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock hold (lock);
        items.erase (std::remove_if (items.begin(), items.end(), [] (const Item& item) { return item.state != Item::State::working; }),
                     items.end());
    }

    changed();
}

void BlobMaker::setBeside (bool besideEachSfz)
{
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock hold (lock);   // the worker reads them
        beside = besideEachSfz;
    }

    keep();
    changed();
}

void BlobMaker::setFolder (const juce::File& newFolder)
{
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock hold (lock);
        folder = newFolder;
        beside = false;
    }

    keep();
    changed();
}

void BlobMaker::setSamples (Samples newSamples)
{
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock hold (lock);
        samples = newSamples;
    }

    keep();
    changed();
}

void BlobMaker::start()
{
    if (running.load())
        return;

    if (worker != nullptr)
        worker->stopThread (20000);

    stopping.store (false);
    running.store (true);
    worker = std::make_unique<Worker> (*this);
    worker->startThread();
    changed();
}

void BlobMaker::stop()
{
    stopping.store (true);
    changed();
}

juce::var BlobMaker::toVar() const
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr state (new juce::DynamicObject());
    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock hold (lock);

        for (const auto& item : items)
        {
            juce::DynamicObject::Ptr row (new juce::DynamicObject());
            row->setProperty ("id", item.id);
            row->setProperty ("name", item.name);
            row->setProperty ("sfz", item.sfz.getFullPathName());
            row->setProperty ("blob", item.state == Item::State::waiting ? blobFor (item.sfz).getFullPathName() : item.blob.getFullPathName());
            row->setProperty ("state", item.state == Item::State::waiting ? "waiting" : item.state == Item::State::working ? "working"
                                     : item.state == Item::State::done ? "done" : "failed");
            row->setProperty ("progress", item.progress);
            row->setProperty ("message", item.message);
            row->setProperty ("regions", item.regions);
            row->setProperty ("samples", item.samples);
            row->setProperty ("bytes", (double) item.bytes);
            list.add (juce::var (row.get()));
        }
    }

    state->setProperty ("kind", "blob");
    state->setProperty ("items", list);
    state->setProperty ("beside", beside);
    state->setProperty ("folder", folder.getFullPathName());
    state->setProperty ("samples", samples == Samples::s16 ? "s16" : samples == Samples::s24 ? "s24" : samples == Samples::f32 ? "f32" : "keep");
    state->setProperty ("running", running.load() && ! stopping.load());
    return juce::var (state.get());
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\BlobMaker.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_formats/juce_audio_formats.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Sampling Studio's SFZ to Blob: an SFZ and its samples packed into one blob (stella_blob.h),
    the file a sampler made in the Plugins Creator Studio plays from the disk (its sample library,
    PluginLibrary.h). Several at once: a list, made one after another on a thread of its own.

    The SFZ is read as SFZ players read it: <control> (default_path, note_offset, octave_offset),
    <global>, <master>, <group> and <region>, each region with what's above it; #include and
    #define; comments. Every region's opcodes go into the blob (keys as MIDI note numbers), and
    its sample once however many regions play it: WAV, AIFF, FLAC, Ogg or MP3, kept as it is (16
    or 24-bit, float) or made 16-bit, 24-bit or float. A WAV's own loop (its smpl chunk) is the
    region's loop when the SFZ gives none (loop_continuous, as the standard has it). A region whose
    sample is missing is left out, and said.

    The blob goes beside its SFZ (named after it), or into one folder; it's written whole under
    another name first, so a blob that's there is always complete.

    Threads: the list and its choices on the message thread; convert() on any.
*/
class BlobMaker final
{
public:
    enum class Samples { asTheyAre, s16, s24, f32 };

    struct Item
    {
        enum class State { waiting, working, done, failed };

        int id = 0;
        juce::File sfz, blob;
        juce::String name;
        State state = State::waiting;
        double progress = 0.0;
        juce::String message;            // failed: why; done: what was left out, when anything was
        int regions = 0, samples = 0;
        juce::int64 bytes = 0;
    };

    /** keptFile: its choices, kept for next time. */
    explicit BlobMaker (const juce::File& keptFile);
    ~BlobMaker();

    //==========================================================================
    // Message thread

    /** SFZs, or folders (every SFZ in them and their folders). One already listed waits again. */
    void add (const juce::Array<juce::File>& files);
    void remove (int id);
    void clear();                        // every one but the one being made

    /** Where blobs go: beside each SFZ, or into the folder. */
    void setBeside (bool besideEachSfz);
    void setFolder (const juce::File& folder);
    void setSamples (Samples samples);

    /** The waiting ones, one after another. */
    void start();

    /** The one being made stops (nothing of it is left), and the rest wait. */
    void stop();

    bool isRunning() const noexcept      { return running.load(); }

    /** The list and the choices, for the page. */
    juce::var toVar() const;

    /** Called on the message thread when the list or its progress changed. */
    std::function<void()> onChange;

    //==========================================================================
    // Any thread
    struct Result
    {
        bool ok = false;
        juce::String name, problem;
        juce::StringArray notes;         // what was left out
        int regions = 0, samples = 0;
        juce::int64 bytes = 0;
    };

    /** One SFZ into one blob. progress (0..1): false calls it off. */
    static Result convert (const juce::File& sfz, const juce::File& blob, Samples samples,
                           const std::function<bool (double)>& progress);

    /** The instrument's name, as the SFZ says it ("// Family:"), else its file's. */
    static juce::String nameOf (const juce::File& sfz);

private:
    class Worker;

    void changed();
    void keep() const;
    juce::File blobFor (const juce::File& sfz) const;

    juce::File keptFile, folder;
    bool beside = true;
    Samples samples = Samples::asTheyAre;

    mutable juce::CriticalSection lock;  // the list, between the message thread and the worker
    std::vector<Item> items;
    int nextId = 1;
    std::atomic<bool> running { false }, stopping { false };
    std::unique_ptr<Worker> worker;

    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> alive = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>> (true);
    std::atomic<bool> changePending { false };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (BlobMaker)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\BmpImage.cpp
// From KnobMaker (C:\workspace\knobmaker), unchanged: the same layer builder in both apps.

/*
    BmpImage.cpp
*/

#include "BmpImage.h"

#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    /** One colour channel described by its bit mask, as BI_BITFIELDS gives it.
        The shift and scale are worked out once so the per-pixel path is a
        mask, a shift and a multiply. */
    struct Channel
    {
        juce::uint32 mask  = 0;
        int          shift = 0;
        float        scale = 0.0f;

        juce::uint8 extract (juce::uint32 value) const noexcept
        {
            if (mask == 0)
                return 255;

            const auto raw = (value & mask) >> shift;

            return (juce::uint8) juce::jlimit (0, 255, (int) std::lround ((float) raw * scale));
        }
    };

    Channel makeChannel (juce::uint32 mask) noexcept
    {
        Channel c;
        c.mask = mask;

        if (mask == 0)
            return c;

        while (((mask >> c.shift) & 1u) == 0u && c.shift < 31)
            ++c.shift;

        const auto range = mask >> c.shift;
        c.scale = range > 0 ? 255.0f / (float) range : 0.0f;

        return c;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
bool BmpImage::looksLikeBmp (const juce::File& file)
{
    juce::FileInputStream in (file);

    if (! in.openedOk())
        return false;

    char magic[2] = {};

    return in.read (magic, 2) == 2 && magic[0] == 'B' && magic[1] == 'M';
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Image BmpImage::load (const void* rawData, size_t numBytes)
{
    const auto* data = static_cast<const juce::uint8*> (rawData);

    // 14-byte file header plus the smallest DIB header there is.
    if (data == nullptr || numBytes < 26)
        return {};

    if (data[0] != 'B' || data[1] != 'M')
        return {};

    auto u16 = [data] (size_t o) noexcept -> juce::uint32
    {
        return (juce::uint32) data[o] | ((juce::uint32) data[o + 1] << 8);
    };

    auto u32 = [data] (size_t o) noexcept -> juce::uint32
    {
        return  (juce::uint32) data[o]
             | ((juce::uint32) data[o + 1] << 8)
             | ((juce::uint32) data[o + 2] << 16)
             | ((juce::uint32) data[o + 3] << 24);
    };

    const size_t       pixelOffset = (size_t) u32 (10);
    const juce::uint32 dibSize     = u32 (14);

    if (dibSize < 12 || (size_t) 14 + dibSize > numBytes)
        return {};

    int          width = 0, height = 0, bitCount = 0;
    juce::uint32 compression = 0, paletteCount = 0;
    size_t       paletteEntrySize = 4;

    if (dibSize == 12)
    {
        // BITMAPCOREHEADER: 16-bit dimensions, 3-byte palette entries.
        width    = (int) (juce::int16) (juce::uint16) u16 (18);
        height   = (int) (juce::int16) (juce::uint16) u16 (20);
        bitCount = (int) u16 (24);
        paletteEntrySize = 3;
    }
    else
    {
        width        = (int) (juce::int32) u32 (18);
        height       = (int) (juce::int32) u32 (22);
        bitCount     = (int) u16 (28);
        compression  = u32 (30);
        paletteCount = u32 (46);
    }

    // A negative height means the rows are stored top-down instead of the usual
    // bottom-up. Getting this wrong flips the texture, which on a symmetrical
    // pattern is invisible and on anything else is obvious.
    const bool topDown = height < 0;
    height = std::abs (height);

    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0 || width > 20000 || height > 20000)
        return {};

    // BI_RGB and BI_BITFIELDS only. An RLE bitmap decoded as if it were raw
    // would produce confident garbage, which is worse than refusing it.
    if (compression != 0 && compression != 3)
        return {};

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Channel cr, cg, cb, ca;

    if (compression == 3)
    {
        // The masks sit straight after a 40-byte header, and at the same file
        // offsets inside a V4 or V5 header.
        // Three masks live at 54, 58 and 62, so 66 bytes have to be there.
        if (numBytes < 66)
            return {};

        cr = makeChannel (u32 (54));
        cg = makeChannel (u32 (58));
        cb = makeChannel (u32 (62));

        // The alpha mask arrives with BITMAPV3INFOHEADER at 56 bytes, not with
        // V4 at 108 — requiring 108 would drop the alpha on every V3 file.
        if (dibSize >= 56 && numBytes >= 70)
            ca = makeChannel (u32 (66));
    }
    else if (bitCount == 32)
    {
        cb = makeChannel (0x000000ffu);
        cg = makeChannel (0x0000ff00u);
        cr = makeChannel (0x00ff0000u);
        ca = makeChannel (0xff000000u);
    }
    else if (bitCount == 16)
    {
        // BI_RGB at 16bpp is X1R5G5B5, not R5G6B5.
        cb = makeChannel (0x001fu);
        cg = makeChannel (0x03e0u);
        cr = makeChannel (0x7c00u);
    }

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const juce::uint8* palette = nullptr;

    if (bitCount <= 8)
    {
        if (paletteCount == 0)
            paletteCount = 1u << bitCount;

        const size_t paletteOffset = (size_t) 14 + dibSize;

        if (paletteOffset + paletteCount * paletteEntrySize > numBytes)
            return {};

        palette = data + paletteOffset;
    }

    const size_t stride = (size_t) (((width * bitCount + 31) / 32) * 4);

    if (pixelOffset + stride * (size_t) height > numBytes)
        return {};

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    juce::Image image (juce::Image::ARGB, width, height, false);
    juce::Image::BitmapData dest (image, juce::Image::BitmapData::readWrite);

    auto fromPalette = [palette, paletteCount, paletteEntrySize]
                       (juce::uint32 index, juce::uint8& r, juce::uint8& g, juce::uint8& b) noexcept
    {
        if (palette == nullptr || index >= paletteCount)
        {
            r = g = b = 0;
            return;
        }

        const auto* entry = palette + (size_t) index * paletteEntrySize;
        b = entry[0];
        g = entry[1];
        r = entry[2];
    };

    bool sawAlpha = false;

    for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y)
    {
        const int sourceRow = topDown ? y : (height - 1 - y);
        const juce::uint8* row = data + pixelOffset + (size_t) sourceRow * stride;

        for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x)
        {
            juce::uint8 r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 255;

            switch (bitCount)
            {
                case 32:
                {
                    const juce::uint32 v =  (juce::uint32) row[x * 4]
                                         | ((juce::uint32) row[x * 4 + 1] << 8)
                                         | ((juce::uint32) row[x * 4 + 2] << 16)
                                         | ((juce::uint32) row[x * 4 + 3] << 24);

                    r = cr.extract (v);
                    g = cg.extract (v);
                    b = cb.extract (v);

                    if (ca.mask != 0)
                    {
                        a = ca.extract (v);

                        if (a != 0)
                            sawAlpha = true;
                    }

                    break;
                }

                case 24:
                    b = row[x * 3];
                    g = row[x * 3 + 1];
                    r = row[x * 3 + 2];
                    break;

                case 16:
                {
                    const juce::uint32 v = (juce::uint32) row[x * 2]
                                         | ((juce::uint32) row[x * 2 + 1] << 8);

                    r = cr.extract (v);
                    g = cg.extract (v);
                    b = cb.extract (v);
                    break;
                }

                case 8:
                    fromPalette (row[x], r, g, b);
                    break;

                case 4:
                {
                    const auto byte = row[x >> 1];
                    fromPalette ((x & 1) ? (juce::uint32) (byte & 0x0f)
                                         : (juce::uint32) (byte >> 4), r, g, b);
                    break;
                }

                case 1:
                {
                    const auto byte = row[x >> 3];
                    fromPalette ((juce::uint32) ((byte >> (7 - (x & 7))) & 1), r, g, b);
                    break;
                }

                default:
                    return {};
            }

            dest.setPixelColour (x, y, juce::Colour (r, g, b, a));
        }
    }

    // A 32-bit BMP is very often written with its alpha channel left at zero.
    // Taken at face value that is a fully invisible image, so read an all-zero
    // alpha channel as "this file has no alpha" rather than "erase everything".
    if (bitCount == 32 && ca.mask != 0 && ! sawAlpha)
        for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y)
            for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x)
                dest.setPixelColour (x, y, dest.getPixelColour (x, y).withAlpha (1.0f));

    return image;
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Image BmpImage::loadFrom (const juce::File& file)
{
    juce::MemoryBlock block;

    if (! file.loadFileAsData (block) || block.getSize() == 0)
        return {};

    return load (block.getData(), block.getSize());
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Image loadImageFile (const juce::File& file)
{
    // JUCE sniffs the content rather than trusting the extension, so this
    // handles a PNG named .bmp correctly and falls through cleanly on a real
    // BMP, which it has no decoder for.
    auto image = juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom (file);

    if (image.isValid())
        return image;

    return BmpImage::loadFrom (file);
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\BmpImage.h
// From KnobMaker (C:\workspace\knobmaker), unchanged: the same layer builder in both apps.

/*
    BmpImage.h

    A BMP decoder, because JUCE does not have one.

    juce::ImageFileFormat registers exactly three decoders — PNG, JPEG and GIF —
    and there is no hook to add a fourth, so this cannot be plugged into
    ImageFileFormat::loadFrom. loadImageFile() below is the entry point to use
    instead: it tries JUCE first and falls back to here.

    That matters because KnobMan's own stock textures are bitmaps. Without this,
    pointing the texture folder at a JKnobMan install lists a set of files that
    all silently fail to load.

    Covers what a texture is realistically saved as: 1, 4, 8, 16, 24 and 32 bit,
    BI_RGB and BI_BITFIELDS, bottom-up or top-down, BITMAPCOREHEADER through
    BITMAPV5HEADER. RLE-compressed bitmaps are rejected rather than guessed at.
*/

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

//==============================================================================
namespace BmpImage
{
    /** Cheap magic-number test. Does not read the whole file. */
    bool looksLikeBmp (const juce::File&);

    /** An invalid image if the data is not a BMP we can decode. */
    juce::Image load (const void* data, size_t numBytes);

    juce::Image loadFrom (const juce::File&);
}

//==============================================================================
/** Every format JUCE knows, plus BMP. Use this anywhere an image comes from a
    file the user chose, rather than juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom. */
juce::Image loadImageFile (const juce::File&);

    Plugin::Descriptor descriptorFor (const char* id, const char* name, const juce::StringArray& features)
    {
        Plugin::Descriptor descriptor;
        descriptor.id = id;
        descriptor.name = name;
        descriptor.vendor = "Sonify";
        descriptor.version = "1.0";
        descriptor.features = features;
        return descriptor;
    }

    Plugin::Descriptor eqDescriptor()          { return descriptorFor (Builtins::eqId, "Sonify EQ", { "audio-effect", "equalizer", "stereo" }); }
    Plugin::Descriptor compressorDescriptor()  { return descriptorFor (Builtins::compressorId, "Sonify Compressor", { "audio-effect", "compressor", "stereo" }); }
    Plugin::Descriptor limiterDescriptor()     { return descriptorFor (Builtins::limiterId, "Sonify Limiter", { "audio-effect", "limiter", "mastering", "stereo" }); }

    //==============================================================================
    // Sonify EQ: a channel EQ. Low and high cuts, two shelves, two bells.
    namespace EqParam
    {
        enum : uint32_t { lowCut = 1, lowFreq, lowGain, lowMidFreq, lowMidGain, lowMidQ, highMidFreq, highMidGain, highMidQ,
                          highFreq, highGain, highCut, output };
    }

    class EqPlugin final : public BuiltinPlugin
    {
    public:
        EqPlugin()
            : BuiltinPlugin (eqDescriptor(),
                             {
                                 { EqParam::lowCut,      "Low Cut",         10.0,   500.0,    10.0, "Hz", 0, false, false, true, "min" },
                                 { EqParam::lowFreq,     "Low Shelf Freq",  30.0,   500.0,   100.0, "Hz", 0 },
                                 { EqParam::lowGain,     "Low Shelf Gain", -15.0,    15.0,     0.0, "dB", 1 },
                                 { EqParam::lowMidFreq,  "Low Mid Freq",    40.0,  2000.0,   300.0, "Hz", 0 },
                                 { EqParam::lowMidGain,  "Low Mid Gain",   -15.0,    15.0,     0.0, "dB", 1 },
                                 { EqParam::lowMidQ,     "Low Mid Q",        0.3,     8.0,     1.0, "",   2 },
                                 { EqParam::highMidFreq, "High Mid Freq",  300.0, 12000.0,  2500.0, "Hz", 0 },
                                 { EqParam::highMidGain, "High Mid Gain",  -15.0,    15.0,     0.0, "dB", 1 },
                                 { EqParam::highMidQ,    "High Mid Q",       0.3,     8.0,     1.0, "",   2 },
                                 { EqParam::highFreq,    "High Shelf Freq", 1500.0, 18000.0, 8000.0, "Hz", 0 },
                                 { EqParam::highGain,    "High Shelf Gain", -15.0,   15.0,     0.0, "dB", 1 },
                                 { EqParam::highCut,     "High Cut",       2000.0, 22000.0, 22000.0, "Hz", 0, false, false, true, "max" },
                                 { EqParam::output,      "Output",         -24.0,    24.0,     0.0, "dB", 1 }
                             })
        {
        }

    private:
        void prepareAudio (double rate, int) override
        {
            sampleRate = rate;

            for (auto& pair : states)
                for (auto& state : pair)
                    state.reset();
        }

        void update() noexcept override
        {
            using namespace SonifyDsp;
            const auto lowCut = valueOf (EqParam::lowCut);
            const auto highCut = valueOf (EqParam::highCut);

            filters[0] = lowCut > 10.0 ? Biquad::highPass (sampleRate, lowCut, 0.7071) : Biquad {};
            filters[1] = Biquad::lowShelf (sampleRate, valueOf (EqParam::lowFreq), valueOf (EqParam::lowGain));
            filters[2] = Biquad::peak (sampleRate, valueOf (EqParam::lowMidFreq), valueOf (EqParam::lowMidQ), valueOf (EqParam::lowMidGain));
            filters[3] = Biquad::peak (sampleRate, valueOf (EqParam::highMidFreq), valueOf (EqParam::highMidQ), valueOf (EqParam::highMidGain));
            filters[4] = Biquad::highShelf (sampleRate, valueOf (EqParam::highFreq), valueOf (EqParam::highGain));
            filters[5] = highCut < 22000.0 && highCut < sampleRate * 0.49 ? Biquad::lowPass (sampleRate, highCut, 0.7071) : Biquad {};
            output = static_cast<float> (dbToGain (valueOf (EqParam::output)));
        }

        void processAudio (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept override
        {
            for (size_t band = 0; band < filters.size(); ++band)
            {
                if (filters[band].isIdentity())
                    continue;

                auto& [stateLeft, stateRight] = states[band];

                for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
                {
                    left[i] = stateLeft.process (filters[band], left[i]);
                    right[i] = stateRight.process (filters[band], right[i]);
                }
            }

            if (std::abs (output - 1.0f) > 1.0e-6f)
            {
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::multiply (left, output, numSamples);
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::multiply (right, output, numSamples);
            }
        }

        static double dbToGain (double db) noexcept   { return SonifyDsp::dbToGain (db); }

        double sampleRate = 48000.0;
        std::array<SonifyDsp::Biquad, 6> filters {};
        std::array<std::array<SonifyDsp::BiquadState, 2>, 6> states {};
        float output = 1.0f;
    };

    //==============================================================================
    // Sonify Compressor: soft knee, peak or RMS, parallel mix, and a sidechain input to duck.
    namespace CompParam
    {
        enum : uint32_t { threshold = 1, ratio, attack, release, knee, makeup, mix, detector, sidechain };
    }

    class CompressorPlugin final : public BuiltinPlugin
    {
    public:
        CompressorPlugin()
            : BuiltinPlugin (compressorDescriptor(),
                             {
                                 { CompParam::threshold, "Threshold", -60.0,    0.0, -18.0, "dB", 1 },
                                 { CompParam::ratio,     "Ratio",       1.0,   20.0,   3.0, ":1", 1 },
                                 { CompParam::attack,    "Attack",      0.1,  200.0,  10.0, "ms", 1 },
                                 { CompParam::release,   "Release",     5.0, 2000.0, 120.0, "ms", 0 },
                                 { CompParam::knee,      "Knee",        0.0,   24.0,   6.0, "dB", 1 },
                                 { CompParam::makeup,    "Makeup",    -12.0,   24.0,   0.0, "dB", 1 },
                                 { CompParam::mix,       "Mix",         0.0,  100.0, 100.0, "%",  0 },
                                 { CompParam::detector,  "Detector",    0.0,    1.0,   1.0, "",   0, true, false, true, nullptr, { "Peak", "RMS" } },
                                 { CompParam::sidechain, "Sidechain",   0.0,    1.0,   0.0, "",   0, true, false, true, nullptr, { "Off", "On" } }
                             })
        {
        }

        bool hasSidechain() const noexcept override   { return true; }

    private:
        void prepareAudio (double rate, int maxBlockSize) override
        {
            compressor.prepare (rate);
            prepareSidechain (maxBlockSize);
        }

        void update() noexcept override
        {
            SonifyDsp::Compressor::Settings s;
            s.thresholdDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (CompParam::threshold));
            s.ratio = static_cast<float> (valueOf (CompParam::ratio));
            s.attackMs = static_cast<float> (valueOf (CompParam::attack));
            s.releaseMs = static_cast<float> (valueOf (CompParam::release));
            s.kneeDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (CompParam::knee));
            s.makeupDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (CompParam::makeup));
            s.mix = static_cast<float> (valueOf (CompParam::mix) / 100.0);
            s.rms = valueOf (CompParam::detector) > 0.5;
            compressor.setSettings (s);
        }

        void processAudio (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept override
        {
            // Keyed by what the sidechain brings, when asked (it's silent while nothing sends to it).
            const bool keyed = valueOf (CompParam::sidechain) > 0.5 && getSidechainCapacity() >= numSamples;
            compressor.process (left, right, numSamples,
                                keyed ? getSidechainChannel (0) : nullptr,
                                keyed ? getSidechainChannel (1) : nullptr);
        }

        SonifyDsp::Compressor compressor;
    };

    //==============================================================================
    // Sonify Limiter: gain into a true-peak brickwall.
    namespace LimitParam
    {
        enum : uint32_t { gain = 1, ceiling, release };
    }

    class LimiterPlugin final : public BuiltinPlugin
    {
    public:
        LimiterPlugin()
            : BuiltinPlugin (limiterDescriptor(),
                             {
                                 { LimitParam::gain,    "Gain",      0.0,   24.0,  0.0, "dB",   1 },
                                 { LimitParam::ceiling, "Ceiling", -12.0,    0.0, -1.0, "dBTP", 1 },
                                 { LimitParam::release, "Release",   1.0, 1000.0, 80.0, "ms",   0 }
                             })
        {
        }

    private:
        void prepareAudio (double rate, int) override
        {
            limiter.prepare (rate);
        }

        void update() noexcept override
        {
            gain = static_cast<float> (SonifyDsp::dbToGain (valueOf (LimitParam::gain)));
            limiter.setSettings (static_cast<float> (valueOf (LimitParam::ceiling)), static_cast<float> (valueOf (LimitParam::release)));
        }

        void processAudio (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept override
        {
            if (std::abs (gain - 1.0f) > 1.0e-6f)
            {
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::multiply (left, gain, numSamples);
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::multiply (right, gain, numSamples);
            }

            limiter.process (left, right, numSamples);
        }

        SonifyDsp::Limiter limiter;
        float gain = 1.0f;
    };

//==============================================================================
bool Builtins::isBuiltinId (const juce::String& pluginId)
{
    return pluginId.startsWith (idPrefix);
}

const juce::File& Builtins::file()
{
    static const juce::File executable = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile);
    return executable;
}

bool Builtins::isBuiltinFile (const juce::String& path)
{
    return path.isNotEmpty() && path.equalsIgnoreCase (file().getFullPathName());
}

const std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor>& Builtins::describe()
{
    static const std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor> all { eqDescriptor(), compressorDescriptor(), limiterDescriptor(), masteringDescriptor(),
                                                       Containers::describe (false), Containers::describe (true), Playlists::describe(),
                                                       Samplers::describe() };
    return all;
}

juce::String Builtins::categoryOf (const juce::String& pluginId)
{
    if (pluginId == eqId)          return "EQ";
    if (pluginId == masteringId)   return "Mastering";
    if (Containers::isContainerId (pluginId) || pluginId == Playlists::playerId || pluginId == Samplers::playerId)
        return "System Tool";
    return "Dynamics";
}

std::unique_ptr<Plugin> Builtins::create (const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error)
{
    if (pluginId == eqId)          return std::make_unique<EqPlugin>();
    if (pluginId == compressorId)  return std::make_unique<CompressorPlugin>();
    if (pluginId == limiterId)     return std::make_unique<LimiterPlugin>();
    if (pluginId == masteringId)   return std::make_unique<MasteringPlugin>();
    if (pluginId == Containers::instrumentId)  return std::make_unique<ContainerPlugin> (false);
    if (pluginId == Containers::effectId)      return std::make_unique<ContainerPlugin> (true);
    if (pluginId == Playlists::playerId)       return std::make_unique<PlaylistPlayer>();
    if (pluginId == Samplers::playerId)        return std::make_unique<SonifySampler>();

    error = "This version of Sonify has no system tool called " + pluginId.fromFirstOccurrenceOf (idPrefix, false, false) + ".";
    return nullptr;
}

//==============================================================================
BuiltinPlugin::BuiltinPlugin (Descriptor d, std::vector<Spec> s)
    : descriptor (std::move (d)), specs (std::move (s))
{
    inFile.push_back (descriptor);
    values = std::make_unique<std::atomic<double>[]> (specs.size());
    uint32_t largest = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < specs.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& spec = specs[i];

        Parameter parameter;
        parameter.id = spec.id;
        parameter.name = spec.name;
        parameter.minValue = spec.minValue;
        parameter.maxValue = spec.maxValue;
        parameter.defaultValue = spec.defaultValue;
        parameter.stepped = spec.stepped;
        parameter.hidden = spec.hidden;
        parameters.push_back (parameter);

        values[i].store (spec.defaultValue);
        largest = juce::jmax (largest, spec.id);
    }

    indexById.assign (static_cast<size_t> (largest) + 1, -1);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < specs.size(); ++i)
        indexById[static_cast<size_t> (specs[i].id)] = static_cast<int> (i);
}

int BuiltinPlugin::indexOf (uint32_t id) const noexcept
{
    return id < indexById.size() ? indexById[static_cast<size_t> (id)] : -1;
}

int BuiltinPlugin::findParameter (uint32_t id) const noexcept
{
    return indexOf (id);
}

double BuiltinPlugin::getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept
{
    return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (specs.size())) ? values[static_cast<size_t> (index)].load (std::memory_order_relaxed) : 0.0;
}

double BuiltinPlugin::valueOf (uint32_t id) const noexcept
{
    return getParameterValue (indexOf (id));
}

void BuiltinPlugin::setValue (uint32_t id, double value)
{
    queueParameter (indexOf (id), value);
}

juce::String BuiltinPlugin::getParameterText (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (specs.size())))
        return {};

    const auto& spec = specs[static_cast<size_t> (index)];

    if (spec.offAt != nullptr)
    {
        const bool atMin = std::strcmp (spec.offAt, "min") == 0 && value <= spec.minValue + 1.0e-6;
        const bool atMax = std::strcmp (spec.offAt, "max") == 0 && value >= spec.maxValue - 1.0e-6;

        if (atMin || atMax)
            return "Off";
    }

    if (! spec.choices.empty())
    {
        const auto choice = juce::jlimit (0, static_cast<int> (spec.choices.size()) - 1, juce::roundToInt (value - spec.minValue));
        return spec.choices[static_cast<size_t> (choice)];
    }

    const juce::String unit (spec.unit);

    if (unit == "Hz" && value >= 1000.0)
        return juce::String (value / 1000.0, value >= 10000.0 ? 1 : 2) + " kHz";

    auto text = juce::String (value, spec.decimals);

    // Gains read with their sign, as on a console.
    if (unit.startsWith ("dB") && value > 0.0 && spec.minValue < 0.0)
        text = "+" + text;

    if (unit.isEmpty())
        return text;

    return unit.startsWithChar (':') ? text + unit : text + " " + unit;
}

double BuiltinPlugin::queueParameter (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (specs.size())))
        return 0.0;

    const auto& spec = specs[static_cast<size_t> (index)];

    if (! std::isfinite (value))
        value = spec.defaultValue;

    value = juce::jlimit (spec.minValue, spec.maxValue, value);

    if (spec.stepped)
        value = std::round (value);

    values[static_cast<size_t> (index)].store (value);
    dirty.store (true);

    if (spec.saved)
        stateChanged.store (true);

    return value;
}

void BuiltinPlugin::setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (indexHint, static_cast<int> (specs.size())) || specs[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)].id != paramId)
        indexHint = indexOf (paramId);

    if (indexHint < 0)
        return;

    const auto& spec = specs[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)];
    value = juce::jlimit (spec.minValue, spec.maxValue, std::isfinite (value) ? value : spec.defaultValue);
    values[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)].store (spec.stepped ? std::round (value) : value, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    dirty.store (true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

bool BuiltinPlugin::saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination)
{
    auto* params = new juce::DynamicObject();

    for (size_t i = 0; i < specs.size(); ++i)
        if (specs[i].saved)
            params->setProperty (juce::String (specs[i].id), values[i].load());

    auto* root = new juce::DynamicObject();
    root->setProperty ("plugin", descriptor.id);
    root->setProperty ("version", 1);
    root->setProperty ("params", juce::var (params));

    if (const auto extra = saveExtra(); ! extra.isVoid())
        root->setProperty ("extra", extra);

    const auto text = juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (root), true);
    destination.reset();
    destination.append (text.toRawUTF8(), text.getNumBytesAsUTF8());
    return true;
}

bool BuiltinPlugin::loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source)
{
    const auto parsed = juce::JSON::parse (source.toString());

    if (! parsed.isObject() || parsed.getProperty ("plugin", {}).toString() != descriptor.id)
        return false;

    if (const auto* params = parsed.getProperty ("params", {}).getDynamicObject())
    {
        for (const auto& [name, value] : params->getProperties())
        {
            const auto id = static_cast<uint32_t> (name.toString().getIntValue());
            const auto index = indexOf (id);

            if (index >= 0 && specs[static_cast<size_t> (index)].saved)
                queueParameter (index, static_cast<double> (value));
        }
    }

    loadExtra (parsed.getProperty ("extra", {}));
    stateChanged.store (false);
    return true;
}

bool BuiltinPlugin::activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize)
{
    prepareAudio (sampleRate > 0.0 ? sampleRate : 48000.0, juce::jmax (1, maxBlockSize));
    dirty.store (true);
    active.store (true);
    return true;
}

void BuiltinPlugin::process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                             int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer&, const clap_event_transport_t*) noexcept
{
    if (outLeft == nullptr || outRight == nullptr || numSamples <= 0)
        return;

    // Effects work in place; a separate input is copied over first.
    if (inLeft != nullptr && inLeft != outLeft)
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (outLeft, inLeft, numSamples);

    if (inRight != nullptr && inRight != outRight)
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (outRight, inRight, numSamples);

    if (! active.load (std::memory_order_relaxed))
        return;

    if (dirty.exchange (false, std::memory_order_acq_rel))
        update();

    processAudio (outLeft, outRight, numSamples);
}

//==============================================================================
MasteringPlugin::MasteringPlugin()
    : BuiltinPlugin (masteringDescriptor(),
                     {
                         { MasterParam::input,          "Input",           -12.0,    12.0,     0.0, "dB",   1 },

                         { MasterParam::low,            "Low",              -6.0,     6.0,     0.0, "dB",   1 },
                         { MasterParam::lowFreq,        "Low Freq",         40.0,   200.0,    90.0, "Hz",   0 },
                         { MasterParam::lowMid,         "Low Mid",          -6.0,     6.0,     0.0, "dB",   1 },
                         { MasterParam::lowMidFreq,     "Low Mid Freq",    120.0,   600.0,   250.0, "Hz",   0 },

                         { MasterParam::ceiling,        "Ceiling",          -6.0,     0.0,    -1.0, "dBTP", 1 },
                         { MasterParam::limiterRelease, "Limiter Release",  10.0,   500.0,    80.0, "ms",   0 },
                         { MasterParam::output,         "Output",          -12.0,     0.0,     0.0, "dB",   1 },
                         // Comparing (not kept with the song), and what the assistant added (kept).
                         { MasterParam::listen,         "Listen",            0.0,     1.0,     0.0, "",     0, true, true, false, nullptr, { "Master", "Original" } },
                         { MasterParam::sameLoudness,   "Same Loudness",     0.0,     1.0,     0.0, "",     0, true, true, false, nullptr, { "Off", "On" } },
                         { MasterParam::loudnessChange, "Loudness Change", -60.0,    60.0,     0.0, "dB",   1, false, true, true }
                     })
{
}

void MasteringPlugin::applyAssistant (const SonifyDsp::MasteringSettings& s, const juce::var& newInfo, double loudnessChangeDb)
{
    setValue (MasterParam::input, s.inputGainDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::lowCut, s.lowCutHz);
    setValue (MasterParam::low, s.lowGainDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::lowFreq, s.lowHz);
    setValue (MasterParam::lowMid, s.lowMidGainDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::lowMidFreq, s.lowMidHz);
    setValue (MasterParam::mid, s.midGainDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::midFreq, s.midHz);
    setValue (MasterParam::presence, s.presenceGainDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::presenceFreq, s.presenceHz);
    setValue (MasterParam::air, s.airGainDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::airFreq, s.airHz);
    setValue (MasterParam::eqAmount, s.eqAmount * 100.0);
    setValue (MasterParam::threshold, s.compressor.thresholdDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::ratio, s.compressor.ratio);
    setValue (MasterParam::attack, s.compressor.attackMs);
    setValue (MasterParam::release, s.compressor.releaseMs);
    setValue (MasterParam::drive, s.driveDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::width, s.width * 100.0);
    setValue (MasterParam::ceiling, s.ceilingDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::limiterRelease, s.limiterReleaseMs);
    setValue (MasterParam::output, s.outputDb);
    setValue (MasterParam::loudnessChange, loudnessChangeDb);
    info = newInfo;
    stateChanged.store (true);
}

void MasteringPlugin::setListen (bool original, bool sameLoudness)
{
    setValue (MasterParam::listen, original ? 1.0 : 0.0);
    setValue (MasterParam::sameLoudness, sameLoudness ? 1.0 : 0.0);
}

bool MasteringPlugin::isListeningToOriginal() const noexcept   { return valueOf (MasterParam::listen) > 0.5; }
bool MasteringPlugin::isSameLoudness() const noexcept          { return valueOf (MasterParam::sameLoudness) > 0.5; }

void MasteringPlugin::prepareAudio (double rate, int)
{
    chain.prepare (rate);
    scratch.setSize (2, 2048, false, true, false);

    for (auto& line : dryDelay)
        line.assign (static_cast<size_t> (chain.getLatency() + 1), 0.0f);

    dryAt = 0;
    dryMix = isListeningToOriginal() ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    masterGain = 1.0f;
}

void MasteringPlugin::update() noexcept
{
    SonifyDsp::MasteringSettings s;
    s.inputGainDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::input));
    s.lowCutHz = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::lowCut));
    s.lowGainDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::low));
    s.lowHz = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::lowFreq));
    s.lowMidGainDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::lowMid));
    s.lowMidHz = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::lowMidFreq));
    s.midGainDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::mid));
    s.midHz = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::midFreq));
    s.presenceGainDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::presence));
    s.presenceHz = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::presenceFreq));
    s.airGainDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::air));
    s.airHz = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::airFreq));
    s.eqAmount = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::eqAmount) / 100.0);
    s.compressor.thresholdDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::threshold));
    s.compressor.ratio = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::ratio));
    s.compressor.attackMs = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::attack));
    s.compressor.releaseMs = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::release));
    s.driveDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::drive));
    s.width = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::width) / 100.0);
    s.ceilingDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::ceiling));
    s.limiterReleaseMs = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::limiterRelease));
    s.outputDb = static_cast<float> (valueOf (MasterParam::output));
    chain.setSettings (s);
}

void MasteringPlugin::processAudio (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    // Comparing: the original, or the master turned down to the original's loudness.
    const auto targetMix = isListeningToOriginal() ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    const auto targetGain = isSameLoudness() && targetMix < 0.5f
                              ? static_cast<float> (SonifyDsp::dbToGain (-valueOf (MasterParam::loudnessChange)))
                              : 1.0f;
    const auto length = static_cast<int> (dryDelay[0].size());

    for (int start = 0; start < numSamples; start += scratch.getNumSamples())
    {
        const auto count = juce::jmin (scratch.getNumSamples(), numSamples - start);
        auto* l = left + start;
        auto* r = right + start;
        auto* dryLeft = scratch.getWritePointer (0);
        auto* dryRight = scratch.getWritePointer (1);

        // The original, as late as the master comes out of the limiter.
        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            dryDelay[0][static_cast<size_t> (dryAt)] = l[i];
            dryDelay[1][static_cast<size_t> (dryAt)] = r[i];
            const auto readAt = (dryAt + 1) % length;
            dryLeft[i] = dryDelay[0][static_cast<size_t> (readAt)];
            dryRight[i] = dryDelay[1][static_cast<size_t> (readAt)];
            dryAt = readAt;
        }

        chain.process (l, r, count);

        if (dryMix == 0.0f && targetMix == 0.0f && masterGain == 1.0f && targetGain == 1.0f)
            continue;

        // Switching glides across the block, so it never clicks.
        const auto mixStep = (targetMix - dryMix) / static_cast<float> (count);
        const auto gainStep = (targetGain - masterGain) / static_cast<float> (count);

        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            dryMix += mixStep;
            masterGain += gainStep;
            l[i] = l[i] * masterGain * (1.0f - dryMix) + dryLeft[i] * dryMix;
            r[i] = r[i] * masterGain * (1.0f - dryMix) + dryRight[i] * dryMix;
        }

        dryMix = targetMix;
        masterGain = targetGain;
    }
}
