// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Choir.cpp

#include "Choir.h"
#include "AudioMedia.h"
#include "Transport.h"

#if __has_include (<signalsmith-stretch/signalsmith-stretch.h>)
 #include <signalsmith-stretch/signalsmith-stretch.h>
 #define SONIFY_CHOIR_STRETCH 1
#else
 #define SONIFY_CHOIR_STRETCH 0
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

//==============================================================================
// Settings
namespace
{
    const char* modeName (ChoirSettings::Mode mode)
    {
        switch (mode)
        {
            case ChoirSettings::Mode::chord:     return "chord";
            case ChoirSettings::Mode::semitones: return "semitones";
            case ChoirSettings::Mode::scale:     break;
        }

        return "scale";
    }

    ChoirSettings::Mode modeFrom (const juce::String& name)
    {
        return name == "chord" ? ChoirSettings::Mode::chord : name == "semitones" ? ChoirSettings::Mode::semitones : ChoirSettings::Mode::scale;
    }

    double numberOf (const juce::var& value, double fallback)
    {
        if (value.isInt() || value.isInt64() || value.isDouble() || value.isBool())
        {
            const auto number = static_cast<double> (value);
            return std::isfinite (number) ? number : fallback;
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    float rangedFloat (const juce::var& object, const char* key, float fallback, float low, float high)
    {
        return juce::jlimit (low, high, static_cast<float> (numberOf (object.getProperty (key, {}), fallback)));
    }

    int rangedInt (const juce::var& object, const char* key, int fallback, int low, int high)
    {
        return juce::jlimit (low, high, static_cast<int> (std::lround (numberOf (object.getProperty (key, {}), fallback))));
    }

    int intervalLimit (ChoirSettings::Mode mode)
    {
        return mode == ChoirSettings::Mode::semitones ? 24 : mode == ChoirSettings::Mode::chord ? 4 : 7;
    }
}

bool ChoirSettings::Voice::operator== (const Voice& other) const noexcept
{
    return female == other.female && juce::exactlyEqual (character, other.character) && mode == other.mode
        && interval == other.interval && octave == other.octave && juce::exactlyEqual (levelDb, other.levelDb)
        && juce::exactlyEqual (pan, other.pan) && mute == other.mute && solo == other.solo;
}

bool ChoirSettings::operator== (const ChoirSettings& other) const noexcept
{
    if (leadFemale != other.leadFemale || ! juce::exactlyEqual (leadDb, other.leadDb) || ! juce::exactlyEqual (choirDb, other.choirDb)
        || ! juce::exactlyEqual (spread, other.spread) || ! juce::exactlyEqual (timing, other.timing)
        || ! juce::exactlyEqual (pitch, other.pitch) || ! juce::exactlyEqual (vibrato, other.vibrato)
        || ! juce::exactlyEqual (hall, other.hall) || chordTrack != other.chordTrack || count != other.count)
        return false;

    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        if (! (voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)] == other.voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)]))
            return false;

    return true;
}

juce::var ChoirSettings::toVar() const
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr object (new juce::DynamicObject());
    object->setProperty ("leadFemale", leadFemale);
    object->setProperty ("lead", static_cast<double> (leadDb));
    object->setProperty ("choir", static_cast<double> (choirDb));
    object->setProperty ("spread", static_cast<double> (spread));
    object->setProperty ("timing", static_cast<double> (timing));
    object->setProperty ("pitch", static_cast<double> (pitch));
    object->setProperty ("vibrato", static_cast<double> (vibrato));
    object->setProperty ("hall", static_cast<double> (hall));
    object->setProperty ("chordTrack", chordTrack);

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        const auto& voice = voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)];
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
        item->setProperty ("female", voice.female);
        item->setProperty ("character", static_cast<double> (voice.character));
        item->setProperty ("mode", modeName (voice.mode));
        item->setProperty ("interval", voice.interval);
        item->setProperty ("octave", voice.octave);
        item->setProperty ("level", static_cast<double> (voice.levelDb));
        item->setProperty ("pan", static_cast<double> (voice.pan));
        item->setProperty ("mute", voice.mute);
        item->setProperty ("solo", voice.solo);
        list.add (juce::var (item.get()));
    }

    object->setProperty ("voices", list);
    return juce::var (object.get());
}

ChoirSettings ChoirSettings::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    ChoirSettings out;

    if (! value.isObject())
        return makeDefault();

    out.leadFemale = static_cast<bool> (value.getProperty ("leadFemale", false));
    out.leadDb = rangedFloat (value, "lead", 0.0f, leadOff, 6.0f);
    out.choirDb = rangedFloat (value, "choir", 0.0f, -36.0f, 12.0f);
    out.spread = rangedFloat (value, "spread", 0.8f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    out.timing = rangedFloat (value, "timing", 0.5f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    out.pitch = rangedFloat (value, "pitch", 0.4f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    out.vibrato = rangedFloat (value, "vibrato", 0.2f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    out.hall = rangedFloat (value, "hall", 0.25f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    out.chordTrack = juce::jmax (0, rangedInt (value, "chordTrack", 0, 0, std::numeric_limits<int>::max()));

    if (const auto* list = value.getProperty ("voices", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& item : *list)
        {
            if (! item.isObject() || out.count >= maxVoices)
                continue;

            auto& voice = out.voices[static_cast<size_t> (out.count++)];
            voice.female = static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("female", false));
            voice.character = rangedFloat (item, "character", 0.0f, -1.0f, 1.0f);
            voice.mode = modeFrom (item.getProperty ("mode", {}).toString());
            const auto limit = intervalLimit (voice.mode);
            voice.interval = rangedInt (item, "interval", 0, -limit, limit);
            voice.octave = rangedInt (item, "octave", 0, -2, 2);
            voice.levelDb = rangedFloat (item, "level", 0.0f, -36.0f, 6.0f);
            voice.pan = rangedFloat (item, "pan", 0.0f, -1.0f, 1.0f);
            voice.mute = static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("mute", false));
            voice.solo = static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("solo", false));
        }
    }

    return out;
}

ChoirSettings ChoirSettings::makeDefault()
{
    ChoirSettings out;
    out.count = 4;

    // Around a man's lead: a third above and the note itself an octave up (two women), a third
    // above and a fourth below (two men), across the stereo.
    const struct { bool female; int interval, octave; float pan; } parts[] = {
        { true, 2, 1, -0.6f }, { true, 0, 1, 0.6f }, { false, 2, 0, -0.25f }, { false, -3, 0, 0.25f }
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < out.count; ++i)
    {
        auto& voice = out.voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)];
        voice.female = parts[i].female;
        voice.interval = parts[i].interval;
        voice.octave = parts[i].octave;
        voice.pan = parts[i].pan;
    }

    return out;
}

//==============================================================================
/** The note sung: YIN on the vocal, low-passed and taken down to about 12 kHz, every ~5 ms. */
class Choir::PitchTracker
{
public:
    void prepare (double sampleRate)
    {
        factor = juce::jmax (1, static_cast<int> (std::lround (sampleRate / 12000.0)));
        rate = sampleRate / factor;
        maxTau = juce::jmin (static_cast<int> (rate / 65.0), ringSize / 4);
        minTau = juce::jmax (2, static_cast<int> (rate / 1100.0));
        window.assign (static_cast<size_t> (frame + maxTau), 0.0f);
        difference.assign (static_cast<size_t> (maxTau + 1), 0.0f);

        // Two biquads: a fourth-order low-pass well under half the reduced rate.
        const auto cutoff = juce::jmin (2800.0, 0.23 * rate);
        for (auto& stage : stages)
            stage.setCoefficients (juce::IIRCoefficients::makeLowPass (sampleRate, cutoff, 0.7071));

        reset();
    }

    void reset() noexcept
    {
        for (auto& stage : stages)
            stage.reset();

        std::fill (ring.begin(), ring.end(), 0.0f);
        written = 0;
        phase = 0;
        untilNext = hop;
        historyCount = 0;
        historyStart = 0;
    }

    /** n samples of the vocal fed, the first of them at feed index firstIndex. */
    void push (const float* input, int n, juce::int64 firstIndex) noexcept
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        {
            auto sample = input[i];

            for (auto& stage : stages)
                sample = stage.processSingleSampleRaw (sample);

            if (++phase < factor)
                continue;

            phase = 0;
            ring[static_cast<size_t> (written & (ringSize - 1))] = sample;
            ++written;

            if (--untilNext > 0 || written < frame + maxTau)
                continue;

            untilNext = hop;
            const auto midi = analyse();
            // The window's middle, in feed samples.
            const auto centre = firstIndex + i - static_cast<juce::int64> ((frame + maxTau) / 2) * factor;
            remember (centre, midi);
        }
    }

    /** The pitch (MIDI note, with cents) at or just before a feed index; -1 for no note. */
    float pitchAt (juce::int64 index) const noexcept
    {
        float found = -1.0f;

        for (int k = 0; k < historyCount; ++k)
        {
            const auto& entry = history[static_cast<size_t> ((historyStart + k) % historySize)];

            if (entry.index > index)
                break;

            found = entry.midi;
        }

        return found;
    }

private:
    struct Entry
    {
        juce::int64 index = 0;
        float midi = -1.0f;
    };

    float analyse() noexcept
    {
        const auto length = frame + maxTau;

        for (int j = 0; j < length; ++j)
            window[static_cast<size_t> (j)] = ring[static_cast<size_t> ((written - length + j) & (ringSize - 1))];

        // Too quiet to be a note.
        float energy = 0.0f;
        for (int j = 0; j < frame; ++j)
            energy += window[static_cast<size_t> (j)] * window[static_cast<size_t> (j)];

        if (energy / static_cast<float> (frame) < 1.0e-5f)
            return -1.0f;

        const auto* x = window.data();

        for (int tau = 1; tau <= maxTau; ++tau)
        {
            float sum = 0.0f;

            for (int j = 0; j < frame; ++j)
            {
                const auto d = x[j] - x[j + tau];
                sum += d * d;
            }

            difference[static_cast<size_t> (tau)] = sum;
        }

        // The cumulative mean normalised difference, and its first dip under the threshold.
        float running = 0.0f;
        int best = -1;
        float bestValue = 1.0f;
        std::array<float, 2> around {};

        for (int tau = 1; tau <= maxTau; ++tau)
        {
            running += difference[static_cast<size_t> (tau)];
            difference[static_cast<size_t> (tau)] = running > 0.0f ? difference[static_cast<size_t> (tau)] * static_cast<float> (tau) / running : 1.0f;
        }

        for (int tau = minTau; tau < maxTau; ++tau)
        {
            const auto value = difference[static_cast<size_t> (tau)];

            if (value < 0.15f)
            {
                while (tau + 1 < maxTau && difference[static_cast<size_t> (tau + 1)] < difference[static_cast<size_t> (tau)])
                    ++tau;

                best = tau;
                bestValue = difference[static_cast<size_t> (tau)];
                break;
            }

            if (value < bestValue)
            {
                bestValue = value;
                best = tau;
            }
        }

        if (best < minTau || bestValue > 0.3f)
            return -1.0f;

        // Between the samples: a parabola through the dip.
        around[0] = difference[static_cast<size_t> (best - 1)];
        around[1] = best + 1 <= maxTau ? difference[static_cast<size_t> (best + 1)] : difference[static_cast<size_t> (best)];
        const auto centre = difference[static_cast<size_t> (best)];
        const auto denominator = around[0] - 2.0f * centre + around[1];
        const auto shift = std::abs (denominator) > 1.0e-9f ? juce::jlimit (-0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f * (around[0] - around[1]) / denominator) : 0.0f;
        const auto frequency = rate / (static_cast<double> (best) + shift);
        return static_cast<float> (69.0 + 12.0 * std::log2 (frequency / 440.0));
    }

    void remember (juce::int64 index, float midi) noexcept
    {
        if (historyCount == historySize)
        {
            historyStart = (historyStart + 1) % historySize;
            --historyCount;
        }

        history[static_cast<size_t> ((historyStart + historyCount) % historySize)] = { index, midi };
        ++historyCount;
    }

    static constexpr int ringSize = 2048;
    static constexpr int frame = 256;
    static constexpr int hop = 64;
    static constexpr int historySize = 128;

    int factor = 4;
    double rate = 12000.0;
    int maxTau = 180, minTau = 11;
    std::array<juce::IIRFilter, 2> stages;
    std::array<float, ringSize> ring {};
    std::vector<float> window, difference;
    juce::int64 written = 0;
    int phase = 0, untilNext = hop;
    std::array<Entry, historySize> history {};
    int historyCount = 0, historyStart = 0;
};

//==============================================================================
/** One singer: a shifter, and who they are (when they come in, how they drift, their vibrato). */
struct Choir::VoiceDsp
{
    explicit VoiceDsp (int index)
        : random (static_cast<juce::int64> (index) * 7919 + 17)
    #if SONIFY_CHOIR_STRETCH
        , stretch (static_cast<long> (1000 + index))
    #endif
    {
        formantJitter = (random.nextFloat() * 2.0f - 1.0f) * 0.4f;
        baseDelayMs = 4.0f + random.nextFloat() * 22.0f;
        vibratoRate = 4.6f + random.nextFloat() * 1.4f;
        vibratoPhase = random.nextFloat() * juce::MathConstants<float>::twoPi;
        pitchTarget = random.nextFloat() * 2.0f - 1.0f;
        timeTarget = random.nextFloat() * 2.0f - 1.0f;
    }

    /** Message thread (or no audio running): set up for a rate, ready to play without allocating. */
    void setUp (double sampleRate, int lookahead)
    {
        out.assign (maxChunkSamples, 0.0f);
        delayLine.assign (static_cast<size_t> (juce::nextPowerOfTwo (static_cast<int> (0.1 * sampleRate) + maxChunkSamples + 8)), 0.0f);
        delayWrite = 0;
        delaySamples = -1.0f;

    #if SONIFY_CHOIR_STRETCH
        stretch.presetDefault (1, static_cast<float> (sampleRate), true);

        // Once through, so its buffers are as big as they get before the audio thread uses it.
        std::vector<float> silence (static_cast<size_t> (juce::jmax (lookahead, maxChunkSamples)), 0.0f);
        const float* in = silence.data();
        float* output = out.data();
        stretch.outputSeek (&in, lookahead);
        stretch.process (&in, maxChunkSamples, &output, maxChunkSamples);
        stretch.reset();
    #else
        juce::ignoreUnused (lookahead);
    #endif

        stale = true;
        ready = true;
    }

    static constexpr int maxChunkSamples = 256;

    juce::Random random;
#if SONIFY_CHOIR_STRETCH
    signalsmith::stretch::SignalsmithStretch<float> stretch;
#endif
    std::vector<float> out, delayLine;
    int delayWrite = 0;
    float delaySamples = -1.0f;
    bool stale = true, ready = false;
    float lastLeft = 0.0f, lastRight = 0.0f;

    float formantJitter = 0.0f, baseDelayMs = 10.0f, vibratoRate = 5.0f, vibratoPhase = 0.0f;
    float pitchDrift = 0.0f, pitchTarget = 0.0f, timeDrift = 0.0f, timeTarget = 0.0f;
    int driftCountdown = 0;
};

//==============================================================================
Choir::Change::Change() = default;
Choir::Change::~Change() = default;
Choir::Change::Change (Change&&) noexcept = default;
Choir::Change& Choir::Change::operator= (Change&&) noexcept = default;

Choir::Choir()
    : tracker (std::make_unique<PitchTracker>())
{
    static_assert (maxChunk == VoiceDsp::maxChunkSamples);
}

Choir::~Choir() = default;

void Choir::prepare (double rate, int)
{
    sampleRate = rate > 0.0 ? rate : 48000.0;

#if SONIFY_CHOIR_STRETCH
    {
        signalsmith::stretch::SignalsmithStretch<float> probe;
        probe.presetDefault (1, static_cast<float> (sampleRate), true);
        lookahead = probe.inputLatency() + probe.outputLatency();
        analysisDelay = probe.inputLatency();
    }
#else
    lookahead = 0;
    analysisDelay = 0;
#endif

    for (auto& voice : voices)
        if (voice != nullptr)
            voice->setUp (sampleRate, lookahead);

    tracker->prepare (sampleRate);
    feedBuffer.assign (static_cast<size_t> (maxChunk), 0.0f);
    startBuffer.assign (static_cast<size_t> (juce::jmax (1, lookahead)), 0.0f);
    busLeft.assign (static_cast<size_t> (maxChunk), 0.0f);
    busRight.assign (static_cast<size_t> (maxChunk), 0.0f);

    hall.setSampleRate (sampleRate);
    hallParameters = {};
    hallParameters.roomSize = 0.78f;
    hallParameters.damping = 0.5f;
    hallParameters.width = 1.0f;
    hallParameters.wetLevel = 0.0f;
    hallParameters.dryLevel = 1.0f;
    hall.setParameters (hallParameters);
    hall.reset();

    rolling = false;
    spanCount = 0;
}

Choir::Change Choir::prepareChange (const ChoirSettings& wanted) const
{
    Change change;
    change.settings = wanted;

    for (int i = 0; i < wanted.count; ++i)
    {
        if (voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)] != nullptr)
            continue;

        auto voice = std::make_unique<VoiceDsp> (i);

        if (sampleRate > 0.0)
            voice->setUp (sampleRate, lookahead);

        change.voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)] = std::move (voice);
    }

    return change;
}

void Choir::apply (Change& change) noexcept
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < voices.size(); ++i)
        if (change.voices[i] != nullptr && voices[i] == nullptr)
            voices[i] = std::move (change.voices[i]);

    settings = change.settings;
}

std::unique_ptr<const Choir::Timeline> Choir::swapTimeline (std::unique_ptr<const Timeline> fresh) noexcept
{
    std::swap (timeline, fresh);
    return fresh;
}

//==============================================================================
// Reading the clips
void Choir::readMono (const AudioPlaylist* list, juce::int64 from, int numSamples, float* dest) noexcept
{
    std::fill (dest, dest + numSamples, 0.0f);

    if (list == nullptr || numSamples <= 0)
        return;

    constexpr juce::int64 fade = 64;   // as Track::playClips: clip edges ramp in and out
    const auto to = from + numSamples;

    for (const auto& item : list->items)
    {
        if (item.data == nullptr || item.lengthSamples <= 0)
            continue;

        const auto itemEnd = item.startSample + item.lengthSamples;

        if (itemEnd <= from || item.startSample >= to)
            continue;

        const auto& samples = item.data->samples;
        const auto* sourceLeft = samples.getReadPointer (0);
        const auto* sourceRight = samples.getReadPointer (samples.getNumChannels() > 1 ? 1 : 0);
        const auto available = static_cast<juce::int64> (samples.getNumSamples());
        const auto first = juce::jmax (from, item.startSample);
        const auto last = juce::jmin (to, itemEnd);

        for (auto song = first; song < last; ++song)
        {
            const auto intoClip = song - item.startSample;
            const auto source = item.offsetSamples + intoClip;

            if (source < 0 || source >= available)
                continue;

            auto gain = item.gain;
            const auto untilEnd = item.lengthSamples - intoClip;

            if (intoClip < fade)
                gain *= static_cast<float> (intoClip) / static_cast<float> (fade);
            else if (untilEnd < fade)
                gain *= static_cast<float> (untilEnd) / static_cast<float> (fade);

            if (intoClip < item.fadeInSamples)
                gain *= static_cast<float> (std::sin (juce::MathConstants<double>::halfPi * static_cast<double> (intoClip) / static_cast<double> (item.fadeInSamples)));

            if (untilEnd < item.fadeOutSamples)
                gain *= static_cast<float> (std::sin (juce::MathConstants<double>::halfPi * static_cast<double> (untilEnd) / static_cast<double> (item.fadeOutSamples)));

            dest[song - from] += 0.5f * (sourceLeft[source] + sourceRight[source]) * gain;
        }
    }
}

void Choir::addSpan (juce::int64 song, juce::int64 length) noexcept
{
    const auto index = fedIndex;

    if (spanCount > 0)
    {
        auto& last = spans[static_cast<size_t> (spanCount - 1)];

        if (last.index + last.length == index && last.song + last.length == song)
        {
            last.length += length;
            return;
        }
    }

    if (spanCount == maxSpans)
    {
        rolling = false;   // more jumps ahead than it can follow: it starts again where the song is
        return;
    }

    spans[static_cast<size_t> (spanCount++)] = { index, song, length };
}

void Choir::dropSpansBefore (juce::int64 index) noexcept
{
    int keep = 0;

    while (keep < spanCount && spans[static_cast<size_t> (keep)].index + spans[static_cast<size_t> (keep)].length <= index)
        ++keep;

    if (keep == 0)
        return;

    for (int i = keep; i < spanCount; ++i)
        spans[static_cast<size_t> (i - keep)] = spans[static_cast<size_t> (i)];

    spanCount -= keep;
}

juce::int64 Choir::songAt (juce::int64 index) const noexcept
{
    for (int i = 0; i < spanCount; ++i)
    {
        const auto& span = spans[static_cast<size_t> (i)];

        if (index >= span.index && index < span.index + span.length)
            return span.song + (index - span.index);
    }

    return std::numeric_limits<juce::int64>::min();
}

juce::int64 Choir::spanLeft (juce::int64 index) const noexcept
{
    for (int i = 0; i < spanCount; ++i)
    {
        const auto& span = spans[static_cast<size_t> (i)];

        if (index >= span.index && index < span.index + span.length)
            return span.index + span.length - index;
    }

    return 0;
}

void Choir::feed (float* dest, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    int done = 0;

    while (done < numSamples)
    {
        auto chunk = static_cast<juce::int64> (numSamples - done);

        // The loop goes round ahead of the song, as the song will.
        if (loopOn && feedSong < loopEnd && feedSong + chunk > loopEnd)
            chunk = loopEnd - feedSong;

        readMono (reading, feedSong, static_cast<int> (chunk), dest + done);
        addSpan (feedSong, chunk);
        fedIndex += chunk;
        feedSong += chunk;
        done += static_cast<int> (chunk);

        if (loopOn && feedSong == loopEnd)
            feedSong = loopStart;
    }

    tracker->push (dest, numSamples, fedIndex - numSamples);
}

void Choir::readFed (float* dest, juce::int64 fromIndex, int numSamples) const noexcept
{
    std::fill (dest, dest + numSamples, 0.0f);
    const auto toIndex = fromIndex + numSamples;

    for (int i = 0; i < spanCount; ++i)
    {
        const auto& span = spans[static_cast<size_t> (i)];
        const auto first = juce::jmax (fromIndex, span.index);
        const auto last = juce::jmin (toIndex, span.index + span.length);

        if (last > first)
            readMono (reading, span.song + (first - span.index), static_cast<int> (last - first), dest + (first - fromIndex));
    }
}

//==============================================================================
// The parts
namespace
{
    bool hasPitchClass (juce::uint16 notes, int note) noexcept
    {
        return ((notes >> (((note % 12) + 12) % 12)) & 1) != 0;
    }

    int bitCount (juce::uint16 notes) noexcept
    {
        int count = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i)
            count += (notes >> i) & 1;

        return count;
    }

    /** Semitones from the note to the scale note steps away (from the nearest scale note when
        the note sung isn't one). */
    int scaleSteps (int note, int root, juce::uint16 notes, int steps) noexcept
    {
        if (notes == 0)
            notes = 0x0fff;

        const auto inScale = [root, notes] (int n) { return hasPitchClass (notes, n - root); };
        auto base = note;

        if (! inScale (base))
        {
            for (int d = 1; d <= 6; ++d)
            {
                if (inScale (note - d)) { base = note - d; break; }
                if (inScale (note + d)) { base = note + d; break; }
            }
        }

        auto target = base;
        const auto direction = steps > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        auto left = std::abs (steps);

        for (int guard = 0; left > 0 && guard < 60; ++guard)
        {
            target += direction;

            if (inScale (target))
                --left;
        }

        return target - note;
    }

    /** Semitones from the note to the chord note steps away (passing the note's own). */
    int chordSteps (int note, juce::uint16 chord, int steps) noexcept
    {
        auto target = note;
        const auto direction = steps > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        auto left = std::abs (steps);

        for (int guard = 0; left > 0 && guard < 60; ++guard)
        {
            target += direction;

            if (hasPitchClass (chord, target))
                --left;
        }

        return target - note;
    }
}

float Choir::partSemitones (const ChoirSettings::Voice& voice, juce::int64 songSample) noexcept
{
    const auto octave = 12.0f * static_cast<float> (voice.octave);

    if (voice.mode == ChoirSettings::Mode::semitones || voice.interval == 0)
        return octave + static_cast<float> (voice.mode == ChoirSettings::Mode::semitones ? voice.interval : 0);

    // The key and the chord where the shifter listens now.
    int root = 0;
    juce::uint16 scale = 0x0ab5, chord = 0;

    if (timeline != nullptr)
    {
        const auto& keys = timeline->keys;
        auto key = std::upper_bound (keys.begin(), keys.end(), songSample, [] (juce::int64 s, const Timeline::Key& k) { return s < k.sample; });

        if (key != keys.begin())
        {
            --key;
            root = key->root;
            scale = key->notes;
        }
        else if (! keys.empty())
        {
            root = keys.front().root;
            scale = keys.front().notes;
        }

        const auto& chords = timeline->chords;
        auto found = std::upper_bound (chords.begin(), chords.end(), songSample, [] (juce::int64 s, const Timeline::Chord& c) { return s < c.sample; });

        if (found != chords.begin())
            chord = std::prev (found)->notes;
    }

    // Before any note is heard: as if the key's root were sung.
    const auto note = heldNote >= 0.0f ? static_cast<int> (heldNote) : 60 + root;

    if (voice.mode == ChoirSettings::Mode::chord)
    {
        if (bitCount (chord) >= 2)
            return octave + static_cast<float> (chordSteps (note, chord, voice.interval));

        // No chords there: thirds of the key.
        return octave + static_cast<float> (scaleSteps (note, root, scale, juce::jlimit (-7, 7, voice.interval * 2)));
    }

    return octave + static_cast<float> (scaleSteps (note, root, scale, voice.interval));
}

void Choir::setVoiceParameters (VoiceDsp& voice, int index, float semitones) noexcept
{
    const auto& part = settings.voices[static_cast<size_t> (index)];

    // A woman's voice from a man's has its resonances higher (about three semitones), and the
    // other way round; its character and the singer's own make a little more of a difference.
    auto formant = part.female == settings.leadFemale ? 0.0f : (part.female ? 3.0f : -3.0f);
    formant += part.character * 2.5f + voice.formantJitter;

    const auto vibrato = settings.vibrato * 0.3f * std::sin (voice.vibratoPhase);
    const auto drift = settings.pitch * 0.15f * voice.pitchDrift;

#if SONIFY_CHOIR_STRETCH
    // Above 8 kHz (the breath and the s's) the sound isn't moved, which keeps it natural.
    voice.stretch.setTransposeSemitones (semitones + vibrato + drift, static_cast<float> (8000.0 / sampleRate));
    voice.stretch.setFormantSemitones (formant, true);

    // The note sung tells it where the voice's harmonics are, so it finds the resonances cleanly
    // (its own guess can mistake them and leave stray tones).
    voice.stretch.setFormantBase (sungPitch > 0.0f ? static_cast<float> (440.0 * std::pow (2.0, (sungPitch - 69.0) / 12.0) / sampleRate) : 0.0f);
#else
    juce::ignoreUnused (semitones, vibrato, drift, formant);
#endif
}

//==============================================================================
// Playing
void Choir::start (juce::int64 songSample) noexcept
{
    spanCount = 0;
    fedIndex = outIndex = 0;
    feedSong = songSample;
    heldNote = -1.0f;
    sungPitch = -1.0f;
    tracker->reset();
    rolling = true;

    if (lookahead > 0)
        feed (startBuffer.data(), lookahead);

    for (auto& voice : voices)
        if (voice != nullptr)
            voice->stale = true;

    hall.reset();
}

void Choir::startVoice (VoiceDsp& voice, int index) noexcept
{
#if SONIFY_CHOIR_STRETCH
    // What the shifter needs from where the song is: the sound already read ahead.
    readFed (startBuffer.data(), outIndex, lookahead);
    setVoiceParameters (voice, index, partSemitones (settings.voices[static_cast<size_t> (index)], songAt (outIndex)));
    const float* in = startBuffer.data();
    voice.stretch.outputSeek (&in, lookahead);
#else
    juce::ignoreUnused (index);
#endif

    std::fill (voice.delayLine.begin(), voice.delayLine.end(), 0.0f);
    voice.delayWrite = 0;
    voice.delaySamples = -1.0f;
    voice.lastLeft = voice.lastRight = 0.0f;
    voice.stale = false;
}

void Choir::process (const AudioPlaylist* list, const Transport& transport, float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    if (numSamples <= 0 || left == nullptr || right == nullptr || sampleRate <= 0.0)
        return;

    reading = list;

    // The vocal itself, at the lead's level.
    {
        const auto target = settings.leadDb <= ChoirSettings::leadOff ? 0.0f : juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (settings.leadDb);
        const auto step = (target - leadGain) / static_cast<float> (numSamples);
        auto gain = leadGain;

        if (! juce::exactlyEqual (target, 1.0f) || ! juce::exactlyEqual (leadGain, 1.0f))
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
            {
                gain += step;
                left[i] *= gain;
                right[i] *= gain;
            }
        }

        leadGain = target;
    }

    juce::int64 loopFrom = 0, loopTo = 0;
    loopOn = transport.getLoopSamples (loopFrom, loopTo);
    loopStart = loopFrom;
    loopEnd = loopTo;

    const auto segments = transport.getNumSegments();

    if (segments == 0 || settings.count <= 0)
    {
        rolling = false;
        return;
    }

    startsLeft = startsPerBlock;

    for (int s = 0; s < segments; ++s)
    {
        const auto& segment = transport.getSegment (s);
        auto song = segment.sample;
        auto offset = segment.offset;
        auto length = juce::jmin (segment.length, numSamples - offset);

        while (length > 0)
        {
            if (lookahead > 0)
            {
                if (! rolling || songAt (outIndex) != song)
                    start (song);
            }
            else
            {
                // Without a shifter there's nothing ahead to keep: the song is read where it plays.
                if (! rolling || feedSong != song)
                {
                    rolling = true;
                    feedSong = song;
                    spanCount = 0;
                    fedIndex = outIndex;
                }
            }

            auto chunk = juce::jmin (length, maxChunk);

            if (lookahead > 0)
                chunk = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin (static_cast<juce::int64> (chunk), spanLeft (outIndex)));

            if (chunk <= 0)
            {
                start (song);
                continue;
            }

            renderChunk (left + offset, right + offset, chunk);
            outIndex += chunk;
            song += chunk;
            offset += chunk;
            length -= chunk;
            dropSpansBefore (outIndex);
        }
    }
}

void Choir::renderChunk (float* left, float* right, int n) noexcept
{
    auto* in = feedBuffer.data();
    feed (in, n);

    // The note sung where the shifters listen now, held while it wavers less than a semitone.
    const auto listening = fedIndex - analysisDelay - n / 2;

    if (const auto pitch = tracker->pitchAt (listening); pitch > 0.0f)
    {
        sungPitch = pitch;

        if (heldNote < 0.0f || std::abs (pitch - heldNote) > 0.75f)
            heldNote = static_cast<float> (std::lround (pitch));
    }

    const auto songNow = songAt (listening);
    std::fill (busLeft.begin(), busLeft.begin() + n, 0.0f);
    std::fill (busRight.begin(), busRight.begin() + n, 0.0f);

    const auto count = juce::jlimit (0, ChoirSettings::maxVoices, settings.count);
    bool anySolo = false;
    int audible = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        anySolo = anySolo || settings.voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)].solo;

    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        const auto& part = settings.voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)];
        audible += (! part.mute && (! anySolo || part.solo)) ? 1 : 0;
    }

    // More voices sound fuller, not louder.
    const auto ensemble = 1.0f / std::sqrt (static_cast<float> (juce::jmax (1, audible)));
    const auto chunkSeconds = static_cast<float> (n / sampleRate);

    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        auto* voice = voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)].get();

        if (voice == nullptr || ! voice->ready)
            continue;

        if (voice->stale)
        {
            if (startsLeft <= 0)
                continue;   // it comes in a block later

            startVoice (*voice, i);
            --startsLeft;
        }

        const auto& part = settings.voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)];

        // Humanize: slow drifts toward new targets now and then, and the vibrato's swing.
        if ((voice->driftCountdown -= n) <= 0)
        {
            voice->driftCountdown = static_cast<int> ((0.4 + voice->random.nextFloat() * 0.9) * sampleRate);
            voice->pitchTarget = voice->random.nextFloat() * 2.0f - 1.0f;
            voice->timeTarget = voice->random.nextFloat() * 2.0f - 1.0f;
        }

        const auto follow = juce::jmin (1.0f, chunkSeconds / 0.35f);
        voice->pitchDrift += (voice->pitchTarget - voice->pitchDrift) * follow;
        voice->timeDrift += (voice->timeTarget - voice->timeDrift) * follow;
        voice->vibratoPhase += juce::MathConstants<float>::twoPi * voice->vibratoRate * chunkSeconds;

        if (voice->vibratoPhase > juce::MathConstants<float>::twoPi)
            voice->vibratoPhase -= juce::MathConstants<float>::twoPi;

        setVoiceParameters (*voice, i, partSemitones (part, songNow));

        auto* sung = voice->out.data();

    #if SONIFY_CHOIR_STRETCH
        const float* input = in;
        voice->stretch.process (&input, n, &sung, n);
    #else
        std::copy (in, in + n, sung);
    #endif

        // Each singer a little late or early (around the beat, never far), drifting slowly.
        const auto delayTarget = static_cast<float> (sampleRate * 0.001) * settings.timing * juce::jmax (0.0f, voice->baseDelayMs + 6.0f * voice->timeDrift);
        auto& line = voice->delayLine;
        const auto mask = static_cast<int> (line.size()) - 1;
        const auto maxDelay = static_cast<float> (line.size() - static_cast<size_t> (maxChunk) - 4);

        if (voice->delaySamples < 0.0f)
            voice->delaySamples = delayTarget;

        // Where it sits in the stereo, and how loud.
        const auto heard = ! part.mute && (! anySolo || part.solo);
        const auto gain = heard ? juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (part.levelDb) * ensemble : 0.0f;
        const auto pan = juce::jlimit (-1.0f, 1.0f, part.pan * settings.spread);
        const auto angle = (pan + 1.0f) * juce::MathConstants<float>::pi * 0.25f;
        const auto targetLeft = gain * juce::MathConstants<float>::sqrt2 * std::cos (angle);
        const auto targetRight = gain * juce::MathConstants<float>::sqrt2 * std::sin (angle);
        const auto stepLeft = (targetLeft - voice->lastLeft) / static_cast<float> (n);
        const auto stepRight = (targetRight - voice->lastRight) / static_cast<float> (n);
        auto gainLeft = voice->lastLeft, gainRight = voice->lastRight;

        for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k)
        {
            line[static_cast<size_t> (voice->delayWrite & mask)] = sung[k];
            voice->delaySamples += (delayTarget - voice->delaySamples) * 0.0005f;
            const auto delay = juce::jlimit (0.0f, maxDelay, voice->delaySamples);
            const auto readAt = static_cast<float> (voice->delayWrite) - delay;
            const auto whole = static_cast<int> (std::floor (readAt));
            const auto fraction = readAt - static_cast<float> (whole);
            const auto a = line[static_cast<size_t> (whole & mask)];
            const auto b = line[static_cast<size_t> ((whole + 1) & mask)];
            const auto sample = a + (b - a) * fraction;
            ++voice->delayWrite;

            gainLeft += stepLeft;
            gainRight += stepRight;
            busLeft[static_cast<size_t> (k)] += sample * gainLeft;
            busRight[static_cast<size_t> (k)] += sample * gainRight;
        }

        voice->lastLeft = targetLeft;
        voice->lastRight = targetRight;
    }

    // Voices no longer in use start afresh when they come back.
    for (int i = count; i < ChoirSettings::maxVoices; ++i)
        if (auto* voice = voices[static_cast<size_t> (i)].get())
            voice->stale = true;

    // The hall, then the choir into the track.
    const auto wet = settings.hall * 0.55f;

    if (! juce::exactlyEqual (wet, hallParameters.wetLevel))
    {
        hallParameters.wetLevel = wet;
        hallParameters.dryLevel = 1.0f - settings.hall * 0.3f;
        hall.setParameters (hallParameters);
    }

    if (settings.hall > 0.001f)
        hall.processStereo (busLeft.data(), busRight.data(), n);

    const auto target = juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (settings.choirDb);
    const auto step = (target - choirGain) / static_cast<float> (n);
    auto gain = choirGain;

    for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k)
    {
        gain += step;
        left[k] += busLeft[static_cast<size_t> (k)] * gain;
        right[k] += busRight[static_cast<size_t> (k)] * gain;
    }

    choirGain = target;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Choir.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>

#include <array>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

struct AudioPlaylist;
class Transport;

//==============================================================================
/**
    A choir track's settings: the voices made from its vocal, as its Choir window sets them.

    Each voice sings the track's vocal moved to its part:
      scale       steps of the song's key from the note sung (2: a third above in the key)
      chord       chord notes from it (1: the next chord note above), the chords played by
                  another track (chordTrack); without chords there, thirds of the key
      semitones   a fixed interval
    then by whole octaves. A voice is a man's or a woman's: from a man's lead a woman's voice has
    its formants (the resonances that tell voices apart) raised, and the other way round; its
    character moves them a little more, darker or brighter. Humanize makes the voices people: each
    sings a little late or early (timing), a little off and drifting (pitch), with a vibrato of
    its own. Spread places them across the stereo; the hall puts them in a room.
*/
struct ChoirSettings
{
    static constexpr int maxVoices = 16;

    enum class Mode { scale, chord, semitones };

    struct Voice
    {
        bool female = false;
        float character = 0.0f;       // -1 darker .. +1 brighter
        Mode mode = Mode::scale;
        int interval = 0;             // scale: -7..7 steps; chord: -4..4 chord notes; semitones: -24..24
        int octave = 0;               // -2..2
        float levelDb = 0.0f;         // -36..6
        float pan = 0.0f;             // -1 left .. +1 right
        bool mute = false, solo = false;

        bool operator== (const Voice& other) const noexcept;
    };

    bool leadFemale = false;          // the vocal on the track: a man's or a woman's
    float leadDb = 0.0f;              // the vocal itself in the mix; at or below leadOff: not heard
    float choirDb = 0.0f;             // the voices together
    float spread = 0.8f;              // 0..1: how far the voices' pans reach
    float timing = 0.5f;              // humanize, 0..1
    float pitch = 0.4f;
    float vibrato = 0.2f;
    float hall = 0.25f;               // 0..1
    int chordTrack = 0;               // the instrument track playing the chords (0: none)
    int count = 0;                    // voices in use
    std::array<Voice, maxVoices> voices {};

    static constexpr float leadOff = -60.0f;

    /** The page's and the song file's form: { leadFemale, lead, choir, spread, timing, pitch,
        vibrato, hall, chordTrack, voices: [{ female, character, mode ("scale" | "chord" |
        "semitones"), interval, octave, level, pan, mute, solo }] }. */
    juce::var toVar() const;

    /** Read back, each value kept in its range; what's missing takes its default. */
    static ChoirSettings fromVar (const juce::var& value);

    /** A new choir track's: four voices around a man's lead (two women an octave up, two men). */
    static ChoirSettings makeDefault();

    bool operator== (const ChoirSettings& other) const noexcept;
    bool operator!= (const ChoirSettings& other) const noexcept  { return ! operator== (other); }
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    The voices of a choir track, made live from its audio clips as the song plays.

    Each voice is a pitch and formant shifter (Signalsmith Stretch, MIT) following the vocal. A
    shifter needs the sound ahead of the moment it plays (about 150 ms), and the clips are all in
    memory, so the choir reads them ahead of the song: what the voices sing lines up with the
    vocal exactly. Where the song jumps (play from elsewhere, a loop going round) the reading
    follows the loop ahead of time, and a jump it didn't see coming starts the voices again there,
    a few at a time so a block never takes too long (with many voices they come in over the first
    tens of milliseconds).

    The note sung is followed (YIN pitch detection, on the vocal read ahead) for the scale and
    chord parts; the key comes from the song channel and the chords from another track's notes,
    both laid out in song samples (Timeline) by the engine whenever they change.

    Threads: the engine creates and prepares it on the message thread; settings changes are
    made ready there (prepareChange: the shifters a new voice needs) and applied under the
    engine's graph lock (apply), as is the timeline. process() runs on the audio thread, under
    that lock.
*/
class Choir final
{
public:
    struct VoiceDsp;

    /** The song's keys and the chords, in song samples, in order. */
    struct Timeline
    {
        struct Key
        {
            juce::int64 sample = 0;
            int root = 0;                     // 0 C .. 11 B
            juce::uint16 notes = 0x0ab5;      // the scale's notes from the root (TempoMap::scaleNotes)

            bool operator== (const Key& other) const noexcept   { return sample == other.sample && root == other.root && notes == other.notes; }
        };

        struct Chord
        {
            juce::int64 sample = 0;
            juce::uint16 notes = 0;           // pitch classes sounding (bit 0: C); 0: no chord here

            bool operator== (const Chord& other) const noexcept { return sample == other.sample && notes == other.notes; }
        };

        std::vector<Key> keys;
        std::vector<Chord> chords;

        bool operator== (const Timeline& other) const noexcept  { return keys == other.keys && chords == other.chords; }
    };

    /** A settings change made ready on the message thread. */
    struct Change
    {
        Change();
        ~Change();
        Change (Change&&) noexcept;
        Change& operator= (Change&&) noexcept;

        ChoirSettings settings;
        std::array<std::unique_ptr<VoiceDsp>, ChoirSettings::maxVoices> voices;   // new shifters, where the choir has none yet
    };

    Choir();
    ~Choir();

    /** No audio callback active. The voices made so far are set up again at this rate. */
    void prepare (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize);

    /** Message thread: the shifters the settings' voices need that the choir doesn't have yet. */
    Change prepareChange (const ChoirSettings& settings) const;

    /** Under the engine's graph lock (cheap: pointers and a copy). */
    void apply (Change& change) noexcept;

    const ChoirSettings& getSettings() const noexcept           { return settings; }

    /** Under the engine's graph lock; the old one comes back, to be let go outside it. */
    std::unique_ptr<const Timeline> swapTimeline (std::unique_ptr<const Timeline> fresh) noexcept;
    const Timeline* getTimeline() const noexcept                { return timeline.get(); }

    /** Audio thread. left and right hold the vocal as the track plays it (its clips): the lead's
        level goes onto it, and the voices are added, made from the playlist read ahead. */
    void process (const AudioPlaylist* list, const Transport& transport, float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept;

    /** How far ahead the voices read, in samples (the shifters' latency). */
    int getLookahead() const noexcept                           { return lookahead; }

private:
    struct Span
    {
        juce::int64 index = 0;      // the first fed sample it holds (counted from the last start)
        juce::int64 song = 0;       // where that is in the song, in samples
        juce::int64 length = 0;
    };

    class PitchTracker;

    void start (juce::int64 songSample) noexcept;
    void startVoice (VoiceDsp& voice, int index) noexcept;
    void renderChunk (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept;
    void feed (float* dest, int numSamples) noexcept;
    void readFed (float* dest, juce::int64 fromIndex, int numSamples) const noexcept;
    juce::int64 songAt (juce::int64 index) const noexcept;
    juce::int64 spanLeft (juce::int64 index) const noexcept;
    void addSpan (juce::int64 song, juce::int64 length) noexcept;
    void dropSpansBefore (juce::int64 index) noexcept;
    void setVoiceParameters (VoiceDsp& voice, int index, float semitones) noexcept;
    float partSemitones (const ChoirSettings::Voice& voice, juce::int64 songSample) noexcept;

    static void readMono (const AudioPlaylist* list, juce::int64 from, int numSamples, float* dest) noexcept;

    ChoirSettings settings;
    std::array<std::unique_ptr<VoiceDsp>, ChoirSettings::maxVoices> voices;
    std::unique_ptr<const Timeline> timeline;
    std::unique_ptr<PitchTracker> tracker;
    juce::Reverb hall;
    juce::Reverb::Parameters hallParameters;

    double sampleRate = 0.0;
    int lookahead = 0;              // samples: what a shifter needs ahead (its input and output latency)
    int analysisDelay = 0;          // how far behind the newest sample a shifter's analysis sits

    static constexpr int maxChunk = 256;
    static constexpr int maxSpans = 64;
    static constexpr int startsPerBlock = 3;

    // Audio thread: the reading ahead.
    bool rolling = false;
    const AudioPlaylist* reading = nullptr;          // the playlist this block reads
    juce::int64 fedIndex = 0, outIndex = 0;          // samples fed to the shifters, and played, since the last start
    juce::int64 feedSong = 0;                        // where the next sample fed comes from in the song
    bool loopOn = false;
    juce::int64 loopStart = 0, loopEnd = 0;
    std::array<Span, maxSpans> spans {};
    int spanCount = 0;
    int startsLeft = 0;

    // The note sung, held while it wavers (and through breaths), and its pitch as last heard.
    float heldNote = -1.0f, sungPitch = -1.0f;

    std::vector<float> feedBuffer, startBuffer, busLeft, busRight;
    float leadGain = 1.0f, choirGain = 1.0f;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Choir)
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\clap-webview-gui.h

#pragma once

// Stand-in for wclap-bridge's webview-gui module, with the same API.
//
// The real module opens a plugin's web UI in its own native window. The Hub shows
// plugin UIs inside its own web view instead, so every native-window call here
// answers "not supported". Messages a plugin sends to its UI are still forwarded
// to the host's CLAP_EXT_WEBVIEW extension whenever the host provides one.

#include "clap/all.h"   // includes the draft webview extension

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

namespace webview_gui
{

struct ClapWebviewGui
{
    // Plugin GUI extension handed to the host: reports no native GUI support.
    clap_plugin_gui* extPluginGui;

    // Used by the bridge instead of querying the host directly.
    const clap_host_webview* extHostWebview;

    ClapWebviewGui (const clap_plugin* = nullptr, const clap_host* = nullptr)
    {
        extPluginGui = &pluginGuiProxy;
        extHostWebview = &hostWebviewProxy;
    }

    void init (const clap_plugin*, const clap_host*) {}
    void init() {}

    bool isApiSupported (const char*, bool)            { return false; }
    bool getPreferredApi (const char**, bool*)         { return false; }
    bool create (const char*, bool)                    { return false; }
    void destroy()                                     {}
    bool setScale (double)                             { return true; }

    bool getSize (uint32_t* width, uint32_t* height)
    {
        *width = 640;
        *height = 400;
        return true;
    }

    bool canResize()                                   { return false; }

    bool getResizeHints (clap_gui_resize_hints_t* hints)
    {
        *hints = { false, false, false, 0, 0 };
        return true;
    }

    bool adjustSize (uint32_t*, uint32_t*)             { return false; }
    bool setSize (uint32_t, uint32_t)                  { return false; }
    bool setParent (const clap_window*)                { return false; }
    bool setTransient (const clap_window*)             { return false; }
    void suggestTitle (const char*)                    {}
    bool show()                                        { return false; }
    bool hide()                                        { return false; }

private:
    static bool hostWebviewSend (const clap_host_t* host, const void* buffer, uint32_t size)
    {
        if (host == nullptr || host->get_extension == nullptr)
            return false;

        const auto* ext = static_cast<const clap_host_webview*> (host->get_extension (host, CLAP_EXT_WEBVIEW));
        return ext != nullptr && ext->send != nullptr && ext->send (host, buffer, size);
    }

    static bool guiIsApiSupported (const clap_plugin*, const char*, bool)          { return false; }
    static bool guiGetPreferredApi (const clap_plugin*, const char**, bool*)       { return false; }
    static bool guiCreate (const clap_plugin*, const char*, bool)                  { return false; }
    static void guiDestroy (const clap_plugin*)                                    {}
    static bool guiSetScale (const clap_plugin*, double)                           { return true; }

    static bool guiGetSize (const clap_plugin*, uint32_t* width, uint32_t* height)
    {
        *width = 640;
        *height = 400;
        return true;
    }

    static bool guiCanResize (const clap_plugin*)                                  { return false; }

    static bool guiGetResizeHints (const clap_plugin*, clap_gui_resize_hints_t* hints)
    {
        *hints = { false, false, false, 0, 0 };
        return true;
    }

    static bool guiAdjustSize (const clap_plugin*, uint32_t*, uint32_t*)           { return false; }
    static bool guiSetSize (const clap_plugin*, uint32_t, uint32_t)                { return false; }
    static bool guiSetParent (const clap_plugin*, const clap_window*)              { return false; }
    static bool guiSetTransient (const clap_plugin*, const clap_window*)           { return false; }
    static void guiSuggestTitle (const clap_plugin*, const char*)                  {}
    static bool guiShow (const clap_plugin*)                                       { return false; }
    static bool guiHide (const clap_plugin*)                                       { return false; }

    clap_plugin_gui pluginGuiProxy { guiIsApiSupported, guiGetPreferredApi, guiCreate, guiDestroy,
                                     guiSetScale, guiGetSize, guiCanResize, guiGetResizeHints,
                                     guiAdjustSize, guiSetSize, guiSetParent, guiSetTransient,
                                     guiSuggestTitle, guiShow, guiHide };

    clap_host_webview hostWebviewProxy { hostWebviewSend };

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Cloud.cpp

#include "Cloud.h"

namespace
{
    /** The Base44 app that holds what Fanan publishes. FananWebHub-cloud.json beside the
        program can name another (and another server, as the tests do). */
    constexpr const char* fananAppId = "6abdbe690c1a2fa318bee483";   // Fanan Hub Cloud on Base44

    juce::var object()
    {
        return juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    }

    /** What the server said went wrong, in its own words where it gave them. */
    juce::String errorText (int status, const juce::var& body, const juce::String& text)
    {
        for (const auto* key : { "detail", "message", "error" })
        {
            const auto value = body.getProperty (key, {});

            if (value.isString() && value.toString().isNotEmpty())
                return value.toString();

            if (value.isObject() && value.getProperty ("message", {}).toString().isNotEmpty())
                return value.getProperty ("message", {}).toString();
        }

        if (status == 401 || status == 403)
            return "The Fanan cloud refused the request.";

        if (status == 404)
            return "Not found in the Fanan cloud.";

        return "The Fanan cloud answered " + juce::String (status) + (text.isNotEmpty() && text.length() < 120 ? ": " + text : juce::String());
    }
}

//==============================================================================
Cloud::Settings Cloud::loadSettings()
{
    Settings loaded;
    loaded.appId = fananAppId;

    const auto file = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile).getSiblingFile ("FananWebHub-cloud.json");
    const auto config = juce::JSON::parse (file);

    if (const auto appId = config.getProperty ("appId", {}).toString().trim(); appId.isNotEmpty())
        loaded.appId = appId;

    if (const auto server = config.getProperty ("serverUrl", {}).toString().trim(); server.isNotEmpty())
        loaded.serverUrl = server.trimCharactersAtEnd ("/");

    return loaded;
}

Cloud::Cloud (Settings s)
    : settings (std::move (s))
{
}

Cloud::~Cloud()
{
    alive->store (false);                 // no answers after this
    worker.removeAllJobs (true, 20000);   // a job under way finishes first
}

//==============================================================================
void Cloud::run (std::function<void()> job)
{
    ++pending;
    worker.addJob ([this, job = std::move (job)]
    {
        job();
        --pending;
    });
}

void Cloud::answer (const Done& done, juce::Result result, juce::var value)
{
    std::function<void()> call = [alive = alive, done, result = std::move (result), value = std::move (value)]
    {
        if (alive->load() && done != nullptr)
            done (result, value);
    };

    if (deliverer != nullptr)
        deliverer (std::move (call));
    else
        juce::MessageManager::callAsync (std::move (call));
}

void Cloud::report (const Progress& progress, double fraction, const juce::String& text)
{
    if (progress == nullptr)
        return;

    std::function<void()> call = [alive = alive, progress, fraction, text]
    {
        if (alive->load())
            progress (fraction, text);
    };

    if (deliverer != nullptr)
        deliverer (std::move (call));
    else
        juce::MessageManager::callAsync (std::move (call));
}

//==============================================================================
Cloud::Response Cloud::request (const juce::String& method, const juce::String& path, const juce::var& json,
                                const juce::StringPairArray& query, int timeoutMs)
{
    Response response;

    if (blocked.load())
    {
        response.error = "The internet is blocked (the switch at the top left). Turn it off to use the Fanan cloud.";
        return response;
    }

    juce::URL url (settings.serverUrl + "/api/apps/" + settings.appId + path);

    for (const auto& key : query.getAllKeys())
        url = url.withParameter (key, query[key]);

    const bool hasBody = ! json.isVoid();

    if (hasBody)
        url = url.withPOSTData (juce::JSON::toString (json, true));

    juce::String headers;
    headers << "X-App-Id: " << settings.appId << "\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n";

    if (hasBody)
        headers << "Content-Type: application/json\r\n";

    const auto options = juce::URL::InputStreamOptions (hasBody ? juce::URL::ParameterHandling::inPostData
                                                                : juce::URL::ParameterHandling::inAddress)
                             .withExtraHeaders (headers)
                             .withConnectionTimeoutMs (timeoutMs)
                             .withStatusCode (&response.status)
                             .withNumRedirectsToFollow (5)
                             .withHttpRequestCmd (method);

    const auto stream = url.createInputStream (options);

    if (stream == nullptr)
    {
        response.error = "Couldn't reach the Fanan cloud. Check the internet connection.";
        return response;
    }

    const auto text = stream->readEntireStreamAsString();
    response.body = juce::JSON::parse (text);

    if (response.status == 0 || response.status >= 400)
        response.error = errorText (response.status, response.body, text);

    return response;
}

bool Cloud::download (const juce::String& address, const juce::File& destination, juce::String& error)
{
    if (blocked.load())
    {
        error = "The internet is blocked.";
        return false;
    }

    int status = 0;
    const auto stream = juce::URL (address).createInputStream (juce::URL::InputStreamOptions (juce::URL::ParameterHandling::inAddress)
                                                                   .withConnectionTimeoutMs (60000)
                                                                   .withStatusCode (&status)
                                                                   .withNumRedirectsToFollow (5));

    if (stream == nullptr || status >= 400)
    {
        error = "Couldn't download " + destination.getFileName() + (status >= 400 ? " (" + juce::String (status) + ")" : juce::String());
        return false;
    }

    destination.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();
    const auto partial = destination.getSiblingFile (destination.getFileName() + ".part");
    partial.deleteFile();

    {
        juce::FileOutputStream out (partial);
        const auto written = out.openedOk() ? out.writeFromInputStream (*stream, -1) : -1;
        out.flush();

        if (written < 0 || out.getStatus().failed())
        {
            error = "Couldn't write " + destination.getFullPathName();
            return false;
        }
    }

    destination.deleteFile();
    return partial.moveFileTo (destination);
}

//==============================================================================
namespace
{
    /** The file's own extension from its address, the double ones included (.wclap.tar.gz). */
    juce::String extensionOf (const juce::String& address)
    {
        const auto name = juce::URL (address).getFileName().toLowerCase();

        for (const auto* ending : { ".wclap.tar.gz", ".wclap.tgz", ".tar.gz" })
            if (name.endsWith (ending))
                return ending;

        // As File::getFileExtension would, without making a File of a bare name (a debug assertion).
        return name.containsChar ('.') ? name.fromLastOccurrenceOf (".", true, false) : juce::String();
    }

    /** Where an item of a kind goes under the content folder. */
    juce::File placeFor (const juce::String& kind, const juce::File& root)
    {
        if (kind == "loop")    return root.getChildFile ("Loops");
        if (kind == "sample")  return root.getChildFile ("Samples");
        if (kind == "song")    return root.getChildFile ("Songs");
        if (kind == "plugin")  return root.getChildFile ("Plugins");
        if (kind == "miditool") return root.getChildFile ("MIDI Tools");
        return root.getChildFile ("Other");
    }

    /** A song's package, unpacked only if every file in it stays inside its folder. */
    juce::Result unpack (const juce::File& package, const juce::File& folder)
    {
        juce::ZipFile zip (package);

        if (zip.getNumEntries() == 0)
            return juce::Result::fail ("The song's package is empty or damaged.");

        for (int i = 0; i < zip.getNumEntries(); ++i)
        {
            const auto* entry = zip.getEntry (i);
            const auto target = folder.getChildFile (entry->filename);

            if (entry->filename.contains ("..") || juce::File::isAbsolutePath (entry->filename) || ! target.isAChildOf (folder))
                return juce::Result::fail ("The song's package tries to write outside its folder, so it wasn't opened.");
        }

        folder.createDirectory();
        return zip.uncompressTo (folder, true);
    }
}

void Cloud::listContent (Done done)
{
    run ([this, done]
    {
        juce::StringPairArray query;
        query.set ("sort", "-created_date");
        query.set ("limit", "500");

        auto published = object();
        published.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("published", true);
        query.set ("q", juce::JSON::toString (published, true));

        const auto response = request ("GET", juce::String ("/entities/") + contentEntityName, {}, query);

        if (response.error.isNotEmpty())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (response.error));
            return;
        }

        juce::Array<juce::var> items;

        if (const auto* records = response.body.getArray())
        {
            for (const auto& record : *records)
            {
                const auto kind = record.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString().toLowerCase();
                const auto file = record.getProperty ("file_url", {}).toString();

                if (file.isEmpty() || ! juce::StringArray { "loop", "sample", "song", "plugin", "miditool" }.contains (kind))
                    continue;   // nothing the Hub knows how to use

                auto item = object();
                auto* fields = item.getDynamicObject();
                fields->setProperty ("id", record.getProperty ("id", {}).toString());
                fields->setProperty ("title", record.getProperty ("title", "Untitled").toString());
                fields->setProperty ("kind", kind);
                fields->setProperty ("description", record.getProperty ("description", {}).toString());
                fields->setProperty ("tags", record.getProperty ("tags", juce::Array<juce::var>()));
                fields->setProperty ("bpm", record.getProperty ("bpm", 0));
                fields->setProperty ("key", record.getProperty ("key", {}).toString());
                fields->setProperty ("size", record.getProperty ("size_bytes", 0));
                fields->setProperty ("version", record.getProperty ("version", "1").toString());
                fields->setProperty ("file_url", file);
                fields->setProperty ("preview_url", record.getProperty ("preview_url", {}).toString());
                fields->setProperty ("tool_id", record.getProperty ("tool_id", {}).toString());
                items.add (item);
            }
        }

        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), items);
    });
}

void Cloud::installContent (const juce::var& item, const juce::File& root, Done done, Progress progress)
{
    run ([this, item, root, done, progress]
    {
        const auto kind = item.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString();
        const auto address = item.getProperty ("file_url", {}).toString();
        const auto title = juce::File::createLegalFileName (item.getProperty ("title", "Untitled").toString());
        const auto place = placeFor (kind, root);
        place.createDirectory();

        juce::String error;
        const auto extension = extensionOf (address);

        // A MIDI tool: its definition (the model's files are fetched from where it says) or a package.
        if (kind == "miditool")
        {
            if (extension != ".json" && extension != ".zip")
            {
                answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("That MIDI tool isn't a definition or a package Sonify can use."));
                return;
            }

            report (progress, 0.0, "Downloading " + title);
            const auto file = place.getChildFile (juce::Uuid().toString() + extension);

            if (! download (address, file, error))
            {
                answer (done, juce::Result::fail (error));
                return;
            }

            juce::var tool;

            if (extension == ".json")
                tool = juce::JSON::parse (file);
            else if (auto zip = juce::ZipFile (file); const auto* entry = zip.getEntry ("tool.json"))
                if (std::unique_ptr<juce::InputStream> in { zip.createStreamForEntry (*entry) })
                    tool = juce::JSON::parse (in->readEntireStreamAsString());

            if (tool.isObject() && item.getProperty ("tool_id", {}).toString().isNotEmpty())
                tool.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("id", item.getProperty ("tool_id", {}).toString());

            if (tool.isObject())
                tool.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("version", item.getProperty ("version", "1").toString());

            const auto result = installToolNow (tool, place, extension == ".zip" ? file : juce::File(), progress);
            file.deleteFile();

            if (result.failed())
            {
                answer (done, result);
                return;
            }

            auto value = object();
            value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("path", place.getChildFile (tool.getProperty ("id", {}).toString()).getFullPathName());
            answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
            return;
        }

        // Only what the Hub can use safely is taken: plugins as WCLAP (sandboxed WebAssembly,
        // never native code), loops and samples as audio files, songs as packages.
        if (kind == "plugin" && ! juce::StringArray { ".wclap.tar.gz", ".wclap.tgz", ".wasm" }.contains (extension))
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("Only WCLAP plugins can be installed from Fanan's content."));
            return;
        }

        if ((kind == "loop" || kind == "sample") && ! juce::StringArray { ".wav", ".aif", ".aiff", ".flac", ".ogg", ".mp3" }.contains (extension))
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("That " + kind + " isn't an audio file Sonify can use."));
            return;
        }

        report (progress, 0.0, "Downloading " + title);

        if (kind == "song")
        {
            // A song comes as a package (the song file and its audio), unpacked into its own folder.
            const auto package = place.getChildFile (title + ".download.zip");

            if (! download (address, package, error))
            {
                answer (done, juce::Result::fail (error));
                return;
            }

            const auto folder = place.getChildFile (title);
            const auto unpacked = unpack (package, folder);
            package.deleteFile();

            if (unpacked.failed())
            {
                answer (done, unpacked);
                return;
            }

            const auto songs = folder.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, true, "*.fsong");

            if (songs.isEmpty())
            {
                answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("The package has no song in it."));
                return;
            }

            auto value = object();
            value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("path", songs.getFirst().getFullPathName());
            answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
            return;
        }

        const auto target = place.getChildFile (title + extension);

        if (! download (address, target, error))
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (error));
            return;
        }

        report (progress, 1.0, "Installed " + title);
        auto value = object();
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("path", target.getFullPathName());
        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
    });
}

void Cloud::fetchPreview (const juce::var& item, const juce::File& cache, Done done)
{
    run ([this, item, cache, done]
    {
        auto address = item.getProperty ("preview_url", {}).toString();
        const auto kind = item.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString();

        // Loops and samples can be heard as they are when they have no preview of their own.
        if (address.isEmpty() && (kind == "loop" || kind == "sample"))
            address = item.getProperty ("file_url", {}).toString();

        if (address.isEmpty())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("There's nothing to preview."));
            return;
        }

        const auto file = cache.getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (item.getProperty ("id", "item").toString()
                                                                                + "-" + item.getProperty ("version", "1").toString())
                                              + extensionOf (address));
        juce::String error;

        if (! file.existsAsFile() && ! download (address, file, error))
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (error));
            return;
        }

        auto value = object();
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("file", file.getFullPathName());
        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
    });
}

//==============================================================================
// MIDI tools
namespace
{
    /** A plain file name: no folders, nothing that climbs out of one. */
    bool isPlainName (const juce::String& name)
    {
        return name.isNotEmpty() && name.length() <= 120 && name.containsOnly ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789._-")
            && ! name.startsWith (".");
    }

    bool isToolId (const juce::String& id)
    {
        return id.isNotEmpty() && id.length() <= 64 && id.containsOnly ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._-") && ! id.startsWith (".");
    }
}

void Cloud::installMidiTool (const juce::var& tool, const juce::File& root, Done done, Progress progress)
{
    run ([this, tool, root, done, progress]
    {
        const auto result = installToolNow (tool, root, {}, progress);

        if (result.failed())
        {
            answer (done, result);
            return;
        }

        auto value = object();
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("id", tool.getProperty ("id", {}).toString());
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("path", root.getChildFile (tool.getProperty ("id", {}).toString()).getFullPathName());
        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
    });
}

juce::Result Cloud::installToolNow (juce::var tool, const juce::File& root, const juce::File& package, const Progress& progress)
{
    if (! tool.isObject())
        return juce::Result::fail ("That MIDI tool's definition couldn't be read.");

    const auto id = tool.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();
    const auto title = tool.getProperty ("title", id).toString();

    if (! isToolId (id))
        return juce::Result::fail ("That MIDI tool has no proper id.");

    root.createDirectory();
    const auto staging = root.getChildFile (id + "~download");   // "~" is in no tool id: never listed, never another tool's
    staging.deleteRecursively();
    const auto model = staging.getChildFile ("model");
    model.createDirectory();

    const auto fail = [&staging] (const juce::String& why)
    {
        staging.deleteRecursively();
        return juce::Result::fail (why);
    };

    juce::String error;

    if (package.existsAsFile())
    {
        // A package: tool.json and model\ (its files only, nothing outside the folder).
        const auto unpacked = unpack (package, staging);

        if (unpacked.failed())
            return fail ("The MIDI tool's package couldn't be opened.");

        if (! staging.getChildFile ("model").getChildFile ("weights_manifest.json").existsAsFile())
            return fail ("The MIDI tool's package has no model in it.");
    }
    else
    {
        // The checkpoint: config.json (Coconet has none), the manifest, then each weight file it names.
        const auto base = tool.getProperty ("checkpoint", {}).toString().trimCharactersAtEnd ("/");

        if (! base.startsWithIgnoreCase ("https://"))
            return fail ("That MIDI tool doesn't say where its model is.");

        report (progress, 0.0, "Downloading " + title);
        const bool needsConfig = tool.getProperty ("model", {}).toString() != "Coconet";

        if (! download (base + "/config.json", model.getChildFile ("config.json"), error) && needsConfig)
            return fail (error);

        if (! download (base + "/weights_manifest.json", model.getChildFile ("weights_manifest.json"), error))
            return fail (error);

        juce::StringArray files;
        const auto manifest = juce::JSON::parse (model.getChildFile ("weights_manifest.json"));

        if (const auto* groups = manifest.getArray())
            for (const auto& group : *groups)
                if (const auto* paths = group.getProperty ("paths", {}).getArray())
                    for (const auto& path : *paths)
                        files.addIfNotAlreadyThere (path.toString());

        if (files.isEmpty())
            return fail ("The model's manifest lists no weights.");

        for (const auto& name : files)
            if (! isPlainName (name))
                return fail ("The model's manifest names a file Sonify won't write.");

        for (int i = 0; i < files.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (blocked.load())
                return fail ("The internet is blocked.");

            report (progress, (i + 1.0) / (files.size() + 1.0), "Downloading " + title);

            if (! download (base + "/" + files[i], model.getChildFile (files[i]), error))
                return fail (error);
        }
    }

    // What it is, kept with it (the page reads it to know what the model does).
    auto definition = tool;

    if (const auto packaged = juce::JSON::parse (staging.getChildFile ("tool.json")); packaged.isObject() && package.existsAsFile())
    {
        definition = packaged;
        definition.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("id", id);
        definition.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("version", tool.getProperty ("version", packaged.getProperty ("version", "1")));
    }

    definition.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("installed", juce::Time::getCurrentTime().toISO8601 (true));

    if (! staging.getChildFile ("tool.json").replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (definition)))
        return fail ("Couldn't write the MIDI tool into " + root.getFullPathName());

    const auto folder = root.getChildFile (id);
    folder.deleteRecursively();

    if (! staging.moveFileTo (folder))
        return fail ("Couldn't put the MIDI tool into " + root.getFullPathName());

    report (progress, 1.0, "Installed " + title);
    return juce::Result::ok();
}
