// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Container.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_processors_headless/juce_audio_processors_headless.h>

#include "Plugin.h"

#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

class ContainerPlugin;

//==============================================================================
/**
    Containers: Sonify's system tool for a whole patch of plugins in one slot, as Colosseum's
    containers are. A container is a plugin like any other (it goes on a track's instrument
    slot, or into its inserts as an FX Container); inside, its own graph wires plugins and
    system tools as nodes: audio, MIDI and sidechain cables between pins, from the
    container's inputs to its outputs. Its window is Colosseum's node canvas
    (ContainerCanvas.h). Saving a container (a .container file) keeps everything in it:
    every node with its settings and its plugin's state, and every cable.

    Nodes:
      a plugin       any plugin Sonify has (VST3, WCLAP or Sonify's own, another container
                     too), wrapped in a PluginNode: its own MIDI channel filter, pass-through,
                     mute and transport override (Colosseum's CH, P, M and T buttons);
      a system tool  Colosseum's Connector, Stereo Meter and MIDI Monitor;
      I/O            the container's Audio In (main L/R, then the sidechain L/R a track can
                     send to), Audio Out, MIDI In (the track's notes) and MIDI Out (what
                     other tracks can listen to).

    Threads: the graph is changed on the message thread (JUCE's graph rebuilds and prepares
    nodes there, and swaps its render sequence in for the audio thread); process() runs on
    the audio thread under the engine's lock, like any plugin's.
*/
namespace Containers
{
    inline constexpr const char* instrumentId = "sonify.builtin.container";     // on an instrument slot
    inline constexpr const char* effectId     = "sonify.builtin.fxcontainer";   // in the inserts

    bool isContainerId (const juce::String& pluginId);

    Plugin::Descriptor describe (bool effect);

    /** Where .container files are saved (Documents\Sonify\Containers unless the host says). */
    juce::File defaultFolder();

    /** A place on the canvas (its virtual coordinates). */
    struct Spot
    {
        float x = 0.0f, y = 0.0f;
    };

    /** A plugin Sonify offers, for the canvas's menu and its Tools panel. */
    struct Choice
    {
        juce::String file, id, name, vendor, kind, category, format;
        bool favorite = false;
    };

    /** What a container needs of Sonify. MainComponent is it; without one (the engine tests),
        plugins load straight from their files and node ids count from a million. */
    struct Host
    {
        virtual ~Host() = default;

        /** A plugin by its file and id, made but not yet activated (its node activates it). */
        virtual std::unique_ptr<Plugin> loadPlugin (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error) = 0;

        /** The plugins the user has, for the menu (Sonify's own system tools are added by the canvas). */
        virtual std::vector<Choice> listPlugins() = 0;

        /** Shows a node's plugin screen as Sonify shows any plugin's: its web page, the page's
            generic controls, or its own window. */
        virtual void openScreen (Plugin& plugin) = 0;

        /** An id no other plugin in the engine has, so the page can name a node's plugin. */
        virtual int allocateSlotId() = 0;

        /** Something in a container changed (its name, a node, a cable): the song has unsaved
            changes, and the page shows the container's new name. */
        virtual void containerChanged (ContainerPlugin& container) = 0;

        /** The folder container presets go to. */
        virtual juce::File containersFolder()                       { return defaultFolder(); }

        /** The playing rate and block size plugins are activated at (0: not playing). */
        virtual double sampleRate() const                           { return 0.0; }
    };

    void setHost (Host* host);
    Host* getHost();

    /** The container's window: made by ContainerCanvas.cpp in the app (none in the tests). */
    struct Screen
    {
        virtual ~Screen() = default;
        virtual void show (const juce::String& title) = 0;
        virtual void hide() = 0;
        virtual bool isShowing() const = 0;
    };

    using ScreenFactory = std::function<std::unique_ptr<Screen> (ContainerPlugin&)>;
    void setScreenFactory (ScreenFactory factory);
}

//==============================================================================
/**
    A Sonify plugin as a node of a container's graph (Colosseum's MeteringProcessor): its
    pins follow the plugin (an instrument: no audio in; an effect: main in, and a sidechain
    in when it has one), and it adds what Colosseum's nodes have: a MIDI channel filter for
    instruments (CH), pass-through for effects (P), and a transport of its own (T) for
    tempo-synced plugins. Muting is the graph's bypass (M), with every note let go.
*/
class PluginNode final : public juce::AudioProcessor
{
public:
    PluginNode (std::unique_ptr<Plugin> plugin, int slotId, ContainerPlugin& owner);
    ~PluginNode() override;

    Plugin& getPlugin() const noexcept                  { return *plugin; }
    const int slotId;

    bool isInstrument() const noexcept                  { return instrument; }
    bool hasSidechain() const noexcept                  { return sidechain; }
    bool isContainer() const noexcept;
    ContainerPlugin* asContainer() const noexcept;

    /** The MIDI channels an instrument hears, one bit each (bit 0: channel 1). */
    void setMidiChannelMask (int mask) noexcept         { channelMask.store (mask & 0xffff); }
    int getMidiChannelMask() const noexcept             { return channelMask.load(); }

    void setPassThrough (bool on) noexcept              { passThrough.store (on); }
    bool isPassThrough() const noexcept                 { return passThrough.load(); }

    /** Muted (the graph's bypass): every note the plugin holds is let go first. */
    void noteMuted() noexcept                           { notesOffOwed.store (true); }

    // Colosseum's T: a tempo and time signature of its own instead of the song's.
    bool isTransportSynced() const noexcept             { return synced.load(); }
    void setTransportSynced (bool s) noexcept           { synced.store (s); }
    double getCustomTempo() const noexcept              { return tempo.load(); }
    void setCustomTempo (double bpm) noexcept           { tempo.store (juce::jlimit (20.0, 999.0, bpm)); }
    int getCustomTimeSigNumerator() const noexcept      { return numerator.load(); }
    int getCustomTimeSigDenominator() const noexcept    { return denominator.load(); }
    void setCustomTimeSignature (int n, int d) noexcept { numerator.store (juce::jlimit (1, 32, n)); denominator.store (juce::jlimit (1, 32, d)); }

    bool isMidiInActive() const noexcept                { return midiInActive.load(); }
    bool isMidiOutActive() const noexcept               { return midiOutActive.load(); }

    /** Why the plugin stopped (a WCLAP that crashed); empty while it works. */
    juce::String getFailure() const;
    void setFailure (const juce::String& why);
    bool hasFailed() const noexcept                     { return failed.load(); }

    /** Runs fn while the audio thread can't be inside this node. */
    void whileSuspended (const std::function<void()>& fn);

    //==============================================================================
    const juce::String getName() const override;
    void prepareToPlay (double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock) override;
    void releaseResources() override;
    void processBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer, juce::MidiBuffer& midi) override;
    void processBlockBypassed (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer, juce::MidiBuffer& midi) override;
    using juce::AudioProcessor::processBlock;
    using juce::AudioProcessor::processBlockBypassed;

    juce::AudioProcessorEditor* createEditor() override { return nullptr; }
    bool hasEditor() const override                     { return false; }
    bool acceptsMidi() const override                   { return true; }
    bool producesMidi() const override                  { return makesMidi; }
    double getTailLengthSeconds() const override        { return 0.0; }
    int getNumPrograms() override                       { return 1; }
    int getCurrentProgram() override                    { return 0; }
    void setCurrentProgram (int) override               {}
    const juce::String getProgramName (int) override    { return {}; }
    void changeProgramName (int, const juce::String&) override {}
    void getStateInformation (juce::MemoryBlock&) override {}
    void setStateInformation (const void*, int) override {}
    bool isBusesLayoutSupported (const BusesLayout&) const override { return true; }

private:
    static BusesProperties busesFor (const Plugin& plugin);
    void filterChannels (juce::MidiBuffer& midi) noexcept;

    std::unique_ptr<Plugin> plugin;
    ContainerPlugin& owner;
    const juce::String name;
    const bool instrument, sidechain, makesMidi;

    std::atomic<int> channelMask { 0xffff };
    int lastMask = 0xffff;                           // audio thread
    std::array<juce::uint16, 128> held {};           // audio thread: the channels each note is held on
    std::atomic<bool> passThrough { false }, notesOffOwed { false };
    std::atomic<bool> synced { true };
    std::atomic<double> tempo { 120.0 };
    std::atomic<int> numerator { 4 }, denominator { 4 };
    std::atomic<bool> midiInActive { false }, midiOutActive { false };
    float midiInDecay = 0.0f, midiOutDecay = 0.0f;

    juce::MidiBuffer filtered, notesOff;
    juce::CriticalSection failureLock;
    juce::String failure;
    std::atomic<bool> failed { false };              // the audio thread's view of it, without the lock

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (PluginNode)
};

    /** Connector: stereo in, stereo out, a volume and a mute (a place to sum or split cables). */
    class Connector final : public juce::AudioProcessor
    {
    public:
        Connector();
        const juce::String getName() const override                 { return "Connector"; }
        void prepareToPlay (double, int) override                   {}
        void releaseResources() override                            {}
        void processBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer, juce::MidiBuffer&) override;
        using juce::AudioProcessor::processBlock;
        juce::AudioProcessorEditor* createEditor() override          { return nullptr; }
        bool hasEditor() const override                              { return false; }
        bool acceptsMidi() const override                            { return false; }
        bool producesMidi() const override                           { return false; }
        double getTailLengthSeconds() const override                 { return 0.0; }
        int getNumPrograms() override                                { return 1; }
        int getCurrentProgram() override                             { return 0; }
        void setCurrentProgram (int) override                        {}
        const juce::String getProgramName (int) override             { return {}; }
        void changeProgramName (int, const juce::String&) override   {}
        void getStateInformation (juce::MemoryBlock&) override;
        void setStateInformation (const void*, int) override;

        /** 0 silence, 0.5 unity (0 dB), 1 +25 dB. */
        void setVolume (float normalised) noexcept                   { volume.store (juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, normalised)); }
        float getVolume() const noexcept                             { return volume.load(); }
        float getVolumeDb() const noexcept;
        void setMuted (bool m) noexcept                              { muted.store (m); }
        bool isMuted() const noexcept                                { return muted.load(); }
        void toggleMute() noexcept                                   { muted.store (! muted.load()); }

    private:
        std::atomic<float> volume { 0.5f };
        std::atomic<bool> muted { false };
        float lastGain = 1.0f;
    };

    /** Stereo Meter: L/R levels with peak hold and clip lights; it takes audio in only. */

    /** MIDI Monitor: the last note or controller on each of the 16 channels; MIDI in only. */
    class MidiMonitor final : public juce::AudioProcessor
    {
    public:
        struct Event
        {
            bool isActive = false, isNoteOn = false, isCC = false;
            int channel = 1, noteNumber = 60, velocity = 0, ccNumber = 0, ccValue = 0;
            juce::String toString() const;
        };

        MidiMonitor();
        const juce::String getName() const override                 { return "MIDI Monitor"; }
        void prepareToPlay (double, int) override                   {}
        void releaseResources() override                            {}
        void processBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer, juce::MidiBuffer& midi) override;
        using juce::AudioProcessor::processBlock;
        juce::AudioProcessorEditor* createEditor() override          { return nullptr; }
        bool hasEditor() const override                              { return false; }
        bool acceptsMidi() const override                            { return true; }
        bool producesMidi() const override                           { return false; }
        double getTailLengthSeconds() const override                 { return 0.0; }

        void changeProgramName (int, const juce::String&) override   {}
        void getStateInformation (juce::MemoryBlock&) override       {}
        void setStateInformation (const void*, int) override         {}
        bool isBusesLayoutSupported (const BusesLayout&) const override { return true; }

        std::array<Event, 16> getEvents() const;
        bool hasChanged() const noexcept                             { return changed.load(); }
        void clearChanged() noexcept                                 { changed.store (false); }

    private:
        std::array<Event, 16> events;

    };

    /** A plugin a container had that isn't here now: kept as it was, so saving again loses
        nothing, and shown in red until the plugin is back. */
    class Missing final : public juce::AudioProcessor
    {
    public:
        Missing (std::unique_ptr<juce::XmlElement> savedNode, int inputs, int outputs, bool midiIn, bool midiOut);
        const juce::String getName() const override                 { return title; }
        void prepareToPlay (double, int) override                   {}
        void releaseResources() override                            {}
        void processBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer, juce::MidiBuffer& midi) override
        {
            // Silent out; its inputs past the outputs are its sources' own buffers, left alone.
            for (int channel = 0; channel < juce::jmin (getTotalNumOutputChannels(), buffer.getNumChannels()); ++channel)
                buffer.clear (channel, 0, buffer.getNumSamples());

            midi.clear();
        }
        using juce::AudioProcessor::processBlock;
        juce::AudioProcessorEditor* createEditor() override          { return nullptr; }
        bool hasEditor() const override                              { return false; }
        bool acceptsMidi() const override                            { return midiIn; }
        bool producesMidi() const override                           { return midiOut; }
        double getTailLengthSeconds() const override                 { return 0.0; }
        int getNumPrograms() override                                { return 1; }
        int getCurrentProgram() override                             { return 0; }
        void setCurrentProgram (int) override                        {}
        const juce::String getProgramName (int) override             { return {}; }
        void changeProgramName (int, const juce::String&) override   {}
        void getStateInformation (juce::MemoryBlock&) override       {}
        void setStateInformation (const void*, int) override         {}
        bool isBusesLayoutSupported (const BusesLayout&) const override { return true; }

        const juce::XmlElement& getSaved() const noexcept            { return *saved; }
        juce::String getWhy() const                                  { return why; }
        void setWhy (const juce::String& reason)                     { why = reason; }

    private:
        std::unique_ptr<juce::XmlElement> saved;
        juce::String title, why;
        const bool midiIn, midiOut;
    };
}

/**
    The container itself: a Sonify plugin holding a graph. Two kinds, by where it goes:
    Container (an instrument: MIDI in, audio out) and FX Container (an effect: the track's
    sound in, with a sidechain, and out). Both take MIDI and can play MIDI out.
*/
class ContainerPlugin final : public Plugin
{
public:
    explicit ContainerPlugin (bool effect);
    ~ContainerPlugin() override;

    bool isEffect() const noexcept                       { return effect; }

    //==============================================================================
    // The graph, message thread.
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph& getGraph() noexcept       { return *graph; }
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node::Ptr getAudioInputNode() const   { return audioIn; }
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node::Ptr getAudioOutputNode() const  { return audioOut; }
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node::Ptr getMidiInputNode() const    { return midiIn; }
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node::Ptr getMidiOutputNode() const   { return midiOut; }
    bool isIoNode (const juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node* node) const noexcept;

    /** The FX Container's Audio In, on or off (Colosseum's ON/OFF): off, the track's sound and
        the sidechain don't come in. (Not the graph's bypass: that would leave its buffers stale.) */
    bool isAudioInputOn() const noexcept                 { return audioInputOn.load(); }
    void setAudioInputOn (bool on);

    /** Whether a node is off: a muted plugin or tool, Audio Out turned off, or Audio In. */
    bool isOff (const juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node* node) const noexcept;

    /** A plugin as a node at a place on the canvas; null (and error) when it can't load. */
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node::Ptr addPlugin (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId,
                                                    Containers::Spot at, juce::String& error);
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node::Ptr addPluginNode (std::unique_ptr<Plugin> plugin, Containers::Spot at);

    /** A system tool by its name: "Connector", "StereoMeter" or "MidiMonitor". */
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node::Ptr addTool (const juce::String& toolName, Containers::Spot at);

    /** Takes a node out (its cables too); what it held is destroyed once the audio thread lets go. */
    void removeNode (juce::AudioProcessorGraph::NodeID id);

    bool connect (juce::AudioProcessorGraph::NodeID from, int fromChannel, juce::AudioProcessorGraph::NodeID to, int toChannel);
    bool connectMidi (juce::AudioProcessorGraph::NodeID from, juce::AudioProcessorGraph::NodeID to);
    void disconnect (const juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Connection& connection);
    void disconnectNode (juce::AudioProcessorGraph::NodeID id);

    /** Mutes a node (Colosseum's M: the graph's bypass), letting its notes go. */
    void setNodeMuted (juce::AudioProcessorGraph::NodeID id, bool muted);

    /** Every PluginNode in this container and in the containers inside it. */
    void forEachPluginNode (const std::function<void (PluginNode&)>& fn) const;

    /** A plugin in here (or deeper) by its slot id; null when there's none. */
    Plugin* findPlugin (int slotId) const;
    PluginNode* findNode (const Plugin& plugin) const;

    /** Says the container changed (for the song and the page) and repaints the canvas. */
    void changed();
    std::function<void()> onStructureChanged;      // the canvas listens

    //==============================================================================
    // What Colosseum's container has: a name, a mute, a transport override and the zoom it was left at.
    juce::String getContainerName() const                { return containerName; }
    void setContainerName (const juce::String& newName);
    bool isMuted() const noexcept                        { return muted.load(); }
    void setMuted (bool m) noexcept                      { muted.store (m); }
    bool isTransportSynced() const noexcept              { return synced.load(); }
    void setTransportSynced (bool s) noexcept            { synced.store (s); }
    double getCustomTempo() const noexcept               { return tempo.load(); }
    void setCustomTempo (double bpm) noexcept            { tempo.store (juce::jlimit (20.0, 999.0, bpm)); }
    int getCustomTimeSigNumerator() const noexcept       { return numerator.load(); }
    int getCustomTimeSigDenominator() const noexcept     { return denominator.load(); }
    void setCustomTimeSignature (int n, int d) noexcept  { numerator.store (juce::jlimit (1, 32, n)); denominator.store (juce::jlimit (1, 32, d)); }
    float containerZoom = 0.7f;
    Containers::Spot containerPan;

    /** The transport this block's nodes see (this container's own when it isn't synced). Audio thread. */
    const clap_event_transport_t* getBlockTransport() const noexcept  { return blockTransport; }

    /** Plugins that couldn't be loaded the last time a state or preset was read. */
    const juce::StringArray& getProblems() const noexcept { return problems; }

    //==============================================================================
    // Presets and state: the whole container as XML (Colosseum's ContainerPreset).
    juce::String toXml() const;
    bool fromXml (const juce::String& xml);
    bool savePreset (const juce::File& file) const;
    bool loadPreset (const juce::File& file);

    //==============================================================================
    // Plugin
    juce::String getFormatName() const override                          { return "Built-in"; }
    const Descriptor& getDescriptor() const noexcept override            { return descriptor; }
    const std::vector<Descriptor>& getPluginsInFile() const noexcept override { return inFile; }
    const juce::File& getSourceFile() const noexcept override;
    Role getRole() const noexcept override                               { return effect ? Role::effect : Role::instrument; }
    int getMainInputChannels() const noexcept override                   { return effect ? 2 : 0; }
    int getMainOutputChannels() const noexcept override                  { return 2; }
    bool hasSidechain() const noexcept override                          { return effect; }
    bool producesMidi() const noexcept override                          { return midiOutUsed.load(); }

    bool canSaveState() const noexcept override                          { return true; }
    bool saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination) override;
    bool loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source) override;
    bool consumeStateChanged() noexcept override;

    const std::vector<Parameter>& getParameters() const noexcept override { return noParameters; }
    int findParameter (uint32_t) const noexcept override                 { return -1; }
    double getParameterValue (int) const noexcept override               { return 0.0; }
    double readParameterValue (int) override                             { return 0.0; }
    juce::String getParameterText (int, double) override                 { return {}; }
    double queueParameter (int, double) override                         { return 0.0; }

    bool activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize) override;
    void deactivate() override;
    bool isActive() const noexcept override                              { return active.load(); }
    double getActiveSampleRate() const noexcept                          { return rate; }
    int getActiveBlockSize() const noexcept                              { return blockSize; }

    void process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                  int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t* transport) noexcept override;

    ScreenKind getScreenKind() const noexcept override                   { return ScreenKind::native; }
    bool showNativeScreen (const juce::String& title) override;
    void hideNativeScreen() override;

    /** Looks after the plugins inside (what WCLAP plugins ask of the host, restarts, failures). */
    Requests takeRequests() noexcept override;

private:
    void makeIoNodes();
    void placeIoNodes();
    void hideNodeScreens();
    void updateMidiOutUsed();
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node::Ptr nodeFromXml (const juce::XmlElement& xml);

    const bool effect;
    Descriptor descriptor;
    std::vector<Descriptor> inFile;
    static const std::vector<Parameter> noParameters;

    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioProcessorGraph> graph;
    juce::AudioProcessorGraph::Node::Ptr audioIn, audioOut, midiIn, midiOut;

    juce::String containerName;
    std::atomic<bool> muted { false }, synced { true }, audioInputOn { true };
    std::atomic<double> tempo { 120.0 };
    std::atomic<int> numerator { 4 }, denominator { 4 };
    std::atomic<bool> active { false }, stateChanged { false }, midiOutUsed { false };
    juce::StringArray problems;

    // Audio
    double rate = 0.0;
    int blockSize = 0;
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> work;
    juce::MidiBuffer workMidi;
    const clap_event_transport_t* blockTransport = nullptr;
    clap_event_transport_t ownTransport {};

    std::unique_ptr<Containers::Screen> screen;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (ContainerPlugin)
};

// The container window (Colosseum's node canvas): the popups, the Tools panel, the window,
// and the canvas's upkeep and drawing. Mouse work and menus are in ContainerCanvasMouse.cpp.

#include "ContainerCanvas.h"

//==============================================================================
// StatusToolTip
StatusToolTip::StatusToolTip (const juce::String& title, bool isStreaming, std::function<void()> onDelete)
    : streaming (isStreaming), deleteCallback (std::move (onDelete))
{
    addAndMakeVisible (titleLabel);
    titleLabel.setText (title, juce::dontSendNotification);
    titleLabel.setJustificationType (juce::Justification::centred);
    titleLabel.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (14.0f)));
    titleLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colours::white);

    addAndMakeVisible (statusLabel);
    statusLabel.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (12.0f)));
    statusLabel.setJustificationType (juce::Justification::centred);

    if (streaming)
    {
        statusLabel.setText ("Active Streaming", juce::dontSendNotification);
        statusLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colours::lightgreen);
        startTimer (50);
    }
    else
    {
        statusLabel.setText ("Idle (Bypassed)", juce::dontSendNotification);
        statusLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colours::grey);
    }

    if (deleteCallback)
    {
        addAndMakeVisible (deleteButton);
        deleteButton.onClick = [this]
        {
            if (deleteCallback)
                deleteCallback();

            if (auto* callout = findParentComponentOfClass<juce::CallOutBox>())
                callout->dismiss();
        };
    }

    // Long names (a plugin's own) get room.
    const auto width = juce::jlimit (200, 420, juce::GlyphArrangement::getStringWidthInt (titleLabel.getFont(), title) + 30);
    setSize (width, deleteCallback ? 100 : 70);
}

StatusToolTip::~StatusToolTip()   { stopTimer(); }

void StatusToolTip::timerCallback()
{
    alpha += delta;

    if (alpha >= 1.0f || alpha <= 0.2f)
        delta = -delta;

    repaint();
}

void StatusToolTip::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.8f));
    g.setColour (juce::Colours::white);
    g.drawRect (getLocalBounds(), 1);

    if (streaming)
    {
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::green.withAlpha (juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, alpha)));
        const float r = 8.0f;
        g.fillEllipse (static_cast<float> (getWidth()) / 2.0f - r, 45.0f, r * 2.0f, r * 2.0f);
    }
    else
    {
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::red);
        const float r = 4.0f;
        g.drawEllipse (static_cast<float> (getWidth()) / 2.0f - r, 48.0f, r * 2.0f, r * 2.0f, 1.0f);
    }
}

void StatusToolTip::resized()
{
    titleLabel.setBounds (0, 5, getWidth(), 20);
    statusLabel.setBounds (0, 25, getWidth(), 20);

    if (deleteCallback)
        deleteButton.setBounds (10, 65, getWidth() - 20, 25);
}

//==============================================================================
// MidiChannelSelector
MidiChannelSelector::MidiChannelSelector (PluginNode& n, std::function<void()> onUpdate)
    : node (n), updateCallback (std::move (onUpdate))
{
    titleLabel.setText ("Select MIDI Input Channel", juce::dontSendNotification);
    titleLabel.setJustificationType (juce::Justification::centred);
    titleLabel.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (14.0f, juce::Font::bold)));
    titleLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colours::white);
    addAndMakeVisible (titleLabel);

    closeButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, juce::Colours::red.darker());
    closeButton.addListener (this);
    addAndMakeVisible (closeButton);

    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
    {
        auto* button = channelButtons.add (new juce::TextButton (juce::String (i)));
        button->addListener (this);
        addAndMakeVisible (button);
    }

    allButton.addListener (this);
    addAndMakeVisible (allButton);

    showSelection();
    setSize (260, 238);
}

void MidiChannelSelector::showSelection()
{
    const auto mask = node.getMidiChannelMask();
    const auto all = mask == 0xffff;

    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    {
        const bool chosen = ! all && (mask & (1 << i)) != 0;
        channelButtons[i]->setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, chosen ? juce::Colours::orange : juce::Colours::grey.darker());
        channelButtons[i]->setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId, chosen ? juce::Colours::black : juce::Colours::lightgrey);
    }

    allButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, all ? juce::Colours::orange : juce::Colours::grey.darker());
    allButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId, all ? juce::Colours::black : juce::Colours::lightgrey);
}

void MidiChannelSelector::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.95f));
    g.setColour (juce::Colours::orange);
    g.drawRect (getLocalBounds(), 2);
}

void MidiChannelSelector::resized()
{
    auto area = getLocalBounds().reduced (8);
    auto header = area.removeFromTop (25);
    closeButton.setBounds (header.removeFromRight (25));
    titleLabel.setBounds (header);
    area.removeFromTop (8);

    allButton.setBounds (area.removeFromBottom (26).reduced (2));
    area.removeFromBottom (4);

    const int cols = 4, rows = 4;
    const int w = area.getWidth() / cols, h = area.getHeight() / rows;

    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
        channelButtons[i]->setBounds (area.getX() + (i % cols) * w + 2, area.getY() + (i / cols) * h + 2, w - 4, h - 4);
}

void MidiChannelSelector::buttonClicked (juce::Button* button)
{
    if (button == &closeButton)
    {
        if (auto* callout = findParentComponentOfClass<juce::CallOutBox>())
            callout->dismiss();

        return;
    }

    if (button == &allButton)
        node.setMidiChannelMask (0xffff);

    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
        if (channelButtons[i] == button)
            node.setMidiChannelMask (1 << i);   // one channel, as Colosseum's

    showSelection();

    if (updateCallback)
        updateCallback();
}

// TransportOverridePanel
TransportOverridePanel::TransportOverridePanel (Target t)
    : target (std::move (t))
{
    setSize (260, 160);

    titleLabel.setText (target.title, juce::dontSendNotification);
    titleLabel.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (14.0f, juce::Font::bold)));
    titleLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colours::white);
    titleLabel.setJustificationType (juce::Justification::centred);
    addAndMakeVisible (titleLabel);

    syncLabel.setText ("Synced to master transport?", juce::dontSendNotification);
    syncLabel.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (12.0f)));
    syncLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colours::lightgrey);
    addAndMakeVisible (syncLabel);

    for (auto* button : { &yesButton, &noButton })
    {
        button->setRadioGroupId (1001);
        button->setClickingTogglesState (true);
        button->addListener (this);
        button->setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, juce::Colour (0xff3a3a3a));
        button->setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOnId, juce::Colours::white);
        button->setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId, juce::Colours::grey);
        addAndMakeVisible (*button);
    }

    yesButton.setButtonText ("Yes");
    noButton.setButtonText ("No");
    yesButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonOnColourId, juce::Colours::green.darker());
    noButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonOnColourId, juce::Colours::orange.darker());

    timeSigLabel.setText ("Time Signature:", juce::dontSendNotification);
    timeSigLabel.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (12.0f)));
    timeSigLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colours::lightgrey);
    addAndMakeVisible (timeSigLabel);

    const char* signatures[] = { "2/4", "3/4", "4/4", "5/4", "6/4", "7/4", "3/8", "6/8", "7/8", "9/8", "12/8" };

    for (int i = 0; i < 11; ++i)
        timeSigCombo.addItem (signatures[i], i + 1);

    timeSigCombo.addListener (this);
    addAndMakeVisible (timeSigCombo);

    tempoLabel.setText ("Tempo:", juce::dontSendNotification);
    tempoLabel.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (12.0f)));
    tempoLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colours::lightgrey);
    addAndMakeVisible (tempoLabel);

    tempoSlider.setRange (20.0, 999.0, 0.1);
    tempoSlider.setTextBoxStyle (juce::Slider::TextBoxRight, false, 55, 20);
    tempoSlider.setSliderStyle (juce::Slider::LinearHorizontal);
    tempoSlider.setColour (juce::Slider::trackColourId, juce::Colours::yellow.darker());
    tempoSlider.setColour (juce::Slider::thumbColourId, juce::Colours::yellow);
    tempoSlider.addListener (this);
    addAndMakeVisible (tempoSlider);

    const auto synced = target.isSynced();
    yesButton.setToggleState (synced, juce::dontSendNotification);
    noButton.setToggleState (! synced, juce::dontSendNotification);
    tempoSlider.setValue (target.getTempo(), juce::dontSendNotification);
    const auto [numerator, denominator] = target.getSignature();
    selectSignature (numerator, denominator);
    updateEnabledState (synced);
}

void TransportOverridePanel::resized()
{
    auto area = getLocalBounds().reduced (8);
    titleLabel.setBounds (area.removeFromTop (22));
    area.removeFromTop (4);
    auto syncRow = area.removeFromTop (24);
    syncLabel.setBounds (syncRow.removeFromLeft (170));
    syncRow.removeFromLeft (4);
    yesButton.setBounds (syncRow.removeFromLeft (36));
    syncRow.removeFromLeft (2);
    noButton.setBounds (syncRow.removeFromLeft (36));
    area.removeFromTop (8);
    auto tsRow = area.removeFromTop (24);
    timeSigLabel.setBounds (tsRow.removeFromLeft (100));
    tsRow.removeFromLeft (4);
    timeSigCombo.setBounds (tsRow);
    area.removeFromTop (6);
    auto tempoRow = area.removeFromTop (24);
    tempoLabel.setBounds (tempoRow.removeFromLeft (50));
    tempoRow.removeFromLeft (4);
    tempoSlider.setBounds (tempoRow);
}

void TransportOverridePanel::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (juce::Colour (0xff2d2d2d));
    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff555555));
    g.drawRect (getLocalBounds(), 1);
}

void TransportOverridePanel::buttonClicked (juce::Button* button)
{
    if (button == &yesButton || button == &noButton)
    {
        const auto synced = yesButton.getToggleState();
        target.setSynced (synced);
        updateEnabledState (synced);
    }
}

void TransportOverridePanel::comboBoxChanged (juce::ComboBox*)
{
    const auto text = timeSigCombo.getText();
    target.setSignature (text.upToFirstOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false).getIntValue(), text.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false).getIntValue());
}

void TransportOverridePanel::sliderValueChanged (juce::Slider*)
{
    target.setTempo (tempoSlider.getValue());
}

void TransportOverridePanel::selectSignature (int numerator, int denominator)
{
    const auto wanted = juce::String (numerator) + "/" + juce::String (denominator);

    for (int i = 0; i < timeSigCombo.getNumItems(); ++i)
        if (timeSigCombo.getItemText (i) == wanted)
            timeSigCombo.setSelectedItemIndex (i, juce::dontSendNotification);

    if (timeSigCombo.getSelectedId() == 0)
        timeSigCombo.setSelectedId (3, juce::dontSendNotification);   // 4/4
}

void TransportOverridePanel::updateEnabledState (bool synced)
{
    timeSigCombo.setEnabled (! synced);
    tempoSlider.setEnabled (! synced);
    timeSigLabel.setAlpha (synced ? 0.4f : 1.0f);
    tempoLabel.setAlpha (synced ? 0.4f : 1.0f);
}

//==============================================================================
// The Tools panel
class ContainerToolsPanel::Row final : public juce::Component
{
public:
    Row (ContainerGraphCanvas& c, Item i) : canvas (c), item (std::move (i))
    {
        if (item.detail.isNotEmpty())
            setTooltip (item.detail);
    }

    void setTooltip (const juce::String& text)   { tooltip = text; }

    void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override
    {
        auto bounds = getLocalBounds().toFloat();

        if (item.isHeader)
        {
            g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffd4af37));
            g.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (11.0f, juce::Font::bold)));
            g.drawText (item.name.toUpperCase(), bounds.reduced (6, 0), juce::Justification::bottomLeft, true);
            return;
        }

        if (hovered)
        {
            g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff3a3a3a));
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (bounds, 4.0f);
        }

        float x = 8.0f;
        g.setColour (item.badgeColour);
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (x, (static_cast<float> (getHeight()) - 18.0f) / 2.0f, 36.0f, 18.0f, 3.0f);
        g.setColour (item.badge == "CNT" ? juce::Colour (200, 160, 255) : juce::Colours::white);
        g.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (10.0f, juce::Font::bold)));
        g.drawText (item.badge, static_cast<int> (x), 0, 36, getHeight(), juce::Justification::centred);
        x += 42.0f;

        g.setColour (juce::Colours::white);
        g.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (13.0f)));
        g.drawText (item.name, static_cast<int> (x), 0, getWidth() - static_cast<int> (x) - 8, getHeight(), juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);
    }

    void mouseEnter (const juce::MouseEvent&) override   { hovered = true; repaint(); }
    void mouseExit (const juce::MouseEvent&) override    { hovered = false; repaint(); }

    void mouseDrag (const juce::MouseEvent& e) override
    {
        if (item.isHeader || e.getDistanceFromDragStart() <= 5)
            return;

        if (auto* container = juce::DragAndDropContainer::findParentDragContainerFor (this))
        {
            if (container->isDragAndDropActive())
                return;

            const int w = 180, h = 28;
            juce::Image image (juce::Image::ARGB, w, h, true);
            juce::Graphics g (image);
            g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xdd2a1a30));
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (0.0f, 0.0f, static_cast<float> (w), static_cast<float> (h), 4.0f);
            g.setColour (juce::Colour (200, 160, 255));
            g.drawRoundedRectangle (0.5f, 0.5f, w - 1.0f, h - 1.0f, 4.0f, 1.5f);
            g.setColour (juce::Colours::white);
            g.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (12.0f, juce::Font::bold)));
            g.drawText (item.name, 8, 0, w - 16, h, juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);
            container->startDragging (item.dragId, this, juce::ScaledImage (image), true);
        }
    }

    void mouseDoubleClick (const juce::MouseEvent&) override
    {
        if (! item.isHeader)
            canvas.addFromTools (item.dragId, canvas.centreOfView());
    }

private:
    ContainerGraphCanvas& canvas;
    Item item;
    juce::String tooltip;
    bool hovered = false;
};

ContainerToolsPanel::ContainerToolsPanel (ContainerGraphCanvas& c)
    : canvas (c)
{
    for (auto* button : { &toolsButton, &pluginsButton, &containersButton })
    {
        button->setClickingTogglesState (false);
        addAndMakeVisible (*button);
    }

    toolsButton.onClick = [this] { setMode (Mode::tools); };
    pluginsButton.onClick = [this] { setMode (Mode::plugins); };
    containersButton.onClick = [this] { setMode (Mode::containers); };

    searchBox.setTextToShowWhenEmpty ("Search...", juce::Colours::grey);
    searchBox.setColour (juce::TextEditor::backgroundColourId, juce::Colour (0xff1a1a1a));
    searchBox.setColour (juce::TextEditor::outlineColourId, juce::Colour (0xff4a4a4a));
    searchBox.addListener (this);
    addChildComponent (searchBox);

    viewport.setViewedComponent (&list, false);
    viewport.setScrollBarsShown (true, false);
    addAndMakeVisible (viewport);

    countLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colours::grey);
    countLabel.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (11.0f)));
    addAndMakeVisible (countLabel);

    setMode (Mode::tools);
}

ContainerToolsPanel::~ContainerToolsPanel()
{
    searchBox.removeListener (this);
}

void ContainerToolsPanel::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (juce::Colour (0xff252525));
    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff4a4a4a));
    g.drawRect (getLocalBounds(), 1);
}

void ContainerToolsPanel::resized()
{
    auto area = getLocalBounds().reduced (6);
    auto modeRow = area.removeFromTop (24);
    const auto tabW = modeRow.getWidth() / 3;
    toolsButton.setBounds (modeRow.removeFromLeft (tabW - 1));
    modeRow.removeFromLeft (2);
    pluginsButton.setBounds (modeRow.removeFromLeft (tabW - 1));
    modeRow.removeFromLeft (2);
    containersButton.setBounds (modeRow);
    area.removeFromTop (6);

    if (mode != Mode::tools)
    {
        searchBox.setBounds (area.removeFromTop (24));
        area.removeFromTop (6);
    }

    countLabel.setBounds (area.removeFromBottom (16));
    area.removeFromBottom (2);
    viewport.setBounds (area);
    refresh();
}

void ContainerToolsPanel::setMode (Mode newMode)
{
    mode = newMode;

    const auto paintTab = [] (juce::TextButton& button, bool on)
    {
        button.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, on ? juce::Colour (0xff2e7d32) : juce::Colour (0xff333333));
        button.setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId, on ? juce::Colours::white : juce::Colours::lightgrey);
    };

    paintTab (toolsButton, mode == Mode::tools);
    paintTab (pluginsButton, mode == Mode::plugins);
    paintTab (containersButton, mode == Mode::containers);
    searchBox.setVisible (mode != Mode::tools);
    resized();
}

void ContainerToolsPanel::textEditorTextChanged (juce::TextEditor&)
{
    refresh();
}

std::vector<ContainerToolsPanel::Item> ContainerToolsPanel::itemsFor (Mode which) const
{
    std::vector<Item> items;
    const auto system = juce::Colour (0xffff9800);
    const auto search = searchBox.getText().trim().toLowerCase();
    const auto matches = [&search] (const juce::String& text) { return search.isEmpty() || text.toLowerCase().contains (search); };

    if (which == Mode::tools)
    {
        items.push_back ({ "SYS", "Connector", "Sum or split cables, with a volume and a mute", "TOOL:Connector", system });
        items.push_back ({ "SYS", "Container", "A container inside this one (instruments and effects)", "PLUGIN:|" + juce::String (Containers::instrumentId), system });
        items.push_back ({ "SYS", "FX Container", "A container inside this one, for effects", "PLUGIN:|" + juce::String (Containers::effectId), system });
        items.push_back ({ "SYS", "MIDI Monitor", "Shows the notes and controllers that reach it", "TOOL:MidiMonitor", system });
        items.push_back ({ "SYS", "Playlist Player", "Plays a playlist of songs", "PLUGIN:|sonify.builtin.playlist", system });
        items.push_back ({ "SYS", "Sonify Sampler", "Plays a sampled instrument (SFZ)", "PLUGIN:|sonify.builtin.sampler", system });
        items.push_back ({ "SYS", "Stereo Meter", "Left and right levels, peaks and clipping", "TOOL:StereoMeter", system });
        items.push_back ({ "VST", "VST3 Plugin...", "Load a .vst3 file", "FILE:", juce::Colour (0xffcc2222) });
        return items;
    }

    if (which == Mode::plugins)
    {
        auto* host = Containers::getHost();
        auto choices = host != nullptr ? host->listPlugins() : std::vector<Containers::Choice> {};
        std::sort (choices.begin(), choices.end(), [] (const auto& a, const auto& b)
        {
            return a.kind != b.kind ? a.kind > b.kind : a.name.compareNatural (b.name) < 0;   // instruments first
        });

        juce::String lastKind;

        for (const auto& choice : choices)
        {
            if (Containers::isContainerId (choice.id) || ! matches (choice.name + " " + choice.vendor + " " + choice.category))
                continue;

            const juce::String kind = choice.kind == "effect" ? "Effects" : choice.kind == "noteEffect" ? "Note FX" : "Instruments";

            if (kind != lastKind)
            {
                Item header;
                header.name = kind;
                header.isHeader = true;
                items.push_back (header);
                lastKind = kind;
            }

            const auto badge = choice.format == "Built-in" ? "SYS" : choice.format == "WCLAP" ? "WCL" : "VST";
            const auto colour = choice.format == "Built-in" ? system : choice.format == "WCLAP" ? juce::Colour (0xff1e88e5) : juce::Colour (0xffcc2222);
            items.push_back ({ badge, choice.name, choice.vendor + (choice.category.isNotEmpty() ? " - " + choice.category : juce::String()),
                               "PLUGIN:" + choice.file + "|" + choice.id, colour });
        }

        return items;
    }

    const auto folder = Containers::defaultFolder();

    for (const auto& file : folder.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, "*.container"))
        if (matches (file.getFileNameWithoutExtension()))
            items.push_back ({ "CNT", file.getFileNameWithoutExtension(), file.getFullPathName(), "CONTAINERPRESET:" + file.getFullPathName(),
                               juce::Colour (80, 40, 100) });

    std::sort (items.begin(), items.end(), [] (const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.name.compareNatural (b.name) < 0; });
    return items;
}

void ContainerToolsPanel::refresh()
{
    rows.clear();
    list.removeAllChildren();
    const auto items = itemsFor (mode);
    const auto width = juce::jmax (100, viewport.getWidth() - viewport.getScrollBarThickness());
    int y = 0, count = 0;

    for (const auto& item : items)
    {
        auto* row = rows.add (new Row (canvas, item));
        const auto height = item.isHeader ? 24 : 30;
        row->setBounds (0, y, width, height);
        list.addAndMakeVisible (row);
        y += height + 2;

        if (! item.isHeader)
            ++count;
    }

    list.setSize (width, juce::jmax (y, 10));

    if (mode == Mode::containers && count == 0)
        countLabel.setText ("No saved containers yet", juce::dontSendNotification);
    else
        countLabel.setText (juce::String (count) + (mode == Mode::tools ? " tools" : mode == Mode::plugins ? " plugins" : " containers"),
                            juce::dontSendNotification);
}
