// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\CreatorAudio.cpp

#include "CreatorAudio.h"
#include "CreatorPlugin.h"   // MadePlugins::transportOf

//==============================================================================
void TestTone::prepare (double newSampleRate) noexcept
{
    sampleRate = newSampleRate > 0.0 ? newSampleRate : 48000.0;

    // One-pole envelope: about 4 ms to open, 180 ms to fade.
    attackCoeff  = (float) (1.0 - std::exp (-1.0 / (0.004 * sampleRate)));
    releaseCoeff = (float) (1.0 - std::exp (-1.0 / (0.180 * sampleRate)));

    reset();
}

void TestTone::reset() noexcept
{
    for (auto& voice : voices)
        voice = Voice();
}

void TestTone::handle (const juce::MidiMessage& message) noexcept
{
    if (message.isNoteOn())
    {
        // A free voice, or the one playing longest.
        Voice* chosen = nullptr;

        for (auto& voice : voices)
            if (voice.note < 0)
                { chosen = &voice; break; }

        if (chosen == nullptr)
        {
            chosen = &voices[0];

            for (auto& voice : voices)
                if (voice.started < chosen->started)
                    chosen = &voice;
        }

        const auto frequency = juce::MidiMessage::getMidiNoteInHertz (message.getNoteNumber());

        chosen->note = message.getNoteNumber();
        chosen->step = juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi * frequency / sampleRate;
        chosen->target = 1.0f;
        chosen->velocity = message.getFloatVelocity();
        chosen->started = ++counter;
    }
    else if (message.isNoteOff())
    {
        for (auto& voice : voices)
            if (voice.note == message.getNoteNumber() && voice.target > 0.0f)
                voice.target = 0.0f;
    }
    else if (message.isAllNotesOff() || message.isAllSoundOff())
    {
        for (auto& voice : voices)
            voice.target = 0.0f;
    }
}

void TestTone::renderVoices (float* left, float* right, int start, int end) noexcept
{
    if (end <= start)
        return;

    for (auto& voice : voices)
    {
        if (voice.note < 0)
            continue;

        const auto coeff = voice.target > voice.level ? attackCoeff : releaseCoeff;
        const auto gain = 0.18f * (0.25f + 0.75f * voice.velocity);

        for (int i = start; i < end; ++i)
        {
            voice.level += (voice.target - voice.level) * coeff;

            // A touch of the second harmonic so low notes are audible on small speakers.
            const auto sample = (float) (std::sin (voice.phase) + 0.25 * std::sin (2.0 * voice.phase)) * voice.level * gain;

            voice.phase += voice.step;

            if (voice.phase >= juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi)
                voice.phase -= juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi;

            left[i] += sample;

            if (right != nullptr)
                right[i] += sample;
        }

        if (voice.target == 0.0f && voice.level < 1.0e-4f)
            voice = Voice();
    }
}

void TestTone::render (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi) noexcept
{
    int position = 0;

    for (const auto metadata : midi)
    {
        const auto when = juce::jlimit (0, numSamples, metadata.samplePosition);
        renderVoices (left, right, position, when);
        handle (metadata.getMessage());
        position = when;
    }

    renderVoices (left, right, position, numSamples);
}

//==============================================================================
CreatorAudio::CreatorAudio (AudioEngine& sonifyEngine)
    : sonify (sonifyEngine)
{
    midiBuffer.ensureSize ((size_t) midiBufferBytes);
    scratch.setSize (2, largestBlock);
    scratch.clear();

    prepare (sonify.getPlaybackRate(), sonify.getBlockSize());
    sonify.setCreatorPreview (this);
    startTimerHz (10);
}

CreatorAudio::~CreatorAudio()
{
    stopTimer();
    sonify.setCreatorListening (false);
    sonify.setCreatorPreview (nullptr);   // waits for a block that's playing it
    setPlugin (nullptr);
}

void CreatorAudio::prepare (double rate, int blockSize)
{
    const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (pluginLock);

    preparedRate = rate;
    preparedBlockSize = blockSize;
    currentRate.store (rate);
    currentBlockSize.store (blockSize);
    testTone.prepare (rate);

    // Room for the device's blocks (allocated here, on the message thread, never while playing).
    if (blockSize > scratch.getNumSamples())
        scratch.setSize (2, blockSize, false, true, true);
}

void CreatorAudio::timerCallback()
{
    // Sonify's device: a new sample rate means the plugin restarts with it (LivePreview does);
    // another device (or none) shows in the top bar's pill.
    const auto rate = sonify.getPlaybackRate();
    const auto blockSize = sonify.getBlockSize();
    const auto description = describeDevice();
    const bool newRate = std::abs (rate - preparedRate) >= 0.5 || blockSize != preparedBlockSize;

    if (! newRate && description == shownDevice)
        return;

    if (newRate)
        prepare (rate, blockSize);

    shownDevice = description;

    if (onDeviceChanged != nullptr)
        onDeviceChanged();
}

void CreatorAudio::setListening (bool shouldListen)
{
    if (listening.load() == shouldListen)
        return;

    listening.store (shouldListen);
    sonify.setCreatorListening (shouldListen);

    // Leaving: whatever was held lets go (the plugin hears it as soon as it plays again).
    if (! shouldListen)
        allNotesOff();
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String CreatorAudio::describeDevice() const
{
    auto* device = sonify.getDeviceManager().getCurrentAudioDevice();

    if (device == nullptr)
        return "No audio device";

    const auto rate = device->getCurrentSampleRate();
    const auto rateText = std::abs (rate - std::round (rate / 1000.0) * 1000.0) < 1.0
                              ? juce::String (juce::roundToInt (rate / 1000.0)) + " kHz"
                              : juce::String (rate / 1000.0, 1) + " kHz";

    const auto dot = juce::String::fromUTF8 (" \xc2\xb7 ");

    return device->getTypeName() + dot + device->getName()
         + dot + rateText
         + dot + juce::String (device->getCurrentBufferSizeSamples()) + " samples";
}

juce::StringArray CreatorAudio::describeDeviceLines() const
{
    auto* device = sonify.getDeviceManager().getCurrentAudioDevice();

    if (device == nullptr)
        return { "No audio device", "Click to choose one", "" };

    const auto rate = device->getCurrentSampleRate();
    const auto rateText = std::abs (rate - std::round (rate / 1000.0) * 1000.0) < 1.0
                              ? juce::String (juce::roundToInt (rate / 1000.0)) + " kHz"
                              : juce::String (rate / 1000.0, 1) + " kHz";

    const auto buffer = device->getCurrentBufferSizeSamples();
    const auto milliseconds = rate > 0.0 ? 1000.0 * (double) buffer / rate : 0.0;

    return { device->getName(), rateText,
             juce::String (buffer) + juce::String::fromUTF8 (" samples \xc2\xb7 ") + juce::String (milliseconds, 1) + " ms" };
}

double CreatorAudio::getCpuLoad() const
{
    return sonify.getDeviceManager().getCpuUsage();
}

float CreatorAudio::takePeak (int channel) noexcept
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (channel, (int) peaks.size()))
        return 0.0f;

    return peaks[(size_t) channel].exchange (0.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void CreatorAudio::raisePeak (std::atomic<float>& peak, float value) noexcept
{
    auto current = peak.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

    while (value > current && ! peak.compare_exchange_weak (current, value, std::memory_order_relaxed))
    {
    }
}

void CreatorAudio::allNotesOff()
{
    keyboardState.allNotesOff (0);
    panicRequested.store (true);
    silenceRequested.store (true);
}

void CreatorAudio::setPlugin (std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin> newPlugin)
{
    std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin> old;

    {
        // Waits at most for the audio block that's using the old plugin.
        const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (pluginLock);
        old = std::move (plugin);
        plugin = std::move (newPlugin);
    }

    // The old plugin goes here, on the message thread, never on the audio thread.
}

bool CreatorAudio::playChime()
{
    if (! sonify.isAudioRunning())
        return false;

    chimeRequested.store (true);
    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
void CreatorAudio::renderPreview (const juce::MidiBuffer& live, const float* inLeft, const float* inRight,
                                  float* left, float* right, int numSamples, const clap_event_transport_t& song) noexcept
{
    // If the plugin is being swapped (or the device's rate changed) right now, this block simply skips it.
    const juce::SpinLock::ScopedTryLockType lock (pluginLock);

    if (! lock.isLocked() || numSamples <= 0 || left == nullptr)
        return;

    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, scratch.getNumSamples());
    const bool on = listening.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

    // Sonify's live notes while the studio is in front, then the GUI's keyboard (which also lights
    // up for the notes played).
    midiBuffer.clear();

    if (on)
        midiBuffer.addEvents (live, 0, numSamples, 0);

    keyboardState.processNextMidiBuffer (midiBuffer, 0, numSamples, true);

    if (silenceRequested.exchange (false))
        testTone.reset();

    auto* outLeft = scratch.getWritePointer (0);
    auto* outRight = scratch.getWritePointer (1);
    juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (outLeft, numSamples);
    juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (outRight, numSamples);

    bool pluginPlayed = false;

    if (on && plugin != nullptr)
    {
        int numEvents = 0;

        // Panic: "all notes off" and "all sound off" first, so every voice lets go.
        if (panicRequested.exchange (false))
        {
            pluginEvents[(size_t) numEvents++] = { 0, 0xb0, 123, 0 };
            pluginEvents[(size_t) numEvents++] = { 0, 0xb0, 120, 0 };
        }

        for (const auto metadata : midiBuffer)
        {
            const auto* raw = metadata.data;

            if (metadata.numBytes < 1 || raw[0] >= 0xf0 || numEvents >= (int) pluginEvents.size())
                continue;

            pluginEvents[(size_t) numEvents++] = { (std::uint32_t) juce::jlimit (0, numSamples - 1, metadata.samplePosition),
                                                   raw[0],
                                                   metadata.numBytes > 1 ? raw[1] : (std::uint8_t) 0,
                                                   metadata.numBytes > 2 ? raw[2] : (std::uint8_t) 0 };
        }

        plugin->setTransport (MadePlugins::transportOf (&song));   // the song's tempo and position: tempo sync
        plugin->process (inLeft, inRight != nullptr ? inRight : inLeft, outLeft, outRight, numSamples, pluginEvents.data(), numEvents);
        pluginPlayed = true;
    }

    if (on && ! pluginPlayed && testToneOn.load (std::memory_order_relaxed))
        testTone.render (outLeft, outRight, numSamples, midiBuffer);

    // Sonify AI has finished: the chime goes over whatever is playing, wherever the user is.
    if (chimeRequested.exchange (false))
        chime.start (currentRate.load());

    if (chime.active)
        chime.render (outLeft, outRight, numSamples);

    for (int channel = 0; channel < 2; ++channel)
    {
        const auto range = juce::FloatVectorOperations::findMinAndMax (scratch.getReadPointer (channel), numSamples);
        raisePeak (peaks[(size_t) channel], juce::jmax (std::abs (range.getStart()), std::abs (range.getEnd())));
    }

    juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (left, outLeft, numSamples);

    if (right != nullptr && right != left)
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (right, outRight, numSamples);
}

void CreatorAudio::Chime::render (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    // C6 then G6, 140 ms apart, each a sine with a quiet octave, a 5 ms rise and a
    // quarter-second fade: gentle, and clear over music.
    struct Note { double frequency, startSeconds; };
    static constexpr Note notes[] { { 1046.5, 0.0 }, { 1568.0, 0.14 } };
    constexpr double lengthSeconds = 1.2, attack = 0.005, decay = 0.25;
    constexpr float level = 0.16f;

    const auto total = (int) (lengthSeconds * sampleRate);

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples && position < total; ++i, ++position)
    {
        const auto t = (double) position / sampleRate;
        double sample = 0.0;

        for (const auto& note : notes)
        {
            const auto local = t - note.startSeconds;

            if (local < 0.0)
                continue;

            const auto envelope = juce::jmin (1.0, local / attack) * std::exp (-local / decay);
            const auto phase = juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi * note.frequency * local;
            sample += envelope * (std::sin (phase) + 0.3 * std::sin (2.0 * phase));
        }

        const auto value = (float) sample * level;
        left[i] += value;

        if (right != nullptr)
            right[i] += value;
    }

    if (position >= total)
        active = false;
}

/**
    A small sine synth, so the keyboard can be tried before a plugin exists. Allocation-free
    and lock-free: everything happens on the audio thread.
*/
class TestTone final
{
public:
    void prepare (double newSampleRate) noexcept;
    void reset() noexcept;

    /** Adds into left/right (right may be null). Notes are applied at their sample positions. */
    void render (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi) noexcept;

private:
    struct Voice
    {
        int note = -1;
        double phase = 0.0, step = 0.0;
        float level = 0.0f, target = 0.0f, velocity = 0.0f;
        std::uint32_t started = 0;
    };

    void handle (const juce::MidiMessage& message) noexcept;
    void renderVoices (float* left, float* right, int start, int end) noexcept;

    static constexpr int numVoices = 12;
    std::array<Voice, numVoices> voices {};
    double sampleRate = 48000.0;
    float attackCoeff = 0.0f, releaseCoeff = 0.0f;
    std::uint32_t counter = 0;
};

/**
    The Plugins Creator Studio's audio side (Stella AI Studio's engine, inside Sonify). Sonify's
    engine owns the audio device and the MIDI inputs: this plays the plugin being made (live, in
    its sandbox) in Sonify's audio callback, on the Audition output after everything else, fed by
    Sonify's live notes while the studio listens (it's in front), by its GUI's keyboard, and for
    an effect by the device's first two inputs, in time with the song (its tempo and position,
    for tempo sync). With no plugin it plays the test tone.

    It keeps the on-screen keyboard's state and the output meter (its own sound alone), and plays
    a chime when Sonify AI has finished (heard wherever the user is).
*/
class CreatorAudio final : public AudioEngine::CreatorPreview,
                           private juce::Timer
{
public:
    explicit CreatorAudio (AudioEngine& sonifyEngine);
    ~CreatorAudio() override;

    juce::AudioDeviceManager& getDeviceManager() noexcept   { return sonify.getDeviceManager(); }
    juce::MidiKeyboardState& getKeyboardState() noexcept    { return keyboardState; }

    /** Whether the studio is in front: it takes the live notes then, and plays. Message thread. */
    void setListening (bool shouldListen);
    bool isListening() const noexcept                       { return listening.load(); }

    /** The highest peak on an output channel since the last call (0..1, can exceed 1). */
    float takePeak (int channel) noexcept;

    /** 0..1: how much of each audio block's time Sonify's callback used. */
    double getCpuLoad() const;

    /** The device in three short lines: its name, the sample rate, the buffer
        ("Focusrite USB ASIO", "48 kHz", "128 samples · 2.7 ms"). */
    juce::StringArray describeDeviceLines() const;

    /** e.g. "ASIO · Focusrite USB ASIO · 48 kHz · 128 samples", or "No audio device". */
    juce::String describeDevice() const;

    /** A short two-note chime over whatever is playing (Sonify AI has finished). False if no
        audio device is running, so nothing can be heard. */
    bool playChime();

    void setTestToneEnabled (bool shouldBeOn) noexcept    { testToneOn.store (shouldBeOn); }
    bool isTestToneEnabled() const noexcept               { return testToneOn.load(); }

    /** Panic: silences everything that's sounding. The plugin gets "all notes off" (every
        voice is let go, stuck ones too), the keyboards' held keys go up, the test tone stops. */
    void allNotesOff();

    /** Message thread. Swaps the playing plugin (null: none); the old one is deleted here. */
    void setPlugin (std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin> newPlugin);

    /** Message thread only: the plugin is only ever replaced there. */
    WasmPlugin* getPlugin() const noexcept    { return plugin.get(); }

    double getCurrentSampleRate() const noexcept  { return currentRate.load(); }
    int getCurrentBlockSize() const noexcept      { return currentBlockSize.load(); }

    /** Called on the message thread when the device changes: another one, or a new sample rate
        or block size. */
    std::function<void()> onDeviceChanged;

    // AudioEngine::CreatorPreview
    void renderPreview (const juce::MidiBuffer& live, const float* inLeft, const float* inRight,
                        float* left, float* right, int numSamples, const clap_event_transport_t& song) noexcept override;

private:
    void timerCallback() override;   // follows the device's rate and block size
    void prepare (double rate, int blockSize);
    static void raisePeak (std::atomic<float>& peak, float value) noexcept;

    AudioEngine& sonify;
    juce::MidiKeyboardState keyboardState;
    juce::MidiBuffer midiBuffer;
    TestTone testTone;
    std::atomic<bool> testToneOn { true };
    std::atomic<bool> listening { false };

    /** The chime, on the audio thread: two soft bell notes, a fifth apart. */
    struct Chime
    {
        void start (double rate) noexcept    { sampleRate = rate; position = 0; active = true; }
        void render (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept;

        double sampleRate = 48000.0;
        int position = 0;
        bool active = false;
    };

    Chime chime;
    std::atomic<bool> chimeRequested { false };

    // The plugin's own block (it's added to Sonify's output after), sized as the device's
    // blocks are: the audio thread only uses it while it holds the plugin's lock.
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> scratch;

    juce::SpinLock pluginLock;
    std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin> plugin;
    std::array<WasmPlugin::MidiEvent, 512> pluginEvents {};

    std::atomic<double> currentRate { 48000.0 };
    std::atomic<int> currentBlockSize { 512 };
    double preparedRate = 0.0;            // message thread
    int preparedBlockSize = 0;
    juce::String shownDevice;             // the device as the top bar last showed it

    std::atomic<bool> silenceRequested { false };
    std::atomic<bool> panicRequested { false };
    std::array<std::atomic<float>, 2> peaks { 0.0f, 0.0f };

    static constexpr int midiBufferBytes = 16384;
    static constexpr int largestBlock = 8192;   // samples: the scratch always has room for a device block

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (CreatorAudio)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\CreatorPlugin.cpp

#include "CreatorPlugin.h"

#include "GuiLayout.h"
#include "Looks.h"
#include "PluginCanvas.h"
#include "PresetBank.h"
#include "Settings.h"
#include "StellaLookAndFeel.h"

#include <set>

namespace
{
    constexpr const char* infoFileName = "plugin.json";
    constexpr const char* wasmFileName = "plugin.wasm";
    constexpr const char* descriptionFileName = "description.json";
    constexpr const char* elementsFileName = "elements.wasm";
    constexpr const char* guiFolderName = "gui";
    constexpr const char* formatTag = "Sonify plugin";

    std::vector<std::uint8_t> readBytes (const juce::File& file)
    {
        juce::MemoryBlock data;

        if (! file.existsAsFile() || ! file.loadFileAsData (data))
            return {};

        const auto* start = static_cast<const std::uint8_t*> (data.getData());
        return std::vector<std::uint8_t> (start, start + data.getSize());
    }

    bool writeBytes (const juce::File& file, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes)
    {
        return file.replaceWithData (bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    }

    /** The Browser's words for a made plugin's type: an instrument, an effect, or a widget
        (anything else, on a track like an effect: the sound goes through it). */
    juce::StringArray featuresFor (const juce::String& kind)
    {
        if (kind == "effect")  return { "audio-effect" };
        if (kind == "widget")  return { "audio-effect", "utility" };
        return { "instrument", "synthesizer" };
    }

    /** A parameter's number for songs and automation, from its id: the same on every computer
        and in every version that keeps the id. */
    uint32_t stableId (const juce::String& text)
    {
        uint32_t hash = 2166136261u;

        for (const auto* p = text.toRawUTF8(); *p != 0; ++p)
            hash = (hash ^ (uint32_t) (std::uint8_t) *p) * 16777619u;

        return (hash & 0x7fffffffu) | 1u;
    }

    juce::String valueText (double value)
    {
        const auto size = std::abs (value);
        return juce::String (value, size >= 100.0 ? 0 : (size >= 10.0 ? 1 : 2));
    }

    /** The pictures in a made plugin's own looks (its knobs', sliders' and switches' Image
        layers), pinned to its own gui/images: in the studio a bare name is found in the open
        project's pictures, which a plugin on a track never is. Rewrites only what changed (a
        name, or a pinned path whose folder has moved since). */
    void pinLookPictures (const juce::File& gui)
    {
        const auto images = gui.getChildFile (GuiLayout::imagesFolder);
        const auto looksFolder = gui.getChildFile (Looks::folderName);

        if (! looksFolder.isDirectory())
            return;

        for (const auto& file : looksFolder.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, juce::String ("*") + Looks::fileExtension))
        {
            Looks::Look look;

            if (! Looks::readFile (file, look))
                continue;

            bool changed = false;

            for (auto& layer : look.doc.layers)
            {
                auto& picture = layer.prim.imageFile;

                if (layer.prim.type != PrimType::Image || picture.trim().isEmpty())
                    continue;

                const auto name = juce::File::isAbsolutePath (picture) ? juce::File (picture).getFileName() : picture.trim();
                const auto own = images.getChildFile (name);

                if (own.existsAsFile() && picture != own.getFullPathName())
                {
                    picture = own.getFullPathName();
                    changed = true;
                }
            }

            if (changed)
                Looks::writeFile (file, look);
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File MadePlugins::folder()
{
    return Settings::getDataFolder().getChildFile ("Plugins");
}

bool MadePlugins::isMadeFile (const juce::String& path)
{
    return path.trimCharactersAtEnd ("\\/").endsWithIgnoreCase (extension);
}

juce::Array<juce::File> MadePlugins::installed()
{
    juce::Array<juce::File> found;
    const auto home = folder();

    if (! home.isDirectory())
        return found;

    for (const auto& item : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (home, false, juce::String ("*") + extension, juce::File::findDirectories))
        if (item.getFile().getChildFile (infoFileName).existsAsFile())
            found.add (item.getFile());

    found.sort();
    return found;
}

juce::File MadePlugins::findInstalled (const juce::String& id)
{
    for (const auto& existing : installed())
    {
        const auto info = juce::JSON::parse (existing.getChildFile (infoFileName));

        if (info.getProperty ("id", {}).toString() == id)
            return existing;
    }

    return {};
}

int MadePlugins::installedVersion (const juce::String& id)
{
    const auto existing = findInstalled (id);

    if (existing == juce::File())
        return 0;

    const auto info = juce::JSON::parse (existing.getChildFile (infoFileName));
    return juce::jmax (1, (int) info.getProperty ("version", 1));
}

juce::Result MadePlugins::installUnpacked (const juce::File& unpacked, const juce::String& id, juce::File& installedFolder, bool& replaced)
{
    replaced = false;
    const auto info = juce::JSON::parse (unpacked.getChildFile (infoFileName));

    if (info.getProperty ("format", {}).toString() != formatTag || info.getProperty ("id", {}).toString() != id
        || ! unpacked.getChildFile (wasmFileName).existsAsFile())
        return juce::Result::fail ("The package isn't a plugin made in Sonify.");

    auto target = findInstalled (id);
    replaced = target != juce::File();

    if (! replaced)
    {
        const auto name = info.getProperty ("name", "Store plugin").toString().trim();
        const auto base = juce::File::createLegalFileName (name.isNotEmpty() ? name : juce::String ("Store plugin"));
        target = folder().getChildFile (base + extension);

        for (int n = 2; target.exists(); ++n)
            target = folder().getChildFile (base + " " + juce::String (n) + extension);
    }

    if (! target.createDirectory())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't make the folder " + target.getFullPathName());

    // What the new version doesn't have goes; plugin.json comes last, so a folder that's only
    // half there is never taken for a plugin.
    for (const auto& old : target.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFilesAndDirectories, false))
        if (! unpacked.getChildFile (old.getFileName()).exists() || old.isDirectory())
            old.deleteRecursively();

    for (const auto& item : unpacked.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFilesAndDirectories, false))
    {
        if (item.getFileName() == infoFileName)
            continue;

        const auto copied = item.isDirectory() ? item.copyDirectoryTo (target.getChildFile (item.getFileName()))
                                               : item.copyFileTo (target.getChildFile (item.getFileName()));

        if (! copied)
            return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + item.getFileName() + " in " + target.getFullPathName());
    }

    if (! unpacked.getChildFile (infoFileName).copyFileTo (target.getChildFile (infoFileName)))
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + juce::String (infoFileName) + " in " + target.getFullPathName());

    installedFolder = target;
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor> MadePlugins::describe (const juce::File& pluginFolder)
{
    const auto info = juce::JSON::parse (pluginFolder.getChildFile (infoFileName));
    const auto id = info.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();

    if (info.getProperty ("format", {}).toString() != formatTag || ! id.startsWith (idPrefix))
        return {};

    Plugin::Descriptor descriptor;
    descriptor.id = id;
    descriptor.name = info.getProperty ("name", pluginFolder.getFileNameWithoutExtension()).toString();
    descriptor.vendor = info.getProperty ("vendor", "Made in Sonify").toString();
    descriptor.version = juce::String ((int) info.getProperty ("version", 1));
    descriptor.features = featuresFor (info.getProperty ("kind", "instrument").toString());
    return { descriptor };
}

juce::Result MadePlugins::install (const Package& package, juce::File& installedFolder, bool& replaced)
{
    replaced = false;

    if (package.wasm.empty() || package.projectId.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("There's nothing to add: the plugin hasn't been built.");

    const auto id = juce::String (idPrefix) + package.projectId;
    const auto name = package.name.trim().isNotEmpty() ? package.name.trim() : juce::String ("My Plugin");
    juce::File target;
    int version = 1;

    // The folder it went into before (by its id: a new name doesn't make it another plugin),
    // or a new one named after it.
    for (const auto& existing : installed())
    {
        const auto info = juce::JSON::parse (existing.getChildFile (infoFileName));

        if (info.getProperty ("id", {}).toString() == id)
        {
            target = existing;
            version = (int) info.getProperty ("version", 0) + 1;
            replaced = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (target == juce::File())
    {
        const auto base = juce::File::createLegalFileName (name);
        target = folder().getChildFile (base + extension);

        for (int n = 2; target.exists(); ++n)
            target = folder().getChildFile (base + " " + juce::String (n) + extension);
    }

    if (const auto written = writeFolder (package, target, version); written.failed())
        return written;

    installedFolder = target;
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result MadePlugins::writeFolder (const Package& package, const juce::File& target, int version)
{
    if (package.wasm.empty() || package.projectId.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("There's nothing to write: the plugin hasn't been built.");

    const auto id = juce::String (idPrefix) + package.projectId;
    const auto name = package.name.trim().isNotEmpty() ? package.name.trim() : juce::String ("My Plugin");

    if (! target.createDirectory())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't make the folder " + target.getFullPathName());

    const auto cantWrite = [&target] (const char* file)
    {
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + juce::String (file) + " in " + target.getFullPathName());
    };

    if (! writeBytes (target.getChildFile (wasmFileName), package.wasm))
        return cantWrite (wasmFileName);

    if (! package.elementsWasm.empty())
    {
        if (! writeBytes (target.getChildFile (elementsFileName), package.elementsWasm))
            return cantWrite (elementsFileName);
    }
    else
    {
        target.getChildFile (elementsFileName).deleteFile();
    }

    if (! target.getChildFile (descriptionFileName).replaceWithText (juce::String (juce::CharPointer_UTF8 (package.description.c_str()))))
        return cantWrite (descriptionFileName);

    const auto presets = target.getChildFile (PresetBank::fileName);

    if (package.presetsFile.existsAsFile())
    {
        if (! package.presetsFile.copyFileTo (presets))
            return cantWrite (PresetBank::fileName);
    }
    else
    {
        presets.deleteFile();
    }

    // The panel: its layout, pictures and looks (the studio's view of it stays behind).
    const auto gui = target.getChildFile (guiFolderName);
    gui.deleteRecursively();

    if (package.guiFolder.isDirectory() && ! package.guiFolder.copyDirectoryTo (gui))
        return cantWrite (guiFolderName);

    gui.getChildFile ("view.json").deleteFile();
    pinLookPictures (gui);

    // A sampler's library: its blobs by name (and, made here, where they are; never in the store's).
    if (! PluginLibrary::writeMade (target, package.library, ! package.store.isValid()))
        return cantWrite (PluginLibrary::fileName);

    // Last, so a folder that's only half there is never taken for a plugin.
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr info (new juce::DynamicObject());
    info->setProperty ("format", formatTag);
    info->setProperty ("formatVersion", 1);
    info->setProperty ("id", id);
    info->setProperty ("name", name);
    info->setProperty ("vendor", package.vendor.trim().isNotEmpty() ? package.vendor.trim() : juce::String ("Made in Sonify"));
    info->setProperty ("kind", package.kind == "effect" || package.kind == "widget" ? package.kind : juce::String ("instrument"));
    info->setProperty ("version", version);
    info->setProperty ("added", juce::Time::getCurrentTime().toISO8601 (true));
    info->setProperty ("project", package.projectId);

    if (package.store.isValid())
        info->setProperty ("store", package.store.toVar());

    if (! target.getChildFile (infoFileName).replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (info.get()))))
        return cantWrite (infoFileName);

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

    {

    };
}

//==============================================================================
/** The plugin's own window: its panel, as designed in Edit UI, playing (with the demo's bar
    and Buy under it while a paid plugin plays its demo). Hides when closed, and goes with the
    plugin. */
class CreatorPlugin::Screen final : public juce::DocumentWindow,
                                    private juce::Timer
{
public:
    explicit Screen (CreatorPlugin& owner)
        : DocumentWindow (owner.descriptor.name, juce::Colours::black, DocumentWindow::closeButton),
          plugin (owner)
    {
        setUsingNativeTitleBar (true);

        const auto gui = plugin.sourceFolder.getChildFile (guiFolderName);
        pinLookPictures (gui);   // the folder may have moved since it was added
        looks.setGuiFolder (gui);

        canvas.setLooks (looks);
        canvas.setPanelOnly (true);
        canvas.setGuiFolder (gui);

        // Its panel; a plain automatic one if it never had one.
        GuiLayout layout;

        if (GuiLayout::load (gui.getChildFile (GuiLayout::fileName), layout).failed() || layout.width <= 0 || layout.height <= 0)
        {
            juce::Array<GuiLayout::ParamInfo> paramInfos;

            for (const auto& p : plugin.infos)
                paramInfos.add ({ p.id, p.module, p.name, p.unit, p.min, p.max, p.def });

            layout = GuiLayout::makeDefault (paramInfos, plugin.descriptor.name);
        }

        canvas.onParameterChanged = [this] (int pluginIndex, float value)
        {
            if (const auto index = plugin.indexOfPluginParameter (pluginIndex); index >= 0)
                plugin.setValue (index, value, true);

            // The chosen preset's values aren't its own any more: it shows a *.
            if (plugin.presets.getCurrent() >= 0 && ! plugin.presets.isModified())
            {
                plugin.presets.setModified (true);
                canvas.setPresets (plugin.presets.getMenu());
            }
        };

        canvas.onNote = [this] (int note, float velocity)
        {
            if (velocity > 0.0f)
                plugin.keyboardState.noteOn (1, note, velocity);
            else
                plugin.keyboardState.noteOff (1, note, 0.0f);
        };

        canvas.isNoteDown = [this] (int note) { return plugin.keyboardState.isNoteOnForChannels (0xffff, note); };

        // The preset manager: the plugin's presets, the user's own (Save, Save as, Load), banks.
        presetUi.getValues = [this] { return plugin.currentValues(); };
        presetUi.apply = [this] (const Preset& preset)
        {
            plugin.applyPreset (preset, true);
            pushParameters (true);
        };
        presetUi.changed = [this]
        {
            canvas.setPresets (plugin.presets.getMenu());
            plugin.stateChanged.store (true);
        };
        canvas.onPresetChosen = [this] (int index) { presetUi.choose (index); };
        canvas.onPresetAction = [this] (PresetAction action) { presetUi.perform (action); };
        canvas.readLevel = [this] (const juce::String& source, bool rms) { return plugin.takeLevel (source, rms); };
        canvas.readScope = [this] (const juce::String& source, float* destination, int numSamples) { plugin.readScope (source, destination, numSamples); };
        canvas.onSourcesChanged = [this] (const juce::StringArray& levels, const juce::StringArray& scopes) { plugin.setScreenSources (levels, scopes); };

        // The panel's programmed elements, in a sandbox of their own.
        if (const auto bytes = readBytes (plugin.sourceFolder.getChildFile (elementsFileName)); ! bytes.empty())
        {
            std::string error;
            std::shared_ptr<WasmElements> elements (WasmElements::load (bytes, error));
            canvas.setElements (elements);
        }

        canvas.setLayout (layout);
        pushParameters (true);

        canvas.setPresets (plugin.presets.getMenu());

        // A paid plugin from the store, not licensed here: the demo's bar, with Buy.
        auto product = plugin.store;

        if (! product.isValid())
            product.id = plugin.productId;

        demoBar.setProduct (product);
        demoBar.buy.onClick = [this, product] { buy (product); };
        demoBar.setVisible (plugin.isInDemo());

        // A sampler whose blobs aren't here: which, and Locate...
        libraryBar.locate.onClick = [this] { locateLibrary(); };
        libraryBar.setVisible (! plugin.getMissingInstruments().isEmpty());
        libraryBar.setMissing (plugin.getMissingInstruments(), PluginLibrary::homeFolder (plugin.descriptor.vendor, plugin.descriptor.name));

        holder.setSize (layout.width, layout.height + (demoBar.isVisible() ? PanelHolder::barHeight : 0)
                                                    + (libraryBar.isVisible() ? PanelHolder::barHeight : 0));
        setContentNonOwned (&holder, true);
        setResizable (true, false);
        setResizeLimits (juce::jmax (120, layout.width / 4), juce::jmax (90, layout.height / 4),
                         layout.width * 3, layout.height * 3 + 2 * PanelHolder::barHeight);
        centreWithSize (getWidth(), getHeight());

        startTimerHz (15);
    }

    ~Screen() override
    {
        stopTimer();
        presetUi.getValues = nullptr;
        presetUi.apply = nullptr;
        presetUi.changed = nullptr;
        clearContentComponent();   // the canvas is a member: let go of it before it goes
    }

    void show (const juce::String& title)
    {
        setName (title);
        pushParameters (true);

        // Presets saved elsewhere since (the studio, another track) show up.
        plugin.presets.refresh();
        canvas.setPresets (plugin.presets.getMenu());

        setVisible (true);
        toFront (true);
    }

    void closeButtonPressed() override
    {
        setVisible (false);
    }

private:
    void timerCallback() override
    {
        // Automation, the Hub's controls and presets move its knobs too (and an undo, its preset).
        if (isVisible())
        {
            pushParameters (false);
            canvas.setPresets (plugin.presets.getMenu());
        }

        // Bought meanwhile (its licence arrived): the demo's bar goes.
        if (const bool demo = plugin.isInDemo(); demo != demoBar.isVisible())
        {
            demoBar.setVisible (demo);
            setSize (getWidth(), getHeight() + (demo ? PanelHolder::barHeight : -PanelHolder::barHeight));
            holder.resized();
        }

        // Its blobs found meanwhile (Locate...): the library's bar goes.
        if (const bool missing = ! plugin.getMissingInstruments().isEmpty(); missing != libraryBar.isVisible())
        {
            libraryBar.setVisible (missing);
            setSize (getWidth(), getHeight() + (missing ? PanelHolder::barHeight : -PanelHolder::barHeight));
            holder.resized();
        }
    }

    void locateLibrary()
    {
        chooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("The folder " + plugin.descriptor.name + "'s blobs are in",
                                                       PluginLibrary::homeFolder (plugin.descriptor.vendor, plugin.descriptor.name).getParentDirectory());

        chooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectDirectories,
                              [safe = juce::Component::SafePointer<Screen> (this)] (const juce::FileChooser& fc)
                              {
                                  if (safe == nullptr || fc.getResult() == juce::File())
                                      return;

                                  safe->plugin.locateLibrary (fc.getResult());

                                  if (const auto missing = safe->plugin.getMissingInstruments(); ! missing.isEmpty())
                                  {
                                      safe->libraryBar.setMissing (missing, PluginLibrary::homeFolder (safe->plugin.descriptor.vendor,
                                                                                                       safe->plugin.descriptor.name));
                                      juce::AlertWindow::showMessageBoxAsync (juce::MessageBoxIconType::InfoIcon, "Not there",
                                                                              missing.joinIntoString (", ") + (missing.size() == 1 ? " isn't" : " aren't")
                                                                              + " in " + fc.getResult().getFullPathName() + " either.",
                                                                              "OK", safe.getComponent());
                                  }
                              });
    }

    void buy (const Licences::Product& product)
    {
        if (Licences::buyHandler() != nullptr)
        {
            Licences::buy (product);
            return;
        }

        juce::AlertWindow::showMessageBoxAsync (juce::MessageBoxIconType::InfoIcon, "Buy " + plugin.descriptor.name,
                                                "Buy it in Sonify's store, in the Plugins Studio. Its licence comes to this computer "
                                                "by itself, and it plays fully from then on.",
                                                "OK", this);
    }

    void pushParameters (bool always)
    {
        const auto count = plugin.infos.size();
        bool changed = always || shown.size() != count;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < count && ! changed; ++i)
            changed = std::abs (shown[i] - plugin.values[i].load (std::memory_order_relaxed)) > 1.0e-6f;

        if (! changed)
            return;

        shown.resize (count);
        juce::Array<PluginCanvas::Param> params;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            const auto& info = plugin.infos[i];
            shown[i] = plugin.values[i].load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

            PluginCanvas::Param p;
            p.index = info.index;
            p.id = info.id;
            p.name = info.name;
            p.unit = info.unit;
            p.min = info.min;
            p.max = info.max;
            p.def = info.def;
            p.skew = info.skew;
            p.value = shown[i];
            params.add (p);
        }

        canvas.setParameters (params);
    }

    CreatorPlugin& plugin;
    Looks looks;               // before the canvas, which draws with it
    PluginCanvas canvas;
    DemoBar demoBar;
    LibraryBar libraryBar;
    PanelHolder holder { canvas, demoBar, libraryBar };
    PresetUi presetUi { *this, plugin.presets };
    std::unique_ptr<juce::FileChooser> chooser;
    std::vector<float> shown;  // the values the canvas has

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Screen)
};

//==============================================================================
std::unique_ptr<Plugin> CreatorPlugin::load (const juce::File& pluginFolder, juce::String& error)
{
    const auto descriptors = MadePlugins::describe (pluginFolder);

    if (descriptors.empty())
    {
        error = "It isn't a plugin made in Sonify, or its plugin.json is damaged: " + pluginFolder.getFullPathName();
        return nullptr;
    }

    auto bytes = readBytes (pluginFolder.getChildFile (wasmFileName));

    if (bytes.empty())
    {
        error = descriptors.front().name + " is missing its plugin.wasm: add it to Sonify again from the Plugins Creator Studio.";
        return nullptr;
    }

    std::unique_ptr<CreatorPlugin> plugin (new CreatorPlugin());
    plugin->descriptor = descriptors.front();
    plugin->inFile = descriptors;
    plugin->sourceFolder = pluginFolder;
    plugin->instrument = juce::JSON::parse (pluginFolder.getChildFile (infoFileName)).getProperty ("kind", "instrument").toString() == "instrument";
    plugin->wasmBytes = std::move (bytes);
    plugin->library = PluginLibrary::load (pluginFolder);
    plugin->findLibrary();

    // What the plugin said of itself when it was added: its parameters, modules and displays.
    const auto description = juce::JSON::parse (pluginFolder.getChildFile (descriptionFileName));
    std::set<uint32_t> usedIds;

    // The store's: a paid plugin plays its demo until this computer holds its licence. The id
    // its own WebAssembly carries comes first (its plugin.json can be edited, its build can't).
    plugin->store = Licences::Product::fromVar (juce::JSON::parse (pluginFolder.getChildFile (infoFileName)).getProperty ("store", {}));
    const auto builtProduct = description.getProperty ("product", {}).toString().trim();
    plugin->protectedBuild = builtProduct.isNotEmpty();
    plugin->productId = plugin->protectedBuild ? builtProduct : plugin->store.id;

    if (plugin->protectedBuild || plugin->store.isPaid())
    {
        plugin->licensed = Licences::flagFor (plugin->productId);
        plugin->licenceToken = Licences::runtimeToken (plugin->productId);
    }

    if (const auto* list = description.getProperty ("params", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& item : *list)
        {
            Info info;
            info.index = (int) item.getProperty ("index", 0);
            info.id = item.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();
            info.name = item.getProperty ("name", {}).toString();
            info.module = item.getProperty ("module", {}).toString();
            info.unit = item.getProperty ("unit", {}).toString();
            info.min = (float) (double) item.getProperty ("min", 0.0);
            info.max = (float) (double) item.getProperty ("max", 1.0);
            info.def = (float) (double) item.getProperty ("def", 0.0);
            info.skew = (float) (double) item.getProperty ("skew", 1.0);

            if (! (info.max > info.min) || info.id.isEmpty())
                continue;

            Parameter parameter;
            parameter.id = stableId (info.id);

            while (! usedIds.insert (parameter.id).second)   // two ids that read the same: the next number
                parameter.id = (parameter.id + 1) & 0x7fffffffu;

            parameter.name = info.name.isNotEmpty() ? info.name : info.id;
            parameter.minValue = info.min;
            parameter.maxValue = info.max;
            parameter.defaultValue = juce::jlimit (info.min, info.max, info.def);

            plugin->infos.push_back (info);
            plugin->parameters.push_back (parameter);
        }
    }

    plugin->values = std::make_unique<std::atomic<float>[]> (juce::jmax ((size_t) 1, plugin->infos.size()));

    for (size_t i = 0; i < plugin->infos.size(); ++i)
        plugin->values[i].store (juce::jlimit (plugin->infos[i].min, plugin->infos[i].max, plugin->infos[i].def));

    // Its presets: the factory ones it came with, and the user's own by its name. A new one
    // starts on the first (a song's state, loaded next, brings back what it was left on).
    plugin->presets.setPlugin (plugin->descriptor.name, pluginFolder.getChildFile (PresetBank::fileName), false);

    if (! plugin->presets.isEmpty())
    {
        plugin->presets.choose (0);
        plugin->applyPreset (plugin->presets.getEntries().front().preset, false);
    }

    if (const auto* list = description.getProperty ("modules", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < list->size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto& item = list->getReference (i);
            ModuleInfo module;
            module.index = i;
            module.id = item.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();

            if (const auto* outs = item.getProperty ("outputs", {}).getArray())
                for (const auto& port : *outs)
                    module.outputs.add (port.toString());

            plugin->modules.push_back (module);
        }
    }

    if (const auto* list = description.getProperty ("displays", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& item : *list)
            plugin->displays.push_back ({ (int) item.getProperty ("index", 0), item.getProperty ("id", {}).toString() });

    return plugin;
}

CreatorPlugin::~CreatorPlugin()
{
    screen.reset();   // the window goes before the plugin it shows
    deactivate();
}

//==============================================================================
bool CreatorPlugin::saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination)
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr saved (new juce::DynamicObject());

    for (size_t i = 0; i < infos.size(); ++i)
        saved->setProperty (infos[i].id, (double) this->values[i].load());

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr state (new juce::DynamicObject());
    state->setProperty ("version", descriptor.version);
    state->setProperty ("values", juce::var (saved.get()));

    // The preset it's on (and whether its values changed since), as a DAW keeps it.
    if (const auto* chosen = presets.getCurrentEntry())
    {
        state->setProperty ("preset", chosen->preset.name);
        state->setProperty ("presetGroup", chosen->group);
        state->setProperty ("presetModified", presets.isModified());
    }

    const auto text = juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (state.get()), true);
    destination.replaceAll (text.toRawUTF8(), text.getNumBytesAsUTF8());
    return true;
}

bool CreatorPlugin::loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source)
{
    const auto state = juce::JSON::parse (source.toString());
    const auto saved = state.getProperty ("values", {});

    if (! saved.isObject())
        return false;

    // Matched by id: parameters a newer version added keep their defaults.
    for (size_t i = 0; i < infos.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto value = saved.hasProperty (infos[i].id) ? (float) (double) saved.getProperty (infos[i].id, infos[i].def) : infos[i].def;
        setValue ((int) i, juce::jlimit (infos[i].min, infos[i].max, value), false);
    }

    // The preset it was on, if it's still there.
    presets.restore (state.getProperty ("preset", {}).toString(), state.getProperty ("presetGroup", {}).toString(),
                     static_cast<bool> (state.getProperty ("presetModified", false)));
    return true;
}

void CreatorPlugin::applyPreset (const Preset& preset, bool byUser)
{
    // Its values by id; parameters it doesn't name go back to their defaults.
    for (size_t i = 0; i < infos.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto found = preset.values.find (infos[i].id);
        const auto value = found != preset.values.end() ? found->second : infos[i].def;
        setValue ((int) i, juce::jlimit (infos[i].min, infos[i].max, value), false);
    }

    if (byUser)
        stateChanged.store (true);
}

std::map<juce::String, float> CreatorPlugin::currentValues() const
{
    std::map<juce::String, float> current;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < infos.size(); ++i)
        current[infos[i].id] = values[i].load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

    return current;
}

//==============================================================================
int CreatorPlugin::findParameter (uint32_t id) const noexcept
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < parameters.size(); ++i)
        if (parameters[i].id == id)
            return (int) i;

    return -1;
}

int CreatorPlugin::indexOfPluginParameter (int pluginIndex) const noexcept
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < infos.size(); ++i)
        if (infos[i].index == pluginIndex)
            return (int) i;

    return -1;
}

double CreatorPlugin::getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept
{
    return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, (int) infos.size()) ? (double) values[(size_t) index].load (std::memory_order_relaxed) : 0.0;
}

juce::String CreatorPlugin::getParameterText (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, (int) infos.size()))
        return {};

    const auto& unit = infos[(size_t) index].unit;
    return unit.isNotEmpty() ? valueText (value) + " " + unit : valueText (value);
}

double CreatorPlugin::queueParameter (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, (int) infos.size()))
        return 0.0;

    const auto& info = infos[(size_t) index];
    const auto clamped = juce::jlimit (info.min, info.max, (float) value);
    setValue (index, clamped, false);
    stateChanged.store (true);
    return clamped;
}

void CreatorPlugin::setValue (int index, float value, bool fromScreen)
{
    // Message thread: the instance is only ever replaced here.
    values[(size_t) index].store (value, std::memory_order_relaxed);

    if (wasm != nullptr)
        wasm->setParameter (infos[(size_t) index].index, value);

    if (fromScreen)
    {
        touched.store (index);
        stateChanged.store (true);
    }
}

void CreatorPlugin::setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept
{
    if (! (juce::isPositiveAndBelow (indexHint, (int) parameters.size()) && parameters[(size_t) indexHint].id == paramId))
        indexHint = findParameter (paramId);

    if (indexHint < 0)
        return;

    const auto& info = infos[(size_t) indexHint];
    const auto clamped = juce::jlimit (info.min, info.max, (float) value);
    values[(size_t) indexHint].store (clamped, std::memory_order_relaxed);

    // The audio thread: the instance can't be swapped while this holds the lock.
    const juce::SpinLock::ScopedTryLockType lock (wasmLock);

    if (lock.isLocked() && wasm != nullptr)
        wasm->setParameter (info.index, clamped);
}

//==============================================================================
bool CreatorPlugin::activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize)
{
    // Longer blocks are split up as they play: only a new sample rate needs a new instance.
    if (active && std::abs (sampleRate - activeRate) < 0.5)
        return true;

    // A new instance at this rate (compiled once a run, so starting again is quick), with the
    // values the host holds.
    std::string error;
    auto fresh = WasmPlugin::load (wasmBytes, sampleRate, juce::jmax (32, maxBlockSize), error);

    if (fresh == nullptr)
    {
        failure = descriptor.name + " didn't start: " + juce::String (error);
        deactivate();
        return false;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < infos.size(); ++i)
        fresh->setParameter (infos[i].index, values[i].load());

    // Its sample library, with its blobs as they're found now (put there since, they're found).
    findLibrary();

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock hold (libraryLock);
        fresh->setLibrary (libraryEntries);
    }

    playedMidi.ensureSize (16384);

    {
        const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (wasmLock);
        std::swap (wasm, fresh);
    }

    fresh.reset();   // the one it replaced, if any: here, never on the audio thread

    active = true;
    activeRate = sampleRate;
    activeBlockSize = maxBlockSize;
    failure.clear();
    failureReported = false;
    applyScreenSources();
    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
void CreatorPlugin::findLibrary()
{
    auto found = PluginLibrary::entriesFor (library, descriptor.vendor, descriptor.name,
                                            { sourceFolder.getChildFile ("library"), sourceFolder });
    const juce::ScopedLock hold (libraryLock);
    libraryEntries = std::move (found);
}

juce::StringArray CreatorPlugin::getMissingInstruments() const
{
    juce::StringArray missing;
    const juce::ScopedLock hold (libraryLock);

    for (const auto& entry : libraryEntries)
        if (entry.path.empty())
            missing.add (juce::String (juce::CharPointer_UTF8 (entry.name.c_str())));

    return missing;
}

void CreatorPlugin::locateLibrary (const juce::File& folder)
{
    PluginLibrary::addToList (descriptor.vendor, descriptor.name, { folder.getFullPathName() });
    findLibrary();

    const juce::ScopedLock hold (libraryLock);
    const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (wasmLock);

    if (wasm != nullptr)
        wasm->setLibrary (libraryEntries);
}

void CreatorPlugin::deactivate()
{
    std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin> old;

    {
        const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (wasmLock);
        old = std::move (wasm);
    }

    active = false;
    activeRate = 0.0;
    activeBlockSize = 0;
}

WasmPlugin::Transport MadePlugins::transportOf (const clap_event_transport_t* song) noexcept
{
    WasmPlugin::Transport t;

    if (song == nullptr)
        return t;

    if ((song->flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TEMPO) != 0 && song->tempo > 1.0)
        t.tempo = song->tempo;

    if ((song->flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_BEATS_TIMELINE) != 0)
    {
        t.beat = (double) song->song_pos_beats / (double) CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR;
        t.barStart = (double) song->bar_start / (double) CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR;
    }

    if ((song->flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TIME_SIGNATURE) != 0 && song->tsig_num > 0 && song->tsig_denom > 0)
    {
        t.numerator = song->tsig_num;
        t.denominator = song->tsig_denom;
    }

    t.playing = (song->flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_PLAYING) != 0;
    return t;
}

void CreatorPlugin::process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                             int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t* song) noexcept
{
    const juce::SpinLock::ScopedTryLockType lock (wasmLock);

    if (! lock.isLocked() || wasm == nullptr || numSamples <= 0)
    {
        // Not playing: an instrument is silent, an effect lets the sound through.
        for (int channel = 0; channel < 2; ++channel)
        {
            auto* out = channel == 0 ? outLeft : outRight;
            const auto* in = channel == 0 ? inLeft : (inRight != nullptr ? inRight : inLeft);

            if (out == nullptr)
                continue;

            if (instrument || in == nullptr)
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (out, juce::jmax (0, numSamples));
            else if (in != out)
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (out, in, numSamples);
        }

        return;
    }

    // The track's notes, and the panel's keyboard (which lights up with every note played).
    playedMidi.clear();
    playedMidi.addEvents (midi, 0, numSamples, 0);
    keyboardState.processNextMidiBuffer (playedMidi, 0, numSamples, true);

    int count = 0;

    for (const auto metadata : playedMidi)
    {
        const auto* raw = metadata.data;

        if (metadata.numBytes < 1 || raw[0] >= 0xf0)
            continue;

        if (count >= maxEvents)
            break;

        events[(size_t) count++] = { (std::uint32_t) juce::jlimit (0, numSamples - 1, metadata.samplePosition),
                                     raw[0],
                                     metadata.numBytes > 1 ? raw[1] : (std::uint8_t) 0,
                                     metadata.numBytes > 2 ? raw[2] : (std::uint8_t) 0 };
    }

    wasm->setTransport (MadePlugins::transportOf (song));   // the song's tempo and position: tempo sync

    // The store's licence: the plugin's own token while this computer has one.
    const bool licensedHere = licensed == nullptr || licensed->load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

    if (protectedBuild)
        wasm->setLicenceToken (licensedHere ? licenceToken : 0);

    if (instrument)
        wasm->process (nullptr, nullptr, outLeft, outRight, numSamples, events.data(), count);
    else
        wasm->process (inLeft, inRight != nullptr ? inRight : inLeft, outLeft, outRight, numSamples, events.data(), count);

    // A paid plugin whose build doesn't carry the demo: Sonify plays it.
    if (licensed != nullptr && ! protectedBuild)
        demoGate.process (outLeft, outRight, numSamples, activeRate, licensedHere);
}

bool CreatorPlugin::isInDemo() const noexcept
{
    return licensed != nullptr && ! licensed->load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

//==============================================================================
Plugin::Requests CreatorPlugin::takeRequests() noexcept
{
    Requests requests;

    // It stopped (it crashed, or got stuck): Sonify says so once.
    if (wasm != nullptr && wasm->hasFailed() && ! failureReported)
    {
        failureReported = true;
        requests.processError = true;
    }

    return requests;
}

bool CreatorPlugin::getError (juce::String& error) const
{
    if (wasm != nullptr && wasm->hasFailed())
    {
        error = juce::String (wasm->getFailure());
        return true;
    }

    if (failure.isNotEmpty())
    {
        error = failure;
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

//==============================================================================
bool CreatorPlugin::showNativeScreen (const juce::String& title)
{
    if (screen == nullptr)
        screen = std::make_unique<Screen> (*this);

    screen->show (title);
    return true;
}

void CreatorPlugin::hideNativeScreen()
{
    if (screen != nullptr)
        screen->setVisible (false);
}

//==============================================================================
bool CreatorPlugin::resolve (const juce::String& source, int& moduleIndex, int& port) const
{
    const auto module = source.upToFirstOccurrenceOf (".", false, false);
    const auto portName = source.fromFirstOccurrenceOf (".", false, false);

    if (module == "plugin")
    {
        // "plugin.out L" is what the plugin plays; "plugin.in L" what it gets.
        moduleIndex = portName.startsWith ("in") ? WasmPlugin::pluginInput : WasmPlugin::pluginOutput;
        port = portName.endsWithChar ('R') ? 1 : 0;
        return true;
    }

    for (const auto& m : modules)
    {
        if (m.id == module && m.outputs.contains (portName))
        {
            moduleIndex = m.index;
            port = m.outputs.indexOf (portName);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

void CreatorPlugin::setScreenSources (const juce::StringArray& levels, const juce::StringArray& scopes)
{
    levelSources = levels;
    scopeSources = scopes;
    applyScreenSources();
}

void CreatorPlugin::applyScreenSources()
{
    tappedSources.clear();

    if (wasm == nullptr)
        return;

    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> taps;

    for (const auto& source : levelSources)
    {
        int moduleIndex = 0, port = 0;

        if (taps.size() < (size_t) WasmPlugin::maxTaps && resolve (source, moduleIndex, port))
        {
            taps.push_back ({ moduleIndex, port });
            tappedSources.add (source);
        }
    }

    wasm->setTaps (taps);

    // As in the studio: the panel's scopes use slots 1 to 3.
    for (int slot = 1; slot < WasmPlugin::maxScopes; ++slot)
    {
        int moduleIndex = WasmPlugin::off, port = 0;

        if (slot - 1 < scopeSources.size())
            resolve (scopeSources[slot - 1], moduleIndex, port);

        wasm->setScope (slot, moduleIndex, port);
    }
}

float CreatorPlugin::takeLevel (const juce::String& source, bool rms)
{
    if (wasm == nullptr)
        return 0.0f;

    for (const auto& d : displays)
        if (d.id == source)
            return wasm->getDisplay (d.index);

    const auto tap = tappedSources.indexOf (source);

    if (tap < 0)
        return 0.0f;

    return rms ? wasm->getTapRms (tap) : wasm->takeTapPeak (tap);
}

void CreatorPlugin::readScope (const juce::String& source, float* destination, int numSamples) const
{
    const auto slot = scopeSources.indexOf (source) + 1;

    if (wasm != nullptr && slot >= 1 && slot < WasmPlugin::maxScopes)
        wasm->readScope (slot, destination, numSamples);
    else
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (destination, numSamples);
}

/**
    Plugins made in the Plugins Creator Studio, as Sonify's own: Add to Sonify puts the one that
    plays into a folder of its own here (no VST3 or CLAP), the Browser lists it under
    "Made in Sonify", and tracks play it like Sonify's system tools, with its own window: the
    panel designed in Edit UI.

    A made plugin is a folder, "<name>.sonifyplugin", in <user data>\Plugins Creator\Plugins:
        plugin.json      its name, company, kind, id ("sonify.made." and the project's id) and version
        plugin.wasm      the plugin, as built (it runs in its sandbox, as in the studio)
        description.json what the plugin says of itself: its parameters, modules and displays
        elements.wasm    its panel's programmed elements, when it has some
        presets.json     its factory presets
        library.json     a sampler's sample library: its blobs by name (PluginLibrary), when it has one
        gui              its panel: layout.json, its pictures and its own looks
    One from the store also says so in plugin.json ("store": its id, title and price, see
    Licences::Product): a paid one plays its demo until this computer has its licence.
    Adding the same project again updates it in place (songs keep finding it); tracks that
    already play it get the new version when their song opens again.

    The user's own presets aren't in it: they're on the hard drive, by the plugin's name
    (PresetLibrary), shared with the studio and every track that plays it.
*/
namespace MadePlugins
{
    inline constexpr const char* extension = ".sonifyplugin";
    inline constexpr const char* idPrefix = "sonify.made.";
    inline constexpr const char* category = "Made in Sonify";
    inline constexpr const char* formatName = "Sonify";
    inline constexpr const char* folderLabel = "Plugins Creator";

    /** <user data>\Plugins Creator\Plugins: where they're kept. */
    juce::File folder();

    /** The song's tempo and position as the plugins hear them (tempo sync); none: 120, stopped. */
    WasmPlugin::Transport transportOf (const clap_event_transport_t* song) noexcept;

    /** Whether a plugin file is a made plugin's folder. */
    bool isMadeFile (const juce::String& path);

    /** Every made plugin's folder. */
    juce::Array<juce::File> installed();

    /** The plugin in a made plugin's folder (none if it can't be read). */
    std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor> describe (const juce::File& pluginFolder);

    /** What Add to Sonify takes from the studio. */
    struct Package
    {
        juce::String projectId, name, vendor;
        juce::String kind { "instrument" };      // "instrument", "effect" or "widget" (Project::kindToString)
        std::string description;                  // the playing plugin's own (WasmPlugin::getDescription)
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> wasm, elementsWasm;
        juce::File guiFolder;                     // copied, without the studio's view of it
        juce::File presetsFile;                   // copied when there is one
        juce::Array<PluginLibrary::Instrument> library;   // a sampler's blobs (they aren't copied)
        Licences::Product store;                  // the store's details, for a store package (none: made here)
    };

    /** Writes it: into the folder this project was added to before (replaced: true), or a new one. */
    juce::Result install (const Package& package, juce::File& installedFolder, bool& replaced);

    /** Writes a made plugin's folder as install does, into target (made or emptied first): the
        store's package is this folder, zipped. */
    juce::Result writeFolder (const Package& package, const juce::File& target, int version);

    /** The made plugin's folder with this id ("sonify.made." ...), or none. */
    juce::File findInstalled (const juce::String& id);

    /** Its version in plugin.json (0: not installed). */
    int installedVersion (const juce::String& id);

    /** A made plugin's folder from the store (unpacked from its package, plugin.json already
        checked) put into the library: over the one with the same id (replaced: true), or into a
        new folder named after it. */
    juce::Result installUnpacked (const juce::File& unpacked, const juce::String& id, juce::File& installedFolder, bool& replaced);

    /** The id a store product's plugin has in Sonify. */
    inline juce::String storeId (const juce::String& product)    { return juce::String (idPrefix) + "store-" + product; }
}

//==============================================================================
/** A made plugin on a track: Sonify's Plugin around the sandboxed plugin (WasmPlugin), with its
    panel as its own window. Its presets are a modern preset manager's: the plugin's factory
    presets, the user's own, banks. A new one starts on its first preset; a song brings back the
    preset it was left on, with its values. */
class CreatorPlugin final : public Plugin
{
public:
    static std::unique_ptr<Plugin> load (const juce::File& pluginFolder, juce::String& error);
    ~CreatorPlugin() override;

    juce::String getFormatName() const override                          { return MadePlugins::formatName; }
    const Descriptor& getDescriptor() const noexcept override            { return descriptor; }
    const std::vector<Descriptor>& getPluginsInFile() const noexcept override { return inFile; }
    const juce::File& getSourceFile() const noexcept override            { return sourceFolder; }
    Role getRole() const noexcept override                               { return instrument ? Role::instrument : Role::effect; }
    int getMainInputChannels() const noexcept override                   { return instrument ? 0 : 2; }
    int getMainOutputChannels() const noexcept override                  { return 2; }

    bool canSaveState() const noexcept override                          { return true; }
    bool saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination) override;
    bool loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source) override;
    bool consumeStateChanged() noexcept override                         { return stateChanged.exchange (false); }

    const std::vector<Parameter>& getParameters() const noexcept override { return parameters; }
    int findParameter (uint32_t id) const noexcept override;
    double getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept override;
    double readParameterValue (int index) override                       { return getParameterValue (index); }
    juce::String getParameterText (int index, double value) override;
    double queueParameter (int index, double value) override;
    int takeTouchedParameter() noexcept override                         { return touched.exchange (-1); }
    void setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept override;

    bool activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize) override;
    void deactivate() override;
    bool isActive() const noexcept override                              { return active; }

    void process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                  int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t* transport) noexcept override;

    ScreenKind getScreenKind() const noexcept override                   { return ScreenKind::native; }
    bool showNativeScreen (const juce::String& title) override;
    void hideNativeScreen() override;

    Requests takeRequests() noexcept override;
    bool getError (juce::String& error) const override;

    /** What the store says of it (none: it was made here, or isn't the store's). */
    const Licences::Product& getStoreProduct() const noexcept            { return store; }

    /** A paid plugin from the store this computer has no licence for: it plays its demo. */
    bool isInDemo() const noexcept;

    /** A sampler's instruments whose blobs aren't on this computer (PluginLibrary says where
        they're looked for); Locate... adds the folder they're in to the places it looks. */
    juce::StringArray getMissingInstruments() const;
    void locateLibrary (const juce::File& folder);

private:
    CreatorPlugin() = default;

    struct Info
    {
        int index = 0;                 // the plugin's own parameter number
        juce::String id, name, module, unit;
        float min = 0.0f, max = 1.0f, def = 0.0f, skew = 1.0f;
    };

    struct ModuleInfo
    {
        int index = 0;
        juce::String id;
        juce::StringArray outputs;
    };

    struct DisplayInfo
    {
        int index = 0;
        juce::String id;
    };

    class Screen;
    friend class Screen;

    void findLibrary();   // each instrument's blob, as it's found now
    void setValue (int index, float value, bool fromScreen);
    void applyPreset (const Preset& preset, bool byUser);   // byUser: the song has changed
    std::map<juce::String, float> currentValues() const;
    int indexOfPluginParameter (int pluginIndex) const noexcept;
    bool resolve (const juce::String& source, int& moduleIndex, int& port) const;
    void setScreenSources (const juce::StringArray& levels, const juce::StringArray& scopes);
    void applyScreenSources();
    float takeLevel (const juce::String& source, bool rms);
    void readScope (const juce::String& source, float* destination, int numSamples) const;

    Descriptor descriptor;
    std::vector<Descriptor> inFile;
    juce::File sourceFolder;
    bool instrument = true;

    std::vector<std::uint8_t> wasmBytes;
    juce::Array<PluginLibrary::Instrument> library;      // a sampler's blobs (library.json)
    std::vector<stella::blob::Entry> libraryEntries;     // ...and where each was found
    mutable juce::CriticalSection libraryLock;           // libraryEntries: activate() may run on the device's thread
    std::vector<Info> infos;                      // as the plugin described them, in the host's order
    std::vector<Parameter> parameters;
    std::unique_ptr<std::atomic<float>[]> values; // the host's copy, so values hold while inactive
    std::vector<ModuleInfo> modules;
    std::vector<DisplayInfo> displays;

    // The playing instance: replaced only on the message thread, under the lock; the audio
    // thread plays it while it can take the lock (a block during a swap is silent).
    juce::SpinLock wasmLock;
    std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin> wasm;
    bool active = false;
    double activeRate = 0.0;
    int activeBlockSize = 0;
    juce::String failure;                         // why it couldn't start
    bool failureReported = false;

    // The panel's keyboard plays it too (and lights up with every note it plays).
    juce::MidiKeyboardState keyboardState;
    juce::MidiBuffer playedMidi;                  // sized as it activates
    static constexpr int maxEvents = 1024;
    std::array<WasmPlugin::MidiEvent, maxEvents> events {};

    // Its presets (message thread): the chosen one is remembered with the song.
    PresetLibrary presets;

    // What the panel's meters and scopes watch (message thread).
    juce::StringArray levelSources, scopeSources, tappedSources;

    // The store's protection: what it says of this plugin, the product its licence names (the
    // id built into its WebAssembly first: a store plugin whose plugin.json lost its store details
    // still asks for its own licence), and that licence's flag on this computer (null: free).
    Licences::Product store;
    juce::String productId;
    bool protectedBuild = false;                       // its WebAssembly plays the demo itself (stella_licence.h)
    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> licensed;
    std::uint32_t licenceToken = 0;                    // what its WebAssembly expects while licensed
    stella::licence::DemoGate demoGate;                // a paid plugin whose WebAssembly doesn't carry the demo

    std::unique_ptr<Screen> screen;

    std::atomic<bool> stateChanged { false };
    std::atomic<int> touched { -1 };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (CreatorPlugin)
};
