                info.name = dialog.getTextEditorContents ("name").trim();
                info.vendor = dialog.getTextEditorContents ("vendor").trim();
                info.kind = kindAt (kindIndex);

                safeThis->flushLayoutSave();
                const auto created = safeThis->project.create (safeThis->settings.getProjectsFolder(), info);

                if (created.failed())
                    safeThis->showError ("Couldn't create the plugin", created.getErrorMessage());
                else
                    safeThis->settings.setVendor (info.vendor);
            }

            // Let the modal machinery finish with the dialog before it goes.
            juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safeThis, askAgain]
            {
                if (safeThis == nullptr)
                    return;

                safeThis->newProjectDialog = nullptr;

                if (askAgain)
                    safeThis->newProject (true);
            });
        }), false);

    // Typing goes straight into the name, ready to be replaced. Done once the window is
    // on screen: a window that isn't showing yet can't take the keyboard.
    juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<CreatorStudio> (this)]
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr || safeThis->newProjectDialog == nullptr)
            return;

        if (auto* nameEditor = safeThis->newProjectDialog->getTextEditor ("name"))
        {
            nameEditor->grabKeyboardFocus();
            nameEditor->selectAll();
        }
    });
}

void CreatorStudio::playFinishSound()
{
    // Through Sonify's output (over whatever plays), wherever the user is; with no audio
    // device running, the system's alert sound instead.
    if (! audio.playChime())
        juce::LookAndFeel::getDefaultLookAndFeel().playAlertSound();
}

void CreatorStudio::saveProject()
{
    // A MIDI FX is kept in My Devices as it changes.
    if (isMakingMidiFx())
    {
        topBar.showNotice ("Saved");
        return;
    }

    if (! project.isOpen())
        return;

    // Everything else is written as it changes.
    flushLayoutSave();
    topBar.showNotice ("Saved");
}

void CreatorStudio::saveProjectAs()
{
    if (isMakingMidiFx())
    {
        saveMidiFxCopy();
        return;
    }

    if (! project.isOpen() || saveAsDialog != nullptr)
        return;

    // Sonify AI writes into the project as it works: the copy waits until it's done.
    if (ai.isBusy())
    {
        showError ("Fanan AI is still working", "Save a copy once it's finished.");
        return;
    }

    flushLayoutSave();

    saveAsDialog = std::make_unique<juce::AlertWindow> (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Save as\xe2\x80\xa6"),
                                                        "A copy of this plugin in a new folder, to go on with under a new name. "
                                                        "This one stays as it is.",
                                                        juce::MessageBoxIconType::NoIcon, this);

    saveAsDialog->addTextEditor ("name", project.getInfo().name + " 2", "Name");
    saveAsDialog->addButton ("Save", 1, juce::KeyPress (juce::KeyPress::returnKey));
    saveAsDialog->addButton ("Cancel", 0, juce::KeyPress (juce::KeyPress::escapeKey));

    saveAsDialog->enterModalState (true, juce::ModalCallbackFunction::create (
        [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<CreatorStudio> (this)] (int result)
        {
            if (safeThis == nullptr || safeThis->saveAsDialog == nullptr)
                return;

            const auto name = safeThis->saveAsDialog->getTextEditorContents ("name").trim();
            safeThis->saveAsDialog->setVisible (false);

            if (result == 1)
            {
                const auto saved = safeThis->project.saveAs (name);

                if (saved.failed())
                {
                    safeThis->showError ("Couldn't save a copy", saved.getErrorMessage());
                }
                else
                {
                    // The copy is a plugin of its own: Add to Sonify adds it beside the first one.
                    safeThis->topBar.showNotice ("Saved as " + safeThis->project.getInfo().name);
                }
            }

            // Let the modal machinery finish with the dialog before it goes.
            juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safeThis]
            {
                if (safeThis != nullptr)
                    safeThis->saveAsDialog = nullptr;
            });
        }), false);

    // The name is ready to be typed over.
    juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<CreatorStudio> (this)]
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr || safeThis->saveAsDialog == nullptr)
            return;

        if (auto* nameEditor = safeThis->saveAsDialog->getTextEditor ("name"))
        {
            nameEditor->grabKeyboardFocus();
            nameEditor->selectAll();
        }
    });
}

void CreatorStudio::openProject()
{
    if (refuseWhileBusy())
        return;

    const auto start = project.isOpen() ? project.getFolder().getParentDirectory() : settings.getProjectsFolder();

    // A plugin project, or a MIDI FX (a Sonify device, from My Devices or anywhere).
    chooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Open a plugin project or a MIDI FX", start.isDirectory() ? start : juce::File(),
                                                   juce::String ("*.stella;*") + Devices::fileExtension);

    chooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles,
                          [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<CreatorStudio> (this)] (const juce::FileChooser& fc)
                          {
                              const auto file = fc.getResult();

                              if (safeThis != nullptr && file != juce::File())
                                  safeThis->openProjectFile (file);
                          });
}

void CreatorStudio::openProjectFile (const juce::File& file)
{
    if (refuseWhileBusy())
        return;

    if (file.hasFileExtension (Devices::fileExtension))
    {
        if (const auto opened = openMidiFxFile (file); opened.failed())
            showError ("Couldn't open the MIDI FX", opened.getErrorMessage());

        return;
    }

    flushLayoutSave();   // the open project's last GUI change, before another one opens
    const auto result = project.open (file);

    if (result.failed())
    {
        settings.removeRecentProject (file);
        showError ("Couldn't open the project", result.getErrorMessage());
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void CreatorStudio::showError (const juce::String& title, const juce::String& message)
{
    juce::AlertWindow::showMessageBoxAsync (juce::MessageBoxIconType::WarningIcon, title, message, "OK", this);
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\CreatorStudio.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_extra/juce_gui_extra.h>

#include "ChatPanel.h"

class AiAgent;
class DeviceStudio;

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Plugins Creator Studio: Stella AI Studio inside Sonify, with Sonify AI as its builder.

        its top bar (Options menu, the five tabs, its meter and the load)
        the open tab: Build with AI / Edit UI / Knob Studio / Protection / Store

    Build with AI makes everything: instruments, effects and widgets (plugin projects), and MIDI
    FX, which are Sonify's MIDI devices (DeviceStudio, built by its own Sonify AI, in the same
    conversation panel). One thing is open at a time: a plugin project, or a MIDI FX. The chat
    shows the open one's card (name, type, developer).

    Add to Sonify puts the plugin that plays into the Browser, to use on tracks like Sonify's
    system tools (it's built first, from its code as it is). Export Plugin makes plugin files any
    DAW loads, built on this computer (PluginExporter): VST3 and CLAP, and on a Mac an Audio Unit
    too. A MIDI FX plays on its instrument track as soon as it's built, and is kept in
    My Devices. Sonify's engine owns the audio device and the MIDI inputs; the plugin being made
    plays in its callback (CreatorAudio), fed by the live notes while the studio is in front
    (while a MIDI FX is open, the live notes go to the tracks, where it plays). Sonify's server
    is shared: the same Fanan account and credits as Sonify AI everywhere else.

    Protection puts the open plugin or MIDI FX into Sonify's store (StorePublisher): free, or
    paid (built with its protection, the buyer paying the seller's PayPal), with the store's
    story, which Fanan AI can write from its code and its picture. The Store is Sonify's store
    itself (StoreClient), open to every user: what's bought there plays fully, by its licence.

    The plugin's presets are a modern preset manager's (PresetLibrary): factory presets in the
    project, the user's own on the hard drive, banks; the chosen preset and the values are kept
    with the project, and come back when it opens (the first preset, the first time).

    Message thread only. Lives in a window of its own laid over Sonify's page (MainCreator.cpp).
*/
class CreatorStudio final : public juce::Component
{
public:
    CreatorStudio (AudioEngine& sonifyEngine, FananServer& fananServer);
    ~CreatorStudio() override;

    void paint (juce::Graphics&) override;
    void resized() override;

    /** Whether the studio is in front (Sonify's selector): it takes the live notes then, unless
        a MIDI FX is open (they go to the tracks, where it plays). */
    void setShown (bool shown);
    bool isShown() const noexcept                  { return shownInSonify; }

    /** One of the tabs, in TopBar::tabNames' order. */
    void showTab (int index);
    int getCurrentTab() const noexcept             { return currentTab; }

    /** Sonify's server: the connection or the account changed. */
    void connectionChanged();

    /** Sonify AI here is working on a plugin (or has a plan waiting): Sonify keeps it in mind on
        quitting, and nothing else opens here meanwhile. */
    bool isBusy() const                            { return ai.isBusy(); }

    /** What's waiting is written now (Sonify is quitting, or saving). */
    void flush()                                   { flushLayoutSave(); }

    /** Sonify's MIDI devices and the Sonify AI that builds them (Sonify's own, set once): a MIDI
        FX is made here as one. */
    void setMidiDevices (DeviceStudio& studio, AiAgent& builder);

    /** The open MIDI device, or its Sonify AI, changed (Sonify says so). A device that opens (from
        a track's MIDI FX, or a new one) takes the place of the plugin project open here. */
    void midiDeviceChanged();

    /** A MIDI device opened elsewhere (a track's MIDI FX, its menu's New Device): Build with AI
        shows it, in front. */
    void showMidiDevice();

    /** Whether a MIDI FX is what's open here. */
    bool isMakingMidiFx() const noexcept;

    /** One of Sonify's own keys pressed here: a page command for the studios' selector
        ("showStudio", "pluginsCreator", "nextStudio"...). */
    std::function<void (const juce::String& command)> onPageCommand;

    /** Add to Sonify: the plugin's folder in Sonify's library of made plugins (CreatorPlugin). */
    std::function<void (const juce::File& pluginFolder, const juce::String& name, bool replaced)> onPluginAdded;

private:
    void newProject (bool typeMissing = false);   // typeMissing: asked again, its type wasn't chosen
    void openProject();
    void openProjectFile (const juce::File& file);
    void playFinishSound();   // Sonify AI has finished
    void saveProject();       // what's waiting is written now
    void saveProjectAs();     // a copy in a new folder, under a new name, and work goes on there

    void projectChanged();
    void previewChanged();
    void loadLayout (bool makeOneIfMissing);
    void saveLayout();
    void saveLayoutSoon();
    void flushLayoutSave();   // a save that's waiting happens now
    void autoLayout();
    void askAiAboutGui (int widgetIndex, const juce::String& instruction);
    void sendFromChat (const juce::String& request, const juce::Array<juce::File>& files);
    juce::String lastAnswer() const;
    void buildPlugin();
    void showBuildLog();
    void showLog (const juce::String& title, const juce::String& text);
    void addToSonify();

# D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\DeviceCompiler.cmake
#
# The Device Studio's compiler: wasi-sdk 25 (clang, and the C and C++ libraries for
# WebAssembly). Sonify devices are compiled with it on the user's computer, so it ships with
# Sonify: the part it needs is copied next to Sonify.exe as "Device Compiler" (about 110 MB on
# Windows). Nothing is installed anywhere else.
#
# Downloaded once into <build>/deps at a pinned version (checked against its SHA-256), or taken
# from the copy kept beside the project (deps\ next to CMakeLists.txt), as WclapBridge.cmake
# does: include this after it. Sets FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR (the unpacked wasi-sdk), or leaves
# it empty where there's no wasi-sdk for the platform (Sonify then says devices can't be built
# there; built ones still play).

include_guard(GLOBAL)

set(FANAN_WASI_SDK_VERSION "25")
set(_fanan_wasi_sdk_base "https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-${FANAN_WASI_SDK_VERSION}")
set(FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR "")

if(WIN32)
    if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
        fanan_fetch_archive(wasi-sdk
            "${_fanan_wasi_sdk_base}/wasi-sdk-25.0-x86_64-windows.tar.gz"
            "ebd4868f95a6e764bf29283e3bdf54df0df3902a29737176da9c17da218b939b" FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR)
    endif()
elseif(APPLE)
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "arm64|aarch64")
        fanan_fetch_archive(wasi-sdk
            "${_fanan_wasi_sdk_base}/wasi-sdk-25.0-arm64-macos.tar.gz"
            "e1e529ea226b1db0b430327809deae9246b580fa3cae32d31c82dfe770233587" FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR)
    else()
        fanan_fetch_archive(wasi-sdk
            "${_fanan_wasi_sdk_base}/wasi-sdk-25.0-x86_64-macos.tar.gz"
            "55e3ff3fee1a15678a16eeccba0129276c9f6be481bc9c283e7f9f65bf055c11" FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR)
    endif()
else()
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "aarch64|arm64")
        fanan_fetch_archive(wasi-sdk
            "${_fanan_wasi_sdk_base}/wasi-sdk-25.0-arm64-linux.tar.gz"
            "47fccad8b2498f2239e05e1115c3ffc652bf37e7de2f88fb64b2d663c976ce2d" FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR)
    else()
        fanan_fetch_archive(wasi-sdk
            "${_fanan_wasi_sdk_base}/wasi-sdk-25.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz"
            "52640dde13599bf127a95499e61d6d640256119456d1af8897ab6725bcf3d89c" FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR)
    endif()
endif()

if(NOT FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR)
    message(STATUS "No device compiler for this platform: Sonify devices can be played here, not built.")
endif()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# fanan_copy_device_compiler(target)
# After each build, the compiler's parts next to the target's executable, in
# "Device Compiler" (on macOS in the app's Resources; only what changed is copied again):
#     bin/clang, bin/wasm-ld             the compiler and the linker
#     lib/clang                          clang's own headers and runtime
#     lib/lib*.so.* / lib*.dylib         (Linux and macOS: the libraries clang runs on)
#     share/wasi-sysroot/include/...     the C and C++ headers for WebAssembly (clang looks for
#                                        include/c++/v1 to use them, though it's empty)
#     share/wasi-sysroot/lib/wasm32-wasip1   the C and C++ libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function(fanan_copy_device_compiler target)
    if(NOT FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR)
        return()
    endif()

    if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL "3.26")
        set(copy_folder copy_directory_if_different)
    else()
        set(copy_folder copy_directory)
    endif()

    set(from "${FANAN_DEVICE_COMPILER_DIR}")

    if(APPLE)
        # In the app's Resources (Contents/MacOS is for the app itself).
        set(to "$<TARGET_BUNDLE_CONTENT_DIR:${target}>/Resources/Device Compiler")
    else()
        set(to "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/Device Compiler")
    endif()
    set(sysroot "${from}/share/wasi-sysroot")

    if(WIN32)
        set(clang_from "${from}/bin/clang.exe")
        set(clang_to "${to}/bin/clang.exe")
        set(ld_from "${from}/bin/wasm-ld.exe")
        set(ld_to "${to}/bin/wasm-ld.exe")
        set(libraries "")
    else()
        # clang and wasm-ld are links there; the files they lead to are copied under their names.
        get_filename_component(clang_from "${from}/bin/clang" REALPATH)
        set(clang_to "${to}/bin/clang")
        get_filename_component(ld_from "${from}/bin/wasm-ld" REALPATH)
        set(ld_to "${to}/bin/wasm-ld")
        file(GLOB libraries "${from}/lib/lib*.so.*" "${from}/lib/lib*.dylib")
    endif()

    add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${to}/bin" "${to}/lib"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${clang_from}" "${clang_to}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${ld_from}" "${ld_to}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${copy_folder} "${from}/lib/clang" "${to}/lib/clang"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${copy_folder} "${sysroot}/include/wasm32-wasip1" "${to}/share/wasi-sysroot/include/wasm32-wasip1"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${to}/share/wasi-sysroot/include/c++/v1"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${copy_folder} "${sysroot}/lib/wasm32-wasip1" "${to}/share/wasi-sysroot/lib/wasm32-wasip1"
        VERBATIM)

    if(libraries)
        add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different ${libraries} "${to}/lib"
            VERBATIM)
    endif()
endfunction()

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\DeviceFiles.cpp

#include "DeviceFiles.h"
#include "SonifyAiData.h"

#include <juce_cryptography/juce_cryptography.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cctype>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

namespace Devices
{
namespace
{
    constexpr size_t maxWasmSize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
    constexpr size_t maxChatSize = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
    constexpr int maxEntries = 32;
    constexpr int compileTimeoutMs = 120000;

    juce::File& configuredFolder()
    {
        static juce::File folder;
        return folder;
    }

    /** An entry of the zip as text or bytes, when it's not too big. */
    bool readEntry (juce::ZipFile& zip, int index, size_t limit, juce::MemoryBlock& into)
    {
        const auto* entry = zip.getEntry (index);

        if (entry == nullptr || entry->uncompressedSize < 0 || static_cast<size_t> (entry->uncompressedSize) > limit)
            return false;

        std::unique_ptr<juce::InputStream> stream (zip.createStreamForEntry (index));

        if (stream == nullptr)
            return false;

        into.reset();
        juce::MemoryOutputStream out (into, false);
        const auto copied = out.writeFromInputStream (*stream, static_cast<juce::int64> (limit) + 1);
        out.flush();
        return copied >= 0 && static_cast<size_t> (copied) <= limit;
    }

    juce::String asText (const juce::MemoryBlock& data)
    {
        if (! juce::CharPointer_UTF8::isValidString (static_cast<const char*> (data.getData()), static_cast<int> (data.getSize())))
            return {};

        return juce::String::fromUTF8 (static_cast<const char*> (data.getData()), static_cast<int> (data.getSize()));
    }

    juce::String cleanName (const juce::String& name)
    {
        auto clean = juce::File::createLegalFileName (name.trim()).trim().substring (0, 60);
        return clean.isNotEmpty() ? clean : juce::String ("Device");
    }
}

//==============================================================================
DeviceFile DeviceFile::make (const juce::String& name)
{
    DeviceFile file;
    file.id = juce::Uuid().toDashedString();
    file.name = name.trim().isNotEmpty() ? name.trim().substring (0, 60) : juce::String ("New Device");
    return file;
}

bool DeviceFile::isValidSourceName (const juce::String& name)
{
    if (name.length() < 3 || name.length() > 40 || name.equalsIgnoreCase ("sonify_device.h"))
        return false;

    if (! (name.endsWith (".cpp") || name.endsWith (".h")))
        return false;

    return name.containsOnly ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-.")
        && name.indexOfChar ('.') == name.lastIndexOfChar ('.')
        && ! name.startsWithChar ('.');
}

juce::String DeviceFile::fingerprint() const
{
    juce::MemoryOutputStream all;

    for (const auto& [fileName, text] : sources)   // std::map: in order of name
    {
        all << fileName;
        all.writeByte (0);
        all << text;
        all.writeByte (0);
    }

    return juce::SHA256 (all.getData(), all.getDataSize()).toHexString();
}

juce::Result DeviceFile::read (const juce::File& file)
{
    juce::ZipFile zip (file);

    if (zip.getNumEntries() == 0 || zip.getNumEntries() > maxEntries)
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify device.");

    const auto manifestIndex = zip.getIndexOfFileName ("device.json");
    juce::MemoryBlock data;

    if (manifestIndex < 0 || ! readEntry (zip, manifestIndex, 65536, data))
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify device.");

    const auto manifest = juce::JSON::parse (asText (data));

    if (! manifest.isObject() || static_cast<int> (manifest.getProperty ("format", 0)) != 1)
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify device this Sonify can read.");

    DeviceFile loaded;
    loaded.id = manifest.getProperty ("id", {}).toString().substring (0, 80);
    loaded.name = manifest.getProperty ("name", "Device").toString().substring (0, 60);
    loaded.description = manifest.getProperty ("description", {}).toString().substring (0, 2000);
    loaded.vendor = manifest.getProperty ("vendor", {}).toString().substring (0, 60);
    loaded.version = juce::jmax (0, static_cast<int> (manifest.getProperty ("version", 0)));
    loaded.builtFrom = manifest.getProperty ("builtFrom", {}).toString().substring (0, 64);
    loaded.store = Licences::Product::fromVar (manifest.getProperty ("store", {}));

    if (loaded.id.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify device (it has no id).");

    for (int i = 0; i < zip.getNumEntries(); ++i)
    {
        const auto path = zip.getEntry (i)->filename;

        if (path.startsWith ("source/"))
        {
            const auto fileName = path.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("source/", false, false);

            if (! isValidSourceName (fileName) || static_cast<int> (loaded.sources.size()) >= maxSources)
                continue;

            if (! readEntry (zip, i, static_cast<size_t> (maxSourceSize) * 4, data))
                return juce::Result::fail ("Part of " + file.getFileName() + " couldn't be read.");

            loaded.sources[fileName] = asText (data).substring (0, maxSourceSize);
        }
        else if (path == "module.wasm")
        {
            if (! readEntry (zip, i, maxWasmSize, data))
                return juce::Result::fail ("Part of " + file.getFileName() + " couldn't be read.");

            loaded.wasm = data;
        }
        else if (path == "chat.json")
        {
            if (readEntry (zip, i, maxChatSize, data))
                loaded.chat = juce::JSON::parse (asText (data));
        }
    }

    *this = std::move (loaded);
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result DeviceFile::readInfo (const juce::File& file, Info& info)
{
    juce::ZipFile zip (file);

    if (zip.getNumEntries() == 0 || zip.getNumEntries() > maxEntries)
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify device.");

    const auto manifestIndex = zip.getIndexOfFileName ("device.json");
    juce::MemoryBlock data;

    if (manifestIndex < 0 || ! readEntry (zip, manifestIndex, 65536, data))
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify device.");

    const auto manifest = juce::JSON::parse (asText (data));

    if (! manifest.isObject() || static_cast<int> (manifest.getProperty ("format", 0)) != 1)
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify device this Sonify can read.");

    info.id = manifest.getProperty ("id", {}).toString().substring (0, 80);
    info.name = manifest.getProperty ("name", "Device").toString().substring (0, 60);
    info.description = manifest.getProperty ("description", {}).toString().substring (0, 2000);
    info.version = juce::jmax (0, static_cast<int> (manifest.getProperty ("version", 0)));
    info.builtFrom = manifest.getProperty ("builtFrom", {}).toString().substring (0, 64);
    info.built = zip.getIndexOfFileName ("module.wasm") >= 0;
    info.fromStore = Licences::Product::fromVar (manifest.getProperty ("store", {})).isValid();
    return info.id.isNotEmpty() ? juce::Result::ok() : juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify device (it has no id).");
}

juce::Result DeviceFile::write (const juce::File& file) const
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr manifest (new juce::DynamicObject());
    manifest->setProperty ("format", 1);
    manifest->setProperty ("kind", "midi");
    manifest->setProperty ("id", id);
    manifest->setProperty ("name", name);
    manifest->setProperty ("description", description);
    manifest->setProperty ("vendor", vendor);
    manifest->setProperty ("version", version);
    manifest->setProperty ("builtFrom", builtFrom);
    manifest->setProperty ("app", "Sonify");

    if (store.isValid())
        manifest->setProperty ("store", store.toVar());

    juce::ZipFile::Builder zip;
    const auto now = juce::Time::getCurrentTime();

    const auto addText = [&zip, &now] (const juce::String& path, const juce::String& text)
    {
        const auto utf8 = text.toUTF8();
        zip.addEntry (std::make_unique<juce::MemoryInputStream> (utf8.getAddress(), utf8.sizeInBytes() - 1, true), 9, path, now);
    };

    addText ("device.json", juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (manifest.get())));

    for (const auto& [fileName, text] : sources)
        addText ("source/" + fileName, text);

    if (! wasm.isEmpty())
        zip.addEntry (std::make_unique<juce::MemoryInputStream> (wasm, true), 9, "module.wasm", now);

    if (! chat.isVoid())
        addText ("chat.json", juce::JSON::toString (chat, true));

    if (! file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't make the folder " + file.getParentDirectory().getFullPathName() + ".");

    juce::TemporaryFile temp (file);

    {
        juce::FileOutputStream out (temp.getFile());

        if (! out.openedOk() || ! zip.writeToStream (out, nullptr))
            return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't save " + file.getFileName() + ".");

        out.flush();

        if (out.getStatus().failed())
            return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't save " + file.getFileName() + ": " + out.getStatus().getErrorMessage());
    }

    if (! temp.overwriteTargetFileWithTemporary())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't save " + file.getFileName() + ".");

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::File myDevicesFolder()
{
    auto folder = configuredFolder();

    if (folder == juce::File())
        folder = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userDocumentsDirectory).getChildFile ("Sonify").getChildFile ("Devices");

    return folder;
}

juce::Array<juce::File> listMyDevices()
{
    auto files = myDevicesFolder().findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, juce::String ("*") + fileExtension);
    std::sort (files.begin(), files.end(), [] (const juce::File& a, const juce::File& b)
    {
        return a.getFileNameWithoutExtension().compareNatural (b.getFileNameWithoutExtension()) < 0;
    });
    return files;
}

juce::File freeFileFor (const juce::String& name, const juce::File& except)
{
    const auto folder = myDevicesFolder();
    const auto base = cleanName (name);
    auto file = folder.getChildFile (base + fileExtension);

    for (int n = 2; file.exists() && file != except && n < 1000; ++n)
        file = folder.getChildFile (base + " " + juce::String (n) + fileExtension);

    return file;
}

namespace
{
    juce::File clangIn (const juce::File& folder)
    {
       #if JUCE_WINDOWS
        return folder.getChildFile ("bin").getChildFile ("clang.exe");
       #else
        return folder.getChildFile ("bin").getChildFile ("clang");
       #endif
    }

    /** One run of the compiler: what it said and how it ended. */
    struct Step
    {
        bool stopped = false, timedOut = false, started = false;
        int exitCode = -1;
        juce::String messages;
    };

    Step runStep (const juce::StringArray& args, std::atomic<bool>* cancelled, double since)
    {
        Step step;
        juce::ChildProcess process;

        if (! process.start (args, juce::ChildProcess::wantStdOut | juce::ChildProcess::wantStdErr))
            return step;

        step.started = true;

        // Reading its messages waits for them, so a watch of its own stops it when it's asked to
        // stop or takes too long (the reading then ends, as it does when the compiler exits).
        std::atomic<bool> finished { false }, stopped { false }, timedOut { false };

        std::thread watch ([&]
        {
            while (! finished.load())
            {
                if (cancelled != nullptr && cancelled->load())
                    stopped.store (true);
                else if (juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes() - since > compileTimeoutMs)
                    timedOut.store (true);

                if (stopped.load() || timedOut.load())
                {
                    process.kill();
                    return;
                }

                std::this_thread::sleep_for (std::chrono::milliseconds (10));
            }
        });

        juce::MemoryOutputStream messages;
        char buffer[4096];

        for (;;)
        {
            const auto read = process.readProcessOutput (buffer, sizeof (buffer));

            if (read > 0)
            {
                if (messages.getDataSize() < 64 * 1024)
                    messages.write (buffer, static_cast<size_t> (read));

                continue;
            }

            if (! process.isRunning() || stopped.load() || timedOut.load())
                break;

            juce::Thread::sleep (5);
        }

        finished.store (true);
        watch.join();

        step.stopped = stopped.load();
        step.timedOut = timedOut.load();
        step.exitCode = step.stopped || step.timedOut ? -1 : static_cast<int> (process.getExitCode());
        step.messages = messages.toString();
        return step;
    }

    /** A source as the compiler reads its directives: lines joined where they end in \, comments
        gone, %: read as #. */
    juce::String directivesOf (const juce::String& text)
    {
        const auto in = text.toStdString();
        std::string out;
        out.reserve (in.size());

        enum class In { code, lineComment, blockComment, quoted } state = In::code;
        char quote = 0;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < in.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto c = in[i];
            const auto next = i + 1 < in.size() ? in[i + 1] : '\0';

            if (c == '\\' && (next == '\n' || (next == '\r' && i + 2 < in.size() && in[i + 2] == '\n')))
            {
                i += next == '\r' ? 2 : 1;
                continue;
            }

            switch (state)
            {
                case In::code:
                    if (c == '/' && next == '/')            { state = In::lineComment; out += ' '; ++i; }
                    else if (c == '/' && next == '*')       { state = In::blockComment; out += ' '; ++i; }
                    else if (c == '%' && next == ':')       { out += '#'; ++i; }
                    else if (c == '"' || (c == '\'' && (out.empty() || ! std::isalnum (static_cast<unsigned char> (out.back())))))
                                                            { state = In::quoted; quote = c; out += c; }
                    else                                    { out += c; }
                    break;

                case In::lineComment:
                    if (c == '\n')                          { state = In::code; out += c; }
                    break;

                case In::blockComment:
                    if (c == '*' && next == '/')            { state = In::code; ++i; }
                    else if (c == '\n')                     { out += c; }
                    break;

                case In::quoted:
                    out += c;

                    if (c == '\\' && next != '\0')          { out += next; ++i; }
                    else if (c == quote || c == '\n')       { state = In::code; }
                    break;
            }
        }

        return juce::String::fromUTF8 (out.data(), static_cast<int> (out.size()));
    }

    /** What's named in an include ("a.h" or <a.h>) after its keyword; "" when it isn't written
        out (made by a macro). */
    juce::String includeTarget (const juce::String& afterKeyword)
    {
        const auto quote = afterKeyword.indexOfChar ('"');
        const auto angle = afterKeyword.indexOfChar ('<');

        if (quote >= 0 && (angle < 0 || quote < angle))
            return afterKeyword.substring (quote + 1).upToFirstOccurrenceOf ("\"", false, false);

        if (angle >= 0)
            return afterKeyword.substring (angle + 1).upToFirstOccurrenceOf (">", false, false);

        return {};
    }

    bool isOwnOrStandard (const juce::String& target)
    {
        return target.isNotEmpty() && ! target.startsWithChar ('/') && ! target.containsChar ('\\')
            && ! target.containsChar (':') && ! target.contains ("..");
    }

    /** The files a compiler's dependency file lists (make's format: spaces escaped, lines joined). */
    juce::StringArray filesInDepFile (const juce::String& text)
    {
        juce::StringArray files;
        const auto body = text.fromFirstOccurrenceOf (":", false, false).toStdString();   // after "deps:"
        std::string current;

        auto finish = [&]
        {
            if (! current.empty())
                files.add (juce::String::fromUTF8 (current.data(), static_cast<int> (current.size())));

            current.clear();
        };

        for (size_t i = 0; i < body.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto c = body[i];
            const auto next = i + 1 < body.size() ? body[i + 1] : '\0';

            if (c == '\\' && (next == '\n' || next == '\r'))
            {
                finish();
                ++i;
            }
            else if (c == '\\' && (next == ' ' || next == '#'))
            {
                current += next;
                ++i;
            }
            else if (c == '$' && next == '$')
            {
                current += '$';
                ++i;
            }
            else if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r')
            {
                finish();
            }
            else
            {
                current += c;
            }
        }

        finish();
        return files;
    }

    /** A path with its . and .. worked out and / between its parts (case left out where the
        computer's files ignore it), to compare. */
    juce::String comparable (const juce::File& base, juce::String path)
    {
        path = path.replaceCharacter ('\\', '/');

        const auto absolute = path.startsWithChar ('/') || (path.length() > 1 && path[1] == ':');

        if (! absolute)
            path = base.getFullPathName().replaceCharacter ('\\', '/') + "/" + path;

        juce::StringArray parts;
        parts.addTokens (path, "/", {});
        juce::StringArray kept;

        for (const auto& part : parts)
        {
            if (part.isEmpty() || part == ".")
                continue;

            if (part == "..")
            {
                if (kept.size() > 0)
                    kept.remove (kept.size() - 1);
            }
            else
            {
                kept.add (part);
            }
        }

        auto result = "/" + kept.joinIntoString ("/");

       #if JUCE_WINDOWS || JUCE_MAC
        result = result.toLowerCase();
       #endif

        return result;
    }

    bool isWithin (const juce::String& path, const juce::String& folder)
    {
        return path.startsWith (folder + "/");
    }
}

bool Compiler::isAvailable (juce::String* why)
{
    const auto f = folder();
    const auto ok = clangIn (f).existsAsFile() && f.getChildFile ("share").getChildFile ("wasi-sysroot").isDirectory();

    if (why != nullptr)
        *why = ok ? juce::String() : juce::String ("The device compiler isn't next to Sonify (its \"Device Compiler\" folder), so devices can't be built here. Devices already built still play.");

    return ok;
}

juce::String Compiler::apiHeader()
{
    return juce::String::fromUTF8 (SonifyAiData::sonify_device_h, SonifyAiData::sonify_device_hSize);
}

Compiler::Result Compiler::compile (const std::map<juce::String, juce::String>& sources, std::atomic<bool>* cancelled)
{
    Result result;
    const auto started = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();
    juce::String why;

    if (! isAvailable (&why))
    {
        result.log = why;
        return result;
    }

    bool anyCpp = false;

    for (const auto& [fileName, text] : sources)
        anyCpp = anyCpp || fileName.endsWith (".cpp");

    if (! anyCpp)
    {
        result.log = "There's no .cpp file to build.";
        return result;
    }

    // A device's code includes its own files and the standard library's headers, nothing else
    // of the computer's (its files would travel in the device), and embeds nothing. Said plainly
    // here; what holds it is the compiler's own list of what it read, checked after.
    for (const auto& [fileName, text] : sources)
    {
        for (auto line : juce::StringArray::fromLines (directivesOf (text)))
        {
            line = line.trim();

            if (line.contains ("__has_embed") || line.contains ("incbin")
                 || (line.startsWithChar ('#') && line.substring (1).trimStart().startsWith ("embed")))
            {
                result.log = fileName + ": devices can't embed files.";
                return result;
            }

            juce::String target;
            bool bad = false;

            if (line.startsWithChar ('#'))
            {
                const auto directive = line.substring (1).trimStart();

                for (auto keyword : { "include_next", "include", "import" })
                {
                    if (directive.startsWith (keyword))
                    {
                        target = includeTarget (directive.substring (juce::String (keyword).length()));
                        bad = ! isOwnOrStandard (target);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int at = line.indexOf ("__has_include"); at >= 0 && ! bad; at = line.indexOf (at + 1, "__has_include"))
            {
                target = includeTarget (line.substring (at).fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("(", false, false));
                bad = ! isOwnOrStandard (target);
            }

            if (bad)
            {
                result.log = fileName + ": devices include only their own files and the standard headers, not "
                           + (target.isEmpty() ? juce::String ("a name made by a macro") : "\"" + target + "\"") + ".";
                return result;
            }
        }
    }

    // A folder of its own for each build, gone afterwards.
    const auto work = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::tempDirectory)
                          .getChildFile ("Sonify Device Build " + juce::Uuid().toString().substring (0, 12));

    struct Cleanup { juce::File folder; ~Cleanup() { folder.deleteRecursively(); } } cleanup { work };

    if (! work.createDirectory() || ! work.getChildFile ("sonify_device.h").replaceWithText (apiHeader(), false, false, "\n"))
    {
        result.log = "Couldn't make a folder to build in.";
        return result;
    }

    juce::Array<juce::File> units;

    for (const auto& [fileName, text] : sources)
    {
        if (! DeviceFile::isValidSourceName (fileName))
            continue;

        const auto file = work.getChildFile (fileName);

        if (! file.replaceWithText (text, false, false, "\n"))
        {
            result.log = "Couldn't write " + fileName + " to build it.";
            return result;
        }

        if (fileName.endsWith (".cpp"))
            units.add (file);
    }

    const auto tools = folder();
    const auto output = work.getChildFile ("module.wasm");
    juce::StringArray common {
        clangIn (tools).getFullPathName(),
        "--driver-mode=g++", "--target=wasm32-wasip1",
        "--sysroot=" + tools.getChildFile ("share").getChildFile ("wasi-sysroot").getFullPathName(),
        "-O2"
    };

    // Its own headers named from the folder as it's given here (found on its own, a link on the
    // way would be followed, and they'd seem to be from elsewhere).
    if (const auto versions = tools.getChildFile ("lib").getChildFile ("clang").findChildFiles (juce::File::findDirectories, false); ! versions.isEmpty())
        common.add ("-resource-dir=" + versions.getFirst().getFullPathName());

    // The compiler's messages, without its folders' paths.
    auto clean = [&] (juce::String log)
    {
        for (const auto& [folderPath, shownAs] : { std::pair { work.getFullPathName(), juce::String (".") },
                                                   std::pair { tools.getFullPathName(), juce::String ("compiler") } })
        {
            const auto prefix = folderPath + juce::File::getSeparatorString();
            log = log.replace (prefix, {}).replace (prefix.replaceCharacter ('\\', '/'), {})
                     .replace (folderPath, shownAs).replace (folderPath.replaceCharacter ('\\', '/'), shownAs);
        }

        return log;
    };

    auto ended = [&] (const Step& step)
    {
        if (! step.started)
            result.log = "The device compiler couldn't start.";
        else if (step.stopped || step.timedOut)
            result.log = step.stopped ? "Stopped." : "The build took too long and was stopped.";
        else
            return false;

        return true;
    };

    const auto ownFolder = comparable (work, work.getFullPathName());
    const auto toolsFolder = comparable (work, tools.getFullPathName());
    juce::StringArray objects;
    juce::String log;
    bool compiled = true;

    // Each file on its own (the compiler working in its own process, so stopping it stops it),
    // with inline assembly off: assembly reads files of its own.
    for (const auto& unit : units)
    {
        const auto object = work.getChildFile (unit.getFileNameWithoutExtension() + ".o");
        const auto depFile = work.getChildFile (unit.getFileNameWithoutExtension() + ".d");

        auto args = common;
        args.addArray (juce::StringArray {
            "-std=c++20", "-fno-exceptions", "-fno-rtti", "-fintegrated-cc1", "-fno-gnu-inline-asm",
            "-Wall", "-Wno-unused-parameter", "-Wno-unused-private-field", "-ferror-limit=12", "-fno-color-diagnostics",
            "-ffile-prefix-map=" + work.getFullPathName() + "=.",
            "-ffile-prefix-map=" + tools.getFullPathName() + "=compiler",
            "-I" + work.getFullPathName(),
            "-MD", "-MT", "deps", "-MF", depFile.getFullPathName(),
            "-c", unit.getFullPathName(), "-o", object.getFullPathName()
        });

        const auto step = runStep (args, cancelled, started);

        if (ended (step))
            return result;

        // Everything it read is the device's own or the compiler's (checked first: its messages
        // could show what it read).
        for (const auto& read : filesInDepFile (depFile.loadFileAsString()))
        {
            const auto path = comparable (work, read);

            if (! isWithin (path, ownFolder) && ! isWithin (path, toolsFolder))
            {
                result.log = unit.getFileName() + ": devices include only their own files and the standard headers, not \""
                           + read.replaceCharacter ('\\', '/').fromLastOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false) + "\".";
                return result;
            }
        }

        log += step.messages;

        if (step.exitCode != 0 || ! object.existsAsFile())
        {
            compiled = false;
            continue;
        }

        objects.add (object.getFullPathName());
    }

    if (compiled)
    {
        // The stack first in memory: running past it traps, instead of writing over the device's own data.
        auto args = common;
        args.addArray (juce::StringArray { "-mexec-model=reactor", "-o", output.getFullPathName() });
        args.addArray (objects);
        args.addArray (juce::StringArray { "-Wl,--strip-all", "-Wl,--stack-first", "-Wl,-z,stack-size=262144", "-Wl,--max-memory=67108864" });

        const auto step = runStep (args, cancelled, started);

        if (ended (step))
            return result;

        log += step.messages;
        compiled = step.exitCode == 0;
    }

    result.log = clean (log).trim().substring (0, 12000);
    result.seconds = (juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes() - started) / 1000.0;

    if (compiled && output.existsAsFile() && output.getSize() > 0 && output.loadFileAsData (result.wasm))
        result.ok = true;
    else if (result.log.isEmpty())
        result.log = "The build failed.";

    return result;
}
}

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include "Licences.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <map>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Sonify devices on disk, and the compiler that makes them.

    A device is one file, <name>.sonidev, in My Devices (<user data>\Devices): a zip holding
        device.json     what it is: its id (the same for good), name, description, version
        source\*        its code (C++ against sonify_device.h)
        module.wasm     its last good build (any Sonify plays it without compiling)
        chat.json       the conversation that built it, so Sonify AI can carry on
    Share the file and anyone's Sonify can play it, or open it in the Device Studio.

    One from the store has no code or conversation, and says so in device.json ("store": its
    id, title and price, see Licences::Product): it plays (a paid one in its demo until this
    computer has its licence), but never opens for editing.

    The compiler ships with Sonify ("Device Compiler" next to it: clang and the WebAssembly
    libraries of wasi-sdk), so nothing has to be installed.
*/
namespace Devices
{
    constexpr const char* fileExtension = ".sonidev";

    //==========================================================================
    struct DeviceFile
    {
        juce::String id;                                // made once, never changes
        juce::String name { "New Device" }, description;
        juce::String vendor;                            // who made it (the developer)
        int version = 0;                                // counts the builds
        std::map<juce::String, juce::String> sources;   // file name -> its text
        juce::MemoryBlock wasm;                         // the last good build (empty: never built)
        juce::String builtFrom;                         // the sources' fingerprint when wasm was built
        juce::var chat;                                 // the builder's conversation
        Licences::Product store;                        // from the store (none: made here)

        static constexpr int maxSources = 8;
        static constexpr int maxSourceSize = 200000;    // characters, each

        /** A new device: a fresh id. */
        static DeviceFile make (const juce::String& name);

        juce::Result read (const juce::File& file);
        juce::Result write (const juce::File& file) const;   // safely: a whole new file or none

        /** What a file says it is, without reading its code, build or conversation (quick). */
        struct Info
        {
            juce::String id, name, description, builtFrom;
            int version = 0;
            bool built = false;
            bool fromStore = false;
        };

        static juce::Result readInfo (const juce::File& file, Info& info);

        /** The sources' fingerprint (what was built from them, and whether they changed since). */
        juce::String fingerprint() const;
        bool isBuiltFromSources() const                 { return ! wasm.isEmpty() && builtFrom == fingerprint(); }

        /** A source file's name Sonify takes: letters, digits, _ and -, ending .cpp or .h. */
        static bool isValidSourceName (const juce::String& name);
    };

    //==========================================================================
    /** My Devices: <user data>\Devices (made when first needed). Sonify sets where its user
        data is; until it does, Documents\Sonify\Devices. */
    juce::File myDevicesFolder();
    void setMyDevicesFolder (const juce::File& folder);

    /** The .sonidev files in My Devices, by name. */
    juce::Array<juce::File> listMyDevices();

    /** A free file in My Devices for a device of this name. */
    juce::File freeFileFor (const juce::String& name, const juce::File& except = {});

    //==========================================================================
    struct Compiler
    {
        /** The compiler's folder: SONIFY_DEVICE_COMPILER when set, else "Device Compiler" next to
            Sonify. Nonexistent when it isn't there. */
        static juce::File folder();

        static bool isAvailable (juce::String* why = nullptr);

        struct Result
        {
            bool ok = false;
            juce::String log;                // the compiler's messages, its file paths left out
            juce::MemoryBlock wasm;
            double seconds = 0.0;
        };

        /** Compiles a device's sources (with sonify_device.h) into WebAssembly. Takes a few
            seconds: call it on a worker thread. */
        static Result compile (const std::map<juce::String, juce::String>& sources, std::atomic<bool>* cancelled = nullptr);

        /** The API devices are written against (sonify_device.h, as built into Sonify). */
        static juce::String apiHeader();
    };
