// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Edits.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_data_structures/juce_data_structures.h>

#include "AudioEngine.h"

#include <map>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Undo and redo for the song, as juce::UndoableActions for a juce::UndoManager.

    Each action is made after its change has happened and knows how to take it back
    and do it again: the first perform() (from UndoManager::perform) just accepts the
    change, later ones redo it, and undo() reverses it. Whatever an action takes out of
    the song (a removed track, a replaced plugin) stays alive inside it, so bringing it
    back is instant and exact, plugin state and all.

    Like Studio One, it covers editing the song: clips and notes, recording, tracks,
    plugins and MIDI FX, tempo and time signature. Mixing (faders, pan, mute, solo, bypass) and
    plugin settings are not part of it.
*/
namespace Edits
{
    /** Some tracks' clips, by track id. */
    using Clips = std::map<int, std::vector<MidiClip>>;

    Clips snapshot (const AudioEngine& engine, const std::vector<int>& trackIds);
    std::vector<int> allTrackIds (const AudioEngine& engine);
    bool same (const Clips& a, const Clips& b);

    struct TrackName
    {
        juce::String text;
        bool automatic = true;       // still following its instrument's name
    };

    TrackName nameOf (const AudioEngine& engine, int trackId);

    //==============================================================================
    class Action : public juce::UndoableAction
    {
    public:
        bool perform() final;
        bool undo() final;

    protected:
        virtual void redo() = 0;
        virtual void revert() = 0;

    private:
        bool fresh = true;           // the change already happened when the action was made
    };

    //==============================================================================
    /** Any clip or note edit, a recording too: the touched tracks' clips before and after. */
    class ClipsChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        ClipsChanged (AudioEngine& engine, Clips before, Clips after);
        int getSizeInUnits() override;

    private:
        void redo() override         { apply (after); }
        void revert() override       { apply (before); }
        void apply (const Clips& clips);

        AudioEngine& engine;
        Clips before, after;
    };

    class TrackAdded final : public Action
    {
    public:
        TrackAdded (AudioEngine& engine, int trackId, int index);

    private:
        void redo() override;
        void revert() override;

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int id, index;
        std::unique_ptr<Track> kept;
    };

    class TrackRemoved final : public Action
    {
    public:
        TrackRemoved (AudioEngine& engine, int trackId, int index, std::unique_ptr<Track> removed);

    private:
        void redo() override;
        void revert() override;

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int id, index;
        std::unique_ptr<Track> kept;
    };

    /** Tracks put into buses (or back to their outputs): each one's bus before and after. */
    class BusesChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        BusesChanged (AudioEngine& e, std::map<int, int> beforeChange, std::map<int, int> afterChange)
            : engine (e), before (std::move (beforeChange)), after (std::move (afterChange)) {}

        void redo() override     { apply (after); }
        void revert() override   { apply (before); }
        int getSizeInUnits() override   { return 1; }

    private:
        void apply (const std::map<int, int>& buses)
        {
            for (const auto& [track, bus] : buses)
                if (auto* t = engine.findTrack (track))
                    t->outputBus.store (bus);   // the bus itself may be away (undone): the track waits for it
        }

        AudioEngine& engine;
        const std::map<int, int> before, after;
    };

    /** Song Blocks made, renamed, recoloured or taken out, or the song's order of them changed:
        all of them before and after (they're small: clips without audio). */
    class BlocksChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        BlocksChanged (AudioEngine& e, SongBlocks beforeChange, SongBlocks afterChange)
            : engine (e), before (std::move (beforeChange)), after (std::move (afterChange)) {}

        void redo() override     { engine.setSongBlocks (after); }
        void revert() override   { engine.setSongBlocks (before); }

        int getSizeInUnits() override
        {
            size_t notes = 0;

            for (const auto* blocks : { &before, &after })
                for (const auto& block : blocks->blocks)
                    for (const auto& part : block.parts)
                        notes += part.clip.notes.size() + 1;

            return static_cast<int> (notes / 64) + 1;
        }

    private:
        AudioEngine& engine;
        const SongBlocks before, after;
    };

    /** The song's video added, moved or taken away (its sound's clip is a ClipsChanged of its own). */

    /** A track's MIDI FX added, removed or moved: the devices before and after, as plain data
        (their settings and ids; what a device was in the middle of playing isn't kept). */
    class MidiFxChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        MidiFxChanged (AudioEngine& e, int trackId, juce::var beforeChange, juce::var afterChange)
            : engine (e), id (trackId), before (std::move (beforeChange)), after (std::move (afterChange)) {}

        int getSizeInUnits() override   { return 1; }

    private:
        void redo() override         { engine.setMidiFx (id, after); }
        void revert() override       { engine.setMidiFx (id, before); }

        AudioEngine& engine;
        const int id;
        const juce::var before, after;
    };

    /** The song channel's tempo map (tempo changes and ramps, time signatures, keys), before
        and after: the tempo field, the Tempo, Signature and Key lanes, a recording's tempo taken on. */
    class TempoChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        TempoChanged (AudioEngine& e, TempoMap beforeChange, TempoMap afterChange)
            : engine (e), before (std::move (beforeChange)), after (std::move (afterChange)) {}

        int getSizeInUnits() override   { return 1; }

    private:
        void redo() override         { engine.setTempoMap (after); }
        void revert() override       { engine.setTempoMap (before); }

        AudioEngine& engine;
        const TempoMap before, after;
    };

    /** Main's volume envelope (the song channel's Main Volume lane), before and after. */
    class MainAutomationChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        MainAutomationChanged (AudioEngine& e, std::vector<AutomationPoint> beforeChange, std::vector<AutomationPoint> afterChange)
            : engine (e), before (std::move (beforeChange)), after (std::move (afterChange)) {}

        int getSizeInUnits() override   { return 1; }

    private:
        void redo() override         { engine.setMainAutomation (after); }
        void revert() override       { engine.setMainAutomation (before); }

        AudioEngine& engine;
        const std::vector<AutomationPoint> before, after;
    };
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\EffectChain.cpp

#include "EffectChain.h"

#include <algorithm>

namespace
{
    constexpr int minimumBufferSize = 4096;
}

//==============================================================================
EffectChain::EffectChain()
{
    // Reserved now, so changes made under the engine's lock never allocate.
    inserts.reserve (static_cast<size_t> (maxInserts));
}

EffectChain::~EffectChain()
{
    clear();
}

void EffectChain::clear()
{
    // Last insert first, the reverse of how a signal meets them.
    while (! inserts.empty())
        inserts.pop_back();
}

//==============================================================================
EffectChain::Insert* EffectChain::at (int index) const noexcept
{
    return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, size()) ? inserts[static_cast<size_t> (index)].get() : nullptr;
}

EffectChain::Insert* EffectChain::find (int insertId) const noexcept
{
    return at (indexOf (insertId));
}

int EffectChain::indexOf (int insertId) const noexcept
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < inserts.size(); ++i)
        if (inserts[i]->id == insertId)
            return static_cast<int> (i);

    return -1;
}

bool EffectChain::add (std::unique_ptr<Insert> insert, int position)
{
    if (insert == nullptr || isFull())
        return false;

    const auto where = position < 0 ? size() : juce::jmin (position, size());
    inserts.insert (inserts.begin() + where, std::move (insert));
    return true;
}

std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> EffectChain::remove (int insertId)
{
    const auto index = indexOf (insertId);

    if (index < 0)
        return {};

    auto removed = std::move (inserts[static_cast<size_t> (index)]);
    inserts.erase (inserts.begin() + index);
    return removed;
}

std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> EffectChain::replace (int insertId, std::unique_ptr<Insert> newInsert)
{
    const auto index = indexOf (insertId);

    if (index < 0 || newInsert == nullptr)
        return {};

    auto old = std::move (inserts[static_cast<size_t> (index)]);
    inserts[static_cast<size_t> (index)] = std::move (newInsert);
    return old;
}

bool EffectChain::move (int insertId, int newPosition)
{
    const auto from = indexOf (insertId);

    if (from < 0)
        return false;

    const auto to = juce::jlimit (0, size() - 1, newPosition);

    if (to > from)
        std::rotate (inserts.begin() + from, inserts.begin() + from + 1, inserts.begin() + to + 1);
    else if (to < from)
        std::rotate (inserts.begin() + to, inserts.begin() + from, inserts.begin() + from + 1);

    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
void EffectChain::prepare (int maxBlockSize)
{
    dry.setSize (2, juce::jmax (maxBlockSize * 2, minimumBufferSize), false, true, true);
}

void EffectChain::process (float* left, float* right, int numSamples,
                           const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t& transport) noexcept
{
    if (left == nullptr || right == nullptr || numSamples <= 0)
        return;

    for (const auto& slot : inserts)
    {
        auto& insert = *slot;
        const bool bypassed = insert.bypassed.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
        auto* plugin = insert.plugin.get();

        // A plugin that could not start passes the signal through untouched.
        if (plugin == nullptr || ! plugin->isActive())
        {
            insert.mix = bypassed ? 0.0f : 1.0f;
            continue;
        }

        if (bypassed && insert.mix <= 0.0f)
            continue;

        if (! bypassed && insert.mix >= 1.0f)
        {
            plugin->process (left, right, left, right, numSamples, midi, &transport);
            continue;
        }

        // Switching: fade from where the mix is now to where it's going, across this block.
        const auto target = bypassed ? 0.0f : 1.0f;

        if (numSamples > dry.getNumSamples())
        {
            insert.mix = target;   // no room for a fade (never with a normal block size)

            if (! bypassed)
                plugin->process (left, right, left, right, numSamples, midi, &transport);

            continue;
        }

        auto* dryLeft = dry.getWritePointer (0);
        auto* dryRight = dry.getWritePointer (1);
        std::copy (left, left + numSamples, dryLeft);
        std::copy (right, right + numSamples, dryRight);

        plugin->process (left, right, left, right, numSamples, midi, &transport);

        const auto step = (target - insert.mix) / static_cast<float> (numSamples);
        auto mix = insert.mix;

        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
        {
            mix += step;
            left[i] = dryLeft[i] + (left[i] - dryLeft[i]) * mix;
            right[i] = dryRight[i] + (right[i] - dryRight[i]) * mix;
        }

        insert.mix = target;
    }
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\EffectChain.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>

#include "Plugin.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    An ordered chain of insert effects, as on a Studio One channel. Every track has
    one, and so does the Main channel.

    The engine changes a chain only while it holds its graph lock, and the audio
    thread processes it under the same lock, so a change is never seen half done.
    Room for every insert is reserved up front: adding, moving or removing one never
    allocates while that lock is held.

    Each insert can be bypassed. Switching fades between the processed and the dry
    signal across one block, so it never clicks.
*/
class EffectChain final
{
public:
    static constexpr int maxInserts = 16;

    struct Insert
    {
        Insert (int insertId, std::unique_ptr<Plugin> effect)
            : id (insertId), plugin (std::move (effect)) {}

        const int id;                              // unique in the engine, so the page can name it
        std::unique_ptr<Plugin> plugin;
        std::atomic<bool> bypassed { false };
        float mix = 1.0f;                          // audio thread: 1 processed, 0 dry

        JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE (Insert)
    };

    EffectChain();
    ~EffectChain();

    //==============================================================================
    // Message thread. The engine holds its graph lock around the changes.
    int size() const noexcept                 { return static_cast<int> (inserts.size()); }
    bool isFull() const noexcept              { return size() >= maxInserts; }
    Insert* at (int index) const noexcept;
    Insert* find (int insertId) const noexcept;
    int indexOf (int insertId) const noexcept;

    /** Adds at position (clamped; -1 means the end). Does nothing when the chain is full. */
    bool add (std::unique_ptr<Insert> insert, int position);

    /** Takes one out; destroy what it returns after letting go of the lock. */
    std::unique_ptr<Insert> remove (int insertId);

    /** Swaps in a new insert at the same position; returns the old one to destroy. */
    std::unique_ptr<Insert> replace (int insertId, std::unique_ptr<Insert> newInsert);

    /** Moves an insert to a new position (clamped). */
    bool move (int insertId, int newPosition);

    /** Destroys every insert. Only while no audio callback can run. */
    void clear();

    //==============================================================================
    // Audio side. prepare() runs while no audio callback is active.
    void prepare (int maxBlockSize);

    /** Runs the inserts in order, in place, on a stereo block. */
    void process (float* left, float* right, int numSamples,
                  const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t& transport) noexcept;

private:
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Insert>> inserts;
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> dry;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (EffectChain)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\FananServer.cpp

#include "FananServer.h"

#include <juce_cryptography/juce_cryptography.h>

#include <random>

namespace
{
    // The Stella AI Cloud app on Base44 and its site: Fanan accounts and credits, shared with
    // Stella AI Studio. FananWebHub-server.json beside the program can name others (for testing
    // against another server).
    constexpr const char* builtInAppId   = "6ac03f5bd8e7cddad8252682";
    constexpr const char* builtInSiteUrl = "https://rugged-stella-studio-flow.base44.app";

    constexpr int probeTimeoutMs = 8000;
    constexpr int chatTimeoutMs  = 320000;   // an AI step can take minutes: Base44 allows 5, plus a margin
    constexpr int relayTimeoutMs = 660000;   // through the relay: it gives a building step up to 10 minutes
    constexpr int relayConnectMs = 30000;    // a relay that can't be reached within this: the server answers instead
    constexpr int onlineCheckMs  = 120000;
    constexpr int offlineCheckMs = 10000;
    constexpr int watchCheckMs   = 6000;
    constexpr int watchChecks    = 100;      // ten minutes: signing in and paying take a while
    constexpr juce::uint32 lostAfterMs = 30000;   // an AI step that fails later than this had reached the server
    constexpr int listenTimeoutMs = 30000;        // turning a few seconds of speech into words
    constexpr int remoteTimeoutMs = 10000;        // the phone remote's quick checks
    constexpr int storeTimeoutMs = 60000;         // the store's answers
    constexpr int uploadTimeoutMs = 120000;       // a plugin's package going up

    const char* const blockedText = "The internet is blocked (the switch at the top left). Turn it off to use your Fanan account.";

    juce::var object()
    {
        return juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    }
}

//==============================================================================
FananServer::Settings FananServer::loadSettings()
{
    Settings loaded;
    loaded.appId = builtInAppId;
    loaded.siteUrl = builtInSiteUrl;

    const auto config = juce::JSON::parse (juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile)
                                               .getSiblingFile ("FananWebHub-server.json"));

    if (const auto value = config.getProperty ("serverUrl", {}).toString().trim(); value.isNotEmpty())
        loaded.serverUrl = value.trimCharactersAtEnd ("/");

    if (const auto value = config.getProperty ("appId", {}).toString().trim(); value.isNotEmpty())
        loaded.appId = value;

    if (const auto value = config.getProperty ("siteUrl", {}).toString().trim(); value.isNotEmpty())
        loaded.siteUrl = value.trimCharactersAtEnd ("/");

    if (const auto* list = config.getProperty ("internetTestUrls", {}).getArray())
    {
        loaded.internetTestUrls.clear();

        for (const auto& address : *list)
            if (address.toString().trim().isNotEmpty())
                loaded.internetTestUrls.add (address.toString().trim());
    }

    return loaded;
}

//==============================================================================
FananServer::FananServer (Settings s)
    : settings (std::move (s))
{
    const auto saved = juce::JSON::parse (getIdentityFile());

    key = saved.getProperty ("key", {}).toString();
    computerCode = saved.getProperty ("account", {}).toString();
    lastEmail = saved.getProperty ("lastEmail", {}).toString();

    // Stella AI Studio on this computer signs in to the same accounts: until Sonify has signed
    // in itself, the email last used there is the one suggested.
    if (lastEmail.isEmpty())
        lastEmail = juce::JSON::parse (getStellaIdentityFile()).getProperty ("lastEmail", {}).toString().trim();

    // The key is made once and kept, so this computer stays known to the server (and signed in).
    if (! isValidKey (key))
    {
        key = makeKey();
        computerCode.clear();
        saveIdentity();
    }
}

FananServer::~FananServer()
{
    stopTimer();
    alive->store (false);

    // Waiting requests are broken off, so quitting never hangs on the network.
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock lock (streamsLock);

        for (auto* stream : activeStreams)
            stream->cancel();
    }

    workers.removeAllJobs (true, 4000);
}

void FananServer::start()
{
    if (started.exchange (true))
        return;

    startCheck();
}

void FananServer::setBlocked (bool shouldBlock)
{
    if (blocked.exchange (shouldBlock) == shouldBlock)
        return;

    ++generation;   // a check under way when this changed is let go, and asked again

    if (shouldBlock)
    {
        stopTimer();

        // What's on its way is broken off: nothing more reaches the network.
        {
            const juce::ScopedLock lock (streamsLock);

            for (auto* stream : activeStreams)
                stream->cancel();
        }

        {
            const juce::ScopedLock lock (stateLock);
            status = Status::blocked;   // the account as last known stays shown
        }

        if (onStateChanged != nullptr)
            onStateChanged();

        return;
    }

    checkNow();
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File FananServer::getIdentityFile()
{
    // In the user's application data, not beside the program: reinstalling or updating
    // Sonify keeps the computer known (and signed in), and remembers the last email used.
    return juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userApplicationDataDirectory)
               .getChildFile ("Fanan")
               .getChildFile ("Sonify")
               .getChildFile ("account.json");
}

juce::File FananServer::getStellaIdentityFile()
{
    return juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userApplicationDataDirectory)
               .getChildFile ("Fanan")
               .getChildFile ("Stella AI Studio")
               .getChildFile ("account.json");
}

void FananServer::saveIdentity() const
{
    auto saved = object();
    saved.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("key", key);
    saved.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("account", getComputerCode());
    saved.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("lastEmail", getLastEmail());

    const auto file = getIdentityFile();
    file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();

    juce::TemporaryFile temp (file);

    if (temp.getFile().replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (saved)))
        temp.overwriteTargetFileWithTemporary();
}

juce::String FananServer::makeKey()
{
    // 256 bits from the system's secure random source.
    std::random_device source;
    juce::String hex;

    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
        hex << juce::String::toHexString ((juce::uint32) source()).paddedLeft ('0', 8);

    return hex.toLowerCase();
}

bool FananServer::isValidKey (const juce::String& candidate)
{
    return candidate.length() == 64 && candidate.containsOnly ("0123456789abcdef");
}

juce::String FananServer::deviceHash()
{
    // Only a one-way hash leaves the computer, never the ID itself. Made exactly as Stella
    // AI Studio makes it, so one computer is one device to Fanan's server, whichever app asks.
    const auto id = juce::SystemStats::getUniqueDeviceID();

    if (id.isEmpty())
        return {};

    return juce::SHA256 (("stella-device:" + id).toUTF8()).toHexString();
}

juce::var FananServer::makeRequest (const juce::String& action) const
{
    auto body = object();
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("action", action);
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("token", key);
    return body;
}

juce::String FananServer::getStatusText() const
{
    const juce::ScopedLock lock (stateLock);

    switch (status)
    {
        case Status::checking:    return juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Connecting\xe2\x80\xa6");
        case Status::notSetUp:    return "Online, but Fanan accounts aren't set up in this build yet";
        case Status::noInternet:  return "No internet connection";
        case Status::serverDown:  return "Fanan's server isn't responding";
        case Status::blocked:     return "Internet blocked";
        case Status::online:
            // Credits belong to the account: before signing in there's no balance to show.
            if (credits < 0 || ! linked)
                return "Online";

            return juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Online \xc2\xb7 ") + juce::String (credits) + (credits == 1 ? " credit" : " credits");
    }

    return {};
}

juce::URL FananServer::getStoreUrl() const

    return hasSite() ? juce::URL (settings.siteUrl + "/buy").withParameter ("app", "sonify") : juce::URL();
}

juce::String FananServer::getRemotePageUrl() const

    return hasSite() ? settings.siteUrl + "/sonify" : juce::String();
}

//==============================================================================
void FananServer::checkNow()
{
    stopTimer();

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock lock (stateLock);

        if (status != Status::online)
            status = blocked.load() ? Status::blocked : Status::checking;
    }

    if (onStateChanged != nullptr)
        onStateChanged();

    startCheck();
}

void FananServer::watchForChanges()
{
    fastChecksLeft = watchChecks;

    if (! checking.load() && ! blocked.load())
        startTimer (watchCheckMs);
}

void FananServer::timerCallback()
{
    stopTimer();
    startCheck();
}

void FananServer::startCheck()
{
    if (! started.load())
        return;

    if (checking.exchange (true))
        return;   // one is under way; its answer schedules the next

    workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, asked = generation]
    {
        if (stillAlive->load())
            runCheck (asked);
    });
}

void FananServer::runCheck (int asked)
{
    Snapshot snapshot;

    if (blocked.load())
    {
        snapshot.status = Status::blocked;   // nothing is tried
    }
    else if (! isConfigured())
    {
        snapshot.status = canReachInternet() ? Status::notSetUp : Status::noInternet;
    }
    else
    {
        // "hello" makes this computer known the first time, and reports its credits and
        // account (if it's signed in) after that: signing in at startup is just this.
        auto body = makeRequest ("hello");
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("device", deviceHash());
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("app", juce::String ("Sonify ") + JUCE_APPLICATION_VERSION_STRING);

        const auto response = post ("stellaAccount", body, probeTimeoutMs);

        if (blocked.load())
        {
            snapshot.status = Status::blocked;   // blocked while it was asking
        }
        else if (response.connected && response.status == 200 && (bool) response.body.getProperty ("ok", false))
        {
            snapshot.status = Status::online;
            snapshot.known = true;
            snapshot.credits = juce::jmax (0, (int) response.body.getProperty ("credits", 0));
            snapshot.code = response.body.getProperty ("account", {}).toString();
            snapshot.linked = (bool) response.body.getProperty ("linked", false);
            snapshot.email = response.body.getProperty ("email", {}).toString();
            snapshot.relay = response.body.getProperty ("relay", {}).toString().trim();
        }
        else if (response.connected)
        {
            snapshot.status = Status::serverDown;   // it answered, but not properly
        }
        else
        {
            snapshot.status = canReachInternet() ? Status::serverDown : Status::noInternet;
        }
    }

    deliver ([this, snapshot, asked]
    {
        checking.store (false);

        // Asked before this computer signed out or Block internet changed: what it found is
        // out of date, so it's asked again at once.
        if (asked != generation)
        {
            startCheck();
            return;
        }

        setState (snapshot);
    });
}

void FananServer::setState (const Snapshot& snapshot)
{
    bool identityChanged = false;

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock lock (stateLock);

        status = blocked.load() ? Status::blocked : snapshot.status;

        if (snapshot.known)
        {
            credits = snapshot.credits;
            // A dot or slash left at the end ("https://relay.workers.dev.") is the same address, but
            // a dot after the host fails the secure connection's name check: the relay would be
            // skipped, and long building steps sent straight to the server, past its time limit.
            auto relay = snapshot.relay.trim();

            while (relay.endsWithChar ('.') || relay.endsWithChar ('/'))
                relay = relay.dropLastCharacters (1);

            relayUrl = isUsableRelay (relay) ? relay : juce::String();
            linked = snapshot.linked;
            email = snapshot.linked ? snapshot.email : juce::String();

            if (snapshot.code.isNotEmpty() && snapshot.code != computerCode)
            {
                computerCode = snapshot.code;
                identityChanged = true;
            }

            // Remembered for next time: after signing out, Sonify suggests it.
            if (email.isNotEmpty() && email != lastEmail)
            {
                lastEmail = email;
                identityChanged = true;
            }
        }
    }

    if (identityChanged)
        saveIdentity();

    scheduleNextCheck();

    if (onStateChanged != nullptr)
        onStateChanged();
}

void FananServer::scheduleNextCheck()
{
    if (blocked.load())
        return;   // checked again when the internet is allowed

    if (fastChecksLeft > 0)
    {
        --fastChecksLeft;
        startTimer (watchCheckMs);
        return;
    }

    const auto current = getStatus();
    startTimer (current == Status::online || current == Status::notSetUp ? onlineCheckMs : offlineCheckMs);
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String FananServer::failureText (const Response& response, const juce::String& fallback)
{
    if (! response.connected)
        return "Sonify couldn't reach Fanan's server. Check the internet connection and try again.";

    const auto message = response.body.getProperty ("message", {}).toString().trim();
    return message.isNotEmpty() ? message : fallback;
}

void FananServer::signIn (bool thenBuy, const juce::String& emailHint, Done done)
{
    if (blocked.load())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail (blockedText), {});

        return;
    }

    if (! hasSite() || ! isConfigured())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("Signing in isn't set up in this build yet."), {});

        return;
    }

    workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, thenBuy, hint = emailHint.trim(), done]
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        // A one-time link: it works once, for a few minutes, and only for this computer.
        const auto response = post ("stellaAccount", makeRequest ("link"), probeTimeoutMs);
        const auto linkToken = response.body.getProperty ("link", {}).toString();

        auto result = juce::Result::ok();

        if (! response.connected || response.status != 200 || ! (bool) response.body.getProperty ("ok", false) || linkToken.isEmpty())
            result = juce::Result::fail (failureText (response, "Signing in isn't available right now. Please try again."));

        deliver ([this, result, linkToken, thenBuy, hint, done]
        {
            auto outcome = result;

            if (outcome.wasOk())
            {
                // app=sonify: the site's pages speak of Sonify, not Stella AI Studio.
                auto url = juce::URL (settings.siteUrl + "/link").withParameter ("t", linkToken)
                                                                 .withParameter ("app", "sonify");

                if (hint.containsChar ('@'))
                    url = url.withParameter ("email", hint);   // the site can fill it in

                if (thenBuy)
                    url = url.withParameter ("next", "buy");

                if (url.launchInDefaultBrowser())
                    watchForChanges();   // the account shows up here within seconds of signing in
                else
                    outcome = juce::Result::fail ("The web browser couldn't be opened.");
            }

            if (done != nullptr)
                done (outcome, {});
        });
    });
}

void FananServer::signOut (Done done)
{
    if (blocked.load())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail (blockedText), {});

        return;
    }

    workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, done]
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        const auto response = post ("stellaAccount", makeRequest ("unlink"), probeTimeoutMs);

        auto result = juce::Result::ok();

        if (! response.connected || response.status != 200 || ! (bool) response.body.getProperty ("ok", false))
            result = juce::Result::fail (failureText (response, "Signing out didn't work. Please try again."));

        deliver ([this, result, done]
        {
            if (result.wasOk())
            {
                // Signed out on the server: shown at once, and checked again (a check already
                // under way still saw the account, so its answer is let go).
                ++generation;

                {
                    const juce::ScopedLock lock (stateLock);
                    linked = false;
                    email.clear();
                    credits = -1;
                }

                checkNow();
            }

            if (done != nullptr)
                done (result, {});
        });
    });
}

//==============================================================================
void FananServer::chat (const juce::var& request, Done done)
{
    ask (chatFunction, false, request, std::move (done));
}

void FananServer::stellaChat (const juce::var& request, Done done)
{
    ask (builderFunction, true, request, std::move (done));
}

bool FananServer::isUsableRelay (const juce::String& address)
{
    // Only over HTTPS (or this computer, for testing).
    const juce::URL url (address);
    const auto host = url.getDomain().toLowerCase();

    return address.startsWithIgnoreCase ("https://")
        || (address.startsWithIgnoreCase ("http://") && (host == "127.0.0.1" || host == "localhost"));
}

void FananServer::ask (const juce::String& function, bool throughRelay, const juce::var& request, Done done)
{
    if (blocked.load())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("The internet is blocked (the switch at the top left), and Fanan AI works through it."), {});

        return;
    }

    auto body = request.isObject() ? request.clone() : object();
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("token", key);

    workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, body, done, function, throughRelay]
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        juce::String relay;

        if (throughRelay)
        {
            const juce::ScopedLock lock (stateLock);
            relay = relayUrl;
        }

        // Through the relay when there is one; if it can't be reached at all, the server
        // answers as before (nothing was sent, so nothing is done twice).
        const auto sentAt = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter();
        Response response;
        bool viaRelay = false;   // for a failure's code: which way it went

        if (relay.isNotEmpty())
        {
            response = postTo (juce::URL (relay), body, relayTimeoutMs);
            viaRelay = response.connected;

            if (! response.connected && ! blocked.load() && juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() - sentAt < (juce::uint32) relayConnectMs)
                response = post (function, body, chatTimeoutMs);
        }
        else
        {
            response = post (function, body, chatTimeoutMs);
        }

        const auto waitedMs = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() - sentAt;
        const auto& answer = response.body;
        const auto error = answer.getProperty ("error", {}).toString();

        auto result = juce::Result::ok();
        bool checkAgain = false;

        if (blocked.load())
        {
            // Broken off by "Block internet": the server may have finished the step (and charged it).
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Stopped: the internet was blocked while Fanan AI was working.");
        }
        else if (! response.connected && waitedMs < lostAfterMs)
        {
            checkAgain = true;
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Not sent, and nothing was charged: Sonify couldn't reach Fanan's server. "
                                         "Send again once the connection is back.");
        }
        else if (! response.connected)
        {
            // It got there and was being answered: the server may have finished the step (and charged it).
            checkAgain = true;
            result = juce::Result::fail ("The connection to Fanan's server was lost while Fanan AI was working, so its answer "
                                         "didn't arrive (the step may still have used credits). Send again once the connection is back.");
        }
        else if (response.status == 402 || error == "no_credits")
        {
            result = juce::Result::fail ("You're out of credits. Use Buy credits to get more, then send again.");
        }
        else if (error == "sign_in" || error == "unknown")
        {
            checkAgain = true;   // signed out elsewhere (the site's account page): the account shows it
            result = juce::Result::fail (failureText (response, "Sign in to use Fanan AI."));
        }
        else if (response.status != 200 || ! (bool) answer.getProperty ("ok", false))
        {
            // An answer without words of its own (a server's error page, a cut-off answer) says
            // which way it went and its status, so it can be traced.
            auto text = failureText (response, "Fanan AI couldn't answer that. Please try again.");

            if (answer.getProperty ("message", {}).toString().trim().isEmpty())
                text << " (" << (viaRelay ? "relay-" : "server-") << response.status << ")";

            result = juce::Result::fail (text);
        }

        deliver ([this, result, answer, done, checkAgain]
        {
            if (answer.hasProperty ("credits"))
            {
                const juce::ScopedLock lock (stateLock);
                credits = juce::jmax (0, (int) answer.getProperty ("credits", 0));
            }

            if (checkAgain)
                checkNow();   // the warning shows at once, and the retries begin
            else if (onStateChanged != nullptr)
                onStateChanged();

            if (done != nullptr)
                done (result, answer);
        });
    });
}

//==============================================================================
void FananServer::transcribe (const juce::MemoryBlock& wav, Done done)
{
    if (blocked.load())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("The internet is blocked (the switch at the top left), and voice control works through it."), {});

        return;
    }

    auto body = object();
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("token", key);
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("format", "wav");
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("audio", juce::Base64::toBase64 (wav.getData(), wav.getSize()));

    workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, body, done]
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        const auto response = post (listenFunction, body, listenTimeoutMs);
        const auto& answer = response.body;
        const auto error = answer.getProperty ("error", {}).toString();

        auto result = juce::Result::ok();
        bool checkAgain = false;

        if (blocked.load())
        {
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Stopped: the internet was blocked.");
        }
        else if (! response.connected)
        {
            checkAgain = true;
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Sonify couldn't reach Fanan's server. Check the internet connection.");
        }
        else if (response.status == 402 || error == "no_credits")
        {
            checkAgain = true;   // the credits show it, and voice control waits for more
            result = juce::Result::fail ("You're out of credits. Use Buy credits to get more.");
        }
        else if (error == "sign_in" || error == "unknown")
        {
            checkAgain = true;   // signed out elsewhere: the account shows it
            result = juce::Result::fail (failureText (response, "Sign in to use voice control."));
        }
        else if (response.status != 200 || ! (bool) answer.getProperty ("ok", false))
        {
            result = juce::Result::fail (failureText (response, "Voice control couldn't understand that right now."));
        }

        deliver ([this, result, answer, done, checkAgain]
        {
            if (checkAgain)
                checkNow();

            if (done != nullptr)
                done (result, answer);
        });
    });
}

//==============================================================================
void FananServer::remote (const juce::String& action, const juce::var& fields, Done done)
{
    if (blocked.load())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("The internet is blocked (the switch at the top left), and Sonify Remote works through it."), {});

        return;
    }

    auto body = fields.isObject() ? fields.clone() : object();
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("token", key);
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("action", action);

    workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, body, done]
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        const auto response = post (remoteFunction, body, remoteTimeoutMs);
        const auto& answer = response.body;
        const auto error = answer.getProperty ("error", {}).toString();

        auto result = juce::Result::ok();
        bool checkAgain = false;

        if (blocked.load())
        {
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Stopped: the internet was blocked.");
        }
        else if (! response.connected)
        {
            checkAgain = true;
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Sonify couldn't reach Fanan's server. Check the internet connection.");
        }
        else if (error == "sign_in" || error == "unknown")
        {
            checkAgain = true;   // signed out elsewhere: the account shows it
            result = juce::Result::fail (failureText (response, "Sign in to use Sonify Remote."));
        }
        else if (response.status != 200 || ! (bool) answer.getProperty ("ok", false))
        {
            result = juce::Result::fail (failureText (response, "Sonify Remote couldn't reach your phone right now."));
        }

        deliver ([this, result, answer, done, checkAgain]

            if (done != nullptr)

        });
    });
}

//==============================================================================
void FananServer::store (const juce::String& action, const juce::var& fields, Done done)
{
    if (blocked.load())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("The internet is blocked (the switch at the top left), and the store works through it."), {});

        return;
    }

    auto body = fields.isObject() ? fields.clone() : object();
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("token", key);
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("action", action);
    body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("device", deviceHash());   // the computer its licences name

    workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, body, done]
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        const auto response = post (storeFunction, body, storeTimeoutMs);
        const auto& answer = response.body;
        auto result = juce::Result::ok();

        if (blocked.load())
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Stopped: the internet was blocked.");
        else if (! response.connected)
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Sonify couldn't reach the store. Check the internet connection.");
        else if (response.status != 200 || ! (bool) answer.getProperty ("ok", false))
            result = juce::Result::fail (failureText (response, "The store couldn't do that right now. Please try again."));

        deliver ([result, answer, done]
        {
            if (done != nullptr)
                done (result, answer);
        });
    });
}

void FananServer::upload (const juce::String& address, const juce::MemoryBlock& data, const juce::String& contentType, Done done)
{
    if (blocked.load())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("The internet is blocked (the switch at the top left)."), {});

        return;
    }

    workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, address, data, contentType, done]
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        // The address exactly as the store signed it: its query stays in the address (parsed into
        // parameters, it would be moved into the body and the file would arrive spoiled).
        int httpStatus = 0;
        const auto url = juce::URL::createWithoutParsing (address).withPOSTData (data);
        const auto options = juce::URL::InputStreamOptions (juce::URL::ParameterHandling::inAddress)
                                 .withHttpRequestCmd ("PUT")
                                 .withExtraHeaders ("Content-Type: " + contentType + "\r\n")
                                 .withConnectionTimeoutMs (uploadTimeoutMs)
                                 .withStatusCode (&httpStatus);

        auto stream = url.createInputStream (options);

        if (stream != nullptr)
            stream->readEntireStreamAsString();

        auto result = juce::Result::ok();

        if (blocked.load())
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Stopped: the internet was blocked.");
        else if (stream == nullptr || httpStatus == 0)
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Sonify couldn't reach the store to send the file. Check the internet connection.");
        else if (httpStatus < 200 || httpStatus >= 300)
            result = juce::Result::fail ("The store didn't take the file (" + juce::String (httpStatus) + "). Please try again.");

        auto answer = object();
        answer.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("status", httpStatus);

        deliver ([result, answer, done]
        {
            if (done != nullptr)
                done (result, answer);
        });
    });
}

//==============================================================================
FananServer::Response FananServer::post (const juce::String& function, const juce::var& body, int timeoutMs)
{
    return postTo (juce::URL (settings.serverUrl + "/api/apps/" + settings.appId + "/functions/" + function), body, timeoutMs);
}

FananServer::Response FananServer::postTo (const juce::URL& address, const juce::var& body, int timeoutMs)
{
    const auto url = address.withPOSTData (juce::JSON::toString (body, true));

    juce::String headers;
    headers << "X-App-Id: " << settings.appId << "\r\n"
            << "Accept: application/json\r\n"
            << "Content-Type: application/json\r\n";

    return fetch (url, headers, timeoutMs, true);
}

FananServer::Response FananServer::fetch (const juce::URL& url, const juce::String& headers, int timeoutMs, bool isPost)
{
    Response response;

    if (! alive->load() || blocked.load())
        return response;

    juce::WebInputStream stream (url, isPost);
    stream.withExtraHeaders (headers)
          .withConnectionTimeout (timeoutMs)
          .withNumRedirectsToFollow (5);

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock lock (streamsLock);
        activeStreams.add (&stream);
    }

    if (alive->load() && ! blocked.load() && stream.connect (nullptr))
    {
        response.status = stream.getStatusCode();
        response.connected = response.status > 0;

        if (response.connected)
            response.body = juce::JSON::parse (stream.readEntireStreamAsString());
    }

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock lock (streamsLock);
        activeStreams.removeFirstMatchingValue (&stream);
    }

    return response;
}

bool FananServer::canReachInternet()
{
    for (const auto& address : settings.internetTestUrls)
    {
        const auto response = fetch (juce::URL (address), {}, probeTimeoutMs, false);

        if (response.connected && response.status >= 200 && response.status < 400)
            return true;
    }

    return false;
}

void FananServer::deliver (std::function<void()> fn)
{
    juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([stillAlive = alive, fn = std::move (fn)]
    {
        if (stillAlive->load())
            fn();
    });
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\FananServer.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>
#include <juce_events/juce_events.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Sonify's link to Fanan's server: the Fanan account, its credits, and Sonify AI.

    It's the same server, the same accounts and the same credits as Stella AI Studio (the
    Stella AI Cloud app on Base44): one Fanan account, one credit balance, both apps.

    Each computer introduces itself with a random key that stays on it, plus a one-way hash
    of the computer's ID. To sign in, Sonify asks the server for a one-time link and opens
    it in the browser; once the user is signed in there, the site links this computer to
    their Fanan account. From then on Sonify is signed in by itself at every start, until
    the user signs out. The user never types or copies a code, and no password passes
    through Sonify. The email last signed in with is remembered, to suggest it next time.

    The connection is watched all the time, and "no internet" is told apart from "Fanan's
    server isn't answering", so the user is warned with the right message. While Sonify's
    "Block internet" is on, nothing here touches the network. Nothing here names the AI
    service behind the server.

    Network waits happen on worker threads; every answer arrives on the message thread.
*/
class FananServer final : private juce::Timer
{
public:
    enum class Status
    {
        checking,       // no answer yet
        online,         // the server answered
        notSetUp,       // the internet works, but this build has no server address yet
        noInternet,     // nothing can be reached
        serverDown,     // the internet works, but Fanan's server doesn't answer properly
        blocked         // Sonify's "Block internet" is on: nothing is tried
    };

    struct Settings
    {
        juce::String serverUrl { "https://base44.app" };
        juce::String appId;      // the Stella AI Cloud app on Base44, shared with Stella AI Studio
        juce::String siteUrl;    // its site: /link signs in and links, /buy sells credits
        juce::StringArray internetTestUrls { "https://www.msftconnecttest.com/connecttest.txt",
                                             "https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace" };
    };

    /** The built-in settings, overridden by FananWebHub-server.json beside the program. */
    static Settings loadSettings();

    using Done = std::function<void (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)>;

    explicit FananServer (Settings settings);
    ~FananServer() override;

    /** Starts watching the connection (the first check at once). Call after setBlocked. */
    void start();

    /** Sonify's "Block internet": when on, nothing reaches the network; off, it checks again. */
    void setBlocked (bool shouldBlock);
    bool isBlocked() const noexcept         { return blocked.load(); }

    Status getStatus() const;
    juce::String getStatusText() const;     // one short line for the UI
    int getCredits() const;                 // -1 until the server has said
    juce::String getComputerCode() const;   // this computer's code, for support
    bool isSignedIn() const;                // linked to a Fanan account
    juce::String getEmail() const;          // that account's email
    juce::String getLastEmail() const;      // the email last signed in with on this computer (kept after signing out;
                                            // at first, the one Stella AI Studio last used here)

    bool isConfigured() const noexcept      { return settings.appId.isNotEmpty(); }
    bool hasSite() const noexcept           { return settings.siteUrl.isNotEmpty(); }
    bool isReady() const;                   // online, and known to the server

    /** Tests the connection again now (the Try again button). */
    void checkNow();

    /** Opens the Fanan site to sign in; the site links this computer to the account.
        emailHint: the email the user typed (the site can fill it in). thenBuy: the site goes
        on to the credits page. done says whether the browser opened. */
    void signIn (bool thenBuy, const juce::String& emailHint, Done done);

    /** Unlinks this computer from its account. */
    void signOut (Done done);

    /** The credits page, for a computer that's signed in. */
    juce::URL getStoreUrl() const;

    /** Sonify Remote's page, for the phone (empty without a site). */
    juce::String getRemotePageUrl() const;

    /** Checks often for a while: a sign-in or purchase in the browser shows up in seconds. */
    void watchForChanges();

    /** Sends one step of a Sonify AI request: { system, tools, messages, max_tokens }.
        The answer holds { content, stop, used, credits }. */
    void chat (const juce::var& request, Done done);

    /** Sends one step of the Plugins Creator Studio's Sonify AI (Stella AI Studio's builder, with
        its own settings on the server: its stellaChat function). Through Fanan's relay when the
        server names one (in its "hello" answer): the relay makes the AI call with no time limit,
        so long building steps aren't cut off, and the server still checks and charges the
        credits. If the relay can't be reached at all, the step goes to the server as before. */
    void stellaChat (const juce::var& request, Done done);

    /** Voice control: a short recording (16 kHz mono WAV) to be turned into words. The answer
        holds { text }. Nothing is charged; the server keeps a daily limit per account. */
    void transcribe (const juce::MemoryBlock& wav, Done done);

    /** Sonify Remote (the phone page): action "open" { name }, "poll" { state? } or "close". A poll's
        answer holds { request: { id, kind, text, spoken } or null }; a failed call's answer holds
        the server's { error } ("closed": open it again). */
    void remote (const juce::String& action, const juce::var& fields, Done done);

    /** Sonify's store (the server's sonifyStore function): an action ("begin", "publish", "list",
        "buy", "licence"...) with its fields; the answer is the server's ({ ok, ... }, or
        { error }). A failed call's answer still holds the server's error. */
    void store (const juce::String& action, const juce::var& fields, Done done);

    /** Sends a file to an address the store gave (an HTTP PUT): a plugin's package or its
        picture. The answer holds { status }. */
    void upload (const juce::String& address, const juce::MemoryBlock& data, const juce::String& contentType, Done done);

    /** Called on the message thread whenever the status, credits or account change. */
    std::function<void()> onStateChanged;

    static constexpr const char* chatFunction = "sonifyChat";
    static constexpr const char* builderFunction = "stellaChat";
    static constexpr const char* listenFunction = "sonifyListen";
    static constexpr const char* remoteFunction = "sonifyRemote";
    static constexpr const char* storeFunction = "sonifyStore";

private:
    struct Response
    {
        bool connected = false;   // a server answered at all
        int status = 0;
        juce::var body;
    };

    struct Snapshot
    {
        Status status = Status::checking;
        int credits = -1;
        juce::String code, email;
        bool linked = false;
        bool known = false;   // the server answered "hello"
        juce::String relay;   // Fanan's relay for building steps, when the server names one
    };

    void timerCallback() override;
    void startCheck();
    void runCheck (int asked);
    void setState (const Snapshot& snapshot);
    void scheduleNextCheck();

    Response post (const juce::String& function, const juce::var& body, int timeoutMs);
    Response postTo (const juce::URL& address, const juce::var& body, int timeoutMs);

    /** One step of an AI request to a server function (through the relay when asked and there is one). */
    void ask (const juce::String& function, bool throughRelay, const juce::var& request, Done done);
    static bool isUsableRelay (const juce::String& address);
    Response fetch (const juce::URL& url, const juce::String& headers, int timeoutMs, bool isPost);
    bool canReachInternet();
    juce::var makeRequest (const juce::String& action) const;
    static juce::String failureText (const Response& response, const juce::String& fallback);

    void deliver (std::function<void()> fn);
    void saveIdentity() const;

    static juce::File getIdentityFile();
    static juce::File getStellaIdentityFile();   // Stella AI Studio's, read only for its last email
    static juce::String makeKey();
    static bool isValidKey (const juce::String& key);
    static juce::String deviceHash();

    const Settings settings;
    juce::String key;   // set once in the constructor, then only read

    mutable juce::CriticalSection stateLock;
    Status status = Status::checking;
    int credits = -1;
    juce::String computerCode, email, lastEmail;
    juce::String relayUrl;   // under stateLock
    bool linked = false;

    std::atomic<bool> blocked { false };
    std::atomic<bool> started { false };
    std::atomic<bool> checking { false };
    int generation = 0;        // moves on when this computer signs out or Block internet changes (message thread only)
    int fastChecksLeft = 0;

    juce::CriticalSection streamsLock;
    juce::Array<juce::WebInputStream*> activeStreams;

    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> alive = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>> (true);

    // Last, so it's the first to go: its jobs finish while everything above still exists.
    // Four: an AI step can take minutes, and the checks, voice control and the phone remote go on meanwhile.
    juce::ThreadPool workers { juce::ThreadPoolOptions{}.withThreadName ("Fanan server").withNumberOfThreads (4) };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (FananServer)
};

# D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\FFmpeg.cmake
#
# Live streaming (LiveStream.cpp) and the Live Show's videos' sound (VideoSound.cpp): FFmpeg 7.1
# for 64-bit Windows, LGPL, shared (BtbN's builds: headers, import libraries and DLLs, no GPL
# parts). Sonify links its DLLs late (delay-loaded) and looks for them itself before the first
# call. The DLLs and FFmpeg's licence are copied next to Sonify.exe, inside the build folder.
#
# The build is a fixed one: BtbN's last 7.1 build, from the monthly release of 2026-07-31 (their
# monthly releases are kept for two years; their "latest" no longer has 7.1, which is why it's
# named exactly), its SHA-256 written here, so a download can never come out another. It's
# downloaded once into <build>/deps. As with the other downloads, a copy kept beside the project
# (deps\ next to CMakeLists.txt, copied there from a build folder) is used instead when it's this
# very one, and an FFmpeg folder already on the computer can be named instead
# (cmake -DFANAN_FFMPEG_DIR=...), the one with include, lib and bin in it (a shared build).
#
# On Windows Sonify isn't built without it: when it can't be had, configuring stops and says
# why. Elsewhere, FFmpeg's development packages are used when pkg-config finds them.
#
# Sets FANAN_FFMPEG_FOUND, and FANAN_FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR, FANAN_FFMPEG_LIBRARIES (Windows: the
# import libraries), FANAN_FFMPEG_DLLS (their DLLs), FANAN_FFMPEG_LICENSE, or FANAN_FFMPEG_TARGET
# (pkg-config's).

include_guard(GLOBAL)

set(FANAN_FFMPEG_FOUND OFF)
set(FANAN_FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR "")
set(FANAN_FFMPEG_LIBRARIES "")
set(FANAN_FFMPEG_DLLS "")
set(FANAN_FFMPEG_LICENSE "")
set(FANAN_FFMPEG_TARGET "")
set(FANAN_FFMPEG_DIR "" CACHE PATH "A shared FFmpeg 7 build for 64-bit Windows (include, lib, bin); empty: downloaded into the build folder")

# The libraries Sonify calls.
set(_ffmpeg_parts avdevice avformat avcodec swscale swresample avutil)

if(NOT WIN32)
    find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)

    if(PKG_CONFIG_FOUND)
        pkg_check_modules(FANAN_FFMPEG_PC QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET
                          libavdevice libavformat libavcodec libswscale libswresample libavutil)

        if(FANAN_FFMPEG_PC_FOUND)
            set(FANAN_FFMPEG_TARGET PkgConfig::FANAN_FFMPEG_PC)
            set(FANAN_FFMPEG_FOUND ON)
            message(STATUS "Using FFmpeg from pkg-config for live streaming")
        endif()
    endif()

    if(NOT FANAN_FFMPEG_FOUND)
        message(STATUS "FFmpeg's development packages aren't there: Sonify builds without live streaming.")
    endif()

    return()
endif()

# A folder with FFmpeg in it: its root, if it has the headers, import libraries and DLLs.
function(_fanan_ffmpeg_use root)
    foreach(_part IN LISTS _ffmpeg_parts)
        if(NOT EXISTS "${root}/lib/${_part}.lib")
            return()
        endif()

        file(GLOB _dll "${root}/bin/${_part}-*.dll")

        if(NOT _dll)
            return()
        endif()
    endforeach()

    if(NOT EXISTS "${root}/include/libavformat/avformat.h")
        return()
    endif()

    set(_libraries "")
    set(_dlls "")

    foreach(_part IN LISTS _ffmpeg_parts)
        list(APPEND _libraries "${root}/lib/${_part}.lib")
    endforeach()

    # Every DLL it has (avdevice needs avfilter's, say).
    file(GLOB _dlls "${root}/bin/*.dll")
    file(GLOB _license "${root}/LICENSE*")

    set(FANAN_FFMPEG_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(FANAN_FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR "${root}/include" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(FANAN_FFMPEG_LIBRARIES "${_libraries}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(FANAN_FFMPEG_DLLS "${_dlls}" PARENT_SCOPE)

    if(_license)
        list(GET _license 0 _license)
        set(FANAN_FFMPEG_LICENSE "${_license}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    endif()
endfunction()

if(FANAN_FFMPEG_DIR)
    _fanan_ffmpeg_use("${FANAN_FFMPEG_DIR}")

    if(FANAN_FFMPEG_FOUND)
        message(STATUS "Using FFmpeg in ${FANAN_FFMPEG_DIR}")
        return()
    endif()

    message(WARNING "FANAN_FFMPEG_DIR (${FANAN_FFMPEG_DIR}) isn't a shared FFmpeg build (include, lib, bin): FFmpeg is downloaded instead.")
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED FANAN_DEPS_DIR)

endif()

if(NOT DEFINED FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR)
    set(FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps")
endif()

set(_ffmpeg_name "ffmpeg-n7.1.5-12-g1fdbca85aa-win64-lgpl-shared-7.1")
set(_ffmpeg_url "https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/autobuild-2026-07-31-14-10/${_ffmpeg_name}.zip")
set(_ffmpeg_sha256 "0f376f96fb38554ccefb1b2ae9c7c6a7b351f0e60a372b38262c320e8392c5d0")
set(_ffmpeg_dir "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/${_ffmpeg_name}")
set(_ffmpeg_stamp "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/${_ffmpeg_name}.done")

# The copy kept beside the project, when its stamp names this very download.
if(EXISTS "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_ffmpeg_name}.done")
    file(READ "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_ffmpeg_name}.done" _ffmpeg_kept)
    string(STRIP "${_ffmpeg_kept}" _ffmpeg_kept)

    if(_ffmpeg_kept STREQUAL _ffmpeg_url)
        set(_ffmpeg_dir "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_ffmpeg_name}")
        set(_ffmpeg_stamp "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_ffmpeg_name}.done")
        message(STATUS "Using ${_ffmpeg_name} kept in ${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}")
    endif()
endif()

# Why it can't be had, and what to do: configuring stops here.
function(_fanan_ffmpeg_missing why)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Sonify needs FFmpeg for live streaming, and ${why}\n"
                        "Check the internet connection and configure again. Or download ${_ffmpeg_url} "
                        "yourself, unpack it, and configure with -DFANAN_FFMPEG_DIR=<the folder with include, lib and bin in it>.")
endfunction()

# Downloaded and unpacked once (about 60 MB); the stamp is written only when that's whole and
# the zip is this very one.
if(NOT EXISTS "${_ffmpeg_stamp}")
    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${_ffmpeg_dir}")
    set(_ffmpeg_archive "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/downloads/${_ffmpeg_name}.zip")
    message(STATUS "Downloading ${_ffmpeg_name} (about 60 MB)")

    file(DOWNLOAD "${_ffmpeg_url}" "${_ffmpeg_archive}" STATUS _ffmpeg_status TLS_VERIFY ON)
    list(GET _ffmpeg_status 0 _ffmpeg_code)

    if(NOT _ffmpeg_code EQUAL 0)
        list(GET _ffmpeg_status 1 _ffmpeg_reason)
        file(REMOVE "${_ffmpeg_archive}")
        _fanan_ffmpeg_missing("its download failed (${_ffmpeg_reason}).")
    endif()

    file(SHA256 "${_ffmpeg_archive}" _ffmpeg_hash)

    if(NOT _ffmpeg_hash STREQUAL _ffmpeg_sha256)
        file(REMOVE "${_ffmpeg_archive}")
        _fanan_ffmpeg_missing("the file downloaded isn't the one expected (its SHA-256 differs; it may have been cut short).")
    endif()

    file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${_ffmpeg_archive}" DESTINATION "${_ffmpeg_dir}")
    file(REMOVE "${_ffmpeg_archive}")
    file(WRITE "${_ffmpeg_stamp}" "${_ffmpeg_url}\n")
endif()

# The zip holds one folder (named as the zip) with everything in it.
file(GLOB _ffmpeg_found LIST_DIRECTORIES false "${_ffmpeg_dir}/*/include/libavformat/avformat.h" "${_ffmpeg_dir}/include/libavformat/avformat.h")

if(_ffmpeg_found)
    list(GET _ffmpeg_found 0 _ffmpeg_found)
    get_filename_component(_ffmpeg_root "${_ffmpeg_found}" DIRECTORY)   # libavformat
    get_filename_component(_ffmpeg_root "${_ffmpeg_root}" DIRECTORY)    # include
    get_filename_component(_ffmpeg_root "${_ffmpeg_root}" DIRECTORY)    # the build
    _fanan_ffmpeg_use("${_ffmpeg_root}")
endif()

if(NOT FANAN_FFMPEG_FOUND)
    _fanan_ffmpeg_missing("${_ffmpeg_name} in ${_ffmpeg_dir} isn't a whole shared build. Delete ${_ffmpeg_stamp} to download it again.")
endif()

message(STATUS "Using ${_ffmpeg_name} for live streaming")

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\FontLibrary.cpp

#include "FontLibrary.h"
#include "SonifyFonts.h"         // fonts/*.ttf (the folder beside src)
#include "StellaLookAndFeel.h"   // Theme::font, the standard font
#include "StellaRuntimeData.h"   // Inter, the programmed elements' own font

#include <map>

namespace
{
    /** Which font is which: its name, its group, its files' names in fonts and what it's like. */
    struct Entry
    {
        const char* name;
        const char* group;
        const char* character;
    };

    const Entry entries[]
    {
        { "Inter",            "Clean",     "neutral modern sans, very readable at small sizes" },
        { "Roboto",           "Clean",     "friendly modern sans" },
        { "Montserrat",       "Clean",     "geometric sans, wide and confident" },
        { "Oswald",           "Condensed", "tall condensed sans, strong headings" },
        { "Barlow Condensed", "Condensed", "narrow technical sans, fits long captions" },
        { "Bebas Neue",       "Condensed", "tall all-capitals display, posters and titles" },
        { "Rajdhani",         "Technical", "squared technical sans, hardware labels" },
        { "Exo 2",            "Technical", "futuristic sans, synths and electronics" },
        { "Orbitron",         "Technical", "wide geometric sci-fi capitals" },
        { "Michroma",         "Technical", "wide squared capitals, studio-hardware nameplates" },
        { "Audiowide",        "Technical", "rounded retro-tech display, 80s gear" },
        { "Russo One",        "Technical", "heavy blocky display, bold titles" },
        { "Share Tech Mono",  "Displays",  "monospaced technical, readouts and screens" },
        { "VT323",            "Displays",  "pixel terminal, LCD and old computer screens" },
        { "Roboto Mono",      "Displays",  "clean monospaced, values and numbers" },
        { "Press Start 2P",   "Displays",  "8-bit game pixels, chiptune" },
        { "Playfair Display", "Classic",   "elegant high-contrast serif, vintage and luxury" },
        { "Cinzel",           "Classic",   "engraved Roman capitals, classic and orchestral" },
        { "Righteous",        "Retro",     "rounded 70s display" },
        { "Monoton",          "Retro",     "neon tube outlines, disco and synthwave titles" },
        { "Pacifico",         "Retro",     "brush script, surf and vintage logos" },
    };

    juce::String keyOf (const juce::String& name)
    {
        return name.toLowerCase().removeCharacters (" -_");
    }

    /** A font file by its name in the fonts folder ("Bebas_Neue-Regular.ttf"). */
    const char* fileNamed (const juce::String& fileName, int& size)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < SonifyFonts::namedResourceListSize; ++i)
        {
            if (fileName.equalsIgnoreCase (SonifyFonts::getNamedResourceOriginalFilename (SonifyFonts::namedResourceList[i])))
                return SonifyFonts::getNamedResource (SonifyFonts::namedResourceList[i], size);
        }

        size = 0;
        return nullptr;
    }

    std::vector<FontLibrary::Family> makeFamilies()
    {
        std::vector<FontLibrary::Family> list;

        for (const auto& e : entries)
        {
            FontLibrary::Family f;
            f.name = e.name;
            f.group = e.group;
            f.character = e.character;

            if (f.name == "Inter")
            {
                f.regular = StellaRuntimeData::inter_regular_ttf;
                f.regularSize = StellaRuntimeData::inter_regular_ttfSize;
                f.bold = StellaRuntimeData::inter_bold_ttf;
                f.boldSize = StellaRuntimeData::inter_bold_ttfSize;
            }
            else
            {
                const auto stem = f.name.replaceCharacter (' ', '_');
                f.regular = fileNamed (stem + "-Regular.ttf", f.regularSize);
                f.bold = fileNamed (stem + "-Bold.ttf", f.boldSize);
            }

            if (f.regular != nullptr && f.regularSize > 0)
                list.push_back (f);
        }

        return list;
    }

    juce::CriticalSection typefaceLock;

    juce::Typeface::Ptr typefaceFor (const FontLibrary::Family& f, bool bold)
    {
        static std::map<juce::String, juce::Typeface::Ptr> made;
        const bool hasBold = f.bold != nullptr && f.boldSize > 0;
        const auto key = f.name + (bold && hasBold ? "|bold" : "|regular");

        const juce::ScopedLock lock (typefaceLock);

        if (const auto found = made.find (key); found != made.end())
            return found->second;

        auto typeface = bold && hasBold ? juce::Typeface::createSystemTypefaceFor (f.bold, (size_t) f.boldSize)
                                        : juce::Typeface::createSystemTypefaceFor (f.regular, (size_t) f.regularSize);
        made[key] = typeface;
        return typeface;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
const std::vector<FontLibrary::Family>& FontLibrary::families()
{
    static const auto list = makeFamilies();
    return list;
}

juce::StringArray FontLibrary::groups()
{
    juce::StringArray names;

    for (const auto& f : families())
        names.addIfNotAlreadyThere (f.group);

    return names;
}

const FontLibrary::Family* FontLibrary::find (const juce::String& name)
{
    const auto wanted = keyOf (name);

    if (wanted.isEmpty())
        return nullptr;

    for (const auto& f : families())
        if (keyOf (f.name) == wanted)
            return &f;

    return nullptr;
}

juce::String FontLibrary::canonical (const juce::String& name)
{
    const auto* f = find (name);
    return f != nullptr ? f->name : juce::String();
}

juce::Font FontLibrary::font (const juce::String& family, float height, bool bold)
{
    const auto* f = find (family);

    if (f == nullptr)
        return Theme::font (height, bold);

    if (auto typeface = typefaceFor (*f, bold))
        return juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (typeface).withHeight (juce::jmax (1.0f, height)));

    return Theme::font (height, bold);
}

bool FontLibrary::file (const juce::String& family, bool bold, const void*& data, int& size)
{
    const auto* f = find (family);

    if (f == nullptr)
        return false;

    const bool hasBold = f->bold != nullptr && f->boldSize > 0;
    data = bold && hasBold ? f->bold : f->regular;
    size = bold && hasBold ? f->boldSize : f->regularSize;
    return data != nullptr && size > 0;
}

juce::String FontLibrary::describe()
{
    juce::StringArray lines;

    for (const auto& group : groups())
    {
        juce::StringArray names;

        for (const auto& f : families())
            if (f.group == group)
                names.add (f.name + " (" + f.character + ")");

        lines.add (group + ": " + names.joinIntoString ("; "));
    }

    return lines.joinIntoString ("\n");
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\FontLibrary.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_graphics/juce_graphics.h>

#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The fonts a plugin's panel can use for its text (a label, a group's title, captions, a
    selector's buttons, the page tabs, the preset manager, programmed elements' text): built
    into Sonify (the fonts folder beside src, SIL Open Font License), so a panel looks the same on every
    computer. An element's "font" names one; none (or one that isn't here) is the standard
    font.

    Clean: Inter, Roboto, Montserrat. Condensed: Oswald, Barlow Condensed, Bebas Neue.
    Technical: Rajdhani, Exo 2, Orbitron, Michroma, Audiowide, Russo One. Displays: Share Tech
    Mono, VT323, Roboto Mono, Press Start 2P. Classic: Playfair Display, Cinzel. Retro:
    Righteous, Monoton, Pacifico.
*/
namespace FontLibrary
{
    struct Family
    {
        juce::String name, group, character;    // "Orbitron", "Technical", "wide sci-fi capitals"
        const char* regular = nullptr;           // its font files (bold: none, the regular one stands in)
        int regularSize = 0;
        const char* bold = nullptr;
        int boldSize = 0;
    };

    /** Every font, group by group. */
    const std::vector<Family>& families();

    /** The groups, in order. */
    juce::StringArray groups();

    /** A font by its name, any case, spaces ignored ("bebasneue" finds Bebas Neue); nullptr: none. */
    const Family* find (const juce::String& name);

    /** Its name as the list has it; empty if there's no such font. */
    juce::String canonical (const juce::String& name);

    /** The font to draw with: the family's (bold if it has a bold), or the standard one. */
    juce::Font font (const juce::String& family, float height, bool bold = false);

    /** Its font file, for text drawn by programmed elements (bold: the regular one if it has
        none). False if there's no such font. */
    bool file (const juce::String& family, bool bold, const void*& data, int& size);

    /** For the AI: the fonts by group, with what each is like. */
    juce::String describe();
}

#include "GalleryBrowser.h"

namespace
{
    constexpr int kRowHeight = 56;

    // Short, so a stalled server cannot hold the sync thread past the point
    // where shutdown is willing to wait for it.
    constexpr int kConnectionTimeoutMs = 6000;

    // Read size. Small enough that Stop and app shutdown are answered promptly,
    // large enough not to matter.
    constexpr int kChunkBytes = 16384;
}

//==============================================================================
bool GalleryItem::isCommercialSafe() const noexcept
{
    // Anything carrying NC (non-commercial) or ND (no derivatives) is out.
    if (licence.containsIgnoreCase ("NC") || licence.containsIgnoreCase ("ND"))
        return false;

    return licence.isEmpty()
        || licence.equalsIgnoreCase ("PD")
        || licence.startsWithIgnoreCase ("CC0")
        || licence.startsWithIgnoreCase ("CC-BY");
}

juce::String GalleryItem::category() const
{
    juce::StringArray parts;
    parts.addTokens (tags, ",", {});

    for (auto& p : parts)
    {
        auto t = p.trim();

        if (t.startsWith ("$"))
            return t;
    }

    return "$other";
}

//==============================================================================
namespace GalleryLibrary
{
    juce::File root()
    {
        // The Plugins Creator Studio's own copy of the gallery.
        return Settings::getCacheFolder().getChildFile ("gallery");
    }

    juce::File indexFile()      { return root().getChildFile ("index.json"); }
    juce::File knobDir()        { return root().getChildFile ("knob"); }
    juce::File thumbDir()       { return root().getChildFile ("thumb"); }

    juce::File knobFile (int id)  { return knobDir().getChildFile (juce::String (id) + ".knob"); }
    juce::File thumbFile (int id) { return thumbDir().getChildFile (juce::String (id) + ".png"); }

    juce::Array<GalleryItem> parseIndex (const juce::String& json)
    {
        juce::Array<GalleryItem> items;

        auto parsed = juce::JSON::parse (json);

        if (auto* array = parsed.getArray())
        {
            for (const auto& entry : *array)
            {
                GalleryItem item;
                item.id      = entry.getProperty ("id", "0").toString().getIntValue();
                item.licence = entry.getProperty ("license", "").toString();
                item.date    = entry.getProperty ("date", "").toString();
                item.author  = entry.getProperty ("author", "").toString();
                item.file    = entry.getProperty ("file", "").toString();
                item.comment = entry.getProperty ("comment", "").toString();
                item.tags    = entry.getProperty ("tags", "").toString();
                item.size    = entry.getProperty ("size", "0").toString().getIntValue();

                if (item.id > 0)
                    items.add (item);
            }
        }

        return items;
    }

    juce::Array<GalleryItem> loadIndex()
    {
        auto f = indexFile();

        if (! f.existsAsFile())
            return {};

        return parseIndex (f.loadFileAsString());
    }

    int countLocal (const juce::Array<GalleryItem>& items)
    {
        int n = 0;

        for (const auto& item : items)
            if (knobFile (item.id).existsAsFile())
                ++n;

        return n;
    }
}
