// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-audioeditor.js
//
// The Audio Editor: an audio clip big, on the song's bars, with the Audio menu's changes. It
// shares the space at the bottom with the Editor and the Console; its button is next to the
// Editor's (F2 stays the Editor's). It shows the audio clip selected in the arrangement, or
// the one double-clicked.
//
//   Clip tempo   the clip's own tempo (Detect listens for it)
//   Sync Tempo   a stretched copy whose beats land on the song's; the original is kept
//   Follow       the same, stretched again whenever the song's tempo changes under it
//   Pitch        semitones up or down (and hundredths), its length kept
//   Volume       the clip's own volume
//   Audio ▾      Reverse, Normalize, Audio to MIDI (Notes or Drums, on a new track), Back to
//                the Original
// The Event menu has the same, and so does an audio clip's right-click menu in the arrangement;
// AI Tools' Tempo & Pitch and Audio to MIDI tabs run them too (Hub.audioOps), and say themselves
// how they went.
// Each change is one Undo step in the engine. Click the waveform to move the song position;
// Ctrl + wheel zooms.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  const MIN_ZOOM = 4, MAX_ZOOM = 2000;
  const ae = { trackId: 0, clipId: 0, zoom: 0, busy: null, pendingSync: null, autoZoom: true, quiet: false };

  const panelOpen = () => !document.body.classList.contains("hide-audio-editor");
  const map = () => Hub.tempoMap;

  /** The clip shown and its track (null when it's gone). */
  function current() {
    const track = Hub.trackById(ae.trackId);
    const clip = track ? (track.clips || []).find((c) => c.id === ae.clipId && c.audioFile) : null;
    return clip ? { track, clip } : null;
  }

  /** The audio clip a command works on: the selected one (or the one shown). */
  function target() {
    const chosen = Hub.state.selectedClip;
    if (chosen) {
      const found = Hub.findClip(chosen.clipId);
      if (found && found.clip.audioFile) return { track: found.track, clip: found.clip };
    }
    return current();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
  const wrap = () => $("audio-wave-wrap");
  const xOf = (ppq) => ppq * ae.zoom - wrap().scrollLeft;
  const ppqAtX = (x) => Math.max(0, (x + wrap().scrollLeft) / ae.zoom);

  /** The song position where the clip's file is at a time (seconds into the file). */
  function ppqOfFile(clip, seconds) {
    const m = map();
    return m.ppqAt(m.secondsAt(clip.start) + seconds - (clip.audioOffset || 0));
  }

  function fileSecondsAt(clip, ppq) {
    const m = map();
    return (clip.audioOffset || 0) + m.secondsAt(ppq) - m.secondsAt(clip.start);
  }

  function sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height) {
    const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale));
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
      canvas.style.width = width + "px";
      canvas.style.height = height + "px";
    }
    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (context) context.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
    return context;
  }

  /** The zoom that shows the whole clip, with a little room either side. */
  function fitZoom(clip) {
    const width = wrap().clientWidth || 800;
    return Hub.clamp(width * 0.86 / Math.max(0.25, clip.length), MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM);
  }

  function updateSize(clip) {
    const end = clip ? Math.max(clip.start + clip.length, ppqOfFile(clip, Hub.state.peaks[clip.audioFile] ? Hub.state.peaks[clip.audioFile].length || 0 : 0)) : 16;
    $("audio-size").style.width = Math.ceil((end + 8) * ae.zoom) + "px";
    $("audio-size").style.height = "1px";
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
  function drawRuler(clip) {
    const canvas = $("audio-ruler");
    const width = wrap().clientWidth, height = canvas.parentElement.clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height);
    if (!context) return;
    context.fillStyle = "#1d1e21";
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const from = wrap().scrollLeft / ae.zoom, to = (wrap().scrollLeft + width) / ae.zoom + 1e-6;
    const tick = map().gridStep(from, ae.zoom, 8), label = map().gridStep(from, ae.zoom, 56, 0.25);
    const labelled = new Set(map().lines(from, to, label).map((line) => line.ppq.toFixed(6)));
    context.font = "11px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif";
    context.textBaseline = "top";

    for (const line of map().lines(from, to, tick)) {
      const x = Math.round(xOf(line.ppq)) + 0.5;
      const isLabel = labelled.has(line.ppq.toFixed(6));
      context.strokeStyle = line.bar ? Hub.theme.muted : Hub.theme.tick;
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(x, isLabel ? 4 : height - 6);
      context.lineTo(x, height);
      context.stroke();
      if (isLabel) {
        context.fillStyle = line.bar ? Hub.theme.text : Hub.theme.muted;
        context.fillText(map().label(line.ppq, label.q), x + 3, 4);
      }
    }

    // The clip's extent along the bottom.
    if (clip) {
      const track = Hub.trackById(ae.trackId);
      context.fillStyle = (track && track.colour) || "#25984d";
      context.fillRect(xOf(clip.start), height - 3, clip.length * ae.zoom, 3);
    }
    context.fillStyle = Hub.theme.line;
    context.fillRect(0, height - 1, width, 1);
  }

  function drawWave(clip) {
    const canvas = $("audio-wave");
    const width = wrap().clientWidth, height = wrap().clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height);
    if (!context) return;
    const colours = Hub.theme.lanes;
    context.fillStyle = colours.empty;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    if (!clip) return;

    // The bars behind.
    const from = wrap().scrollLeft / ae.zoom, to = (wrap().scrollLeft + width) / ae.zoom + 1e-6;
    for (const line of map().lines(from, to, map().gridStep(from, ae.zoom, 12))) {
      const x = Math.round(xOf(line.ppq)) + 0.5;
      context.strokeStyle = line.bar ? colours.bar : line.beat ? colours.beat : colours.fine;
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(x, 0);
      context.lineTo(x, height);
      context.stroke();
    }

    // The clip's window lit; the rest of the file (trimmed away) dim.
    const x0 = xOf(clip.start), x1 = xOf(clip.start + clip.length);
    const track = Hub.trackById(ae.trackId);
    context.globalAlpha = 0.28;
    context.fillStyle = (track && track.colour) || "#25984d";
    context.fillRect(x0, 0, x1 - x0, height);
    context.globalAlpha = 1;

    const coarse = Hub.state.peaks[clip.audioFile], fine = Hub.state.finePeaks[clip.audioFile];
    if (!coarse) {
      context.fillStyle = Hub.theme.muted;
      context.font = "12px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif";
      context.fillText(clip.missing ? "The clip's audio is missing." : "Loading the waveform…", Math.max(8, x0 + 8), 20);
      return;
    }

    const pixelsPerSecond = ae.zoom * map().bpmAt(clip.start) / 60;
    const wantFine = pixelsPerSecond > 1.5 * coarse.rate / coarse.bucket;
    if (wantFine && !fine && ae.askedFine !== clip.audioFile) { ae.askedFine = clip.audioFile; Hub.send("audioPeaksFine", { file: clip.audioFile }); }
    const peaks = wantFine && fine ? fine : coarse;
    const perBucket = peaks.bucket / peaks.rate, buckets = peaks.peaks.length / 2;
    const gain = Math.pow(10, (clip.gain || 0) / 20);
    const middle = height / 2, scale = Math.min(gain, 2) * (height / 2 - 6) / 127;
    const fileStart = Math.max(-8, xOf(ppqOfFile(clip, 0))), fileEnd = Math.min(width + 8, xOf(ppqOfFile(clip, coarse.length || 0)));

    context.fillStyle = "rgba(18, 19, 22, 0.75)";
    context.fillRect(Math.max(0, fileStart), Math.round(middle), Math.max(0, fileEnd - Math.max(0, fileStart)), 1);
    let next = fileSecondsAt(clip, ppqAtX(Math.floor(Math.max(0, fileStart))));

    for (let x = Math.floor(Math.max(0, fileStart)); x < fileEnd; x++) {
      const a = next;
      next = fileSecondsAt(clip, ppqAtX(x + 1));
      let first = Math.floor(a / perBucket), last = Math.max(first, Math.ceil(next / perBucket) - 1);
      if (last < 0 || first >= buckets) continue;
      first = Math.max(0, first);
      last = Math.min(buckets - 1, last);
      let high = 0, low = 0;
      for (let b = first; b <= last; b++) { high = Math.max(high, peaks.peaks[2 * b]); low = Math.min(low, peaks.peaks[2 * b + 1]); }
      const inside = x >= x0 && x < x1;
      context.fillStyle = inside ? "rgba(18, 19, 22, 0.85)" : "rgba(18, 19, 22, 0.35)";
      context.fillRect(x, middle - high * scale, 1, Math.max(1, (high - low) * scale));
    }

    // Fades, as the arrangement draws them.
    const fade = (fromPpq, toPpq, rising) => {
      const a = xOf(fromPpq), b = xOf(toPpq);
      if (b - a < 1) return;
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(a, 0);
      for (let i = 0; i <= 24; i++) {
        const t = i / 24, level = Math.sin(Math.PI / 2 * (rising ? t : 1 - t));
        context.lineTo(a + (b - a) * t, height - level * height);
      }
      context.lineTo(b, 0);
      context.closePath();
      context.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)";
      context.fill();
    };
    if (clip.fadeIn > 0) fade(clip.start, ppqOfFile(clip, (clip.audioOffset || 0) + clip.fadeIn), true);
    if (clip.fadeOut > 0) fade(ppqOfFile(clip, (clip.audioOffset || 0) + clip.audioLength - clip.fadeOut), clip.start + clip.length, false);

    context.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
    context.strokeRect(Math.round(x0) + 0.5, 0.5, Math.max(1, Math.round(x1 - x0) - 1), height - 1);
  }

  function placePlayhead() {
    const head = $("audio-playhead");
    if (!panelOpen() || !current()) { head.hidden = true; return; }
    const x = xOf(Hub.songPosition());
    head.hidden = x < 0 || x > wrap().clientWidth;
    head.style.transform = `translateX(${Math.round(x)}px)`;
  }

  /** What the clip is: its file, length, and what was done to it. */
  function describe(clip) {
    const parts = [`${clip.fileName}`, `${clip.audioLength.toFixed(2)} s`];
    if (clip.sourceFile) {
      const done = [];
      if (clip.sourceTempo > 0) done.push(`${clip.followTempo ? "follows the song's tempo" : "synced to the song"} from ${+clip.sourceTempo.toFixed(2)} BPM`);
      if (clip.pitch) done.push(`${clip.pitch > 0 ? "+" : ""}${+clip.pitch.toFixed(2)} semitones`);
      if (clip.reversed) done.push("reversed");
      parts.push(`made from ${clip.sourceName}: ${done.join(", ")}`);
    }
    if (clip.gain) parts.push(`volume ${clip.gain > 0 ? "+" : ""}${clip.gain.toFixed(1)} dB`);
    return parts.join(" · ");
  }

  const showValue = (input, value) => { if (document.activeElement !== input && input.value !== value) input.value = value; };

  function render() {
    const found = current();
    const editor = $("audio-editor");
    editor.classList.toggle("empty", !found);
    if (!panelOpen()) return;
    const clip = found ? found.clip : null;

    if (found) {
      if (ae.autoZoom || !ae.zoom) {
        ae.zoom = fitZoom(clip);
        updateSize(clip);
        wrap().scrollLeft = Math.max(0, clip.start * ae.zoom - wrap().clientWidth * 0.07);
        ae.autoZoom = false;
      }
      updateSize(clip);   // a render can make it longer or shorter
      const bar = map().barAt(clip.start + 1e-9).index + 1;
      $("audio-title").textContent = `${found.track.name} · bar ${bar}`;
      $("audio-info").textContent = describe(clip);
      $("audio-follow").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(Boolean(clip.followTempo)));
      showValue($("audio-pitch"), String(+(clip.pitch || 0).toFixed(2)));
      showValue($("audio-gain"), (clip.gain || 0).toFixed(1));
      if (clip.sourceTempo > 0) showValue($("audio-tempo"), String(+clip.sourceTempo.toFixed(2)));
    } else {
      $("audio-title").textContent = "";
      $("audio-info").textContent = "";
    }

    for (const id of ["audio-detect", "audio-sync", "audio-follow", "audio-menu", "audio-pitch", "audio-gain", "audio-tempo"])
      $(id).disabled = !found || Boolean(ae.busy);

    drawRuler(clip);
    drawWave(clip);
    placePlayhead();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- showing a clip
  Hub.openAudioEditor = (trackId, clipId) => {
    if (ae.trackId !== trackId || ae.clipId !== clipId) {
      ae.trackId = trackId;
      ae.clipId = clipId;
      ae.autoZoom = true;
      ae.askedFine = null;
      $("audio-tempo").value = "";
    }
    document.body.classList.remove("hide-audio-editor");
    document.body.classList.add("hide-editor", "hide-console");
    Hub.emit("layout");
    Hub.selectTrack(trackId, "keep");
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  };

  /** The selection moved to another audio clip: the editor shows it (as Studio One's follows). */
  function followSelection() {
    const chosen = Hub.state.selectedClip;
    if (!chosen || (chosen.trackId === ae.trackId && chosen.clipId === ae.clipId)) return;
    const found = Hub.findClip(chosen.clipId);
    if (!found || !found.clip.audioFile) return;
    ae.trackId = found.track.id;
    ae.clipId = chosen.clipId;
    ae.autoZoom = true;
    ae.askedFine = null;
    $("audio-tempo").value = "";
    render();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the Audio menu
  /** quiet: AI Tools sent it, and its page says how it went (no notes here). */
  function send(op, extra = {}, chosen = target(), quiet = false) {
    if (!chosen) { Hub.toast("Select an audio clip first."); return false; }
    if (ae.busy) { Hub.toast("Sonify is still working on the last one."); return false; }
    ae.quiet = quiet;
    Hub.send("audioOp", { op, trackId: chosen.track.id, clipId: chosen.clip.id, ...extra });
    return true;
  }

  const typedTempo = () => {
    const value = Number($("audio-tempo").value);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 20 && value <= 400 ? value : 0;
  };

  /** Sync (or Follow) with the clip's tempo: the one given, the one typed, the one it was synced
      from, or heard first. */
  function syncTempo(follow, chosen = target(), given = 0, quiet = false) {
    if (!chosen) { Hub.toast("Select an audio clip first."); return false; }
    const tempo = given || (chosen.clip.id === ae.clipId ? typedTempo() : 0) || chosen.clip.sourceTempo || 0;
    if (tempo > 0) return send(follow ? "followTempo" : "syncTempo", follow ? { on: true, tempo } : { tempo }, chosen, quiet);
    if (!send("detectTempo", {}, chosen, quiet)) return false;
    ae.pendingSync = { follow, trackId: chosen.track.id, clipId: chosen.clip.id, quiet };
    return true;
  }

  function askPitch(chosen = target()) {
    if (!chosen) { Hub.toast("Select an audio clip first."); return; }
    if (chosen.clip.id !== ae.clipId) Hub.openAudioEditor(chosen.track.id, chosen.clip.id);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { $("audio-pitch").focus(); $("audio-pitch").select(); });
  }

  function askToMidi(anchor, chosen = target()) {
    if (!chosen) { Hub.toast("Select an audio clip first."); return; }
    Hub.popupMenu(anchor, [{ group: "Audio to MIDI, on a new track" },
                           { label: "Notes: any instrument or voice, chords too", value: "notes" },
                           { label: "Drums: kick, snare and hi-hat", value: "drums" }],
                  (mode) => send("toMidi", { mode }, chosen));
  }

  /** The Audio menu as a popup (the toolbar's Audio button, an audio clip's right-click). */
  function audioMenu(anchor, chosen = target()) {
    if (!chosen) return;
    const clip = chosen.clip;
    Hub.popupMenu(anchor, [
      { label: "Sync Tempo", value: "sync" },
      { label: clip.followTempo ? "Stop Following the Song's Tempo" : "Follow Song Tempo", value: "follow" },
      { label: "Pitch…", value: "pitch" },
      { label: clip.reversed ? "Forwards Again" : "Reverse", value: "reverse" },
      { label: "Normalize", value: "normalize" },
      { label: "Audio to MIDI…", value: "toMidi" },
      { label: "Back to the Original", value: "original", disabled: !clip.sourceFile },
      { label: "Open in the Audio Editor", value: "open" },
      { group: "Song Builder Blocks" },
      ...(Hub.songBlockMenuItems || [])
    ], (pick) => {
      if (pick === "sync") syncTempo(false, chosen);
      if (pick === "follow") { if (clip.followTempo) send("followTempo", { on: false }, chosen); else syncTempo(true, chosen); }
      if (pick === "pitch") askPitch(chosen);
      if (pick === "reverse") send("reverse", {}, chosen);
      if (pick === "normalize") send("normalize", {}, chosen);
      if (pick === "toMidi") askToMidi(anchor, chosen);
      if (pick === "original") send("original", {}, chosen);
      if (pick === "open") Hub.openAudioEditor(chosen.track.id, chosen.clip.id);
      if (pick === "makeSongBlock" || pick === "songBlocks") Hub.run(pick);
    });
  }

  Hub.audioMenu = audioMenu;

  /** The same changes for AI Tools (hub-aitools.js), on a clip it names: false when one can't
      start (the clip is gone, or Sonify is still working on the last one). */
  const clipOf = (trackId, clipId) => {
    const track = Hub.trackById(trackId);
    const clip = track ? (track.clips || []).find((c) => c.id === clipId && c.audioFile) : null;
    return clip ? { track, clip } : null;
  };
  Hub.audioOps = {
    run: (op, extra, trackId, clipId) => { const found = clipOf(trackId, clipId); return found ? send(op, extra || {}, found, true) : false; },
    syncTempo: (follow, trackId, clipId, tempo = 0) => { const found = clipOf(trackId, clipId); return found ? syncTempo(follow, found, tempo, true) : false; },
    busy: () => ae.busy
  };
  Hub.commands.audioSyncTempo = () => syncTempo(false);
  Hub.commands.audioFollowTempo = () => { const t = target(); if (t && t.clip.followTempo) send("followTempo", { on: false }, t); else syncTempo(true, t); };
  Hub.commands.audioPitch = () => askPitch();
  Hub.commands.audioReverse = () => send("reverse");
  Hub.commands.audioNormalize = () => send("normalize");
  Hub.commands.audioOriginal = () => { const t = target(); if (t && !t.clip.sourceFile) Hub.toast("The clip plays its original already."); else send("original", {}, t); };
  Hub.commands.audioToMidi = () => {
    const anchor = $("audio-menu").offsetParent ? $("audio-menu") : { getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: window.innerWidth / 2 - 120, right: 0, top: 120, bottom: 120 }) };
    askToMidi(anchor);
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- what the engine says
  const OP_NAMES = { syncTempo: "Syncing the tempo", followTempo: "Stretching to the song's tempo", pitch: "Moving the pitch", reverse: "Reversing",
                     original: "Going back to the original", toMidi: "Listening for notes", detectTempo: "Listening for the tempo",
                     analyse: "Listening for the chords, key and tempo" };

  Hub.on("audioJob", (job) => {
    if (!job) return;
    if (job.state === "working") {
      ae.busy = job;
      $("audio-busy").hidden = false;
      $("audio-busy-text").textContent = `${OP_NAMES[job.op] || "Working"}… ${Math.round((job.progress || 0) * 100)}%`;
      render();
      return;
    }
    ae.busy = null;
    $("audio-busy").hidden = true;
    if (job.state === "failed" && job.error && !ae.quiet) Hub.toast(job.error);
    if (job.state === "done" && job.error && !ae.quiet) Hub.toast(job.error);
    if (job.state === "done" && job.op === "toMidi" && job.newTrackId && !ae.quiet) {
      Hub.toast("The notes are on a new track under the clip's.");
      Hub.selectTrack(job.newTrackId, "only");
    }
    if (job.state !== "done" && ae.pendingSync && job.op === "detectTempo") ae.pendingSync = null;
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("audioTempo", (data) => {
    if (!data) return;
    if (data.trackId === ae.trackId && data.clipId === ae.clipId) $("audio-tempo").value = String(+Number(data.bpm).toFixed(2));
    const pending = ae.pendingSync;
    ae.pendingSync = null;

    // Detect Tempo was the first step of Sync or Follow: on with it.
    if (pending && pending.trackId === data.trackId && pending.clipId === data.clipId && data.bpm > 0) {
      ae.busy = null;
      const found = Hub.findClip(data.clipId);
      if (found) send(pending.follow ? "followTempo" : "syncTempo", pending.follow ? { on: true, tempo: data.bpm } : { tempo: data.bpm }, { track: found.track, clip: found.clip }, pending.quiet);
    } else if (!data.known && !ae.quiet) {
      Hub.toast(`The clip's tempo: ${+Number(data.bpm).toFixed(2)} BPM${data.steadiness !== undefined && data.steadiness < 0.5 ? " (it isn't very steady)" : ""}.`);
    }
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- wiring
  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    $("audio-close").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("toggleAudioEditor"));
    $("audio-detect").addEventListener("click", () => { const t = current(); if (t) send("detectTempo", {}, t); });
    $("audio-sync").addEventListener("click", () => syncTempo(false, current()));
    $("audio-follow").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const t = current();
      if (!t) return;
      if (t.clip.followTempo) send("followTempo", { on: false }, t);
      else syncTempo(true, t);
    });
    $("audio-menu").addEventListener("click", (event) => audioMenu(event.currentTarget, current()));
    $("audio-busy-cancel").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("audioCancel"));

    $("audio-pitch").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      const t = current(), value = Number(event.target.value);
      if (!t || !Number.isFinite(value)) { render(); return; }
      const semitones = Hub.clamp(Math.round(value * 100) / 100, -24, 24);
      if (Math.abs(semitones - (t.clip.pitch || 0)) > 1e-6) send("pitch", { semitones }, t);
    });

    $("audio-gain").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      const t = current(), value = Number(event.target.value);
      if (!t || !Number.isFinite(value)) { render(); return; }
      send("gain", { db: Hub.clamp(value, -60, 12) }, t);
    });

    for (const id of ["audio-pitch", "audio-gain", "audio-tempo"]) {
      $(id).addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
        if (event.key === "Enter") event.target.blur();
        if (event.key === "Escape") { event.target.value = ""; render(); event.target.blur(); }
      });
    }

    // Click the waveform to move the song position (snapped as the arrangement snaps).
    $("audio-wave").addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.button !== 0 || !current()) return;
      const rect = wrap().getBoundingClientRect();
      const ppq = ppqAtX(event.clientX - rect.left);
      Hub.locate(Hub.arrange ? Hub.arrange.snap(ppq) : ppq);
    });

    wrap().addEventListener("scroll", render);
    wrap().addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
      if (!event.ctrlKey || !current()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      const rect = wrap().getBoundingClientRect();
      const anchor = event.clientX - rect.left, ppq = ppqAtX(anchor);
      ae.zoom = Hub.clamp(ae.zoom * (event.deltaY < 0 ? 1.2 : 1 / 1.2), MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM);
      updateSize(current().clip);
      wrap().scrollLeft = Math.max(0, ppq * ae.zoom - anchor);
      render();
    }, { passive: false });

    // An audio clip's right-click in the arrangement: the Audio menu.
    $("lanes").addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => {
      if (!Hub.arrange || Hub.arrange.view.automation) return;
      const track = Hub.arrange.trackAt(event.clientY);
      const clip = track ? Hub.arrange.clipAt(track, Hub.arrange.ppqAt(event.clientX)) : null;
      if (!clip || !clip.audioFile) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (!Hub.state.selectedClips.includes(clip.id)) Hub.state.selectedClips = [clip.id];
      Hub.arrange.redraw();
      const at = { getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: event.clientX, right: event.clientX, top: event.clientY, bottom: event.clientY }) };
      audioMenu(at, { track, clip });
    });

    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(() => render()).observe(wrap());
    requestAnimationFrame(function tick() { if (panelOpen()) placePlayhead(); requestAnimationFrame(tick); });
  });

  Hub.on("layout", () => requestAnimationFrame(render));
  Hub.on("theme", render);
  Hub.on("tempoMap", render);
  Hub.on("audioPeaks", render);
  Hub.on("audioPeaksFine", render);
  Hub.on("tracks", () => {
    if (!current() && ae.clipId) {
      ae.clipId = 0;
      ae.trackId = 0;
    }
    render();
  });
  document.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { if (panelOpen()) followSelection(); });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-blocks.js
//
// Song Builder Blocks, a studio of its own (the top bar's selector, Ctrl+4): selected clips made into a
// block (a snapshot: a copy of them as they are, not linked to them), each block a pad on the
// page. Clicking pads puts them in the song's order (the strip under the pads); Build Song lays
// the song out on the timeline, one block after another, each clip on the track it came from.
// Every change is a step in Edit > Undo, and the blocks are kept with the song (MainBlocks.cpp,
// SongBlocks.h).
//
// Make one: in the Studio, Song > Make Block from Selected Clips or a clip's right-click (the
// Studio stays in front, and says where the block went); or here, Make from Selected Clips, with
// the clips selected in the Studio (the button counts them). A block made here is named at once.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const COLOURS = [["Green", "#2fb36b"], ["Blue", "#3f8fd8"], ["Amber", "#e5a93d"], ["Pink", "#d65db1"],
                   ["Red", "#e5484d"], ["Violet", "#8b6cf0"], ["Teal", "#25b5b0"], ["Olive", "#c2c95a"]];

  let data = { blocks: [], sequence: [] };
  let win = null;              // the page's parts: { pads, strip, info, clear, at, build, make }
  let shown = false;           // the page is in front
  let chosen = -1;             // the chip chosen in the song (its place), for Delete
  let renameId = 0;            // a pad just made on the page: its name is offered for typing
  let atTyped = false;         // the user typed where to build: kept until the song is built
  let padsDrawn = "";          // what the pads were drawn from (blocks and tracks), so they're only drawn again when it changes

  const send = (action, payload = {}) => Hub.send("songBlocks", Object.assign({ action }, payload));
  const blockById = (id) => data.blocks.find((block) => block.id === id) || null;
  const plural = (n, word) => `${n} ${word}${n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- making one
  function makeFromSelection(name) {
    const ids = (Hub.state.selectedClips || []).slice();

    if (!ids.length) {
      Hub.toast(shown ? "Select the clips in the Studio (Ctrl+1) first, then make the block here."
                      : "Select the clips to make a block from first.");
      return;
    }

    send("make", name ? { clipIds: ids, name } : { clipIds: ids });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the song's order
  function setSequence(ids, label) {
    data.sequence = ids.slice();
    chosen = Math.min(chosen, data.sequence.length - 1);
    if (shown) renderSong();
    send("sequence", { ids, label });
  }

  const addToSong = (id) => setSequence([...data.sequence, id], "Add Block to the Song");

  function removeFromSong(place) {
    if (place < 0 || place >= data.sequence.length) return;
    const ids = data.sequence.slice();
    ids.splice(place, 1);
    chosen = Math.min(place, ids.length - 1);
    setSequence(ids, "Remove Block from the Song");
  }

  /** Where Build Song starts by default: the bar after the song's last clip (so nothing's covered). */
  function barAfterSong() {
    let end = 0;

    for (const track of Hub.state.tracks || [])
      for (const clip of track.clips || [])
        end = Math.max(end, clip.start + clip.length);

    if (end <= 0) return 1;
    const bar = Hub.tempoMap.barAt(end - 1e-6);
    return bar.index + 2;
  }

  function buildSong() {
    if (!data.sequence.length) {
      Hub.toast("Click pads to put their blocks in the song first.");
      return;
    }

    const bar = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(win && win.at.value) || barAfterSong()));
    const at = Hub.tempoMap.ppqOfBar(bar - 1);
    if (Hub.arrange && Hub.arrange.expectNewClips) Hub.arrange.expectNewClips();   // they become the selection
    send("build", { at });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- a pad's menu
  function padMenu(anchor, block) {
    Hub.popupMenu(anchor, [
      { label: "Add to the Song", value: "add" },
      { label: "Rename", value: "rename" },
      { label: "Colour…", value: "colour" },
      { label: "Duplicate", value: "duplicate" },
      { label: "Delete", value: "delete" }
    ], (pick) => {
      if (pick === "add") addToSong(block.id);
      if (pick === "rename") renamePad(block.id);
      if (pick === "duplicate") send("duplicate", { id: block.id });
      if (pick === "delete") send("remove", { id: block.id });
      if (pick === "colour") {
        Hub.popupMenu(anchor, [{ group: "Colour" }].concat(COLOURS.map(([name, value]) => ({ label: name, value, disabled: value === block.colour }))),
                      (colour) => send("edit", { id: block.id, colour }));
      }
    });
  }

  /** The pad's name, typed over (Enter or leaving it keeps it, Escape doesn't). */
  function renamePad(id) {
    if (!win) return;
    const pad = win.pads.querySelector(`[data-block="${id}"]`);
    const block = blockById(id);
    if (!pad || !block) return;

    const label = pad.querySelector(".block-name");
    const input = element("input");
    input.type = "text";
    input.value = block.name;
    input.maxLength = 60;
    input.setAttribute("aria-label", "Block name");
    label.textContent = "";
    label.appendChild(input);
    input.focus();
    input.select();

    let done = false;
    const finish = (save) => {
      if (done) return;
      done = true;
      const value = input.value.trim();
      label.textContent = save && value ? value : block.name;   // (the input goes with it)
      if (save && value && value !== block.name) send("edit", { id, name: value });
    };

    input.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") finish(true);
      if (event.key === "Escape") finish(false);
      event.stopPropagation();
    });
    input.addEventListener("blur", () => finish(true));
    input.addEventListener("click", (event) => event.stopPropagation());
    input.addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => event.stopPropagation());
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
  /** A pad's picture of its block: a lane per track, its clips, and their notes. */
  function drawPreview(canvas, block) {
    const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const width = canvas.clientWidth || 120, height = canvas.clientHeight || 40;
    canvas.width = Math.round(width * scale);
    canvas.height = Math.round(height * scale);
    const g = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!g) return;
    g.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
    g.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const order = (Hub.state.tracks || []).map((t) => t.id);
    const lanes = [...new Set(block.parts.map((p) => p.trackId))].sort((a, b) => order.indexOf(a) - order.indexOf(b));
    if (!lanes.length || !(block.length > 0)) return;

    const laneHeight = height / lanes.length;
    const x = (ppq) => (ppq / block.length) * width;

    // Bar lines, faintly.
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)";
    for (let bar = 1; bar < block.bars; bar++) g.fillRect(Math.round((bar / block.bars) * width), 0, 1, height);

    lanes.forEach((trackId, lane) => {
      const track = Hub.trackById(trackId);
      const colour = track ? track.colour : "#777777";
      const top = lane * laneHeight;
      const parts = block.parts.filter((p) => p.trackId === trackId);
      const pitches = parts.flatMap((p) => (p.notes || []).map((n) => n[0]));
      const low = pitches.length ? Math.min(...pitches) : 0, high = pitches.length ? Math.max(...pitches) : 127;

      for (const part of parts) {
        const left = x(part.start), right = x(Math.min(block.length, part.start + part.length));
        g.globalAlpha = track ? 0.45 : 0.25;
        g.fillStyle = colour;
        g.fillRect(left, top + 1, Math.max(1, right - left), Math.max(1, laneHeight - 2));
        g.globalAlpha = 1;

        if (part.audio) {
          // An audio clip: a band across its middle.
          g.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
          g.fillRect(left + 1, top + laneHeight / 2 - 1, Math.max(1, right - left - 2), 2);
          continue;
        }

        g.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
        for (const [pitch, start, length] of part.notes || []) {
          const span = Math.max(1, high - low);
          const y = top + 2 + (1 - (pitch - low) / span) * Math.max(1, laneHeight - 5);
          g.fillRect(x(start), y, Math.max(1, x(start + length) - x(start) - 0.5), 1.5);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function renderPads() {
    win.pads.textContent = "";

    if (!data.blocks.length) {
      win.pads.appendChild(element("p", "blocks-empty muted",
        "No blocks yet. In the Studio (Ctrl+1), select the clips of a whole verse or chorus, then come back and Make from Selected Clips, or right-click one of them there."));
      return;
    }

    for (const block of data.blocks) {
      const pad = element("div", "block-pad");
      pad.dataset.block = String(block.id);
      pad.tabIndex = 0;
      pad.setAttribute("role", "button");
      pad.title = "Click: add it to the song. Right-click: rename, colour, duplicate, delete.";
      pad.style.setProperty("--pad-colour", block.colour || "#2fb36b");

      const tracks = new Set(block.parts.map((p) => p.trackId)).size;
      const name = element("span", "block-name", block.name);
      name.title = "F2 or right-click: rename";
      const info = element("span", "block-info", `${plural(block.bars, "bar")} · ${plural(tracks, "track")}`);
      const preview = element("canvas", "block-preview");
      pad.append(name, info, preview);

      // A click adds it once (a double-click too: its second click is left alone).
      pad.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest("input") || event.detail > 1) return;
        addToSong(block.id);
      });

      // Its keys are its own: not the arrangement's (Space would play, Delete would delete clips).
      pad.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
        if (event.target !== pad) return;
        const add = event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ";
        if (add) addToSong(block.id);
        if (event.key === "F2") renamePad(block.id);
        if (event.key === "Delete") send("remove", { id: block.id });
        if (add || event.key === "F2" || event.key === "Delete") {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
        }
      });
      pad.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        padMenu({ getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: event.clientX, right: event.clientX, top: event.clientY, bottom: event.clientY }) }, block);
      });

      win.pads.appendChild(pad);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => drawPreview(preview, block));
    }
  }

  function renderSong() {
    win.strip.textContent = "";
    const blocks = data.sequence.map(blockById);
    const bars = blocks.reduce((sum, block) => sum + (block ? block.bars : 0), 0);
    win.info.textContent = data.sequence.length ? `${plural(data.sequence.length, "block")} · ${plural(bars, "bar")}` : "";
    win.clear.disabled = !data.sequence.length;
    win.build.disabled = !data.sequence.length;

    if (!data.sequence.length) {
      win.strip.appendChild(element("p", "blocks-empty muted", "Click pads to put their blocks here, in the song's order."));
      return;
    }

    blocks.forEach((block, place) => {
      if (!block) return;
      const chip = element("div", "block-chip" + (place === chosen ? " chosen" : ""));
      chip.dataset.place = String(place);
      chip.style.setProperty("--pad-colour", block.colour || "#2fb36b");
      chip.style.flexGrow = String(Math.max(1, block.bars));
      chip.style.flexBasis = `${Math.max(1, block.bars) * 22}px`;
      chip.title = `${block.name}: ${plural(block.bars, "bar")}. Drag to move it; × or Delete takes it out.`;

      const label = element("span", "block-chip-name", block.name);
      const out = element("button", "block-chip-remove", "×");
      out.type = "button";
      out.setAttribute("aria-label", `Take ${block.name} out of the song`);
      out.addEventListener("click", (event) => { event.stopPropagation(); removeFromSong(place); });
      chip.append(label, out);

      chip.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => startChipDrag(event, chip, place));
      win.strip.appendChild(chip);
    });
  }

  /** The Make button counts the clips selected in the Studio. */
  function renderMake() {
    const count = (Hub.state.selectedClips || []).length;
    win.make.textContent = count ? `Make from ${plural(count, "Selected Clip")}` : "Make from Selected Clips";
  }

  function render(force = false) {
    if (!win || !shown) return;
    renderMake();

    // The pads again only when what they show changed (not while a name is being typed).
    const tracksKey = (Hub.state.tracks || []).map((t) => `${t.id}:${t.colour}`).join(",");
    const key = JSON.stringify(data.blocks) + "|" + tracksKey;
    const typing = win.pads.contains(document.activeElement) && document.activeElement.tagName === "INPUT";

    if ((force || key !== padsDrawn) && !typing) {
      padsDrawn = key;
      renderPads();
    }

    renderSong();
    if (!atTyped) win.at.value = String(barAfterSong());

    if (renameId && blockById(renameId)) {
      const id = renameId;
      renameId = 0;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => renamePad(id));
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- moving a chip in the song
  function startChipDrag(event, chip, place) {
    if (event.button !== 0 || event.target.closest("button")) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    chosen = place;
    win.strip.querySelectorAll(".block-chip").forEach((c) => c.classList.toggle("chosen", c === chip));
    win.strip.focus();

    const startX = event.clientX;
    let moved = false, target = place;
    const marker = element("div", "block-drop");

    const move = (e) => {
      if (!moved && Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 5) return;
      moved = true;
      chip.classList.add("dragging");

      // Before the first chip whose middle is right of the pointer.
      const chips = [...win.strip.querySelectorAll(".block-chip")];
      target = chips.length;
      for (const other of chips) {
        const r = other.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (e.clientX < r.left + r.width / 2) { target = Number(other.dataset.place); break; }
      }

      const strip = win.strip.getBoundingClientRect();
      const ref = chips[Math.min(target, chips.length - 1)].getBoundingClientRect();
      marker.style.left = `${(target < chips.length ? ref.left : ref.right) - strip.left + win.strip.scrollLeft - 1}px`;
      if (!marker.isConnected) win.strip.appendChild(marker);
    };

    const up = () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
      marker.remove();
      chip.classList.remove("dragging");
      if (!moved) return;

      const to = target > place ? target - 1 : target;
      if (to === place) return;
      const ids = data.sequence.slice();
      const [id] = ids.splice(place, 1);
      ids.splice(to, 0, id);
      chosen = to;
      setSequence(ids, "Move Block in the Song");
    };

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the page
  /** The page in front (on) or not: drawn afresh when it comes. */
  function show(on) {
    if (on === shown) return;
    shown = on;
    if (!on) {
      chosen = -1;
      return;
    }
    render(true);
    if (!renameId) win.pads.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  function setUpPage() {
    win = { pads: $("blocks-pads"), strip: $("blocks-strip"), info: $("blocks-song-info"), clear: $("blocks-clear"),
            at: $("blocks-at"), build: $("blocks-build"), make: $("blocks-make") };
    win.pads.tabIndex = -1;

    win.make.addEventListener("click", () => makeFromSelection());
    win.clear.addEventListener("click", () => setSequence([], "Clear the Song"));
    win.build.addEventListener("click", buildSong);
    win.at.addEventListener("input", () => { atTyped = true; });
    win.at.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => { event.stopPropagation(); if (event.key === "Enter") buildSong(); });

    // Delete and the arrows are the strip's own; everything else (Ctrl+Z, Space...) goes on as usual.
    win.strip.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if ((event.key === "Delete" || event.key === "Backspace") && chosen >= 0) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        removeFromSong(chosen);
      }
      if ((event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowRight") && data.sequence.length) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        chosen = Hub.clamp(chosen + (event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 1), 0, data.sequence.length - 1);
        renderSong();
      }
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- a clip's right-click
  const clipMenuItems = [
    { label: "Make Block from Selected Clips", value: "makeSongBlock" },
    { label: "Go to Song Builder Blocks", value: "songBlocks" }
  ];
  Hub.songBlockMenuItems = clipMenuItems;   // the Audio menu (an audio clip's right-click) has them too

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    setUpPage();

    const lanes = $("lanes");
    if (!lanes) return;

    // A MIDI clip's right-click (an audio clip's is the Audio menu).
    lanes.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => {
      if (!Hub.arrange || Hub.arrange.view.automation) return;
      const track = Hub.arrange.trackAt(event.clientY);
      const clip = track ? Hub.arrange.clipAt(track, Hub.arrange.ppqAt(event.clientX)) : null;
      if (!clip || clip.audioFile) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (!Hub.state.selectedClips.includes(clip.id)) Hub.state.selectedClips = [clip.id];
      Hub.arrange.redraw();
      const at = { getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: event.clientX, right: event.clientX, top: event.clientY, bottom: event.clientY }) };
      Hub.popupMenu(at, [...clipMenuItems, { separator: true }, { label: "Show Track as Score\u2026", value: "showClipScore" }], (command) => Hub.run(command));
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- what the engine says
  Hub.on("songBlocks", (message) => {
    data = {
      blocks: Array.isArray(message && message.blocks) ? message.blocks : [],
      sequence: Array.isArray(message && message.sequence) ? message.sequence : []
    };
    Hub.state.songBlocks = data;
    chosen = Math.min(chosen, data.sequence.length - 1);
    render();
  });

  // A pad just made. On the page: it shows, its name ready for typing. In the Studio (the menu or a
  // clip's right-click): the Studio stays in front, and says where the block went.
  Hub.on("songBlockMade", (message) => {
    const id = message && message.id ? message.id : 0;

    if (shown) {
      renameId = id;
      render();
      return;
    }

    const block = blockById(id);
    const what = block ? `Block "${block.name}"` : "Block";
    Hub.toast(`${what} ${message && message.action === "duplicate" ? "copied" : "made"}: it's in Song Builder Blocks (Ctrl+4).`);
  });

  Hub.on("songBlocksBuilt", (message) => {
    if (!message) return;
    const notice = message.notice || "";

    if (!message.placed) {
      if (notice) Hub.toast(notice);
      return;
    }

    const from = Hub.tempoMap.barAt(message.from).index + 1;
    const to = Hub.tempoMap.barAt(Math.max(message.from, message.to - 1e-6)).index + 1;
    Hub.toast(`Song built: bars ${from} to ${to}.` + (notice ? " " + notice : "") + (shown ? " See it in the Studio (Ctrl+1)." : ""));
    atTyped = false;
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("tracks", () => render());   // the pads draw their tracks' colours
  Hub.on("theme", () => render(true));

  Hub.commands.makeSongBlock = () => makeFromSelection();   // Song Builder Blocks itself: the selector (hub-studios.js)
  Hub.blocks = { show, isShown: () => shown };
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-board.js
//
// The Analog Board: a tab of its own (+ Open new tab › Analog Board, or View › Analog Board), a
// second mixer laid out as an analog desk. A strip for each instrument and audio track, left to
// right as the song has them, and the master section on the right.
//   A strip, top to bottom: the preamp (Trim, Drive, phase), the high-pass filter and EQ In, the
//   EQ (HF, HMF, LMF, LF: gain and frequency), the compressor (threshold, ratio, release, make-up,
//   Comp In, Fast, and its reduction lights), the sends to the Plate and the Tape Echo, pan, Mute
//   and Solo, the fader with its meter, and the track's name on a strip of tape.
//   The master: two VU meters, the Plate, the Tape Echo, the Bus Compressor, the Tape Machine and
//   the master fader.
// Mix on the board: the song is mixed here instead of on the Console. Each track's dry sound comes
// in (before its inserts); the Console's inserts, faders, sends, FX channels, buses and Main are
// left out. The first time, the strips start where the Console's faders are.
// Knobs: drag up or down (Shift for fine), the mouse wheel, the arrow keys; double-click puts one
// back where it starts. MIDI Link's chips link to any knob, fader or button here.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  let board = { mixing: false, specs: { strip: [], master: [] }, strips: [], master: {} };
  let shown = false;
  let renderDue = true;
  let dragging = 0;                     // controls being dragged: no redraw under them
  const specs = { strip: new Map(), master: new Map() };
  const meters = new Map();             // strip id ("master" too) -> { columns, clip, clipUntil, lights }
  let vus = [];                         // the master's two needles
  const pending = new Map();            // "strip|id" -> value, sent at the next frame
  let flushing = false;

  // A knob cap's colour says what it does, as on a desk.
  const CAPS = {
    trim: "steel", drive: "steel", hpf: "stone",
    hf: "red", hfFreq: "red", hmf: "green", hmfFreq: "green", lmf: "blue", lmfFreq: "blue", lf: "brown", lfFreq: "brown",
    threshold: "amber", ratio: "amber", release: "amber", makeup: "amber",
    sendPlate: "ivory", sendEcho: "ivory", pan: "grey",
    plateDecay: "ivory", plateTone: "ivory", platePredelay: "ivory", plateReturn: "ivory",
    echoNote: "sand", echoTime: "sand", echoFeedback: "sand", echoTone: "sand", echoWow: "sand", echoReturn: "sand",
    busThreshold: "amber", busRatio: "amber", busAttack: "amber", busRelease: "amber", busMakeup: "amber", busMix: "amber",
    tapeDrive: "brown", tapeSpeed: "brown", tapeWow: "brown"
  };

  // What a strip's knob is called on it (its legend), where the setting's own name is long.
  const SHORT = { lfFreq: "Freq", lmfFreq: "Freq", hmfFreq: "Freq", hfFreq: "Freq", threshold: "Thresh", release: "Release",
                  makeup: "Gain", sendPlate: "Plate", sendEcho: "Echo", hpf: "HPF", busThreshold: "Thresh", busMakeup: "Gain",
                  platePredelay: "Pre-delay", tapeWow: "Wow", echoTime: "Time" };

  // The LED meters: VU, 0 at -18 dBFS (RMS), from -20 to +3; the lights' steps.
  const VU_ZERO_DBFS = -18;
  const STEPS = [-20, -15, -10, -7, -5, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3];
  const GR_STEPS = [1, 3, 6, 10, 15];

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- values
  const clamp01 = (v) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
  const isLog = (spec) => spec.unit === "Hz" || spec.id === "release" || spec.id === "echoTime";
  const isSendLevel = (spec) => spec.unit === "dB" && (spec.id.startsWith("send") || spec.id.endsWith("Return"));
  const isBipolar = (spec) => spec.min < 0 && spec.max > 0 && spec.kind !== "fader" && !isSendLevel(spec);

  /** A setting's value to its knob's position (0..1), along the same curves MIDI Link uses. */
  function toPosition(spec, value) {
    if (spec.kind === "toggle") return value >= 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
    if (spec.kind === "choice") return spec.max > 0 ? clamp01(value / spec.max) : 0;
    if (spec.kind === "fader") return Hub.dbToFader(value <= Hub.SILENT_DB ? -1000 : value);
    if (isLog(spec)) return clamp01(Math.log(value / spec.min) / Math.log(spec.max / spec.min));
    if (isSendLevel(spec)) return clamp01(1 - Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, (spec.max - value) / (spec.max - spec.min))));
    return clamp01((value - spec.min) / (spec.max - spec.min));
  }

  function fromPosition(spec, position) {
    const p = clamp01(position);
    if (spec.kind === "toggle") return p >= 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
    if (spec.kind === "choice") return Math.round(p * spec.max);
    if (spec.kind === "fader") return Math.max(spec.min, Math.round(Hub.faderToDb(p) * 10) / 10);
    if (isLog(spec)) return spec.min * Math.pow(spec.max / spec.min, p);
    if (isSendLevel(spec)) return spec.max - (spec.max - spec.min) * (1 - p) * (1 - p);
    if (spec.id === "pan") { const pan = p * 2 - 1; return Math.abs(pan) < 0.01 ? 0 : pan; }
    return spec.min + (spec.max - spec.min) * p;
  }

  const trimZeros = (text) => text.includes(".") ? text.replace(/0+$/, "").replace(/\.$/, "") : text;

  /** A value as the board shows it: "+3.0 dB", "2.4 kHz", "Off", "L30", "4:1". */
  function text(spec, value) {
    if (spec.kind === "toggle") return value >= 0.5 ? "On" : "Off";
    if (spec.kind === "choice") return (spec.choices || [])[Math.round(value)] || "";
    if (spec.id === "pan") {
      const amount = Math.round(Math.abs(value) * 100);
      return amount === 0 ? "C" : (value < 0 ? "L" : "R") + amount;
    }
    if (spec.unit === "dB") {
      if (spec.kind === "fader" && value <= Hub.SILENT_DB) return "\u2212\u221e dB";
      if (isSendLevel(spec) && value <= spec.min) return "Off";
      const shown = Math.abs(value) < 0.05 ? 0 : value;
      return (shown > 0 && ["lf", "lmf", "hmf", "hf", "trim"].includes(spec.id) ? "+" : "") + shown.toFixed(1) + " dB";
    }
    if (spec.unit === "Hz") {
      if (spec.id === "hpf" && value <= spec.min + 0.5) return "Off";
      return value >= 1000 ? trimZeros((value / 1000).toFixed(value >= 10000 ? 1 : 2)) + " kHz" : Math.round(value) + " Hz";
    }
    if (spec.unit === "ms") return (value < 10 ? trimZeros(value.toFixed(1)) : String(Math.round(value))) + " ms";
    if (spec.unit === "%") return Math.round(value) + "%";
    if (spec.unit === ":1") return trimZeros(value.toFixed(1)) + ":1";
    return trimZeros(value.toFixed(2));
  }

  /** A strip's values ("master" for the master's). */
  function valuesOf(stripId) {
    if (stripId === "master") return board.master;
    const strip = board.strips.find((s) => s.id === stripId);
    return strip ? strip.values : null;
  }

  function valueOf(stripId, spec) {
    const values = valuesOf(stripId);
    return values && values[spec.id] !== undefined ? values[spec.id] : spec.default;
  }

  /** Sets a value: here at once, to Sonify at the next frame (a drag sends each frame's last). */
  function setValue(stripId, spec, value) {
    let values = valuesOf(stripId);
    if (!values) {
      values = {};
      board.strips.push({ id: stripId, values });
    }
    values[spec.id] = value;
    pending.set(`${stripId}|${spec.id}`, { strip: stripId, id: spec.id, value });
    if (!flushing) {
      flushing = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        flushing = false;
        for (const change of pending.values()) Hub.send("board", { action: "set", ...change });
        pending.clear();
      });
    }
    if (spec.id === "echoSync") updateEchoTime();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- controls
  // Ticks round a knob: eleven over its 270 degrees, the middle one marked on a centred knob.
  const TICKS = (() => {
    let path = "";
    for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
      const a = (-135 + 27 * i) * Math.PI / 180;
      const x1 = 20 + 16.6 * Math.sin(a), y1 = 20 - 16.6 * Math.cos(a), x2 = 20 + 19 * Math.sin(a), y2 = 20 - 19 * Math.cos(a);
      path += `M${x1.toFixed(2)} ${y1.toFixed(2)}L${x2.toFixed(2)} ${y2.toFixed(2)}`;
    }
    return path;
  })();

  /** Where a strip is for MIDI Link: the track's number, or "master". */
  const linkStrip = (stripId) => {
    if (stripId === "master") return "master";
    const track = Hub.trackById(stripId);
    return track ? String(track.number) : "";
  };

  const stripName = (stripId) => {
    if (stripId === "master") return "Master";
    const track = Hub.trackById(stripId);
    return track ? `Track ${track.number} (${track.name})` : "Track";
  };

  function knob(stripId, spec, extraClass = "") {
    const holder = element("div", `bk ${extraClass}`.trim());
    holder.dataset.boardStrip = linkStrip(stripId);
    holder.dataset.boardParam = spec.id;
    holder.dataset.continuous = "1";
    const cap = CAPS[spec.id] || "grey";
    holder.style.setProperty("--cap", `var(--cap-${cap})`);
    if (cap === "ivory" || cap === "sand" || cap === "stone") holder.style.setProperty("--pointer", "#1d2125");
    holder.tabIndex = 0;
    holder.setAttribute("role", "slider");
    holder.setAttribute("aria-label", `${stripName(stripId)} ${spec.name}`);

    const centred = isBipolar(spec);
    const choice = spec.kind === "choice";
    holder.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><path class="bk-ticks${choice ? " detents" : ""}" d="${TICKS}"/>`
      + (centred ? '<circle class="bk-centre" cx="20" cy="2.2" r="1.2"/>' : "")
      + '<circle class="bk-skirt" cx="20" cy="20" r="14.6"/><circle class="bk-cap" cx="20" cy="20" r="10.8"/>'
      + '<circle class="bk-shine" cx="20" cy="20" r="10.8"/><g class="bk-rot"><line class="bk-pointer" x1="20" y1="6.2" x2="20" y2="13.5"/></g></svg>';
    const label = element("span", "bk-label", SHORT[spec.id] || spec.name);
    holder.appendChild(label);

    const rot = holder.querySelector(".bk-rot");
    const show = () => {
      const value = valueOf(stripId, spec);
      const position = toPosition(spec, value);
      rot.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${(-135 + 270 * position).toFixed(1)} 20 20)`);
      holder.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", text(spec, value));
      holder.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(Math.round(position * 100)));
      holder.title = `${spec.name}: ${text(spec, value)}`;
      if (holder.classList.contains("reading")) label.textContent = text(spec, value);
    };

    const set = (value) => { setValue(stripId, spec, value); show(); };
    const setPosition = (position) => set(fromPosition(spec, position));
    const reading = (on) => {
      holder.classList.toggle("reading", on);
      label.textContent = on ? text(spec, valueOf(stripId, spec)) : (SHORT[spec.id] || spec.name);
    };

    let drag = null;
    holder.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.button !== 0 || document.body.classList.contains("linking")) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      holder.focus();
      holder.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      drag = { y: event.clientY, position: toPosition(spec, valueOf(stripId, spec)), fine: event.shiftKey };
      dragging++;
      reading(true);
    });
    holder.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!drag) return;
      // Shift pressed or let go mid-drag: carries on from here at the new speed.
      if (event.shiftKey !== drag.fine) drag = { y: event.clientY, position: toPosition(spec, valueOf(stripId, spec)), fine: event.shiftKey };
      const travel = choice ? Math.max(60, 24 * spec.max) : (drag.fine ? 700 : 170);
      setPosition(drag.position + (drag.y - event.clientY) / travel);
    });
    const end = () => {
      if (!drag) return;
      drag = null;
      dragging = Math.max(0, dragging - 1);
      reading(holder.matches(":hover"));
      if (renderDue && !dragging) render();
    };
    holder.addEventListener("pointerup", end);
    holder.addEventListener("pointercancel", end);
    holder.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", end);   // the tab left mid-drag, say
    holder.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => { if (!drag) reading(true); });
    holder.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { if (!drag) reading(false); });
    holder.addEventListener("dblclick", () => set(spec.default));
    holder.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const step = choice ? 1 / Math.max(1, spec.max) : event.shiftKey ? 0.004 : 0.02;
      setPosition(toPosition(spec, valueOf(stripId, spec)) + (event.deltaY < 0 ? step : -step));
    }, { passive: false });
    holder.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      const step = choice ? 1 / Math.max(1, spec.max) : event.shiftKey ? 0.004 : 0.02;
      const now = toPosition(spec, valueOf(stripId, spec));
      if (event.key === "ArrowUp" || event.key === "ArrowRight") setPosition(now + step);
      else if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowLeft") setPosition(now - step);
      else if (event.key === "Home") setPosition(0);
      else if (event.key === "End") setPosition(1);
      else if (event.key === "Delete" || event.key === "Backspace") set(spec.default);
      else return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
    });

    show();
    return holder;
  }

  /** A lit push button (a switch). */
  function button(stripId, spec, label, extraClass = "") {
    const holder = element("button", `bb ${extraClass}`.trim(), label);
    holder.type = "button";
    holder.dataset.boardStrip = linkStrip(stripId);
    holder.dataset.boardParam = spec.id;
    holder.setAttribute("aria-label", `${stripName(stripId)} ${spec.name}`);
    const show = () => {
      const on = valueOf(stripId, spec) >= 0.5;
      holder.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
      holder.title = `${spec.name}: ${on ? "on" : "off"}`;
    };
    holder.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (document.body.classList.contains("linking")) return;
      setValue(stripId, spec, valueOf(stripId, spec) >= 0.5 ? 0 : 1);
      show();
    });
    show();
    return holder;
  }

  /** A long fader, on the Console's scale, with its value under it. */
  function fader(stripId, spec, meterOf) {
    const holder = element("div", "bf-area");
    const travel = element("div", "bf");
    travel.dataset.boardStrip = linkStrip(stripId);
    travel.dataset.boardParam = spec.id;
    travel.dataset.continuous = "1";
    travel.tabIndex = 0;
    travel.setAttribute("role", "slider");
    travel.setAttribute("aria-label", `${stripName(stripId)} fader`);
    travel.innerHTML = '<div class="bf-slot"></div>'
      + [10, 5, 0, -5, -10, -20, -30, -40, -60].map((db) =>
        `<span class="bf-mark${db === 0 ? " zero" : ""}" style="bottom:calc(var(--cap-h) / 2 + ${Hub.dbToFader(db).toFixed(4)} * (100% - var(--cap-h)))">${db > 0 ? "+" + db : db}</span>`).join("")
      + '<div class="bf-cap"></div>';
    const readout = element("span", "bf-readout");
    const row = element("div", "bf-row");
    row.appendChild(travel);
    if (meterOf) row.appendChild(meterOf);
    holder.append(row, readout);

    const show = () => {
      const value = valueOf(stripId, spec);
      travel.style.setProperty("--pos", toPosition(spec, value).toFixed(4));
      readout.textContent = text(spec, value);
      travel.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", text(spec, value));
    };
    const set = (value) => { setValue(stripId, spec, value); show(); };

    let drag = null;
    travel.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.button !== 0 || document.body.classList.contains("linking")) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      travel.focus();
      travel.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      drag = { y: event.clientY, position: toPosition(spec, valueOf(stripId, spec)), fine: event.shiftKey };
      dragging++;
    });
    travel.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!drag) return;
      if (event.shiftKey !== drag.fine) drag = { y: event.clientY, position: toPosition(spec, valueOf(stripId, spec)), fine: event.shiftKey };
      const height = Math.max(40, travel.clientHeight - 30);
      set(fromPosition(spec, drag.position + (drag.y - event.clientY) / height * (drag.fine ? 0.2 : 1)));
    });
    const end = () => {
      if (!drag) return;
      drag = null;
      dragging = Math.max(0, dragging - 1);
      if (renderDue && !dragging) render();
    };
    travel.addEventListener("pointerup", end);
    travel.addEventListener("pointercancel", end);
    travel.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", end);
    travel.addEventListener("dblclick", () => set(0));
    // A step up from all the way down starts where its scale does (-72 dB), not below it.
    const step = (up) => {
      const now = toPosition(spec, valueOf(stripId, spec));
      set(fromPosition(spec, (up ? Math.max(now, Hub.dbToFader(spec.min)) : now) + (up ? 0.01 : -0.01)));
    };
    travel.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      step(event.deltaY < 0);
    }, { passive: false });
    travel.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "ArrowUp") step(true);
      else if (event.key === "ArrowDown") step(false);
      else if (event.key === "Delete" || event.key === "Backspace") set(0);
      else return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
    });

    show();
    return holder;
  }

  /** A stereo LED meter with a clip light; kept by the strip's id for the status's levels. */
  function ledMeter(stripId) {
    const holder = element("div", "bm");
    holder.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    const clip = element("span", "bm-clip");
    const columns = [element("span", "bm-col"), element("span", "bm-col")];
    const pair = element("div", "bm-pair");
    pair.append(...columns);
    holder.append(clip, pair);
    meters.set(stripId, { columns, clip, clipUntil: 0, lights: meters.get(stripId) ? meters.get(stripId).lights : null, lit: [-1, -1] });
    return holder;
  }

  function reductionLights(stripId) {
    const holder = element("div", "bg");
    holder.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    holder.title = "Gain reduction: 1, 3, 6, 10 and 15 dB";
    const lights = GR_STEPS.map(() => element("span", "bg-led"));
    holder.append(...lights);
    const meter = meters.get(stripId) || { lit: [-1, -1] };
    meter.lights = lights;
    meter.reductionLit = -1;
    meters.set(stripId, meter);
    return holder;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- a strip
  const cell = (cls, ...children) => {
    const holder = element("div", `bs-cell ${cls}`);
    holder.append(...children.filter(Boolean));
    return holder;
  };

  function strip(track) {
    const id = track.id;
    const s = (key) => specs.strip.get(key);
    const holder = element("div", "bs");
    holder.dataset.id = String(id);
    holder.style.setProperty("--track", track.colour || "#888");

    const meter = ledMeter(id);
    holder.append(
      cell("r-preamp", knob(id, s("trim")), knob(id, s("drive"))),
      cell("r-filter", button(id, s("phase"), "\u00d8", "small"), knob(id, s("hpf"), "small"), button(id, s("eqOn"), "EQ", "small")),
      cell("r-hf", knob(id, s("hf")), knob(id, s("hfFreq"), "freq")),
      cell("r-hmf", knob(id, s("hmf")), knob(id, s("hmfFreq"), "freq")),
      cell("r-lmf", knob(id, s("lmf")), knob(id, s("lmfFreq"), "freq")),
      cell("r-lf", knob(id, s("lf")), knob(id, s("lfFreq"), "freq")),
      cell("r-dyn1", knob(id, s("threshold")), knob(id, s("ratio"))),
      cell("r-dyn2", knob(id, s("release")), knob(id, s("makeup"))),
      cell("r-dyn3", button(id, s("compOn"), "Comp", "small amber"), button(id, s("fastAttack"), "Fast", "small amber"), reductionLights(id)),
      cell("r-sends", knob(id, s("sendPlate")), knob(id, s("sendEcho"))),
      cell("r-pan", knob(id, s("pan"))),
      cell("r-buttons", button(id, s("mute"), "Mute", "mute"), button(id, s("solo"), "Solo", "solo")),
      cell("r-fader", fader(id, s("volume"), meter))
    );

    const tape = element("div", "bs-tape", track.name);
    tape.title = `Track ${track.number}: ${track.name}\nRight-click: reset this strip`;
    tape.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      Hub.popupMenu(tape, [{ group: track.name }, { label: "Reset this strip", value: "reset" }],
                    () => Hub.send("board", { action: "reset", strip: id }));
    });
    const number = element("span", "bs-number", String(track.number));
    holder.append(cell("r-name", number, tape));
    return holder;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the master
  function vuMeter(side) {
    const holder = element("div", "vu");
    holder.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    // The scale: -20 .. +3 VU on a voltage law, red from 0.
    const angleOf = (vu) => {
      const v = Math.pow(10, vu / 20), p = (v - 0.1) / (Math.pow(10, 3 / 20) - 0.1);
      return -48 + 96 * Math.max(-0.04, Math.min(1.04, p));
    };
    const at = (angle, r) => [60 + r * Math.sin(angle * Math.PI / 180), 74 - r * Math.cos(angle * Math.PI / 180)];
    const marks = [-20, -10, -7, -5, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3];
    let scale = "";
    for (const vu of marks) {
      const a = angleOf(vu);
      const [x1, y1] = at(a, 52), [x2, y2] = at(a, vu === 0 || vu === -20 || vu === 3 ? 60 : 57);
      const [tx, ty] = at(a, 66);
      scale += `<line class="vu-tick${vu > 0 ? " hot" : ""}" x1="${x1.toFixed(1)}" y1="${y1.toFixed(1)}" x2="${x2.toFixed(1)}" y2="${y2.toFixed(1)}"/>`;
      if ([-20, -10, -7, -5, -3, 0, 3].includes(vu)) scale += `<text class="vu-num${vu > 0 ? " hot" : ""}" x="${tx.toFixed(1)}" y="${ty.toFixed(1)}">${vu > 0 ? "+" + vu : vu === 0 ? "0" : Math.abs(vu)}</text>`;
    }
    const [a0x, a0y] = at(angleOf(0), 55), [a3x, a3y] = at(angleOf(3), 55), [m0x, m0y] = at(angleOf(-20), 55);
    holder.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 120 84"><path class="vu-arc" d="M${m0x.toFixed(1)} ${m0y.toFixed(1)}A55 55 0 0 1 ${a0x.toFixed(1)} ${a0y.toFixed(1)}"/>`
      + `<path class="vu-arc hot" d="M${a0x.toFixed(1)} ${a0y.toFixed(1)}A55 55 0 0 1 ${a3x.toFixed(1)} ${a3y.toFixed(1)}"/>${scale}`
      + `<text class="vu-word" x="60" y="54">VU</text><text class="vu-side" x="60" y="66">${side}</text>`
      + `<g class="vu-needle"><line x1="60" y1="80" x2="60" y2="16"/></g><circle class="vu-pivot" cx="60" cy="80" r="6"/></svg>`;
    const needle = holder.querySelector(".vu-needle");
    needle.style.transform = `rotate(${angleOf(-40).toFixed(1)}deg)`;
    return { holder, needle, angleOf, shown: -999 };
  }

  function master() {
    const m = (key) => specs.master.get(key);
    const holder = element("div", "bmaster");
    const id = "master";

    vus = [vuMeter("Left"), vuMeter("Right")];
    const meterBridge = element("div", "bmaster-vus");
    meterBridge.append(vus[0].holder, vus[1].holder);
    const glue = element("div", "bmaster-gr");
    glue.append(element("span", "bmaster-gr-label", "Bus comp"), reductionLights("master"));

    const section = (title, cls, ...rows) => {
      const box = element("section", `bmod ${cls}`);
      box.appendChild(element("h3", "bmod-title", title));
      for (const row of rows) {
        const line = element("div", "bmod-row");
        line.append(...row.filter(Boolean));
        box.appendChild(line);
      }
      return box;
    };

    const echoTime = element("div", "echo-time");
    echoTime.append(knob(id, m("echoNote"), "note"), knob(id, m("echoTime"), "ms"));

    const modules = element("div", "bmaster-modules");
    modules.append(
      section("Plate", "plate", [knob(id, m("plateDecay")), knob(id, m("plateTone")), knob(id, m("platePredelay")), knob(id, m("plateReturn"))]),
      section("Tape Echo", "echo", [button(id, m("echoSync"), "Sync", "small"), echoTime, knob(id, m("echoFeedback"))],
              [knob(id, m("echoTone")), knob(id, m("echoWow")), knob(id, m("echoReturn"))]),
      section("Bus Compressor", "glue", [button(id, m("busOn"), "In", "small amber"), knob(id, m("busThreshold")), knob(id, m("busRatio")), knob(id, m("busAttack"))],
              [knob(id, m("busRelease")), knob(id, m("busMakeup")), knob(id, m("busMix"))]),
      section("Tape Machine", "tape", [button(id, m("tapeOn"), "In", "small amber"), knob(id, m("tapeDrive")), knob(id, m("tapeSpeed")), knob(id, m("tapeWow")),
                                       button(id, m("tapeHiss"), "Hiss", "small")])
    );

    const left = element("div", "bmaster-left");
    left.append(meterBridge, glue, modules);
    const right = element("div", "bmaster-right");
    right.append(element("span", "bmaster-name", "Master"), fader(id, m("masterVolume"), ledMeter("master")));
    holder.append(left, right);
    return holder;
  }

  /** The Tape Echo shows the note it's synced to, or its milliseconds. */
  function updateEchoTime() {
    const synced = valueOf("master", specs.master.get("echoSync") || { id: "echoSync", default: 1 }) >= 0.5;
    const box = document.querySelector("#board-master .echo-time");
    if (box) box.classList.toggle("free", !synced);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the board
  function render() {
    if (!shown) { renderDue = true; return; }
    if (dragging) { renderDue = true; return; }
    renderDue = false;

    const root = $("analog-board");
    root.classList.toggle("on", Boolean(board.mixing));
    const toggle = $("board-mixing");
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(Boolean(board.mixing)));
    $("board-note").textContent = board.mixing
      ? "The board mixes the song. Each track's dry sound comes in here; the Console's inserts, faders, sends and Main are left out."
      : "The Console mixes the song. Set the board up here, then switch it on to mix on it.";

    if (!specs.strip.size) return;

    // Keeps the strips where they're scrolled to.
    const strips = $("board-strips");
    const scrollLeft = strips.scrollLeft, scrollTop = strips.scrollTop;
    const focused = document.activeElement && document.activeElement.closest && document.activeElement.closest("#analog-board [data-board-param]");
    const focusKey = focused ? `${focused.dataset.boardStrip}|${focused.dataset.boardParam}` : "";

    meters.clear();
    const tracks = (Hub.state.tracks || []).filter((t) => t.kind === "instrument" || t.kind === "audio");
    strips.replaceChildren($("board-legend"), ...tracks.map(strip));   // the legend first: it stays at the left as they scroll
    if (!tracks.length) strips.appendChild(element("p", "board-empty", "Add an instrument or audio track: each one gets a strip here."));
    strips.scrollLeft = scrollLeft;
    strips.scrollTop = scrollTop;

    $("board-master").replaceChildren(master());
    updateEchoTime();

    if (focusKey) {
      const [s, p] = focusKey.split("|");
      const again = document.querySelector(`#analog-board [data-board-strip="${CSS.escape(s)}"][data-board-param="${CSS.escape(p)}"]`);
      if (again) again.focus();
    }
  }

  function renderLegend() {
    const legend = $("board-legend");
    if (legend.childElementCount) return;
    const rows = [["Preamp", "r-preamp"], ["Filter", "r-filter"], ["EQ", "r-eq"], ["Dynamics", "r-dyn"], ["Sends", "r-sends"], ["Pan", "r-pan"], ["", "r-buttons"], ["Fader", "r-fader"]];
    for (const [name, cls] of rows) legend.appendChild(element("span", `bl ${cls}`, name));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- meters
  const litCount = (vu) => STEPS.filter((step) => vu >= step).length;

  function feedMeters(levels) {
    if (!shown || !levels) return;
    const now = performance.now();
    const off = !board.mixing;

    const apply = (meter, reading) => {
      if (!meter || !reading) return;
      const [vuL, vuR, peakL, peakR, reduction] = off ? [-100, -100, -100, -100, 0] : reading;
      if (meter.columns) {
        [vuL, vuR].forEach((dbfs, side) => {
          const lit = litCount(dbfs - VU_ZERO_DBFS);
          if (lit !== meter.lit[side]) {
            meter.lit[side] = lit;
            meter.columns[side].style.setProperty("--lit", String(lit));
          }
        });
        if (Math.max(peakL, peakR) > -0.3) meter.clipUntil = now + 1200;
        const clipped = now < meter.clipUntil;
        if (clipped !== meter.clipped) { meter.clipped = clipped; meter.clip.classList.toggle("lit", clipped); }
      }
      if (meter.lights) {
        const lit = GR_STEPS.filter((step) => reduction >= step).length;
        if (lit !== meter.reductionLit) {
          meter.reductionLit = lit;
          meter.lights.forEach((light, i) => light.classList.toggle("lit", i < lit));
        }
      }
    };

    for (const [id, meter] of meters) apply(meter, id === "master" ? levels.master : (levels.strips || {})[String(id)]);

    // The VU needles: the master's sound, on a VU's scale (0 VU at -18 dBFS).
    if (levels.master) {
      vus.forEach((vu, side) => {
        const dbfs = off ? -100 : levels.master[side];
        const angle = Math.round(vu.angleOf(dbfs - VU_ZERO_DBFS) * 10) / 10;
        if (angle !== vu.shown) {
          vu.shown = angle;
          vu.needle.style.transform = `rotate(${angle}deg)`;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- from Sonify
  Hub.on("board", (data) => {
    board = { mixing: Boolean(data.mixing), specs: data.specs || board.specs, strips: data.strips || [], master: data.master || {} };
    // A value still on its way to Sonify stays as the page has it.
    for (const change of pending.values()) {
      const values = valuesOf(change.strip);
      if (values) values[change.id] = change.value;
    }
    specs.strip = new Map((board.specs.strip || []).map((spec) => [spec.id, spec]));
    specs.master = new Map((board.specs.master || []).map((spec) => [spec.id, spec]));
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("tracks", () => { if (shown) render(); else renderDue = true; });
  Hub.on("status", (status) => feedMeters(status.board));

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the tab
  function show(on) {
    if (on === shown) return;
    shown = on;
    if (!on) dragging = 0;   // nothing is held on a page that isn't shown
    $("analog-board").hidden = !on;
    Hub.send("board", { action: "shown", shown: on });
    if (on) {
      renderLegend();
      render();
    }
  }

  Hub.board = {
    show,
    isShown: () => shown,
    isMixing: () => Boolean(board.mixing),
    setMixing: (on) => Hub.send("board", { action: "mixing", on: Boolean(on) }),
    /** For MIDI Link: whether a board key ("board.<n>.<setting>") is a knob or fader (not a button). */
    isContinuous(key) {
      const parts = String(key).split(".");
      const spec = parts[1] === "master" ? specs.master.get(parts[2]) : specs.strip.get(parts[2]);
      return Boolean(spec) && spec.kind !== "toggle";
    },
    /** "Board · Track 2 (Piano) · HMF", "Board · Master · Return". */
    targetText(key) {
      const parts = String(key).split(".");
      const spec = parts[1] === "master" ? specs.master.get(parts[2]) : specs.strip.get(parts[2]);
      const track = parts[1] === "master" ? null : (Hub.state.tracks || []).find((t) => t.number === Number(parts[1]));
      const where = parts[1] === "master" ? "Master" : `Track ${parts[1]}${track ? ` (${track.name})` : ""}`;
      const section = spec && spec.section && spec.section !== "Fader" && spec.section !== "Master" ? `${spec.section} ` : "";
      return `Board · ${where} · ${section}${spec ? spec.name : parts[2]}`;
    }
  };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    $("board-mixing").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.board.setMixing(!board.mixing));
    $("board-copy").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("board", { action: "copyConsole" }));
    $("board-reset").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      Hub.popupMenu(event.currentTarget, [
        { group: "Put every strip and the master back where they start?" },
        { label: "Reset the board", value: true },
        { label: "Keep it", value: false }
      ], (yes) => { if (yes) Hub.send("board", { action: "resetAll" }); });
    });
  });
})();
