// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-browser.js
//
// The Browser on the right, as in Studio One: instruments and effects from the library
// database, sorted Flat, by Folder, by Vendor or by Type, with Favorites and Recent at
// the top, and search across names, vendors, types and plugin features.
//
//   Drag an item onto a track, a Console strip or the Inspector's inserts, or into the
//   empty space below the tracks to make a new track. Double-click: an instrument makes
//   a new track; an effect joins the inserts of the channel in the Inspector.
//   Right-click an item: favorite, show its file, remove it from the Browser.
//   Plugin Folders (the folder button) are searched for WCLAPs at startup and on Rescan;
//   a plugin whose file has gone shows greyed out until it's back.
//   Files: folders and audio files, from places like Music or the song's Media folder.
//   Preview a file, see its format, double-click it (or Import) to put it on the selected
//   audio track at the playhead, or drag it onto the arrangement.
//   MIDI: the MIDI tools, built in and Magenta's (hub-miditools.js).

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const BUILTIN = { builtin: true, file: "", id: "test-synth", name: "Test Synth", vendor: "Built-in", kind: "instrument",
                    category: "Synth", folder: "Built-in", features: ["instrument", "synthesizer"] };
  const KIND_TEXT = { instrument: "Instrument", effect: "Effect", noteEffect: "Note FX" };
  const RECENT_COUNT = 10;
  // Third-party plugins off for this run (the question at startup): only Sonify's own are offered.
  const OWN_ONLY = "Only Sonify's internal plugins this time. To use your own plugins, restart Sonify and choose Yes.";
  const ownOnly = () => library.thirdParty === false;
  let hint = "";   // the usual hint, as the page has it

  let tab = "instruments";
  let sortBy = "vendor";
  let query = "";
  let chosenKey = "";
  let library = { folders: [], scan: { active: false } };
  let listing = { path: "", parent: "", folders: [], files: [], places: [] };
  let chosenFile = "", fileInfo = null, listed = false;
  // Groups start closed (and close again when a song opens); while searching, all show open.
  const opened = new Set();
  const isOpen = (key) => opened.has(key) || query.trim() !== "";

  const keyOf = (entry) => entry.builtin ? "builtin" : `${entry.file}|${entry.id}`;
  // Built into Sonify: the Test Synth (the page's own) and Sonify's own effects (the engine's).
  const isBuiltin = (entry) => Boolean(entry.builtin) || entry.format === "Built-in";
  const typeOf = (entry) => entry.category || KIND_TEXT[entry.kind] || "Plugin";
  const inTab = (entry) => tab === "effects" ? entry.kind === "effect" : entry.kind !== "effect";
  const byName = (a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });   // "Synth 2" before "Synth 10"

  function matches(entry, text) {
    if (!text) return true;
    return [entry.name, entry.vendor, typeOf(entry), ...(entry.features || [])].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(text);
  }

  function entriesForTab() {
    const text = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return [BUILTIN, ...Hub.state.library].filter(inTab)
                                          .filter((entry) => matches(entry, text))
                                          .sort((a, b) => byName(a.name, b.name));
  }

  function groupOf(entry) {
    if (sortBy === "folder") return entry.builtin ? "Built-in" : entry.folder || "Added files";
    if (sortBy === "type") return typeOf(entry);
    return entry.vendor;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- items
  function showMenu(entry, x, y) {
    const sameFile = Hub.state.library.filter((other) => other.file === entry.file).length;
    const at = { getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: x, right: x, top: y, bottom: y }) };

    const favorite = { label: entry.favorite ? "Remove from Favorites" : "Add to Favorites", value: "favorite" };

    // Sonify's own effects have no file of their own to show or remove.
    Hub.popupMenu(at, isBuiltin(entry) ? [favorite] : [
      favorite,
      { label: "Show in Explorer", value: "reveal", disabled: entry.missing },
      { label: sameFile > 1 ? `Remove ${entry.fileName} from Browser (${sameFile} plugins)` : "Remove from Browser", value: "remove" }
    ], (value) => {
      if (value === "favorite") Hub.send("setFavorite", { file: entry.file, id: entry.id, favorite: !entry.favorite });
      if (value === "reveal") Hub.send("revealLibraryFile", { file: entry.file });
      if (value === "remove") { chosenKey = ""; Hub.send("removeLibraryFile", { file: entry.file }); }
    });
  }

  function itemFor(entry, nested) {
    const item = element("div", "browser-item" + (nested ? " nested" : "") + (entry.missing ? " missing" : ""));
    item.draggable = !entry.missing;
    item.dataset.key = keyOf(entry);
    item.setAttribute("role", "option");
    item.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(keyOf(entry) === chosenKey));
    item.appendChild(element("span", "browser-icon " + (entry.kind === "effect" ? "fx" : "inst")));
    item.appendChild(element("span", "browser-label", entry.name));
    if (entry.format === "VST3") item.appendChild(element("span", "browser-format", "VST3"));
    if (entry.format === "Sonify") item.appendChild(element("span", "browser-format made", "Made"));   // in the Plugins Creator Studio
    if (entry.favorite) item.appendChild(element("span", "browser-star", "★"));
    item.title = isBuiltin(entry) ? "Built into Sonify"
               : entry.missing ? `File not found: ${entry.file}`
               : `${entry.vendor} · ${typeOf(entry)} · ${entry.fileName || ""}`;

    item.addEventListener("click", () => {
      chosenKey = keyOf(entry);
      render();
    });

    item.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
      if (entry.missing) return;

      if (entry.kind !== "effect") {
        Hub.dropEntryOn(entry, null);
        return;
      }

      const channel = Hub.state.inspectMain ? Hub.MAIN : (Hub.selectedTrack() ? Hub.state.selected : null);
      Hub.dropEntryOn(entry, channel);
    });

    item.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (entry.builtin) return;
      chosenKey = keyOf(entry);
      render();
      showMenu(entry, event.clientX, event.clientY);
    });

    item.addEventListener("dragstart", (event) => {
      Hub.dragEntry = entry;
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", entry.name);
    });

    item.addEventListener("dragend", () => { Hub.dragEntry = null; });
    return item;
  }

  function folderRow(key, label, count, extraClass = "") {
    const folder = element("div", "browser-folder" + extraClass);
    folder.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen(key)));
    folder.appendChild(element("span", "browser-caret"));
    folder.appendChild(element("span", "browser-label", label));
    folder.appendChild(element("span", "browser-count", String(count)));
    folder.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (opened.has(key)) opened.delete(key);
      else opened.add(key);
      render();
    });
    return folder;
  }

  function addGroup(list, key, label, entries, extraClass) {
    list.appendChild(folderRow(key, label, entries.length, extraClass));
    if (isOpen(key))
      for (const entry of entries) list.appendChild(itemFor(entry, true));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the list, the info, the scan
  function renderInfo(entries) {
    const entry = entries.find((item) => keyOf(item) === chosenKey);
    const info = $("browser-info");
    info.hidden = !entry;
    if (!entry) return;

    $("info-icon").className = "browser-icon large " + (entry.kind === "effect" ? "fx" : "inst");
    $("info-name").textContent = entry.name;
    $("info-vendor").textContent = `Vendor: ${entry.vendor}`;
    $("info-kind").textContent = `Category: ${entry.builtin ? "Built-in" : entry.format || "WCLAP"} · ${typeOf(entry)}`;
    $("info-file").textContent = isBuiltin(entry) ? ""
                               : entry.missing ? `${entry.fileName || ""} (file not found)`
                               : [entry.version ? `Version ${entry.version}` : "", entry.fileName || ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    $("info-favorite").hidden = Boolean(entry.builtin);
    $("info-favorite").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(Boolean(entry.favorite)));
    $("info-favorite").onclick = () => Hub.send("setFavorite", { file: entry.file, id: entry.id, favorite: !entry.favorite });
    $("info-remove").hidden = isBuiltin(entry);
    $("info-remove").onclick = () => {
      chosenKey = "";
      Hub.send("removeLibraryFile", { file: entry.file });
    };
  }

  function renderScan() {
    const scan = library.scan || {};
    $("browser-scan").hidden = !scan.active;
    if (!scan.active) return;
    $("browser-scan-text").textContent = `Scanning ${Math.min(scan.done + 1, scan.total)} of ${scan.total}: ${scan.current || ""}`;
    $("browser-scan-bar").style.width = `${scan.total ? (100 * scan.done) / scan.total : 0}%`;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Files
  const openFolder = (path) => Hub.send("listFolder", { path });

  function importFile(path) {
    const track = Hub.selectedTrack();
    Hub.send("importAudio", { file: path, trackId: track && track.kind === "audio" ? track.id : 0, start: Hub.songPosition() });
  }

  function togglePreview(path) {
    const status = Hub.state.status;
    if (status && status.previewing === path) Hub.send("stopPreview");
    else Hub.send("previewAudio", { path });
  }

  function fileRow(item, folder) {
    const row = element("div", "browser-item file-row" + (folder ? " folder" : ""));
    row.dataset.path = item.path;
    row.setAttribute("role", "option");
    row.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(item.path === chosenFile));
    row.appendChild(element("span", "file-icon", folder ? "📁" : item.video ? "🎞" : "♪"));
    row.appendChild(element("span", "browser-label", item.name));

    if (folder) {
      row.addEventListener("click", () => { chosenFile = item.path; render(); });
      row.addEventListener("dblclick", () => openFolder(item.path));
      return row;
    }

    // A video: no preview here; double-click or drag it to make it the song's video.
    if (!item.video) {
      const previewing = Hub.state.status && Hub.state.status.previewing === item.path;
      const play = element("button", "file-play", previewing ? "■" : "▶");
      play.type = "button";
      play.title = previewing ? "Stop the preview" : "Preview";
      play.setAttribute("aria-label", previewing ? `Stop ${item.name}` : `Preview ${item.name}`);
      play.addEventListener("click", (event) => { event.stopPropagation(); togglePreview(item.path); });
      row.appendChild(play);
    }

    row.draggable = true;
    row.title = item.path;

    row.addEventListener("click", () => {
      chosenFile = item.path;
      fileInfo = item.video ? { path: item.path, video: true } : null;
      if (!item.video) Hub.send("audioFileInfo", { path: item.path });
      render();
    });
    row.addEventListener("dblclick", () => importFile(item.path));
    row.addEventListener("dragstart", (event) => {
      Hub.dragFile = { path: item.path, name: item.name };
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", item.name);
    });
    row.addEventListener("dragend", () => { Hub.dragFile = null; });
    return row;
  }

  function describe(info) {
    if (info && info.video) return "Video: double-click it, or drag it onto the arrangement, to make it the song's video";
    if (!info || !info.rate) return "Can't read this file";
    const minutes = Math.floor(info.length / 60), seconds = (info.length - minutes * 60).toFixed(1).padStart(4, "0");
    const channels = info.channels === 1 ? "Mono" : info.channels === 2 ? "Stereo" : `${info.channels} channels`;
    return `${info.format} · ${(info.rate / 1000).toFixed(1)} kHz · ${info.float ? "32 bit float" : info.bits + " bit"} · ${channels} · ${minutes}:${seconds}`;
  }

  function renderFiles() {
    if (!listed) { listed = true; openFolder(""); }

    const places = $("files-places");
    places.textContent = "";
    places.add(new Option(listing.path || "…", listing.path || ""));
    for (const place of listing.places || []) places.add(new Option(place.name, place.path));
    places.value = listing.path || "";
    $("files-up").disabled = !listing.parent;
    $("files-path").textContent = listing.path;

    const text = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const keep = (item) => !text || item.name.toLowerCase().includes(text);
    const list = $("files-list");
    list.textContent = "";
    for (const folder of (listing.folders || []).filter(keep)) list.appendChild(fileRow(folder, true));
    for (const file of (listing.files || []).filter(keep)) list.appendChild(fileRow(file, false));
    $("files-none").hidden = list.children.length > 0;

    const chosen = (listing.files || []).find((file) => file.path === chosenFile);
    $("files-info").hidden = !chosen;
    if (chosen) {
      $("files-info-name").textContent = chosen.name;
      $("files-info-format").textContent = fileInfo && fileInfo.path === chosen.path ? describe(fileInfo) : "…";
      const previewing = Hub.state.status && Hub.state.status.previewing === chosen.path;
      $("files-preview").textContent = previewing ? "Stop" : "Preview";
      $("files-preview").hidden = Boolean(chosen.video);
    }
  }

  function render() {
    $("browser").classList.toggle("files", tab === "files");
    $("browser").classList.toggle("fanan", tab === "fanan");
    $("browser").classList.toggle("midi", tab === "midi");
    Hub.emit("browserTab", tab);
    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-browser-tab]"))
      button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(button.dataset.browserTab === tab));

    if (tab === "files") {
      renderFiles();
      return;
    }

    if (tab === "fanan") {
      Hub.emit("contentTab");   // hub-content.js draws it
      return;
    }

    if (tab === "midi") {
      Hub.emit("midiTab");      // hub-miditools.js draws it
      return;
    }

    const entries = entriesForTab();
    const list = $("browser-list");
    list.textContent = "";

    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-sort]"))
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(button.dataset.sort === sortBy));

    // Favorites and Recent come first, as in Studio One (not while searching, and only when not empty).
    if (!query.trim()) {
      const favorites = entries.filter((entry) => entry.favorite);
      const recent = entries.filter((entry) => entry.lastUsed > 0).sort((a, b) => b.lastUsed - a.lastUsed).slice(0, RECENT_COUNT);
      if (favorites.length) addGroup(list, "special:favorites", "Favorites", favorites, " special favorites");
      if (recent.length) addGroup(list, "special:recent", "Recent", recent, " special recent");
    }

    if (sortBy === "flat") {
      for (const entry of entries) list.appendChild(itemFor(entry, false));
    } else {
      const groups = new Map();

      for (const entry of entries) {
        const group = groupOf(entry);
        if (!groups.has(group)) groups.set(group, []);
        groups.get(group).push(entry);
      }

      const order = [...groups.keys()].sort((a, b) => (a === "Built-in") - (b === "Built-in") || byName(a, b));
      for (const group of order) addGroup(list, `${sortBy}:${group}`, group, groups.get(group), "");
    }

    const onlyBuiltin = Hub.state.library.length === 0;
    if (!hint) hint = $("browser-hint").textContent;
    $("browser-hint").textContent = ownOnly() ? OWN_ONLY : hint;
    $("browser-hint").hidden = (!onlyBuiltin && !ownOnly()) || query !== "";
    for (const id of ["browser-add", "browser-folders", "browser-rescan"]) $(id).hidden = ownOnly();
    $("browser-none").hidden = entries.length > 0;
    renderInfo(entries);
    renderScan();
  }

  // While third-party plugins are off, adding and rescanning them wait for the next start.
  // (The Plugin Folders are in File > Settings > Locations > Plug-ins: hub-settings.js.)
  const withThirdParty = (run) => () => ownOnly() ? Hub.toast(OWN_ONLY) : run();
  Hub.commands.addLibraryFiles = withThirdParty(() => Hub.send("addLibraryFiles"));
  Hub.commands.rescanLibrary = withThirdParty(() => Hub.send("rescanLibrary", { full: true }));

  Hub.on("library", (data) => {
    library = data;
    for (const command of ["addLibraryFiles", "rescanLibrary"])
      for (const item of document.querySelectorAll(`[data-command="${command}"]`)) item.disabled = ownOnly();
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("folderListing", (data) => {
    listing = data;
    chosenFile = "";
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("audioFileInfo", (info) => {
    fileInfo = info;
    if (tab === "files") render();
  });

  // The preview buttons follow what's playing.
  let previewing = "";
  Hub.on("status", (s) => {
    if ((s.previewing || "") === previewing) return;
    previewing = s.previewing || "";
    if (tab === "files") render();
  });

  Hub.on("song", (data) => {
    if (!data.opened) return;
    opened.clear();
    render();
  });

  Hub.commands.importAudioFiles = () => Hub.send("importAudioFiles");

  /** Shows one of the Browser's tabs (instruments, effects, files, fanan, midi). */
  Hub.showBrowserTab = (name) => {
    tab = name;
    render();
  };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-browser-tab]")) {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        tab = button.dataset.browserTab;
        render();
      });
    }

    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-sort]")) {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sortBy = button.dataset.sort;
        render();
      });
    }

    $("browser-search").addEventListener("input", (event) => {
      query = event.target.value;
      render();
    });

    $("browser-add").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("addLibraryFiles"));
    $("files-places").addEventListener("change", (event) => { openFolder(event.target.value); event.target.blur(); });
    $("files-up").addEventListener("click", () => { if (listing.parent) openFolder(listing.parent); });
    $("files-preview").addEventListener("click", () => { if (chosenFile) togglePreview(chosenFile); });
    $("files-import").addEventListener("click", () => { if (chosenFile) importFile(chosenFile); });
    $("browser-folders").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("pluginFolders"));
    $("browser-rescan").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("rescanLibrary"));

    render();
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-choir.js
//
// The Choir window: a choir track's voices (Choir.h), opened from the choir icon on its header.
// A choir track is an audio track whose clips (a vocal) sing as a choir as well, live as the song
// plays (Sonify reads the clips a little ahead, so the voices line up with the vocal exactly).
//   Lead voice    whether the vocal is a man's or a woman's (women's voices are made from a man's
//                 with their resonances raised, and the other way round)
//   Lead          the vocal itself in the mix (Off: the choir alone)
//   Choir, Spread, Hall    the voices together: their level, how wide, and their room
//   Timing, Pitch, Vibrato humanize: each singer a little late or early, a little off and drifting,
//                 with a vibrato of their own
//   Chords from   an instrument track whose notes give the chords (for the Chord parts)
//   A row per voice (up to 16): Man or Woman (switching moves its octave too), Character (darker
//   or brighter), the part (Scale: steps of the song's key from the note sung; Chord: chord notes
//   from it; Semitones: a fixed interval), Octave, Level, Pan, M(ute) and S(olo), and remove.
// Presets put in a whole choir, laid out around the lead's voice; Save keeps the choir as one of
// yours (on this computer). Changes are heard at once; they're saved with the song (they aren't
// Undo steps, as a plugin's knobs aren't).

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const MAX_VOICES = 16;
  const LEAD_OFF = -60;
  const STORE = "sonify.choirPresets";

  // Who sings, relative to the lead: "same" or "other" gender, or a fixed one.
  const v = (g, mode, interval, octave, pan, level = 0) => ({ g, mode, interval, octave, pan, level });
  const PRESETS = [
    { name: "Double Track", timing: 0.6, pitch: 0.3, vibrato: 0, hall: 0.1, spread: 1, lead: 0,
      voices: [v("same", "semitones", 0, 0, -0.75, -3), v("same", "semitones", 0, 0, 0.75, -3)] },
    { name: "Wide Double (4 voices)", timing: 0.8, pitch: 0.4, vibrato: 0.1, hall: 0.15, spread: 1, lead: 0,
      voices: [v("same", "semitones", 0, 0, -1, -4), v("same", "semitones", 0, 0, -0.4, -4), v("same", "semitones", 0, 0, 0.4, -4), v("same", "semitones", 0, 0, 1, -4)] },
    { name: "Thirds", timing: 0.4, pitch: 0.3, vibrato: 0.15, hall: 0.2, spread: 0.8, lead: 0,
      voices: [v("same", "scale", 2, 0, -0.5), v("same", "scale", -2, 0, 0.5)] },
    { name: "Octaves", timing: 0.4, pitch: 0.3, vibrato: 0.1, hall: 0.2, spread: 0.7, lead: 0,
      voices: [v("same", "semitones", 0, 1, -0.4, -2), v("same", "semitones", 0, -1, 0.4, -2)] },
    { name: "Women's Trio", timing: 0.5, pitch: 0.4, vibrato: 0.2, hall: 0.25, spread: 0.8, lead: 0,
      voices: [v("female", "scale", 2, 0, -0.6), v("female", "scale", 0, 0, 0), v("female", "scale", -3, 0, 0.6)] },
    { name: "Men's Choir", timing: 0.5, pitch: 0.4, vibrato: 0.2, hall: 0.3, spread: 0.8, lead: 0,
      voices: [v("male", "scale", 2, 0, -0.6), v("male", "scale", 0, 0, -0.2), v("male", "scale", -3, 0, 0.2), v("male", "scale", 0, -1, 0.6, -2)] },
    { name: "Mixed Choir (SATB)", timing: 0.5, pitch: 0.4, vibrato: 0.2, hall: 0.3, spread: 0.8, lead: 0,
      voices: [v("female", "scale", 2, 0, -0.6), v("female", "scale", 0, 0, 0.6), v("male", "scale", 2, 0, -0.25), v("male", "scale", -3, 0, 0.25)] },
    { name: "Gospel (6 voices)", timing: 0.6, pitch: 0.4, vibrato: 0.25, hall: 0.3, spread: 0.9, lead: 0,
      voices: [v("female", "scale", 2, 0, -0.8), v("female", "scale", 0, 0, -0.5), v("female", "scale", -3, 0, -0.2),
               v("male", "scale", 2, 0, 0.2), v("male", "scale", 0, 0, 0.5), v("male", "scale", -3, 0, 0.8)] },
    { name: "Chord Pad (follows the chords)", timing: 0.5, pitch: 0.3, vibrato: 0.15, hall: 0.35, spread: 0.9, lead: 0,
      voices: [v("same", "chord", 1, 0, -0.6), v("same", "chord", 2, 0, 0.6), v("same", "chord", -1, 0, 0)] },
    { name: "Big Choir (12 voices)", timing: 0.7, pitch: 0.5, vibrato: 0.25, hall: 0.4, spread: 1, lead: -6,
      voices: [v("female", "scale", 2, 0, -1, -2), v("female", "scale", 2, 0, -0.6, -2), v("female", "scale", 0, 0, -0.3, -2),
               v("female", "scale", 0, 0, 0.3, -2), v("female", "scale", -3, 0, 0.6, -2), v("female", "scale", -3, 0, 1, -2),
               v("male", "scale", 2, 0, -0.9, -2), v("male", "scale", 2, 0, -0.5, -2), v("male", "scale", 0, 0, -0.15, -2),
               v("male", "scale", 0, 0, 0.15, -2), v("male", "scale", -3, 0, 0.5, -2), v("male", "scale", -3, 0, 0.9, -2)] }
  ];

  let trackId = 0;
  let state = null;              // the settings as the window shows them
  let sentJson = "";
  let sendTimer = 0;
  let sentAt = 0;
  let dragging = null;

  const clamp = (x, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, x));
  const copy = (x) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));

  /** An octave a voice sits at for its gender against the lead's: a woman's an octave up from a
      man's lead, a man's an octave down from a woman's. */
  const octaveFor = (female, leadFemale) => (female && !leadFemale ? 1 : !female && leadFemale ? -1 : 0);

  function normalise(raw) {
    const s = Object.assign({ leadFemale: false, lead: 0, choir: 0, spread: 0.8, timing: 0.5, pitch: 0.4, vibrato: 0.2, hall: 0.25, chordTrack: 0, voices: [] }, raw || {});
    s.voices = (Array.isArray(s.voices) ? s.voices : []).slice(0, MAX_VOICES).map((voice) =>
      Object.assign({ female: false, character: 0, mode: "scale", interval: 0, octave: 0, level: 0, pan: 0, mute: false, solo: false }, voice));
    return s;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- telling Sonify
  function send(now) {
    if (!state || !trackId) return;
    clearTimeout(sendTimer);
    const go = () => {
      sendTimer = 0;
      const json = JSON.stringify(state);
      if (json === sentJson) return;
      sentJson = json;
      sentAt = Date.now();
      Hub.send("choirSettings", { id: trackId, settings: copy(state) });
      const track = Hub.trackById(trackId);
      if (track) track.choir = copy(state);   // until Sonify sends the tracks again
    };
    if (now) go(); else sendTimer = setTimeout(go, 40);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- presets
  function userPresets() {
    try {
      const kept = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "[]");
      return Array.isArray(kept) ? kept.filter((p) => p && typeof p.name === "string" && p.settings) : [];
    } catch (error) { return []; }
  }

  function keepUserPresets(list) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(list)); } catch (error) { Hub.toast("Presets can't be kept on this computer."); }
  }

  function applyPreset(preset) {
    const leadFemale = state.leadFemale;
    const voices = preset.voices.map((p, i) => {
      const female = p.g === "female" || (p.g === "same" && leadFemale) || (p.g === "other" && !leadFemale);
      return { female, character: 0, mode: p.mode, interval: p.interval, octave: clamp(p.octave + octaveFor(female, leadFemale), -2, 2),
               level: p.level || 0, pan: p.pan, mute: false, solo: false };
    });
    Object.assign(state, { lead: preset.lead, timing: preset.timing, pitch: preset.pitch, vibrato: preset.vibrato, hall: preset.hall, spread: preset.spread, voices });
    render();
    send(true);
  }

  function fillPresets() {
    const select = $("choir-preset");
    select.textContent = "";
    select.add(new Option("Presets\u2026", ""));
    const builtIn = element("optgroup");
    builtIn.label = "Sonify";
    PRESETS.forEach((preset, i) => builtIn.appendChild(new Option(preset.name, `b${i}`)));
    select.appendChild(builtIn);
    const mine = userPresets();
    if (mine.length) {
      const group = element("optgroup");
      group.label = "Yours";
      mine.forEach((preset, i) => group.appendChild(new Option(preset.name, `u${i}`)));
      select.appendChild(group);
    }
    select.value = "";
    $("choir-delete").hidden = true;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the window
  const pct = (x) => `${Math.round(x * 100)} %`;
  const db = (x) => (x <= LEAD_OFF ? "Off" : `${x > 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(x * 10) / 10} dB`);

  const GLOBALS = [
    // id, key, min, max, step, scale (slider value -> setting), text
    ["lead", "lead", LEAD_OFF, 6, 0.5, 1, db, 0],
    ["choir", "choir", -36, 12, 0.5, 1, db, 0],
    ["spread", "spread", 0, 100, 1, 0.01, pct, 0.8],
    ["hall", "hall", 0, 100, 1, 0.01, pct, 0.25],
    ["timing", "timing", 0, 100, 1, 0.01, pct, 0.5],
    ["pitch", "pitch", 0, 100, 1, 0.01, pct, 0.4],
    ["vibrato", "vibrato", 0, 100, 1, 0.01, pct, 0.2]
  ];

  function intervalOptions(select, mode, value) {
    const signature = mode;
    if (select.dataset.mode !== signature) {
      select.dataset.mode = signature;
      select.textContent = "";
      if (mode === "semitones") {
        for (let i = 24; i >= -24; i--) select.add(new Option(i === 0 ? "Unison" : `${i > 0 ? "+" : ""}${i} semitone${Math.abs(i) === 1 ? "" : "s"}`, String(i)));
      } else if (mode === "chord") {
        for (let i = 4; i >= -4; i--) select.add(new Option(i === 0 ? "Unison" : `${Math.abs(i)} chord note${Math.abs(i) === 1 ? "" : "s"} ${i > 0 ? "above" : "below"}`, String(i)));
      } else {
        const names = ["Unison", "2nd", "3rd", "4th", "5th", "6th", "7th", "Octave"];
        for (let i = 7; i >= -7; i--) select.add(new Option(i === 0 ? names[0] : `${names[Math.abs(i)]} ${i > 0 ? "above" : "below"}`, String(i)));
      }
    }
    select.value = String(value);
  }

  const limitFor = (mode) => (mode === "semitones" ? 24 : mode === "chord" ? 4 : 7);

  function voiceRow(voice, index) {
    const row = element("div", "choir-voice");
    row.dataset.index = String(index);
    row.innerHTML = `
      <span class="choir-num">${index + 1}</span>
      <span class="choir-gender" role="group" aria-label="Voice">
        <button type="button" data-g="male" title="A man's voice">Man</button><button type="button" data-g="female" title="A woman's voice (switching moves its octave too)">Woman</button>
      </span>
      <input class="choir-character" type="range" min="-100" max="100" step="1" title="Character: darker (left) or brighter (right). Double-click: as it is" aria-label="Character">
      <select class="choir-mode" aria-label="Part" title="Scale: steps of the song's key from the note sung. Chord: chord notes from it (Chords from). Semitones: a fixed interval">
        <option value="scale">Scale</option><option value="chord">Chord</option><option value="semitones">Semitones</option>
      </select>
      <select class="choir-interval" aria-label="Interval"></select>
      <select class="choir-octave" aria-label="Octave">
        <option value="2">2 oct. up</option><option value="1">1 oct. up</option><option value="0">No octave</option><option value="-1">1 oct. down</option><option value="-2">2 oct. down</option>
      </select>
      <span class="choir-level"><input type="range" min="-36" max="6" step="0.5" aria-label="Level" title="Level (double-click: 0 dB)"><output></output></span>
      <input class="choir-pan" type="range" min="-100" max="100" step="1" aria-label="Pan" title="Pan (double-click: centre)">
      <button type="button" class="tbtn choir-mute" title="Mute this voice">M</button>
      <button type="button" class="tbtn choir-solo" title="Solo: hear this voice (and other soloed ones) alone">S</button>
      <button type="button" class="choir-remove" title="Remove this voice" aria-label="Remove">\u00d7</button>`;
    return row;
  }

  function updateRow(row, voice) {
    for (const button of row.querySelectorAll(".choir-gender button"))
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String((button.dataset.g === "female") === voice.female));
    const character = row.querySelector(".choir-character");
    if (document.activeElement !== character) character.value = String(Math.round(voice.character * 100));
    row.querySelector(".choir-mode").value = voice.mode;
    intervalOptions(row.querySelector(".choir-interval"), voice.mode, voice.interval);
    row.querySelector(".choir-octave").value = String(voice.octave);
    const level = row.querySelector(".choir-level input");
    if (document.activeElement !== level) level.value = String(voice.level);
    row.querySelector(".choir-level output").textContent = db(voice.level);
    const pan = row.querySelector(".choir-pan");
    if (document.activeElement !== pan) pan.value = String(Math.round(voice.pan * 100));
    pan.title = `Pan: ${voice.pan === 0 ? "centre" : `${Math.round(Math.abs(voice.pan) * 100)} % ${voice.pan < 0 ? "left" : "right"}`} (double-click: centre)`;
    row.querySelector(".choir-mute").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(voice.mute));
    row.querySelector(".choir-solo").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(voice.solo));
  }

  function renderVoices() {
    const list = $("choir-voices");
    const rows = [...list.querySelectorAll(".choir-voice:not(.choir-voice-head)")];
    while (rows.length > state.voices.length) rows.pop().remove();
    while (rows.length < state.voices.length) {
      const row = voiceRow(state.voices[rows.length], rows.length);
      list.appendChild(row);
      rows.push(row);
    }
    rows.forEach((row, i) => { row.dataset.index = String(i); row.querySelector(".choir-num").textContent = String(i + 1); updateRow(row, state.voices[i]); });
    $("choir-add").disabled = state.voices.length >= MAX_VOICES;
    $("choir-count").textContent = `${state.voices.length} of ${MAX_VOICES} voices`;
    $("choir-empty").hidden = state.voices.length > 0;
  }

  function chordOptions() {
    const select = $("choir-chords");
    const tracks = Hub.state.tracks.filter((t) => t.kind === "instrument");
    const signature = tracks.map((t) => `${t.id}:${t.name}`).join("|");
    if (select.dataset.signature !== signature) {
      select.dataset.signature = signature;
      select.textContent = "";
      select.add(new Option("None (thirds of the key)", "0"));
      for (const t of tracks) select.add(new Option(`${t.number}. ${t.name}`, String(t.id)));
    }
    select.value = [...select.options].some((o) => o.value === String(state.chordTrack)) ? String(state.chordTrack) : "0";
  }

  function render() {
    if (!state) return;
    const track = Hub.trackById(trackId);
    $("choir-track").textContent = track ? track.name : "";
    $("choir-lead-gender").value = state.leadFemale ? "female" : "male";
    for (const [id, key, , , , scale, text] of GLOBALS) {
      const input = $(`choir-${id}`);
      if (document.activeElement !== input) input.value = String(state[key] / scale);
      $(`choir-${id}-value`).textContent = text(state[key]);
    }
    chordOptions();
    renderVoices();
  }

  function open(id) {
    const track = Hub.trackById(id);
    if (!track || !track.choir) return;
    trackId = id;
    state = normalise(copy(track.choir));
    sentJson = JSON.stringify(state);
    const panel = $("choir-window");
    const wasHidden = panel.hidden;
    panel.hidden = false;
    fillPresets();
    render();
    // Centred the first time; afterwards where it was left, kept on screen (the window may have
    // been made smaller meanwhile).
    const width = panel.offsetWidth || 900;
    if (wasHidden && !panel.dataset.placed) {
      panel.style.left = `${Math.max(8, Math.round((window.innerWidth - width) / 2))}px`;
      panel.style.top = `${Math.max(8, Math.round(window.innerHeight * 0.12))}px`;
      panel.style.right = "auto";
      panel.dataset.placed = "1";
    } else {
      keepOnScreen();
    }
  }

  function keepOnScreen() {
    const panel = $("choir-window");
    if (panel.hidden) return;
    const r = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    panel.style.left = `${Math.round(clamp(r.left, 8, Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - r.width - 8)))}px`;
    panel.style.top = `${Math.round(clamp(r.top, 8, Math.max(8, window.innerHeight - r.height - 8)))}px`;
    panel.style.right = "auto";
  }

  function close() {
    send(true);
    const panel = $("choir-window");
    if (panel.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    panel.hidden = true;
    trackId = 0;
    state = null;
  }

  const isOpen = () => !$("choir-window").hidden && state !== null;

  Hub.choir = { open, close, isOpen, presets: PRESETS, trackId: () => trackId, settings: () => (state ? copy(state) : null) };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- wiring
  function voiceAt(target) {
    const row = target.closest(".choir-voice");
    if (!row || row.classList.contains("choir-voice-head")) return null;
    const index = Number(row.dataset.index);
    return state && state.voices[index] ? { row, index, voice: state.voices[index] } : null;
  }

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const panel = $("choir-window");

    for (const [id, key, min, max, step, scale, text, reset] of GLOBALS) {
      const input = $(`choir-${id}`);
      Object.assign(input, { min: String(min), max: String(max), step: String(step) });
      const take = (final) => {
        if (!state) return;
        state[key] = clamp(Number(input.value) * scale, min * scale, max * scale);
        $(`choir-${id}-value`).textContent = text(state[key]);
        send(final);
      };
      input.addEventListener("input", () => take(false));
      input.addEventListener("change", () => take(true));
      input.addEventListener("dblclick", () => { if (!state) return; state[key] = reset; render(); send(true); });
    }

    $("choir-lead-gender").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      if (!state) return;
      const leadFemale = event.target.value === "female";
      // The voices keep where they sit against the lead: a woman's an octave up from a man's lead...
      for (const voice of state.voices)
        voice.octave = clamp(voice.octave + octaveFor(voice.female, leadFemale) - octaveFor(voice.female, state.leadFemale), -2, 2);
      state.leadFemale = leadFemale;
      render();
      send(true);
    });

    $("choir-chords").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      if (!state) return;
      state.chordTrack = Number(event.target.value) || 0;
      send(true);
    });

    $("choir-preset").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      const value = event.target.value;
      if (!state || !value) { $("choir-delete").hidden = true; return; }
      if (value[0] === "b") {
        applyPreset(PRESETS[Number(value.slice(1))]);
        event.target.value = "";
        return;
      }
      const preset = userPresets()[Number(value.slice(1))];
      if (preset) {
        const chordTrack = state.chordTrack;
        state = normalise(copy(preset.settings));
        state.chordTrack = chordTrack;   // the chords stay this song's
        render();
        send(true);
      }
      $("choir-delete").hidden = false;
    });

    $("choir-delete").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const value = $("choir-preset").value;
      if (value[0] !== "u") return;
      const list = userPresets();
      list.splice(Number(value.slice(1)), 1);
      keepUserPresets(list);
      fillPresets();
    });

    $("choir-save").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const row = $("choir-save-row");
      row.hidden = !row.hidden;
      if (!row.hidden) { $("choir-save-name").value = ""; $("choir-save-name").focus(); }
    });

    const saveNamed = () => {
      const name = $("choir-save-name").value.trim().slice(0, 60);
      if (!name || !state) return;
      const list = userPresets().filter((p) => p.name !== name);
      const settings = copy(state);
      delete settings.chordTrack;
      list.push({ name, settings });
      list.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
      keepUserPresets(list);
      fillPresets();
      $("choir-save-row").hidden = true;
      Hub.toast(`Saved the choir as "${name}".`);
    };
    $("choir-save-ok").addEventListener("click", saveNamed);
    $("choir-save-name").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); saveNamed(); }
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.stopPropagation(); $("choir-save-row").hidden = true; }
    });

    $("choir-add").addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (!state || state.voices.length >= MAX_VOICES) return;
      const n = state.voices.length;
      const pan = n === 0 ? 0 : clamp((n % 2 ? 1 : -1) * (0.3 + 0.15 * Math.floor(n / 2)), -1, 1);
      state.voices.push({ female: state.leadFemale, character: 0, mode: "scale", interval: 0, octave: 0, level: 0, pan, mute: false, solo: false });
      render();
      send(true);
    });

    const list = $("choir-voices");
    list.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const at = voiceAt(event.target);
      if (!at) return;
      const { voice, index } = at;
      const gender = event.target.closest(".choir-gender button");
      if (gender) {
        const female = gender.dataset.g === "female";
        if (female !== voice.female) {
          voice.octave = clamp(voice.octave + octaveFor(female, state.leadFemale) - octaveFor(voice.female, state.leadFemale), -2, 2);
          voice.female = female;
        }
      } else if (event.target.closest(".choir-mute")) {
        voice.mute = !voice.mute;
      } else if (event.target.closest(".choir-solo")) {
        voice.solo = !voice.solo;
      } else if (event.target.closest(".choir-remove")) {
        state.voices.splice(index, 1);
      } else {
        return;
      }
      render();
      send(true);
    });

    list.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      const at = voiceAt(event.target);
      if (!at) return;
      const { voice, row } = at;
      const target = event.target;
      if (target.classList.contains("choir-mode")) {
        voice.mode = target.value;
        voice.interval = clamp(voice.interval, -limitFor(voice.mode), limitFor(voice.mode));
      } else if (target.classList.contains("choir-interval")) {
        voice.interval = Number(target.value) || 0;
      } else if (target.classList.contains("choir-octave")) {
        voice.octave = clamp(Number(target.value) || 0, -2, 2);
      } else if (target.type !== "range") {
        return;
      }
      updateRow(row, voice);
      send(true);
    });

    list.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
      const at = voiceAt(event.target);
      if (!at || event.target.type !== "range") return;
      const { voice, row } = at;
      const target = event.target;
      if (target.classList.contains("choir-character")) voice.character = clamp(Number(target.value) / 100, -1, 1);
      else if (target.classList.contains("choir-pan")) voice.pan = clamp(Number(target.value) / 100, -1, 1);
      else if (target.closest(".choir-level")) voice.level = clamp(Number(target.value), -36, 6);
      updateRow(row, voice);
      send(false);
    });

    list.addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => {
      const at = voiceAt(event.target);
      if (!at || event.target.type !== "range") return;
      const target = event.target;
      if (target.classList.contains("choir-character")) at.voice.character = 0;
      else if (target.classList.contains("choir-pan")) at.voice.pan = 0;
      else if (target.closest(".choir-level")) at.voice.level = 0;
      updateRow(at.row, at.voice);
      send(true);
    });

    $("choir-close").addEventListener("click", close);
    panel.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.stopPropagation(); close(); }
    });

    // Dragged by its title bar, kept on screen.
    const head = $("choir-head");
    head.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.button !== 0 || event.target.closest("button, select, input")) return;
      const r = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
      dragging = { x: event.clientX - r.left, y: event.clientY - r.top, pointer: event.pointerId };
      head.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      event.preventDefault();
    });
    head.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!dragging || event.pointerId !== dragging.pointer) return;
      const width = panel.offsetWidth;
      panel.style.left = `${Math.round(clamp(event.clientX - dragging.x, 80 - width, window.innerWidth - 80))}px`;
      panel.style.top = `${Math.round(clamp(event.clientY - dragging.y, 0, window.innerHeight - 40))}px`;
      panel.style.right = "auto";
    });
    window.addEventListener("resize", keepOnScreen);
    const stopDrag = () => { dragging = null; };
    head.addEventListener("pointerup", stopDrag);
    head.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", stopDrag);
  });

  // The track gone, or no longer a choir: the window closes. Otherwise it follows what Sonify
  // has (an undo, a song opened), unless a change of its own is on its way.
  Hub.on("tracks", () => {
    if (!isOpen()) return;
    const track = Hub.trackById(trackId);
    if (!track || !track.choir) { close(); return; }
    if (sendTimer || Date.now() - sentAt < 600) { render(); return; }
    const theirs = JSON.stringify(normalise(copy(track.choir)));
    if (theirs !== sentJson && theirs !== JSON.stringify(state)) {
      state = normalise(copy(track.choir));
      sentJson = theirs;
    }
    render();
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-cloud.js
//
// The Fanan account: the same account, and the same credits, as Stella AI Studio.
//   The account button (top right) opens it. Signing in happens on the Fanan site, in the
//   browser: Sonify asks Fanan's server for a one-time link, the site signs the user in (or
//   makes the account) and links this computer. From then on Sonify is signed in by itself
//   at every start, until the user signs out. No password is ever typed here.
//   The email box knows the email last signed in with on this computer: it's suggested on
//   hover (a click takes it), completed as it's typed, and greeted once it's there.
//   Fanan's content (the Browser's Fanan tab) needs no account: that's hub-content.js.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  let account = { configured: true, siteAvailable: true, status: "checking", statusText: "Connecting…", signedIn: false,
                  email: "", lastEmail: "", credits: -1, computer: "", busy: false, waiting: false };
  let askingSignOut = false;   // "Sign out?" is showing
  let signingOut = false;
  let typedEmail = "";         // what was last sent to sign in with (Open the browser again uses it)

  const online = () => account.status === "online";
  const creditsText = (count) => `${count} ${count === 1 ? "credit" : "credits"}`;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the account button
  function renderButton() {
    const button = $("account-button");
    const waiting = !account.signedIn && account.waiting;
    button.classList.toggle("signed-in", account.signedIn);
    button.classList.toggle("waiting", waiting);

    if (!account.configured) {
      button.textContent = "Account";
      button.title = "Fanan accounts aren't set up in this build yet";
    } else if (account.signedIn) {
      button.textContent = (account.email[0] || "?").toUpperCase();
      button.title = `Signed in as ${account.email}` + (account.credits >= 0 ? ` · ${creditsText(account.credits)}` : "");
    } else if (waiting) {
      button.textContent = "Signing in…";
      button.title = "Finish signing in in your browser";
    } else {
      button.textContent = "Sign in";
      button.title = "Sign in to your Fanan account to use Fanan AI";
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the account window
  function renderDialog() {
    const views = {
      missing: !account.configured,
      in: account.configured && account.signedIn,
      waiting: account.configured && !account.signedIn && account.waiting,
      out: account.configured && !account.signedIn && !account.waiting,
    };
    for (const [name, shown] of Object.entries(views)) $(`account-${name}`).hidden = !shown;

    // The connection, in one line, with Try again while it's down.
    $("account-connection").hidden = !account.configured;
    $("account-connection").dataset.status = account.status;
    $("account-connection-text").textContent = account.statusText || "";
    $("account-retry").hidden = account.status !== "noInternet" && account.status !== "serverDown";

    const canSignIn = online() && account.siteAvailable && !account.busy;
    $("account-signin").disabled = !canSignIn;
    $("account-signin").textContent = account.busy ? "Opening…" : "Sign in";
    $("account-again").disabled = !canSignIn;

    $("account-email-shown").textContent = account.email;
    $("account-signout-email").textContent = account.email;
    $("account-credits").textContent = account.credits >= 0 ? String(account.credits) : "–";
    $("account-credits-word").textContent = account.credits === 1 ? "credit" : "credits";
    $("account-buy").hidden = !account.siteAvailable;
    $("account-buy").disabled = !online();
    $("account-computer").textContent = account.computer ? `This computer: ${account.computer}` : "";
    $("account-computer").title = "For Fanan's support, if you ever need it";

    $("account-signout-ask").hidden = !askingSignOut;
    $("account-in-actions").hidden = askingSignOut;
    $("account-signout").disabled = !online() || signingOut;
    $("account-signout-yes").disabled = !online() || signingOut;
    $("account-signout-yes").textContent = signingOut ? "Signing out…" : "Sign out";
    greet();
  }

  function render() {
    renderButton();
    renderDialog();
  }

  function say(message, error) {
    const line = $("account-status");
    line.textContent = error || message || "";
    line.classList.toggle("error", Boolean(error));
  }

  function openAccount() {
    say("");
    askingSignOut = false;
    render();
    $("account-dialog").hidden = false;
    Hub.send("accountCheck");   // the credits as they are now
    // The keyboard goes into the window (so Escape and Enter reach it), even with nothing to type.
    (!$("account-out").hidden ? $("account-email") : $("account-close")).focus();
  }

  function closeAccount() {
    const box = $("account-dialog");
    if (box.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    box.hidden = true;
    askingSignOut = false;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the email box
  // The email last signed in with on this computer: suggested in the empty box while the
  // mouse is over it (a click takes it), completed while it's typed, and greeted.
  const lastEmail = () => (account.lastEmail || "").trim();
  const sameEmail = (a, b) => a.trim().toLowerCase() === b.trim().toLowerCase();

  function canSuggest() {
    return !$("account-out").hidden && $("account-email").value === "" && lastEmail() !== "";
  }

  function showSuggestion(show) {
    const box = $("account-email");
    const suggesting = show && canSuggest();
    box.placeholder = suggesting ? lastEmail() : "you@example.com";
    box.classList.toggle("suggesting", suggesting);
  }

  /** Completes the known email as it's typed: the rest is selected, so typing on replaces it. */
  function complete(event) {
    const box = $("account-email");
    const typed = box.value;
    const known = lastEmail();

    // Only when typing at the end, and never while deleting or composing.
    if (!known || !typed || event.isComposing || (event.inputType || "").startsWith("delete")) return;
    if (box.selectionStart !== typed.length || box.selectionEnd !== typed.length) return;

    if (known.length > typed.length && known.toLowerCase().startsWith(typed.toLowerCase())) {
      box.value = typed + known.slice(typed.length);
      box.setSelectionRange(typed.length, box.value.length);
    }
  }

  /** "Welcome back" once the box holds the email last signed in with. */
  function greet() {
    const known = lastEmail();
    const welcome = Boolean(known) && sameEmail($("account-email").value, known);
    $("account-hint").textContent = welcome ? "Welcome back! Press Enter to sign in." : "";
    $("account-hint").classList.toggle("welcome", welcome);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- signing in and out
  function signIn() {
    if ($("account-signin").disabled) return;
    const email = $("account-email").value.trim();
    if (email && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) return say("", "That doesn't look like an email address.");

    say("");
    typedEmail = email;
    account.busy = true;   // until the browser has opened
    render();
    Hub.send("accountSignIn", { email, buy: false });
  }

  function signOut() {
    signingOut = true;
    say("");
    render();
    Hub.send("accountSignOut");
  }

  Hub.on("account", (update) => {
    const before = account;
    account = { ...account, ...update };

    if (signingOut && (!account.signedIn || update.error)) {
      signingOut = false;
      askingSignOut = false;
    }
    if (!account.signedIn) askingSignOut = false;
    if (account.signedIn && !before.signedIn) $("account-email").value = "";

    render();

    const open = !$("account-dialog").hidden;
    if (update.message || update.error) {
      if (open) say(update.message, update.error);
      else Hub.toast(update.error || update.message);
    }

    // Back from the browser: said once, wherever the user is.
    if (account.signedIn && !before.signedIn && (before.waiting || open)) {
      if (open) say(`Signed in as ${account.email}.`);
      Hub.toast(`Signed in as ${account.email}` + (account.credits >= 0 ? ` · ${creditsText(account.credits)}` : ""));
    }

    // Signed out (the button that had the keyboard is gone): typing goes to the email box.
    if (open && !$("account-out").hidden && document.activeElement === document.body) $("account-email").focus();
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands
  Hub.commands.account = openAccount;
  Hub.commands.buyCredits = () => Hub.send("accountBuy");

  Hub.account = { state: () => account, open: openAccount };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    render();
    $("account-button").addEventListener("click", openAccount);
    $("account-close").addEventListener("click", closeAccount);
    $("account-retry").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("accountCheck"));
    $("account-signin").addEventListener("click", signIn);
    $("account-again").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("accountSignIn", { email: typedEmail, buy: false }));
    $("account-cancel").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("accountSignInCancel"));
    $("account-buy").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("accountBuy"));
    $("account-signout").addEventListener("click", () => {
      askingSignOut = true;
      render();
      $("account-signout-no").focus();
    });
    $("account-signout-yes").addEventListener("click", signOut);
    $("account-signout-no").addEventListener("click", () => {
      askingSignOut = false;
      render();
      $("account-signout").focus();
    });

    const box = $("account-email");
    box.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
      complete(event);
      greet();
      say("");
    });
    box.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => showSuggestion(true));
    box.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => showSuggestion(false));
    box.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (!canSuggest()) return;
      // A click takes the suggestion: filled in and selected, so typing replaces it.
      box.value = lastEmail();
      box.select();
      showSuggestion(false);
      greet();
    });
    box.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") {
        event.preventDefault();
        signIn();
      }
    });

    // While the window is open, keys stay in it: Space clicks its buttons rather than playing.
    for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup"]) {
      $("account-dialog").addEventListener(type, (event) => {
        if (event.key !== "Escape") event.stopPropagation();
      });
    }

    // Escape closes the window wherever the keyboard is (a button that just went busy drops it).
    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key !== "Escape" || $("account-dialog").hidden) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      closeAccount();
    }, true);
  });
})();
