// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-core.js
//
// Shared by every part of the page: the bridge to the native engine, shared state,
// the fader law, menus, the panel toggles (Browser, Console, Editor) and the look
// (Settings > Appearance). Keyboard shortcuts are in hub-keys.js.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const backend = window.__JUCE__ && window.__JUCE__.backend;
  const handlers = {};

  // Inputs that don't take text: the DAW's shortcuts still work while one of these has focus.
  const NOT_TEXT_INPUTS = new Set(["button", "checkbox", "radio", "range", "color", "file", "submit", "reset", "image", "hidden"]);

  const Hub = window.Hub = {
    state: { tracks: [], selected: 0, selectedTracks: [], inspectMain: false, selectedClips: [], focus: "arrange", master: { volume: 0, mute: false, inserts: [] },
             inputs: [], inputChannels: [], recordBits: 24, peaks: {}, finePeaks: {},
             outputs: [{ id: 0, name: "Main", left: 0, right: 1, mainMix: false, volume: 0, mute: false }], outputChannels: [],
             audition: 0, ioDefaults: null,
             library: [], transport: null, status: null },

    /** Channel 0 is the Main channel in every message to and from the engine. */
    MAIN: 0,
    commands: {},

    $: (id) => document.getElementById(id),

    /** Sends an event to the native engine. */
    send(eventId, payload = {}) {
      if (backend) backend.emitEvent(eventId, payload);
    },

    /** Listens to engine events (status, tracks, library, param) and page events. */
    on(eventId, handler) {
      (handlers[eventId] = handlers[eventId] || []).push(handler);
    },

    /** Each listener runs on its own: an error in one part of the page can't stop the others. */
    emit(eventId, data) {
      for (const handler of handlers[eventId] || []) {
        try {
          handler(data);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`Hub: a "${eventId}" listener failed`, error);
        }
      }
    },

    run(command) {
      const action = Hub.commands[command];
      if (action) action();
    },

    clamp: (value, min, max) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value)),
    clamp01: (value) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value)),

    /** Typing into a field must not play notes or trigger shortcuts. */
    /** Is the keyboard writing text here (a sign-in form, a name, the AI box)? Then the DAW's
        shortcuts keep out of its way. Every field that takes text counts: email, password,
        codes, numbers, addresses. Buttons, boxes and sliders don't, so Space still plays. */
    isTyping(target) {
      if (!(target instanceof Element)) return false;
      if (target.isContentEditable || target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) return true;
      return target instanceof HTMLInputElement && !NOT_TEXT_INPUTS.has(target.type);
    },

    element(tag, className, text) {
      const node = document.createElement(tag);
      if (className) node.className = className;
      if (text !== undefined) node.textContent = text;
      return node;
    },

    /** A clip and its track, by the clip's id (ids are unique across tracks). */
    findClip(clipId) {
      for (const track of Hub.state.tracks) {
        const clip = (track.clips || []).find((c) => c.id === clipId);
        if (clip) return { track, clip };
      }
      return null;
    },

    selectedTrack() {
      return Hub.state.tracks.find((track) => track.id === Hub.state.selected) || null;
    },

    trackById(id) {
      return Hub.state.tracks.find((track) => track.id === id)
          || (Hub.state.busChannels || []).find((channel) => channel.id === id)
          || (Hub.state.fxChannels || []).find((channel) => channel.id === id) || null;
    },

    dbText(db) {
      return db <= Hub.SILENT_DB ? "-∞ dB" : `${db > 0 ? "+" : ""}${db.toFixed(1)} dB`;
    },

    /** Changes one fader setting of a track and tells every view (header, Console) about it.
        A fader or pan of a selected channel moves the rest of the selection with it, by as much
        (in dB for faders), each from where it was when the drag began. */
    setTrackValue(id, key, value, source) {
      const track = Hub.trackById(id);
      const before = track ? track[key] : value;
      if (track) track[key] = value;
      Hub.send("trackSettings", { id, [key]: value });
      Hub.emit("trackValue", { id, key, value, source });

      const group = key === "volume" || key === "pan" ? Hub.groupOf(id) : [id];
      if (group.length < 2) return;
      const base = groupBase && groupBase.id === id ? groupBase.values : null;
      const delta = value - (base && base.has(id) ? base.get(id)[key] : before);

      for (const other of group) {
        const channel = other !== id && Hub.trackById(other);
        if (!channel) continue;
        const from = base && base.has(other) ? base.get(other)[key] : channel[key];
        const next = key === "pan" ? Hub.clamp(from + delta, -1, 1) : Hub.clamp(from + delta, OFF_DB, Hub.MAX_DB);
        channel[key] = next;
        Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: other, [key]: next });
        Hub.emit("trackValue", { id: other, key, value: next, source: null });
      }
    },

    /** The Console's order: tracks, buses, then FX channels (ids). */
    channelOrder() {
      return [...Hub.state.tracks.map((track) => track.id), ...(Hub.state.busChannels || []).map((channel) => channel.id),
              ...(Hub.state.fxChannels || []).map((channel) => channel.id)];
    },

    /** Whether a track or channel is in the selection (Main in focus: none is). */
    isTrackSelected(id) {
      return !Hub.state.inspectMain && Hub.state.selectedTracks.includes(id);
    },

    /** What a click on a channel's button works on: the whole selection when the channel is in
        it, otherwise the channel alone. In the Console's order. */
    groupOf(id) {
      const selection = Hub.state.selectedTracks;
      return selection.length > 1 && selection.includes(id) ? selection.slice() : [id];
    },

    setMasterValue(key, value, source) {
      Hub.state.master[key] = value;
      Hub.send("masterSettings", { [key]: value });
      Hub.emit("masterValue", { key, value, source });
    },

    /**
        Selects a track or channel at once on the page; the engine confirms with a tracks update.
          how "only"     it alone (a click)
              "toggle"   in or out of the selection, the rest kept (Ctrl + click)
              "range"    every channel from the last one clicked to it added (Shift + click)
              "keep"     the selection as it is when it's in it, else it alone (a clip clicked)
        The keyboard plays the track clicked last (an FX channel or a bus plays nothing: the track stays).
    */
    selectTrack(id, how = "only") {
      const track = id ? Hub.trackById(id) : null;
      if (!track) return;
      const order = Hub.channelOrder();
      let chosen = Hub.state.selectedTracks.filter((other) => order.includes(other));

      if (how === "toggle") {
        if (!chosen.includes(id)) chosen.push(id);
        else if (chosen.length > 1) chosen = chosen.filter((other) => other !== id);
        selectionAnchor = id;
      } else if (how === "range") {
        const from = order.indexOf(order.includes(selectionAnchor) ? selectionAnchor : Hub.state.selected);
        const to = order.indexOf(id);
        if (from < 0) chosen = [id];
        else for (const other of order.slice(Math.min(from, to), Math.max(from, to) + 1)) if (!chosen.includes(other)) chosen.push(other);
      } else if (how !== "keep" || !chosen.includes(id)) {
        chosen = [id];
        selectionAnchor = id;
      }

      Hub.state.selectedTracks = order.filter((other) => chosen.includes(other));

      // Only a track plays notes: FX channels and buses join the selection, the keyboard stays.
      const plays = (channel) => Boolean(channel) && channel.kind !== "fx" && channel.kind !== "bus";
      let primary = Hub.state.selected;
      if (plays(track) && chosen.includes(id)) primary = id;
      else if (!chosen.includes(primary)) {
        const playable = chosen.map((other) => Hub.trackById(other)).find(plays);
        if (playable) primary = playable.id;
      }

      const trackChanged = primary !== Hub.state.selected;
      Hub.state.inspectMain = false;
      Hub.state.selected = primary;
      Hub.emit("selection");
      if (trackChanged) Hub.send("selectTrack", { id: primary });
    },

    /** Marks the Main channel as the one in focus (its strip shows it). The keyboard keeps playing the selected track. */
    inspectMain() {
      if (Hub.state.inspectMain) return;
      Hub.state.inspectMain = true;
      Hub.emit("selection");
    },

    /** The inserts of a channel: a track id, or Hub.MAIN. */
    insertsOf(channel) {
      if (channel === Hub.MAIN) return Hub.state.master.inserts || [];
      const track = Hub.trackById(channel);
      return track ? track.inserts || [] : [];
    },

    effects() {
      return Hub.state.library.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "effect" && !entry.missing)
                              .sort((a, b) => a.vendor.localeCompare(b.vendor) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    },

    /** A small menu under anchor (an element, or anything with getBoundingClientRect). Items:
        { label, value } picked with a click (onPick(value)), and as each needs: disabled, checked
        (a tick before it), icon (an SVG's markup, beside the tick), shortcut (its key, on the
        right), submenu (items of its own, opened beside it as the pointer comes over it; a click
        on the item itself still picks its value, when it has one); { separator: true } a line;
        { group } a heading. */
    popupMenu(anchor, items, onPick) {
      document.querySelectorAll(".popup-menu").forEach((menu) => menu.remove());
      const open = [];   // the menu, then each submenu opened from the one before it

      const close = () => {
        for (const menu of open) menu.remove();
        open.length = 0;
        document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside, true);
        window.removeEventListener("keydown", escape, true);
        window.removeEventListener("blur", close);
      };
      const outside = (event) => { if (!open.some((menu) => menu.contains(event.target))) close(); };
      const escape = (event) => { if (event.key === "Escape") { event.stopPropagation(); close(); } };

      /** Places a menu below (or above) a rectangle, or beside it for a submenu, inside the window. */
      const place = (menu, r, beside) => {
        const width = menu.offsetWidth || 220, height = menu.offsetHeight || 0;
        let left = beside ? r.right - 2 : r.left;
        let top = beside ? r.top - 4 : r.bottom + 2;
        if (beside && left + width > window.innerWidth - 4) left = r.left - width + 2;
        if (!beside && top + height > window.innerHeight - 4) top = Math.max(4, r.top - height - 2);
        if (beside && top + height > window.innerHeight - 4) top = Math.max(4, window.innerHeight - height - 4);
        menu.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerWidth - width - 4, left)) + "px";
        menu.style.top = top + "px";
      };

      const build = (list, level) => {
        const menu = document.createElement("div");
        menu.className = "popup-menu" + (level ? " popup-sub" : "");
        menu.setAttribute("role", "menu");
        const marks = list.some((item) => item.checked !== undefined || item.icon);
        if (marks) menu.classList.add("with-marks");

        const closeFrom = (depth) => { while (open.length > depth) open.pop().remove(); };

        for (const item of list) {
          if (item.group) {
            menu.appendChild(Hub.element("div", "popup-group", item.group));
            continue;
          }
          if (item.separator) {
            menu.appendChild(Hub.element("div", "popup-separator"));
            continue;
          }

          const button = Hub.element("button", item.submenu ? "has-submenu" : "");
          button.type = "button";
          button.setAttribute("role", "menuitem");
          button.disabled = Boolean(item.disabled);
          if (item.title) button.title = item.title;

          if (marks) {
            button.appendChild(Hub.element("span", "popup-check", item.checked ? "\u2713" : ""));
            const icon = Hub.element("span", "popup-icon");
            if (item.icon) icon.innerHTML = item.icon;
            button.appendChild(icon);
          }
          button.appendChild(Hub.element("span", "popup-label", item.label));
          if (item.shortcut) button.appendChild(Hub.element("span", "popup-key", item.shortcut));
          if (item.submenu) button.appendChild(Hub.element("span", "popup-arrow", "\u203a"));

          button.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => {
            closeFrom(level + 1);
            menu.querySelectorAll("button.open").forEach((other) => other.classList.remove("open"));
            if (!item.submenu || button.disabled) return;
            button.classList.add("open");
            const sub = build(item.submenu, level + 1);
            place(sub, button.getBoundingClientRect(), true);
          });
          button.addEventListener("click", () => {
            if (item.value === undefined && item.submenu) return;   // its submenu has the choices
            close();
            onPick(item.value);
          });
          menu.appendChild(button);
        }

        document.body.appendChild(menu);
        open.push(menu);
        return menu;
      };

      const menu = build(items, 0);
      place(menu, anchor.getBoundingClientRect(), false);
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside, true);
      window.addEventListener("keydown", escape, true);
      window.addEventListener("blur", close);
      return menu;
    },

    /** A point (a right-click's), as popupMenu takes an anchor. */
    pointAnchor(event) {
      return { getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: event.clientX, right: event.clientX, top: event.clientY, bottom: event.clientY }) };
    },

    /** The "+" menu: every effect in the Browser, grouped by vendor, added to a channel. */
    addEffectMenu(anchor, channel, position = -1) {
      const effects = Hub.effects();
      const items = [];
      let vendor = null;

      for (const entry of effects) {
        if (entry.vendor !== vendor) {
          vendor = entry.vendor;
          items.push({ group: vendor });
        }
        items.push({ label: entry.name, value: entry });
      }

      if (!effects.length) items.push({ label: "No effects yet: add WCLAP files to the Browser", value: null, disabled: true });
      if (Hub.insertsOf(channel).length >= Hub.MAX_INSERTS) items.unshift({ label: "This channel is full (16 inserts)", value: null, disabled: true });

      return Hub.popupMenu(anchor, items, (entry) => {
        if (entry) Hub.send("loadPlugin", { trackId: channel, file: entry.file, pluginId: entry.id, position });
      });
    },

    /** Turns a label into a text field; Enter or leaving it commits, Escape cancels. */
    inlineRename(label, current, commit) {
      const input = document.createElement("input");
      input.type = "text";
      input.value = current;
      input.setAttribute("aria-label", "Name");
      label.textContent = "";
      label.appendChild(input);
      input.focus();
      input.select();

      // Once: taking the field away blurs it, which would finish it again.
      let finished = false;
      const finish = (save) => {
        if (finished || !input.isConnected) return;
        finished = true;
        const value = input.value.trim();
        input.remove();
        label.textContent = save && value ? value : current;
        if (save && value && value !== current) commit(value);
      };

      input.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
        if (event.key === "Enter") finish(true);
        if (event.key === "Escape") finish(false);
        event.stopPropagation();
      });
      input.addEventListener("blur", () => finish(true));
    },

    panText(pan) {
      if (Math.abs(pan) < 0.005) return "<C>";
      const amount = Math.round(Math.abs(pan) * 100);
      return pan < 0 ? `${amount}L` : `${amount}R`;
    },

    toast(text) {
      const toast = Hub.$("toast");
      if (!text) return;
      toast.textContent = text;
      toast.hidden = false;
      clearTimeout(Hub._toastTimer);
      Hub._toastTimer = setTimeout(() => { toast.hidden = true; }, 7000);
    },

    start() {
      if (backend) {
        for (const id of ["status", "tracks", "library", "param", "song", "songFolder", "audioPeaks", "audioPeaksFine", "folderListing", "audioFileInfo", "pluginScreen", "screenMessages", "mixdown", "mixdownFolder", "webTabOpened", "webTabState", "webTabClosed", "webTabsRestore", "account", "fananContent", "contentProgress", "contentResult", "contentPreviewing", "pluginChoice", "pluginScan", "internetBlocked", "aiState", "voiceState", "remoteState", "settings", "audioSetup", "runCommand", "mastering", "sessionSetup", "sessionChords", "sessionPlayers", "stems", "midiLink", "selectTracks", "songChannel", "audioJob", "audioTempo", "audioAnalysis", "midiFxTypes", "midiFxAdded", "midiToolResult", "magentaRequest", "midiTools", "midiToolProgress", "midiToolInstalled", "songBlocks", "songBlockMade", "songBlocksBuilt", "songVideo", "videoExport", "deviceStudio", "deviceStudioMessage", "deviceAiState", "deviceLive", "board", "live", "creator", "sampling"])
          backend.addEventListener(id, (data) => Hub.emit(id, data));
      }

      // While the page loads, the window covers it with Fanan's and Sonify's logos. Once the page
      // has drawn itself as the user set it up (the first settings bring Settings > Appearance),
      // it says so and the cover goes.
      let shown = false;
      Hub.on("settings", () => {
        if (shown) return;
        shown = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => Hub.send("uiShown")));
      });

      Hub.emit("ready");
      Hub.send("uiReady");
    }
  };

  // The clip selection is a list of clip ids; selectedClip is the one picked last, as
  // {trackId, clipId}, for anything that works on a single clip (the Editor's F2).
  Object.defineProperty(Hub.state, "selectedClip", {
    get() {
      const id = this.selectedClips[this.selectedClips.length - 1];
      const found = id === undefined ? null : Hub.findClip(id);
      return found ? { trackId: found.track.id, clipId: id } : null;
    },
    set(value) {
      this.selectedClips = value ? [value.clipId] : [];
    }
  });

  // Finer waveforms arrive when a zoomed-in view asks for them.
  Hub.on("audioPeaksFine", (data) => {
    if (!data || !data.file) return;
    Hub.state.finePeaks[data.file] = data;
    if (Hub.arrange) Hub.arrange.redraw();
  });

  // Waveforms arrive once per audio file.
  Hub.on("audioPeaks", (data) => {
    if (!data || !data.file) return;
    Hub.state.peaks[data.file] = data;
    if (Hub.arrange) Hub.arrange.redraw();
  });

  Hub.on("tracks", (data) => {
    const selectedBefore = Hub.state.selected;
    Hub.state.tracks = data.tracks || [];
    Hub.state.fxChannels = data.fxChannels || [];            // in the Console only
    Hub.state.busChannels = data.busChannels || [];          // in the Console only
    Hub.state.sidechainTargets = data.sidechainTargets || []; // plugins with a sidechain input
    Hub.state.inputs = data.inputs || Hub.state.inputs;
    Hub.state.inputChannels = data.inputChannels || Hub.state.inputChannels;
    Hub.state.outputs = data.outputs && data.outputs.length ? data.outputs : Hub.state.outputs;   // Main first
    Hub.state.outputChannels = data.outputChannels || Hub.state.outputChannels;
    if (data.audition !== undefined) Hub.state.audition = data.audition;
    Hub.state.ioDefaults = data.ioDefaults || Hub.state.ioDefaults;
    Hub.state.recordBits = data.recordBits || Hub.state.recordBits;
    Hub.state.selected = data.selected || 0;
    if (data.master) Hub.state.master = data.master;
    Hub.state.boardMixing = Boolean(data.boardMixing);   // the Analog Board mixes the song, not the Console
    if (data.notice) Hub.toast(data.notice);

    // The selection keeps the channels still there; the engine selecting another track (a new
    // one, the AI's) starts it afresh with that one.
    const order = Hub.channelOrder();
    let chosen = Hub.state.selectedTracks.filter((id) => order.includes(id));
    if (Hub.state.selected && Hub.state.selected !== selectedBefore && !chosen.includes(Hub.state.selected)) chosen = [Hub.state.selected];
    if (!chosen.length && Hub.state.selected) chosen = [Hub.state.selected];
    Hub.state.selectedTracks = order.filter((id) => chosen.includes(id));
  });

  // Copies just made (Duplicate): they're the selection.
  Hub.on("selectTracks", (data) => {
    const order = Hub.channelOrder();
    const chosen = (data.ids || []).filter((id) => order.includes(id));
    if (!chosen.length) return;
    Hub.state.selectedTracks = order.filter((id) => chosen.includes(id));
    selectionAnchor = chosen[0];
    Hub.state.inspectMain = false;
    Hub.emit("selection");
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the web view's own menu
  // A right-click never shows the web view's menu (Back, Refresh, Save as, Print): the page's own
  // menus open where there are some, and nothing elsewhere. A text field keeps its Cut, Copy and
  // Paste.
  const isTextField = (el) => Boolean(el && el.closest && el.closest("textarea, [contenteditable=''], [contenteditable='true'], input"))
    && !(el.closest("input") && NOT_TEXT_INPUTS.has((el.closest("input").type || "").toLowerCase()));
  window.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => {
    if (!isTextField(event.target)) event.preventDefault();
  });

  // Where a Shift + click's range starts, and the selection's values as a fader drag began.
  let selectionAnchor = 0;
  let groupBase = null;

  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    groupBase = null;
    const control = event.target.closest && event.target.closest('.fader, [data-control="volume"], [data-control="pan"]');
    const holder = control && control.closest(".track[data-id], .strip[data-id]");
    if (!holder) return;
    const id = Number(holder.dataset.id);
    const group = Hub.groupOf(id);
    if (group.length < 2) return;
    groupBase = { id, values: new Map(group.map((other) => {
      const channel = Hub.trackById(other) || {};
      return [other, { volume: channel.volume || 0, pan: channel.pan || 0 }];
    })) };
  }, true);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- fader law
  // Studio One's fader scale: +10 dB at the top, 0 dB about three quarters up,
  // then ever wider steps down to -72 dB and off.
  Hub.MAX_INSERTS = 16;
  Hub.SILENT_DB = -72;
  Hub.MAX_DB = 10;
  const OFF_DB = -144;   // what the page sends for "off": below -72 the engine is silent
  const LAW = [[0, OFF_DB], [0.05, -72], [0.14, -48], [0.24, -36], [0.36, -24], [0.52, -12],
               [0.64, -6], [0.78, 0], [0.91, 6], [1, 10]];

  /** Fader position (0 bottom .. 1 top) to dB. */
  Hub.faderToDb = (position) => {
    const p = Hub.clamp01(position);
    for (let i = 1; i < LAW.length; i++) {
      const [p1, d1] = LAW[i];
      if (p <= p1) {
        const [p0, d0] = LAW[i - 1];
        return d0 + (d1 - d0) * (p - p0) / (p1 - p0);
      }
    }
    return Hub.MAX_DB;
  };

  /** dB to fader position; also used to place meter levels on the same scale. */
  Hub.dbToFader = (db) => {
    if (!(db > OFF_DB)) return 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < LAW.length; i++) {
      const [p1, d1] = LAW[i];
      if (db <= d1) {
        const [p0, d0] = LAW[i - 1];
        return p0 + (p1 - p0) * (db - d0) / (d1 - d0);
      }
    }
    return 1;
  };

  Hub.gainToDb = (gain) => gain > 0 ? 20 * Math.log10(gain) : OFF_DB;

  Hub.on("library", (data) => {
    Hub.state.library = data.entries || [];
    if (data.notice) Hub.toast(data.notice);
  });

  Hub.on("status", (data) => {
    Hub.state.status = data;
    if (data.transport) Hub.state.transport = data.transport;
    if (typeof data.masterVolume === "number") Hub.state.master.volume = data.masterVolume;   // Main's fader moved on a control surface
  });

  // A control surface asks for a page command: zooming with its jog wheel.
  Hub.on("runCommand", (data) => {
    if (data && ["zoomIn", "zoomOut", "zoomFull"].includes(data.command)) Hub.run(data.command);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- panels
  const PANELS = { toggleBrowser: "hide-browser", toggleEditor: "hide-editor",
                   toggleConsole: "hide-console", toggleAudioEditor: "hide-audio-editor" };

  // Like Studio One, the Editor, the Audio Editor and the Console share the space at the bottom.
  const SHARES_WITH = { toggleEditor: ["hide-console", "hide-audio-editor"], toggleConsole: ["hide-editor", "hide-audio-editor"],
                        toggleAudioEditor: ["hide-editor", "hide-console"] };

  for (const [command, bodyClass] of Object.entries(PANELS)) {
    Hub.commands[command] = () => {
      const hidden = document.body.classList.toggle(bodyClass);
      if (!hidden && SHARES_WITH[command]) document.body.classList.add(...SHARES_WITH[command]);
      Hub.emit("layout");
    };
  }

  function syncPanelButtons() {
    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-panel]")) {
      const hidden = document.body.classList.contains(PANELS[button.dataset.panel]);
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!hidden));
    }
  }

  Hub.on("layout", syncPanelButtons);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- appearance
  // Settings > Appearance. Luminance takes the arrangement's lanes and the Editor's piano roll
  // from dark to bright, as Studio One's does; Contrast sets how bright text and symbols are
  // against the dark. The canvases draw with Hub.theme; the rest of the page uses the CSS
  // variables. 0 and 50 are the look Sonify always had.
  const rgb = (colour) => [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(colour.slice(i, i + 2), 16));

  /** From a (t = 0) to b (t = 1). */
  function mix(a, b, t) {
    const x = rgb(a), y = rgb(b);
    return "#" + x.map((v, i) => Math.round(v + (y[i] - v) * Hub.clamp01(t)).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  }

  /** a at 0, b at 0.5 (the default), c at 1. */
  const mix3 = (a, b, c, t) => (t <= 0.5 ? mix(a, b, t * 2) : mix(b, c, (t - 0.5) * 2));

  function makeTheme(luminance, contrast) {
    const l = Hub.clamp01(luminance / 100), c = Hub.clamp01(contrast / 100);
    return {
      luminance, contrast,
      text: mix3("#a9abaf", "#d6d7d9", "#ffffff", c),
      bright: mix3("#c3c5c8", "#eceded", "#ffffff", c),
      muted: mix3("#6e7278", "#8e939a", "#b6bac0", c),
      line: mix3("#323438", "#3b3d42", "#4f5258", c),
      line2: mix3("#3c3e43", "#47494f", "#5d6067", c),
      tick: mix3("#45474d", "#55585e", "#6c6f76", c),
      lanes: {
        empty: mix("#26272a", "#b4b7bc", l),
        lane: mix("#2c2d31", "#c4c7cb", l),
        selected: mix("#3b3e44", "#d6d9dc", l),
        armed: mix("#35272a", "#dab9bb", l),
        bar: mix("#46484e", "#85888f", l),
        beat: mix("#36383c", "#a0a3a9", l),
        fine: mix("#2f3134", "#b1b4b9", l),
        mark: l < 0.5 ? "#ffffff" : "#16171a"       // a split line, a clip being painted
      },
      roll: {
        white: mix("#2b2c30", "#d0d3d7", l),
        black: mix("#232427", "#bdc1c6", l),
        row: mix("#1f2023", "#aeb2b8", l),          // the line between every two rows
        octave: mix("#3f4147", "#989ca3", l),
        bar: mix("#4a4d53", "#868a91", l),
        beat: mix("#383a3f", "#a2a6ac", l),
        fine: mix("#303236", "#b3b6bb", l),
        outside: `rgba(0, 0, 0, ${(0.38 - 0.2 * l).toFixed(3)})`,
        velocity: mix("#222326", "#c7cacf", l),
        velocityLine: mix("#34363b", "#a9acb1", l),
        mark: l < 0.5 ? "#ffffff" : "#16171a"       // a selected note's outline
      }
    };
  }

  Hub.theme = makeTheme(0, 50);

  /** Applies Settings > Appearance at once (the settings remember it). */
  Hub.setAppearance = ({ luminance = Hub.theme.luminance, contrast = Hub.theme.contrast } = {}) => {
    const theme = Hub.theme = makeTheme(luminance, contrast);
    const root = document.documentElement.style;
    root.setProperty("--text", theme.text);
    root.setProperty("--bright", theme.bright);
    root.setProperty("--muted", theme.muted);
    root.setProperty("--line", theme.line);
    root.setProperty("--line-2", theme.line2);
    root.setProperty("--lane", theme.lanes.lane);
    root.setProperty("--lane-selected", theme.lanes.selected);
    root.setProperty("--lane-bar", theme.lanes.bar);
    root.setProperty("--roll-white", theme.roll.white);
    root.setProperty("--roll-black", theme.roll.black);
    Hub.emit("theme", theme);
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- menus
  function setupMenus() {
    const bar = Hub.$("menubar");
    let openMenu = null;

    const close = () => {
      if (!openMenu) return;
      openMenu.classList.remove("open");
      openMenu.querySelector(".menu-title").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      openMenu = null;
    };

    const open = (menu) => {
      close();
      openMenu = menu;
      menu.classList.add("open");
      menu.querySelector(".menu-title").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    };

    bar.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const title = event.target.closest(".menu-title");

      if (title) {
        const menu = title.parentElement;
        if (menu === openMenu) close(); else open(menu);
        return;
      }

      const item = event.target.closest("[data-command]");

      if (item && !item.disabled) {
        close();
        Hub.run(item.dataset.command);
      }
    });

    bar.addEventListener("mouseover", (event) => {
      if (!openMenu) return;
      const menu = event.target.closest(".menu");
      if (menu && menu !== openMenu) open(menu);
    });

    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (openMenu && !bar.contains(event.target)) close();
    }, true);

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") close();
    });

    window.addEventListener("blur", close);
  }

  // Panel toggle buttons in the transport bar
  document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    const button = event.target.closest("[data-panel]");
    if (button) Hub.run(button.dataset.panel);
  });

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    setupMenus();
    syncPanelButtons();
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-creator.js
//
// The Plugins Creator Studio (the top bar's selector, Ctrl+5): Stella AI Studio inside Sonify,
// with Sonify AI building instruments, effects, widgets and MIDI FX (Sonify's MIDI devices) for
// Sonify's tracks (Add to Sonify puts a plugin in the Browser, under Made in Sonify; a MIDI FX plays
// on its track as it's built, and is kept in My Devices). The studio is Sonify's own window, laid
// over this page's area while the studio is in front (creatorShow / creatorHide); it steps aside
// while a dialog, a menu, the Start page or the plugin scan is open, as the Web Browser's views do.
// Its tabs: Build with AI, Edit UI and Knob Studio.
// Sonify sends: creator {tab} when its tab changes; runCommand {command} for Sonify's keys pressed in
// the studio's window (Ctrl+1..8, Ctrl+Tab).

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  let shown = false;          // the studio is in front

  // The page's own windows over the studio: the studio's window steps aside for them.
  function overlayOpen() {
    const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll(".modal"), $("start-page"), $("scan-page")];
    return boxes.some((box) => box && !box.hidden) || Boolean(document.querySelector(".popup-menu"));
  }

  /** Where the studio's window goes (in the page's pixels, which are the window's own), or none. */
  function place() {
    if (!shown || overlayOpen()) {
      // Under a dialog or a menu the studio is still in front: it keeps the live notes.
      Hub.send("creatorHide", { overlay: shown });
      return;
    }

    const r = $("creator-studio").getBoundingClientRect();

    if (r.width < 2 || r.height < 2) {
      Hub.send("creatorHide", { overlay: true });   // no room just now: still in front
      return;
    }

    Hub.send("creatorShow", { x: Math.round(r.left), y: Math.round(r.top), width: Math.round(r.width), height: Math.round(r.height) });
  }

  /** The studio in front (on) or not. */
  function show(on) {
    if (on === shown) return;
    shown = on;
    place();
  }

  /** One of its tabs (Build with AI 0, Edit UI 1, Knob Studio 2). */
  function showTab(index) {
    Hub.send("creatorTab", { index });
  }

  Hub.creator = { show, showTab, isShown: () => shown };

  Hub.on("creator", () => {
    if (shown) place();
  });

  // Sonify's keys pressed inside the studio's window.
  const COMMANDS = new Set(["showStudio", "analogBoard", "sonifyAi", "songBlocks", "pluginsCreator", "liveShow", "samplingStudio", "webBrowser", "guide",
                            "nextStudio", "previousStudio"]);

  Hub.on("runCommand", (data) => {
    if (data && COMMANDS.has(data.command)) Hub.run(data.command);
  });

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    // The window follows the page's area as the window changes.
    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(() => { if (shown) place(); }).observe($("creator-studio"));
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (shown) place(); });

    // A dialog or a menu opened over the studio needs the page in front: the window steps aside meanwhile.
    const watch = new MutationObserver(() => { if (shown) place(); });
    for (const box of [...document.querySelectorAll(".modal"), $("start-page"), $("scan-page")])
      if (box) watch.observe(box, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["hidden"] });
    watch.observe(document.body, { childList: true });

    Hub.send("creatorState");
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-devices.js
//
// Sonify devices: MIDI devices made by asking Sonify AI in the Plugins Creator Studio's Build with AI
// (type MIDI FX), the way Max for Live devices are built. A device sits in an instrument track's MIDI
// FX, hears the notes, plays its own, and can move Sonify's controls. Every device made is kept in My
// Devices (Documents\Sonify\Devices, one .sonidev file each), which the MIDI FX menus list.
//
// This page keeps what the rest of it needs to know about them (My Devices, whether devices can be
// built here) and sends the Plugins Creator Studio a device to work on: the one in a track's MIDI FX
// slot (its window's "Open in Plugins Creator Studio"), or a new one. The studio shows it in Build
// with AI, with its own conversation.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  let studio = { available: true, why: "", open: false, library: [] };

  /** The device a song's place came from, when My Devices has a newer version of it. */
  function newerFor(item) {
    if (!item || !item.device) return null;
    const entry = (studio.library || []).find((e) => e.id === item.device.deviceId);
    return entry && entry.built && entry.version > (item.device.version || 0) ? entry : null;
  }

  /** The Plugins Creator Studio in front, on Build with AI, where the device is made. */
  function showCreator() {
    if (Hub.studios) Hub.studios.activate("plugins");
    if (Hub.creator) Hub.creator.showTab(0);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- from the engine
  Hub.on("deviceStudio", (data) => {
    studio = { ...data };
  });

  Hub.on("deviceStudioMessage", (data) => {
    const text = data.message || data.error;
    if (text) Hub.toast(text.split("\n")[0]);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- for the rest of the page
  Hub.devices = {
    library: () => (studio.library || []).filter((entry) => entry.built),
    available: () => studio.available,
    why: () => studio.why,
    newerFor,
    /** The device in a track's MIDI FX slot, in the Plugins Creator Studio's Build with AI. */
    openSlot(trackId, fxId) {
      Hub.send("deviceStudio", { action: "openSlot", trackId, fxId });
      showCreator();
    },
    /** A new device (fresh) or the one open, in the Plugins Creator Studio's Build with AI. */
    openStudio(fresh = false) {
      if (fresh) Hub.send("deviceStudio", { action: "new" });
      showCreator();
    }
  };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    Hub.send("deviceStudio", { action: "state" });
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-editor.js
//
// The Editor (F2): Studio One's piano roll for one MIDI clip. Double-click a clip in
// the arrangement to open it.
//
//   Mouse       left click a note to select it (Shift or Ctrl adds or removes), drag on empty
//               space to select several in a box, drag notes to move them, drag a note's right
//               edge to change its length. Double-click empty space to draw a note. Right-click
//               anywhere for the menu (below).
//   Tools       Studio One's, picked with the toolbar, their keys (Studio One's map below), or
//               the right-click menu; the mouse pointer is the tool's own symbol:
//     Arrow (1)   as above.
//     Range (2)   drag across a stretch of time: every note starting in it is selected, at any
//                 pitch (Shift adds); drag a selected note to move them all.
//     Split (3)   click a note to cut it in two there (on the grid with Snap on); a selected one
//                 cuts every selected note under that time.
//     Eraser (4)  click or drag over notes to delete them.
//     Paint (5)   the Pencil: click to draw a note, drag to set its length. In the lane under
//                 the notes it draws as its shape says (the right-click menu's Paint Tool):
//                 Freehand, or a Line, Parabola, Square, Triangle, Saw or Sine from where the
//                 drag began to where the pointer is (a wave four Quantize steps a cycle).
//     Mute (6)    click a note to mute it (it stays, silent, drawn hollow) or unmute it; drag
//                 over notes to do the same to each. A selected one does it to the selection.
//     Listen (8)  hold the mouse down to hear the clip's track alone from there; let go and the
//                 song goes back where it was.
//   Right-click Studio One's menu: the tools, Cut, Copy, Paste (where you clicked), Duplicate,
//               Delete, Select All, Deselect All, Undo and Redo. On a note, the note joins the
//               selection first.
//   Quantize    the grid's lines, a new note's length and the steps notes move and grow by
//               (with Snap on); a note's end dragged moves a quarter of that at a time.
//   Zoom        the sliders right of the lanes' names: length (time) and height (the rows), with
//               - and + beside each; Ctrl + mouse wheel zooms the length too.
//   Keys        as the keyboard map in use has them (hub-keys.js); in Studio One's: Delete
//               removes the selected notes, Ctrl+A selects all, Ctrl+C / X / V / D copy, cut,
//               paste and duplicate them, Q quantizes. Always: Up/Down transpose (Shift: an
//               octave), Left/Right move by the grid.
//   Look        the piano roll follows Settings > Appearance > Luminance (Hub.theme).
//   Lanes       under the notes, chosen above them: Velocity (drag over the notes' bars), Pitch
//               Bend and Aftertouch (drag to draw the line; the Eraser clears it back to rest;
//               the middle of Pitch Bend catches), Chance (drag over the bars: how likely each
//               note plays).
//   Operators   (the toolbar's button) Bitwig's, for the selected notes: Chance and Vel Spread
//               (rolled again each pass), Repeats (ratchets: a count or a note value, their Curve
//               and the last one's Vel End), Occurrence (first pass, not first, with or without
//               the note before, or the one before on its key) and Recurrence (a cycle of 2 to 8
//               passes, and the ones it plays on). Seed: what the clip's rolls come from; the die
//               rolls a new one. A note shows them: a die's dots (Chance), a line at each repeat,
//               a corner (Occurrence) and the passes (Recurrence); Vel Spread shows in the
//               Velocity lane. A pass: each time the loop comes round over the clip, and copy by
//               copy along copies of it back to back.
//   Keyboard    click the keys on the left to hear a note.
//
// The editor works on a copy of the clip's notes and lines at song positions and sends the
// whole clip to the engine when the mouse is released.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  const MIN_ROW = 5, MAX_ROW = 36, DEFAULT_ROW = 12;        // pixels per semitone (the height zoom)
  const MIN_ZOOM = 8, MAX_ZOOM = 1200, DEFAULT_ZOOM = 96;   // pixels per quarter note (the length zoom)
  const QUANTIZE = [["1/1", 4], ["1/2", 2], ["1/4", 1], ["1/8", 0.5], ["1/16", 0.25], ["1/32", 0.125], ["1/64", 0.0625]];
  const BLACK = new Set([1, 3, 6, 8, 10]);
  const NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"];
  const LINES = ["pitchBend", "aftertouch"];                // the lanes that are lines of points
  const BEND_MIN = -8192, BEND_MAX = 8191, PRESSURE_MAX = 127;
  const POINT_STEP = 1 / 64;                                // quarter notes between a drawn line's points
  // The tools, as Studio One's menu lists them: [tool, its name, its key's command].
  const TOOLS = [["arrow", "Arrow Tool", "toolArrow"], ["range", "Range Tool", "toolRange"], ["split", "Split Tool", "toolSplit"],
                 ["eraser", "Eraser Tool", "toolEraser"], ["pencil", "Paint Tool", "toolPaint"], ["mute", "Mute Tool", "toolMute"],
                 ["listen", "Listen Tool", "toolListen"]];
  const ICONS = {
    arrow: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M4 1.5v12l3.2-3 2.1 4.6 1.8-.8-2.1-4.5H13z"/></svg>',

    split: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M2 14l7.5-7.5 1.4 1.4L4 14.6z"/><path d="M9.5 6.5 13 2.2c1 .6 1.5 1.6 1.2 2.6l-3.3 3.1z" opacity=".75"/></svg>',
    eraser: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M9.5 2 15 7.5 8.5 14H4L1 11z"/><path d="M5 14h10v1.2H5z"/></svg>',
    pencil: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M11.3 1.7l3 3-8.6 8.6-3.7.7.7-3.7z"/></svg>',
    mute: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1.5 6h2.8l3.7-3v10L4.3 10H1.5z"/><path d="M10 5.5l4.5 5M14.5 5.5l-4.5 5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/></svg>',
    listen: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1.5 6h2.8l3.7-3v10L4.3 10H1.5z"/><path d="M10.2 5.3a3.6 3.6 0 0 1 0 5.4M12 3.6a6 6 0 0 1 0 8.8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>'
  };
  // The Paint tool's shapes in the lane under the notes (Studio One's Paint Tool menu).
  const SHAPES = [["freehand", "Freehand", '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M11.3 1.7l3 3-8.6 8.6-3.7.7.7-3.7z"/></svg>'],
                  ["line", "Line", '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M3 13 13 3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/></svg>'],
                  ["parabola", "Parabola", '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M3 13c5 0 8-3 10-10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/></svg>'],
                  ["square", "Square", '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M2 11h3V5h5v6h4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/></svg>'],
                  ["triangle", "Triangle", '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1.5 11 5 5l3.5 6L12 5l2.5 4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/></svg>'],
                  ["saw", "Saw", '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1.5 12 5 4v8l3.5-8v8L12 4v8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none"/></svg>'],
                  ["sine", "Sine", '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1.5 8c1.6-5 3.6-5 5.2 0s3.6 5 5.2 0 2.1-3 2.6-2.4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/></svg>']];
  const LANE_TIPS = { velocity: "Velocity: drag over the notes' bars to set it",
                      pitchBend: "Pitch Bend: drag to draw it, the Eraser takes it back to rest",
                      aftertouch: "Aftertouch: drag to draw it, the Eraser takes it back to rest",
                      chance: "Chance: drag over the notes' bars to set how likely each plays" };
  const BARS = new Set(["velocity", "chance"]);             // the lanes that are a bar for each note
  // Operators: Occurrence's choices, Repeats' (a count, or a note value in quarter notes) and
  // Recurrence's cycles.
  const OCCURRENCES = [["", "Always"], ["first", "First pass"], ["notFirst", "Not first pass"], ["prev", "With previous note"],
                       ["noPrev", "Without previous note"], ["prevKey", "With previous on its key"], ["noPrevKey", "Without previous on its key"]];
  const REPEATS = [["off", "Off"], ["n:2", "\u00d72"], ["n:3", "\u00d73"], ["n:4", "\u00d74"], ["n:5", "\u00d75"], ["n:6", "\u00d76"],
                   ["n:8", "\u00d78"], ["n:12", "\u00d712"], ["n:16", "\u00d716"], ["n:24", "\u00d724"], ["n:32", "\u00d732"],
                   ["r:1", "1/4"], ["r:0.5", "1/8"], ["r:1/3", "1/8T"], ["r:0.25", "1/16"], ["r:1/6", "1/16T"],
                   ["r:0.125", "1/32"], ["r:0.0625", "1/64"]];
  const RATES = { "r:1": 1, "r:0.5": 0.5, "r:1/3": 1 / 3, "r:0.25": 0.25, "r:1/6": 1 / 6, "r:0.125": 0.125, "r:0.0625": 0.0625 };
  const OPS_DEFAULT = { c: 100, vs: 0, rn: 0, rr: 0, rc: 0, rv: 0, oc: "", rl: 0, rm: 255 };

  const ed = {
    trackId: 0, clipId: 0, clipStart: 0, clipLength: 0, clipOffset: 0,
    notes: [],                     // the notes the clip shows: {pitch, start (song position), length, velocity 1-127, muted, ops, selected}
    hidden: [],                    // notes a trim has hidden: kept as they are, [pitch, content start, length, velocity, muted?, ops?]
    lines: { pitchBend: [], aftertouch: [] },         // the points the clip shows: {time (song position), value}
    hiddenLines: { pitchBend: [], aftertouch: [] },   // points a trim has hidden: [content time, value]
    edited: { pitchBend: false, aftertouch: false },  // drawn here since the engine last heard (only those lines are sent)
    zoom: DEFAULT_ZOOM, row: DEFAULT_ROW, tool: "arrow", snap: true, quantize: 0.25, velocity: 100, audition: true,
    shape: "freehand",             // the Paint tool's shape in the lane
    range: null,                   // the Range tool's stretch of time: {from, to} (song positions)
    splitHover: null,              // where the Split tool would cut: {note, time}
    lane: "velocity", drag: null, pendingReload: false,
    downOnNotes: false,            // the last press was on the notes (a double-click there draws one)
    hover: null,                   // the lane's value under the mouse
    hoverTime: 0, hoverInside: false,  // where the mouse is over the notes (Paste goes there)
    seed: 0, seedEdited: false,    // the clip's seed (operators roll from it); changed here, not yet sent
    showOps: false                 // the Operators row shows
  };

  const grid = () => $("editor-grid");
  const isOpen = () => ed.clipId !== 0 && !document.body.classList.contains("hide-editor");
  const track = () => Hub.trackById(ed.trackId);
  const clipOf = () => { const t = track(); return t ? (t.clips || []).find((c) => c.id === ed.clipId) || null : null; };
  const noteName = (n) => NAMES[n % 12] + (Math.floor(n / 12) - 1);
  const keyOf = (n) => `${n.pitch}|${n.start.toFixed(5)}|${n.length.toFixed(5)}`;
  const selected = () => ed.notes.filter((n) => n.selected);
  const clipEnd = () => ed.clipStart + ed.clipLength;

  // The song's bars, as the song channel's time signatures count them (hub-tempo.js).
  const map = () => Hub.tempoMap;

  /** The bar a position is in, and the first bar line at or after a position. */
  const barAt = (t) => map().barAt(t);
  const barLineAtOrAfter = (t) => { const b = barAt(t - 1e-9); return t - b.start < 1e-9 ? b.start : b.end; };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- operators
  /** A note's operators, every one of them (the defaults where it has none). */
  const opsOf = (n) => Object.assign({}, OPS_DEFAULT, (n && n.ops) || {});
  const repeating = (o) => o.rn >= 2 || o.rr > 0;
  /** Repeats as the list has them: "off", "n:<count>" or "r:<note value>". */
  function repeatCode(o) {
    if (o.rn >= 2) return `n:${o.rn}`;
    if (!(o.rr > 0)) return "off";
    const known = Object.keys(RATES).find((code) => Math.abs(RATES[code] - o.rr) < 1e-6);
    return known || `r:${Math.round(o.rr * 1e6) / 1e6}`;
  }
  const chanceOf = (n) => opsOf(n).c;

  /** Only what isn't the default, in range (null when nothing is): as Sonify keeps it. */
  function tidyOps(o) {
    const t = {};
    const whole = (v, lo, hi, fallback) => (Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? Hub.clamp(Math.round(Number(v)), lo, hi) : fallback);
    const c = whole(o.c, 0, 100, 100), vs = whole(o.vs, 0, 100, 0);
    if (c !== 100) t.c = c;
    if (vs) t.vs = vs;
    const rn = whole(o.rn, 0, 64, 0), rr = Number(o.rr) || 0;
    if (rn >= 2) t.rn = rn;
    else if (rr >= 1 / 128 && rr <= 16) t.rr = rr;
    if (t.rn || t.rr) {
      const rc = whole(o.rc, -100, 100, 0), rv = whole(o.rv, -100, 100, 0);
      if (rc) t.rc = rc;
      if (rv) t.rv = rv;
    }
    if (OCCURRENCES.some(([code]) => code && code === o.oc)) t.oc = o.oc;
    const rl = whole(o.rl, 0, 8, 0);
    if (rl >= 2) { t.rl = rl; t.rm = whole(o.rm, 0, 255, 255) & ((1 << rl) - 1); }
    return Object.keys(t).length ? t : null;
  }

  /** Where a note's repeats start (song positions), as Sonify plays them: evenly or every note
      value through its length (cut at the clip's end), crowded by the curve; the ones crowded
      closer than the shortest note merge into the one before. */
  function repeatStarts(n) {
    const o = opsOf(n);
    if (!repeating(o)) return [n.start];
    const span = Math.min(n.start + n.length, clipEnd()) - n.start;
    if (span <= 2 / 128) return [n.start];
    const count = Hub.clamp(o.rn >= 2 ? o.rn : Math.ceil(span / o.rr - 1e-3), 1, 64);
    const exponent = Math.pow(4, -o.rc / 100);
    const place = (k) => Math.pow(o.rn >= 2 ? k / count : Math.min(1, (k * o.rr) / span), exponent);
    const starts = [n.start];
    let last = 0;
    for (let k = 1; k < count; k++) {
      if ((place(k) - last) * span < 1 / 128 || (1 - place(k)) * span < 1 / 128) continue;
      last = place(k);
      starts.push(n.start + last * span);
    }
    return starts;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- snapping
  // With Snap on, notes start, move and grow by the quantize value (counted from each bar's
  // start); a new note is that long.
  const step = () => (ed.snap ? ed.quantize : 0);
  const quantizeStep = (t) => map().stepOf(ed.quantize, t);
  const snapFloor = (t) => (step() ? map().snapFloor(t, quantizeStep(t)) : t);
  const snapRound = (t) => (step() ? map().snap(t, quantizeStep(t)) : t);
  const minLength = () => step() || 1 / 64;
  const newLength = () => ed.quantize;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
  /** A pointer position as a place in the grid's content: pixels, song time and pitch. */
  function point(event) {
    const box = grid();
    const r = box.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = event.clientX - r.left + box.scrollLeft;
    const y = event.clientY - r.top + box.scrollTop;
    return { x, y, time: Math.max(0, x / ed.zoom), pitch: Hub.clamp(127 - Math.floor(y / ed.row), 0, 127) };
  }

  /** Over the notes themselves, not the grid's scrollbars. */
  function overNotes(event) {
    const box = grid(), r = box.getBoundingClientRect();
    return event.clientX >= r.left && event.clientX < r.left + box.clientWidth && event.clientY >= r.top && event.clientY < r.top + box.clientHeight;
  }

  function noteAt(p) {
    for (let i = ed.notes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const n = ed.notes[i];
      if (n.pitch === p.pitch && p.time >= n.start && p.time < n.start + n.length) return n;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** On the right edge, where dragging changes the length. */
  function onEnd(n, p) {
    const endX = (n.start + n.length) * ed.zoom;
    return endX - p.x <= Math.min(6, (n.length * ed.zoom) / 3);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- engine
  /** Takes the clip's notes and lines from the engine, keeping the selection on the same notes. */
  function load() {
    const clip = clipOf();

    if (!clip) {
      ed.clipId = 0;
      ed.notes = [];
      render();
      return;
    }

    const keep = new Set(selected().map(keyOf));
    ed.clipStart = clip.start;
    ed.clipLength = clip.length;
    ed.clipOffset = clip.offset || 0;
    ed.notes = [];
    ed.hidden = [];
    const shows = (time) => time >= ed.clipOffset && time < ed.clipOffset + clip.length;

    // Only what the clip shows is edited here; what a trim hid stays as it is.
    for (const note of clip.notes || []) {
      const [pitch, start, length, velocity, muted, ops] = note;
      if (shows(start)) ed.notes.push({ pitch, start: clip.start + start - ed.clipOffset, length, velocity, muted: Boolean(muted),
                                        ops: ops && typeof ops === "object" ? tidyOps(opsOf({ ops })) : null, selected: false });
      else ed.hidden.push(note.slice());
    }

    // The clip's seed (unless one chosen here is still on its way).
    if (!ed.seedEdited) ed.seed = Number(clip.seed) || 0;

    for (const name of LINES) {
      ed.lines[name] = [];
      ed.hiddenLines[name] = [];
      for (const [time, value] of clip[name] || []) {
        if (shows(time)) ed.lines[name].push({ time: clip.start + time - ed.clipOffset, value });
        else ed.hiddenLines[name].push([time, value]);
      }
    }

    for (const n of ed.notes) n.selected = keep.has(keyOf(n));

    $("editor-title").textContent = `${track().name} · bar ${barAt(clip.start + 1e-9).index + 1}`;
    updateSize();
    render();
  }

  /** Sends the clip as edited; label names the undo step (a MIDI tool's name), else Edit Notes. */
  function commit(label) {
    ed.notes.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.pitch - b.pitch);
    const message = { trackId: ed.trackId, clipId: ed.clipId };
    if (typeof label === "string" && label) message.label = label;

    // Notes taken past the clip's edges grow it to whole bars, like Studio One's parts.
    let first = ed.clipStart, last = clipEnd();
    for (const n of ed.notes) { first = Math.min(first, n.start); last = Math.max(last, n.start + n.length); }

    if (first < ed.clipStart - 1e-9 || last > clipEnd() + 1e-9) {
      const start = barAt(Math.max(0, first) + 1e-9).start;
      const end = barLineAtOrAfter(last);
      ed.clipOffset += start - ed.clipStart;
      ed.clipStart = start;
      ed.clipLength = end - start;
      Object.assign(message, { start, length: ed.clipLength, offset: ed.clipOffset });
    }

    const content = (time) => time - ed.clipStart + ed.clipOffset;
    message.notes = ed.notes.map((n) => {
      const values = [n.pitch, content(n.start), n.length, Math.round(n.velocity)];
      if (n.muted || n.ops) values.push(n.muted ? 1 : 0);
      if (n.ops) values.push(n.ops);
      return values;
    }).concat(ed.hidden);

    if (ed.seedEdited) {
      message.seed = ed.seed;
      ed.seedEdited = false;
    }

    // A line goes along only when it was drawn here, so points the engine has that the Editor
    // hasn't heard of yet (a take recording into this clip) aren't overwritten by a note edit.
    for (const name of LINES) {
      if (!ed.edited[name]) continue;
      message[name] = ed.lines[name].map((p) => [content(p.time), Math.round(p.value)]).concat(ed.hiddenLines[name]).sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
      ed.edited[name] = false;
    }
    Hub.send("setClipNotes", message);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- audition
  let sounding = null, auditionTimer = 0;

  function stopAudition() {
    clearTimeout(auditionTimer);
    if (sounding === null) return;
    Hub.send("noteOff", { note: sounding });
    sounding = null;
  }

  function audition(pitch, velocity) {
    if (!ed.audition) return;
    stopAudition();
    sounding = pitch;
    Hub.send("noteOn", { note: pitch, velocity: velocity / 127 });
    auditionTimer = setTimeout(stopAudition, 220);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
  function sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height) {
    const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale));
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
      canvas.style.width = width + "px";
      canvas.style.height = height + "px";
    }
    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (context) context.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
    return context;
  }

  /** From colour a toward colour b by t (0..1). */
  function blend(a, b, t) {
    const rgb = (c) => [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(c.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
    const x = rgb(a), y = rgb(b);
    return "#" + x.map((v, i) => Math.round(v + (y[i] - v) * t).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  }

  /** Grid steps from a 64th note up to many bars (for the bar where the view starts); the
      finest (no finer than finest) at least minPx wide. */
  const gridStep = (minPx, finest = 0) => map().gridStep(grid().scrollLeft / ed.zoom, ed.zoom, minPx, finest);

  /** "5", "5.2" or "5.2.3" for a position, as fine as the label step needs. */
  const positionLabel = (t, labelStep) => map().label(t, labelStep.q);

  /** The lines down the grid, as Studio One draws them: every quantize step (when they're far
      enough apart to see), every beat, every bar, each counted from its bar's start. One path each. */
  function timeLines(context, sx, width, height, colours, minPx = 5) {
    const from = sx / ed.zoom, to = (sx + width) / ed.zoom + 1e-6;
    const ref = barAt(from);

    const draw = (lines, colour) => {
      context.strokeStyle = colour;
      context.beginPath();
      for (const line of lines) {
        const x = Math.round(line.ppq * ed.zoom - sx) + 0.5;
        context.moveTo(x, 0);
        context.lineTo(x, height);
      }
      context.stroke();
    };

    let bars = 1;
    while (ref.length * bars * ed.zoom < minPx && bars < 1024) bars *= 2;
    if (ed.quantize * ed.zoom >= minPx) draw(map().lines(from, to, map().stepOf(ed.quantize, from)).filter((l) => !l.beat), colours.fine);
    if (ref.beat * ed.zoom >= minPx) draw(map().lines(from, to, { q: ref.beat, bars: 0, beat: true }).filter((l) => !l.bar), colours.beat);
    draw(map().lines(from, to, { q: ref.length * bars, bars }), colours.bar);
  }

  function drawGrid() {
    const box = grid();
    const width = box.clientWidth, height = box.clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas($("editor-canvas"), width, height);
    if (!context) return;

    const sx = box.scrollLeft, sy = box.scrollTop;
    const colours = Hub.theme.roll;
    const firstRow = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sy / ed.row)), lastRow = Math.min(127, Math.ceil((sy + height) / ed.row));

    // Pitch rows: black keys darker, a line between every two.
    for (let row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; row++) {
      context.fillStyle = BLACK.has((127 - row) % 12) ? colours.black : colours.white;
      context.fillRect(0, row * ed.row - sy, width, ed.row);
    }
    context.fillStyle = colours.row;
    for (let row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; row++) context.fillRect(0, row * ed.row - sy + ed.row - 1, width, 1);

    // Down the grid: quantize steps, beats, bars.
    context.lineWidth = 1;
    timeLines(context, sx, width, height, colours);

    // A stronger line under every C, across them.
    context.fillStyle = colours.octave;
    for (let row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; row++)
      if ((127 - row) % 12 === 0) context.fillRect(0, row * ed.row - sy + ed.row - 1, width, 1);

    // Outside the clip is dimmed.
    const c0 = ed.clipStart * ed.zoom - sx, c1 = clipEnd() * ed.zoom - sx;
    context.fillStyle = colours.outside;
    if (c0 > 0) context.fillRect(0, 0, Math.min(c0, width), height);
    if (c1 < width) context.fillRect(Math.max(c1, 0), 0, width - Math.max(c1, 0), height);

    // The Range tool's stretch of time, right down the grid.
    if (ed.range) {
      const r0 = Math.round(ed.range.from * ed.zoom - sx), r1 = Math.round(ed.range.to * ed.zoom - sx);
      context.fillStyle = "rgba(37, 152, 77, 0.14)";
      context.fillRect(r0, 0, r1 - r0, height);
      context.fillStyle = Hub.theme.luminance >= 50 ? "#16702f" : "#3fd47a";
      context.fillRect(r0, 0, 1, height);
      context.fillRect(r1 - 1, 0, 1, height);
    }

    // Notes in the track's colour, stronger with velocity, on the grid's own pixels so a note
    // as long as the quantize fills one step exactly. Selected ones stand out in any look:
    // lighter on the dark grid, darker on the bright one, and outlined.
    const colour = (track() || {}).colour || "#25984d";
    const bright = Hub.theme.luminance >= 50;
    const chosen = bright ? blend(colour, "#000000", 0.45) : blend(colour, "#ffffff", 0.5);
    for (const n of ed.notes) {
      const x0 = Math.round(n.start * ed.zoom - sx), x1 = Math.round((n.start + n.length) * ed.zoom - sx);
      const w = Math.max(3, x1 - x0), y = (127 - n.pitch) * ed.row - sy;
      if (x0 > width || x0 + w < 0 || y > height || y + ed.row < 0) continue;
      // A muted note: hollow, its outline only (in the selection's colour when selected).
      if (n.muted) {
        context.globalAlpha = 0.14;
        context.fillStyle = colour;
        context.fillRect(x0, y + 1, w, ed.row - 2);
        context.globalAlpha = 1;
        context.strokeStyle = n.selected ? colours.mark : colour;
        context.lineWidth = n.selected ? 2 : 1;
        context.setLineDash([3, 2]);
        context.strokeRect(x0 + 1, y + 2, Math.max(1, w - 2), Math.max(1, ed.row - 4));
        context.setLineDash([]);
        context.lineWidth = 1;
        continue;
      }
      context.globalAlpha = n.selected ? 1 : 0.45 + 0.55 * (n.velocity / 127);
      context.fillStyle = n.selected ? chosen : colour;
      context.fillRect(x0, y + 1, w, ed.row - 2);
      context.globalAlpha = 1;
      if (n.ops) drawOps(context, n, x0, w, y, sx);
      if (n.selected && ed.row >= 8) {
        context.strokeStyle = colours.mark;
        context.lineWidth = 2;
        context.strokeRect(x0 + 1, y + 2, w - 2, ed.row - 4);
        context.lineWidth = 1;
      } else {
        context.strokeStyle = n.selected ? colours.mark : "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)";
        context.strokeRect(x0 + 0.5, y + 1.5, w - 1, ed.row - 3);
      }
    }

    // Where the Split tool would cut the note under the pointer.
    const cut = ed.splitHover;
    if (cut && ed.tool === "split" && !ed.drag) {
      const x = Math.round(cut.time * ed.zoom - sx) + 0.5, y = (127 - cut.note.pitch) * ed.row - sy;
      context.strokeStyle = bright ? "#000000" : "#ffffff";
      context.lineWidth = 2;
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(x, y - 2);
      context.lineTo(x, y + ed.row + 2);
      context.stroke();
      context.lineWidth = 1;
    }

    // The selection box while dragging one.
    const d = ed.drag;
    if (d && d.kind === "box") {
      const x = Math.min(d.from.x, d.to.x) - sx, y = Math.min(d.from.y, d.to.y) - sy;
      const w = Math.abs(d.to.x - d.from.x), h = Math.abs(d.to.y - d.from.y);
      context.fillStyle = "rgba(37, 152, 77, 0.18)";
      context.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
      context.strokeStyle = bright ? "#16702f" : "#3fd47a";
      context.strokeRect(Math.round(x) + 0.5, Math.round(y) + 0.5, Math.round(w), Math.round(h));
    }
  }

  /** A note's operators, drawn on it: a line at each repeat, a die's dots for Chance (one to
      five), a corner for Occurrence, a square a pass for Recurrence (filled where it plays). */
  function drawOps(context, n, x0, w, y, sx) {
    const o = opsOf(n);
    if (ed.row < 7) return;
    // Dark on a light note, light on a dark one (a selected note is lighter on the dark grid,
    // darker on the bright one).
    const darkInk = (Hub.theme.luminance >= 50) !== Boolean(n.selected);
    const ink = darkInk ? "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78)" : "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)";
    context.save();
    context.beginPath();
    context.rect(x0, y + 1, w, ed.row - 2);
    context.clip();
    context.fillStyle = ink;
    context.strokeStyle = ink;

    if (repeating(o))
      for (const t of repeatStarts(n).slice(1)) context.fillRect(Math.round(t * ed.zoom - sx), y + 2, 1, ed.row - 4);

    if (o.c < 100 && w >= 8) {
      const dots = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(o.c / 20));
      for (let i = 0; i < dots && 3 + i * 4 < w - 2; i++) {
        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(x0 + 3.5 + i * 4, y + 4.5, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fill();
      }
    }

    if (o.oc && w >= 6) {
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(x0 + w - 1, y + 1);
      context.lineTo(x0 + w - 1, y + 6);
      context.lineTo(x0 + w - 6, y + 1);
      context.closePath();
      context.fill();
    }

    if (o.rl >= 2) {
      const size = Math.max(2, Math.min(4, ed.row - 7));
      const across = o.rl * (size + 1);
      if (across + 4 <= w) {
        const left = x0 + w - across - 2, top = y + ed.row - size - 3;
        for (let k = 0; k < o.rl; k++) {
          const x = left + k * (size + 1);
          if ((o.rm >> k) & 1) context.fillRect(x, top, size, size);
          else context.strokeRect(x + 0.5, top + 0.5, size - 1, size - 1);
        }
      }
    }

    context.restore();
  }

  function drawKeys() {
    const canvas = $("editor-keys");
    const width = canvas.parentElement.clientWidth, height = grid().clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height);
    if (!context) return;

    const sy = grid().scrollTop;
    const lit = new Set((Hub.state.status && Hub.state.status.notes) || []);
    const blackWidth = Math.round(width * 0.62);
    const firstRow = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sy / ed.row)), lastRow = Math.min(127, Math.ceil((sy + height) / ed.row));
    context.font = "9px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif";
    context.textBaseline = "middle";

    // The white keys under everything.
    context.fillStyle = "#e6e6e8";
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    for (let row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; row++) {
      const pitch = 127 - row;
      if (lit.has(pitch) && !BLACK.has(pitch % 12)) {
        context.fillStyle = "#95d3a1";
        context.fillRect(0, row * ed.row - sy, width, ed.row);
      }
    }

    // The lines between white keys: right across where no black key sits between them (E and F,
    // B and C), and from a black key's tip to the edge through its middle everywhere else.
    context.fillStyle = "#9ea2a8";
    for (let row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; row++) {
      const pitch = 127 - row, y = row * ed.row - sy;
      if (pitch % 12 === 0 || pitch % 12 === 5) context.fillRect(0, y + ed.row - 1, width, 1);
      if (BLACK.has(pitch % 12)) context.fillRect(blackWidth, y + Math.floor(ed.row / 2), width - blackWidth, 1);
    }

    // The black keys over them.
    for (let row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; row++) {
      const pitch = 127 - row;
      if (!BLACK.has(pitch % 12)) continue;
      context.fillStyle = lit.has(pitch) ? "#25984d" : "#1c1c1f";
      context.fillRect(0, row * ed.row - sy + 1, blackWidth, ed.row - 2);
    }

    // Every C named; the edge against the grid.
    context.fillStyle = "#55585e";
    for (let row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; row++) {
      const pitch = 127 - row;
      if (pitch % 12 === 0) context.fillText(noteName(pitch), width - 26, row * ed.row - sy + ed.row / 2);
    }
    context.fillStyle = "#9ea2a8";
    context.fillRect(width - 1, 0, 1, height);
  }

  function drawRuler() {
    const canvas = $("editor-ruler");
    const width = grid().clientWidth, height = canvas.parentElement.clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height);
    if (!context) return;

    const sx = grid().scrollLeft;
    const beat = barAt(sx / ed.zoom).beat;
    context.fillStyle = "#1d1e21";
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // The clip's extent along the top.
    const c0 = ed.clipStart * ed.zoom - sx, c1 = clipEnd() * ed.zoom - sx;
    context.fillStyle = (track() || {}).colour || "#25984d";
    context.fillRect(c0, 0, c1 - c0, 3);

    // Ticks where the grid has lines (quantize steps, beats, bars), numbers as room allows.
    context.font = "11px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif";
    context.textBaseline = "top";
    const from = sx / ed.zoom, to = (sx + width) / ed.zoom + 1e-6;
    const tick = ed.quantize * ed.zoom >= 8 ? map().stepOf(Math.min(ed.quantize, beat), from)
                                            : beat * ed.zoom >= 8 ? { q: beat, bars: 0, beat: true } : gridStep(8);
    const label = gridStep(56, 0.25);
    const labelledAt = new Set(map().lines(from, to, label).map((line) => line.ppq.toFixed(6)));

    for (const line of map().lines(from, to, tick)) {
      const t = line.ppq, x = Math.round(t * ed.zoom - sx) + 0.5;
      const labelled = labelledAt.has(t.toFixed(6));
      context.strokeStyle = line.bar ? Hub.theme.muted : Hub.theme.tick;
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(x, labelled ? 6 : line.beat ? height - 8 : height - 5);
      context.lineTo(x, height);
      context.stroke();
      if (labelled) {
        context.fillStyle = line.bar ? Hub.theme.text : Hub.theme.muted;
        context.fillText(positionLabel(t, label), x + 3, 5);
      }
    }
    context.fillStyle = Hub.theme.line;
    context.fillRect(0, height - 1, width, 1);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the lane under the notes
  /** A lane's y for a value: Pitch Bend's rest in the middle, the rest from the bottom. */
  function laneY(value, height) {
    if (ed.lane === "pitchBend") {
      const mid = height / 2, half = height / 2 - 3;
      return mid - (value >= 0 ? value / BEND_MAX : value / -BEND_MIN) * half;
    }
    const top = 3, bottom = height - 1;
    return bottom - (value / (ed.lane === "velocity" ? 127 : ed.lane === "chance" ? 100 : PRESSURE_MAX)) * (bottom - top);
  }

  /** The value at a pointer position in the lane (and its song time). */
  function laneValue(event) {
    const canvas = $("editor-lane");
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const height = r.height || 1;
    const y = Hub.clamp(event.clientY - r.top, 0, height);
    const time = Math.max(0, (event.clientX - r.left + grid().scrollLeft) / ed.zoom);

    if (ed.lane === "pitchBend") {
      const mid = height / 2, half = height / 2 - 3;
      const share = Hub.clamp((mid - y) / half, -1, 1);
      const value = share >= 0 ? Math.round(share * BEND_MAX) : Math.round(share * -BEND_MIN);
      return { time, value: Math.abs(value) < 0.05 * BEND_MAX ? 0 : value };   // the middle catches
    }

    const top = 3, bottom = height - 1;
    const share = Hub.clamp((bottom - y) / (bottom - top), 0, 1);
    if (ed.lane === "chance") return { time, value: Math.round(share * 100) };
    return ed.lane === "velocity" ? { time, value: Hub.clamp(Math.round(share * 127), 1, 127) } : { time, value: Math.round(share * PRESSURE_MAX) };
  }

  /** What a line stands at where the clip's window opens: the last point a trim hid before it. */
  function lineStart(name) {
    let value = 0;
    for (const [time, v] of ed.hiddenLines[name]) if (time < ed.clipOffset) value = v;
    return value;
  }

  function laneText(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
    if (ed.lane === "pitchBend") return value > 0 ? `+${value}` : String(value);
    if (ed.lane === "chance") return `${value}%`;
    return String(value);
  }

  function drawLane() {
    const canvas = $("editor-lane");
    const width = grid().clientWidth, height = canvas.parentElement.clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height);
    if (!context) return;

    const sx = grid().scrollLeft;
    const colours = Hub.theme.roll;
    context.fillStyle = colours.velocity;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    context.lineWidth = 1;
    timeLines(context, sx, width, height, { fine: colours.velocity, beat: colours.velocityLine, bar: colours.bar }, 6);

    const c0 = ed.clipStart * ed.zoom - sx, c1 = clipEnd() * ed.zoom - sx;
    const colour = (track() || {}).colour || "#25984d";

    if (BARS.has(ed.lane)) {
      const chance = ed.lane === "chance";
      context.fillStyle = colours.velocityLine;
      context.fillRect(0, Math.round(height / 2), width, 1);
      for (const n of ed.notes) {
        const x = Math.round(n.start * ed.zoom - sx);
        if (x < -4 || x > width) continue;
        const value = chance ? chanceOf(n) : n.velocity;
        const top = Math.round(laneY(value, height));
        // Vel Spread: the range a pass may move the velocity to, faint behind its bar.
        const spread = chance ? 0 : opsOf(n).vs * 1.27;
        if (spread > 0) {
          const high = Math.round(laneY(Math.min(127, n.velocity + spread), height));
          const low = Math.round(laneY(Math.max(1, n.velocity - spread), height));
          context.globalAlpha = 0.28;
          context.fillStyle = n.selected ? colours.mark : colour;
          context.fillRect(x - 2, high, 7, Math.max(1, low - high));
        }
        context.globalAlpha = n.muted ? 0.35 : 1;
        context.fillStyle = n.selected ? colours.mark : colour;
        context.fillRect(x, top, 3, height - top);
        context.fillRect(x - 1, top - 1, 5, 3);
        context.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    } else {
      const bend = ed.lane === "pitchBend";
      const base = bend ? Math.round(height / 2) : height - 1;
      context.fillStyle = colours.velocityLine;
      context.fillRect(0, base - (bend ? 0 : 1), width, 1);

      // A step line: each point holds until the next; back to rest at the clip's end.
      let value = lineStart(ed.lane);
      const path = new Path2D();
      path.moveTo(c0, laneY(value, height));
      for (const p of ed.lines[ed.lane]) {
        const x = p.time * ed.zoom - sx;
        path.lineTo(x, laneY(value, height));
        value = p.value;
        path.lineTo(x, laneY(value, height));
      }
      path.lineTo(c1, laneY(value, height));

      const area = new Path2D(path);
      area.lineTo(c1, base);
      area.lineTo(c0, base);
      area.closePath();
      context.globalAlpha = 0.3;
      context.fillStyle = colour;
      context.fill(area);
      context.globalAlpha = 1;
      context.strokeStyle = colour;
      context.lineWidth = 1.5;
      context.stroke(path);
      context.lineWidth = 1;
    }

    // Outside the clip is dimmed, as above.
    context.fillStyle = colours.outside;
    if (c0 > 0) context.fillRect(0, 0, Math.min(c0, width), height);
    if (c1 < width) context.fillRect(Math.max(c1, 0), 0, width - Math.max(c1, 0), height);

    $("editor-lane-label").textContent = laneText(ed.hover);
  }

  function placePlayhead() {
    const playhead = $("editor-playhead");
    const box = grid();
    const x = Hub.songPosition() * ed.zoom - box.scrollLeft;
    playhead.hidden = !isOpen() || x < 0 || x > box.clientWidth;
    playhead.style.height = ($("editor-ruler-wrap").offsetHeight + box.clientHeight) + "px";
    playhead.style.transform = `translateX(${Math.round(x)}px)`;
  }

  function render() {
    const open = ed.clipId !== 0;
    $("editor").classList.toggle("empty", !open);
    document.querySelectorAll("#editor-toolbar [data-tool]").forEach((b) => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.tool === ed.tool)));
    document.querySelectorAll("#editor-lane-tabs [data-lane]").forEach((b) => b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(b.dataset.lane === ed.lane)));
    grid().dataset.tool = ed.tool;
    $("editor-lane-wrap").dataset.tool = !BARS.has(ed.lane) && ed.tool === "eraser" ? "eraser" : "pencil";
    renderOps();
    $("editor-lane").setAttribute("aria-label", LANE_TIPS[ed.lane]);
    $("editor-lane").title = LANE_TIPS[ed.lane];
    if (!open || document.body.classList.contains("hide-editor")) return;
    drawGrid();
    drawKeys();
    drawRuler();
    drawLane();
    placePlayhead();
    showZoom();
  }

  function updateSize() {
    const quarters = Math.max(map().ppqOfBar(200), map().ppqOfBar(barAt(clipEnd()).index + 32));
    $("editor-size").style.width = Math.ceil(quarters * ed.zoom) + "px";
    $("editor-size").style.height = 128 * ed.row + "px";
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- editing gestures
  function erase(p) {
    const n = noteAt(p);
    if (!n) return;
    ed.notes.splice(ed.notes.indexOf(n), 1);
    ed.drag.erased = true;
  }

  /** A new note where the pointer is, as long as the quantize value, selected alone. */
  function addNote(p) {
    for (const n of ed.notes) n.selected = false;
    const note = { pitch: p.pitch, start: snapFloor(p.time), length: newLength(), velocity: ed.velocity, selected: true };
    ed.notes.push(note);
    audition(note.pitch, note.velocity);
    return note;
  }

  /** The Split tool: the note cut in two at a time (and, when it's selected, every selected
      note under that time). Each part keeps the note's pitch, velocity and mute. */
  function splitAt(hit, time) {
    const pool = hit.selected ? selected() : [hit];
    const shortest = minLength();
    let cut = false;

    for (const n of pool) {
      if (time <= n.start + shortest / 2 || time >= n.start + n.length - shortest / 2) continue;
      const rest = { pitch: n.pitch, start: time, length: n.start + n.length - time, velocity: n.velocity, muted: n.muted, ops: n.ops, selected: n.selected };
      n.length = time - n.start;
      ed.notes.push(rest);
      cut = true;
    }

    if (cut) commit();
    render();
  }

  /** The Split tool's cut, on the grid with Snap on. */
  const splitTime = (p) => (ed.snap ? snapRound(p.time) : p.time);

  /** The Mute tool: a note muted or unmuted, as the drag began (with a selected one, the selection). */
  function muteNote(n, d) {
    const pool = n.selected && d.first ? selected() : [n];
    for (const each of pool) {
      if (d.touched.has(each)) continue;
      d.touched.add(each);
      if (each.muted !== d.state) { each.muted = d.state; d.changed = true; }
    }
    d.first = false;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the Listen tool
  let listening = null;   // {wasPlaying, from, trackId, soloed}

  /** Held down: the clip's track alone, from the pointer's time. */
  function startListening(p) {
    stopListening();
    const t = track();
    listening = { wasPlaying: Boolean(Hub.transportInfo().playing), from: Hub.songPosition(), trackId: ed.trackId, soloed: false };
    if (t && !t.solo) {
      t.solo = true;
      listening.soloed = true;
      Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: t.id, solo: true });
    }
    Hub.locate(p.time);
    if (!listening.wasPlaying) Hub.run("play");
  }

  /** Let go: the song stops and goes back where it was (if it wasn't playing), the solo goes. */
  function stopListening() {
    if (!listening) return;
    const was = listening;
    listening = null;
    if (!was.wasPlaying) {
      if (Hub.transportInfo().playing) Hub.run("stop");
      Hub.locate(was.from);
    }
    if (was.soloed) {
      const t = Hub.trackById(was.trackId);
      if (t) t.solo = false;
      Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: was.trackId, solo: false });
    }
  }

  function onPointerDown(event) {
    ed.downOnNotes = event.target === $("editor-canvas");
