// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-guide.js
//
// The Guide studio (the top bar's selector, Ctrl+9): Sonify's user guide, and Fanan AI answering
// anything about Sonify.
//
// The guide is sonify_guide.md, compiled into Sonify with the page: "# " lines are the guide's
// tabs (Getting Started, Studio, Analog Board...), "## " lines the chapters in each tab, shown as
// a row of selectors over the chapter's text. Inside a chapter: "### " headings, "- " bullets,
// "1. " steps, "> " tips, and paragraphs (one line each); **bold** for the names of buttons,
// menus and keys. The search box finds chapters by their words, in every tab. The chapter last
// read opens again next time.
//
// "Ask anything about Sonify", on the right: a question goes to Sonify (a "guide" event:
// { action: "ask", text, reading }, reading being the chapter open here), which asks Fanan AI
// with the same guide (GuideAi), with the Fanan account's credits. Sonify sends "guideState":
// { busy, entries: [{ role: "user" | "ai" | "notice", text }] } and the account (configured,
// blocked, status, signedIn, credits, siteAvailable), as the AI panels have it. In an answer,
// [[Tab > Chapter]] is a link that opens that chapter.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const PLACE_KEY = "sonify.guide.place";
  const EXAMPLES = [
    "How do I record my voice on a new track?",
    "How do I export my song as an audio file?",
    "How do I turn a plugin I made into a VST3 or CLAP plugin?",
  ];

  let tabs = [];          // [{ name, chapters: [{ title, lines: [] }] }]
  let loaded = false, loading = false, failed = false;
  let tabIndex = 0, chapterIndex = 0;
  let shown = false;
  let state = { busy: false, entries: [], configured: true, blocked: false, status: "checking",
                signedIn: false, credits: -1, siteAvailable: false };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the guide's text
  function parse(text) {
    const result = [];
    let tab = null, chapter = null;

    for (const raw of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      const line = raw.replace(/\s+$/, "");
      if (line.trimStart().startsWith("<!--")) continue;   // the file's title

      if (line.startsWith("# ")) {
        tab = { name: line.slice(2).trim(), chapters: [] };
        result.push(tab);
        chapter = null;
      } else if (line.startsWith("## ")) {
        if (!tab) { tab = { name: "Guide", chapters: [] }; result.push(tab); }
        chapter = { title: line.slice(3).trim(), lines: [] };
        tab.chapters.push(chapter);
      } else if (chapter) {
        chapter.lines.push(line);
      }
    }

    return result.filter((t) => t.chapters.length);
  }

  /** A line's **bold** parts, as text and strong nodes. */
  function inline(parent, text) {
    const parts = text.split("**");
    const closed = parts.length % 2 === 1;   // an odd number of marks: the last one stays as it is

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      if (!part) return;
      const bold = i % 2 === 1 && (closed || i < parts.length - 1);
      if (bold) parent.appendChild(element("strong", "", part));
      else parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(i % 2 === 1 ? "**" + part : part));
    });
  }

  function renderChapterText(article, tab, chapter) {
    article.replaceChildren();
    const inner = element("div", "guide-page-text");
    inner.appendChild(element("div", "guide-crumb", tab.name));
    inner.appendChild(element("h3", "guide-title", chapter.title));

    let list = null;
    const endList = () => { list = null; };

    for (const line of chapter.lines) {
      const trimmed = line.trim();

      if (!trimmed) { endList(); continue; }

      if (trimmed.startsWith("### ")) {
        endList();
        const heading = element("h4", "guide-heading");
        inline(heading, trimmed.slice(4));
        inner.appendChild(heading);
      } else if (/^[-*] /.test(trimmed)) {
        if (!list || list.tagName !== "UL") { list = element("ul", "guide-list"); inner.appendChild(list); }
        const item = element("li");
        inline(item, trimmed.slice(2));
        list.appendChild(item);
      } else if (/^\d+\. /.test(trimmed)) {
        if (!list || list.tagName !== "OL") { list = element("ol", "guide-steps"); inner.appendChild(list); }
        const item = element("li");
        inline(item, trimmed.replace(/^\d+\.\s+/, ""));
        list.appendChild(item);
      } else if (trimmed.startsWith("> ")) {
        endList();
        const tip = element("p", "guide-tip");
        const body = trimmed.slice(2).replace(/^Tip:\s*/i, "");
        tip.appendChild(element("span", "guide-tip-mark", "Tip"));
        inline(tip, body);
        inner.appendChild(tip);
      } else {
        endList();
        const paragraph = element("p", "guide-para");
        inline(paragraph, trimmed);
        inner.appendChild(paragraph);
      }
    }

    // On to the chapter before or after, across the tabs.
    const nav = element("div", "guide-nav");
    const before = neighbour(-1), after = neighbour(1);
    if (before) nav.appendChild(navButton("\u2190 " + before.label, before.tab, before.chapter));
    nav.appendChild(element("span", "guide-nav-gap"));
    if (after) nav.appendChild(navButton(after.label + " \u2192", after.tab, after.chapter));
    inner.appendChild(nav);

    article.appendChild(inner);
    article.scrollTop = 0;
  }

  function neighbour(step) {
    let t = tabIndex, c = chapterIndex + step;
    if (c < 0) { t -= 1; if (t < 0) return null; c = tabs[t].chapters.length - 1; }
    else if (c >= tabs[t].chapters.length) { t += 1; if (t >= tabs.length) return null; c = 0; }
    const label = t === tabIndex ? tabs[t].chapters[c].title : tabs[t].name + ": " + tabs[t].chapters[c].title;
    return { tab: t, chapter: c, label };
  }

  function navButton(text, tab, chapter) {
    const button = element("button", "plain-button small guide-nav-button", text);
    button.type = "button";
    button.addEventListener("click", () => open(tab, chapter));
    return button;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- tabs, selectors and the page
  function renderTabs() {
    const row = $("guide-tabs");
    row.replaceChildren();

    tabs.forEach((tab, i) => {
      const button = element("button", "guide-tab", tab.name);
      button.type = "button";
      button.setAttribute("role", "tab");
      button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(i === tabIndex));
      button.tabIndex = i === tabIndex ? 0 : -1;
      button.addEventListener("click", () => open(i, 0));
      row.appendChild(button);
    });
  }

  function renderChapters() {
    const grid = $("guide-chapters");
    grid.replaceChildren();
    const tab = tabs[tabIndex];
    if (!tab) return;

    tab.chapters.forEach((chapter, i) => {
      const button = element("button", "guide-chapter");
      button.type = "button";
      button.setAttribute("role", "tab");
      button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(i === chapterIndex));
      button.tabIndex = i === chapterIndex ? 0 : -1;
      button.append(element("span", "guide-chapter-number", String(i + 1)), element("span", "guide-chapter-name", chapter.title));
      button.addEventListener("click", () => open(tabIndex, i));
      grid.appendChild(button);
    });
  }

  function renderPage() {
    const article = $("guide-text");

    if (!loaded) {
      article.replaceChildren(element("p", "guide-empty", failed ? "The guide couldn't be loaded." : "Loading the guide\u2026"));
      return;
    }

    const query = $("guide-search").value.trim();
    renderTabs();
    renderChapters();

    if (query) renderResults(article, query);
    else renderChapterText(article, tabs[tabIndex], tabs[tabIndex].chapters[chapterIndex]);
  }

  /** Opens a chapter (the search, if any, is done with). */
  function open(tab, chapter) {
    if (!tabs[tab] || !tabs[tab].chapters[chapter]) return;
    tabIndex = tab;
    chapterIndex = chapter;
    $("guide-search").value = "";
    try { localStorage.setItem(PLACE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ tab: tabs[tab].name, chapter: tabs[tab].chapters[chapter].title })); } catch (e) { /* not kept */ }
    renderPage();
  }

  function plainName(text) {
    return String(text).replace(/[\[\]"*]/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();
  }

  /** A chapter by its name, "Tab > Chapter" (or a chapter's title, or a tab's): [tab, chapter] or null. */
  function find(name) {
    const wanted = plainName(name);
    if (!wanted) return null;

    if (wanted.includes(">")) {
      const at = wanted.indexOf(">");
      const tab = wanted.slice(0, at).trim(), title = wanted.slice(at + 1).trim();
      for (let t = 0; t < tabs.length; t++)
        for (let c = 0; c < tabs[t].chapters.length; c++)
          if (plainName(tabs[t].name) === tab && plainName(tabs[t].chapters[c].title) === title) return [t, c];
      return find(title);
    }

    for (let t = 0; t < tabs.length; t++)
      for (let c = 0; c < tabs[t].chapters.length; c++)
        if (plainName(tabs[t].chapters[c].title) === wanted) return [t, c];

    for (let t = 0; t < tabs.length; t++)
      if (plainName(tabs[t].name) === wanted) return [t, 0];

    return null;
  }

  function openByName(name) {
    const found = find(name);
    if (found) open(found[0], found[1]);
    return Boolean(found);
  }

  function readingName() {
    const tab = tabs[tabIndex];
    const chapter = tab && tab.chapters[chapterIndex];
    return chapter && !$("guide-search").value.trim() ? tab.name + " > " + chapter.title : "";
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the search
  function renderResults(article, query) {
    article.replaceChildren();
    const inner = element("div", "guide-page-text");
    const words = query.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    const found = [];

    tabs.forEach((tab, t) => tab.chapters.forEach((chapter, c) => {
      const title = chapter.title.toLowerCase();
      const body = chapter.lines.join("\n").replace(/\*\*/g, "").toLowerCase();
      if (!words.every((word) => title.includes(word) || body.includes(word) || tab.name.toLowerCase().includes(word))) return;
      const score = words.reduce((sum, word) => sum + (title.includes(word) ? 10 : 0) + Math.min(5, body.split(word).length - 1), 0);
      const line = chapter.lines.find((l) => l.toLowerCase().includes(words[0])) || chapter.lines.find((l) => l.trim()) || "";
      found.push({ t, c, score, line: line.replace(/^\s*(#+|[-*]|\d+\.|>)\s*/, "").replace(/\*\*/g, "") });
    }));

    found.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    inner.appendChild(element("div", "guide-crumb", "Search"));
    inner.appendChild(element("h3", "guide-title", found.length ? `${found.length} ${found.length === 1 ? "chapter" : "chapters"} for "${query}"`
                                                               : `Nothing in the guide for "${query}"`));
    if (!found.length) inner.appendChild(element("p", "guide-para", "Try other words, or ask Fanan AI on the right."));

    for (const result of found.slice(0, 40)) {
      const tab = tabs[result.t], chapter = tab.chapters[result.c];
      const button = element("button", "guide-result");
      button.type = "button";
      button.appendChild(element("span", "guide-result-name", tab.name + " > " + chapter.title));
      const snippet = result.line.length > 180 ? result.line.slice(0, 177) + "..." : result.line;
      button.appendChild(element("span", "guide-result-line", snippet));
      button.addEventListener("click", () => open(result.t, result.c));
      inner.appendChild(button);
    }

    article.appendChild(inner);
    article.scrollTop = 0;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Ask anything about Sonify
  /** A line's inline marks, each only when closed on the same line: **bold**, *italic*, `code`
      (shown as plain words), and [[Tab > Chapter]] (a link to that chapter). */
  function inlineAnswer(parent, line, bold) {
    const pieces = line.split(/(\[\[[^\]]+\]\])/);

    for (const piece of pieces) {
      const link = /^\[\[([^\]]+)\]\]$/.exec(piece);

      if (link) {
        const name = link[1].trim();
        if (find(name)) {
          const button = element("button", "guide-link", name);
          button.type = "button";
          button.title = "Open this chapter of the guide";
          button.addEventListener("click", () => openByName(name));
          parent.appendChild(button);
        } else {
          parent.appendChild(element("span", bold ? "ai-bold" : "", name));
        }
        continue;
      }

      let italic = false, code = false, current = "";
      const flush = () => {
        if (current) parent.appendChild(element("span", [bold && "ai-bold", italic && "ai-italic"].filter(Boolean).join(" "), current));
        current = "";
      };
      const closedLater = (mark, from) => piece.indexOf(mark, from) >= 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < piece.length;) {
        if (!code && piece.startsWith("**", i) && (bold || closedLater("**", i + 2))) { flush(); bold = !bold; i += 2; }
        else if (piece[i] === "`" && (code || closedLater("`", i + 1))) { flush(); code = !code; i += 1; }
        else if (!code && piece[i] === "*" && (italic || (i + 1 < piece.length && piece[i + 1] !== " " && closedLater("*", i + 1)))) { flush(); italic = !italic; i += 1; }
        else { current += piece[i]; i += 1; }
      }
      flush();
    }
  }

  function renderAnswer(text) {
    const lines = [];
    let inCode = false;
    for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      if (line.trimStart().startsWith("```")) inCode = !inCode;
      else if (!inCode) lines.push(line);
    }
    while (lines.length && !lines[lines.length - 1].trim()) lines.pop();

    const box = element("div", "ai-text");

    for (const original of lines) {
      let line = original;
      const trimmed = line.trimStart();
      let kind = "";

      if (trimmed === "---" || trimmed === "***" || trimmed === "___") line = "";
      else if (trimmed.startsWith("#")) { line = trimmed.replace(/^#+\s*/, ""); kind = " heading"; }
      else if (/^([-*]|\u2022) /.test(trimmed)) { line = trimmed.slice(2); kind = " bullet"; }
      else if (trimmed.startsWith("> ")) line = trimmed.slice(2);

      const row = element("div", "ai-line" + kind);
      row.dir = "auto";   // Hebrew, Arabic...: right to left
      inlineAnswer(row, line, kind === " heading");
      box.appendChild(row);
    }

    return box;
  }

  /** [why Fanan AI can't answer right now, what a button does about it, the button's text]. */
  function whyNot() {
    const tryAgain = () => Hub.send("accountCheck");
    if (!state.configured) return ["Fanan AI isn't set up in this build yet."];
    if (state.blocked) return ["The internet is blocked (top left): Fanan AI works through it."];
    if (state.status === "checking") return ["Connecting to Fanan's server\u2026"];
    if (state.status === "noInternet") return ["No internet connection: Fanan AI works through it.", tryAgain, "Try again"];
    if (state.status !== "online") return ["Fanan's server isn't responding right now.", tryAgain, "Try again"];
    if (!state.signedIn) return ["Sign in to ask Fanan AI. It's your Fanan account: its Fanan AI credits work in every Fanan app.", () => Hub.run("account"), "Sign in"];
    if (state.credits === 0) return ["You're out of credits.", () => Hub.run("buyCredits"), "Buy credits"];
    return [""];
  }

  function renderAsk() {
    const log = $("guide-ask-log");
    const nearBottom = log.scrollHeight - log.scrollTop - log.clientHeight < 40;
    log.replaceChildren();

    if (!state.entries.length) {
      const hello = element("div", "ai-hello");
      hello.appendChild(element("p", "", "Ask anything about Sonify: how to do something, where to find it, what a studio is for. "
                                          + "Fanan AI answers from this guide, in your language, and links the chapters to read."));
      for (const text of EXAMPLES) {
        const example = element("button", "ai-example", text);
        example.type = "button";
        example.addEventListener("click", () => { $("guide-ask-input").value = text; $("guide-ask-input").focus(); });
        hello.appendChild(example);
      }
      hello.appendChild(element("p", "guide-ask-cost", "Each question uses Fanan AI credits, like any Fanan AI request."));
      log.appendChild(hello);
    }

    for (const entry of state.entries) {
      if (entry.role === "ai") {
        const box = element("div", "ai-assistant");
        box.appendChild(renderAnswer(entry.text || ""));
        log.appendChild(box);
      } else {
        const line = element("div", entry.role === "user" ? "ai-user" : "ai-error", entry.text);
        line.dir = "auto";
        log.appendChild(line);
      }
    }

    if (state.busy) log.appendChild(element("div", "ai-working", "Fanan AI is reading the guide\u2026"));
    if (nearBottom || state.busy) log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;

    const [reason, action, actionText] = whyNot();
    $("guide-ask-notice").hidden = !reason;
    $("guide-ask-notice-text").textContent = reason;
    $("guide-ask-notice-action").hidden = !action;
    $("guide-ask-notice-action").textContent = actionText || "";
    $("guide-ask-notice-action").onclick = action || null;
    $("guide-ask-input").disabled = Boolean(reason);
    $("guide-ask-send").disabled = Boolean(reason);
    $("guide-ask-send").hidden = state.busy;
    $("guide-ask-stop").hidden = !state.busy;
    $("guide-ask-clear").disabled = state.busy || !state.entries.length;

    const credits = $("guide-ask-credits");
    credits.replaceChildren();
    if (state.signedIn && state.credits >= 0) {
      credits.appendChild(document.createTextNode(`${state.credits} ${state.credits === 1 ? "credit" : "credits"}`));
      if (state.siteAvailable) {
        const buy = element("button", "ai-buy", "Buy credits");
        buy.type = "button";
        buy.title = "Buy Fanan AI credits on the Fanan site: they work in every Fanan app";
        buy.addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("buyCredits"));
        credits.append(" \u00b7 ", buy);
      }
    }
  }

  function ask() {
    const input = $("guide-ask-input");
    const text = input.value.trim();
    if (!text || state.busy || input.disabled) return;
    Hub.send("guide", { action: "ask", text, reading: readingName() });
    input.value = "";
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- loading and showing
  function restorePlace() {
    try {
      const place = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PLACE_KEY) || "null");
      const found = place && find(place.tab + " > " + place.chapter);
      if (found) { tabIndex = found[0]; chapterIndex = found[1]; }
    } catch (e) { /* the first chapter, then */ }
  }

  function load() {
    if (loaded || loading) return;
    loading = true;
    failed = false;

    fetch("sonify_guide.md")
      .then((response) => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error("status " + response.status);
        return response.text();
      })
      .then((text) => {
        tabs = parse(text);
        if (!tabs.length) throw new Error("empty");
        loaded = true;
        restorePlace();
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        failed = true;
        console.error("Guide: the guide couldn't be loaded", error);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        loading = false;
        renderPage();
      });
  }

  function show(on) {
    shown = on;
    if (!on) return;
    load();
    renderPage();
    renderAsk();
    Hub.send("guide", { action: "state" });
  }

  Hub.guide = { show, open: openByName, isShown: () => shown };

  // Sonify's answers (an event the page's own list doesn't name, so it's listened to here).
  if (window.__JUCE__ && window.__JUCE__.backend)
    window.__JUCE__.backend.addEventListener("guideState", (data) => Hub.emit("guideState", data));

  Hub.on("guideState", (data) => {
    state = { ...state, ...data };
    renderAsk();
  });

  /** The arrow keys move along a row of tabs or selectors while it has the focus. */
  function arrowKeys(row, move) {
    row.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight") return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      move(event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 1);
      const selected = row.querySelector('[aria-selected="true"]');
      if (selected) selected.focus();
    });
  }

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const input = $("guide-ask-input");
    input.dir = "auto";
    $("guide-ask-send").addEventListener("click", ask);
    $("guide-ask-stop").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("guide", { action: "stop" }));
    $("guide-ask-clear").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("guide", { action: "clear" }));
    input.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
        event.preventDefault();
        ask();
      }
    });

    const search = $("guide-search");
    search.addEventListener("input", () => { if (loaded) renderPage(); });
    search.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && search.value) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        search.value = "";
        renderPage();
      }
    });

    arrowKeys($("guide-tabs"), (step) => { if (tabs.length) open((tabIndex + step + tabs.length) % tabs.length, 0); });
    arrowKeys($("guide-chapters"), (step) => {
      const count = tabs[tabIndex] ? tabs[tabIndex].chapters.length : 0;
      if (count) open(tabIndex, (chapterIndex + step + count) % count);
    });

    renderAsk();
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-import.js
//
// Media into the song (MainImport.cpp does the work):
//
//   Files dragged in straight from a folder on the computer (Explorer, Finder) and dropped in the
//   arrangement. The page can't learn where such files are, so as they come over the arrangement
//   Sonify lays a drop zone of its own over it; while they move there it says where they are, and
//   the page shows where they'd go: the track and the bar (snapped as the grid is), and what
//   happens to each of them.
//     On an audio track:  the first file on it, the others on new audio tracks under it.
//     Anywhere else:      each file on a new audio track (under the track there, or at the end).
//     Shift held:         all on one track, one after another.
//   Folders bring their audio files, by name; a video becomes the song's video.
//
//   Load Media... in an audio track's right-click menu (at the song position) and in the
//   arrangement's (where it was clicked): the files chosen go the same way.
//
// Files of a kind Sonify doesn't play as they are (M4A, AAC, Opus, WMA...) are read into WAVs
// first; the page says which while it's at it. A file from the computer dropped anywhere else in
// the page isn't taken (nor opened in the page's place).

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  let askedAt = 0;               // when Sonify was last asked for its drop zone
  let hint = null;               // where the dragged files would go: { box, line, band, label }

  const fromComputer = (event) => Boolean(event.dataTransfer) && Array.from(event.dataTransfer.types || []).includes("Files");
  const inStudio = () => !Hub.studios || Hub.studios.active() === "studio";

  /** Where files dropped at this point of the page go. */
  function placeAt(clientX, clientY, shift) {
    const lanes = $("lanes").getBoundingClientRect();
    const start = Math.max(0, Hub.arrange.snap(Hub.arrange.ppqAt(clientX)));
    const track = clientY >= lanes.top && clientY < lanes.bottom ? Hub.arrange.trackAt(clientY) : null;
    if (track && track.kind === "audio") return { trackId: track.id, after: track.id, start, oneTrack: Boolean(shift), track };
    return { trackId: 0, after: track ? track.id : 0, start, oneTrack: Boolean(shift), track };
  }

  /** Load Media...: a file dialog of Sonify's; the files go onto this track from start (none: the song position). */
  function choose(trackId, start) {
    const track = Hub.trackById(trackId);
    Hub.send("importMedia", {
      action: "choose",
      trackId: track && track.kind === "audio" ? track.id : 0,
      after: track ? track.id : 0,
      start: Number.isFinite(start) ? start : Hub.songPosition()
    });
  }

  /** Load Media... where the arrangement was right-clicked. */
  function chooseAt(clientX, clientY) {
    const place = placeAt(clientX, clientY, false);
    Hub.send("importMedia", { action: "choose", trackId: place.trackId, after: place.after, start: place.start });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- where they'd go
  function buildHint() {
    const box = Hub.element("div", "file-drop-hint");
    box.id = "file-drop-hint";
    box.hidden = true;
    const band = Hub.element("div", "fdh-band");
    const line = Hub.element("div", "fdh-line");
    const label = Hub.element("div", "fdh-label");
    box.append(band, line, label);
    $("arrange").appendChild(box);
    hint = { box, line, band, label };
  }

  function words(place, count, name) {
    const bar = Hub.tempoMap.barAt(place.start + 1e-9);
    const beat = Math.min(bar.numerator, Math.floor((place.start + 1e-9 - bar.start) / bar.beat) + 1);
    const where = ` at bar ${bar.index + 1}${beat > 1 ? "." + beat : ""}`;
    if (count <= 0) return "Nothing here Sonify can bring in";
    const files = count === 1 ? name : `${count} files`;
    if (place.trackId) {
      const on = place.track.name;
      if (count === 1) return `${files} \u2192 ${on}${where}`;
      if (place.oneTrack) return `${files} \u2192 ${on}, one after another${where}`;
      return `${files}${where}: the first on ${on}, the others on new tracks under it (Shift: all on ${on})`;
    }
    if (count === 1) return `${files} \u2192 a new audio track${where}`;
    if (place.oneTrack) return `${files} \u2192 one new audio track, one after another${where}`;
    return `${files} \u2192 ${count} new audio tracks${where} (Shift: one track, one after another)`;
  }

  function showHint(data) {
    if (!hint) return;
    if (!data || !data.active || !inStudio()) { hint.box.hidden = true; return; }

    const x = Number(data.x) || 0, y = Number(data.y) || 0;
    const place = placeAt(x, y, data.shift);
    const arrange = $("arrange").getBoundingClientRect();
    const lanes = $("lanes").getBoundingClientRect();
    const left = lanes.left - arrange.left, top = lanes.top - arrange.top;
    const width = $("lanes").clientWidth, height = $("lanes").clientHeight;
    const scrollTop = $("lanes").scrollTop;
    hint.box.hidden = false;

    const lineX = Hub.clamp(Hub.arrange.xOf(place.start), 0, width);
    Object.assign(hint.line.style, { left: `${left + lineX}px`, top: `${top}px`, height: `${height}px` });

    // The track it goes on, from there on; or the line new tracks go in at.
    const tracks = Hub.state.tracks;
    let bandTop, bandHeight;
    if (place.trackId) {
      const index = tracks.indexOf(place.track);
      bandTop = Hub.arrange.rowTop(index) - scrollTop;
      bandHeight = Hub.arrange.heightOf(place.track);
      hint.band.className = "fdh-band";
      Object.assign(hint.band.style, { left: `${left + lineX}px`, width: `${Math.max(0, width - lineX)}px` });
    } else {
      const index = place.after ? tracks.findIndex((t) => t.id === place.after) + 1 : tracks.length;
      bandTop = Hub.arrange.rowTop(index) - scrollTop - 1;
      bandHeight = 3;
      hint.band.className = "fdh-band insert";
      Object.assign(hint.band.style, { left: `${left}px`, width: `${width}px` });
    }
    const clippedTop = Hub.clamp(bandTop, 0, height), clippedBottom = Hub.clamp(bandTop + bandHeight, 0, height);
    hint.band.hidden = clippedBottom - clippedTop <= 0;
    Object.assign(hint.band.style, { top: `${top + clippedTop}px`, height: `${Math.max(0, clippedBottom - clippedTop)}px` });

    // What happens, by the pointer, kept inside the lanes.
    hint.label.textContent = words(place, Number(data.count) || 0, String(data.name || ""));
    const labelWidth = hint.label.offsetWidth || 200, labelHeight = hint.label.offsetHeight || 22;
    const labelX = Hub.clamp(x - arrange.left + 14, left + 4, left + width - labelWidth - 4);
    const labelY = Hub.clamp(y - arrange.top + 16, top + 4, top + height - labelHeight - 4);
    Object.assign(hint.label.style, { left: `${labelX}px`, top: `${labelY}px` });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- what Sonify says
  function dropped(data) {
    if (hint) hint.box.hidden = true;
    const paths = Array.isArray(data && data.paths) ? data.paths : [];
    if (!paths.length || !inStudio()) return;
    const place = placeAt(Number(data.x) || 0, Number(data.y) || 0, data.shift);
    Hub.send("importMedia", { action: "files", paths, trackId: place.trackId, after: place.after, start: place.start, oneTrack: place.oneTrack });
  }

  function reading(data) {
    if (!data) return;
    if (data.state === "working" && data.name)
      Hub.toast(`Reading ${data.name} into the song (${(Number(data.done) || 0) + 1} of ${Number(data.total) || 1})\u2026`);
  }

  if (window.__JUCE__ && window.__JUCE__.backend) {
    window.__JUCE__.backend.addEventListener("arrangeFileDrag", (data) => Hub.emit("arrangeFileDrag", data));
    window.__JUCE__.backend.addEventListener("arrangeFileDrop", (data) => Hub.emit("arrangeFileDrop", data));
    window.__JUCE__.backend.addEventListener("mediaImport", (data) => Hub.emit("mediaImport", data));
  }

  Hub.on("arrangeFileDrag", showHint);
  Hub.on("arrangeFileDrop", dropped);
  Hub.on("mediaImport", reading);

  Hub.importMedia = { choose, chooseAt, placeAt };
  Hub.commands.loadMedia = () => choose(Hub.state.selected);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the page's side of the drag
  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    buildHint();
    const lanes = $("lanes");

    const askSonify = () => {
      const now = performance.now();
      if (now - askedAt < 400 || !inStudio()) return;
      askedAt = now;
      const r = lanes.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.width < 40 || r.height < 20) return;
      Hub.send("importMedia", { action: "fileDrag", left: r.left, top: r.top, width: r.width, height: r.height });
    };

    lanes.addEventListener("dragenter", (event) => { if (fromComputer(event)) askSonify(); });
    lanes.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
      if (!fromComputer(event)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "copy";
      askSonify();
    });
    lanes.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
      if (!fromComputer(event)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      Hub.toast("Hold the files over the arrangement a moment before letting go: Sonify takes them there.");
    });

    // Anywhere nothing takes them, a file from the computer isn't taken, nor opened in the page's place.
    document.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
      if (!fromComputer(event) || event.defaultPrevented) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "none";
    });
    document.addEventListener("drop", (event) => { if (fromComputer(event)) event.preventDefault(); });
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-inspector.js
//
// The Inspector (F4): the selected track's instrument and inserts, or the Main
// channel's inserts. Each insert can be switched off (bypass), opened to show its
// parameters, removed, or dragged to a new place in the chain. Effects dragged from
// the Browser drop into the list where you let go; + adds one from a menu.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const SCREEN_ICON = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><rect x="1.5" y="2.5" width="13" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/><path d="M1.5 5.5h13" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>';

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const POWER = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M7.25 1.5h1.5v6h-1.5z"/><path d="M4.2 3.6l1.06 1.06A4.25 4.25 0 1 0 10.74 4.66L11.8 3.6A5.75 5.75 0 1 1 4.2 3.6z"/></svg>';

  const expanded = new Set();     // insert ids showing their parameters
  const views = new Map();        // "instrument" or an insert id -> { signature, params }
  let listKey = "";               // the insert list as last built; rebuilt only when it changes
  let dragInsert = null;          // { channel, insertId, from } while an insert is being dragged

  const shownChannel = () => Hub.state.inspectMain ? Hub.MAIN : (Hub.selectedTrack() ? Hub.state.selected : null);

  function setFill(input) {
    const min = Number(input.min), max = Number(input.max);
    input.style.setProperty("--fill", Hub.clamp01(max > min ? (Number(input.value) - min) / (max - min) : 0) * 100 + "%");
  }

  function roleText(plugin) {
    return { instrument: "Instrument", effect: "Effect", noteEffect: "Note effect" }[plugin.role] || plugin.role;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- parameters
  /** Sliders for a plugin's parameters. Returns index -> {input, value} for later updates. */
  function paramsView(container, channel, insertId, plugin) {
    const list = element("div", "params");
    const rows = new Map();

    if (plugin.params.length === 0) list.appendChild(element("p", "slot-hint", "This plugin has no parameters."));

    for (const p of plugin.params) {
      const row = element("div", "param");
      const name = element("span", "param-name", p.name);
      name.title = p.name;
      const input = element("input");
      input.type = "range";
      input.min = String(p.min);
      input.max = String(p.max);
      input.step = p.stepped ? "1" : String((p.max - p.min) / 1000 || 0.001);
      input.value = String(p.value);
      input.disabled = p.readOnly;
      input.setAttribute("aria-label", p.name);
      input.addEventListener("input", () => {
        setFill(input);
        Hub.send("setParam", { trackId: channel, insertId, index: p.index, value: Number(input.value) });
      });
      const value = element("span", "param-value", p.text);
      value.title = p.text;
      row.append(name, input, value);
      list.appendChild(row);
      rows.set(p.index, { input, value });
      setFill(input);
    }

    container.appendChild(list);
    return rows;
  }

  /** The same plugin as shown: refresh values in place, so a slider being dragged isn't rebuilt. */
  function refreshParams(rows, plugin) {
    for (const p of plugin.params) {
      const row = rows.get(p.index);
      if (!row) continue;
      if (document.activeElement !== row.input) {
        row.input.value = String(p.value);
        setFill(row.input);
      }
      row.value.textContent = p.text;
    }
  }

  const signature = (channel, plugin) => `${channel}|${plugin.file}|${plugin.id}|${plugin.params.map((p) => p.index).join(".")}`;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- instrument
  /** Audio tracks: which input the track hears and records (made on first use). */
  function renderInput(track) {
    let section = $("insp-input");
    if (!section) {
      section = element("section", "insp-section");
      section.id = "insp-input";
      section.innerHTML = '<h3 class="insp-heading">Input</h3><select id="insp-input-select" aria-label="Input"></select>'
                        + '<p class="muted small">Song Setup (Song menu) names the inputs and their channels.</p>';
      $("insp-instrument").after(section);
      $("insp-input-select").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
        const selected = Hub.selectedTrack();
        if (selected) Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: selected.id, input: Number(event.target.value) });
      });
    }
    section.hidden = !track || track.kind !== "audio";
    if (section.hidden) return;
    const select = $("insp-input-select");
    select.textContent = "";
    (Hub.state.inputs || []).forEach((input, index) => select.add(new Option(input.name, String(index))));
    select.value = String(track.input || 0);
  }

  function renderInstrument(track) {
    const section = $("insp-instrument");
    renderInput(track);
    section.hidden = !track || track.kind === "audio";
    if (section.hidden) return;

    const body = section.querySelector(".slot-body");
    const plugin = track.instrument;
    const sig = plugin ? signature(track.id, plugin) : `${track.id}|none`;
    const view = views.get("instrument");

    if (view && view.signature === sig) {
      if (plugin) refreshParams(view.params, plugin);
      return;
    }

    body.textContent = "";

    if (!plugin) {
      body.appendChild(element("div", "slot-name", "Test Synth"));
      body.appendChild(element("p", "slot-hint", "Built-in. Drag an instrument from the Browser onto the track to replace it."));
      views.set("instrument", { signature: sig, params: new Map() });
      return;
    }

    const head = element("div", "slot-head");
    const instrumentName = element("div", "slot-name", plugin.name);
    instrumentName.title = "Double-click to open its screen";
    instrumentName.addEventListener("dblclick", () => Hub.openScreen(track.id, 0));
    head.appendChild(instrumentName);
    head.appendChild(screenButton(track.id, 0, plugin));
    const remove = element("button", "slot-remove", "×");
    remove.title = "Remove, back to the Test Synth";
    remove.setAttribute("aria-label", remove.title);
    remove.addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("clearInstrument", { trackId: track.id }));
    head.appendChild(remove);
    body.appendChild(head);

    const details = [plugin.vendor, roleText(plugin)];
    if (plugin.outputs === 1) details.push("mono");
    body.appendChild(element("div", "slot-meta", details.filter(Boolean).join(" · ")));

    if (plugin.plugins.length > 1) {
      const choice = element("select", "slot-choice");
      choice.setAttribute("aria-label", "Plugin in this file");
      for (const entry of plugin.plugins) choice.add(new Option(entry.name, entry.id, false, entry.id === plugin.id));
      choice.addEventListener("change", () => {
        choice.blur();
        Hub.send("loadPlugin", { trackId: track.id, file: plugin.file, pluginId: choice.value });
      });
      body.appendChild(choice);
    }

    views.set("instrument", { signature: sig, params: paramsView(body, track.id, 0, plugin) });
  }

  /** Opens a plugin's screen: its own (web or native), or the Hub's controls. */
  function screenButton(channel, slot, plugin) {
    const button = element("button", "slot-screen");
    button.innerHTML = SCREEN_ICON;
    const own = plugin && (plugin.screen === "web" || plugin.screen === "native");
    button.title = own ? "Open its screen" : "Open its controls in a window";
    button.setAttribute("aria-label", `${button.title}: ${plugin ? plugin.name : ""}`);
    button.addEventListener("click", () => Hub.openScreen(channel, slot));
    return button;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- inserts
  function insertRow(channel, insert, index) {
    const row = element("div", "insert");
    row.dataset.insertId = String(insert.insertId);
    row.draggable = true;
    row.classList.toggle("bypassed", Boolean(insert.bypass));

    const head = element("div", "insert-head");

    const power = element("button", "insert-power");
    power.innerHTML = POWER;
    power.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!insert.bypass));
    power.title = insert.bypass ? "Off (bypassed). Click to switch it on." : "On. Click to bypass.";
    power.setAttribute("aria-label", power.title);
    power.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const bypass = power.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true";
      power.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!bypass));
      row.classList.toggle("bypassed", bypass);
      Hub.send("bypassInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId: insert.insertId, bypass });
    });

    const isOpen = expanded.has(insert.insertId);
    const expand = element("button", "insert-expand");
    expand.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen));
    expand.setAttribute("aria-label", "Show parameters");
    const toggle = () => {
      if (expanded.has(insert.insertId)) expanded.delete(insert.insertId); else expanded.add(insert.insertId);
      listKey = "";
      render();
    };
    expand.addEventListener("click", toggle);

    const name = element("span", "insert-name", `${index + 1}  ${insert.name}`);
    name.title = `${insert.name} · ${insert.vendor}. Double-click to open its screen; drag to reorder.`;
    name.addEventListener("dblclick", () => Hub.openScreen(channel, insert.insertId));

    const remove = element("button", "slot-remove", "×");
    remove.title = "Remove this insert";
    remove.setAttribute("aria-label", remove.title);
    remove.addEventListener("click", () => {
      expanded.delete(insert.insertId);
      Hub.send("removeInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId: insert.insertId });
    });

    head.append(power, expand, name, screenButton(channel, insert.insertId, insert), remove);
    row.appendChild(head);

    const body = element("div", "insert-body");
    body.hidden = !isOpen;
    const details = [insert.vendor, roleText(insert)];
    if (insert.outputs === 1) details.push("mono");
    body.appendChild(element("div", "slot-meta", details.filter(Boolean).join(" · ")));

    if (insert.plugins.length > 1) {
      const choice = element("select", "slot-choice");
      choice.setAttribute("aria-label", "Plugin in this file");
      for (const entry of insert.plugins) choice.add(new Option(entry.name, entry.id, false, entry.id === insert.id));
      choice.addEventListener("change", () => {
        choice.blur();
        Hub.send("loadPlugin", { trackId: channel, file: insert.file, pluginId: choice.value, replaceInsertId: insert.insertId });
      });
      body.appendChild(choice);
    }

    const params = isOpen ? paramsView(body, channel, insert.insertId, insert) : new Map();
    row.appendChild(body);
    views.set(insert.insertId, { signature: signature(channel, insert), params });

    row.addEventListener("dragstart", (event) => {
      dragInsert = { channel, insertId: insert.insertId, from: index };
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", insert.name);
      row.classList.add("dragging");
    });

    row.addEventListener("dragend", () => {
      dragInsert = null;
      row.classList.remove("dragging");
      showDropLine(-1);
    });

    return row;
  }

  function renderInserts(channel, inserts) {
    $("insp-insert-count").textContent = `${inserts.length}/${Hub.MAX_INSERTS}`;
    $("insp-insert-empty").hidden = inserts.length > 0;

    const key = channel + "|" + inserts.map((i) =>
      `${i.insertId}:${i.bypass ? 1 : 0}:${signature(channel, i)}:${expanded.has(i.insertId) ? 1 : 0}`).join(",");

    if (key === listKey) {
      for (const insert of inserts) {
        const view = views.get(insert.insertId);
        if (view) refreshParams(view.params, insert);
      }
      return;
    }

    listKey = key;

    for (const id of [...views.keys()])
      if (id !== "instrument") views.delete(id);

    const list = $("insp-insert-list");
    list.textContent = "";
    inserts.forEach((insert, index) => list.appendChild(insertRow(channel, insert, index)));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- dropping into the list
  /** Which gap the pointer is over: 0 is above the first insert. */
  function dropIndex(clientY) {
    const rows = [...$("insp-insert-list").querySelectorAll(".insert")];

    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const r = rows[i].getBoundingClientRect();
      if (clientY < r.top + r.height / 2) return i;
    }

    return rows.length;
  }

  function showDropLine(index) {
    const list = $("insp-insert-list");
    list.querySelectorAll(".drop-line").forEach((line) => line.remove());
    if (index < 0) return;
    const rows = list.querySelectorAll(".insert");
    list.insertBefore(element("div", "drop-line"), rows[index] || null);
  }

  function setupDrops() {
    const zone = $("insp-inserts");

    const accepts = () => {
      const channel = shownChannel();
      if (channel === null) return false;
      if (dragInsert) return dragInsert.channel === channel;
      return Boolean(Hub.dragEntry) && Hub.dragEntry.kind === "effect";
    };

    zone.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
      if (!accepts()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = dragInsert ? "move" : "copy";
      showDropLine(dropIndex(event.clientY));
    });

    zone.addEventListener("dragleave", (event) => {
      if (!zone.contains(event.relatedTarget)) showDropLine(-1);
    });

    zone.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
      if (!accepts()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      const channel = shownChannel();
      const index = dropIndex(event.clientY);
      showDropLine(-1);

      if (dragInsert) {
        // Dropping below itself counts the gap it leaves behind.
        const position = index > dragInsert.from ? index - 1 : index;
        if (position !== dragInsert.from) Hub.send("moveInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId: dragInsert.insertId, position });
        dragInsert = null;
        return;
      }

      Hub.dropEntryOn(Hub.dragEntry, channel, index);
      Hub.dragEntry = null;
    });

    // An instrument dropped on the instrument section replaces it.
    const instrument = $("insp-instrument");

    instrument.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
      if (!Hub.dragEntry || Hub.dragEntry.kind === "effect" || Hub.state.inspectMain) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      instrument.classList.add("drop-target");
    });

    instrument.addEventListener("dragleave", () => instrument.classList.remove("drop-target"));

    instrument.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
      if (!Hub.dragEntry || Hub.dragEntry.kind === "effect" || Hub.state.inspectMain) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      instrument.classList.remove("drop-target");
      Hub.dropEntryOn(Hub.dragEntry, Hub.state.selected);
      Hub.dragEntry = null;
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the whole Inspector
  function render() {
    const main = Hub.state.inspectMain;
    const track = main ? null : Hub.selectedTrack();
    const channel = main ? Hub.MAIN : (track ? track.id : null);
    const inspector = $("inspector");

    inspector.classList.toggle("empty", channel === null);
    inspector.classList.toggle("main", main);
    if (channel === null) return;

    const name = $("insp-name");
    name.disabled = main;
    if (document.activeElement !== name) name.value = main ? "Main" : track.name;
    $("insp-swatch").style.background = main ? "#5b5e65" : track.colour;

    renderInstrument(track);

    const state = main ? Hub.state.master : track;
    renderInserts(channel, state.inserts || []);

    const status = $("insp-status");
    status.textContent = state.loading ? `Loading ${state.loading}…` : (state.message || "");
    status.classList.toggle("error", Boolean(state.message) && !state.loading);
  }

  Hub.on("tracks", render);
  Hub.on("selection", render);
  Hub.on("library", render);

  Hub.on("param", (reply) => {
    if (reply.trackId !== shownChannel()) return;
    const view = views.get(reply.insertId ? reply.insertId : "instrument");
    const row = view && view.params.get(reply.index);
    if (row) {
      row.value.textContent = reply.text;
      row.value.title = reply.text;
    }
  });

  /** Opens an insert's parameters in the Inspector (from the Console). */
  Hub.showInsert = (channel, insertId) => {
    expanded.add(insertId);
    listKey = "";
    if (channel === Hub.MAIN) Hub.inspectMain(); else Hub.selectTrack(channel);
    if (document.body.classList.contains("hide-inspector")) Hub.run("toggleInspector");
    render();
  };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const name = $("insp-name");

    name.addEventListener("change", () => {
      const track = Hub.selectedTrack();
      const value = name.value.trim();
      if (!Hub.state.inspectMain && track && value && value !== track.name) Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: track.id, name: value });
    });

    name.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") name.blur();
    });

    $("insp-remove").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("removeTrack"));
    $("insp-add-insert").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const channel = shownChannel();
      if (channel !== null) Hub.addEffectMenu(event.currentTarget, channel);
    });

    setupDrops();
    render();
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-keyboard.js
//
// On-screen keyboard (F6). Plays the monitoring track(s), same as a hardware MIDI
// keyboard. The A to L row of the computer keyboard plays too; Z and X shift octaves.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"];
  const noteName = (n) => NAMES[n % 12] + (Math.floor(n / 12) - 1);
  const RANGE = 36;                  // three octaves, C to C
  const LOWEST_BASE = 12, HIGHEST_BASE = 84;
  let base = 48;                     // C3

  const held = new Map();            // note -> number of local holders
  const pointerNotes = new Map();    // pointerId -> note
  const keyNotes = new Map();        // KeyboardEvent.code -> note
  let engineNotes = new Set();       // notes the engine reports sounding (includes hardware MIDI)

  // Physical key positions, so it works with any keyboard layout (Hebrew included).
  const KEY_OFFSETS = {
    KeyA: 0, KeyW: 1, KeyS: 2, KeyE: 3, KeyD: 4, KeyF: 5, KeyT: 6, KeyG: 7, KeyY: 8,
    KeyH: 9, KeyU: 10, KeyJ: 11, KeyK: 12, KeyO: 13, KeyL: 14, KeyP: 15, Semicolon: 16, Quote: 17
  };

  function keyboard() { return $("keyboard"); }

  function paintKeys() {
    for (const key of keyboard().children) {
      const note = Number(key.dataset.note);
      key.classList.toggle("down", held.has(note) || engineNotes.has(note));
    }
  }

  function hold(note, velocity) {
    held.set(note, (held.get(note) || 0) + 1);
    Hub.send("noteOn", { note, velocity });
    paintKeys();
  }

  function unhold(note) {
    const count = (held.get(note) || 0) - 1;
    if (count > 0) held.set(note, count); else held.delete(note);
    Hub.send("noteOff", { note });
    paintKeys();
  }

  function releaseAll() {
    for (const note of pointerNotes.values()) unhold(note);
    for (const note of keyNotes.values()) unhold(note);
    pointerNotes.clear();
    keyNotes.clear();
  }

  function build() {
    const board = keyboard();
    board.textContent = "";
    let whiteIndex = 0;

    for (let note = base; note <= base + RANGE; note++) {
      const isBlack = [1, 3, 6, 8, 10].includes(note % 12);
      const key = element("div", "key " + (isBlack ? "black" : "white"));
      key.dataset.note = String(note);

      if (isBlack) {
        key.style.left = `calc(${whiteIndex} * var(--w) - var(--bw) / 2)`;
      } else {
        key.style.left = `calc(${whiteIndex} * var(--w))`;
        whiteIndex++;
        if (note % 12 === 0) key.appendChild(element("span", "label", noteName(note)));
      }

      board.appendChild(key);
    }

    $("octave-range").textContent = `${noteName(base)}–${noteName(base + RANGE)}`;
    paintKeys();
  }

  function shiftOctave(direction) {
    const next = base + direction * 12;
    if (next < LOWEST_BASE || next > HIGHEST_BASE) return;
    releaseAll();
    base = next;
    build();
  }

  // Lower on the key plays louder, like a real key.
  function velocityAt(event, key) {
    const r = key.getBoundingClientRect();
    return 0.35 + 0.65 * Hub.clamp01((event.clientY - r.top) / (r.height || 1));
  }

  function renderTarget() {
    const monitoring = Hub.state.tracks.filter((track) => track.monitor).map((track) => track.name);
    $("kb-target").textContent = monitoring.length ? "→ " + monitoring.join(", ") : "→ no track is monitoring";
    $("kb-target").title = $("kb-target").textContent;
  }

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const board = keyboard();

    board.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      const key = event.target.closest(".key");
      if (!key) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      const note = Number(key.dataset.note);
      pointerNotes.set(event.pointerId, note);
      hold(note, velocityAt(event, key));
    });

    // Dragging across keys plays each one in turn.
    board.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!pointerNotes.has(event.pointerId)) return;
      const hit = document.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
      const key = hit && hit.closest ? hit.closest(".key") : null;
      const note = key ? Number(key.dataset.note) : null;
      const current = pointerNotes.get(event.pointerId);
      if (note === current) return;

      unhold(current);

      if (note === null) {
        pointerNotes.delete(event.pointerId);
        return;
      }

      pointerNotes.set(event.pointerId, note);
      hold(note, velocityAt(event, key));
    });

    const endPointer = (event) => {
      const note = pointerNotes.get(event.pointerId);
      if (note === undefined) return;
      pointerNotes.delete(event.pointerId);
      unhold(note);
    };

    window.addEventListener("pointerup", endPointer);
    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", endPointer);

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.repeat || event.ctrlKey || event.altKey || event.metaKey) return;
      if (Hub.isTyping(event.target) || event.target instanceof HTMLSelectElement) return;
      if (Hub.isShortcut(event.code)) return;
      if (event.code === "KeyZ") { shiftOctave(-1); return; }
      if (event.code === "KeyX") { shiftOctave(1); return; }

      const offset = KEY_OFFSETS[event.code];
      if (offset === undefined || keyNotes.has(event.code)) return;
      event.preventDefault();

      const note = base + 12 + offset;   // computer keys start at the middle octave
      keyNotes.set(event.code, note);
      hold(note, 0.8);
    });

    window.addEventListener("keyup", (event) => {
      const note = keyNotes.get(event.code);
      if (note === undefined) return;
      keyNotes.delete(event.code);
      unhold(note);
    });

    window.addEventListener("blur", releaseAll);

    $("panic").addEventListener("click", () => { releaseAll(); Hub.send("allNotesOff"); });
    $("oct-down").addEventListener("click", () => shiftOctave(-1));
    $("oct-up").addEventListener("click", () => shiftOctave(1));

    build();
    renderTarget();
  });

  Hub.on("tracks", renderTarget);

  Hub.on("status", (s) => {
    engineNotes = new Set(s.notes || []);
    paintKeys();
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-keys.js
//
// Keyboard shortcuts in the keys of the user's DAW (File > Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts):
// Studio One's (the default), Cubase's, Logic Pro's, Pro Tools', Ableton Live's, Cakewalk's or
// FL Studio's. Each map gives Sonify's commands the keys that DAW ships with; a command that DAW
// has no key for has none here either. Logic is a Mac DAW: its Cmd is Ctrl here and Option is Alt.
// Logic picks tools with the Tool menu: T, then the tool's letter.
//
// One listener runs them all. Keys that edit clips act while the arrangement has focus, keys
// for notes while the Editor has; the rest act anywhere in the Studio. In the other studios
// (Analog Board, Device Studio, Sonify AI, Song Blocks...) the transport's keys, Undo and Redo,
// and New, Open, Save and Save As act too: the song plays and records wherever you are. None act
// while a dialog is open, or while typing in a field (except New, Open, Save and Save As). Menus
// and button tips show the keys of the map in use.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;

  // Sonify's commands that keys can run, in the groups the Settings list shows. Ones marked
  // only exist in some maps (FL Studio's Ctrl+Z, Live's draw mode) and are listed only there.
  const COMMANDS = [
    ["Transport", [["togglePlay", "Start / Stop"], ["returnToZero", "Return to Zero"], ["toggleRecord", "Record"],
                   ["toggleLoop", "Loop Active"], ["toggleMetronome", "Metronome"]]],
    ["File", [["newSong", "New Song"], ["openSong", "Open"], ["saveSong", "Save"], ["saveSongAs", "Save As"],
              ["importAudioFiles", "Import Media Files..."], ["exportMixdown", "Export Mixdown"], ["exportStems", "Export Stems"]]],
    ["Edit", [["undo", "Undo"], ["undoToggle", "Undo / Redo the Last Step", true], ["redo", "Redo"], ["cut", "Cut"], ["copy", "Copy"],
              ["paste", "Paste at Playhead"], ["duplicate", "Duplicate"], ["selectAll", "Select All"], ["deselectAll", "Deselect All"],
              ["delete", "Delete"],
              ["splitAtPlayhead", "Split at Playhead"], ["quantize", "Quantize"]]],
    ["View", [["toggleEditor", "Editor"], ["toggleConsole", "Console"], ["toggleBrowser", "Browser"],
              ["toggleSongChannel", "Master Song Channel"], ["songChannelSignature", "Master Song Channel: Signature"],
              ["songChannelKey", "Master Song Channel: Key"], ["songChannelTempo", "Master Song Channel: Tempo"],
              ["songChannelVolume", "Master Song Channel: Volume"],
              ["toggleAutomation", "Automation"], ["zoomIn", "Zoom In"], ["zoomOut", "Zoom Out"],
              ["zoomFull", "Zoom to the Whole Song"], ["zoomReset", "Default Zoom"]]],
    ["Tools", [["toolArrow", "Arrow"], ["toolRange", "Range"], ["toolSplit", "Split"], ["toolEraser", "Eraser"],
               ["toolPaint", "Paint (Pencil)"], ["toolMute", "Mute"], ["toolListen", "Listen"],
               ["toolPaintToggle", "Draw Mode On / Off", true]]],
    ["Track", [["addTracks", "Add Tracks..."], ["addTrack", "Add Instrument Track"], ["addAudioTrack", "Add Audio Track"],
               ["addBusChannel", "Add Bus Channel"], ["addBusForSelected", "Add Bus for Selected Channels"],
               ["duplicateTracks", "Duplicate Selected Tracks"], ["removeTrack", "Remove Selected Tracks"], ["selectAllTracks", "Select All Tracks"]]]
  ];

  // The maps. Each key: modifiers first ("Ctrl+Alt+S"), a key sequence with ", " ("T, T").
  const MAPS = {
    studioOne: {
      name: "Studio One",
      keys: {
        togglePlay: ["Space"], returnToZero: ["Num .", "Home"], toggleRecord: ["Num *"], toggleLoop: ["Num /", "/"],
        toggleMetronome: ["C"],
        newSong: ["Ctrl+N"], openSong: ["Ctrl+O"], saveSong: ["Ctrl+S"], saveSongAs: ["Ctrl+Alt+S"], exportMixdown: ["Ctrl+E"],
        undo: ["Ctrl+Z"], redo: ["Ctrl+Y", "Ctrl+Shift+Z"], cut: ["Ctrl+X"], copy: ["Ctrl+C"], paste: ["Ctrl+V"],
        duplicate: ["D"], selectAll: ["Ctrl+A"], deselectAll: ["Ctrl+D"], delete: ["Delete", "Backspace"], splitAtPlayhead: ["Alt+X"],
        quantize: ["Q"],
        toggleEditor: ["F2"], toggleConsole: ["F3"], toggleBrowser: ["F5"], toggleAutomation: ["A"],
        zoomIn: ["E", "Ctrl+=", "Ctrl+Num +"], zoomOut: ["W", "Ctrl+-", "Ctrl+Num -"], zoomFull: ["Alt+Z"], zoomReset: ["Ctrl+0"],
        toolArrow: ["1"], toolRange: ["2"], toolSplit: ["3"], toolEraser: ["4"], toolPaint: ["5"], toolMute: ["6"], toolListen: ["8"],
        addTracks: ["T"]
      }
    },
    cubase: {
      name: "Cubase",
      keys: {
        togglePlay: ["Space"], returnToZero: ["Num ."], toggleRecord: ["Num *"], toggleLoop: ["Num /"], toggleMetronome: ["C"],
        newSong: ["Ctrl+N"], openSong: ["Ctrl+O"], saveSong: ["Ctrl+S"], saveSongAs: ["Ctrl+Shift+S"],
        undo: ["Ctrl+Z"], redo: ["Ctrl+Shift+Z"], cut: ["Ctrl+X"], copy: ["Ctrl+C"], paste: ["Ctrl+V"],
        duplicate: ["Ctrl+D"], selectAll: ["Ctrl+A"], delete: ["Delete", "Backspace"], splitAtPlayhead: ["Alt+X"], quantize: ["Q"],
        toggleEditor: ["Ctrl+E"], toggleConsole: ["F3"], toggleBrowser: ["F5"],

      }

      keys: {

        newSong: ["Ctrl+N"], openSong: ["Ctrl+O"], saveSong: ["Ctrl+S"], saveSongAs: ["Ctrl+Shift+S"], exportMixdown: ["Ctrl+Shift+R"],
        undo: ["Ctrl+Z"], redo: ["Ctrl+Y"], cut: ["Ctrl+X"], copy: ["Ctrl+C"], paste: ["Ctrl+V"],
        duplicate: ["Ctrl+D"], selectAll: ["Ctrl+A"], delete: ["Delete", "Backspace"], splitAtPlayhead: ["Ctrl+E"], quantize: ["Ctrl+U"],
        toggleEditor: ["Ctrl+Alt+L", "Ctrl+Alt+3"], toggleConsole: ["Ctrl+Alt+M"], toggleBrowser: ["Ctrl+Alt+B", "Ctrl+Alt+5"],
        toggleAutomation: ["A"],
        zoomIn: ["=", "Shift+=", "Num +"], zoomOut: ["-", "Num -"], zoomFull: ["W"], zoomReset: ["Ctrl+0"],
        toolPaintToggle: ["B"],
        addTrack: ["Ctrl+Shift+T"], addAudioTrack: ["Ctrl+T"]
      }
    },
    cakewalk: {
      name: "Cakewalk",
      keys: {
        togglePlay: ["Space"], returnToZero: ["Ctrl+Home", "W"], toggleRecord: ["R"], toggleLoop: ["L"], toggleMetronome: ["Ctrl+F3", "F3"],
        newSong: ["Ctrl+N"], openSong: ["Ctrl+O"], saveSong: ["Ctrl+S"],
        undo: ["Ctrl+Z"], redo: ["Ctrl+Y", "Ctrl+Shift+Z"], cut: ["Ctrl+X"], copy: ["Ctrl+C", "Ctrl+Insert"], paste: ["Ctrl+V", "Shift+Insert"],
        duplicate: ["Ctrl+D"], selectAll: ["Ctrl+A"], delete: ["Delete"], splitAtPlayhead: ["S"], quantize: ["Q"],
        toggleEditor: ["Alt+3"], toggleConsole: ["Alt+2"], toggleBrowser: ["B"], toggleAutomation: ["Shift+A"],
        zoomIn: ["Ctrl+Right"], zoomOut: ["Ctrl+Left"], zoomFull: ["Shift+F", "Ctrl+Alt+F"], zoomReset: ["Ctrl+0"],
        toolArrow: ["F5", "F6"], toolSplit: ["F8"], toolEraser: ["F10"], toolPaint: ["F9"], deselectAll: ["Ctrl+Shift+A"],
        addAudioTrack: ["Ctrl+T"]
      }
    },
    flStudio: {
      name: "FL Studio",
      note: "As in FL Studio, Ctrl+Z undoes the last step and, right after, redoes it; Ctrl+Alt+Z goes back step by step.",
      keys: {
        togglePlay: ["Space"], returnToZero: ["Home"], toggleRecord: ["R"], toggleMetronome: ["Ctrl+M"],
        openSong: ["Ctrl+O"], saveSong: ["Ctrl+S"], saveSongAs: ["Ctrl+Shift+S"], exportMixdown: ["Ctrl+R"],
        undo: ["Ctrl+Alt+Z"], undoToggle: ["Ctrl+Z"], cut: ["Ctrl+X"], copy: ["Ctrl+C"], paste: ["Ctrl+V"],
        duplicate: ["Ctrl+B"], selectAll: ["Ctrl+A"], delete: ["Delete"], quantize: ["Ctrl+Q"],
        toggleEditor: ["F7"], toggleConsole: ["F9"], toggleBrowser: ["Alt+F8"],
        zoomIn: ["PageUp"], zoomOut: ["PageDown"], zoomReset: ["Ctrl+0"],
        toolArrow: ["E"], toolSplit: ["C"], toolEraser: ["D"], toolPaint: ["P"], toolMute: ["T"], toolListen: ["Y"]
      }
    }
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- keys
  const NAMED = {
    Space: "Space", Enter: "Enter", Home: "Home", End: "End", PageUp: "PageUp", PageDown: "PageDown",
    Delete: "Delete", Backspace: "Backspace", Insert: "Insert", Tab: "Tab",
    Left: "ArrowLeft", Right: "ArrowRight", Up: "ArrowUp", Down: "ArrowDown",
    "=": "Equal", "-": "Minus", "[": "BracketLeft", "]": "BracketRight", ";": "Semicolon", "/": "Slash",
    ",": "Comma", ".": "Period",
    "Num *": "NumpadMultiply", "Num /": "NumpadDivide", "Num .": "NumpadDecimal", "Num +": "NumpadAdd",
    "Num -": "NumpadSubtract", "Num Enter": "NumpadEnter"
  };
  const SHOWN = { Delete: "Del", PageUp: "Page Up", PageDown: "Page Down" };

  /** "Ctrl+Alt+S" as {ctrl, alt, shift, code, label}; null for a key name it doesn't know. */
  function parseKey(text) {
    const key = { ctrl: false, alt: false, shift: false, code: "", label: "" };
    let rest = text;
    const parts = [];

    for (;;) {
      const modifier = ["Ctrl", "Alt", "Shift"].find((m) => rest.startsWith(m + "+") && rest.length > m.length + 1);
      if (!modifier) break;
      key[modifier.toLowerCase()] = true;
      parts.push(modifier);
      rest = rest.slice(modifier.length + 1);
    }

    if (/^[A-Z]$/.test(rest)) key.code = "Key" + rest;
    else if (/^[0-9]$/.test(rest)) key.code = "Digit" + rest;
    else if (/^Num [0-9]$/.test(rest)) key.code = "Numpad" + rest.slice(4);
    else if (/^F([1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(rest)) key.code = rest;
    else if (NAMED[rest]) key.code = NAMED[rest];
    else return null;

    parts.push(SHOWN[rest] || rest);
    key.label = parts.join(" + ");
    return key;
  }

  /** A map's bindings: [{command, steps: [key, key?], label}]. */
  function bindingsOf(mapName) {
    const map = MAPS[mapName] || MAPS.studioOne;
    const list = [];

    for (const [command, specs] of Object.entries(map.keys)) {
      for (const spec of specs) {
        const steps = spec.split(", ").map(parseKey);
        if (steps.some((step) => !step)) { console.warn(`Hub keys: "${spec}" isn't a key`); continue; }
        list.push({ command, steps, label: steps.map((step) => step.label).join(", ") });
      }
    }

    return list;
  }

  let current = "studioOne";
  let bindings = bindingsOf(current);
  let pending = null;            // the first key of a sequence: {binding steps' first key, time}

  const sameKey = (key, event) => key.code === event.code && key.ctrl === (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey)
                                  && key.alt === event.altKey && key.shift === event.shiftKey;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- running a command
  const editorFocused = () => Hub.editor && Hub.editor.isOpen() && Hub.state.focus === "editor";
  const ARRANGE_ONLY = new Set(["cut", "copy", "paste", "duplicate", "splitAtPlayhead"]);
  const NOTES_TOO = new Set(["cut", "copy", "paste", "duplicate"]);   // in the Editor, on its notes
  const FILE = new Set(["newSong", "openSong", "saveSong", "saveSongAs"]);
  // What acts in every studio, not only in the Studio: the transport, Undo and Redo.
  const EVERY_STUDIO = new Set(["togglePlay", "returnToZero", "toggleRecord", "toggleLoop", "toggleMetronome",
                                "undo", "redo", "undoToggle"]);

  /** Picks a tool in the area with focus (the arrangement's, or the Editor's: its Pencil is the
      Paint tool there). */
  const ARRANGE_TOOLS = new Set(["arrow", "range", "split", "eraser", "paint", "mute", "listen"]);

  function pickTool(name) {
    if (editorFocused()) {
      const tool = { arrow: "arrow", range: "range", split: "split", eraser: "eraser", paint: "pencil", mute: "mute", listen: "listen" }[name];
      if (tool && Hub.editor.setTool) Hub.editor.setTool(tool);
    } else if (Hub.arrange && Hub.arrange.setTool && ARRANGE_TOOLS.has(name)) {
      Hub.arrange.setTool(name);
    }
  }

  const RUN = {
    cut: () => Hub.run("cutClips"),          // notes instead while the Editor has focus (hub-editor.js)
    copy: () => Hub.run("copyClips"),
    paste: () => Hub.run("pasteClips"),
    duplicate: () => Hub.run("duplicateClips"),
    selectAll: () => Hub.run(editorFocused() ? "selectAllNotes" : "selectAllClips"),
    delete: () => Hub.run("deleteSelection"),
    quantize: () => Hub.run("quantizeNotes"),
    undoToggle: () => Hub.send("undoToggle"),
    toolArrow: () => pickTool("arrow"),
    toolRange: () => pickTool("range"),
    toolSplit: () => pickTool("split"),
    toolEraser: () => pickTool("eraser"),
    toolPaint: () => pickTool("paint"),
    toolMute: () => pickTool("mute"),
    toolListen: () => pickTool("listen"),
    toolPaintToggle: () => {
      const now = editorFocused() ? Hub.editor.state.tool : Hub.arrange.view.tool;
      pickTool(now === "paint" || now === "pencil" ? "arrow" : "paint");
    }
  };

  function run(command) {
    if (RUN[command]) RUN[command]();
    else Hub.run(command);
  }

  /** May this command run now? Not with a dialog open, not while typing (File keys excepted),
      in the other studios only File keys and the ones for every studio, clip keys only with the
      arrangement in focus. */
  function allowed(command, event) {
    if (document.querySelector(".modal:not([hidden])")) return false;
    if (!$("scan-page").hidden) return false;
    const file = FILE.has(command);
    if (Hub.isTyping(event.target)) return file;
    if (!file && !$("start-page").hidden) return false;
    if (!file && !EVERY_STUDIO.has(command) && Hub.studios && Hub.studios.active() !== "studio") return false;
    if (ARRANGE_ONLY.has(command) && Hub.state.focus !== "arrange" && !(NOTES_TOO.has(command) && editorFocused())) return false;
    return true;
  }

  // The page itself never zooms (Ctrl + = / - / 0 and Ctrl + wheel): only the arrangement does.
  const BROWSER_ZOOM = new Set(["Equal", "Minus", "Digit0", "NumpadAdd", "NumpadSubtract", "Numpad0"]);

  window.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
    if (event.ctrlKey) event.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (event.ctrlKey && BROWSER_ZOOM.has(event.code)) event.preventDefault();
    if (["Control", "Alt", "Shift", "Meta"].includes(event.key)) return;

    // The second key of a sequence (Logic's T, then the tool).
    if (pending) {
      const first = pending;
      pending = null;
      hideHint();

      if (Date.now() - first.time < 2000) {
        const match = bindings.find((b) => b.steps.length === 2 && sameKey(b.steps[0], first.event) && sameKey(b.steps[1], event));
        if (match) {
          event.preventDefault();
          if (allowed(match.command, event)) run(match.command);
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    const single = bindings.find((b) => b.steps.length === 1 && sameKey(b.steps[0], event));

    if (single) {
      if (!allowed(single.command, event)) return;
      // Also keeps F5 from reloading the page, Space from clicking a focused button, and the like.
      event.preventDefault();
      if (!event.repeat || /^(zoom|tool)/.test(single.command)) run(single.command);
      return;
    }

    // The first key of a sequence: wait for the next.
    const starts = bindings.filter((b) => b.steps.length === 2 && sameKey(b.steps[0], event));
    if (starts.length && allowed(starts[0].command, event) && !event.repeat) {
      event.preventDefault();
      pending = { event: { code: event.code, ctrlKey: event.ctrlKey, metaKey: event.metaKey, altKey: event.altKey, shiftKey: event.shiftKey }, time: Date.now() };
      showHint(starts);
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("keyup", (event) => {
    if (event.code === "Space" && !Hub.isTyping(event.target)) event.preventDefault();
  });

  // The choices after the first key of a sequence, shown for a moment.
  function showHint(starts) {
    const names = { toolArrow: "Arrow", toolRange: "Range", toolSplit: "Split", toolEraser: "Eraser", toolPaint: "Pencil", toolMute: "Mute",
                    toolListen: "Listen" };
    const text = starts.map((b) => `${b.steps[1].label} ${names[b.command] || commandName(b.command)}`).join(" · ");
    const hint = $("key-hint");
    if (!hint) return;
    hint.textContent = text;
    hint.hidden = false;
    clearTimeout(showHint.timer);
    showHint.timer = setTimeout(hideHint, 2000);
  }

  function hideHint() {
    const hint = $("key-hint");
    if (hint) hint.hidden = true;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- what menus and buttons show
  // Menu commands named differently from the keys' commands.
  const MENU_ALIASES = { cutClips: "cut", copyClips: "copy", pasteClips: "paste", duplicateClips: "duplicate",
                         selectAllClips: "selectAll", selectAllNotes: "selectAll", deleteSelection: "delete",
                         quantizeNotes: "quantize" };
  const KNOWN = new Set(COMMANDS.flatMap(([, items]) => items.map(([id]) => id)));

  function commandName(command) {
    for (const [, items] of COMMANDS)
      for (const [id, name] of items) if (id === command) return name;
    return command;
  }

  /** The keys for a command in the map in use, as shown: "Ctrl + E" (the first) or every one. */
  function label(command, all = false) {
    const labels = bindings.filter((b) => b.command === command).map((b) => b.label);
    return all ? labels : labels[0] || "";
  }

  /** Menu shortcuts and the tips of buttons marked data-key="command", with data-tip
      "Text{key}" ({key} becomes " (Ctrl + E)", or nothing when the map has no key). */
  function decorate() {
    for (const item of document.querySelectorAll("#menubar [data-command]")) {
      const command = item.dataset.command;
      const keys = MENU_ALIASES[command] || command;
      let text;

      if (KNOWN.has(keys)) text = label(keys);
      else continue;   // not a command keys run (the studios' Ctrl + 2..7): as the menu has it

      let span = item.querySelector(".shortcut");
      if (!span && text) {
        span = Hub.element("span", "shortcut");
        item.appendChild(span);
      }
      if (span) span.textContent = text;
    }

    for (const element of document.querySelectorAll("[data-key]")) {
      const text = label(element.dataset.key);
      const tip = (element.dataset.tip || "").replace("{key}", text ? ` (${text})` : "");
      if (tip) element.title = tip;
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the API
  Hub.keys = {
    maps: () => Object.entries(MAPS).map(([id, map]) => ({ id, name: map.name, note: map.note || "" })),
    current: () => current,

    /** Uses another map at once (the settings remember it). */
    use(mapName) {
      current = MAPS[mapName] ? mapName : "studioOne";
      bindings = bindingsOf(current);
      pending = null;
      decorate();
      Hub.emit("keymap", current);
    },

    /** Every command with its keys in a map, by group, for the Settings list. */
    list(mapName = current) {
      const map = bindingsOf(mapName);
      return COMMANDS.map(([group, items]) => ({
        group,
        items: items.map(([id, name, special]) => ({ id, name, special: Boolean(special),
                                                     keys: map.filter((b) => b.command === id).map((b) => b.label) }))
                    .filter((item) => !item.special || item.keys.length)
      }));
    },

    label,
    decorate,
    parse: parseKey,

    /** True when the map in use gives this key (as it's pressed) to a command. */
    isBound: (event) => bindings.some((b) => sameKey(b.steps[0], event))
  };

  /** True for keys the map in use gives to a command without Ctrl or Alt (so they don't play notes). */
  Hub.isShortcut = (code) => bindings.some((b) => !b.steps[0].ctrl && !b.steps[0].alt && b.steps[0].code === code);

  Hub.on("ready", decorate);
})();
