// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-quantize.js
//
// Quantize: notes onto a grid, as Studio One's Quantize panel. The toolbar's Quantize button (next
// to the tools) opens the panel; it stays open while notes and clips are chosen, as the MIDI Tools
// panel does.
//   Grid             Follow the grid (the Editor's Quantize in the Editor, the toolbar's for clips),
//                    or one of its own: 1/1 to 1/64, or the triplets 1/4T to 1/32T
//   Strength         how far notes move toward the grid (100%: right onto it)
//   Swing            every second grid position later, up to a triplet shuffle at 100%
//   Starts, Ends     what moves (Ends: each note's end onto the grid too, so lengths tidy up)
//   Quantize         on the notes in the Editor (the selected ones, or all of them), or on the
//                    selected MIDI clips in the arrangement: one undo step. Q does the same, with
//                    the panel's settings, wherever the notes are.
//   Record Quantize  the notes recorded go onto the grid as each take ends, with these settings
//                    (Follow: the toolbar's grid), in the take's undo step (the engine does it:
//                    AudioEngine::NoteQuantize, TempoMap::quantized). The toolbar's button shows
//                    a light while it's on.
// The grid is laid from each bar's start (a grid of a bar or more: the nearest bar line), as the
// engine lays it. The settings stay on this computer (the page's storage) and go to Sonify at
// every start.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const STORE = "sonify.quantize";
  const GRIDS = [["Follow the grid", "follow"], ["1/1", 4], ["1/2", 2], ["1/4", 1], ["1/8", 0.5], ["1/16", 0.25], ["1/32", 0.125], ["1/64", 0.0625],
                 ["1/4 triplet", 2 / 3], ["1/8 triplet", 1 / 3], ["1/16 triplet", 1 / 6], ["1/32 triplet", 1 / 12]];
  const settings = { grid: "follow", strength: 100, swing: 0, starts: true, ends: false, record: false };
  let open = false;

  try {
    const kept = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "null");
    if (kept && typeof kept === "object") {
      if (kept.grid === "follow" || GRIDS.some(([, value]) => value === kept.grid)) settings.grid = kept.grid;
      for (const key of ["strength", "swing"]) if (Number.isFinite(kept[key])) settings[key] = Hub.clamp(Math.round(kept[key]), 0, 100);
      for (const key of ["starts", "ends", "record"]) if (typeof kept[key] === "boolean") settings[key] = kept[key];
    }
  } catch (error) { /* no storage here */ }

  function keep() {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(settings)); } catch (error) { /* no storage here */ }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the grid and the math
  /** The grid to quantize with, in quarter notes: the panel's own, or (Follow) the Editor's or the toolbar's. */
  function gridFor(where) {
    if (settings.grid !== "follow") return settings.grid;
    if (where === "editor" && Hub.editor && Hub.editor.state && Hub.editor.state.quantize) return Hub.editor.state.quantize;
    return (Hub.arrange && Hub.arrange.view && Hub.arrange.view.quantize) || 0.25;
  }

  const gridName = (grid) => (GRIDS.find(([, value]) => value !== "follow" && Math.abs(value - grid) < 1e-9) || [`${+grid.toFixed(3)} beats`])[0];

  /** A song position moved toward the nearest grid position (laid from its bar's start; a bar or
      more: the nearest bar line), swing and strength applied: as the engine's TempoMap::quantized. */
  function time(t, grid, swing = settings.swing / 100, strength = settings.strength / 100) {
    t = Math.max(0, t);
    const bar = Hub.tempoMap.barAt(t);
    const barEnd = bar.start + bar.length;
    const step = grid > 1e-6 ? grid : 0.25;
    let target;
    if (step >= bar.length - 1e-9) {
      target = t - bar.start <= barEnd - t ? bar.start : barEnd;
    } else {
      const shift = Hub.clamp01(swing) * step / 3;
      const k = Math.floor((t - bar.start) / step);
      let distance = Math.abs(barEnd - t);
      target = barEnd;
      for (let j = Math.max(0, k - 1); j <= k + 2; j++) {
        const at = Math.min(barEnd, bar.start + j * step + (j % 2 ? shift : 0));
        if (Math.abs(at - t) < distance) { target = at; distance = Math.abs(at - t); }
      }
    }
    return t + (target - t) * Hub.clamp01(strength);
  }

  /** A note (song positions) quantized with the panel's settings: { start, length }. */
  function place(start, length, grid) {
    const newStart = settings.starts ? time(start, grid) : start;
    let end = settings.ends ? time(start + length, grid) : newStart + length;
    const shortest = settings.ends ? Math.max(1 / 128, grid * settings.strength / 100) : length;
    if (end <= newStart + 1e-6) end = newStart + Math.max(1 / 128, shortest);
    return { start: newStart, length: end - newStart };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- what it works on
  function midiClipsSelected() {
    const out = [];
    for (const id of Hub.state.selectedClips || []) {
      const found = Hub.findClip(id);
      if (found && found.track.kind === "instrument" && !found.clip.audioFile) out.push(found);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** The notes in the Editor (when it's open and has the focus, or no MIDI clip is selected), or
      the selected MIDI clips. */
  function target() {
    const editor = Hub.editor;
    const clips = midiClipsSelected();
    if (editor && editor.isOpen() && editor.state.clipId && (Hub.state.focus === "editor" || !clips.length)) {
      const notes = editor.state.notes || [];
      const chosen = notes.filter((n) => n.selected).length;
      const track = Hub.trackById(editor.state.trackId);
      return { kind: "editor", text: `${chosen ? chosen : "All"} ${(chosen || notes.length) === 1 ? "note" : "notes"} in the Editor${track ? " (" + track.name + ")" : ""}` };
    }
    if (clips.length) return { kind: "clips", clips, text: `${clips.length} selected MIDI ${clips.length === 1 ? "clip" : "clips"}` };
    return null;
  }

  /** The selected MIDI clips' notes onto the grid: the notes each clip shows (the ones a trim
      hides stay as they are), each kept inside its clip; one undo step. */
  function quantizeClips(clips) {
    const grid = gridFor("arrange");
    const edits = [];
    for (const { track, clip } of clips) {
      const offset = clip.offset || 0, clipEnd = clip.start + clip.length;
      let changed = false;
      const notes = (clip.notes || []).map((note) => {
        const out = note.slice();
        const [, start, length] = note;
        if (start < offset || start >= offset + clip.length) return out;   // hidden by a trim
        const song = clip.start + start - offset;
        const q = place(song, length, grid);
        if (q.start >= clipEnd - 1e-9) return out;                       // would leave the clip
        const from = Math.max(clip.start, q.start);
        out[1] = from - clip.start + offset;
        out[2] = Math.max(1 / 128, q.length - (from - q.start));
        if (Math.abs(out[1] - start) > 1e-9 || Math.abs(out[2] - length) > 1e-9) changed = true;
        return out;
      });
      if (changed) edits.push({ op: "notes", trackId: track.id, clipId: clip.id, notes: notes.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]) });
    }
    if (edits.length) Hub.send("clipEdits", { edits, label: "Quantize" });
    return edits.length;
  }

  /** Quantize, with the panel's settings, wherever the notes are (the panel's button, Q). */
  function quantize() {
    const where = target();
    if (!where) { Hub.toast("Select notes in the Editor, or MIDI clips in the arrangement, to quantize."); return; }
    if (where.kind === "editor") { if (Hub.editor.quantize) Hub.editor.quantize(); return; }
    if (!quantizeClips(where.clips)) Hub.toast("They're on the grid already.");
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Record Quantize
  function sendRecord() {
    Hub.send("recordQuantize", { on: settings.record, grid: gridFor("arrange"), strength: settings.strength / 100, swing: settings.swing / 100,
                                 starts: settings.starts, ends: settings.ends });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the panel
  function render() {
    const follow = settings.grid === "follow";
    const select = $("quantize-grid");
    if (select.options.length) select.options[0].textContent = `Follow the grid (${gridName(gridFor(Hub.editor && Hub.editor.isOpen() && Hub.state.focus === "editor" ? "editor" : "arrange"))})`;
    select.value = follow ? "follow" : String(settings.grid);
    $("quantize-strength").value = String(settings.strength);
    $("quantize-strength-value").textContent = `${settings.strength} %`;
    $("quantize-swing").value = String(settings.swing);
    $("quantize-swing-value").textContent = `${settings.swing} %`;
    $("quantize-starts").checked = settings.starts;
    $("quantize-ends").checked = settings.ends;
    const record = $("quantize-record");
    record.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(settings.record));
    record.classList.toggle("on", settings.record);
    showTarget();

    const button = $("quantize-button");
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(open));
    button.classList.toggle("recording", settings.record);
    button.title = settings.record ? "Quantize: notes onto the grid (Record Quantize is on: recorded notes go onto it too)"
                                   : "Quantize: notes onto the grid, with strength, swing, and Record Quantize";
  }

  function showTarget() {
    if (!open) return;
    const where = target();
    $("quantize-target").textContent = where ? `On: ${where.text}` : "Select notes in the Editor, or MIDI clips in the arrangement.";
    $("quantize-apply").disabled = !where || (!settings.starts && !settings.ends);
  }

  function changed() {
    keep();
    render();
    sendRecord();
  }

  function openPanel() {
    open = true;
    const panel = $("quantize-panel");
    panel.hidden = false;
    const r = $("quantize-button").getBoundingClientRect();
    const width = panel.offsetWidth || 380;
    panel.style.left = `${Math.round(Hub.clamp(r.left, 8, window.innerWidth - width - 8))}px`;
    panel.style.top = `${Math.round(r.bottom + 6)}px`;
    panel.style.right = "auto";
    render();
    $("quantize-apply").focus();
  }

  function closePanel() {
    open = false;
    const panel = $("quantize-panel");
    if (panel.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    panel.hidden = true;
    render();
  }

  Hub.quantize = { time, place, gridFor, quantize, open: openPanel, close: closePanel, settings: () => ({ ...settings }) };
  Hub.commands.quantizeNotes = quantize;
  Hub.commands.quantizePanel = () => (open ? closePanel() : openPanel());

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const select = $("quantize-grid");
    for (const [label, value] of GRIDS) select.add(new Option(label, String(value)));
    select.addEventListener("change", () => {
      settings.grid = select.value === "follow" ? "follow" : Number(select.value);
      select.blur();
      changed();
    });
    for (const key of ["strength", "swing"]) {
      $(`quantize-${key}`).addEventListener("input", (event) => {
        settings[key] = Hub.clamp(Math.round(Number(event.target.value) || 0), 0, 100);
        $(`quantize-${key}-value`).textContent = `${settings[key]} %`;
      });
      $(`quantize-${key}`).addEventListener("change", changed);
      $(`quantize-${key}`).addEventListener("dblclick", () => { settings[key] = key === "strength" ? 100 : 0; changed(); });
    }
    $("quantize-starts").addEventListener("change", (event) => { settings.starts = event.target.checked; changed(); });
    $("quantize-ends").addEventListener("change", (event) => { settings.ends = event.target.checked; changed(); });
    $("quantize-record").addEventListener("click", () => { settings.record = !settings.record; changed(); });
    $("quantize-apply").addEventListener("click", quantize);
    $("quantize-close").addEventListener("click", closePanel);
    $("quantize-button").addEventListener("click", () => (open ? closePanel() : openPanel()));
    $("quantize-panel").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.stopPropagation(); closePanel(); }
    });

    // What it works on follows what's chosen while it's open; Follow follows the toolbar's grid.
    document.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { if (open) setTimeout(showTarget, 0); }, true);
    $("quantize").addEventListener("change", () => { render(); sendRecord(); });
    render();
    sendRecord();
  });

  Hub.on("selection", showTarget);
  Hub.on("tracks", showTarget);
  Hub.on("viewChanged", () => { render(); sendRecord(); });
  Hub.on("song", () => setTimeout(sendRecord, 0));   // a song's own toolbar grid
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-sampling-blob.js
//
// The Sampling Studio's SFZ to Blob tab: SFZs and their samples packed into blobs, each one file
// a sampler made in the Plugins Creator Studio plays from the disk (its Options > Sample
// library...). A list, made one after another: Add SFZ..., Add Folder... (every SFZ in a folder
// and its folders), Add Last Sampled; each row its name, where its blob goes, and how it went
// (waiting, the progress, what it made and what was left out, or why it couldn't); F shows the
// blob in its folder, x takes it off the list. Where the blobs go (beside each SFZ, or one
// folder), how the samples are kept (as they are, 16-bit, 24-bit, float), Make Blobs / Stop.
//
// Sonify does the work (MainBlobs.cpp, BlobMaker.cpp): Hub.send("sampling", {action: "blob", op});
// it answers with sampling {kind: "blob", items, beside, folder, samples, running}.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  const st = { visible: false, data: null, run: null };
  const send = (op, data = {}) => Hub.send("sampling", Object.assign({ action: "blob", op }, data));

  function sizeText(bytes) {
    if (bytes >= 1073741824) return (bytes / 1073741824).toFixed(1) + " GB";
    if (bytes >= 1048576) return (bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1) + " MB";
    return Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024)) + " KB";
  }

  function fileName(path) {
    return String(path || "").split(/[\\/]/).pop();
  }

  function folderOf(path) {
    const parts = String(path || "").split(/[\\/]/);
    parts.pop();
    return parts.join(path && path.includes("\\") ? "\\" : "/");
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the list
  function row(item, running) {
    const box = Hub.element("div", "sbl-row " + item.state);
    box.setAttribute("role", "listitem");

    const text = Hub.element("div", "sbl-text");
    const name = Hub.element("div", "sbl-name");
    name.textContent = item.name || fileName(item.sfz);
    const where = Hub.element("div", "sbl-where");
    where.textContent = (item.state === "done" ? "" : fileName(item.sfz) + "  \u2192  ") + item.blob;
    where.title = item.sfz;
    text.append(name, where);

    const status = Hub.element("div", "sbl-state");

    if (item.state === "working") {
      const bar = Hub.element("div", "sbl-bar");
      const fill = Hub.element("div", "sbl-fill");
      fill.style.width = Math.round((Number(item.progress) || 0) * 100) + "%";
      bar.appendChild(fill);
      const percent = Hub.element("span", "sbl-percent");
      percent.textContent = Math.round((Number(item.progress) || 0) * 100) + "%";
      status.append(bar, percent);
    } else if (item.state === "done") {
      const made = Hub.element("span", "sbl-made");
      made.textContent = `${item.regions} regions, ${item.samples} samples, ${sizeText(Number(item.bytes) || 0)}`;
      status.appendChild(made);
      if (item.message) {
        const note = Hub.element("span", "sbl-note-text");
        note.textContent = item.message;
        note.title = item.message;
        status.appendChild(note);
      }
    } else if (item.state === "failed") {
      const why = Hub.element("span", "sbl-why");
      why.textContent = item.message || "It couldn't be made.";
      why.title = item.message || "";
      status.appendChild(why);
    } else {
      const waiting = Hub.element("span", "sbl-waiting");
      waiting.textContent = running ? "Waiting" : "Ready";
      status.appendChild(waiting);
    }

    const buttons = Hub.element("div", "sbl-buttons");
    const reveal = Hub.element("button", "smp-button small sbl-reveal");
    reveal.type = "button";
    reveal.textContent = "F";
    reveal.title = item.state === "done" ? "Show the blob in its folder" : "Show the folder it goes to";
    reveal.addEventListener("click", () => send("reveal", { path: item.state === "done" ? item.blob : folderOf(item.blob) }));
    const remove = Hub.element("button", "smp-button small sbl-remove");
    remove.type = "button";
    remove.textContent = "\u00d7";
    remove.title = "Take it off the list";
    remove.disabled = item.state === "working";
    remove.addEventListener("click", () => send("remove", { id: item.id }));
    buttons.append(reveal, remove);

    box.append(text, status, buttons);
    return box;
  }

  function render() {
    if (!st.visible) return;
    const data = st.data || { items: [], beside: true, folder: "", samples: "keep", running: false };
    const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
    const running = Boolean(data.running);

    const list = $("sbl-list");
    list.replaceChildren();

    if (!items.length) {
      const empty = Hub.element("div", "sbl-empty");
      empty.textContent = "No SFZs yet: Add SFZ..., Add Folder... or Add Last Sampled.";
      list.appendChild(empty);
    }

    for (const item of items) list.appendChild(row(item, running));

    for (const b of $("sbl-where").querySelectorAll("button")) {
      b.classList.toggle("on", (b.dataset.where === "beside") === Boolean(data.beside));
      b.disabled = running;
    }

    $("sbl-folder").disabled = running;
    $("sbl-folder-text").textContent = data.beside ? "" : (data.folder || "No folder set yet");
    $("sbl-samples").value = data.samples || "keep";
    $("sbl-samples").disabled = running;

    const waiting = items.filter((i) => i.state === "waiting").length;
    const done = items.filter((i) => i.state === "done").length;
    const failed = items.filter((i) => i.state === "failed").length;
    const make = $("sbl-make");
    make.textContent = running ? "Stop" : "Make Blobs";
    make.classList.toggle("stop", running);
    make.disabled = !running && waiting === 0;

    const working = items.find((i) => i.state === "working");
    const said = [];
    if (running && working) said.push(`Making ${working.name || fileName(working.sfz)}` + (waiting ? `, ${waiting} waiting` : ""));
    else if (waiting) said.push(`${waiting} to make`);
    if (done) said.push(`${done} made`);
    if (failed) said.push(`${failed} couldn't be made`);
    $("sbl-status").textContent = said.join(", ");

    $("sbl-clear").disabled = !items.length;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Sonify's word
  Hub.on("sampling", (data) => {
    if (!data || data.kind !== "blob") return;
    const before = st.data;
    const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
    st.data = data;

    // A run: the ones it makes, and (once it's over) how it went, said once.
    if (data.running && !(before && before.running))
      st.run = new Set(items.filter((i) => i.state === "waiting" || i.state === "working").map((i) => i.id));

    if (before && before.running && !data.running && st.run) {
      const ran = items.filter((i) => st.run.has(i.id));
      const done = ran.filter((i) => i.state === "done").length;
      const failed = ran.filter((i) => i.state === "failed").length;
      st.run = null;
      if (done || failed) Hub.toast(failed ? `${done} made, ${failed} couldn't be made: their rows say why.` : `${done === 1 ? "The blob is" : done + " blobs are"} made.`);
    }

    render();
  });

  Hub.samplingBlob = {
    setVisible(on) {
      st.visible = Boolean(on);
      if (st.visible) { send("state"); render(); }
    }
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- wiring
  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    $("sbl-add").addEventListener("click", () => send("add"));
    $("sbl-add-folder").addEventListener("click", () => send("addFolder"));
    $("sbl-add-last").addEventListener("click", () => send("addLast"));
    $("sbl-clear").addEventListener("click", () => send("clear"));
    $("sbl-where").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const b = event.target.closest("button");
      if (!b || b.disabled) return;
      if (b.dataset.where === "folder" && !(st.data && st.data.folder)) send("setFolder");
      else send("beside", { on: b.dataset.where === "beside" });
    });
    $("sbl-folder").addEventListener("click", () => send("setFolder"));
    $("sbl-samples").addEventListener("change", () => send("samples", { value: $("sbl-samples").value }));
    $("sbl-make").addEventListener("click", () => send(st.data && st.data.running ? "stop" : "start"));
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-sampling-midi.js
//
// The Sampling Studio's MIDI, beside its nodes (hub-sampling-nodes.js):
//
//   The keyboard    on the nodes' left, upright, the low notes at the bottom: it plays through
//                   the MIDI In node to the VSTis wired from it (as Sonify's other keyboards do:
//                   noteOn, noteOff). Further right on a key plays louder; drag along it for a
//                   glissando; the wheel scrolls it. What comes through the MIDI In node lights up
//                   on it.
//   The tabs        on the nodes' right: Sampled Keys (the keys picked, with their zones; written by
//                   hub-sampling.js) and MIDI Monitor: the last 20 messages that came in, oldest
//                   first, each with its number, channel, what it is and where it came from. One the
//                   MIDI In node doesn't hear (its input isn't ticked) is greyed.
//
// MIDI is heard only in the studio in front: while the Sampling Studio is, the live MIDI is the
// MIDI In node's, and no other studio's (AudioEngine::setMidiFocus).
//
// Sonify sends: sampling {kind: midiMonitor, messages [{n, time, source, bytes, sysex, heard}]}.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;

  const NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"];
  const noteName = (n) => NAMES[n % 12] + (Math.floor(n / 12) - 1);
  const isBlack = (n) => [1, 3, 6, 8, 10].includes(n % 12);
  const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));

  const WHITE_H = 14;                     // a white key's height
  const SHOWN = 20;                       // the monitor keeps the last 20
  const CC_NAMES = {
    0: "Bank Select", 1: "Mod Wheel", 2: "Breath", 4: "Foot", 5: "Portamento Time", 7: "Volume", 8: "Balance", 10: "Pan",
    11: "Expression", 32: "Bank Select LSB", 64: "Sustain", 65: "Portamento", 66: "Sostenuto", 67: "Soft Pedal", 68: "Legato",
    71: "Resonance", 72: "Release", 73: "Attack", 74: "Cutoff", 120: "All Sound Off", 121: "Reset All", 123: "All Notes Off"
  };

  // The keys, bottom to top: each white key's index, and each black key's white key below it.
  const whiteIndex = [];
  let whites = 0;
  for (let n = 0; n < 128; n++) {
    whiteIndex[n] = whites;
    if (!isBlack(n)) whites++;
  }
  const HEIGHT = whites * WHITE_H;

  const st = {
    pressed: new Map(),      // pointerId -> note
    lit: new Set(),          // notes the MIDI In node is holding now (from the monitor)
    messages: [],            // the monitor's, oldest first
    chosen: "keys",          // the tab picked
    keysShown: true,         // Sampled Keys is there (not for chords)
    scrolled: false,         // the keyboard opened at middle C once
    frame: 0
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the keyboard
  /** A white key's top (the low notes at the bottom). */
  const whiteTop = (n) => HEIGHT - (whiteIndex[n] + 1) * WHITE_H;
  const blackHeight = () => Math.round(WHITE_H * 0.64);

  /** A black key's top: across the line between the white keys either side of it. */
  const blackTop = (n) => HEIGHT - (whiteIndex[n]) * WHITE_H - blackHeight() / 2;

  function size() {
    const box = $("smp-vkeys");
    return { box, w: box ? box.clientWidth : 0, h: box ? box.clientHeight : 0 };
  }

  function blackWidth(w) { return Math.round(w * 0.6); }

  /** The key at a point (the canvas's own pixels), and how hard: further right is louder. */
  function keyAt(x, y, w) {
    const bw = blackWidth(w), bh = blackHeight();
    if (x < bw) {
      for (let n = 1; n < 128; n++) {
        if (!isBlack(n)) continue;
        const top = blackTop(n);
        if (y >= top && y < top + bh) return { note: n, velocity: 0.3 + 0.7 * clamp(x / bw, 0, 1) };
      }
    }
    const index = clamp(Math.floor((HEIGHT - y) / WHITE_H), 0, whites - 1);
    let note = 0;
    for (let n = 0; n < 128; n++) if (!isBlack(n) && whiteIndex[n] === index) { note = n; break; }
    return { note, velocity: 0.3 + 0.7 * clamp(x / w, 0, 1) };
  }

  function drawKeys() {
    st.frame = 0;
    const { box, w, h } = size();
    const canvas = $("smp-vkeys-canvas");
    if (!box || !canvas || w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    if (canvas.width !== Math.round(w * dpr) || canvas.height !== Math.round(HEIGHT * dpr)) {
      canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round(HEIGHT * dpr);
      canvas.style.width = `${w}px`;
      canvas.style.height = `${HEIGHT}px`;
    }
    // The first time it shows: middle C in the middle.
    if (!st.scrolled) {
      st.scrolled = true;
      box.scrollTop = Math.max(0, whiteTop(60) - h / 2);
    }

    const g = canvas.getContext("2d");
    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    g.fillStyle = "#141418";
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, HEIGHT);
    const down = new Set(st.pressed.values());

    // White keys, a line between each.
    for (let n = 0; n < 128; n++) {
      if (isBlack(n)) continue;
      const top = whiteTop(n);
      g.fillStyle = down.has(n) ? "#7cc4ff" : st.lit.has(n) ? "#00aaff" : "#e6e6e6";
      g.fillRect(0, top, w, WHITE_H);
      g.fillStyle = "#8a8a8a";
      g.fillRect(0, top, w, 1);
      if (n % 12 === 0) {
        g.fillStyle = down.has(n) || st.lit.has(n) ? "#0a2a40" : "#6a6a6a";
        g.font = "bold 9px sans-serif";
        g.textAlign = "right";
        g.textBaseline = "middle";
        g.fillText(noteName(n), w - 3, top + WHITE_H / 2 + 0.5);
      }
    }

    // Black keys, from the left.
    const bw = blackWidth(w), bh = blackHeight();
    for (let n = 1; n < 128; n++) {
      if (!isBlack(n)) continue;
      const top = blackTop(n);
      g.fillStyle = down.has(n) ? "#4aa6e8" : st.lit.has(n) ? "#0088cc" : "#222226";
      g.fillRect(0, top, bw, bh);
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)";
      g.fillRect(bw - 3, top + 1, 2, bh - 2);
    }
  }

  function drawSoon() {
    if (!st.frame) st.frame = requestAnimationFrame(drawKeys);
  }

  function local(event) {
    const r = $("smp-vkeys-canvas").getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: event.clientX - r.left, y: event.clientY - r.top };
  }

  function hold(pointerId, key) {
    st.pressed.set(pointerId, key.note);
    Hub.send("noteOn", { note: key.note, velocity: key.velocity });
    drawSoon();
  }

  function unhold(pointerId) {
    const note = st.pressed.get(pointerId);
    if (note === undefined) return;
    st.pressed.delete(pointerId);
    Hub.send("noteOff", { note });
    drawSoon();
  }

  function releaseAll() {
    for (const id of [...st.pressed.keys()]) unhold(id);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the monitor
  /** What a message is, in a few words. */
  function describe(bytes, sysex) {
    const [status = 0, a = 0, b = 0] = bytes;
    const type = status & 0xf0;
    if (status === 0xf0) return { text: `SysEx (${sysex || bytes.length} bytes)` };
    if (status >= 0xf0) {
      const names = { 0xf1: "MTC Quarter Frame", 0xf2: `Song Position ${a | (b << 7)}`, 0xf3: `Song Select ${a}`, 0xf6: "Tune Request",
                      0xfa: "Start", 0xfb: "Continue", 0xfc: "Stop", 0xff: "Reset" };
      return { text: names[status] || `System ${status.toString(16).toUpperCase()}` };
    }
    const key = (n) => `${noteName(n)} (${n})`;
    switch (type) {
      case 0x90: return b > 0 ? { text: `Note On ${key(a)} v${b}`, kind: "on" } : { text: `Note Off ${key(a)}`, kind: "off" };
      case 0x80: return { text: `Note Off ${key(a)} v${b}`, kind: "off" };
      case 0xa0: return { text: `Poly Pressure ${key(a)} ${b}` };
      case 0xb0: return { text: `CC ${a}${CC_NAMES[a] ? " " + CC_NAMES[a] : ""} = ${b}` };
      case 0xc0: return { text: `Program ${a}` };
      case 0xd0: return { text: `Channel Pressure ${a}` };
      case 0xe0: {
        const bend = (a | (b << 7)) - 8192;
        return { text: `Pitch Bend ${bend > 0 ? "+" : ""}${bend}` };
      }
      default: return { text: bytes.map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(" ") };
    }
  }

  /** The keys the MIDI In node holds, as what it hears goes by. */
  function follow(bytes) {
    const [status = 0, a = 0, b = 0] = bytes;
    const type = status & 0xf0;
    if (type === 0x90 && b > 0) st.lit.add(a);
    else if (type === 0x80 || type === 0x90) st.lit.delete(a);
    else if (type === 0xb0 && (a === 120 || a === 123)) st.lit.clear();
  }

  function renderMonitor() {
    const list = $("smp-monitor-list");
    if (!list) return;
    list.textContent = "";
    if (!st.messages.length) {
      list.appendChild(element("div", "smp-monitor-empty", "Nothing yet: play a MIDI keyboard (or the keys on the nodes' left). What the MIDI In node hears shows here, the last 20 messages."));
      return;
    }
    for (const m of st.messages) {
      const bytes = Array.isArray(m.bytes) ? m.bytes : [];
      const what = describe(bytes, m.sysex);
      const status = bytes[0] || 0;
      const row = element("div", "smp-monitor-row" + (what.kind ? " " + what.kind : "") + (m.heard ? "" : " unheard"));
      row.appendChild(element("span", "num", `#${m.n}`));
      row.appendChild(element("span", "ch", status < 0xf0 ? String((status & 0x0f) + 1) : ""));
      row.appendChild(element("span", "msg", what.text));
      row.appendChild(element("span", "src", m.source || ""));
      const hex = bytes.map((x) => x.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, "0")).join(" ");
      row.title = `${what.text}, channel ${status < 0xf0 ? (status & 0x0f) + 1 : "-"}, from ${m.source || "?"} (${hex})`
                + (m.heard ? "" : ". Not heard: the MIDI In node's list doesn't tick this input.");
      list.appendChild(row);
    }
    list.scrollTop = list.scrollHeight;
  }

  function take(messages) {
    let heard = false;
    for (const m of messages) {
      st.messages.push(m);
      if (m.heard && Array.isArray(m.bytes)) {
        follow(m.bytes);
        heard = true;
      }
    }
    if (st.messages.length > SHOWN) st.messages.splice(0, st.messages.length - SHOWN);
    renderMonitor();
    if (heard) {
      drawSoon();
      if (Hub.samplingNodes && Hub.samplingNodes.blink) Hub.samplingNodes.blink();
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the tabs
  function tabNow() {
    return st.keysShown ? st.chosen : "monitor";
  }

  function renderTabs() {
    const tab = tabNow();
    for (const b of document.querySelectorAll(".smp-side-tab")) {
      b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(b.dataset.side === tab));
      b.tabIndex = b.dataset.side === tab ? 0 : -1;
      if (b.dataset.side === "keys") b.hidden = !st.keysShown;
    }
    $("smp-zone-list").hidden = tab !== "keys";
    $("smp-monitor").hidden = tab !== "monitor";
    if (tab === "monitor") renderMonitor();
  }

  /** Sampled Keys is there or not (chords have none); the tabs show with it, or with the nodes. */
  function layout(keysShown, nodesShown) {
    st.keysShown = Boolean(keysShown);
    const side = $("smp-side");
    if (side) side.hidden = !keysShown && !nodesShown;
    if (!nodesShown) releaseAll();
    renderTabs();
    drawSoon();
  }

  function showMonitor() {
    st.chosen = "monitor";
    renderTabs();
  }

  Hub.samplingMidi = { layout, showMonitor };

  Hub.on("sampling", (data) => {
    if (data && data.kind === "midiMonitor" && Array.isArray(data.messages)) take(data.messages);
  });

  // Leaving the studio: whatever the keyboard holds lets go, and the lights go out (the MIDI In
  // hears nothing until it's back).
  Hub.on("studio", (id) => {
    if (id === "sampling") return;
    releaseAll();
    st.lit.clear();
    drawSoon();
  });

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const canvas = $("smp-vkeys-canvas");
    if (!canvas) return;

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.button !== 0) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      const p = local(event);
      hold(event.pointerId, keyAt(p.x, p.y, size().w));
    });

    // Along the keys: each in turn.
    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!st.pressed.has(event.pointerId)) return;
      const p = local(event);
      const key = keyAt(p.x, p.y, size().w);
      if (key.note === st.pressed.get(event.pointerId)) return;
      unhold(event.pointerId);
      hold(event.pointerId, key);
    });

    const end = (event) => unhold(event.pointerId);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", end);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", end);
    canvas.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", end);
    canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => event.preventDefault());
    window.addEventListener("blur", releaseAll);

    new ResizeObserver(drawSoon).observe($("smp-vkeys"));

    for (const b of document.querySelectorAll(".smp-side-tab")) {
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        st.chosen = b.dataset.side;
        renderTabs();
      });
    }

    $("smp-monitor-clear").addEventListener("click", () => {
      st.messages = [];
      renderMonitor();
    });

    renderTabs();
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-sampling-nodes.js
//
// The Sampling Studio's nodes, under Clear All Keys (VSTi Sampling and Chord Sampling with the
// Nodes source): Sampler Arena's node system, kept within its area. Sonify plays them
// (SamplingRack.cpp); this draws them and wires them.
//
//   Sampling  the studio's notes: its MIDI out (red) wires to the VSTis that play them.
//             E: the sampler's Settings (speed and the rest); F: the folder the samples go to.
//   MIDI In   the live MIDI, to hear the VSTis before sampling: the inputs ticked in its list
//             (All inputs, or some), and the keyboard on the nodes' left, always. Its MIDI out
//             (red) wires to VSTis too; its light blinks with what comes through. It's heard only
//             while the Sampling Studio is in front (and never sampled).
//   VSTi      an instrument plugin: MIDI in, its sound out as a pair (blue: L and R).
//             E: its window; M: mute; X: remove.
//   Effect    an effect plugin: sound in as a pair, sound out as a pair. E, M, P (pass through:
//             untouched), X.
//   Output    stereo, L and R: what's wired into each side is what's sampled, and heard.
//
// A VSTi whose notes come from the Sampling node and whose sound reaches the Output (straight,
// or through effects) is flagged (a white box with a red dot): every flagged VSTi is sampled,
// together as one sound. Sample waits until there's one.
//
// The area is restricted, so the connectors sit on the nodes' sides: inputs on the right,
// outputs on the left. Drag from an output to an input to wire them: dropped on a connector, that
// side (L to L, or crossed); dropped on the node, both sides at once. Drag a wire's end off an
// input to move it or let it go; click a wire and press Delete to remove it. Drag a node by its
// body; double-click a plugin node for its window; right-click for the rest. The keyboard, the
// MIDI monitor and the tabs beside the nodes are hub-sampling-midi.js's.
//
// The format buttons (VST2, VST3, CLAP; AU on a Mac, LV2 on Linux) open a browse window at the
// format's usual folder (or the one a plugin was last loaded from), listing its folders and
// plugins: double-click a plugin to load it.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const send = (op, data = {}) => Hub.send("sampling", Object.assign({ action: "rack", op }, data));

  // Sampler Arena's node measures.
  const NODE_W = 156, NODE_H = 72, TITLE_H = 24, BTN = 20, BTN_GAP = 4, BTN_MARGIN = 5, BTN_LEFT = 12;
  const PIN_R = 6, PIN_HIT = 11, MARGIN = 6;
  // Inputs on the right, outputs on the left: the sound runs right to left.
  const INPUTS_RIGHT = true;
  const COLOURS = {
    background: "#1e1e1e", dots: "#2c2c2c", body: "#2d2d2d", bodyMuted: "#3a3a3a", border: "#555555",
    active: "#00aaff", audio: "#00aaff", midi: "#ff3b3b", text: "#ffffff", muted: "#9a9a9a",
    sampler: "#7a5c00", output: "#2f6b45", instrument: "#505050", effect: "#45505e", titleMuted: "#404040", missing: "#7a2e2e",
    midiin: "#6a2f63", lit: "#3ddc84", unlit: "#2a3a30"
  };
  const FORMAT_LABELS = { VST2: "VST2", VST3: "VST3", CLAP: "CLAP", AU: "AU", LV2: "LV2" };

  const st = {
    rack: null,            // {nodes, wires, ready}, as Sonify last gave it
    formats: [],
    visible: false,
    selected: 0,           // a node's id
    wire: null,            // a selected wire {from, to, fromSide, toSide}
    drag: null,            // what a press is doing
    hover: null,
    browse: null,          // the browse window: {format, folder, parent, entries, picked}
    size: { w: 600, h: 240 },
    placing: new Set(),    // nodes being given a first place
    midiPorts: [],         // what the MIDI In node can pick: [{name, device}]
    drop: null,            // the MIDI In node's list, while it's open
    heardAt: 0,            // when MIDI last came through the MIDI In node
    litTimer: 0
  };

  const nodes = () => (st.rack && st.rack.nodes) || [];
  const wires = () => (st.rack && st.rack.wires) || [];
  const byId = (id) => nodes().find((n) => n.id === id) || null;
  const isPlugin = (n) => n.kind === "instrument" || n.kind === "effect";
  const isMidiSource = (n) => n.kind === "sampler" || n.kind === "midiin";
  const sideOf = (v) => (v === 1 ? 1 : 0);
  const sameWire = (a, b) => Boolean(a && b) && a.from === b.from && a.to === b.to && sideOf(a.fromSide) === sideOf(b.fromSide) && sideOf(a.toSide) === sideOf(b.toSide);
  /** A wire as Sonify takes it: a MIDI wire's ends, or a sound wire's with its sides. */
  const wireData = (w) => (w.midi ? { from: w.from, to: w.to } : { from: w.from, to: w.to, fromSide: sideOf(w.fromSide), toSide: sideOf(w.toSide) });
  const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));
  const busy = () => Boolean(Hub.sampling && Hub.sampling.isBusy && Hub.sampling.isBusy());

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- where things are
  /** A node's place, kept inside the area (its own place may lie outside a smaller area). */
  function rectOf(n) {
    const w = st.size.w, h = st.size.h;
    let x = n.x, y = n.y;
    if (st.drag && st.drag.kind === "move" && st.drag.id === n.id) { x = st.drag.x; y = st.drag.y; }
    if (!(x >= 0) || !(y >= 0)) {
      const p = firstPlace(n);
      x = p.x; y = p.y;
    }
    return { x: clamp(x, MARGIN, Math.max(MARGIN, w - NODE_W - MARGIN)), y: clamp(y, MARGIN, Math.max(MARGIN, h - NODE_H - MARGIN)), w: NODE_W, h: NODE_H };
  }

  /** Where a node with no place of its own starts: the Sampling node on the right, the MIDI In
      by it, the Output on the left (the sound runs right to left), plugins between. */
  function firstPlace(n) {
    const w = st.size.w, h = st.size.h, middle = (h - NODE_H) / 2;
    if (n.kind === "sampler") return { x: w - NODE_W - 16, y: middle };
    if (n.kind === "output") return { x: 16, y: middle };
    if (n.kind === "midiin") {
      const sampler = nodes().find((x) => x.kind === "sampler");
      const s = sampler ? rectOf(sampler) : { x: w - NODE_W - 16, y: middle };
      if (s.y + 2 * NODE_H + 12 <= h - MARGIN) return { x: s.x, y: s.y + NODE_H + 12 };
      if (s.y - NODE_H - 12 >= MARGIN) return { x: s.x, y: s.y - NODE_H - 12 };
      return { x: Math.max(MARGIN, s.x - NODE_W - 24), y: s.y };
    }
    return freePlace(n.kind);
  }

  /** A free place for a new plugin node: VSTis right of the middle, effects left of it. */
  function freePlace(kind) {
    const w = st.size.w, h = st.size.h;
    const x = clamp(Math.round(w * (kind === "instrument" ? 0.62 : 0.36) - NODE_W / 2), MARGIN, Math.max(MARGIN, w - NODE_W - MARGIN));
    const taken = nodes().filter((n) => n.x >= 0 && n.y >= 0).map((n) => ({ x: n.x, y: n.y }));
    for (let column = 0; column < 4; column++) {
      for (let y = MARGIN + 8; y + NODE_H <= h - MARGIN; y += NODE_H + 12) {
        const cx = clamp(x + (column % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.ceil(column / 2) * (NODE_W + 16), MARGIN, Math.max(MARGIN, w - NODE_W - MARGIN));
        if (!taken.some((t) => Math.abs(t.x - cx) < NODE_W + 8 && Math.abs(t.y - y) < NODE_H + 8)) return { x: cx, y };
      }
    }
    return { x, y: MARGIN + 8 };
  }

  /** A node's connectors: inputs on the right, outputs on the left. MIDI is one connector; sound
      a pair, L above R (side 0 and 1). */
  function pinsOf(n) {
    const r = rectOf(n);
    const single = r.y + TITLE_H + (r.h - TITLE_H) / 2 - 4;
    const pair = [r.y + TITLE_H + 12, r.y + r.h - 14];
    const inX = INPUTS_RIGHT ? r.x + r.w : r.x, outX = INPUTS_RIGHT ? r.x : r.x + r.w;
    const inputs = [], outputs = [];
    if (n.kind === "instrument") inputs.push({ x: inX, y: single, side: 0, midi: true });
    if (n.kind === "effect" || n.kind === "output") pair.forEach((y, side) => inputs.push({ x: inX, y, side, midi: false }));
    if (isMidiSource(n)) outputs.push({ x: outX, y: single, side: 0, midi: true });
    if (isPlugin(n)) pair.forEach((y, side) => outputs.push({ x: outX, y, side, midi: false }));
    return { inputs, outputs };
  }

  /** The MIDI In node's inputs, in a few words. */
  function inputsSummary(n) {
    const list = Array.isArray(n.inputs) ? n.inputs : ["*"];
    if (list.includes("*")) return "All inputs";
    if (!list.length) return "Keyboard only";
    return list.length === 1 ? list[0] : `${list.length} inputs`;
  }

  /** A node's buttons, left to right along its bottom (the MIDI In's: its list, the width of it). */
  function buttonsOf(n) {
    const r = rectOf(n), y = r.y + r.h - BTN_MARGIN - BTN;
    const list = [];
    const add = (key, label) => list.push({ key, label, x: r.x + BTN_LEFT + list.length * (BTN + BTN_GAP), y, w: BTN, h: BTN });
    if (n.kind === "sampler") { add("settings", "E"); add("folder", "F"); }
    if (n.kind === "midiin") list.push({ key: "inputs", label: inputsSummary(n), x: r.x + BTN_LEFT, y, w: r.w - BTN_LEFT - 8, h: BTN });
    if (n.kind === "instrument") { add("window", "E"); add("mute", "M"); add("remove", "X"); }
    if (n.kind === "effect") { add("window", "E"); add("mute", "M"); add("pass", "P"); add("remove", "X"); }
    return list;
  }

  function bezierPoints(from, to) {
    const d = Math.max(36, Math.abs(from.x - to.x) * 0.5);
    const c1 = { x: from.x + (INPUTS_RIGHT ? -d : d), y: from.y }, c2 = { x: to.x + (INPUTS_RIGHT ? d : -d), y: to.y };
    return { from, c1, c2, to };
  }

  /** A wire's ends: its source's connector (MIDI, or its side of the pair) and its target's. */
  function wireEnds(w) {
    const a = byId(w.from), b = byId(w.to);
    if (!a || !b) return null;
    const midi = Boolean(w.midi);
    const pa = pinsOf(a).outputs.find((p) => p.midi === midi && (midi || p.side === sideOf(w.fromSide)));
    const pb = pinsOf(b).inputs.find((p) => p.midi === midi && (midi || p.side === sideOf(w.toSide)));
    return pa && pb ? { from: pa, to: pb } : null;
  }

  function nearWire(p) {
    for (const w of wires().slice().reverse()) {
      const ends = wireEnds(w);
      if (!ends) continue;
      const b = bezierPoints(ends.from, ends.to);
      for (let i = 0; i <= 32; i++) {
        const t = i / 32, u = 1 - t;
        const x = u * u * u * b.from.x + 3 * u * u * t * b.c1.x + 3 * u * t * t * b.c2.x + t * t * t * b.to.x;
        const y = u * u * u * b.from.y + 3 * u * u * t * b.c1.y + 3 * u * t * t * b.c2.y + t * t * t * b.to.y;
        if (Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y) <= 5) return w;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** What's under a point: a button, a connector, a node, a wire, or nothing. */
  function hitAt(p) {
    const list = nodes().slice().reverse();   // the one drawn last is on top
    for (const n of list) {
      for (const b of buttonsOf(n)) if (p.x >= b.x && p.x < b.x + b.w && p.y >= b.y && p.y < b.y + b.h) return { kind: "button", node: n, button: b };
    }
    // The nearest connector in reach.
    let best = null;
    for (const n of list) {
      const pins = pinsOf(n);
      const consider = (kind, pin) => {
        const d = Math.hypot(p.x - pin.x, p.y - pin.y);
        if (d <= PIN_HIT && (!best || d < best.d)) best = { kind, node: n, pin, d };
      };
      for (const pin of pins.outputs) consider("output", pin);
      for (const pin of pins.inputs) consider("input", pin);
    }
    if (best) return best;
    for (const n of list) {
      const r = rectOf(n);
      if (p.x >= r.x && p.x < r.x + r.w && p.y >= r.y && p.y < r.y + r.h) return { kind: "node", node: n };
    }
    const w = nearWire(p);
    if (w) return { kind: "wire", wire: w };
    return { kind: "none" };
  }

  /** Whether a wire from this node may go into that one (Sonify says why not, if it's tried). */
  function canWire(from, to) {
    if (!from || !to || from.id === to.id) return false;
    if (isMidiSource(from)) return to.kind === "instrument";
    return isPlugin(from) && (to.kind === "effect" || to.kind === "output");
  }

  /** Whether a hovered connector is the same one as a pin of that node. */
  const samePin = (hover, n, pin, kind) => Boolean(hover && hover.node && hover.pin) && hover.node.id === n.id && hover.kind === kind
    && hover.pin.side === pin.side && hover.pin.midi === pin.midi;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
  function roundRect(g, x, y, w, h, r) {
    g.beginPath();
    g.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  }

  function fitText(g, text, width) {
    if (g.measureText(text).width <= width) return text;
    let t = text;
    while (t.length > 1 && g.measureText(t + "...").width > width) t = t.slice(0, -1);
    return t + "...";
  }

  /** The area's size, once it's on the page (0 while hidden). */
  function measure() {
    const wrap = $("smp-nodes-wrap");
    if (!wrap || wrap.clientWidth <= 0 || wrap.clientHeight <= 0) return false;
    st.size = { w: Math.max(200, wrap.clientWidth), h: Math.max(120, wrap.clientHeight) };
    return true;
  }

  function draw() {
    const canvas = $("smp-nodes-canvas");
    if (!canvas || !st.visible || !measure()) return;
    const w = st.size.w, h = st.size.h, dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    if (canvas.width !== Math.round(w * dpr) || canvas.height !== Math.round(h * dpr)) {
      canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
      canvas.style.width = `${w}px`;
      canvas.style.height = `${h}px`;
    }
    const g = canvas.getContext("2d");
    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    g.fillStyle = COLOURS.background;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.fillStyle = COLOURS.dots;
    for (let x = 12; x < w; x += 24) for (let y = 12; y < h; y += 24) g.fillRect(x, y, 2, 2);

    // Wires first, under the nodes.
    for (const wire of wires()) {
      const ends = wireEnds(wire);
      if (!ends) continue;
      const picked = sameWire(st.wire, wire);
      drawWire(g, ends.from, ends.to, wire.midi ? COLOURS.midi : COLOURS.audio, picked ? 4 : 2.2, picked);
    }
    if (st.drag && st.drag.kind === "wire") {
      const from = byId(st.drag.from);
      const start = from && pinsOf(from).outputs.find((p) => p.midi === st.drag.midi && (st.drag.midi || p.side === st.drag.fromSide));
      if (start) drawWire(g, start, st.drag.at, st.drag.midi ? COLOURS.midi : COLOURS.audio, 2, false, true);
    }

    for (const n of nodes()) drawNode(g, n);

    if (!nodes().some(isPlugin)) {
      g.fillStyle = COLOURS.muted;
      g.font = "12px sans-serif";
      g.textAlign = "center";
      g.textBaseline = "middle";
      g.fillText("Load a VSTi with the buttons above, wire the Sampling node's MIDI to it (the MIDI In's to hear it), and its sound to the Output", w / 2, h - 16);
    }
  }

  function drawWire(g, from, to, colour, width, glow, dashed) {
    const b = bezierPoints(from, to);
    g.save();
    if (glow) { g.shadowColor = colour; g.shadowBlur = 8; }
    if (dashed) g.setLineDash([6, 4]);
    g.strokeStyle = colour;
    g.lineWidth = width;
    g.lineCap = "round";
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(b.from.x, b.from.y);
    g.bezierCurveTo(b.c1.x, b.c1.y, b.c2.x, b.c2.y, b.to.x, b.to.y);
    g.stroke();
    g.restore();
  }

  function drawNode(g, n) {
    const r = rectOf(n);
    const muted = Boolean(n.muted);
    const picked = st.selected === n.id;

    // Body and border.
    g.fillStyle = muted ? COLOURS.bodyMuted : COLOURS.body;
    roundRect(g, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 5);
    g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle = picked ? COLOURS.active : COLOURS.border;
    g.lineWidth = picked ? 2 : 1;
    roundRect(g, r.x + 0.5, r.y + 0.5, r.w - 1, r.h - 1, 5);
    g.stroke();

    // Title.
    const titleColour = n.missing ? COLOURS.missing : muted ? COLOURS.titleMuted : COLOURS[n.kind] || COLOURS.instrument;
    g.fillStyle = titleColour;
    g.beginPath();
    g.roundRect(r.x + 1, r.y + 1, r.w - 2, TITLE_H - 1, [5, 5, 0, 0]);
    g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = COLOURS.text;
    g.font = "bold 12px sans-serif";
    g.textAlign = "left";
    g.textBaseline = "middle";
    const flagged = n.kind === "instrument" && n.flagged;
    g.fillText(fitText(g, n.name || "", r.w - 12 - (flagged ? 20 : 0)), r.x + 6, r.y + TITLE_H / 2 + 0.5);

    // MIDI In: its light, lit as MIDI comes through.
    if (n.kind === "midiin") {
      const lit = Date.now() - st.heardAt < 180;
      g.fillStyle = lit ? COLOURS.lit : COLOURS.unlit;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(r.x + r.w - 12, r.y + TITLE_H / 2, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.strokeStyle = "#111";
      g.lineWidth = 1;
      g.stroke();
    }

    // Sampled: Sampler Arena's flag, a white box with a red dot.
    if (flagged) {
      const lw = 14, lh = 10, lx = r.x + r.w - lw - 6, ly = r.y + TITLE_H / 2 - lh / 2;
      g.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      roundRect(g, lx, ly, lw, lh, 2);
      g.fill();
      g.fillStyle = "#ff2020";
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(lx + lw / 2, ly + lh / 2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // A line about it, right of the buttons.
    const buttons = buttonsOf(n);
    const textX = buttons.length ? buttons[buttons.length - 1].x + BTN + 6 : r.x + 8;
    g.font = "10px sans-serif";
    g.fillStyle = n.missing ? "#ff8a8a" : COLOURS.muted;
    const about = n.missing ? "missing" : n.kind === "sampler" ? "MIDI out" : n.kind === "output" ? "stereo in" : n.kind === "midiin" ? "" : (FORMAT_LABELS[n.format] || n.format || "");
    if (about) g.fillText(fitText(g, about, r.x + r.w - textX - 6), textX, r.y + r.h - BTN_MARGIN - BTN / 2);
    if (n.kind === "midiin") {
      g.fillStyle = COLOURS.muted;
      g.fillText("live: its inputs and the keys", r.x + BTN_LEFT, r.y + TITLE_H + 12);
    }
    if (n.kind === "output") {
      g.fillStyle = COLOURS.muted;
      g.fillText(st.rack && st.rack.ready ? "sampled" : "wire a chain here", r.x + 8, r.y + TITLE_H + 12);
    }
    if (n.kind === "sampler") {
      g.fillStyle = COLOURS.muted;
      g.fillText("the studio's notes", r.x + BTN_LEFT, r.y + TITLE_H + 12);
    }

    // Buttons.
    for (const b of buttons) {
      if (b.key === "inputs") {
        // The MIDI In's list: what it hears, and the arrow that drops it.
        const open = Boolean(st.drop && !st.drop.el.hidden && st.drop.id === n.id);
        g.fillStyle = open ? "#4a4a5c" : "#3a3a48";
        roundRect(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 3);
        g.fill();
        g.strokeStyle = "#5c5c70";
        g.lineWidth = 1;
        roundRect(g, b.x + 0.5, b.y + 0.5, b.w - 1, b.h - 1, 3);
        g.stroke();
        g.fillStyle = "#e6e6e6";
        g.font = "11px sans-serif";
        g.textAlign = "left";
        g.fillText(fitText(g, b.label, b.w - 22), b.x + 6, b.y + b.h / 2 + 0.5);
        g.fillText("\u25be", b.x + b.w - 13, b.y + b.h / 2 + 0.5);
        continue;
      }
      let fill = "#555", ink = "#000", label = b.label;
      if (b.key === "settings" || b.key === "window") { fill = "#008b8b"; if (b.key === "window" && !n.hasWindow) fill = "#3c5050"; }
      if (b.key === "folder") { fill = "#3c3c41"; ink = "#c8b464"; }
      if (b.key === "mute") fill = muted ? "#ff3030" : "#90ee90";
      if (b.key === "pass") fill = n.pass ? "#ffff00" : "#404040";
      if (b.key === "remove") { fill = "#8b0000"; ink = "#ffffff"; }
      g.fillStyle = fill;
      roundRect(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 3);
      g.fill();
      g.fillStyle = ink;
      g.font = "bold 11px sans-serif";
      g.textAlign = "center";
      g.fillText(label, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2 + 0.5);
      g.textAlign = "left";
    }

    // Connectors: red for MIDI, blue for sound (L and R on them).
    const pins = pinsOf(n);
    const drawPin = (p, kind) => {
      const hot = samePin(st.hover, n, p, kind);
      const radius = hot ? PIN_R + 2 : PIN_R;
      g.fillStyle = p.midi ? COLOURS.midi : COLOURS.audio;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(p.x, p.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.strokeStyle = "#111";
      g.lineWidth = 1;
      g.stroke();
      if (!p.midi) {
        g.fillStyle = "#04202f";
        g.font = `bold ${hot ? 9 : 8}px sans-serif`;
        g.textAlign = "center";
        g.fillText(p.side ? "R" : "L", p.x, p.y + 0.5);
        g.textAlign = "left";
      }
    };
    for (const p of pins.inputs) drawPin(p, "input");
    for (const p of pins.outputs) drawPin(p, "output");
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the bar over the area
  function renderBar() {
    const box = $("smp-nodes-formats");
    if (!box) return;
    box.textContent = "";
    for (const f of st.formats) {
      const b = element("button", "smp-button small smp-format", FORMAT_LABELS[f.id] || f.id);
      b.type = "button";
      b.disabled = !f.available || busy();
      b.title = f.available ? `Load a ${f.id} plugin from its folder (${f.folder})` : f.id === "VST2" ? "VST2 plugins: this Sonify was built without Steinberg's VST2 SDK" : `${f.id} plugins can't be loaded here`;
      b.addEventListener("click", () => openBrowse(f.id));
      box.appendChild(b);
    }
    const status = $("smp-nodes-status");
    const flagged = nodes().filter((n) => n.kind === "instrument" && n.flagged).length;
    const vstis = nodes().filter((n) => n.kind === "instrument").length;
    status.classList.toggle("ready", flagged > 0);
    if (st.drop && !st.drop.el.hidden) renderInputs();
    status.textContent = flagged ? `${flagged} VSTi${flagged > 1 ? "s" : ""} sampled${flagged > 1 ? " together" : ""}`
                       : vstis ? "Wire the Sampling node's MIDI to a VSTi, and its sound to the Output"
                       : "Load a VSTi to sample";
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the browse window
  function openBrowse(format) {
    if (!st.browse) buildBrowse();
    st.browse.format = format;
    st.browse.entries = [];
    st.browse.picked = -1;
    st.browse.el.hidden = false;
    $("smp-browse-title").textContent = `Load a ${format} plugin`;
    $("smp-browse-list").textContent = "";
    send("browse", { format, folder: "" });
  }

  function closeBrowse() {
    if (st.browse) st.browse.el.hidden = true;
  }

  function buildBrowse() {
    const el = element("div", "smp-browse");
    el.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
    el.setAttribute("aria-label", "Load a plugin");
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="smp-browse-box">'
      + '<div class="smp-browse-head"><span id="smp-browse-title" class="smp-browse-title">Load a plugin</span>'
      + '<button id="smp-browse-close" class="smp-browse-close" type="button" title="Close" aria-label="Close">\u00d7</button></div>'
      + '<div class="smp-browse-path"><button id="smp-browse-up" class="smp-button small" type="button" title="Up a folder">Up</button>'
      + '<input id="smp-browse-folder" class="smp-browse-folder" type="text" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Folder" title="Type a folder and press Enter">'
      + '<button id="smp-browse-usual" class="smp-button small" type="button" title="The usual folder for this format">Usual Folder</button></div>'
      + '<div id="smp-browse-list" class="smp-browse-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Folders and plugins" tabindex="0"></div>'
      + '<div class="smp-browse-foot"><span class="smp-browse-hint">Double-click a folder to open it, a plugin to load it.</span>'
      + '<button id="smp-browse-cancel" class="smp-button small" type="button">Cancel</button>'
      + '<button id="smp-browse-load" class="smp-button small smp-browse-load" type="button" disabled>Load</button></div>'
      + '</div>';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    st.browse = { el, format: "VST3", folder: "", parent: "", entries: [], picked: -1 };

    const go = (folder) => send("browse", { format: st.browse.format, folder });
    $("smp-browse-close").addEventListener("click", closeBrowse);
    $("smp-browse-cancel").addEventListener("click", closeBrowse);
    $("smp-browse-up").addEventListener("click", () => { if (st.browse.parent) go(st.browse.parent); });
    $("smp-browse-usual").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const f = st.formats.find((x) => x.id === st.browse.format);
      go(f ? f.defaultFolder : "");
    });
    $("smp-browse-folder").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (event.key === "Enter") go($("smp-browse-folder").value.trim());
      if (event.key === "Escape") closeBrowse();
    });
    $("smp-browse-load").addEventListener("click", () => openEntry(st.browse.entries[st.browse.picked]));
    el.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.target.tagName === "INPUT") return;
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.stopPropagation(); closeBrowse(); }
      if (event.key === "Enter" && st.browse.picked >= 0) { event.preventDefault(); openEntry(st.browse.entries[st.browse.picked]); }
      if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowUp") {
        event.preventDefault();
        const count = st.browse.entries.length;
        if (!count) return;
        pickEntry(clamp(st.browse.picked + (event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1), 0, count - 1));
      }
      if (event.key === "Backspace" && st.browse.parent) { event.preventDefault(); go(st.browse.parent); }
    });
    el.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => { if (event.target === el) closeBrowse(); });
  }

  function pickEntry(index) {
    st.browse.picked = index;
    const items = $("smp-browse-list").children;
    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) items[i].classList.toggle("on", i === index);
    if (items[index]) items[index].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
    const entry = st.browse.entries[index];
    $("smp-browse-load").disabled = !entry || entry.kind !== "plugin";
  }

  function openEntry(entry) {
    if (!entry) return;
    if (entry.kind === "folder") { send("browse", { format: st.browse.format, folder: entry.path }); return; }
    loadPlugin(st.browse.format, entry.path, "");
  }

  /** Loaded by Sonify; placed here once it's known to be a VSTi or an effect. */
  function loadPlugin(format, path, pluginId) {
    closeBrowse();
    Hub.toast("Loading the plugin\u2026");
    send("load", { format, path, pluginId, x: -1, y: -1 });
  }

  function renderBrowse(data) {
    if (!st.browse || st.browse.el.hidden || data.format !== st.browse.format) return;
    st.browse.folder = data.folder || "";
    st.browse.parent = data.parent || "";
    st.browse.entries = Array.isArray(data.entries) ? data.entries : [];
    st.browse.picked = -1;
    $("smp-browse-folder").value = st.browse.folder || "This computer";
    $("smp-browse-up").disabled = !st.browse.parent;
    const list = $("smp-browse-list");
    list.textContent = "";
    if (!st.browse.entries.length) list.appendChild(element("div", "smp-browse-empty", `No folders or ${data.format} plugins here.`));
    st.browse.entries.forEach((entry, i) => {
      const item = element("div", "smp-browse-item " + entry.kind);
      item.setAttribute("role", "option");
      item.appendChild(element("span", "smp-browse-icon", entry.kind === "folder" ? "\u25b8" : "\u25c6"));
      item.appendChild(element("span", "smp-browse-name", entry.name));
      if (entry.kind === "plugin") item.appendChild(element("span", "smp-browse-kind", data.format));
      item.addEventListener("click", () => pickEntry(i));
      item.addEventListener("dblclick", () => openEntry(entry));
      list.appendChild(item);
    });
    $("smp-browse-load").disabled = true;
    list.focus();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- pressing, dragging
  function local(event) {
    const r = $("smp-nodes-canvas").getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: event.clientX - r.left, y: event.clientY - r.top };
  }

  function pressButton(n, key) {
    if (key === "inputs") { toggleInputs(n); return; }
    if (key === "settings") { if (Hub.sampling && Hub.sampling.openSettings) Hub.sampling.openSettings(); return; }
    if (key === "folder") { Hub.send("sampling", { action: "reveal" }); return; }
    if (key === "window") { send("window", { id: n.id }); return; }
    if (key === "mute") { n.muted = !n.muted; draw(); send("mute", { id: n.id, on: n.muted }); return; }
    if (key === "pass") { n.pass = !n.pass; draw(); send("pass", { id: n.id, on: n.pass }); return; }
    if (key === "remove") removeNode(n);
  }

  function removeNode(n) {
    if (!n || !isPlugin(n) || busy()) return;
    if (st.selected === n.id) st.selected = 0;
    send("remove", { id: n.id });
  }

  function onDown(event) {
    const canvas = $("smp-nodes-canvas");
    canvas.focus();
    const p = local(event);
    const hit = hitAt(p);
    if (event.button === 2) { showMenu(event, hit); return; }
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();

    if (hit.kind === "button") {
      if (busy() && ["remove"].includes(hit.button.key)) return;
      pressButton(hit.node, hit.button.key);
      return;
    }

    if (hit.kind === "output") {
      if (busy()) return;
      st.drag = { kind: "wire", from: hit.node.id, fromSide: hit.pin.side, midi: hit.pin.midi, at: p };
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      draw();
      return;
    }

    if (hit.kind === "input") {
      // Its last wire picked up by the end: moved to another input, or let go.
      const pin = hit.pin;
      const into = wires().filter((w) => w.to === hit.node.id && (pin.midi ? Boolean(w.midi) : !w.midi && sideOf(w.toSide) === pin.side));
      if (into.length && !busy()) {
        const w = into[into.length - 1];
        st.rack.wires = wires().filter((x) => x !== w);
        send("disconnect", wireData(w));
        st.drag = { kind: "wire", from: w.from, fromSide: sideOf(w.fromSide), midi: Boolean(w.midi), at: p };
        canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        draw();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (hit.kind === "node") {
      st.selected = hit.node.id;
      st.wire = null;
      const r = rectOf(hit.node);
      st.drag = { kind: "move", id: hit.node.id, dx: p.x - r.x, dy: p.y - r.y, x: r.x, y: r.y, moved: false };
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      draw();
      return;
    }

    if (hit.kind === "wire") {
      st.wire = hit.wire;
      st.selected = 0;
      draw();
      return;
    }

    st.selected = 0;
    st.wire = null;
    draw();
  }

  function onMove(event) {
    const p = local(event);
    const d = st.drag;
    if (d && d.kind === "move") {
      d.x = clamp(p.x - d.dx, MARGIN, Math.max(MARGIN, st.size.w - NODE_W - MARGIN));
      d.y = clamp(p.y - d.dy, MARGIN, Math.max(MARGIN, st.size.h - NODE_H - MARGIN));
      d.moved = true;
      draw();
      return;
    }
    if (d && d.kind === "wire") {
      d.at = p;
      const hit = hitAt(p);
      st.hover = hit.kind === "input" && hit.pin.midi === d.midi && canWire(byId(d.from), hit.node) ? hit : null;
      draw();
      return;
    }
    const hit = hitAt(p);
    const before = st.hover;
    st.hover = hit.kind === "input" || hit.kind === "output" ? hit : null;
    const key = (h) => (h ? `${h.kind}:${h.node.id}:${h.pin.side}:${h.pin.midi}` : "");
    if (key(before) !== key(st.hover)) draw();
    const canvas = $("smp-nodes-canvas");
    canvas.style.cursor = hit.kind === "button" ? "pointer" : hit.kind === "output" || hit.kind === "input" ? "crosshair"
                        : hit.kind === "node" ? "grab" : hit.kind === "wire" ? "pointer" : "default";
  }

  function onUp(event) {
    const d = st.drag;
    st.drag = null;
    if (!d) return;
    if (d.kind === "move") {
      const n = byId(d.id);
      if (n && d.moved) {
        n.x = Math.round(d.x);
        n.y = Math.round(d.y);
        send("move", { id: n.id, x: n.x, y: n.y });
      }
      draw();
      return;
    }
    if (d.kind === "wire") {
      const hit = hitAt(local(event));
      st.hover = null;
      const target = hit.node;
      if (target && target.id !== d.from && (hit.kind === "input" || hit.kind === "node" || hit.kind === "button")) {
        const source = byId(d.from);
        const fits = canWire(source, target);
        const add = (w) => { if (fits && !wires().some((x) => sameWire(x, w))) st.rack.wires = wires().concat([w]); };
        if (d.midi) {
          add({ from: d.from, to: target.id, midi: true });
          send("connect", { from: d.from, to: target.id });
        } else if (hit.kind === "input") {
          // On a connector: that side.
          const w = { from: d.from, to: target.id, fromSide: d.fromSide, toSide: hit.pin.side, midi: false };
          if (!hit.pin.midi) add(w);
          send("connect", wireData(w));
        } else {
          // On the node: both sides, each to its own.
          add({ from: d.from, to: target.id, fromSide: 0, toSide: 0, midi: false });
          add({ from: d.from, to: target.id, fromSide: 1, toSide: 1, midi: false });
          send("connect", { from: d.from, to: target.id });
        }
      }
      draw();
    }
  }

  function showMenu(event, hit) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const at = Hub.pointAnchor ? Hub.pointAnchor(event) : { getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: event.clientX, right: event.clientX, top: event.clientY, bottom: event.clientY }) };
    const items = [];
    const n = hit.node;
    if (n && isPlugin(n)) {
      st.selected = n.id;
      draw();
      items.push({ label: "Open Plugin Window", value: "window", disabled: !n.hasWindow });
      items.push({ label: "Mute", value: "mute", checked: Boolean(n.muted) });
      if (n.kind === "effect") items.push({ label: "Pass Through", value: "pass", checked: Boolean(n.pass) });
      items.push({ separator: true }, { label: "Remove", value: "remove", disabled: busy() });
    } else if (n && n.kind === "sampler") {
      items.push({ label: "Sampler Settings\u2026", value: "settings" }, { label: "Open the Samples Folder", value: "folder" });
    } else if (n && n.kind === "midiin") {
      items.push({ label: "MIDI Inputs\u2026", value: "inputs" }, { label: "Show the MIDI Monitor", value: "monitor" });
    } else if (hit.kind === "wire") {
      st.wire = hit.wire;
      draw();
      items.push({ label: "Remove Wire", value: "unwire", disabled: busy() });
    }
    if (!n || n.kind === "output") {
      if (items.length) items.push({ separator: true });
      for (const f of st.formats) items.push({ label: `Load ${f.id} Plugin\u2026`, value: "load:" + f.id, disabled: !f.available || busy() });
    }
    if (!items.length) return;
    Hub.popupMenu(at, items, (pick) => {
      if (typeof pick !== "string") return;
      if (pick.startsWith("load:")) { openBrowse(pick.slice(5)); return; }
      if (pick === "unwire" && st.wire) { send("disconnect", wireData(st.wire)); st.wire = null; return; }
      if (pick === "remove") { removeNode(n); return; }
      if (pick === "monitor") { if (Hub.samplingMidi) Hub.samplingMidi.showMonitor(); return; }
      if (n) pressButton(n, pick);
    });
  }

  function onKey(event) {
    if (event.key !== "Delete" && event.key !== "Backspace") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (busy()) return;
    if (st.wire) { send("disconnect", wireData(st.wire)); st.wire = null; return; }
    const n = byId(st.selected);
    if (n) removeNode(n);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the MIDI In node's list
  /** Dropped from the node's button: All inputs, or the ports ticked one by one. */
  function toggleInputs(n) {
    if (st.drop && !st.drop.el.hidden && st.drop.id === n.id) { closeInputs(); return; }
    if (!st.drop) {
      const el = element("div", "smp-midiin-drop");
      el.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
      el.setAttribute("aria-label", "MIDI In: the inputs it hears");
      el.hidden = true;
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      el.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => { if (event.key === "Escape") { event.stopPropagation(); closeInputs(); } });
      st.drop = { el, id: 0 };
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
        if (!st.drop || st.drop.el.hidden || st.drop.el.contains(event.target)) return;
        // A press on the node's own button toggles it there.
        if (event.target === $("smp-nodes-canvas")) {
          const hit = hitAt(local(event));
          if (hit.kind === "button" && hit.button.key === "inputs") return;
        }
        closeInputs();
      }, true);
    }
    st.drop.id = n.id;
    st.drop.el.hidden = false;
    renderInputs();
    draw();
  }

  function closeInputs() {
    if (!st.drop || st.drop.el.hidden) return;
    st.drop.el.hidden = true;
    draw();
  }

  function renderInputs() {
    const drop = st.drop;
    const n = drop && byId(drop.id);
    if (!drop || !n) { closeInputs(); return; }
    const chosen = Array.isArray(n.inputs) ? n.inputs : ["*"];
    const every = chosen.includes("*");
    const el = drop.el;
    el.textContent = "";

    const commit = (list) => {
      n.inputs = list;
      send("midiInputs", { inputs: list });
      renderInputs();
      draw();
    };

    const row = (label, checked, disabled, onChange, extra) => {
      const line = element("label", "smp-midiin-row" + (extra ? " " + extra : ""));
      const box = document.createElement("input");
      box.type = "checkbox";
      box.checked = checked;
      box.disabled = disabled;
      box.addEventListener("change", () => onChange(box.checked));
      line.appendChild(box);
      line.appendChild(element("span", "", label));
      el.appendChild(line);
    };

    el.appendChild(element("div", "smp-midiin-title", "MIDI In hears"));
    const ports = st.midiPorts.map((p) => p.name);
    // All off: every port here ticked to begin with, so nothing goes quiet until one is unticked.
    row("All inputs", every, false, (on) => commit(on ? ["*"] : ports.slice()), "every");
    for (const port of st.midiPorts) {
      const label = port.device ? `${port.name}  (${port.device})` : port.name;
      row(label, every || chosen.includes(port.name), every, (on) => {
        const list = chosen.filter((x) => x !== "*" && x !== port.name);
        commit(on ? list.concat([port.name]) : list);
      }, "port");
    }
    for (const name of chosen.filter((x) => x !== "*" && !ports.includes(x))) {
      row(`${name}  (not connected)`, true, every, (on) => { if (!on) commit(chosen.filter((x) => x !== name)); }, "port gone");
    }
    if (!st.midiPorts.length) el.appendChild(element("div", "smp-midiin-note", "No MIDI input is enabled: Audio Settings enables them."));
    el.appendChild(element("div", "smp-midiin-note", "The keyboard on the left always plays through it. Heard only while the Sampling Studio is in front."));

    // Under the node's button.
    const canvas = $("smp-nodes-canvas");
    const b = buttonsOf(n).find((x) => x.key === "inputs");
    if (!canvas || !b) return;
    const area = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const width = Math.max(220, b.w + 60);
    const left = clamp(area.left + b.x, 8, Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - width - 8));
    el.style.width = `${width}px`;
    el.style.left = `${left}px`;
    el.style.top = `${area.top + b.y + b.h + 4}px`;
    const room = window.innerHeight - (area.top + b.y + b.h + 4) - 8;
    if (room < el.offsetHeight) el.style.top = `${Math.max(8, area.top + b.y - el.offsetHeight - 4)}px`;
  }

  /** MIDI came through the MIDI In node (the monitor says so): its light blinks. */
  function blink() {
    st.heardAt = Date.now();
    if (!st.visible) return;
    draw();
    clearTimeout(st.litTimer);
    st.litTimer = setTimeout(draw, 200);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Sonify's word
  function take(rack) {
    st.rack = rack || { nodes: [], wires: [], ready: false };
    if (st.selected && !byId(st.selected)) st.selected = 0;
    if (st.wire && !wires().some((w) => sameWire(w, st.wire))) st.wire = null;
    // Nodes with no place yet get one, kept (once the area has its size).
    const sized = st.visible && measure();
    for (const n of nodes()) {
      if (n.x >= 0 && n.y >= 0) { st.placing.delete(n.id); continue; }
      if (!sized || st.placing.has(n.id)) continue;
      const p = firstPlace(n);
      n.x = Math.round(p.x);
      n.y = Math.round(p.y);
      st.placing.add(n.id);
      send("move", { id: n.id, x: n.x, y: n.y });
    }
    renderBar();
    draw();
    Hub.emit("samplingNodes", st.rack);
  }

  Hub.on("sampling", (data) => {
    if (!data) return;
    if (data.kind === "rack") {
      st.formats = Array.isArray(data.formats) ? data.formats : st.formats;
      st.midiPorts = Array.isArray(data.midiPorts) ? data.midiPorts : st.midiPorts;
      take(data.rack);
    } else if (data.kind === "rackBrowse") {
      renderBrowse(data);
    } else if (data.kind === "rackChoose") {
      const plugins = Array.isArray(data.plugins) ? data.plugins : [];
      const anchor = $("smp-nodes-canvas");
      Hub.popupMenu(anchor, [{ group: `${data.path.split(/[\\/]/).pop()} holds ${plugins.length} plugins: which one?` }]
        .concat(plugins.map((p) => ({ label: p.vendor ? `${p.name}  (${p.vendor})` : p.name, value: p.id }))), (id) => {
        if (typeof id === "string" && id) send("load", { format: data.format, path: data.path, pluginId: id, x: data.x, y: data.y });
      });
    }
  });

  /** Shown or not (the Nodes source, VSTi or Chord Sampling): drawn to its area's size. The MIDI
      In node listens meanwhile. */
  function setVisible(on) {
    on = Boolean(on);
    const box = $("smp-nodes");
    if (box) box.hidden = !on;
    if (st.visible === on) { if (on) requestAnimationFrame(() => { renderBar(); draw(); }); return; }
    st.visible = on;
    send("visible", { on });
    if (!on) closeInputs();
    if (on) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { renderBar(); draw(); take(st.rack); });
      if (!st.rack) send("state");
    }
  }

  Hub.samplingNodes = {
    setVisible,
    isVisible: () => st.visible,
    isReady: () => Boolean(st.rack && st.rack.ready),
    refresh: () => { renderBar(); draw(); },
    blink
  };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const canvas = $("smp-nodes-canvas");
    if (!canvas) return;
    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", () => { st.drag = null; st.hover = null; draw(); });
    canvas.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { if (!st.drag && st.hover) { st.hover = null; draw(); } });
    canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => {
      const hit = hitAt(local(event));
      if (hit.kind === "node" && isPlugin(hit.node)) send("window", { id: hit.node.id });
    });
    canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => event.preventDefault());
    canvas.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    new ResizeObserver(() => { if (st.visible) draw(); }).observe($("smp-nodes-wrap"));
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-sampling.js
//
// The Sampling Studio (the top bar's selector, Ctrl+7): Sampler Arena's Sampling Module, ported
// with its layout, pop-ups, settings and modes, and Sonify's own besides.
//
// The face (Sampler Arena's node): the family name, Play/Stop, where it is ("Cs4  3/48"), the
// L/R meters, F (the folder) and the progress line; Sonify adds Resume, Make Instrument, Discard,
// Skip and Redo (played by the user), Try It and Loop Editor, and the note to play.
// Sampling: VSTi Sampling, Chord Sampling and Sample Builder; Chord Types... (chords); Don't Use
// Key Ranges, Ad Hoc Folder, Settings. Sonify's source row (the nodes, a hardware synth, or the
// user playing). The zone graph (14 px a key, a colour for each zone, its keys, root and
// layers, the yellow locators dragged to move the zones) over the keyboard (click picks a key,
// a drag picks more, a right-click plays it: the lower on the key, the louder); a picked key's E
// opens Edit Key at the key (Velocity Layers, Duration, Key Shift, Custom Name; the Builder's
// Sample Slots). Clear All Keys, the count; the nodes (hub-sampling-nodes.js: the VSTis and effects
// sampled, wired from the Sampling node to the Output) and the zone list.
// Presets: Save Preset, Load Preset (Sampler Arena's .smppreset), Set Folder.
// Loop Editor: Load SFZ Patch, Batch Find All, Ask Fanan AI, Save, Save As; the samples (a green
// dot: it loops), Play/Stop, Auto Find, < >, the score, XFade, Remove Loop; the stereo waveform
// (drag S and E), the status.
// SFZ to Blob (hub-sampling-blob.js): SFZs and their samples packed into blobs, the files the
// Plugins Creator Studio's samplers play from the disk.
// Settings: Sampler Arena's floating window, two columns, its sections by mode.
//
// Sonify does the work (MainSampling.cpp): Hub.send("sampling", {action ...}); it answers with
// sampling {kind: state | progress | exists | builderFiles | builderInfo | preset | notice | loop
// | loopPosition | tried | problem}.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const NAMES = ["C", "Cs", "D", "Ds", "E", "F", "Fs", "G", "Gs", "A", "As", "B"];
  const TIMES = "\u00d7";
  const noteName = (n) => NAMES[((n % 12) + 12) % 12] + (Math.floor(n / 12) - 1);
  const isBlack = (n) => [1, 3, 6, 8, 10].includes(((n % 12) + 12) % 12);
  const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));
  const clone = (o) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));
  const send = (action, data = {}) => Hub.send("sampling", Object.assign({ action }, data));

  // Sampler Arena's 18 chord types: name, file suffix, notes.
  const CHORDS = [
    ["Major", "Maj", [0, 4, 7]], ["Minor", "Min", [0, 3, 7]], ["Diminished", "Dim", [0, 3, 6]], ["Augmented", "Aug", [0, 4, 8]],
