      const adHoc = st.native && st.native.adHoc;
      if (!adHoc) { send("adHoc"); return; }
      Hub.popupMenu($("smp-adhoc"), [{ group: `Ad Hoc: ${adHoc}` }, { label: "Choose another folder...", value: "choose" }, { label: `Stop using it (back to ${st.native.moduleFolder})`, value: "clear" }],
        (v) => send(v === "clear" ? "adHocClear" : "adHoc"));
    });
    $("smp-settings").addEventListener("click", openSettings);

    $("smp-source").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const b = event.target.closest("button");
      if (!b || isBusy()) return;
      st.s.source = b.dataset.source;
      changed();
    });
    $("smp-track").addEventListener("change", () => { st.s.trackId = Number($("smp-track").value) || 0; changed("face"); });
    $("smp-midi-out").addEventListener("change", () => { st.s.midiOutput = $("smp-midi-out").value; changed("face"); });
    $("smp-midi-channel").addEventListener("change", () => { st.s.midiChannel = Number($("smp-midi-channel").value) || 1; changed("face"); });

    $("smp-clear").addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (isBusy()) return;
      st.s.keys = [];
      st.s.overrides = {};
      st.s.boundaries = {};
      changed();
    });

    $("smp-preset-save").addEventListener("click", () => send("presetSave", { settings: st.s }));
    $("smp-preset-load").addEventListener("click", () => send("presetLoad"));
    $("smp-set-folder").addEventListener("click", () => send("setFolder"));

    wireZones();
    wireLoop();

    // The meters fall back when nothing comes.
    setInterval(() => { if (st.shown && (st.level[0] > 0.001 || st.level[1] > 0.001)) setMeter(0, 0); }, 80);
    new ResizeObserver(() => { if (st.shown && st.tab === "loop") drawWave(); }).observe($("sle-wave"));
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-scan.js
//
// The startup question, then the scanning page. At every start this page first asks whether
// to load the user's third-party plugins or use only Sonify's internal ones. Yes: plugins are
// read (new and changed ones) with the scanning page in front, and the welcome page appears
// once the scan is finished. No: no scan, straight to the welcome page, and only Sonify's own
// plugins are offered until the next start. Plugins are also read on every rescan, with this
// page in front. Each plugin is read by a copy of the Hub of its own, so one that crashes or
// hangs is reported here and can't take the Hub down.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  let scan = { state: "starting", startup: true, total: 0, done: 0, problems: [] };
  let finishing = null;
  let chosen = false;   // the question at startup has its answer

  const plural = (n, one, many) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

  function render() {
    const running = scan.state === "running" || scan.state === "starting";
    const fraction = scan.total > 0 ? scan.done / scan.total : running ? 0 : 1;
    $("scan-title").textContent = running ? (scan.startup ? "Checking your plugins" : "Scanning plugins") : "Plugins checked";
    $("scan-fill").style.width = `${Math.round(fraction * 100)}%`;
    $("scan-bar").setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(Math.round(fraction * 100)));

    if (scan.state === "starting") {
      $("scan-sub").textContent = "Starting…";
      $("scan-count").textContent = "";
      $("scan-current").textContent = "";
    } else if (running) {
      $("scan-sub").textContent = scan.total === 1 ? "1 new or changed plugin file to read." : `${scan.total} new or changed plugin files to read.`;
      $("scan-count").textContent = `${Math.min(scan.done + 1, scan.total)} of ${scan.total}`;
      $("scan-current").textContent = scan.current ? `Reading ${scan.current}` : "";
    } else {
      const parts = [plural(scan.plugins || 0, "plugin ready", "plugins ready")];
      if (scan.found > 0) parts.push(`${scan.found} new`);
      if (scan.problems.length) parts.push(`${plural(scan.problems.length, "file", "files")} couldn't be read`);
      if (scan.state === "cancelled") parts.push("the rest are read next time");
      $("scan-sub").textContent = parts.join(" · ");
      $("scan-count").textContent = "";
      $("scan-current").textContent = "";
    }

    const list = $("scan-problem-list");
    list.replaceChildren();
    for (const problem of scan.problems) {
      const item = element("li");
      item.append(element("span", "scan-problem-name", problem.name), element("span", "scan-problem-why", problem.error));
      list.appendChild(item);
    }
    $("scan-problems").hidden = scan.problems.length === 0;

    const skip = $("scan-skip");
    skip.hidden = !running || scan.state === "starting";
    skip.textContent = scan.startup ? "Skip" : "Cancel";
    skip.title = scan.startup ? "Go on now: the rest are read at the next start" : "Stop scanning: the rest are read next time";
    $("scan-continue").hidden = running || scan.problems.length === 0;
  }

  function show() {
    clearTimeout(finishing);
    finishing = null;
    $("scan-page").hidden = false;
  }

  /** The scan is over: the page steps aside, and at startup the welcome page comes up. */
  function finish() {
    clearTimeout(finishing);
    finishing = null;
    const box = $("scan-page");
    if (box.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    box.hidden = true;
    document.body.classList.remove("booting");
  }

  /** The answer to the question at startup: Yes, the scan (its page shows meanwhile); No, the
      welcome page straight away. */
  function choose(thirdParty) {
    if (chosen) return;
    chosen = true;
    $("plugin-choice").hidden = true;
    $("scan-box").hidden = false;
    Hub.send("choosePlugins", { thirdParty });
    if (!thirdParty) finish();
  }

  // A page loading again later (it shouldn't): the question was answered already.
  Hub.on("pluginChoice", () => {
    chosen = true;
    $("plugin-choice").hidden = true;
    $("scan-box").hidden = false;
  });

  Hub.on("pluginScan", (s) => {
    scan = { ...s, problems: s.problems || [] };

    if (s.state === "running") {
      show();
      render();
      return;
    }

    // Done or cancelled.
    const wasShowing = !$("scan-page").hidden;
    render();

    if (scan.problems.length) {
      // Nothing fails unseen: the list stays until Continue.
      show();
      $("scan-continue").focus();
    } else if (!wasShowing || s.total === 0) {
      finish();   // nothing was read (all up to date): straight on
    } else {
      finishing = setTimeout(finish, 700);   // a moment to see it finished
    }
  });

  Hub.scan = { state: () => scan, finish };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    render();
    $("choice-yes").addEventListener("click", () => choose(true));
    $("choice-no").addEventListener("click", () => choose(false));
    if (!chosen) $("choice-yes").focus();
    $("scan-skip").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("cancelScan"));
    $("scan-continue").addEventListener("click", finish);

    // While the page is up, keys don't reach the Hub behind it (Escape would close the welcome
    // page before it appeared); the page's own buttons still take Tab, Enter and Space.
    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      const box = $("scan-page");
      if (box.hidden || (event.target instanceof Node && box.contains(event.target))) return;
      if (event.key === "Tab") return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }, true);
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-score.js
//
// The Score: an instrument track's notes shown as sheet music, as Studio One's Score view shows
// them, to read and print, not to write (the notes are edited in the Editor). The whole track:
// every clip on it, on the song's bars, from the bar of its first note to the bar of its last.
//
//   Opened from a track header's right-click menu (Show as Score...), a MIDI clip's (Show Track
//   as Score...) or View > Score (the selected track).
//   Notation   Auto (drums for a drum track, else one or two staves as the notes need), Piano
//              (two staves, split at a note), Treble clef, Bass clef or Drums (a drum staff:
//              General MIDI drums in their usual places, cymbals as x, the feet stemmed down).
//   Quantize   the grid the notes are read on (1/4 to 1/32): starts and ends land on it.
//   Export     PDF (A4 pages) and MusicXML (for MuseScore, Sibelius, Finale or Dorico); Sonify
//              asks where to save.
//
// How notes become notation: each staff has up to two voices. Notes starting and ending
// together are one chord; a chord that overlaps the voice above goes to the voice below (a
// third layer shortens the note before it). Notes and rests are split into values that show
// the beat, tied across the beat and the bar line; the key from the Song Channel spells the
// accidentals; the time signatures and the first tempo come from it too. Muted notes and
// clips are left out, as they don't play. Drums: each hit lasts until the next in its voice,
// at most to the end of its beat.
//
// Drawn by OpenSheetMusicDisplay (BSD licence) from the MusicXML made here; PDF pages by jsPDF
// and svg2pdf.js (MIT). The three load the first time the Score opens.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const DIV = 16;                  // MusicXML divisions: ticks per quarter note
  const MAX_MEASURES = 600;
  const LIBRARIES = ["opensheetmusicdisplay.min.js", "jspdf.umd.min.js", "svg2pdf.umd.min.js"];
  const NATURAL = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
  const LETTERS = ["C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "A", "B"];
  const MAJOR_FIFTHS = [0, -5, 2, -3, 4, -1, 6, 1, -4, 3, -2, 5];          // by the tonic's pitch class
  // How far each scale's parent major key is from its root, and the MusicXML mode it shows as.
  const MODES = { major: [0, "major"], minor: [3, "minor"], dorian: [10, "dorian"], phrygian: [8, "phrygian"], lydian: [7, "lydian"],
                  mixolydian: [5, "mixolydian"], locrian: [1, "locrian"], "harmonic minor": [3, "minor"], "melodic minor": [3, "minor"],
                  "major pentatonic": [0, "major"], "minor pentatonic": [3, "minor"], blues: [3, "minor"] };
  // Note values in ticks: [ticks, type, dots], longest first.
  const VALUES = [[96, "whole", 1], [64, "whole", 0], [48, "half", 1], [32, "half", 0], [24, "quarter", 1], [16, "quarter", 0],
                  [12, "eighth", 1], [8, "eighth", 0], [6, "16th", 1], [4, "16th", 0], [3, "32nd", 1], [2, "32nd", 0], [1, "64th", 0]];
  // General MIDI drums on a drum staff: [display step, octave, notehead].
  const DRUMS = {
    35: ["F", 4, "normal"], 36: ["F", 4, "normal"], 37: ["C", 5, "x"], 38: ["C", 5, "normal"], 39: ["C", 5, "x"], 40: ["C", 5, "normal"],
    41: ["G", 4, "normal"], 43: ["A", 4, "normal"], 45: ["B", 4, "normal"], 47: ["D", 5, "normal"], 48: ["D", 5, "normal"], 50: ["E", 5, "normal"],
    42: ["G", 5, "x"], 44: ["D", 4, "x"], 46: ["G", 5, "circle-x"], 49: ["A", 5, "x"], 57: ["A", 5, "x"], 55: ["A", 5, "x"], 52: ["B", 5, "x"],
    51: ["F", 5, "x"], 59: ["F", 5, "x"], 53: ["F", 5, "diamond"], 54: ["B", 5, "x"], 56: ["E", 5, "triangle"]
  };
  const FEET = new Set([35, 36, 44]);

  const options = { trackId: 0, staff: "auto", split: 60, grid: 0.25, zoom: 1 };
  let osmd = null, loading = null, shownXml = "", renderTimer = 0;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the notes
  const isDrumTrack = (track) => /drum|kit|perc|beat|cajon|808|909/i.test(`${track.name} ${(track.instrument && track.instrument.name) || ""}`);

  /** Every note the track plays, on the song's timeline (quarter notes): muted ones left out. */
  function trackNotes(track) {
    const notes = [];
    for (const clip of track.clips || []) {
      if (clip.audioFile || clip.muted) continue;
      const offset = clip.offset || 0, clipEnd = clip.start + clip.length;
      for (const [pitch, start, length, , muted] of clip.notes || []) {
        if (muted || start < offset || start >= offset + clip.length) continue;
        const songStart = clip.start + start - offset;
        notes.push({ pitch, start: songStart, end: Math.min(songStart + Math.max(length, 1 / 64), clipEnd) });
      }
    }
    return notes.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || b.pitch - a.pitch);
  }

  /** Notes on the grid, in ticks; the same note twice at once is kept once. */
  function quantize(notes, grid) {
    const g = Math.max(1, Math.round(grid * DIV));
    const seen = new Set(), out = [];
    for (const n of notes) {
      const start = Math.round(n.start * DIV / g) * g;
      let end = Math.round(n.end * DIV / g) * g;
      if (end <= start) end = start + g;
      const key = `${n.pitch}|${start}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      out.push({ pitch: n.pitch, start, end });
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- keys and spelling
  function keyOf(ppq) {
    const key = Hub.tempoMap.keyAt(ppq) || { root: 0, scale: "major" };
    const [offset, mode] = MODES[key.scale] || [0, "major"];
    return { fifths: MAJOR_FIFTHS[(key.root + offset) % 12], mode };
  }

  const spellings = new Map();

  /** Each pitch class's name in a key: the scale's own notes, then sharps (flats in flat keys). */
  function spelling(fifths) {
    if (spellings.has(fifths)) return spellings.get(fifths);
    const map = new Array(12);
    const tonicLetter = ((fifths * 4) % 7 + 7) % 7, tonicPc = ((fifths * 7) % 12 + 12) % 12;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const letter = (tonicLetter + i) % 7, pc = (tonicPc + NATURAL[i]) % 12;
      map[pc] = { step: LETTERS[letter], alter: ((pc - NATURAL[letter] + 18) % 12) - 6 };
    }
    for (let pc = 0; pc < 12; pc++) {
      if (map[pc]) continue;
      const natural = NATURAL.indexOf(pc);
      // C major: C#, Eb, F#, G#, Bb, as they're usually written.
      const flat = fifths < 0 || (fifths === 0 && (pc === 3 || pc === 10));
      if (natural >= 0) map[pc] = { step: LETTERS[natural], alter: 0 };
      else if (flat) map[pc] = { step: LETTERS[NATURAL.indexOf((pc + 1) % 12)], alter: -1 };
      else map[pc] = { step: LETTERS[NATURAL.indexOf((pc + 11) % 12)], alter: 1 };
    }
    spellings.set(fifths, map);
    return map;
  }

  function pitchXml(midi, fifths) {
    const { step, alter } = spelling(fifths)[midi % 12];
    const octave = Math.floor((midi - alter) / 12) - 1;
    return `<pitch><step>${step}</step>${alter ? `<alter>${alter}</alter>` : ""}<octave>${octave}</octave></pitch>`;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- voices
  /** Chords of a staff in up to two voices, each a list of {start, end, notes} that don't overlap. */
  function voicesOf(notes) {
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const n of notes) {
      const key = `${n.start}|${n.end}`;
      if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, { start: n.start, end: n.end, notes: [] });
      groups.get(key).notes.push(n);
    }
    const chords = [...groups.values()].sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || Math.max(...b.notes.map((n) => n.pitch)) - Math.max(...a.notes.map((n) => n.pitch)));
    const voices = [[], []];
    const lastEnd = (v) => (v.length ? v[v.length - 1].end : -Infinity);

    const middle = (c) => c.notes.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n.pitch, 0) / c.notes.length;

    for (const chord of chords) {
      let v = voices.findIndex((voice) => lastEnd(voice) <= chord.start);
      if (v < 0) {
        // A third layer: the voice nearest it in pitch (an inner line, so the top and the bottom
        // stay whole) gives way where it starts.
        const near = voices.map((voice) => Math.abs(middle(voice[voice.length - 1]) - middle(chord)));
        v = near[0] < near[1] ? 0 : 1;
        const before = voices[v][voices[v].length - 1];
        if (before.start >= chord.start) {
          // Starting together: one chord, as long as the shorter.
          before.notes.push(...chord.notes);
          before.end = Math.min(before.end, chord.end);
          continue;
        }
        before.end = chord.start;
      }
      voices[v].push(chord);
    }
    return voices.filter((voice) => voice.length);
  }

  /** Drum hits in two voices (hands up, feet down), each lasting until the next, at most to the
      end of its beat (drums are never tied). */
  function drumVoices(notes, measureAt) {
    const voices = [[], []];
    for (const n of notes) {
      const v = FEET.has(n.pitch) ? 1 : 0;
      const voice = voices[v];
      const last = voice[voice.length - 1];
      if (last && last.start === n.start) {
        if (!last.notes.some((m) => (DRUMS[m.pitch] || DRUMS[38])[0] === (DRUMS[n.pitch] || DRUMS[38])[0]
                                     && (DRUMS[m.pitch] || DRUMS[38])[1] === (DRUMS[n.pitch] || DRUMS[38])[1])) last.notes.push(n);
        continue;
      }
      voice.push({ start: n.start, end: n.start, notes: [n] });
    }
    for (const voice of voices) {
      voice.forEach((chord, i) => {
        const measure = measureAt(chord.start);
        const next = i + 1 < voice.length ? voice[i + 1].start : Infinity;
        const beatEnd = measure.start + (Math.floor((chord.start - measure.start) / measure.beat) + 1) * measure.beat;
        chord.end = Math.max(chord.start + 1, Math.min(next, measure.end, beatEnd));
      });
    }
    return voices;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- note values
  /** A stretch of a measure (from pos, ticks long) as note values that show the beat. */
  function values(pos, length, measure) {
    const out = [];
    let left = length;
    while (left > 0) {
      const fit = VALUES.find(([ticks, , dots]) => {
        if (ticks > left || ticks > measure.length) return false;
        const base = dots ? ticks / 3 * 2 : ticks;
        if (pos % base !== 0) return false;
        // In 4/4 a note doesn't hide the middle of the bar unless it starts the bar.
        if (measure.length === 64 && measure.numerator === 4 && pos !== 0 && pos < 32 && pos + ticks > 32) return false;
        // A note that starts off the beat ends by the next beat (it's tied on from there), so the
        // beats stay where the eye looks for them.
        if (pos % measure.beat !== 0 && Math.floor(pos / measure.beat) !== Math.floor((pos + ticks - 1) / measure.beat)) return false;
        return true;
      }) || [1, "64th", 0];
      out.push({ ticks: fit[0], type: fit[1], dots: fit[2] });
      pos += fit[0];
      left -= fit[0];
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- MusicXML
  const escape = (text) => String(text).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");

  const BEAMS = { eighth: 1, "16th": 2, "32nd": 3, "64th": 4 };

  /** One voice through one measure: its chords (tied over the bar line and between values) and
      rests, as {pos, ticks, type, dots, rest, notes, stop, start}; null when it has no chords there. */
  function voiceEvents(chords, measure) {
    const inside = chords.filter((c) => c.end > measure.start && c.start < measure.end);
    if (!inside.length) return null;
    const events = [];
    const rests = (from, to) => {
      if (from === measure.start && to === measure.end) { events.push({ pos: from, ticks: measure.length, whole: true, rest: true }); return; }
      let pos = from;
      for (const v of values(from - measure.start, to - from, measure)) { events.push({ pos, ...v, rest: true }); pos += v.ticks; }
    };
    let at = measure.start;
    for (const chord of inside) {
      const from = Math.max(chord.start, measure.start), to = Math.min(chord.end, measure.end);
      if (from > at) rests(at, from);
      let pos = from;
      for (const v of values(from - measure.start, to - from, measure)) {
        events.push({ pos, ...v, rest: false, notes: chord.notes, stop: pos > chord.start, start: pos + v.ticks < chord.end });
        pos += v.ticks;
      }
      at = to;
    }
    if (at < measure.end) rests(at, measure.end);
    return events;
  }

  /** Beams, as they'd be engraved: notes shorter than a quarter, one after another within a beat,
      joined; the shorter ones get their second (third...) beam, or a hook when alone. */
  function addBeams(events, measure) {
    let group = [];
    const flush = () => {
      if (group.length > 1) {
        const levels = group.map((e) => BEAMS[e.type] || 0);
        const most = Math.max(...levels);
        group.forEach((e) => { e.beams = []; });
        for (let level = 1; level <= most; level++) {
          group.forEach((e, i) => {
            if (levels[i] < level) return;
            const before = i > 0 && levels[i - 1] >= level, after = i < group.length - 1 && levels[i + 1] >= level;
            const kind = before && after ? "continue" : after ? "begin" : before ? "end" : i < group.length - 1 ? "forward hook" : "backward hook";
            e.beams.push(`<beam number="${level}">${kind}</beam>`);
          });
        }
      }
      group = [];
    };
    let beat = -1;
    for (const e of events) {
      const here = Math.floor((e.pos - measure.start) / measure.beat);
      if (e.rest || !BEAMS[e.type] || here !== beat) flush();
      beat = here;
      if (!e.rest && BEAMS[e.type]) group.push(e);
    }
    flush();
  }

  /** One voice through one measure as MusicXML notes (null: nothing of it there). */
  function voiceXml(chords, measure, staff, voice, stem, drums, fifths) {
    const events = voiceEvents(chords, measure);
    if (!events) return null;
    addBeams(events, measure);
    let xml = "";
    for (const e of events) {
      if (e.rest) {
        xml += e.whole ? `<note><rest measure="yes"/><duration>${e.ticks}</duration><voice>${voice}</voice><staff>${staff}</staff></note>`
                       : `<note><rest/><duration>${e.ticks}</duration><voice>${voice}</voice><type>${e.type}</type>${"<dot/>".repeat(e.dots)}<staff>${staff}</staff></note>`;
        continue;
      }
      const ties = (e.stop ? '<tie type="stop"/>' : "") + (e.start ? '<tie type="start"/>' : "");
      const tied = e.stop || e.start ? `<notations>${e.stop ? '<tied type="stop"/>' : ""}${e.start ? '<tied type="start"/>' : ""}</notations>` : "";
      e.notes.slice().sort((a, b) => a.pitch - b.pitch).forEach((n, i) => {
        let what, head = "";
        if (drums) {
          const [step, octave, notehead] = DRUMS[n.pitch] || DRUMS[38];
          what = `<unpitched><display-step>${step}</display-step><display-octave>${octave}</display-octave></unpitched>`;
          if (notehead !== "normal") head = `<notehead>${notehead}</notehead>`;
        } else {
          what = pitchXml(n.pitch, fifths);
        }
        xml += `<note>${i ? "<chord/>" : ""}${what}<duration>${e.ticks}</duration>${ties}<voice>${voice}</voice><type>${e.type}</type>`
             + `${"<dot/>".repeat(e.dots)}${stem ? `<stem>${stem}</stem>` : ""}${head}<staff>${staff}</staff>${i === 0 && e.beams ? e.beams.join("") : ""}${tied}</note>`;
      });
    }
    return xml;
  }

  /** A staff with nothing in a measure: its whole-bar rest. */
  const restsXml = (measure, staff, voice) => `<note><rest measure="yes"/><duration>${measure.length}</duration><voice>${voice}</voice><staff>${staff}</staff></note>`;

  /** The staves the notation uses: [{clef, notes}], and whether they're drums. */
  function stavesOf(notes, mode, split) {
    if (mode === "drums") return { drums: true, staves: [{ clef: "percussion", notes }] };
    if (mode === "auto") {
      const pitches = notes.map((n) => n.pitch);
      const low = Math.min(...pitches), high = Math.max(...pitches);
      const middle = pitches.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p, 0) / Math.max(1, pitches.length);
      if (low >= 55 && (high >= 64 || middle >= 60)) mode = "treble";
      else if (high < 64) mode = "bass";
      else mode = "grand";
    }
    if (mode === "treble") return { drums: false, staves: [{ clef: "treble", notes }] };
    if (mode === "bass") return { drums: false, staves: [{ clef: "bass", notes }] };
    return { drums: false, staves: [{ clef: "treble", notes: notes.filter((n) => n.pitch >= split) },
                                   { clef: "bass", notes: notes.filter((n) => n.pitch < split) }] };
  }

  const CLEFS = { treble: "<sign>G</sign><line>2</line>", bass: "<sign>F</sign><line>4</line>", percussion: "<sign>percussion</sign>" };

  /** The whole score as MusicXML 4.0 (partwise): {xml, measures, notes} (xml empty: no notes). */
  function musicXml(track) {
    const map = Hub.tempoMap;
    const notes = quantize(trackNotes(track), options.grid);
    if (!notes.length) return { xml: "", measures: 0, notes: 0, cut: false };

    const mode = options.staff === "auto" && isDrumTrack(track) ? "drums" : options.staff;
    const { drums, staves } = stavesOf(notes, mode, options.split);

    // The bars, from the first note's to the last's.
    const first = map.barAt(notes[0].start / DIV + 1e-9);
    const lastEnd = Math.max(...notes.map((n) => n.end)) / DIV;
    const measures = [];
    for (let bar = first; bar.start < lastEnd - 1e-9 && measures.length < MAX_MEASURES; bar = map.barAt(bar.end + 1e-9)) {
      const compound = bar.denominator === 8 && bar.numerator % 3 === 0 && bar.numerator > 3;
      measures.push({ index: bar.index, start: Math.round(bar.start * DIV), end: Math.round(bar.end * DIV), length: Math.round(bar.length * DIV),
                      numerator: bar.numerator, denominator: bar.denominator, ppq: bar.start, compound,
                      beat: Math.round((compound ? 3 * 4 / bar.denominator : 4 / bar.denominator) * DIV) });
    }
    const cut = measures.length >= MAX_MEASURES && measures[measures.length - 1].end < lastEnd * DIV;
    const measureAt = (tick) => measures.find((m) => tick >= m.start && tick < m.end) || measures[measures.length - 1];

    const staffVoices = staves.map((staff) => (drums ? drumVoices(staff.notes, measureAt) : voicesOf(staff.notes)));
    const song = (Hub.state.song && Hub.state.song.name) || "Untitled";
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    let xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>\n'
      + '<!DOCTYPE score-partwise PUBLIC "-//Recordare//DTD MusicXML 4.0 Partwise//EN" "http://www.musicxml.org/dtds/partwise.dtd">\n'
      + '<score-partwise version="4.0">\n'
      + `<work><work-title>${escape(song)}</work-title></work>\n`
      + `<movement-title>${escape(track.name)}</movement-title>\n`
      + `<identification><encoding><software>Sonify</software><encoding-date>${today}</encoding-date></encoding></identification>\n`
      + `<part-list><score-part id="P1"><part-name>${escape(track.name)}</part-name></score-part></part-list>\n<part id="P1">\n`;

    let lastKey = null, lastTime = "";
    measures.forEach((m, i) => {
      const key = drums ? { fifths: 0, mode: "major" } : keyOf(m.ppq);
      const time = `${m.numerator}/${m.denominator}`;
      let attributes = "";
      if (i === 0) attributes += `<divisions>${DIV}</divisions>`;
      if (!lastKey || key.fifths !== lastKey.fifths || key.mode !== lastKey.mode) attributes += `<key><fifths>${key.fifths}</fifths><mode>${key.mode}</mode></key>`;
      if (time !== lastTime) attributes += `<time><beats>${m.numerator}</beats><beat-type>${m.denominator}</beat-type></time>`;
      if (i === 0) {
        if (staves.length > 1) attributes += `<staves>${staves.length}</staves>`;
        staves.forEach((staff, s) => { attributes += `<clef${staves.length > 1 ? ` number="${s + 1}"` : ""}>${CLEFS[staff.clef]}</clef>`; });
      }
      lastKey = key;
      lastTime = time;

      xml += `<measure number="${m.index + 1}">`;
      if (attributes) xml += `<attributes>${attributes}</attributes>`;
      if (i === 0) {
        const bpm = Math.round(map.bpmAt(m.ppq) * 100) / 100;
        xml += `<direction placement="above"><direction-type><metronome><beat-unit>quarter</beat-unit><per-minute>${bpm}</per-minute></metronome></direction-type><sound tempo="${bpm}"/></direction>`;
      }

      let first = true;
      staffVoices.forEach((voices, s) => {
        const staff = s + 1;
        const present = voices.map((v) => v.some((c) => c.end > m.start && c.start < m.end));
        const two = present.filter(Boolean).length > 1;
        voices.forEach((voice, v) => {
          const number = s * 4 + v + 1;
          const stem = drums ? (v === 0 ? "up" : "down") : two ? (v === 0 ? "up" : "down") : "";
          let part = voiceXml(voice, m, staff, number, stem, drums, key.fifths);
          if (part === null && v === 0) part = restsXml(m, staff, number);   // every staff shows the bar
          if (part === null) return;
          if (!first) xml += `<backup><duration>${m.length}</duration></backup>`;
          xml += part;
          first = false;
        });
        if (!voices.length) {
          if (!first) xml += `<backup><duration>${m.length}</duration></backup>`;
          xml += restsXml(m, staff, s * 4 + 1);
          first = false;
        }
      });
      if (i === measures.length - 1 && !cut) xml += '<barline location="right"><bar-style>light-heavy</bar-style></barline>';
      xml += "</measure>\n";
    });
    xml += "</part>\n</score-partwise>\n";
    return { xml, measures: measures.length, notes: notes.length, cut };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the libraries
  function loadScript(src) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const script = document.createElement("script");
      script.src = src;
      script.onload = () => resolve();
      script.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`${src} didn't load`));
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    });
  }

  function loadLibraries() {
    if (!loading) loading = LIBRARIES.reduce((chain, src) => chain.then(() => loadScript(src)), Promise.resolve());
    return loading;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the view
  const scoreTrack = () => Hub.trackById(options.trackId);
  const instrumentTracks = () => Hub.state.tracks.filter((t) => t.kind !== "audio" && t.kind !== "fx" && t.kind !== "bus");

  function setStatus(text, action) {
    const status = $("score-status");
    status.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode(text || ""));
    if (action) {
      const button = element("button", "plain-button small", action.label);
      button.type = "button";
      button.addEventListener("click", action.run);
      status.append(" ", button);
    }
    status.hidden = !text;
  }

  function fillTracks() {
    const select = $("score-track");
    select.textContent = "";
    for (const track of instrumentTracks()) select.add(new Option(track.name, String(track.id)));
    select.value = String(options.trackId);
  }

  function showControls() {
    const track = scoreTrack();
    const drums = options.staff === "drums" || (options.staff === "auto" && track && isDrumTrack(track));
    $("score-split-box").hidden = options.staff !== "grand";
    $("score-export-pdf").disabled = !shownXml;
    $("score-export-xml").disabled = !shownXml;
    $("score-zoom-text").textContent = `${Math.round(options.zoom * 100)}%`;
    $("score-title").textContent = track ? `Score: ${track.name}` : "Score";
    $("score-paper").classList.toggle("drums", drums);
  }

  let rendering = false, again = false;

  /** Draws the score afresh; asked again while drawing, it draws once more when done. */
  async function render() {
    if (rendering) { again = true; return; }
    rendering = true;
    try {
      await draw();
    } finally {
      rendering = false;
      if (again) { again = false; render(); }
    }
  }

  async function draw() {
    const track = scoreTrack();
    shownXml = "";
    showControls();
    if (!track) { setStatus("Pick an instrument track."); $("score-render").replaceChildren(); return; }

    const made = musicXml(track);
    if (!made.xml) {
      $("score-render").replaceChildren();
      setStatus(`"${track.name}" has no notes to show yet.`);
      showControls();
      return;
    }

    setStatus("Writing the score\u2026");
    try {
      await loadLibraries();
      if (!osmd) {
        osmd = new window.opensheetmusicdisplay.OpenSheetMusicDisplay($("score-render"), {
          autoResize: true, backend: "svg", drawTitle: true, drawSubtitle: true, drawPartNames: false, drawMeasureNumbers: true,
          pageFormat: "Endless", drawingParameters: "default"
        });
      }
      await osmd.load(made.xml);
      osmd.zoom = options.zoom;
      osmd.render();
      shownXml = made.xml;
      setStatus(made.cut ? `The first ${made.measures} bars are shown (the score is very long).` : "");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Score:", error);
      setStatus("The score couldn't be drawn.");
    }
    showControls();
  }

  function renderSoon() {
    clearTimeout(renderTimer);
    renderTimer = setTimeout(render, 150);
  }

  /** Opens the Score for a track (the selected one when none is named). */
  function open(trackId) {
    const tracks = instrumentTracks();
    const wanted = Hub.trackById(trackId || Hub.state.selected);
    const track = wanted && tracks.includes(wanted) ? wanted : tracks[0];
    if (!track) { Hub.toast("There's no instrument track to show as a score."); return; }
    options.trackId = track.id;
    fillTracks();
    $("score-staff").value = options.staff;
    $("score-split").value = String(options.split);
    $("score-grid").value = String(options.grid);
    $("score-view").hidden = false;
    render();
  }

  function close() {
    $("score-view").hidden = true;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- export
  const fileName = () => {
    const track = scoreTrack();
    const song = (Hub.state.song && Hub.state.song.name) || "Untitled";
    return `${song} - ${track ? track.name : "Score"}`;
  };

  function exportXml() {
    if (!shownXml) return;
    Hub.send("score", { action: "export", format: "musicxml", name: fileName(), data: shownXml });
  }

  /** A4 pages, drawn by a second copy of the score off screen, made into a PDF. */
  async function exportPdf() {
    if (!shownXml) return;
    setStatus("Making the PDF\u2026");
    const holder = element("div", "score-print");
    document.body.appendChild(holder);
    try {
      await loadLibraries();
      const printer = new window.opensheetmusicdisplay.OpenSheetMusicDisplay(holder, {
        autoResize: false, backend: "svg", drawTitle: true, drawSubtitle: true, drawPartNames: false, drawMeasureNumbers: true,
        pageFormat: "A4_P", pageBackgroundColor: "#FFFFFF"
      });
      await printer.load(shownXml);
      printer.render();

      const pages = [...holder.querySelectorAll("svg")];
      const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
      const pdf = new jsPDF({ orientation: "portrait", unit: "pt", format: "a4" });
      const width = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth(), height = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
      for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
        if (i) pdf.addPage();
        const svg = pages[i];
        const w = Number(svg.getAttribute("width")) || svg.clientWidth || 1, h = Number(svg.getAttribute("height")) || svg.clientHeight || 1;
        const scale = Math.min(width / w, height / h);
        await pdf.svg(svg, { x: 0, y: 0, width: w * scale, height: h * scale });
      }
      const data = pdf.output("datauristring").split(",")[1] || "";
      Hub.send("score", { action: "export", format: "pdf", name: fileName(), data });
      setStatus("");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Score PDF:", error);
      setStatus("The PDF couldn't be made.");
    } finally {
      holder.remove();
    }
  }

  // Sonify's answer: where it saved the file (or why it couldn't).
  if (window.__JUCE__ && window.__JUCE__.backend)
    window.__JUCE__.backend.addEventListener("scoreExported", (data) => Hub.emit("scoreExported", data));

  Hub.on("scoreExported", (data) => {
    if (!data) return;
    if (data.ok) setStatus(`Saved ${data.name}`, { label: "Show in folder", run: () => Hub.send("score", { action: "reveal", path: data.path }) });
    else if (data.message) setStatus(data.message);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- wiring
  Hub.commands.showScore = () => open();
  // A MIDI clip's right-click: its track.
  Hub.commands.showClipScore = () => {
    const found = Hub.findClip(Hub.state.selectedClips[Hub.state.selectedClips.length - 1]);
    open(found ? found.track.id : 0);
  };
  /** The MusicXML for a track, with these options for once (tests, and anything that needs it). */
  function musicXmlWith(track, overrides) {
    const kept = { ...options };
    Object.assign(options, overrides || {});
    try { return musicXml(track).xml; } finally { Object.assign(options, kept); }
  }

  Hub.score = { open, close, musicXml: musicXmlWith, isOpen: () => !$("score-view").hidden };

  Hub.on("tracks", () => {
    if ($("score-view").hidden) return;
    if (!scoreTrack()) { close(); return; }
    fillTracks();
    renderSoon();
  });
  Hub.on("tempoMap", () => { if (!$("score-view").hidden) renderSoon(); });

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const split = $("score-split");
    const names = ["C", "C#", "D", "Eb", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "Ab", "A", "Bb", "B"];
    for (let pitch = 43; pitch <= 72; pitch++) split.add(new Option(`${names[pitch % 12]}${Math.floor(pitch / 12) - 1}`, String(pitch)));

    $("score-track").addEventListener("change", (event) => { options.trackId = Number(event.target.value); render(); });
    $("score-staff").addEventListener("change", (event) => { options.staff = event.target.value; render(); });
    split.addEventListener("change", (event) => { options.split = Number(event.target.value); render(); });
    $("score-grid").addEventListener("change", (event) => { options.grid = Number(event.target.value); render(); });
    $("score-zoom-out").addEventListener("click", () => { options.zoom = Math.max(0.4, Math.round((options.zoom - 0.1) * 10) / 10); render(); });
    $("score-zoom-in").addEventListener("click", () => { options.zoom = Math.min(2.5, Math.round((options.zoom + 0.1) * 10) / 10); render(); });
    $("score-export-pdf").addEventListener("click", exportPdf);
    $("score-export-xml").addEventListener("click", exportXml);
    $("score-close").addEventListener("click", close);
    $("score-view").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); close(); }
    });
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-screens.js
//
// Plugin screens: floating windows inside the Hub's page, like Studio One's plugin windows.
//   web      a WCLAP's own page (CLAP's webview extension), in a sandboxed frame. The plugin
//            serves its files; its messages pass both ways as ArrayBuffers (postMessage).
//   generic  plugins without a screen of their own: the Hub's controls for their parameters.
//   native   VST3 editors open in a window of their own; nothing to show here.
//   panel    the page's own windows (a MIDI FX device's settings, hub-miditools.js): Hub.screens.panel.
// Drag a window by its title, resize it from its corner; a click brings it to the front.
// A window closes by itself when its plugin is removed.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const windows = new Map();   // "channel:slot" -> { root, frame, channel, slot, kind, params }
  const TITLE = 28;
  let topZ = 50, opened = 0;

  const keyOf = (channel, slot) => `${channel}:${slot}`;

  /** The plugin in a slot: the instrument (slot 0) or an insert, from the tracks the page has; or a
      plugin inside a container on the channel (a node's slot id), however deep. */
  function pluginAt(channel, slot) {
    const track = channel === Hub.MAIN ? null : Hub.trackById(channel);
    if (channel !== Hub.MAIN && !track) return null;
    if (slot === 0) return (track && track.instrument) || null;
    const inserts = channel === Hub.MAIN ? (Hub.state.master.inserts || []) : (track.inserts || []);
    const direct = inserts.find((i) => i.insertId === slot);
    if (direct) return direct;
    const inside = (plugin) => {
      for (const node of (plugin && plugin.nodes) || []) {
        if (node.insertId === slot) return node;
        const deeper = inside(node);
        if (deeper) return deeper;
      }
      return null;
    };
    for (const plugin of [track && track.instrument, ...inserts]) {
      const found = inside(plugin);
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return null;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- bytes <-> base64
  function toBase64(bytes) {
    let text = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) text += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
    return btoa(text);
  }

  function fromBase64(base64) {
    const text = atob(base64);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(text.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) bytes[i] = text.charCodeAt(i);
    return bytes;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- windows
  function bringToFront(win) {
    win.root.style.zIndex = String(++topZ);
  }

  function close(key, tellEngine = true) {
    const win = windows.get(key);
    if (!win) return;
    windows.delete(key);
    win.root.remove();
    if (tellEngine && win.kind === "web") Hub.send("closePluginScreen", { channel: win.channel, slot: win.slot });
  }

  function makeWindow(key, channel, slot, kind, title, width, height) {
    const root = element("div", "screen-window");
    root.dataset.key = key;
    root.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
    root.setAttribute("aria-label", title);

    const bar = element("div", "screen-title");
    const name = element("span", "screen-name", title);
    const shut = element("button", "screen-close", "×");
    shut.type = "button";
    shut.title = "Close";
    shut.setAttribute("aria-label", `Close ${title}`);
    shut.addEventListener("click", () => close(key));
    bar.append(name, shut);

    const body = element("div", "screen-body");
    const grip = element("div", "screen-resize");
    root.append(bar, body, grip);

    // Over the arrangement, clear of the track headers, cascaded.
    const w = Math.min(Math.max(width, 260), window.innerWidth - 40);
    const h = Math.min(Math.max(height, 120), window.innerHeight - 80) + TITLE;
    const n = opened++ % 8;
    const headers = $("tracks-area");
    const clear = headers ? headers.getBoundingClientRect().right + 24 : 260;
    root.style.left = `${Math.max(10, Math.min(clear + 60 + n * 28, window.innerWidth - w - 10))}px`;
    root.style.top = `${Math.max(10, Math.min(100 + n * 28, window.innerHeight - h - 10))}px`;
    root.style.width = `${w}px`;
    root.style.height = `${h}px`;

    const win = { root, body, channel, slot, kind, frame: null, params: new Map() };
    root.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => bringToFront(win), true);

    // Move by the title bar.
    bar.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.target === shut) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      const startX = event.clientX, startY = event.clientY;
      const left = root.offsetLeft, top = root.offsetTop;
      root.classList.add("dragging");
      const move = (e) => {
        root.style.left = `${Math.min(Math.max(left + e.clientX - startX, -root.offsetWidth + 80), window.innerWidth - 80)}px`;
        root.style.top = `${Math.min(Math.max(top + e.clientY - startY, 0), window.innerHeight - TITLE)}px`;
      };
      const up = () => {
        root.classList.remove("dragging");
        window.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
        window.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
      };
      window.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
    });

    // Resize by the corner.
    grip.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const startX = event.clientX, startY = event.clientY;
      const startW = root.offsetWidth, startH = root.offsetHeight;
      root.classList.add("dragging");
      const move = (e) => {
        root.style.width = `${Math.max(220, startW + e.clientX - startX)}px`;
        root.style.height = `${Math.max(TITLE + 80, startH + e.clientY - startY)}px`;
      };
      const up = () => {
        root.classList.remove("dragging");
        window.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
        window.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
      };
      window.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
    });

    $("screens").appendChild(root);
    windows.set(key, win);
    bringToFront(win);
    return win;
  }

  /** The Hub's own controls, for plugins without a screen. */
  function fillGeneric(win, plugin) {
    const list = element("div", "params screen-params");
    const params = (plugin && plugin.params) || [];
    if (!params.length) list.appendChild(element("p", "slot-hint", "This plugin has no parameters."));

    for (const p of params) {
      const row = element("div", "param");
      const name = element("span", "param-name", p.name);
      name.title = p.name;
      const input = element("input");
      input.type = "range";
      input.min = String(p.min);
      input.max = String(p.max);
      input.step = p.stepped ? "1" : String((p.max - p.min) / 1000 || 0.001);
      input.value = String(p.value);
      input.disabled = Boolean(p.readOnly);
      input.setAttribute("aria-label", p.name);
      input.addEventListener("input", () => {
        Hub.send("setParam", { trackId: win.channel, insertId: win.slot, index: p.index, value: Number(input.value) });
      });
      const value = element("span", "param-value", p.text);
      row.append(name, input, value);
      list.appendChild(row);
      win.params.set(p.index, { input, value });
    }

    win.body.replaceChildren(list);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- opening
  /** Opens (or brings forward) the screen of the plugin in a slot. */
  Hub.openScreen = (channel, slot) => {
    const existing = windows.get(keyOf(channel, slot));
    if (existing) {
      bringToFront(existing);
      return;
    }
    Hub.send("openPluginScreen", { channel, slot });
  };

  Hub.on("pluginScreen", (reply) => {
    const key = keyOf(reply.channel, reply.slot);
    if (reply.kind === "native" || windows.has(key)) return;

    if (reply.kind === "web") {
      const win = makeWindow(key, reply.channel, reply.slot, "web", reply.title, reply.width || 640, reply.height || 420);
      const frame = element("iframe", "screen-frame");
      // Its own origin: a plugin's page can talk to its plugin, but can't reach into the Hub.
      frame.setAttribute("sandbox", "allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups");
      frame.title = reply.title;
      frame.src = reply.url;
      win.frame = frame;
      win.body.replaceChildren(frame);
      return;
    }

    const win = makeWindow(key, reply.channel, reply.slot, "generic", reply.title, 420, 300);
    fillGeneric(win, pluginAt(reply.channel, reply.slot));
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- messages
  // From a plugin's page: window.parent.postMessage(ArrayBuffer or typed array).
  window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
    for (const win of windows.values()) {
      if (!win.frame || event.source !== win.frame.contentWindow) continue;
      const data = event.data;
      let bytes = null;
      if (data instanceof ArrayBuffer) bytes = new Uint8Array(data);
      else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(data)) bytes = new Uint8Array(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength);
      else if (typeof data === "string") bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(data);
      if (bytes) Hub.send("screenMessage", { channel: win.channel, slot: win.slot, data: toBase64(bytes) });
      return;
    }
  });

  // To a plugin's page: each message as an ArrayBuffer.
  Hub.on("screenMessages", (batch) => {
    const win = windows.get(keyOf(batch.channel, batch.slot));
    if (!win || !win.frame || !win.frame.contentWindow) return;
    for (const message of batch.messages || []) win.frame.contentWindow.postMessage(fromBase64(message).buffer, "*");
  });

  // Generic controls follow the plugin's parameters.
  Hub.on("param", (reply) => {
    const win = windows.get(keyOf(reply.trackId, reply.insertId || 0));
    const row = win && win.params.get(reply.index);
    if (row) row.value.textContent = reply.text;
  });

  // A plugin that has gone takes its window with it (the page's own windows look after themselves);
  // so does a frozen track's (its plugins rest: what's changed there wouldn't be heard), and one
  // in a freeze under way (what's changed there wouldn't be in its render).
  Hub.on("tracks", () => {
    for (const [key, win] of [...windows]) {
      if (win.kind === "panel") continue;
      const plugin = pluginAt(win.channel, win.slot);
      if (!plugin) {
        close(key, false);
        continue;
      }
      const channel = Hub.trackById(win.channel);
      if (channel && (channel.frozen || channel.rendering)) {
        close(key);
        continue;
      }
      if (win.kind === "generic") {
        for (const p of plugin.params || []) {
          const row = win.params.get(p.index);
          if (row && document.activeElement !== row.input) {
            row.input.value = String(p.value);
            row.value.textContent = p.text;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  /** A floating window of the page's own (key names it): made, or brought forward if it's open. */
  function panel(key, title, width, height) {
    const existing = windows.get(key);
    if (existing) {
      bringToFront(existing);
      return existing;
    }
    return makeWindow(key, null, null, "panel", title, width, height);
  }

  Hub.screens = { windows, close, pluginAt, panel };
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-session.js
//
// Track > Add Session Players (also in the "+" over the track list): a drummer, a bass player and
// a keys player who play a chord progression in a style, each on a new track with a fitting
// instrument. One undo step.
//   Chords        bars between |, two chords in a bar split it, % repeats the bar before
//   From Track    the chords an instrument track plays, read off its notes (and where it plays them);
//                 or a recording's, listened to for its tempo, beat and chords: played to the song's
//                 beat, it keeps its place; with a tempo of its own, adding the players sets the song
//                 to it and lines the recordings up with the bars (Half / Double Tempo when it's heard
//                 at the wrong speed)
//   Style         Pop, Rock, Ballad, Funk, House or Hip-Hop
//   Intensity     from calm to busy
//   Start at Bar  the playhead's bar at first; Play n times
//   Players       each on or off, with its instrument: Automatic (the best fit installed), the
//                 Test Synth, or any installed instrument
// The choices stay for the next time, until Sonify closes.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  const PLAYERS = ["drums", "bass", "keys"];

  let open = false, busy = false;
  let best = {};        // the engine's best fit for each player: {file, id, name}, or null (the Test Synth)
  let listening = 0;    // the recording being listened to
  let heard = null;     // what was heard in the recording chosen: {trackId, tempo, songTempo, follows, steadiness}
  const last = { chords: "", style: "pop", intensity: 50, times: 1,
                 players: { drums: true, bass: true, keys: true },
                 instruments: { drums: "auto", bass: "auto", keys: "auto" } };   // "auto", "none" or file + "\n" + id

  const checkbox = (player) => document.querySelector(`#session-dialog input[data-player="${player}"]`);
  const picker = (player) => document.querySelector(`#session-dialog select[data-instrument="${player}"]`);
  const keyOf = (entry) => `${entry.file}\n${entry.id}`;
  const clampInt = (value, min, max, fallback) => {
    const n = Math.round(Number(value));
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? Hub.clamp(n, min, max) : fallback;
  };

  function problem(text) {
    $("session-problem").textContent = text || "";
    $("session-problem").hidden = !text;
  }

  /** How many bars the chords take, read as the engine reads them. */
  function countBars(text) {
    const clean = text.replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, " ");
    if (!clean.includes("|")) return clean.split(" ").filter(Boolean).length;
    const parts = clean.split("|");
    // Empty at either end is the | around the bars; empty between two | is a bar the chord goes on through.
    return parts.filter((part, i) => part.trim() || (i > 0 && i < parts.length - 1)).length;
  }

  function showLength() {
    const bars = countBars($("session-chords").value) * clampInt($("session-times").value, 1, 64, 1);
    const start = clampInt($("session-start").value, 1, 9999, 1);
    $("session-length").textContent = bars ? `${bars} bar${bars === 1 ? "" : "s"}: ${start} – ${start + bars - 1}` : "";
  }

  function showIntensity() {
    const input = $("session-intensity");
    input.style.setProperty("--fill", `${input.value}%`);
  }

  function showPlayers() {
    for (const player of PLAYERS) picker(player).disabled = busy || !checkbox(player).checked;
  }

  function setBusy(on) {
    busy = on;
    $("session-busy").hidden = !on;
    $("session-go").disabled = on || Boolean(listening);
    for (const id of ["session-chords", "session-from", "session-style", "session-intensity", "session-start", "session-times"]) $(id).disabled = on;
    for (const player of PLAYERS) checkbox(player).disabled = on;
    showPlayers();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- a recording heard
  const bpmText = (value) => `${Number(value).toFixed(Math.abs(value - Math.round(value)) < 0.005 ? 0 : 2)} BPM`;

  function showHeard(progress = 0) {
    const name = (Hub.trackById(listening || (heard && heard.trackId)) || {}).name || "the recording";
    $("session-listening").hidden = !listening;
    $("session-tempo-row").hidden = Boolean(listening) || !heard;
    $("session-heard").hidden = !listening && !heard;
    $("session-go").disabled = busy || Boolean(listening);

    if (listening) {
      $("session-listening-text").textContent = `Listening to ${name} for its tempo and chords…`;
      $("session-listen-fill").style.width = `${Math.round(Hub.clamp01(progress) * 100)}%`;
      return;
    }

    if (!heard) return;
    let text = heard.follows
      ? `${name} plays to the song's beat (${bpmText(heard.tempo)}).`
      : `${name} plays at ${bpmText(heard.tempo)}, the song at ${bpmText(heard.songTempo)}. Adding the players sets the song to ${bpmText(heard.tempo)} and lines the recordings up with its bars.`;
    if (heard.steadiness < 0.7) text += " Its tempo wanders, so the players may drift from it in places.";
    $("session-tempo").textContent = text;
    $("session-tempo-buttons").hidden = heard.follows;
  }

  /** Listens to a recording (at a tempo, when one is given). */
  function listenTo(trackId, tempo) {
    heard = null;
    listening = trackId;
    showHeard(0);
    Hub.send("sessionDetect", tempo ? { trackId, tempo } : { trackId });
  }

  function stopListening() {
    if (listening) Hub.send("sessionCancelDetect");
    listening = 0;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- lists
  /** Where chords can come from: instrument tracks that play notes, audio tracks with recordings. */
  function fillTracks() {
    const from = $("session-from");
    const chosen = from.value;
    from.textContent = "";
    from.add(new Option("None", ""));
    for (const track of Hub.state.tracks) {
      const clips = track.clips || [];
      const notes = track.kind === "instrument" && clips.some((clip) => (clip.notes || []).length);
      const recording = track.kind === "audio" && clips.some((clip) => clip.audioFile);
      if (notes || recording) from.add(new Option(`${track.number}. ${track.name}${recording ? " (recording)" : ""}`, String(track.id)));
    }
    from.value = [...from.options].some((option) => option.value === chosen) ? chosen : "";
  }

  function isRecording(trackId) {
    const track = Hub.trackById(trackId);
    return Boolean(track && track.kind === "audio");
  }

  function fillInstruments() {
    const entries = Hub.state.library.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "instrument" && !entry.missing)
                                     .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" }) || (a.format || "").localeCompare(b.format || ""));
    const counts = {};
    for (const entry of entries) counts[entry.name] = (counts[entry.name] || 0) + 1;

    for (const player of PLAYERS) {
      const select = picker(player);
      const chosen = select.options.length ? select.value : last.instruments[player];
      select.textContent = "";
      select.add(new Option(automaticLabel(player), "auto"));
      select.add(new Option("Test Synth", "none"));

      if (entries.length) {
        const group = document.createElement("optgroup");
        group.label = "Installed";
        for (const entry of entries)
          group.appendChild(new Option(counts[entry.name] > 1 ? `${entry.name} (${entry.format})` : entry.name, keyOf(entry)));
        select.appendChild(group);
      }

      select.value = [...select.options].some((option) => option.value === chosen) ? chosen : "auto";
    }
  }

  function automaticLabel(player) {
    return `Automatic: ${best[player] ? best[player].name : "Test Synth"}`;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the window
  function playheadBar() {
    return Hub.tempoMap.barAt(Hub.songPosition() + 1e-9).index + 1;
  }

  function openDialog() {
    if (open) return;
    open = true;
    problem("");
    $("session-chords").value = last.chords;
    $("session-style").value = last.style;
    $("session-intensity").value = String(last.intensity);
    $("session-times").value = String(last.times);
    $("session-start").value = String(playheadBar());
    for (const player of PLAYERS) {
      checkbox(player).checked = last.players[player];
      picker(player).textContent = "";   // filled afresh, as chosen last time
    }
    $("session-from").value = "";
    heard = null;
    fillTracks();
    fillInstruments();
    showIntensity();
    showLength();
    showHeard();
    setBusy(busy);
    $("session-dialog").hidden = false;
    Hub.send("sessionSetup");   // each player's best fit
    $("session-chords").focus();
  }

  function closeDialog() {
    if (!open) return;
    open = false;
    stopListening();
    remember();
    const box = $("session-dialog");
    if (box.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    box.hidden = true;
  }

  function remember() {
    last.chords = $("session-chords").value;
    last.style = $("session-style").value;
    last.intensity = clampInt($("session-intensity").value, 0, 100, 50);
    last.times = clampInt($("session-times").value, 1, 64, 1);
    for (const player of PLAYERS) {
      last.players[player] = checkbox(player).checked;
      last.instruments[player] = picker(player).value || "auto";
    }
  }

  function start() {
    if (busy || listening) return;
    const chords = $("session-chords").value.trim();
    const players = PLAYERS.filter((player) => checkbox(player).checked);
    if (!chords) {
      problem("Type the chords to play, or take them from a track.");
      $("session-chords").focus();
      return;
    }
    if (!players.length) {
      problem("Choose at least one player.");
      return;
    }

    const instruments = {};
    for (const player of players) {
      const value = picker(player).value;
      if (value === "none") instruments[player] = "none";
      else if (value && value !== "auto") {
        const [file, id] = value.split("\n");
        instruments[player] = { file, id };
      }
    }

    const startBar = clampInt($("session-start").value, 1, 9999, 1);
    const times = clampInt($("session-times").value, 1, 64, 1);
    $("session-start").value = String(startBar);
    $("session-times").value = String(times);
    // A recording with a tempo of its own: the song takes it, the recordings onto its bars.
    const alignTrack = heard && !heard.follows && String(heard.trackId) === $("session-from").value ? heard.trackId : 0;
    remember();
    problem("");
    setBusy(true);
    Hub.send("addSessionPlayers", { style: $("session-style").value, intensity: clampInt($("session-intensity").value, 0, 100, 50) / 100,
                                    players, instruments, chords, startBar, times, ...(alignTrack ? { alignTrack } : {}) });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the engine
  Hub.on("sessionSetup", (reply) => {
    best = (reply && reply.best) || {};
    if (!open) return;
    for (const player of PLAYERS) {
      const auto = picker(player).querySelector('option[value="auto"]');
      if (auto) auto.textContent = automaticLabel(player);
    }
  });

  Hub.on("sessionChords", (reply) => {
    if (!open || String(reply.trackId) !== $("session-from").value) return;

    if (reply.audio) {
      if (reply.listening) {
        listening = reply.trackId;
        showHeard(reply.progress);
        return;
      }
      listening = 0;
      if (reply.error || !reply.chords) {
        heard = null;
        showHeard();
        problem(reply.error || "No chords were heard in that recording.");
        return;
      }
      heard = { trackId: reply.trackId, tempo: reply.tempo, songTempo: reply.songTempo, follows: Boolean(reply.follows), steadiness: reply.steadiness };
    } else if (!reply.chords) {
      problem("That track plays no notes to take chords from.");
      return;
    }

    problem("");
    $("session-chords").value = reply.chords;
    $("session-start").value = String(reply.startBar || 1);
    $("session-times").value = "1";
    showLength();
    showHeard();
  });

  Hub.on("sessionPlayers", (reply) => {
    const asked = busy;
    setBusy(false);
    const notes = (reply.notes || []).join(" ");

    if (reply.ok) {
      closeDialog();
      if (notes) Hub.toast(notes);
      return;
    }

    if (open) problem(reply.error || "The players couldn't be added.");
    else if (asked) Hub.toast(reply.error || "The players couldn't be added.");
  });

  // Tracks and instruments come and go while the window is open.
  Hub.on("tracks", () => { if (open) fillTracks(); });
  Hub.on("library", () => { if (open) fillInstruments(); });

  Hub.commands.addSessionPlayers = openDialog;

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    $("session-go").addEventListener("click", start);
    $("session-cancel").addEventListener("click", closeDialog);
    $("session-chords").addEventListener("input", () => { problem(""); showLength(); });
    $("session-start").addEventListener("input", showLength);
    $("session-times").addEventListener("input", showLength);
    $("session-intensity").addEventListener("input", showIntensity);
    for (const player of PLAYERS) checkbox(player).addEventListener("change", () => { problem(""); showPlayers(); });

    $("session-from").addEventListener("change", () => {
      const trackId = Number($("session-from").value);
      problem("");
      stopListening();
      heard = null;
      showHeard();
      if (trackId && isRecording(trackId)) listenTo(trackId);
      else if (trackId) Hub.send("sessionDetect", { trackId });
    });

    // Heard at the wrong speed: listened to again at half or twice it.
    const again = (factor) => {
      if (!heard || heard.follows) return;
      problem("");
      listenTo(heard.trackId, Hub.clamp(Math.round(heard.tempo * factor * 100) / 100, 20, 300));
    };
    $("session-half").addEventListener("click", () => again(0.5));
    $("session-double").addEventListener("click", () => again(2));

    $("session-dialog").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        event.preventDefault();
        closeDialog();
      } else if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey && !["BUTTON", "SELECT"].includes(event.target.tagName)) {
        event.preventDefault();   // Shift + Enter for a new line among the chords
        start();
      }
    });
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-settings.js
//
// File > Settings: one window, its tabs across the top, as Studio One's Options.
//
//   Appearance          Luminance (the arrangement and the Editor, dark to bright) and Contrast
//                       (text and symbols against the dark). Seen at once, kept when let go.
//   Keyboard Shortcuts  whose keys Sonify uses: Studio One's, Cubase's, Logic's, Pro Tools',
//                       Ableton Live's, Cakewalk's or FL Studio's (hub-keys.js), with the list.
//   Network             whether remote control apps on the network can find Sonify.
//   Locations           User Data (where songs, recordings, mixdowns and autosaves go; autosave
//                       every few minutes) and Plug-ins (the folders the Browser reads).
//   Audio Setup         the audio device only: the driver and device, rate, block size and
//                       channels, and, last, releasing the device while Sonify is in the background.
//   MIDI Setup          everything MIDI: the external devices, as Studio One's Add Device
//                       (keyboards, controllers, drum kits and instruments with their model, name,
//                       channels, ports, filters, split channels, default input and MPE; control
//                       surfaces speaking Mackie Control, its Extender or HUI), every MIDI input
//                       with what kind of device it is (hardware, and virtual cables such as
//                       loopMIDI), and the MIDI clock and timecode Sonify sends.
//
// Changes apply at once: there's nothing to confirm but Close. The native side keeps them
// (settings.json in AppData\Roaming\Fanan\Sonify) and tells the page at every start.
