// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-songchannel.js
//
// The Master Song Channel above the tracks, as Studio One's global tracks: a lane along the
// whole song that scrolls and zooms with the arrangement (View > Master Song Channel, or the
// button over the track list). Its tabs, over its header, pick what the lane shows, one at a
// time, with the whole height for it (drag its bottom edge for more or less):
//
//   Signature    time signature changes, each from a bar. Double-click empty space to add one
//                at that bar, double-click one to change it, drag one to another bar.
//   Key          key and scale changes, each from a bar, the same way (MIDI tools follow them).
//   Tempo        the tempo along the song, on a scale from 20 to 250 BPM. Click to add a change
//                (its height is its tempo), drag changes (snapped; Alt for free; Shift moves
//                the tempo a tenth as far, in hundredths), double-click one to type its tempo or
//                make it glide (ramp) to the next.
//   Volume       an envelope for Main's fader: click to add points and drag them. With points,
//                Main's fader follows it while the song plays.
//   Delete, the Eraser tool or right-click > Remove take a change or point away; the song's
//   first time signature, key and tempo stay. Right-click for the rest.
// Each change is one Undo step. The header shows what holds where the song is. The tab and the
// height are kept with the song's view.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  const TABS = [
    { id: "signature", name: "Signature", title: "Time signature changes along the song" },
    { id: "key", name: "Key", title: "Key and scale changes along the song" },
    { id: "tempo", name: "Tempo", title: "The tempo along the song, 20 to 250 BPM" },
    { id: "main", name: "Volume", title: "Main's volume along the song" }
  ];
  const DEFAULT_HEIGHT = 112;     // the channel's height: its tabs and header on the left, the lane on the right
  const MIN_HEIGHT = 76;
  const MAX_HEIGHT = 360;
  const GRAB = 7;                 // px within which a point is grabbed
  const ACCENT = "#25984d";
  const LINE = "#4fc27a";
  const NUMERATORS = 32;
  const DENOMINATORS = [2, 4, 8, 16];

  let shown = false;
  let tab = "tempo";              // what the lane shows
  let height = DEFAULT_HEIGHT;
  let selected = null;            // { lane, index }
  let drag = null;                // what a press in the lanes is doing
  let previewMap = null;          // the map as a drag would leave it
  let previewMain = null;         // Main Volume's points as a drag would leave them
  let markers = [];               // where the signature and key chips were drawn, for hits
  let editor = null;              // the small editor that types a value

  const tempoMap = () => previewMap || Hub.tempoMap;
  const mainPoints = () => previewMain || Hub.songChannel.mainAutomation || [];
  const totalHeight = () => height;
  const laneHeight = () => height;
  const laneAt = (y) => (y >= 0 && y < height ? tab : null);

  const xOf = (ppq) => Hub.arrange.xOf(ppq);
  const bpmText = (bpm) => (Math.abs(bpm - Math.round(bpm)) < 0.005 ? String(Math.round(bpm)) : bpm.toFixed(2));

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- scales of the two envelopes
  /** The tempo lane's scale: every tempo a song can have, 20 to 250 BPM, always the same. */
  const tempoRange = () => ({ lo: Hub.TempoMap.MIN_TEMPO, hi: Hub.TempoMap.MAX_TEMPO });
  const PAD = 8;                  // px above and below the tempo and volume lines' room

  function tempoY(bpm) {
    const { lo, hi } = tempoRange(), room = laneHeight() - 2 * PAD;
    return PAD + (1 - (bpm - lo) / Math.max(1, hi - lo)) * room;
  }

  /** The tempo at a height: whole BPM, or hundredths (fine). */
  function tempoAtY(y, fine) {
    const { lo, hi } = tempoRange(), room = laneHeight() - 2 * PAD;
    const bpm = lo + (1 - Hub.clamp01((y - PAD) / room)) * (hi - lo);
    const step = fine ? 0.01 : 1;
    return Hub.clamp(Math.round(bpm / step) * step, lo, hi);
  }

  function mainY(db) {
    const room = laneHeight() - 2 * PAD;
    return PAD + (1 - Hub.dbToFader(db)) * room;
  }

  function mainAtY(y) {
    const room = laneHeight() - 2 * PAD;
    return Hub.clamp(Math.round(Hub.faderToDb(1 - Hub.clamp01((y - PAD) / room)) * 10) / 10, Hub.SILENT_DB, Hub.MAX_DB);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
  function sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height) {
    const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale));
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
      canvas.style.width = width + "px";
      canvas.style.height = height + "px";
    }
    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (context) context.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
    return context;
  }

  function draw() {
    if (!shown || !Hub.arrange || !Hub.arrange.xOf) return;
    const canvas = $("song-lanes");
    const width = canvas.parentElement.clientWidth, height = totalHeight();
    const context = sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height);
    if (!context) return;

    const map = tempoMap(), zoom = Hub.arrange.zoom(), scroll = Hub.arrange.scrollLeft();
    const from = scroll / zoom, to = (scroll + width) / zoom + 1e-6;
    const colours = Hub.theme.lanes;
    markers = [];

    context.fillStyle = colours.lane;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const chips = tab === "signature" ? map.signatures.map((s) => ({ ppq: map.ppqOfBar(s.bar), text: `${s.numerator}/${s.denominator}` }))
                : tab === "key" ? map.keys.map((k) => ({ ppq: map.ppqOfBar(k.bar), text: Hub.TempoMap.keyName(k) })) : null;
    if (chips) shadeStretches(context, chips, width);

    // The bar lines, as many as the arrangement's grid shows.
    const step = Hub.arrange.gridStep(10);
    context.strokeStyle = colours.bar;
    context.beginPath();
    for (const line of map.lines(from, to, step.bars > 0 ? step : { q: map.barAt(from).length, bars: 1 })) {
      const x = Math.round(xOf(line.ppq)) + 0.5;
      context.moveTo(x, 0);
      context.lineTo(x, height);
    }
    context.stroke();

    context.font = "12px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif";
    context.textBaseline = "middle";
    if (chips) drawChips(context, tab, chips, width);
    if (tab === "tempo") drawTempo(context, map, width);
    if (tab === "main") drawMain(context, width);
  }

  /** Every other change's stretch (to the next) shaded, so where each holds reads at a glance. */
  function shadeStretches(context, items, width) {
    items.forEach((item, index) => {
      const x = Math.round(xOf(item.ppq));
      const next = index + 1 < items.length ? Math.round(xOf(items[index + 1].ppq)) : width + 2;
      if (index % 2 === 1 && next > 0 && x < width) {
        context.globalAlpha = 0.45;
        context.fillStyle = Hub.theme.lanes.selected;
        context.fillRect(Math.max(0, x), 0, Math.min(width, next) - Math.max(0, x), height);
        context.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    });
  }

  /** Each change a flag at the top, its line down the lane. */
  function drawChips(context, lane, items, width) {
    const chip = 22;
    items.forEach((item, index) => {
      const x = Math.round(xOf(item.ppq));
      const w = context.measureText(item.text).width + 14;
      if (x > width || x + w < 0) return;
      const picked = selected && selected.lane === lane && selected.index === index;
      context.fillStyle = picked ? ACCENT : Hub.theme.muted;
      context.fillRect(x, 0, picked ? 2 : 1, height);
      context.fillStyle = picked ? ACCENT : Hub.theme.line2;
      context.fillRect(x, 6, w, chip);
      context.fillStyle = picked ? "#ffffff" : Hub.theme.muted;
      context.fillRect(x, 6, 2, chip);
      context.fillStyle = picked ? "#ffffff" : Hub.theme.text;
      context.fillText(item.text, x + 8, 6 + chip / 2 + 0.5);
      markers.push({ lane, index, x0: x - 3, x1: x + w });
    });
  }

  /** The tempo scale's lines: every 10, 20, 25 or 50 BPM, as many as fit. */
  function drawScale(context, width) {
    const { lo, hi } = tempoRange();
    const perBpm = (laneHeight() - 2 * PAD) / (hi - lo);
    const step = [10, 20, 25, 50, 100].find((s) => s * perBpm >= 18) || 100;
    context.font = "10px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif";
    context.textBaseline = "middle";
    for (let bpm = Math.ceil(lo / step) * step; bpm <= hi; bpm += step) {
      const y = Math.round(tempoY(bpm)) + 0.5;
      context.strokeStyle = Hub.theme.lanes.beat;
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(0, y);
      context.lineTo(width, y);
      context.stroke();
      context.fillStyle = Hub.theme.muted;
      context.fillText(String(bpm), 4, y);
    }
    context.font = "12px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif";
  }

  function drawTempo(context, map, width) {
    drawScale(context, width);
    const top = 0, bottom = height - 1;
    const points = map.tempos.map((t) => ({ x: xOf(t.ppq), y: tempoY(t.bpm), t }));

    const trace = () => {
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);
      points.forEach((p, i) => {
        const next = points[i + 1];
        if (!next) { context.lineTo(width + 2, p.y); return; }
        if (p.t.ramp) context.lineTo(next.x, next.y);
        else { context.lineTo(next.x, p.y); context.lineTo(next.x, next.y); }
      });
    };

    trace();
    context.lineTo(width + 2, bottom);
    context.lineTo(points[0].x, bottom);
    context.closePath();
    context.fillStyle = "rgba(37, 152, 77, 0.16)";
    context.fill();

    trace();
    context.strokeStyle = LINE;
    context.lineWidth = 1.5;
    context.stroke();
    context.lineWidth = 1;

    context.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    points.forEach((p, i) => {
      if (p.x < -40 || p.x > width + 4) return;
      const picked = selected && selected.lane === "tempo" && selected.index === i;
      context.fillStyle = picked ? "#ffffff" : LINE;
      context.fillRect(Math.round(p.x) - 3, Math.round(p.y) - 3, 7, 7);
      context.fillStyle = Hub.theme.text;
      const above = p.y - top > 16;
      // Clear of the scale's numbers at the left edge.
      context.fillText(bpmText(p.t.bpm) + (p.t.ramp ? " ↗" : ""), Math.max(p.x + 6, 30), above ? p.y - 5 : p.y + 13);
    });
    context.textBaseline = "middle";
  }

  function drawMain(context, width) {
    const points = mainPoints();
    const top = 0;

    if (!points.length) {
      const y = Math.round(mainY(Hub.state.master ? Hub.state.master.volume : 0)) + 0.5;
      context.strokeStyle = Hub.theme.muted;
      context.setLineDash([3, 4]);
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(0, y);
      context.lineTo(width, y);
      context.stroke();
      context.setLineDash([]);
      context.fillStyle = Hub.theme.muted;
      context.fillText("Click to add points: Main's fader follows them while the song plays", 8, top + 14);
      return;
    }

    const xy = points.map(([ppq, db]) => ({ x: xOf(ppq), y: mainY(db) }));
    context.strokeStyle = "#e0b04a";
    context.lineWidth = 1.5;
    context.beginPath();
    context.moveTo(-2, xy[0].y);
    for (const p of xy) context.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
    context.lineTo(width + 2, xy[xy.length - 1].y);
    context.stroke();
    context.lineWidth = 1;

    xy.forEach((p, i) => {
      if (p.x < -4 || p.x > width + 4) return;
      const picked = selected && selected.lane === "main" && selected.index === i;
      context.fillStyle = picked ? "#ffffff" : "#e0b04a";
      context.fillRect(Math.round(p.x) - 3, Math.round(p.y) - 3, 7, 7);
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the header: its tabs, and what holds where the song is
  const heads = {};
  const HINTS = {
    signature: "Double-click to add or change; drag to move",
    key: "Double-click to add or change; drag to move",
    tempo: "",
    main: "Click to add points; drag them"
  };

  function buildHeads() {
    const box = $("song-heads");
    box.textContent = "";

    const tabs = Hub.element("div", "song-tabs");
    tabs.setAttribute("role", "tablist");
    tabs.setAttribute("aria-label", "Master Song Channel");
    heads.tabs = {};
    for (const each of TABS) {
      const button = Hub.element("button", "song-tab", each.name);
      button.type = "button";
      button.dataset.tab = each.id;
      button.title = each.title;
      button.setAttribute("role", "tab");
      button.addEventListener("click", () => setTab(each.id));
      tabs.appendChild(button);
      heads.tabs[each.id] = button;
    }
    box.appendChild(tabs);

    const head = Hub.element("div", "song-head");
    head.appendChild(Hub.element("span", "song-head-caption", "Master Song Channel"));
    const line = Hub.element("div", "song-head-line");
    heads.name = Hub.element("span", "song-head-name", "");
    heads.value = Hub.element("span", "song-head-value", "");
    line.append(heads.name, heads.value);
    head.appendChild(line);
    heads.hint = Hub.element("span", "song-head-hint", "");
    head.appendChild(heads.hint);
    box.appendChild(head);

    for (const holder of [box, $("song-lanes-wrap")]) {
      const edge = Hub.element("div", "song-resize");
      edge.title = "Drag for a taller or shorter Master Song Channel; double-click for the usual height";
      edge.addEventListener("pointerdown", startResize);
      edge.addEventListener("dblclick", () => setHeight(DEFAULT_HEIGHT, true));
      holder.appendChild(edge);
    }
    showTab();
  }

  const setText = (element, text) => { if (element && element.textContent !== text) element.textContent = text; };

  function updateHeads() {
    if (!shown || !heads.value) return;
    const map = Hub.tempoMap, at = Hub.songPosition();
    const name = TABS.find((each) => each.id === tab).name;
    let value = "", hint = HINTS[tab];
    if (tab === "signature") { const signature = map.signatureAt(at); value = `${signature.numerator}/${signature.denominator}`; }
    if (tab === "key") value = Hub.TempoMap.keyName(map.keyAt(at));
    if (tab === "tempo") {
      value = `${map.bpmAt(at).toFixed(2)} BPM`;
      const { lo, hi } = tempoRange();
      hint = `Scale ${lo}–${hi} BPM · Shift: fine`;
    }
    if (tab === "main") {
      const volume = Hub.state.master ? Hub.state.master.volume : 0;
      value = Hub.dbText(volume) + ((Hub.songChannel.mainAutomation || []).length ? " · Read" : "");
    }
    setText(heads.name, name);
    setText(heads.value, value);
    setText(heads.hint, hint);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the tabs and the height
  function showTab() {
    if (!heads.tabs) return;
    for (const [id, button] of Object.entries(heads.tabs)) {
      const on = id === tab;
      button.classList.toggle("on", on);
      button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on));
    }
    $("song-lanes").setAttribute("aria-label", `Master Song Channel: ${TABS.find((each) => each.id === tab).name}`);
  }

  function setTab(id) {
    if (!TABS.some((each) => each.id === id)) return;
    if (id !== tab) { selected = null; closeEditor(); }
    tab = id;
    showTab();
    updateHeads();
    draw();
    Hub.emit("viewChanged");
  }

  function applyHeight() {
    $("song-lanes-wrap").style.height = height + "px";
    $("song-heads").style.height = height + "px";
  }

  function setHeight(value, done) {
    const next = Math.round(Hub.clamp(Number(value) || DEFAULT_HEIGHT, MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT));
    if (next !== height) {
      height = next;
      applyHeight();
      Hub.emit("layout");
      if (Hub.arrange) Hub.arrange.redraw();
      draw();
    }
    if (done) Hub.emit("viewChanged");
  }

  function startResize(event) {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    const edge = event.currentTarget, from = event.clientY, start = height;
    edge.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    let frame = 0, wanted = start;
    const move = (e) => {
      wanted = start + e.clientY - from;
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { frame = 0; setHeight(wanted, false); });
    };
    const up = () => {
      edge.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      edge.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
      edge.removeEventListener("pointercancel", up);
      if (frame) { cancelAnimationFrame(frame); frame = 0; }
      setHeight(wanted, true);
    };
    edge.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
    edge.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
    edge.addEventListener("pointercancel", up);
  }

  function tick() {
    updateHeads();
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- showing it
  function show(on) {
    shown = Boolean(on);
    $("song-heads").hidden = !shown;
    $("song-lanes-wrap").hidden = !shown;
    applyHeight();
    const button = $("song-channel-toggle");
    if (button) button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(shown));
    if (!shown) { selected = null; closeEditor(); }
    Hub.emit("layout");
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (Hub.arrange) Hub.arrange.redraw(); });
  }

  Hub.commands.toggleSongChannel = () => {
    show(!shown);
    Hub.emit("viewChanged");
  };
  // The tabs from the keyboard or a menu: the channel shows with it.
  const COMMAND_OF = { signature: "songChannelSignature", key: "songChannelKey", tempo: "songChannelTempo", main: "songChannelVolume" };
  for (const each of TABS) {
    Hub.commands[COMMAND_OF[each.id]] = () => {
      if (!shown) show(true);
      setTab(each.id);
    };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- sending edits
  /** A changed map to the engine (one Undo step); the page has it at once. */
  function commitMap(next, name) {
    previewMap = null;
    if (next.equals(Hub.tempoMap)) { draw(); return; }
    Hub.tempoMap = next;
    Hub.send("setSongChannel", { map: next.toData(), name });
    Hub.emit("tempoMap", next);
  }

  function commitMain(points) {
    previewMain = null;
    const tidy = points.slice().sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
    Hub.songChannel.mainAutomation = tidy;
    Hub.send("setMainAutomation", { points: tidy });
    draw();
  }

  const withTempos = (map, tempos) => { const next = map.clone(); next.setTempos(tempos); return next; };
  const withSignatures = (map, list) => { const next = map.clone(); next.setSignatures(list); return next; };
  const withKeys = (map, list) => { const next = map.clone(); next.setKeys(list); return next; };
  const copyTempos = (map) => map.tempos.map((t) => ({ ...t }));

  function removeItem(lane, index) {
    const map = Hub.tempoMap;
    if (lane === "signature" && index > 0) commitMap(withSignatures(map, map.signatures.filter((_, i) => i !== index)), "Remove Time Signature");
    if (lane === "key" && index > 0) commitMap(withKeys(map, map.keys.filter((_, i) => i !== index)), "Remove Key Change");
    if (lane === "tempo" && index > 0) commitMap(withTempos(map, map.tempos.filter((_, i) => i !== index)), "Remove Tempo Change");
    if (lane === "main") commitMain(mainPoints().filter((_, i) => i !== index));
    selected = null;
    draw();
  }

  function setRamp(index, ramp) {
    const tempos = copyTempos(Hub.tempoMap);
    if (!tempos[index] || index >= tempos.length - 1) return;
    tempos[index].ramp = ramp;
    commitMap(withTempos(Hub.tempoMap, tempos), ramp ? "Ramp Tempo" : "Hold Tempo");
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- hits
  function point(event) {
    const rect = $("song-lanes").getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = event.clientX - rect.left, y = event.clientY - rect.top;
    return { x, y, lane: laneAt(y), ppq: Hub.arrange.ppqAt(event.clientX) };
  }

  const chipAt = (p) => {
    const hits = markers.filter((m) => m.lane === p.lane && p.x >= m.x0 && p.x <= m.x1);
    return hits.length ? hits[hits.length - 1].index : -1;   // the one drawn on top
  };

  function tempoPointAt(p) {
    const map = tempoMap();
    for (let i = map.tempos.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const t = map.tempos[i];
      if (Math.abs(xOf(t.ppq) - p.x) <= GRAB && Math.abs(tempoY(t.bpm) - p.y) <= GRAB) return i;
    }
    return -1;
  }

  function mainPointAt(p) {
    const points = mainPoints();
    for (let i = points.length - 1; i >= 0; i--)
      if (Math.abs(xOf(points[i][0]) - p.x) <= GRAB && Math.abs(mainY(points[i][1]) - p.y) <= GRAB) return i;
    return -1;
  }

  const placed = (event, ppq) => (event.altKey ? Math.max(0, ppq) : Hub.arrange.snap(ppq));

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- pressing, dragging
  function onDown(event) {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    closeEditor();
    const p = point(event);
    const tool = Hub.arrange.view.tool;
    const map = Hub.tempoMap;
    event.preventDefault();
    $("song-lanes").setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

    if (p.lane === "signature" || p.lane === "key") {
      const index = chipAt(p);
      selected = index >= 0 ? { lane: p.lane, index } : null;
      if (index >= 0 && tool === "eraser") { removeItem(p.lane, index); return; }
      if (index > 0) drag = { kind: "chip", lane: p.lane, index, pointer: event.pointerId, base: map, moved: false, x: p.x };
    } else if (p.lane === "tempo") {
      let index = tempoPointAt(p);
      if (index >= 0 && tool === "eraser") { removeItem("tempo", index); return; }
      if (tool === "eraser") { selected = null; draw(); return; }
      let tempos = copyTempos(map), added = false;
      if (index < 0) {
        // A new change where the press is, at the height's tempo.
        const at = placed(event, p.ppq);
        const same = tempos.findIndex((t) => Math.abs(t.ppq - at) < 1e-6);
        if (same >= 0) index = same;
        else {
          const before = tempos.filter((t) => t.ppq < at).length - 1;
          tempos.splice(before + 1, 0, { ppq: at, bpm: tempoAtY(p.y, event.shiftKey), ramp: Boolean(tempos[before] && tempos[before].ramp) });
          index = before + 1;
          added = true;
        }
        previewMap = withTempos(map, tempos);
        tempos = copyTempos(previewMap);
      }
      selected = { lane: "tempo", index };
      // y: where the pointer would be with Shift's tenths taken in (the tempo follows it).
      drag = { kind: "tempo", index, pointer: event.pointerId, tempos, base: map, grab: p, start: tempos[index], moved: added, added, y: p.y, lastY: p.y };
    } else if (p.lane === "main") {
      let index = mainPointAt(p);
      if (index >= 0 && tool === "eraser") { removeItem("main", index); return; }
      if (tool === "eraser") { selected = null; draw(); return; }
      const points = mainPoints().map((q) => q.slice());
      let added = false;
      if (index < 0) {
        const point = [placed(event, p.ppq), mainAtY(p.y)];
        points.push(point);
        points.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
        index = points.indexOf(point);   // this one, even where another point is at the same place
        previewMain = points;
        added = true;
      }
      selected = { lane: "main", index };
      drag = { kind: "main", index, pointer: event.pointerId, points, grab: p, start: points[index].slice(), moved: added, added };
    }

    draw();
  }

  function onMove(event) {
    const p = point(event);
    if (!drag) {
      const over = (p.lane === "signature" || p.lane === "key") ? chipAt(p) >= 0
                 : p.lane === "tempo" ? tempoPointAt(p) >= 0 : p.lane === "main" ? mainPointAt(p) >= 0 : false;
      const tool = Hub.arrange.view.tool;
      $("song-lanes").style.cursor = tool === "eraser" ? (over ? "not-allowed" : "default")
                                   : over ? ((p.lane === "signature" || p.lane === "key") ? "grab" : "move")
                                   : (p.lane === "tempo" || p.lane === "main") ? "crosshair" : "default";
      return;
    }
    if (event.pointerId !== drag.pointer) return;
    const d = drag;

    if (d.kind === "chip") {
      if (Math.abs(p.x - d.x) > 3) d.moved = true;
      if (!d.moved) return;
      // To the nearest bar line, between the changes either side.
      const list = (d.lane === "signature" ? d.base.signatures : d.base.keys).map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      const lowest = list[d.index - 1].bar + 1, highest = d.index + 1 < list.length ? list[d.index + 1].bar - 1 : Hub.TempoMap.MAX_BAR;
      list[d.index].bar = Hub.clamp(d.base.barAt(d.base.nearestBar(p.ppq) + 1e-9).index, lowest, highest);
      previewMap = d.lane === "signature" ? withSignatures(d.base, list) : withKeys(d.base, list);
    } else if (d.kind === "tempo") {
      if (Math.abs(p.x - d.grab.x) > 2 || Math.abs(p.y - d.grab.y) > 2) d.moved = true;
      const tempos = d.tempos.map((t) => ({ ...t }));
      const t = tempos[d.index];
      d.y += (p.y - d.lastY) * (event.shiftKey ? 0.1 : 1);
      d.lastY = p.y;
      // Its tempo stays as it was until the pointer goes up or down a little (a drag along the
      // song only moves it there).
      if (Math.abs(p.y - d.grab.y) >= 3) d.vertical = true;
      if (d.vertical) t.bpm = tempoAtY(tempoY(d.start.bpm) + (d.y - d.grab.y), event.shiftKey);
      if (d.index > 0) {
        const lowest = tempos[d.index - 1].ppq + 1 / 64, highest = d.index + 1 < tempos.length ? tempos[d.index + 1].ppq - 1 / 64 : Infinity;
        t.ppq = Hub.clamp(placed(event, d.start.ppq + p.ppq - d.grab.ppq), lowest, highest);
      }
      previewMap = withTempos(d.base, tempos);
    } else if (d.kind === "main") {
      if (Math.abs(p.x - d.grab.x) > 2 || Math.abs(p.y - d.grab.y) > 2) d.moved = true;
      const points = d.points.map((q) => q.slice());
      const lowest = d.index > 0 ? points[d.index - 1][0] : 0;
      const highest = d.index + 1 < points.length ? points[d.index + 1][0] : Infinity;
      points[d.index] = [Hub.clamp(placed(event, d.start[0] + p.ppq - d.grab.ppq), lowest, highest), mainAtY(mainY(d.start[1]) + (p.y - d.grab.y))];
      previewMain = points;
    }

    draw();
  }

  function onUp(event) {
    const d = drag;
    if (!d || event.pointerId !== d.pointer) return;
    drag = null;

    if (d.kind === "chip") {
      if (d.moved && previewMap) commitMap(previewMap, d.lane === "signature" ? "Move Time Signature" : "Move Key Change");
      else previewMap = null;
    } else if (d.kind === "tempo") {
      if (d.moved && previewMap) commitMap(previewMap, d.added ? "Add Tempo Change" : "Change Tempo");
      else previewMap = null;
    } else if (d.kind === "main") {
      if (d.moved && previewMain) commitMain(previewMain);
      else previewMain = null;
    }

    draw();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- typing a value
  function closeEditor() {
    if (!editor) return;
    editor.close();
  }

  /** A small panel by the pointer: fields, then OK (Enter), Cancel (Escape) and maybe Remove. */
  function openEditor(clientX, clientY, title, build, onOk, onRemove) {
    closeEditor();
    const panel = Hub.element("div", "song-edit");
    panel.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
    panel.appendChild(Hub.element("div", "song-edit-title", title));
    const fields = Hub.element("div", "song-edit-fields");
    panel.appendChild(fields);
    const read = build(fields);
    const buttons = Hub.element("div", "song-edit-buttons");
    if (onRemove) {
      const remove = Hub.element("button", "plain-button small song-edit-remove", "Remove");
      remove.type = "button";
      remove.addEventListener("click", () => { close(); onRemove(); });
      buttons.appendChild(remove);
    }
    const ok = Hub.element("button", "plain-button small primary", "OK");
    ok.type = "button";
    const cancel = Hub.element("button", "plain-button small", "Cancel");
    cancel.type = "button";
    buttons.append(ok, cancel);
    panel.appendChild(buttons);

    const close = () => {
      panel.remove();
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside, true);
      if (editor && editor.panel === panel) editor = null;
    };
    const accept = () => { const value = read(); close(); if (value !== null) onOk(value); };
    const outside = (event) => { if (!panel.contains(event.target)) close(); };

    ok.addEventListener("click", accept);
    cancel.addEventListener("click", close);
    panel.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); accept(); }
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); close(); }
      event.stopPropagation();
    });

    document.body.appendChild(panel);
    const width = panel.offsetWidth || 240, height = panel.offsetHeight || 120;
    panel.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerWidth - width - 4, clientX)) + "px";
    panel.style.top = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerHeight - height - 4, clientY + 8)) + "px";
    setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside, true), 0);
    editor = { panel, close };
    const first = panel.querySelector("input, select");
    if (first) { first.focus(); if (first.select) first.select(); }
  }

  function select(options, value) {
    const element = document.createElement("select");
    for (const [label, v] of options) element.add(new Option(label, String(v), false, String(v) === String(value)));
    return element;
  }

  function editSignature(clientX, clientY, bar) {
    const map = Hub.tempoMap;
    const index = map.signatures.findIndex((s) => s.bar === bar);
    const now = map.bar(bar);
    openEditor(clientX, clientY, `Time signature from bar ${bar + 1}`, (fields) => {
      const numerator = select(Array.from({ length: NUMERATORS }, (_, i) => [String(i + 1), i + 1]), now.numerator);
      const denominator = select(DENOMINATORS.map((d) => [String(d), d]), DENOMINATORS.includes(now.denominator) ? now.denominator : 4);
      numerator.setAttribute("aria-label", "Beats per bar");
      denominator.setAttribute("aria-label", "Beat value");
      fields.append(numerator, Hub.element("span", "song-edit-slash", "/"), denominator);
      return () => ({ numerator: Number(numerator.value), denominator: Number(denominator.value) });
    }, (value) => {
      const list = map.signatures.filter((s) => s.bar !== bar).concat([{ bar, ...value }]);
      commitMap(withSignatures(map, list), index >= 0 ? "Change Time Signature" : "Add Time Signature");
    }, index > 0 ? () => removeItem("signature", index) : null);
  }

  function editKey(clientX, clientY, bar) {
    const map = Hub.tempoMap;
    const index = map.keys.findIndex((k) => k.bar === bar);
    const now = map.keyAt(map.ppqOfBar(bar));
    openEditor(clientX, clientY, `Key from bar ${bar + 1}`, (fields) => {
      const root = select(Hub.TempoMap.NOTE_NAMES.map((name, i) => [name, i]), now.root);
      const scale = select((Hub.songChannel.scales || Hub.TempoMap.SCALES).map((s) => [s, s]), now.scale);
      root.setAttribute("aria-label", "Key");
      scale.setAttribute("aria-label", "Scale");
      fields.append(root, scale);
      return () => ({ root: Number(root.value), scale: scale.value });
    }, (value) => {
      const list = map.keys.filter((k) => k.bar !== bar).concat([{ bar, ...value }]);
      commitMap(withKeys(map, list), index >= 0 ? "Change Key" : "Add Key Change");
    }, index > 0 ? () => removeItem("key", index) : null);
  }

  function editTempo(clientX, clientY, index) {
    const map = Hub.tempoMap;
    const t = map.tempos[index];
    if (!t) return;
    const last = index === map.tempos.length - 1;
    openEditor(clientX, clientY, index === 0 ? "The song's tempo" : `Tempo from ${map.formatBars(t.ppq).replace(/^0+/, "")}`, (fields) => {
      const bpm = document.createElement("input");
      bpm.type = "number";
      bpm.min = String(Hub.TempoMap.MIN_TEMPO);
      bpm.max = String(Hub.TempoMap.MAX_TEMPO);
      bpm.step = "0.01";
      bpm.value = t.bpm.toFixed(2);
      bpm.setAttribute("aria-label", "Tempo in BPM");
      const label = Hub.element("label", "song-edit-check");
      const ramp = document.createElement("input");
      ramp.type = "checkbox";
      ramp.checked = t.ramp;
      ramp.disabled = last;
      label.append(ramp, document.createTextNode(" Glide to the next tempo"));
      fields.append(bpm, Hub.element("span", "song-edit-unit", "BPM"), label);
      return () => {
        const value = Number(bpm.value);
        return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? { bpm: Hub.clamp(value, Hub.TempoMap.MIN_TEMPO, Hub.TempoMap.MAX_TEMPO), ramp: ramp.checked } : null;
      };
    }, (value) => {
      const tempos = copyTempos(map);
      tempos[index].bpm = Math.round(value.bpm * 100) / 100;
      tempos[index].ramp = value.ramp;
      commitMap(withTempos(map, tempos), "Change Tempo");
    }, index > 0 ? () => removeItem("tempo", index) : null);
  }

  function onDoubleClick(event) {
    const p = point(event);
    const map = Hub.tempoMap;
    if (p.lane === "signature" || p.lane === "key") {
      const index = chipAt(p);
      const list = p.lane === "signature" ? map.signatures : map.keys;
      const bar = index >= 0 ? list[index].bar : map.barAt(p.ppq).index;
      if (p.lane === "signature") editSignature(event.clientX, event.clientY, bar);
      else editKey(event.clientX, event.clientY, bar);
    } else if (p.lane === "tempo") {
      const index = tempoPointAt(p);
      if (index >= 0) editTempo(event.clientX, event.clientY, index);
    } else if (p.lane === "main") {
      const index = mainPointAt(p);
      if (index >= 0) removeItem("main", index);
    }
  }

  function onContextMenu(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const p = point(event);
    const map = Hub.tempoMap;
    const at = { getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: event.clientX, right: event.clientX, top: event.clientY, bottom: event.clientY }) };
    const x = event.clientX, y = event.clientY;

    if (p.lane === "signature" || p.lane === "key") {
      const index = chipAt(p);
      const list = p.lane === "signature" ? map.signatures : map.keys;
      const bar = index >= 0 ? list[index].bar : map.barAt(p.ppq).index;
      const edit = p.lane === "signature" ? editSignature : editKey;
      const what = p.lane === "signature" ? "Time Signature" : "Key";
      const items = index >= 0 ? [{ label: `Edit ${what}…`, value: "edit" }, { label: "Remove", value: "remove", disabled: index === 0 }]
                               : [{ label: `Add ${what} at Bar ${bar + 1}…`, value: "edit" }];
      if (index >= 0) { selected = { lane: p.lane, index }; draw(); }
      Hub.popupMenu(at, items, (pick) => {
        if (pick === "edit") edit(x, y, bar);
        if (pick === "remove") removeItem(p.lane, index);
      });
    } else if (p.lane === "tempo") {
      const index = tempoPointAt(p);
      const before = index >= 0 ? index : Math.max(0, map.tempoIndexAt(p.ppq));
      const t = map.tempos[before], last = before === map.tempos.length - 1;
      const items = [];
      if (index >= 0) items.push({ label: "Edit Tempo…", value: "edit" });
      else items.push({ label: "Add Tempo Change Here", value: "add" });
      items.push({ label: t.ramp ? "Hold Until the Next Tempo" : "Glide to the Next Tempo", value: "ramp", disabled: last });
      if (index >= 0) items.push({ label: "Remove", value: "remove", disabled: index === 0 });
      if (index >= 0) { selected = { lane: "tempo", index }; draw(); }
      Hub.popupMenu(at, items, (pick) => {
        if (pick === "edit") editTempo(x, y, index);
        if (pick === "remove") removeItem("tempo", index);
        if (pick === "ramp") setRamp(before, !t.ramp);
        if (pick === "add") {
          const tempos = copyTempos(map);
          const where = Hub.arrange.snap(p.ppq);
          if (!tempos.some((q) => Math.abs(q.ppq - where) < 1e-6)) {
            tempos.push({ ppq: where, bpm: Math.round(map.bpmAt(where) * 100) / 100, ramp: false });
            commitMap(withTempos(map, tempos), "Add Tempo Change");
          }
        }
      });
    } else if (p.lane === "main") {
      const index = mainPointAt(p);
      const items = [];
      if (index >= 0) items.push({ label: "Remove Point", value: "remove" });
      items.push({ label: "Clear Main Volume", value: "clear", disabled: !mainPoints().length });
      Hub.popupMenu(at, items, (pick) => {
        if (pick === "remove") removeItem("main", index);
        if (pick === "clear") { selected = null; commitMain([]); }
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- wiring
  Hub.songLanes = {
    draw,
    show,
    isShown: () => shown,
    /** What the song's view keeps: the tab and the height. */
    getView: () => ({ tab, height }),
    applyView: (saved) => {
      const v = saved || {};
      tab = TABS.some((each) => each.id === v.tab) ? v.tab : "tempo";
      height = Math.round(Hub.clamp(Number(v.height) || DEFAULT_HEIGHT, MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT));
      selected = null;
      showTab();
      applyHeight();
    },
    setTab
  };

  Hub.on("tempoMap", () => { if (!drag) { previewMap = null; previewMain = null; } draw(); });
  Hub.on("theme", draw);
  // Main's fader moved elsewhere: an empty Main Volume lane shows where it is.
  Hub.on("status", (s) => { if (shown && s && s.masterVolume !== undefined && !mainPoints().length) draw(); });
  Hub.on("tracks", () => { if (shown && !mainPoints().length) draw(); });

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    buildHeads();
    const canvas = $("song-lanes");
    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
    canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", onDoubleClick);
    canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", onContextMenu);
    $("song-channel-toggle").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("toggleSongChannel"));

    // Ctrl + wheel zooms here too, as over the lanes.
    $("song-lanes-wrap").addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
      if (!event.ctrlKey || !Hub.arrange) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      Hub.arrange.setZoom(Hub.arrange.zoom() * (event.deltaY < 0 ? 1.2 : 1 / 1.2), event.clientX - $("lanes").getBoundingClientRect().left);
    }, { passive: false });

    // A press anywhere else in the arrangement leaves the song channel's selection.
    for (const id of ["lanes", "ruler-wrap", "tracklist"]) {
      $(id).addEventListener("pointerdown", () => { if (selected) { selected = null; draw(); } }, true);
    }

    // Delete takes the selected change or point away, before anything else.
    const previous = Hub.commands.deleteSelection;
    Hub.commands.deleteSelection = () => {
      if (shown && selected && Hub.state.focus === "arrange") {
        removeItem(selected.lane, selected.index);
        return;
      }
      if (previous) previous();
    };

    show(false);
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-stems.js
//
// Event > Split into Stems: the selected audio clip separated into its vocals, drums, bass and
// the rest (Other), and its guitar and piano when they're ticked, worked out on this computer.
// Each stem goes on a new audio track under the clip's track, where the clip starts; Mute the
// original mutes the clip's track. One undo step. The first time, what Sonify splits with is
// downloaded, once (98 MB; guitar and piano split with a second model, 110 MB, and the rest then
// holds what's left after the ones ticked).
// While it works: a progress bar, Stop, and Hide (it goes on while you work; a note says when the
// stems are there). The AI can split stems too: the window then shows that split's progress.
// AI Tools' Stem Splitter tab (hub-aitools.js) starts the same split, and claims it (no note).
// The choices stay for the next time, until Sonify closes.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  const STEMS = ["vocals", "drums", "bass", "guitar", "piano", "other"];
  const NAMES = { vocals: "vocals", drums: "drums", bass: "bass", guitar: "guitar", piano: "piano", other: "the rest" };

  let state = { state: "idle", progress: 0, modelReady: true, sixReady: true, problem: "", stems: [] };   // the engine's last word
  let open = false, working = false, stopping = false;
  let target = null;      // the clip being split, or to split: {trackId, clipId}
  let announced = false;  // a split the AI started has been mentioned
  const last = { stems: { vocals: true, drums: true, bass: true, guitar: false, piano: false, other: true }, mute: true };

  const isWorking = (s = state) => s.state === "downloading" || s.state === "splitting";
  const checkbox = (stem) => document.querySelector(`#stems-dialog input[data-stem="${stem}"]`);

  function problem(text) {
    $("stems-problem").textContent = text || "";
    $("stems-problem").hidden = !text;
  }

  /** "Take 3 (Audio 2)": the clip's file and its track. */
  function clipLabel(where) {
    const found = where && Hub.findClip(where.clipId);
    if (!found) return "the clip";
    const name = found.clip.fileName || "the clip";
    return found.track.name ? `${name} (${found.track.name})` : name;
  }

  /** What the first split with the stems ticked downloads, when it's still to come ("" when not). */
  function modelNote() {
    const six = ["guitar", "piano"].some((stem) => checkbox(stem).checked);
    if (six && state.sixReady === false) return "Guitar and piano split with a second model: the first time, Sonify downloads it (110 MB), once.";
    if (!six && state.modelReady === false) return "The first time, Sonify downloads what it splits with: 98 MB, once.";
    return "";
  }

  function list(stems) {
    const words = stems.map((stem) => NAMES[stem] || stem);
    return words.length > 1 ? `${words.slice(0, -1).join(", ")} and ${words[words.length - 1]}` : words.join("");
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the window
  function show() {
    working = isWorking();
    $("stems-choices").hidden = working;
    $("stems-progress").hidden = !working;
    $("stems-go").hidden = working;
    $("stems-hide").hidden = !working;
    $("stems-cancel").textContent = working ? "Stop" : "Cancel";
    $("stems-cancel").disabled = working && stopping;
    $("stems-model").textContent = modelNote();
    $("stems-model").hidden = working || !$("stems-model").textContent;
    $("stems-go").disabled = Boolean(state.problem);

    if (working) {
      const stems = state.stems && state.stems.length ? state.stems : STEMS;
      $("stems-lead").textContent = `Splitting ${clipLabel(target)} into ${list(stems)}, each on a new track under it.`;
      const p = Hub.clamp01(state.progress || 0);
      $("stems-fill").style.width = `${Math.round(p * 100)}%`;
      $("stems-step").textContent = stopping ? "Stopping…"
        : state.state === "downloading" ? `Downloading what Sonify splits with (${state.downloadMb || 98} MB, only this once)… ${Math.round(p * 100)}%`
        : `Splitting… ${Math.round(p * 100)}%`;
      return;
    }

    $("stems-lead").textContent = `${clipLabel(target)}: its vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and the rest, the ones ticked, each on a new track under it. `
                                + "It's worked out on this computer and takes a few minutes for a whole song.";
    if (state.problem) problem(state.problem);
  }

  function openDialog() {
    if (open) return;

    if (!isWorking()) {
      const picked = Hub.state.selectedClip;
      const found = picked && Hub.findClip(picked.clipId);
      if (!found || !found.clip.audioFile) {
        Hub.toast("Select an audio clip to split into stems.");
        return;
      }
      if (found.clip.recording) {
        Hub.toast("Not while it's recording.");
        return;
      }
      target = picked;
    }

    open = true;
    problem("");
    for (const stem of STEMS) checkbox(stem).checked = last.stems[stem];
    $("stems-mute").checked = last.mute;
    show();
    $("stems-dialog").hidden = false;
    Hub.send("stemsState");   // how it stands, and whether this computer can split stems
    (working ? $("stems-hide") : $("stems-go")).focus();
  }

  function closeDialog() {
    if (!open) return;
    open = false;
    if (!working) remember();
    const box = $("stems-dialog");
    if (box.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    box.hidden = true;
  }

  function remember() {
    for (const stem of STEMS) last.stems[stem] = checkbox(stem).checked;
    last.mute = $("stems-mute").checked;
  }

  function start() {
    if (working || !target) return;
    const stems = STEMS.filter((stem) => checkbox(stem).checked);
    if (!stems.length) {
      problem("Choose at least one stem.");
      return;
    }
    if (state.problem) {
      problem(state.problem);
      return;
    }
    const found = Hub.findClip(target.clipId);
    if (!found || !found.clip.audioFile) {
      problem("That clip isn't there anymore: select an audio clip and try again.");
      return;
    }

    remember();
    problem("");
    stopping = false;
    announced = true;   // this window started it: no note about it
    const six = stems.includes("guitar") || stems.includes("piano");
    const ready = six ? state.sixReady !== false : state.modelReady !== false;
    state = { ...state, state: ready ? "splitting" : "downloading", progress: 0, stems, downloadMb: six ? 110 : 98 };
    show();
    $("stems-hide").focus();
    Hub.send("splitStems", { trackId: found.track.id, clipId: target.clipId, stems, muteOriginal: $("stems-mute").checked });
  }

  function stop() {
    if (!working) {
      closeDialog();
      return;
    }
    stopping = true;
    show();
    Hub.send("cancelStems");
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the engine
  Hub.on("stems", (s) => {
    state = { ...state, ...s };

    if (isWorking(s)) {
      if (s.trackId && s.clipId) target = { trackId: s.trackId, clipId: s.clipId };
      // Started by the AI, with the window closed: said once where to see how far it is.
      if (!open && !announced) Hub.toast("Splitting stems: Event > Split into Stems shows how far it is.");
      announced = true;
      if (open) show();
      return;
    }

    const wasWorking = working;
    working = false;
    stopping = false;
    announced = false;

    if (s.state === "done") {
      const names = (s.trackIds || []).map((id) => (Hub.trackById(id) || {}).name).filter(Boolean);
      if (open) closeDialog();
      Hub.toast(names.length ? `Split into stems: ${names.join(", ")}.` : "Split into stems.");
      return;
    }

    if (s.state === "failed") {
      if (open) {
        show();
        problem(s.error || "The stems couldn't be split.");
      } else if (s.error) {
        Hub.toast(s.error);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Cancelled, or how it stands (the answer to opening the window).
    if (open) {
      if (wasWorking || s.state === "cancelled") problem("");
      show();
    }
  });

  Hub.commands.splitStems = openDialog;

  // AI Tools' Stem Splitter starts splits of its own and shows how far they are: no note about them.
  Hub.stems = { claim: () => { announced = true; }, state: () => state };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    $("stems-go").addEventListener("click", start);
    $("stems-hide").addEventListener("click", closeDialog);
    $("stems-cancel").addEventListener("click", stop);
    for (const stem of STEMS) checkbox(stem).addEventListener("change", () => { problem(state.problem || ""); if (!working) show(); });
    $("stems-dialog").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        event.preventDefault();
        closeDialog();   // while it works, Escape hides it: it goes on
      } else if (event.key === "Enter" && !working && event.target.tagName !== "BUTTON") {
        event.preventDefault();
        start();
      }
    });
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-studios.js
//
// The studios: Sonify's main pages, one tab each in the selector in the middle of the top bar, all
// there from the moment Sonify starts:
//   Studio                   the DAW: the arrangement, the Editor, the Console and the Browser
//   Analog Board             the song mixed on an analog desk (hub-board.js)
//   AI Tools                 Sonify's AI musical tools, each a small studio in a tab: Stem
//                            Splitter, Audio to MIDI, MIDI Generators, Tempo & Pitch and the
//                            Mastering Assistant (hub-aitools.js). Fanan AI, the assistant, is
//                            the AI Assistant window over every studio (hub-ai.js)
//   Song Builder Blocks      the song built from blocks of clips (hub-blocks.js)
//   Plugins Creator Studio   everything new is made here by asking Fanan AI: instruments and
//                            effects for the tracks (Stella AI Studio, Sonify's own window over
//                            the page: hub-creator.js), and MIDI devices in its MIDI Devices tab
//                            (hub-devices.js)
//   Live Show Studio         the DJ's decks and mixer with the singers and players on it, in
//                            place of the song while it shows or plays (hub-live.js)
//   Sampling Studio          an instrument track, a synth or the user playing, sampled note by
//                            note into an SFZ for the Sonify Sampler; and its Builder, an
//                            instrument from audio files and clips put on keys (hub-sampling.js)
//   Web Browser              the internet in tabs of its own, with + Open new tab (hub-web.js)
//   Guide                    Sonify's user guide in tabs and chapters, and Fanan AI answering
//                            anything about Sonify from it (hub-guide.js)
// MIDI in is heard by the studio in front only, so nothing plays behind it.
// The transport stays at the bottom of every studio, so the song plays and records wherever you
// are; its keys (Start / Stop, Record, Loop, the metronome) and Undo / Redo work in every studio
// too (hub-keys.js). Opening a studio from the Start page closes it, as Esc does.
// Keys: Ctrl+1 .. Ctrl+9 a studio, Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab the next / previous one.
// The top bar also has the internet switch and the Fanan account (left), and the logos (right).

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;

  // Each studio: its id (the selector's data-studio), its page (none: the DAW, which is the page
  // itself) and the body class while it shows.
  const STUDIOS = [
    { id: "studio",  page: null,            mode: "" },
    { id: "board",   page: "analog-board",  mode: "board-mode" },
    { id: "ai",      page: "ai-studio",     mode: "ai-mode" },
    { id: "blocks",  page: "song-blocks",   mode: "blocks-mode" },
    { id: "plugins", page: "creator-studio", mode: "creator-mode" },
    { id: "live",    page: "live-studio",   mode: "live-mode" },
    { id: "sampling", page: "sampling-studio", mode: "sampling-mode" },
    { id: "web",     page: "web-browser",   mode: "web-mode" },
    { id: "guide",   page: "guide-studio",  mode: "guide-mode" }
  ];
  const IDS = STUDIOS.map((studio) => studio.id);
  let active = "studio";

  /** The Start page goes, as its × or Esc does: the song behind it is the project now. */
  function closeStartPage() {
    const start = $("start-page");
    if (!start || start.hidden) return;
    start.hidden = true;
    Hub.send("startPageClosed");
  }

  function renderSwitch() {
    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll(".studio-tab")) {
      const on = button.dataset.studio === active;
      button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on));
      button.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
    }
  }

  /** Shows a studio; the others' pages go. From the Start page, the Start page goes too
      (not as the page first draws itself: the Start page greets you then). */
  function activate(id, leaveStart = true) {
    const studio = STUDIOS.find((s) => s.id === id) || STUDIOS[0];
    const was = active;
    active = studio.id;
    if (leaveStart) closeStartPage();

    for (const s of STUDIOS) {
      if (s.page) $(s.page).hidden = s.id !== active;
      if (s.mode) document.body.classList.toggle(s.mode, s.id === active);
    }
    document.body.classList.toggle("page-mode", active !== "studio");

    // Each page hears whether it shows: the board tells Sonify, which sends it its meters only
    // while it shows; the Plugins Creator Studio lays Sonify's own studio window over its page (and
    // its MIDI Devices tab tells Sonify); the Web Browser lays its page's view over its content
    // area, or takes it away.
    if (Hub.board) Hub.board.show(active === "board");
    if (Hub.creator) Hub.creator.show(active === "plugins");
    if (Hub.aiTools) Hub.aiTools.show(active === "ai");
    if (Hub.blocks) Hub.blocks.show(active === "blocks");
    if (Hub.web) Hub.web.show(active === "web");
    if (Hub.live) Hub.live.show(active === "live");
    if (Hub.sampling) Hub.sampling.show(active === "sampling");
    if (Hub.guide) Hub.guide.show(active === "guide");

    // The arrangement's keys (Delete and the like) rest while another studio is in front.
    if (active !== "studio") Hub.state.focus = active;
    else if (IDS.includes(Hub.state.focus)) Hub.state.focus = "arrange";

    renderSwitch();
    Hub.emit("studio", active);

    // MIDI is heard in the studio in front only: Sonify gives it the live notes (the song's
    // studios share the tracks'; the Plugins Creator Studio and the Sampling Studio have a MIDI In
    // of their own; AI Tools, the Web Browser and the Guide hear none).
    Hub.send("studioShown", { id: active });

    // Back in the Studio: the arrangement and the Editors measure themselves again.
    if (active === "studio" && was !== "studio") Hub.emit("layout");
  }

  function cycle(step) {
    const at = IDS.indexOf(active);
    activate(IDS[(at + step + IDS.length) % IDS.length]);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands
  Hub.commands.showStudio = () => activate("studio");
  Hub.commands.analogBoard = () => activate("board");
  Hub.commands.sonifyAi = () => activate("ai");
  Hub.commands.songBlocks = () => activate("blocks");
  Hub.commands.pluginsCreator = () => activate("plugins");
  Hub.commands.liveShow = () => activate("live");
  Hub.commands.samplingStudio = () => activate("sampling");
  Hub.commands.webBrowser = () => activate("web");
  Hub.commands.guide = () => activate("guide");
  Hub.commands.nextStudio = () => cycle(1);
  Hub.commands.previousStudio = () => cycle(-1);

  Hub.studios = { activate, active: () => active, ids: () => IDS.slice() };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- block internet
  let internetBlocked = false;

  function renderNetToggle() {
    const button = $("net-toggle");
    button.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(internetBlocked));
    button.classList.toggle("blocked", internetBlocked);
    button.querySelector(".net-label").textContent = internetBlocked ? "Internet off" : "Internet on";
    button.title = internetBlocked ? "Internet blocked: no plugin, web page, Fanan AI or Fanan content can reach the network. Click to allow it."
                                   : "Internet on. Click to block it (plugins, web pages, Fanan AI and Fanan content).";
  }

  Hub.on("internetBlocked", (data) => {
    internetBlocked = Boolean(data.blocked);
    renderNetToggle();
    if (internetBlocked) Hub.toast("Internet blocked");
  });

  Hub.netBlocked = () => internetBlocked;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the selector and its keys
  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    renderNetToggle();
    $("net-toggle").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("setInternetBlocked", { blocked: !internetBlocked }));

    const strip = $("studio-switch");
    strip.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const button = event.target.closest(".studio-tab");
      if (button) activate(button.dataset.studio);
    });

    // The arrows move along the selector while it has the focus, as in any row of tabs.
    strip.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight") return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      cycle(event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 1);
      const button = strip.querySelector(`[data-studio="${active}"]`);
      if (button) button.focus();
    });

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      const ctrl = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;

      // The page never reloads, prints or goes back (F5, Ctrl+R, Ctrl+P, Alt+Left/Right, the
      // browser keys), in any studio or field: the keys still reach the keyboard map (F5 is the
      // Browser's in the Studio), but not the web view.
      if (event.code === "F5" || (ctrl && (event.code === "KeyR" || event.code === "KeyP"))
          || (event.altKey && (event.code === "ArrowLeft" || event.code === "ArrowRight") && !ctrl)
          || event.code === "BrowserBack" || event.code === "BrowserForward" || event.code === "BrowserRefresh")
        event.preventDefault();

      if (!ctrl || event.altKey) return;
      if (!$("scan-page").hidden || document.querySelector(".modal:not([hidden])")) return;

      // In the Studio, a key the keyboard map gives a command is the DAW's.
      if (active === "studio" && Hub.keys && Hub.keys.isBound(event)) return;

      let handled = true;
      if (event.code === "Tab") cycle(event.shiftKey ? -1 : 1);
      else if (!event.shiftKey && /^Digit[1-9]$/.test(event.code)) activate(IDS[Number(event.code.slice(5)) - 1]);
      else handled = false;

      if (handled) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      }
    }, true);

    activate("studio", false);
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-tempo.js
//
// The song channel's map on the page, as the engine keeps it (TempoMap.cpp): tempo changes
// (each holds until the next, or ramps to it in a straight line), time signatures from bars,
// and keys from bars. It turns song positions (quarter notes) into seconds and back, finds
// the bars, writes and reads positions (bar.beat.sixteenth.ticks), and lays the grid and
// snapping on the bars as the signatures count them. Bars are counted from 0 here and shown
// from 1.
//
//   Hub.tempoMap        the song's map (a TempoMap), from the engine's "songChannel" event
//   Hub.songChannel     { mainAutomation: [[ppq, dB]], scales }
//   Hub.TempoMap        the class, for maps being edited

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const TINY = 1e-9;
  const MIN_TEMPO = 20, MAX_TEMPO = 250, MAX_BAR = 100000;
  const DENOMINATORS = [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32];
  const SCALES = ["major", "minor", "dorian", "phrygian", "lydian", "mixolydian", "locrian",
                  "harmonic minor", "melodic minor", "major pentatonic", "minor pentatonic", "blues", "chromatic"];
  const NOTE_NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "Eb", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "Ab", "A", "Bb", "B"];

  const finite = (value, fallback) => (Number.isFinite(Number(value)) ? Number(value) : fallback);
  const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

  /** The last index whose key is at or before value (0 when none is). */
  function lastAtOrBefore(list, value, key) {
    let lo = 0, hi = list.length - 1, found = 0;
    while (lo <= hi) {
      const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
      if (key(list[mid]) <= value) { found = mid; lo = mid + 1; } else hi = mid - 1;
    }
    return found;
  }

  class TempoMap {
    /** data: the engine's form, {tempos: [[ppq, bpm, ramp]], signatures: [[bar, n, d]], keys: [[bar, root, scale]]}. */
    constructor(data) {
      const d = data || {};
      this.setTempos((Array.isArray(d.tempos) ? d.tempos : []).map((t) => ({ ppq: finite(t[0], -1), bpm: finite(t[1], 120), ramp: Boolean(t[2]) }))
                                                               .filter((t) => t.ppq >= 0));
      this.setSignatures((Array.isArray(d.signatures) ? d.signatures : []).map((s) => ({ bar: Math.trunc(finite(s[0], -1)), numerator: Math.trunc(finite(s[1], 4)),
                                                                                         denominator: Math.trunc(finite(s[2], 4)) }))
                                                                         .filter((s) => s.bar >= 0));
      this.setKeys((Array.isArray(d.keys) ? d.keys : []).map((k) => ({ bar: Math.trunc(finite(k[0], -1)), root: Math.trunc(finite(k[1], 0)), scale: String(k[2] || "major") }))
                                                         .filter((k) => k.bar >= 0));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ lists, tidied as the engine tidies them
    setTempos(list) {
      const sorted = list.filter((t) => Number.isFinite(t.ppq) && Number.isFinite(t.bpm))
                         .map((t) => ({ ppq: Math.max(0, t.ppq), bpm: clamp(t.bpm, MIN_TEMPO, MAX_TEMPO), ramp: Boolean(t.ramp) }))
                         .sort((a, b) => a.ppq - b.ppq);
      const tidy = [];
      for (const t of sorted) {
        if (tidy.length && Math.abs(tidy[tidy.length - 1].ppq - t.ppq) < TINY) tidy[tidy.length - 1] = t;
        else tidy.push(t);
      }
      if (!tidy.length) tidy.push({ ppq: 0, bpm: 120, ramp: false });
      tidy[0].ppq = 0;
      tidy[tidy.length - 1].ramp = false;
      this.tempos = tidy;
      this.rebuild();
    }

    setSignatures(list) {
      const sorted = list.filter((s) => DENOMINATORS.includes(s.denominator))
                         .map((s) => ({ bar: clamp(s.bar, 0, MAX_BAR), numerator: clamp(s.numerator, 1, 32), denominator: s.denominator }))
                         .sort((a, b) => a.bar - b.bar);
      const tidy = [];
      for (const s of sorted) {
        if (tidy.length && tidy[tidy.length - 1].bar === s.bar) tidy[tidy.length - 1] = s;
        else tidy.push(s);
      }
      if (!tidy.length) tidy.push({ bar: 0, numerator: 4, denominator: 4 });
      tidy[0].bar = 0;
      this.signatures = tidy;
      this.rebuild();
    }

    setKeys(list) {
      const sorted = list.map((k) => ({ bar: clamp(k.bar, 0, MAX_BAR), root: ((k.root % 12) + 12) % 12, scale: SCALES.includes(k.scale) ? k.scale : "major" }))
                         .sort((a, b) => a.bar - b.bar);
      const tidy = [];
      for (const k of sorted) {
        if (tidy.length && tidy[tidy.length - 1].bar === k.bar) tidy[tidy.length - 1] = k;
        else tidy.push(k);
      }
      if (!tidy.length) tidy.push({ bar: 0, root: 0, scale: "major" });
      tidy[0].bar = 0;
      this.keys = tidy;
    }

    rebuild() {
      if (!this.tempos || !this.signatures) return;
      this.tempoSeconds = [0];
      for (let i = 1; i < this.tempos.length; i++)
        this.tempoSeconds.push(this.tempoSeconds[i - 1] + this.secondsIn(i - 1, this.tempos[i].ppq));
      this.signaturePpq = [0];
      for (let i = 1; i < this.signatures.length; i++) {
        const before = this.signatures[i - 1];
        this.signaturePpq.push(this.signaturePpq[i - 1] + (this.signatures[i].bar - before.bar) * before.numerator * 4 / before.denominator);
      }
    }

    toData() {
      return { tempos: this.tempos.map((t) => [t.ppq, t.bpm, t.ramp]),
               signatures: this.signatures.map((s) => [s.bar, s.numerator, s.denominator]),
               keys: this.keys.map((k) => [k.bar, k.root, k.scale]) };
    }

    clone() { return new TempoMap(this.toData()); }

    equals(other) { return Boolean(other) && JSON.stringify(this.toData()) === JSON.stringify(other.toData()); }

    hasOneTempo() { return this.tempos.length === 1; }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ time
    slopeOf(index) {
      const from = this.tempos[index], to = this.tempos[index + 1];
      if (!from.ramp || !to) return 0;
      const span = to.ppq - from.ppq;
      return span > TINY ? (to.bpm - from.bpm) / span : 0;
    }

    secondsIn(index, ppq) {
      const from = this.tempos[index], distance = ppq - from.ppq, slope = this.slopeOf(index);
      if (Math.abs(slope) > 1e-12) return 60 / slope * Math.log((from.bpm + slope * distance) / from.bpm);
      return distance * 60 / from.bpm;
    }

    secondsAt(ppq) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(ppq) || ppq <= 0) return 0;
      const index = lastAtOrBefore(this.tempos, ppq, (t) => t.ppq);
      return this.tempoSeconds[index] + this.secondsIn(index, ppq);
    }

    ppqAt(seconds) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds <= 0) return 0;
      const index = lastAtOrBefore(this.tempoSeconds, seconds, (s) => s);
      const from = this.tempos[index], into = seconds - this.tempoSeconds[index], slope = this.slopeOf(index);
      if (Math.abs(slope) > 1e-12) return from.ppq + from.bpm / slope * (Math.exp(slope * into / 60) - 1);
      return from.ppq + into * from.bpm / 60;
    }

    bpmAt(ppq) {
      ppq = Number.isFinite(ppq) ? Math.max(0, ppq) : 0;
      const index = lastAtOrBefore(this.tempos, ppq, (t) => t.ppq);
      const from = this.tempos[index], to = this.tempos[index + 1];
      if (from.ramp && to && to.ppq - from.ppq > TINY) return from.bpm + (to.bpm - from.bpm) * clamp((ppq - from.ppq) / (to.ppq - from.ppq), 0, 1);
      return from.bpm;
    }

    /** The index of the tempo change in effect at ppq. */
    tempoIndexAt(ppq) { return lastAtOrBefore(this.tempos, Math.max(0, ppq) + TINY, (t) => t.ppq); }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ bars
    /** The bar a position is in: {index, start, numerator, denominator, beat, length, end}. */
    barAt(ppq) {
      ppq = Number.isFinite(ppq) ? Math.max(0, ppq) : 0;
      const i = lastAtOrBefore(this.signaturePpq, ppq + TINY, (p) => p);
      return this.makeBar(i, Math.max(0, Math.floor((ppq - this.signaturePpq[i]) / this.lengthOf(i) + TINY)));
    }

    lengthOf(i) { const s = this.signatures[i]; return s.numerator * 4 / s.denominator; }

    makeBar(i, barsIn) {
      const s = this.signatures[i], length = this.lengthOf(i);
      const index = Math.min(MAX_BAR, s.bar + barsIn);
      const start = this.signaturePpq[i] + (index - s.bar) * length;
      return { index, start, numerator: s.numerator, denominator: s.denominator, beat: 4 / s.denominator, length, end: start + length };
    }

    /** The bar with this index (from 0). */
    bar(index) {
      index = clamp(Math.trunc(index), 0, MAX_BAR);
      const i = lastAtOrBefore(this.signatures, index, (s) => s.bar);
      return this.makeBar(i, index - this.signatures[i].bar);
    }

    ppqOfBar(index) { return this.bar(index).start; }

    nearestBar(ppq) {
      const bar = this.barAt(ppq);
      return ppq - bar.start < bar.length / 2 ? bar.start : bar.end;
    }

    signatureAt(ppq) { const b = this.barAt(ppq); return { bar: b.index, numerator: b.numerator, denominator: b.denominator }; }

    keyAt(ppq) {
      const bar = this.barAt(ppq).index;
      return this.keys[lastAtOrBefore(this.keys, bar, (k) => k.bar)];
    }

    /** Each bar overlapping [from, to), in order. */
    *barsBetween(from, to) {
      let bar = this.barAt(from);
      for (let n = 0; n < 20000 && bar.start < to; n++) {
        yield bar;
        const next = this.barAt(bar.end);
        if (next.start < bar.end - 1e-6) break;   // past the last bar the map counts
        bar = next;
      }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ positions as text
    /** Studio One's bars display: bar.beat.sixteenth.ticks, as in 00001.01.01.00 */
    formatBars(ppq) {
      const bar = this.barAt(Math.max(0, ppq) + 1e-9);
      const inBar = Math.max(0, ppq + 1e-9 - bar.start);
      const beat = Math.min(bar.numerator - 1, Math.floor(inBar / bar.beat));
      const perBeat = Math.max(1, 16 / bar.denominator);
      const sixteenthLength = bar.beat / perBeat;
      const inBeat = inBar - beat * bar.beat;
      const sixteenth = Math.min(perBeat - 1, Math.floor(inBeat / sixteenthLength));
      const ticks = Math.min(99, Math.floor((inBeat - sixteenth * sixteenthLength) / sixteenthLength * 100));
      const pad = (value, width) => String(value).padStart(width, "0");
      return `${pad(bar.index + 1, 5)}.${pad(beat + 1, 2)}.${pad(sixteenth + 1, 2)}.${pad(ticks, 2)}`;
    }

    /** Reads "5", "5.3", "5.3.2", "5.3.2.50" or "00005.03.02.50": quarter notes, or null. */
    parseBars(text) {
      const parts = String(text).trim().split(/[.:\s]+/).filter(Boolean);
      if (parts.length === 0 || parts.length > 4 || parts.some((part) => !/^\d+$/.test(part))) return null;
      const [barNumber, beat = 1, sixteenth = 1, ticks = 0] = parts.map(Number);
      if (barNumber < 1 || barNumber > MAX_BAR + 1) return null;
      const bar = this.bar(barNumber - 1);
      const perBeat = Math.max(1, 16 / bar.denominator);
      if (beat < 1 || beat > bar.numerator || sixteenth < 1 || sixteenth > perBeat || ticks > 99) return null;
      const sixteenthLength = bar.beat / perBeat;
      return bar.start + (beat - 1) * bar.beat + (sixteenth - 1) * sixteenthLength + ticks / 100 * sixteenthLength;
    }

    /** "5", "5.2" or "5.2.3" for a ruler label, as fine as the step needs. */
    label(ppq, step) {
      const bar = this.barAt(ppq + 1e-9);
      const inBar = ppq - bar.start;
      if (step >= bar.length - 1e-9 || inBar < 1e-6) return String(bar.index + 1);
      const beatIndex = Math.floor(inBar / bar.beat + 1e-9);
      const inBeat = inBar - beatIndex * bar.beat;
      if (step >= bar.beat - 1e-9 || inBeat < 1e-6) return `${bar.index + 1}.${beatIndex + 1}`;
      return `${bar.index + 1}.${beatIndex + 1}.${Math.floor(inBeat / 0.25 + 1e-9) + 1}`;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ the grid
    /**
        Grid steps from a 64th note up to many bars, for the bar at ref: the finest divide its
        beat; then the beat, the bar, and 2, 4, 8 ... bars. A step of a bar or more counts bars
        (whatever their lengths); finer steps count from each bar's start.
    */
    steps(ref) {
      const bar = this.barAt(ref);
      const list = [0.0625, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5].filter((s) => s < bar.beat && Math.abs(bar.beat / s - Math.round(bar.beat / s)) < 1e-9)
                                             .map((q) => ({ q, bars: 0 }));
      list.push({ q: bar.beat, bars: 0, beat: true });
      if (bar.length > bar.beat) list.push({ q: bar.length, bars: 1 });
      for (let m = 2; m <= 1024; m *= 2) list.push({ q: bar.length * m, bars: m });
      return list;
    }

    /** The finest step (no finer than finest quarters) at least minPx wide at zoom px per quarter. */
    gridStep(ref, zoom, minPx, finest = 0) {
      const all = this.steps(ref);
      return all.find((s) => s.q >= finest - 1e-9 && s.q * zoom >= minPx) || all[all.length - 1];
    }

    /** A step of q quarters: bars when q is at least the bar at ref, else q within bars. */
    stepOf(q, ref) {
      const bar = this.barAt(ref);
      if (q >= bar.length - 1e-9) return { q, bars: Math.max(1, Math.round(q / bar.length)) };
      return { q, bars: 0, beat: Math.abs(q - bar.beat) < 1e-9 };
    }

    /**
        The grid's lines from..to for a step: {ppq, bar (on a bar line), beat (on a beat)}.
        Bars at each bar start (every step.bars-th); finer steps from each bar's start, the
        beat step following each bar's own beat.
    */
    lines(from, to, step) {
      const out = [];
      for (const bar of this.barsBetween(Math.max(0, from), to)) {
        if (step.bars > 0) {
          if (bar.index % step.bars === 0 && bar.start >= from - 1e-9) out.push({ ppq: bar.start, bar: true, beat: true, index: bar.index });
          continue;
        }
        const q = step.beat ? bar.beat : step.q;
        const count = Math.ceil(bar.length / q - 1e-9);
        for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
          const ppq = bar.start + k * q;
          if (ppq < from - 1e-9) continue;
          if (ppq >= to) break;
          const inBar = k * q;
          out.push({ ppq, bar: k === 0, beat: Math.abs(inBar / bar.beat - Math.round(inBar / bar.beat)) < 1e-6, index: bar.index });
        }
        if (out.length > 20000) break;
      }
      return out;
    }

    /** The nearest grid position to ppq for a step (null step: ppq itself). */
    snap(ppq, step) {
      ppq = Math.max(0, ppq);
      if (!step) return ppq;
      const bar = this.barAt(ppq);
      if (step.bars > 0) {
        const lower = this.bar(Math.floor(bar.index / step.bars) * step.bars);
        const upper = this.bar(lower.index + step.bars);
        return ppq - lower.start <= upper.start - ppq ? lower.start : upper.start;
      }
      const q = step.beat ? bar.beat : step.q;
      const at = Math.min(bar.end, bar.start + Math.round((ppq - bar.start) / q) * q);
      return bar.end - ppq < Math.abs(ppq - at) ? bar.end : at;   // a step that doesn't fill the bar: its end may be nearer
    }

    /** The grid position at or before ppq. */
    snapFloor(ppq, step) {
      ppq = Math.max(0, ppq);
      if (!step) return ppq;
      const bar = this.barAt(ppq);
      if (step.bars > 0) return this.bar(Math.floor(bar.index / step.bars) * step.bars).start;
      const q = step.beat ? bar.beat : step.q;
      return bar.start + Math.floor((ppq - bar.start) / q + 1e-9) * q;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ keys
    static keyName(key) { return `${NOTE_NAMES[key.root] || "C"} ${key.scale}`; }
  }

  TempoMap.MIN_TEMPO = MIN_TEMPO;
  TempoMap.MAX_TEMPO = MAX_TEMPO;
  TempoMap.MAX_BAR = MAX_BAR;
  TempoMap.DENOMINATORS = DENOMINATORS;
  TempoMap.SCALES = SCALES;
  TempoMap.NOTE_NAMES = NOTE_NAMES;

  Hub.TempoMap = TempoMap;
  Hub.tempoMap = new TempoMap();
  Hub.songChannel = { mainAutomation: [], scales: SCALES };

  // The engine sends the song channel when it changes (a song opened, an edit, an undo, the AI).
  Hub.on("songChannel", (data) => {
    const map = new TempoMap(data && data.map);
    const main = Array.isArray(data && data.mainAutomation) ? data.mainAutomation.filter((p) => Array.isArray(p) && p.length === 2) : [];
    const changed = !map.equals(Hub.tempoMap) || JSON.stringify(main) !== JSON.stringify(Hub.songChannel.mainAutomation);
    Hub.tempoMap = map;
    Hub.songChannel = { mainAutomation: main, scales: Array.isArray(data && data.scales) ? data.scales : SCALES };
    if (changed) Hub.emit("tempoMap", map);
  });
})();

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-tracks.js

// Track list: the track headers on the left of the Song page. Plugins dragged
// from the Browser drop onto a track (an instrument replaces its instrument, an
// effect joins the end of its inserts, a MIDI tool joins its MIDI FX) or into the
// empty space below the tracks (a new track). The arrangement lives in hub-arrange.js. Selecting several tracks, and what
// they do together (buttons, faders, the right-click menu, dragging to move), is hub-group.js.
//
// Right-click the empty space under the tracks (or a header, under its own items) for Studio
// One's track menu: Add Tracks... (T: its dialog, with the name, count, type, mono or stereo,
// input and instrument), Add Audio Track (mono), Add Audio Track (stereo), Add Instrument Track,
// Add Choir Track (an audio track whose vocal sings as a choir too: its choir icon opens the
// Choir window, hub-choir.js),
// Add Tracks for all Inputs (one audio track for each of the song's inputs, named after it),
// Collapse All Tracks (all at the small size; again, back as they were), and Store Track
// Preset... (the selected tracks with their instruments, inserts and MIDI FX, into a file) and
// Load Track Preset... (a preset's tracks added to the song).

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- track list
  function instrumentOptions(select, track) {
    // An instrument on its way (dropped, or picked here) shows already, while it loads.
    const loadingName = (track.loading || "").replace(/\.(vst3|wasm|wclap\.tar\.gz|wclap\.tgz|wclap)$/i, "");
    const current = loadingName ? LOADING_KEY : track.instrument ? pluginKey(track.instrument.file, track.instrument.id) : BUILTIN_KEY;
    const entries = Hub.state.library.filter((entry) => entry.kind !== "effect");
    const signature = current + "#" + loadingName + "#" + entries.map((entry) => pluginKey(entry.file, entry.id)).join(",");

    if (select.dataset.signature !== signature) {
      select.dataset.signature = signature;
      select.textContent = "";
      select.add(new Option("Test Synth", BUILTIN_KEY));

      for (const entry of entries)
        select.add(new Option(entry.name, pluginKey(entry.file, entry.id)));

      if (track.instrument && !loadingName && !entries.some((entry) => pluginKey(entry.file, entry.id) === current))
        select.add(new Option(track.instrument.name, current));

      if (loadingName) {
        const loading = new Option(`${loadingName} (loading…)`, LOADING_KEY);
        loading.disabled = true;
        select.add(loading);
      }
    }

    // Always the track's own instrument, also when one is dropped on the track while this list
    // still has the keyboard focus from an earlier pick.
    select.value = current;
  }

  function createRow(track) {
