// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Library.cpp

#include "Library.h"
#include "Preferences.h"   // SettingsFolder

#include "BuiltinPlugins.h"
#include "CreatorPlugin.h"
#include "Plugin.h"
#include "Vst3Plugin.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <set>

namespace
{
    // What changes when a plugin file does. A .wclap bundle folder is judged by its module.
    juce::File contentOf (const juce::File& file)
    {
        return file.isDirectory() ? file.getChildFile ("module.wasm") : file;
    }

    juce::int64 sizeOf (const juce::File& file)       { return contentOf (file).getSize(); }
    juce::int64 modifiedOf (const juce::File& file)   { return contentOf (file).getLastModificationTime().toMilliseconds(); }

    /** Every plugin file in a folder and its sub-folders; a .wclap bundle counts as one. */
    void findPluginFiles (const juce::File& folder, std::vector<juce::File>& found, int depth)
    {
        if (depth > 8 || ! folder.isDirectory())
            return;

        for (const auto& item : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (folder, false, "*",
                                                              juce::File::findFilesAndDirectories | juce::File::ignoreHiddenFiles))
        {
            const auto& file = item.getFile();

            if (Library::isPluginFile (file))
                found.push_back (file);
            else if (item.isDirectory())
                findPluginFiles (file, found, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    juce::var stringsToVar (const juce::StringArray& strings)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> list;

        for (const auto& text : strings)
            list.add (text);

        return list;
    }

    juce::StringArray stringsFromVar (const juce::var& value)
    {
        juce::StringArray strings;

        if (const auto* list = value.getArray())
            for (const auto& item : *list)
                strings.add (item.toString());

        return strings;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File Library::getDefaultFile()
{
    // With Sonify's other settings (a new build keeps it).
    return SettingsFolder::file ("library.json", "FananWebHub-library.json");
}

Library::Library (const juce::File& file)
    : databaseFile (file)
{
    load();
    addBuiltins();   // the made plugins are refreshed once Sonify knows the user data folder (MainCreator.cpp)

    // A plugin that crashed the Hub while it was being read last time is left out.
    const auto scanning = getScanningFile();

    if (scanning.existsAsFile())
    {
        const juce::File crashed (scanning.loadFileAsString().trim());

        if (crashed.exists())
            remember (crashed, "It crashed Sonify while being read, so it's left out. A full rescan tries it again.");

        scanning.deleteFile();
        save();
    }

    // The first time, the system's VST3 folder joins the Plugin Folders, and so does its CLAP
    // folder (once, for libraries made before it was one of the usual places).
    if (! systemFoldersAdded || ! clapFolderAdded)
    {
        const auto defaults = getDefaultFolders();

        for (const auto& folder : defaults)
        {
            const auto isClap = folder.getFileName().equalsIgnoreCase ("CLAP");

            if (folder.isDirectory() && (isClap ? ! clapFolderAdded : ! systemFoldersAdded))
                folders.addIfNotAlreadyThere (folder.getFullPathName());
        }

        systemFoldersAdded = true;
        clapFolderAdded = true;
        save();
    }
}

juce::File Library::getScanningFile() const
{
    return databaseFile.getSiblingFile (databaseFile.getFileNameWithoutExtension() + "-scanning.txt");
}

juce::String Library::Entry::format() const
{
    if (Builtins::isBuiltinId (id))
        return "Built-in";

    if (MadePlugins::isMadeFile (file))
        return MadePlugins::formatName;

    return Plugin::isVst3 (juce::File (file)) ? "VST3" : "WCLAP";
}

bool Library::isPluginFile (const juce::File& file)
{
    const auto name = file.getFileName().toLowerCase();

    // A .vst3 can be a bundle folder or a single file; so can a WCLAP.
    if (name.endsWith (".vst3"))
        return true;

    if (file.isDirectory())
        return name.endsWith (".wclap");

    return name.endsWith (".wasm") || name.endsWith (".wclap.tar.gz") || name.endsWith (".wclap.tgz");
}

juce::String Library::kindFromFeatures (const juce::StringArray& features)
{
    if (features.contains ("instrument"))
        return "instrument";

    if (features.contains ("audio-effect") || features.contains ("analyzer"))
        return "effect";

    if (features.contains ("note-effect"))
        return "noteEffect";

    return "instrument";
}

juce::String Library::categoryFromFeatures (const juce::StringArray& features)
{
    const auto has = [&features] (std::initializer_list<const char*> names)
    {
        for (const auto* name : names)
            if (features.contains (name))
                return true;

        return false;
    };

    const auto kind = kindFromFeatures (features);

    if (kind == "noteEffect")
        return "Note FX";

    if (kind == "instrument")
    {
        if (has ({ "drum", "drum-machine" }))    return "Drums";
        if (has ({ "sampler", "granular" }))     return "Sampler";
        if (has ({ "synthesizer" }))             return "Synth";
        return "Instrument";
    }

    // Effects: the most telling feature first.
    if (has ({ "analyzer" }))                    return "Analyzer";
    if (has ({ "reverb" }))                      return "Reverb";
    if (has ({ "delay" }))                       return "Delay";
    if (has ({ "equalizer" }))                   return "EQ";
    if (has ({ "compressor", "limiter", "expander", "gate", "transient-shaper", "de-esser" }))  return "Dynamics";
    if (has ({ "distortion" }))                  return "Distortion";
    if (has ({ "filter" }))                      return "Filter";
    if (has ({ "chorus", "flanger", "phaser", "tremolo", "rotary-speaker", "frequency-shifter", "pitch-shifter", "vibrato" }))
        return "Modulation";
    if (has ({ "utility", "mixing", "mastering", "restoration", "pitch-correction" }))
        return "Mixing";
    return "Effect";
}

//==============================================================================
void Library::load()
{
    entries.clear();
    files.clear();
    folders.clear();
    addedFiles.clear();
    ignoredFiles.clear();

    const auto parsed = juce::JSON::parse (databaseFile);
    const auto* plugins = parsed.getArray();

    if (plugins != nullptr)
    {
        // The first library was a plain list of plugins, every one added by hand. With no
        // file records, the next scan reads them again and learns their features.
        for (const auto& item : *plugins)
            addedFiles.addIfNotAlreadyThere (item.getProperty ("file", {}).toString());

        addedFiles.removeEmptyStrings();
    }
    else if (parsed.getProperty ("format", {}).toString() == formatName)
    {
        plugins = parsed.getProperty ("plugins", {}).getArray();
        folders = stringsFromVar (parsed.getProperty ("folders", {}));
        addedFiles = stringsFromVar (parsed.getProperty ("addedFiles", {}));
        ignoredFiles = stringsFromVar (parsed.getProperty ("ignoredFiles", {}));
        systemFoldersAdded = static_cast<bool> (parsed.getProperty ("systemFoldersAdded", false));
        clapFolderAdded = static_cast<bool> (parsed.getProperty ("clapFolderAdded", false));

        if (const auto* records = parsed.getProperty ("files", {}).getArray())
        {
            for (const auto& item : *records)
            {
                const auto path = item.getProperty ("path", {}).toString();

                if (path.isNotEmpty())
                    files[path] = { static_cast<juce::int64> (item.getProperty ("size", 0)),
                                    static_cast<juce::int64> (item.getProperty ("modified", 0)),
                                    item.getProperty ("error", {}).toString() };
            }
        }
    }

    if (plugins == nullptr)
        return;

    for (const auto& item : *plugins)
    {
        Entry entry;
        entry.file = item.getProperty ("file", {}).toString();
        entry.id = item.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();
        entry.name = item.getProperty ("name", {}).toString();
        entry.vendor = item.getProperty ("vendor", {}).toString();
        entry.version = item.getProperty ("version", {}).toString();
        entry.features = stringsFromVar (item.getProperty ("features", {}));
        entry.kind = item.getProperty ("kind", "instrument").toString();
        entry.category = item.getProperty ("category", {}).toString();
        entry.favorite = static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("favorite", false));
        entry.missing = static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("missing", false));
        entry.lastUsed = static_cast<juce::int64> (item.getProperty ("lastUsed", 0));
        entry.uses = static_cast<int> (item.getProperty ("uses", 0));

        if (entry.category.isEmpty() && ! entry.features.isEmpty())
            entry.category = categoryFromFeatures (entry.features);

        if (entry.file.isNotEmpty() && entry.id.isNotEmpty())
            entries.push_back (entry);
    }
}

void Library::addBuiltins()
{
    // What the user made of them is kept; where they're listed follows the executable.
    std::map<juce::String, Entry> known;

    for (const auto& entry : entries)
        if (Builtins::isBuiltinId (entry.id))
            known[entry.id] = entry;

    entries.erase (std::remove_if (entries.begin(), entries.end(), [] (const Entry& entry) { return Builtins::isBuiltinId (entry.id); }),
                   entries.end());

    for (const auto& descriptor : Builtins::describe())
    {
        Entry entry;
        entry.file = Builtins::file().getFullPathName();
        entry.id = descriptor.id;
        entry.name = descriptor.name;
        entry.vendor = descriptor.vendor;
        entry.version = descriptor.version;
        entry.features = descriptor.features;
        entry.kind = kindFromFeatures (descriptor.features);   // the system tools include instruments
        entry.category = Builtins::categoryOf (descriptor.id);

        if (const auto found = known.find (descriptor.id); found != known.end())
        {
            entry.favorite = found->second.favorite;
            entry.lastUsed = found->second.lastUsed;
            entry.uses = found->second.uses;
        }

        entries.push_back (entry);
    }
}

void Library::refreshMadePlugins (const juce::File& justAdded)
{
    if (justAdded != juce::File())
        ignoredFiles.removeString (justAdded.getFullPathName());

    // What the user made of them is kept, by id: a plugin added again under a new name is
    // still the same plugin.
    std::map<juce::String, Entry> known;

    for (const auto& entry : entries)
        if (MadePlugins::isMadeFile (entry.file))
            known[entry.id] = entry;

    entries.erase (std::remove_if (entries.begin(), entries.end(), [] (const Entry& entry) { return MadePlugins::isMadeFile (entry.file); }),
                   entries.end());

    for (const auto& folder : MadePlugins::installed())
    {
        const auto path = folder.getFullPathName();

        if (ignoredFiles.contains (path))   // taken out of the Browser
            continue;

        for (const auto& descriptor : MadePlugins::describe (folder))
        {
            Entry entry;
            entry.file = path;
            entry.id = descriptor.id;
            entry.name = descriptor.name;
            entry.vendor = descriptor.vendor;
            entry.version = descriptor.version;
            entry.features = descriptor.features;
            entry.kind = kindFromFeatures (descriptor.features);
            entry.category = MadePlugins::category;

            if (const auto found = known.find (descriptor.id); found != known.end())
            {
                entry.favorite = found->second.favorite;
                entry.lastUsed = found->second.lastUsed;
                entry.uses = found->second.uses;
            }

            entries.push_back (entry);
        }
    }

    save();
}

void Library::save() const
{
    juce::Array<juce::var> records;

    for (const auto& [path, record] : files)
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
        item->setProperty ("path", path);
        item->setProperty ("size", record.size);
        item->setProperty ("modified", record.modified);

        if (record.error.isNotEmpty())
            item->setProperty ("error", record.error);

        records.add (juce::var (item.get()));
    }

    juce::Array<juce::var> plugins;

    for (const auto& entry : entries)
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
        item->setProperty ("file", entry.file);
        item->setProperty ("id", entry.id);
        item->setProperty ("name", entry.name);
        item->setProperty ("vendor", entry.vendor);
        item->setProperty ("version", entry.version);
        item->setProperty ("features", stringsToVar (entry.features));
        item->setProperty ("kind", entry.kind);
        item->setProperty ("category", entry.category);
        item->setProperty ("favorite", entry.favorite);
        item->setProperty ("missing", entry.missing);
        item->setProperty ("lastUsed", entry.lastUsed);
        item->setProperty ("uses", entry.uses);
        plugins.add (juce::var (item.get()));
    }

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr root (new juce::DynamicObject());
    root->setProperty ("format", formatName);
    root->setProperty ("version", formatVersion);
    root->setProperty ("folders", stringsToVar (folders));
    root->setProperty ("addedFiles", stringsToVar (addedFiles));
    root->setProperty ("ignoredFiles", stringsToVar (ignoredFiles));
    root->setProperty ("systemFoldersAdded", systemFoldersAdded);
    root->setProperty ("clapFolderAdded", clapFolderAdded);
    root->setProperty ("files", records);
    root->setProperty ("plugins", plugins);

    databaseFile.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (root.get())));
}

//==============================================================================
void Library::remember (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& error)
{
    files[file.getFullPathName()] = { sizeOf (file), modifiedOf (file), error };
}

bool Library::isInFolders (const juce::String& path) const
{
    const juce::File file (path);

    for (const auto& folder : folders)
        if (file.isAChildOf (juce::File (folder)))
            return true;

    return false;
}

void Library::setThirdPartyPlugins (bool offered, const juce::File& ownFolder)
{
    thirdPartyOffered = offered;
    ownPluginsFolder = ownFolder;
}

bool Library::isOffered (const juce::String& file) const
{
    return thirdPartyOffered || Builtins::isBuiltinFile (file) || MadePlugins::isMadeFile (file)
        || juce::File (file).isAChildOf (ownPluginsFolder);
}

Library::Entry* Library::find (const juce::String& file, const juce::String& id)
{
    for (auto& entry : entries)
        if (entry.file == file && entry.id == id)
            return &entry;

    return nullptr;
}

juce::Result Library::recordScan (const juce::File& file, const std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor>& found,
                                  const juce::String& error, int& added)
{
    added = 0;
    const auto path = file.getFullPathName();

    if (found.empty())
    {
        remember (file, error);
        return juce::Result::fail (error);
    }

    std::vector<Entry> fresh;

    for (const auto& descriptor : found)
    {
        Entry entry;
        entry.file = path;
        entry.id = descriptor.id;
        entry.name = descriptor.name.isNotEmpty() ? descriptor.name : descriptor.id;
        entry.vendor = descriptor.vendor.isNotEmpty() ? descriptor.vendor : juce::String ("Unknown vendor");
        entry.version = descriptor.version;
        entry.features = descriptor.features;
        entry.kind = kindFromFeatures (descriptor.features);
        entry.category = categoryFromFeatures (descriptor.features);

        // What the user made of it survives a rescan.
        if (const auto* known = find (path, entry.id))
        {
            entry.favorite = known->favorite;
            entry.lastUsed = known->lastUsed;
            entry.uses = known->uses;
        }
        else
        {
            ++added;
        }

        fresh.push_back (entry);
    }

    // The file's plugins are exactly what it holds now.
    entries.erase (std::remove_if (entries.begin(), entries.end(), [&path] (const Entry& entry) { return entry.file == path; }),
                   entries.end());
    entries.insert (entries.end(), fresh.begin(), fresh.end());
    remember (file, {});
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

void Library::addFile (const juce::File& file)
{
    const auto path = file.getFullPathName();
    ignoredFiles.removeString (path);

    if (! isInFolders (path))
        addedFiles.addIfNotAlreadyThere (path);

    // Read on the next scan, like a new file in a Plugin Folder.
    files.erase (path);
    save();
}

void Library::removeFile (const juce::String& file)
{
    // A copy: the caller's string may belong to an entry this is about to erase.
    const auto path = file;

    entries.erase (std::remove_if (entries.begin(), entries.end(), [&path] (const Entry& entry) { return entry.file == path; }),
                   entries.end());
    addedFiles.removeString (path);
    files.erase (path);

    // A scan would find it in its folder again (a made plugin: in its own folder): remember
    // that it was taken out.
    if (isInFolders (path) || MadePlugins::isMadeFile (path))
        ignoredFiles.addIfNotAlreadyThere (path);

    save();
}

void Library::addFolder (const juce::File& folder)
{
    if (! folder.isDirectory())
        return;

    folders.addIfNotAlreadyThere (folder.getFullPathName());
    save();
}

void Library::replaceFolder (const juce::String& oldPath, const juce::File& newFolder)
{
    const auto at = folders.indexOf (oldPath);

    if (at < 0 || ! newFolder.isDirectory() || newFolder.getFullPathName() == oldPath)
        return;

    removeFolder (oldPath);   // its plugins go, as when it's removed

    if (! folders.contains (newFolder.getFullPathName()))
        folders.insert (juce::jmin (at, folders.size()), newFolder.getFullPathName());

    save();
}

juce::Array<juce::File> Library::getDefaultFolders()
{
    juce::Array<juce::File> list;
    const auto vst3 = Vst3Plugin::getDefaultFolders();

    for (int i = 0; i < vst3.getNumPaths(); ++i)
        list.addIfNotAlreadyThere (vst3[i]);

   #if JUCE_WINDOWS
    // Where CLAP plugins are installed: C:\Program Files\Common Files\CLAP.
    list.addIfNotAlreadyThere (juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::globalApplicationsDirectory)
                                   .getChildFile ("Common Files").getChildFile ("CLAP"));
   #elif JUCE_MAC
    list.addIfNotAlreadyThere (juce::File ("/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP"));
    list.addIfNotAlreadyThere (juce::File ("~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP"));
   #else
    list.addIfNotAlreadyThere (juce::File ("~/.clap"));
    list.addIfNotAlreadyThere (juce::File ("/usr/lib/clap"));
   #endif

    return list;
}

int Library::addDefaultFolders()
{
    int added = 0;

    for (const auto& folder : getDefaultFolders())
    {
        if (folder.isDirectory() && ! folders.contains (folder.getFullPathName()))
        {
            folders.add (folder.getFullPathName());
            ++added;
        }
    }

    if (added > 0)
        save();

    return added;
}

void Library::removeFolder (const juce::String& folderPath)
{
    // A copy: the caller's string may be the entry in folders this is about to remove.
    const auto path = folderPath;

    folders.removeString (path);
    const juce::File folder (path);

    // Plugins from that folder go, unless they were also added by hand or another folder holds them.
    const auto goes = [this, &folder] (const juce::String& file)
    {
        return juce::File (file).isAChildOf (folder) && ! addedFiles.contains (file) && ! isInFolders (file)
               && ! Builtins::isBuiltinFile (file);   // Sonify's own stay, wherever Sonify is
    };

    entries.erase (std::remove_if (entries.begin(), entries.end(), [&goes] (const Entry& entry) { return goes (entry.file); }),
                   entries.end());

    for (auto record = files.begin(); record != files.end();)
        record = goes (record->first) ? files.erase (record) : std::next (record);

    for (int i = ignoredFiles.size(); --i >= 0;)
        if (juce::File (ignoredFiles[i]).isAChildOf (folder))
            ignoredFiles.remove (i);

    save();
}

std::vector<juce::File> Library::prepareScan (bool full)
{
    std::vector<juce::File> candidates;

    for (const auto& folder : folders)
        findPluginFiles (juce::File (folder), candidates, 0);

    for (const auto& path : addedFiles)
        candidates.push_back (juce::File (path));

    std::vector<juce::File> toRead;
    std::set<juce::String> seen;

    for (const auto& file : candidates)
    {
        const auto path = file.getFullPathName();

        // Third-party plugins off for this run: they wait, still new or changed, for the next.
        if (! file.exists() || ignoredFiles.contains (path) || ! isOffered (path) || ! seen.insert (path).second)
            continue;

        // A file that failed before is only tried again once it changes (or on a full scan).
        const auto known = files.find (path);
        const bool changed = known == files.end() || known->second.size != sizeOf (file) || known->second.modified != modifiedOf (file);

        if (full || changed)
            toRead.push_back (file);
    }

    // Plugins whose files have gone are missing; when the files are back, they're not.
    bool updated = false;

    for (auto& entry : entries)
    {
        const bool gone = ! juce::File (entry.file).exists();

        if (entry.missing != gone)
        {
            entry.missing = gone;
            updated = true;
        }
    }

    if (updated)
        save();

    return toRead;
}

void Library::setFavorite (const juce::String& file, const juce::String& id, bool favorite)
{
    if (auto* entry = find (file, id); entry != nullptr && entry->favorite != favorite)
    {
        entry->favorite = favorite;
        save();
    }
}

void Library::markUsed (const juce::String& file, const juce::String& id)
{
    if (auto* entry = find (file, id))
    {
        entry->lastUsed = juce::Time::currentTimeMillis();
        ++entry->uses;
        save();
    }
}

juce::String Library::folderLabelFor (const juce::String& path) const
{
    if (Builtins::isBuiltinFile (path))
        return "Built-in";

    if (MadePlugins::isMadeFile (path))
        return MadePlugins::folderLabel;

    const juce::File file (path);
    juce::File deepest;

    // The deepest Plugin Folder holding it, then the sub-folders below that.
    for (const auto& folder : folders)
    {
        const juce::File candidate (folder);

        if (file.isAChildOf (candidate) && (deepest == juce::File() || candidate.isAChildOf (deepest)))
            deepest = candidate;
    }

    if (deepest == juce::File())
        return "Added files";

    const auto relative = file.getParentDirectory().getRelativePathFrom (deepest).replaceCharacter ('\\', '/');

    if (relative.isEmpty() || relative == ".")
        return deepest.getFileName();

    return deepest.getFileName() + " / " + relative.replace ("/", " / ");
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Library.h

#pragma once

#include "Plugin.h"

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <map>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The library database: every plugin the Browser offers, and what's known about it.

    Plugins come from the Plugin Folders (searched, sub-folders too, for VST3 plugins
    and for WCLAPs: .wasm files, .wclap bundle folders and .wclap.tar.gz archives) and
    from files added one at a time. The system's VST3 and CLAP folders are added the first
    time (Settings > Locations > Plug-ins lists them all).
    A plugin that crashes the Hub while it's being read is left out after the restart
    (until its file changes or a full rescan), as Studio One's scanner does. Each file is read once: a scan reads only files that are new or changed since
    (every file when full), and a plugin whose file disappears stays listed as missing
    until the file is back or the plugin is removed from the Browser.

    For each plugin: its name, vendor, version and CLAP features, the kind and type
    (category) the Browser sorts by, both read from the features, whether it's a
    favorite, and when it was last used.

    Saved as library.json with Sonify's other settings (SettingsFolder). Message thread only.
*/
class Library final
{
public:
    struct Entry
    {
        juce::String file, id, name, vendor, version;
        juce::StringArray features;
        juce::String kind;             // instrument, effect or noteEffect
        juce::String category;         // the Browser's Type: Synth, Reverb, Note FX...
        bool favorite = false;
        bool missing = false;          // its file isn't there any more
        juce::int64 lastUsed = 0;      // ms since 1970; 0: never
        int uses = 0;

        juce::String format() const;   // "VST3", "WCLAP", "Built-in" or "Sonify" (made in the Plugins Creator Studio)
    };

    explicit Library (const juce::File& databaseFile = getDefaultFile());

    const std::vector<Entry>& getEntries() const noexcept      { return entries; }
    const juce::StringArray& getFolders() const noexcept       { return folders; }

    //==============================================================================
    /** For this run only, from the question at startup: whether third-party plugins are
        offered. Without them, only Sonify's own plugins are (those installed from Fanan's
        content, in ownFolder), and scans read only those. Everything stays listed for the
        next run. */
    void setThirdPartyPlugins (bool offered, const juce::File& ownFolder);
    bool offersThirdParty() const noexcept                     { return thirdPartyOffered; }

    /** Whether a plugin file is offered this run: always, unless third-party plugins are off
        and it isn't one of Sonify's own. */
    bool isOffered (const juce::String& file) const;

    //==============================================================================
    /** A plugin file picked by hand: read now, and kept even outside the Plugin Folders. */
    /** Lists a plugin file added by hand; the next scan reads it. */
    void addFile (const juce::File& file);

    /** Out of the Browser. A file inside a Plugin Folder stays out on later scans too. */
    void removeFile (const juce::String& path);

    void addFolder (const juce::File& folder);

    /** Another folder where one was, in the same place in the list (Settings > Locations >
        Plug-ins: Change). The old folder's plugins go, as with removeFolder. */
    void replaceFolder (const juce::String& oldPath, const juce::File& newFolder);

    /** The usual places for plugins: the system's VST3 and CLAP folders
        (C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3 and ...\CLAP on Windows). */
    static juce::Array<juce::File> getDefaultFolders();

    /** Lists the usual folders that exist and aren't listed yet; returns how many. */
    int addDefaultFolders();

    /** The folder, and the plugins that came from it (not ones also added by hand), go. */
    void removeFolder (const juce::String& path);

    /** The files a scan should read: new and changed ones in the Plugin Folders and among
        the files added by hand, or every one of them when full. Plugins whose files have
        gone are marked missing (and ones whose files are back, not) on the way. */
    std::vector<juce::File> prepareScan (bool full);

    /** Records what a plugin file holds, as the scanner read it (in a copy of the Hub, never
        in the Hub itself): its plugins replace what was known about it, keeping each plugin's
        favorite and use history. With no plugins, error says why. added counts plugins not
        listed before. */
    juce::Result recordScan (const juce::File& file, const std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor>& found,
                             const juce::String& error, int& added);

    void setFavorite (const juce::String& file, const juce::String& id, bool favorite);
    void markUsed (const juce::String& file, const juce::String& id);

    /** The group a plugin file belongs to in the Browser's Folder view. */
    juce::String folderLabelFor (const juce::String& file) const;

    void save() const;

    //==============================================================================
    static bool isPluginFile (const juce::File& file);
    static juce::String kindFromFeatures (const juce::StringArray& features);
    static juce::String categoryFromFeatures (const juce::StringArray& features);
    static juce::File getDefaultFile();

    static constexpr const char* formatName = "Fanan Web Hub Library";
    static constexpr int formatVersion = 2;

private:
    struct FileRecord

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Licences.cpp

#include "Licences.h"
#include "Ed25519.h"

#include <juce_cryptography/juce_cryptography.h>

#include <map>
#include <set>

namespace
{
    // Fanan's public key (Ed25519): licences are signed with its private key, which only Fanan's
    // server holds (Base44's STORE_LICENCE_KEY secret).
    const char* const fananPublicKeyHex = "a796d478ba2ab1dbd87c3ea8179d7ab5e98a8ae1b0e8024376bb3a0dbfa16956";

    constexpr const char* fileExtension = ".licence";

    struct State
    {
        juce::CriticalSection lock;
        std::map<juce::String, std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>>> flags;   // by product
        std::set<juce::String> licensed;                                   // products with a good licence here
        bool read = false;
    };

    State& state()
    {
        static State s;
        return s;
    }

    bool fromHex (const juce::String& hex, std::uint8_t* out, int size)
    {
        if (hex.length() != size * 2)
            return false;

        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        {
            const auto high = juce::CharacterFunctions::getHexDigitValue (hex[i * 2]);
            const auto low = juce::CharacterFunctions::getHexDigitValue (hex[i * 2 + 1]);

            if (high < 0 || low < 0)
                return false;

            out[i] = (std::uint8_t) (high * 16 + low);
        }

        return true;
    }

    /** Standard base64 (or its URL-safe form), padded or not. */
    bool fromBase64 (juce::String text, juce::MemoryBlock& out)
    {
        text = text.trim().replaceCharacter ('-', '+').replaceCharacter ('_', '/');

        while (text.length() % 4 != 0)
            text << "=";

        juce::MemoryOutputStream decoded (out, false);
        return juce::Base64::convertFromBase64 (decoded, text);
    }

    juce::File fileFor (const juce::String& productId)
    {
        return Licences::folder().getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (productId) + fileExtension);
    }

    /** Reads the folder: the products with a good licence for this computer. */
    std::set<juce::String> readFolder()
    {
        std::set<juce::String> good;

        for (const auto& entry : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (Licences::folder(), false, juce::String ("*") + fileExtension))
        {
            juce::String product, why;

            if (Licences::check (entry.getFile().loadFileAsString(), product, why))
                good.insert (product);
        }

        return good;
    }

    /** The flags follow what's licensed now (under the lock). */
    void updateFlags (State& s)
    {
        for (auto& [product, flag] : s.flags)
            flag->store (s.licensed.count (product) > 0);
    }

    void ensureRead()
    {
        auto& s = state();

        {
            const juce::ScopedLock sl (s.lock);

            if (s.read)
                return;
        }

        Licences::reload();
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String Licences::Product::priceText() const
{
    if (! isPaid())
        return "Free";

    const auto amount = juce::String (price, 2);
    const auto code = currency.trim().toUpperCase();

    if (code.isEmpty() || code == "USD") return "$" + amount;
    if (code == "EUR")                   return juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x82\xac") + amount;
    if (code == "GBP")                   return juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xc2\xa3") + amount;
    if (code == "ILS")                   return juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x82\xaa") + amount;
    return amount + " " + code;
}

Licences::Product Licences::Product::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    Product p;

    if (! value.isObject())
        return p;

    p.id = value.getProperty ("product", value.getProperty ("id", {})).toString().trim().substring (0, 80);
    p.title = value.getProperty ("title", {}).toString().trim().substring (0, 120);
    p.price = juce::jmax (0.0, (double) value.getProperty ("price", 0.0));
    p.currency = value.getProperty ("currency", "USD").toString().trim().toUpperCase().substring (0, 3);

    if (p.currency.isEmpty())
        p.currency = "USD";

    return p;
}

juce::var Licences::Product::toVar() const
{
    if (! isValid())
        return {};

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
    item->setProperty ("product", id);

    if (title.isNotEmpty())
        item->setProperty ("title", title);

    item->setProperty ("price", price);
    item->setProperty ("currency", currency);
    return juce::var (item.get());
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String Licences::computerHash()
{
    // Exactly as FananServer (and Stella AI Studio) make it: one computer is one device to
    // Fanan's server.
    const auto id = juce::SystemStats::getUniqueDeviceID();
    return id.isEmpty() ? juce::String() : juce::SHA256 (("stella-device:" + id).toUTF8()).toHexString();
}

juce::File Licences::folder()
{
    // On this computer only (not the user data folder, which may move or be synced elsewhere):
    // a licence is for this computer anyway.
    return juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userApplicationDataDirectory)
               .getChildFile ("Fanan Web Hub")
               .getChildFile ("Licences");
}

bool Licences::check (const juce::String& licenceText, juce::String& productId, juce::String& why)
{
    productId.clear();
    const auto licence = juce::JSON::parse (licenceText);
    const auto payloadText = licence.getProperty ("payload", {}).toString();
    juce::MemoryBlock signature;

    if (payloadText.isEmpty() || ! fromBase64 (licence.getProperty ("signature", {}).toString(), signature) || signature.getSize() != 64)
    {
        why = "It isn't a licence.";
        return false;
    }

    std::uint8_t key[32];

    if (! fromHex (fananPublicKeyHex, key, 32))
    {
        why = "This Sonify can't check licences.";
        return false;
    }

    const auto utf8 = payloadText.toUTF8();

    if (! Ed25519::verify (static_cast<const std::uint8_t*> (signature.getData()), reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*> (utf8.getAddress()),
                           utf8.sizeInBytes() - 1, key))
    {
        why = "The licence isn't Fanan's.";
        return false;
    }

    const auto payload = juce::JSON::parse (payloadText);
    const auto product = payload.getProperty ("product", {}).toString().trim();
    const auto computer = payload.getProperty ("computer", {}).toString().trim();

    if (product.isEmpty())
    {
        why = "The licence names no product.";
        return false;
    }

    if (! computer.equalsIgnoreCase (computerHash()) || computer.isEmpty())
    {
        why = "The licence is for another computer.";
        return false;
    }

    productId = product;
    return true;
}

juce::Result Licences::install (const juce::String& licenceText)
{
    juce::String product, why;

    if (! check (licenceText, product, why))
        return juce::Result::fail (why);

    const auto target = fileFor (product);

    if (! target.getParentDirectory().createDirectory() || ! target.replaceWithText (licenceText))
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't keep the licence in " + folder().getFullPathName());

    auto& s = state();
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (s.lock);
    s.licensed.insert (product);
    s.read = true;
    updateFlags (s);
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

bool Licences::isLicensed (const juce::String& productId)
{
    ensureRead();
    auto& s = state();
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (s.lock);
    return s.licensed.count (productId.trim()) > 0;
}

std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> Licences::flagFor (const juce::String& productId)
{
    ensureRead();
    auto& s = state();
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (s.lock);
    const auto id = productId.trim();
    auto& flag = s.flags[id];

    if (flag == nullptr)
        flag = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>> (s.licensed.count (id) > 0);

    return flag;
}

void Licences::remove (const juce::String& productId)
{
    const auto id = productId.trim();
    fileFor (id).deleteFile();

    auto& s = state();
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (s.lock);
    s.licensed.erase (id);
    updateFlags (s);
}

void Licences::reload()
{
    auto good = readFolder();   // outside the lock: it reads files and checks signatures

    auto& s = state();
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (s.lock);
    s.licensed = std::move (good);
    s.read = true;
    updateFlags (s);
}

//==============================================================================
std::function<void (const Licences::Product&)>& Licences::buyHandler()
{
    static std::function<void (const Product&)> handler;
    return handler;
}

void Licences::buy (const Product& product)
{
    if (auto& handler = buyHandler(); handler != nullptr)
        handler (product);
}

std::uint32_t Licences::runtimeToken (const juce::String& productId)
{
    // FNV-1a of "sonify-licence:" and the id, as stella_licence.h works it out (never 0: 0 is
    // "not licensed").
    std::uint32_t hash = 2166136261u;

    for (const auto* p = "sonify-licence:"; *p != 0; ++p)
        hash = (hash ^ (std::uint8_t) *p) * 16777619u;

    const auto utf8 = productId.trim().toUTF8();

    for (const auto* p = utf8.getAddress(); *p != 0; ++p)
        hash = (hash ^ (std::uint8_t) *p) * 16777619u;

    hash ^= 0x5a17c0deu;
    return hash != 0 ? hash : 1u;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Licences.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Licences for what the store sells: plugins made in Sonify and MIDI FX, bought by users
    from other users.

    The buyer never types a serial. When they buy, Fanan's server makes a licence for that
    product and that computer (as Fanan's server knows it: FananServer's device hash) and
    signs it with Fanan's private key, which never leaves the server. Sonify downloads it
    and keeps it on this computer (Fanan Web Hub\Licences in the user's application data);
    from then on the product plays fully here, online or not. Sonify holds only Fanan's public key (Ed25519), so nobody but
    the server can make a licence that passes, and a licence copied to another computer
    does nothing there.

    A licence, as the server sends it:
        { "payload": "<JSON text>", "signature": "<base64 of 64 bytes>" }
    signed over the payload's text exactly as it is, the payload being
        { "product": "<the store's id>", "computer": "<device hash>", "account": "<email>",
          "issued": "<ISO time>" }

    What isn't licensed plays in its demo: a plugin 10 seconds of sound, then 2 seconds of
    silence; a MIDI FX 10 seconds of notes, then 3 seconds with none. Free products have no
    demo.

    Message thread, except the flags (flagFor), which the audio thread reads.
*/
namespace Licences
{
    //==========================================================================
    /** What the store says about a plugin or MIDI FX it sells or gives away: "store" in its
        plugin.json or device.json (and in the songs that keep a MIDI FX's build). */
    struct Product
    {
        juce::String id;                   // the store's id for it, for good: its licences name it
        juce::String title;
        double price = 0.0;                // 0: free
        juce::String currency { "USD" };

        bool isValid() const noexcept      { return id.isNotEmpty(); }
        bool isPaid() const noexcept       { return isValid() && price > 0.0; }
        juce::String priceText() const;    // "$9.99", "Free"

        static Product fromVar (const juce::var& value);
        juce::var toVar() const;           // void when it isn't a store product
    };

    //==========================================================================
    /** This computer as Fanan's server knows it: the one-way hash FananServer sends. */
    juce::String computerHash();

    /** Where licences are kept: Fanan Web Hub\Licences in the user's application data. */
    juce::File folder();

    /** A licence from Fanan's server: checked (Fanan's signature, this computer), then kept. */
    juce::Result install (const juce::String& licenceText);

    /** Checks a licence's text without keeping it: its product when it's good, else why not. */
    bool check (const juce::String& licenceText, juce::String& productId, juce::String& why);

    /** Whether this computer holds a good licence for the product. */
    bool isLicensed (const juce::String& productId);

    /** The flag a paid product plays by: true while a good licence for it is here. Shared and
        read on the audio thread; it turns true the moment one is installed. */
    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> flagFor (const juce::String& productId);

    /** Reads the licences folder again (at start, or after the store downloaded some). */
    void reload();

    /** Takes a product's licence off this computer (the store gave this computer's place back). */
    void remove (const juce::String& productId);

    //==========================================================================
    /** A plugin's Buy button in its demo: the store opens that product. The app sets the
        handler (Sonify's store, in the Plugins Studio); with none, the button says where the
        store is. */
    void buy (const Product& product);
    std::function<void (const Product&)>& buyHandler();

    //==========================================================================
    /** The demo's timing. */
    constexpr double demoPlaySeconds = 10.0, demoSilentSeconds = 2.0, demoMidiBlockedSeconds = 3.0;

    /** What a protected plugin's runtime expects in its shared block while it's licensed
        (stella_licence.h works it out the same way from the id built into it). */
    std::uint32_t runtimeToken (const juce::String& productId);
}

#include "LiveController.h"
#include "Preferences.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace LiveControl
{
/** Windows leaves the window out of every screen capture (elsewhere: nothing to do). */
void hideFromCaptures (juce::Component& window);

namespace
{
    // Its colours (the Live Show's).
    const juce::Colour ground { 0xff141519 };
    const juce::Colour panelColour { 0xff1b1c20 };
    const juce::Colour widget { 0xff23252a };
    const juce::Colour line { 0xff33363d };
    const juce::Colour ink { 0xffe8eaed };
    const juce::Colour muted { 0xff9aa0a8 };
    const juce::Colour red { 0xffff4d57 };
    const juce::Colour amber { 0xffffcf45 };
    const juce::Colour green { 0xff46c27a };
    const juce::Colour blue { 0xff3fa9f5 };
    const juce::Colour grey { 0xff8a8f98 };
    const juce::Colour learnColour { 0xffffd84a };

    constexpr int formatVersion = 1;
    constexpr float smallestBox = 0.06f;            // a Custom box at its smallest (of the picture's width or height)
    constexpr float boxMargin = 0.03f;              // where boxes snap, in from the picture's edges
    constexpr float snapReach = 0.012f;

    juce::var boxToVar (juce::Rectangle<float> box)
    {
        const auto round = [] (float v) { return std::round (v * 10000.0f) / 10000.0; };
        return juce::Array<juce::var> { round (box.getX()), round (box.getY()), round (box.getWidth()), round (box.getHeight()) };
    }

    /** A box from a file, kept inside the picture and not too small (fallback when it isn't one). */
    juce::Rectangle<float> boxFromVar (const juce::var& value, juce::Rectangle<float> fallback)
    {
        const auto* list = value.getArray();

        if (list == nullptr || list->size() != 4)
            return fallback;

        auto w = juce::jlimit (smallestBox, 1.0f, static_cast<float> (static_cast<double> ((*list)[2])));
        auto h = juce::jlimit (smallestBox, 1.0f, static_cast<float> (static_cast<double> ((*list)[3])));
        auto x = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f - w, static_cast<float> (static_cast<double> ((*list)[0])));
        auto y = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f - h, static_cast<float> (static_cast<double> ((*list)[1])));

        if (! std::isfinite (x + y + w + h))
            return fallback;

        return { x, y, w, h };
    }

    /** Main's focus in the vertical picture from a file (0 .. 1; fallback when it isn't one). */
    float focusFromVar (const juce::var& value, float fallback)
    {
        if (! (value.isDouble() || value.isInt() || value.isInt64()))
            return fallback;

        const auto focus = static_cast<float> (static_cast<double> (value));
        return std::isfinite (focus) ? juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, focus) : fallback;
    }

    /** One row Main at most: the first that says so keeps it. */
    template <typename Rows>
    void oneMain (Rows& rows)
    {
        bool found = false;

        for (auto& row : rows)
        {
            if (row.show != Show::main)
                continue;

            if (found)
                row.show = Show::hidden;

            found = true;
        }
    }

    /** "Camera 1 - Main", "Preset - Intro", "Enable streaming" (a dot between, as chips show it). */
    juce::String actionText (const juce::String& action)
    {
        const auto parts = juce::StringArray::fromTokens (action, ".", "");
        const juce::String dot (juce::CharPointer_UTF8 (" \xc2\xb7 "));

        if (parts.size() == 3 && parts[0] == "row")
        {
            const auto show = parts[2] == "main" ? "Main" : parts[2] == "custom" ? "Custom" : "Hidden";
            return rowName (parts[1].getIntValue() - 1) + dot + show;
        }

        if (action.startsWith ("preset."))
            return "Preset" + dot + action.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("preset.", false, false);

        if (action == "show.monitor")       return "Monitor";
        if (action == "switch.stream")      return "Enable streaming";
        if (action == "switch.mics")        return "Mute mics";
        if (action == "switch.playback")    return "Mute playback";

        return action;
    }

    /** A MIDI port's name without what Windows puts round it ("MIDIIN2 (Pad)" and "MIDIOUT2 (Pad)"
        are one device). */
    juce::String deviceNameOf (const juce::String& port)
    {
        auto name = port.trim();

        for (const auto* prefix : { "MIDIIN", "MIDIOUT" })
        {
            if (name.startsWithIgnoreCase (prefix))
            {
                name = name.substring (juce::String (prefix).length()).trimStart();

                while (name.isNotEmpty() && juce::CharacterFunctions::isDigit (name[0]))
                    name = name.substring (1);

                name = name.trim();

                if (name.startsWithChar ('(') && name.endsWithChar (')'))
                    name = name.substring (1, name.length() - 1).trim();
            }
        }

        return name;
    }

}

//==============================================================================
juce::String rowName (int row)
{
    return row == screenRow ? juce::String ("Screen") : "Camera " + juce::String (row + 1);
}

juce::String showName (Show show)
{
    return show == Show::main ? "main" : show == Show::custom ? "custom" : "hidden";
}

Show showFromName (const juce::String& name)
{
    return name == "main" ? Show::main : name == "custom" ? Show::custom : Show::hidden;
}

juce::Rectangle<float> Setup::standardBox (int row)
{
    // Out of each other's way: the cameras in the corners (bottom ones first, the title and the
    // logo are at the top), the screen in the middle.
    constexpr float size = 0.3f;
    const auto farEdge = 1.0f - boxMargin - size;

    switch (row)
    {
        case 0:  return { farEdge, farEdge, size, size };
        case 1:  return { boxMargin, farEdge, size, size };
        case 2:  return { farEdge, 0.16f, size, size };
        case 3:  return { boxMargin, 0.16f, size, size };
        default: return { 0.35f, 0.35f, size, size };
    }
}

juce::Rectangle<float> Setup::standardTallBox (int row)
{
    // A camera's shape in the vertical picture (16:9, 42% of its width), clear of what TikTok's
    // app puts over it: two above its comments at the bottom, two under the title at the top; the
    // screen across the middle.
    constexpr float width = 0.42f;
    constexpr float height = width * (9.0f / 16.0f) * (9.0f / 16.0f);
    const auto farEdge = 1.0f - boxMargin - width;

    switch (row)
    {
        case 0:  return { farEdge, 0.62f, width, height };
        case 1:  return { boxMargin, 0.62f, width, height };
        case 2:  return { farEdge, 0.15f, width, height };
        case 3:  return { boxMargin, 0.15f, width, height };
        default: return { 0.04f, 0.36f, 0.92f, 0.92f * (9.0f / 16.0f) * (9.0f / 16.0f) };
    }
}

Setup Setup::standard()
{
    Setup made;

    for (int r = 0; r < numRows; ++r)
    {
        made.rows[static_cast<size_t> (r)].box = standardBox (r);
        made.rows[static_cast<size_t> (r)].tallBox = standardTallBox (r);
    }

    made.rows[0].device = "test";
    made.rows[0].show = Show::main;
    return made;
}

juce::var Setup::toVar() const
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr object (new juce::DynamicObject());
    object->setProperty ("format", formatVersion);
    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& row : rows)
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
        item->setProperty ("device", row.device);
        item->setProperty ("show", showName (row.show));
        item->setProperty ("box", boxToVar (row.box));
        item->setProperty ("tallBox", boxToVar (row.tallBox));
        item->setProperty ("focus", std::round (row.tallFocus * 1000.0f) / 1000.0);
        item->setProperty ("delay", row.delayMs);
        list.add (juce::var (item.get()));
    }

    object->setProperty ("rows", list);
    object->setProperty ("view", viewTall ? "vertical" : "landscape");
    object->setProperty ("midiPort", midiPort);
    object->setProperty ("lights", lights);

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr padList (new juce::DynamicObject());

    for (const auto& [action, source] : pads)
        padList->setProperty (action, source);

    object->setProperty ("pads", juce::var (padList.get()));
    object->setProperty ("preset", preset);

    if (! window.isEmpty())
        object->setProperty ("window", juce::Array<juce::var> { window.getX(), window.getY(), window.getWidth(), window.getHeight() });

    if (! monitor.isEmpty())
        object->setProperty ("monitor", juce::Array<juce::var> { monitor.getX(), monitor.getY(), monitor.getWidth(), monitor.getHeight() });

    object->setProperty ("monitorMode", monitorMode);
    return juce::var (object.get());
}

Setup Setup::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    auto made = standard();

    if (! value.isObject())
        return made;

    if (const auto* list = value.getProperty ("rows", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (int r = 0; r < juce::jmin (numRows, list->size()); ++r)
        {
            const auto& item = (*list)[r];
            auto& row = made.rows[static_cast<size_t> (r)];
            row.device = item.getProperty ("device", {}).toString().trim();
            row.show = row.device.isEmpty() ? Show::hidden : showFromName (item.getProperty ("show", "hidden").toString());
            row.box = boxFromVar (item.getProperty ("box", {}), standardBox (r));
            row.tallBox = boxFromVar (item.getProperty ("tallBox", {}), standardTallBox (r));
            row.tallFocus = focusFromVar (item.getProperty ("focus", 0.5), 0.5f);
            row.delayMs = r == screenRow ? 0 : juce::jlimit (0, LiveStream::maxDelayMs, static_cast<int> (item.getProperty ("delay", 0)));
        }
    }

    oneMain (made.rows);
    made.viewTall = value.getProperty ("view", "landscape").toString() == "vertical";
    made.midiPort = value.getProperty ("midiPort", {}).toString();
    made.lights = static_cast<bool> (value.getProperty ("lights", true));

    if (auto* padList = value.getProperty ("pads", {}).getDynamicObject())
        for (const auto& pad : padList->getProperties())
            if (MidiLink::Source::fromKey (pad.value.toString()).has_value())
                made.pads[pad.name.toString()] = pad.value.toString();

    made.preset = value.getProperty ("preset", {}).toString();

    if (const auto* area = value.getProperty ("window", {}).getArray(); area != nullptr && area->size() == 4)
        made.window = { static_cast<int> ((*area)[0]), static_cast<int> ((*area)[1]), static_cast<int> ((*area)[2]), static_cast<int> ((*area)[3]) };

    if (const auto* area = value.getProperty ("monitor", {}).getArray(); area != nullptr && area->size() == 4)
        made.monitor = { static_cast<int> ((*area)[0]), static_cast<int> ((*area)[1]), static_cast<int> ((*area)[2]), static_cast<int> ((*area)[3]) };

    const auto mode = value.getProperty ("monitorMode", "normal").toString();
    made.monitorMode = mode == "min" || mode == "max" ? mode : juce::String ("normal");
    return made;
}

//==============================================================================
namespace
{
    /** Its lists' and buttons' words, the size of the rest of it. */
    class ControllerLook final : public juce::LookAndFeel_V4
    {
    public:
        juce::Font getTextButtonFont (juce::TextButton&, int buttonHeight) override
        {
            return juce::FontOptions (juce::jmin (13.0f, static_cast<float> (buttonHeight) * 0.55f));
        }

        juce::Font getComboBoxFont (juce::ComboBox& box) override
        {
            return juce::FontOptions (juce::jmin (13.0f, static_cast<float> (box.getHeight()) * 0.6f));
        }

        juce::Font getPopupMenuFont() override
        {
            return juce::FontOptions (13.5f);
        }
    };

    /** A button of the Controller's: a pill that's lit while its thing is on, with its pad's name
        in a chip at its corner, and, while Learn is on, a dashed edge (solid and blinking while
        it waits for its pad). */
    class PadButton final : public juce::Button
    {
    public:
        PadButton (juce::String actionKey, const juce::String& label, juce::Colour accent)
            : juce::Button (label), action (std::move (actionKey)), colour (accent)
        {
            setWantsKeyboardFocus (false);
        }

        juce::String action;
        juce::Colour colour;
        bool lit = false;
        bool lamp = false;                  // a dot by its words (blinking while lit, for Enable streaming)
        juce::String pad;                   // its pad's name ("C3", "CC 20")
        bool learnMode = false, armed = false, blinkOn = true;
        std::function<void (bool rightClick)> onPress;

        /** Its look from the Controller: true when it changed. */
        bool update (bool nowLit, const juce::String& nowPad, bool nowLearning, bool nowArmed, bool nowBlink)
        {
            if (nowLit == lit && nowPad == pad && nowLearning == learnMode && nowArmed == armed && (! armed || nowBlink == blinkOn) && (! lamp || ! lit || nowBlink == blinkOn))
                return false;

            lit = nowLit;
            pad = nowPad;
            learnMode = nowLearning;
            armed = nowArmed;
            blinkOn = nowBlink;
            repaint();
            return true;
        }

        void clicked (const juce::ModifierKeys& modifiers) override
        {
            if (onPress != nullptr)
                onPress (modifiers.isPopupMenu());
        }

        void paintButton (juce::Graphics& g, bool over, bool down) override
        {
            auto area = getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (1.5f);
            const auto radius = area.getHeight() * 0.5f;
            auto fill = lit ? colour.withMultipliedBrightness (0.62f).withMultipliedSaturation (0.95f) : widget;

            if (down)
                fill = fill.brighter (0.12f);
            else if (over && ! lit)
                fill = fill.brighter (0.05f);

            g.setColour (fill);
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (area, radius);
            g.setColour (lit ? colour : colour.withAlpha (over ? 0.75f : 0.4f));
            g.drawRoundedRectangle (area, radius, lit ? 1.5f : 1.0f);

            auto words = area.reduced (radius * 0.6f, 0.0f);

            if (lamp)
            {
                const auto dot = juce::Rectangle<float> (9.0f, 9.0f).withCentre ({ words.getX() + 6.0f, area.getCentreY() });
                g.setColour (lit ? (blinkOn ? colour.brighter (0.3f) : colour.withAlpha (0.55f)) : colour.withAlpha (0.3f));
                g.fillEllipse (dot);

                if (lit && blinkOn)
                {
                    g.setColour (colour.withAlpha (0.35f));
                    g.fillEllipse (dot.expanded (3.0f));
                }

                words.removeFromLeft (14.0f);
            }

            g.setColour (lit ? juce::Colours::white : ink.withAlpha (0.88f));
            g.setFont (juce::FontOptions (12.0f, juce::Font::bold));
            g.drawFittedText (getButtonText(), words.toNearestInt(), juce::Justification::centred, 1);

            // Its pad, in a chip at the top right.
            if (pad.isNotEmpty())
            {
                const juce::Font chipFont (juce::FontOptions (9.5f, juce::Font::bold));
                const auto chipWidth = juce::GlyphArrangement::getStringWidth (chipFont, pad) + 8.0f;
                const juce::Rectangle<float> chip (getWidth() - chipWidth - 1.0f, 0.0f, chipWidth, 13.0f);
                g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff0d0e11).withAlpha (0.9f));
                g.fillRoundedRectangle (chip, 4.0f);
                g.setColour (learnColour.withAlpha (0.9f));
                g.drawRoundedRectangle (chip.reduced (0.5f), 4.0f, 1.0f);
                g.setFont (chipFont);
                g.drawText (pad, chip, juce::Justification::centred, false);
            }

            // Learning: a dashed edge; waiting for its pad: blinking.
            if (learnMode)
            {
                juce::Path outline;
                outline.addRoundedRectangle (area.expanded (0.5f), radius);

                if (armed)
                {
                    g.setColour (learnColour.withAlpha (blinkOn ? 0.35f : 0.12f));
                    g.fillPath (outline);
                    g.setColour (learnColour);
                    g.strokePath (outline, juce::PathStrokeType (2.0f));
                }
                else
                {
                    juce::Path dashed;
                    const float dashes[] { 4.0f, 3.0f };
                    juce::PathStrokeType (1.5f).createDashedStroke (dashed, outline, dashes, 2);
                    g.setColour (learnColour.withAlpha (0.8f));
                    g.fillPath (dashed);
                }
            }
        }
    };
}

//==============================================================================
/** The Controller's window: the preview with its boxes, the rows, the presets, the show's switches
    and the MIDI bar. */
class Controller::Panel final : public juce::Component,
                                private juce::Timer
{
public:
    explicit Panel (Controller& owner)
        : controller (owner), preview (*this), presets (*this)
    {
        lookAndFeel.setColourScheme ({ ground, widget, panelColour, line, ink, green, juce::Colours::white, green.darker (0.5f), ink });
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::ListBox::backgroundColourId, panelColour);
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::ListBox::outlineColourId, line);
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, widget);
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId, ink);
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::ComboBox::backgroundColourId, widget);
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::ComboBox::outlineColourId, line);
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::Slider::trackColourId, blue.withAlpha (0.7f));
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::Slider::backgroundColourId, widget.brighter (0.1f));
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::Slider::thumbColourId, ink);
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxBackgroundColourId, widget);
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxOutlineColourId, line);
        lookAndFeel.setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxTextColourId, ink);
        setLookAndFeel (&lookAndFeel);

        for (auto* button : { &streamButton, &micsButton, &playbackButton, &monitorButton })
        {
            addAndMakeVisible (*button);
            button->onPress = [this, button] (bool rightClick) { press (button->action, rightClick); };
        }

        streamButton.lamp = true;
        monitorButton.setTooltip ("Monitor: the picture exactly as the viewers see it, in a small window over every other (never in the stream)");
        streamButton.setTooltip ("Enable streaming: the picture and the sound go out to the stream (off: viewers see the show's name)");
        micsButton.setTooltip ("Mute mics: the live channels go silent");
        playbackButton.setTooltip ("Mute playback: the player, the decks and the pads go silent");
        addAndMakeVisible (preview);

        for (int r = 0; r < numRows; ++r)
        {
            rows[static_cast<size_t> (r)] = std::make_unique<RowView> (*this, r);
            addAndMakeVisible (*rows[static_cast<size_t> (r)]);
        }

        addAndMakeVisible (presets);

        for (auto* button : { &saveButton, &saveAsButton, &renameButton, &deleteButton, &folderButton })
            addAndMakeVisible (*button);

        saveButton.setTooltip ("Keep the rows as they are now in the preset picked");
        saveAsButton.setTooltip ("Keep the rows as they are now as a new preset");
        renameButton.setTooltip ("Give the preset picked another name");
        deleteButton.setTooltip ("Delete the preset picked");
        folderButton.setTooltip ("Show the presets' folder");
        saveButton.onClick = [this] { saveCurrent(); };
        saveAsButton.onClick = [this] { saveAs(); };
        renameButton.onClick = [this] { renamePicked(); };
        deleteButton.onClick = [this] { deletePicked(); };
        folderButton.onClick = [] { auto folder = Controller::getPresetsFolder(); folder.createDirectory(); folder.revealToUser(); };

        midiLabel.setText ("MIDI", juce::dontSendNotification);
        midiLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, muted);
        midiLabel.setFont (juce::FontOptions (11.0f, juce::Font::bold));
        addAndMakeVisible (midiLabel);
        addAndMakeVisible (midiPorts);
        midiPorts.setTooltip ("The MIDI device the Controller listens to");
        midiPorts.onChange = [this] { midiPortPicked(); };

        for (auto* button : { &learnButton, &lightsButton })
        {
            addAndMakeVisible (*button);
            button->onPress = [this, button] (bool) { press (button->action, false); };
        }

        learnButton.setTooltip ("Learn: click a button, then press a pad on your device (right-click a button: forget its pad)");
        lightsButton.setTooltip ("Pad lights: your controller's pads light up for what's live (when it has lights)");
        addAndMakeVisible (lookAgain);
        lookAgain.setTooltip ("Look for cameras again (one plugged in since)");
        lookAgain.onClick = [this] { refreshDevices (true); };

        status.setJustificationType (juce::Justification::centredRight);
        status.setFont (juce::FontOptions (13.0f, juce::Font::bold));
        addAndMakeVisible (status);
        note.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, muted);
        note.setFont (juce::FontOptions (12.0f));
        addAndMakeVisible (note);

        refreshDevices (false);
        refreshMidiPorts();
        presets.refresh();
        refreshLit();
        startTimerHz (15);
    }

    ~Panel() override
    {
        ask = nullptr;
        setLookAndFeel (nullptr);
    }

    /** Words on its line, for a while. */
    void setNote (const juce::String& words)
    {
        note.setText (words, juce::dontSendNotification);
        noteUntil = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes() + 10000.0;
    }

    /** The rows' cameras and screens, as Sonify finds them (again: looked for anew). */
    void refreshDevices (bool again)
    {
        cameras = controller.host.controllerCameras (again);
        screens = controller.host.controllerScreens();

        for (auto& row : rows)
            row->refreshDevices();

        if (again)
            setNote (juce::String (static_cast<int> (std::count_if (cameras.begin(), cameras.end(), [] (const LiveStream::Device& d) { return d.id != "test"; })))
                     + " cameras found.");
    }

    void refreshMidiPorts()
    {
        knownPorts = controller.host.controllerMidiPorts();
        midiPortNames = knownPorts;
        const auto& chosen = controller.getSetup().midiPort;

        if (chosen.isNotEmpty() && ! midiPortNames.contains (chosen))
            midiPortNames.add (chosen);   // not there now: shown as it was chosen

        midiPorts.clear (juce::dontSendNotification);
        midiPorts.addItem ("No MIDI device", 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < midiPortNames.size(); ++i)
            midiPorts.addItem (midiPortNames[i] + (knownPorts.contains (midiPortNames[i]) ? juce::String() : juce::String (" (not connected)")), i + 2);

        midiPorts.setSelectedId (chosen.isEmpty() ? 1 : midiPortNames.indexOf (chosen) + 2, juce::dontSendNotification);
    }

    /** Every button's light, pad and learning look; the rows and the list as the Controller has them. */
    void refreshLit()
    {
        const auto learnMode = controller.isLearnMode();
        const auto& learning = controller.getLearning();
        const auto blink = blinkOn;
        const auto look = [&] (PadButton& button)
        {
            button.update (controller.isLit (button.action), controller.padLabel (button.action), learnMode, learning == button.action, blink);
        };

        look (streamButton);
        look (micsButton);
        look (playbackButton);
        look (monitorButton);
        learnButton.update (learnMode, {}, false, false, blink);
        lightsButton.update (controller.getSetup().lights, {}, false, false, blink);

        for (auto& row : rows)
        {
            for (auto* button : row->buttons())
                look (*button);

            row->refresh();
        }

        // The list drawn again when what it shows changed (and while it blinks for a pad).
        const auto listLook = controller.getSetup().preset + "|" + juce::String ((int) controller.isPresetChanged()) + "|"
                            + juce::String ((int) learnMode) + "|" + learning + "|" + juce::String ((int) (learning.startsWith ("preset.") && blink))
                            + "|" + juce::String (static_cast<int> (controller.getSetup().pads.size()));

        if (listLook != presetsLook)
        {
            presetsLook = listLook;
            presets.list.repaint();
        }

        renameButton.setEnabled (controller.getSetup().preset.isNotEmpty());
        deleteButton.setEnabled (controller.getSetup().preset.isNotEmpty());

        // How the stream goes.
        bool live = false;
        const auto words = controller.host.controllerStatus (live);

        if (words != status.getText() || live != statusLive)
        {
            statusLive = live;
            status.setText (words, juce::dontSendNotification);
            status.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, live ? red : muted);
        }
    }

    /** A button pressed: learning, it's armed (a right-click forgets its pad); else it does its thing. */
    void press (const juce::String& action, bool rightClick)
    {
        if (action == "learn")
        {
            if (! controller.isLearnMode() && controller.getSetup().midiPort.isEmpty())
            {
                setNote ("Choose your MIDI device first (the list beside Learn).");
                return;
            }

            controller.setLearnMode (! controller.isLearnMode());
            setNote (controller.isLearnMode() ? "Learn: click a button, then press a pad on your device. Right-click a button to forget its pad."
                                              : juce::String());
            refreshLit();
            return;
        }

        if (action == "lights")
        {
            controller.setLights (! controller.getSetup().lights);
            refreshLit();
            return;
        }

        if (controller.isLearnMode())
        {
            if (rightClick)
                controller.forget (action);
            else
                controller.learn (action);

            refreshLit();
            return;
        }

        if (! rightClick)
            controller.perform (action);

        refreshLit();
    }

    void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override
    {
        g.fillAll (ground);
        g.setColour (panelColour);
        g.fillRect (topBar);
        g.fillRect (bottomBar);
        g.fillRect (presetArea);
        g.setColour (line);
        g.fillRect (topBar.removeFromBottom (1));
        g.fillRect (bottomBar.removeFromTop (1));
        g.fillRect (presetArea.removeFromLeft (1));

        g.setColour (muted);
        g.setFont (juce::FontOptions (10.5f, juce::Font::bold));
        g.drawText ("PRESETS", presetTitle, juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);
        g.drawText ("Click one: it's on, at once", presetTitle.withTrimmedLeft (70), juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);
    }

    void resized() override
    {
        auto area = getLocalBounds();
        topBar = area.removeFromTop (52);
        bottomBar = area.removeFromBottom (48);
        presetArea = area.removeFromRight (250);

        // The show's switches, and how the stream goes.
        auto top = topBar.reduced (14, 10);
        streamButton.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (180));
        top.removeFromLeft (10);
        micsButton.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (120));
        top.removeFromLeft (8);
        playbackButton.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (140));
        top.removeFromLeft (16);
        monitorButton.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (110));
        top.removeFromLeft (12);
        status.setBounds (top);

        // The presets.
        auto list = presetArea.reduced (12, 10);
        presetTitle = list.removeFromTop (22);
        auto buttons = list.removeFromBottom (64);
        list.removeFromBottom (8);
        presets.setBounds (list);
        auto firstLine = buttons.removeFromTop (28);
        saveButton.setBounds (firstLine.removeFromLeft (firstLine.getWidth() / 2 - 3));
        firstLine.removeFromLeft (6);
        saveAsButton.setBounds (firstLine);
        buttons.removeFromTop (8);
        const auto third = (buttons.getWidth() - 12) / 3;
        renameButton.setBounds (buttons.removeFromLeft (third));
        buttons.removeFromLeft (6);
        deleteButton.setBounds (buttons.removeFromLeft (third));
        buttons.removeFromLeft (6);
        folderButton.setBounds (buttons);

        // The rows under the preview.
        auto left = area.reduced (14, 12);
        constexpr int rowHeight = 64, rowGap = 6;
        auto rowsArea = left.removeFromBottom (numRows * rowHeight + (numRows - 1) * rowGap);
        left.removeFromBottom (10);
        preview.setBounds (left);

        for (auto& row : rows)
        {
            row->setBounds (rowsArea.removeFromTop (rowHeight));
            rowsArea.removeFromTop (rowGap);
        }

        // MIDI.
        auto bottom = bottomBar.reduced (14, 10);
        midiLabel.setBounds (bottom.removeFromLeft (38));
        midiPorts.setBounds (bottom.removeFromLeft (240));
        bottom.removeFromLeft (10);
        learnButton.setBounds (bottom.removeFromLeft (84));
        bottom.removeFromLeft (8);
        lightsButton.setBounds (bottom.removeFromLeft (104));
        bottom.removeFromLeft (14);
        lookAgain.setBounds (bottom.removeFromRight (180));
        bottom.removeFromRight (10);
        note.setBounds (bottom);
    }

private:
    //==============================================================================
    /** The picture laid out (the landscape one or the vertical one, by the tabs over it), and the
        Custom boxes over it: dragged to move, by the corner to size (Shift keeps the box's shape).
        In the vertical picture, dragging across Main picks the part of it that shows. */
    class Preview final : public juce::Component
    {
    public:
        explicit Preview (Panel& p) : panel (p) {}

        void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override
        {
            const auto tall = isTall();

            // The tabs: which picture it shows.
            for (const auto which : { false, true })
            {
                const auto area = tabArea (which);
                const auto on = which == tall;
                g.setColour (on ? widget.brighter (0.25f) : widget);
                g.fillRoundedRectangle (area, 4.0f);
                g.setColour (on ? blue : line);
                g.drawRoundedRectangle (area.reduced (0.5f), 4.0f, 1.0f);
                g.setColour (on ? ink : muted);
                g.setFont (juce::FontOptions (11.5f, on ? juce::Font::bold : juce::Font::plain));
                g.drawText (tabText (which), area, juce::Justification::centred, false);
            }

            g.setColour (muted);
            g.setFont (juce::FontOptions (11.0f));
            g.drawText (tall ? "Drag across the picture: the part of Main that shows. Each box has its place here too."
                             : "Each box: dragged to move, by its corner to size (Shift keeps its shape).",
                        hintArea(), juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);

            const auto frame = frameArea();
            g.setColour (juce::Colours::black);
            g.fillRect (frame);
            const auto picture = tall ? panel.controller.host.controllerTallPicture() : panel.controller.host.controllerPicture();

            if (picture.isValid())
            {
                g.setImageResamplingQuality (juce::Graphics::lowResamplingQuality);
                g.drawImage (picture, frame, juce::RectanglePlacement::centred);
            }
            else
            {
                g.setColour (muted);
                g.setFont (juce::FontOptions (13.0f));
                g.drawFittedText ("The picture shows here once the cameras open", frame.toNearestInt().reduced (8), juce::Justification::centred, 3);
            }

            // The boxes: their edge, their name, their corner.
            const auto& setup = panel.controller.getSetup();

            for (int r = 0; r < numRows; ++r)
            {
                const auto& row = setup.rows[static_cast<size_t> (r)];

                if (row.show != Show::custom || row.device.isEmpty())
                    continue;

                const auto box = onScreen (boxOf (row));
                const bool active = r == dragRow || (dragRow < 0 && r == hoverRow);
                juce::Path outline;
                outline.addRectangle (box);

                if (active)
                {
                    g.setColour (blue);
                    g.strokePath (outline, juce::PathStrokeType (2.0f));
                }
                else
                {
                    juce::Path dashed;
                    const float dashes[] { 5.0f, 4.0f };
                    juce::PathStrokeType (1.2f).createDashedStroke (dashed, outline, dashes, 2);
                    g.setColour (juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.75f));
                    g.fillPath (dashed);
                }

                const juce::Font font (juce::FontOptions (11.0f, juce::Font::bold));
                const auto name = rowName (r);
                const juce::Rectangle<float> tag (box.getX(), box.getY(), juce::GlyphArrangement::getStringWidth (font, name) + 10.0f, 16.0f);
                g.setColour ((active ? blue : juce::Colour (0xff0d0e11)).withAlpha (0.85f));
                g.fillRect (tag);
                g.setColour (juce::Colours::white);
                g.setFont (font);
                g.drawText (name, tag, juce::Justification::centred, false);

                const auto grip = gripOf (box);
                g.setColour (active ? blue : juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.85f));
                g.fillRect (grip.reduced (2.0f));
            }

            // Streaming not enabled: what goes out is the show's name.
            if (! panel.controller.host.controllerSwitch ("stream"))
            {
                const juce::String words (tall ? "Streaming not enabled" : "Streaming not enabled: viewers see the show's name");
                const juce::Font font (juce::FontOptions (11.5f, juce::Font::bold));
                const auto badgeWidth = juce::jmin (frame.getWidth() - 16.0f, juce::GlyphArrangement::getStringWidth (font, words) + 16.0f);
                const juce::Rectangle<float> badge (frame.getX() + 8.0f, frame.getBottom() - 26.0f, badgeWidth, 19.0f);
                g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff3a0f14).withAlpha (0.9f));
                g.fillRoundedRectangle (badge, 4.0f);
                g.setColour (red);
                g.drawRoundedRectangle (badge.reduced (0.5f), 4.0f, 1.0f);
                g.setColour (juce::Colours::white);
                g.setFont (font);
                g.drawFittedText (words, badge.toNearestInt(), juce::Justification::centred, 1);
            }

            g.setColour (line);
            g.drawRect (frame.expanded (1.0f), 1.0f);
        }

        void mouseMove (const juce::MouseEvent& e) override
        {
            bool corner = false;
            const auto row = boxAt (e.position, corner);

            if (row != hoverRow)
            {
                hoverRow = row;
                repaint();
            }

            const auto overTab = tabArea (false).contains (e.position) || tabArea (true).contains (e.position);
            setMouseCursor (overTab ? juce::MouseCursor::PointingHandCursor
                          : row >= 0 ? (corner ? juce::MouseCursor::BottomRightCornerResizeCursor : juce::MouseCursor::DraggingHandCursor)
                          : isTall() && mainRow() >= 0 && frameArea().contains (e.position) ? juce::MouseCursor::LeftRightResizeCursor
                                                                                             : juce::MouseCursor::NormalCursor);
        }

        void mouseExit (const juce::MouseEvent&) override
        {
            if (hoverRow >= 0 && dragRow < 0)
