// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\LivePreview.cpp

#include "LivePreview.h"
#include "WasmCompiler.h"
#include "WasmElements.h"

#include <map>

//==============================================================================
LivePreview::LivePreview (CreatorAudio& creatorAudio)
    : audio (creatorAudio)
{
    startTimerHz (4);   // notices a plugin that stopped
}

LivePreview::~LivePreview()
{
    stopTimer();
    alive->store (false);
    worker.removeAllJobs (true, 10000);
}

void LivePreview::setState (State newState, const juce::String& newStatus)
{
    state = newState;
    status = newStatus;

    if (onChanged != nullptr)
        onChanged();
}

//==============================================================================
void LivePreview::build (const juce::File& projectFolder, const juce::String& projectId, std::function<void (bool)> done)
{
    const auto thisBuild = ++generation;
    setState (State::building, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Building\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    const auto rate = audio.getCurrentSampleRate();
    const auto block = audio.getCurrentBlockSize();

    worker.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, thisBuild, projectFolder, projectId, rate, block, done]
    {
        const auto compiled = WasmCompiler::compile (projectFolder, projectId);

        std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes, elementsBytes;
        auto holder = std::make_shared<std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin>>();
        std::string error;

        // The GUI's programmed elements: built and started once the sound has built.
        WasmCompiler::Result elementsCompiled;
        std::shared_ptr<WasmElements> elements;
        std::string elementsError;

        auto loadFile = [] (const juce::File& file)
        {
            juce::MemoryBlock data;
            file.loadFileAsData (data);
            return std::vector<std::uint8_t> (static_cast<const std::uint8_t*> (data.getData()),
                                              static_cast<const std::uint8_t*> (data.getData()) + data.getSize());
        };

        if (compiled.ok)
        {
            bytes = loadFile (compiled.wasm);
            *holder = WasmPlugin::load (bytes, rate, block, error);

            elementsCompiled = WasmCompiler::compileElements (projectFolder, projectId);

            if (elementsCompiled.ok && elementsCompiled.wasm != juce::File())
            {
                elementsBytes = loadFile (elementsCompiled.wasm);
                elements = WasmElements::load (elementsBytes, elementsError);
            }
        }

        juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([this, stillAlive, thisBuild, compiled, bytes, elementsBytes, holder, error, rate, done,
                                          elementsCompiled, elements, elementsError]
        {
            if (! stillAlive->load())
                return;

            if (thisBuild != generation)
            {
                if (done != nullptr)
                    done (false);   // a newer build took over

                return;
            }

            const bool hasElements = elementsCompiled.wasm != juce::File();

            if (! compiled.ok)
            {
                log = compiled.log;
                setState (State::failed, "Build failed: see the log");
            }
            else if (! elementsCompiled.ok)
            {
                log = "The GUI's programmed elements didn't build:\n" + elementsCompiled.log;
                setState (State::failed, "The GUI's elements didn't build: see the log");
            }
            else if (hasElements && elements == nullptr)
            {
                log = "The GUI's programmed elements built, but didn't start: " + juce::String (elementsError);
                setState (State::failed, "The GUI's elements didn't start: see the log");
            }
            else if (*holder == nullptr)
            {
                log = (compiled.log.isNotEmpty() ? compiled.log + "\n\n" : juce::String()) + juce::String (error);
                setState (State::failed, "Built, but it didn't start: see the log");
            }
            else
            {
                wasm = bytes;
                elementsWasm = elementsBytes;
                loadedRate = rate;
                log = compiled.log;

                if (elementsCompiled.log.isNotEmpty())
                    log << (log.isNotEmpty() ? "\n\n" : "") << "GUI elements:\n" << elementsCompiled.log;

                install (std::move (*holder));
                elementsProblem.clear();

                if (onElements != nullptr)
                    onElements (elements);

                setState (State::playing, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Playing \xc2\xb7 built in ")
                                              + juce::String (compiled.seconds + elementsCompiled.seconds, 1) + " s");
            }

            if (done != nullptr)
                done (state == State::playing);
        });
    });
}

void LivePreview::deviceChanged()
{
    const auto rate = audio.getCurrentSampleRate();

    if (wasm.empty() || state != State::playing || std::abs (rate - loadedRate) < 1.0)
        return;

    // Same plugin, restarted at the new sample rate; parameters carry over.
    const auto thisBuild = ++generation;
    const auto block = audio.getCurrentBlockSize();
    const auto bytes = wasm;

    worker.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, thisBuild, bytes, rate, block]
    {
        auto holder = std::make_shared<std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin>>();
        std::string error;
        *holder = WasmPlugin::load (bytes, rate, block, error);

        juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([this, stillAlive, thisBuild, holder, error, rate]
        {
            if (! stillAlive->load() || thisBuild != generation)
                return;

            if (*holder == nullptr)
            {
                log = juce::String (error);
                setState (State::failed, "Didn't restart at the new sample rate: see the log");
                return;
            }

            loadedRate = rate;
            install (std::move (*holder));
            setState (State::playing, status);
        });
    });
}

void LivePreview::unload()
{
    ++generation;
    audio.setPlugin (nullptr);

    elementsProblem.clear();

    if (onElements != nullptr)
        onElements (nullptr);

    wasm.clear();
    elementsWasm.clear();
    log.clear();
    params.clear();
    modules.clear();
    displays.clear();
    bypassed.clear();
    probeModule.clear();
    ++paramsVersion;
    setState (State::idle, {});
}

//==============================================================================
void LivePreview::install (std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin> plugin)
{
    // Values the user set carry over to the new version, matched by parameter id.
    std::map<juce::String, float> previous;

    for (const auto& p : params)
        previous[p.id] = getParameterValue (p.index);

    auto newParams = parseParameters (plugin->getDescription());

    for (const auto& p : newParams)
        if (const auto found = previous.find (p.id); found != previous.end())
            plugin->setParameter (p.index, found->second);

    params = newParams;
    ++paramsVersion;

    // The modules and their ports, for the schematic.
    modules.clear();
    const auto json = juce::JSON::parse (juce::String (plugin->getDescription()));

    if (const auto* list = json.getProperty ("modules", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < list->size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto& item = list->getReference (i);
            ModuleInfo info;
            info.index = i;
            info.id = item.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();
            info.type = item.getProperty ("type", {}).toString();
            info.name = item.getProperty ("name", {}).toString();

            if (const auto* ins = item.getProperty ("inputs", {}).getArray())
                for (const auto& port : *ins)
                    info.inputs.add (port.toString());

            if (const auto* outs = item.getProperty ("outputs", {}).getArray())
                for (const auto& port : *outs)
                    info.outputs.add (port.toString());

            modules.add (info);
        }
    }

    displays.clear();

    if (const auto* list = json.getProperty ("displays", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& item : *list)
            displays.add ({ (int) item.getProperty ("index", 0), item.getProperty ("id", {}).toString(),
                            item.getProperty ("module", {}).toString(), item.getProperty ("name", {}).toString() });

    plugin->setLibrary (library);
    audio.setPlugin (std::move (plugin));
    applyBypassAndProbe();
    applyGuiSources();
}

void LivePreview::setLibrary (std::vector<stella::blob::Entry> instruments)
{
    library = std::move (instruments);

    if (auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin())
        plugin->setLibrary (library);
}

int LivePreview::getLibraryState (int instrument) const
{
    const auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin();
    return plugin != nullptr ? plugin->getLibraryState (instrument) : stella::blob::notLoaded;
}

juce::String LivePreview::getLibraryProblem (int instrument) const
{
    const auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin();
    return plugin != nullptr ? juce::String (juce::CharPointer_UTF8 (plugin->getLibraryProblem (instrument).c_str())) : juce::String();
}

bool LivePreview::resolve (const juce::String& source, int& moduleIndex, int& port) const
{
    const auto module = source.upToFirstOccurrenceOf (".", false, false);
    const auto portName = source.fromFirstOccurrenceOf (".", false, false);

    if (module == "plugin")
    {
        // "plugin.out L" is what the plugin plays; "plugin.in L" what it gets.
        moduleIndex = portName.startsWith ("in") ? WasmPlugin::pluginInput : WasmPlugin::pluginOutput;
        port = portName.endsWithChar ('R') ? 1 : 0;
        return true;
    }

    for (const auto& m : modules)
    {
        if (m.id == module && m.outputs.contains (portName))
        {
            moduleIndex = m.index;
            port = m.outputs.indexOf (portName);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

void LivePreview::setGuiSources (const juce::StringArray& levels, const juce::StringArray& scopes)
{
    levelSources = levels;
    scopeSources = scopes;
    applyGuiSources();
}

void LivePreview::applyGuiSources()
{
    auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin();
    tappedSources.clear();

    if (plugin == nullptr)
        return;

    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> taps;

    for (const auto& source : levelSources)
    {
        int moduleIndex = 0, port = 0;

        if (taps.size() < (size_t) WasmPlugin::maxTaps && resolve (source, moduleIndex, port))
        {
            taps.push_back ({ moduleIndex, port });
            tappedSources.add (source);
        }
    }

    plugin->setTaps (taps);

    // Slot 0 is the schematic's probe; the GUI's scopes use 1 to 3.
    for (int slot = 1; slot < WasmPlugin::maxScopes; ++slot)
    {
        int moduleIndex = WasmPlugin::off, port = 0;

        if (slot - 1 < scopeSources.size())
            resolve (scopeSources[slot - 1], moduleIndex, port);

        plugin->setScope (slot, moduleIndex, port);
    }
}

float LivePreview::takeLevel (const juce::String& source, bool rms)
{
    auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin();

    if (plugin == nullptr)
        return 0.0f;

    for (const auto& d : displays)
        if (d.id == source)
            return plugin->getDisplay (d.index);

    const auto tap = tappedSources.indexOf (source);

    if (tap < 0)
        return 0.0f;

    return rms ? plugin->getTapRms (tap) : plugin->takeTapPeak (tap);
}

void LivePreview::readScope (const juce::String& source, float* destination, int numSamples) const
{
    const auto slot = scopeSources.indexOf (source) + 1;

    if (auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin(); plugin != nullptr && slot >= 1 && slot < WasmPlugin::maxScopes)
        plugin->readScope (slot, destination, numSamples);
    else
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (destination, numSamples);
}

void LivePreview::applyBypassAndProbe()
{
    auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin();

    if (plugin == nullptr)
        return;

    // Ids that no longer exist are forgotten.
    juce::StringArray stillThere;

    for (const auto& m : modules)
    {
        const bool off = bypassed.contains (m.id);
        plugin->setBypass (m.index, off);

        if (off)
            stillThere.add (m.id);
    }

    bypassed = stillThere;

    int probeIndex = WasmPlugin::off;

    if (probeModule == "plugin")
        probeIndex = WasmPlugin::pluginInput;
    else
        for (const auto& m : modules)
            if (m.id == probeModule && probePort < m.outputs.size())
                probeIndex = m.index;

    if (probeIndex == WasmPlugin::off)
        probeModule.clear();

    plugin->setScope (0, probeIndex, probePort);
}

void LivePreview::setBypass (const juce::String& moduleId, bool shouldBypass)
{
    bypassed.removeString (moduleId);

    if (shouldBypass)
        bypassed.add (moduleId);

    applyBypassAndProbe();

    if (onChanged != nullptr)
        onChanged();
}

void LivePreview::setProbe (const juce::String& moduleId, int port)
{
    probeModule = moduleId;
    probePort = port;
    applyBypassAndProbe();
}

void LivePreview::readProbe (float* destination, int numSamples) const
{
    if (auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin())
        plugin->readScope (0, destination, numSamples);
    else
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (destination, numSamples);
}

juce::Array<LivePreview::Param> LivePreview::parseParameters (const std::string& description)
{
    juce::Array<Param> result;
    const auto json = juce::JSON::parse (juce::String (description));

    if (const auto* list = json.getProperty ("params", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& item : *list)
        {
            Param p;
            p.index  = (int) item.getProperty ("index", 0);
            p.id     = item.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();
            p.name   = item.getProperty ("name", {}).toString();
            p.module = item.getProperty ("module", {}).toString();
            p.unit   = item.getProperty ("unit", {}).toString();
            p.min    = (float) (double) item.getProperty ("min", 0.0);
            p.max    = (float) (double) item.getProperty ("max", 1.0);
            p.def    = (float) (double) item.getProperty ("def", 0.0);
            p.skew   = (float) (double) item.getProperty ("skew", 1.0);

            if (p.max > p.min)
                result.add (p);
        }
    }

    return result;
}

float LivePreview::getParameterValue (int index) const
{
    if (auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin())
        return plugin->getParameter (index);

    for (const auto& p : params)
        if (p.index == index)
            return p.def;

    return 0.0f;
}

void LivePreview::setParameterValue (int index, float value)
{
    if (auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin())
        plugin->setParameter (index, value);
}

//==============================================================================
void LivePreview::timerCallback()
{
    if (state != State::playing)
        return;

    if (auto* plugin = audio.getPlugin(); plugin != nullptr && plugin->hasFailed())
    {
        log << (log.isNotEmpty() ? "\n\n" : "") << "Stopped while playing: " << juce::String (plugin->getFailure());
        setState (State::failed, "Stopped: see the log");
    }
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\LivePreview.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_events/juce_events.h>

#include "CreatorAudio.h"

class WasmElements;

#include <atomic>
#include <map>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The plugin being built, playing live: compiles the project, starts the result in its
    sandbox and hands it to the audio engine. Rebuilding swaps the new version in while
    playing, and parameters keep their values across rebuilds (matched by id). The GUI's
    programmed elements are built with it, into a sandbox of their own, for the canvas.

    If the plugin stops (it crashed, or got stuck), the studio carries on and says why.
*/
class LivePreview final : private juce::Timer
{
public:
    enum class State
    {
        idle,       // no project
        building,   // compiling and starting
        playing,    // live
        failed      // didn't build, didn't start, or stopped
    };

    struct Param
    {
        int index = 0;
        juce::String id, name, module, unit;
        float min = 0.0f, max = 1.0f, def = 0.0f, skew = 1.0f;
    };

    /** A module as the plugin reports it: its place in graph.json and its ports. */
    struct ModuleInfo
    {
        int index = 0;
        juce::String id, type, name;
        juce::StringArray inputs, outputs;
    };

    explicit LivePreview (CreatorAudio& creatorAudio);
    ~LivePreview() override;

    /** done (optional) is called on the message thread when this build has finished:
        true if it's playing, false if it failed (or a newer build replaced it). */
    void build (const juce::File& projectFolder, const juce::String& projectId,
                std::function<void (bool ok)> done = nullptr);
    void unload();

    /** The audio device changed: a new sample rate means the plugin restarts with it. */
    void deviceChanged();

    State getState() const noexcept                       { return state; }
    juce::String getStatus() const                        { return status; }
    juce::String getLog() const                           { return log; }

    const juce::Array<Param>& getParameters() const noexcept   { return params; }
    const juce::Array<ModuleInfo>& getModules() const noexcept { return modules; }

    /** Bypass by module id; kept across rebuilds while the module exists. */
    void setBypass (const juce::String& moduleId, bool bypassed);
    bool isBypassed (const juce::String& moduleId) const       { return bypassed.contains (moduleId); }

    /** The schematic's probe: a module's output port, or "plugin" for the plugin's input.
        An empty id stops watching. Kept across rebuilds. */
    void setProbe (const juce::String& moduleId, int port);
    void readProbe (float* destination, int numSamples) const;

    /** A value a module shows on the GUI (stella::Module::display). */
    struct DisplayInfo
    {
        int index = 0;
        juce::String id, module, name;
    };

    const juce::Array<DisplayInfo>& getDisplays() const noexcept   { return displays; }

    /** What the GUI's meters, lamps and scopes watch, by name: "voices.out" (a module's
        output), "plugin.out L" / "plugin.in R" (the plugin's own audio), or a display
        ("lfo.position"). Up to 32 levels and 3 scopes. Kept across rebuilds. */
    void setGuiSources (const juce::StringArray& levelSources, const juce::StringArray& scopeSources);

    /** A source's level: the highest peak since the last call (or the RMS), or a display's value. */
    float takeLevel (const juce::String& source, bool rms);
    void readScope (const juce::String& source, float* destination, int numSamples) const;
    int getParametersVersion() const noexcept             { return paramsVersion; }   // changes when the list does
    float getParameterValue (int index) const;
    void setParameterValue (int index, float value);

    /** Called on the message thread whenever the state, status or parameters change. */
    std::function<void()> onChanged;

    /** Called on the message thread with the GUI's programmed elements, each time a build
        succeeds (nullptr: the project has none), and with nullptr when it's unloaded. */
    std::function<void (std::shared_ptr<WasmElements>)> onElements;

    /** The playing plugin's WebAssembly, and its GUI's programmed elements' (empty: none), as
        built: Add to Sonify takes them along. */
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& getPluginWasm() const noexcept     { return wasm; }
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& getElementsWasm() const noexcept   { return elementsWasm; }

    /** The plugin's sample library (its instruments, each with the blob found for it): played by
        this build and every one after it. */
    void setLibrary (std::vector<stella::blob::Entry> instruments);

    /** How the playing plugin has an instrument of its library (stella::blob's states), and why it
        can't play it. */
    int getLibraryState (int instrument) const;
    juce::String getLibraryProblem (int instrument) const;

    /** The programmed elements crashed or got stuck while running (the canvas found out):
        why, until the next build. Sonify AI is told, to fix them. */
    void setElementsProblem (const juce::String& why)    { elementsProblem = why; }
    juce::String getElementsProblem() const              { return elementsProblem; }

private:
    void timerCallback() override;
    void start (std::vector<std::uint8_t> wasm, const juce::String& compilerLog, double seconds, bool compiled);
    void install (std::unique_ptr<WasmPlugin> plugin);
    void applyBypassAndProbe();
    void applyGuiSources();
    bool resolve (const juce::String& source, int& moduleIndex, int& port) const;
    void setState (State newState, const juce::String& newStatus);
    static juce::Array<Param> parseParameters (const std::string& description);

    CreatorAudio& audio;

    State state = State::idle;
    juce::String status, log, elementsProblem;
    juce::Array<Param> params;
    juce::Array<ModuleInfo> modules;
    juce::Array<DisplayInfo> displays;
    juce::StringArray levelSources, scopeSources;     // what the GUI asked for
    juce::StringArray tappedSources;                  // levelSources that resolved, in tap order
    juce::StringArray bypassed;
    juce::String probeModule;
    int probePort = 0;
    int paramsVersion = 0;
    int generation = 0;            // a newer build makes older results obsolete
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> wasm;   // the playing plugin, kept to restart it on a new sample rate
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> elementsWasm;   // its GUI's programmed elements (empty: none)
    std::vector<stella::blob::Entry> library; // its sample library
    double loadedRate = 0.0;

    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> alive = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>> (true);
    juce::ThreadPool worker { juce::ThreadPoolOptions{}.withThreadName ("Plugins Creator build").withNumberOfThreads (1) };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (LivePreview)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\LiveScreen.cpp

#include "LiveScreen.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace LiveScreen
{
namespace
{
    /** A track's name, white on the black, in the middle. */
    void paintTitle (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<float> area, const juce::String& title, float alpha)
    {
        if (title.isEmpty() || alpha <= 0.0f || area.isEmpty())
            return;

        const auto size = juce::jlimit (11.0f, 120.0f, area.getHeight() * 0.075f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.92f * alpha));
        g.setFont (juce::FontOptions (size, juce::Font::bold));
        g.drawFittedText (title, area.reduced (area.getWidth() * 0.08f, area.getHeight() * 0.1f).toNearestInt(),
                          juce::Justification::centred, 3, 0.75f);
    }

    /** A picture fitted into the area (its shape kept). */
    void paintFrame (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<float> area, const juce::Image& frame, float alpha,
                     juce::Graphics::ResamplingQuality quality)
    {
        if (! frame.isValid() || alpha <= 0.0f || area.isEmpty())
            return;

        const auto fitted = juce::RectanglePlacement (juce::RectanglePlacement::centred).appliedTo (frame.getBounds().toFloat(), area);
        g.setImageResamplingQuality (quality);
        g.setOpacity (alpha);
        g.drawImage (frame, fitted);
        g.setOpacity (1.0f);
    }

    /** The screen an area is most on (none: the nearest to it): its area for windows (its
        taskbar left out). */
    juce::Rectangle<int> userAreaFor (juce::Rectangle<int> area)
    {
        const auto& displays = juce::Desktop::getInstance().getDisplays();
        const juce::Displays::Display* best = nullptr;
        int most = 0;

        for (const auto& display : displays.displays)
        {
            const auto shared = display.logicalBounds.toNearestInt().getIntersection (area);

            if (shared.getWidth() * shared.getHeight() > most)
            {
                most = shared.getWidth() * shared.getHeight();
                best = &display;
            }
        }

        if (best == nullptr)
            best = displays.getDisplayForPoint (area.getCentre().toFloat());

        return best != nullptr ? best->userBounds.toNearestInt() : area;
    }

    juce::String idOf (juce::Rectangle<int> area)
    {
        return juce::String (area.getX()) + " " + juce::String (area.getY()) + " " + juce::String (area.getWidth()) + " " + juce::String (area.getHeight());
    }
}

//==============================================================================
/** A deck as the screen has it: its video's picture (VLC, following the deck), or its name. */
struct Screen::Layer
{
    explicit Layer (std::function<VideoScreen::Where()> where) : picture (std::move (where)) {}

    VideoScreen::Picture picture;
    juce::File video;                   // none: sound only
    bool open = false;                  // VLC has the video, and shows it
    juce::String title;
};

//==============================================================================
/** What the screen shows at a moment, with its own hold on the pictures (a picture held is never
    written again): the screens' windows paint it. */
struct Screen::Scene
{
    struct Deck
    {
        bool loaded = false;            // a track on it
        bool open = false;              // its video shows (black until its first picture)
        juce::Image picture;            // the video's picture now (none: black)
        juce::String title;             // a sound's name, on black
    };

    bool active = false;
    int front = 0;
    bool dissolving = false;
    float fade = 1.0f;                  // how far the front deck has dissolved in, while it does
    std::array<Deck, numDecks> decks;

    void paint (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<float> area, juce::Graphics::ResamplingQuality quality) const
    {
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::black);
        g.fillRect (area);

        if (! active)
            return;

        // The next one dissolving in over the last one, its whole screen (black and all), as fast
        // as its sound comes in.
        if (dissolving)
        {
            paintDeck (g, area, 1 - front, 1.0f, false, quality);
            paintDeck (g, area, front, fade, true, quality);
            return;
        }

        paintDeck (g, area, front, 1.0f, false, quality);
    }

    void paintDeck (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<float> area, int deck, float alpha, bool backdrop,
                    juce::Graphics::ResamplingQuality quality) const
    {
        const auto& d = decks[static_cast<size_t> (deck)];

        if (! d.loaded || alpha <= 0.0f)
            return;

        if (backdrop)
        {
            g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (alpha));
            g.fillRect (area);
        }

        if (d.open)
        {
            paintFrame (g, area, d.picture, alpha, quality);
            return;
        }

        paintTitle (g, area, d.title, alpha);
    }
};

//==============================================================================
/** The picture full screen on another screen (a projector, a TV): no frame, over the windows
    there, never taking the keys; the pointer shows only while it moves there. It watches both
    decks' pictures (they follow their decks while it shows), and draws what the screen draws. */
class Screen::Output final : public juce::Component,
                             private juce::Timer
{
public:
    Output (Screen& owner, const juce::String& displayId, juce::Rectangle<int> area)
        : screen (owner), id (displayId)
    {
        setOpaque (true);
        setWantsKeyboardFocus (false);
        setMouseCursor (juce::MouseCursor::NoCursor);
        setBounds (area);
        setAlwaysOnTop (true);
        addToDesktop (juce::ComponentPeer::windowIsTemporary | juce::ComponentPeer::windowIgnoresKeyPresses);
        setVisible (true);

        for (auto& layer : screen.layers)
            layer->picture.addView (this);

        startTimerHz (2);
    }

    ~Output() override
    {
        stopTimer();

        for (auto& layer : screen.layers)
            layer->picture.removeView (this);
    }

    void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override
    {
        screen.paintPicture (g, getLocalBounds().toFloat());
    }

    void mouseMove (const juce::MouseEvent&) override
    {
        movedAt = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();

        if (pointerHidden)
        {
            pointerHidden = false;
            setMouseCursor (juce::MouseCursor::NormalCursor);
        }
    }

    Screen& screen;
    const juce::String id;

private:
    void timerCallback() override
    {
        // The pointer keeps out of the picture's way once it rests.
        if (! pointerHidden && juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes() - movedAt > 2000.0)
        {
            pointerHidden = true;
            setMouseCursor (juce::MouseCursor::NoCursor);
        }
    }

    double movedAt = 0.0;
    bool pointerHidden = true;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE (Output)
};

//==============================================================================
/** The picture in picture: a small window of its own over every other window (Sonify's and the
    other apps'), shown while Sonify is minimised too. Its bar: "Screen", the track's name, HDMI,
    and minimise (just the bar: the picture rests), maximise, back to its own size, and close.
    Dragged by its bar or its picture it moves, by its corner it's sized (the picture's shape
    kept); double-click its bar: back to its own size (as it was: back to the top right). A click
    on it never takes the keys from Sonify's window. */
class Screen::Pip final : public juce::Component
{
public:
    static constexpr int barHeight = 28;
    static constexpr int narrowest = 240;           // its width at the least (its bar's buttons and a name)

    explicit Pip (Screen& owner) : screen (owner), picture (owner)
    {
        setOpaque (true);
        setWantsKeyboardFocus (false);
        setMouseClickGrabsKeyboardFocus (false);    // (Windows: clicked, it isn't made the active window)
        addAndMakeVisible (picture);
        setAlwaysOnTop (true);
        setBounds (boundsNow());
        picture.setVisible (screen.pipPlace.mode != "min");
        addToDesktop (juce::ComponentPeer::windowHasDropShadow | juce::ComponentPeer::windowIgnoresKeyPresses);
        setVisible (true);

        for (auto& layer : screen.layers)
            layer->picture.addView (&picture);

        refreshBar();
    }

    ~Pip() override
    {
        for (auto& layer : screen.layers)
            layer->picture.removeView (&picture);
    }

    /** Where it belongs now: its own place and size (or minimised or maximised), on a screen
        that's there. Not while it's being dragged. */
    void place()
    {
        if (moving || sizing)
            return;

        const auto bounds = boundsNow();
        const bool pictureShown = screen.pipPlace.mode != "min";

        if (bounds == getBounds() && picture.isVisible() == pictureShown)
            return;

        setBounds (bounds);
        picture.setVisible (pictureShown);
        repaint();
    }

    void pictureChanged()                           { picture.repaint(); }

    /** The track's name or HDMI changed: its bar drawn again. */
    void refreshBar()
    {
        const auto title = screen.layers[static_cast<size_t> (screen.front)]->title;
        const auto outputs = screen.getOutputCount();

        if (title != shownTitle || outputs != shownOutputs)
        {
            shownTitle = title;
            shownOutputs = outputs;
            repaint (getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (barHeight));
        }
    }

    static int heightFor (int width)                { return barHeight + juce::roundToInt (width * 9.0 / 16.0); }

    void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override
    {
        g.fillAll (juce::Colours::black);
        auto bar = getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (barHeight);
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff1b1d21));
        g.fillRect (bar);
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff2c2e34));
        g.fillRect (bar.removeFromBottom (1));

        // "Screen", and the track's name.
        auto words = getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (barHeight).withTrimmedLeft (10).withRight (areaOf (Part::hdmi).getX() - 6);
        const juce::Font label (juce::FontOptions (12.5f, juce::Font::bold));
        g.setFont (label);
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffeef0f3));
        const auto labelWidth = juce::GlyphArrangement::getStringWidthInt (label, "Screen") + 8;
        g.drawText ("Screen", words.removeFromLeft (labelWidth), juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);
        g.setFont (juce::FontOptions (12.0f));
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff9aa0a8));
        g.drawText (shownTitle, words, juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);

        // HDMI: lit while the picture is full screen on another screen.
        const auto hdmi = areaOf (Part::hdmi).toFloat();
        const bool on = shownOutputs > 0;
        g.setColour (on ? juce::Colour (0xff1f6b3e) : juce::Colour (0xff26282d));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (hdmi, 4.0f);
        g.setColour (on ? juce::Colour (0xff46c27a) : hover == Part::hdmi ? juce::Colour (0xff6d7179) : juce::Colour (0xff3a3d44));
        g.drawRoundedRectangle (hdmi.reduced (0.5f), 4.0f, 1.0f);
        g.setColour (on ? juce::Colours::white : juce::Colour (0xffc9ccd1));
        g.setFont (juce::FontOptions (10.5f, juce::Font::bold));
        g.drawText ("HDMI", hdmi, juce::Justification::centred, false);

        for (const auto part : { Part::minimise, Part::maximise, Part::restore, Part::close })
            paintButton (g, part);
    }

    void paintOverChildren (juce::Graphics& g) override
    {
        // Its edge, over any picture.
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff3a3d44));
        g.drawRect (getLocalBounds(), 1);

        // The corner it's sized by (dark under light: seen on any picture).
        if (screen.pipPlace.mode == "normal")
        {
            const auto grip = gripArea().toFloat();
            const auto light = juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (hover == Part::grip || sizing ? 0.95f : 0.7f);

            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i)
            {
                const auto d = 3.5f * static_cast<float> (i) + 1.0f;
                g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.6f));
                g.drawLine (grip.getRight() - d + 1.0f, grip.getBottom() - 1.0f, grip.getRight() - 1.0f, grip.getBottom() - d + 1.0f, 1.6f);
                g.setColour (light);
                g.drawLine (grip.getRight() - d, grip.getBottom() - 2.0f, grip.getRight() - 2.0f, grip.getBottom() - d, 1.2f);
            }
        }
    }

    void resized() override
    {
        picture.setBounds (getLocalBounds().withTrimmedTop (barHeight).reduced (1, 0).withTrimmedBottom (1));
    }

    void mouseMove (const juce::MouseEvent& event) override
    {
        const auto part = partAt (event.getPosition());
        setMouseCursor (part == Part::grip ? juce::MouseCursor::BottomRightCornerResizeCursor : juce::MouseCursor::NormalCursor);
        setHover (part);
    }

    void mouseExit (const juce::MouseEvent&) override
    {
        setHover (Part::none);
    }

    void mouseDown (const juce::MouseEvent& event) override
    {
        const auto part = partAt (event.getPosition());
        startBounds = getBounds();
        startMouse = event.getScreenPosition();
        moving = sizing = false;
        pressed = Part::none;

        if (part == Part::grip)
            sizing = true;
        else if (part == Part::bar || part == Part::picture)
            moving = screen.pipPlace.mode != "max";     // maximised, it stays put
        else if (enabled (part))
            pressed = part;                             // a button: it acts when let go over it

        repaint();
    }

    void mouseDrag (const juce::MouseEvent& event) override
    {
        const auto by = event.getScreenPosition() - startMouse;

        if (moving)
        {
            setTopLeftPosition (startBounds.getTopLeft() + by);
            return;
        }

        if (sizing)
        {
            // Along whichever way it's dragged more (the picture's shape kept), no bigger than its screen.
            const auto byWidth = std::abs (by.x) * 9 >= std::abs (by.y) * 16 ? by.x : juce::roundToInt (by.y * 16.0 / 9.0);
            const auto room = roomFor (startBounds);
            const auto widest = juce::jmax (narrowest, juce::jmin (room.getRight() - startBounds.getX(),
                                                                  juce::roundToInt ((room.getBottom() - startBounds.getY() - barHeight) * 16.0 / 9.0)));
            const auto width = juce::jlimit (narrowest, widest, startBounds.getWidth() + byWidth);
            setSize (width, heightFor (width));
            return;
        }

        if (pressed != Part::none)
            repaint (getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (barHeight));
    }

    void mouseUp (const juce::MouseEvent& event) override
    {
        if (moving || sizing)
        {
            const bool changed = getBounds() != startBounds;
            moving = sizing = false;

            if (changed)
                keep();
            else
                repaint();

            return;
        }

        const auto part = pressed;
        pressed = Part::none;
        repaint (getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (barHeight));

        if (part == Part::none || partAt (event.getPosition()) != part)
            return;

        if (part == Part::close)
        {
            // Hidden now; closed once this click is done with (closing it ends this window).
            setVisible (false);
            juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([self = juce::Component::SafePointer<Pip> (this)]
            {
                if (self != nullptr && self->screen.onPipClosed)
                    self->screen.onPipClosed();
            });

            return;
        }

        if (part == Part::hdmi)
        {
            // Its menu stays open only while Sonify is the app in front: this window comes in front
            // for it (a click on it alone never makes it so), Sonify's own window left as it is.
            toFront (true);

            if (screen.onPipOutputs)
                screen.onPipOutputs (areaOf (Part::hdmi) + getScreenPosition());

            return;
        }

        setMode (part == Part::minimise ? "min" : part == Part::maximise ? "max" : "normal");
    }

    void mouseDoubleClick (const juce::MouseEvent& event) override
    {
        if (partAt (event.getPosition()) != Part::bar)
            return;

        // Minimised or maximised: back to its own size. As it is: back to the top right.
        if (screen.pipPlace.mode != "normal")
        {
            setMode ("normal");
            return;
        }

        screen.pipPlace.area = defaultArea();
        place();

        if (screen.onPipMoved)
            screen.onPipMoved();
    }

private:
    enum class Part { none, bar, picture, grip, hdmi, minimise, maximise, restore, close };

    /** The picture under the bar: a View of both decks' pictures (they follow their decks while
        it shows). Clicks go through it to the window (dragged by its picture too). */
    struct Picture final : public juce::Component
    {
        explicit Picture (Screen& owner) : screen (owner)
        {
            setOpaque (true);
            setInterceptsMouseClicks (false, false);
        }

        void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override     { screen.paintPicture (g, getLocalBounds().toFloat()); }

        Screen& screen;
    };

    /** Its own size at first: at the top right of the screen Sonify is on. */
    juce::Rectangle<int> defaultArea() const
    {
        const auto room = screen.ownScreenArea();
        const auto width = juce::jlimit (juce::jmin (narrowest, room.getWidth()), juce::jmax (narrowest, room.getWidth()), 400);
        return { room.getRight() - width - 24, room.getY() + 110, width, heightFor (width) };
    }

    /** Where it should be: its own place and size (empty: the top right), its bar alone
        (minimised), or as big as its screen lets the picture be (maximised), on a screen that's
        there. */
    juce::Rectangle<int> boundsNow() const
    {
        const auto& kept = screen.pipPlace;
        const auto own = kept.area.isEmpty() ? defaultArea() : kept.area;
        const auto room = roomFor (kept.mode == "min" ? own.withHeight (barHeight) : own);

        if (kept.mode == "max")
        {
            const auto inside = room.reduced (8);
            const auto width = juce::jmax (narrowest, juce::jmin (inside.getWidth(), juce::roundToInt ((inside.getHeight() - barHeight) * 16.0 / 9.0)));
            return juce::Rectangle<int> (width, heightFor (width)).withCentre (inside.getCentre());
        }

        const auto widest = juce::jmax (narrowest, juce::jmin (room.getWidth(), juce::roundToInt ((room.getHeight() - barHeight) * 16.0 / 9.0)));
        const auto width = juce::jlimit (juce::jmin (narrowest, room.getWidth()), widest, own.getWidth());
        const auto height = kept.mode == "min" ? barHeight : heightFor (width);
        return juce::Rectangle<int> (own.getX(), own.getY(), width, height).constrainedWithin (room);
    }

    /** The screen it goes on (the one most of it is on): never one showing the picture full
        screen (the audience would see it there), Sonify's own instead. */
    juce::Rectangle<int> roomFor (juce::Rectangle<int> area) const
    {
        const auto room = userAreaFor (area);

        for (const auto& output : screen.outputs)
            if (output->getBounds().intersects (room))
                return screen.ownScreenArea();

        return room;
    }

    /** Moved or sized by hand: its own place (and size) from now on, kept. */
    void keep()
    {
        auto& kept = screen.pipPlace;
        const auto now = getBounds();

        // (Kept as it ended up: on its screen, no bigger than it.)
        if (kept.mode == "min")
        {
            kept.area = juce::Rectangle<int> (now.getX(), now.getY(), now.getWidth(), heightFor (now.getWidth()));
            place();
            kept.area.setPosition (getPosition());
        }
        else
        {
            kept.area = now;
            place();
            kept.area = getBounds();
        }

        if (screen.onPipMoved)
            screen.onPipMoved();
    }

    /** Minimised, maximised, or back to its own place and size (kept apart from the other two). */
    void setMode (const juce::String& mode)
    {
        auto& kept = screen.pipPlace;

        if (kept.area.isEmpty())
            kept.area = defaultArea();

        kept.mode = mode;
        place();
        repaint();      // its buttons: the one for the way it is now does nothing

        if (screen.onPipMoved)
            screen.onPipMoved();
    }

    /** The button for the way it already is does nothing. */
    bool enabled (Part part) const
    {
        const auto& mode = screen.pipPlace.mode;
        return ! ((part == Part::minimise && mode == "min") || (part == Part::maximise && mode == "max")
                  || (part == Part::restore && mode == "normal"));
    }

    juce::Rectangle<int> areaOf (Part part) const
    {
        auto bar = getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (barHeight).reduced (4, 3);
        const auto close = bar.removeFromRight (24);
        const auto restore = bar.removeFromRight (24);
        const auto maximise = bar.removeFromRight (24);
        const auto minimise = bar.removeFromRight (24);
        bar.removeFromRight (6);
        const auto hdmi = bar.removeFromRight (44).reduced (0, 1);

        switch (part)
        {
            case Part::close:       return close;
            case Part::restore:     return restore;
            case Part::maximise:    return maximise;
            case Part::minimise:    return minimise;
            case Part::hdmi:        return hdmi;
            case Part::none:
            case Part::bar:
            case Part::picture:
            case Part::grip:        break;
        }

        return {};
    }

    juce::Rectangle<int> gripArea() const           { return getLocalBounds().removeFromBottom (16).removeFromRight (16); }

    Part partAt (juce::Point<int> point) const
    {
        if (! getLocalBounds().contains (point))
            return Part::none;

        for (const auto part : { Part::close, Part::restore, Part::maximise, Part::minimise, Part::hdmi })
            if (areaOf (part).contains (point))
                return part;

        if (screen.pipPlace.mode == "normal" && gripArea().contains (point))
            return Part::grip;

        return point.y < barHeight ? Part::bar : Part::picture;
    }

    void setHover (Part part)
    {
        if (part == hover)
            return;

        hover = part;
        repaint (getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (barHeight));
        repaint (gripArea());
    }

    void paintButton (juce::Graphics& g, Part part) const
    {
        const auto area = areaOf (part).toFloat();
        const bool usable = enabled (part);

        if (usable && (hover == part || pressed == part))
        {
            g.setColour (part == Part::close ? juce::Colour (0xffc42b37) : juce::Colour (pressed == part ? 0xff3a3d44 : 0xff2e3036));
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (area, 4.0f);
        }

        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffd5d8dc).withAlpha (usable ? 1.0f : 0.3f));
        const auto c = area.getCentre();

        switch (part)
        {
            case Part::minimise:
                g.drawLine (c.x - 4.5f, c.y + 3.5f, c.x + 4.5f, c.y + 3.5f, 1.6f);
                break;

            case Part::maximise:
                g.drawRoundedRectangle ({ c.x - 4.5f, c.y - 4.5f, 9.0f, 9.0f }, 1.0f, 1.4f);
                break;

            case Part::restore:
            {
                g.drawRoundedRectangle ({ c.x - 5.0f, c.y - 2.0f, 7.0f, 7.0f }, 0.8f, 1.3f);
                juce::Path behind;
                behind.startNewSubPath (c.x - 2.0f, c.y - 2.0f);
                behind.lineTo (c.x - 2.0f, c.y - 5.0f);
                behind.lineTo (c.x + 5.0f, c.y - 5.0f);
                behind.lineTo (c.x + 5.0f, c.y + 2.0f);
                behind.lineTo (c.x + 2.0f, c.y + 2.0f);
                g.strokePath (behind, juce::PathStrokeType (1.3f));
                break;
            }

            case Part::close:
                g.drawLine (c.x - 4.0f, c.y - 4.0f, c.x + 4.0f, c.y + 4.0f, 1.6f);
                g.drawLine (c.x + 4.0f, c.y - 4.0f, c.x - 4.0f, c.y + 4.0f, 1.6f);
                break;

            case Part::none:
            case Part::bar:
            case Part::picture:
            case Part::grip:
            case Part::hdmi:
                break;
        }
    }

    Screen& screen;
    Picture picture;
    Part hover = Part::none, pressed = Part::none;
    bool moving = false, sizing = false;
    juce::Rectangle<int> startBounds;
    juce::Point<int> startMouse;
    juce::String shownTitle;
    int shownOutputs = -1;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE (Pip)
};

//==============================================================================
Screen::Screen (juce::Component& window, std::function<DeckState (int)> w)
    : ownWindow (window), where (std::move (w))
{
    for (int d = 0; d < numDecks; ++d)
        layers[static_cast<size_t> (d)] = std::make_unique<Layer> ([this, d] { return pictureWhere (d); });

    startTimerHz (60);
}

Screen::~Screen()
{
    stopTimer();
    pip = nullptr;          // the windows watch the pictures: they go first
    outputs.clear();

    for (auto& layer : layers)
        layer->picture.close();
}

//==============================================================================
void Screen::setTrack (int deck, const juce::File& video, const VideoMedia::Info& info, const juce::String& title)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (deck, numDecks))
        return;

    auto& layer = *layers[static_cast<size_t> (deck)];
    layer.title = title;

    if (video == juce::File())
    {
        if (layer.open || layer.video != juce::File())
            layer.picture.close();

        layer.video = juce::File();
        layer.open = false;
    }
    else if (layer.video != video || ! layer.open)
    {
        // A video VLC can't show: its name, as for a sound.
        layer.video = video;
        layer.open = layer.picture.open (video, info);
    }
}

void Screen::clearDeck (int deck)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (deck, numDecks))
        return;

    auto& layer = *layers[static_cast<size_t> (deck)];

    if (layer.open || layer.video != juce::File())
        layer.picture.close();

    layer.video = juce::File();
    layer.open = false;
    layer.title.clear();
}

void Screen::setFront (int deck)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (deck, numDecks) || deck == front)
        return;

    front = deck;
}

void Screen::setActive (bool shouldBeActive)
{
    if (shouldBeActive == active)
        return;

    active = shouldBeActive;
    updateOutputs();
    updatePip();
}

void Screen::setPipShown (bool shown)
{
    pipWanted = shown;
    updatePip();
}

void Screen::setPipPlace (const PipPlace& place)
{
    pipPlace = place;

    if (pipPlace.mode != "min" && pipPlace.mode != "max")
        pipPlace.mode = "normal";

    if (pip != nullptr)
        pip->place();
}

void Screen::updatePip()
{
    const bool show = pipWanted && active;

    if (show && pip == nullptr)
        pip = std::make_unique<Pip> (*this);
    else if (! show)
        pip = nullptr;
}

juce::Rectangle<int> Screen::ownScreenArea() const
{
    const auto& displays = juce::Desktop::getInstance().getDisplays();
    const auto* display = ownWindow.getPeer() != nullptr ? displays.getDisplayForRect (ownWindow.getScreenBounds()) : nullptr;

    if (display == nullptr)
        display = displays.getPrimaryDisplay();

    return display != nullptr ? display->userBounds.toNearestInt() : juce::Rectangle<int> (0, 0, 1280, 720);
}

//==============================================================================
std::vector<Display> Screen::getDisplays() const
{
    std::vector<Display> list;
    const auto& displays = juce::Desktop::getInstance().getDisplays();

    // Sonify's own screen is never one: the picture would cover it. Where its window is while it
    // shows (minimised it's nowhere: the screen it was last on).
    const auto* peer = ownWindow.getPeer();

    if (peer != nullptr && ! peer->isMinimised() && ownWindow.isShowing())
    {
        const auto bounds = ownWindow.getScreenBounds();
        int most = 0;

        for (const auto& display : displays.displays)
        {
            const auto area = display.logicalBounds.toNearestInt();
            const auto shared = area.getIntersection (bounds);

            if (shared.getWidth() * shared.getHeight() > most)
            {
                most = shared.getWidth() * shared.getHeight();
                ownArea = area;
            }
        }
    }

    int number = 0;

    for (const auto& display : displays.displays)
    {
        ++number;
        const auto area = display.logicalBounds.toNearestInt();

        if (! ownArea.isEmpty() ? area == ownArea : display.isMain)
            continue;

        const auto id = idOf (area);
        const auto width = display.physicalBounds.getWidth() > 0 ? display.physicalBounds.getWidth() : juce::roundToInt (area.getWidth() * display.scale);
        const auto height = display.physicalBounds.getHeight() > 0 ? display.physicalBounds.getHeight() : juce::roundToInt (area.getHeight() * display.scale);
        list.push_back ({ id, "Screen " + juce::String (number) + " (" + juce::String (width) + " x " + juce::String (height) + ")",
                          area, chosen.contains (id) });
    }

    return list;
}

void Screen::setOutput (const juce::String& id, bool on)
{
    if (on)
        chosen.addIfNotAlreadyThere (id);
    else
        chosen.removeString (id);

    updateOutputs();
}

void Screen::updateOutputs()
{
    const auto displays = getDisplays();
    const auto there = [&displays] (const juce::String& id)
    {
        return std::any_of (displays.begin(), displays.end(), [&id] (const Display& display) { return display.id == id; });
    };

    // Gone: not chosen any more, its screen unplugged (or Sonify moved onto it), or the screen not
    // in use (DJ show).
    for (auto it = outputs.begin(); it != outputs.end();)
    {
        if (active && chosen.contains ((*it)->id) && there ((*it)->id))
            ++it;
        else
            it = outputs.erase (it);
    }

    if (! active)
        return;

    for (const auto& display : displays)
    {
        if (! display.on)
            continue;

        const auto shown = std::any_of (outputs.begin(), outputs.end(), [&display] (const auto& output) { return output->id == display.id; });

        if (! shown)
            outputs.push_back (std::make_unique<Output> (*this, display.id, display.area));
    }

    // The picture in picture keeps off a screen showing the picture full screen.
    if (pip != nullptr)
        pip->place();
}

//==============================================================================
VideoScreen::Where Screen::pictureWhere (int deck) const
{
    const auto& layer = *layers[static_cast<size_t> (deck)];

    if (! active || ! layer.open)
        return {};

    const auto state = where (deck);

    if (! state.loaded)
        return {};

    // The player's picture, and the last one's while the next dissolves in over it. The next one,
    // waiting behind: its picture where it starts made ready (it isn't shown), so it dissolves in
    // from its own first picture, not from black while VLC gets going. Any other rests.
    if (deck != front && ! state.playing)
        return state.coming ? VideoScreen::Where { true, state.seconds, false, state.rate } : VideoScreen::Where {};

    return { true, state.seconds, state.playing, state.rate };
}

bool Screen::dissolving() const noexcept
{
    const auto& inFront = states[static_cast<size_t> (front)];
    const auto& behind = states[static_cast<size_t> (1 - front)];
    return inFront.loaded && behind.loaded && behind.playing && inFront.fade < 0.999f;
}

void Screen::paintPicture (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<float> area)
{
    // Scaled its best way: a 4K video on an HD screen has every pixel counted, a small one
    // on a big screen comes out smooth.
    sceneNow().paint (g, area, juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);
}

Screen::Scene Screen::sceneNow()
{
    Scene scene;
    scene.active = active;
    scene.front = front;
    scene.dissolving = dissolving();
    scene.fade = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, states[static_cast<size_t> (front)].fade);

    for (int d = 0; d < numDecks; ++d)
    {
        const auto place = static_cast<size_t> (d);
        auto& layer = *layers[place];
        auto& deck = scene.decks[place];
        deck.loaded = states[place].loaded;
        deck.open = layer.open;
        deck.title = layer.title;

        // (Black until VLC's first picture; only the decks painted.)
        const auto painted = d == front || scene.dissolving;

        if (painted && layer.open && layer.picture.hasPicture())
            deck.picture = layer.picture.getDrawable();
    }

    return scene;
}

Screen::Look Screen::lookNow() const
{
    Look now;
    now.active = active;
    now.front = front;
    now.fade = dissolving() ? juce::roundToInt (states[static_cast<size_t> (front)].fade * 64.0f) : 64;

    for (int d = 0; d < numDecks; ++d)
    {
        const auto place = static_cast<size_t> (d);
        const auto& layer = *layers[place];
        now.frames[place] = layer.open ? layer.picture.getFrameNumber() : 0;
        now.loaded[place] = states[place].loaded;
        now.playing[place] = states[place].playing;
        now.open[place] = layer.open;
        now.titles += layer.title + "|";
    }

    return now;
}

//==============================================================================
void Screen::update()
{
    if (! active)
        return;

    for (int d = 0; d < numDecks; ++d)
        states[static_cast<size_t> (d)] = where (d);

    const auto now = lookNow();

    if (now != look)
    {
        look = now;

        for (auto& output : outputs)
            output->repaint();

        if (pip != nullptr)
            pip->pictureChanged();
    }

    if (pip != nullptr)
        pip->refreshBar();

    // Every two seconds: the screens as they are (one plugged in or out, Sonify moved onto one),
    // and the picture in picture kept on one that's there (updateOutputs places it).
    if (++ticks % 120 == 0)
        updateOutputs();
}
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\LiveScreen.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include "VideoScreen.h"

#include <array>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Live Show's screen (Live & podcasts, Live streaming): what the playlist's player plays,
    as the audience sees it. A video's picture (VLC follows its deck: VideoScreen), or, for a
    track that's only sound, black with its name in the middle. The player is two decks (the
    second only crossfades the next track in): while the next one comes in, its whole screen
    dissolves in over the last one's, as fast as its sound fades in (its first picture made ready
    while it waited, so it never comes in from black).

    It's shown as the picture in picture (a small window of its own, over every other window:
    Sonify's and the other apps', Sonify minimised too; moved by its bar, sized by its corner) and
    full screen on the computer's other screens (a projector, a TV on HDMI), each one chosen: no
    frame, no pointer, over the windows there. Each of the video's pictures is drawn as it comes,
    at the window's size, scaled its best way. The screen Sonify itself is on is never one of the
    full screen ones.

    Message thread.
*/
namespace LiveScreen
{
    /** The playlist's player: decks 1 and 2. */
    constexpr int numDecks = 2;

    /** A deck, as the screen needs it each moment. */
    struct DeckState
    {
        bool loaded = false;            // a track on it
        double seconds = 0.0;           // where it is in its track (a video's picture: there in it)
        bool playing = false;
        double rate = 1.0;              // its speed (1: as recorded)
        float fade = 1.0f;              // how far it's faded in (0..1): the dissolve follows it
        bool coming = false;            // the next to play, waiting behind the player: its picture made ready
    };

    /** One of the computer's other screens. */
    struct Display
    {
        juce::String id;                // where it is on the desktop: "x y width height"
        juce::String name;              // "Screen 2 (1920 x 1080)"
        juce::Rectangle<int> area;      // on the desktop (logical pixels)
        bool on = false;                // the picture full screen on it
    };

    class Screen final : private juce::Timer
    {
    public:
        /** window: Sonify's own (its screen is never an output). where: deck 0 or 1, now. */
        Screen (juce::Component& window, std::function<DeckState (int deck)> where);
        ~Screen() override;

        /** The track on a deck: a video (prepared: its Info) or none (sound only), and its name
            (shown on black for sound only, or when a video can't be shown). */
        void setTrack (int deck, const juce::File& video, const VideoMedia::Info& info, const juce::String& title);
        void clearDeck (int deck);

        /** The deck in front: the player. The other shows only while it plays (fading out under it). */
        void setFront (int deck);

        /** The playlist's tabs: on. Off (DJ show): no pictures, the other screens let go, the
            picture in picture hidden. */
        void setActive (bool active);
        bool isActive() const noexcept                  { return active; }

        /** The picture in picture: shown while asked for (and the screen is active). Its bar: the
            track's name, HDMI (the other screens' menu), minimise (just its bar: the picture rests),
            maximise (as big as its screen lets the picture be), back to its own size, and close.
            It never takes the keys (Sonify keeps them). */
        void setPipShown (bool shown);
        bool isPipShown() const noexcept                { return pip != nullptr; }

        /** Its own place and size (empty: the top right of Sonify's screen, as it starts), and how
            it shows: "normal", "min" (its bar) or "max". Sonify keeps them. */
        struct PipPlace
        {
            juce::Rectangle<int> area;
            juce::String mode { "normal" };
        };

        const PipPlace& getPipPlace() const noexcept    { return pipPlace; }
        void setPipPlace (const PipPlace& place);

        std::function<void()> onPipClosed;              // its close button
        std::function<void()> onPipMoved;               // moved, sized, minimised, maximised or back
        std::function<void (juce::Rectangle<int>)> onPipOutputs;   // HDMI pressed (its place on the desktop): the screens' menu

        /** The computer's other screens, and the picture full screen on the ones chosen (by id;
            a screen chosen and not there, or Sonify moved onto it, waits until it is). */
        std::vector<Display> getDisplays() const;
        void setOutput (const juce::String& id, bool on);
        const juce::StringArray& getChosenOutputs() const noexcept   { return chosen; }
        int getOutputCount() const noexcept             { return static_cast<int> (outputs.size()); }

        /** The picture as it is now, into an area (black around it): the screens' windows draw
            it (and the tests look at it). */
        void paintPicture (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<float> area);

        /** Asks where the decks are now (the timer does it, 60 times a second; the tests call it). */
        void update();

    private:
        struct Layer;
        struct Scene;
        class Output;
        class Pip;

        /** What's on the screen now, to know when to draw it again. */
        struct Look
        {
            bool active = false;
            int front = 0, fade = 0;
            std::array<int, numDecks> frames {};
            std::array<bool, numDecks> loaded {}, playing {}, open {};
            juce::String titles;

            bool operator== (const Look& other) const noexcept
            {
                return active == other.active && front == other.front && fade == other.fade && frames == other.frames
                    && loaded == other.loaded && playing == other.playing && open == other.open && titles == other.titles;
            }

            bool operator!= (const Look& other) const noexcept   { return ! (*this == other); }
        };

        void timerCallback() override                   { update(); }
        VideoScreen::Where pictureWhere (int deck) const;
        Scene sceneNow();
        bool dissolving() const noexcept;
        Look lookNow() const;
        void updateOutputs();
        void updatePip();
        juce::Rectangle<int> ownScreenArea() const;     // the desktop's area of the screen Sonify is on (its taskbar left out)

        juce::Component& ownWindow;
        std::function<DeckState (int)> where;
        std::array<std::unique_ptr<Layer>, numDecks> layers;          // before the windows (they watch the layers' pictures)
        std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Output>> outputs;
        std::unique_ptr<Pip> pip;

        std::array<DeckState, numDecks> states {};
        int front = 0;
        bool active = false;
        bool pipWanted = false;
        PipPlace pipPlace;
        juce::StringArray chosen;
        mutable juce::Rectangle<int> ownArea;   // the screen Sonify's window was last seen on
        Look look;
        int ticks = 0;

        JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE (Screen)
    };
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\LiveShow.cpp

#include "LiveShow.h"
#include "RecordingAnalysis.h"

#if __has_include (<signalsmith-stretch/signalsmith-stretch.h>)
 #include <signalsmith-stretch/signalsmith-stretch.h>
 #define SONIFY_LIVE_STRETCH 1
#else
 #define SONIFY_LIVE_STRETCH 0
#endif

#include <cmath>

namespace LiveShow
{
namespace
{
    using Kind = ParamSpec::Kind;
    using SonifyDsp::Biquad;

    constexpr float halfPi = 1.5707963267948966f;
    constexpr float pi = 3.14159265358979323846f;
    constexpr double butterworthQ = 0.70710678118654752;

    // Where a track's waveform splits its low, middle and high (as a DJ mixer's EQ would).
    constexpr double lowCrossover = 250.0, highCrossover = 2500.0;

    // The fastest a deck plays (the widest tempo range), for the stretcher's buffers; and how much
    // faster a track's own rate may run than the device's (a track read before the device changed).
    constexpr double fastest = 1.6;
    constexpr double widestRates = 2.5;

    // What the listening hears of a track: its start, this long.
    constexpr double listenedSeconds = 240.0;

    // The tempos a track is counted in, as DJs count them: an octave from 78 (up to, not including, 156).
    constexpr double slowestBpm = 78.0, fastestBpm = 156.0;

    float dbToGain (float db, float closedAt) noexcept
    {
        return db <= closedAt ? 0.0f : juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (db);
    }

    /** Four points' curve through the middle two (Catmull-Rom). */
    inline float hermite (float before, float a, float b, float after, float t) noexcept
    {
        const auto c1 = 0.5f * (b - before);
        const auto c2 = before - 2.5f * a + 2.0f * b - 0.5f * after;
        const auto c3 = 0.5f * (after - before) + 1.5f * (a - b);
        return ((c3 * t + c2) * t + c1) * t + a;
    }

    template <size_t count>
    int indexIn (const std::array<ParamSpec, count>& specs, const juce::String& id)
    {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            if (id == specs[i].id)
                return static_cast<int> (i);

        return -1;
    }

    /** A mono signal at RecordingAnalysis's rate, from blocks read at another (read fills the
        block it's given and returns how many it filled, 0 at the end). */
    std::vector<float> monoForListening (double fromRate, juce::int64 available,
                                         const std::function<int (float*, int)>& read, const std::function<bool()>& keepGoing)
    {
        const auto ratio = fromRate / RecordingAnalysis::rate;   // samples in per sample out
        const auto wanted = static_cast<juce::int64> (juce::jmin (static_cast<double> (available), listenedSeconds * fromRate));
        std::vector<float> out;
        out.reserve (static_cast<size_t> (static_cast<double> (wanted) / ratio) + 16);

        juce::LagrangeInterpolator interpolator;
        std::vector<float> pending;
        std::vector<float> block (16384);
        juce::int64 taken = 0;
        bool ended = false;

        while (! ended && keepGoing())
        {
            const auto count = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (static_cast<juce::int64> (block.size()), wanted - taken));
            const auto got = count > 0 ? read (block.data(), count) : 0;

            if (got <= 0)
            {
                ended = true;
                pending.insert (pending.end(), 8, 0.0f);   // the interpolator reads a little past the end
            }
            else
            {
                pending.insert (pending.end(), block.begin(), block.begin() + got);
                taken += got;
            }

            const auto canMake = static_cast<int> ((static_cast<double> (pending.size()) - 8.0) / ratio);

            if (canMake <= 0)
                continue;

            const auto at = out.size();
            out.resize (at + static_cast<size_t> (canMake));
            const auto used = interpolator.process (ratio, pending.data(), out.data() + at, canMake);
            pending.erase (pending.begin(), pending.begin() + juce::jmin (used, static_cast<int> (pending.size())));
        }

        return out;
    }

    TrackInfo listenTo (std::vector<float> mono, const std::function<bool()>& keepGoing)
    {
        TrackInfo info;

        if (mono.empty() || ! keepGoing())
            return info;

        // No song to follow: a grid no music keeps (its tempo isn't one), so the track's own is found.
        RecordingAnalysis::Grid none;
        none.bpm = 997.0;
        none.numerator = 4;
        none.denominator = 4;

        const auto heard = RecordingAnalysis::analyse (std::move (mono), 0.0, none, 0.0, [&keepGoing] (double) { return keepGoing(); });

        if (heard.ok && heard.bpm > 0.0)
        {
            // A DJ's range: a beat heard at half (or double) time is counted as dancers count it.
            auto bpm = heard.bpm;

            while (bpm < slowestBpm)
                bpm *= 2.0;

            while (bpm >= fastestBpm)
                bpm *= 0.5;

            info.bpm = std::round (bpm * 100.0) / 100.0;

            // Its first downbeat in the track (one heard before the start: the bar after it).
            auto first = heard.downbeatSeconds;

            while (first < 0.0)
                first += 4.0 * 60.0 / heard.bpm;

            info.firstBeat = first;
            info.keyTonic = heard.keyTonic;
            info.keyMinor = heard.keyMinor;
        }

        return info;
    }
}
