// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Looks.cpp

#include "Looks.h"
#include "LayerRender.h"
#include "Settings.h"

#include "StellaLooks.h"

#include <algorithm>

namespace
{
    /** Unique across every look ever read or changed, so a drawing is never mistaken for
        another look's. */
    int nextRevision()
    {
        static int revision = 0;
        return ++revision;
    }

    /** A look's kind when its file doesn't say: from its shape and frame count. */
    Looks::Kind guessKind (const LayerDoc& doc)
    {
        if (doc.frames == 2)                                return Looks::Kind::button;
        if (doc.canvasWidth >= doc.canvasHeight * 2)        return Looks::Kind::sliderAcross;
        if (doc.canvasHeight >= doc.canvasWidth * 2)        return Looks::Kind::slider;
        return Looks::Kind::knob;
    }

    /** The words of a name a look might be known by, with a few that mean the same. The
        old KnobMaker style names (cream, black, metal) land on the matching looks. */
    juce::StringArray wordsOf (const juce::String& name)
    {
        auto words = juce::StringArray::fromTokens (name.toLowerCase(), " -_.,", "");
        words.removeEmptyStrings();

        for (int i = words.size(); --i >= 0;)
        {
            const auto w = words[i];

            if (w == "metal" || w == "aluminium" || w == "aluminum" || w == "chrome" || w == "steel")  words.add ("silver");
            if (w == "brass" || w == "golden")                                                     words.add ("gold");
            if (w == "ivory" || w == "white" || w == "vintage" || w == "retro")                    words.add ("cream");
            if (w == "chicken" || w == "chickenhead" || w == "davies")                             words.add ("pointer");
            if (w == "arc" || w == "modern" || w == "flat" || w == "minimal")                      words.add ("ring");
            if (w == "led" || w == "lit" || w == "illuminated" || w == "glow")                     words.add ("light");
            if (w == "lever" || w == "bat")                                                        words.add ("toggle");
            if (w == "numbers" || w == "numbered" || w == "dial")                                  words.add ("scale");
        }

        // Words every look of a kind has say nothing about which one.
        for (const auto* generic : { "knob", "knobs", "slider", "sliders", "fader", "faders", "switch", "switches", "button", "buttons", "look", "style" })
            words.removeString (generic);

        return words;
    }

    /** A look that's always there, for when the built-in ones are missing. */
    Looks::Look fallbackLook (Looks::Kind kind)
    {
        Looks::Look look;
        look.kind = kind;
        look.revision = nextRevision();

        switch (kind)
        {
            case Looks::Kind::knob:
                look.name = "Knob";
                look.doc = LayerDoc::knobExample();
                break;

            case Looks::Kind::slider:
            case Looks::Kind::sliderAcross:
            {
                const bool across = kind == Looks::Kind::sliderAcross;
                look.name = across ? "Slider across" : "Slider";
                look.doc = LayerDoc::sliderExample();   // its cap travels from the top down

                for (auto& layer : look.doc.layers)
                {
                    const auto travel = layer.eff.offsetY;

                    if (across)
                    {
                        // Turned on its side: left to right.
                        layer.eff.offsetY = AnimVal (0.0f);
                        layer.eff.offsetX = AnimVal (travel.from, travel.to, travel.mode);
                        std::swap (layer.eff.zoomX, layer.eff.zoomY);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Up from the bottom, as a slider moves.
                        layer.eff.offsetY = AnimVal (travel.to, travel.from, travel.mode);
                    }
                }

                if (across)
                    std::swap (look.doc.canvasWidth, look.doc.canvasHeight);
                break;
            }

            case Looks::Kind::button:
            {
                look.name = "Switch";
                look.doc.canvasWidth = look.doc.canvasHeight = 64;
                look.doc.frames = 2;
                look.doc.layers.clear();

                DocLayer cap;
                cap.name = "Cap";
                cap.prim.type = PrimType::RectFill;
                cap.prim.colour = juce::Colour (0xff36363c);
                cap.prim.round = 30.0f;
                cap.eff.zoomX = cap.eff.zoomY = AnimVal (70.0f);
                look.doc.addLayer (cap);

                DocLayer light;
                light.name = "Light";
                light.prim.type = PrimType::Led;
                light.prim.colour = juce::Colour (0xffffa21a);
                light.prim.ledFollowFrame = true;
                light.eff.zoomX = light.eff.zoomY = AnimVal (50.0f);
                look.doc.addLayer (light);
                break;
            }
        }

        return look;
    }

    /** The look fitted into width x height, with room pixels more on every side for its
        shadows and glows (they reach past the control's box onto the panel). */
    juce::Image renderFitted (const LayerDoc& doc, float t, int width, int height, int room)
    {
        width = juce::jmax (1, width);
        height = juce::jmax (1, height);
        room = juce::jmax (0, room);

        juce::Image out (juce::Image::ARGB, width + 2 * room, height + 2 * room, true);

        const auto docW = (float) juce::jmax (8, doc.canvasWidth), docH = (float) juce::jmax (8, doc.canvasHeight);
        const auto fit = juce::jmin ((float) width / docW, (float) height / docH);

        // Drawn at the size it shows, not shrunk from a big one: the layers are described in
        // fractions of the canvas, so this is the sharpest it can be. Its shadows get the room
        // they need past the canvas.
        const auto pad = juce::jmin ((float) room, std::ceil (LayerRender::overhangOf (doc) * fit));
        const auto rendered = LayerRender::renderFrame (doc, t, fit, pad);

        juce::Graphics g (out);
        g.setImageResamplingQuality (juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);
        g.drawImageAt (rendered, juce::roundToInt (((float) out.getWidth() - (float) rendered.getWidth()) * 0.5f),
                       juce::roundToInt (((float) out.getHeight() - (float) rendered.getHeight()) * 0.5f));
        return out;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String Looks::kindName (Kind kind)
{
    switch (kind)
    {
        case Kind::knob:          return "knob";
        case Kind::slider:        return "slider";
        case Kind::sliderAcross:  return "hslider";
        case Kind::button:        return "switch";
    }

    return "knob";
}

Looks::Kind Looks::kindFromName (const juce::String& name)
{
    const auto n = name.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (n == "switch" || n == "button" || n == "toggle")                         return Kind::button;
    if (n == "hslider" || n == "slider across" || n == "horizontal slider")     return Kind::sliderAcross;
    if (n == "slider" || n == "fader" || n == "vslider")                         return Kind::slider;
    return Kind::knob;
}

juce::String Looks::kindDisplayName (Kind kind)
{
    switch (kind)
    {
        case Kind::knob:          return "knob";
        case Kind::slider:        return "slider";
        case Kind::sliderAcross:  return "slider across";
        case Kind::button:        return "switch";
    }

    return "knob";
}

bool Looks::takesLook (const GuiWidget& widget)
{
    return widget.type == GuiWidget::Type::knob || widget.type == GuiWidget::Type::slider || widget.type == GuiWidget::Type::toggle;
}

Looks::Kind Looks::kindOf (const GuiWidget& widget)
{
    if (widget.type == GuiWidget::Type::slider)   return widget.vertical ? Kind::slider : Kind::sliderAcross;
    if (widget.type == GuiWidget::Type::toggle)   return Kind::button;
    return Kind::knob;
}

juce::File Looks::myLooksFolder()
{
    return Settings::getDataFolder().getChildFile ("Looks");
}

//==============================================================================
Looks::Looks()
{
    for (const auto kind : { Kind::knob, Kind::slider, Kind::sliderAcross, Kind::button })
        fallbacks[(int) kind] = fallbackLook (kind);

    // The built-in looks, compiled into the studio from the looks folder.
    for (int i = 0; i < StellaLooks::namedResourceListSize; ++i)
    {
        const auto* resource = StellaLooks::namedResourceList[i];
        int size = 0;

        if (const auto* data = StellaLooks::getNamedResource (resource, size); data != nullptr && size > 0)
        {
            // "look_Black knob.fklayers" -> "Black knob" (just the name: it's not a path on this
            // computer). Sonify keeps every file in one folder, so the looks' files say what they are.
            auto file = juce::String (StellaLooks::getNamedResourceOriginalFilename (resource))
                            .replaceCharacter ('\\', '/').fromLastOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false);

            if (file.startsWith ("look_"))
                file = file.substring (5);
            Look look;

            if (readXml (juce::String::fromUTF8 (data, size), file.upToLastOccurrenceOf (".", false, false), look))
            {
                look.origin = Origin::builtIn;
                builtIn[look.name] = look;
            }
        }
    }

    readFolder (myLooksFolder(), Origin::mine, mine);
}

//==============================================================================
bool Looks::readXml (const juce::String& xml, const juce::String& name, Look& look)
{
    const auto parsed = juce::parseXML (xml);

    if (parsed == nullptr)
        return false;

    const auto tree = juce::ValueTree::fromXml (*parsed);

    if (! tree.isValid() || ! tree.hasType ("LayerDoc") || name.trim().isEmpty())
        return false;

    look.name = name.trim();
    look.doc = LayerDoc::fromValueTree (tree);
    look.kind = tree.hasProperty ("stellaKind") ? kindFromName (tree["stellaKind"].toString()) : guessKind (look.doc);
    look.order = (int) tree.getProperty ("stellaOrder", 1000);
    look.description = tree.getProperty ("stellaDescription", {}).toString();
    look.pool = (int) tree.getProperty ("stellaPool", 0) != 0;
    look.revision = nextRevision();
    return true;
}

bool Looks::readFile (const juce::File& file, Look& look)
{
    return file.existsAsFile() && readXml (file.loadFileAsString(), file.getFileNameWithoutExtension(), look);
}

bool Looks::writeFile (const juce::File& file, const Look& look)
{
    auto tree = look.doc.toValueTree();
    tree.setProperty ("stellaKind", kindName (look.kind), nullptr);

    if (look.order != 1000)
        tree.setProperty ("stellaOrder", look.order, nullptr);

    if (look.description.isNotEmpty())
        tree.setProperty ("stellaDescription", look.description, nullptr);

    if (look.pool)
        tree.setProperty ("stellaPool", 1, nullptr);

    const auto xml = tree.createXml();

    if (xml == nullptr || ! file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory())
        return false;

    return xml->writeTo (file, {});
}

void Looks::readFolder (const juce::File& folder, Origin origin, std::map<juce::String, Look>& into)
{
    if (! folder.isDirectory())
        return;

    for (const auto& file : folder.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, juce::String ("*") + fileExtension))
    {
        Look look;

        if (readFile (file, look))
        {
            look.origin = origin;
            into[look.name] = look;
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File Looks::projectFolder() const
{
    return guiFolder != juce::File() ? guiFolder.getChildFile (folderName) : juce::File();
}

void Looks::setGuiFolder (const juce::File& folder)
{
    guiFolder = folder;
    reload();
}

void Looks::reload()
{
    project.clear();

    if (guiFolder != juce::File())
        readFolder (projectFolder(), Origin::project, project);

    mine.clear();
    readFolder (myLooksFolder(), Origin::mine, mine);

    frames.clear();
    framesDrawn = 0;
    changed();
}

void Looks::changed()
{
    if (onChanged != nullptr)
        onChanged();
}

//==============================================================================
const Looks::Look* Looks::findIn (const std::map<juce::String, Look>& looks, const juce::String& name) const
{
    if (const auto found = looks.find (name); found != looks.end())
        return &found->second;

    for (const auto& [key, look] : looks)
        if (key.equalsIgnoreCase (name.trim()))
            return &look;

    return nullptr;
}

const Looks::Look* Looks::find (const juce::String& name) const
{
    if (name.trim().isEmpty())
        return nullptr;

    if (const auto* found = findIn (project, name))   return found;
    if (const auto* found = findIn (mine, name))      return found;
    return findIn (builtIn, name);
}

const Looks::Look* Looks::find (const juce::String& name, Origin origin) const
{
    if (name.trim().isEmpty())
        return nullptr;

    return findIn (origin == Origin::project ? project : origin == Origin::mine ? mine : builtIn, name);
}

const Looks::Look& Looks::defaultFor (Kind kind) const
{
    const Look* best = nullptr;

    for (const auto& [name, look] : builtIn)
        if (look.kind == kind && (best == nullptr || look.order < best->order))
            best = &look;

    if (best == nullptr)
        return fallbacks.at ((int) kind);

    // The plugin's own version of it, once it's been changed here.
    if (const auto* own = find (best->name); own != nullptr && own->kind == kind)
        return *own;

    return *best;
}

const Looks::Look& Looks::lookFor (const GuiWidget& widget) const
{
    const auto kind = kindOf (widget);

    if (widget.style.isEmpty())
        return defaultFor (kind);

    if (const auto* found = find (widget.style); found != nullptr && found->kind == kind)
        return *found;

    // A loose name: the look of this kind that shares the most words with it.
    const auto words = wordsOf (widget.style);
    const Look* best = nullptr;
    int bestScore = 0;

    for (const auto* look : listFor (kind))
    {
        int score = 0;

        for (const auto& w : words)
            if (look->name.containsIgnoreCase (w))
                ++score;

        if (score > bestScore)
        {
            best = look;
            bestScore = score;
        }
    }

    return best != nullptr ? *best : defaultFor (kind);
}

std::vector<const Looks::Look*> Looks::listFor (Kind kind) const
{
    std::vector<const Look*> list;
    juce::StringArray names;

    auto addFrom = [&] (const std::map<juce::String, Look>& looks)
    {
        std::vector<const Look*> some;

        for (const auto& [name, look] : looks)
            if (look.kind == kind && ! names.contains (name, true))
                some.push_back (&look);

        std::stable_sort (some.begin(), some.end(), [] (const Look* a, const Look* b) { return a->order < b->order; });

        for (const auto* look : some)
        {
            list.push_back (look);
            names.add (look->name);
        }
    };

    addFrom (project);
    addFrom (mine);
    addFrom (builtIn);
    return list;
}

std::vector<const Looks::Look*> Looks::listFrom (Origin origin, Kind kind) const
{
    std::vector<const Look*> list;

    for (const auto& [name, look] : origin == Origin::project ? project : origin == Origin::mine ? mine : builtIn)
        if (look.kind == kind)
            list.push_back (&look);

    std::stable_sort (list.begin(), list.end(), [] (const Look* a, const Look* b) { return a->order < b->order; });
    return list;
}

std::vector<const Looks::Look*> Looks::all() const
{
    std::vector<const Look*> list;

    for (const auto kind : { Kind::knob, Kind::slider, Kind::sliderAcross, Kind::button })
        for (const auto* look : listFor (kind))
            list.push_back (look);

    return list;
}

//==============================================================================
void Looks::setProjectLook (const juce::String& name, Kind kind, const LayerDoc& doc, const juce::String& description)
{
    if (name.trim().isEmpty())
        return;

    Look look;

    // A look set aside keeps what it said about itself.
    if (const auto* before = find (name))
    {
        look.description = before->description;
        look.order = before->order;
    }

    if (description.isNotEmpty())
        look.description = description;

    look.name = name.trim();
    look.kind = kind;
    look.origin = Origin::project;
    look.doc = doc;
    look.revision = nextRevision();

    // The drawings of what it was are no use now.
    if (const auto before = project.find (look.name); before != project.end())
        frames.erase (before->second.revision);

    if (guiFolder != juce::File())
        writeFile (projectFolder().getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (look.name) + fileExtension), look);

    project[look.name] = look;
    changed();
}

bool Looks::removeProjectLook (const juce::String& name)
{
    const auto found = project.find (name);

    if (found == project.end())
        return false;

    if (guiFolder != juce::File())
        projectFolder().getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (found->second.name) + fileExtension).deleteFile();

    frames.erase (found->second.revision);
    project.erase (found);
    changed();
    return true;
}

juce::String Looks::freeName (const juce::String& base, const juce::StringArray& alsoTaken) const
{
    auto taken = [&] (const juce::String& name)
    {
        return findIn (project, name) != nullptr || alsoTaken.contains (name, true);
    };

    auto stem = base.trim().isNotEmpty() ? base.trim() : juce::String ("Look");

    if (! taken (stem))
        return stem;

    // "Black knob 2" grows to "Black knob 3", not "Black knob 2 2".
    if (const auto last = stem.fromLastOccurrenceOf (" ", false, false); last.containsOnly ("0123456789") && last.isNotEmpty())
        stem = stem.upToLastOccurrenceOf (" ", false, false);

    for (int i = 2;; ++i)
        if (const auto candidate = stem + " " + juce::String (i); ! taken (candidate))
            return candidate;
}

bool Looks::saveToMine (const juce::String& name)
{
    const auto* look = find (name);

    if (look == nullptr)
        return false;

    auto copy = *look;
    copy.origin = Origin::mine;
    copy.pool = false;   // the user's own now
    copy.revision = nextRevision();

    if (! writeFile (myLooksFolder().getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (copy.name) + fileExtension), copy))
        return false;

    mine[copy.name] = copy;
    changed();
    return true;
}

bool Looks::adoptMine (const GuiLayout& layout)
{
    if (guiFolder == juce::File())
        return false;

    bool adopted = false;

    for (const auto& w : layout.widgets)
    {
        if (! takesLook (w) || w.style.isEmpty() || findIn (project, w.style) != nullptr)
            continue;

        if (const auto* own = findIn (mine, w.style); own != nullptr && own->kind == kindOf (w))
        {
            auto copy = *own;
            copy.origin = Origin::project;
            copy.revision = nextRevision();

            if (writeFile (projectFolder().getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (copy.name) + fileExtension), copy))
            {
                project[copy.name] = copy;
                adopted = true;
            }
        }
    }

    if (adopted)
        changed();

    return adopted;
}

//==============================================================================
int Looks::framesFor (const Look& look, Kind kind)
{
    return kind == Kind::button ? 2 : juce::jlimit (1, 512, look.doc.frames);
}

void Looks::setLight (float angle, float altitude)
{
    lightAngle = angle;
    lightAltitude = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 90.0f, altitude);
}

LayerDoc Looks::litBy (const LayerDoc& doc) const
{
    // Turned from the look's own light to the panel's: every layer's light and every bevel's
    // own angle by as much; bevels on the global light take the panel's height as well.
    auto lit = doc;
    const auto turn = lightAngle - doc.globalLightAngle;
    lit.globalLightAngle = lightAngle;
    lit.globalLightAltitude = lightAltitude;

    for (auto& layer : lit.layers)
    {
        layer.prim.lightDir += turn;

        if (! layer.prim.bevel.useGlobalLight)
            layer.prim.bevel.angle += turn;
    }

    return lit;
}

juce::Image Looks::frame (const Look& look, Kind kind, int width, int height, float value, float resolution)
{
    width = juce::jmax (1, width);
    height = juce::jmax (1, height);

    const auto count = framesFor (look, kind);
    const auto index = count > 1 ? juce::jlimit (0, count - 1, juce::roundToInt (juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, value) * (float) (count - 1))) : 0;
    const auto res = juce::jlimit (1.0f, 3.0f, resolution);

    const auto key = juce::String (width) + "x" + juce::String (height) + "|" + juce::String (index) + "/" + juce::String (count)
                   + "@" + juce::String (juce::roundToInt (res * 4.0f)) + "|" + juce::String (lightAngle, 1) + "/" + juce::String (lightAltitude, 1);

    auto& drawn = frames[look.revision];

    if (const auto found = drawn.find (key); found != drawn.end())
        return found->second;

    // Plenty for every control of a big plugin at two zooms; past that, start again.
    if (++framesDrawn > 6000)
    {
        for (auto& [revision, images] : frames)
            images.clear();

        framesDrawn = 1;
    }

    const auto t = count > 1 ? (float) index / (float) (count - 1) : 0.0f;
    const auto room = juce::roundToInt ((float) overhang (look, width, height) * res);
    auto image = renderFitted (litBy (look.doc), t, juce::roundToInt ((float) width * res), juce::roundToInt ((float) height * res), room);
    drawn[key] = image;
    return image;
}

int Looks::overhang (const Look& look, int width, int height)
{
    const auto reach = LayerRender::overhangOf (look.doc);

    if (reach <= 0.0f)
        return 0;

    const auto docW = (float) juce::jmax (8, look.doc.canvasWidth), docH = (float) juce::jmax (8, look.doc.canvasHeight);
    const auto fit = juce::jmin ((float) juce::jmax (1, width) / docW, (float) juce::jmax (1, height) / docH);
    return (int) std::ceil (reach * fit);
}

juce::Image Looks::strip (const Look& look, Kind kind, int width, int height)
{
    const auto count = framesFor (look, kind);
    const auto room = overhang (look, width, height);
    const auto frameW = juce::jmax (1, width) + 2 * room, frameH = juce::jmax (1, height) + 2 * room;
    juce::Image image (juce::Image::ARGB, frameW, frameH * count, true);
    juce::Graphics g (image);

    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        g.drawImageAt (frame (look, kind, width, height, count > 1 ? (float) i / (float) (count - 1) : 0.0f), 0, i * frameH);

    return image;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Looks.h

#pragma once

#include "GuiLayout.h"
#include "LayerDoc.h"

#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    How the plugin's knobs, sliders and switches look: KnobMaker layer documents
    (.fklayers), built in the Knob Studio the KnobMan way, one primitive per layer.

    A look's frames run through the control's travel: a knob's turn, a slider from the
    bottom (or the left) to the top (or the right), a switch from off (the first frame) to
    on (the last). The canvas draws a frame for each value, and Export bakes them into the
    strips the finished plugin plays.

    Where looks come from, in the order a name is looked up:
        the plugin's own   gui/looks in the project: every look edited for this plugin
        mine               <user data>\Plugins Creator\Looks: the user's, for every project
        built-in           the looks folder, compiled into the studio
*/
class Looks
{
public:
    /** What a look is made for. */
    enum class Kind { knob, slider, sliderAcross, button };

    static juce::String kindName (Kind kind);              // "knob", "slider", "hslider", "switch"
    static Kind kindFromName (const juce::String& name);
    static juce::String kindDisplayName (Kind kind);       // "knob", "slider", "slider across", "switch"

    /** Knobs, sliders and switches take a look; nothing else does. */
    static bool takesLook (const GuiWidget& widget);
    static Kind kindOf (const GuiWidget& widget);

    enum class Origin { builtIn, mine, project };

    struct Look
    {
        juce::String name, description;
        Kind kind = Kind::knob;
        Origin origin = Origin::builtIn;
        int order = 1000;
        bool pool = false;    // one of Fanan AI's inspiration pool (the inspiration-looks skill describes it)
        LayerDoc doc;
        int revision = 0;     // new on every change, so its drawings are made again
    };

    Looks();

    /** The open project's gui folder (none: no project): its looks are in gui/looks. */
    void setGuiFolder (const juce::File& guiFolder);
    bool isProjectOpen() const noexcept    { return guiFolder != juce::File(); }

    /** The plugin's own looks and mine, read again (after an undo, or a change on disk). */
    void reload();

    /** Exactly that name: the plugin's own first, then mine, then the built-in ones. */
    const Look* find (const juce::String& name) const;

    /** That name among one kind of look only (a built-in look the plugin's own one hides). */
    const Look* find (const juce::String& name, Origin origin) const;

    /** What a control shows: its look, else a look of its kind with a close name ("black"
        finds "Black knob"), else its kind's default. */
    const Look& lookFor (const GuiWidget& widget) const;
    const Look& defaultFor (Kind kind) const;

    /** Every look of a kind: the plugin's own, then mine, then the built-in ones (a name
        once: the plugin's own hides a built-in one of the same name). */
    std::vector<const Look*> listFor (Kind kind) const;
    std::vector<const Look*> all() const;

    /** The looks of one origin and kind, hidden ones too. */
    std::vector<const Look*> listFrom (Origin origin, Kind kind) const;

    //==========================================================================
    /** The Knob Studio's edits: saved as the plugin's own look. A built-in look (or one of
        mine) with the same name is set aside for this plugin from then on, and its
        description stays unless a new one is given. */
    void setProjectLook (const juce::String& name, Kind kind, const LayerDoc& doc, const juce::String& description = {});
    bool removeProjectLook (const juce::String& name);

    /** A name none of the plugin's own looks has, nor any in alsoTaken (the looks its
        controls wear, say): the base itself if it's free, else "Black knob 2". */
    juce::String freeName (const juce::String& base, const juce::StringArray& alsoTaken = {}) const;

    /** Copies a look into my looks, for every project. */
    bool saveToMine (const juce::String& name);

    /** Looks the layout uses that are only in my looks are copied into the plugin, so it
        opens the same on any computer. True when one was. */
    bool adoptMine (const GuiLayout& layout);

    //==========================================================================
    /** The panel's global light (GuiLayout's): every look is drawn lit from there, its own
        light turned to it (bevels on the global light take its height too). */
    void setLight (float angle, float altitude);

    /** A look's document lit by the panel's global light. */
    LayerDoc litBy (const LayerDoc& doc) const;

    /** The frames a control's strip has: the look's own; two for a switch (off, on). */
    static int framesFor (const Look& look, Kind kind);

    /** A frame of a look for a value (0..1; a switch: 0 off, 1 on), fitted in proportion
        into width x height and centred, with overhang (below) more on every side for its
        shadows and glows: draw it over the box expanded by that much. resolution: pixels per
        plugin pixel (a zoomed-in view asks for more). Kept until the look changes. */
    juce::Image frame (const Look& look, Kind kind, int width, int height, float value, float resolution = 1.0f);

    /** How far a look's drop shadows, glows and outside outlines reach past a width x height
        box, in plugin pixels: they fall on the panel around the control, never cut off at
        its box (0: it has none). */
    static int overhang (const Look& look, int width, int height);

    /** For Export: every frame, stacked top to bottom, each the box plus its overhang on
        every side. */
    juce::Image strip (const Look& look, Kind kind, int width, int height);

    /** A look was added, changed or removed. */
    std::function<void()> onChanged;

    //==========================================================================
    static constexpr const char* folderName = "looks";        // in the project's gui folder
    static constexpr const char* fileExtension = ".fklayers";
    static juce::File myLooksFolder();

    /** A .fklayers file: KnobMaker's layer document, plus what Stella knows about it
        (kind, order, description, whether it's of the inspiration pool) as attributes
        KnobMaker leaves alone. */
    static bool readFile (const juce::File& file, Look& look);
    static bool writeFile (const juce::File& file, const Look& look);
    static bool readXml (const juce::String& xml, const juce::String& name, Look& look);

private:
    juce::File projectFolder() const;
    void readFolder (const juce::File& folder, Origin origin, std::map<juce::String, Look>& into);
    const Look* findIn (const std::map<juce::String, Look>& looks, const juce::String& name) const;
    void changed();

    juce::File guiFolder;
    std::map<juce::String, Look> builtIn, mine, project;
    std::map<int, Look> fallbacks;                    // by kind: when the built-in ones are missing
    std::map<int, std::map<juce::String, juce::Image>> frames;   // drawn frames: by look (its revision), then size, value and light
    int framesDrawn = 0;
    float lightAngle = 120.0f, lightAltitude = 30.0f;            // the panel's global light

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Looks)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\LoopFinder.cpp

#include "LoopFinder.h"

#include <juce_audio_formats/juce_audio_formats.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    /** The pitch period (samples) at a point: Sampler Arena's autocorrelation, or -1. */
    double detectPitch (const float* data, juce::int64 totalSamples, juce::int64 centre, double sampleRate)
    {
        constexpr int windowSize = 4096;
        auto winStart = centre - windowSize / 2;

        if (winStart < 0)
            winStart = 0;

        if (winStart + windowSize >= totalSamples)
            winStart = totalSamples - windowSize - 1;

        if (winStart < 0)
            return -1.0;

        const auto* win = data + winStart;
        auto minLag = static_cast<int> (sampleRate / 4000.0);
        auto maxLag = static_cast<int> (sampleRate / 20.0);

        if (maxLag > windowSize / 2)
            maxLag = windowSize / 2;

        if (minLag < 2)
            minLag = 2;

        float energy = 0.0f;

        for (int i = 0; i < windowSize; ++i)
            energy += win[i] * win[i];

        if (energy < 1.0e-10f)
            return -1.0;

        const auto correlationAt = [win] (int lag)
        {
            float sum = 0.0f, e1 = 0.0f, e2 = 0.0f;
            const auto count = windowSize - lag;

            for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            {
                sum += win[i] * win[i + lag];
                e1 += win[i] * win[i];
                e2 += win[i + lag] * win[i + lag];
            }

            const auto denominator = std::sqrt (e1 * e2);
            return denominator > 1.0e-10f ? sum / denominator : 0.0f;
        };

        // The first strong peak after a dip: the fundamental, not a harmonic.
        float bestCorrelation = 0.0f;
        int bestLag = -1;
        bool foundDip = false;

        for (int lag = minLag; lag <= maxLag; ++lag)
        {
            const auto correlation = correlationAt (lag);

            if (! foundDip && correlation < 0.5f)
                foundDip = true;

            if (foundDip && correlation > bestCorrelation && correlation > 0.7f)
            {
                bestCorrelation = correlation;
                bestLag = lag;
            }
            else if (bestLag > 0 && bestCorrelation > 0.9f && correlation < bestCorrelation)
            {
                // Past the top of the fundamental's peak. (Sampler Arena stopped at the first lag
                // over 0.9, on the way up: a clean tone came out several percent sharp.)
                break;
            }
        }

        if (bestLag <= 0 || bestCorrelation < 0.7f)
            return -1.0;

        if (bestLag > minLag && bestLag < maxLag)
        {
            const auto before = correlationAt (bestLag - 1);
            const auto after = correlationAt (bestLag + 1);
            const auto denominator = before - 2.0f * bestCorrelation + after;

            if (std::abs (denominator) > 1.0e-10f)
                return static_cast<double> (bestLag) + static_cast<double> (juce::jlimit (-0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f * (before - after) / denominator));
        }

        return static_cast<double> (bestLag);
    }

    struct Score
    {
        float total = 0.0f, correlation = 0.0f, levelMatch = 0.0f, valueMatch = 0.0f, slopeMatch = 0.0f;
    };

    /** How well a loop's end matches its start: Sampler Arena's scoreLoopPoint. */
    Score scoreLoopPoint (const float* data, juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd, double period, juce::int64 totalSamples)
    {
        Score score;
        const auto window = juce::jmax (256, static_cast<int> (period * 4));

        if (loopStart + window >= totalSamples || loopEnd + window >= totalSamples || loopEnd <= loopStart)
            return score;

        float sumAB = 0.0f, sumAA = 0.0f, sumBB = 0.0f;

        for (int i = 0; i < window; ++i)
        {
            const auto a = data[loopStart + i];
            const auto b = data[loopEnd + i];
            sumAB += a * b;
            sumAA += a * a;
            sumBB += b * b;
        }

        const auto denominator = std::sqrt (sumAA * sumBB);
        score.correlation = denominator > 1.0e-10f ? sumAB / denominator : 0.0f;

        if (score.correlation < 0.5f)
            return score;

        // The two ends at much the same level (within about 2:1): an end in the decay is no loop.
        const auto rmsStart = std::sqrt (sumAA / static_cast<float> (window));
        const auto rmsEnd = std::sqrt (sumBB / static_cast<float> (window));
        score.levelMatch = rmsStart > 1.0e-9f && rmsEnd > 1.0e-9f ? juce::jmin (rmsStart, rmsEnd) / juce::jmax (rmsStart, rmsEnd) : 0.0f;

        if (score.levelMatch < 0.45f)
            return score;

        float peak = 0.001f;

        for (int i = -10; i <= 10; ++i)
            peak = juce::jmax (peak, std::abs (data[juce::jlimit<juce::int64> (0, totalSamples - 1, loopStart + i)]));

        score.valueMatch = 1.0f - juce::jmin (1.0f, std::abs (data[loopEnd] - data[loopStart]) / peak);

        const auto slopeStart = loopStart + 1 < totalSamples ? data[loopStart + 1] - data[loopStart] : 0.0f;
        const auto slopeEnd = loopEnd + 1 < totalSamples ? data[loopEnd + 1] - data[loopEnd] : 0.0f;
        score.slopeMatch = 1.0f - juce::jmin (1.0f, std::abs (slopeEnd - slopeStart) / juce::jmax (0.001f, peak));

        score.total = score.correlation * 0.5f + score.valueMatch * 0.2f + score.slopeMatch * 0.1f + score.levelMatch * 0.2f;
        return score;
    }

    std::vector<float> monoOf (const juce::AudioBuffer<float>& audio)
    {
        const auto total = audio.getNumSamples();
        const auto channels = juce::jmax (1, audio.getNumChannels());
        std::vector<float> mono (static_cast<size_t> (total), 0.0f);

        for (int channel = 0; channel < audio.getNumChannels(); ++channel)
        {
            const auto* data = audio.getReadPointer (channel);

            for (int i = 0; i < total; ++i)
                mono[static_cast<size_t> (i)] += data[i];
        }

        for (auto& value : mono)
            value /= static_cast<float> (channels);

        return mono;
    }

    /** The share of a window's energy in its first differences: how bright it is. */
    float brightness (const float* data, juce::int64 at, int length, juce::int64 total)
    {
        double energy = 0.0, edges = 0.0;

        for (int i = 1; i < length && at + i < total; ++i)
        {
            const auto value = static_cast<double> (data[at + i]);
            const auto change = value - static_cast<double> (data[at + i - 1]);
            energy += value * value;
            edges += change * change;
        }

        return energy > 1.0e-12 ? static_cast<float> (edges / energy) : 0.0f;
    }

    /** The extra numbers Fanan AI weighs. */
    void addDetails (LoopFinder::Candidate& c, const float* mono, juce::int64 total, double rate, double period)
    {
        c.seconds = static_cast<double> (c.loopEnd - c.loopStart) / rate;
        c.periods = period > 0.0 ? static_cast<double> (c.loopEnd - c.loopStart) / period : 0.0;
        c.startSeconds = static_cast<double> (c.loopStart) / rate;
        c.endSeconds = static_cast<double> (c.loopEnd) / rate;

        const auto startPeriod = detectPitch (mono, total, c.loopStart + 2048, rate);
        const auto endPeriod = detectPitch (mono, total, c.loopEnd - 2048, rate);
        c.startPitchHz = startPeriod > 0.0 ? rate / startPeriod : 0.0;
        c.endPitchHz = endPeriod > 0.0 ? rate / endPeriod : 0.0;

        // The level inside the loop: 30 ms windows, from the quietest to the loudest.
        const auto window = juce::jmax<juce::int64> (64, static_cast<juce::int64> (rate * 0.030));
        float quietest = 1.0e9f, loudest = 0.0f;

        for (auto at = c.loopStart; at + window <= c.loopEnd; at += window / 2)
        {
            double sum = 0.0;

            for (juce::int64 i = 0; i < window; ++i)
                sum += static_cast<double> (mono[at + i]) * static_cast<double> (mono[at + i]);

            const auto rms = static_cast<float> (std::sqrt (sum / static_cast<double> (window)));
            quietest = juce::jmin (quietest, rms);
            loudest = juce::jmax (loudest, rms);
        }

        c.levelWobbleDb = loudest > 0.0f && quietest < 1.0e8f
                        ? juce::Decibels::gainToDecibels (loudest, -100.0f) - juce::Decibels::gainToDecibels (juce::jmax (quietest, 1.0e-6f), -100.0f)
                        : 0.0f;

        const auto length = static_cast<int> (juce::jmax (512.0, period * 8.0));
        const auto a = brightness (mono, c.loopStart, length, total);
        const auto b = brightness (mono, juce::jmax<juce::int64> (0, c.loopEnd - length), length, total);
        c.brightnessMatch = a > 0.0f && b > 0.0f ? juce::jmin (a, b) / juce::jmax (a, b) : 0.0f;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
LoopFinder::Result LoopFinder::analyze (const juce::File& file, int maxCandidates, int crossfadeMs)
{
    juce::AudioFormatManager formats;
    formats.registerBasicFormats();
    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatReader> reader (formats.createReaderFor (file));

    if (reader == nullptr)
    {
        Result result;
        result.error = "Could not read file: " + file.getFileName();
        return result;
    }

    if (reader->lengthInSamples < 8192 || reader->lengthInSamples > static_cast<juce::int64> (reader->sampleRate * 600.0))
    {
        Result result;
        result.error = reader->lengthInSamples < 8192 ? "File too short for loop analysis" : "File too long for loop analysis";
        return result;
    }

    juce::AudioBuffer<float> audio (static_cast<int> (juce::jlimit (1u, 2u, reader->numChannels)), static_cast<int> (reader->lengthInSamples));
    reader->read (&audio, 0, static_cast<int> (reader->lengthInSamples), 0, true, audio.getNumChannels() > 1);
    return analyze (audio, reader->sampleRate, maxCandidates, crossfadeMs);
}

LoopFinder::Result LoopFinder::analyze (const juce::AudioBuffer<float>& audio, double sampleRate, int maxCandidates, int crossfadeMs)
{
    Result result;
    result.sampleRate = sampleRate > 0.0 ? sampleRate : 44100.0;
    result.totalSamples = audio.getNumSamples();

    if (result.totalSamples < 8192)
    {
        result.error = "File too short for loop analysis";
        return result;
    }

    const auto monoData = monoOf (audio);
    const auto* mono = monoData.data();
    const auto total = result.totalSamples;
    const auto rate = result.sampleRate;

    // The sustain: the level (30 ms windows) over 5% of its loudest, after the first 100 ms.
    const auto windowSize = static_cast<int> (rate * 0.030);
    const auto hop = juce::jmax (1, windowSize / 2);
    std::vector<float> envelope;

    for (juce::int64 at = 0; at + windowSize < total; at += hop)
    {
        float sum = 0.0f;

        for (int j = 0; j < windowSize; ++j)
            sum += mono[at + j] * mono[at + j];

        envelope.push_back (std::sqrt (sum / static_cast<float> (windowSize)));
    }

    if (envelope.size() < 20)
    {
        result.error = "Audio too short";
        return result;
    }

    const auto peak = *std::max_element (envelope.begin(), envelope.end());
    result.peakLevelDb = juce::Decibels::gainToDecibels (peak, -100.0f);

    if (peak < 0.001f)
    {
        result.error = "Audio too quiet";
        return result;
    }

    const auto quiet = peak * 0.05f;
    const auto minAttack = static_cast<juce::int64> (rate * 0.100);
    size_t sustainStartIndex = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < envelope.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (static_cast<juce::int64> (i) * hop >= minAttack && envelope[i] > quiet)
        {
            sustainStartIndex = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    auto sustainEndIndex = envelope.size() - 1;

    for (auto i = envelope.size() - 1; i > sustainStartIndex; --i)
    {
        if (envelope[i] > quiet)
        {
            sustainEndIndex = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    result.sustainStart = static_cast<juce::int64> (sustainStartIndex) * hop;
    result.sustainEnd = static_cast<juce::int64> (sustainEndIndex) * hop;
    auto sustainLength = result.sustainEnd - result.sustainStart;

    if (sustainLength < 4096)
    {
        result.sustainStart = total / 10;
        result.sustainEnd = total * 9 / 10;
        sustainLength = result.sustainEnd - result.sustainStart;
    }

    // The body's end: the last point still at half the loudest (loops stay in the full sound).
    auto bodyEnd = result.sustainEnd;

    for (auto i = envelope.size(); i-- > 0;)
    {
        if (envelope[i] > peak * 0.5f)
        {
            bodyEnd = static_cast<juce::int64> (i) * hop;
            break;
        }
    }

    bodyEnd = juce::jlimit (result.sustainStart, result.sustainEnd, bodyEnd);

    if (bodyEnd <= result.sustainStart + static_cast<juce::int64> (rate * 0.3))
        bodyEnd = result.sustainEnd;

    result.bodyEnd = bodyEnd;

    // The pitch: in the middle of the sustain, else at a third, else at two thirds.
    auto period = detectPitch (mono, total, result.sustainStart + sustainLength / 2, rate);

    if (period <= 0.0)
        period = detectPitch (mono, total, result.sustainStart + sustainLength / 3, rate);

    if (period <= 0.0)
        period = detectPitch (mono, total, result.sustainStart + sustainLength * 2 / 3, rate);

    if (period <= 0.0)
    {
        result.error = juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Could not detect pitch \xe2\x80\x94 sample may be noise or unpitched");
        return result;
    }

    result.periodSamples = period;
    result.pitchHz = rate / period;
    const auto crossfadeSamples = static_cast<int> (rate * crossfadeMs / 1000.0);

    // Loop starts: rising zero crossings in the first half of the sustain (past its first 4
    // periods), about 50 of them.
    auto minLength = static_cast<juce::int64> (period * 8);

    if (minLength < static_cast<juce::int64> (rate * 0.5))
        minLength = static_cast<juce::int64> (rate * 0.5);

    std::vector<juce::int64> crossings;
    const auto searchStart = result.sustainStart + static_cast<juce::int64> (period * 4);
    const auto searchEnd = result.sustainStart + sustainLength / 2;

    for (auto i = searchStart; i < searchEnd - 1; ++i)
        if (mono[i] <= 0.0f && mono[i + 1] > 0.0f)
            crossings.push_back (i);

    if (crossings.empty())
        for (auto i = searchStart; i < searchEnd; i += static_cast<juce::int64> (period))
            crossings.push_back (i);

    if (crossings.size() > 50)
    {
        const auto step = crossings.size() / 50;
        std::vector<juce::int64> thinned;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < crossings.size(); i += step)
            thinned.push_back (crossings[i]);

        crossings = std::move (thinned);
    }

    struct Scored
    {
        juce::int64 start, end;
        float score, lateness;
        Score parts;
    };

    std::vector<Scored> scored;

    for (const auto loopStart : crossings)
    {
        const auto idealEnd = bodyEnd - static_cast<juce::int64> (period * 2);

        if (idealEnd <= loopStart + minLength)
            continue;

        const auto n = static_cast<int> (static_cast<double> (idealEnd - loopStart) / period);

        if (n < 8)
            continue;

        for (int offset = 0; offset >= -2; --offset)
        {
            const auto tryN = n + offset;

            if (tryN < 8)
                continue;

            const auto rawEnd = loopStart + static_cast<juce::int64> (static_cast<double> (tryN) * period + 0.5);
            auto bestEnd = rawEnd;
            Score best;
            best.total = -1.0f;
            const auto range = static_cast<int> (period * 0.25);

            for (int nudge = -range; nudge <= range; ++nudge)
            {
                const auto testEnd = rawEnd + nudge;

                if (testEnd < loopStart + minLength || testEnd >= total - 1)
                    continue;

                const auto score = scoreLoopPoint (mono, loopStart, testEnd, period, total);

                if (score.total > best.total)
                {
                    best = score;
                    bestEnd = testEnd;
                }
            }

            if (best.total < 0.5f)
                continue;

            // Later is better: nearer the end of the strong body.
            const auto span = static_cast<float> (bodyEnd - result.sustainStart);
            const auto lateness = span > 0.0f ? 0.5f + 0.5f * static_cast<float> (bestEnd - result.sustainStart) / span : 1.0f;
            scored.push_back ({ loopStart, bestEnd, best.total * lateness, lateness, best });
        }
    }

    if (scored.empty())
    {
        result.error = "No period-aligned loop points found";
        return result;
    }

    std::sort (scored.begin(), scored.end(), [] (const Scored& a, const Scored& b) { return a.score > b.score; });

    // Within 2 periods of a better one: the same loop.
    const auto minSeparation = static_cast<juce::int64> (period * 2);
    std::vector<Scored> kept;

    for (const auto& candidate : scored)
    {
        const auto tooClose = std::any_of (kept.begin(), kept.end(), [&] (const Scored& other)
        {
            return std::abs (candidate.start - other.start) < minSeparation && std::abs (candidate.end - other.end) < minSeparation;
        });

        if (! tooClose)
            kept.push_back (candidate);

        if (static_cast<int> (kept.size()) >= juce::jmax (1, maxCandidates))
            break;
    }

    for (const auto& k : kept)
    {
        Candidate c;
        c.loopStart = k.start;
        c.loopEnd = k.end;
        c.score = k.score;
        c.crossfadeSamples = crossfadeSamples;
        c.correlation = k.parts.correlation;
        c.levelMatch = k.parts.levelMatch;
        c.valueMatch = k.parts.valueMatch;
        c.slopeMatch = k.parts.slopeMatch;
        c.lateness = k.lateness;
        addDetails (c, mono, total, rate, period);
        result.candidates.push_back (c);
    }

    result.success = true;
    return result;
}

LoopFinder::Candidate LoopFinder::describe (const juce::AudioBuffer<float>& audio, double sampleRate, juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd,
                                            double periodSamples)
{
    Candidate c;
    c.loopStart = loopStart;
    c.loopEnd = loopEnd;
    const auto monoData = monoOf (audio);
    const auto total = static_cast<juce::int64> (monoData.size());

    if (loopStart < 0 || loopEnd <= loopStart || loopEnd >= total)
        return c;

    const auto rate = sampleRate > 0.0 ? sampleRate : 44100.0;
    auto period = periodSamples;

    if (period <= 0.0)
        period = detectPitch (monoData.data(), total, (loopStart + loopEnd) / 2, rate);

    const auto parts = scoreLoopPoint (monoData.data(), loopStart, loopEnd, juce::jmax (1.0, period), total);
    c.correlation = parts.correlation;
    c.levelMatch = parts.levelMatch;
    c.valueMatch = parts.valueMatch;
    c.slopeMatch = parts.slopeMatch;
    c.score = parts.total;
    addDetails (c, monoData.data(), total, rate, period);
    return c;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\LoopFinder.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>
#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Sampler Arena's loop finder (its LoopFinder.h), the same method so the same samples get the
    same loops: a loop is a whole number of the note's pitch periods long, from a rising zero
    crossing in the steady part of the sound to near the end of its strong body, the end nudged
    by up to a quarter period to the best match; scored by how alike the two ends are (over four
    periods), how close their levels, values and slopes are, and how late the end sits.

    The pitch: autocorrelation over 4096 samples in the middle of the sustain (else at a third,
    else at two thirds), 20 Hz to 4 kHz, the top of the first strong peak (Sampler Arena took the
    first lag over 0.9, short of the top: clean tones came out sharp), refined between samples. The sustain: where the level
    (30 ms windows) is over 5% of its loudest, after the first 100 ms. The body's end: the last
    point still at half the loudest.

    Each candidate also carries what Fanan AI weighs when it picks one (SfzLoops: Ask Fanan
    AI): how long the loop is, in seconds and in periods; where it sits; the pitch at each end;
    how much the level wobbles inside it; and how alike the two ends' brightness is.
*/
namespace LoopFinder
{
    struct Candidate
    {
        juce::int64 loopStart = 0, loopEnd = 0;
        float score = 0.0f;                     // 0 .. 1, as Sampler Arena's
        int crossfadeSamples = 0;

        // How it scored, and more about it (for Fanan AI).
        float correlation = 0.0f;               // the two ends over four periods, -1 .. 1
        float levelMatch = 0.0f;                // the quieter end's level over the louder's, 0 .. 1
        float valueMatch = 0.0f, slopeMatch = 0.0f;
        float lateness = 0.0f;                  // 0.5 (the sustain's start) .. 1 (the body's end)
        double seconds = 0.0;                   // the loop's length
        double periods = 0.0;                   // in pitch periods
        double startSeconds = 0.0, endSeconds = 0.0;
        double startPitchHz = 0.0, endPitchHz = 0.0;
        float levelWobbleDb = 0.0f;             // the level's spread inside the loop (30 ms windows)
        float brightnessMatch = 0.0f;           // the two ends' share of high frequencies, 0 .. 1 alike
    };

    struct Result
    {
        bool success = false;
        juce::String error;
        juce::int64 sustainStart = 0, sustainEnd = 0, bodyEnd = 0, totalSamples = 0;
        double sampleRate = 44100.0;
        double pitchHz = 0.0, periodSamples = 0.0;
        float peakLevelDb = -100.0f;
        std::vector<Candidate> candidates;      // best first
    };

    /** A sample's loops: up to maxCandidates, best first. */
    Result analyze (const juce::AudioBuffer<float>& audio, double sampleRate, int maxCandidates = 5, int crossfadeMs = 100);

    /** The same, from a file. */
    Result analyze (const juce::File& file, int maxCandidates = 5, int crossfadeMs = 100);

    /** A candidate's numbers, filled in for a loop set by hand (or read from an SFZ). */
    Candidate describe (const juce::AudioBuffer<float>& audio, double sampleRate, juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd,
                        double periodSamples);
}

# D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MagentaJs.cmake
#
# MIDI tools' Magenta models (Google's Magenta, Apache 2.0) run on the page through magenta.js,
# the @magenta/music package's browser build (dist/magentamusic.js, 2.5 MB, TensorFlow.js
# inside), built into Sonify as binary data. The models themselves are downloaded later, from
# the MIDI tab's catalog, each when the user installs it.
#
# The package comes once into <build>/deps from the npm registry at a pinned version, checked
# against its SHA-256. As with BasicPitch.cmake, a copy kept beside the project (deps\ next to
# CMakeLists.txt, copied there from a build folder) is used instead when it's this very file.
#
# Sets FANAN_MAGENTA_JS (empty without it: Sonify builds, and the MIDI tab says the Magenta
# tools need it; the built-in MIDI FX all work).

include_guard(GLOBAL)

set(FANAN_MAGENTA_VERSION "1.23.1")
set(FANAN_MAGENTA_SHA256 "7fcb1b4c0fddb152547a262c46832e2c38f10c8ff7f2237cbdcb6aee33e08885")
set(FANAN_MAGENTA_JS "")

if(NOT DEFINED FANAN_DEPS_DIR)
    set(FANAN_DEPS_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/deps")
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR)
    set(FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps")
endif()

set(_mm_name "magenta-music-${FANAN_MAGENTA_VERSION}")
set(_mm_archive "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/${_mm_name}.tgz")
set(_mm_folder "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/${_mm_name}")
set(_mm_file "${_mm_folder}/package/dist/magentamusic.js")

# The copy kept beside the project, when it's this very package.
if(EXISTS "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_mm_name}.tgz")
    file(SHA256 "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_mm_name}.tgz" _mm_kept_hash)

    if(_mm_kept_hash STREQUAL FANAN_MAGENTA_SHA256)
        set(_mm_archive "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_mm_name}.tgz")
        message(STATUS "Using ${_mm_name} kept in ${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}")
    endif()
endif()

if(EXISTS "${_mm_archive}")
    file(SHA256 "${_mm_archive}" _mm_hash)

    if(NOT _mm_hash STREQUAL FANAN_MAGENTA_SHA256)
        file(REMOVE "${_mm_archive}")
        file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${_mm_folder}")
    endif()
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${_mm_archive}")
    message(STATUS "Downloading magenta.js ${FANAN_MAGENTA_VERSION}")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}")
    file(DOWNLOAD
        "https://registry.npmjs.org/@magenta/music/-/music-${FANAN_MAGENTA_VERSION}.tgz"
        "${_mm_archive}.part"
        STATUS _mm_status
        TLS_VERIFY ON)
    list(GET _mm_status 0 _mm_code)

    # Checked here rather than by file(DOWNLOAD): anything but this very package leaves Sonify
    # building without it rather than stopping the build.
    set(_mm_got_hash "")

    if(_mm_code EQUAL 0)
        file(SHA256 "${_mm_archive}.part" _mm_got_hash)
    endif()

    if(_mm_got_hash STREQUAL FANAN_MAGENTA_SHA256)
        file(RENAME "${_mm_archive}.part" "${_mm_archive}")
    else()
        file(REMOVE "${_mm_archive}.part")
        message(WARNING "Download of magenta.js failed (${_mm_status}): Sonify builds without the Magenta MIDI tools.")
        return()
    endif()
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${_mm_file}")
    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${_mm_folder}")
    file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${_mm_archive}" DESTINATION "${_mm_folder}" PATTERNS "package/dist/magentamusic.js")
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${_mm_file}")
    message(WARNING "magenta.js couldn't be unpacked: Sonify builds without the Magenta MIDI tools.")
    return()
endif()

set(FANAN_MAGENTA_JS "${_mm_file}")

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Main.cpp

#include <juce_gui_extra/juce_gui_extra.h>

#include "MainComponent.h"
#include "PluginScanner.h"
#include "StellaLookAndFeel.h"

//==============================================================================
class FananWebHubApplication final : public juce::JUCEApplication
{
public:
    FananWebHubApplication() = default;

    const juce::String getApplicationName() override       { return JUCE_APPLICATION_NAME_STRING; }
    const juce::String getApplicationVersion() override    { return JUCE_APPLICATION_VERSION_STRING; }

    // One instance only: most ASIO drivers can be opened by a single process at a time.
    // The copies that read plugins for the scanner are the exception: they open no audio.
    bool moreThanOneInstanceAllowed() override
    {
        return PluginScanner::isWorkerCommandLine (getCommandLineParameters());
    }

    void initialise (const juce::String& commandLine) override
    {
        // A copy started only to read one plugin for the scanner: it reads it, answers and goes,
        // with no window and no audio. If the plugin crashes, only this copy goes down.
        if (PluginScanner::isWorkerCommandLine (commandLine))
        {
            setApplicationReturnValue (PluginScanner::runWorker (getCommandLineParameterArray()));
            quit();
            return;
        }

        // Sonify's own windows, menus and dialogs wear the Plugins Creator Studio's look (Stella
        // AI Studio's, in Sonify's green): the studio needs it, and the rest matches it.
        juce::LookAndFeel::setDefaultLookAndFeel (&lookAndFeel);

        mainWindow = std::make_unique<MainWindow> (getApplicationName());
    }

    void shutdown() override
    {
        mainWindow = nullptr;
        juce::LookAndFeel::setDefaultLookAndFeel (nullptr);
    }

    void systemRequestedQuit() override
    {
        // Unsaved changes get the Save / Don't Save / Cancel question first.
        if (mainWindow != nullptr)
        {
            if (auto* content = dynamic_cast<MainComponent*> (mainWindow->getContentComponent()))
            {
                content->whenSongIsSafe ([] { juce::JUCEApplicationBase::quit(); });
                return;
            }
        }

        quit();
    }

    void anotherInstanceStarted (const juce::String&) override
    {
        if (mainWindow != nullptr)
            mainWindow->toFront (true);
    }

    //==============================================================================
    class MainWindow final : public juce::DocumentWindow
    {
    public:
        explicit MainWindow (const juce::String& name)
            : DocumentWindow (name, juce::Colour (0xff1b1d21), DocumentWindow::allButtons)
        {
            setUsingNativeTitleBar (true);
            setContentOwned (new MainComponent(), true);
            setResizable (true, true);
            setResizeLimits (820, 560, 10000, 10000);
            centreWithSize (getWidth(), getHeight());   // the size Restore brings it back to

            // Opens maximised: with the native title bar this is Windows' own maximise (title
            // bar and taskbar stay), not a kiosk-style full screen.
            setFullScreen (true);
            setVisible (true);
        }

        void closeButtonPressed() override
        {
            juce::JUCEApplication::getInstance()->systemRequestedQuit();
        }

    private:
        JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (MainWindow)
    };

private:
    StellaLookAndFeel lookAndFeel;   // outlives every window
    std::unique_ptr<MainWindow> mainWindow;
};
