    //==============================================================================
    // The Live Show (MainLive.cpp): two or four decks, the tracks marked as its channels, the pads,
    // the master and its effects, on Main in place of the song while its tab shows (or it plays). Used
    // three ways (its tabs): DJ show, Live & podcasts, Live streaming. Tracks are read into memory on
    // a thread of their own (the newest load for a deck wins), and listened to on another for their
    // tempo, first beat and key (kept, with their hot cues and loops, in its track library).
    void handleLive (const juce::var& event);
    void handleLiveDeck (int deck, const juce::var& event);
    void pushLive (const juce::String& note = {});
    void pushDeckWave (int deck);
    juce::var liveMeters();
    void loadDeck (int deck, const juce::File& file, int item = 0, bool byUser = true);   // byUser false: the playlist's zipper
    void loadPad (int pad, const juce::File& file);
    void loadSongDecks();                    // the tracks a song's decks had (and its pads), once it's open

    LiveShow::TrackLibrary& liveTracks();
    void saveLiveTracksSoon();
    void deckLoaded (int deck);              // what's known of its track, or listening to it
    void listenToDeck (int deck);
    void heardDeck (int deck, const juce::File& file, LiveShow::TrackInfo found);
    void keepDeckInfo (int deck);            // its tempo, first beat, hot cues and loops: into the library
    void analyseLiveFolder (const juce::File& folder);
    void analyseLiveFiles (std::vector<juce::File> files, const juce::String& what);   // the ones not known yet
    void pushLiveListing (const juce::String& path);

    /** A deck's speed from its tempo (the player's BPM): its track follows it (Track Sync) when its
        own tempo is known, at half or double when that's nearer; else it plays as recorded, and the
        player's BPM shows the track's. */
    void applyDeckTempo (int deck);
    void setDeckSynced (int deck, bool synced);   // SYNC: the player's BPM is the song's (the DAW's)
    void followSong (int deck);              // SYNC on, the track following the song's tempo (no beat lined up)
    void setLiveDeckValue (int deck, int index, float value);   // a deck's setting (the page, MIDI Link), and what follows it
    double songTempo();                      // the DAW's tempo, where the song stands
    void followSongTempo();                  // the status timer: synced decks follow a tempo change
    int liveLeadDeck (int except) const;     // the deck the others follow: synced, playing, its tempo known
    void alignDeckBeat (int deck, int lead); // its beats onto the lead deck's

    // Its tab (DJ show, Live & podcasts, Live streaming), Enable streaming and the mutes, and who has Main.
    void setLiveMode (const juce::String& mode);
    void setLiveSwitch (const juce::String& which, bool on);   // "stream" (Enable streaming), "mics", "playback", "both" (the mutes)
    void applyLiveMute();                    // the mutes (live & podcasts, streaming), and what goes to the stream
    void applyLiveDecks();                   // DJ show: its two or four decks; the playlist tabs: two, one player
    void updateLiveOwnership();              // Main is the show's while its tab shows, or it plays (its playlist between two tracks too)
    bool liveShowPlaying();                  // a deck or pad playing, the night recording, the stream, the playlist between two tracks
    void keepLiveExtras();                   // the mode and playlist, kept with the song

    // The playlist (Live & podcasts, Live streaming): tracks in order, each with its options.
    void handlePlaylist (const juce::String& action, const juce::var& event);
    juce::var playlistToVar();
    juce::var* findPlaylistItem (int id);
    void applyItemToDeck (int deck);         // the item a deck plays: its key, volume and Track Sync
    void placeDefaultCues (int deck);        // hot cues not placed yet: at the start, a little apart

    /** The status timer, playlist modes with Auto on: the decks filled by turns (the zipper: deck 1,
        deck 2, deck 1...), and the next one started as each ends, by its timing (below 0: a
        crossfade that long, before the end; above: a pause after it). */
    void updatePlaylist();
    int nextUnplayedAfter (int itemId);      // in the list's order (0: none left)
    int playlistIndexOf (int itemId) const;  // its place in the list (-1: not there)
    int listPlaceOf (int deck);              // where the list goes on after a deck's track: its item, or where it was (0: the top)
    void emptyDeck (int deck, bool keepLoad = false);   // its track off it, a load on its way forgotten (or kept) (Eject: it isn't playing)
    void clearPlayer();                      // the list emptied: the player's two decks emptied too (one playing fades out first)
    void dropGoneFromPlayer (int gone, int before);   // an item off the list: a deck holding or bringing it emptied, unless it plays
    void choosePlaylistFile (bool saving);   // Save... / Open...: where
    void savePlaylist (const juce::File& file);
    void openPlaylist (const juce::File& file);
    void restoreTrackInfo (const juce::File& file, const LiveShow::TrackInfo& saved);   // a playlist's markers for a track
    static juce::File libraryFolderFile();   // where the folder Browse chose is kept (AppData\Roaming\Fanan\Sonify)
    static juce::String keptLibraryFolder(); // that folder, the library's at every start ("": none chosen)
    static bool keepLibraryFolder (const juce::File& folder);

    // The playlist's tabs: one player (decks 1 and 2 by turns, the deck behind only crossfading the

    /** Media import (MainImport.cpp): audio files dragged in from a folder on the computer and
        dropped in the arrangement, Load Media..., File > Import Media Files.... Kinds Sonify
        doesn't play as they are (M4A, AAC, Opus...) are read into WAVs first by FFmpeg. */
    struct MediaPlace
    {
        int trackId = 0;            // the first file onto this audio track (none: a new track)
        int after = 0;              // new tracks under this one (0: at the end)
        double start = 0.0;         // quarter notes

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainContainers.cpp
//
// Containers (Container.h) and Sonify: what a container asks of it (plugins from the
// Browser's library, a node's screen opened the way Sonify opens any plugin's, ids the page
// can name a node's plugin by), and the page's view of what's inside one. And the Playlist
// Player's window and folders (PlaylistPlayer.h).

#include "MainComponent.h"
#include "BuiltinPlugins.h"
#include "ContainerCanvas.h"
#include "PlaylistScreen.h"

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::setupContainers()
{
    Containers::setHost (this);
    ContainerCanvas::install();   // containers open Colosseum's node canvas

    // The Playlist Player opens OnStage's Media page, and keeps its playlists with the user's things.
    PlaylistScreen::install();
    Playlists::setUserFolder ([] { return UserData::getFolder(); });
}

std::unique_ptr<Plugin> MainComponent::loadPlugin (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error)
{
    auto plugin = Plugin::load (file, pluginId, error);

    if (plugin != nullptr)
        library.markUsed (Builtins::isBuiltinId (pluginId) ? Builtins::file().getFullPathName() : file.getFullPathName(), plugin->getDescriptor().id);

    return plugin;
}

std::vector<Containers::Choice> MainComponent::listPlugins()
{
    std::vector<Containers::Choice> choices;

    for (const auto& entry : library.getEntries())
    {
        if (entry.missing)
            continue;

        Containers::Choice choice;
        choice.file = entry.file;
        choice.id = entry.id;
        choice.name = entry.name;
        choice.vendor = entry.vendor;
        choice.kind = entry.kind;
        choice.category = entry.category;
        choice.format = entry.format();
        choice.favorite = entry.favorite;
        choices.push_back (choice);
    }

    return choices;
}

void MainComponent::openScreen (Plugin& plugin)
{
    int channel = 0, slot = 0;

    if (! engine.locatePlugin (plugin, channel, slot))
        return;

    // The page has to know the node's plugin before it can show it.
    if (std::exchange (containersChanged, false))
        pushTracks();

    openPluginScreen (channel, slot);

    // Its window is on Sonify's page: bring that forward, over the container's window.
    if (plugin.getScreenKind() != Plugin::ScreenKind::native)
        if (auto* top = getTopLevelComponent())
            top->toFront (true);
}

int MainComponent::allocateSlotId()
{
    return engine.allocateInsertId();
}

void MainComponent::containerChanged (ContainerPlugin&)
{
    markChanged();
    containersChanged = true;
}

juce::File MainComponent::containersFolder()
{
    return UserData::getFolder().getChildFile ("Containers");
}

double MainComponent::sampleRate() const
{
    return engine.getPlaybackRate();
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::addContainerInfo (Plugin& plugin, juce::DynamicObject& state)
{
    auto* container = dynamic_cast<ContainerPlugin*> (&plugin);

    if (container == nullptr)
        return;

    // What's inside: each node's plugin (named by its slot id), so its screen can be shown and
    // its controls moved like any plugin's. A container inside lists its own.
    juce::Array<juce::var> nodes;

    for (auto* node : container->getGraph().getNodes())
    {
        if (auto* pluginNode = dynamic_cast<PluginNode*> (node->getProcessor()))
        {
            auto item = pluginToVar (pluginNode->getPlugin());
            item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("insertId", pluginNode->slotId);
            item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("bypass", node->isBypassed());
            nodes.add (item);
        }
    }

    state.setProperty ("container", true);
    state.setProperty ("containerName", container->getContainerName());
    state.setProperty ("nodes", nodes);
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainCreator.cpp
//
// The Plugins Creator Studio (CreatorStudio): Stella AI Studio inside Sonify, with Sonify AI
// building. It's native, so it lives in a window of its own laid over the page's studio area
// while the studio is in front (as the web tabs do), and steps aside for the page's dialogs and
// menus. Its tabs: Build with AI, Edit UI and Knob Studio.
//
// Build with AI makes everything, MIDI FX included: a MIDI FX is one of Sonify's devices, made by
// the Device Studio (MainDevices.cpp) and its own Sonify AI, shown in the studio's conversation. A
// device opened from a track's MIDI FX (or its menu's New Device) shows there too.
//
// Page events: creatorShow {x, y, width, height} (the studio area, in the page's pixels) |
// creatorHide {overlay (the studio is still in front, under a dialog or menu of the page)} |
// creatorTab {index} | creatorState. Sonify sends: creator {tab} whenever its tab changes;
// runCommand {command} for Sonify's keys pressed in it (Ctrl+1..8, Ctrl+Tab).

#include "MainComponent.h"
#include "CreatorPlugin.h"
#include "CreatorStudio.h"
#include "Settings.h"
#include "StellaLookAndFeel.h"

namespace
{
    /** The studio's own window, over Sonify's page (as WebTabLayer: a native window above the
        page's WebView2). */
    class CreatorLayer final : public juce::Component
    {
    public:
        CreatorLayer()
        {
            setOpaque (true);
        }

        void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override
        {
            g.fillAll (Theme::window);
        }

        void resized() override
        {
            for (auto* child : getChildren())
                child->setBounds (getLocalBounds());
        }
    };

    template <typename Handler>
    std::function<void (const juce::var&)> afterCreatorEvent (MainComponent* owner, Handler handler)
    {
        // As every page event: after WebView2's own callback has returned (see afterEvent).
        return [safe = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (owner), handler = std::move (handler)] (const juce::var& event)
        {
            juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safe, handler, event]
            {
                if (safe != nullptr)
                    handler (event);
            });
        };
    }
}


//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::setupCreator()
{
    // Sonify's settings are read by now: the user data folder (where made plugins are) and
    // Block internet.
    Settings::setInternetBlocked (internetBlocked);
    library.refreshMadePlugins();

    creator = std::make_unique<CreatorStudio> (engine, *server);

    creator->onPageCommand = [this] (const juce::String& command) { surfaceCommand (command); };
    creator->onPluginAdded = [this] (const juce::File& folder, const juce::String& name, bool replaced)
    {
        creatorPluginAdded (folder, name, replaced);
    };

    // MIDI FX are Sonify's devices: the studio makes them with the Device Studio and its Sonify AI.
    if (deviceStudio != nullptr && deviceAgent != nullptr)
        creator->setMidiDevices (*deviceStudio, *deviceAgent);
}

juce::WebBrowserComponent::Options MainComponent::withCreatorEvents (juce::WebBrowserComponent::Options options)
{
    return options
        .withEventListener ("creatorShow", afterCreatorEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event)
        {
            creatorArea = { static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("x", 0)), static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("y", 0)),
                            static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("width", 0)), static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("height", 0)) };
            creatorShown = true;
            placeCreator();

            if (creator != nullptr)
                creator->setShown (true);
        }))
        .withEventListener ("creatorHide", afterCreatorEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event)
        {
            creatorShown = false;
            hideCreator();

            // Only stepping aside for the page's dialog or menu: the studio is still in front,
            // and keeps the live notes.
            if (creator != nullptr && ! static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("overlay", false)))
                creator->setShown (false);
        }))
        .withEventListener ("creatorTab", afterCreatorEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event)
        {
            if (creator != nullptr)
                creator->showTab (static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("index", 0)));

            emitCreatorState();
        }))
        .withEventListener ("creatorState", afterCreatorEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var&) { emitCreatorState(); }));
}

void MainComponent::placeCreator()
{
    auto* peer = getPeer();

    if (creator == nullptr || ! creatorShown || creatorArea.isEmpty() || peer == nullptr)
    {
        hideCreator();
        return;
    }

    if (creatorLayer == nullptr)
    {
        creatorLayer = std::make_unique<CreatorLayer>();
        creatorLayer->addAndMakeVisible (*creator);
    }

    if (! creatorLayer->isOnDesktop())
        creatorLayer->addToDesktop (0, peer->getNativeHandle());

    // The page's pixels are this component's own (the page fills it); the layer sits in the main
    // window, so the area is carried over to the window's coordinates.
    creatorLayer->setBounds (getTopLevelComponent()->getLocalArea (this, creatorArea));
    creatorLayer->setVisible (true);
    creatorLayer->toFront (false);   // above the page, every time
}

void MainComponent::hideCreator()
{
    if (creatorLayer == nullptr || ! creatorLayer->isVisible())
        return;

    // The keyboard goes back to the page, which is in front again.
    const bool hadFocus = creatorLayer->hasKeyboardFocus (true);
    creatorLayer->setVisible (false);

    if (hadFocus && webView != nullptr)
        webView->grabKeyboardFocus();
}

void MainComponent::emitCreatorState()
{
    if (webView == nullptr || creator == nullptr)
        return;

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr state (new juce::DynamicObject());
    state->setProperty ("tab", creator->getCurrentTab());
    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("creator", juce::var (state.get()));
}

void MainComponent::creatorPluginAdded (const juce::File& folder, const juce::String& name, bool replaced)
{
    library.refreshMadePlugins (folder);

    pushLibrary (replaced ? name + " is updated in the Browser (Made in Sonify). Tracks that already play it get the new "
                                   "version when their song opens again."
                          : name + " is in the Browser now, under Made in Sonify: drag it onto a track.");
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainDevices.cpp
//
// Sonify devices (DeviceHost.h): made by Sonify AI with the Device Studio (DeviceStudio.h) in the
// Plugins Creator Studio's Build with AI (type MIDI FX), played in instrument tracks' MIDI FX, kept
// in My Devices and in the songs that use them. A device opened from the page (a track's MIDI FX
// window, the MIDI FX menu's New Device) shows there. What devices move in Sonify (their outputs,
// mapped by the user, and controls they name) goes through MIDI Link's host, so it moves exactly
// what a MIDI controller would.

#include "MainComponent.h"
#include "CreatorStudio.h"

namespace
{
    juce::var object()
    {
        return juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    }

    juce::var copyOf (const juce::var& value)
    {
        return juce::JSON::parse (juce::JSON::toString (value, true));
    }

    /** The track's name as MIDI Link and the page number it: "Track 2 (Piano)". */
    juce::String trackLabel (const AudioEngine& engine, int trackId)
    {
        int number = 0;

        for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
        {
            if (track->kind == Track::Kind::fx || track->kind == Track::Kind::bus)
                continue;

            ++number;

            if (track->id == trackId)
                return "Track " + juce::String (number) + " (" + track->name + ")";
        }

        return {};
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::setupDevices()
{
    MidiFx::setExternalMaker (Devices::makeFx);
    Devices::setMyDevicesFolder (UserData::getFolder().getChildFile ("Devices"));
    Devices::setSampleRate (engine.getPlaybackRate());

    deviceStudio = std::make_unique<DeviceStudio> (engine, DeviceStudio::Hooks {
        [this] (const std::shared_ptr<Devices::Build>& build, bool addIfNowhere) { return placeDeviceBuild (build, addIfNowhere); },
        [this] { deviceStudioDue = true; } });

    deviceAgent = std::make_unique<AiAgent> (*server, *deviceStudio, AiAgent::Hooks {
        [] (const juce::String&) {},
        [this] (const juce::String&, bool)
        {
            // The conversation stays with the device, so it carries on next time.
            if (deviceStudio->isOpen())
                deviceStudio->keepConversation (deviceAgent->saveConversation());

            pushDeviceAi();
        },
        [this] { pushDeviceAi(); } });

    deviceTimer.startTimerHz (60);
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String MainComponent::placeDeviceBuild (const std::shared_ptr<Devices::Build>& build, bool addIfNowhere)
{
    if (build == nullptr)
        return {};

    // Every place the device is: the new build, each keeping its settings and maps.
    engine.replaceMidiFx ([&build] (const MidiFx::Device& old) -> std::unique_ptr<MidiFx::Device>
    {
        const auto* fx = dynamic_cast<const Devices::DeviceFx*> (&old);

        if (fx == nullptr || fx->getBuild() == nullptr || fx->getBuild()->deviceId != build->deviceId || fx->getBuild() == build)
            return nullptr;

        auto fresh = std::make_unique<Devices::DeviceFx> (build, Devices::currentSampleRate());

        for (size_t i = 0; i < fresh->spec.params.size(); ++i)
            for (size_t j = 0; j < old.spec.params.size(); ++j)
                if (old.spec.params[j].id == fresh->spec.params[i].id)
                    fresh->set (static_cast<int> (i), old.get (static_cast<int> (j)));

        fresh->maps = copyOf (fx->maps);
        return fresh;
    });

    juce::StringArray places;

    for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
        for (int i = 0; i < track->midiFx.size(); ++i)
            if (const auto* fx = dynamic_cast<const Devices::DeviceFx*> (track->midiFx.at (i)->device.get());
                fx != nullptr && fx->getBuild() != nullptr && fx->getBuild()->deviceId == build->deviceId)
                places.addIfNotAlreadyThere (trackLabel (engine, track->id));

    if (! places.isEmpty())
    {
        pushTracks();
        return places.joinIntoString (", ");
    }

    if (! addIfNowhere)
        return {};

    // Nowhere yet: on the track it's tried on, the selected one, or the first instrument track.
    const auto isInstrument = [this] (int id)
    {
        const auto* track = engine.findTrack (id);
        return track != nullptr && track->kind == Track::Kind::instrument && ! track->midiFx.isFull();
    };

    auto trackId = isInstrument (deviceTryTrack) ? deviceTryTrack : isInstrument (engine.getSelectedTrackId()) ? engine.getSelectedTrackId() : 0;

    for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
        if (trackId == 0 && isInstrument (track->id))
            trackId = track->id;

    if (trackId == 0 || ! addDeviceToTrack (trackId, build, false))
        return {};

    deviceTryTrack = trackId;
    return trackLabel (engine, trackId);
}

bool MainComponent::addDeviceToTrack (int trackId, const std::shared_ptr<Devices::Build>& build, bool open)
{
    if (build == nullptr)
        return false;

    auto settings = object();
    settings.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("device", build->describe());

    const auto before = engine.getMidiFx (trackId);
    const auto added = engine.addMidiFx (trackId, "device", -1, settings);

    if (added == 0)
        return false;

    addToHistory ("Add " + build->name, new Edits::MidiFxChanged (engine, trackId, before, engine.getMidiFx (trackId)));
    pushTracks();

    if (webView != nullptr)
    {
        auto data = object();
        data.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("trackId", trackId);
        data.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("fxId", added);
        data.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("open", open);
        webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("midiFxAdded", data);
    }

    return true;
}

juce::var MainComponent::deviceSettingsFor (const juce::var& event, juce::String& error)
{
    // A device from My Devices (its file), or one already here (its build, by hash).
    std::shared_ptr<Devices::Build> build;
    const auto path = event.getProperty ("file", {}).toString();

    if (path.isNotEmpty() && juce::File::isAbsolutePath (path))
        build = DeviceStudio::buildOfFile (juce::File (path), error);
    else if (const auto hash = event.getProperty ("device", {}).getProperty ("hash", {}).toString(); hash.isNotEmpty())
        build = Devices::findBuild (hash);

    if (build == nullptr)
    {
        if (error.isEmpty())
            error = "That device isn't here.";

        return {};
    }

    auto settings = copyOf (event);
    settings.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("device", build->describe());
    return settings;
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::handleDeviceStudio (const juce::var& event)
{
    const auto action = event.getProperty ("action", {}).toString();
    const auto problem = [this] (const juce::String& text)
    {
        if (webView != nullptr)
        {
            auto data = object();
            data.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("message", text);
            webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("deviceStudioMessage", data);
        }
    };

    // Switching devices while Sonify AI works on one would pull it from under it.
    const auto switching = action == "new" || action == "open" || action == "openSlot" || action == "close" || action == "trash";

    if (switching && deviceAgent->isBusy())
        return problem ("Fanan AI is working on this device: stop it first (or wait for it).");

    // ...or the plugin the Plugins Creator Studio has open, which a device would take the place of.
    if (switching && creator != nullptr && creator->isBusy())
        return problem ("Fanan AI is still working on the plugin in the Plugins Creator Studio: once it's done (or stopped), open the device again.");

    // The conversation that comes with the device opened.
    const auto takeConversation = [this]
    {
        deviceAgent->restoreConversation (deviceStudio->isOpen() ? deviceStudio->getDevice().chat : juce::var());
    };

    if (action == "shown")
    {
        deviceStudioShown = static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("shown", false));
        deviceStudio->getLibrary (true);
        pushDeviceStudio();
    }
    else if (action == "state")
    {
        pushDeviceStudio();
        pushDeviceAi();
    }
    else if (action == "new")
    {
        deviceStudio->newDevice();
        takeConversation();
    }
    else if (action == "open")
    {
        if (const auto result = deviceStudio->open (juce::File (event.getProperty ("file", {}).toString())); result.failed())
            return problem (result.getErrorMessage());

        takeConversation();
    }
    else if (action == "openSlot")
    {
        // A device's window: "Open in Device Studio". It's tried on that track from now on.
        const auto trackId = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("trackId", 0));
        const auto fxId = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("fxId", 0));
        const auto* track = engine.findTrack (trackId);
        const auto* slot = track != nullptr ? track->midiFx.find (fxId) : nullptr;
        const auto* fx = slot != nullptr ? dynamic_cast<const Devices::DeviceFx*> (slot->device.get()) : nullptr;

        if (fx == nullptr || fx->getBuild() == nullptr)
            return problem ("That device can't be opened here (it isn't on this computer).");

        if (! deviceStudio->isOpen() || deviceStudio->getDevice().id != fx->getBuild()->deviceId)
        {
            if (const auto result = deviceStudio->openBuild (fx->getBuild()); result.failed())
                return problem (result.getErrorMessage());

            takeConversation();
        }

        deviceTryTrack = trackId;
    }
    else if (action == "close")
    {
        deviceStudio->close();
        takeConversation();
    }
    else if (action == "build")
    {
        deviceStudio->buildDevice ([this] (const juce::var& result)
        {
            if (result.hasProperty ("error"))
                if (webView != nullptr)
                    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("deviceStudioMessage", result);

            pushDeviceStudio();
        });
    }
    else if (action == "rename")
    {
        if (const auto result = deviceStudio->setInfo (event.getProperty ("name", {}).toString(), event.getProperty ("description", {}).toString()); result.failed())
            return problem (result.getErrorMessage());
    }
    else if (action == "tryOn")
    {
        deviceTryTrack = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("trackId", 0));
    }
    else if (action == "placeOn")
    {
        // Another place for the open device's build: a track of the user's choosing.
        const auto trackId = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("trackId", 0));
        const auto build = deviceStudio->getBuild();

        if (build == nullptr)
            return problem ("Build the device first.");

        const auto* track = engine.findTrack (trackId);

        if (track == nullptr || track->kind != Track::Kind::instrument)
            return problem ("Devices go on instrument tracks.");

        if (track->midiFx.isFull())
            return problem ("That track's MIDI FX are full.");

        if (! addDeviceToTrack (trackId, build, false))
            return problem ("It couldn't be added to that track.");

        deviceTryTrack = trackId;
    }
    else if (action == "trash")
    {
        if (const auto result = deviceStudio->trash (juce::File (event.getProperty ("file", {}).toString())); result.failed())
            return problem (result.getErrorMessage());

        takeConversation();
    }
    else if (action == "reveal")
    {
        const auto folder = Devices::myDevicesFolder();
        folder.createDirectory();
        folder.revealToUser();
    }
    else if (action == "import")
    {
        if (deviceAgent->isBusy())
            return problem ("Fanan AI is working on this device: stop it first (or wait for it).");

        fileChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Add a Sonify device", juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userHomeDirectory),
                                                           juce::String ("*") + Devices::fileExtension);
        fileChooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles,
                                  [safe = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this), problem] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
        {
            if (safe == nullptr || ! chooser.getResult().existsAsFile())
                return;

            // Sonify AI may have started on the open device while the chooser was up.
            if (safe->deviceAgent->isBusy())
                return problem ("Fanan AI is working on this device: stop it first (or wait for it).");

            if (const auto result = safe->deviceStudio->open (chooser.getResult()); result.failed())
                return problem (result.getErrorMessage());

            safe->deviceAgent->restoreConversation (safe->deviceStudio->getDevice().chat);
            safe->pushDeviceStudio();
            safe->pushDeviceAi();

            if (safe->creator != nullptr)
                safe->creator->showMidiDevice();
        });
        return;
    }
    else if (action == "export")
    {
        if (! deviceStudio->isOpen())
            return;

        const auto suggested = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userDocumentsDirectory)
                                   .getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (deviceStudio->getDevice().name) + Devices::fileExtension);
        fileChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Save a copy of the device", suggested, juce::String ("*") + Devices::fileExtension);
        fileChooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::saveMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles
                                      | juce::FileBrowserComponent::warnAboutOverwriting,
                                  [safe = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this), problem] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
        {
            if (safe == nullptr || chooser.getResult() == juce::File() || ! safe->deviceStudio->isOpen())
                return;

            const auto target = chooser.getResult().withFileExtension (Devices::fileExtension);

            if (const auto result = safe->deviceStudio->getDevice().write (target); result.failed())
                problem (result.getErrorMessage());
        });
        return;
    }
    else if (action == "update")
    {
        // A place in the song to the newer version in My Devices.
        const auto trackId = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("trackId", 0));
        const auto fxId = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("fxId", 0));
        const auto* track = engine.findTrack (trackId);
        const auto* slot = track != nullptr ? track->midiFx.find (fxId) : nullptr;
        const auto* fx = slot != nullptr ? dynamic_cast<const Devices::DeviceFx*> (slot->device.get()) : nullptr;
        const auto* entry = fx != nullptr && fx->getBuild() != nullptr ? deviceStudio->findInLibrary (fx->getBuild()->deviceId) : nullptr;

        if (entry == nullptr)
            return problem ("There's no newer version of it in My Devices.");

        juce::String error;
        const auto newer = DeviceStudio::buildOfFile (entry->file, error);

        if (newer == nullptr)
            return problem (error);

        engine.replaceMidiFx ([fx, &newer] (const MidiFx::Device& old) -> std::unique_ptr<MidiFx::Device>
        {
            if (&old != fx)
                return nullptr;

            auto fresh = std::make_unique<Devices::DeviceFx> (newer, Devices::currentSampleRate());

            for (size_t i = 0; i < fresh->spec.params.size(); ++i)
                for (size_t j = 0; j < old.spec.params.size(); ++j)
                    if (old.spec.params[j].id == fresh->spec.params[i].id)
                        fresh->set (static_cast<int> (i), old.get (static_cast<int> (j)));

            fresh->maps = copyOf (fx->maps);
            return fresh;
        });

        markChanged();
        pushTracks();
    }

    pushDeviceStudio();
    pushDeviceAi();

    // A device opened: the Plugins Creator Studio's Build with AI shows it (the page brings the
    // studio to the front).
    if ((action == "new" || action == "open" || action == "openSlot") && creator != nullptr)
        creator->showMidiDevice();
}

void MainComponent::handleDeviceMap (const juce::var& event)
{
    // An output's Map button: what it moves (MIDI Link's Target), or nothing.
    const auto trackId = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("trackId", 0));
    const auto fxId = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("fxId", 0));
    const auto output = event.getProperty ("output", {}).toString().substring (0, 64);
    auto* track = engine.findTrack (trackId);
    auto* slot = track != nullptr ? track->midiFx.find (fxId) : nullptr;
    auto* fx = slot != nullptr ? dynamic_cast<Devices::DeviceFx*> (slot->device.get()) : nullptr;

    if (fx == nullptr || output.isEmpty())
        return;

    if (! fx->maps.isObject())
        fx->maps = object();

    const auto target = MidiLink::Target::fromVar (event.getProperty ("target", {}));

    if (target.isValid())
        fx->maps.getDynamicObject()->setProperty (output, target.toVar());
    else
        fx->maps.getDynamicObject()->removeProperty (output);

    markChanged();
    pushTracks();
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::updateDevices()
{
    if (deviceStudio == nullptr)
        return;

    Devices::setSampleRate (engine.getPlaybackRate());

    // What devices moved: each control only when its value changed since the device last moved it.
    // While a mixdown renders (faster than time goes by), what devices move is left alone: it
    // would land at the wrong moments, and the transport isn't theirs to move then.
    std::vector<Devices::Move> moves;
    Devices::takeMoves (moves);

    if (engine.isMixdownRunning())
        moves.clear();

    for (const auto& move : moves)
    {
        MidiLink::Target target;

        if (move.kind == sonify::abi::controlTarget)
        {
            target.key = juce::String::fromUTF8 (move.target).substring (0, 64);
        }
        else
        {
            const auto* fx = Devices::findFx (move.instance);

            if (fx == nullptr || fx->getBuild() == nullptr || ! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (move.output, static_cast<int> (fx->getBuild()->outputs.size())))
                continue;

            const auto mapped = fx->maps.getProperty (fx->getBuild()->outputs[static_cast<size_t> (move.output)].id, {});

            if (! mapped.isObject())
                continue;

            target = MidiLink::Target::fromVar (mapped);
        }

        // A device names only what MIDI Link has (no plugin by name: that's what outputs are for).
        if (! target.isValid() || (move.kind == sonify::abi::controlTarget && target.key == "plugin"))
            continue;

        const auto key = std::make_pair (move.instance, target.id());
        const auto found = deviceMoveValues.find (key);

        if (target.isContinuous())
        {
            if (found != deviceMoveValues.end() && std::abs (found->second - move.value) < 1.0e-4f)
                continue;

            deviceMoveValues[key] = move.value;
            linkMove (target, move.value);
        }
        else
        {
            const auto on = move.value >= 0.5f;

            if (found != deviceMoveValues.end() && (found->second >= 0.5f) == on)
                continue;

            deviceMoveValues[key] = move.value;
            linkSet (target, on);
        }
    }

    // Now and then, what devices that are gone last moved is forgotten.
    if (++deviceTicks % 300 == 0)
        for (auto it = deviceMoveValues.begin(); it != deviceMoveValues.end();)
            it = Devices::findFx (it->first.first) == nullptr ? deviceMoveValues.erase (it) : std::next (it);

    if (deviceStudioDue)
    {
        deviceStudioDue = false;
        pushDeviceStudio();
    }

    // The Device Studio's view of the open device playing: about ten times a second while it shows.
    if (deviceStudioShown && deviceStudio->isOpen() && deviceTicks % 6 == 0 && webView != nullptr)
    {
        const auto live = deviceStudio->takeLiveStatus();
        const auto text = juce::JSON::toString (live, true);

        if (text != deviceLivePushed || live.getProperty ("log", {}).toString().isNotEmpty())
        {
            deviceLivePushed = text;
            webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("deviceLive", live);
        }
    }
}

void MainComponent::pushDeviceStudio()
{
    // The Plugins Creator Studio shows the open device (a MIDI FX) in Build with AI.
    if (creator != nullptr && deviceStudio != nullptr)
        creator->midiDeviceChanged();

    if (webView == nullptr || deviceStudio == nullptr)
        return;

    auto state = deviceStudio->getState();
    auto* fields = state.getDynamicObject();
    fields->setProperty ("aiBusy", deviceAgent != nullptr && deviceAgent->isBusy());
    fields->setProperty ("tryTrack", deviceTryTrack);
    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("deviceStudio", state);
}

void MainComponent::pushDeviceAi()
{
    // ...with its Sonify AI's conversation.
    if (creator != nullptr && deviceAgent != nullptr)
        creator->midiDeviceChanged();

    if (webView == nullptr || deviceAgent == nullptr)
        return;

    auto state = deviceAgent->getState();
    addAiAccount (state);
    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("deviceAiState", state);
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainGuide.cpp

#include "MainComponent.h"

#include "BinaryData.h"

//==============================================================================
// The Guide (its own tab, hub-guide.js): Sonify's user guide, sonify_guide.md, which the page
// reads and shows in tabs and chapters, and "Ask anything about Sonify": Fanan AI answering the
// user's questions from that same guide (GuideAi), with the Fanan account's credits.
//
// The page sends "guide" events: { action: "ask", text, reading } (reading: the chapter it has
// open, "Tab > Chapter"), { action: "stop" } and { action: "clear" }. Sonify sends "guideState":
// the conversation, whether a question is under way, and the account (as the AI panels have it).

namespace
{
    /** The guide, as compiled into the program with the page's files. */
    juce::String guideText()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < BinaryData::namedResourceListSize; ++i)
        {
            if (juce::String (BinaryData::originalFilenames[i]) == "sonify_guide.md")
            {
                int size = 0;

                if (const auto* data = BinaryData::getNamedResource (BinaryData::namedResourceList[i], size))
                    return juce::String::fromUTF8 (data, size);
            }
        }

        jassertfalse;   // sonify_guide.md belongs in FananWebHubWeb (CMakeLists.txt)
        return {};
    }
}

void MainComponent::setupGuide()
{
    guideAi = std::make_unique<GuideAi> (*server, guideText());
    guideAi->onChanged = [this] { pushGuide(); };
}

void MainComponent::handleGuide (const juce::var& event)
{
    if (guideAi == nullptr)
        return;

    const auto action = event.getProperty ("action", {}).toString();

    if (action == "ask")
        guideAi->ask (event.getProperty ("text", {}).toString(), event.getProperty ("reading", {}).toString());
    else if (action == "stop")
        guideAi->stop();
    else if (action == "clear")
        guideAi->clear();
    else if (action == "state")
        pushGuide();
}

void MainComponent::pushGuide()
{
    if (webView == nullptr || guideAi == nullptr)
        return;

    auto state = guideAi->getState();
    addAiAccount (state);
    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("guideState", state);
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainImport.cpp

#include "MainComponent.h"
#include "PageDropZone.h"
#include "VideoSound.h"

#include <cmath>

//==============================================================================
// Media brought into the song (hub-import.js): audio files dragged in straight from a folder on
// the computer and dropped in the arrangement, Load Media... (an audio track's right-click menu,
// and the arrangement's), and File > Import Media Files....
//
// "importMedia" events from the page:
//   { action: "fileDrag", left, top, width, height }   files from the computer over the
//        arrangement: Sonify's drop zone goes over it (the page can't learn where such files are)
//   { action: "files", paths, trackId, after, start, oneTrack }   the files to bring in, from
//        start (quarter notes): the first onto trackId when that's an audio track, each other one
//        (or every one, with no such track) onto a new audio track named after it, each new track
//        under the one before (the first under `after`, or at the end); oneTrack: all on one
//        track, one after another
//   { action: "choose", trackId, after, start }   Load Media...: the files chosen go the same way
// Sonify tells the page:
//   "arrangeFileDrag" { active, x, y, shift, count, name }   files moving over the drop zone
//                                                           (active false: it's gone)
//   "arrangeFileDrop" { paths, x, y, shift }                 dropped there; the page answers with
//                                                           "files", placed where that is
//   "mediaImport" { state: "working" | "done", done, total, name }   files being read into WAVs
//
// Audio files of the kinds Sonify plays as they are (WAV, AIFF, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, MP3; WMA on
// Windows; M4A, AAC and CAF on a Mac) go in as they are. Other kinds FFmpeg reads (M4A, AAC, Opus,
// WMA, ALAC, AC-3, WavPack, APE...) are written into WAVs first, in the song's Media folder, on a
// thread of their own: every part of Sonify (the Audio Editor, freezing, exports) reads those.
// A folder brings its audio files, by name. A video becomes the song's video, as when it's
// imported (one at a time). All the clips and tracks are one undo step.

namespace
{
    /** Kinds FFmpeg reads sound from: the ones Sonify doesn't play as they are become WAVs. */
    const char* const convertedKinds = "m4a;m4b;m4r;aac;adts;opus;oga;ogg;wma;asf;alac;caf;ac3;eac3;dts;wv;ape;mka;amr;awb;au;snd;"
                                       "mp2;mpa;tta;tak;aifc;wav;wave;aif;aiff;flac;mp3;3ga";

    bool shiftHeld();

    juce::var pathList (const juce::Array<juce::File>& files)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> list;

        for (const auto& file : files)
            list.add (file.getFullPathName());

        return list;
    }
}

bool MainComponent::isImportable (const juce::File& file)
{
    if (! file.existsAsFile())
        return false;

    return engine.getMedia().isAudioFile (file)
        || VideoMedia::isVideoFile (file)
        || (VideoSound::available() && file.hasFileExtension (convertedKinds));
}

juce::Array<juce::File> MainComponent::mediaIn (const juce::StringArray& paths)
{
    juce::Array<juce::File> found;

    for (const auto& path : paths)
    {
        const juce::File file (path);

        if (! file.isDirectory())
        {
            if (isImportable (file))
                found.addIfNotAlreadyThere (file);

            continue;
        }

        // A folder: its audio files, by name (not its videos, nor what's in its folders).
        std::vector<juce::File> inside;

        for (const auto& entry : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (file, false, "*", juce::File::findFiles | juce::File::ignoreHiddenFiles))
            if (isImportable (entry.getFile()) && ! VideoMedia::isVideoFile (entry.getFile()))
                inside.push_back (entry.getFile());

        std::sort (inside.begin(), inside.end(), [] (const juce::File& a, const juce::File& b) { return a.getFileName().compareNatural (b.getFileName()) < 0; });

        for (const auto& each : inside)
            found.addIfNotAlreadyThere (each);
    }

    return found;
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::handleImport (const juce::var& event)
{
    const auto action = event.getProperty ("action", {}).toString();

    if (action == "fileDrag")
    {
        showArrangeDropZone (event);
        return;
    }

    MediaPlace place;
    place.trackId = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("trackId", 0));
    place.after = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("after", 0));
    place.start = juce::jmax (0.0, static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("start", 0.0)));
    place.oneTrack = static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("oneTrack", false));

    if (! std::isfinite (place.start))
        place.start = 0.0;

    if (action == "choose")
    {
        chooseMedia (place);
        return;
    }

    if (action == "files")
    {
        juce::StringArray paths;

        if (const auto* list = event.getProperty ("paths", {}).getArray())
            for (const auto& path : *list)
                paths.add (path.toString());

        importMedia (mediaIn (paths), place);
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::showArrangeDropZone (const juce::var& event)
{
    if (webView == nullptr)
        return;

    const juce::Rectangle<int> area (juce::roundToInt (static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("left", 0.0))),
                                     juce::roundToInt (static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("top", 0.0))),
                                     juce::roundToInt (static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("width", 0.0))),
                                     juce::roundToInt (static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("height", 0.0))));

    if (area.getWidth() < 40 || area.getHeight() < 20)
        return;

    if (arrangeDropZone == nullptr)
    {
        // Quiet: the page shows where the files would go as they move.
        auto zone = std::make_unique<PageDropZone> (juce::String());

        zone->accepts = [this] (const juce::File& file) { return file.isDirectory() || isImportable (file); };

        zone->onMove = [this] (const juce::StringArray& files, juce::Point<int> onPage)
        {
            if (webView == nullptr)
                return;

            // What's dragged is looked at once (a folder opened), then only where it is.
            if (files != arrangeDragPaths)
            {
                arrangeDragPaths = files;
                const auto media = mediaIn (files);
                arrangeDragCount = media.size();
                arrangeDragName = media.isEmpty() ? juce::String() : media.getFirst().getFileName();
            }

            const auto shift = shiftHeld();
            const auto now = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();

            if (onPage == arrangeDragAt && shift == arrangeDragShift && now - arrangeDragSent < 250.0)
                return;

            arrangeDragAt = onPage;
            arrangeDragShift = shift;
            arrangeDragSent = now;

            juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
            item->setProperty ("active", true);
            item->setProperty ("x", onPage.x);
            item->setProperty ("y", onPage.y);
            item->setProperty ("shift", shift);
            item->setProperty ("count", arrangeDragCount);
            item->setProperty ("name", arrangeDragName);
            webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("arrangeFileDrag", juce::var (item.get()));
        };

        zone->onHidden = [this]
        {
            arrangeDragPaths.clear();
            arrangeDragAt = { -1, -1 };

            if (webView == nullptr)
                return;

            juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
            item->setProperty ("active", false);
            webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("arrangeFileDrag", juce::var (item.get()));
        };

        zone->onDrop = [this] (const juce::StringArray& dropped, juce::Point<int> onPage)
        {
            const auto media = mediaIn (dropped);

            if (media.isEmpty())
            {
                pushTracks ("Only audio files (and a video) go in the arrangement.");
                return;
            }

            // The page knows which track and bar that is.
            if (webView != nullptr)
            {
                juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
                item->setProperty ("paths", pathList (media));
                item->setProperty ("x", onPage.x);
                item->setProperty ("y", onPage.y);
                item->setProperty ("shift", shiftHeld());
                webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("arrangeFileDrop", juce::var (item.get()));
            }
        };

        arrangeDropZone = std::move (zone);
    }

    static_cast<PageDropZone*> (arrangeDropZone.get())->showOver (webView->localAreaToGlobal (area), area.getPosition());
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::chooseMedia (MediaPlace place)
{
    if (choosingFile)
        return;

    // Every kind that comes in: the ones Sonify plays as they are, and the ones it reads into WAVs.
    juce::AudioFormatManager formats;
    formats.registerBasicFormats();
    auto wildcards = formats.getWildcardForAllFormats();

    if (VideoSound::available())
        for (const auto& kind : juce::StringArray::fromTokens (convertedKinds, ";", {}))
            if (! wildcards.containsIgnoreCase ("*." + kind + ";") && ! wildcards.endsWithIgnoreCase ("*." + kind))
                wildcards << ";*." << kind;

    auto folder = lastMediaFolder;

    if (! folder.isDirectory())
        folder = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userMusicDirectory);

    choosingFile = true;
    mediaChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Load Media", folder, wildcards);

    mediaChooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles
                                   | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectMultipleItems,
                               [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this), place] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        safeThis->choosingFile = false;
        const auto chosen = chooser.getResults();

        if (chosen.isEmpty())
            return;

        safeThis->lastMediaFolder = chosen.getFirst().getParentDirectory();
        juce::StringArray paths;

        for (const auto& file : chosen)
            paths.add (file.getFullPathName());

        safeThis->importMedia (safeThis->mediaIn (paths), place);
    });
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::importMedia (const juce::Array<juce::File>& files, MediaPlace place)
{
    juce::Array<juce::File> audio;
    juce::File video;
    juce::StringArray problems;

    for (const auto& file : files)
    {
        if (! VideoMedia::isVideoFile (file))
            audio.add (file);
        else if (video == juce::File())
            video = file;
        else
            problems.add (file.getFileName() + " wasn't brought in: a song has one video.");
    }

    // A video: the song's video from there, its sound on a track of its own (MainVideo.cpp).
    if (video != juce::File())
        importVideo (video, place.start);

    if (audio.isEmpty())
    {
        if (! problems.isEmpty())
            pushTracks (problems.joinIntoString ("\n"));

        return;
    }

    // The ones Sonify doesn't play as they are, and FFmpeg reads, become WAVs first.
    std::vector<int> converting;

    for (int i = 0; i < audio.size(); ++i)
    {
        juce::String error;

        if (engine.getMedia().isAudioFile (audio[i]) && engine.getMedia().get (audio[i], engine.getPlaybackRate(), error) != nullptr)
            continue;

        if (VideoSound::available() && audio[i].hasFileExtension (convertedKinds))
            converting.push_back (i);
    }

    if (converting.empty())
    {
        placeMedia (audio, place, problems);
        return;
    }

    auto folder = engine.getRecordingFolder();

    if (folder == juce::File())
        folder = UserData::recordings();

    folder.createDirectory();

    const auto total = static_cast<int> (converting.size());
    const auto generation = songGeneration;
    const auto alive = importAlive.flag;

    const auto progress = [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this)] (const juce::String& state, int done, int count, const juce::String& name)
    {
        juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safeThis, state, done, count, name]
        {
            if (safeThis == nullptr || safeThis->webView == nullptr)
                return;

            juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
            item->setProperty ("state", state);
            item->setProperty ("done", done);
            item->setProperty ("total", count);
            item->setProperty ("name", name);
            safeThis->webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("mediaImport", juce::var (item.get()));
        });
    };

    juce::Thread::launch ([safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this), audio, converting, folder, place, problems,
                           total, generation, alive, progress] () mutable
    {
        for (int n = 0; n < total; ++n)
        {
            if (! alive->load())
                return;

            auto& source = audio.getReference (converting[static_cast<size_t> (n)]);
            progress ("working", n, total, source.getFileName());

            const auto wav = folder.getNonexistentChildFile (source.getFileNameWithoutExtension(), ".wav", false);
            juce::String error;

            if (VideoSound::soundToWav (source, wav, error, [alive] { return alive->load(); }))
            {
                source = wav;
            }
            else
            {
                if (error == "Cancelled")
                    return;

                problems.add ("Couldn't bring in " + source.getFileName() + ": " + error);
                source = juce::File();
            }
        }

        progress ("done", total, total, {});

        juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safeThis, audio, place, problems, generation]
        {
            // Another song opened meanwhile: not into that one.
            if (safeThis == nullptr || safeThis->songGeneration != generation)
                return;

            juce::Array<juce::File> readable;

            for (const auto& file : audio)
                if (file != juce::File())
                    readable.add (file);

            safeThis->placeMedia (readable, place, problems);
        });
    });
}

int MainComponent::addAudioTrackAfter (int afterId, const juce::String& name, const juce::String& undoName, bool joinPreviousStep)
{
    const auto id = engine.addTrack (Track::Kind::audio);
    engine.setTrackName (id, name);

    // Under the track named (as Studio One puts a dropped file's track there), or at the end.
    if (afterId != 0 && engine.findTrack (afterId) != nullptr)
    {
        auto order = Edits::allTrackIds (engine);
        order.erase (std::remove (order.begin(), order.end(), id), order.end());
        const auto after = std::find (order.begin(), order.end(), afterId);
        order.insert (after == order.end() ? order.end() : after + 1, id);
        engine.setTrackOrder (order);
    }

    const auto placed = Edits::allTrackIds (engine);
    const auto index = static_cast<int> (std::find (placed.begin(), placed.end(), id) - placed.begin());
    addToHistory (undoName, new Edits::TrackAdded (engine, id, index), joinPreviousStep);
    return id;
}

void MainComponent::placeMedia (const juce::Array<juce::File>& files, MediaPlace place, juce::StringArray problems)
{
    const auto undoName = juce::String (files.size() > 1 ? "Import Audio Files" : "Import Audio");
    const auto* given = engine.findTrack (place.trackId);
    const auto ontoGiven = given != nullptr && given->kind == Track::Kind::audio;

    std::vector<int> added;
    bool first = true;               // the first change opens the undo step, the rest join it
    int lastTrack = 0;               // the track the last file went onto
    double at = place.start;         // where the next goes, one after another on one track

    for (const auto& file : files)
    {
        juce::String error;
        const auto data = engine.getMedia().get (file, engine.getPlaybackRate(), error);

        if (data == nullptr || data->lengthSeconds <= 0.0)
        {
            problems.add ("Couldn't read " + file.getFileName() + " as audio.");
            continue;
        }

        int trackId = 0;

        if (place.oneTrack && lastTrack != 0)
            trackId = lastTrack;
        else if (lastTrack == 0 && ontoGiven)
            trackId = place.trackId;
        else
        {
            trackId = addAudioTrackAfter (lastTrack != 0 ? lastTrack : place.after, file.getFileNameWithoutExtension(), undoName, ! first);
            first = false;
            added.push_back (trackId);
        }

        auto before = Edits::snapshot (engine, { trackId });

        if (engine.importAudio (trackId, file, place.oneTrack ? at : place.start) <= 0)
        {
            problems.add ("Couldn't put " + file.getFileName() + " on its track.");
            continue;
        }

        addToHistory (undoName, new Edits::ClipsChanged (engine, std::move (before), Edits::snapshot (engine, { trackId })), ! first);
        first = false;
        lastTrack = trackId;

        if (place.oneTrack)
            at += engine.audioLengthInPpq (at, data->lengthSeconds);
    }

    if (! added.empty())
        selectNewTracks (added);

    if (added.empty() || ! problems.isEmpty())
        pushTracks (problems.joinIntoString ("\n"));
}

namespace
{
    /** Shift held right now. While files are dragged in from Explorer the keys go to Explorer,
        so Windows is asked about the key itself. */
    bool shiftHeld()
    {
       #if JUCE_WINDOWS
        return (GetAsyncKeyState (VK_SHIFT) & 0x8000) != 0;
       #else
        return juce::ModifierKeys::getCurrentModifiersRealtime().isShiftDown();
       #endif
    }
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainLink.cpp
//
// MIDI Link (MidiLink.h), the toolbar's strip: a device's knobs, sliders, wheels and pads
// linked to Sonify's controls by dragging their chips onto them. What a link moves, how the
// page hears of it, the Last Touched slot, and the map's files. As with the control surfaces,
// mixing this way is never an undo step (a send's turn is, as on the page).

#include "MainComponent.h"

#include <cmath>

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::setupMidiLink()
{
    midiLink = std::make_unique<MidiLink> (static_cast<MidiLink::Host&> (*this), [this] (std::vector<MidiLink::Message>& into)
    {
        engine.takeLinkMessages (into);
    });

    // What a linked source sends plays Sonify, not a track (the Live Show Controller's pads too).
    midiLink->onLinkedSourcesChanged = [this] (const std::vector<MidiLink::Source>& sources)
    {
        midiLinkSources.clear();

        for (const auto& source : sources)
            midiLinkSources.push_back ({ source.port, source.kind == MidiLink::Kind::note ? 1 : source.kind == MidiLink::Kind::pitchBend ? 2 : 0,
                                         source.channel, source.number });

        applyLinkedSources();
    };

    // The map as it was left (the same in every song), kept up to date from now on.
    midiLink->load (MidiLink::getDefaultAutoFile());
    midiLink->setAutoFile (MidiLink::getDefaultAutoFile());
}

void MainComponent::applyLinkedSources()
{
    auto linked = midiLinkSources;

    if (liveControl != nullptr)
        for (const auto& pad : liveControl->getPadSources())
            linked.push_back ({ pad.port, pad.kind == MidiLink::Kind::note ? 1 : pad.kind == MidiLink::Kind::pitchBend ? 2 : 0,
                                pad.channel, pad.number });

    engine.setLinkedSources (std::move (linked));
}

void MainComponent::applyMidiLinkDevices()
{
    if (midiLink == nullptr)
        return;

    // Chips name the devices; a controller's notes are its pads (a keyboard's are for playing).
    std::map<juce::String, juce::String> names;
    juce::StringArray pads;

    for (const auto& device : prefs.devices)
    {
        if (device.kind == "surface" || device.input.isEmpty())
            continue;

        names.emplace (device.input, device.name);

        if (device.kind == "controller")
            pads.addIfNotAlreadyThere (device.input);
    }

    midiLink->setDevices (std::move (names), std::move (pads));
}

//==============================================================================
bool MainComponent::linkMovedLately (int channelId) const
{
    const auto found = linkMovedMs.find (channelId);
    return found != linkMovedMs.end() && juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes() - found->second < 1000.0;
}

int MainComponent::linkChannelId (const juce::StringArray& parts) const
{
    // "track.<n>": the n-th track as the page numbers them; "fx.<n>", "bus.<n>": the n-th FX channel, bus.
    if (parts.size() < 2 || (parts[0] != "track" && parts[0] != "fx" && parts[0] != "bus"))
        return 0;

    const auto kindOf = [] (const Track& track) { return track.kind == Track::Kind::fx ? "fx" : track.kind == Track::Kind::bus ? "bus" : "track"; };
    const auto wanted = parts[1].getIntValue();
    int count = 0;

    for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
        if (parts[0] == kindOf (*track) && ++count == wanted)
            return track->id;

    return 0;
}

int MainComponent::linkSendId (int channelId, int position)
{
    // The page's list: a send whose FX channel or plugin is gone isn't in it.
    const auto* track = engine.findTrack (channelId);

    if (track == nullptr)
        return 0;

    int count = 0;

    for (const auto& send : track->sends)
    {
        bool shown = false;

        if (send.sidechain)
        {
            auto* plugin = engine.getPlugin (send.target, send.slot);
            shown = plugin != nullptr && plugin->hasSidechain();
        }
        else if (const auto* fx = engine.findTrack (send.target))
        {
            shown = fx->kind == Track::Kind::fx;
        }

        if (shown && ++count == position)
            return send.id;
    }

    return 0;
}

Plugin* MainComponent::findLinkedPlugin (const juce::String& pluginId, int& channel, int& insertId)
{
    // The selected track's copy first (its instrument, then its inserts), then Main's, then the
    // other tracks' in order.
    const auto inTrack = [&] (const Track& track) -> Plugin*
    {
        if (track.instrument != nullptr && track.instrument->getDescriptor().id == pluginId)
        {
            channel = track.id;
            insertId = AudioEngine::instrumentSlot;
            return track.instrument.get();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < track.inserts.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (const auto* insert = track.inserts.at (i); insert != nullptr && insert->plugin != nullptr
                                                           && insert->plugin->getDescriptor().id == pluginId)
            {
                channel = track.id;
                insertId = insert->id;
                return insert->plugin.get();
            }
        }

        return nullptr;
    };

    if (const auto* selected = engine.findTrack (engine.getSelectedTrackId()))
        if (auto* plugin = inTrack (*selected))
            return plugin;

    const auto& main = engine.getMainInserts();

    for (int i = 0; i < main.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (const auto* insert = main.at (i); insert != nullptr && insert->plugin != nullptr && insert->plugin->getDescriptor().id == pluginId)
        {
            channel = AudioEngine::mainChannel;
            insertId = insert->id;
            return insert->plugin.get();
        }
    }

    for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
        if (auto* plugin = inTrack (*track))
            return plugin;

    return nullptr;
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::linkMove (const MidiLink::Target& target, float position)
{
    position = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, position);
    const auto now = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();

    if (target.key == "plugin")
    {
        int channel = 0, insertId = 0;
        auto* plugin = findLinkedPlugin (target.pluginId, channel, insertId);
        const auto index = plugin != nullptr ? plugin->findParameter (target.paramId) : -1;

        if (index < 0)
            return;

        const auto& parameter = plugin->getParameters()[static_cast<size_t> (index)];
        auto value = parameter.minValue + static_cast<double> (position) * (parameter.maxValue - parameter.minValue);

        // A stepped parameter in its own values (CLAP's) lands on one; VST3's are 0..1 and the
        // plugin steps them itself.
        if (parameter.stepped && plugin->getFormatName() != "VST3")
            value = std::round (value);

        engine.setPluginParameter (channel, insertId, index, value);
        markChanged();
        return;
    }

    if (target.key == "main.volume")
    {
        setChannelVolume (ControlSurfaces::mainChannel, ControlSurfaces::faderToDb (position));
        linkMovedMs[ControlSurfaces::mainChannel] = now;
        return;
    }

    const auto parts = juce::StringArray::fromTokens (target.key, ".", "");

    if (parts[0] == "board")
    {
        linkMoveBoard (parts, position);
        return;
    }

    if (parts[0] == "live")
    {
        linkMoveLive (parts, position);
        return;
    }

    const auto id = parts.size() >= 3 ? linkChannelId (parts) : 0;

    if (id == 0)
        return;

    if (parts[2] == "volume")
    {
        setChannelVolume (id, ControlSurfaces::faderToDb (position));
        linkMovedMs[id] = now;
    }
    else if (parts[2] == "pan")
    {
        // The knob's middle is the centre (127 steps have no exact middle).
        const auto pan = position * 2.0f - 1.0f;
        setChannelPan (id, std::abs (pan) < 0.01f ? 0.0f : pan);
        linkMovedMs[id] = now;
    }
    else if (parts[2] == "send" && parts.size() >= 4)
    {
        if (const auto sendId = linkSendId (id, parts[3].getIntValue()); sendId != 0)
            setChannelSendLevel (id, sendId, ControlSurfaces::faderToDb (position));
    }
}

void MainComponent::linkSet (const MidiLink::Target& target, bool on)
{
    const auto& key = target.key;

    if (key == "main.mute")
    {
        engine.setMasterMute (on);
        markChanged();
        surfaceTracksDue = true;
        return;
    }

    if (key.startsWith ("transport."))
    {
        const auto action = key.fromFirstOccurrenceOf (".", false, false);
        const auto state = engine.getTransport().getState();

        if (action == "play")
        {
            if (on != state.playing)
                surfaceTransport (on ? "play" : "stop");
        }
        else if (action == "stop" || action == "start")
        {
            if (on)
                surfaceTransport (action);
        }
        else if (action == "record")
        {
            if (on != engine.isRecording())
                surfaceTransport ("record");
        }
        else if (action == "loop")
        {
            surfaceLoop (on);
        }
        else if (action == "metronome")
        {
            surfaceMetronome (on);
        }

        return;
    }

    const auto parts = juce::StringArray::fromTokens (key, ".", "");

    if (parts[0] == "board")
    {
        linkSetBoard (parts, on);
        return;
    }

    if (parts[0] == "live")
    {
        linkSetLive (parts, on);
        return;
    }

    const auto id = parts.size() >= 3 ? linkChannelId (parts) : 0;

    if (id == 0)
        return;

    if (parts[2] == "mute")
    {
        setChannelMute (id, on);
    }
    else if (parts[2] == "solo")
    {
        setChannelSolo (id, on);
    }
    else if (parts[2] == "arm")
    {
        setChannelRecordArm (id, on);
    }
    else if (parts[2] == "monitor")
    {
        engine.setTrackMonitor (id, on, true);
        markChanged();
        surfaceTracksDue = true;
    }
}

bool MainComponent::linkIsOn (const MidiLink::Target& target)
{
    const auto& key = target.key;

    if (key == "main.mute")
        return engine.isMasterMuted();

    if (key.startsWith ("transport."))
    {
        const auto action = key.fromFirstOccurrenceOf (".", false, false);
        const auto state = engine.getTransport().getState();
        return action == "play"      ? state.playing
             : action == "record"    ? engine.isRecording()
             : action == "loop"      ? state.loopEnabled
             : action == "metronome" ? state.metronomeEnabled
                                     : false;
    }

    const auto parts = juce::StringArray::fromTokens (key, ".", "");

    if (parts[0] == "board")
        return linkIsOnBoard (parts);

    if (parts[0] == "live")
        return linkIsOnLive (parts);

    const auto* track = parts.size() >= 3 ? engine.findTrack (linkChannelId (parts)) : nullptr;

    if (track == nullptr)
        return false;

    return parts[2] == "mute"    ? track->mute.load()
         : parts[2] == "solo"    ? track->solo.load()
         : parts[2] == "arm"     ? track->recordArm.load()
         : parts[2] == "monitor" ? track->monitor.load()
                                 : false;
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::updateMidiLink()
{
    if (midiLink == nullptr)
        return;

    auto due = midiLink->takeChanged();

    // A knob taken hold of in a plugin's window: the strip's Last Touched slot.
    const auto look = [&] (int channel, int insertId, Plugin* plugin, const juce::String& where)
    {
        if (plugin == nullptr)
            return;

        const auto index = plugin->takeTouchedParameter();
        const auto& parameters = plugin->getParameters();

        if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (parameters.size())))
            return;

        const auto& parameter = parameters[static_cast<size_t> (index)];

        if (parameter.hidden || parameter.readOnly)
            return;

        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr touched (new juce::DynamicObject());
        touched->setProperty ("pluginId", plugin->getDescriptor().id);
        touched->setProperty ("pluginName", plugin->getDescriptor().name);
        touched->setProperty ("paramId", static_cast<juce::int64> (parameter.id));
        touched->setProperty ("paramName", parameter.name);
        touched->setProperty ("where", where);
        touched->setProperty ("channel", channel);
        touched->setProperty ("insertId", insertId);

        const juce::var now (touched.get());

        if (juce::JSON::toString (now, true) != juce::JSON::toString (linkTouched, true))
        {
            linkTouched = now;
            due = true;
        }
    };

    for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
    {
        look (track->id, AudioEngine::instrumentSlot, track->instrument.get(), track->name);

        for (int i = 0; i < track->inserts.size(); ++i)
            if (const auto* insert = track->inserts.at (i))
                look (track->id, insert->id, insert->plugin.get(), track->name);
    }

    const auto& main = engine.getMainInserts();

    for (int i = 0; i < main.size(); ++i)
        if (const auto* insert = main.at (i))
            look (AudioEngine::mainChannel, insert->id, insert->plugin.get(), "Main");

    if (due)
        pushMidiLink();
}

void MainComponent::pushMidiLink()
{
    if (webView == nullptr || midiLink == nullptr)
        return;

    const auto kindOf = [] (MidiLink::Kind kind) { return kind == MidiLink::Kind::note ? "note" : kind == MidiLink::Kind::pitchBend ? "pb" : "cc"; };

    juce::Array<juce::var> recent, links;

    for (const auto& chip : midiLink->getRecent())
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
        item->setProperty ("key", chip.source.key());
        item->setProperty ("label", chip.source.label());
        item->setProperty ("device", midiLink->deviceOf (chip.source.port));
        item->setProperty ("channel", chip.source.channel);
        item->setProperty ("kind", kindOf (chip.source.kind));

        if (const auto* link = midiLink->findLink (chip.source))
        {
            juce::DynamicObject::Ptr linked (new juce::DynamicObject());
            linked->setProperty ("target", link->target.toVar());
            linked->setProperty ("mode", MidiLink::modeName (link->mode));
            item->setProperty ("link", juce::var (linked.get()));
        }

        recent.add (juce::var (item.get()));
    }

    for (const auto& link : midiLink->getLinks())
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
        item->setProperty ("source", link.source.key());
        item->setProperty ("label", link.source.label());
        item->setProperty ("device", midiLink->deviceOf (link.source.port));
        item->setProperty ("channel", link.source.channel);
        item->setProperty ("kind", kindOf (link.source.kind));
        item->setProperty ("target", link.target.toVar());
        item->setProperty ("mode", MidiLink::modeName (link.mode));
        links.add (juce::var (item.get()));
    }

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr state (new juce::DynamicObject());
    state->setProperty ("recent", recent);
    state->setProperty ("links", links);
    state->setProperty ("touched", linkTouched);
    state->setProperty ("message", std::exchange (linkMessage, {}));
    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("midiLink", juce::var (state.get()));
}

void MainComponent::handleMidiLink (const juce::String& what, const juce::var& event)
{
    if (midiLink == nullptr)
        return;

    if (what == "set")
    {
        const auto source = MidiLink::Source::fromKey (event.getProperty ("source", {}).toString());
        const auto target = MidiLink::Target::fromVar (event.getProperty ("target", {}));

        if (source.has_value())
        {
            linksBeforeEdit = midiLink->getLinks();

            if (! midiLink->link (*source, target, MidiLink::modeFromName (event.getProperty ("mode", {}).toString(), MidiLink::defaultModeFor (target))))
                linkMessage = source->kind == MidiLink::Kind::note && target.isContinuous()
                                  ? "A key or pad can't move a fader or knob: link a knob, a slider or a wheel."
                                  : "That control can't be linked.";
        }
    }
    else if (what == "mode")
    {
        if (const auto source = MidiLink::Source::fromKey (event.getProperty ("source", {}).toString()))
            midiLink->setMode (*source, MidiLink::modeFromName (event.getProperty ("mode", {}).toString(), MidiLink::Mode::toggle));
    }
    else if (what == "clear")
    {
        midiLink->unlinkTarget (event.getProperty ("target", {}).toString());
    }
    else if (what == "cancel")
    {
        midiLink->setLinks (linksBeforeEdit);
    }
    else if (what == "menu")
    {
        const auto action = event.getProperty ("action", {}).toString();

        if (action == "clearAll")
        {
            linksBeforeEdit = midiLink->getLinks();
            midiLink->clear();
        }
        else if (action == "save" || action == "load")
        {
            chooseMidiLinkFile (action == "save");
        }
    }

    pushMidiLink();
}

void MainComponent::chooseMidiLinkFile (bool saving)
{
    if (choosingFile || midiLink == nullptr)
        return;

    choosingFile = true;
    const auto folder = MidiLink::getMapsFolder();
    folder.createDirectory();

    const auto pattern = juce::String ("*") + MidiLink::fileExtension;
    linkChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> (saving ? "Save the MIDI Link map" : "Load a MIDI Link map",
                                                       saving ? folder.getChildFile (juce::String ("My Controllers") + MidiLink::fileExtension) : folder,
                                                       pattern);

    const auto chooserFlags = saving ? juce::FileBrowserComponent::saveMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::warnAboutOverwriting
                                     : juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles;

    linkChooser->launchAsync (chooserFlags, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this), saving] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        safeThis->choosingFile = false;
        auto file = chooser.getResult();

        if (file == juce::File() || safeThis->midiLink == nullptr)
            return;

        if (saving)
        {
            file = file.withFileExtension (MidiLink::fileExtension);

            if (! safeThis->midiLink->save (file))
                safeThis->linkMessage = "Couldn't save " + file.getFullPathName();
        }
        else
        {
            safeThis->linksBeforeEdit = safeThis->midiLink->getLinks();

            if (const auto loaded = safeThis->midiLink->load (file); loaded.failed())
                safeThis->linkMessage = loaded.getErrorMessage();
        }

        safeThis->pushMidiLink();
    });
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainLive.cpp

#include "MainComponent.h"
#include "PageDropZone.h"

//==============================================================================
// The Live Show (LiveShow.h), its own tab: decks, the tracks marked as its channels (a singer's mic,
// a player's instrument, through their plugins), the pads, the master and its effects channel (the
// dynamic EQ that ducks the music under the voices, a compressor, a drive and the limiter). While
// its tab shows (or it still plays: a deck, a pad, the recording, the stream), it plays on Main in
// place of the song, and the song stops; playing with its tab out of sight, the Studio is heard
// with it (a track opened there, monitored or played). It's used three ways, its tabs: DJ show (the
// mixer, the library and the pads), Live & podcasts (the channels too, and a playlist; Mute mics and
// Mute playback, both on as Sonify starts) and Live streaming (the same, streamed: Enable streaming
// lets the picture and the sound out to it; the Controller sets its cameras). Its settings are kept
// with the song (mixing, as the Console's faders: not undo steps); the tracks on its decks, the
