// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainScore.cpp

#include "MainComponent.h"

//==============================================================================
// The Score's exports (hub-score.js): the page makes the file, Sonify asks where it goes and
// writes it. "score" events:
//   { action: "export", format: "pdf" | "musicxml", name, data }   data: the PDF in base64, or
//                                                                  the MusicXML text
//   { action: "reveal", path }                                     shows a saved file in its folder
// Sonify answers "scoreExported": { ok, name, path } or { ok: false, message }.

void MainComponent::handleScore (const juce::var& event)
{
    const auto action = event.getProperty ("action", {}).toString();

    if (action == "reveal")
    {
        if (const juce::File file (event.getProperty ("path", {}).toString()); file.existsAsFile())
            file.revealToUser();

        return;
    }

    if (action != "export" || choosingFile)
        return;

    const auto pdf = event.getProperty ("format", {}).toString() == "pdf";
    const auto data = event.getProperty ("data", {}).toString();

    if (data.isEmpty())
        return;

    // Next to the song once it's saved; otherwise in a Scores folder of the user data.
    const auto folder = songFile.existsAsFile() ? songFile.getParentDirectory() : UserData::getFolder().getChildFile ("Scores");
    folder.createDirectory();

    const auto extension = juce::String (pdf ? ".pdf" : ".musicxml");
    const auto name = juce::File::createLegalFileName (event.getProperty ("name", "Score").toString().trim().substring (0, 120));
    choosingFile = true;
    scoreChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> (pdf ? "Export the score as PDF" : "Export the score as MusicXML",
                                                        folder.getChildFile ((name.isNotEmpty() ? name : juce::String ("Score")) + extension),
                                                        "*" + extension);

    const auto chooserFlags = juce::FileBrowserComponent::saveMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::warnAboutOverwriting;

    scoreChooser->launchAsync (chooserFlags, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this), pdf, data, extension] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        safeThis->choosingFile = false;
        auto file = chooser.getResult();

        if (file == juce::File())
            return;

        file = file.withFileExtension (extension);
        bool written = false;

        if (pdf)
        {
            juce::MemoryOutputStream bytes;

            if (juce::Base64::convertFromBase64 (bytes, data) && bytes.getDataSize() > 0)
                written = file.replaceWithData (bytes.getData(), bytes.getDataSize());
        }
        else
        {
            written = file.replaceWithText (data, false, false, "\n");
        }

        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr answer (new juce::DynamicObject());
        answer->setProperty ("ok", written);
        answer->setProperty ("name", file.getFileName());
        answer->setProperty ("path", file.getFullPathName());

        if (! written)
            answer->setProperty ("message", "Couldn't write " + file.getFullPathName());

        if (safeThis->webView != nullptr)
            safeThis->webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("scoreExported", juce::var (answer.get()));
    });
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainSettings.cpp
//
// MainComponent's side of File > Settings (the rest of MainComponent is in MainComponent.cpp):
// Sonify's own settings (Preferences), the audio device (Audio Setup), the MIDI ports, the
// external MIDI devices with the clock and timecode they're sent, and the control surfaces that
// play Sonify (MIDI Setup), network discovery (Network), the user data folder and autosave
// (Locations), and letting the audio device go while Sonify is in the background.

#include "MainComponent.h"
#include "Song.h"

#include <algorithm>

namespace
{
    bool nativeDialogShowing();   // (at the end of this file: Windows' own headers come last)

    /** As in MainComponent.cpp: a page event's handler runs just after WebView2's own callback
        has returned (device and COM calls must not run inside it). */
    template <typename Handler>
    std::function<void (const juce::var&)> afterSettingsEvent (MainComponent* owner, Handler handler)
    {
        return [safe = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (owner), handler = std::move (handler)] (const juce::var& event)
        {
            juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safe, handler, event]
            {
                if (safe != nullptr)
                    handler (event);
            });
        };
    }

    juce::var toVar (const juce::StringArray& strings)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> list;

        for (const auto& text : strings)
            list.add (text);

        return list;
    }

    template <typename Number>
    juce::var numbersToVar (const juce::Array<Number>& numbers)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> list;

        for (const auto value : numbers)
            list.add (value);

        return list;
    }

    juce::var bitsToVar (const juce::BigInteger& bits, int count)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> list;

        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            list.add (bits[i]);

        return list;
    }

    juce::uint8 blockedOf (const Preferences::Device& device)
    {
        return static_cast<juce::uint8> ((device.filterAftertouch ? Track::blockAftertouch : 0)
                                         | (device.filterProgramChange ? Track::blockProgramChange : 0)
                                         | (device.filterPitchBend ? Track::blockPitchBend : 0)
                                         | (device.filterControllers ? Track::blockControllers : 0));
    }

    /** How a MIDI port is connected, from the device Windows has behind it (the port's
        identifier): usb, bluetooth, virtual (software only: a loopMIDI cable, a loopback), or
        "" when it doesn't say. */
    juce::String linkOf (const juce::MidiDeviceInfo& info)
    {
        const auto id = info.identifier.toLowerCase();

        if (id.contains ("usb#") || id.contains ("usb\\"))
            return "usb";

        if (id.contains ("bthle") || id.contains ("bthenum") || id.contains ("bluetooth"))
            return "bluetooth";

        if (id.contains ("root#") || id.contains ("loopback") || id.contains ("midiu_diag") || id.contains ("midiu_loop")
            || id.contains ("midiu_virt") || id.contains ("midiu_app"))
            return "virtual";

        return {};
    }

    juce::var transportEvent (const juce::String& property, const juce::var& value)
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr event (new juce::DynamicObject());
        event->setProperty (property, value);
        return juce::var (event.get());
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::WebBrowserComponent::Options MainComponent::withSettingsEvents (juce::WebBrowserComponent::Options options)
{
    return options
        .withEventListener ("getSettings", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var&) { pushSettings(); }))
        .withEventListener ("setPreference", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event) { setPreference (event); }))
        .withEventListener ("chooseUserDataFolder", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var&) { chooseUserDataFolder(); }))
        .withEventListener ("resetUserDataFolder", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var&) { setUserDataFolder ({}); }))
        .withEventListener ("audioSetupGet", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event)
        {
            // Devices plugged in since are found when the page asks afresh.
            if (static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("rescan", false)))
                if (auto* type = engine.getDeviceManager().getCurrentDeviceTypeObject())
                    type->scanForDevices();

            pushAudioSetup();
        }))
        .withEventListener ("audioSetupSet", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event) { changeAudioSetup (event); }))
        .withEventListener ("audioControlPanel", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var&)
        {
            auto& manager = engine.getDeviceManager();

            // The driver's own window (ASIO): what it changes takes effect when the device opens again.
            // (The device watch keeps out of it meanwhile: the driver may pause while it shows.)
            if (auto* device = manager.getCurrentAudioDevice(); device != nullptr && device->hasControlPanel())
            {
                const juce::ScopedValueSetter<bool> busy (deviceSettingUp, true);
                deviceReopens = 0;
                deviceHeard = false;

                if (device->showControlPanel())
                {
                    manager.closeAudioDevice();
                    manager.restartLastAudioDevice();
                }
            }

            pushAudioSetup();
            pushTracks();
        }))
        .withEventListener ("audioTestTone", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var&)
        {
            // On Main's channels only (every output channel is open: JUCE's own test would beep on all).
            engine.playTestTone();
        }))
        .withEventListener ("midiPortEnabled", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event)
        {
            setMidiPortEnabled (event.getProperty ("id", {}).toString(), static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("enabled", false)));
        }))
        .withEventListener ("midiDeviceSave", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event) { saveMidiDevice (event); }))
        .withEventListener ("midiDeviceRemove", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event)
        {
            removeMidiDevice (event.getProperty ("id", {}).toString());
        }))
        .withEventListener ("replaceLibraryFolder", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var& event)
        {
            replaceLibraryFolder (event.getProperty ("folder", {}).toString());
        }))
        .withEventListener ("addDefaultLibraryFolders", afterSettingsEvent (this, [this] (const juce::var&)
        {
            if (library.addDefaultFolders() > 0)
                startLibraryScan (false);
            else
                pushLibrary ("The usual plugin folders are all listed already (or aren't on this computer).");
        }));
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::loadPreferences()
{
    prefs.load();
    applySongDefaults();
    followMidiPorts();   // listens to the MIDI inputs, and applies the external devices
    applyDiscovery();
}

void MainComponent::applySongDefaults()
{
    // Before any Make Default: Main plays where Settings had the audio going (when that wasn't
    // the first pair), now that every output channel is open.
    if (! prefs.songIo.isObject())
    {
        const auto pair = engine.getStartupOutputPair();

        if (pair.first > 0)
        {
            auto outputs = AudioEngine::defaultOutputs();
            outputs.front().left = pair.first;
            outputs.front().right = pair.second;

            juce::DynamicObject::Ptr io (new juce::DynamicObject());
            io->setProperty ("inputs", Song::inputsToVar (AudioEngine::defaultInputs()));
            io->setProperty ("outputs", Song::outputsToVar (outputs));
            io->setProperty ("audition", 0);
            prefs.songIo = juce::var (io.get());
            savePreferences();
        }
    }

    if (! prefs.songIo.isObject())
        return;

    const auto inputs = prefs.songIo.getProperty ("inputs", {});
    const auto outputs = prefs.songIo.getProperty ("outputs", {});

    engine.setSongDefaults (inputs.isArray() ? Song::inputsFromVar (inputs) : AudioEngine::defaultInputs(),
                            outputs.isArray() ? Song::outputsFromVar (outputs) : AudioEngine::defaultOutputs(),
                            static_cast<int> (prefs.songIo.getProperty ("audition", 0)));

    // The song Sonify starts with is a new one.
    engine.setInputs (engine.getSongDefaultInputs());
    engine.setOutputs (engine.getSongDefaultOutputs());
    engine.setAuditionOutput (engine.getSongDefaultAudition());
}

void MainComponent::setSongDefaults (const juce::var& io)
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr kept (new juce::DynamicObject());
    kept->setProperty ("inputs", Song::inputsToVar (Song::inputsFromVar (io.getProperty ("inputs", {}))));
    kept->setProperty ("outputs", Song::outputsToVar (Song::outputsFromVar (io.getProperty ("outputs", {}))));
    kept->setProperty ("audition", static_cast<int> (io.getProperty ("audition", 0)));
    prefs.songIo = juce::var (kept.get());
    savePreferences();

    engine.setSongDefaults (Song::inputsFromVar (prefs.songIo.getProperty ("inputs", {})),
                            Song::outputsFromVar (prefs.songIo.getProperty ("outputs", {})),
                            static_cast<int> (prefs.songIo.getProperty ("audition", 0)));
}

void MainComponent::savePreferences()
{
    prefs.save();
}

void MainComponent::pushSettings()
{
    if (webView == nullptr)
        return;

    auto state = prefs.toVar();
    auto* fields = state.getDynamicObject();

    // The MIDI ports devices can use: inputs (with whether Sonify listens) and outputs.
    juce::Array<juce::var> outputs;

    for (const auto& info : juce::MidiOutput::getAvailableDevices())
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr port (new juce::DynamicObject());
        port->setProperty ("id", info.identifier);
        port->setProperty ("name", info.name);
        outputs.add (juce::var (port.get()));
    }

    fields->setProperty ("midiInputs", midiInputsToVar());
    fields->setProperty ("midiOutputs", outputs);
    fields->setProperty ("syncProblems", toVar (engine.getSyncProblems()));
    fields->setProperty ("surfaceProblems", toVar (surfaceProblems()));

    juce::StringArray defaults;

    for (const auto& folder : Library::getDefaultFolders())
        defaults.add (folder.getFullPathName());

    fields->setProperty ("defaultPluginFolders", toVar (defaults));
    fields->setProperty ("computerName", juce::SystemStats::getComputerName());
    fields->setProperty ("discoveryPort", discoveryPort);

    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("settings", state);
}

void MainComponent::setPreference (const juce::var& event)
{
    const auto number = [&event] (const char* key, int fallback) { return static_cast<int> (event.getProperty (key, fallback)); };

    if (event.hasProperty ("luminance"))   prefs.luminance = juce::jlimit (0, 100, number ("luminance", prefs.luminance));
    if (event.hasProperty ("contrast"))    prefs.contrast = juce::jlimit (0, 100, number ("contrast", prefs.contrast));

    if (event.hasProperty ("keymap"))
        if (const auto keymap = event.getProperty ("keymap", {}).toString(); Preferences::getKeymaps().contains (keymap))
            prefs.keymap = keymap;

    if (event.hasProperty ("discoverable"))
    {
        prefs.discoverable = static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("discoverable", false));
        applyDiscovery();
    }

    if (event.hasProperty ("autosave"))
        prefs.autosave = static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("autosave", true));

    if (event.hasProperty ("autosaveMinutes"))
        prefs.autosaveMinutes = juce::jlimit (Preferences::minAutosaveMinutes, Preferences::maxAutosaveMinutes,
                                              number ("autosaveMinutes", prefs.autosaveMinutes));

    if (event.hasProperty ("releaseInBackground"))
    {
        prefs.releaseInBackground = static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("releaseInBackground", false));

        if (! prefs.releaseInBackground)
            engine.releaseDevice (false);
    }

    if (event.hasProperty ("timecodeRate"))
    {
        if (const auto rate = event.getProperty ("timecodeRate", {}).toString(); Preferences::getTimecodeRates().contains (rate))
            prefs.timecodeRate = rate;

        applyMidiDevices();
    }

    savePreferences();
    pushSettings();
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::applyMidiDevices()
{
    std::vector<AudioEngine::MidiDevice> devices;
    std::vector<MidiSync::Target> targets;
    std::vector<ControlSurfaces::Config> surfaceList;
    juce::StringArray surfacePorts;

    for (const auto& device : prefs.devices)
    {
        // A control surface plays Sonify itself, in the device list's order: no track hears its port.
        if (device.kind == "surface")
        {
            surfaceList.push_back ({ device.name, ControlSurfaces::protocolFromName (device.protocol), device.input, device.output });

            if (device.input.isNotEmpty())
                surfacePorts.addIfNotAlreadyThere (device.input);

            continue;
        }

        AudioEngine::MidiDevice engineDevice;
        engineDevice.name = device.name;
        engineDevice.input = device.input;
        engineDevice.channels = static_cast<juce::uint16> (device.channels & 0xffff);
        engineDevice.blocked = blockedOf (device);
        engineDevice.split = device.splitChannels;
        engineDevice.defaultInput = device.defaultInput;
        engineDevice.mpe = device.mpe;
        engineDevice.pitchRange = device.pitchRange;
        devices.push_back (engineDevice);

        if (device.output.isNotEmpty() && (device.sendClock || device.sendTimecode))
            targets.push_back ({ device.output, device.sendClock, device.clockStart, device.sendTimecode });
    }

    engine.setSurfacePorts (surfacePorts);
    engine.setMidiDevices (std::move (devices));
    engine.setSyncTargets (targets, MidiSync::rateFromName (prefs.timecodeRate));
    if (surfaces != nullptr)
        surfaces->configure (surfaceList);

    applyMidiLinkDevices();
}

void MainComponent::saveMidiDevice (const juce::var& event)
{
    auto device = Preferences::deviceFromVar (event.getProperty ("device", {}));
    juce::String oldName;

    if (const auto* before = prefs.findDevice (device.id))
        oldName = before->name;

    const auto id = prefs.putDevice (std::move (device));
    const auto* saved = prefs.findDevice (id);

    if (saved != nullptr)
    {
        // Renamed: the tracks that chose it keep it (the song changes with them).
        if (oldName.isNotEmpty() && saved->name != oldName)
        {
            engine.renameMidiSource (oldName, saved->name);
            markChanged();
        }

        // Sonify listens to the port it receives from (even one turned off before).
        auto& manager = engine.getDeviceManager();
        prefs.midiInputsOff.removeString (saved->input);

        for (const auto& info : juce::MidiInput::getAvailableDevices())
            if (info.name == saved->input && ! manager.isMidiInputDeviceEnabled (info.identifier))
                manager.setMidiInputDeviceEnabled (info.identifier, true);
    }

    savePreferences();
    applyMidiDevices();
    pushSettings();
    pushTracks();
}

void MainComponent::removeMidiDevice (const juce::String& id)
{
    if (! prefs.removeDevice (id))
        return;

    savePreferences();
    applyMidiDevices();
    pushSettings();
    pushTracks();
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::applyDiscovery()
{
    // Sonify announces itself on the local network every second and a half while this is on.
    if (prefs.discoverable && advertiser == nullptr)
        advertiser = std::make_unique<juce::NetworkServiceDiscovery::Advertiser> ("SonifyRemote", juce::SystemStats::getComputerName(),
                                                                                   discoveryPort, remotePort);
    else if (! prefs.discoverable)
        advertiser.reset();
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::chooseUserDataFolder()
{
    if (choosingFile)
        return;

    choosingFile = true;
    fileChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Where your songs, recordings, mixdowns and autosaves go", UserData::getFolder());

    fileChooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectDirectories,
                              [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this)] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        safeThis->choosingFile = false;
        const auto folder = chooser.getResult();

        if (folder.isDirectory())
            safeThis->setUserDataFolder (folder.getFullPathName());
    });
}

void MainComponent::setUserDataFolder (const juce::String& folder)
{
    // The default folder chosen by hand is the default.
    prefs.userData = folder == UserData::getDefaultFolder().getFullPathName() ? juce::String() : folder;
    UserData::setFolder (prefs.userData);
    savePreferences();
    pushSettings();
    pushSong();   // new songs go there now

    // My Devices is in the user data folder too, and so are the plugins made in the Plugins
    // Creator Studio.
    Devices::setMyDevicesFolder (UserData::getFolder().getChildFile ("Devices"));
    library.refreshMadePlugins();
    pushLibrary();

    if (deviceStudio != nullptr)
    {
        deviceStudio->getLibrary (true);
        pushDeviceStudio();
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::pushAudioSetup (const juce::String& error)
{
    if (webView == nullptr)
        return;

    auto& manager = engine.getDeviceManager();
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr state (new juce::DynamicObject());

    juce::StringArray types;

    for (auto* type : manager.getAvailableDeviceTypes())
        types.add (type->getTypeName());

    state->setProperty ("types", toVar (types));
    state->setProperty ("type", manager.getCurrentAudioDeviceType());

    const auto setup = manager.getAudioDeviceSetup();

    if (auto* type = manager.getCurrentDeviceTypeObject())
    {
        // ASIO drivers are one device for both directions; Windows Audio has inputs and outputs apart.
        state->setProperty ("separate", type->hasSeparateInputsAndOutputs());
        state->setProperty ("outputs", toVar (type->getDeviceNames (false)));
        state->setProperty ("inputs", toVar (type->getDeviceNames (true)));
    }

    state->setProperty ("output", setup.outputDeviceName);
    state->setProperty ("input", setup.inputDeviceName);

    if (auto* device = manager.getCurrentAudioDevice())
    {
        const auto rate = device->getCurrentSampleRate();
        const auto inputNames = device->getInputChannelNames();
        const auto outputNames = device->getOutputChannelNames();

        state->setProperty ("open", true);
        state->setProperty ("deviceName", device->getName());
        state->setProperty ("rates", numbersToVar (device->getAvailableSampleRates()));
        state->setProperty ("rate", rate);
        state->setProperty ("buffers", numbersToVar (device->getAvailableBufferSizes()));
        state->setProperty ("buffer", device->getCurrentBufferSizeSamples());
        state->setProperty ("inputChannels", toVar (inputNames));
        state->setProperty ("activeInputs", bitsToVar (device->getActiveInputChannels(), inputNames.size()));
        state->setProperty ("outputChannels", toVar (outputNames));
        state->setProperty ("activeOutputs", bitsToVar (device->getActiveOutputChannels(), outputNames.size()));
        state->setProperty ("inputLatencyMs", rate > 0.0 ? 1000.0 * device->getInputLatencyInSamples() / rate : 0.0);
        state->setProperty ("outputLatencyMs", rate > 0.0 ? 1000.0 * device->getOutputLatencyInSamples() / rate : 0.0);
        state->setProperty ("hasControlPanel", device->hasControlPanel());
    }
    else
    {
        state->setProperty ("open", false);
    }

    state->setProperty ("released", engine.isDeviceReleased());
    state->setProperty ("releaseInBackground", prefs.releaseInBackground);
    state->setProperty ("error", error);
    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("audioSetup", juce::var (state.get()));
}

//==============================================================================
juce::var MainComponent::midiInputsToVar()
{
    auto& manager = engine.getDeviceManager();
    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& info : juce::MidiInput::getAvailableDevices())
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr port (new juce::DynamicObject());
        port->setProperty ("id", info.identifier);
        port->setProperty ("name", info.name);
        port->setProperty ("enabled", manager.isMidiInputDeviceEnabled (info.identifier));
        port->setProperty ("busy", midiPortsBusy.contains (info.name));
        port->setProperty ("link", linkOf (info));   // the page says what kind of device it is
        list.add (juce::var (port.get()));
    }

    return list;
}

void MainComponent::changeListenerCallback (juce::ChangeBroadcaster*)
{
    // The audio device manager: a device or a MIDI port came or went, or something was set.
    followMidiPorts();
}

void MainComponent::followMidiPorts()
{
    auto& manager = engine.getDeviceManager();
    const auto inputs = juce::MidiInput::getAvailableDevices();
    const auto outputs = juce::MidiOutput::getAvailableDevices();

    juce::String names;

    for (const auto& port : inputs)
        names << port.name << "\n";

    names << "\n";

    for (const auto& port : outputs)
        names << port.name << "\n";

    const auto portsChanged = names != midiPortNames;
    midiPortNames = names;

    // Ports come or go: the ones that couldn't be opened are tried again.
    if (portsChanged)
        midiPortsBusy.clear();

    // Sonify listens to every MIDI input but the ones turned off by hand, so tracks can pick it:
    // a keyboard plugged in, or a loopMIDI port made, is in their MIDI lists at once.
    for (const auto& port : inputs)
    {
        const auto listening = manager.isMidiInputDeviceEnabled (port.identifier);

        // Off by hand stays off (JUCE opens the ones it opened at startup again when ports change).
        if (prefs.midiInputsOff.contains (port.name))
        {
            if (listening)
                manager.setMidiInputDeviceEnabled (port.identifier, false);

            continue;
        }

        if (listening || midiPortsBusy.contains (port.name))
            continue;

        manager.setMidiInputDeviceEnabled (port.identifier, true);

        // Not opened: another app may hold it. Tried again when the ports change.
        if (! manager.isMidiInputDeviceEnabled (port.identifier))
            midiPortsBusy.addIfNotAlreadyThere (port.name);
    }

    // A port that came may be one a device sends MIDI clock or timecode to, or a control surface's.
    if (portsChanged)
        applyMidiDevices();

    // The page hears of ports coming and going, and turned on or off: MIDI Setup lists them, and
    // so do the tracks' MIDI lists (with the ones Sonify isn't listening to).
    auto told = names;

    for (const auto& port : inputs)
        told << (manager.isMidiInputDeviceEnabled (port.identifier) ? "+" : "-") << (midiPortsBusy.contains (port.name) ? "!" : "");

    if (told != midiPortsTold)
    {
        midiPortsTold = told;
        pushSettings();
    }
}

void MainComponent::setMidiPortEnabled (const juce::String& identifier, bool enabled)
{
    juce::String name;

    for (const auto& port : juce::MidiInput::getAvailableDevices())
        if (port.identifier == identifier)
            name = port.name;

    if (name.isEmpty())
        return;

    // Turned off by hand, it stays off, after Sonify starts again too. Turned on, it's opened now.
    if (enabled)
        prefs.midiInputsOff.removeString (name);
    else
        prefs.midiInputsOff.addIfNotAlreadyThere (name);

    savePreferences();

    auto& manager = engine.getDeviceManager();
    midiPortsBusy.removeString (name);
    manager.setMidiInputDeviceEnabled (identifier, enabled);

    if (enabled && ! manager.isMidiInputDeviceEnabled (identifier))
        midiPortsBusy.add (name);

    midiPortsTold.clear();   // the page hears how it went
    followMidiPorts();
}

void MainComponent::changeAudioSetup (const juce::var& event)
{
    // Not while a mixdown renders or a take records: the device carries them.
    if (engine.isMixdownRunning() || engine.isRecording() || engine.isTakeActive())
    {
        pushAudioSetup ("Not while recording or exporting a mixdown.");
        return;
    }

    auto& manager = engine.getDeviceManager();
    juce::String error;
    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<bool> busy (deviceSettingUp, true);   // the device watch keeps out of it
    deviceReopens = 0;                  // the user's choice now: nothing of the watch's to bring back
    deviceHeard = false;

    // Taken back first if it was let go: changing it means using it.
    engine.releaseDevice (false);

    if (event.hasProperty ("type"))
    {
        const auto type = event.getProperty ("type", {}).toString();

        if (type != manager.getCurrentAudioDeviceType())
            manager.setCurrentAudioDeviceType (type, true);   // its default device opens

        if (manager.getCurrentAudioDevice() == nullptr)
            error = "No " + type + " device could be opened.";
    }
    else
    {
        auto setup = manager.getAudioDeviceSetup();

        if (event.hasProperty ("device"))
        {
            // One device both ways (ASIO).
            setup.outputDeviceName = setup.inputDeviceName = event.getProperty ("device", {}).toString();
            setup.useDefaultInputChannels = setup.useDefaultOutputChannels = true;
        }

        if (event.hasProperty ("output"))
        {
            setup.outputDeviceName = event.getProperty ("output", {}).toString();
            setup.useDefaultOutputChannels = true;
        }

        if (event.hasProperty ("input"))
        {
            setup.inputDeviceName = event.getProperty ("input", {}).toString();
            setup.useDefaultInputChannels = true;
        }

        if (event.hasProperty ("rate"))
            setup.sampleRate = static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("rate", 0.0));

        if (event.hasProperty ("buffer"))
            setup.bufferSize = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("buffer", 0));

        if (const auto* list = event.getProperty ("inputChannels", {}).getArray())
        {
            setup.inputChannels.clear();

            for (int i = 0; i < list->size(); ++i)
                if (static_cast<bool> ((*list)[i]))
                    setup.inputChannels.setBit (i);

            setup.useDefaultInputChannels = false;
        }

        // Outputs: every channel stays open (the engine opens them all); Song Setup's Outputs
        // say what plays where.
        error = manager.setAudioDeviceSetup (setup, true);
    }

    // The song's inputs follow the device's active input channels.
    pushTracks();
    pushAudioSetup (error);
    pushStatus();
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::replaceLibraryFolder (const juce::String& folder)
{
    if (choosingFile || ! library.getFolders().contains (folder))
        return;

    choosingFile = true;
    fileChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("A Plugin Folder instead of " + folder,
                                                       juce::File (folder).isDirectory() ? juce::File (folder) : juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userHomeDirectory));

    fileChooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectDirectories,
                              [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this), folder] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        safeThis->choosingFile = false;
        const auto chosen = chooser.getResult();

        if (! chosen.isDirectory() || chosen.getFullPathName() == folder)
            return;

        safeThis->lastPluginFolder = chosen;
        safeThis->library.replaceFolder (folder, chosen);
        safeThis->startLibraryScan (false);
        safeThis->pushLibrary();
    });
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::followForeground()
{
    const auto now = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();

    if (now - lastForegroundCheck < 400.0)
        return;

    lastForegroundCheck = now;

    // Every output channel open (a device change during a take or a mixdown waited till now).
    engine.openAllOutputChannels();

    // Another app in front: the audio device is let go for it, unless Sonify is busy with it
    // (playing, recording, exporting, a live show going on: its decks, the night's recording, the
    // stream). Back in front, Sonify takes it again.
    const auto foreground = juce::Process::isForegroundProcess();
    const auto transport = engine.getTransport().getState();
    const auto busy = transport.playing || transport.recording || engine.isMixdownRunning() || engine.isTakeActive()
                      || (engine.isLiveShowOn() && liveShowPlaying());

    if (prefs.releaseInBackground && ! foreground && ! busy && ! engine.isDeviceReleased())
    {
        engine.releaseDevice (true);
        pushAudioSetup();
    }
    else if (engine.isDeviceReleased() && (foreground || ! prefs.releaseInBackground))
    {
        engine.releaseDevice (false);
        pushAudioSetup();
    }
}

void MainComponent::watchAudioDevice()
{
    const auto now = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();

    if (now - deviceWatchMs < 250.0 || deviceReopening)
        return;

    deviceWatchMs = now;
    auto& manager = engine.getDeviceManager();
    auto* device = manager.getCurrentAudioDevice();
    const auto blocks = engine.getDeviceCallbacks();
    const auto say = [this] (const juce::String& text)
    {
        if (liveShown)
            pushLive (text);
        else
            pushTracks (text);
    };

    // Being brought back (it stopped by itself, or vanished: a cable pulled for a moment): tried
    // again even while no device opens.
    const bool bringingBack = deviceReopens < 4 && (deviceReopens > 0 || (device == nullptr && deviceHeard));

    // None chosen, let go of on purpose (Sonify in the background), being set up (Settings, the
    // driver's own window, a driver's message box: the code that opens it is still under way), or
    // carrying an export or a take: nothing to watch.
    if ((device == nullptr && ! bringingBack) || engine.isDeviceReleased() || deviceSettingUp || nativeDialogShowing()
        || engine.isMixdownRunning() || engine.isTakeActive() || engine.getTransport().getState().recording)
    {
        deviceStalledMs = 0.0;
        lastDeviceCallbacks = blocks;
        return;
    }

    if (device != nullptr)
    {
        // Another device, or the same set up anew: watched afresh.
        const auto setup = manager.getAudioDeviceSetup();
        const auto watched = device->getTypeName() + "|" + setup.outputDeviceName + "|" + setup.inputDeviceName + "|"
                             + juce::String (setup.sampleRate) + "|" + juce::String (setup.bufferSize);

        if (watched != deviceWatched)
        {
            deviceWatched = watched;
            deviceHeard = deviceReopens > 0;   // opened again by the watch: still the one it watched
        }

        // Asking for blocks: it runs (its setup kept, to open it again with: JUCE forgets the
        // device's name once an open fails).
        if (blocks != lastDeviceCallbacks)
        {
            if (deviceReopens > 0)
                say ("The audio device stopped by itself: Sonify started it again.");

            lastDeviceCallbacks = blocks;
            deviceStalledMs = 0.0;
            deviceReopens = 0;
            deviceHeard = true;
            deviceRunningSetup = setup;
            return;
        }

        // One that never ran isn't pushed (Settings say why it didn't start).
        if (! deviceHeard)
            return;

        // Still in the last block it asked for (a plugin taking its time over it): the device is
        // fine (closing it would only wait for that block, and freeze Sonify meanwhile).
        if (engine.isInDeviceCallback())
        {
            deviceStalledMs = 0.0;
            return;
        }
    }

    if (deviceStalledMs <= 0.0)
    {
        deviceStalledMs = now;
        return;
    }

    // Silent for longer than any driver's own reset takes: started again, at most four times, further
    // apart each time (3.5, 5, 10, 20 seconds), so a device that's gone isn't pushed for ever.
    const auto wait = deviceReopens == 0 ? 3500.0 : 2500.0 * static_cast<double> (1 << juce::jmin (deviceReopens, 3));

    if (deviceReopens >= 4 || now - deviceStalledMs < wait)
        return;

    ++deviceReopens;
    bool running = false;

    {
        // (A driver's message box meanwhile runs the message loop: the watch keeps out.)
        const juce::ScopedValueSetter<bool> busy (deviceReopening, true);
        running = engine.reopenDevice (deviceRunningSetup);
    }

    deviceStalledMs = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();
    lastDeviceCallbacks = engine.getDeviceCallbacks();
    pushAudioSetup();

    if (! running)
        say (deviceReopens < 4 ? juce::String ("The audio device stopped by itself: Sonify is starting it again...")
                               : juce::String ("The audio device stopped and won't start again: check it's plugged in and on, then choose it in Settings > Audio."));
}

void MainComponent::autosaveIfDue()
{
    const auto now = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();

    // The time counts from the first change since the song was saved (or last autosaved).
    if (! prefs.autosave || noProject || ! songChanged)
    {
        lastAutosave = now;
        return;
    }

    if (now - lastAutosave < prefs.autosaveMinutes * 60000.0)
        return;

    // Not in the middle of a take or a mixdown: the next tick, once it's done.
    if (engine.isMixdownRunning() || engine.isRecording() || engine.isTakeActive())
        return;

    lastAutosave = now;

    // A copy in the user data folder's Autosave, never over the song itself: open it like any song.
    const auto folder = UserData::autosave();

    if (! folder.createDirectory())
        return;

    const auto file = folder.getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (songTitle()) + " (Autosave)" + Song::fileExtension);
    file.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (Song::capture (engine, songTitle(), songView, file)));
}

void MainComponent::undoToggle()
{
    // FL Studio's Ctrl+Z: undo, and right after an undo, redo it.
    undoOrRedo (! (lastHistoryWasUndo && undoManager.canRedo()));
}

//==============================================================================
// Control surfaces (Mackie Control, its Extender, HUI): what they see of Sonify and change in it.
// Mixing (faders, pan, mutes, solos) is never an undo step, as on the page.
juce::StringArray MainComponent::surfaceProblems() const
{
    auto problems = surfaces != nullptr ? surfaces->getProblems() : juce::StringArray();

    // The port a surface sends from must be listened to.
    for (const auto& device : prefs.devices)
    {
        if (device.kind != "surface" || device.input.isEmpty())
            continue;

        if (prefs.midiInputsOff.contains (device.input))
            problems.add (device.name + ": its port " + device.input + " is turned off under MIDI Inputs.");
        else if (midiPortsBusy.contains (device.input))
            problems.add (device.name + ": couldn't open " + device.input + " (another app may be using it).");
    }

    return problems;
}

std::vector<ControlSurfaces::Channel> MainComponent::getSurfaceChannels (bool withSends)
{
    // The Console's order: tracks, then FX channels.
    std::vector<ControlSurfaces::Channel> list, fxChannels;
    const auto selected = engine.getSelectedTrackId();

    for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
    {
        ControlSurfaces::Channel channel;
        channel.id = track->id;
        channel.kind = track->isMixChannel()               ? ControlSurfaces::Channel::Kind::fx
                     : track->kind == Track::Kind::audio   ? ControlSurfaces::Channel::Kind::audio
                                                           : ControlSurfaces::Channel::Kind::instrument;
        channel.name = track->name;
        channel.volumeDb = track->volumeDb.load();
        channel.pan = track->pan.load();
        channel.mute = track->mute.load();
        channel.solo = track->solo.load();
        channel.recordArm = track->recordArm.load();
        channel.selected = track->id == selected && ! track->isMixChannel();
        channel.automationRead = track->automationMode.load() == static_cast<int> (AutomationMode::read);

        // Its sends to FX channels, as the page lists them (not one whose FX channel is gone).
        if (withSends)
            for (const auto& send : track->sends)
                if (const auto* fx = send.sidechain ? nullptr : engine.findTrack (send.target); fx != nullptr && fx->kind == Track::Kind::fx)
                    channel.sends.push_back ({ send.id, send.levelDb, send.on });

        (track->isMixChannel() ? fxChannels : list).push_back (std::move (channel));
    }

    list.insert (list.end(), std::make_move_iterator (fxChannels.begin()), std::make_move_iterator (fxChannels.end()));
    return list;
}

void MainComponent::surfaceSendEdit (int trackId)
{
    // Another track's send: the turn before is a step of its own.
    if (surfaceSendEditing && surfaceSendTrack != trackId)
        commitSurfaceSendEdit();

    if (! surfaceSendEditing)
    {
        surfaceSendEditing = true;
        surfaceSendTrack = trackId;
        surfaceSendsBefore = engine.getSends (trackId);
    }

    surfaceSendChangedMs = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();
}

void MainComponent::commitSurfaceSendEdit()
{
    if (! std::exchange (surfaceSendEditing, false))
        return;

    auto before = std::move (surfaceSendsBefore);
    auto after = engine.getSends (surfaceSendTrack);
    surfaceSendsBefore.clear();

    const auto same = before.size() == after.size()
                   && std::equal (before.begin(), before.end(), after.begin(), [] (const Track::Send& a, const Track::Send& b)
                                  { return a.id == b.id && a.levelDb == b.levelDb && a.on == b.on; });

    if (! same)
        addToHistory ("Change Send", new Edits::SendsChanged (engine, surfaceSendTrack, std::move (before), std::move (after)));
}

void MainComponent::setChannelAutomationRead (int channelId, bool read)
{
    engine.setAutomationMode (channelId, read ? AutomationMode::read : AutomationMode::off);
    markChanged();
    surfaceTracksDue = true;
}

 #ifndef NOMINMAX
  #define NOMINMAX
 #endif
 #ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
  #define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
 #endif
 #include <windows.h>

namespace
{
   #if JUCE_WINDOWS
    /** One of the message thread's windows: a dialog of Windows' own ("#32770": a message box),
        showing? Then it's found, and the looking stops. */
    BOOL CALLBACK findDialog (HWND window, LPARAM found)
    {
        wchar_t name[16] {};

        if (IsWindowVisible (window) && GetClassNameW (window, name, 16) > 0 && lstrcmpW (name, L"#32770") == 0)
        {
            *reinterpret_cast<bool*> (found) = true;
            return FALSE;
        }

        return TRUE;
    }
   #endif

    /** A dialog of Windows' own (a driver's message box) showing on the message thread: its loop
        runs Sonify's timers while the code that showed it (a device being opened) is still under
        way, so nothing may close the device meanwhile. */
    bool nativeDialogShowing()
    {
       #if JUCE_WINDOWS
        bool found = false;
        EnumThreadWindows (GetCurrentThreadId(), findDialog, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM> (&found));
        return found;
       #else
        return false;
       #endif
    }
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainTracks.cpp

#include "MainComponent.h"
#include "Song.h"

//==============================================================================
// The track list's right-click menu (hub-tracks.js), as Studio One's track column has it:
//   addTracks      Add Tracks... (its dialog), and Add Audio Track (mono / stereo), Add Instrument
//                  Track, Add Choir Track: { type: "instrument" | "audio" | "choir" | "bus" | "fx",
//                  count, name, mono, input (-1: the usual), ascending (each next track the next
//                  input), file, pluginId (an instrument from the Browser) }. A choir track is an
//                  audio track singing its clips as a choir too (Choir.h), with four voices to
//                  start. One undo step; the new tracks are selected.
//   addForInputs   Add Tracks for all Inputs: an audio track for each of the song's inputs (Song
//                  Setup > Audio I/O Setup), named after it, mono or stereo as it is.
//   storePreset    Store Track Preset...: the tracks named ({ ids }) into a .trackpreset file.
//   loadPreset     Load Track Preset...: a preset's tracks added at the end, as one undo step.

namespace
{
    juce::File trackPresetFolder()
    {
        return UserData::getFolder().getChildFile ("Track Presets");
    }
}

void MainComponent::handleTrackMenu (const juce::var& event)
{
    const auto action = event.getProperty ("action", {}).toString();

    if (action == "addTracks")
    {
        const auto type = event.getProperty ("type", "instrument").toString();
        const auto choir = type == "choir";
        const auto kind = type == "audio" || choir ? Track::Kind::audio : type == "bus" ? Track::Kind::bus
                        : type == "fx" ? Track::Kind::fx : Track::Kind::instrument;
        const auto count = juce::jlimit (1, 64, static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("count", 1)));
        const auto name = event.getProperty ("name", {}).toString().trim().substring (0, 60);
        const auto mono = static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("mono", false));
        const auto input = static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("input", -1));
        const auto ascending = static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("ascending", false));
        const auto file = event.getProperty ("file", {}).toString();
        const auto pluginId = event.getProperty ("pluginId", {}).toString();
        const auto inputCount = static_cast<int> (engine.getInputs().size());

        const auto label = count > 1 ? juce::String ("Add Tracks")
                         : choir ? juce::String ("Add Choir Track")
                         : kind == Track::Kind::audio ? juce::String ("Add Audio Track")
                         : kind == Track::Kind::bus ? juce::String ("Add Bus Channel")
                         : kind == Track::Kind::fx ? juce::String ("Add FX Channel") : juce::String ("Add Track");

        std::vector<int> added;

        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            const auto id = engine.addTrack (kind);
            addToHistory (label, new Edits::TrackAdded (engine, id, static_cast<int> (engine.getTracks().size()) - 1), i > 0);

            if (kind == Track::Kind::audio)
            {
                engine.setTrackMono (id, mono);

                if (input >= 0 && inputCount > 0)
                    engine.setTrackInput (id, ascending ? (input + i) % inputCount : juce::jmin (input, inputCount - 1));
            }

            // A choir track, named Choir 1, Choir 2... (the name given, if any, follows).
            if (choir)
            {
                const auto choirs = std::count_if (engine.getTracks().begin(), engine.getTracks().end(),
                                                   [] (const auto& t) { return t->choir != nullptr; });
                engine.setTrackChoir (id, ChoirSettings::makeDefault());

                if (auto* track = engine.findTrack (id))
                {
                    track->name = "Choir " + juce::String (static_cast<int> (choirs) + 1);
                    track->nameIsAutomatic = false;
                }
            }

            if (name.isNotEmpty())
            {
                if (auto* track = engine.findTrack (id))
                {
                    track->name = count > 1 ? name + " " + juce::String (i + 1) : name;
                    track->nameIsAutomatic = false;
                }
            }

            added.push_back (id);
        }

        // An instrument from the Browser on each: its loading joins the same undo step.
        if (kind == Track::Kind::instrument && file.isNotEmpty())
            for (const auto id : added)
                loadPluginInto (id, juce::File (file), pluginId, -1, 0, true);

        selectNewTracks (added);
        return;
    }

    if (action == "addForInputs")
    {
        const auto inputs = engine.getInputs();
        std::vector<int> added;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < inputs.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto id = engine.addTrack (Track::Kind::audio);
            addToHistory ("Add Tracks for All Inputs", new Edits::TrackAdded (engine, id, static_cast<int> (engine.getTracks().size()) - 1), i > 0);
            engine.setTrackInput (id, static_cast<int> (i));
            engine.setTrackMono (id, inputs[i].right < 0);

            if (auto* track = engine.findTrack (id); track != nullptr && inputs[i].name.isNotEmpty())
            {
                track->name = inputs[i].name;
                track->nameIsAutomatic = false;
            }

            added.push_back (id);
        }

        selectNewTracks (added);
        return;
    }

    if (action == "storePreset" || action == "loadPreset")
    {
        std::vector<int> ids;

        if (const auto* list = event.getProperty ("ids", {}).getArray())
            for (const auto& value : *list)
                if (const auto id = static_cast<int> (value); engine.findTrack (id) != nullptr)
                    ids.push_back (id);

        chooseTrackPresetFile (action == "storePreset", ids);
    }
}

void MainComponent::selectNewTracks (const std::vector<int>& ids)
{
    // The keyboard plays the first that's a track (FX channels and buses aren't played).
    for (const auto id : ids)
    {
        if (const auto* track = engine.findTrack (id); track != nullptr && ! track->isMixChannel())
        {
            engine.selectTrack (id);
            break;
        }
    }

    pushTracks();

    if (webView != nullptr && ! ids.empty())
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> list;

        for (const auto id : ids)
            list.add (id);

        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr selection (new juce::DynamicObject());
        selection->setProperty ("ids", list);
        webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("selectTracks", juce::var (selection.get()));
    }
}

void MainComponent::chooseTrackPresetFile (bool storing, const std::vector<int>& ids)
{
    if (choosingFile || (storing && ids.empty()))
        return;

    choosingFile = true;
    const auto folder = trackPresetFolder();
    folder.createDirectory();

    // Named after the first track stored.
    auto suggested = folder;

    if (storing)
        if (const auto* track = engine.findTrack (ids.front()))
            suggested = folder.getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (track->name + (ids.size() > 1 ? " and more" : ""))
                                             + Song::trackPresetExtension);

    trackPresetChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> (storing ? "Store Track Preset" : "Load Track Preset", suggested,
                                                              juce::String ("*") + Song::trackPresetExtension);

    const auto chooserFlags = storing ? juce::FileBrowserComponent::saveMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::warnAboutOverwriting
                               : juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles;

    trackPresetChooser->launchAsync (chooserFlags, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this), storing, ids] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        safeThis->choosingFile = false;
        auto file = chooser.getResult();

        if (file == juce::File())
            return;

        if (storing)
        {
            file = file.withFileExtension (Song::trackPresetExtension);
            const auto preset = Song::captureTrackPreset (safeThis->engine, ids);

            if (! file.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (preset)))
                safeThis->pushTracks ("Couldn't write " + file.getFullPathName());
            else
                safeThis->pushTracks ("Track preset stored: " + file.getFileNameWithoutExtension());

            return;
        }

        juce::StringArray problems;
        const auto loaded = Song::restoreTrackPreset (safeThis->engine, juce::JSON::parse (file), problems);

        if (loaded.empty())
        {
            safeThis->pushTracks (file.getFileName() + " isn't a track preset.");
            return;
        }

        const auto order = Edits::allTrackIds (safeThis->engine);
        bool first = true;

        for (const auto id : loaded)
        {
            const auto index = static_cast<int> (std::find (order.begin(), order.end(), id) - order.begin());
            safeThis->addToHistory ("Load Track Preset", new Edits::TrackAdded (safeThis->engine, id, index), ! first);
            first = false;
        }

        safeThis->markChanged();
        safeThis->selectNewTracks (loaded);

        if (! problems.isEmpty())
            safeThis->pushTracks (problems.joinIntoString ("\n"));
    });
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainVideo.cpp
//
// The song's video, as Studio One has it: one video, its picture in the Video lane over the
// tracks (a strip of small pictures) and in the Video window where the song is, its sound an
// ordinary audio clip on a track of its own. Song > Export Video writes a new MP4: the picture
// as it was, the song's mix as its sound. VLC reads and shows it (VideoMedia.h).

#include "MainComponent.h"

namespace
{
    constexpr const char* thumbnailsPath = "song-video-thumbnails.jpg";
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::handleSongVideo (const juce::var& event)
{
    const auto action = event.getProperty ("action", {}).toString();
    const auto& video = engine.getSongVideo();

    if (action == "import")
    {
        const auto at = event.hasProperty ("at") ? juce::jmax (0.0, static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("at", 0.0)))
                                                 : engine.getTransport().getState().ppq;
        const auto path = event.getProperty ("file", {}).toString();

        if (path.isNotEmpty() && juce::File::isAbsolutePath (path))
            importVideo (juce::File (path), at);
        else
            chooseVideo (at);
    }
    else if (action == "move")
    {
        if (video.isEmpty())
            return;

        const auto before = video;     // a copy: the engine's own changes next
        auto after = before;
        after.start = juce::jmax (0.0, static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("start", before.start)));

        if (after == before)
            return pushSongVideo (true);

        engine.setSongVideo (after);
        addToHistory ("Move Video", new Edits::VideoChanged (engine, before, after));
        pushSongVideo();
    }
    else if (action == "remove")
    {
        if (video.isEmpty())
            return;

        const auto before = video;
        engine.setSongVideo ({});
        addToHistory ("Remove Video", new Edits::VideoChanged (engine, before, {}));
        pushSongVideo();
    }
    else if (action == "window")
    {
        showVideoWindow (static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("show", true)));
    }
    else if (action == "export")
    {
        chooseVideoExport();
    }
    else if (action == "cancelExport")
    {
        if (videoExportStage == VideoExportStage::mixing)
            engine.cancelMixdown();
        else if (videoExport != nullptr)
            videoExport->cancel();
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::importVideo (const juce::File& file, double at)
{
    if (const auto problem = VideoMedia::problem(); problem.isNotEmpty())
        return pushTracks (problem);

    if (videoImport != nullptr)
        return pushTracks ("A video is being imported: one at a time.");

    if (! file.existsAsFile())
        return pushTracks (file.getFileName() + " isn't there.");

    // Read once, faster than it plays: its sound into a WAV, its small pictures (VideoMedia.h).
    videoImport = std::make_unique<VideoMedia::Preparation> (file, VideoMedia::Wanted {});
    videoImportAt = juce::jmax (0.0, at);
    videoImportGeneration = songGeneration;
    videoProgressPushed = -1.0;
    pushSongVideo (true);
}

void MainComponent::chooseVideo (double at)
{
    if (choosingFile)
        return;

    choosingFile = true;
    songChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Import a video", juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userMoviesDirectory),
                                                       VideoMedia::wildcards());

    songChooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles,
                              [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this), at] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        safeThis->choosingFile = false;
        const auto chosen = chooser.getResult();

        if (chosen.existsAsFile())
            safeThis->importVideo (chosen, at);
    });
}

void MainComponent::finishVideoImport()
{
    const auto prepared = videoImport->getResult();
    const auto file = videoImport->getVideo();
    videoImport = nullptr;

    // Another song opened meanwhile: the video was for the one before.
    if (videoImportGeneration != songGeneration)
    {
        pushSongVideo (true);
        return pushTracks (file.getFileName() + " was imported for the song before: import it again here.");
    }

    if (! prepared.ok())
    {
        pushSongVideo (true);

        if (prepared.error != "Cancelled")
            pushTracks ("Couldn't import " + file.getFileName() + ": " + prepared.error);

        return;
    }

    const auto before = engine.getSongVideo();
    const AudioEngine::SongVideo after { file, videoImportAt };
    bool joined = false;

    // Its sound: a WAV of its own with the song's recordings (its Media folder), on a new audio
    // track named after the video, starting with its picture.
    if (prepared.sound.existsAsFile())
    {
        auto folder = engine.getRecordingFolder();

        if (folder == juce::File())
            folder = UserData::recordings();

        folder.createDirectory();
        const auto wav = folder.getNonexistentChildFile (file.getFileNameWithoutExtension() + " (video sound)", ".wav", false);

        if (prepared.sound.copyFileTo (wav))
        {
            const auto trackId = engine.addTrack (Track::Kind::audio);
            engine.setTrackName (trackId, file.getFileNameWithoutExtension());
            addToHistory ("Import Video", new Edits::TrackAdded (engine, trackId, static_cast<int> (engine.getTracks().size()) - 1));
            joined = true;

            auto clipsBefore = Edits::snapshot (engine, { trackId });

            if (engine.importAudio (trackId, wav, videoImportAt) > 0)
                addToHistory ("Import Video", new Edits::ClipsChanged (engine, std::move (clipsBefore), Edits::snapshot (engine, { trackId })), true);
        }
        else
        {
            pushTracks ("Couldn't write the video's sound into " + folder.getFullPathName());
        }
    }

    engine.setSongVideo (after);
    addToHistory ("Import Video", new Edits::VideoChanged (engine, before, after), joined);

    videoPrepared = prepared;
    videoPreparedFor = file;
    ++videoThumbnailsVersion;
    pushTracks();
    pushSongVideo (true);
    showVideoWindow (true);
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::updateVideo()
{
    if (videoImport != nullptr)
    {
        if (videoImport->isDone())
        {
            finishVideoImport();
        }
        else if (std::abs (videoImport->getProgress() - videoProgressPushed) >= 0.01)
        {
            videoProgressPushed = videoImport->getProgress();
            pushSongVideo (true);
        }
    }

    if (videoPreparing != nullptr)
    {
        if (videoPreparing->isDone())
        {
            const auto prepared = videoPreparing->getResult();

            if (videoPreparing->getVideo() == engine.getSongVideo().file)
            {
                if (prepared.ok())
                {
                    videoPrepared = prepared;
                    videoPreparedFor = videoPreparing->getVideo();
                    ++videoThumbnailsVersion;
                }
                else
                {
                    videoPrepareError = prepared.error;
                }
            }

            videoPreparing = nullptr;
            pushSongVideo (true);
        }
        else if (std::abs (videoPreparing->getProgress() - videoProgressPushed) >= 0.01)
        {
            videoProgressPushed = videoPreparing->getProgress();
            pushSongVideo (true);
        }
    }

    // An undo, a redo or another song: the lane and the window catch up.
    pushSongVideo();
}

double MainComponent::videoEnd() const
{
    const auto& video = engine.getSongVideo();

    if (video.isEmpty() || ! videoPrepared || videoPreparedFor != video.file)
        return video.start;

    const auto& map = engine.getTempoMap();
    return map.ppqAt (map.secondsAt (video.start) + videoPrepared->info.seconds);
}

void MainComponent::pushSongVideo (bool force)
{
    const auto& video = engine.getSongVideo();
    const auto generation = engine.getSongVideoGeneration();

    if (! force && generation == pushedVideoGeneration)
        return;

    pushedVideoGeneration = generation;

    // What the video's pictures are: from the cache, or made again (a song from elsewhere).
    if (! video.isEmpty() && videoPreparedFor != video.file)
    {
        videoPrepared.reset();
        videoPreparedFor = video.file;
        videoPrepareError.clear();
        ++videoThumbnailsVersion;

        VideoMedia::Wanted wanted;
        wanted.sound = false;

        if (auto cached = VideoMedia::cached (video.file, wanted))
            videoPrepared = std::move (cached);
        else if (video.file.existsAsFile() && VideoMedia::problem().isEmpty()
                 && (videoPreparing == nullptr || videoPreparing->getVideo() != video.file))
            videoPreparing = std::make_unique<VideoMedia::Preparation> (video.file, wanted);
    }

    syncVideoPicture();

    if (webView == nullptr)
        return;

    // (VLC is loaded only once there's a video to show.)
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr data (new juce::DynamicObject());
    data->setProperty ("problem", video.isEmpty() && videoImport == nullptr ? juce::String() : VideoMedia::problem());
    data->setProperty ("window", videoWindow != nullptr && videoWindow->isVisible());

    if (videoImport != nullptr || (videoPreparing != nullptr && videoPreparing->getVideo() == video.file))
    {
        const auto& job = videoImport != nullptr ? *videoImport : *videoPreparing;
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr preparing (new juce::DynamicObject());
        preparing->setProperty ("name", job.getVideo().getFileName());
        preparing->setProperty ("progress", job.getProgress());
        preparing->setProperty ("importing", videoImport != nullptr);
        data->setProperty ("preparing", juce::var (preparing.get()));
    }

    if (! video.isEmpty())
    {
        data->setProperty ("file", video.file.getFullPathName());
        data->setProperty ("name", video.file.getFileName());
        data->setProperty ("start", video.start);
        data->setProperty ("end", videoEnd());
        data->setProperty ("missing", ! video.file.existsAsFile());
        data->setProperty ("error", videoPrepareError);

        if (videoPrepared && videoPreparedFor == video.file)
        {
            const auto& info = videoPrepared->info;
            data->setProperty ("seconds", info.seconds);
            data->setProperty ("width", info.width);
            data->setProperty ("height", info.height);

            if (const auto& t = videoPrepared->thumbnails; t.isValid())
            {
                juce::DynamicObject::Ptr thumbs (new juce::DynamicObject());
                thumbs->setProperty ("url", juce::String (thumbnailsPath) + "?v=" + juce::String (videoThumbnailsVersion));
                thumbs->setProperty ("count", t.count);
                thumbs->setProperty ("columns", t.columns);
                thumbs->setProperty ("cellWidth", t.cellWidth);
                thumbs->setProperty ("cellHeight", t.cellHeight);
                thumbs->setProperty ("every", t.every);
                data->setProperty ("thumbnails", juce::var (thumbs.get()));
            }
        }
    }

    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("songVideo", juce::var (data.get()));
}

std::optional<juce::WebBrowserComponent::Resource> MainComponent::getVideoResource()
{
    if (! videoPrepared || videoPreparedFor != engine.getSongVideo().file)
        return std::nullopt;

    juce::MemoryBlock data;

    if (! videoPrepared->thumbnails.file.loadFileAsData (data))
        return std::nullopt;

    const auto* bytes = static_cast<const std::byte*> (data.getData());
    return juce::WebBrowserComponent::Resource { std::vector<std::byte> (bytes, bytes + data.getSize()), "image/jpeg" };
}

//==============================================================================
VideoScreen::Where MainComponent::videoWhere()
{
    const auto& video = engine.getSongVideo();

    // (A mixdown races through the song: the picture rests meanwhile.)
    if (video.isEmpty() || ! videoPrepared || videoPreparedFor != video.file || engine.isMixdownRunning())
        return {};

    // The song's time where the picture is: the transport's, less where the picture starts.
    const auto state = engine.getTransport().getState();
    const auto start = engine.getTempoMap().secondsAt (video.start);
    return { true, state.seconds - start, state.playing, 1.0 };
}

void MainComponent::syncVideoPicture()
{
    const auto& video = engine.getSongVideo();

    if (videoPicture == nullptr)
        videoPicture = std::make_unique<VideoScreen::Picture> ([this] { return videoWhere(); });

    if (video.isEmpty())
    {
        if (videoPicture->isOpen())
            videoPicture->close();

        videoPicture->setMessage ("The song has no video. Song > Import Video adds one.");
        return;
    }

    if (const auto problem = VideoMedia::problem(); problem.isNotEmpty())
        return videoPicture->setMessage (problem);

    if (! video.file.existsAsFile())
    {
        videoPicture->close();
        return videoPicture->setMessage (video.file.getFileName() + " isn't there any more.");
    }

    if (! videoPrepared || videoPreparedFor != video.file)
    {
        videoPicture->close();

        if (videoPrepareError.isNotEmpty())
            return videoPicture->setMessage ("Couldn't read " + video.file.getFileName() + ": " + videoPrepareError);

        return videoPicture->setMessage ("Getting " + video.file.getFileName() + " ready...");
    }

    if (videoPicture->getFile() != video.file && ! videoPicture->open (video.file, videoPrepared->info))
        videoPicture->setMessage ("VLC couldn't play " + video.file.getFileName() + ".");

    if (videoWindow != nullptr)
        videoWindow->setName ("Video - " + video.file.getFileName());
}

void MainComponent::showVideoWindow (bool show)
{
    if (! show)
    {
        if (videoWindow != nullptr)
            videoWindow->setVisible (false);

        return pushSongVideo (true);
    }

    syncVideoPicture();

    if (videoWindow == nullptr)
    {
        videoWindow = std::make_unique<VideoScreen::Window> (*videoPicture, "Video");
        videoWindow->onClose = [this] { pushSongVideo (true); };
    }

    const auto& video = engine.getSongVideo();
    videoWindow->setName (video.isEmpty() ? juce::String ("Video") : "Video - " + video.file.getFileName());
    videoWindow->setVisible (true);
    videoWindow->toFront (true);
    pushSongVideo (true);
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::chooseVideoExport()
{
    const auto& video = engine.getSongVideo();

    if (video.isEmpty())
        return emitVideoExport ("failed", 0.0, "The song has no video: Song > Import Video adds one.");

    if (! videoPrepared || videoPreparedFor != video.file)
        return emitVideoExport ("failed", 0.0, videoPrepareError.isNotEmpty() ? "Couldn't read the video: " + videoPrepareError
                                                                              : juce::String ("The video is still being got ready: try again in a moment."));

    if (choosingFile)
        return;

    auto name = songTitle().isNotEmpty() ? songTitle() : video.file.getFileNameWithoutExtension();
    const auto folder = defaultMixdownFolder();
    folder.createDirectory();
    choosingFile = true;
    songChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Export Video", folder.getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (name) + ".mp4"), "*.mp4");

    songChooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::saveMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles
                                  | juce::FileBrowserComponent::warnAboutOverwriting,
                              [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this)] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        safeThis->choosingFile = false;
        auto target = chooser.getResult();

        if (target == juce::File())
            return;

        if (! target.hasFileExtension (".mp4"))
            target = target.withFileExtension (".mp4");

        safeThis->startVideoExport (target);
    });
}

void MainComponent::startVideoExport (const juce::File& target)
{
    const auto& video = engine.getSongVideo();

    if (video.isEmpty() || ! videoPrepared || videoPreparedFor != video.file)
        return emitVideoExport ("failed", 0.0, "The song has no video ready.");

    if (! video.file.existsAsFile())
        return emitVideoExport ("failed", 0.0, video.file.getFileName() + " isn't there any more.");

    if (videoExportStage != VideoExportStage::idle)
        return emitVideoExport ("failed", 0.0, "A video is being exported already.");

    if (engine.isMixdownRunning() || masteringStage != MasteringStage::idle)
        return emitVideoExport ("failed", 0.0, "Not while a mixdown is being made.");

    if (engine.isRecording())
        return emitVideoExport ("failed", 0.0, "Not while recording.");

    // First the mix, over the picture's length exactly, at 48 kHz (the new file's sound).
    videoExportMix = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::tempDirectory).getNonexistentChildFile ("Sonify video mix", ".wav", false);
    videoExportTarget = target;
    videoExportSource = video.file;

    AudioEngine::MixdownSettings settings;
    settings.file = videoExportMix;
    settings.format = AudioEngine::MixdownSettings::Format::wav;
    settings.bits = 32;
    settings.outputRate = 48000.0;
    settings.startPpq = video.start;
    settings.endPpq = videoEnd();
    settings.tailSeconds = 0.0;

    setMasteringListen (false, false);
    const auto result = engine.startMixdown (settings);

    if (result.failed())
        return emitVideoExport ("failed", 0.0, result.getErrorMessage());

    videoExportStage = VideoExportStage::mixing;
    emitVideoExport ("running", 0.0);
}

void MainComponent::updateVideoExport()
{
    if (videoExportStage == VideoExportStage::mixing)
    {
        juce::File written;

        if (const auto result = engine.collectMixdown (written))
        {
            pushStatus();

            if (result->failed())
            {
                videoExportStage = VideoExportStage::idle;
                videoExportMix.deleteFile();
                const auto cancelled = result->getErrorMessage() == "Cancelled";
                return emitVideoExport (cancelled ? "cancelled" : "failed", 0.0, cancelled ? juce::String() : result->getErrorMessage());
            }

            // Then the new file: the picture as it was, the mix as its sound (on a thread of its own).
            videoExportStage = VideoExportStage::writing;
            videoExport = std::make_unique<Mp4::Export> (videoExportSource, videoExportMix, videoExportTarget);
            return emitVideoExport ("running", 0.5);
        }

        return emitVideoExport ("running", 0.5 * engine.getMixdownProgress());
    }

    if (videoExportStage == VideoExportStage::writing && videoExport != nullptr)
    {
        if (! videoExport->isDone())
            return emitVideoExport ("running", 0.5 + 0.5 * videoExport->getProgress());

        const auto result = videoExport->getResult();
        videoExport = nullptr;
        videoExportStage = VideoExportStage::idle;
        videoExportMix.deleteFile();

        if (result.failed())
        {
            // (The new file is written beside it and only then put in its place: a file
            // already there stays as it was.)
            const auto cancelled = result.getErrorMessage() == "Cancelled";
            return emitVideoExport (cancelled ? "cancelled" : "failed", 0.0, cancelled ? juce::String() : result.getErrorMessage());
        }

        emitVideoExport ("done", 1.0);
    }
}

void MainComponent::emitVideoExport (const juce::String& state, double progress, const juce::String& error)
{
    if (webView == nullptr)
        return;

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
    item->setProperty ("state", state);
    item->setProperty ("progress", progress);
    item->setProperty ("file", videoExportTarget.getFullPathName());
    item->setProperty ("name", videoExportTarget.getFileName());
    item->setProperty ("error", error);
    webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("videoExport", juce::var (item.get()));
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MasteringAssistant.cpp

#include "MasteringAssistant.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

namespace
{
    using namespace SonifyDsp;

    constexpr std::array<double, 10> bandCentres { 31.5, 63.0, 125.0, 250.0, 500.0, 1000.0, 2000.0, 4000.0, 8000.0, 16000.0 };

    /** Energy in octave bands of the mid signal, every 100 ms step (as the loudness meter's). */
    class BandMeter
    {
    public:
        BandMeter (double sampleRate, int stepSamples)
            : stepLength (stepSamples)
        {
            // Two of the same band-pass in a row: about two thirds of an octave, the same for every band.
            for (size_t b = 0; b < bandCentres.size(); ++b)
                filters[b] = Biquad::bandPass (sampleRate, juce::jmin (bandCentres[b], sampleRate * 0.45), 1.414);
        }

        void process (const float* left, const float* right, int numSamples)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
            {
                const auto mid = 0.5 * (static_cast<double> (left[i]) + static_cast<double> (right[i]));

                for (size_t b = 0; b < bandCentres.size(); ++b)
                {
                    const auto y = second[b].processDouble (filters[b], first[b].processDouble (filters[b], mid));
                    energy[b] += y * y;
                }

                if (++count == stepLength)
                {
                    steps.push_back (energy);
                    energy.fill (0.0);
                    count = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::array<double, 10>> steps;

    private:
        std::array<Biquad, 10> filters {};
        std::array<BiquadState, 10> first {}, second {};
        std::array<double, 10> energy {};
        int stepLength = 4800, count = 0;
    };

    /** The glue's reduction (dB) averaged over the loud milliseconds, simulated on the detector's
        level taken every millisecond: the same gain computer and smoothing as the compressor. */
    double simulateGlue (const std::vector<float>& levels, const std::vector<char>& loud, const Compressor::Settings& s)
    {
        const auto slope = s.ratio > 1.0f ? 1.0 - 1.0 / static_cast<double> (s.ratio) : 0.0;
        const auto knee = static_cast<double> (s.kneeDb);
        const auto attack = std::exp (-1.0 / juce::jmax (0.01, static_cast<double> (s.attackMs)));    // a step per millisecond
        const auto release = std::exp (-1.0 / juce::jmax (0.01, static_cast<double> (s.releaseMs)));
        double held = 0.0, smoothed = 0.0, sum = 0.0;
        juce::int64 count = 0;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < levels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto above = static_cast<double> (levels[i]) - s.thresholdDb;
            double over = 0.0;

            if (slope > 0.0)
            {
                if (2.0 * above <= -knee)
                    over = 0.0;
                else if (knee > 0.0 && 2.0 * std::abs (above) <= knee)
                    over = slope * (above + knee * 0.5) * (above + knee * 0.5) / (2.0 * knee);
                else
                    over = slope * above;
            }

            held = juce::jmax (over, release * held + (1.0 - release) * over);
            smoothed = attack * smoothed + (1.0 - attack) * held;

            if (i < loud.size() && loud[i] != 0)
            {
                sum += smoothed;
                ++count;
            }
        }

        return count > 0 ? sum / static_cast<double> (count) : 0.0;
    }
}
