// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PluginCanvas_Elements.cpp
// The canvas's programmed elements: Sonify AI's own GUI elements (the project's elements
// folder), run in their sandbox (WasmElements), drawn from the pixels they paint, given the
// mouse in Play mode, with their popups over everything.

#include "PluginCanvas.h"
#include "PluginCanvasMenu.h"
#include "StellaLookAndFeel.h"
#include "FontLibrary.h"
#include "WasmElements.h"

#include <set>

namespace
{
    // As in stella_elements.h: the mouse events.
    enum { mouseDownEvent = 0, mouseDragEvent = 1, mouseUpEvent = 2, mouseMoveEvent = 3, mouseExitEvent = 4, mouseWheelEvent = 5 };

    void copyPixels (juce::Image& image, const std::uint32_t* pixels, int w, int h)
    {
        if (! image.isValid() || image.getWidth() != w || image.getHeight() != h)
            image = juce::Image (juce::Image::ARGB, w, h, false, juce::SoftwareImageType());

        // Both are premultiplied 0xAARRGGBB.
        juce::Image::BitmapData data (image, juce::Image::BitmapData::writeOnly);

        for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y)
            std::memcpy (data.getLinePointer (y), pixels + (size_t) y * (size_t) w, sizeof (std::uint32_t) * (size_t) w);
    }
}

//==============================================================================
// What the elements ask
const GuiWidget* PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::widget (int element) const
{
    const auto& widgets = canvas.layout.widgets;
    return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (element, (int) widgets.size()) && widgets[(size_t) element].type == GuiWidget::Type::custom
               ? &widgets[(size_t) element] : nullptr;
}

const PluginCanvas::Param* PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::paramAt (int element, int slot) const
{
    const auto* w = widget (element);

    if (w == nullptr || slot < 0)
        return nullptr;

    if (slot == 0)
        return canvas.paramById (w->param);

    // Slots 1 and up: its roles, in the order the layout keeps them.
    int i = 1;

    for (const auto& [role, id] : w->roles)
        if (i++ == slot)
            return canvas.paramById (id);

    return nullptr;
}

bool PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::paramInfo (int element, int slot, int info, float& result)
{
    const auto* p = paramAt (element, slot);

    if (p == nullptr)
        return false;

    switch (info)
    {
        case valueInfo:    result = canvas.currentValue (*p); return true;
        case minInfo:      result = p->min; return true;
        case maxInfo:      result = p->max; return true;
        case defaultInfo:  result = p->def; return true;
        case skewInfo:     result = p->skew; return true;
        default:           return false;
    }
}

int PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::findSlot (int element, const std::string& role)
{
    const auto* w = widget (element);

    if (w == nullptr)
        return -1;

    const auto name = juce::String (role).trim();

    if (name.isEmpty() || name == "param")
        return w->param.isNotEmpty() ? 0 : -1;

    int i = 1;

    for (const auto& r : w->roles)
    {
        if (r.first == name)
            return i;

        ++i;
    }

    return -1;
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::setValue (int element, int slot, float newValue)
{
    if (const auto* p = paramAt (element, slot))
        canvas.setValue (*p, newValue);
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::gesture (int, int, bool)
{
    // The studio has no host to tell: each value goes to the plugin as it's set.
}

bool PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::text (int element, int which, int index, const std::string& key, std::string& result)
{
    const auto* w = widget (element);

    if (w == nullptr)
        return false;

    juce::String text;

    switch (which)
    {
        case labelText:
            text = w->label;
            break;

        case optionText:
            if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, w->options.size()))
                return false;

            text = w->options[index];
            break;

        case paramNameText:
        case unitText:
        {
            const auto* p = paramAt (element, index);

            if (p == nullptr)
                return false;

            text = which == paramNameText ? p->name : p->unit;
            break;
        }

        case settingText:
            // Its font is the element's own field: the runtime draws its text in it.
            if (key == "font" && w->settings.find ("font") == w->settings.end())
            {
                text = FontLibrary::canonical (w->font);

                if (text.isEmpty())
                    return false;

                break;
            }

            if (w->settings.find (juce::String (key)) == w->settings.end())
                return false;

            text = w->settingText (juce::String (key));
            break;

        case sourceText:
            text = sourceOf (*w, key);

            if (text.isEmpty())
                return false;

            break;

        case presetNameText:
        case presetGroupText:
        {
            const auto& list = which == presetNameText ? canvas.presetMenu.names : canvas.presetMenu.groups;

            if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, canvas.presetMenu.names.size()))
                return false;

            text = list[index];
            break;
        }

        default:
            return false;
    }

    result = text.toStdString();
    return true;
}

juce::String PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::sourceOf (const GuiWidget& w, const std::string& role)
{
    // "" is the element's own "source"; any other role is one of its "sources".
    if (role.empty())
        return w.source;

    const auto found = w.sources.find (juce::String::fromUTF8 (role.data(), (int) role.size()));
    return found != w.sources.end() ? found->second : juce::String();
}

int PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::numOptions (int element)
{
    const auto* w = widget (element);
    return w != nullptr ? w->options.size() : 0;
}

std::uint32_t PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::colour (int element)
{
    const auto* w = widget (element);
    return w != nullptr && ! w->colour.isTransparent() ? w->colour.getARGB() : 0u;
}

float PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::level (int element, bool rms)
{
    const auto* w = widget (element);
    return w != nullptr && w->source.isNotEmpty() ? canvas.frameLevel (w->source, rms) : 0.0f;
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::readScope (int element, float* destination, int numSamples)
{
    const auto* w = widget (element);

    if (w != nullptr && w->source.isNotEmpty() && canvas.readScope != nullptr)
        canvas.readScope (w->source, destination, numSamples);
    else
        std::fill (destination, destination + juce::jmax (0, numSamples), 0.0f);
}

float PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::sourceLevel (int element, const std::string& role, bool rms)
{
    const auto* w = widget (element);
    const auto source = w != nullptr ? sourceOf (*w, role) : juce::String();
    return source.isNotEmpty() ? canvas.frameLevel (source, rms) : 0.0f;
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::readSourceScope (int element, const std::string& role, float* destination, int numSamples)
{
    const auto* w = widget (element);
    const auto source = w != nullptr ? sourceOf (*w, role) : juce::String();

    if (source.isNotEmpty() && canvas.readScope != nullptr)
        canvas.readScope (source, destination, numSamples);
    else
        std::fill (destination, destination + juce::jmax (0, numSamples), 0.0f);
}

//==============================================================================
// The presets: the same as the preset manager's, the same callbacks
bool PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::canDoPreset (const PresetMenu& menu, bool hasActions, int command)
{
    if (! hasActions || command < (int) PresetAction::save || command > (int) PresetAction::showFolder)
        return false;

    switch ((PresetAction) command)
    {
        case PresetAction::save:         return menu.canSave;
        case PresetAction::saveFactory:  return menu.canSaveFactory;
        case PresetAction::saveBank:     return ! menu.names.isEmpty();
        case PresetAction::remove:       return menu.canDelete;
        case PresetAction::saveAs:
        case PresetAction::loadFile:
        case PresetAction::loadBank:
        case PresetAction::showFolder:   return true;
    }

    return false;
}

int PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::presetInfo (int, int which, int index)
{
    const auto& presets = canvas.presetMenu;

    switch (which)
    {
        case presetCountInfo:     return presets.names.size();
        case presetCurrentInfo:   return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (presets.current, presets.names.size()) ? presets.current : -1;
        case presetModifiedInfo:  return presets.modified ? 1 : 0;
        case presetCanDoInfo:     return canDoPreset (presets, canvas.onPresetAction != nullptr, index) ? 1 : 0;
        case presetVersionInfo:   return canvas.presetVersion;
        default:                  return 0;
    }
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::presetTask (int, int task, int index)
{
    // Done once the element's call is over: a preset's values go onto the plugin, and a command
    // may open a dialog.
    juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safeCanvas = juce::Component::SafePointer<PluginCanvas> (&canvas), task, index]
    {
        if (safeCanvas == nullptr)
            return;

        auto& c = *safeCanvas;
        const auto& menu = c.presetMenu;

        if (task == choosePresetTask)
        {
            if (juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, menu.names.size()) && c.onPresetChosen != nullptr)
                c.onPresetChosen (index);
        }
        else if (task == stepPresetTask)
        {
            if (const auto next = menu.step (index < 0 ? -1 : 1); next >= 0 && c.onPresetChosen != nullptr)
                c.onPresetChosen (next);
        }
        else if (task == presetCommandTask && c.onPresetAction != nullptr)
        {
            // Save over a preset that can't be saved over is Save as (the manager does the same).
            if (index == (int) PresetAction::save || canDoPreset (menu, true, index))
                c.onPresetAction ((PresetAction) index);
        }
    });
}

//==============================================================================
// Pictures: the plugin's own, from gui/images
juce::Image PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::pictureIn (PluginCanvas& canvas, const std::string& name)
{
    const auto file = juce::String::fromUTF8 (name.data(), (int) name.size()).trim();

    // A file name only: nothing outside the images folder.
    if (file.isEmpty() || file.containsAnyOf ("/\\:") || file.startsWithChar ('.'))
        return {};

    return canvas.picture (file);
}

bool PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::pictureSize (int, const std::string& name, int& width, int& height)
{
    const auto image = pictureIn (canvas, name);

    if (! image.isValid())
        return false;

    width = image.getWidth();
    height = image.getHeight();
    return true;
}

bool PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::readPicture (int, const std::string& name, int width, int height, std::uint32_t* destination)
{
    auto image = pictureIn (canvas, name);

    if (! image.isValid() || width <= 0 || height <= 0 || destination == nullptr)
        return false;

    if (image.getWidth() != width || image.getHeight() != height)
        image = image.rescaled (width, height, juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);

    // Premultiplied 0xAARRGGBB, as the canvas keeps it.
    image = image.convertedToFormat (juce::Image::ARGB);
    const juce::Image::BitmapData data (image, juce::Image::BitmapData::readOnly);

    if (data.pixelStride != (int) sizeof (juce::PixelARGB))
        return false;

    for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* line = reinterpret_cast<const juce::PixelARGB*> (data.getLinePointer (y));
        auto* row = destination + (size_t) y * (size_t) width;

        for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x)
            row[x] = line[x].getInARGBMaskOrder();
    }

    return true;
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::playNote (int, int note, float velocity)
{
    if (canvas.onNote != nullptr && note >= 0 && note < 128)
        canvas.onNote (note, juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, velocity));
}

bool PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::isNoteDown (int note)
{
    return canvas.isNoteDown != nullptr && note >= 0 && note < 128 && canvas.isNoteDown (note);
}

int PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::fontData (const std::string& name, bool bold, std::uint8_t* destination, int capacity)
{
    // One of the fonts built in (a bold only where the font has one).
    const auto* family = FontLibrary::find (juce::String (name));

    if (family == nullptr || (bold && (family->bold == nullptr || family->boldSize <= 0)))
        return 0;

    const void* data = nullptr;
    int size = 0;

    if (! FontLibrary::file (family->name, bold, data, size))
        return 0;

    if (destination != nullptr && capacity >= size)
        std::memcpy (destination, data, (size_t) size);

    return size;
}

double PluginCanvas::ElementBridge::seconds()
{
    return juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes() / 1000.0;
}

//==============================================================================
float PluginCanvas::frameLevel (const juce::String& source, bool rms)
{
    // Each source is read once per frame: a peak is "the highest since the last read".
    const auto key = source + (rms ? "|rms" : "|peak");

    if (const auto found = frameLevels.find (key); found != frameLevels.end())
        return found->second;

    const auto level = readLevel != nullptr ? readLevel (source, rms) : 0.0f;
    frameLevels[key] = level;
    return level;
}

void PluginCanvas::setElements (std::shared_ptr<WasmElements> newElements)
{
    if (elements != nullptr)
    {
        closeElementPopups();
        elements->setHost (nullptr);
    }

    elementViews.clear();
    hoveredElement = -1;
    elementsProblem.clear();
    elements = std::move (newElements);

    if (elementBridge == nullptr)
        elementBridge = std::make_unique<ElementBridge> (*this);

    if (elements != nullptr)
        elements->setHost (elementBridge.get());

    syncElements();
    repaint();
}

void PluginCanvas::checkElementsFailed()
{
    if (elements == nullptr || ! elements->hasFailed() || elementsProblem.isNotEmpty())
        return;

    elementsProblem = juce::String (elements->getFailure());
    elementViews.clear();
    hoveredElement = -1;
    repaint();

    if (onElementsFailed != nullptr)
        onElementsFailed (elementsProblem);
}

void PluginCanvas::syncElements()
{
    checkElementsFailed();

    if (elements == nullptr || elements->hasFailed())
    {
        elementViews.clear();
        return;
    }

    std::set<int> shown;

    for (int i = 0; i < (int) layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& w = layout.widgets[(size_t) i];

        if (w.type != GuiWidget::Type::custom)
            continue;

        shown.insert (i);
        auto& view = elementViews[i];
        const auto width = w.bounds.getWidth(), height = w.bounds.getHeight();

        if (view.created && view.type == w.element)
        {
            if (view.width != width || view.height != height)
            {
                elements->resize (i, width, height);
                view.width = width;
                view.height = height;
            }

            elements->invalidate (i);   // its label, options or colour may have changed
            continue;
        }

        // A new element here (or a different one): made afresh.
        if (view.created)
            elements->destroy (i);

        view = {};
        view.type = w.element;
        view.width = width;
        view.height = height;
        view.created = elements->hasType (w.element.toStdString()) && elements->create (i, w.element.toStdString(), width, height);
    }

    for (auto it = elementViews.begin(); it != elementViews.end();)
    {
        if (shown.count (it->first) > 0)
        {
            ++it;
            continue;
        }

        if (it->second.created)
            elements->destroy (it->first);

        it = elementViews.erase (it);
    }

    refreshElements (true);
}

void PluginCanvas::refreshElements (bool all)
{
    if (elements == nullptr || elements->hasFailed())
    {
        checkElementsFailed();
        return;
    }

    for (auto& [index, view] : elementViews)
    {
        if (! view.created || ! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, (int) layout.widgets.size()))
            continue;

        if (! all && ! elements->needsPaint (index))
            continue;

        const auto& w = layout.widgets[(size_t) index];
        const auto before = view.popup;

        if (! elements->render (index))
            break;

        if (const auto* pixels = elements->pixels (index, false, view.width, view.height))
            copyPixels (view.image, pixels, view.width, view.height);
        else
            view.image = {};

        // The popup, kept inside the window where it fits.
        int px = 0, py = 0, pw = 0, ph = 0;

        if (! design && elements->popupArea (index, px, py, pw, ph))
        {
            view.popup = { juce::jlimit (0, juce::jmax (0, layout.width - pw), w.bounds.getX() + px),
                           juce::jlimit (0, juce::jmax (0, layout.height - ph), w.bounds.getY() + py), pw, ph };

            if (const auto* pixels = elements->pixels (index, true, pw, ph))
                copyPixels (view.popupImage, pixels, pw, ph);
            else
                view.popupImage = {};
        }
        else
        {
            view.popup = {};
            view.popupImage = {};
        }

        repaint (viewAreaOf (w));

        for (const auto& area : { before, view.popup })
            if (! area.isEmpty())
                repaint (toView (area).getSmallestIntegerContainer().expanded (2));
    }

    checkElementsFailed();
}

void PluginCanvas::drawElement (juce::Graphics& g, const GuiWidget& w, int index)
{
    const auto b = w.bounds.toFloat();
    const auto found = elementViews.find (index);

    if (found != elementViews.end() && found->second.created && found->second.image.isValid())
    {
        auto& view = found->second;

        // Being resized: drawn again at the new size.
        if (view.width != w.bounds.getWidth() || view.height != w.bounds.getHeight())
        {
            elements->resize (index, w.bounds.getWidth(), w.bounds.getHeight());
            view.width = w.bounds.getWidth();
            view.height = w.bounds.getHeight();

            if (elements->render (index))
                if (const auto* pixels = elements->pixels (index, false, view.width, view.height))
                    copyPixels (view.image, pixels, view.width, view.height);
        }

        g.setOpacity (1.0f);   // drawImage draws at the current colour's alpha
        g.drawImage (view.image, b);
        return;
    }

    if (baking)
        return;   // the exported plugin draws it itself

    // Not running (yet): a frame that says why.
    g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.3f));
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (b, 4.0f);
    g.setColour (Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.55f));
    const float dashes[] { 5.0f, 4.0f };

    for (const auto& edge : { juce::Line<float> (b.getTopLeft(), b.getTopRight()), juce::Line<float> (b.getTopRight(), b.getBottomRight()),
                              juce::Line<float> (b.getBottomRight(), b.getBottomLeft()), juce::Line<float> (b.getBottomLeft(), b.getTopLeft()) })
        g.drawDashedLine (edge, dashes, 2, 1.0f);

    const auto name = w.element.isNotEmpty() ? w.element : juce::String ("(no name)");
    juce::String why;

    if (elementsProblem.isNotEmpty())
        why = "Stopped: it crashed or got stuck";   // Sonify AI is told the details
    else if (elements == nullptr)
        why = "Shows after the next build";
    else
        why = "Not programmed yet (elements/" + name + ".cpp)";

    juce::Graphics::ScopedSaveState state (g);
    g.reduceClipRegion (w.bounds);
    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffd8d4ca));
    g.setFont (Theme::font (juce::jmin (12.5f, juce::jmax (9.0f, b.getHeight() * 0.3f)), true));
    g.drawFittedText (name + (b.getHeight() >= 34.0f ? "\n" : ": ") + why, b.reduced (6.0f, 2.0f).toNearestInt(),
                      juce::Justification::centred, b.getHeight() >= 34.0f ? 2 : 1, 0.7f);
}

void PluginCanvas::drawElementPopups (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    for (const auto& [index, view] : elementViews)
    {
        if (view.popup.isEmpty() || ! view.popupImage.isValid())
            continue;

        // A soft shadow under it, as menus have.
        juce::DropShadow (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.45f), 10, { 0, 3 }).drawForRectangle (g, view.popup);
        g.setOpacity (1.0f);   // drawImage draws at the current colour's alpha
        g.drawImage (view.popupImage, view.popup.toFloat());
    }
}

int PluginCanvas::popupAt (juce::Point<float> plugin) const
{
    // The topmost: the last in the layout.
    for (auto it = elementViews.rbegin(); it != elementViews.rend(); ++it)
        if (! it->second.popup.isEmpty() && it->second.popup.toFloat().contains (plugin))
            return it->first;

    return -1;
}

bool PluginCanvas::anyPopupOpen() const
{
    for (const auto& [index, view] : elementViews)
        if (! view.popup.isEmpty())
            return true;

    return false;
}

void PluginCanvas::closeElementPopups()
{
    if (elements == nullptr)
        return;

    for (auto& [index, view] : elementViews)
    {
        if (view.popup.isEmpty())
            continue;

        repaint (toView (view.popup).getSmallestIntegerContainer().expanded (12));
        elements->closePopup (index);
        view.popup = {};
        view.popupImage = {};
    }

    refreshElements (false);
}

bool PluginCanvas::elementMouse (int index, bool popup, int event, juce::Point<float> plugin, const juce::ModifierKeys& mods,
                                 bool doubleClick, float notches)
{
    if (elements == nullptr || ! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, (int) layout.widgets.size()))
        return false;

    const auto found = elementViews.find (index);

    if (found == elementViews.end() || ! found->second.created)
        return false;

    // Its own pixels: a turned element hears the mouse in its own frame (a popup isn't turned).
    const auto& w = layout.widgets[(size_t) index];
    const auto origin = popup ? found->second.popup.getPosition() : w.bounds.getPosition();
    const auto local = (popup ? plugin : intoWidget (w, plugin)) - origin.toFloat();
    const auto mouseFlags = (mods.isShiftDown() || mods.isCtrlDown() || mods.isCommandDown() ? 1 : 0) | (doubleClick ? 2 : 0);

    const auto taken = elements->mouse (index, popup, event, local.x, local.y, mouseFlags, notches);
    refreshElements (false);
    return taken;
}

void PluginCanvas::hoverElements (juce::Point<float> plugin, const juce::ModifierKeys& mods)
{
    if (elements == nullptr || design)
        return;

    int index = popupAt (plugin);
    bool popup = index >= 0;

    if (! popup)
    {
        const juce::Rectangle<float> window (0.0f, 0.0f, (float) layout.width, (float) layout.height);
        index = window.contains (plugin) ? widgetAt (plugin, true) : -1;

        if (index >= 0 && layout.widgets[(size_t) index].type != GuiWidget::Type::custom)
            index = -1;
    }

    if (index != hoveredElement || popup != hoveredPopup)
    {
        if (hoveredElement >= 0)
            elementMouse (hoveredElement, hoveredPopup, mouseExitEvent, plugin, mods);

        hoveredElement = index;
        hoveredPopup = popup;
    }

    if (index >= 0)
        elementMouse (index, popup, mouseMoveEvent, plugin, mods);
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PluginCanvas_Export.cpp
// The canvas baked for Export to plugin files (PluginExporter): each page's background, and what
// moves as strips of frames drawn the way the panel draws it, so the exported plugin's window
// looks as the panel does in Play.

#include "PluginCanvas.h"
#include "MeterPaint.h"
#include "PanelParts.h"

namespace
{
    constexpr int meterFrames = 48, lampFrames = 16, readoutFrames = 101, plainControlFrames = 64;

    /** A box turned about its middle: what it covers, in whole pixels. */
    juce::Rectangle<int> turnedArea (const GuiWidget& w, juce::Rectangle<int> box)
    {
        if (! w.isTurned() || box.isEmpty())
            return box;

        juce::Path outline;
        outline.addRectangle (box.toFloat());
        return outline.getBoundsTransformed (w.turn()).getSmallestIntegerContainer().expanded (1);
    }

    /** A level that a meter shows at a fraction of its height (MeterPaint::fractionOf, backwards). */
    float levelAt (float fraction, bool isDisplay)
    {
        return isDisplay ? fraction : std::pow (10.0f, (fraction * 66.0f - 60.0f) / 20.0f);
    }
}

PluginCanvas::ExportBake PluginCanvas::bakeForExport (const juce::StringArray& presetNames)
{
    // As it plays: nothing hovered or held, no Edit marks. What's changed here is put back after.
    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<int> noHover (hovered, -1), noActive (active, -1);
    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<bool> bakingNow (baking, true);
    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<int> pageNow (shownPage, shownPage);
    const auto savedPresets = presetMenu;
    const auto savedValues = values;
    const auto savedLevels = meterLevels;
    const auto savedNeedles = meterNeedles;
    const auto savedPeaks = meterPeaks;

    presetMenu = {};
    presetMenu.names = presetNames;

    ExportBake result;
    result.width = layout.width;
    result.height = layout.height;
    const juce::Rectangle<int> window (0, 0, layout.width, layout.height);
    const auto numPages = juce::jmax (1, layout.pages.size());

    // The page an element lies on (-1: every page), as GuiLayout::isOnPage has it.
    auto pageOf = [this] (const GuiWidget& w)
    {
        if (layout.pages.isEmpty() || w.page.isEmpty())
            return -1;

        return juce::jmax (0, layout.pages.indexOf (w.page));
    };

    auto sharePage = [&] (const GuiWidget& a, const GuiWidget& b)
    {
        const auto pa = pageOf (a), pb = pageOf (b);
        return pa < 0 || pb < 0 || pa == pb;
    };

    // What moves: in the plugin a readout's value and the page tabs move too.
    auto movingPart = [this] (const GuiWidget& w)
    {
        if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::tabs)
            return w.bounds;

        return movingAreaOf (w);
    };

    auto isStill = [] (const GuiWidget& w)
    {
        return (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::label && ! PanelParts::labelMoves (w)) || w.type == GuiWidget::Type::group
            || w.type == GuiWidget::Type::shape || (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::image && w.image.isNotEmpty());
    };

    // Still things lying over something that moves (a frame over a meter, glass over a knob, a
    // caption on that glass) stay in front of it: layers of their own, not in the background.
    std::vector<bool> layered (layout.widgets.size(), false);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& w = layout.widgets[i];

        for (size_t below = 0; isStill (w) && below < i && ! layered[i]; ++below)
        {
            const auto& under = layout.widgets[below];

            if (sharePage (w, under))
                layered[i] = movingPart (under).intersects (w.bounds) || (layered[below] && under.bounds.intersects (w.bounds));
        }
    }

    // Each page's background: the window, and everything still on that page.
    for (int p = 0; p < numPages; ++p)
    {
        shownPage = p;
        juce::Image page (juce::Image::ARGB, juce::jmax (1, layout.width), juce::jmax (1, layout.height), true);

        {
            juce::Graphics g (page);
            drawPanel (g);

            for (int i = 0; i < (int) layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
                if (! layered[(size_t) i])
                    drawWidget (g, i, Part::still);
        }

        result.pages.push_back (page);
    }

    // Frames: each drawn over its area, as drawWidget draws it there.
    auto addStrip = [&] (int index, juce::Rectangle<int> area, int frames, const std::function<void (int frame, juce::Graphics&)>& draw)
    {
        ExportBake::Strip strip;
        strip.frameWidth = area.getWidth();
        strip.frameHeight = area.getHeight();
        strip.frames = frames;
        strip.image = juce::Image (juce::Image::ARGB, area.getWidth(), area.getHeight() * frames, true);

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; ++f)
        {
            juce::Graphics g (strip.image);
            g.reduceClipRegion (0, f * area.getHeight(), area.getWidth(), area.getHeight());
            g.setOrigin ({ -area.getX(), f * area.getHeight() - area.getY() });
            draw (f, g);
        }

        juce::ignoreUnused (index);
        result.strips.push_back (strip);
        return (int) result.strips.size() - 1;
    };

    std::map<juce::String, int> lookStrips;   // upright controls with the same look and size share frames

    for (int i = 0; i < (int) layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& w = layout.widgets[(size_t) i];
        const auto page = pageOf (w);
        shownPage = juce::jmax (0, page);   // so it's drawn

        ExportBake::Item item;
        item.widget = i;
        item.page = page;
        item.angle = w.shownAngle();
        item.box = w.bounds;

        const auto moving = movingAreaOf (w);
        const auto drawn = turnedArea (w, moving).getIntersection (window);

        // A still layer in front of something that moves: one frame.
        if (layered[(size_t) i])
        {
            const auto area = turnedArea (w, w.bounds).getIntersection (window);

            if (area.isEmpty())
                continue;

            item.kind = "picture";
            item.area = area;
            item.angle = 0.0f;
            item.strip = addStrip (i, area, 1, [&] (int, juce::Graphics& g) { drawWidget (g, i, Part::still); });
            result.items.push_back (item);
            continue;
        }

        switch (w.type)
        {
            case GuiWidget::Type::knob:
            case GuiWidget::Type::slider:
            case GuiWidget::Type::toggle:
            {
                item.kind = w.type == GuiWidget::Type::knob ? "knob" : (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::slider ? "slider" : "toggle");

                // A slider's track is where it's played; knobs and switches anywhere on them.
                if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::slider)
                    item.box = moving;

                const bool withLook = Looks::takesLook (w) && looks != nullptr;
                auto kind = Looks::Kind();
                const Looks::Look* look = nullptr;
                int room = 0, frames = w.type == GuiWidget::Type::toggle ? 2 : plainControlFrames;

                if (withLook)
                {
                    looks->setLight (layout.lightAngle, layout.lightAltitude);   // lit by the panel's global light
                    kind = Looks::kindOf (w);
                    look = &looks->lookFor (w);
                    room = Looks::overhang (*look, moving.getWidth(), moving.getHeight());
                    frames = juce::jmax (1, Looks::framesFor (*look, kind));
                }

                // Upright and solid: the look's own frames, shared by the controls like it.
                if (withLook && ! w.isTurned() && w.shownOpacity() >= 0.999f && ! moving.isEmpty())
                {
                    item.area = moving.expanded (room);
                    const auto key = juce::String (look->revision) + "|" + Looks::kindName (kind) + "|"
                                   + juce::String (moving.getWidth()) + "x" + juce::String (moving.getHeight());

                    if (const auto found = lookStrips.find (key); found != lookStrips.end())
                    {
                        item.strip = found->second;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ExportBake::Strip strip;
                        strip.image = looks->strip (*look, kind, moving.getWidth(), moving.getHeight());
                        strip.frameWidth = moving.getWidth() + 2 * room;
                        strip.frameHeight = moving.getHeight() + 2 * room;
                        strip.frames = frames;
                        result.strips.push_back (strip);
                        item.strip = lookStrips[key] = (int) result.strips.size() - 1;
                    }

                    result.items.push_back (item);
                    break;
                }

                // Turned or faded: each frame drawn as it shows, turned and faded.
                item.area = turnedArea (w, moving.expanded (room)).getIntersection (window);

                if (item.area.isEmpty())
                    break;

                item.strip = addStrip (i, item.area, frames, [&] (int f, juce::Graphics& g)
                {
                    drawWidget (g, i, Part::moving, frames > 1 ? (float) f / (float) (frames - 1) : 0.0f);
                });

                result.items.push_back (item);
                break;
            }

            case GuiWidget::Type::selector:
            {
                const auto* p = paramFor (w);
                const auto count = juce::jmax (1, w.options.size() > 0 ? w.options.size() : (p != nullptr ? (int) (p->max - p->min) + 1 : 1));

                item.kind = "selector";
                item.count = count;
                item.box = moving;
                item.area = drawn;

                // How a click picks a position: across, down, or with arrows (PanelParts::selectorPick).
                const auto box = moving.toFloat();

                if (PanelParts::selectorDisplayOf (w) == "vfd")
                    item.mode = 2;
                else if (count > 1)
                    item.mode = PanelParts::selectorPick (w, box, count, 0, { box.getX() + 1.0f, box.getBottom() - 1.0f }) == count - 1 ? 1 : 0;

                if (item.area.isEmpty())
                    break;

                item.strip = addStrip (i, item.area, count, [&] (int f, juce::Graphics& g) { drawWidget (g, i, Part::moving, (float) f); });
                result.items.push_back (item);
                break;
            }

            case GuiWidget::Type::preset:
            {
                // One frame per preset, then one with none chosen.
                item.kind = "preset";
                item.count = presetNames.size();
                item.area = turnedArea (w, w.bounds).getIntersection (window);

                if (item.area.isEmpty())
                    break;

                item.strip = addStrip (i, item.area, presetNames.size() + 1, [&] (int f, juce::Graphics& g)
                {
                    drawWidget (g, i, Part::moving, f < presetNames.size() ? (float) f : -1.0f);
                });

                result.items.push_back (item);
                break;
            }

            case GuiWidget::Type::tabs:
            {
                // A frame per page, its own tab lit.
                item.kind = "tabs";
                item.count = numPages;
                item.area = turnedArea (w, w.bounds).getIntersection (window);

                if (item.area.isEmpty())
                    break;

                item.strip = addStrip (i, item.area, numPages, [&] (int f, juce::Graphics& g)
                {
                    shownPage = f;
                    drawWidget (g, i, Part::moving);
                    shownPage = juce::jmax (0, page);
                });

                result.items.push_back (item);
                break;
            }

            case GuiWidget::Type::meter:
            {
                // Its look at each level (a needle where the level puts it), the peak left out.
                const bool isDisplay = displaySources.contains (w.source);
                item.kind = "meter";
                item.mode = (w.mode == "rms" ? 1 : 0) | (MeterPaint::hasNeedle (MeterPaint::styleOf (w)) ? 2 : 0);
                item.area = drawn;

                if (item.area.isEmpty())
                    break;

                item.strip = addStrip (i, item.area, meterFrames, [&] (int f, juce::Graphics& g)
                {
                    const auto fraction = (float) f / (float) (meterFrames - 1);
                    meterLevels[i] = levelAt (fraction, isDisplay);
                    meterNeedles[i] = fraction;
                    meterPeaks.erase (i);
                    drawWidget (g, i, Part::moving);
                });

                result.items.push_back (item);
                break;
            }

            case GuiWidget::Type::lamp:
            {
                // Off and on; or, following the level, lit by steps.
                const auto follows = PanelParts::lampFollows (w);
                const auto frames = follows ? lampFrames : 2;
                item.kind = "lamp";
                item.mode = follows ? 1 : 0;
                item.area = drawn;

                if (item.area.isEmpty())
                    break;

                item.strip = addStrip (i, item.area, frames, [&] (int f, juce::Graphics& g)
                {
                    drawWidget (g, i, Part::moving, (float) f / (float) (frames - 1));
                });

                result.items.push_back (item);
                break;
            }

            case GuiWidget::Type::label:
            {
                // A readout: its value at each step of its parameter (words alone are still).
                const auto* p = paramFor (w);

                if (! PanelParts::labelMoves (w) || p == nullptr)
                    break;

                item.kind = "readout";
                item.area = turnedArea (w, w.bounds).getIntersection (window);

                if (item.area.isEmpty())
                    break;

                item.strip = addStrip (i, item.area, readoutFrames, [&] (int f, juce::Graphics& g)
                {
                    values[p->index] = valueAt (*p, (float) f / (float) (readoutFrames - 1));
                    drawWidget (g, i, Part::moving);
                });

                result.items.push_back (item);
                break;
            }

            // Drawn live by the plugin, upright.
            case GuiWidget::Type::scope:
            case GuiWidget::Type::envelope:
            case GuiWidget::Type::filter:
            case GuiWidget::Type::xy:
            case GuiWidget::Type::keyboard:
            case GuiWidget::Type::custom:
            {
                item.kind = w.type == GuiWidget::Type::scope ? "scope"
                          : w.type == GuiWidget::Type::envelope ? "envelope"
                          : w.type == GuiWidget::Type::filter ? "filter"
                          : w.type == GuiWidget::Type::xy ? "xy"
                          : w.type == GuiWidget::Type::keyboard ? "keyboard" : "custom";
                item.area = moving;
                item.box = moving;
                item.angle = 0.0f;

                if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::keyboard)
                {
                    item.count = w.highNote;
                    item.mode = w.lowNote;
                }
                else if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::filter)
                {
                    item.mode = juce::jmax (0, juce::StringArray { "lowpass", "lowpass24", "highpass", "highpass24", "bandpass" }.indexOf (w.mode));
                }

                if (! item.area.isEmpty())
                    result.items.push_back (item);

                break;
            }

            // In the background (or a layer of their own, above); the registration badge isn't
            // in exports (they're never protected).
            case GuiWidget::Type::group:
            case GuiWidget::Type::shape:
            case GuiWidget::Type::image:
            case GuiWidget::Type::registration:
                break;
        }
    }

    presetMenu = savedPresets;
    values = savedValues;
    meterLevels = savedLevels;
    meterNeedles = savedNeedles;
    meterPeaks = savedPeaks;
    return result;
}

// The canvas's edit menu (an element's, several elements', or the window's: the one menu a

    const juce::StringArray meterModes { "peak", "rms" };

    constexpr int numTypes = (int) (sizeof (typeOrder) / sizeof (typeOrder[0]));

    constexpr int headerHeight = 46, actionsHeight = 40, pad = 12;
    const juce::Colour askYellow { 0xffffcc00 };   // as in the chat: what the user should answer or do

    /** Whether its colour is the menu's to set (knobs, sliders and switches wear looks). */
    bool takesColour (const GuiWidget& w)
    {
        return ! Looks::takesLook (w) && w.type != GuiWidget::Type::image && w.type != GuiWidget::Type::meter;
    }

    /** Whether it has text the menu's font is for: captions, labels, titles, buttons, the
        preset manager, a programmed element's own text. */
    bool takesFont (const GuiWidget& w)
    {
        return w.type != GuiWidget::Type::image && w.type != GuiWidget::Type::shape && w.type != GuiWidget::Type::keyboard
            && w.type != GuiWidget::Type::registration;

    juce::String pictureChoice (const juce::String& name)

    }

    using namespace MaterialChoices;   // the materials, finishes, patterns and blends the menu offers

    juce::String hexOf (juce::Colour c)    { return "#" + c.toDisplayString (true); }

    /** A slider on a line of its own: its value in a box at its right, typed in or dragged. */
    void setUpSlider (juce::Slider& s, double low, double high, double step, double middle, const juce::String& tip,
                      const juce::String& suffix = {})
    {
        s.setSliderStyle (juce::Slider::LinearHorizontal);
        s.setTextBoxStyle (juce::Slider::TextBoxRight, false, 56, 20);
        s.setRange (low, high, step);
        s.setTextValueSuffix (suffix);

        if (middle > low && middle < high)
            s.setSkewFactorFromMidPoint (middle);

        s.setTooltip (tip);

        // Its whole track shows, the part up to its value in green.
        s.setColour (juce::Slider::backgroundColourId, Theme::outline.brighter (0.45f));
        s.setColour (juce::Slider::trackColourId, Theme::accent);
        s.setColour (juce::Slider::thumbColourId, Theme::text);
    }

    constexpr int tabsHeight = 34;

    // The Type list's shapes, after the other types: their ids, kinds and names.
    constexpr int shapeIds = 100;
    const juce::StringArray shapeKindIds { "rectangle", "circle", "triangle", "star", "line", "drawn" };
    const juce::StringArray shapeKindNames { "Rectangle", "Circle", "Triangle", "Star", "Line", "Drawn shape" };

    /** A new shape's box: a star about as tall as it's wide, the rest as they look best. */
    juce::Rectangle<int> shapeBox (const juce::String& kind, int x, int y)
    {
        if (kind == "rectangle") return { x, y, 120, 72 };
        if (kind == "triangle")  return { x, y, 80, 70 };
        if (kind == "star")      return { x, y, 64, 61 };
        if (kind == "line")      return { x, y, 160, 32 };
        return { x, y, 80, 80 };
    }

    // A label's arrowheads, and a line's.
    const juce::StringArray arrowIds { "none", "left", "right", "both", "up", "down" };
    const juce::StringArray arrowNames { "None", "On the left", "On the right", "Both sides", "Pointing up", "Pointing down" };
    const juce::StringArray lineArrowIds { "none", "start", "end", "both" };
    const juce::StringArray lineArrowNames { "None", "At its start", "At its end", "At both ends" };
    const juce::StringArray lineCapIds { "round", "flat", "square" };
    const juce::StringArray lineCapNames { "Round", "Flat", "Square" };

    /** A number for a box: no trailing zeros. */
    juce::String shortNumber (double v, int decimals)
    {
        auto text = juce::String (v, decimals);
        return text.containsChar ('.') ? text.trimCharactersAtEnd ("0").trimCharactersAtEnd (".") : text;
    }

    // A keyboard's lowest and highest key: the white keys from A0 to C8, the piano's range.
    constexpr int lowestPianoKey = 21, highestPianoKey = 108;

    void fillKeys (juce::ComboBox& box, int selected)
    {
        box.clear (juce::dontSendNotification);

        for (int note = lowestPianoKey; note <= highestPianoKey; ++note)
            if (! stella::keys::isBlack (note))
                box.addItem (GuiLayout::noteName (note) + (note == 60 ? "  (middle C)" : ""), note + 1);

        box.setSelectedId (selected + 1, juce::dontSendNotification);
    }

//==============================================================================
bool PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::Rows::isShowing (size_t index, const juce::String& inTab) const
{
    const auto& row = rows[index];

    if (row.tab != inTab)
        return false;

    if (! row.header)
        return row.shown;

    // A group's title: while a row of its group shows.
    for (auto i = index + 1; i < rows.size() && ! rows[i].header; ++i)
        if (rows[i].tab == inTab && rows[i].shown)
            return true;

    return false;
}

namespace
{
    constexpr int rowCaption = 18, rowGap = 8, headerRow = 30;
}

int PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::Rows::measure (const juce::String& inTab) const
{
    int y = 2;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (! isShowing (i, inTab))
            continue;

        const auto& row = rows[i];
        y += row.header ? headerRow : (row.caption.isNotEmpty() ? rowCaption : 0) + row.height + rowGap;
    }

    return y + 4;
}

int PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::Rows::layOut (int width)
{
    int y = 2;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i)
    {
        auto& row = rows[i];
        const bool showing = isShowing (i, tab);
        row.laidOut = showing;

        if (! row.header)
        {
            row.first->setVisible (showing);

            if (row.second != nullptr)
                row.second->setVisible (showing);
        }

        if (! showing)
            continue;

        if (row.header)
        {
            row.top = y;
            y += headerRow;
            continue;
        }

        if (row.caption.isNotEmpty())
            y += rowCaption;

        row.top = y;

        // A colour swatch sits inside its frame (painted around it).
        auto place = [] (juce::Component& c, juce::Rectangle<int> box)
        {
            c.setBounds (dynamic_cast<ColourSwatchButton*> (&c) != nullptr ? box.reduced (2, 0) : box);
        };

        if (row.second != nullptr)
        {
            const auto firstWidth = juce::roundToInt ((float) (width - 8) * row.firstShare);
            place (*row.first, { 0, y, firstWidth, row.height });
            place (*row.second, { firstWidth + 8, y, width - firstWidth - 8, row.height });
        }
        else
        {
            place (*row.first, { 0, y, juce::roundToInt ((float) width * row.firstShare), row.height });
        }

        y += row.height + rowGap;
    }

    y += 4;
    setSize (width, y);
    return y;
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::Rows::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    for (const auto& row : rows)
    {
        if (! row.laidOut)
            continue;

        if (row.header)
        {
            // A group: its name, and a line across under it.
            const auto lineY = row.top + headerRow - 7;
            g.setColour (Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.9f));
            g.setFont (Theme::font (11.5f, true));
            g.drawText (row.caption.toUpperCase(), 0, row.top + 4, getWidth(), 16, juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);
            g.setColour (Theme::outline.brighter (0.25f));
            g.fillRect (0, lineY, getWidth(), 1);
            continue;
        }

        if (row.caption.isNotEmpty())
        {
            g.setColour (Theme::muted);
            g.setFont (Theme::font (12.5f));
            g.drawText (row.caption, 0, row.top - rowCaption, getWidth(), 16, juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);
        }

        // Colour swatches get a frame, so dark colours still show where they are.
        for (auto* c : { row.first, row.second })
        {
            if (dynamic_cast<ColourSwatchButton*> (c) != nullptr)
            {
                g.setColour (Theme::outline.brighter (0.35f));
                g.drawRoundedRectangle (c->getBounds().toFloat().expanded (1.5f), 4.0f, 1.0f);
            }
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
std::vector<juce::Rectangle<float>> PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::TabStrip::cells() const
{
    // Each as wide as its name needs, spread over the strip.
    std::vector<juce::Rectangle<float>> result;
    const auto font = Theme::font (12.5f, true);
    std::vector<float> widths;
    float total = 0.0f;

    for (const auto& name : names)
    {
        widths.push_back ((float) juce::GlyphArrangement::getStringWidthInt (font, name) + 16.0f);
        total += widths.back();
    }

    const auto gap = 3.0f;
    const auto room = (float) getWidth() - gap * (float) juce::jmax (0, names.size() - 1);
    const auto scale = total > 0.0f ? room / total : 1.0f;
    float x = 0.0f;

    for (const auto w : widths)
    {
        result.push_back ({ x, 4.0f, w * scale, (float) getHeight() - 8.0f });
        x += w * scale + gap;
    }

    return result;
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::TabStrip::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    const auto boxes = cells();

    for (int i = 0; i < names.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto box = boxes[(size_t) i];
        const bool on = names[i] == current;

        g.setColour (on ? Theme::accentDeep : Theme::raised);
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (box, 5.0f);
        g.setColour (on ? Theme::accent : Theme::outline.brighter (0.2f));
        g.drawRoundedRectangle (box.reduced (0.5f), 5.0f, 1.0f);
        g.setColour (on ? Theme::text : Theme::muted.brighter (0.2f));
        g.setFont (Theme::font (12.5f, true));
        g.drawFittedText (names[i], box.toNearestInt(), juce::Justification::centred, 1, 0.8f);
    }
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::TabStrip::mouseDown (const juce::MouseEvent& e)
{
    const auto boxes = cells();

    for (int i = 0; i < names.size(); ++i)
        if (boxes[(size_t) i].contains (e.position) && onPick != nullptr)
            onPick (names[i]);
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::FontSample::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    const auto box = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
    g.setColour (Theme::inset);
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (box, 5.0f);
    g.setColour (Theme::text);
    g.setFont (FontLibrary::font (family, 22.0f));
    g.drawFittedText (text, getLocalBounds().reduced (10, 2), juce::Justification::centredLeft, 1, 0.7f);
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::SendButton::paintButton (juce::Graphics& g, bool highlighted, bool down)
{
    const auto bounds = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
    const auto size = juce::jmin (bounds.getWidth(), bounds.getHeight());
    const auto circle = juce::Rectangle<float> (size, size).withCentre (bounds.getCentre()).reduced (1.0f);
    const auto centre = circle.getCentre();

    g.setColour (down ? Theme::accent.darker (0.2f) : (highlighted ? Theme::accent.brighter (0.15f) : Theme::accent));
    g.fillEllipse (circle);

    // An arrow pointing up, as in the chat.
    juce::Path arrow;
    const auto a = size * 0.22f;
    arrow.startNewSubPath (centre.x, centre.y + a);
    arrow.lineTo (centre.x, centre.y - a);
    arrow.startNewSubPath (centre.x - a * 0.8f, centre.y - a * 0.2f);
    arrow.lineTo (centre.x, centre.y - a);
    arrow.lineTo (centre.x + a * 0.8f, centre.y - a * 0.2f);
    g.setColour (juce::Colours::white);
    g.strokePath (arrow, juce::PathStrokeType (2.0f, juce::PathStrokeType::curved, juce::PathStrokeType::rounded));
}

//==============================================================================
PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::ElementMenu (PluginCanvas& owner)
    : canvas (owner)
{
    closeButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xc3\x97"));
    closeButton.setTooltip ("Close (Esc)");
    closeButton.onClick = [this] { canvas.select (-1); };
    addAndMakeVisible (closeButton);

    pictureMode.addItemList (GuiLayout::pictureModeNames(), 1);

    for (auto* box : { &type, &source, &mode, &style, &pictureMode, &lowKey, &highKey })
        box->onChange = [this] { apply(); };

    for (auto* editor : { &label, &options, &textSize, &widthBox, &heightBox, &param, &roles[0], &roles[1], &roles[2], &roles[3] })
    {
        editor->setFont (Theme::font (14.0f));
        editor->setIndents (6, 4);
    }

    // Parameters are typed in, an id (or a name): they're used on Enter, or on leaving the box.
    for (auto* editor : { &param, &roles[0], &roles[1], &roles[2], &roles[3] })
    {
        editor->setTextToShowWhenEmpty ("none: type a parameter id", Theme::muted);
        editor->setTooltip ("The parameter it works: its id (or name). A new id is a parameter for Fanan AI to add to the plugin");
        editor->onReturnKey = [this] { apply(); };
        editor->onFocusLost = [this] { apply(); };
    }

    // What it does, under the title.
    copyButton.setTooltip ("Copy (Ctrl+C): a frame takes what's inside it along");
    pasteButton.setTooltip ("Paste (Ctrl+V)");
    duplicateButton.setTooltip ("Duplicate (Ctrl+D)");
    layerBox.setTooltip ("Bring to front or forward, send backward or to the back (Ctrl+Shift+], Ctrl+], Ctrl+[, Ctrl+Shift+[)");

    copyButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        canvas.copyElements (targets());
        pasteButton.setEnabled (true);
    };

    pasteButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        // The first paste lands where the menu was opened, the next ones a step further each.
        const auto at = canvas.pastePoint;
        canvas.pastePoint.reset();
        canvas.pasteElements (at);
    };

    duplicateButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        canvas.copyElements (targets());
        canvas.pasteElements ({});
    };

    layerBox.onChange = [this]
    {
        const auto choice = layerBox.getSelectedId();
        layerBox.setText ("Layer", juce::dontSendNotification);   // it stays "Layer"
        layer (choice);
    };

    addChildComponent (copyButton);
    addChildComponent (pasteButton);
    addChildComponent (duplicateButton);
    addChildComponent (layerBox);

    label.onTextChange = [this] { apply(); };
    options.onTextChange = [this] { apply(); };
    options.setTextToShowWhenEmpty ("Saw, Square, Triangle", Theme::muted);

    textSize.setInputRestrictions (4, "0123456789.");
    textSize.setTextToShowWhenEmpty ("auto", Theme::muted);
    textSize.onReturnKey = [this] { apply(); };
    textSize.onFocusLost = [this] { apply(); };
    boldToggle.onClick = [this] { apply(); };

    colour.setTooltip ("Its colour (see-through: the standard one)");
    colour.onColourChange = [this] { apply(); };

    for (auto* box : { &widthBox, &heightBox })
    {
        box->setInputRestrictions (4, "0123456789");
        box->onReturnKey = [this] { applyWindow(); showFor (-1); };
        box->onFocusLost = [this] { applyWindow(); };
    }

    topColour.onColourChange = [this] { applyWindow(); };
    bottomColour.onColourChange = [this] { applyWindow(); };

    pictureButton.setTooltip ("Choose the picture it shows (PNG, JPEG or GIF): it's copied into the project");
    pictureButton.onClick = [this] { canvas.choosePicture (widget); };

    paintBackgroundButton.setTooltip ("A background painted in code and lit like the knobs: then choose its material (metals, stone, "
                                      "wood, plastics...), colours, finish and a pattern in its menu");
    paintBackgroundButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Paint a lit background (materials, patterns)\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    paintBackgroundButton.onClick = [this] { canvas.paintNewBackground(); };

    // A painted background's surface (and a shape's).
    {
        fillMaterials (false);

        for (size_t i = 0; i < finishChoices().size(); ++i)   surfaceFinish.addItem (finishChoices()[i].label, (int) i + 1);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < patternChoices().size(); ++i)  patternBox.addItem (patternChoices()[i].label, (int) i + 1);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < blendChoices().size(); ++i)    blendBox.addItem (blendChoices()[i].label, (int) i + 1);

        surfaceMaterial.onChange = [this] { applySurface (true); };

        for (auto* box : { &surfaceFinish, &patternBox, &blendBox })
            box->onChange = [this] { applySurface (false); };

        for (auto* swatch : { &surfaceColour, &surfaceColour2, &patternColour })
            swatch->onColourChange = [this] { applySurface (false); };

        surfaceColour.setTooltip ("Its main colour");
        surfaceColour2.setTooltip ("Its second colour: marble's veins, granite's flecks, wood's dark grain, a two-tone shade away from the light");
        patternColour.setTooltip ("The pattern's colour (see-through: black or white, as its blend suits)");

        setUpSlider (textureSize, 0.25, 4.0, 0.01, 1.0, "How big the material's texture is");
        setUpSlider (textureStrength, 0.0, 2.0, 0.01, 1.0, "How strong the material's texture is");
        setUpSlider (patternOpacity, 0.0, 1.0, 0.01, 0.0, "How strong the pattern is");
        setUpSlider (patternSize, 4.0, 200.0, 1.0, 24.0, "The pattern's size, in pixels", " px");
        setUpSlider (patternAngle, -180.0, 180.0, 1.0, 0.0, "The pattern's angle, in degrees", juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xc2\xb0"));
        setUpSlider (keyLight, 0.0, 1.0, 0.01, 0.0, "How strong the key light's pool is (the light itself is the panel's global light)");

        for (auto* slider : { &textureSize, &textureStrength, &patternOpacity, &patternSize, &patternAngle, &keyLight })
            slider->onValueChange = [this] { applySurface (false); };
    }

    // Pages: the element's page, and the window's list of them.
    pageBox.setTooltip ("The page it lies on (Every page: it shows whichever page is shown)");
    pageBox.onChange = [this] { apply(); };

    pagesBox.setFont (Theme::font (14.0f));
    pagesBox.setIndents (6, 4);
    pagesBox.setTextToShowWhenEmpty ("One page: type names (Main, Effects...) to make pages", Theme::muted);
    pagesBox.setTooltip ("The window's pages in order, comma separated: rename one by changing its name, take it out to delete it "
                         "(its elements go to the page before). The page tabs show them; above the window, a click on a page's name shows it");
    pagesBox.onReturnKey = [this] { canvas.setPages (juce::StringArray::fromTokens (pagesBox.getText(), ",", "")); showFor (-1); };
    pagesBox.onFocusLost = [this] { if (widget < 0 && several.empty()) canvas.setPages (juce::StringArray::fromTokens (pagesBox.getText(), ",", "")); };

    // Every element: where it lies, how big, turned and see-through.
    for (auto* box : { &xBox, &yBox, &wBox, &hBox, &angleBox })
    {
        box->setFont (Theme::font (14.0f));
        box->setIndents (6, 4);
        box->setInputRestrictions (7, "-0123456789.");
        box->onReturnKey = [this] { applyObject(); };
        box->onFocusLost = [this] { applyObject(); };
    }

    xBox.setTooltip ("Its left edge, in the window's pixels");
    yBox.setTooltip ("Its top edge, in the window's pixels");
    wBox.setTooltip ("Its width, in pixels");
    hBox.setTooltip ("Its height, in pixels");
    angleBox.setTooltip ("Its angle in degrees, clockwise (or drag the round handle above it; Shift: steps of 15)");

    setUpSlider (opacitySlider, 0.0, 100.0, 1.0, 0.0, "How solid it is: 100 solid, 0 invisible (in Edit a dashed frame still shows where it is)", " %");
    opacitySlider.onValueChange = [this] { applyObject(); };

    // A shape's geometry; its layer style in a window of its own.
    setUpSlider (cornerRadius, 0.0, 100.0, 1.0, 0.0, "How round its corners are: 0 sharp, 100 as round as they go (a rectangle "
                                                    "becomes a pill; a rectangle's yellow handle drags it too)", " %");
    setUpSlider (starPoints, 3.0, 24.0, 1.0, 0.0, "How many points the star has");
    setUpSlider (starInner, 0.05, 1.0, 0.01, 0.0, "How far in its points' roots lie: small for sharp points, 1 for a polygon");
    setUpSlider (topPoint, -0.95, 0.95, 0.01, 0.0, "Where its top point lies, left to right (or drag its yellow handle)");
    setUpSlider (middleX, -0.95, 0.95, 0.01, 0.0, "Its middle moved sideways: lopsided, longer on one side (or drag its yellow handle)");
    setUpSlider (middleY, -0.95, 0.95, 0.01, 0.0, "Its middle moved up or down: lopsided, longer on one side (or drag its yellow handle)");
    setUpSlider (leanX, -1.0, 1.0, 0.01, 0.0, "Leant sideways: its top one way, its bottom the other");
    setUpSlider (leanY, -1.0, 1.0, 0.01, 0.0, "Leant up or down: its right side one way, its left the other");

    for (auto* slider : { &cornerRadius, &starPoints, &starInner, &topPoint, &middleX, &middleY, &leanX, &leanY })
        slider->onValueChange = [this] { applyShape(); };

    for (auto* slider : { &topPoint, &middleX, &middleY, &leanX, &leanY })
        slider->setDoubleClickReturnValue (true, 0.0);

    layerStyleButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Layer style (fx)\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    layerStyleButton.setTooltip ("Photoshop's Layer Style: Bevel & Emboss with its Contour, Stroke, Inner Shadow, Color Overlay "
                                 "and Drop Shadow, with their blend modes (or double-click the shape)");
    layerStyleButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        if (widget >= 0)
            canvas.editLayerStyle (widget);
    };

    globalLightButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Global light\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    globalLightButton.setTooltip ("Where the panel's one light comes from: the knobs' looks, the shapes and painted backgrounds "
                                  "are all lit from it (Photoshop's Global Light)");
    globalLightButton.onClick = [this] { canvas.editGlobalLight(); };

    backgroundButton.setTooltip ("A picture behind everything, filling the window (it's copied into the project). "
                                 "Drag its corners and sides to stretch it; right-click it to change its layer");
    backgroundButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Add a background picture\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    backgroundButton.onClick = [this] { canvas.choosePicture (-1); };

    knobStudioButton.setTooltip ("Open its look in the Knob Studio: layers, bevels, textures, the KnobMan gallery");
    knobStudioButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        if (widget >= 0 && canvas.onEditLook != nullptr)
            canvas.onEditLook (widget, similarToggle.getToggleState());
    };

    similarToggle.setTooltip ("Design every control like this one at once (the same kind, wearing the same look). "
                              "Unticked, only this one changes");

    // Delete, in the header beside the close button: on every tab.
    removeButton.setTooltip ("Delete it from the window (Delete key)");
    removeButton.onClick = [this] { canvas.removeSelected(); };
    removeButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, juce::Colour (0xff5c1f24));
    removeButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId, juce::Colours::white);
    addChildComponent (removeButton);

    // The look it had before others were tried, and a built-in look as it came.
    originalLookButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (widget, (int) canvas.layout.widgets.size()))
            return;

        auto& w = canvas.layout.widgets[(size_t) widget];
        w.style = w.originalStyle;
        w.originalKnown = false;
        w.originalStyle.clear();
        canvas.edited();
        showFor (widget);
    };

    restoreLookButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (widget, (int) canvas.layout.widgets.size()) || canvas.looks == nullptr)
            return;

        const auto name = canvas.looks->lookFor (canvas.layout.widgets[(size_t) widget]).name;
        canvas.looks->removeProjectLook (name);
        canvas.repaint();
        showFor (widget);
    };

    // A level meter's display, colours and details.
    for (int i = 0; i < MeterPaint::displays().size(); ++i)
        meterDisplay.addItem (MeterPaint::displayNames()[i], i + 1);

    meterDisplay.setTooltip ("How it shows the level: a bar, LEDs, a neon tube, a glass tube, an analog VU needle or a ring");
    meterDisplay.onChange = [this] { applyMeter(); };

    for (auto* swatch : { &meterLow, &meterMid, &meterHigh, &meterBack })
        swatch->onColourChange = [this] { applyMeter(); };

    meterLow.setTooltip ("Its colour at low levels (see-through: the standard one)");
    meterMid.setTooltip ("Its colour from -12 dB (see-through: the standard one)");
    meterHigh.setTooltip ("Its colour from -3 dB, near clipping: a VU's red zone and peak lamp too (see-through: the standard one)");
    meterBack.setTooltip ("Its background: a VU's face, a ring's disc (see-through: the standard one)");

    setUpSlider (meterSegments, 0.0, 48.0, 1.0, 0.0, "How many LEDs (0: as many as fit)");
    setUpSlider (meterGlow, 0.0, 100.0, 1.0, 0.0, "How much its light blooms", " %");

    for (auto* slider : { &meterSegments, &meterGlow })
        slider->onValueChange = [this] { applyMeter(); };

    meterPeakToggle.setTooltip ("A mark stays at the highest level for a moment, then falls");
    meterScaleToggle.setTooltip ("Its dB marks (a display's: quarters)");

    for (auto* toggle : { &meterPeakToggle, &meterScaleToggle })
        toggle->onClick = [this] { applyMeter(); };

    // A lamp's, selector's, keyboard's or label's display (its list is filled for its kind).
    partDisplay.setTooltip ("How it looks: a lamp as a domed LED, a jewel, a glowing tube...; a selector as a sliding pill, console keys, "
                            "lamps or a glowing display; a keyboard in reverse colours or modern slate; a label as a value readout, "
                            "a glowing display or a backlit LCD");
    partDisplay.onChange = [this] { applyPart(); };
    followToggle.setTooltip ("Its light follows the level, brighter as it rises (otherwise it's on from its threshold)");
    followToggle.onClick = [this] { applyPart(); };
    arrowsBox.addItemList (arrowNames, 1);
    arrowsBox.setTooltip ("Small arrowheads beside its words");
    arrowsBox.onChange = [this] { applyPart(); };

    // A line's stroke.
    setUpSlider (lineWidthSlider, 0.5, 40.0, 0.5, 6.0, "How wide the line is, in pixels", " px");
    lineWidthSlider.onValueChange = [this] { applyShape(); };
    lineArrowBox.addItemList (lineArrowNames, 1);
    lineArrowBox.setTooltip ("Arrowheads at its ends");
    lineArrowBox.onChange = [this] { applyShape(); };
    lineCapBox.addItemList (lineCapNames, 1);
    lineCapBox.setTooltip ("How its ends finish where there's no arrowhead");
    lineCapBox.onChange = [this] { applyShape(); };
    straightenButton.setTooltip ("Its bend point back on the straight way between its ends (or double-click the bend point). "
                                 "Drag the line to bow it, drag its ends to move them, right-drag it to move it all");
    straightenButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        if (! canvas.isLine (widget))
            return;

        ObjectPaint::straighten (canvas.layout.widgets[(size_t) widget]);
        canvas.edited();
        canvas.repaint();
        showFor (widget);
    };

    windowButton.setTooltip ("The window's own menu: its size, colours and background picture");
    windowButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        canvas.selectPanel();
        canvas.openMenu();
    };

    // Its text's font: the standard one, or one of the fonts built in, by group.
    fontBox.addItem ("Standard", 1);

    for (const auto& group : FontLibrary::groups())
    {
        fontBox.addSectionHeading (group);

        for (int i = 0; i < (int) FontLibrary::families().size(); ++i)
            if (FontLibrary::families()[(size_t) i].group == group)
                fontBox.addItem (FontLibrary::families()[(size_t) i].name, i + 2);
    }

    fontBox.setTooltip ("Its text's font: built into Sonify, so the panel looks the same on every computer");
    fontBox.onChange = [this] { apply(); };

    setUpSlider (presetRounding, 0.0, 100.0, 1.0, 0.0, "How round its corners are: 0 square, 100 round ends", " %");
    presetRounding.onValueChange = [this] { apply(); };

    for (auto* button : { &windowLightButton, &shapeLightButton })
    {
        button->setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Global light\xe2\x80\xa6"));
        button->setTooltip (globalLightButton.getTooltip());
        button->onClick = [this] { canvas.editGlobalLight(); };
    }

    fontSample.setInterceptsMouseClicks (false, false);

    cropToolButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Crop the window (C)\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    cropToolButton.setTooltip ("Photoshop's Crop tool: a box over the window, its sides and corners dragged in or out, then Enter");
    cropToolButton.onClick = [this]
    {
        auto& c = canvas;   // the menu closes as the tool starts
        c.select (-1);
        c.startCrop();
    };

    tabStrip.onPick = [this] (const juce::String& name) { pickTab (name); };
    addChildComponent (tabStrip);

    // An element's rows, tab by tab, in the order they show...
    const juce::String object ("Object"), control ("Control"), text ("Text"), look ("Look"), shape ("Shape"), surface ("Surface"),
                       window ("Window"), background ("Background");

    addHeader (object, "Kind");
    addRow (object, "Type", type);
    addHeader (object, "Place");
    addRow (object, "Position (left, top)", xBox, &yBox, 0.5f);
    addRow (object, "Size (width, height)", wBox, &hBox, 0.5f);
    addHeader (object, "Turn and see-through");
    addRow (object, "Angle (degrees)", angleBox, nullptr, 0.4f);
    addRow (object, "Opacity", opacitySlider, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addHeader (object, "Page");
    addRow (object, "Page", pageBox);
    addHeader (object, "Window");
    addRow (object, {}, windowButton, nullptr, 1.0f, 28);

    addHeader (control, "Parameters");
    addRow (control, "Parameter", param);
    addRow (control, "Watches", source);

    for (auto& box : roles)
        addRow (control, "Role", box);

    addRow (control, "Mode", mode);
    addHeader (control, "Choices");
    addRow (control, "Positions (comma separated)", options);
    addRow (control, "Keys (lowest, highest)", lowKey, &highKey, 0.5f);

    const juce::String meter ("Meter");
    addHeader (meter, "Display");
    addRow (meter, "Display", meterDisplay);
    addHeader (meter, "Colours");
    addRow (meter, "Low", meterLow, nullptr, 1.0f, 22);
    addRow (meter, "Middle (from -12 dB)", meterMid, nullptr, 1.0f, 22);
    addRow (meter, "Top (from -3 dB)", meterHigh, nullptr, 1.0f, 22);
    addRow (meter, "Background", meterBack, nullptr, 1.0f, 22);
    addHeader (meter, "Details");
    addRow (meter, "LEDs", meterSegments, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (meter, "Glow", meterGlow, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (meter, {}, meterPeakToggle, &meterScaleToggle, 0.5f, 24);

    addHeader (text, "Words");
    addRow (text, "Text", label);
    addRow (text, "Text size, bold", textSize, &boldToggle, 0.4f);
    addHeader (text, "Font");
    addRow (text, "Font", fontBox);
    addRow (text, {}, fontSample, nullptr, 1.0f, 40);

    addHeader (look, "Display");
    addRow (look, "Display", partDisplay);
    addRow (look, {}, followToggle, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (look, "Arrowheads", arrowsBox);
    addHeader (look, "Look");
    addRow (look, "Look", style);
    addRow (look, {}, knobStudioButton, &similarToggle, 0.64f, 28);
    addRow (look, {}, originalLookButton, nullptr, 1.0f, 28);
    addRow (look, {}, restoreLookButton, nullptr, 1.0f, 28);
    addHeader (look, "Picture");
    addRow (look, "Picture", pictureButton);
    addRow (look, "Picture fit", pictureMode);
    addHeader (look, "Colour");
    addRow (look, "Colour", colour, nullptr, 1.0f, 22);
    addHeader (look, "Corners");
    addRow (look, "Rounding", presetRounding, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addHeader (look, "Light");
    addRow (look, {}, globalLightButton, nullptr, 1.0f, 28);   // what's lit: looks, painted pictures

    addHeader (shape, "Line");
    addRow (shape, "Width", lineWidthSlider, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (shape, "Arrowheads", lineArrowBox);
    addRow (shape, "Ends", lineCapBox);
    addRow (shape, {}, straightenButton, nullptr, 1.0f, 28);
    addHeader (shape, "Corners");
    addRow (shape, "Rounding", cornerRadius, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addHeader (shape, "Star");
    addRow (shape, "Points", starPoints, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (shape, "Inner size", starInner, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addHeader (shape, "Form");
    addRow (shape, "Top point (left to right)", topPoint, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (shape, "Middle (sideways)", middleX, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (shape, "Middle (up and down)", middleY, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (shape, "Lean (sideways)", leanX, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (shape, "Lean (up and down)", leanY, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addHeader (shape, "Effects and light");
    addRow (shape, {}, layerStyleButton, &shapeLightButton, 0.5f, 28);

    // A shape's surface, a painted picture's (and the window's painted background's, in its
    // Background tab).
    addHeader (surface, "Material");
    addRow (surface, "Material", surfaceMaterial);
    addRow (surface, "Finish", surfaceFinish);
    addRow (surface, "Colours (main, second)", surfaceColour, &surfaceColour2, 0.5f, 22);
    addHeader (surface, "Texture");
    addRow (surface, "Texture size", textureSize, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (surface, "Texture strength", textureStrength, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addHeader (surface, "Light");
    addRow (surface, "Key light", keyLight, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);

    // Its pattern layer, Photoshop-style (the window's too).
    const juce::String pattern ("Pattern");
    addHeader (pattern, "Pattern");
    addRow (pattern, "Pattern", patternBox);
    addRow (pattern, "Blend", blendBox);
    addRow (pattern, "Colour", patternColour, nullptr, 1.0f, 22);
    addHeader (pattern, "Strength and scale");
    addRow (pattern, "Opacity", patternOpacity, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (pattern, "Size", patternSize, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);
    addRow (pattern, "Angle", patternAngle, nullptr, 1.0f, 24);

    // ...and the window's.
    addHeader (window, "Size");
    addRow (window, "Window size (width, height)", widthBox, &heightBox, 0.5f);
    addRow (window, {}, cropToolButton, nullptr, 1.0f, 28);
    addHeader (window, "Pages");
    addRow (window, "Pages (in order, comma separated)", pagesBox);
    addHeader (window, "Light");
    addRow (window, {}, windowLightButton, nullptr, 1.0f, 28);

    addHeader (background, "Colours");
    addRow (background, "Background colours (top, bottom)", topColour, &bottomColour, 0.5f, 22);
    addHeader (background, "Picture");
    addRow (background, "Background picture", backgroundButton);
    addRow (background, {}, paintBackgroundButton, nullptr, 1.0f, 28);

    viewport.setViewedComponent (&rows, false);
    viewport.setScrollBarsShown (true, false);
    viewport.setScrollBarThickness (8);
    addAndMakeVisible (viewport);

    // Sonify AI, at the foot.
    instruction.setMultiLine (true, true);
    instruction.setReturnKeyStartsNewLine (false);
    instruction.setFont (Theme::font (14.0f));
    instruction.setIndents (8, 6);
    instruction.onReturnKey = [this] { send(); };
    addAndMakeVisible (instruction);

    sendButton.setTooltip ("Send it to Fanan AI (Enter)");
    sendButton.onClick = [this] { send(); };
    addAndMakeVisible (sendButton);
}

PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::~ElementMenu() = default;

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::addRow (const juce::String& tab, const juce::String& caption, juce::Component& first, juce::Component* second,
                                        float firstShare, int height)
{
    Rows::Row row;
    row.caption = caption;
    row.first = &first;
    row.second = second;
    row.firstShare = firstShare;
    row.height = height;
    row.shown = false;
    row.tab = tab;
    row.surface = tab == "Surface";
    rows.rows.push_back (row);
    rows.addChildComponent (first);

    if (second != nullptr)
        rows.addChildComponent (*second);
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::addHeader (const juce::String& tab, const juce::String& heading)
{
    Rows::Row row;
    row.caption = heading;
    row.tab = tab;
    row.surface = tab == "Surface";
    row.header = true;
    row.height = 0;
    rows.rows.push_back (row);
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::showTabs()
{
    // The surface rows: the shape's or painted picture's Surface tab, or the window's painted
    // background's, in its Background tab.
    const bool forWindow = widget < 0 && several.empty();

    for (auto& row : rows.rows)
        if (row.surface)
            row.tab = forWindow ? "Background" : "Surface";

    // The tabs with a row showing, in their order.
    juce::StringArray names;

    for (const auto* name : { "Object", "Control", "Meter", "Text", "Look", "Shape", "Surface", "Window", "Background", "Pattern" })
        for (const auto& row : rows.rows)
            if (! row.header && row.shown && row.tab == name)
            {
                names.add (name);
                break;
            }

    tabStrip.names = names;
    tabStrip.setVisible (names.size() > 1);
    tabStrip.current = names.contains (chosenTab) ? chosenTab : names[0];
    rows.tab = tabStrip.current;
    tabStrip.repaint();
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::pickTab (const juce::String& name)
{
    chosenTab = name;
    showTabs();
    viewport.setViewPosition (0, 0);
    resized();
    repaint();
}

void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::setShown (juce::Component& first, bool shouldShow, const juce::String& caption)
{
    for (auto& row : rows.rows)
    {
        if (row.first != &first)
            continue;

        row.shown = shouldShow;

        if (caption.isNotEmpty())
            row.caption = caption;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void PluginCanvas::ElementMenu::showFor (int widgetIndex)
{
    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<bool> quiet (updating, true);
    widget = juce::isPositiveAndBelow (widgetIndex, (int) canvas.layout.widgets.size()) ? widgetIndex : -1;
    several.clear();

    for (auto& row : rows.rows)
        row.shown = false;

    showActions (widget >= 0);
    removeButton.setVisible (widget >= 0);
    instruction.setVisible (true);
    sendButton.setVisible (true);

    if (widget < 0)
    {
        // The window itself.
        const auto& l = canvas.layout;
        title = "Plugin window";
        subtitle = juce::String (l.width) + juce::String::fromUTF8 (" \xc3\x97 ") + juce::String (l.height);

        widthBox.setText (juce::String (l.width), juce::dontSendNotification);
        heightBox.setText (juce::String (l.height), juce::dontSendNotification);
        topColour.setColourValue (l.backgroundTop, juce::dontSendNotification);
        bottomColour.setColourValue (l.backgroundBottom, juce::dontSendNotification);

        setShown (widthBox, true);
        setShown (cropToolButton, true);
        setShown (topColour, true);
        setShown (backgroundButton, true);
        pagesBox.setText (l.pages.joinIntoString (", "), juce::dontSendNotification);
        setShown (pagesBox, true);

        // A painted background: its material, colours, finish, texture, pattern and light, in
        // the Background tab (the one filling the window, or else the first). None yet: a
        // button to paint one.
        juce::var painted;

        for (const auto& w : l.widgets)
            if (const auto recipe = canvas.paintedRecipeOf (w); recipe.isObject() && (! painted.isObject() || canvas.isBackdrop (w)))
