            break;   // drawn above
    }
}

void PluginCanvas::drawKeyboardAtRest (juce::Graphics& g, const GuiWidget& w)
{
    // Its keys as its display has them (classic ivory, reverse colours, modern slate).
    PanelParts::paintKeyboard (g, w);
}

void PluginCanvas::drawKeyboard (juce::Graphics& g, const GuiWidget& w, int index, Part part)
{
    if (part != Part::moving)
        drawKeyboardAtRest (g, w);

    // The keys that are down (never baked: the plugin draws them live, the same way).
    if (part == Part::still || baking)
        return;

    const auto accent = w.colour.isTransparent() ? defaultAccent : w.colour;

    PanelParts::paintKeysDown (g, w, [this, index] (int note)
    {
        return (note == heldNote && index == heldKeyboard) || (note >= 0 && note < 128 && notesShown[(size_t) note]);
    }, accent);
}

void PluginCanvas::playKey (int widgetIndex, juce::Point<float> plugin)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (widgetIndex, (int) layout.widgets.size()))
        return;

    const auto& w = layout.widgets[(size_t) widgetIndex];
    const auto b = w.bounds.toFloat();
    const auto note = stella::keys::noteAt (plugin.x, plugin.y, w.lowNote, w.highNote, b.getX(), b.getY(), b.getWidth(), b.getHeight());

    if (note == heldNote && widgetIndex == heldKeyboard)
        return;

    releaseKey();

    if (note < 0)
        return;

    heldNote = note;
    heldKeyboard = widgetIndex;

    if (onNote != nullptr)
        onNote (note, stella::keys::velocityAt (plugin.y, stella::keys::keyOf (note, w.lowNote, w.highNote, b.getX(), b.getY(), b.getWidth(), b.getHeight())));

    repaint (viewAreaOf (w));
}

void PluginCanvas::releaseKey()
{
    if (heldNote < 0)
        return;

    const auto note = heldNote;
    const auto keyboard = heldKeyboard;
    heldNote = heldKeyboard = -1;

    if (onNote != nullptr)
        onNote (note, 0.0f);

    if (juce::isPositiveAndBelow (keyboard, (int) layout.widgets.size()))
        repaint (viewAreaOf (layout.widgets[(size_t) keyboard]));
}

juce::Rectangle<int> PluginCanvas::movingAreaOf (const GuiWidget& w) const
{
    switch (w.type)
    {
        case GuiWidget::Type::knob:      return knobSquare (w);
        case GuiWidget::Type::slider:
        case GuiWidget::Type::toggle:
        case GuiWidget::Type::selector:  return w.bounds.withTrimmedBottom (GuiLayout::captionHeight);
        case GuiWidget::Type::lamp:
        case GuiWidget::Type::meter:
        case GuiWidget::Type::scope:
        case GuiWidget::Type::envelope:
        case GuiWidget::Type::filter:    return w.bounds.withTrimmedBottom (w.label.isNotEmpty() ? GuiLayout::captionHeight : 0);
        case GuiWidget::Type::xy:        return w.bounds.withTrimmedBottom (GuiLayout::captionHeight);
        case GuiWidget::Type::preset:
        case GuiWidget::Type::keyboard:
        case GuiWidget::Type::custom:    return w.bounds;
        case GuiWidget::Type::label:     return PanelParts::labelMoves (w) ? w.bounds : juce::Rectangle<int>();   // a readout's value
        case GuiWidget::Type::group:
        case GuiWidget::Type::shape:
        case GuiWidget::Type::image:
        case GuiWidget::Type::registration:
        case GuiWidget::Type::tabs:      break;   // the plugin draws it itself
    }

    return {};
}

juce::String PluginCanvas::registrationText()
{
    return juce::String::fromUTF8 ("UNREGISTERED \xc2\xb7 click to register");
}

void PluginCanvas::drawRegistration (juce::Graphics& g, const GuiWidget& w)
{
    // A dark pill with an outline and words in the badge's colour (amber unless chosen).
    const auto box = w.bounds.toFloat().reduced (0.5f);
    const auto colour = w.colour.isTransparent() ? standardColour (w) : w.colour;
    const auto radius = juce::jmin (box.getHeight() * 0.5f, 14.0f);

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xe8141418));
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (box, radius);
    g.setColour (colour.withAlpha (0.85f));
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (box, radius, 1.0f);
    g.setColour (colour.brighter (0.15f));
    g.setFont (Theme::font (juce::jlimit (9.0f, 18.0f, box.getHeight() * 0.48f), true));
    g.drawFittedText (w.label.isNotEmpty() ? w.label : registrationText(), w.bounds.reduced (juce::roundToInt (radius * 0.6f), 0),
                      juce::Justification::centred, 1, 0.8f);
}

void PluginCanvas::drawPanel (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    const auto plugin = juce::Rectangle<float> (0.0f, 0.0f, (float) layout.width, (float) layout.height);
    g.setGradientFill (juce::ColourGradient (layout.backgroundTop, 0.0f, 0.0f, layout.backgroundBottom, 0.0f, plugin.getBottom(), false));
    g.fillRect (plugin);

    if (layout.backgroundImage.isNotEmpty())
        drawPicture (g, layout.backgroundImage, plugin, layout.backgroundMode);
}

void PluginCanvas::drawPicture (juce::Graphics& g, const juce::String& name, juce::Rectangle<float> area, const juce::String& mode)
{
    const auto& image = picture (name);

    if (! image.isValid() || area.isEmpty())
        return;

    juce::Graphics::ScopedSaveState state (g);
    g.reduceClipRegion (area.getSmallestIntegerContainer());
    g.setImageResamplingQuality (juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);
    g.setOpacity (1.0f);

    if (mode == "tile")
    {
        g.setTiledImageFill (image, juce::roundToInt (area.getX()), juce::roundToInt (area.getY()), 1.0f);
        g.fillRect (area);
        return;
    }

    const auto placement = mode == "stretch" ? juce::RectanglePlacement (juce::RectanglePlacement::stretchToFit)
                         : mode == "fit"     ? juce::RectanglePlacement (juce::RectanglePlacement::centred)
                         : mode == "centre"  ? juce::RectanglePlacement (juce::RectanglePlacement::centred | juce::RectanglePlacement::doNotResize)
                                             : juce::RectanglePlacement (juce::RectanglePlacement::centred | juce::RectanglePlacement::fillDestination);
    g.drawImage (image, area, placement);
}

juce::Image PluginCanvas::snapshot (float scale)
{
    if (! hasPanel() || layout.width <= 0 || layout.height <= 0)
        return {};

    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<int> noHover (hovered, -1), noActive (active, -1);
    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<bool> asPlayed (design, false);

    scale = juce::jlimit (0.25f, 3.0f, scale);
    juce::Image image (juce::Image::ARGB, juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt ((float) layout.width * scale)),
                       juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt ((float) layout.height * scale)), true);

    {
        juce::Graphics g (image);
        g.addTransform (juce::AffineTransform::scale (scale));
        drawPanel (g);

        for (int i = 0; i < (int) layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
            drawWidget (g, i);
    }

    return image;
}

PluginCanvas::Bake PluginCanvas::bake()
{
    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<int> noHover (hovered, -1), noActive (active, -1);
    const juce::ScopedValueSetter<bool> bakingNow (baking, true);

    Bake result;
    result.background = juce::Image (juce::Image::ARGB, layout.width, layout.height, true);

    // Still things lying over something that moves (a frame over a meter, glass over a knob,
    // a caption on that glass) stay in front of it in the plugin too: layers of their own,
    // not part of the background.
    std::vector<bool> layered (layout.widgets.size(), false);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& w = layout.widgets[i];
        const bool still = w.type == GuiWidget::Type::label || w.type == GuiWidget::Type::group || w.type == GuiWidget::Type::shape
                        || (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::image && w.image.isNotEmpty());

        for (size_t below = 0; still && below < i && ! layered[i]; ++below)
            layered[i] = movingAreaOf (layout.widgets[below]).intersects (w.bounds)
                      || (layered[below] && layout.widgets[below].bounds.intersects (w.bounds));
    }

    {
        juce::Graphics g (result.background);
        drawPanel (g);

        for (int i = 0; i < (int) layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
            if (! layered[(size_t) i])
                drawWidget (g, i, Part::still);
    }

    // The registration badge (the first one), on its own: a protected plugin draws it until
    // it's registered.
    for (const auto& w : layout.widgets)
    {
        if (w.type != GuiWidget::Type::registration)
            continue;

        result.registrationArea = w.bounds.getIntersection ({ 0, 0, layout.width, layout.height });

        if (! result.registrationArea.isEmpty())
        {
            result.registration = juce::Image (juce::Image::ARGB, result.registrationArea.getWidth(), result.registrationArea.getHeight(), true);
            juce::Graphics g (result.registration);
            g.setOrigin ({ -result.registrationArea.getX(), -result.registrationArea.getY() });
            drawRegistration (g, w);
        }

        break;
    }

    std::map<juce::String, int> lookStrips;   // controls with the same look and size share frames

    for (int i = 0; i < (int) layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& w = layout.widgets[(size_t) i];
        const auto area = layered[(size_t) i] ? w.bounds.getIntersection ({ 0, 0, layout.width, layout.height }) : movingAreaOf (w);
        result.stripOf.push_back (-1);
        result.movingArea.push_back (area);

        if (area.isEmpty())
            continue;

        // A layer in front of something that moves: one frame, drawn over it by the plugin.
        if (layered[(size_t) i])
        {
            Bake::Strip strip;
            strip.frameWidth = area.getWidth();
            strip.frameHeight = area.getHeight();
            strip.frames = 1;
            strip.image = juce::Image (juce::Image::ARGB, area.getWidth(), area.getHeight(), true);

            {
                juce::Graphics g (strip.image);
                g.setOrigin ({ -area.getX(), -area.getY() });
                drawWidget (g, i, Part::still);
            }

            result.stripOf.back() = (int) result.strips.size();
            result.strips.push_back (strip);
            continue;
        }

        // Knobs, sliders and switches: their look's frames (a switch: off, on).
        if (Looks::takesLook (w) && looks != nullptr)
        {
            looks->setLight (layout.lightAngle, layout.lightAltitude);   // lit by the panel's global light
            const auto kind = Looks::kindOf (w);
            const auto& look = looks->lookFor (w);
            const auto key = juce::String (look.revision) + "|" + Looks::kindName (kind) + "|"
                           + juce::String (area.getWidth()) + "x" + juce::String (area.getHeight());

            // Its frames reach past its box by the look's shadows: drawn over the box expanded.
            const auto room = Looks::overhang (look, area.getWidth(), area.getHeight());
            result.movingArea.back() = area.expanded (room);

            if (const auto found = lookStrips.find (key); found != lookStrips.end())
            {
                result.stripOf.back() = found->second;
                continue;
            }

            Bake::Strip strip;
            strip.image = looks->strip (look, kind, area.getWidth(), area.getHeight());
            strip.frameWidth = area.getWidth() + 2 * room;
            strip.frameHeight = area.getHeight() + 2 * room;
            strip.frames = Looks::framesFor (look, kind);

            lookStrips[key] = (int) result.strips.size();
            result.stripOf.back() = (int) result.strips.size();
            result.strips.push_back (strip);
            continue;
        }

        int frames = 0;

        switch (w.type)
        {
            case GuiWidget::Type::preset:    frames = juce::jmax (1, presetMenu.names.size()); break;
            case GuiWidget::Type::lamp:      frames = 2; break;
            case GuiWidget::Type::selector:
            {
                const auto* p = paramFor (w);
                frames = juce::jmax (1, w.options.size() > 0 ? w.options.size() : (p != nullptr ? (int) (p->max - p->min) + 1 : 1));
                break;
            }
            case GuiWidget::Type::knob:
            case GuiWidget::Type::slider:
            case GuiWidget::Type::toggle:
            case GuiWidget::Type::label:
            case GuiWidget::Type::group:
            case GuiWidget::Type::meter:
            case GuiWidget::Type::scope:
            case GuiWidget::Type::envelope:
            case GuiWidget::Type::filter:
            case GuiWidget::Type::xy:
            case GuiWidget::Type::shape:
            case GuiWidget::Type::image:
            case GuiWidget::Type::keyboard:           // its keys are in the background; the plugin draws the ones that are down
            case GuiWidget::Type::custom:             // the plugin draws it itself
            case GuiWidget::Type::registration:
            case GuiWidget::Type::tabs: break;
        }

        if (frames == 0)
            continue;

        Bake::Strip strip;
        strip.frameWidth = area.getWidth();
        strip.frameHeight = area.getHeight();
        strip.frames = frames;
        strip.image = juce::Image (juce::Image::ARGB, area.getWidth(), area.getHeight() * frames, true);

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; ++f)
        {
            juce::Graphics g (strip.image);
            g.setOrigin ({ -area.getX(), f * area.getHeight() - area.getY() });
            g.reduceClipRegion (area);

            drawWidget (g, i, Part::moving, (float) f);
        }

        result.stripOf.back() = (int) result.strips.size();
        result.strips.push_back (strip);
    }

    return result;
}

void PluginCanvas::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    // A made plugin's window in Sonify: the panel and what's on it, nothing around it.
    if (panelOnly)
    {
        g.fillAll (juce::Colours::black);

        if (! hasPanel())
            return;

        const auto area = panelArea();
        juce::Graphics::ScopedSaveState state (g);
        g.reduceClipRegion (area.toNearestInt());
        g.addTransform (juce::AffineTransform::scale (zoom).translated (area.getX(), area.getY()));

        drawPanel (g);

        for (int i = 0; i < (int) layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
            drawWidget (g, i);

        drawElementPopups (g);
        return;
    }

    // A grid over the whole tab, FlowStone-style; it moves and zooms with the view.
    g.fillAll (Theme::panel);
    drawGrid (g);

    if (! hasPanel())
        return;

    const auto area = panelArea();

    juce::DropShadow (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.45f), 18, { 0, 6 }).drawForRectangle (g, area.toNearestInt());

    {
        juce::Graphics::ScopedSaveState state (g);
        g.reduceClipRegion (area.toNearestInt());
        g.addTransform (juce::AffineTransform::scale (zoom).translated (area.getX(), area.getY()));

        drawPanel (g);

        // The alignment grid shows only while something is being moved or resized: the rest of
        // the time the window shows exactly as the plugin will (a grid over it looked like part
        // of its background).
        if (design && dragMoved && (drag == Drag::element || drag == Drag::resizeElement || drag == Drag::resizePanel))
        {
            const auto plugin = juce::Rectangle<float> (0.0f, 0.0f, (float) layout.width, (float) layout.height);
            g.setColour (juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.035f));

            for (int x = 16; x < layout.width; x += 16)
                g.drawVerticalLine (x, 0.0f, plugin.getBottom());

            for (int y = 16; y < layout.height; y += 16)
                g.drawHorizontalLine (y, 0.0f, plugin.getRight());
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (int) layout.widgets.size(); ++i)
            drawWidget (g, i);

        // Programmed elements' popups lie over everything.
        if (! design)
            drawElementPopups (g);
    }

    g.setColour (design ? (panelSelected ? Theme::accent : Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.55f)) : Theme::outline);
    g.drawRect (area, design ? (panelSelected ? 2.0f : 1.5f) : 1.0f);

    // Which tab, and the window's size, above its top-left corner.
    {
        const auto tab = juce::String (design ? "EDIT" : "PLAY");
        const auto font = Theme::font (12.0f, true);
        const auto caption = juce::Rectangle<float> (area.getX(), area.getY() - 20.0f, 320.0f, 16.0f);

        g.setColour (design ? Theme::accent : Theme::safe);
        g.setFont (font);
        g.drawText (tab, caption, juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);

        g.setColour (Theme::muted);
        g.setFont (Theme::font (12.0f));
        g.drawText (juce::String (layout.width) + juce::String::fromUTF8 (" \xc3\x97 ") + juce::String (layout.height),
                    caption.withTrimmedLeft ((float) juce::GlyphArrangement::getStringWidthInt (font, tab) + 10.0f),
                    juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);
    }

    drawPageStrip (g);

    if (design && ! cropping)
    {
        // The window's own corner: drag it to resize the window.
        const auto grip = panelHandle();
        g.setColour (panelSelected || drag == Drag::resizePanel ? Theme::accent : Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.7f));
        juce::Path corner;
        corner.addTriangle (grip.getTopRight(), grip.getBottomRight(), grip.getBottomLeft());
        g.fillPath (corner);

        // Several selected: a frame round each (handles only for one alone).
        for (const auto index : manySelected)
        {
            if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, (int) layout.widgets.size()) || ! isShown (layout.widgets[(size_t) index]))
                continue;

            g.setColour (index == selected ? Theme::accent : Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.75f));
            g.strokePath (viewOutline (layout.widgets[(size_t) index], 2.0f), juce::PathStrokeType (1.5f));
        }

        // Shift+drag's box.
        if (drag == Drag::marquee && ! marquee.isEmpty())
        {
            const auto box = toView (marquee);
            g.setColour (Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.12f));
            g.fillRect (box);
            g.setColour (Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.8f));
            g.drawRect (box, 1.0f);
        }

        if (juce::isPositiveAndBelow (selected, (int) layout.widgets.size()) && manySelected.empty() && isShown (layout.widgets[(size_t) selected]))
        {
            const auto& w = layout.widgets[(size_t) selected];
            g.setColour (isLine (selected) ? Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.35f) : Theme::accent);   // a line's box only faintly: its handles shape it
            g.strokePath (viewOutline (w, 2.0f), juce::PathStrokeType (1.5f));

            // The turn: a round handle on a stem above its top, with its angle while it turns.
            if (const auto knob = handleArea (turnHandle); ! knob.isEmpty())
            {
                g.setColour (Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.8f));
                g.drawLine ({ handleCentre (1), knob.getCentre() }, 1.2f);
                g.setColour (Theme::accent);
                g.fillEllipse (knob);
                g.setColour (juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.9f));
                g.drawEllipse (knob.reduced (0.5f), 1.0f);

                // A little turning arrow inside.
                juce::Path arrow;
                const auto c = knob.getCentre();
                const auto r = knob.getWidth() * 0.26f;
                arrow.addCentredArc (c.x, c.y, r, r, 0.0f, 0.4f, 4.9f, true);
                g.strokePath (arrow, juce::PathStrokeType (1.1f));

                if (drag == Drag::turnElement)
                {
                    g.setFont (Theme::font (12.0f, true));
                    g.drawText (juce::String (w.angle, 1).trimCharactersAtEnd ("0").trimCharactersAtEnd (".") + juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xc2\xb0"),
                                knob.translated (knob.getWidth() + 6.0f, 0.0f).withWidth (60.0f), juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);
                }
            }

            // Its handles: corners and sides.
            for (int handle = 0; handle < 8; ++handle)
            {
                if (const auto square = handleArea (handle); ! square.isEmpty())
                {
                    g.setColour (Theme::accent);
                    g.fillRect (square);
                    g.setColour (juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.85f));
                    g.drawRect (square, 1.0f);
                }
            }

            // A line's ends: round handles; the way between them, faint, while it's bent.
            if (const auto start = handleArea (lineStartHandle), end = handleArea (lineEndHandle); ! start.isEmpty() && ! end.isEmpty())
            {
                if (ObjectPaint::isBent (w))
                {
                    const float dashes[] { 4.0f, 4.0f };
                    g.setColour (Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.45f));
                    g.drawDashedLine ({ start.getCentre(), end.getCentre() }, dashes, 2, 1.0f);
                }

                for (const auto& knob : { start, end })
                {
                    g.setColour (juce::Colours::white);
                    g.fillEllipse (knob);
                    g.setColour (Theme::accent);
                    g.drawEllipse (knob.reduced (0.75f), 1.5f);
                }
            }

            // A shape's own: a yellow diamond.
            if (const auto own = handleArea (shapeHandle); ! own.isEmpty())
            {
                juce::Path diamond;
                const auto c = own.getCentre();
                const auto r = own.getWidth() * 0.62f;
                diamond.addQuadrilateral (c.x, c.y - r, c.x + r, c.y, c.x, c.y + r, c.x - r, c.y);
                g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffffcc00));
                g.fillPath (diamond);
                g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.6f));
                g.strokePath (diamond, juce::PathStrokeType (1.0f));
            }
        }
    }

    if (cropping)
        drawCrop (g);

    drawDropGhost (g);
    drawScrollbars (g);
    drawMinimap (g);
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PluginCanvas.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include "GuiLayout.h"
#include "Looks.h"
#include "ObjectPaint.h"
#include "PresetLibrary.h"
#include "Primitives.h"

#include <bitset>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <set>

class WasmElements;

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Edit UI tab's canvas: the plugin's window, drawn from its layout, sitting on a big
    grid you zoom and move around, like Colosseum's rack. Ctrl + wheel zooms (10% to 200%)
    around the mouse, the wheel scrolls (Shift + wheel: sideways), dragging empty space
    moves the view, and the minimap and the scrollbars jump anywhere. Fit shows the whole
    window.

    Play mode: the controls work like the finished plugin's: drag a knob or slider
    (Shift for fine moves), click a switch or a selector's position, drag in an XY pad,
    double-click for the default, use the mouse wheel; a keyboard's keys play notes while
    they're held (sliding across them plays each in turn). Meters, lamps and scopes move
    with the sound; envelope and filter curves follow their parameters; keyboards light up
    for every note that sounds, a MIDI keyboard's too.

    Edit mode: drag primitives in from the toolbox (or pictures from the desktop). Click an
    element to select it; right-click it for its menu (the one menu): Copy, Paste,
    Duplicate and its layer at the top, then what edits it (its parameter typed in by id),
    Delete, and an instruction for Sonify AI at its foot. Right-click the window's empty
    space for the window's own menu (size, colours, a picture behind everything, Paste).
    Drag to move (snapped); drag the selected element's handles (corners and sides) to
    resize it, Shift on a corner keeps its shape. Delete removes it, the arrow keys nudge
    it (Shift: further). Dragging a group carries what's inside. The window's own corner
    handle resizes the window; the Crop tool (the Crop button beside Fit, or C) crops it as
    Photoshop does: a box over it whose sides and corners drag in or out (past the window:
    it grows), dragged inside to move it, then Enter (or Apply, or a double-click) to crop to
    it, Esc to leave it. Double-clicking a knob, slider or switch opens its menu, where
    "Design it in the Knob Studio" opens its look there (with "Include similars": the controls
    like it too); double-clicking a picture picks its file.

    Elements lie in layers, in the layout's order: the first at the back. The menu's Layer
    list brings one to the front or forward, or sends it backward or to the back (also
    Ctrl+Shift+], Ctrl+], Ctrl+[, Ctrl+Shift+[). Copy, Paste and Duplicate (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V,
    Ctrl+D): a copied frame takes what's inside it along, and a paste lands where the menu
    was opened (Ctrl+V: under the mouse). Copies go through the system clipboard, so they
    paste into another project too.

    Every element is an object: the round handle above the selected one turns it (Shift: in
    steps of 15 degrees), its menu has its position, size, angle and opacity, and a turned one
    is still resized by its handles and played in its own frame. Shapes (rectangles, circles,
    triangles, stars) have a handle of their own (the yellow diamond) that rounds a rectangle's
    corners, moves a triangle's top point or a star's or circle's middle (lopsided), and their
    menu gives them a material with pattern layers, relief, a shadow and an outline.

    Several at once: Shift+click adds an element to the selection (or takes it away), and
    Shift+drag on empty space draws a box that adds what it touches. Dragging any of them
    moves them all; Delete, the arrow keys, Copy, Duplicate, Bring to front and Send to back
    work on them all, and their menu gives them one colour; a click on one of them alone
    selects just that one. A background picture is a picture element covering the window
    at the back; until it's selected, dragging it moves the view, as empty space does.

    Knobs, sliders and switches are drawn from their looks (see Looks): a frame for each
    value, made by KnobMaker's layer renderer. Programmed elements (Sonify AI's own, from
    the project's elements folder) draw themselves, through the GUI's sandboxed module
    (WasmElements); in Play mode they get the mouse, and their popups lie over everything.
*/
class PluginCanvas final : public juce::Component,
                           public juce::DragAndDropTarget,
                           public juce::FileDragAndDropTarget,
                           private juce::Timer
{
public:
    struct Param
    {
        int index = -1;
        juce::String id, name, unit;
        float min = 0.0f, max = 1.0f, def = 0.0f, value = 0.0f, skew = 1.0f;
    };

    PluginCanvas();
    ~PluginCanvas() override;

    void setLayout (const GuiLayout& newLayout);
    const GuiLayout& getLayout() const noexcept    { return layout; }

    /** The open project's gui folder: its pictures are in images/, the view is kept in
        view.json. None: no project. */
    void setGuiFolder (const juce::File& folder);

    void setDesignMode (bool shouldDesign);
    void setParameters (const juce::Array<Param>& newParams);

    /** The plugin's own window in Sonify (a plugin made here, on a track): Play mode, the panel
        alone, fitted to the component, with no grid, caption, minimap or scrollbars, and a view
        that doesn't move or zoom by hand. */
    void setPanelOnly (bool shouldBePanelOnly);
    bool isPanelOnly() const noexcept    { return panelOnly; }

    /** What meters, lamps and scopes can watch: signals ("voices.out", "plugin.out L") and
        module displays ("lfo.position"). For the edit menu's lists. */
    void setSources (const juce::StringArray& signals, const juce::StringArray& displays);

    /** What the preset manager widgets show: the presets under their headings, the chosen one
        (and whether it changed), and what can be done (Save, Delete...). */
    void setPresets (const PresetMenu& presets);

    /** The GUI's programmed elements from the latest build (nullptr: none, or not built yet). */
    void setElements (std::shared_ptr<WasmElements> newElements);

    void setLooks (Looks& looksToUse);

    void useLook (int widgetIndex, const juce::String& lookName);

    void editGlobalLight();

    void editLayerStyle (int widgetIndex);

    void addPrimitive (const Primitive& primitive, std::optional<juce::Point<float>> centre = {});

    /** For Export: the GUI as images the exported plugin draws from. Everything that never
        moves is in the background (pictures too); each control's moving part is a strip of
        frames (controls with the same look and size share one: their look's own frames, a
        switch's off and on). Meters, scopes, curves and XY dots are drawn live by the plugin
        itself. */
    /** An element's size when it's added, at a point of the plugin window. */
    static juce::Rectangle<int> defaultBounds (GuiWidget::Type type, int x, int y);

    /** The registration badge: its words when none are given, and how it's drawn (the
        exported plugin shows the same picture). */
    static juce::String registrationText();
    static void drawRegistration (juce::Graphics&, const GuiWidget&);

    struct Bake
    {
        juce::Image background;

        struct Strip
        {
            juce::Image image;   // frames stacked vertically
            int frameWidth = 0, frameHeight = 0, frames = 0;
        };

        std::vector<Strip> strips;
        std::vector<int> stripOf;                        // per widget: its strip, or -1
        std::vector<juce::Rectangle<int>> movingArea;    // per widget: where its moving part goes

        juce::Image registration;                        // the registration badge, if the panel has one
        juce::Rectangle<int> registrationArea;           // ...and where it goes
    };

    Bake bake();

    /** For Export to plugin files (PluginExporter, PluginCanvas_Export.cpp): the window baked page
        by page, as the exported plugin shows it. Each page's background holds everything still on
        it; what moves is a strip of frames, drawn as the panel draws it (a control's look at each
        value, turned and faded as it is; a meter at each level; a lamp lit; a selector at each
        position; a preset manager at each preset, then with none chosen; the page tabs at each
        page; a readout at each value). Scopes, curves, XY pads, keyboards and programmed
        elements are drawn live by the plugin. presetNames: the presets the plugin carries. */
    struct ExportBake
    {
        int width = 0, height = 0;
        std::vector<juce::Image> pages;      // each page's background (one when the window has no pages)

        struct Strip
        {
            juce::Image image;                // frames stacked top to bottom
            int frameWidth = 0, frameHeight = 0, frames = 0;
        };

        std::vector<Strip> strips;

        /** One element as the plugin has it (stella::gui::Widget), in the layout's order. */
        struct Item
        {
            int widget = -1;                  // its place in the layout
            juce::String kind;                // stella::gui::Kind's name: "knob" .. "tabs", "readout"
            int page = -1;                    // the page it's on; -1: every page
            juce::Rectangle<int> area;        // where its frames go, or what's drawn live
            juce::Rectangle<int> box;         // where it's played, upright
            int strip = -1;
            int count = 0, mode = 0;          // as stella::gui::Widget has them
            float angle = 0.0f;
        };

        std::vector<Item> items;
    };

    ExportBake bakeForExport (const juce::StringArray& presetNames);

    /** The panel as it plays now, as the finished plugin shows it (no Edit marks), scaled:
        the store's picture. Invalid when there's no panel. */
    juce::Image snapshot (float scale);

    std::function<void (int index, float value)> onParameterChanged;
    std::function<void (int note, float velocity)> onNote;         // a keyboard's key: down (velocity 0..1) or up (0)
    std::function<bool (int note)> isNoteDown;                     // whether a note is sounding, for the keyboards to show
    std::function<void()> onLayoutEdited;                          // save it
    std::function<void (int widgetIndex, bool includeSimilars)> onEditLook;   // open a control's look in the Knob Studio (with the controls like it)

    /** Paints a picture in code, as paint_picture does (the recipe: "element", "file", "width",
        "height", "color", "settings", and "quiet": the canvas reads it afresh itself); done
        gets what went wrong, or nothing when it's painted. The Edit tab's material controls. */
    std::function<void (const juce::var& recipe, std::function<void (const juce::String& problem)> done)> onPaintPicture;
    std::function<void (int presetIndex)> onPresetChosen;          // a preset manager's arrows or list, in Play mode
    std::function<void (PresetAction action)> onPresetAction;      // its menu's Save, Save as, Load, banks...
    std::function<void (const juce::String& why)> onElementsFailed; // the programmed elements crashed or got stuck

    /** Live data, read about 30 times a second. */
    std::function<float (const juce::String& source, bool rms)> readLevel;
    std::function<void (const juce::String& source, float* destination, int numSamples)> readScope;
    std::function<void (const juce::StringArray& levels, const juce::StringArray& scopes)> onSourcesChanged;

    /** What to draw of a widget: all of it, only what never moves, or only what moves. */
    enum class Part { all, still, moving };

    /** override >= 0 draws the moving part as if at that value: a proportion for knobs and
        sliders, 0 or 1 for switches and lamps, a position for selectors. */
    void drawWidget (juce::Graphics&, int index, Part part = Part::all, float override = -1.0f);
    void drawUpright (juce::Graphics&, int index, Part part, float override);   // drawWidget's work, before it's turned and faded

    void drawCurve (juce::Graphics&, const GuiWidget&, Part part);
    void drawPanel (juce::Graphics&);   // the window's colours and background picture, in plugin pixels

    /** The crop tool: a box in plugin pixels over the window. Its handles are numbered as an
        element's (0 top-left round to 7 left); 8 is inside it (moves it), 9 a new box drawn
        from outside it. Applied, the window takes its size, everything moves with its
        top-left corner, a background picture fills the new window (painted ones are painted
        again at its size), and what lies wholly outside it is deleted. */
    bool cropping = false;

    void drawCrop (juce::Graphics&);
    void fitPaintedBackdrops();                            // painted backgrounds painted again at the window's size

    /** The selected element's handles: 0 top-left, 1 top, 2 top-right, 3 right, 4 bottom-right,
        5 bottom, 6 bottom-left, 7 left resize it (knobs, which stay round, have the corners
        only; a small element, its corners only; a line, none: its points shape it); 8 turns it
        (the round one above it); 9 is a shape's own (see ObjectPaint::adjust: a line's bend
        point); 10 and 11 a line's ends. All turn with it. Empty: no such handle. */
    static constexpr int turnHandle = 8, shapeHandle = 9, lineStartHandle = 10, lineEndHandle = 11, numHandles = 12;

# D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PluginCompiler.cmake
#
# Export Plugin's tools (PluginExporter): the plugin formats' headers, and on Windows the compiler
# that builds the plugin files on the user's computer. They ship with Sonify:
#   llvm-mingw 20260922 (Windows): copied next to Sonify.exe as "Plugin Compiler", only its
#     64-bit Windows part (the compiler, the linker, and the C and C++ headers and libraries)
#   VST3 3.8.1's pluginterfaces (MIT licensed) and CLAP's headers (the ones WCLAP hosting brings,
#     also MIT): copied as "Plugin SDKs" (on macOS into the app's Resources)
# A Mac uses Apple's own compiler (its Command Line Tools), Linux the system's C++ compiler.
#
# Downloaded once into <build>/deps at pinned versions (or taken from the copy kept beside the
# project), as WclapBridge.cmake does: include this after it. Sets FANAN_PLUGIN_COMPILER_DIR (the
# unpacked llvm-mingw; empty off Windows), FANAN_PLUGIN_VST3_DIR (the folder holding
# pluginterfaces/) and FANAN_PLUGIN_CLAP_DIR (the folder holding clap/).

include_guard(GLOBAL)

set(FANAN_PLUGIN_COMPILER_DIR "")

if(WIN32 AND CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    fanan_fetch_archive(llvm-mingw
        "https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw/releases/download/20260922/llvm-mingw-20260922-ucrt-x86_64.zip"
        "e3ad77d117a4bea19a7a3b333341824d79a5a371004a10e25b8504e7b3047666" FANAN_PLUGIN_COMPILER_DIR)
endif()

fanan_fetch_archive(vst3-pluginterfaces
    "https://codeload.github.com/steinbergmedia/vst3_pluginterfaces/tar.gz/refs/tags/v3.8.1_build_84" "" _fanan_vst3_interfaces)

# The headers are included as "pluginterfaces/...", so they need a folder of that name.
set(FANAN_PLUGIN_VST3_DIR "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/vst3-sdk")

if(NOT EXISTS "${FANAN_PLUGIN_VST3_DIR}/pluginterfaces/base/funknown.h")
    file(COPY "${_fanan_vst3_interfaces}/" DESTINATION "${FANAN_PLUGIN_VST3_DIR}/pluginterfaces")
endif()

set(FANAN_PLUGIN_CLAP_DIR "${FANAN_CLAP_DIR}/include")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# fanan_copy_plugin_tools(target)
# After each build, beside the target's executable (on macOS in the app's Resources; only what
# changed is copied again):
#     Plugin SDKs/clap/include/clap          CLAP's headers
#     Plugin SDKs/vst3/pluginterfaces        VST3's interfaces
#     Plugin Compiler/                       (Windows) llvm-mingw's 64-bit Windows part:
#         bin/                               clang, its 64-bit Windows driver, lld and their DLLs
#         lib/clang                          clang's own headers, and its runtime for 64-bit Windows
#         x86_64-w64-mingw32/                the Windows headers and libraries
#         generic-w64-mingw32/               (the headers, where llvm-mingw keeps them shared)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function(fanan_copy_plugin_tools target)
    if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL "3.26")
        set(copy_folder copy_directory_if_different)
    else()
        set(copy_folder copy_directory)
    endif()

    if(APPLE)
        set(sdks "$<TARGET_BUNDLE_CONTENT_DIR:${target}>/Resources/Plugin SDKs")
    else()
        set(sdks "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/Plugin SDKs")
    endif()

    add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${sdks}/clap/include" "${sdks}/vst3"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${copy_folder} "${FANAN_PLUGIN_CLAP_DIR}/clap" "${sdks}/clap/include/clap"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${copy_folder} "${FANAN_PLUGIN_VST3_DIR}/pluginterfaces" "${sdks}/vst3/pluginterfaces"
        VERBATIM)

    if(NOT FANAN_PLUGIN_COMPILER_DIR)
        return()
    endif()

    set(from "${FANAN_PLUGIN_COMPILER_DIR}")
    set(to "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/Plugin Compiler")

    # From bin, what building a 64-bit Windows plugin runs: clang, its 64-bit Windows driver,
    # the linker, and the DLLs and settings they need (not the other targets' drivers, nor the
    # debugger and the other tools).
    file(GLOB _fanan_mingw_bin LIST_DIRECTORIES false "${from}/bin/*")
    set(tools "")

    foreach(file IN LISTS _fanan_mingw_bin)
        get_filename_component(name "${file}" NAME)

        if(name MATCHES "^(clang|clang\\+\\+|clang-[0-9]+|ld\\.lld|lld|lld-link|x86_64-w64-mingw32-.*)\\.exe$" OR name MATCHES "\\.(dll|cfg)$")
            list(APPEND tools "${file}")
        endif()
    endforeach()

    add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${to}/bin" "${to}/lib"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different ${tools} "${to}/bin"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${copy_folder} "${from}/x86_64-w64-mingw32" "${to}/x86_64-w64-mingw32"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${from}/LICENSE.TXT" "${to}/LICENSE.TXT"
        VERBATIM)

    # clang's own headers, and its runtime for 64-bit Windows (not the other targets', nor the sanitizers).
    file(GLOB _fanan_clang_versions LIST_DIRECTORIES true "${from}/lib/clang/*")

    foreach(version IN LISTS _fanan_clang_versions)
        if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${version}")
            continue()
        endif()

        get_filename_component(number "${version}" NAME)
        set(runtime "${version}/lib/windows/libclang_rt.builtins-x86_64.a")

        add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${to}/lib/clang/${number}/lib/windows"
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${copy_folder} "${version}/include" "${to}/lib/clang/${number}/include"
            VERBATIM)

        if(EXISTS "${runtime}")
            add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
                COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${runtime}" "${to}/lib/clang/${number}/lib/windows"
                VERBATIM)
        endif()
    endforeach()

    # The headers: in the 64-bit folder itself, or shared (a link to them there, where links are kept).
    if(IS_DIRECTORY "${from}/generic-w64-mingw32" AND (IS_SYMLINK "${from}/x86_64-w64-mingw32/include"
                                                       OR NOT EXISTS "${from}/x86_64-w64-mingw32/include/windows.h"))
        add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${copy_folder} "${from}/generic-w64-mingw32" "${to}/generic-w64-mingw32"
            VERBATIM)
    endif()

    if(IS_DIRECTORY "${from}/include")
        add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${copy_folder} "${from}/include" "${to}/include"
            VERBATIM)
    endif()
endfunction()
