// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PluginLibrary.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include "stella_blob.h"

#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    A plugin's sample library: the blobs (sampled instruments, made by the Sampling Studio's SFZ to
    Blob) a sampler made in the Plugins Creator Studio plays, numbered 0, 1, 2... in its list
    (stella::blob in stella_api.h; the engine is stella_blob.h, compiled into Sonify here).

        A project       library.json: [{ "name", "file" }], the blobs where they were added from.
                        Options > Sample library... edits it; the Edit UI toolbox's Instrument
                        list shows its names (a list whose settings say "library": true).
        Add to Sonify   the made plugin's library.json: [{ "name", "file" (its name), "origin"
                        (where it was) }]; a store package's has no origin.
        Export          the plugin knows its blobs by their files' names.

    Where a plugin finds a blob on a computer, in order (the same in Sonify and in an exported
    plugin, so one copy serves both):
        1. the folders (or blobs) listed in <app data>\<vendor>\<plugin>\library.txt, a line each:
           Locate... adds a folder, an export adds the creator's own blobs;
        2. <Documents>\<vendor>\<plugin>, where a buyer puts them;
        3. beside the plugin (a made plugin's folder, its "library" folder);
        4. where it was added from (Sonify only).
*/
namespace PluginLibrary
{
    inline constexpr const char* fileName = "library.json";

    struct Instrument
    {
        juce::String name;           // as the plugin lists it
        juce::File file;             // the blob (a made plugin's: where it was added from)
    };

    /** The library in a project's folder, or a made plugin's (in order). */
    juce::Array<Instrument> load (const juce::File& folder);
    bool save (const juce::File& folder, const juce::Array<Instrument>& instruments);

    /** A made plugin's library.json: each blob by its file's name, and (origins: true) where it was. */
    bool writeMade (const juce::File& pluginFolder, const juce::Array<Instrument>& instruments, bool origins);

    /** A name fit for a folder, as an exported plugin makes it (stella_blob.h). */
    juce::String folderName (const juce::String& text);

    /** <Documents>\<vendor>\<plugin>. */
    juce::File homeFolder (const juce::String& vendor, const juce::String& plugin);

    /** <app data>\<vendor>\<plugin>\library.txt. */
    juce::File listFile (const juce::String& vendor, const juce::String& plugin);

    /** Adds lines to the plugin's list (each once): folders, or blobs. */
    void addToList (const juce::String& vendor, const juce::String& plugin, const juce::StringArray& paths);

    /** A blob, by its file's name, as the plugin finds it (see above): besides are the plugin's own
        folders, origin where it was added from. None: it isn't on this computer. */
    juce::File find (const juce::String& blobName, const juce::String& vendor, const juce::String& plugin,
                     const juce::Array<juce::File>& besides, const juce::File& origin);

    /** The library as the engine takes it: each instrument with the blob found for it. ownFirst:
        each blob where it was added from comes first (the studio's own project). */
    std::vector<stella::blob::Entry> entriesFor (const juce::Array<Instrument>& instruments, const juce::String& vendor,
                                                 const juce::String& plugin, const juce::Array<juce::File>& besides,
                                                 bool ownFirst = false);

    /** A blob's summary, said in a few words: "Grand Piano: 244 regions, 1.2 GB", or its problem. */
    juce::String describe (const juce::File& blob);

    //==========================================================================
    /** The Plugins Creator Studio's Sample library window (Options > Sample library...). */
    struct WindowHooks
    {
        std::function<juce::Array<Instrument>()> get;
        std::function<void (const juce::Array<Instrument>&)> set;   // kept, and the plugin plays it
        std::function<int (int)> stateOf;                           // stella::blob's states, as the plugin has them
        std::function<juce::String (int)> problemOf;
        std::function<juce::File()> startFolder;                    // where Add... opens
    };

    std::unique_ptr<juce::DocumentWindow> makeWindow (const juce::String& pluginName, WindowHooks hooks);
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PluginScanner.cpp

#include "PluginScanner.h"
#include "Vst3Plugin.h"

PluginScanner::PluginScanner (std::vector<juce::File> filesToRead, int timeout, juce::File workerProgram)
    : juce::Thread ("Fanan plugin scanner"),
      files (std::move (filesToRead)), timeoutSeconds (juce::jmax (1, timeout)), worker (std::move (workerProgram))
{
}

PluginScanner::~PluginScanner()
{
    // A copy still reading is stopped on the way out (run() kills it when asked to stop).
    signalThreadShouldExit();
    stopThread (10000);
}

void PluginScanner::start()
{
    startThread();
}

void PluginScanner::cancel()
{
    cancelled = true;
    signalThreadShouldExit();
}

juce::String PluginScanner::getCurrent() const
{
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
    return current;
}

std::vector<PluginScanner::Outcome> PluginScanner::takeOutcomes()
{
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
    std::vector<Outcome> taken;
    taken.swap (outcomes);
    return taken;
}

void PluginScanner::run()
{
    for (const auto& file : files)
    {
        if (threadShouldExit())
            break;

        {
            const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
            current = file.getFileName();
        }

        auto outcome = read (file);

        if (threadShouldExit() && outcome.error.isNotEmpty())
            break;   // stopped while reading it: it isn't judged, it's read next time

        {
            const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
            outcomes.push_back (std::move (outcome));
        }

        ++done;
    }

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
        current.clear();
    }

    finished = true;
}

PluginScanner::Outcome PluginScanner::read (const juce::File& file)
{
    Outcome outcome;
    outcome.file = file;

    const auto result = juce::File::createTempFile (".json");
    juce::ChildProcess child;

    if (! child.start (juce::StringArray { worker.getFullPathName(), workerFlag, file.getFullPathName(), result.getFullPathName() }, 0))
    {
        outcome.error = "The scanner couldn't start.";
        return outcome;
    }

    // Waits for the copy, a little at a time, so a cancel or a hung plugin doesn't hold the Hub up.
    const auto deadline = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() + static_cast<juce::uint32> (timeoutSeconds) * 1000u;

    while (child.isRunning())
    {
        if (threadShouldExit())
        {
            child.kill();
            result.deleteFile();
            outcome.error = "Cancelled.";
            return outcome;
        }

        if (juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() > deadline)
        {
            child.kill();
            result.deleteFile();
            outcome.error = "It didn't answer within " + juce::String (timeoutSeconds) + (timeoutSeconds == 1 ? " second" : " seconds")
                          + ", so it was stopped.";
            return outcome;
        }

        wait (20);
    }

    // The answer counts even if the copy crashed on its way out afterwards (some plugins do).
    const auto answer = juce::JSON::parse (result);
    result.deleteFile();

    if (! answer.isObject())
    {
        outcome.error = "It crashed while being read.";
        return outcome;
    }

    if (const auto* list = answer.getProperty ("plugins", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& item : *list)
            outcome.plugins.push_back (fromVar (item));

    if (outcome.plugins.empty())
        outcome.error = answer.getProperty ("error", "It holds no plugins.").toString();

    return outcome;
}

//==============================================================================
bool PluginScanner::isWorkerCommandLine (const juce::String& commandLine)
{
    return commandLine.contains (workerFlag);
}

int PluginScanner::runWorker (const juce::StringArray& arguments)
{
    const auto at = arguments.indexOf (workerFlag);

    if (at < 0 || at + 2 >= arguments.size())
        return 2;

    const juce::File plugin (arguments[at + 1].unquoted());
    const juce::File output (arguments[at + 2].unquoted());

    // This copy exists only to read this one plugin: if the plugin crashes, only this copy goes.
    juce::String error;
    const auto found = Plugin::describe (plugin, error);

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& descriptor : found)
        list.add (toVar (descriptor));

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr answer (new juce::DynamicObject());
    answer->setProperty ("plugins", list);
    answer->setProperty ("error", error);
    const auto written = output.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (answer.get())));

    // The VST3 host is let go properly, as the Hub does on its way out.
    Vst3Plugin::shutdownFormats();
    return written ? 0 : 3;
}

juce::var PluginScanner::toVar (const Plugin::Descriptor& descriptor)
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
    item->setProperty ("id", descriptor.id);
    item->setProperty ("name", descriptor.name);
    item->setProperty ("vendor", descriptor.vendor);
    item->setProperty ("version", descriptor.version);

    juce::Array<juce::var> features;

    for (const auto& feature : descriptor.features)
        features.add (feature);

    item->setProperty ("features", features);
    return juce::var (item.get());
}

Plugin::Descriptor PluginScanner::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    Plugin::Descriptor descriptor;
    descriptor.id = value.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();
    descriptor.name = value.getProperty ("name", {}).toString();
    descriptor.vendor = value.getProperty ("vendor", {}).toString();
    descriptor.version = value.getProperty ("version", {}).toString();

    if (const auto* features = value.getProperty ("features", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& feature : *features)
            descriptor.features.add (feature.toString());

    return descriptor;
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PluginScanner.h

#pragma once

#include "Plugin.h"

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Reads plugin files the safe way, as Colosseum does: never inside the Hub.

    Each plugin is read by a copy of the Hub started just for it
    (FananWebHub.exe --scan-plugin <plugin> <result.json>): it loads that one plugin,
    writes what it holds, and exits. A plugin that crashes or hangs takes only that copy
    down (after 30 seconds it's stopped), and is reported; the Hub itself never loads a
    plugin while scanning.

    The reading runs on a thread of its own; the Hub asks for progress and results from
    its own timer (no calls from this thread into the Hub).
*/
class PluginScanner final : private juce::Thread
{
public:
    struct Outcome
    {
        juce::File file;
        std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor> plugins;
        juce::String error;            // why it couldn't be read, when it couldn't
    };

    /** worker: the program that reads a plugin (the Hub itself, unless a test says otherwise). */
    explicit PluginScanner (std::vector<juce::File> files,
                            int timeoutSeconds = 30,
                            juce::File worker = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile));
    ~PluginScanner() override;

    void start();
    void cancel();

    bool isFinished() const noexcept        { return finished.load(); }
    bool wasCancelled() const noexcept      { return cancelled.load(); }
    int getTotal() const noexcept           { return static_cast<int> (files.size()); }
    int getDone() const noexcept            { return done.load(); }
    juce::String getCurrent() const;

    /** What has been read since the last call. */
    std::vector<Outcome> takeOutcomes();

    //==============================================================================
    /** The reading copy's side: true when the command line asks for it. */
    static bool isWorkerCommandLine (const juce::String& commandLine);

    /** Reads the plugin named on the command line and writes the result; returns the exit code. */
    static int runWorker (const juce::StringArray& arguments);

    static juce::var toVar (const Plugin::Descriptor& descriptor);
    static Plugin::Descriptor fromVar (const juce::var& value);

    static constexpr const char* workerFlag = "--scan-plugin";

private:
    void run() override;
    Outcome read (const juce::File& file);

    const std::vector<juce::File> files;
    const int timeoutSeconds;
    const juce::File worker;

    std::atomic<bool> finished { false }, cancelled { false };
    std::atomic<int> done { 0 };

    mutable juce::CriticalSection lock;
    juce::String current;
    std::vector<Outcome> outcomes;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (PluginScanner)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PodcastExport.cpp

#include "PodcastExport.h"
#include "Mp3Encoder.h"
#include "SonifyDsp.h"

#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    constexpr int blockSize = 32768;

    // How far the whole recording may be turned: a recording this far off is something else.
    constexpr double mostGainDb = 40.0;

    /** Reads the file a block at a time as stereo (a mono one on both sides). */
    class Blocks
    {
    public:
        Blocks (juce::AudioFormatReader& r)
            : reader (r), buffer (2, blockSize)
        {
        }

        juce::int64 total() const noexcept     { return reader.lengthInSamples; }

        /** The next block (count samples, 0 at the end). */
        int next()
        {
            const auto count = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (blockSize, reader.lengthInSamples - at));

            if (count <= 0)
                return 0;

            buffer.clear();
            reader.read (&buffer, 0, count, at, true, reader.numChannels > 1);

            if (reader.numChannels < 2)
                buffer.copyFrom (1, 0, buffer, 0, 0, count);

            at += count;
            return count;
        }

        void rewind() noexcept                 { at = 0; }

        float* left() noexcept                 { return buffer.getWritePointer (0); }
        float* right() noexcept                { return buffer.getWritePointer (1); }

    private:
        juce::AudioFormatReader& reader;
        juce::AudioBuffer<float> buffer;
        juce::int64 at = 0;
    };

    /** Where the turned, limited sound goes as each block is made (the limiter's delay taken
        out): to a meter, or to the file. */
    using Out = std::function<bool (const float* left, const float* right, int count)>;

    /** The whole recording turned by gainDb through the limiter, into out. */
    bool render (Blocks& blocks, double rate, double gainDb, float ceilingDb, const Out& out,
                 const std::function<bool (double)>& report, double from, double share)
    {
        SonifyDsp::Limiter limiter;
        limiter.prepare (rate);
        limiter.setSettings (ceilingDb, 80.0f);

        const auto gain = static_cast<float> (juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (gainDb));
        const auto delay = limiter.getLatency();
        juce::int64 skipped = 0;
        juce::int64 made = 0;
        blocks.rewind();

        const auto pass = [&] (float* left, float* right, int count)
        {
            limiter.process (left, right, count);

            // The limiter's first samples are its delay: what comes after them is the recording.
            auto offset = 0;

            if (skipped < delay)
            {
                offset = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (count, delay - skipped));
                skipped += offset;
            }

            return offset >= count || out (left + offset, right + offset, count - offset);
        };

        while (const auto count = blocks.next())
        {
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::multiply (blocks.left(), gain, count);
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::multiply (blocks.right(), gain, count);

            if (! pass (blocks.left(), blocks.right(), count))
                return false;

            made += count;

            if (! report (from + share * static_cast<double> (made) / static_cast<double> (juce::jmax<juce::int64> (1, blocks.total()))))
                return false;
        }

        // What the limiter still holds.
        std::vector<float> silenceLeft (static_cast<size_t> (juce::jmax (1, delay)), 0.0f), silenceRight (silenceLeft);
        return delay <= 0 || pass (silenceLeft.data(), silenceRight.data(), delay);
    }
}

//==============================================================================
PodcastExport::PodcastExport (Settings s)
    : juce::Thread ("Sonify podcast export"), settings (std::move (s))
{
}

PodcastExport::~PodcastExport()
{
    stopThread (10000);
    cancelPendingUpdate();
}

void PodcastExport::run()
{
    result = make (settings, [this] (double p)
    {
        progress = p;
        return ! threadShouldExit();
    });

    progress = 1.0;
    done = true;
    triggerAsyncUpdate();
}

void PodcastExport::handleAsyncUpdate()
{
    if (onDone != nullptr)
        onDone();
}

PodcastExport::Result PodcastExport::make (const Settings& settings, const std::function<bool (double)>& report)
{
    Result result;
    const auto fail = [&result] (const juce::String& why) { result.error = why; return result; };

    juce::AudioFormatManager formats;
    formats.registerBasicFormats();
    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatReader> reader (formats.createReaderFor (settings.source));

    if (reader == nullptr || reader->sampleRate <= 0.0 || reader->lengthInSamples <= 0)
        return fail (settings.source.existsAsFile() ? "Sonify can't read " + settings.source.getFileName() + "."
                                                    : settings.source.getFullPathName() + " isn't there.");

    const auto rate = reader->sampleRate;
    Blocks blocks (*reader);

    // 1. Its loudness as it is.
    {
        SonifyDsp::LoudnessMeter meter;
        meter.prepare (rate);
        juce::int64 read = 0;

        while (const auto count = blocks.next())
        {
            meter.process (blocks.left(), blocks.right(), count);
            read += count;

            if (! report (0.3 * static_cast<double> (read) / static_cast<double> (blocks.total())))
                return fail ("Cancelled");
        }

        result.measuredLufs = meter.getIntegrated();
    }

    if (result.measuredLufs < -70.0)
        return fail (settings.source.getFileName() + " is silent: there's nothing to make loud.");

    auto gainDb = juce::jlimit (-mostGainDb, mostGainDb, settings.lufs - result.measuredLufs);

    // 2. Turned and limited: what the limiter takes off is given back once.
    {
        SonifyDsp::LoudnessMeter meter;
        meter.prepare (rate);

        const auto measured = render (blocks, rate, gainDb, settings.ceilingDb, [&meter] (const float* l, const float* r, int count)
        {
            meter.process (l, r, count);
            return true;
        }, report, 0.3, 0.3);

        if (! measured)
            return fail ("Cancelled");

        const auto missing = settings.lufs - meter.getIntegrated();

        if (missing > 0.1)
            gainDb = juce::jlimit (-mostGainDb, mostGainDb, gainDb + missing);
    }

    result.gainDb = gainDb;

    // 3. Written: MP3, or WAV without LAME (or when a .wav is asked for).
    const bool wantMp3 = ! settings.target.hasFileExtension ("wav") && Mp3Encoder::problem().isEmpty();
    result.wroteWav = ! wantMp3;
    result.file = wantMp3 ? settings.target.withFileExtension ("mp3") : settings.target.withFileExtension ("wav");

    // A WAV in place of the MP3 asked for doesn't replace one that's there.
    if (result.file != settings.target && result.file.exists())
        result.file = result.file.getNonexistentSibling (false);

    result.file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();

    const auto temporary = result.file.getSiblingFile (result.file.getFileNameWithoutExtension() + ".part" + result.file.getFileExtension());
    temporary.deleteFile();

    SonifyDsp::LoudnessMeter finalMeter;
    finalMeter.prepare (rate);
    SonifyDsp::TruePeakMeter peaks;
    peaks.reset();

    Mp3Encoder mp3;
    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatWriter> wav;

    if (wantMp3)
    {
        if (const auto opened = mp3.open (temporary, rate, settings.kbps); opened.failed())
            return fail (opened.getErrorMessage());
    }
    else
    {
        std::unique_ptr<juce::OutputStream> stream = temporary.createOutputStream();

        if (stream != nullptr)
        {
            juce::WavAudioFormat format;
            wav = format.createWriterFor (stream, juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions{}.withSampleRate (rate)
                                                                                   .withNumChannels (2)
                                                                                   .withBitsPerSample (24));
        }

        if (wav == nullptr)
            return fail ("Sonify can't write " + result.file.getFullPathName() + ".");
    }

    const auto written = render (blocks, rate, gainDb, settings.ceilingDb, [&] (const float* l, const float* r, int count)
    {
        finalMeter.process (l, r, count);
        peaks.process (l, r, count);

        if (wantMp3)
            return mp3.write (l, r, count);

        const float* const channels[] = { l, r };
        return wav->writeFromFloatArrays (channels, 2, count);
    }, report, 0.6, 0.4);

    const auto closed = wantMp3 ? mp3.close() : juce::Result::ok();
    wav = nullptr;   // closes the WAV

    if (! written || closed.failed())
    {
        temporary.deleteFile();
        return fail (! written && closed.wasOk() ? juce::String ("Cancelled")
                                                 : "Sonify couldn't finish " + result.file.getFileName() + (closed.failed() ? ": " + closed.getErrorMessage() : "."));
    }

    result.file.deleteFile();

    if (! temporary.moveFileTo (result.file))
    {
        temporary.deleteFile();
        return fail ("Sonify couldn't put " + result.file.getFileName() + " in place (is it open somewhere?).");
    }

    result.finalLufs = finalMeter.getIntegrated();
    result.truePeakDb = peaks.getPeakDb();
    result.ok = true;
    report (1.0);
    return result;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PodcastExport.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_formats/juce_audio_formats.h>
#include <juce_events/juce_events.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <functional>

//==============================================================================
/**
    A recording made ready to publish: a podcast (-16 LUFS, as Apple Podcasts and Spotify ask)
    or a video or stream (-14 LUFS, as YouTube plays them).

    Its loudness is measured as Sonify Mastering measures it (ITU-R BS.1770-4 and EBU R 128:
    K-weighted, gated, the whole recording), then the whole of it is turned up or down to the
    loudness asked for, a true-peak limiter keeping it under its ceiling (-1 dBTP). What the
    limiter takes off the loudness is measured too, and given back once (the limiter holding
    the peaks), so it lands within a few tenths of the target. Written as MP3 (LAME, constant
    bit rate), or as 24-bit WAV when LAME isn't there.

    Three passes over the file (measure, try, write), on a thread of its own.
*/
class PodcastExport final : private juce::Thread,
                            private juce::AsyncUpdater
{
public:
    struct Settings
    {
        juce::File source;                  // the recording (any file Sonify reads)
        juce::File target;                  // .mp3 (or .wav: written as WAV)
        double lufs = -16.0;
        float ceilingDb = -1.0f;            // true peak
        int kbps = 192;
    };

    struct Result
    {
        bool ok = false;
        juce::String error;                 // "Cancelled" when cancelled
        juce::File file;                    // what was written (a WAV when LAME wasn't there)
        bool wroteWav = false;
        double measuredLufs = -200.0;       // the recording as it was
        double gainDb = 0.0;                // what it was turned by
        double finalLufs = -200.0;          // as written
        double truePeakDb = -200.0;
    };

    explicit PodcastExport (Settings settings);
    ~PodcastExport() override;

    void start()                                        { startThread (juce::Thread::Priority::low); }
    void cancel()                                       { signalThreadShouldExit(); }
    bool isDone() const noexcept                        { return done.load(); }
    double getProgress() const noexcept                 { return progress.load(); }
    const Settings& getSettings() const noexcept        { return settings; }

    /** Once isDone(). */
    const Result& getResult() const noexcept            { return result; }

    /** Called on the message thread once it's done (it may be deleted from there). */
    std::function<void()> onDone;

    /** The work itself, here and now: report says how far it got (0..1) and false stops it. */
    static Result make (const Settings& settings, const std::function<bool (double)>& report);

private:
    void run() override;
    void handleAsyncUpdate() override;

    Settings settings;
    Result result;
    std::atomic<bool> done { false };
    std::atomic<double> progress { 0.0 };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (PodcastExport)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Preferences.cpp

#include "Preferences.h"

#include <algorithm>

namespace
{
    constexpr const char* formatName = "Sonify Settings";
    constexpr int formatVersion = 1;

    juce::File chosenUserData;   // empty: the default

    int number (const juce::var& value, int fallback, int min, int max)
    {
        if (! (value.isInt() || value.isInt64() || value.isDouble()))
            return fallback;

        return juce::jlimit (min, max, static_cast<int> (value));
    }

    bool flag (const juce::var& value, bool fallback)
    {
        return value.isBool() || value.isInt() ? static_cast<bool> (value) : fallback;
    }

    juce::String text (const juce::var& value, const juce::String& fallback = {})
    {
        return value.isString() ? value.toString() : fallback;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::StringArray Preferences::getKeymaps()
{
    return { "studioOne", "cubase", "logic", "proTools", "ableton", "cakewalk", "flStudio" };
}

juce::StringArray Preferences::getTimecodeRates()
{
    return { "24", "25", "29.97", "30" };
}

juce::File Preferences::getFile()
{
    return SettingsFolder::file ("settings.json", "FananWebHub-settings.json");
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File SettingsFolder::get()
{
    static const juce::File folder = []
    {
        const auto made = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userApplicationDataDirectory)
                              .getChildFile ("Fanan")
                              .getChildFile ("Sonify");
        made.createDirectory();
        return made;
    }();

    return folder;
}

juce::File SettingsFolder::file (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& oldName)
{
    const auto target = get().getChildFile (name);

    // Kept beside Sonify.exe before (a new build lost it): taken over, once.
    if (oldName.isNotEmpty() && ! target.exists())
    {
        const auto old = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile).getSiblingFile (oldName);

        if (old.existsAsFile())
        {
            get().createDirectory();
            old.copyFileTo (target);
        }
    }

    return target;
}

//==============================================================================
void Preferences::load()
{
    const auto parsed = juce::JSON::parse (getFile());

    if (parsed.getProperty ("format", {}).toString() == formatName)
    {
        const auto appearance = parsed.getProperty ("appearance", {});
        luminance = number (appearance.getProperty ("luminance", {}), luminance, 0, 100);
        contrast = number (appearance.getProperty ("contrast", {}), contrast, 0, 100);

        keymap = text (parsed.getProperty ("keymap", {}), keymap);
        discoverable = flag (parsed.getProperty ("discoverable", {}), discoverable);

        const auto locations = parsed.getProperty ("locations", {});
        userData = text (locations.getProperty ("userData", {}));
        autosave = flag (locations.getProperty ("autosave", {}), autosave);
        autosaveMinutes = number (locations.getProperty ("autosaveMinutes", {}), autosaveMinutes, minAutosaveMinutes, maxAutosaveMinutes);

        releaseInBackground = flag (parsed.getProperty ("releaseInBackground", {}), releaseInBackground);
        timecodeRate = text (parsed.getProperty ("timecodeRate", {}), timecodeRate);

        devices.clear();

        if (const auto* list = parsed.getProperty ("devices", {}).getArray())
            for (const auto& item : *list)
                devices.push_back (deviceFromVar (item));

        midiInputsOff.clear();

        if (const auto* list = parsed.getProperty ("midiInputsOff", {}).getArray())
            for (const auto& item : *list)
                if (item.isString() && item.toString().isNotEmpty())
                    midiInputsOff.addIfNotAlreadyThere (item.toString());

        const auto io = parsed.getProperty ("songIo", {});
        songIo = io.isObject() ? io : juce::var();
    }

    tidy();
    UserData::setFolder (userData);
}

bool Preferences::save() const
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr appearance (new juce::DynamicObject());
    appearance->setProperty ("luminance", luminance);
    appearance->setProperty ("contrast", contrast);

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr locations (new juce::DynamicObject());
    locations->setProperty ("userData", userData);
    locations->setProperty ("autosave", autosave);
    locations->setProperty ("autosaveMinutes", autosaveMinutes);

    juce::Array<juce::var> list, off;

    for (const auto& device : devices)
        list.add (deviceToVar (device));

    for (const auto& port : midiInputsOff)
        off.add (port);

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr root (new juce::DynamicObject());
    root->setProperty ("format", formatName);
    root->setProperty ("version", formatVersion);
    root->setProperty ("appearance", juce::var (appearance.get()));
    root->setProperty ("keymap", keymap);
    root->setProperty ("discoverable", discoverable);
    root->setProperty ("locations", juce::var (locations.get()));
    root->setProperty ("releaseInBackground", releaseInBackground);
    root->setProperty ("timecodeRate", timecodeRate);
    root->setProperty ("devices", list);
    root->setProperty ("midiInputsOff", off);

    if (songIo.isObject())
        root->setProperty ("songIo", songIo);

    return getFile().replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (root.get())));
}

void Preferences::tidy()
{
    luminance = juce::jlimit (0, 100, luminance);
    contrast = juce::jlimit (0, 100, contrast);
    autosaveMinutes = juce::jlimit (minAutosaveMinutes, maxAutosaveMinutes, autosaveMinutes);

    if (! getKeymaps().contains (keymap))
        keymap = "studioOne";

    if (! getTimecodeRates().contains (timecodeRate))
        timecodeRate = "30";

    if (userData.isNotEmpty() && ! juce::File::isAbsolutePath (userData))
        userData.clear();

    // Every device with an id and a name of its own, and one default input at most.
    std::vector<Device> kept;
    bool haveDefault = false;

    for (auto device : devices)
    {
        if (device.id.isEmpty())
            device.id = juce::Uuid().toString();

        bool duplicateId = false;

        for (const auto& other : kept)
            duplicateId = duplicateId || other.id == device.id;

        if (duplicateId)
            continue;

        device.defaultInput = device.defaultInput && ! haveDefault;
        haveDefault = haveDefault || device.defaultInput;

        // A name of its own among the ones kept so far.
        auto base = device.name.removeCharacters ("|").trim();

        if (base.isEmpty())
            base = device.model.isNotEmpty() ? device.model : juce::String ("MIDI Device");

        auto name = base;

        for (int n = 2; std::any_of (kept.begin(), kept.end(), [&name] (const Device& d) { return d.name.equalsIgnoreCase (name); }); ++n)
            name = base + " (" + juce::String (n) + ")";

        device.name = name;
        kept.push_back (device);
    }

    devices = std::move (kept);
}

//==============================================================================
juce::var Preferences::toVar() const
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr appearance (new juce::DynamicObject());
    appearance->setProperty ("luminance", luminance);
    appearance->setProperty ("contrast", contrast);

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& device : devices)
        list.add (deviceToVar (device));

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr root (new juce::DynamicObject());
    root->setProperty ("appearance", juce::var (appearance.get()));
    root->setProperty ("keymap", keymap);
    root->setProperty ("discoverable", discoverable);
    root->setProperty ("userData", UserData::getFolder().getFullPathName());
    root->setProperty ("userDataIsDefault", userData.isEmpty());
    root->setProperty ("userDataDefault", UserData::getDefaultFolder().getFullPathName());
    root->setProperty ("autosave", autosave);
    root->setProperty ("autosaveMinutes", autosaveMinutes);
    root->setProperty ("autosaveFolder", UserData::autosave().getFullPathName());
    root->setProperty ("releaseInBackground", releaseInBackground);
    root->setProperty ("timecodeRate", timecodeRate);
    root->setProperty ("devices", list);
    return juce::var (root.get());
}

const Preferences::Device* Preferences::findDevice (const juce::String& id) const
{
    for (const auto& device : devices)
        if (device.id == id)
            return &device;

    return nullptr;
}

juce::String Preferences::uniqueDeviceName (const juce::String& wanted, const juce::String& exceptId) const
{
    auto base = wanted.removeCharacters ("|").trim();

    if (base.isEmpty())
        base = "MIDI Device";

    const auto taken = [this, &exceptId] (const juce::String& name)
    {
        return std::any_of (devices.begin(), devices.end(), [&] (const Device& d) { return d.id != exceptId && d.name.equalsIgnoreCase (name); });
    };

    auto name = base;

    for (int n = 2; taken (name); ++n)
        name = base + " (" + juce::String (n) + ")";

    return name;
}

juce::String Preferences::putDevice (Device device)
{
    if (device.id.isEmpty())
        device.id = juce::Uuid().toString();

    device.name = uniqueDeviceName (device.name.isNotEmpty() ? device.name : device.model, device.id);
    device.pitchRange = juce::jlimit (1, 96, device.pitchRange);
    device.channels &= 0xffff;

    if (device.channels == 0)
        device.channels = 0xffff;

    if (device.defaultInput)
        for (auto& other : devices)
            other.defaultInput = false;

    const auto id = device.id;

    for (auto& existing : devices)
    {
        if (existing.id == id)
        {
            existing = std::move (device);
            return id;
        }
    }

    devices.push_back (std::move (device));
    return id;
}

bool Preferences::removeDevice (const juce::String& id)
{
    const auto before = devices.size();
    devices.erase (std::remove_if (devices.begin(), devices.end(), [&id] (const Device& d) { return d.id == id; }), devices.end());
    return devices.size() != before;
}

Preferences::Device Preferences::deviceFromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    Device device;
    device.id = text (value.getProperty ("id", {}));
    device.model = text (value.getProperty ("model", {}), "New Keyboard");

    const auto kind = text (value.getProperty ("kind", {}), "keyboard");
    device.kind = juce::StringArray { "keyboard", "controller", "drums", "instrument", "surface" }.contains (kind) ? kind : juce::String ("keyboard");

    const auto protocol = text (value.getProperty ("protocol", {}), "mackie");
    device.protocol = juce::StringArray { "mackie", "extender", "hui" }.contains (protocol) ? protocol : juce::String ("mackie");
    device.manufacturer = text (value.getProperty ("manufacturer", {}));
    device.name = text (value.getProperty ("name", {}));
    device.input = text (value.getProperty ("input", {}));
    device.output = text (value.getProperty ("output", {}));
    device.channels = number (value.getProperty ("channels", {}), 0xffff, 0, 0xffff);

    if (device.channels == 0)
        device.channels = 0xffff;

    device.filterAftertouch = flag (value.getProperty ("filterAftertouch", {}), false);
    device.filterProgramChange = flag (value.getProperty ("filterProgramChange", {}), false);
    device.filterPitchBend = flag (value.getProperty ("filterPitchBend", {}), false);
    device.filterControllers = flag (value.getProperty ("filterControllers", {}), false);
    device.splitChannels = flag (value.getProperty ("splitChannels", {}), false);
    device.defaultInput = flag (value.getProperty ("defaultInput", {}), false);
    device.mpe = flag (value.getProperty ("mpe", {}), false);
    device.pitchRange = number (value.getProperty ("pitchRange", {}), 48, 1, 96);
    device.sendClock = flag (value.getProperty ("sendClock", {}), false);
    device.clockStart = flag (value.getProperty ("clockStart", {}), false);
    device.sendTimecode = flag (value.getProperty ("sendTimecode", {}), false);

    // A control surface plays Sonify: no track takes it, and it isn't sent the clock.
    if (device.kind == "surface")
    {
        device.channels = 0xffff;
        device.filterAftertouch = device.filterProgramChange = device.filterPitchBend = device.filterControllers = false;
        device.splitChannels = device.defaultInput = device.mpe = false;
        device.sendClock = device.clockStart = device.sendTimecode = false;
    }

    return device;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Preferences.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Sonify's own settings, the ones File > Settings shows: how the arrangement and the Editor
    look, which DAW's keyboard shortcuts it uses, whether remote control apps can find it on
    the network, where the user's things go, whether the audio device is let go while Sonify
    is in the background, the external MIDI devices (keyboards, controllers, drum kits,
    instruments and control surfaces) with what Sonify sends them (MIDI clock, MIDI timecode),
    and the MIDI input ports turned off.

    The audio device itself keeps its own file (audio.xml), as before.

    Saved as settings.json in Sonify's settings folder (SettingsFolder below), with Sonify's other
    settings: a new build of Sonify keeps them. Message thread only.
*/
class Preferences final
{
public:
    //==============================================================================
    /** An external MIDI device, as in Studio One's External Devices (Settings > MIDI Setup): a
        keyboard, a controller (pads, knobs) or a drum kit that plays notes, an instrument (a synth
        or drum machine with MIDI in), or a control surface that plays Sonify itself (Mackie
        Control, its Extender, HUI). Tracks choose the others by name; split channels make one
        input per MIDI channel. A control surface's port plays no track. */
    struct Device
    {
        juce::String id;                    // made when it's added; never changes
        juce::String model;                 // "New Keyboard", "New Instrument" or a model from the list
        juce::String kind = "keyboard";     // keyboard, controller, drums, instrument or surface
        juce::String protocol = "mackie";   // a surface's: mackie, extender or hui
        juce::String manufacturer;
        juce::String name;                  // unique; what tracks choose it by
        juce::String input, output;         // MIDI ports by name: Receive From, Send To (empty: none)
        int channels = 0xffff;              // the MIDI channels it uses, one bit each (bit 0: channel 1)
        bool filterAftertouch = false;      // these never reach the tracks
        bool filterProgramChange = false;
        bool filterPitchBend = false;
        bool filterControllers = false;
        bool splitChannels = false;         // one track input per channel
        bool defaultInput = false;          // new instrument tracks take it
        bool mpe = false;                   // MPE: per-note expression on its own channels
        int pitchRange = 48;                // semitones, for MPE
        bool sendClock = false;             // MIDI clock to its output while Sonify plays
        bool clockStart = false;            // Start rather than Song Position + Continue
        bool sendTimecode = false;          // MIDI timecode (MTC) to its output
    };

    //==============================================================================
    int luminance = 0;                      // 0 dark .. 100 bright: the arrangement and the Editor
    int contrast = 50;                      // 0 low .. 100 high: text and symbols against the dark
    juce::String keymap = "studioOne";      // see keymaps
    bool discoverable = false;              // remote control apps on the network can find Sonify
    juce::String userData;                  // empty: the default, Documents\Sonify
    bool autosave = true;
    int autosaveMinutes = 5;
    bool releaseInBackground = false;       // let the audio device go while another app is in front
    juce::String timecodeRate = "30";       // MIDI timecode frames: 24, 25, 29.97 (drop frame) or 30
    std::vector<Device> devices;
    juce::StringArray midiInputsOff;        // MIDI input ports turned off by hand (by name); the rest are listened to
    juce::var songIo;                       // Song Setup's Make Default: {inputs, outputs, audition} new songs start with

    static constexpr int minAutosaveMinutes = 1;
    static constexpr int maxAutosaveMinutes = 120;

    /** The keyboard shortcut maps the page knows: Studio One's (the default), Cubase's, Logic's,
        Pro Tools', Ableton Live's, Cakewalk's and FL Studio's. */
    static juce::StringArray getKeymaps();
    static juce::StringArray getTimecodeRates();

    //==============================================================================
    void load();
    bool save() const;

    /** Everything, as the page gets it. */
    juce::var toVar() const;

    const Device* findDevice (const juce::String& id) const;

    /** Adds the device, or replaces the one with its id. Its name is made unique among the
        others, and only one device is the default input. Returns its id. */
    juce::String putDevice (Device device);
    bool removeDevice (const juce::String& id);

    /** A name no other device has: "Keys", else "Keys (2)" and so on. Never empty; "|" is
        left out (it names a channel in a track's input). */
    juce::String uniqueDeviceName (const juce::String& wanted, const juce::String& exceptId) const;

    static juce::var deviceToVar (const Device& device);
    static Device deviceFromVar (const juce::var& value);
    static juce::File getFile();

private:
    void tidy();
};

namespace SettingsFolder

#include "PresetBank.h"

Preset PresetBank::fromVar (const juce::var& json)
{
    Preset preset;
    preset.name = json.getProperty ("name", {}).toString().trim();

    if (auto* values = json.getProperty ("values", {}).getDynamicObject())
        for (const auto& entry : values->getProperties())
            if (entry.value.isDouble() || entry.value.isInt() || entry.value.isInt64())
                preset.values[entry.name.toString()] = (float) (double) entry.value;

    return preset;
}

juce::var PresetBank::toVar (const Preset& preset)
{
    auto* values = new juce::DynamicObject();

    for (const auto& [id, value] : preset.values)
        values->setProperty (id, value);

    auto* json = new juce::DynamicObject();
    json->setProperty ("name", preset.name);
    json->setProperty ("values", juce::var (values));
    return juce::var (json);
}

juce::Result PresetBank::load (const juce::File& projectFolder)
{
    presets.clear();
    const auto file = projectFolder.getChildFile (fileName);

    if (! file.existsAsFile())
        return juce::Result::ok();

    juce::var json;

    if (const auto parsed = juce::JSON::parse (file.loadFileAsString(), json); parsed.failed())
        return juce::Result::fail ("presets.json isn't valid JSON");

    if (const auto* list = json.getProperty ("presets", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& item : *list)
            if (auto preset = fromVar (item); preset.name.isNotEmpty())
                put (preset);

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result PresetBank::save (const juce::File& projectFolder) const
{
    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& preset : presets)
        list.add (toVar (preset));

    auto* json = new juce::DynamicObject();
    json->setProperty ("format", 1);
    json->setProperty ("presets", list);

    if (! projectFolder.getChildFile (fileName).replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (json))))
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't save presets.json");

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

int PresetBank::indexOf (const juce::String& name) const
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < presets.size(); ++i)
        if (presets[i].name.equalsIgnoreCase (name))
            return (int) i;

    return -1;
}

int PresetBank::put (const Preset& preset)
{
    if (const auto index = indexOf (preset.name); index >= 0)
    {
        presets[(size_t) index] = preset;
        return index;
    }

    presets.push_back (preset);
    return (int) presets.size() - 1;
}

juce::StringArray PresetBank::getNames() const
{
    juce::StringArray names;

    for (const auto& preset : presets)
        names.add (preset.name);

    return names;
}

    int put (const Preset& preset);

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PresetLibrary.cpp

#include "PresetLibrary.h"
#include "Preferences.h"   // Sonify's user data folder

#include <algorithm>

namespace
{
    constexpr const char* presetFormat = "Sonify preset";
    constexpr const char* bankFormat = "Sonify preset bank";
    constexpr int maxNameLength = 60;
    constexpr int maxBankPresets = 1000;

    juce::String cleanName (const juce::String& name)
    {
        return name.replaceCharacters ("\r\n\t", "   ").trim().substring (0, maxNameLength).trim();
    }

    /** A preset from a file's JSON: its name (or the file's) and its values. */
    Preset presetFrom (const juce::var& json, const juce::String& fallbackName)
    {
        auto preset = PresetBank::fromVar (json);

        if (preset.name.isEmpty())
            preset.name = fallbackName;

        preset.name = cleanName (preset.name);
        return preset;
    }

    juce::String legalName (const juce::String& name)
    {
        auto legal = juce::File::createLegalFileName (name).trim();
        return legal.isNotEmpty() ? legal : juce::String ("Preset");
    }

    bool byName (const juce::File& a, const juce::File& b)
    {
        return a.getFileName().compareNatural (b.getFileName()) < 0;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String PresetMenu::currentText() const
{
    if (juce::isPositiveAndBelow (current, names.size()))
        return names[current] + (modified ? " *" : "");

    return names.isEmpty() ? juce::String ("Default") : juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Choose a preset\xe2\x80\xa6");
}

int PresetMenu::step (int delta) const
{
    const auto count = names.size();

    if (count == 0)
        return -1;

    if (current < 0)
        return delta >= 0 ? 0 : count - 1;

    return ((current + delta) % count + count) % count;
}

bool PresetMenu::operator== (const PresetMenu& other) const
{
    return names == other.names && groups == other.groups && current == other.current && modified == other.modified
        && canSave == other.canSave && canDelete == other.canDelete && canSaveFactory == other.canSaveFactory;
}

void PresetMenus::addPresets (juce::PopupMenu& menu, const PresetMenu& presets, int firstId)
{
    juce::String heading;

    for (int i = 0; i < presets.names.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (i == 0 || presets.groups[i] != heading)
        {
            heading = presets.groups[i];
            menu.addSectionHeader (heading);
        }

        menu.addItem (firstId + i, presets.names[i], true, i == presets.current);
    }

    if (presets.names.isEmpty())
        menu.addSectionHeader ("No presets yet: Save as makes one");
}

void PresetMenus::addActions (juce::PopupMenu& menu, const PresetMenu& presets, int firstId)
{
    const auto id = [firstId] (PresetAction action) { return firstId + (int) action; };
    const auto chosen = juce::isPositiveAndBelow (presets.current, presets.names.size()) ? presets.names[presets.current] : juce::String();

    menu.addItem (id (PresetAction::save), chosen.isNotEmpty() && presets.canSave ? "Save \"" + chosen + "\"" : juce::String ("Save"), presets.canSave);
    menu.addItem (id (PresetAction::saveAs), juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Save as\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    if (presets.canSaveFactory)
        menu.addItem (id (PresetAction::saveFactory), juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Save as a factory preset\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    menu.addItem (id (PresetAction::loadFile), juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Load a preset file\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    menu.addSeparator();
    menu.addItem (id (PresetAction::saveBank), juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Save bank\xe2\x80\xa6"), ! presets.names.isEmpty());
    menu.addItem (id (PresetAction::loadBank), juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Load bank\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    menu.addSeparator();
    menu.addItem (id (PresetAction::remove), chosen.isNotEmpty() ? juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Delete \"") + chosen + juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\"\xe2\x80\xa6")
                                                                 : juce::String ("Delete"),
                  presets.canDelete);
    menu.addItem (id (PresetAction::showFolder), "Show the presets folder");
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File PresetLibrary::root()
{
    return UserData::getFolder().getChildFile ("Presets");
}

void PresetLibrary::setPlugin (const juce::String& name, const juce::File& factoryPresets, bool editable)
{
    pluginName = name.trim();
    factoryFile = factoryPresets;
    factoryEditable = editable;
    current = -1;
    modified = false;
    read();
}

juce::File PresetLibrary::getFolder() const
{
    return pluginName.isNotEmpty() ? root().getChildFile (legalName (pluginName)) : juce::File();
}

void PresetLibrary::refresh()
{
    const auto* chosen = getCurrentEntry();
    const auto name = chosen != nullptr ? chosen->preset.name : juce::String();
    const auto group = chosen != nullptr ? chosen->group : juce::String();

    read();

    current = name.isNotEmpty() ? find (name, group) : -1;

    if (current < 0)
        modified = false;
}

void PresetLibrary::read()
{
    entries.clear();

    if (pluginName.isEmpty())
        return;

    // The plugin's own first.
    if (factoryFile.existsAsFile())
    {
        PresetBank bank;
        const auto json = juce::JSON::parse (factoryFile);   // kept: the list lives in it

        if (const auto* list = json.getProperty ("presets", {}).getArray())
            for (const auto& item : *list)
                if (auto preset = PresetBank::fromVar (item); preset.name.isNotEmpty())
                    bank.put (preset);

        for (const auto& preset : bank.presets)
            entries.push_back ({ preset, factoryGroup, {} });
    }

    // Then the user's: My presets, and each bank's folder.
    const auto folder = getFolder();

    if (! folder.isDirectory())
        return;

    const auto readFolder = [this] (const juce::File& dir, const juce::String& group)
    {
        auto files = dir.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, juce::String ("*") + presetExtension);
        std::sort (files.begin(), files.end(), byName);

        for (const auto& file : files)
        {
            const auto json = juce::JSON::parse (file);

            if (! json.isObject())
                continue;

            auto preset = presetFrom (json, file.getFileNameWithoutExtension());

            if (preset.name.isNotEmpty() && find (preset.name, group) < 0)
                entries.push_back ({ preset, group, file });
        }
    };

    readFolder (folder, userGroup);

    auto banks = folder.findChildFiles (juce::File::findDirectories, false);
    std::sort (banks.begin(), banks.end(), byName);

    for (const auto& bank : banks)
        readFolder (bank, bank.getFileName());
}

int PresetLibrary::find (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& group) const
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < entries.size(); ++i)
        if (entries[i].preset.name.equalsIgnoreCase (name) && (group.isEmpty() || entries[i].group == group))
            return (int) i;

    return -1;
}

const PresetLibrary::Entry* PresetLibrary::getCurrentEntry() const
{
    return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (current, (int) entries.size()) ? &entries[(size_t) current] : nullptr;
}

void PresetLibrary::choose (int index)
{
    current = juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, (int) entries.size()) ? index : -1;
    modified = false;
}

bool PresetLibrary::restore (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& group, bool wasModified)
{
    current = name.isNotEmpty() ? find (name, group) : -1;

    // A bank's preset whose group was renamed: the name alone.
    if (current < 0 && name.isNotEmpty() && group.isNotEmpty())
        current = find (name, {});

    modified = current >= 0 && wasModified;
    return current >= 0;
}

PresetMenu PresetLibrary::getMenu() const
{
    PresetMenu menu;

    for (const auto& entry : entries)
    {
        menu.names.add (entry.preset.name);
        menu.groups.add (entry.group);
    }

    menu.current = current;
    menu.modified = modified;

    const auto* chosen = getCurrentEntry();
    menu.canSave = chosen != nullptr && (! chosen->isFactory() || factoryEditable);
    menu.canDelete = chosen != nullptr && (! chosen->isFactory() || factoryEditable);
    menu.canSaveFactory = factoryEditable && factoryFile != juce::File();
    return menu;
}

bool PresetLibrary::hasPreset (const juce::String& name, bool factory) const
{
    return find (cleanName (name), factory ? factoryGroup : userGroup) >= 0;
}

juce::String PresetLibrary::suggestedBankName() const
{
    return (pluginName.isNotEmpty() ? pluginName : juce::String ("My")) + " presets";
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Result PresetLibrary::writePresetFile (const juce::File& file, const Preset& preset) const
{
    auto json = PresetBank::toVar (preset);
    auto* fields = json.getDynamicObject();
    fields->setProperty ("format", presetFormat);
    fields->setProperty ("formatVersion", 1);
    fields->setProperty ("plugin", pluginName);

    if (! file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't make the folder " + file.getParentDirectory().getFullPathName());

    if (! file.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (json)))
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + file.getFullPathName());

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result PresetLibrary::save (const std::map<juce::String, float>& values)
{
    const auto* chosen = getCurrentEntry();

    if (chosen == nullptr)
        return juce::Result::fail ("No preset is chosen: Save as makes a new one.");

    if (chosen->isFactory())
    {
        if (! factoryEditable)
            return juce::Result::fail ("Factory presets come with the plugin: Save as keeps your version as a preset of your own.");

        return saveFactory (chosen->preset.name, values);
    }

    auto preset = chosen->preset;
    preset.values = values;

    if (const auto written = writePresetFile (chosen->file, preset); written.failed())
        return written;

    const auto name = preset.name;
    const auto group = chosen->group;
    read();
    current = find (name, group);
    modified = false;
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result PresetLibrary::saveAs (const juce::String& name, const std::map<juce::String, float>& values)
{
    const auto clean = cleanName (name);

    if (clean.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("The preset needs a name.");

    if (pluginName.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("There's no plugin to save presets for.");

    Preset preset;
    preset.name = clean;
    preset.values = values;

    // Over the one of the same name, if it's there; otherwise a file named after it.
    auto file = getFolder().getChildFile (legalName (clean) + presetExtension);

    if (const auto existing = find (clean, userGroup); existing >= 0)
        file = entries[(size_t) existing].file;
    else
        file = file.getNonexistentSibling (false);

    if (const auto written = writePresetFile (file, preset); written.failed())
        return written;

    read();
    current = find (clean, userGroup);
    modified = false;
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result PresetLibrary::saveFactory (const juce::String& name, const std::map<juce::String, float>& values)
{
    const auto clean = cleanName (name);

    if (! factoryEditable || factoryFile == juce::File())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Factory presets are made in the Plugins Creator Studio.");

    if (clean.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("The preset needs a name.");

    PresetBank bank;
    bank.load (factoryFile.getParentDirectory());

    Preset preset;
    preset.name = clean;
    preset.values = values;
    bank.put (preset);

    if (const auto saved = bank.save (factoryFile.getParentDirectory()); saved.failed())
        return saved;

    read();
    current = find (clean, factoryGroup);
    modified = false;
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result PresetLibrary::remove (int index)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, (int) entries.size()))
        return juce::Result::fail ("That preset isn't there.");

    const auto entry = entries[(size_t) index];

    if (entry.isFactory())
    {
        if (! factoryEditable)
            return juce::Result::fail ("Factory presets come with the plugin: they can't be deleted here.");

        PresetBank bank;
        bank.load (factoryFile.getParentDirectory());

        if (const auto at = bank.indexOf (entry.preset.name); at >= 0)
            bank.presets.erase (bank.presets.begin() + at);

        if (const auto saved = bank.save (factoryFile.getParentDirectory()); saved.failed())
            return saved;
    }
    else if (! entry.file.moveToTrash() && ! entry.file.deleteFile())
    {
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't delete " + entry.file.getFullPathName());
    }

    // A bank's folder with nothing left in it goes too.
    if (! entry.isFactory() && entry.group != userGroup)
        if (const auto dir = entry.file.getParentDirectory(); dir.isDirectory() && dir.getNumberOfChildFiles (juce::File::findFilesAndDirectories) == 0)
            dir.deleteRecursively();

    const auto* chosen = getCurrentEntry();
    const auto keepName = chosen != nullptr && index != current ? chosen->preset.name : juce::String();
    const auto keepGroup = chosen != nullptr ? chosen->group : juce::String();

    read();
    current = keepName.isNotEmpty() ? find (keepName, keepGroup) : -1;

    if (current < 0)
        modified = false;

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result PresetLibrary::importPreset (const juce::File& file)
{
    const auto json = juce::JSON::parse (file);

    if (! json.isObject() || ! json.getProperty ("values", {}).isObject())
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify preset.");

    const auto preset = presetFrom (json, file.getFileNameWithoutExtension());
    return saveAs (preset.name, preset.values);
}

juce::Result PresetLibrary::exportBank (const juce::File& file) const
{
    if (entries.empty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("There are no presets to put in a bank.");

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& entry : entries)
    {
        auto item = PresetBank::toVar (entry.preset);
        item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("group", entry.group);
        list.add (item);
    }

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr bank (new juce::DynamicObject());
    bank->setProperty ("format", bankFormat);
    bank->setProperty ("formatVersion", 1);
    bank->setProperty ("plugin", pluginName);
    bank->setProperty ("name", file.getFileNameWithoutExtension());
    bank->setProperty ("presets", list);

    if (! file.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (bank.get()))))
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + file.getFullPathName());

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result PresetLibrary::importBank (const juce::File& file)
{
    const auto json = juce::JSON::parse (file);
    const auto* list = json.getProperty ("presets", {}).getArray();

    if (! json.isObject() || list == nullptr)
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " isn't a Sonify preset bank.");

    if (pluginName.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("There's no plugin to load presets for.");

    auto bankName = cleanName (json.getProperty ("name", {}).toString());

    if (bankName.isEmpty())
        bankName = cleanName (file.getFileNameWithoutExtension());

    // Not over the user's own or the plugin's: a bank keeps to a folder of its own.
    if (bankName.isEmpty() || bankName.equalsIgnoreCase (userGroup) || bankName.equalsIgnoreCase (factoryGroup))
        bankName = "Bank " + bankName;

    const auto dir = getFolder().getChildFile (legalName (bankName));
    int count = 0;

    for (const auto& item : *list)
    {
        if (count >= maxBankPresets)
            break;

        const auto preset = presetFrom (item, {});

        if (preset.name.isEmpty())
            continue;

        if (const auto written = writePresetFile (dir.getChildFile (legalName (preset.name) + presetExtension), preset); written.failed())
            return written;

        ++count;
    }

    if (count == 0)
        return juce::Result::fail (file.getFileName() + " has no presets in it.");

    // Listed by name, as every folder of presets is: the first of the bank's is chosen.
    read();
    current = -1;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < entries.size() && current < 0; ++i)
        if (entries[i].group == dir.getFileName())
            current = (int) i;

    modified = false;
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

//==============================================================================
PresetUi::PresetUi (juce::Component& dialogParent, PresetLibrary& presets)
    : parent (dialogParent), library (presets)
{
}

PresetUi::~PresetUi()
{
    *alive = false;
}

void PresetUi::choose (int index)
{
    library.choose (index);
    chooseCurrentAndApply();
}

void PresetUi::chooseCurrentAndApply()
{
    if (const auto* entry = library.getCurrentEntry(); entry != nullptr && apply != nullptr)
        apply (entry->preset);

    if (changed != nullptr)
        changed();
}

void PresetUi::report (const juce::Result& result, const juce::String& what)
{
    if (result.failed())
        juce::AlertWindow::showMessageBoxAsync (juce::MessageBoxIconType::WarningIcon, what, result.getErrorMessage(), "OK", &parent);
}

void PresetUi::perform (PresetAction action)
{
    if (! library.hasPlugin())
        return;

    const auto values = [this] { return getValues != nullptr ? getValues() : std::map<juce::String, float>(); };
    const auto* chosen = library.getCurrentEntry();
    const auto chosenName = chosen != nullptr ? chosen->preset.name : juce::String();

    switch (action)
    {
        case PresetAction::save:
        {
            if (chosen == nullptr || (chosen->isFactory() && ! library.getMenu().canSave))
            {
                perform (PresetAction::saveAs);
                return;
            }

            report (library.save (values()), "Couldn't save the preset");
            break;
        }

        case PresetAction::saveAs:
        case PresetAction::saveFactory:
        {
            const bool factory = action == PresetAction::saveFactory;

            askName (factory ? "Save as a factory preset" : "Save preset",
                     factory ? "A name for the current values. Factory presets come with the plugin when it's added to Sonify."
                             : "A name for the current values. Your presets are kept on this computer, for this plugin wherever it plays.",
                     chosenName.isNotEmpty() ? chosenName : juce::String ("My preset"),
                     factory,
                     [this, factory, values] (const juce::String& name)
                     {
                         report (factory ? library.saveFactory (name, values()) : library.saveAs (name, values()), "Couldn't save the preset");

                         if (changed != nullptr)
                             changed();
                     });
            return;
        }

        case PresetAction::loadFile:
        {
            chooseFile (false, false, [this] (const juce::File& file)
            {
                const auto result = library.importPreset (file);
                report (result, "Couldn't load the preset");

                if (result.wasOk())
                    chooseCurrentAndApply();
            });
            return;
        }

        case PresetAction::saveBank:
        {
            chooseFile (true, true, [this] (const juce::File& file)
            {
                report (library.exportBank (file.withFileExtension (PresetLibrary::bankExtension)), "Couldn't save the bank");
            });
            return;
        }

        case PresetAction::loadBank:
        {
            chooseFile (false, true, [this] (const juce::File& file)
            {
                const auto result = library.importBank (file);
                report (result, "Couldn't load the bank");

                if (result.wasOk())
                    chooseCurrentAndApply();
            });
            return;
        }

        case PresetAction::remove:
        {
            if (chosen == nullptr || ! library.getMenu().canDelete)
                return;

            const auto index = library.getCurrent();
            confirm ("Delete the preset?",
                     chosen->isFactory() ? "\"" + chosenName + "\" is taken out of the plugin's factory presets."
                                         : "\"" + chosenName + "\" goes to the Recycle Bin.",
                     "Delete",
                     [this, index, chosenName]
                     {
                         // Still the same one (the list may have changed meanwhile).
                         const auto* now = library.getCurrentEntry();

                         if (now == nullptr || library.getCurrent() != index || now->preset.name != chosenName)
                             return;

                         report (library.remove (index), "Couldn't delete the preset");

                         if (changed != nullptr)
                             changed();
                     });
            return;
        }

        case PresetAction::showFolder:
        {
            const auto folder = library.getFolder();
            folder.createDirectory();
            folder.revealToUser();
            return;
        }
    }

    if (changed != nullptr)
        changed();
}

void PresetUi::askName (const juce::String& title, const juce::String& message, const juce::String& suggested, bool factory,
                        std::function<void (const juce::String&)> then)
{
    auto* dialog = new juce::AlertWindow (title, message, juce::MessageBoxIconType::NoIcon, &parent);
    dialog->addTextEditor ("name", suggested);
    dialog->addButton ("Save", 1, juce::KeyPress (juce::KeyPress::returnKey));
    dialog->addButton ("Cancel", 0, juce::KeyPress (juce::KeyPress::escapeKey));

    juce::Component::SafePointer<juce::AlertWindow> safeDialog (dialog);
    std::weak_ptr<bool> weak = alive;

    dialog->enterModalState (true, juce::ModalCallbackFunction::create ([this, weak, safeDialog, factory, then] (int result)
    {
        if (weak.expired() || safeDialog == nullptr || result != 1)
            return;

        const auto name = safeDialog->getTextEditorContents ("name").trim();

        if (name.isEmpty())
            return;

        // The same name: replaced only once the user says so.
        if (! library.hasPreset (name, factory))
        {
            then (name);
            return;
        }

        juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([this, weak, name, then]
        {
            if (! weak.expired())
                confirm ("Replace the preset?", "There's a preset called \"" + name + "\" already. Replace it with the current values?",
                         "Replace", [name, then] { then (name); });
        });
    }), true);

    juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([safeDialog]
    {
        if (safeDialog != nullptr)
            if (auto* editor = safeDialog->getTextEditor ("name"))
            {
                editor->grabKeyboardFocus();
                editor->selectAll();
            }
    });
}

void PresetUi::confirm (const juce::String& title, const juce::String& message, const juce::String& yes, std::function<void()> then)
{
    auto* dialog = new juce::AlertWindow (title, message, juce::MessageBoxIconType::QuestionIcon, &parent);
    dialog->addButton (yes, 1, juce::KeyPress (juce::KeyPress::returnKey));
    dialog->addButton ("Cancel", 0, juce::KeyPress (juce::KeyPress::escapeKey));

    std::weak_ptr<bool> weak = alive;

    dialog->enterModalState (true, juce::ModalCallbackFunction::create ([weak, then] (int result)
    {
        if (! weak.expired() && result == 1)
            then();
    }), true);
}

void PresetUi::chooseFile (bool saving, bool bank, std::function<void (const juce::File&)> then)
{
    const auto folder = library.getFolder();
    const auto start = folder.isDirectory() ? folder : PresetLibrary::root().isDirectory() ? PresetLibrary::root()
                                                     : juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userDocumentsDirectory);
    const auto extension = juce::String (bank ? PresetLibrary::bankExtension : PresetLibrary::presetExtension);

    chooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> (saving ? "Save the presets in a bank" : bank ? "Load a preset bank" : "Load a preset",
                                                   saving ? start.getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (library.suggestedBankName()) + extension)
                                                          : start,
                                                   "*" + extension);

    const auto flags = saving ? juce::FileBrowserComponent::saveMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles
                                    | juce::FileBrowserComponent::warnAboutOverwriting
                              : juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles;

    std::weak_ptr<bool> weak = alive;

    chooser->launchAsync (flags, [weak, then] (const juce::FileChooser& fc)
    {
        const auto file = fc.getResult();

        if (! weak.expired() && file != juce::File())
            then (file);
    });
}
