// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PresetLibrary.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include "PresetBank.h"

#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/** What a preset menu shows: the plugin's preset manager on its panel, and the studio's Play row. */
struct PresetMenu
{
    juce::StringArray names, groups;   // each preset's name, and the heading it's listed under
    int current = -1;                  // the chosen one (-1: none)
    bool modified = false;             // its values changed since it was chosen
    bool canSave = false;              // Save writes over the chosen one (a preset of the user's)
    bool canDelete = false;            // the chosen one can be deleted
    bool canSaveFactory = false;       // the studio: presets that come with the plugin can be made

    /** What a preset manager shows: the chosen one's name (a * when its values changed), or what
        to do when none is chosen. Never "No presets" while there are some. */
    juce::String currentText() const;

    /** The next (+1) or previous (-1) preset, round the list; -1 when there are none. */
    int step (int delta) const;

    bool operator== (const PresetMenu&) const;
    bool operator!= (const PresetMenu& other) const    { return ! operator== (other); }
};

/** What a preset menu asks for besides choosing a preset. */
enum class PresetAction { save, saveAs, saveFactory, loadFile, saveBank, loadBank, remove, showFolder };

namespace PresetMenus
{
    /** The presets under their headings, ticked when chosen: item ids firstId + index. */
    void addPresets (juce::PopupMenu& menu, const PresetMenu& presets, int firstId);

    /** Save, Save as, Load, the banks, Delete and the folder: item ids firstId + (int) action. */
    void addActions (juce::PopupMenu& menu, const PresetMenu& presets, int firstId);
}

//==============================================================================
/**
    A plugin's presets, kept the way a modern plugin keeps them:

        Factory     the presets that come with the plugin (presets.json in its project, and in the
                    plugin added to Sonify): made in the Plugins Creator Studio by the user or by
                    Sonify AI
        My presets  the user's own, saved on the hard drive, one file each:
                    <user data>\Presets\<plugin's name>\<preset>.sonifypreset
        banks       a bank file (.sonifybank) holds a whole set of presets in one file: Save bank
                    writes every preset in the list into one, Load bank brings one's presets in
                    (into a folder of their own beside My presets, listed under the bank's name)

    One preset is chosen at a time (or none), and whether its values changed since it was chosen
    is kept, so a song can remember both. The plugin made and the plugin on a track share their
    presets by the plugin's name: a preset saved in one shows in the other.

    Message thread.
*/
class PresetLibrary final
{
public:
    struct Entry
    {
        Preset preset;
        juce::String group;     // "Factory", "My presets", or a bank's name
        juce::File file;        // a preset of the user's: its file (none: it comes with the plugin)

        bool isFactory() const noexcept    { return file == juce::File(); }
    };

    static constexpr const char* presetExtension = ".sonifypreset";
    static constexpr const char* bankExtension = ".sonifybank";
    static constexpr const char* factoryGroup = "Factory";
    static constexpr const char* userGroup = "My presets";

    /** <user data>\Presets: every plugin's own folder of presets. */
    static juce::File root();

    /** Whose presets: the plugin's name (its folder of presets is named after it) and the file
        with its factory presets (presets.json, which may not be there). factoryEditable: the
        studio, where factory presets are made and deleted. Reads them all; none is chosen.
        An empty name: no plugin, no presets. */
    void setPlugin (const juce::String& pluginName, const juce::File& factoryPresets, bool factoryEditable);

    /** Reads everything again (the files may have changed), keeping the chosen preset while it's
        still there. */
    void refresh();

    const std::vector<Entry>& getEntries() const noexcept    { return entries; }
    bool isEmpty() const noexcept                            { return entries.empty(); }
    bool hasPlugin() const noexcept                          { return pluginName.isNotEmpty(); }

    /** The plugin's folder of presets (made when something is saved into it). */
    juce::File getFolder() const;

    int getCurrent() const noexcept                          { return current; }
    const Entry* getCurrentEntry() const;
    bool isModified() const noexcept                         { return modified; }

    /** Chooses one (-1: none). Applying its values is the host's. */
    void choose (int index);
    void setModified (bool shouldBeModified)                 { modified = shouldBeModified && current >= 0; }

    /** The chosen preset again, by what a song remembered of it (its name and group) and whether
        its values had changed. False (and none chosen) when it's not there any more. */
    bool restore (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& group, bool wasModified);

    PresetMenu getMenu() const;

    //==========================================================================
    /** Save: the values over the chosen preset (one of the user's). */
    juce::Result save (const std::map<juce::String, float>& values);

    /** Save as: a new preset of the user's (one with the same name in My presets is replaced),
        chosen. */
    juce::Result saveAs (const juce::String& name, const std::map<juce::String, float>& values);

    /** The studio: a preset that comes with the plugin (presets.json; the same name replaced). */
    juce::Result saveFactory (const juce::String& name, const std::map<juce::String, float>& values);

    /** Whether My presets (or, factory: the factory presets) has one by this name. */
    bool hasPreset (const juce::String& name, bool factory) const;

    /** Deletes one: a preset of the user's goes to the Recycle Bin; a factory one only in the
        studio. */
    juce::Result remove (int index);

    /** A preset file from anywhere, copied into My presets and chosen. */
    juce::Result importPreset (const juce::File& file);

    /** Every preset in the list, into one bank file. */
    juce::Result exportBank (const juce::File& file) const;

    /** A bank file's presets, into a folder of their own named after the bank (replacing ones of
        the same name there); the first of them in the list chosen. */
    juce::Result importBank (const juce::File& file);

    /** A bank's name for a file chooser: "<plugin> presets". */
    juce::String suggestedBankName() const;

private:
    void read();
    juce::Result writePresetFile (const juce::File& file, const Preset& preset) const;
    int find (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& group) const;

    juce::String pluginName;
    juce::File factoryFile;
    bool factoryEditable = false;

    std::vector<Entry> entries;
    int current = -1;
    bool modified = false;
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    The preset manager's dialogs and choices, for a window that shows a plugin's presets (the
    studio, a made plugin's own window): it asks what an action needs (a name, a file), carries
    it out on the library, and says what changed.
*/
class PresetUi final
{
public:
    PresetUi (juce::Component& dialogParent, PresetLibrary& presets);
    ~PresetUi();

    /** The plugin's values now, by parameter id (what Save writes). */
    std::function<std::map<juce::String, float>()> getValues;

    /** A preset's values, to put on the plugin. */
    std::function<void (const Preset&)> apply;

    /** The presets, or the chosen one, changed: show them again. */
    std::function<void()> changed;

    /** Chooses one and puts its values on the plugin. */
    void choose (int index);

    /** Carries out what a menu asked for. */
    void perform (PresetAction action);

private:
    void askName (const juce::String& title, const juce::String& message, const juce::String& suggested, bool factory,
                  std::function<void (const juce::String&)> then);
    void confirm (const juce::String& title, const juce::String& message, const juce::String& yes, std::function<void()> then);
    void chooseFile (bool saving, bool bank, std::function<void (const juce::File&)> then);
    void report (const juce::Result& result, const juce::String& what);
    void chooseCurrentAndApply();

    juce::Component& parent;
    PresetLibrary& library;
    std::unique_ptr<juce::FileChooser> chooser;
    std::shared_ptr<bool> alive = std::make_shared<bool> (true);

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (PresetUi)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Primitives.cpp

#include "Primitives.h"

#include "StellaPrimitives.h"
#include "Settings.h"

#include <algorithm>

//==============================================================================
GuiWidget Primitive::makeWidget() const
{
    auto json = widget.isObject() ? widget.clone() : juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    json.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("x", 0);
    json.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("y", 0);
    return GuiLayout::widgetFromVar (json);
}

//==============================================================================
const PrimitiveLibrary& PrimitiveLibrary::get()
{
    static const PrimitiveLibrary library;
    return library;
}

PrimitiveLibrary::PrimitiveLibrary()
{
    // The prepared ones, compiled into the app...
    for (int i = 0; i < StellaPrimitives::namedResourceListSize; ++i)
    {
        const auto* resource = StellaPrimitives::namedResourceList[i];
        int size = 0;

        if (const auto* data = StellaPrimitives::getNamedResource (resource, size); data != nullptr && size > 0)
        {
            // "primitive_knob.json" -> "knob" (just the name: it's not a path on this computer).
            // Sonify keeps every file in one folder, so the primitives' files say what they are.
            auto original = juce::String (StellaPrimitives::getNamedResourceOriginalFilename (resource))
                                .replaceCharacter ('\\', '/').fromLastOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false);

            if (original.startsWith ("primitive_"))
                original = original.substring (10);

            add (original.upToLastOccurrenceOf (".", false, false), juce::String::fromUTF8 (data, size));
        }
    }

    // ...then the user's own, which can replace them.
    auto files = getUserFolder().findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, "*.json");
    files.sort();

    for (const auto& file : files)
        add (file.getFileNameWithoutExtension(), file.loadFileAsString());

    std::stable_sort (primitives.begin(), primitives.end(),
                      [] (const Primitive& a, const Primitive& b) { return a.order < b.order; });
}

void PrimitiveLibrary::add (const juce::String& id, const juce::String& json)
{
    const auto parsed = juce::JSON::parse (json);

    if (! parsed.isObject() || id.isEmpty())
        return;

    Primitive p;
    p.id = id;
    p.name = parsed.getProperty ("name", id).toString();
    p.category = parsed.getProperty ("category", "More").toString();
    p.icon = parsed.getProperty ("icon", id).toString();
    p.description = parsed.getProperty ("description", {}).toString();
    p.order = (int) parsed.getProperty ("order", 1000);
    p.action = parsed.getProperty ("action", {}).toString().trim().toLowerCase();
    p.widget = parsed.getProperty ("widget", {});

    if (! p.setsBackground() && ! p.widget.isObject())
        return;   // makes nothing

    for (auto& existing : primitives)
    {
        if (existing.id == id)
        {
            existing = p;
            return;
        }
    }

    primitives.add (p);
}

juce::StringArray PrimitiveLibrary::getCategories() const
{
    juce::StringArray categories;

    for (const auto& p : primitives)
        categories.addIfNotAlreadyThere (p.category);

    return categories;
}

const Primitive* PrimitiveLibrary::find (const juce::String& id) const
{
    for (const auto& p : primitives)
        if (p.id == id)
            return &p;

    return nullptr;
}

juce::File PrimitiveLibrary::getUserFolder()
{
    return Settings::getDataFolder().getChildFile ("Primitives");
}

juce::String PrimitiveLibrary::idFromDrag (const juce::var& description)
{
    const auto text = description.toString();
    return text.startsWith ("primitive:") ? text.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("primitive:", false, false) : juce::String();
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Primitives.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include "GuiLayout.h"

//==============================================================================
/**
    A primitive: one item of the Edit UI tab's toolbox, FlowStone-style. Each is a small
    JSON file in the primitives folder, compiled into the app:

        { "name": "Knob", "category": "Controls", "order": 10, "icon": "knob",
          "description": "A round knob that turns one parameter.",
          "widget": { "type": "knob", "size": 56, "style": "black" } }

    "widget" is the element it makes, written like an element of gui/layout.json (without
    x and y: it lands where it's dropped). A primitive with "action": "background" makes no
    element: it sets the window's background picture.

    More primitives can sit in <user data>\Plugins Creator\Primitives: they're read at start
    up, and one with the same file name as a built-in one replaces it.
*/
struct Primitive
{
    juce::String id;                 // the file name, without .json
    juce::String name, category, icon, description;
    int order = 0;
    juce::String action;             // "background", or empty
    juce::var widget;                // the element, as in layout.json

    /** The element it makes, at the top-left of the plugin window. */
    GuiWidget makeWidget() const;

    bool setsBackground() const      { return action == "background"; }
};

//==============================================================================
class PrimitiveLibrary final
{
public:
    /** Read once, the first time it's asked for. */
    static const PrimitiveLibrary& get();

    /** All primitives, by order. */
    const juce::Array<Primitive>& getAll() const noexcept    { return primitives; }

    /** The categories, in the order of their first primitive. */
    juce::StringArray getCategories() const;

    const Primitive* find (const juce::String& id) const;

    /** Where the user's own primitives go: <user data>\Plugins Creator\Primitives. */
    static juce::File getUserFolder();

    /** What a toolbox drag carries: "primitive:<id>". */
    static juce::String dragDescription (const juce::String& id)    { return "primitive:" + id; }
    static juce::String idFromDrag (const juce::var& description);

private:
    PrimitiveLibrary();
    void add (const juce::String& id, const juce::String& json);

    juce::Array<Primitive> primitives;
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Project.cpp

#include "Project.h"

namespace
{
    juce::String slug (const juce::String& text)
    {
        juce::String result;

        for (auto c : text.toLowerCase())
            if (juce::CharacterFunctions::isLetterOrDigit (c) && c < 128)
                result << juce::String::charToString (c);

        return result;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String Project::kindToString (PluginKind kind)
{
    switch (kind)
    {
        case PluginKind::instrument:  return "instrument";
        case PluginKind::effect:      return "effect";
        case PluginKind::noteEffect:  return "note-effect";
        case PluginKind::widget:      return "widget";
    }

    return "instrument";
}

PluginKind Project::kindFromString (const juce::String& text)
{
    if (text == "effect")       return PluginKind::effect;
    if (text == "note-effect")  return PluginKind::noteEffect;
    if (text == "widget")       return PluginKind::widget;

    return PluginKind::instrument;
}

juce::String Project::kindDisplayName (PluginKind kind)
{
    switch (kind)
    {
        case PluginKind::instrument:  return "Instrument";
        case PluginKind::effect:      return "Effect";
        case PluginKind::noteEffect:  return "MIDI FX";
        case PluginKind::widget:      return "Widget";
    }

    return "Instrument";
}

juce::String Project::makePluginId (const juce::String& vendor, const juce::String& name)
{
    auto vendorPart = slug (vendor);
    auto namePart = slug (name);

    if (vendorPart.isEmpty())  vendorPart = "vendor";
    if (namePart.isEmpty())    namePart = "plugin";

    // A domain label can't start with a digit.
    if (juce::CharacterFunctions::isDigit (vendorPart[0]))  vendorPart = "v" + vendorPart;
    if (juce::CharacterFunctions::isDigit (namePart[0]))    namePart = "p" + namePart;

    return "com." + vendorPart + "." + namePart;
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Result Project::create (const juce::File& parentFolder, ProjectInfo newInfo)
{
    newInfo.name = newInfo.name.trim();
    newInfo.vendor = newInfo.vendor.trim();

    if (newInfo.name.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("The plugin needs a name.");

    if (newInfo.vendor.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("The plugin needs a company name.");

    if (! parentFolder.isDirectory() && ! parentFolder.createDirectory())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't create the folder " + parentFolder.getFullPathName());

    const auto legalName = juce::File::createLegalFileName (newInfo.name).trim();
    auto newFolder = parentFolder.getChildFile (legalName.isNotEmpty() ? legalName : juce::String ("Plugin"));

    if (newFolder.exists())
        newFolder = parentFolder.getNonexistentChildFile (newFolder.getFileName(), {}, true);

    if (! newFolder.createDirectory())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't create the folder " + newFolder.getFullPathName());

    if (newInfo.pluginId.isEmpty())
        newInfo.pluginId = makePluginId (newInfo.vendor, newInfo.name);

    newInfo.uuid = juce::Uuid().toDashedString();
    newInfo.created = juce::Time::getCurrentTime().toISO8601 (true);

    const auto previousFolder = folder;
    const auto previousInfo = info;
    const auto wasOpen = opened;

    folder = newFolder;
    info = newInfo;

    auto result = makeSubfolders();

    if (result.wasOk())
        result = write();

    if (result.failed())
    {
        newFolder.deleteRecursively();
        folder = previousFolder;
        info = previousInfo;
        opened = wasOpen;
        return result;
    }

    opened = true;
    notify();
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result Project::open (const juce::File& projectFileOrFolder)
{
    const auto file = projectFileOrFolder.isDirectory() ? projectFileOrFolder.getChildFile (fileName)
                                                        : projectFileOrFolder;

    if (! file.existsAsFile())
        return juce::Result::fail ("There's no plugin project at " + projectFileOrFolder.getFullPathName());

    juce::var parsed;
    const auto parseResult = juce::JSON::parse (file.loadFileAsString(), parsed);

    if (parseResult.failed() || ! parsed.isObject())
        return juce::Result::fail ("The project file is damaged: " + file.getFullPathName());

    if ((int) parsed.getProperty ("format", 0) > formatVersion)
        return juce::Result::fail ("This project was made by a newer version of Sonify's Plugins Creator Studio.");

    ProjectInfo loaded;
    loaded.name     = parsed.getProperty ("name", {}).toString().trim();
    loaded.vendor   = parsed.getProperty ("vendor", {}).toString().trim();
    loaded.kind     = kindFromString (parsed.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString());
    loaded.version  = parsed.getProperty ("version", "1.0.0").toString();
    loaded.pluginId = parsed.getProperty ("pluginId", {}).toString();
    loaded.uuid     = parsed.getProperty ("uuid", {}).toString();
    loaded.created  = parsed.getProperty ("created", {}).toString();
    loaded.firstBuilt = parsed.getProperty ("firstBuilt", {}).toString();

    if (loaded.name.isEmpty())
        loaded.name = file.getParentDirectory().getFileName();

    if (loaded.vendor.isEmpty())
        loaded.vendor = "My Company";

    // Projects copied by hand may lack their ids; they get new ones once.
    bool repaired = false;

    if (loaded.pluginId.isEmpty())
    {
        loaded.pluginId = makePluginId (loaded.vendor, loaded.name);
        repaired = true;
    }

    if (loaded.uuid.isEmpty())
    {
        loaded.uuid = juce::Uuid().toDashedString();
        repaired = true;
    }

    folder = file.getParentDirectory();
    info = loaded;
    opened = true;

    makeSubfolders();

    if (repaired)
        write();

    notify();
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result Project::saveAs (const juce::String& newName)
{
    if (! opened)
        return juce::Result::fail ("No project is open.");

    const auto name = newName.trim();

    if (name.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("The copy needs a name.");

    const auto parent = folder.getParentDirectory();
    const auto legalName = juce::File::createLegalFileName (name).trim();
    auto newFolder = parent.getChildFile (legalName.isNotEmpty() ? legalName : juce::String ("Plugin"));

    if (newFolder.exists())
        newFolder = parent.getNonexistentChildFile (newFolder.getFileName(), {}, true);

    if (! folder.copyDirectoryTo (newFolder))
    {
        newFolder.deleteRecursively();
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't copy the plugin to " + newFolder.getFullPathName());
    }

    const auto previousFolder = folder;
    const auto previousInfo = info;

    folder = newFolder;
    info.name = name;
    info.pluginId = makePluginId (info.vendor, name);
    info.uuid = juce::Uuid().toDashedString();
    info.created = juce::Time::getCurrentTime().toISO8601 (true);

    if (info.pluginId == previousInfo.pluginId)   // a name that reads the same in an id
        info.pluginId << "copy";

    if (const auto result = write(); result.failed())
    {
        newFolder.deleteRecursively();
        folder = previousFolder;
        info = previousInfo;
        return result;
    }

    notify();
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

void Project::close()
{
    if (! opened)
        return;

    opened = false;
    folder = juce::File();
    info = ProjectInfo();
    notify();
}

void Project::markBuilt()
{
    if (! opened || info.firstBuilt.isNotEmpty())
        return;

    // Quietly: nothing the studio shows changes.
    info.firstBuilt = juce::Time::getCurrentTime().toISO8601 (true);
    write();
}

juce::Result Project::updateInfo (const juce::String& newName, const juce::String& newVendor,
                                  PluginKind newKind, const juce::String& newVersion)
{
    if (! opened)
        return juce::Result::fail ("No project is open.");

    if (newName.trim().isEmpty() || newVendor.trim().isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("The plugin needs a name and a company name.");

    const auto previous = info;

    info.name = newName.trim();
    info.vendor = newVendor.trim();
    info.kind = newKind;
    info.version = newVersion.trim().isNotEmpty() ? newVersion.trim() : previous.version;

    const auto result = write();

    if (result.failed())
    {
        info = previous;
        return result;
    }

    notify();
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Result Project::makeSubfolders() const
{
    for (const auto& sub : { getModulesFolder(), getGuiFolder(), getAssetsFolder() })
        if (! sub.isDirectory() && ! sub.createDirectory())
            return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't create the folder " + sub.getFullPathName());

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Result Project::write() const
{
    auto* object = new juce::DynamicObject();
    const juce::var json (object);

    object->setProperty ("format", formatVersion);
    object->setProperty ("app", juce::String ("Sonify ") + JUCE_APPLICATION_VERSION_STRING);
    object->setProperty ("name", info.name);
    object->setProperty ("vendor", info.vendor);
    object->setProperty ("kind", kindToString (info.kind));
    object->setProperty ("version", info.version);
    object->setProperty ("pluginId", info.pluginId);
    object->setProperty ("uuid", info.uuid);
    object->setProperty ("created", info.created);

    if (info.firstBuilt.isNotEmpty())
        object->setProperty ("firstBuilt", info.firstBuilt);

    const auto file = getProjectFile();
    juce::TemporaryFile temp (file);

    if (! temp.getFile().replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (json))
        || ! temp.overwriteTargetFileWithTemporary())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + file.getFullPathName());

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

void Project::notify()
{
    if (onChanged != nullptr)
        onChanged();
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Project.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <functional>

//==============================================================================
enum class PluginKind
{
    instrument,   // MIDI in, audio out
    effect,       // audio in, audio out
    noteEffect,   // MIDI in, MIDI out (Stella's; in Sonify a MIDI FX is a MIDI device)
    widget        // anything else (a tuner, a visualizer, a tool...): audio and MIDI in, audio out
};

//==============================================================================
/** What a plugin is called and who makes it. The ids are fixed when the project is
    created and never change, so hosts keep recognising the plugin across versions. */
struct ProjectInfo
{
    juce::String name;
    juce::String vendor;
    PluginKind kind = PluginKind::instrument;
    juce::String version { "1.0.0" };
    juce::String pluginId;   // reverse-DNS, e.g. com.mycompany.myplugin (the CLAP id)
    juce::String uuid;       // the VST3 class id is derived from this
    juce::String created;    // ISO 8601
    juce::String firstBuilt; // ISO 8601: when it first built and played (empty: not yet)
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    A plugin being built: one folder on disk.

        <folder>/project.stella   what the plugin is (JSON)
        <folder>/modules/         its DSP modules, written by the AI
        <folder>/gui/             its GUI layout and widget styles
        <folder>/assets/          images and other files the plugin carries

    The AI writes straight into the folder and the compiler reads from it, so the project
    on disk is always the current one; the studio's Save only writes what's waiting (the
    GUI's last change). Changes to the project's info are written at once. Save as copies
    the whole folder into a new one, as a plugin of its own.
*/
class Project final
{
public:
    static constexpr const char* fileName = "project.stella";
    static constexpr int formatVersion = 1;

    Project() = default;

    /** Makes <parentFolder>/<name> (numbered if taken) with its subfolders and file. */
    juce::Result create (const juce::File& parentFolder, ProjectInfo newInfo);

    /** Accepts the project file or its folder. */
    juce::Result open (const juce::File& projectFileOrFolder);

    void close();

    /** Copies the whole project into a new folder beside it, <newName> (numbered if taken),
        and goes on there as a plugin of its own: the new name, new ids (so a host shows it
        beside the original). The original stays as it was. */
    juce::Result saveAs (const juce::String& newName);

    bool isOpen() const noexcept                    { return opened; }
    const ProjectInfo& getInfo() const noexcept     { return info; }

    /** It built and plays: the first time, that's noted in the project file (until then,
        Fanan AI's foundation builder works on it). */
    void markBuilt();

    /** Writes the new info at once. The ids and creation time can't be changed. */
    juce::Result updateInfo (const juce::String& newName, const juce::String& newVendor,
                             PluginKind newKind, const juce::String& newVersion);

    juce::File getFolder() const                    { return folder; }
    juce::File getProjectFile() const               { return folder.getChildFile (fileName); }
    juce::File getModulesFolder() const             { return folder.getChildFile ("modules"); }
    juce::File getGuiFolder() const                 { return folder.getChildFile ("gui"); }
    juce::File getAssetsFolder() const              { return folder.getChildFile ("assets"); }

    /** Called on the message thread whenever a project opens, closes or changes. */
    std::function<void()> onChanged;

    //==============================================================================
    static juce::String kindToString (PluginKind kind);
    static PluginKind kindFromString (const juce::String& text);
    static juce::String kindDisplayName (PluginKind kind);

    /** e.g. "My Company" + "Big Reverb" -> "com.mycompany.bigreverb" */
    static juce::String makePluginId (const juce::String& vendor, const juce::String& name);

private:
    juce::Result write() const;
    juce::Result makeSubfolders() const;
    void notify();

    juce::File folder;
    ProjectInfo info;
    bool opened = false;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Project)
};

    /** What a plugin of each type is, for the AI. */
    juce::String kindRole (PluginKind kind)
    {
        switch (kind)
        {
            case PluginKind::effect:
                return "It's an effect: it reads plugin.in L / plugin.in R and writes plugin.out L / plugin.out R.";

            case PluginKind::widget:
                return "It's a widget: something that isn't an instrument, an effect or a MIDI FX (a tuner, a visualizer, an analyzer, "
                       "a tool, or something new). It gets the audio (plugin.in L / plugin.in R) and the notes, and writes plugin.out L / "
                       "plugin.out R: pass the audio through unchanged unless it's meant to change it. Its panel is often the heart of it.";

            case PluginKind::noteEffect:
                return "It's an old MIDI effect project: plugins made here don't send MIDI. A MIDI FX is made by starting a new plugin "
                       "of type MIDI FX (it's built as one of Sonify's MIDI devices, in this same conversation panel).";

            case PluginKind::instrument:
                break;
        }

        return "It's an instrument: notes in, audio out on plugin.out L / plugin.out R.";
    }

    juce::var tool (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& description, const juce::var& properties,
                    const juce::StringArray& required)
    {
        auto schema = object();
        schema.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("type", "object");
        schema.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("properties", properties.isObject() ? properties : object());

        juce::Array<juce::var> needed;

        for (const auto& r : required)
            needed.add (r);

        schema.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("required", needed);

        auto definition = object();
        definition.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("name", name);
        definition.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("description", description);
        definition.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("input_schema", schema);
        return definition;
    }

    /** One element of the GUI in a line, its fields named as in layout.json: what the AI needs
        to find it and change it with edit_layout. */
    /** A shape's layer style, the effects that are on: "bevel,stroke,dropShadow". */
    juce::String effectsOf (const GuiWidget& w)
    {
        const auto found = w.settings.find ("effects");

        if (found == w.settings.end())
            return {};

        const auto style = LayerStyle::fromVar (found->second);
        juce::StringArray on;

        if (style.bevel.enabled)         on.add (style.bevel.contourEnabled ? "bevel+contour" : "bevel");
        if (style.stroke.enabled)        on.add ("stroke");
        if (style.innerShadow.enabled)   on.add ("innerShadow");
        if (style.colourOverlay.enabled) on.add ("colorOverlay");
        if (style.dropShadow.enabled)    on.add ("dropShadow");

        return on.joinIntoString (",");
    }

    juce::String elementLine (int index, const GuiWidget& w, const juce::StringArray& paramIds)
    {
        juce::String line;
        const bool dropdown = w.type == GuiWidget::Type::custom && w.element == GuiLayout::builtInElementFor ("dropdown");
        const auto kind = w.type == GuiWidget::Type::shape ? w.shapeKind() : juce::String();
        line << index << ": " << (dropdown ? juce::String ("dropdown")
                                  : kind.isNotEmpty() && kind != "drawn" ? kind   // a shape's type is its kind
                                                                          : GuiLayout::typeName (w.type));

        if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::custom && ! dropdown)
            line << " element=" << (w.element.isNotEmpty() ? w.element : juce::String ("(none)"));

        if (w.label.isNotEmpty())
            line << " \"" << w.label.replaceCharacters ("\r\n", "  ").substring (0, 48) << "\"";

        auto addParam = [&] (const juce::String& key, const juce::String& id)
        {
            line << " " << key << "=" << id;

            if (! paramIds.isEmpty() && ! paramIds.contains (id))
                line << " (not in the plugin yet)";
        };

        if (w.param.isNotEmpty())
            addParam ("param", w.param);

        for (const auto& [role, id] : w.roles)
            addParam (role, id);

        if (w.source.isNotEmpty())
            line << " source=" << w.source;

        for (const auto& [role, watched] : w.sources)
            line << " source." << role << "=" << watched;

        if (! w.options.isEmpty() && (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::selector || w.type == GuiWidget::Type::custom))
            line << " options=" << w.options.joinIntoString ("|").substring (0, 80);

        if (w.image.isNotEmpty())
            line << " image=" << w.image;

        if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::keyboard)
            line << " low=" << GuiLayout::noteName (w.lowNote) << " high=" << GuiLayout::noteName (w.highNote);

        line << " x=" << w.bounds.getX() << " y=" << w.bounds.getY();

        if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::knob)
            line << " size=" << w.bounds.getWidth();
        else
            line << " w=" << w.bounds.getWidth() << " h=" << w.bounds.getHeight();

        if (w.style.isNotEmpty())
            line << " style=\"" << w.style << "\"";

        // A shape's material and its layer style (read gui/layout.json for their settings).
        if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::shape)
        {
            if (const auto found = w.settings.find ("material"); found != w.settings.end() && found->second.toString().isNotEmpty())
                line << " material=" << found->second.toString();

            if (const auto effects = effectsOf (w); effects.isNotEmpty())
                line << " effects=" << effects;

            if (const auto found = w.settings.find ("rounding"); found != w.settings.end())
                line << " rounding=" << juce::String ((double) found->second, 2);
        }

        // A meter's display (read gui/layout.json for its colours and the rest).
        if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::meter)
            if (const auto found = w.settings.find ("display"); found != w.settings.end() && found->second.toString().isNotEmpty())
                line << " display=" << found->second.toString();

        // Its text's font, and the preset manager's corners.
        if (w.font.isNotEmpty())
            line << " font=\"" << w.font << "\"";

        if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::preset && w.rounding >= 0.0f)
            line << " rounding=" << juce::String (w.rounding, 2);

        // Every element is an object: turned, see-through, on a page.
        if (w.shownAngle() != 0.0f)
            line << " angle=" << juce::String (w.angle, 1).trimCharactersAtEnd ("0").trimCharactersAtEnd (".");

        if (w.shownOpacity() < 1.0f)
            line << " opacity=" << juce::String (w.opacity, 2);

        if (w.page.isNotEmpty())
            line << " page=\"" << w.page << "\"";

        return line;
    }

    /** An element's index as the AI gave it: a number (or a number in a string); -1 if it isn't one. */
    int indexFrom (const juce::var& value)
    {
        if (value.isInt() || value.isInt64())
            return (int) value;

        if (value.isDouble())
        {
            const auto number = (double) value;
            return std::abs (number - std::round (number)) < 1.0e-6 ? juce::roundToInt (number) : -1;
        }

        const auto text = value.toString().trim();
        return text.isNotEmpty() && text.containsOnly ("0123456789") ? text.getIntValue() : -1;
    }

    /** An element with some of its fields set anew (named as in layout.json); the rest stay. */
    GuiWidget changedWidget (const GuiWidget& widget, const juce::var& change)
    {
        auto merged = GuiLayout::widgetToVar (widget);
        auto* target = merged.getDynamicObject();
        const auto* fields = change.getDynamicObject();

        if (target == nullptr || fields == nullptr)
            return widget;

        // Fields that go by more than one name: the one given replaces them all.
        const juce::StringArray synonyms[] { { "label", "text" }, { "color", "colour" }, { "style", "look" },
                                             { "low", "from" }, { "high", "to" } };

        for (const auto& field : fields->getProperties())
            for (const auto& names : synonyms)
                if (names.contains (field.name.toString()))
                    for (const auto& name : names)
                        target->removeProperty (name);

        // A knob's diameter is its "size" (or "w").
        const auto typeAfter = fields->hasProperty ("type") ? GuiLayout::typeFromName (fields->getProperty ("type").toString()) : widget.type;

        if (typeAfter == GuiWidget::Type::knob && (fields->hasProperty ("size") || fields->hasProperty ("w")))
        {
            target->removeProperty ("size");
            target->removeProperty ("w");
        }

        for (const auto& field : fields->getProperties())
            if (field.name.toString() != "index")
                target->setProperty (field.name, field.value);

        return GuiLayout::widgetFromVar (merged);
    }

    bool isIdentifier (const juce::String& text)
    {
        return text.isNotEmpty() && text.length() <= 64
            && text.containsOnly ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_")
            && ! juce::CharacterFunctions::isDigit (text[0]);
    }

    int countLines (const juce::String& text)
    {
        return juce::StringArray::fromLines (text).size();
    }

    /** A picture's size in pixels, read once per version of the file. */
    juce::Point<int> pictureSize (const juce::File& file)
    {
        static std::map<juce::String, std::pair<juce::Time, juce::Point<int>>> known;

        const auto modified = file.getLastModificationTime();
        auto& entry = known[file.getFullPathName()];

        if (entry.first != modified)
        {
            const auto image = juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom (file);
            entry = { modified, { image.getWidth(), image.getHeight() } };
        }

        return entry.second;
    }

    /** What a painter element asks while it paints: its settings, label, options and colour from
        the call, the plugin's pictures; no parameters, no presets, no sound, the clock stopped. */
    struct PainterHost final : stella::ui::ElementHost
    {
        juce::String label;
        juce::StringArray options;
        std::map<juce::String, juce::String> settings;
        std::uint32_t colourValue = 0;
        juce::File images;                              // gui/images
        std::map<std::string, juce::Image> pictures;   // read when asked for

        juce::Image pictureNamed (const std::string& name)
        {
            const auto file = juce::String::fromUTF8 (name.data(), (int) name.size()).trim();

            // A file name only: nothing outside the images folder.
            if (file.isEmpty() || file.containsAnyOf ("/\\:") || file.startsWithChar ('.') || images == juce::File())
                return {};

            auto found = pictures.find (name);

            if (found == pictures.end())
                found = pictures.emplace (name, juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom (images.getChildFile (file))).first;

            return found->second;
        }

        bool pictureSize (int, const std::string& name, int& width, int& height) override
        {
            const auto image = pictureNamed (name);
            width = image.getWidth();
            height = image.getHeight();
            return image.isValid();
        }

        bool readPicture (int, const std::string& name, int width, int height, std::uint32_t* destination) override
        {
            auto image = pictureNamed (name);

            if (! image.isValid() || width <= 0 || height <= 0 || destination == nullptr)
                return false;

            if (image.getWidth() != width || image.getHeight() != height)
                image = image.rescaled (width, height, juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);

            image = image.convertedToFormat (juce::Image::ARGB);
            const juce::Image::BitmapData data (image, juce::Image::BitmapData::readOnly);

            if (data.pixelStride != (int) sizeof (juce::PixelARGB))
                return false;

            for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y)
            {
                const auto* line = reinterpret_cast<const juce::PixelARGB*> (data.getLinePointer (y));

                for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x)
                    destination[(size_t) y * (size_t) width + (size_t) x] = line[x].getInARGBMaskOrder();
            }

            return true;
        }

        bool paramInfo (int, int, int, float&) override                  { return false; }
        int findSlot (int, const std::string&) override                  { return -1; }
        void setValue (int, int, float) override                         {}
        void gesture (int, int, bool) override                           {}

        bool text (int, int which, int index, const std::string& key, std::string& result) override
        {
            if (which == labelText && label.isNotEmpty())
            {
                result = label.toStdString();
                return true;
            }

            if (which == optionText && juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, options.size()))
            {
                result = options[index].toStdString();
                return true;
            }

            if (which == settingText)
            {
                if (const auto found = settings.find (juce::String (key)); found != settings.end())
                {
                    result = found->second.toStdString();
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        int numOptions (int) override                                    { return options.size(); }
        std::uint32_t colour (int) override                              { return colourValue; }
        float level (int, bool) override                                 { return 0.0f; }
        void readScope (int, float* destination, int n) override         { std::fill (destination, destination + juce::jmax (0, n), 0.0f); }
        void playNote (int, int, float) override                         {}
        bool isNoteDown (int) override                                   { return false; }
        double seconds() override                                        { return 0.0; }
    };

    /** A look whose shadow or glow falls past the control: how far, for the layout to leave room. */
    juce::String shadowNote (const Looks::Look& look)
    {
        const auto side = (float) juce::jmax (8, juce::jmin (look.doc.canvasWidth, look.doc.canvasHeight));
        const auto reach = LayerRender::overhangOf (look.doc);

        if (reach <= 0.0f)
            return {};

        return " [its shadow falls " + juce::String (juce::roundToInt (reach / side * 100.0f)) + "% of its size past the control: leave that room]";
    }

    /** A look's layers, bottom first, each with its material: "layers: Shadow, Bezel=anodized, Body=titanium, Pointer". */
    juce::String layersNote (const Looks::Look& look)
    {
        juce::StringArray names;

        for (const auto& layer : look.doc.layers)
            if (layer.visible)
                names.add (layer.name + (layer.prim.material.isNotEmpty() ? "=" + layer.prim.material : juce::String()));

        return names.isEmpty() ? juce::String() : " {layers: " + names.joinIntoString (", ") + "}";
    }

    /** Where a look's own surface is, for a material given without a layer: the layer called
        Body, Top, Cap, Face, Head or Knob, else the first with a material (-1: none). */
    int bodyLayerOf (const LayerDoc& doc)
    {
        for (const auto* wanted : { "body", "top", "cap", "face", "head", "knob" })
            for (size_t i = 0; i < doc.layers.size(); ++i)
                if (doc.layers[i].name.trim().equalsIgnoreCase (wanted))
                    return (int) i;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < doc.layers.size(); ++i)
            if (doc.layers[i].prim.material.isNotEmpty())
                return (int) i;

        return -1;
    }

    /** A layer's surface from make_look's settings: its material, finish, colours, texture and
        pattern. Empty, or what was wrong. described: what changed, in a few words. */
    juce::String setSurface (DocLayer& layer, const juce::var& settings, juce::StringArray& described)
    {
        using namespace MaterialChoices;
        auto& p = layer.prim;
        auto text = [&settings] (const char* key) { return settings.getProperty (key, {}).toString().trim(); };
        auto number = [&settings] (const char* key, float fallback, float low, float high)
        {
            return juce::jlimit (low, high, settings.hasProperty (key) ? (float) (double) settings.getProperty (key, fallback) : fallback);
        };

        if (settings.hasProperty ("material"))
        {
            const auto material = text ("material").toLowerCase();

            if (material.isEmpty() || material == "none" || material == "flat")
            {
                p.material.clear();
                p.materialFinish.clear();
                p.materialColour2 = {};
                described.add ("no material");
            }
            else
            {
                const auto all = allMaterials();
                const auto index = indexOf (all, material);

                if (index < 0)
                {
                    juce::StringArray names;

                    for (const auto& c : all)
                        names.add (c.name);

                    return "There's no material \"" + material + "\". The materials: " + names.joinIntoString (", ") + ".";
                }

                // A new material comes in its own colours and finish, as in the Knob Studio.
                p.material = all[(size_t) index].name;
                juce::Colour main, second;
                materialColours (p.material, main, second);
                p.colour = main;
                p.materialColour2 = {};
                p.materialFinish.clear();
                described.add (p.material);
            }
        }

        if (settings.hasProperty ("finish"))
        {
            const auto index = indexOf (finishChoices(), text ("finish"));

            if (index < 0)
                return "There's no finish \"" + text ("finish") + "\". The finishes: natural, polished, satin, brushed, hammered, sandblasted, matte, liquid.";

            p.materialFinish = index == 0 ? juce::String() : juce::String (finishChoices()[(size_t) index].name);
            described.add (finishChoices()[(size_t) index].name);
        }

        if (const auto colour = text ("color").isNotEmpty() ? text ("color") : text ("colour"); colour.isNotEmpty())
        {
            p.colour = GuiLayout::colourFromString (colour, p.colour);
            described.add ("colour " + colour);
        }

        if (const auto colour = text ("color2").isNotEmpty() ? text ("color2") : text ("colour2"); colour.isNotEmpty())
            p.materialColour2 = GuiLayout::colourFromString (colour, p.materialColour2);

        p.materialScale = number ("scale", p.materialScale, 0.25f, 4.0f);
        p.materialGrain = number ("grain", p.materialGrain, 0.0f, 2.0f);

        if (settings.hasProperty ("pattern"))
        {
            const auto index = indexOf (patternChoices(), text ("pattern"));

            if (index < 0)
            {
                juce::StringArray names;

                for (const auto& c : patternChoices())
                    names.add (c.name);

                return "There's no pattern \"" + text ("pattern") + "\". The patterns: " + names.joinIntoString (", ") + ".";
            }

            p.pattern = index == 0 ? juce::String() : juce::String (patternChoices()[(size_t) index].name);

            if (p.pattern.isNotEmpty())
                described.add (p.pattern + " pattern");
        }

        if (settings.hasProperty ("patternBlend"))
        {
            const auto index = indexOf (blendChoices(), text ("patternBlend"));

            if (index < 0)
                return "There's no pattern blend \"" + text ("patternBlend") + "\". The blends: normal, multiply, screen, overlay, softlight, "
                       "add, darken, lighten, emboss, deboss, engrave.";

            p.patternBlend = blendChoices()[(size_t) index].name;
        }

        if (const auto colour = text ("patternColor").isNotEmpty() ? text ("patternColor") : text ("patternColour"); colour.isNotEmpty())
            p.patternColour = GuiLayout::colourFromString (colour, p.patternColour);

        p.patternOpacity = number ("patternOpacity", p.patternOpacity, 0.0f, 100.0f);
        p.patternSize = number ("patternSize", p.patternSize, 2.0f, 200.0f);
        p.patternAngle = number ("patternAngle", p.patternAngle, -180.0f, 180.0f);
        return {};
    }

    /** Where a control wearing a look draws it, as the canvas does (a knob: the square above its caption). */
    juce::Rectangle<int> lookArea (const GuiWidget& w)
    {
        if (w.type == GuiWidget::Type::knob)
        {
            const auto size = juce::jmax (8, juce::jmin (w.bounds.getWidth(), w.bounds.getHeight() - GuiLayout::captionHeight));
            return { w.bounds.getX() + (w.bounds.getWidth() - size) / 2, w.bounds.getY(), size, size };
        }

        return w.bounds;
    }

    /** A picture's file name from what the AI asked for: letters, digits, - and _ only, .png. */
    juce::String pictureFileName (const juce::String& asked)
    {
        auto stem = asked.trim();

        if (stem.endsWithIgnoreCase (".png"))
            stem = stem.dropLastCharacters (4);

        stem = stem.retainCharacters ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_").substring (0, 48);
        return stem.isEmpty() ? juce::String() : stem + ".png";
    }
}

//==============================================================================
ProjectTools::ProjectTools (Project& p, LivePreview& lp)
    : project (p), preview (lp)
{
    // Code brought for a plugin that was never created (Sonify closed before it was) isn't
    // for whatever opens next.
    waitingReferenceFolder().deleteRecursively();
}

ProjectTools::~ProjectTools()
{
    // Work still under way answers no one now.
    *alive = false;
    worker.removeAllJobs (true, 10000);
}

const juce::String& ProjectTools::getGuide()
{
    static const juce::String guide = [] {
        juce::String text = juce::String::fromUTF8 (StellaRuntimeData::stella_builder_guide_md, StellaRuntimeData::stella_builder_guide_mdSize);

        // The file's path title is for the project, not for the AI.
        if (text.startsWith ("<!--"))
            text = text.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("-->", false, false).trimStart();

        text << "\n\n## stella_api.h\n```cpp\n"
             << juce::String::fromUTF8 (StellaRuntimeData::stella_api_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_api_hSize)
             << "\n```\n"
             << "\n## stella_element_api.h (programmed GUI elements)\n```cpp\n"
             << juce::String::fromUTF8 (StellaRuntimeData::stella_element_api_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_element_api_hSize)
             << "\n```\n";

        if (const auto skills = Skills::index (Skills::For::plugins); skills.isNotEmpty())
            text << "\n" << skills;

        return text;
    }();

    return guide;
}
