// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\RecordingAnalysis.h

#pragma once

#include "AudioMedia.h"
#include "TempoMap.h"

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

class AudioEngine;

//==============================================================================
/**
    Backing for a recording: listens to an audio track for its tempo, its beat and its chords,
    so Sonify's session players can play along with it (Track > Add Session Players, From Track).

    The tempo comes from how regularly the sound's onsets come round (their autocorrelation,
    leaning toward everyday tempos), then the one steady beat that fits the onsets best over the
    whole recording; the bars start where the chords tend to change and the low end hits. The
    chords come from the notes heard on each beat (spectral peaks gathered into notes by their
    harmonics, tuned to the recording), matched against major, minor, seventh, sus, diminished
    and power chords, a bar at a time, or two to a bar when it clearly changes in the middle.

    A recording made to Sonify's click already follows the song's beat, and keeps its place. Any
    other has a tempo of its own: the song can take it, and the song's audio then moves alike
    (less than half a bar, unless that would take some before the song's start) so the
    recording's first downbeat lands on a bar line.

    Listens on a thread of its own; the audio it reads is shared and never changes.
*/
class RecordingAnalysis final : private juce::Thread
{
public:
    /** A clip of the recording, as the song plays it. */
    struct Clip
    {
        std::shared_ptr<const AudioData> data;
        double startSeconds = 0.0;      // where it plays in the song now
        double offsetSeconds = 0.0;     // where in the file its window starts
        double lengthSeconds = 0.0;
        float gain = 1.0f;
    };

    /** The song's beat as it stands where the recording is: its tempo and time signature there,
        counted from a bar line at or before the recording (the song's tempo map can change
        elsewhere; a recording is heard against the stretch it starts in). */
    struct Grid
    {
        double bpm = 120.0;             // quarter notes a minute
        int numerator = 4, denominator = 4;
        double originSeconds = 0.0;     // where that bar line is, in the song's time
        int originBar = 0;              // which bar it is (from 0)
    };

    /** The grid of the song's tempo map at a song position (quarter notes). */
    static Grid gridAt (const TempoMap& map, double ppq);

    struct Result
    {
        bool ok = false;
        juce::String error;             // "Cancelled" when cancelled

        double bpm = 0.0;               // the recording's tempo, quarter notes a minute
        bool followsSong = false;       // it plays to the song's beat already: nothing needs to move
        double downbeatSeconds = 0.0;   // its first downbeat, in the song's time as it stands
        int firstBar = 1;               // when it follows the song: the song's bar the chords start in
        juce::String chords;            // a bar at a time from the first downbeat, as SessionPlayers reads them
        int keyTonic = -1;              // its key, from all the notes heard: 0 C .. 11 B (-1: not found)
        bool keyMinor = false;
        int bars = 0;
        double steadiness = 1.0;        // 0..1: how well one steady tempo fits it all
    };

    /** tempo: one to go by (quarter notes a minute), or 0 to find it. */
    RecordingAnalysis (std::vector<Clip> clips, Grid song, double tempo = 0.0);
    ~RecordingAnalysis() override;

    void start()                                       { startThread (juce::Thread::Priority::normal); }
    void cancel()                                      { signalThreadShouldExit(); }
    bool isDone() const noexcept                       { return done.load(); }
    double getProgress() const noexcept                { return progress.load(); }

    /** Once isDone(). */
    const Result& getResult() const noexcept           { return result; }

    //==============================================================================
    static constexpr double rate = 22050.0;            // what it listens at
    static constexpr double longest = 12.0 * 60.0;     // seconds listened to at most

    /** Says how far it got (0..1); false stops it. */
    using Report = std::function<bool (double progress)>;

    /** The listening itself: a mono signal at `rate` whose first sample plays at songSeconds. */
    static Result analyse (std::vector<float> mono, double songSeconds, Grid song, double tempo, const Report& report);

    /** The clips as one mono signal at `rate`, from where the first starts (songSeconds), at
        most `longest` long. */
    static std::vector<float> mixDown (const std::vector<Clip>& clips, double& songSeconds);

    //==============================================================================
    // In the song. Message thread only.

    /** An audio track's clips, as the song plays them now. */
    static std::vector<Clip> clipsOf (AudioEngine& engine, int trackId);

    /** The song's audio and tempo as they stand: what was heard still fits while it's the same. */
    static juce::String layoutOf (AudioEngine& engine);

    /** For a recording with a tempo of its own: the song at its tempo, and all the song's audio
        moved alike (in time with itself) so the recording's first downbeat lands on a bar line,
        the nearest one it can (no clip before the song's start). MIDI stays on its bars. */
    struct Alignment
    {
        double bpm = 0.0;               // the song's new tempo
        double shiftSeconds = 0.0;      // how far the audio moves
        int startBar = 1;               // the bar the first downbeat lands on
    };

    static Alignment alignmentFor (const Result& heard, AudioEngine& engine);
    static void align (AudioEngine& engine, const Alignment& alignment);

    /** Listens to an audio track here and now (Sonify AI's way: it waits). */
    static Result listen (AudioEngine& engine, int trackId, double tempo = 0.0);

private:
    void run() override;

    std::vector<Clip> clips;
    Grid song;
    double tempo;
    Result result;
    std::atomic<bool> done { false };
    std::atomic<double> progress { 0.0 };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (RecordingAnalysis)
};

        void drawLinearSlider (juce::Graphics& g, int x, int y, int width, int height, float sliderPos, float minPos, float maxPos,
                               juce::Slider::SliderStyle style, juce::Slider& slider) override
        {
            if (style != juce::Slider::LinearVertical)
            {
                LookAndFeel_V4::drawLinearSlider (g, x, y, width, height, sliderPos, minPos, maxPos, style, slider);
                return;
            }

            const auto accent = slider.findColour (juce::Slider::trackColourId);
            const auto centre = static_cast<float> (x) + static_cast<float> (width) * 0.5f;
            const auto trackWidth = 6.0f;
            const juce::Rectangle<float> track (centre - trackWidth * 0.5f, static_cast<float> (y), trackWidth, static_cast<float> (height));

            g.setColour (Look::inset);
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (track, 3.0f);

            if (const auto fill = track.getBottom() - sliderPos; fill > 0.0f)
            {
                g.setColour (accent.withAlpha (slider.isEnabled() ? 0.55f : 0.25f));
                g.fillRoundedRectangle (track.withTop (sliderPos), 3.0f);
            }

            const auto thumb = juce::Rectangle<float> (static_cast<float> (width) - 4.0f, 20.0f).withCentre ({ centre, sliderPos });
            g.setColour (slider.isMouseButtonDown() ? Look::panel2.brighter (0.15f) : Look::panel2);
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (thumb, 4.0f);
            g.setColour (accent.withAlpha (slider.isEnabled() ? 0.9f : 0.4f));
            g.drawRoundedRectangle (thumb.reduced (0.5f), 4.0f, 1.0f);

            g.setColour (slider.isEnabled() ? Look::bright : Look::muted);
            g.setFont (Look::font (10.5f, true));
            g.drawFittedText (slider.getTextFromValue (slider.getValue()), thumb.toNearestInt().reduced (2, 0), juce::Justification::centred, 1, 0.7f);
        }

        int getSliderThumbRadius (juce::Slider&) override   { return 10; }

        void drawButtonBackground (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Button& button, const juce::Colour&, bool over, bool down) override
        {
            const auto area = button.getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (0.5f);
            auto fill = button.findColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId);

            if (down)       fill = fill.brighter (0.18f);
            else if (over)  fill = fill.brighter (0.08f);

            g.setColour (button.isEnabled() ? fill : fill.withAlpha (0.5f));
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (area, 4.0f);
            g.setColour (Look::line);
            g.drawRoundedRectangle (area, 4.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        juce::Font getTextButtonFont (juce::TextButton&, int) override   { return Look::font (12.5f); }
        juce::Font getComboBoxFont (juce::ComboBox&) override             { return Look::font (12.5f); }

    /** A slider for one of the sampler's parameters: its own range (skewed round a middle
        value for times and frequencies), its value as the sampler writes it. */
    class ParamSlider final : public juce::Slider
    {
    public:
        ParamSlider (SonifySampler& s, SonifySampler::Param p, juce::Colour accent, double middle, const juce::String& shortName)
            : sampler (s), param (p), label (shortName)
        {
            const auto& parameter = sampler.getParameters()[static_cast<size_t> (sampler.findParameter (param))];
            juce::NormalisableRange<double> range (parameter.minValue, parameter.maxValue, parameter.stepped ? 1.0 : 0.0);

            if (middle > parameter.minValue && middle < parameter.maxValue)
                range.setSkewForCentre (middle);

            setSliderStyle (juce::Slider::LinearVertical);
            setTextBoxStyle (juce::Slider::NoTextBox, false, 0, 0);
            setNormalisableRange (range);
            setDoubleClickReturnValue (true, sampler.getDefault (param));
            setColour (juce::Slider::trackColourId, accent);
            setTooltip (parameter.name + " (double-click: back to " + sampler.getParameterText (sampler.findParameter (param), sampler.getDefault (param)) + ")");
            setValue (sampler.get (param), juce::dontSendNotification);
            onValueChange = [this] { sampler.set (param, getValue()); };
        }

        juce::String getTextFromValue (double value) override
        {
            return sampler.getParameterText (sampler.findParameter (param), value);
        }

        /** The sampler's value, unless the slider is being dragged (automation, a preset, an SFZ). */
        void refresh()
        {
            if (isMouseButtonDown())
                return;

            if (const auto value = sampler.get (param); std::abs (value - getValue()) > 1.0e-9)
                setValue (value, juce::dontSendNotification);
        }

        SonifySampler& sampler;
        const SonifySampler::Param param;
        const juce::String label;
    };

                return;    // still being made

            loadButton.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (92));       top.removeFromLeft (4);

            const auto floorHeight = (area.getHeight() - Look::groupGap) / 2;

            area.removeFromTop (Look::groupGap);

            // First floor: amp, filter, filter envelope, play (what's left), volume.

                filterType.setBounds (inside.removeFromTop (24));
                inside.removeFromTop (6);
                placeSliders (*filter, inside);
            }

            first.removeFromLeft (Look::groupGap);
            layout (*filterEnv, first.removeFromLeft (widthFor (*filterEnv)));
            first.removeFromLeft (Look::groupGap);
            layout (*vol, first.removeFromRight (widthFor (*vol) + 24));   // room for its title
            first.removeFromRight (Look::groupGap);

            play->box.setBounds (first);
            {
                auto inside = first.reduced (8, 0).withTrimmedTop (Look::groupTitle);
                playMode.setBounds (inside.removeFromTop (24));
                inside.removeFromTop (4);
                monoMode.setBounds (inside.removeFromTop (24));
                inside.removeFromTop (6);
                placeSliders (*play, inside);
            }

            // Second floor: the pitch envelope, pitch, the three LFOs sharing what's left.
            layout (*pitchEnv, second.removeFromLeft (widthFor (*pitchEnv)));
            second.removeFromLeft (Look::groupGap);
            layout (*pitch, second.removeFromLeft (widthFor (*pitch)));
            second.removeFromLeft (Look::groupGap);

            const auto lfoWidth = (second.getWidth() - 2 * Look::groupGap) / 3;
            layout (*tremolo, second.removeFromLeft (lfoWidth));
            second.removeFromLeft (Look::groupGap);
            layout (*filterLfo, second.removeFromLeft (lfoWidth));
            second.removeFromLeft (Look::groupGap);
            layout (*vibrato, second);
        }

        {

        Group* addGroup (const juce::String& title, juce::Colour colour, std::initializer_list<SliderSpec> list)
        {
            auto group = std::make_unique<Group>();
            group->colour = colour;
            group->box.setText (title);
            group->box.setColour (juce::GroupComponent::outlineColourId, colour.withAlpha (0.45f));
            group->box.setColour (juce::GroupComponent::textColourId, colour);
            addAndMakeVisible (group->box);

            for (const auto& spec : list)
            {
                auto slider = std::make_unique<ParamSlider> (sampler, spec.param, colour, spec.middle, spec.label);
                addAndMakeVisible (*slider);
                group->sliders.push_back (slider.get());
                sliders.push_back (std::move (slider));
            }

            groups.push_back (std::move (group));
            return groups.back().get();
        }

        static int widthFor (const Group& group)
        {
            return static_cast<int> (group.sliders.size()) * Look::sliderWidth + 16;
        }

        void layout (Group& group, juce::Rectangle<int> area)
        {
            group.box.setBounds (area);
            placeSliders (group, area.reduced (8, 0).withTrimmedTop (Look::groupTitle));
        }

        /** The group's sliders side by side, in the middle of the area, their names under them. */
        static void placeSliders (Group& group, juce::Rectangle<int> area)
        {
            area.removeFromBottom (Look::labelHeight + 4);
            const auto count = static_cast<int> (group.sliders.size());
            const auto total = count * Look::sliderWidth;
            auto x = area.getX() + juce::jmax (0, (area.getWidth() - total) / 2);

            for (auto* slider : group.sliders)
            {
                slider->setBounds (x + 2, area.getY(), Look::sliderWidth - 4, juce::jmax (40, area.getHeight()));
                x += Look::sliderWidth;
            }
        }

        void updateMono()
        {
            monoMode.setVisible (juce::roundToInt (sampler.get (SonifySampler::playMode)) == 1);
            play->sliders[1]->setEnabled (juce::roundToInt (sampler.get (SonifySampler::playMode)) == 1);
        }

        void refreshPatch()
        {
            const auto file = sampler.getInstrumentFile();
            juce::String text;
            auto colour = juce::Colour (0xffd4a843);

            switch (sampler.getLoading())
            {
                case SonifySampler::Loading::loading:
                    text = "Loading " + file.getFileNameWithoutExtension() + "...";
                    colour = Look::muted;
                    break;

                case SonifySampler::Loading::failed:
                    text = sampler.getProblem();
                    colour = Look::problem;
                    break;

                case SonifySampler::Loading::ready:
                    text = sampler.describeInstrument();
                    break;

                case SonifySampler::Loading::none:
                    text = "No instrument: Load SFZ, or Latest for the one sampled last";
                    colour = Look::muted;
                    break;
            }

            if (text != patch.getText())
                patch.setText (text, juce::dontSendNotification);

            patch.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, colour);
            patch.setTooltip (file.getFullPathName());

            const auto hasFile = file.existsAsFile();
            saveButton.setEnabled (hasFile && sampler.getLoading() == SonifySampler::Loading::ready);
            saveAsButton.setEnabled (sampler.getLoading() == SonifySampler::Loading::ready);
            clearButton.setEnabled (file != juce::File());

            if (++latestTicks % 20 == 1)
                latestButton.setEnabled (Samplers::latest().existsAsFile());
        }

        void timerCallback() override
        {
            for (auto& slider : sliders)
                slider->refresh();

            const auto sync = [this] (juce::ComboBox& box, SonifySampler::Param param)
            {
                const auto id = juce::roundToInt (sampler.get (param)) + 1;

                if (box.getSelectedId() != id && ! box.isPopupActive())
                    box.setSelectedId (id, juce::dontSendNotification);
            };

            sync (filterType, SonifySampler::filterType);
            sync (playMode, SonifySampler::playMode);
            sync (monoMode, SonifySampler::monoMode);
            updateMono();
            refreshPatch();
        }

        void chooseInstrument()
        {
            chooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Load SFZ", startFolder(), "*.sfz");
            chooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles,
                                  [safe = juce::Component::SafePointer<SamplerPage> (this)] (const juce::FileChooser& fc)
            {
                const auto file = fc.getResult();

                if (safe == nullptr || ! file.existsAsFile())
                    return;

                lastFolder() = file.getParentDirectory();
                safe->sampler.loadInstrument (file, true);
            });
        }

        void chooseSaveInstrument()
        {
            const auto current = sampler.getInstrumentFile();
            const auto start = current != juce::File() ? current : startFolder().getChildFile ("Instrument.sfz");
            chooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Save SFZ As", start, "*.sfz");
            chooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::saveMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles
                                      | juce::FileBrowserComponent::warnAboutOverwriting,
                                  [safe = juce::Component::SafePointer<SamplerPage> (this)] (const juce::FileChooser& fc)
            {
                const auto file = fc.getResult();

                if (safe == nullptr || file == juce::File())
                    return;

                lastFolder() = file.getParentDirectory();
                safe->sampler.saveInstrument (file);
            });
        }

        void choosePreset (bool saving)
        {
            auto folder = Samplers::folder().getChildFile ("Sampler Presets");
            folder.createDirectory();
            const juce::String wildcard = juce::String ("*") + Samplers::presetExtension;

            if (saving)
            {
                const auto name = sampler.getInstrumentFile().getFileNameWithoutExtension();
                chooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Save Preset", folder.getChildFile ((name.isNotEmpty() ? name : juce::String ("Preset")) + Samplers::presetExtension), wildcard);
                chooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::saveMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles
                                          | juce::FileBrowserComponent::warnAboutOverwriting,
                                      [safe = juce::Component::SafePointer<SamplerPage> (this)] (const juce::FileChooser& fc)
                {
                    if (safe != nullptr && fc.getResult() != juce::File())
                        safe->sampler.savePreset (fc.getResult());
                });
                return;
            }

            chooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Load Preset", folder, wildcard);
            chooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles,
                                  [safe = juce::Component::SafePointer<SamplerPage> (this)] (const juce::FileChooser& fc)
            {
                if (safe != nullptr && fc.getResult().existsAsFile())
                    safe->sampler.loadPreset (fc.getResult());
            });
        }

        static constexpr int topHeight = 42;

        SonifySampler& sampler;
        SamplerLook look;          // first: it outlasts the controls that use it
        juce::TooltipWindow tooltips { this, 600 };

        juce::TextButton loadButton, latestButton, clearButton, saveButton, saveAsButton, loadPresetButton, savePresetButton;
        juce::Label patch;
        juce::ComboBox filterType, playMode, monoMode;

        std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Group>> groups;
        std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ParamSlider>> sliders;
        Group* amp = nullptr;
        Group* filter = nullptr;
        Group* filterEnv = nullptr;
        Group* play = nullptr;
        Group* vol = nullptr;
        Group* pitchEnv = nullptr;
        Group* pitch = nullptr;
        Group* tremolo = nullptr;
        Group* filterLfo = nullptr;
        Group* vibrato = nullptr;

        std::unique_ptr<juce::FileChooser> chooser;
        int latestTicks = 0;
    };

    //==============================================================================
    class SamplerWindow final : public juce::DocumentWindow
    {
    public:
        explicit SamplerWindow (SonifySampler& sampler)
            : juce::DocumentWindow ("Sonify Sampler", Look::page, juce::DocumentWindow::closeButton | juce::DocumentWindow::minimiseButton)
        {
            setUsingNativeTitleBar (true);
            setContentOwned (SamplerScreen::createPage (sampler).release(), true);
            setResizable (true, true);
            setResizeLimits (1020, 500, 2400, 1200);
            centreWithSize (getWidth(), getHeight());
        }

        void closeButtonPressed() override
        {
            setVisible (false);   // kept for next time, where it was
        }
    };

    class WindowScreen final : public Samplers::Screen
    {
    public:
        explicit WindowScreen (SonifySampler& s) : sampler (s) {}

        void show (const juce::String& title) override
        {
            if (window == nullptr)
                window = std::make_unique<SamplerWindow> (sampler);

            window->setName (title.isNotEmpty() ? title : juce::String ("Sonify Sampler"));
            window->setVisible (true);
            window->toFront (true);
        }

        void hide() override
        {
            if (window != nullptr)
                window->setVisible (false);
        }

        bool isShowing() const override   { return window != nullptr && window->isVisible(); }

    private:
        SonifySampler& sampler;
        std::unique_ptr<SamplerWindow> window;
    };
}

    return std::make_unique<SamplerPage> (sampler);
}

{
    Samplers::setScreenFactory ([] (SonifySampler& sampler) -> std::unique_ptr<Samplers::Screen>
    {
        return std::make_unique<WindowScreen> (sampler);
    });
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\SamplingRack.cpp

#include "SamplingRack.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <map>
#include <set>

namespace
{
    constexpr int capacityFloor = 4096;   // a step's sound holds this much (or two device blocks)
}

//==============================================================================
SamplingRack::SamplingRack (AudioEngine& audioEngine) : engine (audioEngine)
{
    auto sampler = std::make_unique<Node>();
    sampler->id = samplerId;
    sampler->kind = Kind::sampler;
    sampler->name = "Sampling";
    nodes.push_back (std::move (sampler));

    auto output = std::make_unique<Node>();
    output->id = outputId;
    output->kind = Kind::output;
    output->name = "Output";
    nodes.push_back (std::move (output));

    auto midiIn = std::make_unique<Node>();
    midiIn->id = midiInId;
    midiIn->kind = Kind::midiIn;
    midiIn->name = "MIDI In";
    nodes.push_back (std::move (midiIn));

    chunkNotes.ensureSize (8192);
    chunkLive.ensureSize (8192);
    chunkBoth.ensureSize (16384);
    engine.setMidiInInputs (AudioEngine::MidiIn::rack, midiInputs);
    rebuild();
}

SamplingRack::~SamplingRack()
{
    // The plan goes first (nothing plays them any more), then the plugins' windows, then them.
    {
        const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (planLock);
        plan.reset();
    }

    closeWindows();

    for (auto& node : nodes)
        if (node->plugin != nullptr)
            node->plugin->deactivate();

    nodes.clear();
}

//==============================================================================
SamplingRack::Node* SamplingRack::find (int id) const noexcept
{
    for (const auto& node : nodes)
        if (node->id == id)
            return node.get();

    return nullptr;
}

juce::String SamplingRack::kindName (Kind kind)
{
    switch (kind)
    {
        case Kind::sampler:     return "sampler";
        case Kind::instrument:  return "instrument";
        case Kind::effect:      return "effect";
        case Kind::output:      return "output";
        case Kind::midiIn:      return "midiin";
    }

    return "effect";
}

bool SamplingRack::activatePlugin (Plugin& plugin)
{
    // Before the device starts, it's activated as it does (prepareRack).
    if (! engine.isAudioRunning())
        return true;

    if (plugin.isActive())
        plugin.deactivate();

    // The device's rate and block, as the rack plays them (when it started before the rack was made).
    if (rate <= 0.0 || blockSize <= 0)
    {
        const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (planLock);
        rate = engine.getPlaybackRate();
        blockSize = engine.getBlockSize();
    }

    return plugin.activate (rate, blockSize);
}

int SamplingRack::addPlugin (std::unique_ptr<Plugin> plugin, const juce::String& format, float x, float y, juce::String& error)
{
    if (plugin == nullptr)
    {
        error = "No plugin.";
        return 0;
    }

    const auto role = plugin->getRole();

    if (role == Plugin::Role::noAudio || plugin->getMainOutputChannels() <= 0)
    {
        error = plugin->getDescriptor().name + " makes no sound of its own (a MIDI effect?): it can't go in the rack.";
        return 0;
    }

    if (! activatePlugin (*plugin))
    {
        error = plugin->getDescriptor().name + " couldn't start at " + juce::String (engine.getPlaybackRate() / 1000.0, 1) + " kHz.";
        return 0;
    }

    auto node = std::make_unique<Node>();
    node->id = nextId++;
    node->kind = role == Plugin::Role::instrument ? Kind::instrument : Kind::effect;
    node->format = format.isNotEmpty() ? format : plugin->getFormatName();
    node->file = plugin->getSourceFile();
    node->pluginId = plugin->getDescriptor().id;
    node->name = plugin->getDescriptor().name;
    node->vendor = plugin->getDescriptor().vendor;
    node->x = x;
    node->y = y;
    node->plugin = std::move (plugin);

    const auto id = node->id;
    nodes.push_back (std::move (node));
    rebuild();
    return id;
}

bool SamplingRack::removeNode (int id)
{
    if (id == samplerId || id == outputId || id == midiInId)
        return false;

    const auto found = std::find_if (nodes.begin(), nodes.end(), [id] (const auto& node) { return node->id == id; });

    if (found == nodes.end())
        return false;

    wires.erase (std::remove_if (wires.begin(), wires.end(), [id] (const Wire& w) { return w.from == id || w.to == id; }), wires.end());

    // Out of the plan first; then the node (its window, its plugin) goes outside the lock.
    std::unique_ptr<Node> gone = std::move (*found);
    nodes.erase (found);
    rebuild();

    if (gone->plugin != nullptr)
    {
        gone->plugin->hideNativeScreen();
        gone->plugin->deactivate();
    }

    return true;
}

bool SamplingRack::moveNode (int id, float x, float y)
{
    auto* node = find (id);

    if (node == nullptr || ! std::isfinite (x) || ! std::isfinite (y))
        return false;

    node->x = juce::jmax (0.0f, x);
    node->y = juce::jmax (0.0f, y);
    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
bool SamplingRack::reaches (int from, int to) const
{
    std::set<int> seen;
    std::vector<int> waiting { from };

    while (! waiting.empty())
    {
        const auto at = waiting.back();
        waiting.pop_back();

        if (at == to)
            return true;

        if (! seen.insert (at).second)
            continue;

        for (const auto& wire : wires)
            if (wire.from == at)
                waiting.push_back (wire.to);
    }

    return false;
}

juce::String SamplingRack::connect (int from, int to, int fromSide, int toSide)
{
    const auto* source = find (from);
    const auto* target = find (to);

    if (source == nullptr || target == nullptr || from == to)
        return "There's nothing to wire there.";

    // MIDI: the Sampling node's notes, or the MIDI In's, to a VSTi.
    if (isMidiSource (source->kind))
    {
        if (target->kind != Kind::instrument)
            return source->kind == Kind::midiIn ? "The MIDI In node's MIDI goes to a VSTi." : "The Sampling node's MIDI goes to a VSTi.";

        if (std::none_of (wires.begin(), wires.end(), [from, to] (const Wire& w) { return w.from == from && w.to == to; }))
            wires.push_back ({ from, to, 0, 0 });

        rebuild();
        return {};
    }

    // Sound: a VSTi's or an effect's, into an effect or the Output.
    if (source->kind == Kind::instrument || source->kind == Kind::effect)
    {
        if (target->kind != Kind::effect && target->kind != Kind::output)
            return target->kind == Kind::instrument ? "A VSTi takes MIDI, not sound: wire the sound to an effect or the Output."
                                                    : "Sound goes into an effect or the Output.";

        if (reaches (to, from))
            return "That wire would make a loop.";

        const auto add = [this, from, to] (int a, int b)
        {
            if (std::none_of (wires.begin(), wires.end(), [=] (const Wire& w) { return w.from == from && w.to == to && w.fromSide == a && w.toSide == b; }))
                wires.push_back ({ from, to, a, b });
        };

        // Node to node: both sides, each to its own. Otherwise the one side asked for (a side
        // not given is the other's).
        if (fromSide == bothSides && toSide == bothSides)
        {
            add (leftSide, leftSide);
            add (rightSide, rightSide);
        }
        else
        {
            const auto a = fromSide == bothSides ? toSide : fromSide;
            const auto b = toSide == bothSides ? fromSide : toSide;
            add (juce::jlimit (leftSide, rightSide, a), juce::jlimit (leftSide, rightSide, b));
        }

        rebuild();
        return {};
    }

    return "The Output's sound is what's sampled: it has nothing to wire on.";
}

bool SamplingRack::disconnect (int from, int to, int fromSide, int toSide)
{
    const auto before = wires.size();
    wires.erase (std::remove_if (wires.begin(), wires.end(), [=] (const Wire& w)
    {
        return w.from == from && w.to == to && (fromSide == bothSides || w.fromSide == fromSide) && (toSide == bothSides || w.toSide == toSide);
    }), wires.end());

    if (wires.size() == before)
        return false;

    rebuild();
    return true;
}

void SamplingRack::setMidiInputs (const juce::StringArray& ports)
{
    midiInputs = ports;
    midiInputs.trim();
    midiInputs.removeEmptyStrings();
    midiInputs.removeDuplicates (false);
    engine.setMidiInInputs (AudioEngine::MidiIn::rack, midiInputs);
}

void SamplingRack::setMuted (int id, bool muted)
{
    if (auto* node = find (id))
        node->muted.store (muted);
}

void SamplingRack::setPassThrough (int id, bool pass)
{
    if (auto* node = find (id); node != nullptr && node->kind == Kind::effect)
        node->pass.store (pass);
}

bool SamplingRack::showWindow (int id, juce::String& why)
{
    auto* node = find (id);

    if (node == nullptr || node->plugin == nullptr)
    {
        why = node != nullptr && node->missing ? node->name + " isn't loaded: " + node->file.getFullPathName() + " couldn't be opened."
                                               : "That node has no plugin window.";
        return false;
    }

    auto& plugin = *node->plugin;

    if (plugin.getScreenKind() == Plugin::ScreenKind::native && plugin.showNativeScreen (node->name))
        return true;

    why = node->name + " has no window of its own.";
    return false;
}

void SamplingRack::closeWindows()
{
    for (auto& node : nodes)
        if (node->plugin != nullptr)
            node->plugin->hideNativeScreen();
}

//==============================================================================
bool SamplingRack::hearsNotes (int id) const
{
    return std::any_of (wires.begin(), wires.end(), [id] (const Wire& w) { return w.from == samplerId && w.to == id; });
}

bool SamplingRack::hearsLive (int id) const
{
    return std::any_of (wires.begin(), wires.end(), [id] (const Wire& w) { return w.from == midiInId && w.to == id; });
}

bool SamplingRack::reachesOutput (int id) const
{
    // Through nodes that play: a missing plugin breaks its chain.
    std::set<int> seen;
    std::vector<int> waiting { id };

    while (! waiting.empty())
    {
        const auto at = waiting.back();
        waiting.pop_back();

        if (at == outputId)
            return true;

        const auto* node = find (at);

        if (node == nullptr || node->plugin == nullptr || ! seen.insert (at).second)
            continue;

        for (const auto& wire : wires)
            if (wire.from == at)
                waiting.push_back (wire.to);
    }

    return false;
}

bool SamplingRack::isFlagged (int id) const
{
    const auto* node = find (id);
    return node != nullptr && node->kind == Kind::instrument && node->plugin != nullptr && hearsNotes (id) && reachesOutput (id);
}

bool SamplingRack::isReady() const
{
    return std::any_of (nodes.begin(), nodes.end(), [this] (const auto& node) { return isFlagged (node->id); });
}

bool SamplingRack::hasPlugins() const
{
    return std::any_of (nodes.begin(), nodes.end(), [] (const auto& node) { return node->plugin != nullptr; });
}

//==============================================================================
std::unique_ptr<SamplingRack::Plan> SamplingRack::makePlan() const
{
    auto made = std::make_unique<Plan>();

    // The plugin nodes whose sound reaches the Output, upstream first (each after its inputs).
    std::vector<int> order;
    std::set<int> placed;
    std::vector<int> candidates;

    for (const auto& node : nodes)
        if ((node->kind == Kind::instrument || node->kind == Kind::effect) && node->plugin != nullptr && reachesOutput (node->id))
            candidates.push_back (node->id);

    bool progress = true;

    while (progress && placed.size() < candidates.size())
    {
        progress = false;

        for (const auto id : candidates)
        {
            if (placed.count (id) != 0)
                continue;

            // Ready once every input that plays is placed.
            const auto ready = std::all_of (wires.begin(), wires.end(), [&] (const Wire& w)
            {
                return w.to != id || w.from == samplerId || w.from == midiInId || placed.count (w.from) != 0
                    || std::find (candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), w.from) == candidates.end();
            });

            if (ready)
            {
                order.push_back (id);
                placed.insert (id);
                progress = true;
            }
        }
    }

    std::map<int, int> stepOf;
    const auto capacity = juce::jmax (capacityFloor, 2 * juce::jmax (1, blockSize > 0 ? blockSize : engine.getBlockSize()));

    for (const auto id : order)
    {
        auto* node = find (id);
        Step step;
        step.node = node;
        step.plugin = node->plugin.get();
        step.instrument = node->kind == Kind::instrument;
        step.hearsNotes = step.instrument && hearsNotes (id);
        step.hearsLive = step.instrument && hearsLive (id);

        for (const auto& wire : wires)
            if (wire.to == id)
                if (const auto found = stepOf.find (wire.from); found != stepOf.end())
                    step.inputs.push_back ({ found->second, wire.fromSide, wire.toSide });

        step.sound.setSize (2, capacity, false, true, false);
        stepOf[id] = static_cast<int> (made->steps.size());
        made->steps.push_back (std::move (step));
    }

    for (const auto& wire : wires)
        if (wire.to == outputId)
            if (const auto found = stepOf.find (wire.from); found != stepOf.end())
                made->outputInputs.push_back ({ found->second, wire.fromSide, wire.toSide });

    return made;
}

void SamplingRack::rebuild()
{
    auto next = makePlan();

    {
        const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (planLock);
        std::swap (plan, next);
    }

    // The old plan goes here, outside the lock.
}

//==============================================================================
void SamplingRack::prepareRack (double sampleRate, int newBlockSize)
{
    const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (planLock);
    rate = sampleRate;
    blockSize = newBlockSize;

    for (auto& node : nodes)
    {
        if (node->plugin == nullptr)
            continue;

        if (node->plugin->isActive())
            node->plugin->deactivate();

        node->plugin->activate (sampleRate, newBlockSize);
    }

    // The steps' sound as long as two of the device's blocks.
    if (plan != nullptr)
        for (auto& step : plan->steps)
            if (step.sound.getNumSamples() < 2 * newBlockSize)
                step.sound.setSize (2, 2 * newBlockSize, false, true, false);
}

void SamplingRack::releaseRack()
{
    const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (planLock);

    for (auto& node : nodes)
        if (node->plugin != nullptr)
            node->plugin->stopProcessing();
}

void SamplingRack::renderRack (const juce::MidiBuffer& notes, const juce::MidiBuffer& live, float* leftOut, float* rightOut,
                               int numSamples, const clap_event_transport_t& transport) noexcept
{
    const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (planLock);

    if (plan == nullptr || plan->steps.empty() || numSamples <= 0)
        return;

    // A block at a time as long as the plugins were readied for (and the steps hold).
    auto chunk = blockSize > 0 ? blockSize : engine.getBlockSize();

    for (const auto& step : plan->steps)
        chunk = juce::jmin (chunk, step.sound.getNumSamples());

    chunk = juce::jmax (1, chunk);

    const auto slice = [] (const juce::MidiBuffer& from, juce::MidiBuffer& into, int start, int count) noexcept
    {
        into.clear();

        for (const auto metadata : from)
            if (metadata.samplePosition >= start && metadata.samplePosition < start + count)
                into.addEvent (metadata.data, metadata.numBytes, metadata.samplePosition - start);
    };

    // One side of a step's sound added into a buffer.
    const auto addSide = [this] (float* into, const Input& input, int count) noexcept
    {
        const auto& sound = plan->steps[static_cast<size_t> (input.step)].sound;
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (into, sound.getReadPointer (input.fromSide == rightSide ? 1 : 0), count);
    };

    for (int start = 0; start < numSamples; start += chunk)
    {
        const auto count = juce::jmin (chunk, numSamples - start);

        slice (notes, chunkNotes, start, count);
        slice (live, chunkLive, start, count);

        // A VSTi wired from both: the studio's notes and the live ones, together.
        chunkBoth.clear();
        chunkBoth.addEvents (chunkNotes, 0, -1, 0);
        chunkBoth.addEvents (chunkLive, 0, -1, 0);

        for (auto& step : plan->steps)
        {
            auto* soundLeft = step.sound.getWritePointer (0);
            auto* soundRight = step.sound.getWritePointer (1);
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (soundLeft, count);
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (soundRight, count);

            if (step.instrument)
            {
                const auto& heard = step.hearsNotes && step.hearsLive ? chunkBoth
                                  : step.hearsNotes ? chunkNotes
                                  : step.hearsLive ? chunkLive : noNotes;
                step.plugin->process (nullptr, nullptr, soundLeft, soundRight, count, heard, &transport);
            }
            else
            {
                // What's wired into each side, added; through the effect unless it's passed through.
                for (const auto& input : step.inputs)
                    addSide (input.toSide == rightSide ? soundRight : soundLeft, input, count);

                if (! step.node->pass.load (std::memory_order_relaxed))
                    step.plugin->process (soundLeft, soundRight, soundLeft, soundRight, count, noNotes, &transport);
            }

            if (step.node->muted.load (std::memory_order_relaxed))
            {
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (soundLeft, count);
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (soundRight, count);
            }
        }

        for (const auto& input : plan->outputInputs)
            addSide ((input.toSide == rightSide ? rightOut : leftOut) + start, input, count);
    }
}

//==============================================================================
bool SamplingRack::update()
{
    bool changed = false;

    for (auto& node : nodes)
    {
        if (node->plugin == nullptr)
            continue;

        auto& plugin = *node->plugin;
        const auto requests = plugin.takeRequests();

        if (requests.callback)
            plugin.runOnMainThread();

        if (requests.rescan || requests.restart)
        {
            const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (planLock);

            if (requests.restart && plugin.isActive() && rate > 0.0)
            {
                plugin.deactivate();
                plugin.activate (rate, blockSize);
            }

            if (requests.rescan)
                plugin.rescanParameters();

            changed = true;
        }

        if (requests.flush && ! awake.load())
        {
            const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (planLock);
            plugin.flushQueuedParameters();
        }
    }

    return changed;
}

//==============================================================================
juce::var SamplingRack::toVar (bool withStates) const
{
    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& node : nodes)
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
        item->setProperty ("id", node->id);
        item->setProperty ("kind", kindName (node->kind));
        item->setProperty ("name", node->name);
        item->setProperty ("x", node->x);
        item->setProperty ("y", node->y);

        if (node->kind == Kind::midiIn)
            item->setProperty ("inputs", midiInputs);

        if (node->kind == Kind::instrument || node->kind == Kind::effect)
        {
            item->setProperty ("format", node->format);
            item->setProperty ("file", node->file.getFullPathName());
            item->setProperty ("pluginId", node->pluginId);
            item->setProperty ("vendor", node->vendor);
            item->setProperty ("muted", node->muted.load());
            item->setProperty ("pass", node->pass.load());

            if (node->missing)
                item->setProperty ("missing", true);

            if (withStates)
            {
                juce::String state = node->keptState;

                if (node->plugin != nullptr && node->plugin->canSaveState())
                {
                    juce::MemoryBlock block;

                    if (node->plugin->saveState (block) && block.getSize() > 0)
                        state = block.toBase64Encoding();
                }

                if (state.isNotEmpty())
                    item->setProperty ("state", state);
            }
            else
            {
                item->setProperty ("flagged", isFlagged (node->id));
                item->setProperty ("hasWindow", node->plugin != nullptr && node->plugin->getScreenKind() == Plugin::ScreenKind::native);
            }
        }

        list.add (juce::var (item.get()));
    }

    juce::Array<juce::var> links;

    for (const auto& wire : wires)
    {
        juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
        item->setProperty ("from", wire.from);
        item->setProperty ("to", wire.to);
        item->setProperty ("fromSide", wire.fromSide);
        item->setProperty ("toSide", wire.toSide);
        item->setProperty ("midi", wire.from == samplerId || wire.from == midiInId);
        links.add (juce::var (item.get()));
    }

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr result (new juce::DynamicObject());
    result->setProperty ("nodes", list);
    result->setProperty ("wires", links);

    if (! withStates)
        result->setProperty ("ready", isReady());

    return juce::var (result.get());
}

void SamplingRack::clear()
{
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Node>> gone;

    for (auto it = nodes.begin(); it != nodes.end();)
    {
        if ((*it)->kind == Kind::instrument || (*it)->kind == Kind::effect)
        {
            gone.push_back (std::move (*it));
            it = nodes.erase (it);
        }
        else
        {
            ++it;
        }
    }

    wires.clear();
    rebuild();

    for (auto& node : gone)
    {
        if (node->plugin != nullptr)
        {
            node->plugin->hideNativeScreen();
            node->plugin->deactivate();
        }
    }
}

void SamplingRack::restore (const juce::var& saved, juce::StringArray& problems)
{
    clear();

    const auto* list = saved.getProperty ("nodes", {}).getArray();

    if (list == nullptr)
        return;

    std::map<int, int> idOf;   // the kept ids to the new ones

    for (const auto& item : *list)
    {
        const auto keptId = static_cast<int> (item.getProperty ("id", 0));
        const auto kind = item.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString();
        const auto x = static_cast<float> (static_cast<double> (item.getProperty ("x", -1.0)));
        const auto y = static_cast<float> (static_cast<double> (item.getProperty ("y", -1.0)));

        // The Sampling, MIDI In and Output nodes are always there: only where they were (and the
        // MIDI In's ports).
        if (kind == "sampler" || kind == "output" || kind == "midiin")
        {
            const auto id = kind == "sampler" ? samplerId : kind == "output" ? outputId : midiInId;
            find (id)->x = x;
            find (id)->y = y;
            idOf[keptId] = id;

            if (kind == "midiin")
            {
                juce::StringArray ports;

                if (const auto* picked = item.getProperty ("inputs", {}).getArray())
                    for (const auto& port : *picked)
                        ports.add (port.toString());

                setMidiInputs (ports);
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (kind != "instrument" && kind != "effect")
            continue;

        const auto format = item.getProperty ("format", "VST3").toString();
        const juce::File file (item.getProperty ("file", {}).toString());
        const auto pluginId = item.getProperty ("pluginId", {}).toString();
        const auto state = item.getProperty ("state", {}).toString();
        juce::String error;
        int id = 0;

        if (juce::File::isAbsolutePath (file.getFullPathName()))
        {
            if (auto plugin = Plugin::loadFormat (file, format, pluginId, error))
            {
                if (state.isNotEmpty() && plugin->canSaveState())
                {
                    juce::MemoryBlock block;

                    if (block.fromBase64Encoding (state))
                        plugin->loadState (block);
                }

                id = addPlugin (std::move (plugin), format, x, y, error);
            }
        }

        if (id == 0)
        {
            // Kept as it was, silent, so its place, wires and settings aren't lost.
            auto node = std::make_unique<Node>();
            node->id = nextId++;
            node->kind = kind == "instrument" ? Kind::instrument : Kind::effect;
            node->format = format;
            node->file = file;
            node->pluginId = pluginId;
            node->name = item.getProperty ("name", file.getFileNameWithoutExtension()).toString();
            node->vendor = item.getProperty ("vendor", {}).toString();
            node->x = x;
            node->y = y;
            node->missing = true;
            node->keptState = state;
            id = node->id;
            nodes.push_back (std::move (node));
            problems.add (find (id)->name + ": " + (error.isNotEmpty() ? error : file.getFullPathName() + " couldn't be opened."));
        }

        if (auto* node = find (id))
        {
            node->muted.store (static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("muted", false)));
            node->pass.store (static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("pass", false)));
        }

        idOf[keptId] = id;
    }

    if (const auto* links = saved.getProperty ("wires", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& link : *links)
        {
            const auto from = idOf.find (static_cast<int> (link.getProperty ("from", 0)));
            const auto to = idOf.find (static_cast<int> (link.getProperty ("to", 0)));

            // As kept (a missing node's wires too: they play again once it's back).
            if (from == idOf.end() || to == idOf.end() || from->second == to->second)
                continue;

            const auto* source = find (from->second);
            const auto midi = source != nullptr && isMidiSource (source->kind);

            // Kept before sound came in pairs: one wire was both sides.
            if (! midi && ! link.hasProperty ("fromSide"))
            {
                wires.push_back ({ from->second, to->second, leftSide, leftSide });
                wires.push_back ({ from->second, to->second, rightSide, rightSide });
                continue;
            }

            const auto side = [] (const juce::var& value) { return juce::jlimit (0, 1, static_cast<int> (value)); };
            wires.push_back ({ from->second, to->second, midi ? 0 : side (link.getProperty ("fromSide", 0)), midi ? 0 : side (link.getProperty ("toSide", 0)) });
        }
    }

    rebuild();
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\SamplingRack.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>

#include "AudioEngine.h"
#include "Plugin.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Sampling Studio's nodes (Sampler Arena's node system, kept within its area): the
    plugins it samples, loaded straight from their files, and how they're wired.

      Sampling   the studio's notes: its MIDI out wires to the VSTis that play them.
      MIDI In    the live MIDI (the ports it picks, and the keyboard beside the nodes), to hear
                 the VSTis before sampling: its MIDI out wires to them too. It never samples.
      VSTi       an instrument plugin: MIDI in, its sound out as a pair (left, right).
      Effect     an effect plugin: sound in as a pair, sound out as a pair.
      Output     the sound that's sampled (and heard), stereo: what's wired into each side, added.

    A sound wire goes from one side of a node's pair to one side of another's (left to left,
    right to right, or crossed: two wires into one side add up). Wired node to node, both sides
    go at once, left to left and right to right.

    A VSTi is sampled (flagged) once the Sampling node's MIDI reaches it and its sound reaches the
    Output, straight or through effects; Sample needs at least one. Several flagged VSTis are
    sampled together, as one sound. A node can be muted (M: silent), an effect passed through
    (P: its sound goes on untouched). No loops: a wire that would make one isn't made.

    Threads: the nodes, the wires and the plugins are the message thread's; what the audio thread
    plays (the plan: the plugins in the order they play, each one's inputs) is swapped in under
    the rack's own lock, so the engine (holding its graph lock) never meets a half-made change.
    Plugins are activated as they're added (at the device's rate and block), and again as the
    device starts. The MIDI In node's ports are the engine's (AudioEngine::MidiIn::rack), which
    hands it the live notes only while the Sampling Studio is in front.
*/
class SamplingRack final : public AudioEngine::RackPlayer
{
public:
    enum class Kind { sampler, instrument, effect, output, midiIn };

    static constexpr int samplerId = 1;
    static constexpr int outputId = 2;
    static constexpr int midiInId = 3;

    /** A sound wire's side: left or right (a MIDI wire's is 0). bothSides: node to node, a wire
        for each side. */
    static constexpr int leftSide = 0, rightSide = 1, bothSides = -1;

    explicit SamplingRack (AudioEngine& engine);
    ~SamplingRack() override;

    //==============================================================================
    // Message thread

    /** A plugin as a node (an instrument: a VSTi; an effect; a plugin with no sound out isn't
        taken). x, y: its place in the area (the page's pixels). Returns its id, or 0 with why. */
    int addPlugin (std::unique_ptr<Plugin> plugin, const juce::String& format, float x, float y, juce::String& error);

    bool removeNode (int id);
    bool moveNode (int id, float x, float y);

    /** A wire from one node's out to another's in: a side of a pair to a side of a pair, or both
        sides (bothSides). Returns why it can't be, or nothing. */
    juce::String connect (int from, int to, int fromSide = bothSides, int toSide = bothSides);

    /** That wire (bothSides: every wire between the two nodes). */
    bool disconnect (int from, int to, int fromSide = bothSides, int toSide = bothSides);

    /** The MIDI In node's ports, by name (AudioEngine::everyMidiInput: all of them). */
    void setMidiInputs (const juce::StringArray& ports);
    juce::StringArray getMidiInputs() const                { return midiInputs; }

    void setMuted (int id, bool muted);
    void setPassThrough (int id, bool pass);

    /** The plugin's own window. False (with why) when it has none. */
    bool showWindow (int id, juce::String& why);
    void closeWindows();

    /** A VSTi the Sampling node's notes reach whose sound reaches the Output. */
    bool isFlagged (int id) const;

    /** At least one VSTi flagged: Sample can begin. */
    bool isReady() const;

    bool hasPlugins() const;

    /** The nodes and wires: for the page (withStates false), or to keep (the plugins' states too). */
    juce::var toVar (bool withStates) const;

    /** Nodes and wires kept before (toVar (true)): the plugins loaded again. One that can't be is
        kept as a missing node (silent, its settings kept), and said in problems. */
    void restore (const juce::var& saved, juce::StringArray& problems);

    /** Every plugin node gone; the Sampling, MIDI In and Output nodes stay (where they were). */
    void clear();

    /** Played by the device only while it's awake (the studio shows, or samples). */
    void setAwake (bool shouldBeAwake) noexcept           { awake.store (shouldBeAwake); }

    /** Plugins' upkeep: their calls for the message thread, restarts, parameter rescans. Several
        times a second. True when the page's view of them changed. */
    bool update();

    //==============================================================================
    // AudioEngine::RackPlayer: the engine's threads, under its graph lock
    void prepareRack (double sampleRate, int blockSize) override;
    void releaseRack() override;
    bool isRackAwake() const noexcept override              { return awake.load (std::memory_order_relaxed); }
    void renderRack (const juce::MidiBuffer& notes, const juce::MidiBuffer& live, float* leftOut, float* rightOut,
                     int numSamples, const clap_event_transport_t& transport) noexcept override;

private:
    struct Node
    {
        int id = 0;
        Kind kind = Kind::instrument;
        std::unique_ptr<Plugin> plugin;
        juce::String format;                 // "VST3", "VST2", "CLAP", "AU", "LV2"
        juce::File file;
        juce::String pluginId, name, vendor;
        float x = -1.0f, y = -1.0f;          // -1: the page places it
        std::atomic<bool> muted { false }, pass { false };
        bool missing = false;                // its plugin couldn't be loaded again: kept, silent
        juce::String keptState;              // a missing one's state, as it was kept (base64)
    };

    struct Wire
    {
        int from = 0, to = 0;
        int fromSide = 0, toSide = 0;        // left or right (a MIDI wire's: 0)
    };

    /** A sound coming in: a step's side, into a side. */
    struct Input
    {
        int step = 0, fromSide = 0, toSide = 0;
    };

    /** What the audio thread plays: the plugin nodes reaching the Output, upstream first. */
    struct Step
    {
        Node* node = nullptr;
        Plugin* plugin = nullptr;
        bool instrument = false;
        bool hearsNotes = false;             // wired from the Sampling node
        bool hearsLive = false;              // wired from the MIDI In node
        std::vector<Input> inputs;           // the sound wired in
        juce::AudioBuffer<float> sound;
    };

    struct Plan
    {
        std::vector<Step> steps;
        std::vector<Input> outputInputs;     // the sound wired into the Output
    };

    Node* find (int id) const noexcept;
    bool reachesOutput (int id) const;
    bool hearsNotes (int id) const;
    bool hearsLive (int id) const;
    static bool isMidiSource (Kind kind) noexcept    { return kind == Kind::sampler || kind == Kind::midiIn; }
    bool reaches (int from, int to) const;   // through wires
    bool activatePlugin (Plugin& plugin);
    void rebuild();
    std::unique_ptr<Plan> makePlan() const;
    static juce::String kindName (Kind kind);

    AudioEngine& engine;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Node>> nodes;
    std::vector<Wire> wires;
    int nextId = midiInId + 1;
    juce::StringArray midiInputs { AudioEngine::everyMidiInput };

    juce::SpinLock planLock;
    std::unique_ptr<Plan> plan;              // swapped under planLock
    std::atomic<bool> awake { false };
    double rate = 0.0;                       // as activated (the audio thread's while it renders)
    int blockSize = 0;
    juce::MidiBuffer chunkNotes, chunkLive, chunkBoth, noNotes;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (SamplingRack)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\SamplingStudio.cpp

#include "SamplingStudio.h"
#include "LoopFinder.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

namespace
{
    // The takes go from the audio thread to the keeper in chunks: frames, or a marker (a take
    // begins, ends, or is thrown away). The last few chunks are kept for the markers.
    constexpr int chunkFrames = 1024;
    constexpr int queueChunks = 512;
    constexpr int reservedChunks = 8;

    enum ChunkType { framesChunk = 0, beginChunk, endChunk, dropChunk };

    struct Chunk
    {
        int type = framesChunk, shot = -1, value = 0, count = 0;
        float left[chunkFrames] {};
        float right[chunkFrames] {};
    };

    juce::int64 samplesFor (double ms, double rate)
    {
        return static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (juce::jmax (0.0, ms) * rate / 1000.0));
    }

    void storeMax (std::atomic<float>& peak, float value) noexcept
    {
        auto now = peak.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

        while (value > now && ! peak.compare_exchange_weak (now, value, std::memory_order_relaxed))
        {
        }
    }

    float peakOf (const float* data, int numSamples) noexcept
    {
        if (data == nullptr || numSamples <= 0)
            return 0.0f;

        const auto range = juce::FloatVectorOperations::findMinAndMax (data, numSamples);
        return juce::jmax (-range.getStart(), range.getEnd());
    }

    /** A block's level as Sampler Arena measures it: the RMS of both channels. */
    float rmsOf (const float* left, const float* right, int numSamples) noexcept
    {
        if (numSamples <= 0)
            return 0.0f;

        double sum = 0.0;

        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
            sum += static_cast<double> (left[i]) * left[i] + static_cast<double> (right[i]) * right[i];

        return static_cast<float> (std::sqrt (sum / (2.0 * numSamples)));
    }

    juce::String stripWav (const juce::String& name)
    {
        return name.endsWithIgnoreCase (".wav") ? name.dropLastCharacters (4) : name;
    }

    /** "a,b,c," -> the numbers. */
    std::vector<int> numbersOf (const juce::String& text, const juce::String& separator = ",")
    {
        std::vector<int> found;

        for (const auto& token : juce::StringArray::fromTokens (text, separator, ""))
            if (token.trim().isNotEmpty())
                found.push_back (token.trim().getIntValue());

        return found;
    }

    std::vector<Sampling::VelocityLayer> layersOf (const juce::String& text)
    {
        std::vector<Sampling::VelocityLayer> layers;

        for (const auto& token : juce::StringArray::fromTokens (text, ",", ""))
        {
            const auto t = token.trim();

            if (t.contains ("-"))
            {
                const auto dash = t.indexOf ("-");
                layers.push_back ({ juce::jlimit (1, 127, t.substring (0, dash).getIntValue()), juce::jlimit (1, 127, t.substring (dash + 1).getIntValue()) });
            }
        }

        return layers;
    }

    juce::String layersText (const std::vector<Sampling::VelocityLayer>& layers)
    {
        juce::String text;

        for (const auto& layer : layers)
            text << layer.low << "-" << layer.high << ",";

        return text;
    }

    juce::var layersVar (const std::vector<Sampling::VelocityLayer>& layers)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> list;

        for (const auto& layer : layers)
            list.add (juce::Array<juce::var> { layer.low, layer.high });

        return list;
    }

    std::vector<Sampling::VelocityLayer> layersFromVar (const juce::var& value)
    {
        std::vector<Sampling::VelocityLayer> layers;

        if (const auto* list = value.getArray())
        {
            for (const auto& item : *list)
            {
                if (const auto* pair = item.getArray(); pair != nullptr && pair->size() == 2)
                    layers.push_back ({ juce::jlimit (1, 127, static_cast<int> ((*pair)[0])), juce::jlimit (1, 127, static_cast<int> ((*pair)[1])) });

                if (layers.size() >= 16)
                    break;
            }
        }

        return layers;
    }

    juce::String modeName (Sampling::Mode mode)
    {
        return mode == Sampling::Mode::chord ? "chord" : mode == Sampling::Mode::builder ? "builder" : "vsti";
    }

    juce::String speedName (Sampling::Speed speed)
    {
        return speed == Sampling::Speed::turbo ? "turbo" : speed == Sampling::Speed::unleashed ? "unleashed" : "realtime";
    }

    /** A take's channels as the WAVs have them: two (stereo), the left, or the two mixed. */
    void applyChannelMode (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& audio, int frames, int mode, int& channelsOut)
    {
        if (mode == 0)
        {
            if (audio.getNumChannels() == 1)
            {
                audio.setSize (2, audio.getNumSamples(), true, false, true);
                audio.copyFrom (1, 0, audio, 0, 0, frames);
            }

            channelsOut = 2;
            return;
        }

        if (mode == 2 && audio.getNumChannels() > 1)
        {
            audio.addFrom (0, 0, audio, 1, 0, frames);
            audio.applyGain (0, 0, frames, 0.5f);
        }

        channelsOut = 1;
    }

    /** Sampler Arena's fade: a straight line from full to nothing over the last ms. */
    void fadeTail (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& audio, int frames, double rate, int fadeMs)
    {
        const auto fade = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (frames, samplesFor (fadeMs, rate)));

        if (fade < 2)
            return;

        const auto start = frames - fade;

        for (int channel = 0; channel < audio.getNumChannels(); ++channel)
        {
            auto* data = audio.getWritePointer (channel);

            for (int i = 0; i < fade; ++i)
                data[start + i] *= 1.0f - static_cast<float> (i) / static_cast<float> (fade);
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
const std::vector<Sampling::ChordType>& Sampling::chordTypes()
{
    static const std::vector<ChordType> types {
        { "Major",      "Maj",  { 0, 4, 7 } },
        { "Minor",      "Min",  { 0, 3, 7 } },
        { "Diminished", "Dim",  { 0, 3, 6 } },
        { "Augmented",  "Aug",  { 0, 4, 8 } },
        { "Sus2",       "Sus2", { 0, 2, 7 } },
        { "Sus4",       "Sus4", { 0, 5, 7 } },
        { "Dom 7th",    "7",    { 0, 4, 7, 10 } },
        { "Maj 7th",    "Maj7", { 0, 4, 7, 11 } },
        { "Min 7th",    "Min7", { 0, 3, 7, 10 } },
        { "Dim 7th",    "Dim7", { 0, 3, 6, 9 } },
        { "Aug 7th",    "Aug7", { 0, 4, 8, 10 } },
        { "Min/Maj 7",  "mM7",  { 0, 3, 7, 11 } },
        { "Dom 9th",    "9",    { 0, 4, 7, 10, 14 } },
        { "Maj 9th",    "Maj9", { 0, 4, 7, 11, 14 } },
        { "Min 9th",    "Min9", { 0, 3, 7, 10, 14 } },
        { "Add 9",      "Add9", { 0, 4, 7, 14 } },
        { "6th",        "6",    { 0, 4, 7, 9 } },
        { "Min 6th",    "Min6", { 0, 3, 7, 9 } },
    };

    return types;
}

//==============================================================================
Sampling::Settings Sampling::Settings::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    Settings s;
    const auto mode = value.getProperty ("mode", "vsti").toString();
    s.mode = mode == "chord" ? Mode::chord : mode == "builder" ? Mode::builder : Mode::vsti;
    const auto source = value.getProperty ("source", "nodes").toString();   // "instrument" before the nodes: the nodes
    s.source = source == "hardware" ? Source::hardware : source == "voice" ? Source::voice : Source::nodes;
    s.trackId = static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("trackId", 0));
    s.midiOutput = value.getProperty ("midiOutput", {}).toString();
    s.midiChannel = juce::jlimit (1, 16, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("midiChannel", 1)));

    s.family = value.getProperty ("family", "Sample").toString().trim();

    if (s.family.isEmpty())
        s.family = "Sample";

    if (const auto* keys = value.getProperty ("keys", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& key : *keys)
            s.keys.insert (juce::jlimit (0, 127, static_cast<int> (key)));

    if (auto* boundaries = value.getProperty ("boundaries", {}).getDynamicObject())
        for (const auto& b : boundaries->getProperties())
            s.boundaries[b.name.toString().getIntValue()] = juce::jlimit (0, 127, static_cast<int> (b.value));

    s.noKeyRanges = static_cast<bool> (value.getProperty ("noKeyRanges", false));
    s.fillGap = static_cast<bool> (value.getProperty ("fillGap", false));

    if (auto layers = layersFromVar (value.getProperty ("layers", {})); ! layers.empty())
        s.layers = layers;

    s.samplingVelocity = juce::jlimit (1, 127, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("samplingVelocity", 127)));
    s.velocityOffset = juce::jlimit (0, 30, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("velocityOffset", 3)));
    s.keyShift = juce::jlimit (-48, 48, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("keyShift", 0)));

    s.durationMode = value.getProperty ("durationMode", "time").toString() == "bars" ? DurationMode::bars : DurationMode::time;
    s.durationMs = juce::jlimit (200.0f, 30000.0f, static_cast<float> (value.getProperty ("durationMs", 2000.0)));
    s.durationBars = juce::jlimit (0.25f, 16.0f, static_cast<float> (value.getProperty ("durationBars", 1.0)));
    s.timeSigNumerator = juce::jlimit (1, 16, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("timeSigNum", 4)));
    s.timeSigDenominator = juce::jlimit (1, 32, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("timeSigDen", 4)));

    if (const auto* bpms = value.getProperty ("bpmLayers", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& bpm : *bpms)
            s.bpmLayers.push_back (juce::jlimit (20, 300, static_cast<int> (bpm)));

    std::sort (s.bpmLayers.begin(), s.bpmLayers.end());
    s.bpmLayers.erase (std::unique (s.bpmLayers.begin(), s.bpmLayers.end()), s.bpmLayers.end());

    s.minChordKey = juce::jlimit (0, 127, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("minChordKey", 48)));
    s.maxChordKey = juce::jlimit (0, 127, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("maxChordKey", 72)));

    if (const auto* chords = value.getProperty ("chords", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& chord : *chords)
            if (juce::isPositiveAndBelow (static_cast<int> (chord), static_cast<int> (chordTypes().size())))
                s.chords.insert (static_cast<int> (chord));

    if (auto* overrides = value.getProperty ("overrides", {}).getDynamicObject())
    {
        for (const auto& item : overrides->getProperties())
        {
            const auto note = item.name.toString().getIntValue();

            if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (note, 128))
                continue;

            KeyOverride o;

            if (const auto layers = layersFromVar (item.value.getProperty ("vel", {})); ! layers.empty())
            {
                o.customVelocity = true;
                o.layers = layers;
            }

            if (const auto duration = item.value.getProperty ("dur", {}); duration.isObject())
            {
                o.customDuration = true;
                o.durationMode = duration.getProperty ("mode", "time").toString() == "bars" ? DurationMode::bars : DurationMode::time;
                o.durationMs = juce::jlimit (200.0f, 30000.0f, static_cast<float> (duration.getProperty ("ms", 2000.0)));
                o.durationBars = juce::jlimit (0.25f, 16.0f, static_cast<float> (duration.getProperty ("bars", 1.0)));
            }

            if (const auto shift = item.value.getProperty ("shift", {}); ! shift.isVoid() && ! shift.isUndefined())
            {
                o.customKeyShift = true;
                o.keyShift = juce::jlimit (-48, 48, static_cast<int> (shift));
            }

            if (o.customVelocity || o.customDuration || o.customKeyShift)
                s.overrides[note] = o;
        }
    }

    if (auto* names = value.getProperty ("customNames", {}).getDynamicObject())
        for (const auto& item : names->getProperties())
            if (const auto name = item.value.toString().trim(); name.isNotEmpty())
                s.customNames[juce::jlimit (0, 127, item.name.toString().getIntValue())] = name;

    if (auto* slots = value.getProperty ("slots", {}).getDynamicObject())
    {
        for (const auto& item : slots->getProperties())
        {
            const auto note = item.name.toString().getIntValue();

            if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (note, 128))
                continue;

            if (const auto* list = item.value.getArray())
            {
                for (const auto& slotVar : *list)
                {
                    BuilderSlot slot;
                    slot.file = juce::File (slotVar.getProperty ("path", {}).toString());

                    if (slot.file.getFullPathName().isEmpty() || ! juce::File::isAbsolutePath (slot.file.getFullPathName()))
                        continue;

                    slot.name = slotVar.getProperty ("name", slot.file.getFileNameWithoutExtension()).toString().trim();

                    if (slot.name.isEmpty())
                        slot.name = slot.file.getFileNameWithoutExtension();

                    slot.lovel = juce::jlimit (0, 127, static_cast<int> (slotVar.getProperty ("lovel", 0)));
                    slot.hivel = juce::jlimit (0, 127, static_cast<int> (slotVar.getProperty ("hivel", 127)));

                    if (slot.lovel > slot.hivel)
                        std::swap (slot.lovel, slot.hivel);

                    if (const auto clip = slotVar.getProperty ("clip", {}); clip.isObject())
                    {
                        slot.clip = true;
                        slot.offset = juce::jmax (0.0, static_cast<double> (clip.getProperty ("offset", 0.0)));
                        slot.length = juce::jmax (0.0, static_cast<double> (clip.getProperty ("length", 0.0)));
                        slot.gainDb = juce::jlimit (-72.0, 24.0, static_cast<double> (clip.getProperty ("gainDb", 0.0)));
                        slot.fadeIn = juce::jmax (0.0, static_cast<double> (clip.getProperty ("fadeIn", 0.0)));
                        slot.fadeOut = juce::jmax (0.0, static_cast<double> (clip.getProperty ("fadeOut", 0.0)));
                    }

                    s.slots[note].push_back (slot);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    s.silenceDb = juce::jlimit (-90.0f, -20.0f, static_cast<float> (value.getProperty ("silenceDb", -60.0)));
    s.silenceMs = juce::jlimit (100.0f, 5000.0f, static_cast<float> (value.getProperty ("silenceMs", 500.0)));
    s.fadeOut = static_cast<bool> (value.getProperty ("fadeOut", true));
    s.fadeMs = juce::jlimit (10, 2000, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("fadeMs", 200)));
    s.createSfz = static_cast<bool> (value.getProperty ("createSfz", false));
    s.autoLoop = static_cast<bool> (value.getProperty ("autoLoop", false));

    const auto bits = static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("bitDepth", 24));
    s.bitDepth = bits == 16 || bits == 32 ? bits : 24;
    const auto rate = static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("sampleRate", 0));
    s.sampleRateChoice = rate == 44100 || rate == 48000 || rate == 88200 || rate == 96000 || rate == 192000 ? rate : 0;
    s.channelMode = juce::jlimit (0, 2, static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("channelMode", 0)));
    const auto speed = value.getProperty ("speed", "realtime").toString();
    s.speed = speed == "turbo" ? Speed::turbo : speed == "unleashed" ? Speed::unleashed : Speed::realTime;

    const auto takes = static_cast<int> (value.getProperty ("roundRobins", 0));
    s.roundRobins = takes < 2 ? 0 : juce::jmin (4, takes);
    s.trim = static_cast<bool> (value.getProperty ("trim", false));
    s.normalize = static_cast<bool> (value.getProperty ("normalize", false));
    s.triggerDb = juce::jlimit (-60.0f, -6.0f, static_cast<float> (value.getProperty ("triggerDb", -35.0)));
    return s;
}

juce::var Sampling::Settings::toVar() const
{
    auto* o = new juce::DynamicObject();
    o->setProperty ("mode", modeName (mode));
    o->setProperty ("source", source == Source::hardware ? "hardware" : source == Source::voice ? "voice" : "nodes");
    o->setProperty ("trackId", trackId);
    o->setProperty ("midiOutput", midiOutput);
    o->setProperty ("midiChannel", midiChannel);
    o->setProperty ("family", family);

    juce::Array<juce::var> keyList;

    for (const auto key : keys)
        keyList.add (key);

    o->setProperty ("keys", keyList);

    auto* boundaryObject = new juce::DynamicObject();

    for (const auto& [zone, key] : boundaries)
        boundaryObject->setProperty (juce::String (zone), key);

    o->setProperty ("boundaries", juce::var (boundaryObject));
    o->setProperty ("noKeyRanges", noKeyRanges);
    o->setProperty ("fillGap", fillGap);
    o->setProperty ("layers", layersVar (layers));
    o->setProperty ("samplingVelocity", samplingVelocity);
    o->setProperty ("velocityOffset", velocityOffset);
    o->setProperty ("keyShift", keyShift);
    o->setProperty ("durationMode", durationMode == DurationMode::bars ? "bars" : "time");
    o->setProperty ("durationMs", durationMs);
    o->setProperty ("durationBars", durationBars);
    o->setProperty ("timeSigNum", timeSigNumerator);
    o->setProperty ("timeSigDen", timeSigDenominator);

    juce::Array<juce::var> bpmList;

    for (const auto bpm : bpmLayers)
        bpmList.add (bpm);

    o->setProperty ("bpmLayers", bpmList);
    o->setProperty ("minChordKey", minChordKey);
    o->setProperty ("maxChordKey", maxChordKey);

    juce::Array<juce::var> chordList;

    for (const auto chord : chords)
        chordList.add (chord);

    o->setProperty ("chords", chordList);

    auto* overrideObject = new juce::DynamicObject();

    for (const auto& [note, k] : overrides)
    {
        auto* item = new juce::DynamicObject();

        if (k.customVelocity)
            item->setProperty ("vel", layersVar (k.layers));

        if (k.customDuration)
        {
            auto* duration = new juce::DynamicObject();
            duration->setProperty ("mode", k.durationMode == DurationMode::bars ? "bars" : "time");
            duration->setProperty ("ms", k.durationMs);
            duration->setProperty ("bars", k.durationBars);
            item->setProperty ("dur", juce::var (duration));
        }

        if (k.customKeyShift)
            item->setProperty ("shift", k.keyShift);

        overrideObject->setProperty (juce::String (note), juce::var (item));
    }

    o->setProperty ("overrides", juce::var (overrideObject));

    auto* nameObject = new juce::DynamicObject();

    for (const auto& [note, name] : customNames)
        nameObject->setProperty (juce::String (note), name);

    o->setProperty ("customNames", juce::var (nameObject));

    auto* slotObject = new juce::DynamicObject();

    for (const auto& [note, list] : slots)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> items;

        for (const auto& slot : list)
        {
            auto* item = new juce::DynamicObject();
            item->setProperty ("path", slot.file.getFullPathName());
            item->setProperty ("name", slot.name);
            item->setProperty ("lovel", slot.lovel);
            item->setProperty ("hivel", slot.hivel);

            if (slot.clip)
            {
                auto* clip = new juce::DynamicObject();
                clip->setProperty ("offset", slot.offset);
                clip->setProperty ("length", slot.length);
                clip->setProperty ("gainDb", slot.gainDb);
                clip->setProperty ("fadeIn", slot.fadeIn);
                clip->setProperty ("fadeOut", slot.fadeOut);
                item->setProperty ("clip", juce::var (clip));
            }

            items.add (juce::var (item));
        }

        slotObject->setProperty (juce::String (note), items);
    }

    o->setProperty ("slots", juce::var (slotObject));
    o->setProperty ("silenceDb", silenceDb);
