// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Sequence.cpp

#include "Sequence.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <utility>

namespace
{
    constexpr juce::uint8 noteOn = 0x90, noteOff = 0x80, pitchBendStatus = 0xe0, aftertouchStatus = 0xd0;

    // At the same moment: notes end, controllers go back to rest (a clip ending), controllers
    // move (a clip starting there sets its own), then notes start, already bent.
    enum Order : juce::uint8 { ending = 0, resting = 1, moving = 2, starting = 3 };

    Sequence::Event controlEvent (double ppq, juce::uint8 status, int value, juce::uint8 order)
    {
        if (status == pitchBendStatus)
        {
            const auto raw = juce::jlimit (0, 16383, value + 8192);
            return { ppq, status, static_cast<juce::uint8> (raw & 0x7f), static_cast<juce::uint8> ((raw >> 7) & 0x7f), order };
        }

        return { ppq, status, static_cast<juce::uint8> (juce::jlimit (0, 127, value)), 0, order };
    }

    int valueOf (const Sequence::Event& event) noexcept
    {
        if (event.status == pitchBendStatus)
            return ((event.data2 & 0x7f) << 7 | (event.data1 & 0x7f)) - 8192;

        return event.data1 & 0x7f;
    }

    /** A clip's line of one controller: the value in effect where its window opens (a trim may
        hide the point that set it), its points in the window, and rest at its right edge. */
    void addControls (std::vector<Sequence::Event>& events, const MidiClip& clip, const std::vector<MidiControlPoint>& points,
                      juce::uint8 status)
    {
        constexpr int rest = 0;

        if (points.empty())
            return;

        size_t first = 0;
        int before = rest;

        while (first < points.size() && points[first].time < clip.offset)
            before = points[first++].value;

        int last = rest;

        if (before != rest)
        {
            events.push_back (controlEvent (clip.start, status, before, moving));
            last = before;
        }

        for (auto i = first; i < points.size() && points[i].time < clip.offset + clip.length; ++i)
        {
            events.push_back (controlEvent (clip.songPosition (points[i].time), status, points[i].value, moving));
            last = points[i].value;
        }

        if (last != rest)
            events.push_back (controlEvent (clip.start + clip.length, status, rest, resting));
    }

    /** The last of these events before ppq: its value, or rest when there's none. */
    int valueBefore (const std::vector<Sequence::Event>& list, double ppq) noexcept
    {
        const auto after = std::lower_bound (list.begin(), list.end(), ppq, [] (const Sequence::Event& e, double t) { return e.ppq < t; });
        return after == list.begin() ? 0 : valueOf (*std::prev (after));
    }

    const char* const occurrenceNames[] { "", "first", "notFirst", "prev", "noPrev", "prevKey", "noPrevKey" };

    /** A number from a var, or a fallback when it isn't one. */
    double numberOf (const juce::var& value, double fallback) noexcept
    {
        if (value.isInt() || value.isInt64() || value.isDouble() || value.isBool())
        {
            const auto v = static_cast<double> (value);
            return std::isfinite (v) ? v : fallback;
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    /** SplitMix64: a well spread number from any other. */
    juce::uint64 mix (juce::uint64 x) noexcept
    {
        x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull;
        x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ull;
        x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebull;
        return x ^ (x >> 31);
    }

    /** A roll in [0, 1) for a note on a pass: the same every time that pass plays. */
    double roll (juce::uint64 key, int pass, juce::uint64 salt) noexcept
    {
        const auto x = mix (key ^ mix (static_cast<juce::uint64> (static_cast<juce::uint32> (pass)) * 0x100000001b3ull + salt));
        return static_cast<double> (x >> 11) * (1.0 / 9007199254740992.0);
    }

    /** Two clips with the same content, as it plays (copies of one pattern). */
    bool sameContent (const MidiClip& a, const MidiClip& b) noexcept
    {
        if (! juce::exactlyEqual (a.offset, b.offset) || ! juce::exactlyEqual (a.length, b.length) || a.seed != b.seed
            || a.notes.size() != b.notes.size())
            return false;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < a.notes.size(); ++i)
            if (! a.notes[i].sameAs (b.notes[i]))
                return false;

        return true;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
bool NoteOperators::isDefault() const noexcept
{
    return operator== (NoteOperators());
}

bool NoteOperators::operator== (const NoteOperators& other) const noexcept
{
    // Settings that change nothing compare equal: a mask with no cycle, a curve with no repeats.
    const auto cycle = recurrenceLength >= 2 ? recurrenceLength : 0;
    const auto otherCycle = other.recurrenceLength >= 2 ? other.recurrenceLength : 0;
    const auto bits = cycle > 0 ? (recurrenceMask & ((1 << cycle) - 1)) : 0;
    const auto otherBits = otherCycle > 0 ? (other.recurrenceMask & ((1 << otherCycle) - 1)) : 0;

    return chance == other.chance && velocitySpread == other.velocitySpread
        && repeatCount == other.repeatCount && juce::exactlyEqual (repeatRate, other.repeatRate)
        && (repeats() ? repeatCurve == other.repeatCurve && repeatVelocity == other.repeatVelocity
                      : ! other.repeats())
        && occurrence == other.occurrence && cycle == otherCycle && bits == otherBits;
}

juce::var NoteOperators::toVar() const
{
    auto* object = new juce::DynamicObject();

    if (chance != 100)          object->setProperty ("c", chance);
    if (velocitySpread != 0)    object->setProperty ("vs", velocitySpread);

    if (repeats())
    {
        if (repeatCount >= 2)   object->setProperty ("rn", repeatCount);
        else                    object->setProperty ("rr", repeatRate);

        if (repeatCurve != 0)   object->setProperty ("rc", repeatCurve);
        if (repeatVelocity != 0) object->setProperty ("rv", repeatVelocity);
    }

    if (occurrence > always && occurrence <= withoutPreviousKey)
        object->setProperty ("oc", occurrenceNames[occurrence]);

    if (recurrenceLength >= 2)
    {
        object->setProperty ("rl", recurrenceLength);
        object->setProperty ("rm", recurrenceMask & ((1 << recurrenceLength) - 1));
    }

    return juce::var (object);
}

NoteOperators NoteOperators::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    NoteOperators ops;

    if (! value.isObject())
        return ops;

    const auto whole = [&value] (const char* name, int fallback, int low, int high)
    {
        return juce::jlimit (low, high, juce::roundToInt (numberOf (value.getProperty (name, {}), fallback)));
    };

    ops.chance = whole ("c", 100, 0, 100);
    ops.velocitySpread = whole ("vs", 0, 0, 100);
    ops.repeatCount = whole ("rn", 0, 0, maxRepeats);

    if (ops.repeatCount < 2)
    {
        ops.repeatCount = 0;
        const auto rate = numberOf (value.getProperty ("rr", {}), 0.0);
        ops.repeatRate = rate >= 1.0 / 128.0 && rate <= 16.0 ? rate : 0.0;
    }

    ops.repeatCurve = whole ("rc", 0, -100, 100);
    ops.repeatVelocity = whole ("rv", 0, -100, 100);

    const auto occurrence = value.getProperty ("oc", {}).toString();

    for (int i = withoutPreviousKey; i > always; --i)
        if (occurrence == occurrenceNames[i])
            ops.occurrence = i;

    ops.recurrenceLength = whole ("rl", 0, 0, 8);

    if (ops.recurrenceLength < 2)
        ops.recurrenceLength = 0;
    else
        ops.recurrenceMask = whole ("rm", 0xff, 0, 0xff) & ((1 << ops.recurrenceLength) - 1);

    return ops;
}

//==============================================================================
juce::var MidiNote::toVar() const
{
    juce::Array<juce::var> values { pitch, start, length, juce::jlimit (1, 127, juce::roundToInt (velocity * 127.0f)) };
    const auto plain = ops.isDefault();

    if (muted || ! plain)
        values.add (muted ? 1 : 0);

    if (! plain)
        values.add (ops.toVar());

    return values;
}

bool MidiNote::fromVar (const juce::var& value, MidiNote& note)
{
    const auto* fields = value.getArray();

    if (fields == nullptr || fields->size() < 4)
        return false;

    note = {};
    note.pitch = juce::roundToInt (numberOf ((*fields)[0], -1.0));
    note.start = numberOf ((*fields)[1], 0.0);
    note.length = numberOf ((*fields)[2], 0.25);
    note.velocity = static_cast<float> (numberOf ((*fields)[3], 100.0) / 127.0);
    note.muted = fields->size() >= 5 && numberOf ((*fields)[4], 0.0) > 0.5;

    if (fields->size() >= 6)
        note.ops = NoteOperators::fromVar ((*fields)[5]);

    return true;
}

bool MidiNote::sameAs (const MidiNote& other) const noexcept
{
    return pitch == other.pitch && juce::exactlyEqual (start, other.start) && juce::exactlyEqual (length, other.length)
        && juce::exactlyEqual (velocity, other.velocity) && muted == other.muted && ops == other.ops;
}

//==============================================================================
void MidiClip::tidy (std::vector<MidiControlPoint>& points, int minimum, int maximum)
{
    points.erase (std::remove_if (points.begin(), points.end(), [] (const MidiControlPoint& point) { return ! std::isfinite (point.time); }),
                  points.end());

    for (auto& point : points)
        point.value = juce::jlimit (minimum, maximum, point.value);

    std::stable_sort (points.begin(), points.end(), [] (const MidiControlPoint& a, const MidiControlPoint& b) { return a.time < b.time; });

    // One value per moment: the last one given.
    std::vector<MidiControlPoint> kept;
    kept.reserve (points.size());

    for (const auto& point : points)
    {
        if (! kept.empty() && juce::exactlyEqual (kept.back().time, point.time))
            kept.back() = point;
        else
            kept.push_back (point);
    }

    points = std::move (kept);
}

//==============================================================================
std::unique_ptr<const Sequence> Sequence::build (const std::vector<MidiClip>& clips, int quietControlsClip)
{
    auto sequence = std::make_unique<Sequence>();
    auto& events = sequence->events;

    // The clips whose notes have operators, and among them the copies placed back to back (one
    // pattern repeated): a chain, whose passes count copy by copy.
    const auto playable = [] (const MidiClip& clip, const MidiNote& note)
    {
        return ! note.muted && clip.shows (note) && note.pitch >= 0 && note.pitch <= 127;
    };

    std::vector<int> chainOf (clips.size(), -1), copyOf (clips.size(), 0);
    std::vector<size_t> operated;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < clips.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& clip = clips[i];

        if (clip.isAudio() || clip.muted)
            continue;

        if (std::any_of (clip.notes.begin(), clip.notes.end(), [&] (const MidiNote& n) { return playable (clip, n) && ! n.ops.isDefault(); }))
            operated.push_back (i);
    }

    std::stable_sort (operated.begin(), operated.end(), [&clips] (size_t a, size_t b) { return clips[a].start < clips[b].start; });

    int chains = 0;
    std::vector<size_t> chainEnd;   // each chain's last copy so far

    for (const auto i : operated)
    {
        const auto& clip = clips[i];

        for (int c = 0; c < chains && chainOf[i] < 0; ++c)
        {
            const auto& last = clips[chainEnd[static_cast<size_t> (c)]];

            if (std::abs (last.start + last.length - clip.start) < 1.0e-6 && sameContent (last, clip))
            {
                chainOf[i] = c;
                copyOf[i] = copyOf[chainEnd[static_cast<size_t> (c)]] + 1;
                chainEnd[static_cast<size_t> (c)] = i;
            }
        }

        if (chainOf[i] < 0)
        {
            chainOf[i] = chains++;
            chainEnd.push_back (i);
        }
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < clips.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& clip = clips[i];

        if (clip.isAudio() || clip.muted)
            continue;

        const auto withOperators = chainOf[i] >= 0;

        for (const auto& note : clip.notes)
        {
            // Only notes the clip shows play (a muted one doesn't); a note running over the clip's
            // end is cut there.
            if (! playable (clip, note))
                continue;

            const auto on = clip.songPosition (note.start);
            const auto off = juce::jmin (on + juce::jmax (note.length, minimumNoteLength), clip.start + clip.length);
            const auto pitch = static_cast<juce::uint8> (note.pitch);
            const auto velocity = static_cast<juce::uint8> (juce::jlimit (1, 127, juce::roundToInt (note.velocity * 127.0f)));

            if (! withOperators)
            {
                events.push_back ({ on, noteOn, pitch, velocity, starting });
                events.push_back ({ off, noteOff, pitch, 0, ending });
                continue;
            }

            // In a clip with operators every note is followed (the ones with none count as played
            // for the notes after them).
            OperatorNote entry;
            entry.ops = note.ops;
            entry.chain = chainOf[i];
            entry.clip = static_cast<int> (i);
            entry.copy = copyOf[i];
            entry.pitch = pitch;
            entry.key = mix (static_cast<juce::uint64> (clip.seed) * 0x1000193ull
                             ^ mix (static_cast<juce::uint64> (note.pitch) << 40
                                    ^ static_cast<juce::uint64> (static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (note.start * 3840.0)))));
            const auto index = static_cast<int> (sequence->operatorNotes.size());
            sequence->operatorNotes.push_back (entry);

            const auto& ops = note.ops;
            const auto span = off - on;

            if (! ops.repeats() || span <= minimumNoteLength * 2.0)
            {
                events.push_back ({ on, noteOn, pitch, velocity, starting, index, true });
                events.push_back ({ off, noteOff, pitch, 0, ending, index, true });
                continue;
            }

            // Repeats: evenly through its length (a count), or every note value (a rate), the curve
            // crowding them to its start or its end; the velocity going towards the last one's.
            auto count = ops.repeatCount >= 2 ? ops.repeatCount
                                              : static_cast<int> (std::ceil (span / ops.repeatRate - 1.0e-3));
            count = juce::jlimit (1, NoteOperators::maxRepeats, count);

            const auto exponent = std::pow (4.0, -ops.repeatCurve / 100.0);
            const auto placeOf = [&] (int k)
            {
                if (k >= count)
                    return 1.0;

                const auto share = ops.repeatCount >= 2 ? static_cast<double> (k) / count : juce::jmin (1.0, k * ops.repeatRate / span);
                return std::pow (share, exponent);
            };

            const auto from = static_cast<double> (velocity);
            const auto change = ops.repeatVelocity / 100.0;
            const auto to = change >= 0.0 ? from + change * (127.0 - from) : from + change * from;

            // The repeats a curve crowds closer than the shortest note go (and one that would be
            // shorter than that at the end): the one before lasts until the next that stays. The
            // first always plays, where the note starts.
            std::array<int, NoteOperators::maxRepeats> kept {};
            int keptCount = 0;

            for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k)
                if (k == 0 || ((placeOf (k) - placeOf (kept[static_cast<size_t> (keptCount - 1)])) * span >= minimumNoteLength
                               && (1.0 - placeOf (k)) * span >= minimumNoteLength))
                    kept[static_cast<size_t> (keptCount++)] = k;

            for (int r = 0; r < keptCount; ++r)
            {
                const auto k = kept[static_cast<size_t> (r)];
                const auto a = on + placeOf (k) * span;
                const auto b = r + 1 < keptCount ? on + placeOf (kept[static_cast<size_t> (r + 1)]) * span : off;
                const auto v = count > 1 ? from + (to - from) * k / (count - 1) : from;
                const auto level = static_cast<juce::uint8> (juce::jlimit (1, 127, juce::roundToInt (v)));
                events.push_back ({ a, noteOn, pitch, level, starting, index, r == 0 });
                events.push_back ({ b, noteOff, pitch, 0, ending, index, r == 0 });
            }
        }

        if (clip.id != quietControlsClip || quietControlsClip == 0)
        {
            addControls (events, clip, clip.pitchBend, pitchBendStatus);
            addControls (events, clip, clip.aftertouch, aftertouchStatus);
        }
    }

    // By time; at the same time a note-off comes first (so a repeated note plays again), then
    // controllers going to rest, then controllers moving, then note-ons.
    std::stable_sort (events.begin(), events.end(), [] (const Event& a, const Event& b)
    {
        if (a.ppq < b.ppq) return true;
        if (b.ppq < a.ppq) return false;
        return a.order < b.order;
    });

    for (const auto& event : events)
    {
        if (event.status == pitchBendStatus)
            sequence->bends.push_back (event);
        else if (event.status == aftertouchStatus)
            sequence->pressures.push_back (event);
    }

    sequence->chains.resize (static_cast<size_t> (chains));
    sequence->noteStates.resize (sequence->operatorNotes.size());
    return sequence;
}

//==============================================================================
void Sequence::startRun() const noexcept
{
    for (auto& chain : chains)
        chain = {};

    for (auto& state : noteStates)
        state = {};
}

void Sequence::jumped() const noexcept
{
    for (auto& chain : chains)
        chain.clip = -1;
}

bool Sequence::decide (const Event& event, juce::uint8& velocity) const noexcept
{
    if (event.note < 0 || static_cast<size_t> (event.note) >= operatorNotes.size())
        return true;

    const auto& note = operatorNotes[static_cast<size_t> (event.note)];
    auto& state = noteStates[static_cast<size_t> (event.note)];

    // A note's end: it ends what it started.
    if (event.status != noteOn)
        return state.plays;

    auto& chain = chains[static_cast<size_t> (note.chain)];

    // Into a copy of the clip (or into the clip again, the loop gone round): the next pass. Where
    // playback starts, a copy counts from its place among the copies.
    if (chain.clip != note.clip)
    {
        chain.pass = juce::jmax (note.copy, chain.last + 1);
        chain.last = chain.pass;
        chain.clip = note.clip;
    }

    // Decided once a pass, by its first repeat (or by the first one heard, started in the middle).
    if (event.first || state.pass != chain.pass)
    {
        const auto& ops = note.ops;
        const auto pass = chain.pass;
        bool plays = true;

        switch (ops.occurrence)
        {
            case NoteOperators::first:              plays = pass == 0; break;
            case NoteOperators::notFirst:           plays = pass > 0; break;
            case NoteOperators::withPrevious:       plays = chain.previousPlayed; break;
            case NoteOperators::withoutPrevious:    plays = ! chain.previousPlayed; break;
            case NoteOperators::withPreviousKey:    plays = ! chain.keyMissed.test (note.pitch); break;
            case NoteOperators::withoutPreviousKey: plays = chain.keyMissed.test (note.pitch); break;
            default: break;
        }

        if (ops.recurrenceLength >= 2)
            plays = plays && ((ops.recurrenceMask >> (pass % ops.recurrenceLength)) & 1) != 0;

        if (ops.chance < 100)
            plays = plays && roll (note.key, pass, 1) * 100.0 < ops.chance;

        state.spread = ops.velocitySpread > 0 ? juce::roundToInt ((roll (note.key, pass, 2) * 2.0 - 1.0) * ops.velocitySpread * 1.27) : 0;
        state.plays = plays;
        state.pass = pass;

        // What the notes after it go by.
        chain.previousPlayed = plays;
        chain.keyMissed.set (note.pitch, ! plays);
    }

    velocity = static_cast<juce::uint8> (juce::jlimit (1, 127, velocity + state.spread));
    return state.plays;
}

int Sequence::pitchBendBefore (double ppq) const noexcept   { return valueBefore (bends, ppq); }
int Sequence::aftertouchBefore (double ppq) const noexcept  { return valueBefore (pressures, ppq); }

//==============================================================================
void Sequencer::sendPitchBend (int value, juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept
{
    const auto raw = juce::jlimit (0, 16383, value + 8192);
    const juce::uint8 message[] = { pitchBendStatus, static_cast<juce::uint8> (raw & 0x7f), static_cast<juce::uint8> ((raw >> 7) & 0x7f) };
    out.addEvent (message, 3, sampleOffset);
    pitchBendNow = value;
}

void Sequencer::sendAftertouch (int value, juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept
{
    const juce::uint8 message[] = { aftertouchStatus, static_cast<juce::uint8> (juce::jlimit (0, 127, value)) };
    out.addEvent (message, 2, sampleOffset);
    aftertouchNow = value;
}

void Sequencer::releaseAll (juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept
{
    for (int pitch = 0; pitch < 128; ++pitch)
    {
        if (! sounding.test (static_cast<size_t> (pitch)))
            continue;

        const juce::uint8 message[] = { noteOff, static_cast<juce::uint8> (pitch), 0 };
        out.addEvent (message, 3, sampleOffset);
    }

    sounding.reset();

    // Nothing left bent or pressed.
    if (pitchBendNow != 0)
        sendPitchBend (0, out, sampleOffset);

    if (aftertouchNow != 0)
        sendAftertouch (0, out, sampleOffset);
}

void Sequencer::chase (const Sequence& sequence, double ppq, juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept
{
    // Playing from the middle of a bend: the instrument hears where it stands first.
    if (const auto bend = sequence.pitchBendBefore (ppq); bend != pitchBendNow)
        sendPitchBend (bend, out, sampleOffset);

    if (const auto pressure = sequence.aftertouchBefore (ppq); pressure != aftertouchNow)
        sendAftertouch (pressure, out, sampleOffset);
}

void Sequencer::render (const Sequence* sequence, const Transport& transport, juce::MidiBuffer& out) noexcept
{
    // Asked to let go (the clips changed under it): what's playing stops, and the controllers
    // are found again where they stand.
    bool chaseDue = chaseRequested.exchange (false);

    if (releaseRequested.exchange (false))
    {
        releaseAll (out, 0);
        chaseDue = true;
    }

    const auto segments = transport.getNumSegments();

    if (segments == 0)
    {
        if (wasPlaying)
            releaseAll (out, 0);          // stopped

        wasPlaying = false;
        return;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < segments; ++i)
    {
        const auto& segment = transport.getSegment (i);
        const auto perSample = segment.perSample;   // each stretch has its own (the tempo may ramp)

        // A jump (the loop going round, a locate while playing) releases what was playing; the
        // clips under it are entered again (their next pass).
        if (wasPlaying && std::abs (segment.from - expected) > 1.0e-6)
        {
            releaseAll (out, segment.offset);
            chaseDue = true;

            if (sequence != nullptr)
                sequence->jumped();
        }

        // Starting: the clips' passes count from where they stand.
        if (! wasPlaying)
        {
            chaseDue = true;

            if (sequence != nullptr)
                sequence->startRun();
        }

        wasPlaying = true;
        expected = segment.to;

        if (sequence == nullptr || perSample <= 0.0)
            continue;

        if (std::exchange (chaseDue, false))
            chase (*sequence, segment.from, out, segment.offset);

        const auto& events = sequence->getEvents();
        auto event = std::lower_bound (events.begin(), events.end(), segment.from,
                                       [] (const Sequence::Event& e, double ppq) { return e.ppq < ppq; });

        for (; event != events.end() && event->ppq < segment.to; ++event)
        {
            const auto within = static_cast<int> ((event->ppq - segment.from) / perSample);
            const auto at = segment.offset + juce::jlimit (0, segment.length - 1, within);

            if (event->status == pitchBendStatus)
            {
                sendPitchBend (valueOf (*event), out, at);
                continue;
            }

            if (event->status == aftertouchStatus)
            {
                sendAftertouch (valueOf (*event), out, at);
                continue;
            }

            const auto pitch = static_cast<size_t> (event->data1 & 0x7f);
            auto velocity = event->data2;

            // A note with operators: whether it plays this pass, and how hard.
            if (event->note >= 0 && ! sequence->decide (*event, velocity))
                continue;

            if (event->status == noteOff)
            {
                if (! sounding.test (pitch))
                    continue;             // started before playback began here: nothing to end

                sounding.reset (pitch);
            }
            else
            {
                sounding.set (pitch);
            }

            const juce::uint8 message[] = { event->status, event->data1, velocity };
            out.addEvent (message, 3, at);
        }
    }
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Sequence.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>

#include "Transport.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <bitset>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    A note's operators (Bitwig's): whether it plays each time the music comes round, and how.

        Chance       the chance it plays, rolled again on every pass
        Vel Spread   its velocity moves up to this much up or down, rolled again on every pass
        Repeats      ratchets: played several times through its length, evenly (a count) or every
                     note value (a rate), crowded to its start or end (the curve), its velocity
                     going towards silence or the top by the last one
        Occurrence   only on the first pass (or never on it), or only when the note before it in
                     the clip (or on its key) played (or didn't)
        Recurrence   a cycle of 2 to 8 passes, and the passes of it the note plays on

    A pass is a time the music plays the clip: again each time the loop goes round over it, and
    copy by copy along copies of the clip placed back to back (one pattern repeated). The rolls
    come from the clip's seed (the Editor's Seed), so a pass sounds the same every time it plays,
    in a mixdown too. Chance and Vel Spread are the only random ones.
*/
struct NoteOperators
{
    enum Occurrence { always, first, notFirst, withPrevious, withoutPrevious, withPreviousKey, withoutPreviousKey };

    int chance = 100;                  // % it plays
    int velocitySpread = 0;            // % of the velocity range it may move, up or down
    int repeatCount = 0;               // 2..64: played this many times through its length (0: once)
    double repeatRate = 0.0;           // or again every this many quarter notes (0: not)
    int repeatCurve = 0;               // -100..100: the repeats crowd towards its start (below 0) or its end
    int repeatVelocity = 0;            // -100..100: the last repeat's velocity, from the note's towards silence or the top
    int occurrence = always;
    int recurrenceLength = 0;          // 2..8 passes a cycle (0: every pass)
    int recurrenceMask = 0xff;         // the passes of the cycle it plays on, bit 0 the first

    static constexpr int maxRepeats = 64;

    bool repeats() const noexcept      { return repeatCount >= 2 || repeatRate > 0.0; }
    bool isDefault() const noexcept;
    bool operator== (const NoteOperators& other) const noexcept;
    bool operator!= (const NoteOperators& other) const noexcept   { return ! operator== (other); }

    /** For the page and the song file: only what isn't the default ({} when nothing is):
        c chance, vs velocity spread, rn repeat count, rr repeat rate, rc repeat curve, rv repeat
        velocity, oc occurrence ("first", "notFirst", "prev", "noPrev", "prevKey", "noPrevKey"),
        rl recurrence length, rm recurrence mask. */
    juce::var toVar() const;

    /** Read back, every value kept in range. */
    static NoteOperators fromVar (const juce::var& value);
};

//==============================================================================
/** One note in a clip. Times are quarter notes on the clip's own content timeline. */
struct MidiNote
{
    int pitch = 60;
    double start = 0.0;
    double length = 0.25;
    float velocity = 0.8f;             // 0..1
    bool muted = false;                // the Editor's Mute tool: kept in the clip, but silent
    NoteOperators ops {};

    /** As the page and the song file have it: [pitch, start, length, velocity 1-127], then 1 for a
        muted note (0 when operators follow), then its operators when they aren't the default. */
    juce::var toVar() const;

    /** Read back; false when the value isn't a note. */
    static bool fromVar (const juce::var& value, MidiNote& note);

    /** Everything about it the same (a copy of it). */
    bool sameAs (const MidiNote& other) const noexcept;
};

/** A point on one of a clip's controller lines (pitch bend, aftertouch): from its time on the
    controller has its value, until the next point, or the clip's end, where it goes back to rest. */
struct MidiControlPoint
{
    double time = 0.0;                 // quarter notes on the clip's content timeline
    int value = 0;                     // pitch bend -8192..8191 (0 at rest), aftertouch 0..127
};

/**
    A MIDI clip on a track (Studio One calls it a part): a window onto its notes.

    The clip shows its content from offset to offset + length, placed at start in the
    song. Trimming a clip moves that window without touching the notes, so notes
    outside it are hidden, not lost, and come back when the clip is dragged longer.
    A note plays when its start is inside the window; it's cut at the clip's end.
    Its pitch bend and aftertouch (channel pressure) are lines of points in the same
    window: the value in effect where the window opens plays from its left edge, and
    both go back to rest at its right edge.
*/
struct MidiClip
{
    int id = 0;
    double start = 0.0;                // song position of the clip's left edge, quarter notes
    double length = 4.0;
    double offset = 0.0;               // content position shown at the left edge
    bool muted = false;                // the arrangement's Mute tool: kept in the song, but silent
    juce::uint32 seed = 0;             // what its notes' operators roll from (Chance, Vel Spread): the Editor's Seed
    std::vector<MidiNote> notes;       // content positions, sorted by start
    std::vector<MidiControlPoint> pitchBend;    // content positions, sorted by time
    std::vector<MidiControlPoint> aftertouch;   // channel pressure, content positions, sorted by time

    // An audio clip plays a window of a file instead of notes. Audio keeps its speed
    // whatever the tempo, so its window is in seconds; length above is the same window in
    // quarter notes at the current tempo, kept up to date by the engine.
    juce::String audioFile;            // set: an audio clip
    double audioOffset = 0.0;          // seconds into the file where the window starts
    double audioLength = 0.0;          // seconds of the file the window shows
    double audioGainDb = 0.0;          // the clip's own volume, as on Studio One's events
    double fadeIn = 0.0, fadeOut = 0.0;   // seconds

    // An audio clip made from an original (Audio > Sync Tempo, Pitch, Reverse): audioFile is the
    // render, made from this window of the original, which stays as it was. A further change
    // starts from the original again; Undo goes back to it.
    juce::String sourceFile;           // empty: the clip plays its file as it is
    double sourceOffset = 0.0;         // seconds into the original
    double sourceLength = 0.0;
    double sourceTempo = 0.0;          // the original's tempo, stretched to the song's (0: not stretched)
    double pitch = 0.0;                // semitones it's moved by
    bool reversed = false;
    bool followTempo = false;          // rendered again whenever the song's tempo changes under it

    bool isAudio() const noexcept                                  { return audioFile.isNotEmpty(); }
    bool isRender() const noexcept                                 { return sourceFile.isNotEmpty(); }

    /** Follows the song's tempo: its window is counted in the original's beats as well (offset:
        beats of the original before its left edge; length: the beats it shows), and its render
        covers the whole original window, so trimming shows or hides audio as with any clip. */
    bool followsTempo() const noexcept                             { return followTempo && sourceTempo > 0.0 && isRender(); }

    double songPosition (double contentPosition) const noexcept   { return start + contentPosition - offset; }
    double contentPosition (double songPosition) const noexcept   { return songPosition - start + offset; }
    bool shows (const MidiNote& note) const noexcept              { return note.start >= offset && note.start < offset + length; }

    static constexpr int pitchBendMin = -8192, pitchBendMax = 8191, aftertouchMax = 127;

    /** Points sorted by time, one per time (the last given wins), values in range, impossible times dropped. */
    static void tidy (std::vector<MidiControlPoint>& points, int minimum, int maximum);
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    Everything a track's clips play, flattened into one list of events sorted by song
    position: notes, pitch bend and aftertouch. Built on the message thread whenever the
    clips change and handed to the audio thread whole; the audio thread only ever reads it.
*/
class Sequence final
{
public:
    struct Event
    {
        double ppq = 0.0;
        juce::uint8 status = 0, data1 = 0, data2 = 0;
        juce::uint8 order = 0;         // at the same moment: notes end, controllers rest, controllers move, notes start
        int note = -1;                 // a note in a clip with operators: its place among them (-1: none)
        bool first = true;             // its first repeat (or it has none)
    };

    /** quietControlsClip: a clip whose pitch bend and aftertouch aren't played (one being recorded into).
        A note's repeats are its own notes here; whether each plays is decided as it comes (decide). */
    static std::unique_ptr<const Sequence> build (const std::vector<MidiClip>& clips, int quietControlsClip = 0);

    //==========================================================================
    // The operators, as the music plays: audio thread only (the Sequencer's).

    /** Playback starts: every clip is counted from where it stands in its copies again. */
    void startRun() const noexcept;

    /** A jump (the loop going round, a locate): each clip is entered again as it plays next, one
        pass on. */
    void jumped() const noexcept;

    /** Whether a note event (one with operators) plays this time; a note-on's velocity, spread. */
    bool decide (const Event& event, juce::uint8& velocity) const noexcept;

    const std::vector<Event>& getEvents() const noexcept     { return events; }

    /** The pitch bend (-8192..8191) and aftertouch (0..127) in effect just before a song position:
        what playing from there must send first. */
    int pitchBendBefore (double ppq) const noexcept;
    int aftertouchBefore (double ppq) const noexcept;

    static constexpr double minimumNoteLength = 1.0 / 128.0;   // quarter notes

private:
    struct OperatorNote
    {
        NoteOperators ops;
        int chain = 0;                 // the clip's chain: its copies back to back
        int clip = 0;                  // the clip (its place in the track's clips)
        int copy = 0;                  // which copy of the chain it is, from 0
        juce::uint64 key = 0;          // the clip's seed and the note: what it rolls from
        juce::uint8 pitch = 0;
    };

    struct ChainState
    {
        int clip = -1;                 // the copy being played (-1: none since the last jump)
        int pass = -1, last = -1;      // the pass playing, and the last one counted
        bool previousPlayed = true;
        std::bitset<128> keyMissed;    // the last note on each key didn't play
    };

    struct NoteState
    {
        int pass = -1;                 // the pass it was decided for
        bool plays = true;
        int spread = 0;                // added to its velocities
    };

    std::vector<Event> events;
    std::vector<Event> bends, pressures;   // the controller events alone, for finding where they stand
    std::vector<OperatorNote> operatorNotes;
    mutable std::vector<ChainState> chains;     // the audio thread's
    mutable std::vector<NoteState> noteStates;
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    Plays a Sequence into a block's MIDI, following the transport's plan for the
    block. It remembers the notes it has started, so stopping, locating or looping
    back never leaves one hanging, and where pitch bend and aftertouch stand: they go
    back to rest when it stops, and playing from anywhere starts with the values in
    effect there. Audio thread only, apart from requestRelease().
*/
class Sequencer final
{
public:
    void render (const Sequence* sequence, const Transport& transport, juce::MidiBuffer& out) noexcept;

    /** Releases every note it started, at the start of the next block (any thread). */
    void requestRelease() noexcept        { releaseRequested.store (true); }

    /** Sends the pitch bend and aftertouch in effect at the playhead again, at the start of the
        next block, when they differ from what it last sent: the lines changed under it (any thread). */
    void requestChase() noexcept          { chaseRequested.store (true); }

private:
    void releaseAll (juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept;
    void chase (const Sequence& sequence, double ppq, juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept;
    void sendPitchBend (int value, juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept;
    void sendAftertouch (int value, juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept;

    std::bitset<128> sounding;
    std::atomic<bool> releaseRequested { false }, chaseRequested { false };
    bool wasPlaying = false;
    double expected = 0.0;             // where the next block should start if nothing jumps
    int pitchBendNow = 0;              // what it last sent (0: at rest)
    int aftertouchNow = 0;
};

    struct Quality
    {

    /** A note name (C, F#, Bb, eb) at the start of text: its pitch class, and how many characters it took. */
    int readNote (const juce::String& text, int& used)
    {
        used = 0;

        if (text.isEmpty())
            return -1;

        static const std::array<int, 7> letters { 9, 11, 0, 2, 4, 5, 7 };   // A B C D E F G
        const auto letter = juce::CharacterFunctions::toUpperCase (text[0]);

        if (letter < 'A' || letter > 'G')
            return -1;

        auto pc = letters[static_cast<size_t> (letter - 'A')];
        used = 1;

        while (used < text.length() && (text[used] == '#' || text[used] == 'b'))
        {
            pc += text[used] == '#' ? 1 : -1;
            ++used;
        }

        return (pc % 12 + 12) % 12;
    }

    bool sameChord (const Chord& a, const Chord& b)
    {
        return a.root == b.root && a.bass == b.bass && a.intervals == b.intervals;
    }

    juce::String chordName (int root, const Quality& quality, int bass)
    {
        juce::String name (noteNames[static_cast<size_t> (root)]);
        name << quality.spellings.front();

        if (bass >= 0 && bass != root)
            name << "/" << noteNames[static_cast<size_t> (bass)];

        return name;
    }

    //==============================================================================
    // Patterns. A bar is a row of steps (sixteenths in 4/4); each player reads its own symbols.
    //   drums   X accent, x hit, g ghost, . nothing (a row per drum, General MIDI notes)
    //   bass    R root, r short root, 5 fifth, O octave, 3 third, b seventh, A a step into the
    //           next chord, - holds, . rests
    //   keys    C chord, c soft chord, B chord with the left hand's root, b left hand alone,
    //           a the next note of a broken chord, - holds, . rests
    enum class Tier { low, mid, high };

    constexpr int kick = 36, rim = 37, snare = 38, clap = 39, floorTom = 43, closedHat = 42, lowTom = 45,
                  openHat = 46, midTom = 47, crash = 49, highTom = 50, ride = 51;

    struct Pattern
    {
        std::vector<std::pair<int, std::string>> drums;
        std::string bass, keys;
    };

    struct Feel
    {
        double swing = 0.5;              // where the second sixteenth of each eighth falls (0.5: straight)
        bool staccato = false;           // short bass and keys (funk, house)
        bool electronic = false;         // drums on the grid
        int phraseBars = 4;              // fills before, crashes at, each phrase
    };

    Feel feelOf (Style style)
    {
        switch (style)
        {
            case Style::funk:   return { 0.54, true, false, 4 };
            case Style::house:  return { 0.5, true, true, 8 };
            case Style::hiphop: return { 0.58, false, true, 4 };
            case Style::ballad: return { 0.5, false, false, 8 };
            case Style::rock:
            case Style::pop:    break;
        }

        return {};
    }

    Pattern pattern44 (Style style, Tier tier)
    {
        const auto t = [tier] (const char* low, const char* mid, const char* high)
        {
            return std::string (tier == Tier::low ? low : tier == Tier::mid ? mid : high);
        };

        switch (style)
        {
            case Style::rock:
                return { { { kick,      t ("X.......X.......", "X.......X.X.....", "X.x.....X.X.....") },

            case Style::ballad:

                         t ("R---------------", "R-------5-------", "R-----5-R-----3-"),
                         t ("B---------------", "b-a-a-a-b-a-a-a-", "b-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-") };

            case Style::funk:
                return { { { kick,      t ("X..x......X.....", "X..x..x...X..x..", "X..x..x.x.X..x..") },
                           { snare,     t ("....X.......X...", "....X..g.g..X..g", "..g.X..g.g.gX.g.") },
                           { closedHat, t ("x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.", "XxXxXxXxXxXxXxXx", "XxXxXxXxXxXxXxXx") },
                           { openHat,   t ("................", "................", "......x.........") } },
                         t ("R..R......R..5..", "R.rR..R.O.R..5.A", "R.rRr.R.O.rR.5rA"),
                         t ("..C...C...C...C.", "..c.C..c..C.c...", "c.cC.cC.c.cC.cC.") };

            case Style::house:
                return { { { kick,      t ("X...X...X...X...", "X...X...X...X...", "X...X...X...X...") },
                           { clap,      t ("................", "....X.......X...", "....X.......X...") },
                           { closedHat, t ("..x...x...x...x.", "................", ".x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x") },
                           { openHat,   t ("................", "..x...x...x...x.", "..x...x...x...x.") } },
                         t ("..R...R...R...R.", "..R-..R-..R-..R-", "R.R-..R-.RR-..RA"),
                         t ("..C...C...C...C.", "..C...C...C...C.", "..C.C.C...C.C.C.") };

            case Style::hiphop:
                return { { { kick,      t ("X.........X.....", "X......x..X.....", "X......x.xX....x") },
                           { snare,     t ("....X.......X...", "....X.......X...", "....X.......X...") },
                           { closedHat, t ("x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.", "x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.", "x.xxx.x.x.xxx.x.") } },
                         t ("R-------..R-----", "R-----.R..R---5-", "R---.R.R..R-.R5A"),
                         t ("C---------------", "C-------..C-----", "C---..C-..C-..C-") };

            case Style::pop:
                break;
        }

        return { { { kick,      t ("X.......x.......", "X.....x.X.......", "X.....x.X.x.....") },
                   { snare,     t ("....x.......x...", "....X.......X...", "....X.......X..g") },
                   { closedHat, t ("x...x...x...x...", "x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.", "XxxxXxxxXxxxXxxx") },
                   { openHat,   t ("................", "................", "..............x.") } },
                 t ("R-------R-------", "R---R-.RR---5-.A", "R-.RR-.RR-.R5-.A"),
                 t ("B-------C-------", "B-.C..C.C-.C..C.", "B.c.C.c.C.c.C.c.") };
    }

    /** 3/4: a waltz, whatever the style. */
    Pattern pattern34 (Tier tier)
    {
        const auto t = [tier] (const char* low, const char* mid, const char* high)
        {
            return std::string (tier == Tier::low ? low : tier == Tier::mid ? mid : high);
        };

        return { { { kick,      t ("X...........", "X...........", "X.......x...") },
                   { rim,       t ("....x...x...", "....x...x...", "............") },
                   { snare,     t ("............", "............", "....X...X...") },
                   { closedHat, t ("x...x...x...", "x.x.x.x.x.x.", "x.x.x.x.x.x.") } },
                 t ("R-----------", "R---5---5---", "R---5---3---"),
