    /** 6/8 (and 12/8, twice over): two lilting groups of three. */
    Pattern pattern68 (Tier tier)
    {
        const auto t = [tier] (const char* low, const char* mid, const char* high)
        {
            return std::string (tier == Tier::low ? low : tier == Tier::mid ? mid : high);
        };

        return { { { kick,      t ("X...........", "X...........", "X...x.X.....") },
                   { rim,       t ("......x.....", "............", "............") },
                   { snare,     t ("............", "......X.....", "......X.....") },
                   { closedHat, t ("x.x.x.x.x.x.", "x.x.x.x.x.x.", "x.x.x.x.x.x.") } },
                 t ("R-----------", "R-----5-----", "R---5-R---5-"),
                 t ("B-----------", "b.a.a.b.a.a.", "b.a.a.a.a.a.") };
    }

    /** Any other metre: the downbeat, a backbeat on the even beats, eighths on the hi-hat. */
    Pattern patternAny (int steps, int numerator, int denominator, Tier tier)
    {
        const auto beatSteps = denominator >= 8 ? 2 : 4;
        const auto beats = juce::jmax (1, steps / beatSteps);
        std::string kicks (static_cast<size_t> (steps), '.'), snares = kicks, hats = kicks, bass = kicks, keys = kicks;

        kicks[0] = 'X';
        hats[0] = 'x';
        bass[0] = 'R';
        keys[0] = tier == Tier::low ? 'B' : 'b';

        for (int beat = 1; beat < beats; ++beat)
        {
            const auto at = static_cast<size_t> (beat * beatSteps);

            if (beat % 2 == 1)
                snares[at] = tier == Tier::low ? 'x' : 'X';
            else if (tier == Tier::high)
                kicks[at] = 'x';

            if (tier != Tier::low)
                keys[at] = 'C';
        }

        for (int step = 0; step < steps; step += 2)
            hats[static_cast<size_t> (step)] = 'x';

        for (int step = 1; step < steps; ++step)
        {
            if (bass[static_cast<size_t> (step)] == '.')
                bass[static_cast<size_t> (step)] = '-';

            if (keys[static_cast<size_t> (step)] == '.')
                keys[static_cast<size_t> (step)] = '-';
        }

        if (tier != Tier::low && beats >= 3)
            bass[static_cast<size_t> ((beats / 2) * beatSteps)] = '5';

        juce::ignoreUnused (numerator);
        return { { { kick, kicks }, { snare, snares }, { closedHat, hats } }, bass, keys };
    }

    //==============================================================================
    // Playing
    class Performer
    {
    public:
        Performer (Player p, Style s, const std::vector<Chord>& c, double from, double to, int numerator, int denominator,
                   double intensityIn, juce::uint32 seed)
            : player (p), style (s), chords (c), fromPpq (from), toPpq (to), intensity (juce::jlimit (0.0, 1.0, intensityIn)),
              tier (intensity < 0.34 ? Tier::low : intensity < 0.67 ? Tier::mid : Tier::high),
              feel (feelOf (s)), random (seed)
        {
            quartersPerBar = numerator * 4.0 / juce::jmax (1, denominator);
            steps = juce::jmax (1, static_cast<int> (std::lround (quartersPerBar / 0.25)));
            stepLength = quartersPerBar / steps;

            if (numerator == 4 && denominator == 4)
                pattern = pattern44 (style, tier);
            else if (numerator == 3 && denominator == 4)
                pattern = pattern34 (tier);
            else if ((numerator == 6 || numerator == 12) && denominator == 8)
                pattern = pattern68 (tier);
            else
                pattern = patternAny (steps, numerator, denominator, tier);

            // Louder as it gets busier.
            levelShift = tier == Tier::low ? -10 : tier == Tier::high ? 6 : 0;
        }

        std::vector<MidiNote> play()
        {
            const auto bars = juce::jmax (1, static_cast<int> (std::ceil ((toPpq - fromPpq) / quartersPerBar - 1.0e-9)));

            for (int bar = 0; bar < bars; ++bar)
            {
                const auto barStart = fromPpq + bar * quartersPerBar;

                if (player == Player::drums)
                    playDrums (bar, bars, barStart);
                else if (player == Player::bass)
                    playBass (barStart);
                else
                    playKeys (barStart);
            }

            finishNotes (toPpq);

            // Nothing past the end, nothing before the start.
            notes.erase (std::remove_if (notes.begin(), notes.end(), [this] (const MidiNote& n) { return n.start >= toPpq - 1.0e-6; }), notes.end());

            for (auto& n : notes)
            {
                n.start = juce::jmax (fromPpq, n.start);
                n.length = juce::jmax (1.0 / 64.0, juce::jmin (n.length, toPpq - n.start));
            }

            std::sort (notes.begin(), notes.end(), [] (const MidiNote& a, const MidiNote& b) { return a.start < b.start || (a.start == b.start && a.pitch < b.pitch); });
            return notes;
        }

    private:
        //==============================================================================
        char symbolAt (const std::string& row, int step) const
        {
            return row.empty() ? '.' : row[static_cast<size_t> (step % static_cast<int> (row.size()))];
        }

        double timeOf (double barStart, int step)
        {
            auto time = barStart + step * stepLength;

            // Swing: the second sixteenth of each eighth comes late.
            if (step % 2 == 1 && feel.swing > 0.5)
                time += (feel.swing - 0.5) * 2.0 * stepLength;

            // Human timing, except where the style lives on the grid.
            const auto spread = player == Player::drums ? (feel.electronic ? 0.0 : 0.004) : 0.006;
            return time + spread * unit (random);
        }

        int velocityOf (int base, int spread)
        {
            return juce::jlimit (1, 127, juce::roundToInt (base + levelShift + spread * unit (random)));
        }

        void addNote (int pitch, double start, double length, int velocity)
        {
            if (pitch < 0 || pitch > 127)
                return;

            MidiNote note;
            note.pitch = pitch;
            note.start = start;
            note.length = juce::jmax (1.0 / 64.0, length);
            note.velocity = static_cast<float> (velocity) / 127.0f;
            notes.push_back (note);
        }

        const Chord* chordAt (double ppq) const
        {
            for (const auto& chord : chords)
                if (ppq >= chord.start - 1.0e-6 && ppq < chord.start + chord.length - 1.0e-6)
                    return &chord;

            return nullptr;
        }

        /** The first chord that starts after ppq (for a step into it). */
        const Chord* chordAfter (double ppq) const
        {
            for (const auto& chord : chords)
                if (chord.start > ppq + 1.0e-6)
                    return &chord;

            return nullptr;
        }

        //==============================================================================
        void playDrums (int bar, int bars, double barStart)
        {
            const auto phrase = juce::jmax (1, feel.phraseBars);
            const bool fillBar = tier != Tier::low && bar % phrase == phrase - 1 && bar < bars - 1;
            const auto fillSteps = ! fillBar ? 0 : juce::jmin (steps / 2, tier == Tier::high ? 8 : 4);
            const auto fillFrom = steps - fillSteps;

            // A crash where each phrase starts (just the first, when it's calm).
            if (bar == 0 || (tier != Tier::low && bar % phrase == 0))
                addNote (crash, timeOf (barStart, 0), 0.5, velocityOf (108, 6));

            for (const auto& [note, row] : pattern.drums)
            {
                for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step)
                {
                    const auto symbol = symbolAt (row, step);

                    if (symbol == '.' || symbol == '-')
                        continue;

                    // The fill takes over the end of the bar (the kick on its first step stays).
                    if (fillSteps > 0 && step >= fillFrom && ! (note == kick && step == fillFrom))
                        continue;

                    const auto base = symbol == 'X' ? 112 : symbol == 'g' ? 44 : 90;
                    addNote (note, timeOf (barStart, step), 0.1, velocityOf (base, symbol == 'g' ? 4 : 7));
                }
            }

            if (fillSteps <= 0)
                return;

            // A roll on the snare (a clap in house), or snare into the toms.
            const bool roll = style == Style::house || style == Style::hiphop;
            static const std::array<int, 8> toms { snare, snare, snare, snare, highTom, midTom, lowTom, floorTom };

            for (int i = 0; i < fillSteps; ++i)
            {
                const auto step = fillFrom + i;
                const auto progress = static_cast<double> (i + 1) / fillSteps;
                const auto drum = roll ? (style == Style::house ? clap : snare)
                                       : toms[static_cast<size_t> (8 - fillSteps + i)];
                addNote (drum, timeOf (barStart, step), 0.1, velocityOf (juce::roundToInt (70 + 40 * progress), 5));
            }
        }

        //==============================================================================
        static int bassPitchOf (int pitchClass)
        {
            return 28 + ((pitchClass - 4) % 12 + 12) % 12;   // E1 .. D#2
        }

        static bool has (const Chord& chord, int interval)
        {
            return std::find (chord.intervals.begin(), chord.intervals.end(), interval) != chord.intervals.end();
        }

        int bassPitch (const Chord& chord, char symbol, double at) const
        {
            const auto root = bassPitchOf (chord.root);
            const auto bottom = bassPitchOf (chord.bass >= 0 ? chord.bass : chord.root);

            switch (symbol)
            {
                case 'O': return bottom + 12;
                case '5': return has (chord, 7) ? (root + 7 > 43 ? root - 5 : root + 7) : (has (chord, 6) ? root + 6 : (has (chord, 8) ? root + 8 : root + 7));
                case '3': return root + (has (chord, 3) ? 3 : has (chord, 4) ? 4 : has (chord, 5) ? 5 : has (chord, 2) ? 2 : 7);
                case 'b': return root + (has (chord, 10) ? 10 : has (chord, 11) ? 11 : has (chord, 9) ? 9 : 12);
                case 'A':
                {
                    // A half step into the next chord's bass, from below (from above at the bottom).
                    const auto* next = chordAfter (at);

                    if (next == nullptr || next->root < 0 || sameChord (*next, chord))
                        return bassPitch (chord, '5', at);

                    const auto target = bassPitchOf (next->bass >= 0 ? next->bass : next->root);
                    return target - 1 >= 28 ? target - 1 : target + 1;
                }
                default:  return bottom;
            }
        }

        void playBass (double barStart)
        {
            const auto& row = pattern.bass;
            char lastSymbol = 'R';

            for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step)
            {
                const auto symbol = symbolAt (row, step);
                const auto at = barStart + step * stepLength;
                const auto* chord = chordAt (at);

                if (symbol == '.')
                {
                    finishNotes (at);
                    continue;
                }

                // Held through a chord change: the next chord's note, softer.
                const bool changed = chord != nullptr && current != nullptr && ! sameChord (*chord, *current);
                const auto play = symbol != '-' ? symbol : (changed ? (lastSymbol == 'A' ? 'R' : lastSymbol) : '-');

                if (play == '-')
                    continue;

                finishNotes (at);
                current = chord;

                if (chord == nullptr || chord->root < 0)
                    continue;   // no chord: the bass rests

                const auto base = play == 'R' ? 104 : play == 'r' ? 70 : play == 'O' ? 96 : 88;
                const auto velocity = velocityOf (symbol == '-' ? base - 14 : base, 5);
                startNote (bassPitch (*chord, play, at), timeOf (barStart, step), velocity, play == 'r' || feel.staccato);
                lastSymbol = play;
            }
        }

        //==============================================================================
        /** The chord's tones in the keys' middle register, as close as can be to the last ones. */
        std::vector<int> voicing (const Chord& chord)
        {
            std::vector<int> tones;

            for (const auto interval : chord.intervals)
            {
                const auto pc = (chord.root + interval) % 12;

                if (std::find (tones.begin(), tones.end(), pc) == tones.end())
                    tones.push_back (pc);
            }

            // At most four tones: the fifth goes first, then the extensions beyond.
            if (tones.size() > 4)
            {
                const auto fifth = (chord.root + 7) % 12;
                tones.erase (std::remove (tones.begin(), tones.end(), fifth), tones.end());
            }

            while (tones.size() > 4)
                tones.pop_back();

            std::vector<int> best;
            auto bestCost = 1.0e9;

            for (size_t rotation = 0; rotation < tones.size(); ++rotation)
            {
                std::vector<int> notesUp;
                auto pitch = 55 + ((tones[rotation] - 55) % 12 + 12) % 12;   // the lowest at G3 or above

                for (size_t i = 0; i < tones.size(); ++i)
                {
                    const auto pc = tones[(rotation + i) % tones.size()];
                    while (pitch % 12 != pc)
                        ++pitch;

                    notesUp.push_back (pitch);
                    ++pitch;
                }

                double cost = 0.0;

                if (lastVoicing.empty())
                {
                    double centre = 0.0;
                    for (const auto n : notesUp) centre += n;
                    cost = std::abs (centre / static_cast<double> (notesUp.size()) - 64.0);
                }
                else
                {
                    for (const auto n : notesUp)
                    {
                        auto nearest = 1.0e9;
                        for (const auto m : lastVoicing)
                            nearest = juce::jmin (nearest, static_cast<double> (std::abs (n - m)));
                        cost += nearest;
                    }

                    // Not too far from the middle of the keyboard, either.
                    cost += 0.3 * std::abs (notesUp.front() - 60);
                }

                if (cost < bestCost)
                {
                    bestCost = cost;
                    best = notesUp;
                }
            }

            lastVoicing = best;
            return best;
        }

        void playKeys (double barStart)
        {
            const auto& row = pattern.keys;
            char lastSymbol = 'C';

            for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step)
            {
                const auto symbol = symbolAt (row, step);
                const auto at = barStart + step * stepLength;
                const auto* chord = chordAt (at);

                if (symbol == '.')
                {
                    finishNotes (at);
                    continue;
                }

                const bool changed = chord != nullptr && current != nullptr && ! sameChord (*chord, *current);
                auto play = symbol;

                if (symbol == '-')
                {
                    if (! changed)
                        continue;

                    play = lastSymbol == 'a' ? 'a' : 'c';   // held into a new chord: it's played again
                }

                // A broken chord rings on, as with the sustain pedal, until the chord or the figure changes.
                if (play != 'a' || changed)
                    finishNotes (at);

                // A broken chord starts again with each new chord, and with each note of the left hand.
                if (chord != current || play == 'b' || play == 'B')
                    arpeggio = 0;

                current = chord;

                if (chord == nullptr || chord->root < 0)
                    continue;

                if (changed || currentVoicing.empty())
                    currentVoicing = voicing (*chord);

                const auto when = timeOf (barStart, step);
                const auto shortNotes = feel.staccato;

                if (play == 'b' || play == 'B')
                    startNote (48 + (chord->bass >= 0 ? chord->bass : chord->root), when, velocityOf (80, 5), shortNotes);   // C3 .. B3

                if (play == 'C' || play == 'c' || play == 'B')
                {
                    const auto base = play == 'c' ? 66 : 90;

                    for (const auto pitch : currentVoicing)
                        startNote (pitch, when + 0.004 * std::abs (unit (random)), velocityOf (base, 5), shortNotes);
                }

                if (play == 'a')
                {
                    // Up through the chord and on into the octave above, then round again.
                    const auto size = static_cast<int> (currentVoicing.size());
                    const auto turn = arpeggio % (2 * size);
                    const auto pitch = currentVoicing[static_cast<size_t> (turn % size)] + (turn >= size ? 12 : 0);
                    ++arpeggio;
                    startNote (pitch, when, velocityOf (72, 6), false);
                }

                lastSymbol = play;
            }
        }

        //==============================================================================
        // Notes sound until the next thing their player does (or a rest); short ones stop sooner.
        struct Sounding
        {
            int pitch;
            double start;
            int velocity;
            bool shortNote;
        };

        void startNote (int pitch, double start, int velocity, bool shortNote)
        {
            // The same key again: the one still sounding ends first.
            for (auto s = sounding.begin(); s != sounding.end(); ++s)
            {
                if (s->pitch == pitch)
                {
                    addNote (s->pitch, s->start, juce::jmin (start - s->start - 0.02, s->shortNote ? stepLength * 1.4 : 1.0e9), s->velocity);
                    sounding.erase (s);
                    break;
                }
            }

            sounding.push_back ({ pitch, start, velocity, shortNote });
        }

        void finishNotes (double at)
        {
            for (const auto& s : sounding)
            {
                auto length = at - s.start - 0.02;

                if (s.shortNote)
                    length = juce::jmin (length, stepLength * 1.4);

                addNote (s.pitch, s.start, length, s.velocity);
            }

            sounding.clear();
        }

        //==============================================================================
        const Player player;
        const Style style;
        const std::vector<Chord>& chords;
        const double fromPpq, toPpq, intensity;
        const Tier tier;
        const Feel feel;
        std::mt19937 random;
        std::uniform_real_distribution<double> unit { -1.0, 1.0 };

        double quartersPerBar = 4.0, stepLength = 0.25;
        int steps = 16, levelShift = 0;
        Pattern pattern;

        std::vector<MidiNote> notes;
        std::vector<Sounding> sounding;
        const Chord* current = nullptr;
        std::vector<int> lastVoicing, currentVoicing;
        int arpeggio = 0;
    };
}

//==============================================================================
bool SessionPlayers::parseChord (const juce::String& symbolIn, Chord& chord)
{
    // Typographic spellings, a character at a time: sharp and flat signs, the triangle (maj7),
    // the circles (dim, and m7b5 crossed), a long minus.
    juce::String symbol;
    const auto trimmed = symbolIn.trim();

    for (auto p = trimmed.getCharPointer(); ! p.isEmpty();)
    {
        const auto c = p.getAndAdvance();
        const auto sevenNext = *p == '7';

        if (c == 0x266f)                        symbol << "#";
        else if (c == 0x266d)                   symbol << "b";
        else if (c == 0x2212 || c == 0x2013)    symbol << "-";
        else if (c == 0x00b0)                   symbol << "dim";
        else if (c == 0x0394 || c == 0x00f8)
        {
            symbol << (c == 0x0394 ? "maj7" : "m7b5");

            if (sevenNext)
                ++p;                            // its 7 is already said
        }
        else
        {
            symbol << juce::String::charToString (c);
        }
    }

    chord = {};

    if (symbol.equalsIgnoreCase ("N.C.") || symbol.equalsIgnoreCase ("NC") || symbol.equalsIgnoreCase ("x"))
    {
        chord.name = "N.C.";
        return true;
    }

    auto main = symbol;
    juce::String slash;

    if (symbol.containsChar ('/'))
    {
        main = symbol.upToFirstOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false);
        slash = symbol.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false);
    }

    int used = 0;
    const auto root = readNote (main, used);

    if (root < 0)
        return false;

    auto quality = main.substring (used);

    // Words in any case: Maj7, MIN, Sus4, Add9.
    for (const auto* word : { "maj", "min", "dim", "aug", "sus", "add", "dom" })
        if (quality.startsWithIgnoreCase (word))
            quality = juce::String (word) + quality.substring (3);

    const Quality* found = nullptr;

    for (const auto& candidate : qualities())
        for (const auto* spelling : candidate.spellings)
            if (found == nullptr && quality == spelling)
                found = &candidate;

    if (found == nullptr)
        return false;

    auto bass = -1;

    if (slash.isNotEmpty())
    {
        int bassUsed = 0;
        bass = readNote (slash, bassUsed);

        if (bass < 0 || bassUsed != slash.length())
            return false;
    }

    chord.root = root;
    chord.bass = bass == root ? -1 : bass;
    chord.intervals = found->intervals;
    chord.name = chordName (root, *found, chord.bass);
    return true;
}

juce::Result SessionPlayers::parseProgression (const juce::String& textIn, double startPpq, double quartersPerBar, int beatsPerBar,
                                               int times, std::vector<Chord>& chords)
{
    chords.clear();
    const auto text = textIn.replaceCharacters ("\r\n\t", "   ");
    std::vector<juce::StringArray> bars;

    if (text.containsChar ('|'))
    {
        auto parts = juce::StringArray::fromTokens (text, "|", "");

        for (int i = 0; i < parts.size(); ++i)
        {
            auto tokens = juce::StringArray::fromTokens (parts[i], " ", "");
            tokens.removeEmptyStrings();

            if (tokens.isEmpty())
            {
                if (i == 0 || i == parts.size() - 1)
                    continue;            // the | at either end

                tokens.add ("%");        // an empty bar: the chord goes on
            }

            bars.push_back (tokens);
        }
    }
    else
    {
        auto tokens = juce::StringArray::fromTokens (text, " ", "");
        tokens.removeEmptyStrings();

        for (const auto& token : tokens)
            bars.push_back (juce::StringArray (token));
    }

    if (bars.empty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Type the chords to play: C | Am | F | G, say.");

    times = juce::jlimit (1, 64, times);

    if (bars.size() * static_cast<size_t> (times) > 2048)
        return juce::Result::fail ("That's more than 2048 bars: play fewer times, or fewer bars.");

    beatsPerBar = juce::jmax (1, beatsPerBar);
    const auto beat = quartersPerBar / beatsPerBar;
    Chord previous;
    bool havePrevious = false;

    for (int round = 0; round < times; ++round)
    {
        for (size_t b = 0; b < bars.size(); ++b)
        {
            const auto barStart = startPpq + static_cast<double> (static_cast<size_t> (round) * bars.size() + b) * quartersPerBar;
            const auto& tokens = bars[b];
            const auto count = tokens.size();

            for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k)
            {
                // Evenly through the bar, on a beat; more chords than beats and the extras drop out.
                const auto from = barStart + std::round (static_cast<double> (k) * beatsPerBar / count) * beat;
                const auto to = barStart + std::round (static_cast<double> (k + 1) * beatsPerBar / count) * beat;

                if (to <= from + 1.0e-9)
                    continue;

                Chord chord;
                const auto& token = tokens[k];

                if (token == "%" || token == "-" || token == "/" || token == ".")
                {
                    if (! havePrevious)
                        return juce::Result::fail ("The progression starts with \"" + token + "\": there's no chord to go on with yet.");

                    chord = previous;
                }
                else if (! parseChord (token, chord))
                {
                    return juce::Result::fail ("\"" + token + "\" isn't a chord Sonify knows. Try C, Am, F#m7, Bbmaj7, G/B or Dsus4.");
                }

                chord.start = from;
                chord.length = to - from;

                // The same chord again simply goes on.
                if (! chords.empty() && sameChord (chords.back(), chord)
                    && std::abs (chords.back().start + chords.back().length - from) < 1.0e-6)
                    chords.back().length += chord.length;
                else
                    chords.push_back (chord);

                previous = chord;
                havePrevious = true;
            }
        }
    }

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::String SessionPlayers::detectChords (const std::vector<MidiClip>& clips, const TempoMap& map, int& firstBar, int& bars)
{
    struct Heard
    {
        double from, to;
        int pitch;
        float velocity;
    };

    std::vector<Heard> heard;

    for (const auto& clip : clips)
    {
        if (clip.isAudio())
            continue;

        for (const auto& note : clip.notes)
        {
            if (! clip.shows (note))
                continue;

            const auto from = clip.songPosition (note.start);
            const auto to = juce::jmin (from + note.length, clip.start + clip.length);

            if (to > from)
                heard.push_back ({ from, to, note.pitch, note.velocity });
        }
    }

    firstBar = 1;
    bars = 0;

    if (heard.empty())
        return {};

    auto begin = heard.front().from, end = heard.front().to;

    for (const auto& h : heard)
    {
        begin = juce::jmin (begin, h.from);
        end = juce::jmax (end, h.to);
    }

    // On the song's bars, as its time signatures count them.
    const auto first = map.barAt (begin + 1.0e-6).index;
    const auto endBar = map.barAt (end - 1.0e-6);
    const auto last = juce::jmax (first + 1, endBar.index + (end - endBar.start > 1.0e-6 ? 1 : 0));
    firstBar = first + 1;
    bars = last - first;

    struct Candidate
    {
        int root = -1;
        const Quality* quality = nullptr;
        int bass = -1;
        double score = 0.0;
    };

    // What sounds between from and to, and the chord that explains it best.
    const auto listen = [&heard] (double from, double to) -> Candidate
    {
        std::array<double, 12> weights {};
        int lowest = 128;
        double total = 0.0;

        for (const auto& h : heard)
        {
            const auto overlap = juce::jmin (h.to, to) - juce::jmax (h.from, from);

            if (overlap <= 0.0)
                continue;

            const auto w = overlap * (0.4 + h.velocity);
            weights[static_cast<size_t> (h.pitch % 12)] += w;
            total += w;
            lowest = juce::jmin (lowest, h.pitch);
        }

        Candidate best;

        if (total <= 0.0)
            return best;

        // The usual shapes only: major, minor, the three common sevenths, diminished, sus4 and the
        // bare fifth (indexes into qualities()).
        static const std::array<int, 8> shapes { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 11, 23 };
        auto bestScore = -1.0e9;

        for (int root = 0; root < 12; ++root)
        {
            for (const auto shape : shapes)
            {
                const auto& quality = qualities()[static_cast<size_t> (shape)];
                double inside = 0.0;
                auto missing = 0.0;

                for (const auto interval : quality.intervals)
                {
                    const auto w = weights[static_cast<size_t> ((root + interval) % 12)];
                    inside += w;

                    if (w < 0.05 * total)
                        missing += interval == 7 ? 0.1 : 0.3;
                }

                auto score = inside - 0.6 * (total - inside) - missing * total;

                if (quality.intervals.size() > 3)
                    score -= 0.05 * total;          // a seventh must really be there

                if (quality.intervals.size() < 3)
                    score -= 0.15 * total;          // a bare fifth only when nothing else fits

                if (lowest % 12 == root)
                    score += 0.15 * total;

                if (score > bestScore)
                {
                    bestScore = score;
                    best.root = root;
                    best.quality = &quality;
                }
            }
        }

        // The lowest note, when it's a chord tone other than the root: an inversion (C/E).
        const auto lowPc = lowest % 12;

        for (const auto interval : best.quality->intervals)
            if (interval != 0 && (best.root + interval) % 12 == lowPc)
                best.bass = lowPc;

        best.score = bestScore / total;
        return best;
    };

    juce::StringArray written;
    juce::String previous;

    const auto nameOfCandidate = [] (const Candidate& c) { return chordName (c.root, *c.quality, c.bass); };

    for (int bar = first; bar < last; ++bar)
    {
        const auto from = map.ppqOfBar (bar), length = map.barAt (from).length();
        const auto middle = from + length * 0.5, to = from + length;
        const auto whole = listen (from, to);

        if (whole.quality == nullptr)
        {
            written.add (previous.isNotEmpty() ? "%" : "N.C.");
            continue;
        }

        // Two chords in the bar, when its halves clearly say so: a new root (a broken chord or a
        // melody leaves a half without some tone, which only seems to change its colour).
        const auto a = listen (from, middle), b = listen (middle, to);

        if (a.quality != nullptr && b.quality != nullptr && a.root != b.root
            && 0.5 * (a.score + b.score) > whole.score + 0.1)
        {
            written.add (nameOfCandidate (a) + " " + nameOfCandidate (b));
            previous = nameOfCandidate (b);
            continue;
        }

        written.add (nameOfCandidate (whole));
        previous = nameOfCandidate (whole);
    }

    return written.joinIntoString (" | ");
}

std::vector<MidiNote> SessionPlayers::generate (Player player, Style style, const std::vector<Chord>& chords,
                                                double fromPpq, double toPpq, int numerator, int denominator,
                                                double intensity, juce::uint32 seed)
{
    if (toPpq <= fromPpq)
        return {};

    Performer performer (player, style, chords, fromPpq, toPpq, juce::jmax (1, numerator), juce::jmax (1, denominator), intensity, seed);
    return performer.play();
}

//==============================================================================
const Library::Entry* SessionPlayers::bestInstrument (const Library& library, Player player)
{
    static const juce::StringArray drumWords { "drum", "kit", "beat", "808", "909", "percussion", "battery", "groove agent", "addictive" };
    static const juce::StringArray bassWords { "bass" };
    static const juce::StringArray keyWords { "piano", "keys", "rhodes", "e-piano", "epiano", "wurli", "organ", "clav", "grand", "upright" };

    const Library::Entry* best = nullptr;
    double bestScore = 0.0;

    for (const auto& entry : library.getEntries())
    {
        if (entry.kind != "instrument" || entry.missing || ! library.isOffered (entry.file))
            continue;

        const auto name = entry.name.toLowerCase();
        double score = 0.0;

        const auto named = [&name] (const juce::StringArray& words)
        {
            for (const auto& word : words)
                if (name.contains (word))
                    return true;

            return false;
        };

        if (player == Player::drums)
        {
            if (entry.category == "Drums")                                                score += 5.0;
            if (entry.features.contains ("drum") || entry.features.contains ("drum-machine")) score += 4.0;
            if (named (drumWords))                                                         score += 3.0;
        }
        else if (player == Player::bass)
        {
            if (named (bassWords) && ! name.contains ("drum"))                             score += 5.0;
        }
        else if (named (keyWords))
        {
            score += 5.0;
        }

        if (score <= 0.0)
            continue;

        // Among equals: favorites, then what's used most.
        score += (entry.favorite ? 1.0 : 0.0) + 0.05 * juce::jmin (20, entry.uses);

        if (score > bestScore)
        {
            bestScore = score;
            best = &entry;
        }
    }

    return best;
}

juce::Result SessionPlayers::create (AudioEngine& engine, Library& library, const Request& request,
                                     std::vector<int>& trackIds, juce::StringArray& notes)
{
    trackIds.clear();

    if (request.players.empty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Choose at least one player.");

    // The players play in the time signature of the bar they start on.
    const auto& map = engine.getTempoMap();
    const auto startPpq = map.ppqOfBar (juce::jmax (0, request.startBar - 1));
    const auto startBar = map.barAt (startPpq);
    const auto numerator = juce::jmax (1, startBar.numerator);
    const auto denominator = juce::jmax (1, startBar.denominator);
    const auto quartersPerBar = startBar.length();

    std::vector<Chord> chords;
    const auto parsed = parseProgression (request.chords, startPpq, quartersPerBar, numerator, request.times, chords);

    if (parsed.failed())
        return parsed;

    if (chords.empty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Type the chords to play: C | Am | F | G, say.");

    const auto endPpq = chords.back().start + chords.back().length;
    const auto seed = request.seed != 0 ? request.seed : static_cast<juce::uint32> (juce::Random::getSystemRandom().nextInt());

    for (const auto player : request.players)
    {
        auto part = generate (player, request.style, chords, startPpq, endPpq, numerator, denominator, request.intensity,
                              seed + static_cast<juce::uint32> (player) * 7919u);
        const auto trackId = engine.addTrack (Track::Kind::instrument);

        // Its instrument: the one chosen, or the best fit installed (the Test Synth when there's none).
        juce::String file, pluginId, pluginName;

        if (const auto chosen = request.instruments.find (player); chosen != request.instruments.end())
        {
            if (chosen->second.first != "none")
            {
                for (const auto& entry : library.getEntries())
                {
                    if (entry.file == chosen->second.first && entry.id == chosen->second.second && entry.kind == "instrument"
                        && ! entry.missing && library.isOffered (entry.file))
                    {
                        file = entry.file;
                        pluginId = entry.id;
                        pluginName = entry.name;
                    }
                }

                if (file.isEmpty())
                    notes.add ("The instrument chosen for the " + nameOf (player) + " isn't available now, so it plays the Test Synth.");
            }
        }
        else if (const auto* best = bestInstrument (library, player))
        {
            file = best->file;
            pluginId = best->id;
            pluginName = best->name;
        }

        if (file.isNotEmpty())
        {
            int slot = 0;
            const auto loaded = engine.loadPlugin (trackId, juce::File (file), pluginId, -1, 0, slot);

            if (loaded.failed())
                notes.add (pluginName + " didn't load for the " + nameOf (player) + ", so it plays the Test Synth: " + loaded.getErrorMessage());
            else
                library.markUsed (file, pluginId);
        }

        engine.setTrackName (trackId, trackNameOf (player));

        MidiClip clip;
        clip.start = startPpq;
        clip.length = endPpq - startPpq;
        clip.offset = 0.0;

        for (auto note : part)
        {
            note.start = juce::jmax (0.0, note.start - startPpq);
            clip.notes.push_back (note);
        }

        std::sort (clip.notes.begin(), clip.notes.end(), [] (const MidiNote& a, const MidiNote& b) { return a.start < b.start; });
        engine.addClip (trackId, std::move (clip));
        trackIds.push_back (trackId);
    }

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

//==============================================================================
SessionPlayers::Style SessionPlayers::styleFrom (const juce::String& name)
{
    const auto n = name.toLowerCase().removeCharacters (" -");

    if (n == "rock")                    return Style::rock;
    if (n == "ballad")                  return Style::ballad;
    if (n == "funk")                    return Style::funk;
    if (n == "house" || n == "edm")     return Style::house;
    if (n == "hiphop" || n == "rap")    return Style::hiphop;
    return Style::pop;
}

juce::String SessionPlayers::nameOf (Style style)
{
    switch (style)
    {
        case Style::rock:   return "rock";
        case Style::ballad: return "ballad";
        case Style::funk:   return "funk";
        case Style::house:  return "house";
        case Style::hiphop: return "hiphop";
        case Style::pop:    break;
    }

    return "pop";
}

bool SessionPlayers::playerFrom (const juce::String& name, Player& player)
{
    const auto n = name.toLowerCase().trim();

    if (n == "drums" || n == "drum" || n == "drummer")   { player = Player::drums; return true; }
    if (n == "bass" || n == "bassist")                   { player = Player::bass;  return true; }
    if (n == "keys" || n == "piano" || n == "keyboard")  { player = Player::keys;  return true; }
    return false;
}

juce::String SessionPlayers::nameOf (Player player)
{
    return player == Player::drums ? "drums" : player == Player::bass ? "bass" : "keys";
}

juce::String SessionPlayers::trackNameOf (Player player)
{
    return player == Player::drums ? "Drums" : player == Player::bass ? "Bass" : "Keys";
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\SessionPlayers.h

#pragma once

#include "AudioEngine.h"
#include "Library.h"

#include <map>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Sonify's session players (Track > Add Session Players, and Sonify AI): a drummer, a bass
    player and a keys player who play a chord progression in a style, each on a track of its
    own with a fitting installed instrument.

    The parts are made from patterns, not recordings: each style has its grooves at three
    intensities, played over the chords (roots, fifths and approach notes for the bass, voiced
    chords that move as little as they can for the keys), with fills at phrase ends, crashes at
    phrase starts, a little swing where the style has it, and human velocities and timing.
    Drums use General MIDI notes (36 kick, 38 snare, 42 hi-hat...), so any GM drum plugin plays them.

    Chords come written as text (bars between |, chords in a bar split it evenly) or read off the
    notes a track plays. Message thread only.
*/
namespace SessionPlayers
{
    enum class Player { drums, bass, keys };
    enum class Style { pop, rock, ballad, funk, house, hiphop };

    struct Chord
    {
        double start = 0.0, length = 0.0;     // song positions, quarter notes
        int root = -1;                        // pitch class 0..11; -1: no chord (N.C.)
        int bass = -1;                        // a slash chord's bass note (pitch class), or -1
        std::vector<int> intervals;           // from the root, in semitones
        juce::String name;
    };

    /** A chord symbol: C, Am, F#m7, Bbmaj7, G/B, Dsus4, E7, Cadd9, Bdim, N.C. False when it isn't one. */
    bool parseChord (const juce::String& symbol, Chord& chord);

    /** A progression as written, placed from startPpq: bars between | (chords in a bar split it
        evenly, on the beat), or, without any |, a bar for each chord. % repeats the chord before,
        N.C. (or x) is silence. Played `times` times. */
    juce::Result parseProgression (const juce::String& text, double startPpq, double quartersPerBar, int beatsPerBar,
                                   int times, std::vector<Chord>& chords);

    /** The chords a track plays, a bar at a time (halves when they change mid-bar), written as a
        progression to edit; firstBar (from 1) and bars say where. Empty when it plays no notes. */
    juce::String detectChords (const std::vector<MidiClip>& clips, const TempoMap& map, int& firstBar, int& bars);

    /** One player's part over the chords, from fromPpq to toPpq (song positions). */
    std::vector<MidiNote> generate (Player player, Style style, const std::vector<Chord>& chords,
                                    double fromPpq, double toPpq, int numerator, int denominator,
                                    double intensity, juce::uint32 seed);

    struct Request
    {
        Style style = Style::pop;
        double intensity = 0.5;                                   // 0 calm .. 1 busy
        std::vector<Player> players { Player::drums, Player::bass, Player::keys };

        // Each player's instrument: a library entry's file and id. None given: the best fit
        // installed; file "none": the Test Synth.
        std::map<Player, std::pair<juce::String, juce::String>> instruments;

        juce::String chords;
        int startBar = 1;
        int times = 1;
        juce::uint32 seed = 0;
    };

    /** A track for each player, with its instrument and its part as one clip. trackIds: the new
        tracks; notes: anything worth telling (an instrument that wouldn't load). */
    juce::Result create (AudioEngine& engine, Library& library, const Request& request,
                         std::vector<int>& trackIds, juce::StringArray& notes);

    /** The installed instrument that fits a player best (by type, name and features), or null. */
    const Library::Entry* bestInstrument (const Library& library, Player player);

    Style styleFrom (const juce::String& name);
    juce::String nameOf (Style style);
    bool playerFrom (const juce::String& name, Player& player);
    juce::String nameOf (Player player);              // "drums", "bass", "keys"
    juce::String trackNameOf (Player player);         // "Drums", "Bass", "Keys"
}

//==============================================================================
double Settings::getStepCost (const juce::String& size) const
{
    const auto record = data.getProperty (stepCostsKey, {}).getProperty (juce::Identifier (size), {});

    if ((int) record.getProperty ("count", 0) < stepCostMinimum)
        return 0.0;

    return juce::jmax (0.0, (double) record.getProperty ("average", 0.0));
}

void Settings::addStepCost (const juce::String& size, int credits)
{
    auto* object = data.getDynamicObject();

    if (object == nullptr || size.isEmpty() || credits <= 0)
        return;

    auto costs = data.getProperty (stepCostsKey, {});

    if (! costs.isObject())
    {
        costs = juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
        object->setProperty (stepCostsKey, costs);
    }

    // A running average over about the last steps of this size, so it follows the prices.
    const auto record = costs.getProperty (juce::Identifier (size), {});
    const auto count = (int) record.getProperty ("count", 0) + 1;
    auto average = (double) record.getProperty ("average", 0.0);
    average += ((double) credits - average) / (double) juce::jmin (count, stepCostWindow);

    auto* updated = new juce::DynamicObject();
    updated->setProperty ("count", count);
    updated->setProperty ("average", average);
    costs.getDynamicObject()->setProperty (juce::Identifier (size), juce::var (updated));

    save();
}

//==============================================================================
juce::StringArray Settings::getRecentProjects() const
{
    juce::StringArray result;

    if (const auto* list = data.getProperty (recentKey, {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& entry : *list)
            if (const auto path = entry.toString(); juce::File::isAbsolutePath (path) && juce::File (path).existsAsFile())
                result.addIfNotAlreadyThere (path);

    return result;
}

void Settings::addRecentProject (const juce::File& projectFile)
{
    auto recent = getRecentProjects();
    recent.removeString (projectFile.getFullPathName());
    recent.insert (0, projectFile.getFullPathName());

    while (recent.size() > maxRecentProjects)
        recent.remove (recent.size() - 1);

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& path : recent)
        list.add (path);

    if (auto* object = data.getDynamicObject())
        object->setProperty (recentKey, list);

    save();
}

void Settings::removeRecentProject (const juce::File& projectFile)
{
    auto recent = getRecentProjects();
    recent.removeString (projectFile.getFullPathName());

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& path : recent)
        list.add (path);

    if (auto* object = data.getDynamicObject())
        object->setProperty (recentKey, list);

    save();
}

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Plugins Creator Studio's own settings (Stella AI Studio's, inside Sonify): recent
    projects, the projects folder, the company name new plugins get, whether a sound says
    Sonify AI has finished, and what Sonify AI's plan steps really cost (for its estimates).

    Kept in one JSON file next to the executable, as Sonify keeps its own, so a development
    build writes nothing outside its build folder.

    Its folders: the user's things in <user data>\Plugins Creator (Settings > Locations in
    Sonify; Documents\Sonify by default): Projects, Looks, Primitives, Shapes, Textures; and
    what can be fetched again in Sonify's own application data (Plugins Creator).
*/

{
public:
    Settings();

    void save() const;

    juce::File getProjectsFolder() const;
    void setProjectsFolder (const juce::File& folder);

    juce::String getVendor() const;
    void setVendor (const juce::String& vendor);

    /** Project files, most recent first. Files that no longer exist are left out. */
    juce::StringArray getRecentProjects() const;
    void addRecentProject (const juce::File& projectFile);
    void removeRecentProject (const juce::File& projectFile);

    juce::String getWindowState() const;
    void setWindowState (const juce::String& state);

    /** A short sound when Sonify AI finishes a request (on unless turned off). */
    bool getFinishSound() const;
    void setFinishSound (bool shouldPlay);

    /** The studio's MIDI In: the ports it hears, by name ("*", the first time: all of them). */
    juce::StringArray getMidiInputs() const;
    void setMidiInputs (const juce::StringArray& ports);

    /** What a plan step of a size ("small", "medium", "large") really cost on average, in
        credits, over the last steps of that size (0 until a few were measured), and a
        finished step's cost. */
    double getStepCost (const juce::String& size) const;
    void addStepCost (const juce::String& size, int credits);
    static constexpr int stepCostMinimum = 3, stepCostWindow = 20;

    static juce::File getFile();
    static juce::File getDefaultProjectsFolder();

    /** <user data>\Plugins Creator: the user's projects, looks, primitives, shapes and textures. */
    static juce::File getDataFolder();

    /** Sonify's application data, Plugins Creator: downloads and caches that can be fetched again. */
    static juce::File getCacheFolder();

    /** Sonify's "Block internet": while on, nothing here reaches the network (the gallery, say). */
    static void setInternetBlocked (bool blocked) noexcept;
    static bool isInternetBlocked() noexcept;

    static constexpr int maxRecentProjects = 12;

private:
    juce::String getString (const juce::Identifier& key) const;
    void setString (const juce::Identifier& key, const juce::String& value);

    juce::var data;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Settings)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\SfzFile.cpp

#include "SfzFile.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>

//==============================================================================
juce::String Sfz::keyName (int note)
{
    static const char* const names[] { "C", "Cs", "D", "Ds", "E", "F", "Fs", "G", "Gs", "A", "As", "B" };
    note = juce::jlimit (0, 127, note);
    return juce::String (names[note % 12]) + juce::String (note / 12 - 1);
}

juce::String Sfz::safeName (const juce::String& name)
{
    static const juce::String forbidden (" :/\\*?\"<>|");
    juce::String safe;

    for (const auto c : name.trim())
        safe += (c < 32 || c == 127 || forbidden.containsChar (c)) ? static_cast<juce::juce_wchar> ('_') : c;

    // Windows drops a dot at the end of a folder's name: Piano. would be Piano.
    while (safe.endsWithChar ('.'))
        safe = safe.dropLastCharacters (1) + "_";

    return safe.isNotEmpty() ? safe : juce::String ("Sample");
}

//==============================================================================
std::vector<Sfz::Zone> Sfz::zones (const std::vector<int>& roots, int rangeLow, int rangeHigh, bool fill)
{
    std::vector<Zone> made;

    if (roots.empty())
        return made;

    const auto count = roots.size();
    made.resize (count);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        auto& zone = made[i];
        zone.root = juce::jlimit (0, 127, roots[i]);

        // From 3 keys below it, but never into the zone of the key below.
        zone.low = i == 0 ? (fill ? 0 : juce::jmin (rangeLow, zone.root))
                          : juce::jmax (roots[i - 1] + 1, zone.root - 3);
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        auto& zone = made[i];
        zone.high = i + 1 < count ? made[i + 1].low - 1
                                  : (fill ? 127 : juce::jmax (rangeHigh, zone.root));

        zone.low = juce::jlimit (0, 127, juce::jmin (zone.low, zone.root));
        zone.high = juce::jlimit (zone.root, 127, zone.high);
    }

    return made;
}

std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> Sfz::velocityRanges (const std::vector<int>& velocities)
{
    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> ranges;
    const auto count = velocities.size();

    for (size_t v = 0; v < count; ++v)
    {
        const auto low = v == 0 ? 0 : (velocities[v - 1] + velocities[v]) / 2 + 1;
        const auto high = v + 1 == count ? 127 : (velocities[v] + velocities[v + 1]) / 2;
        ranges.emplace_back (juce::jlimit (0, 127, low), juce::jlimit (0, 127, high));
    }

    return ranges;
}

int Sfz::layerVelocity (int layer, int layers)
{
    layers = juce::jlimit (1, 127, layers);

    if (layers == 1)
        return 127;

    const auto top = juce::roundToInt (127.0 * (juce::jlimit (0, layers - 1, layer) + 1) / layers);
    return juce::jlimit (1, 127, top - 3);
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String Sfz::text (const juce::String& name, int keys, const std::vector<Region>& regions)
{
    juce::String sfz;
    sfz << "// Auto-generated by Sonify\n";
    sfz << "// Family: " << name << "\n";
    sfz << "// Notes: " << keys << "\n\n";
    sfz << "<global>\n\n";

    for (const auto& region : regions)
    {
        sfz << "<region>\n";
        sfz << "sample=samples\\" << region.sample << "\n";
        sfz << "lokey=" << region.lokey << "\nhikey=" << region.hikey << "\n";
        sfz << "pitch_keycenter=" << region.keycenter << "\n";
        sfz << "lovel=" << region.lovel << " hivel=" << region.hivel << "\n";
        sfz << "amp_veltrack=100\n";

        if (region.seqLength > 1)
        {
            sfz << "seq_length=" << region.seqLength << "\n";
            sfz << "seq_position=" << region.seqPosition << "\n";
        }

        sfz << loopOpcodes (region.loopStart, region.loopEnd, region.loopCrossfade);
        sfz << "\n";
    }

    return sfz;
}

juce::String Sfz::builderText (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& samplesFolder, const std::vector<Region>& regions)
{
    juce::String sfz;
    sfz << "// Generated by " << name << " (Sample Builder)\n";
    sfz << "<group>\n";
    sfz << "ampeg_attack=0.001 ampeg_release=0.1\n\n";

    for (const auto& region : regions)
    {
        sfz << "<region>\n";
        sfz << "sample=" << samplesFolder << region.sample << "\n";
        sfz << "lokey=" << region.lokey << " hikey=" << region.hikey << " pitch_keycenter=" << region.keycenter << "\n";
        sfz << "lovel=" << region.lovel << " hivel=" << region.hivel << "\n";
        sfz << "amp_veltrack=100\n";

        if (region.seqLength > 1)
        {
            sfz << "seq_length=" << region.seqLength << "\n";
            sfz << "seq_position=" << region.seqPosition << "\n";
        }

        sfz << loopOpcodes (region.loopStart, region.loopEnd, region.loopCrossfade);
        sfz << "\n";
    }

    return sfz;
}

juce::String Sfz::loopOpcodes (juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd, double crossfadeSeconds)
{
    if (loopStart < 0 || loopEnd <= loopStart)
        return {};

    juce::String s;
    s << "loop_mode=loop_sustain\n";
    s << "loop_start=" << juce::String (loopStart) << "\n";
    s << "loop_end=" << juce::String (loopEnd) << "\n";

    if (crossfadeSeconds >= 0.0005)
    {
        auto seconds = juce::String (crossfadeSeconds, 3);

        while (seconds.endsWithChar ('0'))
            seconds = seconds.dropLastCharacters (1);

        if (seconds.endsWithChar ('.'))
            seconds = seconds.dropLastCharacters (1);

        s << "loop_crossfade=" << seconds << "\n";
    }

    return s;
}

double Sfz::readCrossfade (const juce::String& value, double sampleRate)
{
    const auto text = value.trim();
    const auto number = text.getDoubleValue();

    if (number <= 0.0)
        return 0.0;

    if (! text.containsChar ('.') && number >= 10.0)
        return number / (sampleRate > 0.0 ? sampleRate : 44100.0);

    return juce::jmin (number, 10.0);
}

bool Sfz::writeLoopFile (const juce::File& wav, juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd, int crossfade, float score)
{
    juce::String s;
    s << "loop_start=" << juce::String (loopStart) << "\nloop_end=" << juce::String (loopEnd)
      << "\ncrossfade=" << juce::String (crossfade) << "\nscore=" << juce::String (score, 4) << "\n";
    return wav.withFileExtension ("loop").replaceWithText (s);
}

bool Sfz::readLoopFile (const juce::File& wav, juce::int64& loopStart, juce::int64& loopEnd, int& crossfade)
{
    const auto file = wav.withFileExtension ("loop");

    if (! file.existsAsFile())
        return false;

    juce::String start, end, fade;

    for (const auto& line : juce::StringArray::fromLines (file.loadFileAsString()))
    {
        const auto trimmed = line.trim();

        if (trimmed.startsWith ("loop_start="))     start = trimmed.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("=", false, false).trim();
        else if (trimmed.startsWith ("loop_end="))  end = trimmed.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("=", false, false).trim();
        else if (trimmed.startsWith ("crossfade=")) fade = trimmed.fromFirstOccurrenceOf ("=", false, false).trim();
    }

    if (start.isEmpty() || end.isEmpty())
        return false;

    loopStart = start.getLargeIntValue();
    loopEnd = end.getLargeIntValue();
    crossfade = fade.getIntValue();
    return loopEnd > loopStart && loopStart >= 0;
}

void Sfz::removeLoopFile (const juce::File& wav)
{
    wav.withFileExtension ("loop").deleteFile();
}

bool Sfz::write (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& text)
{
    file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();
    return file.replaceWithText (text, false, false, "\r\n");
}

//==============================================================================
namespace
{
    void put16 (juce::MemoryOutputStream& out, int value)      { out.writeShort (static_cast<short> (value)); }
    void put32 (juce::MemoryOutputStream& out, juce::uint32 value) { out.writeInt (static_cast<int> (value)); }

    /** smpl: manufacturer, product, sample period (ns), unity note, pitch fraction, SMPTE format
        and offset, how many loops, no sampler data; and the loop (forward, played for ever). */
    void putSmpl (juce::MemoryOutputStream& out, juce::uint32 rate, int rootNote, juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd)
    {
        const bool looped = loopStart >= 0 && loopEnd > loopStart && loopEnd <= 0xffffffffll;
        out.write ("smpl", 4);
        put32 (out, looped ? 60u : 36u);
        put32 (out, 0);
        put32 (out, 0);
        put32 (out, static_cast<juce::uint32> (1000000000.0 / static_cast<double> (juce::jmax (1u, rate))));
        put32 (out, static_cast<juce::uint32> (juce::jlimit (0, 127, rootNote)));
        put32 (out, 0);
        put32 (out, 0);
        put32 (out, 0);
        put32 (out, looped ? 1u : 0u);
        put32 (out, 0);

        if (looped)
        {
            put32 (out, 0);                                     // cue point id
            put32 (out, 0);                                     // forward
            put32 (out, static_cast<juce::uint32> (loopStart));
            put32 (out, static_cast<juce::uint32> (loopEnd));
            put32 (out, 0);                                     // fraction
            put32 (out, 0);                                     // play count: for ever
        }
    }

    bool writeWhole (const juce::File& file, const juce::MemoryOutputStream& out)
    {
        file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();
        juce::TemporaryFile temporary (file);

        {
            juce::FileOutputStream stream (temporary.getFile());

            if (! stream.openedOk() || ! stream.write (out.getData(), out.getDataSize()))
                return false;

            stream.flush();

            if (stream.getStatus().failed())
                return false;
        }

        return temporary.overwriteTargetFileWithTemporary();
    }
}

bool Sfz::writeWav (const juce::File& file, const juce::AudioBuffer<float>& audio, int numSamples, double sampleRate,
                    int rootNote, float gain, int bitDepth, int channels, juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd)
{
    if (audio.getNumChannels() < 1)
        return false;

    numSamples = juce::jlimit (0, audio.getNumSamples(), numSamples);
    channels = juce::jlimit (1, 2, channels > 0 ? juce::jmin (channels, audio.getNumChannels()) : audio.getNumChannels());
    bitDepth = bitDepth == 16 || bitDepth == 32 ? bitDepth : 24;
    const bool isFloat = bitDepth == 32;
    const auto bytes = bitDepth / 8;
    const auto rate = static_cast<juce::uint32> (juce::roundToInt (sampleRate > 0.0 ? sampleRate : 48000.0));

    const auto dataBytes = static_cast<juce::uint64> (numSamples) * static_cast<juce::uint64> (channels) * static_cast<juce::uint64> (bytes);

    if (dataBytes > 0xffff0000ull)
        return false;   // far longer than any sample

    const auto pad = static_cast<int> (dataBytes & 1);
    const bool looped = loopStart >= 0 && loopEnd > loopStart;
    const juce::uint32 smplBytes = looped ? 60 : 36;
    const auto riffBytes = static_cast<juce::uint32> (4 + (8 + 16) + (8 + dataBytes + static_cast<juce::uint64> (pad)) + (8 + smplBytes));

    juce::MemoryOutputStream out;
    out.preallocate (static_cast<size_t> (riffBytes) + 8);

    out.write ("RIFF", 4);
    put32 (out, riffBytes);
    out.write ("WAVE", 4);

    // The plain fmt chunk: 16 bytes (PCM, or IEEE float for 32 bits).
    out.write ("fmt ", 4);
    put32 (out, 16);
    put16 (out, isFloat ? 3 : 1);
    put16 (out, channels);
    put32 (out, rate);
    put32 (out, rate * static_cast<juce::uint32> (channels * bytes));
    put16 (out, channels * bytes);
    put16 (out, bitDepth);

    out.write ("data", 4);
    put32 (out, static_cast<juce::uint32> (dataBytes));

    {
        juce::HeapBlock<char> frames (static_cast<size_t> (channels) * static_cast<size_t> (bytes) * 4096);

        for (int start = 0; start < numSamples; start += 4096)
        {
            const auto count = juce::jmin (4096, numSamples - start);
            auto* write = frames.get();

            for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            {
                for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; ++channel)
                {
                    const auto raw = audio.getSample (channel, start + i) * gain;

                    if (isFloat)
                    {
                        const auto value = std::isfinite (raw) ? raw : 0.0f;
                        juce::uint32 bits = 0;
                        std::memcpy (&bits, &value, 4);
                        *write++ = static_cast<char> (bits & 0xff);
                        *write++ = static_cast<char> ((bits >> 8) & 0xff);
                        *write++ = static_cast<char> ((bits >> 16) & 0xff);
                        *write++ = static_cast<char> ((bits >> 24) & 0xff);
                        continue;
                    }

                    const auto value = juce::jlimit (-1.0f, 1.0f, std::isfinite (raw) ? raw : 0.0f);

                    if (bitDepth == 16)
                    {
                        const auto sample = juce::jlimit (-32768, 32767, static_cast<int> (std::lround (static_cast<double> (value) * 32767.0)));
                        *write++ = static_cast<char> (sample & 0xff);
                        *write++ = static_cast<char> ((sample >> 8) & 0xff);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        const auto sample = juce::jlimit (-8388608, 8388607, static_cast<int> (std::lround (static_cast<double> (value) * 8388607.0)));
                        *write++ = static_cast<char> (sample & 0xff);
                        *write++ = static_cast<char> ((sample >> 8) & 0xff);
                        *write++ = static_cast<char> ((sample >> 16) & 0xff);
                    }
                }
            }

            out.write (frames.get(), static_cast<size_t> (write - frames.get()));
        }
    }

    if (pad != 0)
        out.writeByte (0);

    putSmpl (out, rate, rootNote, loopStart, loopEnd);
    return writeWhole (file, out);
}

bool Sfz::setWavLoop (const juce::File& wav, int rootNote, juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd)
{
    juce::MemoryBlock data;

    if (! wav.loadFileAsData (data) || data.getSize() < 44)
        return false;

    const auto* raw = static_cast<const juce::uint8*> (data.getData());
    const auto size = data.getSize();

    if (std::memcmp (raw, "RIFF", 4) != 0 || std::memcmp (raw + 8, "WAVE", 4) != 0)
        return false;

    const auto read32 = [raw] (size_t at)
    {
        return static_cast<juce::uint32> (raw[at]) | (static_cast<juce::uint32> (raw[at + 1]) << 8)
             | (static_cast<juce::uint32> (raw[at + 2]) << 16) | (static_cast<juce::uint32> (raw[at + 3]) << 24);
    };

    juce::MemoryOutputStream out;
    out.write ("RIFF", 4);
    put32 (out, 0);   // its size, once it's known
    out.write ("WAVE", 4);

    juce::uint32 rate = 48000;
    bool hasFmt = false, hasData = false;

    for (size_t at = 12; at + 8 <= size;)
    {
        const auto chunkSize = read32 (at + 4);
        const auto body = at + 8;
        const auto available = static_cast<size_t> (juce::jmin<juce::uint64> (chunkSize, size - body));

        if (std::memcmp (raw + at, "fmt ", 4) == 0 && available >= 16)
        {
            // The plain 16 bytes; an extensible one's sub-format decides PCM or float.
            juce::uint8 fmt[16];
            std::memcpy (fmt, raw + body, 16);
            auto tag = static_cast<int> (fmt[0] | (fmt[1] << 8));

            if (tag == 0xfffe && available >= 26)
                tag = static_cast<int> (raw[body + 24] | (raw[body + 25] << 8));

            fmt[0] = static_cast<juce::uint8> (tag == 3 ? 3 : 1);
            fmt[1] = 0;
            rate = static_cast<juce::uint32> (fmt[4] | (fmt[5] << 8) | (fmt[6] << 16) | (fmt[7] << 24));
            out.write ("fmt ", 4);
            put32 (out, 16);
            out.write (fmt, 16);
            hasFmt = true;
        }
        else if (std::memcmp (raw + at, "data", 4) == 0)
        {
            out.write ("data", 4);
            put32 (out, static_cast<juce::uint32> (available));
            out.write (raw + body, available);

            if ((available & 1) != 0)
                out.writeByte (0);

            hasData = true;
        }
        else if (std::memcmp (raw + at, "smpl", 4) != 0 && std::memcmp (raw + at, "JUNK", 4) != 0
                 && std::memcmp (raw + at, "junk", 4) != 0 && std::memcmp (raw + at, "bext", 4) != 0
                 && std::memcmp (raw + at, "LIST", 4) != 0)
        {
            out.write (raw + at, 8 + available);

            if ((available & 1) != 0)
                out.writeByte (0);
        }

        at = body + static_cast<size_t> (chunkSize) + (chunkSize & 1);
    }

    if (! hasFmt || ! hasData)
        return false;

    putSmpl (out, rate, rootNote, loopStart, loopEnd);

    auto* written = static_cast<juce::uint8*> (const_cast<void*> (out.getData()));
    const auto riff = static_cast<juce::uint32> (out.getDataSize() - 8);
    written[4] = static_cast<juce::uint8> (riff & 0xff);
    written[5] = static_cast<juce::uint8> ((riff >> 8) & 0xff);
    written[6] = static_cast<juce::uint8> ((riff >> 16) & 0xff);
    written[7] = static_cast<juce::uint8> ((riff >> 24) & 0xff);
    return writeWhole (wav, out);
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\SfzFile.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>
#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <utility>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    SFZ instruments as Sonify writes them (the Sampling Studio and its Builder): Sampler Arena's
    own dialect, byte for byte, so either app (and any SFZ player) plays the other's.

    The file: UTF-8 without a byte order mark (plain ASCII when the name is), Windows line ends
    (CR LF). Three comment lines (who wrote it, the instrument's name, how many keys were
    sampled), a blank line, an empty <global> and a blank line; then a <region> for each sample,
    its header alone on its line, one opcode per line (sample=, lokey=, hikey=, pitch_keycenter=,
    then lovel= and hivel= together on one line, then amp_veltrack=100) and a blank line after
    it. No <control>, no default_path, no key=: the samples are in a samples folder beside it,
    named with a backslash (sample=samples\Piano_C4_V124.wav). Round robins (takes of the same
    note played in turn) add seq_length= and seq_position=, a line each, after amp_veltrack.

    A sample with a loop (Create Legato Loop, or the Loop Editor) adds loop_mode=loop_sustain,
    loop_start=, loop_end= and loop_crossfade= (when it has one, in seconds), a line each, after
    amp_veltrack, as Sampler Arena does.

    The samples: 16 or 24-bit PCM (or 32-bit float) WAV with the plain 16-byte fmt chunk (never
    the extensible one) and no JUNK chunk, then a smpl chunk naming the key it was sampled at (its
    unity note) and its loop, when it has one.

    The Sample Builder's instruments are written as Sampler Arena's Sample Builder writes them:
    a comment, a <group> with a short attack and release, then a region for each sample with its
    keys on one line (builderText).

    Names: a key as Sampler Arena writes it in file names, "C4", "Cs4" (middle C, note 60, is
    C4); a sample as <name>_<key>_V<velocity>.wav (_RR<take> after it for a round robin's takes),
    the name with spaces, the characters Windows forbids in a name and control characters made
    underscores.
*/
namespace Sfz
{
    /** A key's name as Sampler Arena writes it in file names: "C4", "Cs4", "C-1". */
    juce::String keyName (int note);

    /** A name made fit for folders, files and the SFZ: spaces, the characters Windows forbids
        (: / \ * ? " < > |) and control characters become underscores, and so does a dot at its
        end. Never empty ("Sample"). */
    juce::String safeName (const juce::String& name);

    /** The keys a sampled key plays: from 3 keys below it (no lower than the key above the one
        below it) up to the key before the next one's zone, so a sample stretches further up than
        down; the lowest from the bottom of the range and the highest to its top (fill: the whole
        keyboard, 0 to 127). Every key of the range plays one sample, never two. roots: sorted,
        each once. */
    struct Zone
    {
        int root = 60, low = 60, high = 60;
    };

    std::vector<Zone> zones (const std::vector<int>& roots, int rangeLow, int rangeHigh, bool fill);

    /** A key's velocity ranges, from the velocities its samples were played at (sorted, each
        once): each from just above the middle between it and the one below to the middle between
        it and the one above, the first from 0 and the last to 127 (one alone: 0 to 127). */
    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> velocityRanges (const std::vector<int>& velocities);

    /** The velocity the Sampling Studio plays a layer at: a single layer at 127, otherwise 3
        below the top of the layer's share of 1..127 (layer 0 the softest). */
    int layerVelocity (int layer, int layers);

    /** One sample's place in the instrument. */
    struct Region
    {
        juce::String sample;                    // its file's name, in the samples folder
        int lokey = 0, hikey = 127, keycenter = 60;
        int lovel = 0, hivel = 127;
        int seqLength = 0, seqPosition = 0;     // round robins: how many take turns, and which this is (0: none)
        juce::int64 loopStart = -1, loopEnd = -1;   // its loop (sample frames), none when loopEnd <= loopStart
        double loopCrossfade = 0.0;             // seconds (0: none written)
    };

    /** The instrument's text (lines end in a line feed; write() makes them CR LF). keys: how many
        keys were sampled. */
    juce::String text (const juce::String& name, int keys, const std::vector<Region>& regions);

    /** A Sample Builder instrument's text, as Sampler Arena's builder writes it. samplesFolder:
        "samples\\" when the samples are in a samples folder beside it, else empty. */
    juce::String builderText (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& samplesFolder, const std::vector<Region>& regions);

    /** A region's loop opcodes (empty without a loop). The crossfade in seconds, as the SFZ
        standard has it (Sampler Arena wrote samples, which other players read as seconds). */
    juce::String loopOpcodes (juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd, double crossfadeSeconds);

    /** A loop_crossfade value in seconds: as the standard has it, or a whole number of samples
        as Sampler Arena writes it (10 or more, without a point). */
    double readCrossfade (const juce::String& value, double sampleRate);

    /** A sample's .loop sidecar (beside it, Sampler Arena's: loop_start=, loop_end=, crossfade=,
        score=): written, read (false when there's none) and removed. */
    bool writeLoopFile (const juce::File& wav, juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd, int crossfade, float score);
    bool readLoopFile (const juce::File& wav, juce::int64& loopStart, juce::int64& loopEnd, int& crossfade);
    void removeLoopFile (const juce::File& wav);

    /** A WAV's smpl chunk made again with this unity note and loop (none: loopEnd <= loopStart),
        and the file cleaned as Sampler Arena cleans it: no JUNK, bext or LIST chunk, the plain
        16-byte fmt chunk, one smpl chunk. The audio itself is copied as it is. */
    bool setWavLoop (const juce::File& wav, int rootNote, juce::int64 loopStart, juce::int64 loopEnd);

    /** Writes the text as UTF-8 (no byte order mark) with CR LF line ends. */
    bool write (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& text);

    /** A sample as Sonify writes them: 16 or 24-bit PCM or 32-bit float, one or two channels (the
        buffer's first two; channels 1 for one alone), its key (and its loop, when loopEnd >
        loopStart) in a smpl chunk; gain applied as it's written (PCM clipped at full scale).
        Written whole to a temporary file first, then put in place. */
    bool writeWav (const juce::File& file, const juce::AudioBuffer<float>& audio, int numSamples, double sampleRate,
                   int rootNote, float gain = 1.0f, int bitDepth = 24, int channels = 0,
                   juce::int64 loopStart = -1, juce::int64 loopEnd = -1);
}
