// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\stella_builtin_paint.cpp
//
// PanelPainter: a built-in painter for paint_picture (part of the elements' runtime, in every
// build): a whole panel background, lit by one light the way the knobs' looks are, from its
// settings alone (stella_paint.h does the painting):
//
//   material   powder, aluminium, steel, silver, chrome, gold, rosegold, brass, copper, bronze,
//              titanium (liquid), gunmetal, iron, hammertone, anodized, carbon, marble,
//              blackmarble, granite, slate, concrete, terrazzo, sandstone, plastic,
//              matteplastic, rubber, bakelite, ceramic, wood (walnut, oak, rosewood, ebony),
//              burl, leather, tolex, felt, paper, glass, frosted, pearl, smooth
//   color, color2         its colours (paint_picture's "color" is the main one; color2: marble's
//                         veins, granite's flecks, wood's dark grain...)
//   finish                natural, polished, satin, brushed, hammered, sandblasted, matte, liquid
//   scale, angle, grain   the texture's size, direction (degrees) and strength (0..2)
//   shine, flow           0 matte .. 1 mirror; liquid swirls 0..1 (titanium has them)
//   seed                  another grain
//   pattern               a pattern layer over it: a name with patternColor, patternOpacity,
//                         patternBlend, patternSize, patternAngle; or "patterns": a list of
//                         { "pattern", "color", "opacity", "blend", "size", "angle", "width",
//                         "depth", "x", "y", "count", "invert" } layers, bottom first
//   light, altitude       where the light comes from (degrees, 120: the upper left, as the
//                         looks), and how high (10..80, default 35: low is dramatic)
//   key, keyX, keyY       the key light's pool (0..1, default 0.6) and where it falls (0..1)
//   vignette              darker edges (0..1, default 0.45)
//   rim, corner           the panel's own bevelled edge (px), and its corner radius
//   screws                1: a screw in each corner of the window
//   parts     [{ "kind": recess|raise|plate|screen|inlay|light|well, "x", "y", "w", "h",
//                "shape": "circle", "radius", "depth", "strength", "screws", "glow",
//                and a surface of its own: "material", "color", "finish", "pattern"... }]
//              (the older "sections": "x,y,w,h;..." are recesses)
//   lines     [{ "x1", "y1", "x2", "y2", "width", "kind": groove|ridge }]
//   vents     [{ "x", "y", "w", "h", "slots", "across" }]
//   grilles   [{ "x", "y", "w", "h", "spacing", "size" }]
//   texts     [{ "x", "y", "w", "h", "text", "size", "bold", "style": engraved|embossed|printed,
//                "color", "align": left|centre|right }]

#include "stella_elements.h"
#include "stella_paint.h"

#include <cstdlib>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace stella::ui::builtin
{
    class PanelPainter final : public Element
    {
    public:
        void resized() override
        {
            namespace p = stella::paint;

            // The panel's own surface, from its settings.
            p::Json look;
            look.type = p::Json::Type::object;

            for (const auto* key : { "material", "color", "colour", "color2", "colour2", "finish", "scale", "angle", "grain", "shine", "flow",
                                     "seed", "pattern", "patterns", "patternColor", "patternColour", "patternOpacity", "patternBlend",
                                     "patternSize", "patternScale", "patternAngle", "patternWidth", "patternDepth" })
            {
                const auto text = settingText (key, "");

                if (text.empty())
                    continue;

                look.fields.push_back ({ key, text[0] == '[' || text[0] == '{' ? p::Json::parse (text) : textValue (text) });
            }

            panel = {};
            panel.surfacing = p::surfacingFrom (look, p::Surfacing::of (p::Material::powder, (int) setting ("seed", 1.0f)));

            if (const auto given = colour (0u); given != 0u)
                panel.surfacing.colour = p::rgbOf (given);

            panel.light = p::Light::from (setting ("light", 120.0f), setting ("altitude", 35.0f));
            panel.key = setting ("key", 0.6f);
            panel.keyX = setting ("keyX", -1.0f);
            panel.keyY = setting ("keyY", -1.0f);
            panel.vignette = setting ("vignette", 0.45f);
            rim = setting ("rim", 0.0f);
            corner = setting ("corner", 0.0f);
            screws = setting ("screws", 0.0f) > 0.5f;

            parts.clear();
            lines = p::Json::parse (settingText ("lines", "[]"));
            vents = p::Json::parse (settingText ("vents", "[]"));
            grilles = p::Json::parse (settingText ("grilles", "[]"));
            texts = p::Json::parse (settingText ("texts", "[]"));

            for (const auto* name : { "parts", "sections" })
            {
                const auto text = settingText (name, "");

                if (text.empty())
                    continue;

                if (text[0] == '[' || text[0] == '{')
                {
                    const auto list = p::Json::parse (text);

                    if (list.type == p::Json::Type::object)
                        addPart (list);

                    for (const auto& item : list.items)
                        addPart (item);
                }
                else
                {
                    addOldSections (text);
                }
            }
        }

        void paint (Canvas& g) override
        {
            namespace p = stella::paint;

            surface.resize (width(), height());
            panel.setSize (width(), height());
            p::paintBase (surface, panel);

            // Lights first (they fall on the panel), then the parts in their order.
            for (const auto& part : parts)
                if (part.kind == p::PartKind::light)
                    p::paintPart (surface, part, panel);

            for (const auto& part : parts)
                if (part.kind != p::PartKind::light)
                    p::paintPart (surface, part, panel);

            for (const auto& l : lines.items)
                p::paintLine (surface, l.num ("x1", 0.0f), l.num ("y1", 0.0f), l.num ("x2", 0.0f), l.num ("y2", 0.0f),
                              l.num ("width", 2.0f), l.str ("kind", "groove") == "ridge", panel.light);

            for (const auto& v : vents.items)
                p::paintSlots (surface, v.num ("x", 0.0f), v.num ("y", 0.0f), v.num ("w", 60.0f), v.num ("h", 30.0f),
                               (int) v.num ("slots", 6.0f), v.flag ("across"), panel);

            for (const auto& h : grilles.items)
                p::paintHoles (surface, h.num ("x", 0.0f), h.num ("y", 0.0f), h.num ("w", 80.0f), h.num ("h", 80.0f),
                               h.num ("spacing", 7.0f), h.num ("size", 3.5f), panel.light);

            p::paintRim (surface, rim, corner, panel.light);

            if (screws)
            {
                const float r = 5.0f, m = 14.0f, w = (float) width(), h = (float) height();
                p::paintScrew (surface, m, m, r, 0.6f, panel.light);
                p::paintScrew (surface, w - m, m, r, 2.1f, panel.light);
                p::paintScrew (surface, m, h - m, r, 1.2f, panel.light);
                p::paintScrew (surface, w - m, h - m, r, 2.7f, panel.light);
            }

            surface.write (g);
            paintTexts (g);
        }

    private:
        /** A setting's text as a value: a number when it reads as one, otherwise words. */
        static stella::paint::Json textValue (const std::string& text)
        {
            stella::paint::Json j;
            char* end = nullptr;
            const double d = std::strtod (text.c_str(), &end);

            if (end != text.c_str() && *end == 0)
            {
                j.type = stella::paint::Json::Type::number;
                j.number = d;
            }
            else
            {
                j.type = stella::paint::Json::Type::text;
                j.text = text;
            }

            return j;
        }

        void addPart (const stella::paint::Json& j)
        {
            namespace p = stella::paint;

            if (j.type != p::Json::Type::object || parts.size() >= 64)
                return;

            p::Part part;
            part.kind = p::partKindNamed (j.str ("kind", "recess"));
            const float x = j.num ("x", 0.0f), y = j.num ("y", 0.0f), w = j.num ("w", 40.0f), h = j.num ("h", 40.0f);
            const bool round = j.str ("shape") == "circle" || part.kind == p::PartKind::well;

            part.shape = round ? p::Shape::circle (x + w * 0.5f, y + h * 0.5f, std::fmin (w, h) * 0.5f)
                               : p::Shape::box (x, y, w, h, j.num ("radius", part.kind == p::PartKind::screen ? 6.0f : 8.0f));

            const float defaultDepth = part.kind == p::PartKind::raise ? 5.0f : (part.kind == p::PartKind::plate || part.kind == p::PartKind::well ? 3.0f : 4.0f);
            part.depth = j.num ("depth", defaultDepth);
            part.strength = j.num ("strength", part.kind == p::PartKind::light ? 0.6f : 1.0f);
            part.screws = j.flag ("screws");

            const auto colourText = j.str ("color", j.str ("colour"));

            if (part.kind == p::PartKind::light || part.kind == p::PartKind::screen)
            {
                // Its colour is its light's, or its glass's.
                if (! colourText.empty())
                {
                    part.colour = p::colourNamed (colourText, { 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f });
                    part.hasColour = true;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Its own surface when it says anything about one (a plate always has its own).
                bool own = part.kind == p::PartKind::plate;

                for (const auto* key : { "material", "color", "colour", "color2", "finish", "pattern", "patterns", "shine", "grain", "scale", "angle", "flow" })
                    own = own || j.has (key);

                if (own)
                {
                    const auto fallback = part.kind == p::PartKind::plate && ! j.has ("material") ? p::Surfacing::of (p::Material::aluminium, panel.surfacing.seed + 7)
                                                                                                  : panel.surfacing;
                    part.surfacing = p::surfacingFrom (j, fallback);
                    part.ownSurface = true;
                }
            }

            if (const auto glow = j.str ("glow"); ! glow.empty())
            {
                part.glow = p::colourNamed (glow, { 0.3f, 1.0f, 0.6f });
                part.glowAmount = 1.0f;
            }

            parts.push_back (part);
        }

        /** "x,y,w,h;x,y,w,h": recessed sections, as the first painter took them. */
        void addOldSections (const std::string& text)
        {
            namespace p = stella::paint;
            std::size_t start = 0;

            while (start < text.size() && parts.size() < 64)
            {
                const auto end = text.find (';', start);
                const auto piece = text.substr (start, end == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : end - start);
                float v[4] {};
                int n = 0;
                const char* at = piece.c_str();

                while (n < 4 && *at != 0)
                {
                    char* next = nullptr;
                    v[n] = std::strtof (at, &next);

                    if (next == at)
                        break;

                    ++n;
                    at = *next == ',' ? next + 1 : next;
                }

                if (n == 4)
                {
                    p::Part part;
                    part.shape = p::Shape::box (v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3], 8.0f);
                    parts.push_back (part);
                }

                if (end == std::string::npos)
                    break;

                start = end + 1;
            }
        }

        /** Words on the panel, cut in (engraved), standing out (embossed) or printed, lit from
            the same place as everything else. */
        void paintTexts (Canvas& g)
        {
            namespace p = stella::paint;

            for (const auto& t : texts.items)
            {
                const auto words = t.str ("text");

                if (words.empty())
                    continue;

                const float x = t.num ("x", 0.0f), y = t.num ("y", 0.0f), w = t.num ("w", 200.0f), h = t.num ("h", 24.0f);
                const float size = t.num ("size", 14.0f);
                const bool bold = t.flag ("bold");
                const auto alignText = t.str ("align", "left");
                const auto align = alignText == "right" ? Align::right : (alignText == "centre" || alignText == "center" ? Align::centre : Align::left);
                const auto style = t.str ("style", "engraved");
                const auto ink = p::colourOf (p::colourNamed (t.str ("color", t.str ("colour")), { 0.10f, 0.11f, 0.12f }));
                const float ax = -panel.light.tx, ay = -panel.light.ty;   // away from the light

                if (style == "embossed")
                {
                    g.drawText (words, x + ax, y + ay, w, h, size, 0x66000000, align, bold);
                    g.drawText (words, x - ax * 0.7f, y - ay * 0.7f, w, h, size, 0x40ffffff, align, bold);
                }
                else if (style != "printed")
                {
                    g.drawText (words, x + ax, y + ay, w, h, size, 0x38ffffff, align, bold);   // the far edge of the cut catches the light
                }

                g.drawText (words, x, y, w, h, size, ink, align, bold);
            }
        }

        stella::paint::Panel panel;
        float rim = 0.0f, corner = 0.0f;
        bool screws = false;
        std::vector<stella::paint::Part> parts;
        stella::paint::Json lines, vents, grilles, texts;
        stella::paint::Surface surface;
    };

    STELLA_BUILTIN_ELEMENT (PanelPainter, "Painter for paint_picture: a whole panel background lit by one light, from settings (material in any "
                                          "colour and finish, pattern layers, light, key, vignette, rim, screws, parts: recess, raise, plate, "
                                          "screen, inlay, light, well; lines, vents, grilles, texts). Nothing to write or build.")
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\stella_clap.cpp
//
// An exported plugin's CLAP side: no JUCE, just the CLAP API around the plugin's core
// (stella_plugin.h). Built by the Plugins Creator Studio's Export (PluginExporter) with the
// project's modules, the Stella runtime, the window (stella_gui.cpp and the platform's own
// window) and three generated files: stella_graph.cpp (the graph), stella_plugin_info.h (name,
// vendor, id, kind) and stella_gui_data.cpp (the baked window).
//
// The window changes parameters the CLAP way: gesture begin, values, gesture end, sent to the
// host from process() or flush(). On Linux its window runs on the host's timer and watches its
// connection to the X server through the host (timer-support, posix-fd-support).

#include "stella_plugin.h"

#include <clap/clap.h>

namespace
{
    using stella::plugin::Core;

    //==========================================================================
    clap_id idFor (const std::string& text)
    {
        const auto hash = stella::plugin::hashOf (text);
        return hash == CLAP_INVALID_ID ? 1u : hash;
    }

    void copyText (char* destination, size_t capacity, const std::string& text)
    {
        if (capacity == 0)
            return;

        std::strncpy (destination, text.c_str(), capacity - 1);
        destination[capacity - 1] = 0;
    }

    /** A parameter change made on the window, on its way to the host. */
    struct WindowEvent
    {
        int type = 0;   // 0 gesture begins, 1 value, 2 gesture ends
        int index = 0;
        float value = 0.0f;
    };

    struct Plugin final : public Core
    {
        clap_plugin_t clap {};
        const clap_host_t* host = nullptr;
        const clap_host_params_t* hostParams = nullptr;
        bool active = false;
        std::vector<clap_id> ids;

        std::unique_ptr<stella::gui::Window> window;

       #if defined (__linux__)
        const clap_host_timer_support_t* hostTimers = nullptr;
        const clap_host_posix_fd_support_t* hostFds = nullptr;
        clap_id timerId = CLAP_INVALID_ID;
        int watchedFd = -1;
       #endif

        // Window -> host parameter changes: one writer (the window), one reader (process or flush).
        std::array<WindowEvent, 1024> windowEvents {};
        std::atomic<std::uint32_t> windowHead { 0 }, windowTail { 0 };

        int indexOf (clap_id id) const
        {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i)
                if (ids[i] == id)
                    return (int) i;

            return -1;
        }

        //======================================================================
        void pushWindowEvent (int type, int index, float value)
        {
            const auto head = windowHead.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
            const auto next = (head + 1) % (std::uint32_t) windowEvents.size();

            if (next == windowTail.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
                return;   // full: the host isn't listening; the value itself is already set

            windowEvents[head] = { type, index, value };
            windowHead.store (next, std::memory_order_release);

            if (hostParams != nullptr)
                hostParams->request_flush (host);
        }

        /** Hands the window's changes to the host (from process() or flush()). */
        void drainWindowEvents (const clap_output_events_t* out)
        {
            auto tail = windowTail.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

            while (tail != windowHead.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
            {
                const auto event = windowEvents[tail];
                tail = (tail + 1) % (std::uint32_t) windowEvents.size();
                windowTail.store (tail, std::memory_order_release);

                if (event.index < 0 || event.index >= (int) ids.size() || out == nullptr)
                    continue;

                if (event.type == 1)
                {
                    clap_event_param_value_t value {};
                    value.header = { sizeof (value), 0, CLAP_CORE_EVENT_SPACE_ID, CLAP_EVENT_PARAM_VALUE, 0 };
                    value.param_id = ids[(size_t) event.index];
                    value.note_id = -1;
                    value.port_index = -1;
                    value.channel = -1;
                    value.key = -1;
                    value.value = event.value;
                    out->try_push (out, &value.header);
                }
                else
                {
                    clap_event_param_gesture_t gesture {};
                    gesture.header = { sizeof (gesture), 0, CLAP_CORE_EVENT_SPACE_ID,
                                       (std::uint16_t) (event.type == 0 ? CLAP_EVENT_PARAM_GESTURE_BEGIN : CLAP_EVENT_PARAM_GESTURE_END), 0 };
                    gesture.param_id = ids[(size_t) event.index];
                    out->try_push (out, &gesture.header);
                }
            }
        }

        // The window's edits.
        void beginEdit (int param) override    { pushWindowEvent (0, param, 0.0f); }
        void endEdit (int param) override      { pushWindowEvent (2, param, 0.0f); }

        void setValue (int param, float value) override
        {
            if (param < 0 || param >= numParams())
                return;

            storeValue (param, value);
            pushWindowEvent (1, param, valueOf (param));
        }

        void applyParamEvent (const clap_event_header_t* header)
        {
            if (header->space_id != CLAP_CORE_EVENT_SPACE_ID || header->type != CLAP_EVENT_PARAM_VALUE)
                return;

            const auto* event = reinterpret_cast<const clap_event_param_value_t*> (header);
            storeValue (indexOf (event->param_id), (float) event->value);
        }
    };

    Plugin* self (const clap_plugin_t* plugin)
    {
        return static_cast<Plugin*> (plugin->plugin_data);
    }

    //==========================================================================
    // Parameters
    uint32_t paramsCount (const clap_plugin_t* plugin)
    {
        return (uint32_t) self (plugin)->numParams();
    }

    bool paramsGetInfo (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, uint32_t index, clap_param_info_t* info)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);

        if (index >= (uint32_t) p->numParams())
            return false;

        const auto& param = p->paramInfo ((int) index);
        std::memset (info, 0, sizeof (*info));
        info->id = p->ids[index];
        info->flags = CLAP_PARAM_IS_AUTOMATABLE;
        info->cookie = nullptr;
        copyText (info->name, sizeof (info->name), param.name);
        copyText (info->module, sizeof (info->module), param.module);
        info->min_value = param.min;
        info->max_value = param.max;
        info->default_value = param.def;
        return true;
    }

    bool paramsGetValue (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, clap_id id, double* value)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);
        const auto index = p->indexOf (id);

        if (index < 0)
            return false;

        *value = p->valueOf (index);
        return true;
    }

    bool paramsValueToText (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, clap_id id, double value, char* text, uint32_t capacity)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);
        const auto index = p->indexOf (id);

        if (index < 0 || capacity == 0)
            return false;

        copyText (text, capacity, p->valueText (index, value));
        return true;
    }

    bool paramsTextToValue (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, clap_id id, const char* text, double* value)
    {
        if (self (plugin)->indexOf (id) < 0)
            return false;

        char* end = nullptr;
        const auto parsed = std::strtod (text, &end);

        if (end == text)
            return false;

        *value = parsed;
        return true;
    }

    void paramsFlush (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, const clap_input_events_t* in, const clap_output_events_t* out)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);

        if (in != nullptr)
            for (uint32_t i = 0, n = in->size (in); i < n; ++i)
                p->applyParamEvent (in->get (in, i));

        p->drainWindowEvents (out);
    }

    const clap_plugin_params_t paramsExtension { paramsCount, paramsGetInfo, paramsGetValue,
                                                 paramsValueToText, paramsTextToValue, paramsFlush };

    //==========================================================================
    // Audio and note ports
    uint32_t audioPortsCount (const clap_plugin_t*, bool isInput)
    {
        return isInput ? (stella::info::isInstrument ? 0u : 1u) : 1u;
    }

    bool audioPortsGet (const clap_plugin_t*, uint32_t index, bool isInput, clap_audio_port_info_t* info)
    {
        if (index != 0 || (isInput && stella::info::isInstrument))
            return false;

        std::memset (info, 0, sizeof (*info));
        info->id = isInput ? 0 : 1;
        copyText (info->name, sizeof (info->name), isInput ? "Input" : "Output");
        info->flags = CLAP_AUDIO_PORT_IS_MAIN;
        info->channel_count = 2;
        info->port_type = CLAP_PORT_STEREO;
        info->in_place_pair = CLAP_INVALID_ID;
        return true;
    }

    const clap_plugin_audio_ports_t audioPortsExtension { audioPortsCount, audioPortsGet };

    uint32_t notePortsCount (const clap_plugin_t*, bool isInput)
    {
        // Instruments take notes; effects take them too (a module may follow the keyboard).
        return isInput ? 1u : 0u;
    }

    bool notePortsGet (const clap_plugin_t*, uint32_t index, bool isInput, clap_note_port_info_t* info)
    {
        if (index != 0 || ! isInput)
            return false;

        std::memset (info, 0, sizeof (*info));
        info->id = 0;
        info->supported_dialects = CLAP_NOTE_DIALECT_CLAP | CLAP_NOTE_DIALECT_MIDI;
        info->preferred_dialect = CLAP_NOTE_DIALECT_CLAP;
        copyText (info->name, sizeof (info->name), "Notes");
        return true;
    }

    const clap_plugin_note_ports_t notePortsExtension { notePortsCount, notePortsGet };

    //==========================================================================
    // State: one "id=value" line per parameter.
    bool stateSave (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, const clap_ostream_t* stream)
    {
        const auto text = self (plugin)->saveState();
        size_t written = 0;

        while (written < text.size())
        {
            const auto n = stream->write (stream, text.data() + written, text.size() - written);

            if (n <= 0)
                return false;

            written += (size_t) n;
        }

        return true;
    }

    bool stateLoad (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, const clap_istream_t* stream)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);
        std::string text;
        char buffer[4096];

        for (;;)
        {
            const auto n = stream->read (stream, buffer, sizeof (buffer));

            if (n < 0)
                return false;

            if (n == 0)
                break;

            text.append (buffer, (size_t) n);
        }

        if (! p->loadState (text))
            return false;

        // Let the host refresh its view of the values.
        if (p->hostParams != nullptr)
            p->hostParams->rescan (p->host, CLAP_PARAM_RESCAN_VALUES);

        return true;
    }

    const clap_plugin_state_t stateExtension { stateSave, stateLoad };

    //==========================================================================
    // The plugin
    bool pluginInit (const clap_plugin_t* plugin)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);

        if (! p->build())
            return false;

        for (int i = 0; i < p->numParams(); ++i)
            p->ids.push_back (idFor (p->paramInfo (i).id));

        if (p->host != nullptr)
        {
            p->hostParams = static_cast<const clap_host_params_t*> (p->host->get_extension (p->host, CLAP_EXT_PARAMS));

           #if defined (__linux__)
            p->hostTimers = static_cast<const clap_host_timer_support_t*> (p->host->get_extension (p->host, CLAP_EXT_TIMER_SUPPORT));
            p->hostFds = static_cast<const clap_host_posix_fd_support_t*> (p->host->get_extension (p->host, CLAP_EXT_POSIX_FD_SUPPORT));
           #endif
        }

        return true;
    }

    void pluginDestroy (const clap_plugin_t* plugin)
    {
        delete self (plugin);
    }

    bool pluginActivate (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, double sampleRate, uint32_t, uint32_t maxFrames)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);
        p->active = p->isBuilt() && p->prepare (sampleRate, (int) maxFrames);
        return p->active;
    }

    void pluginDeactivate (const clap_plugin_t* plugin)
    {
        self (plugin)->active = false;
        self (plugin)->notes.clear();
    }

    bool pluginStartProcessing (const clap_plugin_t*)  { return true; }
    void pluginStopProcessing (const clap_plugin_t*)   {}

    void pluginReset (const clap_plugin_t* plugin)
    {
        self (plugin)->reset();
    }

    clap_process_status pluginProcess (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, const clap_process_t* process)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);

        if (! p->active || process->audio_outputs_count == 0)
            return CLAP_PROCESS_CONTINUE;

        const stella::plugin::NoDenormals noDenormals;
        p->drainWindowEvents (process->out_events);

        // The host's tempo and position at the block's start.
        stella::plugin::Transport transport;

        if (const auto* t = process->transport)
        {
            if ((t->flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TEMPO) != 0)
                transport.tempo = t->tempo;

            if ((t->flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_BEATS_TIMELINE) != 0)
            {
                transport.beat = (double) t->song_pos_beats / (double) CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR;
                transport.barStart = (double) t->bar_start / (double) CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR;
            }

            if ((t->flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TIME_SIGNATURE) != 0)
            {
                transport.numerator = t->tsig_num;
                transport.denominator = t->tsig_denom;
            }

            transport.playing = (t->flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_PLAYING) != 0;
        }

        auto& shared = p->shared();
        const auto total = process->frames_count;
        const auto maxFrames = (uint32_t) p->getMaxFrames();
        const auto numEvents = process->in_events != nullptr ? process->in_events->size (process->in_events) : 0u;
        uint32_t nextEvent = 0;

        float* const* outputs = process->audio_outputs[0].data32;
        const auto outputChannels = (int) process->audio_outputs[0].channel_count;

        const float* const* inputs = process->audio_inputs_count > 0 ? process->audio_inputs[0].data32 : nullptr;
        const auto inputChannels = process->audio_inputs_count > 0 ? (int) process->audio_inputs[0].channel_count : 0;

        for (uint32_t start = 0; start < total; start += maxFrames)
        {
            const auto frames = (total - start) < maxFrames ? (total - start) : maxFrames;

            // The window's keyboard: its notes come first, at the start of the block.
            uint32_t count = start == 0 ? p->takeWindowNotes (shared.events, 0, (uint32_t) stella::maxEvents) : 0u;

            // This stretch's events: notes and MIDI to the runtime, parameter changes to the values.
            while (nextEvent < numEvents)
            {
                const auto* header = process->in_events->get (process->in_events, nextEvent);

                if (header->time >= start + frames)
                    break;

                ++nextEvent;

                if (header->space_id != CLAP_CORE_EVENT_SPACE_ID)
                    continue;

                const auto frame = header->time > start ? header->time - start : 0u;

                switch (header->type)
                {
                    case CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_ON:
                    case CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_OFF:
                    {
                        const auto* note = reinterpret_cast<const clap_event_note_t*> (header);

                        if (note->key < 0 || note->key > 127 || count >= (uint32_t) stella::maxEvents)
                            break;

                        const auto on = header->type == CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_ON;
                        auto velocity = (int) (note->velocity * 127.0 + 0.5);
                        velocity = velocity < 1 ? (on ? 1 : 0) : (velocity > 127 ? 127 : velocity);
                        const auto channel = note->channel >= 0 && note->channel < 16 ? note->channel : 0;

                        shared.events[count++] = { frame, (std::uint8_t) ((on ? 0x90 : 0x80) | channel), (std::uint8_t) note->key,
                                                   (std::uint8_t) (on ? velocity : 0), 0 };
                        break;
                    }

                    case CLAP_EVENT_MIDI:
                    {
                        const auto* midi = reinterpret_cast<const clap_event_midi_t*> (header);

                        if (count < (uint32_t) stella::maxEvents && midi->data[0] < 0xf0)
                            shared.events[count++] = { frame, midi->data[0], midi->data[1], midi->data[2], 0 };
                        break;
                    }

                    case CLAP_EVENT_PARAM_VALUE:
                        p->applyParamEvent (header);
                        break;

                    default:
                        break;
                }
            }

            p->run (inputs, inputChannels, outputs, outputChannels, (int) start, (int) frames, count, transport);
        }

        return CLAP_PROCESS_CONTINUE;
    }

    //==========================================================================
    // The window, inside the host's.
   #if defined (_WIN32)
    const char* const windowApi = CLAP_WINDOW_API_WIN32;
   #elif defined (__APPLE__)
    const char* const windowApi = CLAP_WINDOW_API_COCOA;
   #else
    const char* const windowApi = CLAP_WINDOW_API_X11;
   #endif

    bool guiIsApiSupported (const clap_plugin_t*, const char* api, bool floating)
    {
        return stella::gui::hasWindow() && ! floating && api != nullptr && std::strcmp (api, windowApi) == 0;
    }

    bool guiGetPreferredApi (const clap_plugin_t*, const char** api, bool* floating)
    {
        *api = windowApi;
        *floating = false;
        return true;
    }

   #if defined (__linux__)
    void stopWatching (Plugin* p)
    {
        if (p->timerId != CLAP_INVALID_ID && p->hostTimers != nullptr)
            p->hostTimers->unregister_timer (p->host, p->timerId);

        if (p->watchedFd >= 0 && p->hostFds != nullptr)
            p->hostFds->unregister_fd (p->host, p->watchedFd);

        p->timerId = CLAP_INVALID_ID;
        p->watchedFd = -1;
    }
   #endif

    bool guiCreate (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, const char* api, bool floating)
    {
        if (! guiIsApiSupported (plugin, api, floating))
            return false;

        auto* p = self (plugin);

       #if defined (__linux__)
        // Its window runs on the host's timer: without one, the host shows its own controls.
        if (p->hostTimers == nullptr)
            return false;
       #endif

        p->window = stella::gui::Window::create (*p);
        return p->window != nullptr;
    }

    void guiDestroy (const clap_plugin_t* plugin)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);

       #if defined (__linux__)
        stopWatching (p);
       #endif

        p->window.reset();
    }

    bool guiSetScale (const clap_plugin_t*, double)                        { return false; }
    bool guiCanResize (const clap_plugin_t*)                               { return false; }
    bool guiGetResizeHints (const clap_plugin_t*, clap_gui_resize_hints_t*) { return false; }
    bool guiSetTransient (const clap_plugin_t*, const clap_window_t*)      { return false; }
    void guiSuggestTitle (const clap_plugin_t*, const char*)               {}

    bool guiGetSize (const clap_plugin_t*, uint32_t* width, uint32_t* height)
    {
        *width = (uint32_t) stella::gui::width;
        *height = (uint32_t) stella::gui::height;
        return true;
    }

    bool guiAdjustSize (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, uint32_t* width, uint32_t* height)
    {
        return guiGetSize (plugin, width, height);
    }

    bool guiSetSize (const clap_plugin_t*, uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
    {
        return width == (uint32_t) stella::gui::width && height == (uint32_t) stella::gui::height;
    }

    bool guiSetParent (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, const clap_window_t* window)
    {
        auto* p = self (plugin);

        if (p->window == nullptr || window == nullptr)
            return false;

       #if defined (_WIN32)
        return p->window->attach (window->win32);
       #elif defined (__APPLE__)
        return p->window->attach (window->cocoa);
       #else
        if (! p->window->attach (reinterpret_cast<void*> ((std::uintptr_t) window->x11)))
            return false;

        // About 30 times a second, and whenever the X server has something for it.
        stopWatching (p);
        p->hostTimers->register_timer (p->host, 33, &p->timerId);
        p->watchedFd = p->window->getFileDescriptor();

        if (p->watchedFd >= 0 && (p->hostFds == nullptr || ! p->hostFds->register_fd (p->host, p->watchedFd, CLAP_POSIX_FD_READ)))
            p->watchedFd = -1;

        return true;
       #endif
    }

    bool guiShow (const clap_plugin_t* plugin)
    {
        if (auto& w = self (plugin)->window) w->setVisible (true);
        return true;
    }

    bool guiHide (const clap_plugin_t* plugin)
    {
        if (auto& w = self (plugin)->window) w->setVisible (false);
        return true;
    }

    const clap_plugin_gui_t guiExtension { guiIsApiSupported, guiGetPreferredApi, guiCreate, guiDestroy, guiSetScale,
                                           guiGetSize, guiCanResize, guiGetResizeHints, guiAdjustSize, guiSetSize,
                                           guiSetParent, guiSetTransient, guiSuggestTitle, guiShow, guiHide };

   #if defined (__linux__)
    void onTimer (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, clap_id)
    {
        if (auto& w = self (plugin)->window) w->idle();
    }

    void onFd (const clap_plugin_t* plugin, int, clap_posix_fd_flags_t)
    {
        if (auto& w = self (plugin)->window) w->idle();
    }

    const clap_plugin_timer_support_t timerExtension { onTimer };
    const clap_plugin_posix_fd_support_t fdExtension { onFd };
   #endif

    const void* pluginGetExtension (const clap_plugin_t*, const char* id)
    {
        if (std::strcmp (id, CLAP_EXT_PARAMS) == 0)       return &paramsExtension;
        if (std::strcmp (id, CLAP_EXT_AUDIO_PORTS) == 0)  return &audioPortsExtension;
        if (std::strcmp (id, CLAP_EXT_NOTE_PORTS) == 0)   return &notePortsExtension;
        if (std::strcmp (id, CLAP_EXT_STATE) == 0)        return &stateExtension;

        if (std::strcmp (id, CLAP_EXT_GUI) == 0 && stella::gui::hasWindow())
            return &guiExtension;

       #if defined (__linux__)
        if (std::strcmp (id, CLAP_EXT_TIMER_SUPPORT) == 0)     return &timerExtension;
        if (std::strcmp (id, CLAP_EXT_POSIX_FD_SUPPORT) == 0)  return &fdExtension;
       #endif

        return nullptr;
    }

    void pluginOnMainThread (const clap_plugin_t*) {}

    //==========================================================================
    // The factory: one plugin.
    const char* const instrumentFeatures[] { CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_INSTRUMENT, CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_SYNTHESIZER, CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_STEREO, nullptr };
    const char* const effectFeatures[]     { CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_AUDIO_EFFECT, CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_STEREO, nullptr };
    const char* const widgetFeatures[]     { CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_AUDIO_EFFECT, CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_ANALYZER, CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_STEREO, nullptr };

    const clap_plugin_descriptor_t descriptor {
        CLAP_VERSION_INIT,
        stella::info::id,
        stella::info::name,
        stella::info::vendor,
        "",   // url
        "",   // manual
        "",   // support
        stella::info::version,
        stella::info::description,
        stella::info::kind == 0 ? instrumentFeatures : (stella::info::kind == 2 ? widgetFeatures : effectFeatures)
    };

    uint32_t factoryCount (const clap_plugin_factory_t*)
    {
        return 1;
    }

    const clap_plugin_descriptor_t* factoryDescriptor (const clap_plugin_factory_t*, uint32_t index)
    {
        return index == 0 ? &descriptor : nullptr;
    }

    const clap_plugin_t* factoryCreate (const clap_plugin_factory_t*, const clap_host_t* host, const char* pluginId)
    {
        if (! clap_version_is_compatible (host->clap_version) || std::strcmp (pluginId, descriptor.id) != 0)
            return nullptr;

        auto* p = new Plugin();
        p->host = host;
        p->clap.desc = &descriptor;
        p->clap.plugin_data = p;
        p->clap.init = pluginInit;
        p->clap.destroy = pluginDestroy;
        p->clap.activate = pluginActivate;
        p->clap.deactivate = pluginDeactivate;
        p->clap.start_processing = pluginStartProcessing;
        p->clap.stop_processing = pluginStopProcessing;
        p->clap.reset = pluginReset;
        p->clap.process = pluginProcess;
        p->clap.get_extension = pluginGetExtension;
        p->clap.on_main_thread = pluginOnMainThread;
        return &p->clap;
    }

    const clap_plugin_factory_t factory { factoryCount, factoryDescriptor, factoryCreate };

    bool entryInit (const char*)    { return true; }
    void entryDeinit()              {}

    const void* entryGetFactory (const char* factoryId)
    {
        return std::strcmp (factoryId, CLAP_PLUGIN_FACTORY_ID) == 0 ? &factory : nullptr;
    }
}

// Exported by clap/entry.h's declaration of clap_entry.
extern "C" CLAP_EXPORT const clap_plugin_entry_t clap_entry { CLAP_VERSION_INIT, entryInit, entryDeinit, entryGetFactory };

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\stella_element_api.h
//
// Programmed GUI elements: for a GUI element the toolbox doesn't have (a drop-down list,
// a step sequencer, a custom-drawn knob...), write a class that draws itself and answers
// the mouse, in elements/<Name>.cpp. The studio shows it live in Edit UI and Play, and
// exported plugins and apps draw it the same way, pixel for pixel.
//
// Use it in gui/layout.json as { "type": "custom", "element": "<Name>", "x", "y", "w", "h" }
// plus what it needs: "param" (its parameter), "params" (more, by role: { "x": "id" }),
// "label", "options" (a list of texts), "color", "source" (a signal or display to watch),
// "sources" (more, by role: { "position": "osc.position", "cutoff": "synth.cutoff" }) and
// "settings" (anything else: { "rows": 4, "style": "round" }).
//
// An element can do everything the toolbox's own can (parameters, live signals and displays,
// notes, presets, pictures, popups), so any of them can be split up, combined or remade in
// another shape: a preset list apart from its Save and Load, a preset table in a popup...
//
// Coordinates are pixels, floats, from the element's top-left corner (0, 0) to
// (width(), height()); pixel (x, y) covers x..x+1, y..y+1. Drawing is anti-aliased and
// clipped to the element (a popup to the popup). Colours are 0xAARRGGBB.
//
// Read values in paint() and the mouse functions, not in the constructor: the element
// knows its size and parameters only once it's placed (resized() is called first).

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace stella::ui
{
    //==========================================================================
    using Colour = std::uint32_t;   // 0xAARRGGBB: 0xff2080ff is solid blue

    constexpr Colour rgb (int r, int g, int b) noexcept
    {
        return 0xff000000u | ((std::uint32_t) (r & 255) << 16) | ((std::uint32_t) (g & 255) << 8) | (std::uint32_t) (b & 255);
    }

    Colour withAlpha (Colour c, float alpha) noexcept;    // alpha 0..1, times the colour's own
    Colour mix (Colour a, Colour b, float t) noexcept;    // t 0: a, 1: b
    Colour brighter (Colour c, float amount) noexcept;    // amount 0..1: towards white
    Colour darker (Colour c, float amount) noexcept;      // amount 0..1: towards black

    enum class Align { left, centre, right };

    /** A picture of the plugin's (Element::picture), ready to draw. */
    struct Image
    {
        int width = 0, height = 0;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> pixels;    // width x height, row by row from the top: premultiplied 0xAARRGGBB

        bool isValid() const noexcept    { return width > 0 && height > 0 && pixels.size() == (std::size_t) width * (std::size_t) height; }
    };

    /** What a preset manager does besides choosing a preset (Element::doPreset). */
    enum class PresetCommand
    {
        save,          // the values over the chosen preset (one of the user's)
        saveAs,        // a new preset of the user's: the studio asks its name
        saveFactory,   // making the plugin: a preset it comes with (asks its name)
        load,          // a preset file from anywhere (asks which)
        saveBank,      // every preset into one bank file (asks where)
        loadBank,      // a bank file's presets (asks which)
        remove,        // deletes the chosen preset (asks "are you sure")
        showFolder     // opens the folder the user's presets are in
    };

    //==========================================================================
    /** Where an element draws. Angles are in radians, 0 at 12 o'clock, going clockwise
        (a knob from 7 to 5 o'clock: -2.36 to 2.36). */
    class Canvas
    {
    public:
        int width() const noexcept    { return width_; }
        int height() const noexcept   { return height_; }

        void fillAll (Colour c);

        /** One pixel, for pictures made point by point (noise, grain, brushed metal, wood):
            blends c over the pixel at whole-number x, y (an opaque colour replaces it); outside
            the clip it does nothing. Cheap enough to fill a whole window pixel by pixel in a
            picture painted once (paint_picture). */
        void drawPixel (int x, int y, Colour c);
        void fillRect (float x, float y, float w, float h, Colour c);
        void fillRoundedRect (float x, float y, float w, float h, float radius, Colour c);
        void fillEllipse (float x, float y, float w, float h, Colour c);
        void fillCircle (float cx, float cy, float radius, Colour c);
        void fillTriangle (float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, Colour c);
        void fillPolygon (const float* xy, int numPoints, Colour c);           // xy: x0, y0, x1, y1, ...
        void fillPie (float cx, float cy, float radius, float from, float to, Colour c);

        /** Gradients: top to bottom in a box (radius > 0 rounds its corners), or from the
            middle of a circle out. */
        void fillGradient (float x, float y, float w, float h, Colour top, Colour bottom, float radius = 0.0f);
        void fillRadialGradient (float cx, float cy, float radius, Colour inside, Colour outside);

        /** Outlines of boxes and ellipses lie inside the box. Lines and arcs are centred on
            their path, with round ends (arcs: square ends unless roundEnds). */
        void drawRect (float x, float y, float w, float h, float thickness, Colour c);
        void drawRoundedRect (float x, float y, float w, float h, float radius, float thickness, Colour c);
        void drawEllipse (float x, float y, float w, float h, float thickness, Colour c);
        void drawLine (float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float thickness, Colour c);
        void drawPolyline (const float* xy, int numPoints, float thickness, Colour c);
        void drawArc (float cx, float cy, float radius, float from, float to, float thickness, Colour c, bool roundEnds = false);

        /** One line of text, centred up and down in the box and placed across it by align;
            too long, it ends in "...". size is the font's height in pixels (13 is usual). */
        void drawText (const std::string& text, float x, float y, float w, float h, float size, Colour c,
                       Align align = Align::centre, bool bold = false);
        float textWidth (const std::string& text, float size, bool bold = false);

        /** A picture (Element::picture) with its top-left at x, y (whole pixels), at its own
            size; alpha 0..1 fades it. The second draws only part of it: sw x sh pixels from sx, sy
            (one frame of a filmstrip, a strip of frames one under the other: sy = frame * sh). */
        void drawImage (const Image& image, float x, float y, float alpha = 1.0f);
        void drawImage (const Image& image, float x, float y, int sx, int sy, int sw, int sh, float alpha = 1.0f);

        /** Drawing stays inside this box until resetClip() (a scrolling list, say). */
        void setClip (float x, float y, float w, float h);
        void resetClip();

    private:
        friend struct CanvasAccess;
        Canvas() = default;

        std::uint32_t* pixels_ = nullptr;
        int width_ = 0, height_ = 0;
        int clip_[4] {};
        void* painter_ = nullptr;
    };

    //==========================================================================
    struct Mouse
    {
        float x = 0.0f, y = 0.0f;    // in the element's pixels (on the popup: the popup's)
        bool shift = false;          // Shift or Ctrl held: fine moves
        bool doubleClick = false;
    };

    //==========================================================================
    /** A programmed element. Override paint(), and the mouse functions it needs. */
    class Element
    {
    public:
        virtual ~Element() = default;

        virtual void paint (Canvas& g) = 0;
        virtual void resized() {}                                   // width() / height() are new (also once at the start)

        /** The mouse on the element. Return true from mouseDown to get the drag and mouseUp. */
        virtual bool mouseDown (const Mouse&)                       { return false; }
        virtual void mouseDrag (const Mouse&)                       {}
        virtual void mouseUp (const Mouse&)                         {}
        virtual void mouseMove (const Mouse&)                       {}  // hovering, no button down
        virtual void mouseExit()                                    {}
        virtual void mouseWheel (const Mouse&, float /*notches*/)   {}  // + is up

        //======================================================================
        // A popup: a box drawn above the whole window (a drop-down's list, say), while it's
        // open. A click outside it closes it (and isn't passed on).
        void openPopup (float x, float y, float w, float h);       // in the element's pixels: x 0, y height() opens it just below
        void closePopup();
        bool isPopupOpen() const;

        virtual void paintPopup (Canvas&)                           {}  // the popup's own pixels: (0, 0) is its top-left
        virtual void popupMouseDown (const Mouse&)                  {}
        virtual void popupMouseDrag (const Mouse&)                  {}
        virtual void popupMouseUp (const Mouse&)                    {}
        virtual void popupMouseMove (const Mouse&)                  {}
        virtual void popupMouseExit()                               {}
        virtual void popupMouseWheel (const Mouse&, float /*notches*/) {}
        virtual void popupClosed()                                  {}  // closed by a click outside it

        //======================================================================
        int width() const;
        int height() const;

        /** Parameters. role "" is the element's own ("param" in the layout); others are
            named in its "params". Values are the parameter's own (e.g. Hz); normalised is
            0..1 along its range, as a knob shows it. */
        bool hasParam (const char* role = "") const;
        float value (const char* role = "") const;
        float normalised (const char* role = "") const;
        float minimum (const char* role = "") const;
        float maximum (const char* role = "") const;
        float defaultValue (const char* role = "") const;
        int choices (const char* role = "") const;                 // whole-number positions: maximum - minimum + 1
        std::string paramName (const char* role = "") const;
        std::string unit (const char* role = "") const;
        std::string valueText (const char* role = "") const;       // "440 Hz"

        /** Setting a value. Alone, each call is one undoable change for the host; for a drag,
            put the calls between beginEdit and endEdit (endEdit comes by itself on mouseUp). */
        void setValue (float newValue, const char* role = "");
        void setNormalised (float proportion, const char* role = "");
        void beginEdit (const char* role = "");
        void endEdit (const char* role = "");

        /** From the layout. */
        std::string label() const;
        int numOptions() const;
        std::string option (int index) const;
        Colour colour (Colour fallback) const;                      // "color", or fallback if none
        float setting (const char* key, float fallback) const;      // "settings": a number
        std::string settingText (const char* key, const std::string& fallback = {}) const;

        /** Live. Reading level() or seconds() in paint() redraws the element every frame. */
        float level (bool rms = false) const;                       // its "source": a peak 0..1+ (or RMS), or a display's value
        void readScope (float* destination, int numSamples) const;  // its "source": the newest samples, oldest first

        /** More live values, by role (the layout's "sources"; role "" is its own "source"): a
            display's value as its module shows it (Hz, 0..1...), a signal's peak (or RMS) and
            newest samples. hasSource says whether the role is bound, so the element can fall
            back on a parameter's value when it isn't. */
        bool hasSource (const char* role = "") const;
        float level (const char* role, bool rms = false) const;
        void readScope (const char* role, float* destination, int numSamples) const;

        //======================================================================
        /** The plugin's presets, the same ones the toolbox's preset manager has: those it comes
            with, the user's own and the banks they loaded, each under its group ("Factory",
            "My presets", a bank's name), in the manager's order. Every part of a preset manager
            can be an element of its own (a list, a table in a popup, Save and Load buttons, a
            menu of the commands): they all work on these presets, follow each other, and the
            element is drawn again when they change. */
        int numPresets() const;
        std::string presetName (int index) const;
        std::string presetGroup (int index) const;
        int currentPreset() const;                                  // -1: none chosen
        bool isPresetModified() const;                              // its values changed since it was chosen (a manager adds "*")
        void choosePreset (int index);                              // puts its values on the plugin
        void stepPreset (int delta);                                // the next (+1) or previous (-1), round the list

        /** A preset command, with the dialog it needs (a name, a file, "are you sure"): the
            studio shows the dialog, the element only says which. canDoPreset: whether it can be
            done now (save: the chosen preset is the user's, otherwise saveAs; remove: it can be
            deleted; saveFactory: only while the plugin is being made). */
        void doPreset (PresetCommand command);
        bool canDoPreset (PresetCommand command) const;

        //======================================================================
        /** A picture of the plugin's (gui/images: the ones the user added and the painted ones,
            "knob.png"), scaled smoothly to w x h (0 and 0: its own size; one of them 0: keeping
            its shape), up to 4 million pixels. Empty (isValid() false) when there's no such
            picture. Load it in resized() (the size is known there) and keep it: it's too slow
            for every paint. */
        Image picture (const std::string& name, int w = 0, int h = 0) const;
        bool pictureSize (const std::string& name, int& w, int& h) const;   // its own size; false if there's none

        double seconds() const;                                     // a clock, for animation
        void playNote (int note, float velocity);                   // MIDI note 0..127; velocity 0..1, 0 stops it
        bool isNoteDown (int note) const;                           // sounding, from anywhere

        /** Draw again (it's done by itself after the mouse, and when its values change). */
        void repaint();

    private:
        friend struct ElementAccess;
        void* instance_ = nullptr;
    };

    //==========================================================================
    struct Registrar
    {
        Registrar (const char* name, const char* description, Element* (*make)());
    };
}

/** Makes an element available, after its class: STELLA_ELEMENT (DropDown, "A drop-down list"). */
#define STELLA_ELEMENT(Type, Description) \
    static ::stella::ui::Registrar stellaElementRegistrar_##Type (#Type, Description, [] () -> ::stella::ui::Element* { return new Type(); });

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\stella_element_host.h
//
// What programmed GUI elements (stella_element_api.h) ask of whoever shows them: the
// studio, through WebAssembly, or an exported plugin's own GUI. element is the shower's
// own number for the element (its place in the layout). A slot is one of the element's
// parameters: 0 its own ("param"), 1 and up its roles ("params"), as findSlot gives them.

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

namespace stella::ui
{
    class ElementHost
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ElementHost() = default;

        enum Info { valueInfo = 0, minInfo = 1, maxInfo = 2, defaultInfo = 3, skewInfo = 4 };

        /** A parameter's value or range; false if the slot has no parameter. */
        virtual bool paramInfo (int element, int slot, int info, float& result) = 0;
        virtual int findSlot (int element, const std::string& role) = 0;                  // -1: none
        virtual void setValue (int element, int slot, float newValue) = 0;
        virtual void gesture (int element, int slot, bool starts) = 0;                    // a drag starts or ends

        enum Text { labelText = 0, optionText = 1, paramNameText = 2, unitText = 3, settingText = 4, sourceText = 5,
                    presetNameText = 6, presetGroupText = 7 };

        /** option: index is which one; paramName and unit: index is the slot; setting: key
            names it; source: key is the role ("" its own), the result what it watches; preset
            name and group: index is the preset. False if there's none. */
        virtual bool text (int element, int which, int index, const std::string& key, std::string& result) = 0;
        virtual int numOptions (int element) = 0;
        virtual std::uint32_t colour (int element) = 0;                                   // 0: none given

        virtual float level (int element, bool rms) = 0;
        virtual void readScope (int element, float* destination, int numSamples) = 0;

        /** The same by role (the layout's "sources"; "" is the element's own "source"). */
        virtual float sourceLevel (int element, const std::string& role, bool rms)
        {
            return role.empty() ? level (element, rms) : 0.0f;
        }

        virtual void readSourceScope (int element, const std::string& role, float* destination, int numSamples)
        {
            if (role.empty())
                readScope (element, destination, numSamples);
            else
                for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
                    destination[i] = 0.0f;
        }

        /** The presets (the preset manager's): how many, the chosen one (-1: none), whether its
            values changed since, whether a PresetCommand (index) can be done now, and a number
            that changes whenever any of them does. */
        enum PresetInfo { presetCountInfo = 0, presetCurrentInfo = 1, presetModifiedInfo = 2, presetCanDoInfo = 3, presetVersionInfo = 4 };

        virtual int presetInfo (int /*element*/, int which, int /*index*/)    { return which == presetCurrentInfo ? -1 : 0; }

        /** Choose a preset (index), step (index: +1 or -1), or a PresetCommand (index). */
        enum PresetTask { choosePresetTask = 0, stepPresetTask = 1, presetCommandTask = 2 };

        virtual void presetTask (int /*element*/, int /*task*/, int /*index*/) {}

        /** A picture of the plugin's by file name: its own size (false: there's none), and its
            pixels scaled to width x height (premultiplied 0xAARRGGBB, row by row from the top). */
        virtual bool pictureSize (int /*element*/, const std::string& /*name*/, int& /*width*/, int& /*height*/)   { return false; }

        virtual bool readPicture (int /*element*/, const std::string& /*name*/, int /*width*/, int /*height*/, std::uint32_t* /*destination*/)
        {
            return false;
        }

        /** A font the elements' text may be drawn in, by name (an element's "font" setting): the
            size of its file in bytes (0: there's no such font), and the file itself copied to
            destination when capacity is that size. bold: its bold (0 when it has none: the
            regular one stands in). */
        virtual int fontData (const std::string& /*name*/, bool /*bold*/, std::uint8_t* /*destination*/, int /*capacity*/)   { return 0; }

        virtual void playNote (int element, int note, float velocity) = 0;
        virtual bool isNoteDown (int note) = 0;
        virtual double seconds() = 0;
    };
}
