{
}

StellaAi::~StellaAi()
{
    *alive = false;   // answers and tool results arriving later find no one
}

void StellaAi::addEntry (Entry::Kind kind, const juce::String& text)
{
    entries.push_back ({ kind, text });
}

void StellaAi::notify()
{
    if (onChanged != nullptr)
        onChanged();
}

void StellaAi::clear()
{
    if (busy)
        return;

    entries.clear();
    messages.clear();
    clearPlan();
    later.clear();
    notify();
}

void StellaAi::stop()
{
    if (! busy)
        return;

    stopRequested = true;
    addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Stopping after this step\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    notify();
}

void StellaAi::finish()
{
    // The last step finished and Sonify AI answered: the plan is done.
    if (! steps.empty() && planApproved && ! planDone && (planFinishing || (lastStop == "done" && planCurrent >= (int) steps.size())))
    {
        planDone = true;
        planFinishing = false;
        planCurrent = (int) steps.size();
        recordFinishedSteps();
        showPlan();
    }

    busy = false;
    pendingCalls.clear();
    toolResults.clear();
    notify();

    if (onTurnFinished != nullptr)
        onTurnFinished (currentRequest);
}

//==============================================================================
bool StellaAi::canAttach (const juce::File& file)
{
    const auto extension = file.getFileExtension().trimCharactersAtStart (".").toLowerCase();
    return CodeReference::canTake (file)
        || (file.existsAsFile() && (imageTypes.contains (extension) || textTypes.contains (extension) || extension == "pdf"));
}

juce::String StellaAi::attachableFiles()
{
    juce::StringArray patterns;

    for (const auto& type : imageTypes)  patterns.add ("*." + type);
    patterns.add ("*.pdf");
    for (const auto& type : textTypes)   patterns.add ("*." + type);
    patterns.addTokens (CodeReference::filePatterns(), ";", {});
    patterns.removeDuplicates (true);

    return patterns.joinIntoString (";");
}

juce::Result StellaAi::attach (const juce::File& file, juce::Array<juce::var>& blocks)
{
    const auto extension = file.getFileExtension().trimCharactersAtStart (".").toLowerCase();
    const auto name = file.getFileName();

    if (textTypes.contains (extension))
    {
        if (file.getSize() > 150 * 1024)
            return juce::Result::fail ("it's over 150 KB of text");

        blocks.add (blockOf ({ { "type", "text" }, { "text", "Attached file " + name + ":\n```\n" + file.loadFileAsString() + "\n```" } }));
        return juce::Result::ok();
    }

    juce::MemoryBlock data;

    if (! file.loadFileAsData (data))
        return juce::Result::fail ("it couldn't be read");

    if (extension == "pdf")
    {
        if (data.getSize() > 3 * 1024 * 1024)
            return juce::Result::fail ("PDFs can be up to 3 MB");

        blocks.add (blockOf ({ { "type", "document" },
                               { "source", blockOf ({ { "type", "base64" }, { "media_type", "application/pdf" },
                                                      { "data", juce::Base64::toBase64 (data.getData(), data.getSize()) } }) },
                               { "title", name } }));
        return juce::Result::ok();
    }

    // Images: shown to Sonify AI. Large ones are scaled down (cheaper, and it sees no more anyway).
    juce::String mediaType = "image/webp";

    if (extension != "webp")
    {
        auto image = juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom (data.getData(), data.getSize());

        if (! image.isValid())
            return juce::Result::fail ("it isn't an image the studio can read");

        constexpr int longest = 1568;
        const auto scale = (float) longest / (float) juce::jmax (image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());

        if (scale < 1.0f)
            image = image.rescaled (juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt ((float) image.getWidth() * scale)),
                                    juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt ((float) image.getHeight() * scale)),
                                    juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);

        juce::MemoryOutputStream encoded;

        if (image.hasAlphaChannel())
        {
            juce::PNGImageFormat().writeImageToStream (image, encoded);
            mediaType = "image/png";
        }
        else
        {
            juce::JPEGImageFormat jpeg;
            jpeg.setQuality (0.85f);
            jpeg.writeImageToStream (image, encoded);
            mediaType = "image/jpeg";
        }

        data = encoded.getMemoryBlock();
    }

    if (data.getSize() > (size_t) 3500 * 1024)
        return juce::Result::fail ("the image is too big (over 3.5 MB)");

    blocks.add (blockOf ({ { "type", "image" },
                           { "source", blockOf ({ { "type", "base64" }, { "media_type", mediaType },
                                                  { "data", juce::Base64::toBase64 (data.getData(), data.getSize()) } }) } }));
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

void StellaAi::send (const juce::String& text, const juce::Array<juce::File>& files, const juce::String& shownText)
{
    auto request = text.trim();

    if (busy || (request.isEmpty() && files.isEmpty()))
        return;

    // The files, read and made ready; any that can't be used are named in a note. The user's
    // own code isn't sent: it's kept in the project's reference/ folder, read only, and Fanan AI
    // reads what it needs (read_file a part at a time, search_reference), so a whole codebase fits.
    juce::Array<juce::var> blocks;
    juce::StringArray attached, problems;
    juce::Array<juce::File> code;
    int sent = 0;

    for (const auto& file : files)
    {
        if (CodeReference::canTake (file))
        {
            code.add (file);
            continue;
        }

        if (sent >= maxAttachments)
        {
            problems.add (file.getFileName() + " (at most " + juce::String (maxAttachments) + " pictures, PDFs or texts at a time)");
            continue;
        }

        if (const auto result = attach (file, blocks); result.wasOk())
        {
            attached.add (file.getFileName());
            ++sent;
        }
        else
        {
            problems.add (file.getFileName() + " (" + result.getErrorMessage() + ")");
        }
    }

    juce::String codeNote;

    if (! code.isEmpty())
    {
        const auto added = tools.addReference (code);
        problems.addArray (added.problems);

        if (! added.paths.isEmpty())
        {
            for (const auto& file : code)
                attached.add (file.getFileName() + (file.isDirectory() ? "/" : ""));

            codeNote = "\n\n(The user brought their own code: " + juce::String (added.paths.size())
                     + (added.paths.size() == 1 ? " file" : " files") + ", saved read only in reference/:\n"
                     + tools.getReference().listing (40, added.paths)
                     + "Read what you need with read_file (a long file a part at a time) and search_reference, and port it as the guide's "
                       "\"The user's own code\" says.)";
        }
    }

    if (request.isEmpty() && attached.isEmpty())
    {
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Not sent: " + problems.joinIntoString (", ") + ".");
        notify();
        return;
    }

    if (request.isEmpty())
        request = codeNote.isNotEmpty() && sent == 0 ? juce::String ("Have a look at my code.")
                                                     : "Have a look at the attached file" + juce::String (attached.size() > 1 ? "s." : ".");

    addEntry (Entry::Kind::user, (shownText.trim().isNotEmpty() ? shownText.trim() : request)
                                     + (attached.isEmpty() ? juce::String()
                                                           : juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\n\xf0\x9f\x93\x8e ") + attached.joinIntoString (", ")));

    if (! problems.isEmpty())
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Not attached: " + problems.joinIntoString (", ") + ".");

    if (! canReachServer())
        return;

    currentRequest = shownText.trim().isNotEmpty() ? shownText.trim() : request;

    if (planDone || planCancelled)
        clearPlan();   // a finished plan isn't told again; an unfinished one is, so "continue" carries on

    auto startMode = juce::String ("chat");

    if (proposalPending)
    {
        // About the plan on show: "yes, go ahead" starts it, anything else changes it (or
        // is answered while it waits). Its own mode knows it best.
        userSpokeSinceProposal = true;
        startMode = planMode;
    }
    else if (planApproved && ! planDone && planCurrent > 0)
    {
        // Typing on after a step ran over its estimate means going on with it.
        overrunPaused = false;
        auto& step = steps[(size_t) planCurrent - 1];

        if (step.used >= step.allowance)
            step.allowance = step.used + juce::roundToInt (step.high * overrunFactor);
    }

    if (blocks.isEmpty())
    {
        beginTurn (makeMessage ("user", request + codeNote), currentRequest, startMode);
    }
    else
    {
        blocks.add (blockOf ({ { "type", "text" }, { "text", request + codeNote } }));
        beginTurn (makeMessage ("user", blocks), currentRequest, startMode);
    }
}

bool StellaAi::canReachServer()
{
    // Nothing is sent (or charged) unless the server can take it.
    if (! server.isReady())
    {
        const auto status = server.getStatus();
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, status == FananServer::Status::blocked    ? "Not sent: the internet is blocked (the switch at the top left), and Fanan AI works through it."
                                     : status == FananServer::Status::noInternet ? "Not sent: there's no internet connection. Check it and send again."
                                                                                 : "Not sent: Fanan's server can't be reached right now. Please try again in a moment.");
        server.checkNow();
        notify();
        return false;
    }

    if (server.getCredits() == 0)
    {
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Not sent: you're out of credits. Use Buy credits to get more, then send again.");
        notify();
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

void StellaAi::beginTurn (const juce::var& message, const juce::String& shown, const juce::String& startMode)
{
    if (onTurnStarted != nullptr)
        onTurnStarted (shown);

    trimHistory();
    turnStart = messages.size();
    messages.add (message);

    mode = startMode;
    foundationOff = false;
    retriesInARow = 0;
    lastStop.clear();
    cutsInARow = 0;
    cutThisAnswer = false;
    roundsLeft = maxRounds;
    stopRequested = false;
    turnCredits = 0;
    busy = true;

    notify();
    sendRound();
}

void StellaAi::sendRound()
{
    auto* body = new juce::DynamicObject();
    const juce::var payload (body);

    body->setProperty ("mode", mode);

    // A new plugin's foundation goes to the strongest builder (a server that doesn't know it
    // yet uses its usual builder).
    sentFoundation = usesFoundation();

    if (sentFoundation)
        body->setProperty ("foundation", true);

    body->setProperty ("guide", ProjectTools::getGuide());
    body->setProperty ("context", tools.describeProject() + modeContext() + planContext() + lookContext());
    body->setProperty ("messages", compacted());
    body->setProperty ("tools", tools.getDefinitions (mode == "build"));
    body->setProperty ("request_id", juce::Uuid().toString());

    server.stellaChat (payload, [this, stillAlive = alive] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        if (*stillAlive)
            onAnswer (result, answer);
    });
}

bool StellaAi::usesFoundation() const
{
    // A new plugin's design: never built, no design brief yet, no plan under way. Once the
    // brief is written (or a plan runs), the usual builder builds it.
    return mode == "build" && ! foundationOff && ! tools.hasBuiltOnce() && ! tools.hasDesign() && ! (planApproved && ! planDone);
}

bool StellaAi::foundationFailed (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
{
    if (! result.failed())
        return answer.getProperty ("stop", {}).toString() == "refused";

    // The server answered that the AI service failed: not the credits, not signing in, and
    // not the connection (which fails for any builder alike).
    const auto error = answer.getProperty ("error", {}).toString();
    return error.isNotEmpty() && error != "no_credits" && error != "sign_in" && error != "unknown";
}

bool StellaAi::worthRetrying (const juce::var& answer)
{
    // Not the credits, not signing in, not the AI service being down, not the connection
    // (which has its own message and its own checks).
    const auto error = answer.getProperty ("error", {}).toString();
    return error.isNotEmpty() && error != "no_credits" && error != "sign_in" && error != "unknown" && error != "unavailable";
}

void StellaAi::onAnswer (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
{
    // The foundation builder failed or declined: the usual builder takes the same round over
    // (nothing was charged for it), and carries on for the rest of this request.
    if (sentFoundation && ! stopRequested && foundationFailed (result, answer))
    {
        foundationOff = true;
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Trying that again\xe2\x80\xa6"));
        notify();
        sendRound();
        return;
    }

    // The server failed the round for a reason of its own (busy, or a hiccup): it's tried once
    // more after a moment, so a plan under way goes on by itself. The round added nothing to
    // the conversation, so it goes again as it was.
    if (result.failed() && ! stopRequested && retriesInARow < maxRetries && worthRetrying (answer))
    {
        ++retriesInARow;
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Trying that again\xe2\x80\xa6"));
        notify();

        juce::Timer::callAfterDelay (retryDelayMs, [this, stillAlive = alive]
        {
            if (! *stillAlive || ! busy)
                return;

            if (stopRequested)
            {
                messages.removeRange (turnStart, messages.size() - turnStart);
                addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Stopped.");
                finish();
                return;
            }

            sendRound();
        });

        return;
    }

    if (! result.failed())
        retriesInARow = 0;

    if (result.failed())
    {
        // The request didn't happen: the conversation goes back to before it (files already
        // written stay in the project, and the AI sees them next time).
        messages.removeRange (turnStart, messages.size() - turnStart);
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, result.getErrorMessage());
        finish();
        return;
    }

    const auto content = answer.getProperty ("content", {});
    const auto reply = answer.getProperty ("reply", {}).toString().trim();
    const auto stopReason = answer.getProperty ("stop", {}).toString();
    const bool cut = stopReason == "cut";
    lastStop = stopReason;
    answerUsed = juce::jmax (0, (int) answer.getProperty ("used", 0));
    proposedThisAnswer = false;

    if (! cut)
        cutsInARow = 0;

    // Its tool calls. An answer that ran out of room still has the calls it finished (the one
    // cut half-way is left out): they run like any others, and it carries on from there.
    juce::Array<juce::var> calls;

    if (const auto* blocks = content.getArray())
        for (const auto& block : *blocks)
            if (block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString() == "tool_use")
                calls.add (block);

    const bool runsTools = (stopReason == "tools" || cut) && ! calls.isEmpty();

    // A call kept in the conversation must get its result, or the next request is refused:
    // calls that won't run are left out of it.
    auto kept = content;

    if (! runsTools && content.isArray())
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> blocks;

        for (const auto& block : *content.getArray())
            if (block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString() != "tool_use")
                blocks.add (block);

        kept = blocks;
    }

    messages.add (makeMessage ("assistant", kept.isArray() && kept.getArray()->size() > 0
                                                ? kept : juce::var (reply.isNotEmpty() ? reply : juce::String (cut ? "(cut off)" : "(no reply)"))));

    showSearches (content);

    if (reply.isNotEmpty() && ! cut)   // words cut off half-way aren't shown
    {
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::ai, reply);
        showSources (content);
    }

    if (runsTools)
    {
        pendingCalls = calls;
        toolResults.clear();
        cutThisAnswer = cut;
        layoutChangedThisStep = false;
        notify();
        runNextTool();
        return;
    }

    chargeAnswer();

    // A long web search can pause the answer: it goes back as it is, and the AI carries on.
    if (stopReason == "paused" && ! stopRequested && --roundsLeft > 0)
    {
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Researching\xe2\x80\xa6"));
        notify();
        sendRound();
        return;
    }

    // Cut off before any call: it tries again, smaller, a couple of times.
    if (cut && ++cutsInARow <= maxCutRetries && --roundsLeft > 0 && ! stopRequested)
    {
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("That was too much at once: carrying on in smaller pieces\xe2\x80\xa6"));
        messages.add (makeMessage ("user", cutNote (false)));
        notify();
        sendRound();
        return;
    }

    if (cut)
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Fanan AI's answers keep running out of room. Ask for less at once, or say \"continue\".");
    else if (stopReason == "refused")
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Fanan AI declined that request.");
    else if (reply.isEmpty())
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Fanan AI finished without a reply.");

    finish();
}

//==============================================================================
// Research: the AI service searches the web inside a step, when the AI asks it to.
void StellaAi::showSearches (const juce::var& content)
{
    if (const auto* blocks = content.getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& block : *blocks)
        {
            if (block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString() != "server_tool_use" || block.getProperty ("name", {}).toString() != "web_search")
                continue;

            const auto query = block.getProperty ("input", {}).getProperty ("query", {}).toString().trim();

            if (query.isNotEmpty())
                addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Looking up â") + query.substring (0, 120)
                                                     + juce::String::fromUTF8 ("â"));
        }
    }
}

void StellaAi::showSources (const juce::var& content)
{
    // Every page the reply's words drew on, once: its title and address.
    juce::StringArray urls, lines;

    if (const auto* blocks = content.getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& block : *blocks)
        {
            if (block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString() != "text")
                continue;

            if (const auto* citations = block.getProperty ("citations", {}).getArray())
            {
                for (const auto& citation : *citations)
                {
                    const auto url = citation.getProperty ("url", {}).toString().trim();

                    if (! url.startsWithIgnoreCase ("http") || urls.contains (url) || urls.size() >= 5)
                        continue;

                    urls.add (url);
                    const auto title = citation.getProperty ("title", {}).toString().trim();
                    lines.add ((title.isNotEmpty() ? title.substring (0, 90) + juce::String::fromUTF8 (" â ") : juce::String()) + url);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (! lines.isEmpty())
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, "Sources:\n" + lines.joinIntoString ("\n"));
}

//==============================================================================
void StellaAi::runNextTool()
{
    if (pendingCalls.isEmpty())
    {
        answerDone();
        return;
    }

    const auto call = pendingCalls.removeAndReturn (0);
    const auto name = call.getProperty ("name", {}).toString();
    const auto id = call.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();
    const auto input = call.getProperty ("input", {});

    if (name == "propose_plan" || name == "plan")
    {
        const auto result = name == "plan" ? runPlan (input) : proposePlan (input);
        toolResults.add (makeToolResult (id, result, result.startsWith ("Not ")));
        notify();
        runNextTool();
        return;
    }

    if (name == "start_building")
    {
        // From here on, this request goes to the builder.
        mode = "build";
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Handing over to the builder\xe2\x80\xa6"));
        toolResults.add (makeToolResult (id, "The builder has taken over. Look at the project as you need, then size the request with "
                                             "propose_plan: nothing changes before the user approves it.", false));
        runNextTool();
        return;
    }

    // Nothing in the plugin changes without a plan the user approved.
    static const juce::StringArray changeTools { "set_layout", "edit_layout", "save_preset", "write_file", "delete_file", "set_graph", "build",
                                                 "paint_picture", "make_look" };

    // The design brief is written before the plan: it's what the plan is made from.
    const bool designBrief = name == "write_file" && input.getProperty ("path", {}).toString().trim().equalsIgnoreCase (ProjectTools::designFileName);

    if (changeTools.contains (name) && ! designBrief && ! (planApproved && ! planDone))
    {
        toolResults.add (makeToolResult (id, proposalPending
                                                 ? "Not done: the plan is waiting for the user's approval. Nothing changes until they start it."
                                                 : "Not done: nothing in the plugin changes before the user approves a plan. Size this request "
                                                   "with propose_plan first (read_project, read_file, search_reference, read_skill and analyze_sound are fine before it).",
                                         true));
        runNextTool();
        return;
    }

    // edit_layout names elements by the indexes Sonify AI was shown: after another change to
    // the GUI in the same step they'd point at the wrong elements.
    if (name == "edit_layout" && layoutChangedThisStep)
    {
        toolResults.add (makeToolResult (id, "Not done: the GUI changed just before in this step, so these indexes are out of date. "
                                             "Make this edit in your next step, with the updated \"GUI elements\" list.", true));
        runNextTool();
        return;
    }

    if (const auto line = ProjectTools::describeCall (name, input); line.isNotEmpty())
    {
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, line);
        notify();
    }

    tools.run (name, input, [this, stillAlive = alive, id, name] (const juce::String& result, bool isError)
    {
        if (! *stillAlive)
            return;

        toolResults.add (makeToolResult (id, result, isError));

        if (! isError && (name == "set_layout" || name == "edit_layout"))
            layoutChangedThisStep = true;

        if (name == "build")
            addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, isError ? juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Fixing a few things\xe2\x80\xa6")
                                                     : juce::String ("Ready: playing live"));

        runNextTool();
    });
}

void StellaAi::answerDone()
{
    // Every call answered: the results go back as the next turn (after an answer that ran
    // out of room, with a word to carry on in smaller pieces).
    const bool wasCut = cutThisAnswer;
    cutThisAnswer = false;

    if (wasCut)
        toolResults.add (blockOf ({ { "type", "text" }, { "text", cutNote (true) } }));

    messages.add (makeMessage ("user", toolResults));
    toolResults.clear();
    chargeAnswer();

    // The plan is on show: the user starts it, changes it or cancels it.
    if (proposedThisAnswer)
    {
        messages.add (makeMessage ("assistant", juce::var ("(I've shown the user my plan and its price, and I'm waiting for them "
                                                           "to start it, change it or cancel it.)")));
        finish();
        return;
    }

    if (stopRequested)
    {
        messages.add (makeMessage ("assistant", juce::var ("(The user stopped me here.)")));
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Stopped.");
        finish();
        return;
    }

    // A step well over its estimate pauses: the user decides whether it goes on.
    if (planApproved && ! planDone && ! planFinishing && planCurrent > 0)
    {
        const auto& step = steps[(size_t) planCurrent - 1];

        if (step.used > step.allowance)
        {
            overrunPaused = true;
            messages.add (makeMessage ("assistant", juce::var ("(I paused: this step is taking longer than planned, and the user decides "
                                                               "whether I go on.)")));
            addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Step " + juce::String (planCurrent) + " is taking longer than planned: " + juce::String (step.used)
                                               + " credits so far (estimated " + juce::String (step.low) + juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x80\x93")
                                               + juce::String (step.high) + "). Go on, or pause it below.");
            finish();
            return;
        }
    }

    if (wasCut)
    {
        if (++cutsInARow > maxCutRetries)
        {
            messages.add (makeMessage ("assistant", juce::var ("(I stopped: my answers kept running out of room.)")));
            addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Fanan AI's answers keep running out of room. Ask for less at once, or say \"continue\".");
            finish();
            return;
        }

        addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("That was too much at once: carrying on in smaller pieces\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    }

    if (--roundsLeft <= 0)
    {
        messages.add (makeMessage ("assistant", juce::var ("(I paused here after many steps.)")));
        addEntry (Entry::Kind::notice, "Fanan AI paused after many steps. Say \"continue\" to carry on.");
        finish();
        return;
    }

    notify();
    sendRound();
}

//==============================================================================
StellaAi::Waiting StellaAi::getWaiting() const noexcept
{
    if (busy)
        return Waiting::nothing;

    if (proposalPending)
        return Waiting::approval;

    if (overrunPaused && planApproved && ! planDone && planCurrent > 0)
        return Waiting::overrun;

    return Waiting::nothing;
}

juce::String StellaAi::getWaitingText() const
{
    const auto dash = juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x80\x93");
    const auto dot = juce::String::fromUTF8 (" \xc2\xb7 ");

    switch (getWaiting())
    {
        case Waiting::approval:
        {
            const auto credits = server.getCredits();
            return juce::String ((int) steps.size()) + ((int) steps.size() == 1 ? " step" : " steps") + (later.empty() ? juce::String() : juce::String (" (phase 1)"))
                 + dot + "about " + juce::String (planLow()) + dash + juce::String (planHigh()) + " credits"
                 + (credits >= 0 ? dot + "you have " + juce::String (credits) : juce::String());
        }

        case Waiting::overrun:
        {
            const auto& step = steps[(size_t) planCurrent - 1];
            return "Step " + juce::String (planCurrent) + ": " + juce::String (step.used) + " credits so far, estimated "
                 + juce::String (step.low) + dash + juce::String (step.high);
        }

        case Waiting::nothing:
        default:
            return {};
    }
}

bool StellaAi::isWaitingWarning() const
{
    const auto credits = server.getCredits();
    return getWaiting() == Waiting::approval && credits >= 0 && credits < planHigh();
}

void StellaAi::approvePlan()
{
    if (busy || ! proposalPending || ! canReachServer())
        return;

    proposalPending = false;
    planApproved = true;
    planCurrent = 0;
    showPlan();

    currentRequest = planRequest;
    addEntry (Entry::Kind::user, "Start the plan.");
    beginTurn (makeMessage ("user", "I approve the plan: start it now. Do the steps one at a time, calling plan with current as each one "
                                    "starts and done: true after the last."),
               planRequest, planMode);
}

void StellaAi::cancelPlan()
{
    if (busy || ! proposalPending)
        return;

    proposalPending = false;
    planApproved = false;
    planCancelled = true;
    later.clear();
    showPlan();

    messages.add (makeMessage ("user", "(I cancelled the plan you proposed: don't build it.)"));
    messages.add (makeMessage ("assistant", juce::var ("(Cancelled: nothing was built.)")));
    notify();
}

void StellaAi::continueStep()
{
    if (busy || getWaiting() != Waiting::overrun || ! canReachServer())
        return;

    overrunPaused = false;
    auto& step = steps[(size_t) planCurrent - 1];
    step.allowance = step.used + juce::roundToInt (step.high * overrunFactor);

    currentRequest = planRequest;
    addEntry (Entry::Kind::user, "Go on.");
    beginTurn (makeMessage ("user", "Go on with this step."), planRequest, planMode);
}

void StellaAi::pausePlan()
{
    if (busy || getWaiting() != Waiting::overrun)
        return;

    overrunPaused = false;
    addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, "Paused at step " + juce::String (planCurrent) + ". Say \"continue\" when you want to go on.");
    notify();
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String StellaAi::proposePlan (const juce::var& input)
{
    auto sizeOf = [] (const juce::var& value)
    {
        const auto size = value.toString().trim().toLowerCase();
        return size == "small" || size == "large" ? size : juce::String ("medium");
    };

    auto text = [] (const juce::var& value, int length)
    {
        return value.toString().replaceCharacters ("\r\n", "  ").trim().substring (0, length);
    };

    std::vector<Step> newSteps;

    if (const auto* list = input.getProperty ("steps", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& item : *list)
        {
            Step step;

            if (item.isObject())
            {
                step.title = text (item.getProperty ("title", {}), 80);
                step.builds = text (item.getProperty ("builds", {}), 200);
                step.size = sizeOf (item.getProperty ("size", {}));
            }
            else
            {
                step.title = text (item, 80);
                step.size = "medium";
            }

            if (step.title.isNotEmpty())
                newSteps.push_back (step);
        }
    }

    if (newSteps.empty())
        return "Not done: the plan has no steps. Give its steps, each with title, builds and size.";

    if ((int) newSteps.size() > maxPlanSteps)
        return "Not done: at most " + juce::String (maxPlanSteps) + " steps in one plan. Make this plan the first phase and put the rest in "
               "later, as phases with their number of steps.";

    std::vector<Phase> newLater;

    if (const auto* list = input.getProperty ("later", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& item : *list)
        {
            Phase phase;
            phase.title = text (item.getProperty ("title", {}), 80);
            phase.builds = text (item.getProperty ("builds", {}), 200);
            phase.size = sizeOf (item.getProperty ("size", {}));
            phase.steps = juce::jlimit (1, maxPlanSteps, (int) item.getProperty ("steps", 4));

            if (phase.title.isNotEmpty())
                newLater.push_back (phase);
        }
    }

    if ((int) newLater.size() > maxLaterPhases)
        return "Not done: at most " + juce::String (maxLaterPhases) + " later phases. Make each phase bigger (up to 12 steps).";

    // Priced from what steps of each size really cost so far (the usual builder builds them:
    // the foundation builder only designs a new plugin, before its plan).
    for (auto& step : newSteps)
        priceStep (step, false);

    for (auto& phase : newLater)
    {
        estimate (phase.size, phase.low, phase.high);
        phase.low *= phase.steps;
        phase.high *= phase.steps;
    }

    steps = std::move (newSteps);
    later = std::move (newLater);
    summary = text (input.getProperty ("summary", {}), 400);
    planMode = mode;
    planRequest = currentRequest;
    planCurrent = 0;
    planDone = planCancelled = planFinishing = false;
    proposalPending = true;
    planApproved = false;
    proposedThisAnswer = true;
    userSpokeSinceProposal = false;
    overrunPaused = false;

    entries.push_back ({ Entry::Kind::plan, {} });
    planEntry = entries.size() - 1;
    showPlan();

    return "The user sees your plan and its price. Stop here and write nothing more: they start it, change it or cancel it.";
}

juce::String StellaAi::runPlan (const juce::var& input)
{
    if (steps.empty() || planCancelled)
        return "Not done: there's no plan. Propose one with propose_plan.";

    if (proposalPending)
    {
        // The user answered the plan in words ("yes, go ahead"): starting it is the approval.
        if ((int) input.getProperty ("current", 0) >= 1 && userSpokeSinceProposal && ! proposedThisAnswer)
        {
            proposalPending = false;
            planApproved = true;
            planCurrent = 0;
        }
        else
        {
            return "Not done: the plan is waiting for the user's approval. Stop here: they start it, change it or cancel it.";
        }
    }

    if (! planApproved || planDone)
        return "Not done: there's no approved plan under way. Propose one with propose_plan.";

    const auto numSteps = (int) steps.size();

    if (input.hasProperty ("current"))
    {
        const auto current = juce::jlimit (0, numSteps, (int) input.getProperty ("current", 0));

        if (current != planCurrent && current > 0)
            addEntry (Entry::Kind::activity, "Step " + juce::String (current) + " of " + juce::String (numSteps) + ": " + steps[(size_t) current - 1].title);

        if (current > 0)
            planCurrent = current;
    }

    if ((bool) input.getProperty ("done", false))
        planFinishing = true;   // done when the request finishes, with every credit it cost counted

    showPlan();

    if (planFinishing)
        return "Plan done: all " + juce::String (numSteps) + " steps.";

    return "The user sees the plan" + (planCurrent > 0 ? ", now at step " + juce::String (planCurrent) + " of " + juce::String (numSteps)
                                                        : juce::String (" (" + juce::String (numSteps) + " steps)"))
         + ". Do the steps one at a time, calling plan with current as each starts and done: true after the last.";
}

void StellaAi::chargeAnswer()
{
    const auto used = answerUsed;
    answerUsed = 0;
    turnCredits += used;

    if (planApproved && ! planDone && ! steps.empty())
    {
        if (planCurrent == 0)
            planCurrent = 1;   // working without saying so: it's the first step

        auto& step = steps[(size_t) planCurrent - 1];
        step.used += used;

        if (sentFoundation)
        {
            step.foundationUsed += used;

            if (! step.foundation)
                priceStep (step, true);   // the foundation builder took it on: its rate
        }
    }

    if (proposedThisAnswer)
        sizingCredits = turnCredits;   // reading the project and sizing it, before the plan showed

    if (planFinishing)
        planCurrent = (int) steps.size();   // done once the answer closing the request is counted too (finish)

    recordFinishedSteps();
    showPlan();
}

void StellaAi::recordFinishedSteps()
{
    // Finished steps teach the estimates what steps of their size really cost.
    for (size_t i = 0; i < steps.size(); ++i)
    {
        auto& step = steps[i];
        const bool finished = planDone || (int) i + 1 < planCurrent;

        if (finished && ! step.recorded && step.used > 0)
        {
            step.recorded = true;

            // At the usual builder's rate, so the averages compare like with like.
            if (onStepCost != nullptr)
                onStepCost (step.size, juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt ((double) (step.used - step.foundationUsed)
                                                                        + (double) step.foundationUsed / foundationCost)));
        }
    }
}

void StellaAi::estimate (const juce::String& size, int& low, int& high) const
{
    // A first guess per size until real steps have been measured (credits per step of the
    // builder: one round of thinking and writing a file is about 8, a full module with a fix
    // about 18, a big part with helpers and fixes about 35).
    const double guess = size == "small" ? 8.0 : size == "large" ? 35.0 : 18.0;
    const auto measured = averageStepCost != nullptr ? averageStepCost (size) : 0.0;
    const auto average = measured > 0.0 ? measured : guess;

    low = juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt (average * estimateLow));
    high = juce::jmax (low + 1, juce::roundToInt (average * estimateHigh));
}

void StellaAi::priceStep (Step& step, bool foundation) const
{
    estimate (step.size, step.low, step.high);
    step.foundation = foundation;

    if (foundation)
    {
        step.low = juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt (step.low * foundationCost));
        step.high = juce::jmax (step.low + 1, juce::roundToInt (step.high * foundationCost));
    }

    step.allowance = step.used + juce::roundToInt (step.high * overrunFactor);
}

int StellaAi::planLow() const    { int total = 0; for (const auto& s : steps) total += s.low;  return total; }
int StellaAi::planHigh() const   { int total = 0; for (const auto& s : steps) total += s.high; return total; }
int StellaAi::laterLow() const   { int total = 0; for (const auto& p : later) total += p.low;  return total; }
int StellaAi::laterHigh() const  { int total = 0; for (const auto& p : later) total += p.high; return total; }
int StellaAi::planUsed() const   { int total = 0; for (const auto& s : steps) total += s.used; return total; }

juce::String StellaAi::jobSize() const
{
    const auto high = planHigh() + laterHigh();
    return high <= 30 ? "Small" : high <= 100 ? "Medium" : high <= 300 ? "Large" : "Huge";
}

juce::String StellaAi::planText() const
{
    // One line each; the first character tells the panel how to show it: "#" the title,
    // "~" what it builds, a mark for each step, "+" a later phase, "=" a note, "!" a warning.
    const auto dash = juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x80\x93");
    const auto dot = juce::String::fromUTF8 (" \xc2\xb7 ");
    const auto range = [&dash] (int low, int high) { return juce::String (low) + dash + juce::String (high); };
    const auto numSteps = (int) steps.size();
    const auto stepWord = juce::String (numSteps == 1 ? " step" : " steps");

    juce::StringArray lines;

    if (planCancelled)
        lines.add ("# Plan cancelled" + dot + "nothing was built");
    else if (planDone)
        lines.add ("# Plan done" + dot + juce::String (numSteps) + stepWord + dot + juce::String (planUsed()) + " credits (estimated "
                   + range (planLow(), planHigh()) + ")");
    else if (planApproved && planCurrent > 0)
        lines.add ("# Plan" + dot + "step " + juce::String (planCurrent) + " of " + juce::String (numSteps) + dot + juce::String (planUsed())
                   + " credits so far (estimated " + range (planLow(), planHigh()) + ")");
    else if (planApproved)
        lines.add ("# Plan" + dot + "starting" + dot + "estimated " + range (planLow(), planHigh()) + " credits");
    else
        lines.add ("# Plan" + dot + jobSize() + " job" + (later.empty() ? juce::String() : dot + "phase 1 of " + juce::String ((int) later.size() + 1)));

    if (summary.isNotEmpty())
        lines.add ("~ " + summary);

    for (int i = 0; i < numSteps; ++i)
    {
        const auto& step = steps[(size_t) i];
        const auto number = i + 1;
        const bool done = planDone || (planApproved && number < planCurrent);
        const bool now = ! done && planApproved && number == planCurrent;

        const auto mark = done ? juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x9c\x93 ")   // ✓
                        : now  ? juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x96\xb8 ")   // ▸
                               : juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x97\x8b ");  // ○

        const auto cost = done ? juce::String (step.used) + " credits"
                        : now  ? juce::String (step.used) + " so far (" + range (step.low, step.high) + ")"
                               : range (step.low, step.high) + " credits";

        lines.add (mark + juce::String (number) + ". " + step.title
                   + (step.builds.isNotEmpty() ? juce::String::fromUTF8 (" \xe2\x80\x94 ") + step.builds : juce::String())
                   + dot + cost);
    }

    const auto later0 = later.empty() ? nullptr : &later.front();

    if (proposalPending)
    {
        lines.add ("= This plan: about " + range (planLow(), planHigh()) + " credits");

        for (const auto& phase : later)
            lines.add ("+ Later: " + phase.title + (phase.builds.isNotEmpty() ? juce::String::fromUTF8 (" \xe2\x80\x94 ") + phase.builds : juce::String())
                       + dot + juce::String (phase.steps) + (phase.steps == 1 ? " step" : " steps") + dot + range (phase.low, phase.high) + " credits");

        if (! later.empty())
            lines.add ("= The whole job, all phases: about " + range (planLow() + laterLow(), planHigh() + laterHigh()) + " credits");

        const auto credits = server.getCredits();
        lines.add ("= Planning it used " + juce::String (sizingCredits) + (sizingCredits == 1 ? " credit" : " credits")
                   + (credits >= 0 ? dot + "you have " + juce::String (credits) : juce::String()));

        if (credits >= 0 && credits < planHigh())
            lines.add ("! That may not be enough for all of this plan: buy credits first, or it may stop partway (it carries on after).");
    }
    else if (planDone && later0 != nullptr)
    {
        lines.add ("= Next: " + later0->title + dot + "say \"next phase\" to plan it");
    }

    return lines.joinIntoString ("\n");
}

juce::String StellaAi::modeContext() const
{
    // A conversation can design the panel but can't write code: a GUI element the toolbox
    // lacks (a drop-down list, say) is the builder's to program, never a toolbox stand-in.
    if (mode == "build")
        return "\nYou're the builder. Size every request with propose_plan before changing anything. A drop-down list (droplist, "
               "combo box) is the toolbox's \"dropdown\". When the request needs a GUI element the toolbox doesn't have and the "
               "project hasn't programmed (a menu, tabs, a step sequencer, a rotary switch...), program it in elements/<Name>.cpp, "
               "build, then put it on the panel. Never make do with a selector or another toolbox type instead, and never tell the "
               "user it can't be done.\n";

    return "\nYou're in a conversation: you can't write code or build. When the request needs code (a new sound, a change to one, "
           "a GUI element the toolbox doesn't have and the project hasn't programmed: a menu, tabs, a step sequencer, a rotary "
           "switch...), call start_building straight away: the builder sizes it, programs it and puts it on the panel. A change "
           "only to the panel (toolbox types, a drop-down list being the toolbox's \"dropdown\", and the programmed elements listed "
           "above) or to presets: size it with propose_plan first, then do it once the user starts it. Never make do with a "
           "selector or another toolbox type instead of a missing element, and never tell the user something can't be done.\n";
}

juce::String StellaAi::lookContext() const
{
    if (pickedLook.isEmpty())
        return {};

    return "\nThe user picked the look \"" + pickedLook + "\" from your inspiration pool (the Look box beside Send): design the panel in it, "
           "and change it in it (the inspiration-looks skill has its recipe; read it before designing). Say so in one line when you "
           "present a design.\n";
}

juce::String StellaAi::planContext() const
{
    juce::String text;

    if (! steps.empty() && ! planDone && ! planCancelled)
    {
        if (proposalPending)
            text << "\nYour plan for the request \"" << planRequest.substring (0, 200) << "\" is on show with its price, waiting for the user:\n";
        else
            text << "\nYour approved plan for the request \"" << planRequest.substring (0, 200) << "\" (the user sees it as a checklist with "
                    "the credits each step used):\n";

        for (size_t i = 0; i < steps.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto number = (int) i + 1;
            text << number << ". " << steps[i].title << " (" << steps[i].size << "): " << steps[i].builds
                 << (! proposalPending && number < planCurrent ? " (done)" : ! proposalPending && number == planCurrent ? " (under way)" : "") << "\n";
        }

        if (proposalPending)
            text << "Nothing changes until the user starts it. If their message approves it (yes, go ahead, start), call plan with current 1 "
                    "and begin. If they want it changed, propose the changed plan with propose_plan. If they ask something else, answer "
                    "it: the plan keeps waiting.\n";
        else
            text << "Carry on from the step under way (or the first one not done), one step at a time, calling plan with current as each "
                    "starts and done: true after the last, unless the user now asks for something else: then propose a new plan.\n";
    }

    if (! later.empty() && ! planCancelled)
    {
        text << "Phases still to come after this plan, as you proposed them:\n";

        for (size_t i = 0; i < later.size(); ++i)
            text << (int) i + 1 << ". " << later[i].title << ": " << later[i].builds << " (" << later[i].steps << " steps, mostly "
                 << later[i].size << ")\n";

        text << "When the user asks for the next phase, propose it with propose_plan: its steps, and the phases left after it in later.\n";
    }

    return text;
}

void StellaAi::showPlan()
{
    if (planEntry < entries.size() && entries[planEntry].kind == Entry::Kind::plan)
        entries[planEntry].text = planText();
}

void StellaAi::clearPlan()
{
    // The phases still to come stay: "next phase" plans the next one.
    steps.clear();
    planCurrent = 0;
    planDone = planCancelled = planFinishing = false;
    proposalPending = planApproved = proposedThisAnswer = userSpokeSinceProposal = overrunPaused = false;
    planRequest.clear();
    summary.clear();
    sizingCredits = 0;
    planEntry = noEntry;   // its card stays as it last was
}

juce::String StellaAi::cutNote (bool afterCalls)
{
    return juce::String ("(Your last answer ran out of room and was cut off")
         + (afterCalls ? ": the calls above ran, anything after them wasn't done." : ", so nothing in it was done.")
         + " Carry on with what's left in smaller pieces: one file, or at most three presets, per answer.)";
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Array<juce::var> StellaAi::compacted() const
{
    // A tool call must be followed by its result, or the AI service refuses the whole
    // request: a call left without one (an answer cut off, say) goes out as words only.
    juce::Array<juce::var> list (messages);

    for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& message = list.getReference (i);
        const auto* blocks = message.getProperty ("content", {}).getArray();

        if (message.getProperty ("role", {}).toString() != "assistant" || blocks == nullptr)
            continue;

        juce::StringArray answered;

        if (i + 1 < list.size())
            if (const auto* next = list.getReference (i + 1).getProperty ("content", {}).getArray())
                for (const auto& block : *next)
                    if (block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString() == "tool_result")
                        answered.add (block.getProperty ("tool_use_id", {}).toString());

        // A web search goes with its results. One without them is kept only beside calls that
        // were answered (the service runs it with the next request); otherwise (an answer cut
        // off half-way) it goes too.
        juce::StringArray searched;

        for (const auto& block : *blocks)
            if (block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString() == "web_search_tool_result")
                searched.add (block.getProperty ("tool_use_id", {}).toString());

        juce::Array<juce::var> keptBlocks;
        bool dropped = false;

        for (const auto& block : *blocks)
        {
            const auto type = block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString();
            const auto id = block.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();

            if (type == "tool_use" && ! answered.contains (id))
                dropped = true;
            else if (type == "server_tool_use" && ! searched.contains (id) && answered.isEmpty() && i + 1 < list.size())
                dropped = true;
            else
                keptBlocks.add (block);
        }

        if (dropped)
            list.set (i, makeMessage ("assistant", keptBlocks.isEmpty() ? juce::var ("(cut off)") : juce::var (keptBlocks)));
    }

    // Old steps are sent short: a file written earlier is in the project now (the AI can
    // read it again), and long old tool results are cut. That keeps every request small.
    // A skill read in this request stays whole until the request ends: its recipes are what
    // the following steps are built from.
    juce::StringArray skillCalls;

    for (int i = turnStart; i < list.size(); ++i)
        if (const auto* blocks = list.getReference (i).getProperty ("content", {}).getArray())
            for (const auto& block : *blocks)
                if (block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString() == "tool_use" && block.getProperty ("name", {}).toString() == "read_skill")
                    skillCalls.add (block.getProperty ("id", {}).toString());

    int lastAssistant = -1, lastUser = -1;

    for (int i = list.size(); --i >= 0;)
    {
        const auto role = list.getReference (i).getProperty ("role", {}).toString();

        if (role == "assistant" && lastAssistant < 0) lastAssistant = i;
        if (role == "user" && lastUser < 0)           lastUser = i;
    }

    juce::Array<juce::var> result;

    for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& message = list.getReference (i);
        const auto content = message.getProperty ("content", {});

        // The request being worked on keeps its attachments whole for every step.
        if (! content.isArray() || i == lastAssistant || i == lastUser || (i >= turnStart && isPlainUserMessage (message)))
        {
            result.add (message);
            continue;
        }

        // Earlier requests: their tool steps are told as plain text, so the request being
        // sent only carries tool blocks of its own (whatever tools this request offers).
        if (i < turnStart)
        {
            juce::StringArray lines;

            for (const auto& block : *content.getArray())
            {
                const auto type = block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString();

                if (type == "text")
                {
                    const auto text = block.getProperty ("text", {}).toString();
                    lines.add (text.length() > 1500 ? text.substring (0, 1500) + "\n[... cut]" : text);
                }
                else if (type == "tool_use")
                {
                    const auto input = block.getProperty ("input", {});
                    const auto path = input.getProperty ("path", input.getProperty ("name", {})).toString();
                    lines.add ("(Earlier step: " + block.getProperty ("name", {}).toString() + (path.isNotEmpty() ? " " + path : juce::String()) + ")");
                }
                else if (type == "server_tool_use")
                {
                    // A search's results aren't sent again: what was learned is in the words after it.
                    const auto query = block.getProperty ("input", {}).getProperty ("query", {}).toString();
                    lines.add ("(Earlier step: looked up \"" + query + "\" on the web)");
                }
                else if (type == "tool_result")
                {
                    const auto text = block.getProperty ("content", {}).toString();
                    lines.add ("(Result: " + (text.length() > 300 ? text.substring (0, 300) + juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x80\xa6") : text) + ")");
                }
                else if (type == "image" || type == "document")
                {
                    lines.add (type == "image" ? "[an image the user attached earlier]" : "[a PDF the user attached earlier]");
                }
            }

            result.add (makeMessage (message.getProperty ("role", {}).toString(), lines.joinIntoString ("\n")));
            continue;
        }

        juce::Array<juce::var> blocks;

        for (const auto& block : *content.getArray())
        {
            auto copy = block.clone();
            const auto type = copy.getProperty ("type", {}).toString();

            if (type == "tool_use" && copy.getProperty ("name", {}).toString() == "write_file")
            {
                auto input = copy.getProperty ("input", {}).clone();
                const auto lines = juce::StringArray::fromLines (input.getProperty ("content", {}).toString()).size();

                if (auto* object = input.getDynamicObject())
                    object->setProperty ("content", "[" + juce::String (lines) + " lines, saved in the project]");

                copy.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("input", input);
            }
            else if (type == "tool_result")
            {
                const auto text = copy.getProperty ("content", {}).toString();

                if (text.length() > 1500 && ! skillCalls.contains (copy.getProperty ("tool_use_id", {}).toString()))
                    copy.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("content", text.substring (0, 1500)
                                                                         + "\n[... cut to keep requests small: read it again to see all of it]");
            }
            else if (type == "image" || type == "document")
            {
                // Shown once already: later requests carry a note instead of the file again.
                copy = blockOf ({ { "type", "text" }, { "text", type == "image" ? "[an image the user attached earlier]"
                                                                                 : "[a PDF the user attached earlier]" } });
            }
            else if (type == "text" && copy.getProperty ("text", {}).toString().startsWith ("Attached file "))
            {
                const auto text = copy.getProperty ("text", {}).toString();

                if (text.length() > 1500)
                    copy.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("text", text.substring (0, 1500) + "\n[... the rest was shown earlier]");
            }

            blocks.add (copy);
        }

        result.add (makeMessage (message.getProperty ("role", {}).toString(), blocks));
    }

    return result;
}

void StellaAi::trimHistory()
{
    if (messages.size() <= maxHistory)
        return;

    // Cut only before one of the user's own messages, never between a tool call and its result.
    for (int i = messages.size() - maxHistory; i < messages.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (isPlainUserMessage (messages.getReference (i)))
        {
            messages.removeRange (0, i);
            return;
        }
    }
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\StellaAi.h

#pragma once

#include "FananServer.h"
#include "ProjectTools.h"

#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Sonify AI at work: the conversation, and the loop that lets it build.

    Each request goes to Fanan's server with the studio's tools. When the answer asks for
    tools, the studio runs them (writing files, wiring, building) and sends the results
    back, round after round, until Sonify AI is done, the user presses Stop, or a step
    limit is reached. A conversation turns into building with start_building: from then
    on, for that request, the server uses its builder (a strong model).

    A new plugin's design goes to the foundation builder, the strongest model: while the
    plugin has never built, has no design brief and no plan under way, it reads up, imagines
    the plugin and writes it down in design.md (ProjectTools::designFileName), which the usual
    builder then plans and builds from, and every later request reads (conversations aren't
    kept). If the foundation builder fails or declines, the usual builder takes the same round
    over and carries on. Credits it spent count at the usual builder's rate in the step
    averages (foundationCost).

    Nothing in the plugin changes without a plan the user has approved. Sonify AI first
    sizes the request (propose_plan): the steps, what each one builds and how big it is,
    and, for a very big request, the phases that come after this one. The studio prices
    each step in credits from what steps of that size really cost so far, and shows the
    plan with Start, Change and Cancel. Once started, the plan is a checklist that ticks
    along with the credits each step used; a step that runs well over its estimate pauses
    and asks before going on.

    A request that fails costs nothing and leaves the conversation as it was, with a note
    saying what happened. The persona and rules about the AI service live on the server.
*/
class StellaAi final
{
public:
    struct Entry
    {
        enum class Kind { user, ai, notice, activity, plan };   // plan: the plan's card (see planText)

        Kind kind = Kind::notice;
        juce::String text;
    };

    /** What the plan waits for from the user, if anything. */
    enum class Waiting { nothing, approval, overrun };

    StellaAi (FananServer& server, ProjectTools& tools);
    ~StellaAi();

    /** Sends a request, with files for Sonify AI to look at: images (shown to it), PDFs and
        other text (read by it), up to maxAttachments. The user's own code (code files, a zip, a
        folder) isn't sent: it's kept in the project's reference/ folder (ProjectTools), and
        Fanan AI is told what's there and reads what it needs. The conversation shows shownText
        when it's given (the request without the context added for Sonify AI). */
    void send (const juce::String& text, const juce::Array<juce::File>& files = {}, const juce::String& shownText = {});

    static bool canAttach (const juce::File& file);
    static juce::String attachableFiles();   // for a file chooser: "*.png;*.jpg;..."
    static constexpr int maxAttachments = 5;      // pictures, PDFs and text sent with a request
    static constexpr int maxFilesAtOnce = 20;     // everything attached to one request, code included

    /** Stops after the step that's running (a build in progress finishes first). */
    void stop();
    void clear();

    /** The look the user picked beside Send from the inspiration pool (empty: Auto, Fanan AI
        chooses): every request says so, so the panel is designed and changed in it. */
    void setPickedLook (const juce::String& name)            { pickedLook = name.trim(); }
    const juce::String& getPickedLook() const noexcept       { return pickedLook; }

    bool isBusy() const noexcept                            { return busy; }
    const std::vector<Entry>& getEntries() const noexcept   { return entries; }

    //==============================================================================
    // The plan's approval, and a step that ran over its estimate.
    Waiting getWaiting() const noexcept;
    juce::String getWaitingText() const;   // the line beside the buttons
    bool isWaitingWarning() const;         // the credits may not last

    void approvePlan();    // Start
    void cancelPlan();     // Cancel: nothing is built
    void continueStep();   // the step over its estimate goes on
    void pausePlan();      // ...or waits until the user says "continue"

    /** What a step of a size ("small", "medium", "large") really cost on average so far
        (0: no record yet), and a finished step's cost, so the estimates learn. */
    std::function<double (const juce::String& size)> averageStepCost;
    std::function<void (const juce::String& size, int credits)> onStepCost;

    /** Called on the message thread whenever the conversation changes. */
    std::function<void()> onChanged;

    /** A request starts, and ends (done, stopped or failed): undo snapshots go around it. */
    std::function<void (const juce::String& request)> onTurnStarted, onTurnFinished;

    static constexpr int maxRounds = 40;      // steps for one request
    static constexpr int maxPlanSteps = 12;   // steps in one plan: a bigger request goes in phases
    static constexpr int maxLaterPhases = 8;
    static constexpr int maxHistory = 80;     // messages kept in the conversation
    static constexpr int maxCutRetries = 2;   // answers in a row that may run out of room before it stops
    static constexpr int maxRetries = 1;      // a round the server failed is tried again this often
    static constexpr int retryDelayMs = 3000;

    /** A step's estimate, and how far over it the step may run before it pauses. */
    static constexpr double estimateLow = 0.7, estimateHigh = 1.4, overrunFactor = 1.5;

    /** What the foundation builder costs, against the usual builder (the server's price weights). */
    static constexpr double foundationCost = 2.5;

private:
    struct Step
    {
        juce::String title, builds, size;   // size: "small", "medium" or "large"
        int low = 0, high = 0;              // the estimate, in credits
        int used = 0;                       // credits spent on it so far
        int allowance = 0;                  // past this, it pauses and asks
        bool recorded = false;              // its cost went into the averages
        bool foundation = false;            // priced for the foundation builder
        int foundationUsed = 0;             // the credits of it the foundation builder spent
    };

    struct Phase
    {
        juce::String title, builds, size;
        int steps = 0, low = 0, high = 0;
    };

    bool canReachServer();   // false, with a note saying why, when nothing can be sent
    void beginTurn (const juce::var& message, const juce::String& shown, const juce::String& startMode);
    void sendRound();
    void onAnswer (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer);
    bool usesFoundation() const;   // this round goes to the foundation builder
    static bool foundationFailed (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer);   // ...and it failed or declined
    static bool worthRetrying (const juce::var& answer);   // the server failed the round for a reason of its own
    void runNextTool();
    void answerDone();   // every tool call of the answer has its result
    static juce::String cutNote (bool afterCalls);   // to carry on in smaller pieces after an answer ran out of room
    void showSearches (const juce::var& content);     // what the answer looked up on the web
    void showSources (const juce::var& content);      // the pages its words drew on
    void finish();
    juce::Array<juce::var> compacted() const;
    static juce::Result attach (const juce::File& file, juce::Array<juce::var>& blocks);
    void trimHistory();
    void addEntry (Entry::Kind kind, const juce::String& text);
    void notify();

    // The plan.
    juce::String proposePlan (const juce::var& input);
    juce::String runPlan (const juce::var& input);
    void chargeAnswer();                         // the answer's credits go to the step it worked on
    void recordFinishedSteps();
    void estimate (const juce::String& size, int& low, int& high) const;
    void priceStep (Step& step, bool foundation) const;   // its estimate and allowance
    int planLow() const;
    int planHigh() const;
    int laterLow() const;
    int laterHigh() const;
    int planUsed() const;
    juce::String jobSize() const;
    bool isRunning() const noexcept;             // approved, started, not finished
    juce::String planText() const;               // the card's lines (see ChatPanel)
    juce::String planContext() const;            // for the project's description
    juce::String modeContext() const;            // what this mode may do, so a conversation hands code over to the builder
    juce::String lookContext() const;            // the look the user picked, for the project's description
    void showPlan();
    void clearPlan();

    FananServer& server;
    ProjectTools& tools;

    std::vector<Entry> entries;          // what the panel shows
    juce::Array<juce::var> messages;     // the conversation as the AI sees it
    juce::String mode { "chat" };        // "chat" or "build"
    juce::String pickedLook;             // the inspiration pool's look the user picked (empty: Auto)
    bool sentFoundation = false;         // the round being answered went to the foundation builder
    bool foundationOff = false;          // it failed this request: the usual builder carries on
    int retriesInARow = 0;               // rounds tried again after the server failed them
    int roundsLeft = 0, turnStart = 0;
    bool busy = false, stopRequested = false;
    bool layoutChangedThisStep = false;   // set_layout or edit_layout ran among this answer's calls
    juce::String lastStop;                // how the last answer ended: "tools", "done", "cut"...
    int answerUsed = 0;                   // the credits the answer being handled cost
    bool cutThisAnswer = false;           // the answer being handled ran out of room
    int cutsInARow = 0;                   // answers in a row that did
    int turnCredits = 0;                  // the credits this request has cost so far

    juce::Array<juce::var> pendingCalls, toolResults;   // the current answer's tool calls
    juce::String currentRequest;

    std::vector<Step> steps;
    std::vector<Phase> later;            // phases after this plan (a very big request)
    juce::String summary;                // what the plan builds, in a sentence or two
    juce::String planMode { "build" };   // where it was proposed, and where it runs
    juce::String planRequest;            // the request it was made for
    int planCurrent = 0;                 // 1-based: the step under way (0: not started)
    bool planDone = false, planCancelled = false;
    bool planFinishing = false;          // done: true came: the plan is done when this request finishes
    bool proposalPending = false;        // shown, waiting for Start, Change or Cancel
    bool planApproved = false;
    bool proposedThisAnswer = false;
    bool userSpokeSinceProposal = false;  // a typed "yes, go ahead" may start it
    bool overrunPaused = false;
    int sizingCredits = 0;               // spent before the plan was shown (reading, sizing)
    static constexpr size_t noEntry = ~(size_t) 0;
    size_t planEntry = noEntry;          // its card in entries

    std::shared_ptr<bool> alive = std::make_shared<bool> (true);

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (StellaAi)
};

//==============================================================================
void StellaLookAndFeel::drawButtonBackground (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Button& button, const juce::Colour& backgroundColour,
                                              bool isMouseOverButton, bool isButtonDown)
{
    auto bounds = button.getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (0.5f);
    auto fill = backgroundColour;

    if (! button.isEnabled())
        fill = fill.withMultipliedAlpha (0.45f);
    else if (isButtonDown)
        fill = fill.darker (0.25f);
    else if (isMouseOverButton)
        fill = fill.brighter (0.12f);

    // Buttons joined to a neighbour (the Design / Play pair) are square on that side.
    const bool flatLeft   = button.isConnectedOnLeft();
    const bool flatRight  = button.isConnectedOnRight();
    const bool flatTop    = button.isConnectedOnTop();
    const bool flatBottom = button.isConnectedOnBottom();

    juce::Path shape;
    shape.addRoundedRectangle (bounds.getX(), bounds.getY(), bounds.getWidth(), bounds.getHeight(), 5.0f, 5.0f,
                               ! (flatLeft || flatTop), ! (flatRight || flatTop),
                               ! (flatLeft || flatBottom), ! (flatRight || flatBottom));

    g.setColour (fill);
    g.fillPath (shape);

    if (! button.getToggleState())
    {
        g.setColour (Theme::outline);
        g.strokePath (shape, juce::PathStrokeType (1.0f));
    }
}

juce::Font StellaLookAndFeel::getTextButtonFont (juce::TextButton&, int buttonHeight)
{
    return Theme::font (juce::jmin (15.0f, (float) buttonHeight * 0.5f));
}

//==============================================================================
void StellaLookAndFeel::drawTabButton (juce::TabBarButton& button, juce::Graphics& g, bool isMouseOver, bool)
{
    const auto area = button.getActiveArea().toFloat();
    const bool front = button.isFrontTab();

    if (front)
    {
        g.setColour (Theme::panel);
        g.fillRect (area);

        // The selected tab carries the accent as an underline.
        g.setColour (Theme::accent);
        g.fillRect (area.withTop (area.getBottom() - 2.0f));
    }
    else if (isMouseOver)
    {
        g.setColour (Theme::raised.withAlpha (0.6f));
        g.fillRect (area);
    }

    g.setColour (front ? Theme::text : (isMouseOver ? Theme::text.withAlpha (0.85f) : Theme::muted));
    g.setFont (Theme::font (14.0f, front));
    g.drawText (button.getButtonText(), area.toNearestInt(), juce::Justification::centred, false);
}

int StellaLookAndFeel::getTabButtonBestWidth (juce::TabBarButton& button, int tabDepth)
{
    juce::GlyphArrangement glyphs;
    glyphs.addLineOfText (Theme::font (14.0f, true), button.getButtonText(), 0.0f, 0.0f);
    return juce::jmax (tabDepth * 2, (int) std::ceil (glyphs.getBoundingBox (0, glyphs.getNumGlyphs(), true).getWidth()) + 36);
}

void StellaLookAndFeel::drawTabAreaBehindFrontButton (juce::TabbedButtonBar&, juce::Graphics& g, int w, int h)
{
    // This layer sits in front of the other tabs (only the front tab is above it),
    // so it must stay transparent apart from the baseline.
    g.setColour (Theme::outline);
    g.fillRect (0, h - 1, w, 1);
}

//==============================================================================
void StellaLookAndFeel::fillTextEditorBackground (juce::Graphics& g, int width, int height, juce::TextEditor& editor)
{
    g.setColour (editor.findColour (juce::TextEditor::backgroundColourId));
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (juce::Rectangle<int> (width, height).toFloat(), 5.0f);
}

void StellaLookAndFeel::drawTextEditorOutline (juce::Graphics& g, int width, int height, juce::TextEditor& editor)
{
    if (! editor.isEnabled())
        return;

    const bool focused = editor.hasKeyboardFocus (true) && ! editor.isReadOnly();
    g.setColour (editor.findColour (focused ? juce::TextEditor::focusedOutlineColourId : juce::TextEditor::outlineColourId));
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (juce::Rectangle<int> (width, height).toFloat().reduced (0.5f), 5.0f, focused ? 1.5f : 1.0f);
}

//==============================================================================
void StellaLookAndFeel::drawStretchableLayoutResizerBar (juce::Graphics& g, int w, int h, bool isVerticalBar,
                                                         bool isMouseOver, bool isMouseDragging)
{
    g.setColour (Theme::window);
    g.fillRect (0, 0, w, h);

    g.setColour (isMouseDragging ? Theme::accent : (isMouseOver ? Theme::muted : Theme::outline));

    if (isVerticalBar)
        g.fillRect (w / 2, 0, 1, h);
    else
        g.fillRect (0, h / 2, w, 1);
}
