// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\StoreClient.cpp

#include "StoreClient.h"
#include "CreatorPlugin.h"
#include "DeviceFiles.h"
#include "DeviceStudio.h"
#include "Settings.h"

#include <juce_cryptography/juce_cryptography.h>

#include <algorithm>

namespace
{
    constexpr int pictureTimeoutMs = 20000, packageTimeoutMs = 120000;
    constexpr juce::int64 maxPackage = 64 * 1024 * 1024, maxPicture = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
    constexpr juce::int64 maxUnpacked = 256 * 1024 * 1024;
    constexpr int maxEntries = 2000;

    juce::var object()
    {
        return juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    }

    juce::var fields (std::initializer_list<std::pair<const char*, juce::var>> items)
    {
        auto o = object();

        for (const auto& [name, value] : items)
            o.getDynamicObject()->setProperty (name, value);

        return o;
    }

    juce::String deviceIdFor (const juce::String& product)
    {
        return "store-" + product;
    }

    /** A file from the store's files (public): its bytes, at most limit, or empty. */
    juce::MemoryBlock fetch (const juce::String& address, juce::int64 limit, int timeoutMs)
    {
        juce::MemoryBlock data;
        int status = 0;
        auto stream = juce::URL (address).createInputStream (juce::URL::InputStreamOptions (juce::URL::ParameterHandling::inAddress)
                                                                 .withConnectionTimeoutMs (timeoutMs)
                                                                 .withStatusCode (&status));

        if (stream == nullptr || status < 200 || status >= 300)
            return {};

        const auto length = stream->getTotalLength();

        if (length > limit)
            return {};

        juce::MemoryOutputStream out (data, false);
        char buffer[65536];

        while (! stream->isExhausted())
        {
            const auto got = stream->read (buffer, (int) sizeof (buffer));

            if (got <= 0)
                break;

            out.write (buffer, (size_t) got);

            if ((juce::int64) out.getDataSize() > limit)
                return {};
        }

        out.flush();
        return data;
    }

    /** A zip entry's path that stays inside the folder it's unpacked into. */
    bool isSafePath (const juce::String& path)
    {
        return path.isNotEmpty() && ! path.startsWithChar ('/') && ! path.startsWithChar ('\\') && ! path.containsChar (':')
            && ! path.contains ("..") && path.length() < 400;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
const juce::StringArray& StoreClient::sectionsFor (const juce::String& kind)
{
    static const juce::StringArray instruments { "Synths", "Keys & Pianos", "Pads & Atmospheres", "Bass", "Drums & Percussion",
                                                 "Leads & Plucks", "Orchestral & Acoustic", "Experimental" };
    static const juce::StringArray effects { "Reverb & Space", "Delay & Echo", "Distortion & Saturation", "Dynamics", "EQ & Filters",
                                             "Modulation", "Pitch & Vocal", "Creative FX", "Mixing Utilities" };
    static const juce::StringArray midiFx { "Arpeggiators", "Chords & Harmony", "Rhythm & Patterns", "Generators", "MIDI Utilities" };
    static const juce::StringArray widgets { "Visualizers & Meters", "Tools", "Games & Fun" };
    static const juce::StringArray none;

    if (kind == "instrument")  return instruments;
    if (kind == "effect")      return effects;
    if (kind == "midifx")      return midiFx;
    if (kind == "widget")      return widgets;
    return none;
}

juce::String StoreClient::youtubeId (const juce::String& link)
{
    const auto isId = [] (const juce::String& text)
    {
        return text.length() == 11 && text.containsOnly ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_");
    };

    const auto text = link.trim();

    if (isId (text))
        return text;

    const juce::URL url (text.startsWithIgnoreCase ("http") ? text : "https://" + text);
    const auto host = url.getDomain().toLowerCase();
    const auto path = url.getSubPath();
    juce::String id;

    if (host == "youtu.be" || host == "www.youtu.be")
        id = path.upToFirstOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false);
    else if (host.endsWith ("youtube.com") || host.endsWith ("youtube-nocookie.com"))
    {
        if (path == "watch")
        {
            const auto names = url.getParameterNames();
            const auto index = names.indexOf ("v");
            id = index >= 0 ? url.getParameterValues()[index] : juce::String();
        }
        else
        {
            for (const auto* prefix : { "shorts/", "embed/", "live/", "v/" })
                if (path.startsWith (prefix))
                    id = path.fromFirstOccurrenceOf (prefix, false, false).upToFirstOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false);
        }
    }

    id = id.upToFirstOccurrenceOf ("?", false, false).upToFirstOccurrenceOf ("&", false, false);
    return isId (id) ? id : juce::String();
}

juce::String StoreClient::kindOfSection (const juce::String& section)
{
    for (const auto* kind : { "instrument", "effect", "midifx", "widget" })
        if (sectionsFor (kind).contains (section))
            return kind;

    return {};
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String StoreClient::Item::kindName() const
{
    if (kind == "effect")  return "Effect";
    if (kind == "widget")  return "Widget";
    if (kind == "midifx")  return "MIDI FX";
    return "Instrument";
}

juce::String StoreClient::Item::priceText() const
{
    return toProduct().priceText();
}

Licences::Product StoreClient::Item::toProduct() const
{
    Licences::Product p;
    p.id = product;
    p.title = title;
    p.price = price;
    p.currency = currency;
    return p;
}

StoreClient::Item StoreClient::Item::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    Item item;

    if (! value.isObject())
        return item;

    item.product = value.getProperty ("product", {}).toString().trim();
    item.kind = value.getProperty ("kind", "instrument").toString();
    item.title = value.getProperty ("title", {}).toString();
    item.tagline = value.getProperty ("tagline", {}).toString();
    item.story = value.getProperty ("story", {}).toString();
    item.vendor = value.getProperty ("vendor", {}).toString();
    item.section = value.getProperty ("section", {}).toString();
    item.currency = value.getProperty ("currency", "USD").toString();
    item.pictureUrl = value.getProperty ("picture", {}).toString();
    item.logoUrl = value.getProperty ("logo", {}).toString();
    item.video = youtubeId (value.getProperty ("video", {}).toString()).isNotEmpty() ? value.getProperty ("video", {}).toString() : juce::String();
    item.price = juce::jmax (0.0, (double) value.getProperty ("price", 0.0));
    item.version = (int) value.getProperty ("version", 0);
    item.downloads = (int) value.getProperty ("downloads", 0);
    item.size = (juce::int64) value.getProperty ("size", 0);
    item.published = (juce::int64) value.getProperty ("published", 0);
    item.isProtected = (bool) value.getProperty ("protected", false);
    item.owned = (bool) value.getProperty ("owned", false);
    item.status = value.getProperty ("status", {}).toString();
    item.paypalProblem = value.getProperty ("paypalProblem", {}).toString();

    if (const auto* list = value.getProperty ("features", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& feature : *list)
            if (feature.toString().trim().isNotEmpty())
                item.features.add (feature.toString().trim());

    // The store's id: what licences and folders are named after (letters, digits, '-', '_', '.').
    if (item.product.length() > 80 || ! item.product.containsOnly ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_."))
        item.product.clear();

    return item;
}

//==============================================================================
StoreClient::StoreClient (FananServer& fananServer)
    : server (fananServer)
{
}

StoreClient::~StoreClient()
{
    stopTimer();
    alive->store (false);
    workers.removeAllJobs (true, 30000);
}

void StoreClient::call (const juce::String& action, juce::var body, FananServer::Done done)
{
    server.store (action, body, [stillAlive = alive, done] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        if (stillAlive->load() && done != nullptr)
            done (result, answer);
    });
}

//==============================================================================
void StoreClient::list (const juce::String& kind, const juce::String& section, const juce::String& query, int page, Listed done)
{
    call ("list", fields ({ { "kind", kind }, { "section", section }, { "query", query.trim() }, { "page", juce::jmax (1, page) } }),
          [done] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        Page found;

        if (result.wasOk())
        {
            if (const auto* list = answer.getProperty ("products", {}).getArray())
                for (const auto& value : *list)
                    if (auto item = Item::fromVar (value); item.isValid())
                        found.items.push_back (std::move (item));

            found.page = juce::jmax (1, (int) answer.getProperty ("page", 1));
            found.pages = juce::jmax (1, (int) answer.getProperty ("pages", 1));
            found.total = juce::jmax (0, (int) answer.getProperty ("total", 0));
        }

        if (done != nullptr)
            done (result, found);
    });
}

void StoreClient::mine (Listed done)
{
    call ("mine", object(), [done] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        Page found;

        if (const auto* list = answer.getProperty ("products", {}).getArray(); result.wasOk() && list != nullptr)
        {
            for (const auto& value : *list)
            {
                if (auto item = Item::fromVar (value); item.isValid())
                {
                    item.mine = true;
                    item.owned = true;
                    found.items.push_back (std::move (item));
                }
            }

            found.total = (int) found.items.size();
        }

        if (done != nullptr)
            done (result, found);
    });
}

void StoreClient::owned (Listed done)
{
    call ("owned", object(), [this, done] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        if (result.failed())
        {
            if (done != nullptr)
                done (result, {});

            return;
        }

        // Each one as the store lists it (a handful: an account's purchases).
        juce::StringArray ids;

        if (const auto* list = answer.getProperty ("products", {}).getArray())
            for (const auto& value : *list)
                ids.addIfNotAlreadyThere (value.getProperty ("product", {}).toString());

        ids.removeEmptyStrings();

        if (ids.isEmpty())
        {
            if (done != nullptr)
                done (juce::Result::ok(), {});

            return;
        }

        auto found = std::make_shared<Page>();
        auto left = std::make_shared<int> (ids.size());

        for (const auto& id : ids)
        {
            get (id, [found, left, done, order = ids] (const juce::Result& got, const Item& item)
            {
                if (got.wasOk() && item.isValid())
                    found->items.push_back (item);

                if (--*left > 0)
                    return;

                std::sort (found->items.begin(), found->items.end(), [&order] (const Item& a, const Item& b)
                {
                    return order.indexOf (a.product) < order.indexOf (b.product);
                });

                found->total = (int) found->items.size();

                if (done != nullptr)
                    done (juce::Result::ok(), *found);
            });
        }
    });
}

void StoreClient::get (const juce::String& product, std::function<void (const juce::Result&, const Item&)> done)
{
    call ("get", fields ({ { "product", product } }), [done] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (result, result.wasOk() ? Item::fromVar (answer.getProperty ("product", {})) : Item());
    });
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File StoreClient::pictureCacheFile (const Item& item, const juce::String& part)
{
    return Settings::getCacheFolder().getChildFile ("Store pictures")
               .getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (item.product) + "-v" + juce::String (item.version) + part + ".png");
}

void StoreClient::picture (const Item& item, std::function<void (const juce::Image&)> done)
{
    fetchImage (item.pictureUrl, item.product + "-v" + juce::String (item.version), pictureCacheFile (item, {}), std::move (done));
}

void StoreClient::logo (const Item& item, std::function<void (const juce::Image&)> done)
{
    if (item.logoUrl.isEmpty())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done ({});

        return;
    }

    fetchImage (item.logoUrl, item.product + "-v" + juce::String (item.version) + "-logo", pictureCacheFile (item, "-logo"), std::move (done));
}

void StoreClient::fetchImage (const juce::String& address, const juce::String& key, const juce::File& cacheFile,
                              std::function<void (const juce::Image&)> done)
{
    if (const auto known = pictures.find (key); known != pictures.end())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (known->second);

        return;
    }

    auto& waiting = waitingPictures[key];
    waiting.push_back (std::move (done));

    if (waiting.size() > 1)
        return;   // already on its way

    const bool online = ! server.isBlocked();

    workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, key, cacheFile, address, online]
    {
        auto image = cacheFile.existsAsFile() ? juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom (cacheFile) : juce::Image();

        if (! image.isValid() && online && address.startsWithIgnoreCase ("http"))
        {
            const auto data = fetch (address, maxPicture, pictureTimeoutMs);
            image = juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom (data.getData(), data.getSize());

            if (image.isValid() && cacheFile.getParentDirectory().createDirectory())
                cacheFile.replaceWithData (data.getData(), data.getSize());
        }

        juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([this, stillAlive, key, image]
        {
            if (! stillAlive->load())
                return;

            if (image.isValid())
                pictures[key] = image;

            auto callbacks = std::move (waitingPictures[key]);
            waitingPictures.erase (key);

            for (auto& callback : callbacks)
                if (callback != nullptr)
                    callback (image);
        });
    });
}

//==============================================================================
int StoreClient::installedVersion (const Item& item) const
{
    if (! item.isValid())
        return 0;

    if (item.isMidiFx())
    {
        if (deviceStudio == nullptr)
            return 0;

        const auto* entry = deviceStudio->findInLibrary (deviceIdFor (item.product));
        return entry != nullptr ? juce::jmax (1, entry->version) : 0;
    }

    return MadePlugins::installedVersion (MadePlugins::storeId (item.product));
}

bool StoreClient::isInstalling (const juce::String& product) const
{
    return std::find (installing.begin(), installing.end(), product) != installing.end();
}

void StoreClient::install (const Item& item, Progress progress, Done done)
{
    const auto say = [progress] (const juce::String& step) { if (progress != nullptr) progress (step); };

    if (! item.isValid() || isInstalling (item.product))
        return;

    if (item.isMidiFx() && deviceStudio == nullptr)
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("MIDI FX can't be added in this Sonify: its MIDI devices aren't available."));

        return;
    }

    installing.push_back (item.product);
    say (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Asking the store\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    const auto finish = [this, product = item.product, done] (const juce::Result& result)
    {
        installing.erase (std::remove (installing.begin(), installing.end(), product), installing.end());

        if (done != nullptr)
            done (result);
    };

    call ("download", fields ({ { "product", item.product } }), [this, item, say, finish] (const juce::Result& asked, const juce::var& download)
    {
        if (asked.failed())
        {
            finish (asked);
            return;
        }

        const auto address = download.getProperty ("url", {}).toString();

        if (! address.startsWithIgnoreCase ("http") || server.isBlocked())
        {
            finish (juce::Result::fail (server.isBlocked() ? "The internet is blocked (the switch at the top left)."
                                                           : "The store didn't say where its package is. Please try again later."));
            return;
        }

        say (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Downloading\xe2\x80\xa6"));

        workers.addJob ([this, stillAlive = alive, item, address, download, finish]
        {
            Unpacked unpacked;
            const auto package = fetch (address, maxPackage, packageTimeoutMs);
            const auto expectedSize = (juce::int64) download.getProperty ("size", 0);
            const auto expectedHash = download.getProperty ("sha256", {}).toString().toLowerCase();

            if (package.isEmpty())
                unpacked.error = "The download didn't arrive. Check the internet connection and try again.";
            else if ((expectedSize > 0 && (juce::int64) package.getSize() != expectedSize)
                     || (expectedHash.isNotEmpty() && juce::SHA256 (package).toHexString() != expectedHash))
                unpacked.error = "The download arrived damaged. Please try again.";
            else
                unpacked = unpack (package, download, item.product);

            juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([this, stillAlive, item, unpacked, finish]
            {
                if (! stillAlive->load())
                {
                    unpacked.folder.deleteRecursively();
                    return;
                }

                finishInstall (item, unpacked, finish);
            });
        });
    });
}

StoreClient::Unpacked StoreClient::unpack (const juce::MemoryBlock& package, const juce::var& download, const juce::String& product)
{
    Unpacked result;
    juce::MemoryInputStream in (package, false);
    juce::ZipFile zip (in);
    juce::int64 total = 0;

    if (zip.getNumEntries() == 0 || zip.getNumEntries() > maxEntries)
    {
        result.error = "The package isn't one Sonify can read.";
        return result;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < zip.getNumEntries(); ++i)
    {
        const auto* entry = zip.getEntry (i);
        total += entry->uncompressedSize;

        if (! isSafePath (entry->filename) || total > maxUnpacked)
        {
            result.error = "The package isn't one Sonify can read.";
            return result;
        }
    }

    result.folder = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::tempDirectory).getChildFile ("Sonify store " + juce::Uuid().toString().substring (0, 8));
    const auto files = result.folder.getChildFile ("package");

    if (! files.createDirectory() || zip.uncompressTo (files, true).failed())
    {
        result.error = "The package couldn't be unpacked.";
        return result;
    }

    const auto store = download.getProperty ("store", {});
    const auto version = juce::jmax (1, (int) download.getProperty ("version", 1));
    const auto kind = download.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString();

    if (kind == "midifx")
    {
        // A MIDI FX: its file, as this product (its id from the store's), with the store's details.
        const auto found = files.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, juce::String ("*") + Devices::fileExtension);
        Devices::DeviceFile device;

        if (found.size() != 1 || device.read (found.getFirst()).failed() || device.wasm.isEmpty())
        {
            result.error = "The package isn't a MIDI FX Sonify can play.";
            return result;
        }

        device.id = deviceIdFor (product);
        device.version = version;
        device.sources.clear();
        device.chat = juce::var();
        device.builtFrom.clear();
        device.store = Licences::Product::fromVar (store);
        device.store.id = product;

        result.name = device.name;
        result.device = result.folder.getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (device.name.isNotEmpty() ? device.name : juce::String ("MIDI FX"))
                                                    + Devices::fileExtension);

        if (const auto written = device.write (result.device); written.failed())
            result.error = written.getErrorMessage();

        return result;
    }

    // A plugin: its folder, as this product, with the store's details written over its own.
    const auto folders = files.findChildFiles (juce::File::findDirectories, false, juce::String ("*") + MadePlugins::extension);
    const auto info = folders.size() == 1 ? folders.getFirst().getChildFile ("plugin.json") : juce::File();
    auto json = info.existsAsFile() ? juce::JSON::parse (info) : juce::var();

    if (auto* o = json.getDynamicObject(); o != nullptr && json.getProperty ("format", {}).toString() == "Sonify plugin")
    {
        const auto id = MadePlugins::storeId (product);
        o->setProperty ("id", id);
        o->setProperty ("project", "store-" + product);
        o->setProperty ("version", version);
        o->setProperty ("added", juce::Time::getCurrentTime().toISO8601 (true));

        auto details = Licences::Product::fromVar (store);
        details.id = product;
        o->setProperty ("store", details.toVar());

        result.name = json.getProperty ("name", "Store plugin").toString();
        result.plugin = folders.getFirst();

        if (! info.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (json)))
            result.error = "The package couldn't be unpacked.";
    }
    else
    {
        result.error = "The package isn't a plugin made in Sonify.";
    }

    return result;
}

void StoreClient::finishInstall (const Item& item, Unpacked unpacked, Done done)
{
    auto result = juce::Result::ok();

    if (unpacked.error.isNotEmpty())
    {
        result = juce::Result::fail (unpacked.error);
    }
    else if (unpacked.device != juce::File())
    {
        juce::File copied;

        if (deviceStudio == nullptr)
            result = juce::Result::fail ("MIDI FX can't be added in this Sonify: its MIDI devices aren't available.");
        else
            result = deviceStudio->import (unpacked.device, copied);

        if (result.wasOk() && onDeviceInstalled != nullptr)
            onDeviceInstalled (unpacked.name);
    }
    else
    {
        juce::File folder;
        bool replaced = false;
        result = MadePlugins::installUnpacked (unpacked.plugin, MadePlugins::storeId (item.product), folder, replaced);

        if (result.wasOk() && onPluginInstalled != nullptr)
            onPluginInstalled (folder, unpacked.name.isNotEmpty() ? unpacked.name : item.title, replaced);
    }

    unpacked.folder.deleteRecursively();

    if (done != nullptr)
        done (result);
}

//==============================================================================
void StoreClient::buy (const Item& item, Progress progress, Done done)
{
    if (! item.isValid() || buying.product.isNotEmpty())
        return;

    buying = { item.product, item.title, progress, done, 0, false };

    if (progress != nullptr)
        progress (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Asking the store\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    call ("buy", fields ({ { "product", item.product } }), [this, item] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        if (buying.product != item.product)
            return;   // cancelled meanwhile

        if (result.failed())
        {
            endBuy (result);
            return;
        }

        if ((bool) answer.getProperty ("owned", false))
        {
            // Bought before (or it's the seller's own): only the licence is missing.
            fetchLicence (item, [this] (const juce::Result& got) { endBuy (got); });
            return;
        }

        const auto approve = answer.getProperty ("approve", {}).toString();

        if (! approve.startsWithIgnoreCase ("https://") || ! juce::URL (approve).launchInDefaultBrowser())
        {
            endBuy (juce::Result::fail ("PayPal couldn't be opened in the browser. Please try again."));
            return;
        }

        if (buying.progress != nullptr)
            buying.progress ("Pay in the browser (PayPal): the licence comes here by itself as soon as it's paid.");

        buying.until = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() + (juce::uint32) buyMinutes * 60000;
        startTimer (pollMs);
    });
}

void StoreClient::cancelBuy()
{
    if (buying.product.isEmpty())
        return;

    stopTimer();
    auto done = std::move (buying.done);
    buying = {};

    if (done != nullptr)
        done (juce::Result::fail ("Stopped waiting. If you paid, the licence still comes: open the product again."));
}

void StoreClient::endBuy (const juce::Result& result)
{
    stopTimer();
    polling = false;
    auto done = std::move (buying.done);
    buying = {};

    if (done != nullptr)
        done (result);
}

void StoreClient::timerCallback()
{
    if (buying.product.isEmpty())
    {
        stopTimer();
        return;
    }

    if (juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() > buying.until)
    {
        endBuy (juce::Result::fail ("No payment arrived in time. If you paid, open the product again: the licence comes then."));
        return;
    }

    if (polling)
        return;   // the last question isn't answered yet

    polling = true;

    call ("licence", fields ({ { "product", buying.product } }), [this, product = buying.product] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        polling = false;

        if (buying.product != product)
            return;

        if (result.wasOk())
        {
            const auto installed = Licences::install (answer.getProperty ("licence", {}).toString());
            endBuy (installed.wasOk() ? juce::Result::ok()
                                      : juce::Result::fail ("The licence that came didn't pass (" + installed.getErrorMessage() + "). Contact Fanan."));
            return;
        }

        const auto error = answer.getProperty ("error", {}).toString();

        if (error == "waiting")
            return;   // asked again in a moment

        if (error == "pending")
        {
            // PayPal holds it until the seller accepts: asked less often, for longer.
            if (! buying.pending)
            {
                buying.pending = true;
                buying.until = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() + (juce::uint32) pendingMinutes * 60000;
                startTimer (pendingPollMs);
            }

            if (buying.progress != nullptr)
                buying.progress (result.getErrorMessage());

            return;
        }

        endBuy (result);
    });
}

void StoreClient::fetchLicence (const Item& item, Done done)
{
    call ("licence", fields ({ { "product", item.product } }), [done] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        auto outcome = result;

        if (result.wasOk())
        {
            const auto installed = Licences::install (answer.getProperty ("licence", {}).toString());

            if (installed.failed())
                outcome = juce::Result::fail ("The licence that came didn't pass (" + installed.getErrorMessage() + "). Contact Fanan.");
        }

        if (done != nullptr)
            done (outcome);
    });
}

void StoreClient::release (const Item& item, Done done)
{
    call ("release", fields ({ { "product", item.product } }), [product = item.product, done] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var&)
    {
        if (result.wasOk())
            Licences::remove (product);

        if (done != nullptr)
            done (result);
    });
}

void StoreClient::hide (const Item& item, bool hidden, Done done)
{
    call ("hide", fields ({ { "product", item.product }, { "hidden", hidden } }), [done] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var&)
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (result);
    });
}

void StoreClient::fetchMissingLicences (const std::vector<Item>& items, std::function<void()> changed)
{
    if (! server.isSignedIn())
        return;

    for (const auto& item : items)
    {
        if (! item.owned || ! item.isPaid() || isLicensedHere (item) || installedVersion (item) == 0
            || std::find (licenceAsked.begin(), licenceAsked.end(), item.product) != licenceAsked.end())
            continue;

        licenceAsked.push_back (item.product);   // once per run: a computer over the limit isn't asked again and again

        fetchLicence (item, [changed] (const juce::Result& result)
        {
            if (result.wasOk() && changed != nullptr)
                changed();
        });
    }
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\StoreClient.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include "FananServer.h"
#include "Licences.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

class DeviceStudio;

//==============================================================================
/**
    Sonify's store, as the Store tab uses it: plugins and MIDI FX that Sonify users made and
    posted (StorePublisher), open to every user.

        browse     the list (by kind, by words), what this account owns, what it sells
        add        the product's package is downloaded from the store's files, checked (its
                   size and SHA-256), and installed: a plugin into Made in Sonify (an update
                   replaces the older version, songs keep finding it), a MIDI FX into My Devices.
                   A paid one plays its demo until this computer has its licence
        buy        PayPal opens in the browser (the buyer pays the seller directly); Sonify asks
                   the store every few seconds until it's paid, then keeps the licence
                   (Licences) and the product plays fully at once
        licences   for what the account owns and is installed here, they come by themselves;
                   a computer's place can be given back (up to 3 computers per purchase)

    A package can only install as its own product: its id in Sonify comes from the store's id
    ("store-<product>"), whatever its files say, and the store's details are written over its own.

    Message thread; downloads and unpacking run on workers of its own.
*/
class StoreClient final : private juce::Timer
{
public:
    //==========================================================================
    struct Item
    {
        juce::String product, kind, title, tagline, story, vendor, section;
        juce::String currency { "USD" };
        juce::String pictureUrl;
        juce::String logoUrl;                 // its maker's logo (none: no logo)
        juce::String video;                   // its demo video on YouTube (none: no video)
        juce::StringArray features;
        double price = 0.0;
        int version = 0, downloads = 0;
        juce::int64 size = 0, published = 0;
        bool isProtected = false, owned = false;

        // The seller's own (My products).
        bool mine = false;
        juce::String status, paypalProblem;

        bool isValid() const noexcept         { return product.isNotEmpty(); }
        bool isPaid() const noexcept          { return price > 0.0; }
        bool isMidiFx() const noexcept        { return kind == "midifx"; }
        juce::String videoId() const          { return youtubeId (video); }
        juce::String kindName() const;        // "Instrument", "Effect", "Widget", "MIDI FX"
        juce::String priceText() const;       // "Free", "$4.99"
        Licences::Product toProduct() const;

        static Item fromVar (const juce::var& value);
    };

    struct Page
    {
        std::vector<Item> items;
        int page = 1, pages = 1, total = 0;
    };

    /** The store's sections, by kind ("instrument", "effect", "midifx", "widget"): a product is in
        one of its kind's (its seller picks it in the Protection tab). The store keeps the same list
        (sonifyStore's SECTIONS). */
    static const juce::StringArray& sectionsFor (const juce::String& kind);

    /** The kind a section belongs to (empty: none). */
    static juce::String kindOfSection (const juce::String& section);

    /** A YouTube video's id (11 letters, digits, '-' and '_') from a link to it (watch?v=,
        youtu.be/, shorts/, embed/, live/) or the id itself; empty when it isn't one. */
    static juce::String youtubeId (const juce::String& link);

    explicit StoreClient (FananServer& server);
    ~StoreClient() override;

    /** Sonify's MIDI devices: a MIDI FX installs into My Devices (none: it can't install). */
    void setDevices (DeviceStudio* devices) noexcept    { deviceStudio = devices; }

    bool isSignedIn() const                             { return server.isSignedIn(); }

    //==========================================================================
    using Listed = std::function<void (const juce::Result& result, const Page& page)>;
    using Done = std::function<void (const juce::Result& result)>;
    using Progress = std::function<void (const juce::String& step)>;

    /** The store's list: kind and section empty for all, words to look for, a page (from 1). */
    void list (const juce::String& kind, const juce::String& section, const juce::String& query, int page, Listed done);

    /** What this account bought (and sells). */
    void owned (Listed done);

    /** What this account sells: its own products, hidden ones too, with any PayPal problem. */
    void mine (Listed done);

    /** One product. */
    void get (const juce::String& product, std::function<void (const juce::Result&, const Item&)> done);

    /** Its picture: from the cache, or fetched (invalid when it can't be had). */
    void picture (const Item& item, std::function<void (const juce::Image&)> done);

    /** Its maker's logo, the same way (invalid when it has none). */
    void logo (const Item& item, std::function<void (const juce::Image&)> done);

    //==========================================================================
    /** The store version installed here (0: not installed). */
    int installedVersion (const Item& item) const;
    bool isLicensedHere (const Item& item) const        { return Licences::isLicensed (item.product); }

    /** Downloads, checks and installs it (an update replaces the older version). */
    void install (const Item& item, Progress progress, Done done);
    bool isInstalling (const juce::String& product) const;

    /** Buys it: PayPal in the browser, then the licence once it's paid (or right away when it's
        owned already). progress tells how it's going; done ends it. */
    void buy (const Item& item, Progress progress, Done done);
    void cancelBuy();
    juce::String buyingProduct() const                  { return buying.product; }

    /** This computer's licence for something the account owns. */
    void fetchLicence (const Item& item, Done done);

    /** Gives this computer's place back, and takes its licence off it. */
    void release (const Item& item, Done done);

    /** The seller takes one of theirs out of the store, or puts it back. */
    void hide (const Item& item, bool hidden, Done done);

    /** Licences for what's owned and installed here but not licensed yet, quietly; changed is
        called when one came. */
    void fetchMissingLicences (const std::vector<Item>& items, std::function<void()> changed);

    /** A plugin was installed (or updated): Sonify's Browser shows it. */
    std::function<void (const juce::File& folder, const juce::String& name, bool replaced)> onPluginInstalled;

    /** A MIDI FX was installed into My Devices. */
    std::function<void (const juce::String& name)> onDeviceInstalled;

    static constexpr int pollMs = 4000, pendingPollMs = 30000;
    static constexpr int buyMinutes = 20, pendingMinutes = 60;

private:
    struct Unpacked
    {
        juce::String error;
        juce::File folder;      // the work folder (deleted once installed)
        juce::File plugin;      // a plugin's folder, ready
        juce::File device;      // a MIDI FX's file, ready
        juce::String name;
    };

    struct Buying
    {
        juce::String product, title;
        Progress progress;
        Done done;
        juce::uint32 until = 0;
        bool pending = false;
    };

    static Unpacked unpack (const juce::MemoryBlock& package, const juce::var& download, const juce::String& product);
    void finishInstall (const Item& item, Unpacked unpacked, Done done);
    void timerCallback() override;
    void endBuy (const juce::Result& result);
    void call (const juce::String& action, juce::var fields, FananServer::Done done);
    static juce::File pictureCacheFile (const Item& item, const juce::String& part);
    void fetchImage (const juce::String& address, const juce::String& key, const juce::File& cacheFile,
                     std::function<void (const juce::Image&)> done);

    FananServer& server;
    DeviceStudio* deviceStudio = nullptr;

    std::map<juce::String, juce::Image> pictures;                                          // by product and version
    std::map<juce::String, std::vector<std::function<void (const juce::Image&)>>> waitingPictures;
    std::vector<juce::String> installing;
    std::vector<juce::String> licenceAsked;   // asked for once per run, quietly
    Buying buying;
    bool polling = false;

    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> alive = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>> (true);

    // Last, so they're the first to go: a download under way finishes while the rest exists.
    juce::ThreadPool workers { juce::ThreadPoolOptions{}.withThreadName ("Store").withNumberOfThreads (3) };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (StoreClient)
};

#include "StorePage.h"

namespace
{
    constexpr int headerHeight = 64, footerHeight = 44, detailWidth = 420, narrowWidth = 900;
    const juce::Colour problemColour { 0xffff8a80 };
    const juce::Colour ownedColour { 0xff7fd6a3 };

    juce::String sizeText (juce::int64 bytes)
    {
        if (bytes <= 0)
            return {};

        return bytes < 1024 * 1024 ? juce::String (juce::jmax ((juce::int64) 1, bytes / 1024)) + " KB"
                                   : juce::String ((double) bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0), 1) + " MB";
    }

   #if JUCE_WEB_BROWSER
    /** A YouTube video, playing: its embedded player, in a page of its own (so YouTube knows where
        it's shown). Links out of it open in the browser. */
    class VideoView final : public juce::WebBrowserComponent
    {
    public:
        explicit VideoView (const juce::String& videoId)
            : WebBrowserComponent (optionsFor (videoId))
        {
            goToURL (getResourceProviderRoot() + "video.html");
        }

        bool pageAboutToLoad (const juce::String& url) override
        {
            if (url.startsWith (getResourceProviderRoot()) || url.startsWith ("about:") || url.containsIgnoreCase ("/embed/"))
                return true;

            juce::URL (url).launchInDefaultBrowser();
            return false;
        }

        void newWindowAttemptingToLoad (const juce::String& url) override    { juce::URL (url).launchInDefaultBrowser(); }

    private:
        static Options optionsFor (const juce::String& videoId)
        {
            const juce::String html = R"(<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="referrer" content="strict-origin-when-cross-origin">
<style>html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#000;overflow:hidden}iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}</style></head>
<body><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/)" + videoId + R"(?autoplay=1&rel=0&playsinline=1&modestbranding=1" title="Demo video"
allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; fullscreen" allowfullscreen referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"></iframe></body></html>)";

            const auto folder = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userApplicationDataDirectory)
                                    .getChildFile ("Fanan Web Hub").getChildFile ("Store video");

            return Options{}
                .withBackend (Options::Backend::webview2)
                .withWinWebView2Options (Options::WinWebView2{}.withUserDataFolder (folder).withBackgroundColour (juce::Colours::black))
                .withResourceProvider ([html] (const juce::String&) -> std::optional<Resource>
                {
                    const auto utf8 = html.toUTF8();
                    std::vector<std::byte> data (utf8.sizeInBytes() - 1);
                    std::memcpy (data.data(), utf8.getAddress(), data.size());
                    return Resource { std::move (data), "text/html" };
                });
        }
    };
   #endif

    juce::String watchUrl (const juce::String& videoId)
    {
        return "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=" + videoId;
    }

StorePage::Card::Card (StorePage& owner, const StoreClient::Item& storeItem)
    : item (storeItem), page (owner)
{
    setSize (width, height);
    setMouseCursor (juce::MouseCursor::PointingHandCursor);
    setTitle (item.title);
}

void StorePage::Card::mouseUp (const juce::MouseEvent& e)
{
    if (e.mouseWasClicked())
        page.select (item);
}

void StorePage::Card::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    const auto bounds = getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (0.5f);

    g.setColour (selected ? Theme::accentDeep : hover ? Theme::raised.brighter (0.06f) : Theme::raised);
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (bounds, 10.0f);
    g.setColour (selected ? Theme::accent : Theme::outline);
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (bounds, 10.0f, selected ? 2.0f : 1.0f);

    // The picture, filling its box (16:10).
    const auto pictureBox = getLocalBounds().reduced (8).removeFromTop ((width - 16) * 10 / 16).toFloat();

    {
        juce::Graphics::ScopedSaveState state (g);
        juce::Path clip;
        clip.addRoundedRectangle (pictureBox, 7.0f);
        g.reduceClipRegion (clip);
        g.setColour (Theme::inset);
        g.fillRect (pictureBox);

        if (picture.isValid())
            g.drawImage (picture, pictureBox, juce::RectanglePlacement::centred | juce::RectanglePlacement::fillDestination);
        else
        {
            g.setColour (Theme::muted.withAlpha (0.5f));
            g.setFont (Theme::font (13.0f));
            g.drawText (item.kindName(), pictureBox, juce::Justification::centred);
        }
    }

    auto text = getLocalBounds().reduced (12, 0).withTrimmedTop ((int) pictureBox.getBottom() + 8);

    g.setColour (Theme::text);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (15.0f, true));
    g.drawText (item.title, text.removeFromTop (22), juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);

    auto vendorRow = text.removeFromTop (18);

    if (logo.isValid())
    {
        // The maker's logo, before their name: 14 pixels high, at most 60 wide.
        const auto logoWidth = juce::jmin (60, juce::roundToInt (14.0f * (float) logo.getWidth() / (float) juce::jmax (1, logo.getHeight())));
        g.drawImage (logo, vendorRow.removeFromLeft (logoWidth).withSizeKeepingCentre (logoWidth, 14).toFloat(), juce::RectanglePlacement::centred);
        vendorRow.removeFromLeft (6);
    }

    g.setColour (Theme::muted);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (13.0f));
    g.drawText (item.vendor.isNotEmpty() ? item.vendor : juce::String ("Made in Sonify"), vendorRow, juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);

    auto row = text.removeFromTop (26);

    // The price, or what this account has of it.
    juce::String price = item.priceText();
    auto priceColour = item.isPaid() ? Theme::text : ownedColour;

    if (item.mine)
    {
        price = item.status == "hidden" ? juce::String ("Hidden") : juce::String ("Yours");
        priceColour = item.status == "hidden" ? Theme::muted : ownedColour;
    }
    else if (item.isPaid() && (item.owned || page.client.isLicensedHere (item)))
    {
        price = "Owned";
        priceColour = ownedColour;
    }

    g.setColour (priceColour);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (14.0f, true));
    g.drawText (price, row, juce::Justification::centredRight, false);

    juce::String kind = item.kindName();

    if (page.client.installedVersion (item) > 0)
        kind << juce::String::fromUTF8 (" \xc2\xb7 Added");

    g.setColour (Theme::muted);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (12.5f));
    g.drawText (kind, row.withTrimmedRight (80), juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);

    if (item.mine && item.paypalProblem.isNotEmpty())
    {
        g.setColour (problemColour);
        g.fillEllipse (pictureBox.getRight() - 18.0f, pictureBox.getY() + 8.0f, 10.0f, 10.0f);
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void StorePage::Grid::layOut (int width)
{
    const auto columns = juce::jmax (1, (width - 2 * margin + gap) / (Card::width + gap));
    const auto used = columns * Card::width + (columns - 1) * gap;
    const auto left = juce::jmax (margin, (width - used) / 2);
    int rows = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < cards.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto column = i % columns, row = i / columns;
        cards[i]->setTopLeftPosition (left + column * (Card::width + gap), margin + row * (Card::height + gap));
        rows = row + 1;
    }

    setSize (width, juce::jmax (1, margin * 2 + rows * Card::height + juce::jmax (0, rows - 1) * gap));
}

StorePage::Detail::Detail (StorePage& owner)
    : page (owner)
{
    backButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x97\x80  Back"));

    primaryButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId, juce::Colours::white);
    primaryButton.onClick = [this] { page.addToSonify(); };

    buyButton.onClick = [this] { page.buyIt(); };
    licenceButton.setButtonText ("Get its licence for this computer");
    licenceButton.setTooltip ("This account bought it: its licence for this computer comes from the store (up to 3 computers at a time)");
    licenceButton.onClick = [this] { page.getLicence(); };

    watchButton.setTooltip ("Its demo video, played here");
    watchButton.onClick = [this] { if (video != nullptr) stopVideo(); else playVideo(); };
    youtubeButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("YouTube \xe2\x86\x97"));
    youtubeButton.setTooltip ("Watch it on YouTube, in your browser");
    youtubeButton.onClick = [this] { juce::URL (watchUrl (item.videoId())).launchInDefaultBrowser(); };

    moreButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x8b\xaf"));
    moreButton.setTooltip ("More");
    moreButton.onClick = [this] { page.showMoreMenu(); };

    styleNote (licensedLabel, ownedColour);
    styleNote (warningLabel, problemColour);
    styleNote (statusLabel);

    storyText.setMultiLine (true, true);
    storyText.setReadOnly (true);
    storyText.setScrollbarsShown (true);
    storyText.setCaretVisible (false);
    storyText.setFont (Theme::font (14.5f));
    storyText.setColour (juce::TextEditor::backgroundColourId, juce::Colours::transparentBlack);
    storyText.setColour (juce::TextEditor::outlineColourId, juce::Colours::transparentBlack);
    storyText.setColour (juce::TextEditor::focusedOutlineColourId, juce::Colours::transparentBlack);
    storyText.setColour (juce::TextEditor::textColourId, Theme::text.withAlpha (0.9f));

    for (auto* c : std::initializer_list<juce::Component*> { &backButton, &primaryButton, &buyButton, &licenceButton, &moreButton,
                                                            &licensedLabel, &warningLabel, &statusLabel, &storyText })
        addAndMakeVisible (c);

    addChildComponent (watchButton);
    addChildComponent (youtubeButton);
}

void StorePage::Detail::setItem (const StoreClient::Item& newItem)
{
    const bool other = newItem.product != item.product;
    item = newItem;

    if (other)
    {
        stopVideo();
        picture = {};
        logo = {};
        setStatus ({}, false);
    }

    watchButton.setVisible (item.videoId().isNotEmpty());

    juce::String text = item.story.trim();

    if (! item.features.isEmpty())
    {
        text << "\n\n";

        for (const auto& feature : item.features)
            text << juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x80\xa2  ") << feature << "\n";
    }

    storyText.setText (text.trimEnd(), false);
    storyText.moveCaretToTop (false);
    refreshState();
}

void StorePage::Detail::setStatus (const juce::String& text, bool problem)
{
    statusLabel.setText (text, juce::dontSendNotification);
    statusLabel.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, problem ? problemColour : Theme::muted);
}

void StorePage::Detail::playVideo()
{
    const auto id = item.videoId();

    if (id.isEmpty())
        return;

   #if JUCE_WEB_BROWSER
    video = std::make_unique<VideoView> (id);
    addAndMakeVisible (*video);
   #else
    juce::URL (watchUrl (id)).launchInDefaultBrowser();   // no web pages in this Sonify: the browser shows it
   #endif

    refreshState();
}

void StorePage::Detail::stopVideo()
{
    if (video == nullptr)
        return;

    video = nullptr;   // the player goes, and its sound with it
    refreshState();
}

void StorePage::Detail::refreshState()
{
    auto& store = page.client;
    const auto installed = store.installedVersion (item);
    const bool licensed = store.isLicensedHere (item);
    const bool owns = item.owned || item.mine || licensed;
    const bool installing = store.isInstalling (item.product);
    const bool buying = store.buyingProduct() == item.product;
    const bool buyingOther = store.buyingProduct().isNotEmpty() && ! buying;

    // Add to Sonify, Try it (its demo), Update, or Added.
    if (installing)
        primaryButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Adding\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    else if (installed == 0)
        primaryButton.setButtonText (item.isPaid() && ! owns ? juce::String ("Try it (demo)") : juce::String ("Add to Sonify"));
    else if (installed < item.version)
        primaryButton.setButtonText ("Update to version " + juce::String (item.version));
    else
        primaryButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Added \xe2\x9c\x93"));

    primaryButton.setEnabled (! installing && (installed == 0 || installed < item.version));
    primaryButton.setTooltip (item.isPaid() && ! owns
                                  ? "Add it to Sonify in its demo: 10 seconds of sound, then 2 of silence"
                                    + juce::String (item.isMidiFx() ? " (a MIDI FX: 10 seconds of notes, then 3 with none)" : "")
                                    + ", until you buy it"
                                  : juce::String (item.isMidiFx() ? "Add it to My Devices: it's in the tracks' MIDI FX menu"
                                                                  : "Add it to Sonify's Browser, under Made in Sonify"));

    // Buy (or stop waiting for the payment).
    buyButton.setVisible (item.isPaid() && ! owns);
    buyButton.setButtonText (buying ? juce::String ("Stop waiting") : "Buy  " + item.priceText());
    buyButton.setEnabled (! buyingOther);
    buyButton.setTooltip (buying ? juce::String ("Stop waiting for the payment (if you paid, the licence still comes when you open it again)")
                                 : juce::String ("Pay the maker directly with PayPal, in your browser. The licence comes to this computer by itself"));

    licenceButton.setVisible (item.isPaid() && (item.owned || item.mine) && ! licensed);
    licensedLabel.setVisible (item.isPaid() && licensed);
    licensedLabel.setText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x9c\x93  Licensed on this computer: it plays fully."), juce::dontSendNotification);

    juce::String warning;

    if (item.mine && item.paypalProblem.isNotEmpty())
        warning = "PayPal refused a buyer's payment to your account (" + item.paypalProblem.upToFirstOccurrenceOf (" ", false, false)
                + "): check it can receive money, then post again from the Protection tab.";
    else if (item.mine && item.status == "hidden")
        warning = "Hidden: it isn't in the store. Show it again from the menu.";

    warningLabel.setText (warning, juce::dontSendNotification);
    warningLabel.setVisible (warning.isNotEmpty());

    watchButton.setButtonText (video != nullptr ? juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x96\xa0  Stop the video")
                                                : juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x96\xb6  Watch the demo video"));
    youtubeButton.setVisible (video != nullptr);

    resized();
    repaint();
}

void StorePage::Detail::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (Theme::panel);
    g.setColour (Theme::outline);
    g.drawVerticalLine (0, 0.0f, (float) getHeight());

    if (! item.isValid())
        return;

    {
        juce::Graphics::ScopedSaveState state (g);
        juce::Path clip;
        clip.addRoundedRectangle (pictureArea.toFloat(), 9.0f);
        g.reduceClipRegion (clip);
        g.setColour (Theme::inset);
        g.fillRect (pictureArea);

        if (picture.isValid())
            g.drawImage (picture, pictureArea.toFloat(), juce::RectanglePlacement::centred | juce::RectanglePlacement::onlyReduceInSize);
    }

    auto text = textArea;

    // The maker's logo, at the right of the title.
    if (logo.isValid() && ! logoArea.isEmpty())
        g.drawImage (logo, logoArea.toFloat(), juce::RectanglePlacement::xRight | juce::RectanglePlacement::yTop | juce::RectanglePlacement::onlyReduceInSize);

    g.setColour (Theme::text);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (21.0f, true));
    g.drawFittedText (item.title, text.removeFromTop (30).withTrimmedRight (logo.isValid() ? logoArea.getWidth() + 10 : 0),
                      juce::Justification::centredLeft, 1, 0.9f);

    juce::StringArray facts;
    facts.add (item.vendor.isNotEmpty() ? item.vendor : juce::String ("Made in Sonify"));
    facts.add (item.kindName());

    if (item.section.isNotEmpty())
        facts.add (item.section);

    if (item.version > 0)    facts.add ("version " + juce::String (item.version));
    if (item.size > 0)       facts.add (sizeText (item.size));

    g.setColour (Theme::muted);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (13.0f));
    g.drawFittedText (facts.joinIntoString (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("  \xc2\xb7  ")),
                      text.removeFromTop (20).withTrimmedRight (logo.isValid() ? logoArea.getWidth() + 10 : 0), juce::Justification::centredLeft, 1, 0.8f);

    g.setColour (item.isPaid() ? Theme::text : ownedColour);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (17.0f, true));
    g.drawText (item.priceText(), text.removeFromTop (28), juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);

    if (item.tagline.isNotEmpty())
    {
        g.setColour (Theme::text.withAlpha (0.85f));
        g.setFont (Theme::font (14.5f, true));
        g.drawFittedText (item.tagline, text.removeFromTop (40), juce::Justification::topLeft, 2, 1.0f);
    }
}

void StorePage::Detail::resized()
{
    auto area = getLocalBounds().reduced (20, 16);
    area.removeFromLeft (1);

    const bool back = backButton.isVisible();

    if (back)
    {
        backButton.setBounds (area.removeFromTop (30).removeFromLeft (100));
        area.removeFromTop (10);
    }

    pictureArea = area.removeFromTop (juce::jmin (area.getWidth() * 10 / 16, 300));

    // The video plays where the picture is (a web page: nothing can lie over it), its buttons
    // under it.
    if (video != nullptr)
        video->setBounds (pictureArea);

    if (watchButton.isVisible())
    {
        area.removeFromTop (8);
        auto row = area.removeFromTop (30);
        watchButton.setBounds (row.removeFromLeft (210));
        row.removeFromLeft (8);
        youtubeButton.setBounds (row.removeFromLeft (100));
    }

    area.removeFromTop (12);
    textArea = area.removeFromTop (78 + (item.tagline.isNotEmpty() ? 42 : 0));
    logoArea = textArea.withHeight (46).removeFromRight (juce::jmin (130, textArea.getWidth() / 3));
    area.removeFromTop (6);

    auto row = area.removeFromTop (36);
    moreButton.setBounds (row.removeFromRight (40));
    row.removeFromRight (8);

    if (buyButton.isVisible())
    {
        const auto half = (row.getWidth() - 8) / 2;
        primaryButton.setBounds (row.removeFromLeft (half));
        row.removeFromLeft (8);
        buyButton.setBounds (row);
    }
    else
    {
        primaryButton.setBounds (row);
    }

    area.removeFromTop (8);

    if (licenceButton.isVisible())
    {
        licenceButton.setBounds (area.removeFromTop (32));
        area.removeFromTop (6);
    }

    if (licensedLabel.isVisible())
        licensedLabel.setBounds (area.removeFromTop (22));

    if (warningLabel.isVisible())
        warningLabel.setBounds (area.removeFromTop (40));

    statusLabel.setBounds (area.removeFromBottom (40));
    area.removeFromBottom (4);
    area.removeFromTop (6);
    storyText.setBounds (area.expanded (4, 0));
}

//==============================================================================
StorePage::StorePage (StoreClient& storeClient)
    : client (storeClient)
{
    searchBox.setTextToShowWhenEmpty ("Search the store", Theme::muted);
    searchBox.setFont (Theme::font (14.5f));
    searchBox.setIndents (10, 8);
    searchBox.onTextChange = [this] { startTimer (450); };
    searchBox.onReturnKey = [this] { stopTimer(); page = 1; load(); };

    kindBox.addItemList ({ "Every kind", "Instruments", "Effects", "MIDI FX", "Widgets" }, 1);
    kindBox.setSelectedId (1, juce::dontSendNotification);
    kindBox.onChange = [this] { fillSections(); page = 1; load(); };

    sectionBox.setTooltip ("Its section in the store");
    sectionBox.onChange = [this] { page = 1; load(); };
    fillSections();

    showBox.addItemList ({ "Everything", "What I own", "My products" }, 1);
    showBox.setSelectedId (1, juce::dontSendNotification);
    showBox.setTooltip ("Everything in the store, what your account bought, or what you sell");
    showBox.onChange = [this]
    {
        show = (Show) juce::jlimit (0, 2, showBox.getSelectedId() - 1);
        page = 1;
        load();
    };

    refreshButton.setTooltip ("Ask the store again");
    refreshButton.onClick = [this] { refresh(); };

    previousButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x97\x80"));
    nextButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x96\xb6"));
    previousButton.onClick = [this] { if (page > 1) { --page; load(); } };
    nextButton.onClick = [this] { if (page < pages) { ++page; load(); } };
    styleNote (pageLabel);
    pageLabel.setJustificationType (juce::Justification::centred);

    viewport.setViewedComponent (&grid, false);
    viewport.setScrollBarsShown (true, false);

    for (auto* c : std::initializer_list<juce::Component*> { &searchBox, &kindBox, &sectionBox, &showBox, &refreshButton, &previousButton, &nextButton,
                                                            &pageLabel, &viewport })
        addAndMakeVisible (c);

    addChildComponent (detail);
    signedIn = client.isSignedIn();
}

StorePage::~StorePage()
{
    stopTimer();
}

void StorePage::timerCallback()
{
    stopTimer();
    page = 1;
    load();
}

juce::String StorePage::kindFilter() const
{
    switch (kindBox.getSelectedId())
    {
        case 2:  return "instrument";
        case 3:  return "effect";
        case 4:  return "midifx";
        case 5:  return "widget";
        default: return {};
    }
}

juce::String StorePage::sectionFilter() const
{
    const auto id = sectionBox.getSelectedId();
    return id >= 2 ? sectionNames[id - 2] : juce::String();
}

void StorePage::fillSections()
{
    const auto kept = sectionFilter();
    const auto kind = kindFilter();

    sectionBox.clear (juce::dontSendNotification);
    sectionNames.clear();
    sectionBox.addItem ("Every section", 1);

    for (const auto* each : { "instrument", "effect", "midifx", "widget" })
    {
        if (kind.isNotEmpty() && kind != each)
            continue;

        StoreClient::Item kindOf;
        kindOf.kind = each;

        if (kind.isEmpty())
            sectionBox.addSectionHeading (kindOf.kindName());

        const juce::String eachKind (each);   // the lists are the store's own, kept for good

        for (const auto& section : StoreClient::sectionsFor (eachKind))
        {
            sectionNames.add (section);
            sectionBox.addItem (section, sectionNames.size() + 1);
        }
    }

    const auto index = sectionNames.indexOf (kept);
    sectionBox.setSelectedId (index >= 0 ? index + 2 : 1, juce::dontSendNotification);
}

void StorePage::refresh()
{
    loadedOnce = true;
    load();
}

void StorePage::load()
{
    const auto number = ++loadNumber;
    loading = true;
    message = juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Asking the store\xe2\x80\xa6");
    repaint();

    auto done = [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this), number] (const juce::Result& result, const StoreClient::Page& found)
    {
        if (safeThis != nullptr && number == safeThis->loadNumber)
            safeThis->showPage (result, found);
    };

    if (show == Show::mine)
        client.mine (done);
    else if (show == Show::owned)
        client.owned (done);
    else
        client.list (kindFilter(), sectionFilter(), searchBox.getText(), page, done);
}

void StorePage::showPage (const juce::Result& result, const StoreClient::Page& found)
{
    loading = false;
    items.clear();

    if (result.wasOk())
    {
        // Owned and My products are short lists: the kind and the words filter them here.
        const auto kind = kindFilter();
        const auto section = sectionFilter();
        const auto words = searchBox.getText().trim();

        for (const auto& item : found.items)
            if (show == Show::everything
                || ((kind.isEmpty() || item.kind == kind) && (section.isEmpty() || item.section == section)
                    && (words.isEmpty() || item.title.containsIgnoreCase (words) || item.vendor.containsIgnoreCase (words)
                        || item.tagline.containsIgnoreCase (words))))
                items.push_back (item);

        page = found.page;
        pages = show == Show::everything ? found.pages : 1;
        total = show == Show::everything ? found.total : (int) items.size();
    }

    if (result.failed())
        message = result.getErrorMessage();
    else if (! items.empty())
        message.clear();
    else if (show == Show::mine)
        message = "You haven't posted anything yet: plugins and MIDI FX go into the store from the Protection tab.";
    else if (show == Show::owned)
        message = "Nothing bought yet.";
    else if (sectionFilter().isNotEmpty())
        message = "Nothing in " + sectionFilter() + " yet.";
    else if (searchBox.getText().trim().isNotEmpty() || kindFilter().isNotEmpty())
        message = "Nothing matches.";
    else
        message = "The store is empty so far. Post the first one from the Protection tab!";

    grid.cards.clear();

    for (const auto& item : items)
    {
        auto* card = grid.cards.add (new Card (*this, item));
        card->setSelected (item.product == selected);
        grid.addAndMakeVisible (card);

        client.picture (item, [safeCard = juce::Component::SafePointer<Card> (card)] (const juce::Image& image)
        {
            if (safeCard != nullptr)
                safeCard->setPicture (image);
        });

        client.logo (item, [safeCard = juce::Component::SafePointer<Card> (card)] (const juce::Image& image)
        {
            if (safeCard != nullptr)
                safeCard->setLogo (image);
        });
    }

    // The open one, as the store has it now.
    for (const auto& item : items)
        if (item.product == selected)
            detail.setItem (item);

    pageLabel.setText (show == Show::everything && total > 0
                           ? "Page " + juce::String (page) + " of " + juce::String (pages) + juce::String::fromUTF8 ("  \xc2\xb7  ")
                             + juce::String (total) + (total == 1 ? " product" : " products")
                           : juce::String(),
                       juce::dontSendNotification);
    previousButton.setEnabled (page > 1);
    nextButton.setEnabled (page < pages);

    // What this account owns and has here, licensed by itself.
    client.fetchMissingLicences (items, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this)]
    {
        if (safeThis != nullptr)
            safeThis->itemChanged();
    });

    resized();
    repaint();
}

void StorePage::select (const StoreClient::Item& item)
{
    selected = item.product;

    for (auto* card : grid.cards)
        card->setSelected (card->item.product == selected);

    detail.setItem (item);
    detail.setVisible (true);

    client.picture (item, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this), product = item.product] (const juce::Image& image)
    {
        if (safeThis != nullptr && safeThis->detail.item.product == product)
            safeThis->detail.setPicture (image);
    });

    client.logo (item, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this), product = item.product] (const juce::Image& image)
    {
        if (safeThis != nullptr && safeThis->detail.item.product == product)
            safeThis->detail.setLogo (image);
    });

    resized();
}

void StorePage::closeDetail()
{
    detail.stopVideo();
    selected.clear();
    detail.setVisible (false);

    for (auto* card : grid.cards)
        card->setSelected (false);

    resized();
}

void StorePage::showProduct (const juce::String& product)
{
    for (const auto& item : items)
    {
        if (item.product == product)
        {
            select (item);
            return;
        }
    }

    client.get (product, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this)] (const juce::Result& result, const StoreClient::Item& item)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        if (result.wasOk() && item.isValid())
            safeThis->select (item);
        else
        {
            safeThis->message = result.failed() ? result.getErrorMessage() : juce::String ("That isn't in the store any more.");
            safeThis->repaint();
        }
    });
}

void StorePage::connectionChanged()
{
    const auto now = client.isSignedIn();

    if (now == signedIn)
        return;

    signedIn = now;

    if (loadedOnce)
        load();   // what's owned changed
}

void StorePage::updateCards()
{
    for (auto* card : grid.cards)
        card->repaint();
}

void StorePage::itemChanged()
{
    updateCards();

    if (detail.isVisible())
        detail.refreshState();
}

//==============================================================================
void StorePage::addToSonify()
{
    const auto item = detail.item;

    client.install (item,
                    [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this), product = item.product] (const juce::String& step)
                    {
                        if (safeThis != nullptr && safeThis->detail.item.product == product)
                            safeThis->detail.setStatus (step, false);
                    },
                    [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this), item] (const juce::Result& result)
                    {
                        if (safeThis == nullptr)
                            return;

                        if (safeThis->detail.item.product == item.product)
                        {
                            if (result.failed())
                                safeThis->detail.setStatus (result.getErrorMessage(), true);
                            else
                                safeThis->detail.setStatus (item.isMidiFx() ? "Added to My Devices: it's in the tracks' MIDI FX menu."
                                                                            : "Added: it's in Sonify's Browser, under Made in Sonify.", false);
                        }

                        safeThis->itemChanged();
                    });

    itemChanged();
}

void StorePage::buyIt()
{
    const auto item = detail.item;

    if (client.buyingProduct() == item.product)
    {
        client.cancelBuy();
        itemChanged();
        return;
    }

    if (! client.isSignedIn())
    {
        detail.setStatus ("Sign in to your Fanan account first (in Build with AI): what you buy is your account's.", true);
        return;
    }

    client.buy (item,
                [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this), product = item.product] (const juce::String& step)
                {
                    if (safeThis != nullptr && safeThis->detail.item.product == product)
                        safeThis->detail.setStatus (step, false);
                },
                [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this), item] (const juce::Result& result)
                {
                    if (safeThis == nullptr)
                        return;

                    if (safeThis->detail.item.product == item.product)
                    {
                        if (result.failed())
                            safeThis->detail.setStatus (result.getErrorMessage(), true);
                        else
                            safeThis->detail.setStatus (safeThis->client.installedVersion (item) > 0
                                                            ? "Bought: thank you! It plays fully now."
                                                            : "Bought: thank you! Add it to Sonify: it plays fully.", false);
                    }

                    if (result.wasOk())
                        safeThis->detail.item.owned = true;

                    safeThis->itemChanged();
                });

    itemChanged();
}

void StorePage::getLicence()
{
    const auto item = detail.item;
    detail.setStatus (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Asking the store\xe2\x80\xa6"), false);

    client.fetchLicence (item, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this), product = item.product] (const juce::Result& result)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        if (safeThis->detail.item.product == product)
            safeThis->detail.setStatus (result.failed() ? result.getErrorMessage() : juce::String ("Licensed on this computer: it plays fully."),
                                        result.failed());

        safeThis->itemChanged();
    });
}

void StorePage::showMoreMenu()
{
    const auto item = detail.item;
    const bool licensed = client.isLicensedHere (item);
    juce::PopupMenu menu;

    menu.addItem (1, "Give this computer's place back", item.isPaid() && licensed && ! item.mine);

    if (item.mine)
        menu.addItem (2, item.status == "hidden" ? "Show it in the store again" : "Hide it from the store");

    menu.addSeparator();
    menu.addItem (3, "Copy its store id (" + item.product + ")");

    menu.showMenuAsync (juce::PopupMenu::Options().withTargetComponent (&detail.moreButton),
                        [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<StorePage> (this), item] (int choice)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        auto& self = *safeThis;

        if (choice == 3)
        {
            juce::SystemClipboard::copyTextToClipboard (item.product);
            return;
        }

        if (choice == 1)
        {
            // A purchase plays fully on up to 3 computers at a time: this one's place is freed.
            auto options = juce::MessageBoxOptions::makeOptionsOkCancel (juce::MessageBoxIconType::QuestionIcon, "Give this computer's place back?",
                                                                         item.title + " goes back to its demo here, and the place is free for another "
                                                                         "computer. Get its licence again here any time (while a place is free).",
                                                                         "Give it back", "Cancel", &self);

            juce::AlertWindow::showAsync (options, [safeThis, item] (int answer)
            {
                if (safeThis == nullptr || answer != 1)
                    return;

                safeThis->client.release (item, [safeThis, product = item.product] (const juce::Result& result)
                {
                    if (safeThis == nullptr)
                        return;

                    if (safeThis->detail.item.product == product)
                        safeThis->detail.setStatus (result.failed() ? result.getErrorMessage()
                                                                    : juce::String ("This computer's place is free: it plays its demo here now."),
                                                    result.failed());

                    safeThis->itemChanged();
                });
            });
            return;
        }

        if (choice == 2)
        {
            const bool hide = item.status != "hidden";

            self.client.hide (item, hide, [safeThis, hide] (const juce::Result& result)
            {
                if (safeThis == nullptr)
                    return;

                if (result.failed())
                {
                    safeThis->detail.setStatus (result.getErrorMessage(), true);
                    return;
                }

                safeThis->detail.item.status = hide ? "hidden" : "listed";
                safeThis->detail.setStatus (hide ? "Hidden: it isn't in the store now." : "It's in the store again.", false);
                safeThis->load();
            });
        }
    });
}

//==============================================================================
void StorePage::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (Theme::panel);

    g.setColour (Theme::window.withAlpha (0.5f));
    g.fillRect (headerArea);
    g.setColour (Theme::outline);
    g.drawHorizontalLine (headerArea.getBottom() - 1, 0.0f, (float) getWidth());

    g.setColour (Theme::text);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (20.0f, true));
    g.drawText ("Store", headerArea.withTrimmedLeft (20).withWidth (90), juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);

    if (message.isNotEmpty() && items.empty())
    {
        auto area = viewport.getBounds().withSizeKeepingCentre (juce::jmin (560, viewport.getWidth() - 40), 120);
        g.setColour (loading ? Theme::muted : Theme::text.withAlpha (0.85f));
        g.setFont (Theme::font (15.5f));
        g.drawFittedText (message, area, juce::Justification::centred, 4, 1.0f);
    }
}

void StorePage::resized()
{
    auto area = getLocalBounds();
    headerArea = area.removeFromTop (headerHeight);

    auto header = headerArea.reduced (16, 14);
    header.removeFromLeft (100);
    refreshButton.setBounds (header.removeFromRight (90));
    header.removeFromRight (10);
    showBox.setBounds (header.removeFromRight (150));
    header.removeFromRight (10);
    sectionBox.setBounds (header.removeFromRight (180));
    header.removeFromRight (10);
    kindBox.setBounds (header.removeFromRight (140));
    header.removeFromRight (10);
    searchBox.setBounds (header.withWidth (juce::jmin (header.getWidth(), 420)));

    footerArea = area.removeFromBottom (pages > 1 || total > 0 ? footerHeight : 0);
    bodyArea = area;
    layOutBody();

    auto footer = footerArea.withWidth (viewport.getWidth()).reduced (16, 8);
    const bool paging = pages > 1;
    previousButton.setVisible (paging);
    nextButton.setVisible (paging);
    pageLabel.setVisible (footerArea.getHeight() > 0);

    if (paging)
    {
        previousButton.setBounds (footer.removeFromLeft (40));
        nextButton.setBounds (footer.removeFromRight (40));
    }

    pageLabel.setBounds (footer);
}

void StorePage::layOutBody()
{
    auto body = bodyArea;
    const bool open = detail.isVisible() && detail.item.isValid();
    const bool narrow = getWidth() < narrowWidth;

    detail.backButton.setVisible (narrow);

    if (open && narrow)
    {
        detail.setBounds (getLocalBounds().withTrimmedTop (headerHeight));
        viewport.setBounds (body.withWidth (0));
        detail.toFront (false);
    }
    else
    {
        if (open)
            detail.setBounds (body.removeFromRight (detailWidth).withBottom (getHeight()));

        viewport.setBounds (body);
    }

    grid.layOut (juce::jmax (Card::width + 2 * Grid::margin, viewport.getMaximumVisibleWidth()));
    detail.resized();
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\StorePage.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include "StoreClient.h"

#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Plugins Creator Studio's Store tab: Sonify's store, open to every user.

        top     words to look for, the kind (instruments, effects, MIDI FX, widgets), its
                section (each kind's own: Synths, Reverb & Space, Arpeggiators...), and what to
                show: everything, what this account owns, or what it sells
        middle  the products as cards (picture, title, maker, price), page by page
        right   the chosen one: its picture, story and features, and what can be done with it:
                its maker's logo and demo video (YouTube, played right there), and
                Add to Sonify (a paid one: Try it, in its demo), Update, Buy (PayPal in the
                browser, then its licence by itself), Get the licence for this computer, give
                this computer's place back; and for the seller's own, Hide or Show it in the store

    The work is the StoreClient's.
*/
class StorePage final : public juce::Component,
                        private juce::Timer
{
public:
    explicit StorePage (StoreClient& client);
    ~StorePage() override;

    /** The list again (the tab opened, or Refresh). */
    void refresh();

    /** That product, opened (a demo's Buy button). */
    void showProduct (const juce::String& product);

    /** Signed in or out: what's owned changes. */
    void connectionChanged();

    void paint (juce::Graphics&) override;
    void resized() override;

private:
    enum class Show { everything, owned, mine };

    //==========================================================================
    class Card final : public juce::Component
    {
    public:
        Card (StorePage& owner, const StoreClient::Item& item);

        void setPicture (const juce::Image& image)    { picture = image; repaint(); }
        void setLogo (const juce::Image& image)       { logo = image; repaint(); }
        void setSelected (bool shouldBeSelected)      { selected = shouldBeSelected; repaint(); }
        void paint (juce::Graphics&) override;
        void mouseEnter (const juce::MouseEvent&) override   { hover = true; repaint(); }
        void mouseExit (const juce::MouseEvent&) override    { hover = false; repaint(); }
        void mouseUp (const juce::MouseEvent&) override;

        StoreClient::Item item;

        static constexpr int width = 232, height = 228;

    private:
        StorePage& page;
        juce::Image picture, logo;
        bool selected = false, hover = false;
    };

    //==========================================================================
