namespace
{
    constexpr const char* listingExtension = ".json";
    constexpr const char* pictureExtension = ".png";
    constexpr int pictureLongest = 1600;       // the store's picture, at most (pixels)
    constexpr int storyPictureLongest = 1568;  // what Fanan AI is shown
    constexpr int maxFactsLength = 60000;

    juce::String limited (const juce::String& text, int length)
    {
        return text.trim().substring (0, length).trim();
    }

    juce::var object()
    {
        return juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    }

    void set (juce::var& target, const juce::Identifier& name, const juce::var& value)
    {
        target.getDynamicObject()->setProperty (name, value);
    }

    juce::String kindName (const juce::String& kind)
    {
        if (kind == "effect")  return "effect";
        if (kind == "widget")  return "widget";
        if (kind == "midifx")  return "MIDI FX";
        return "instrument";
    }

    /** A temporary folder of its own, for one post's files (gone once it's posted). */
    juce::File makeWorkFolder()
    {
        auto folder = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::tempDirectory)
                          .getChildFile ("Sonify store " + juce::Uuid().toString().substring (0, 8));
        folder.deleteRecursively();
        return folder.createDirectory() ? folder : juce::File();
    }
}

//==============================================================================
Licences::Product StorePublisher::Listing::toProduct() const
{
    Licences::Product p;
    p.id = product;
    p.title = title;
    p.price = isPaid() ? price : 0.0;
    p.currency = currency.isNotEmpty() ? currency : juce::String ("USD");
    return p;
}

juce::var StorePublisher::Listing::toVar() const
{
    auto item = object();
    set (item, "key", key);
    set (item, "kind", kind);
    set (item, "product", product);
    set (item, "title", title);
    set (item, "tagline", tagline);
    set (item, "story", story);
    set (item, "section", section);
    set (item, "video", video);

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& feature : features)
        list.add (feature);

    set (item, "features", list);
    set (item, "price", price);
    set (item, "currency", currency);
    set (item, "paypal", paypal);
    set (item, "postedVersion", postedVersion);
    set (item, "postedAt", postedAt);
    return item;
}

StorePublisher::Listing StorePublisher::Listing::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    Listing l;

    if (! value.isObject())
        return l;

    l.key = value.getProperty ("key", {}).toString().trim();
    l.kind = value.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString().trim();
    l.product = value.getProperty ("product", {}).toString().trim();
    l.title = limited (value.getProperty ("title", {}).toString(), maxTitle);
    l.tagline = limited (value.getProperty ("tagline", {}).toString(), maxTagline);
    l.story = limited (value.getProperty ("story", {}).toString(), maxStory);
    l.section = value.getProperty ("section", {}).toString().trim();
    l.video = limited (value.getProperty ("video", {}).toString(), 300);

    if (const auto* list = value.getProperty ("features", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& feature : *list)
            if (const auto text = limited (feature.toString(), maxFeature); text.isNotEmpty() && l.features.size() < maxFeatures)
                l.features.add (text);

    l.price = juce::jlimit (0.0, maximumPrice, (double) value.getProperty ("price", 0.0));
    l.currency = value.getProperty ("currency", "USD").toString().trim().toUpperCase();

    if (! currencies().contains (l.currency))
        l.currency = "USD";

    l.paypal = value.getProperty ("paypal", {}).toString().trim();
    l.postedVersion = juce::jmax (0, (int) value.getProperty ("postedVersion", 0));
    l.postedAt = value.getProperty ("postedAt", {}).toString();
    return l;
}

juce::File StorePublisher::folder()
{
    return Settings::getDataFolder().getChildFile ("Store");
}

StorePublisher::Listing StorePublisher::load (const juce::String& key, const juce::String& kind)
{
    const auto file = folder().getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (key) + listingExtension);
    const auto parsed = juce::JSON::parse (file);
    auto listing = Listing::fromVar (parsed);

    listing.key = key;
    listing.kind = kind;

    if (! StoreClient::sectionsFor (kind).contains (listing.section))
        listing.section.clear();

    return listing;
}

juce::Result StorePublisher::save (const Listing& listing)
{
    if (listing.key.isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("Nothing to keep it for.");

    const auto file = folder().getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (listing.key) + listingExtension);

    if (! file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory() || ! file.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (listing.toVar())))
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't keep the store's details in " + folder().getFullPathName());

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::File StorePublisher::pictureFile (const juce::String& key)
{
    return folder().getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (key) + pictureExtension);
}

juce::Image StorePublisher::loadPicture (const juce::String& key)
{
    const auto file = pictureFile (key);
    return file.existsAsFile() ? juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom (file) : juce::Image();
}

juce::Result StorePublisher::savePicture (const juce::String& key, const juce::Image& picture)
{
    const auto file = pictureFile (key);

    if (! picture.isValid())
    {
        file.deleteFile();
        return juce::Result::ok();
    }

    const auto png = pngOf (picture, pictureLongest);

    if (png.isEmpty() || ! file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory() || ! file.replaceWithData (png.getData(), png.getSize()))
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't keep the picture in " + folder().getFullPathName());

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::Image StorePublisher::fitLogo (const juce::Image& source, juce::String& report)
{
    if (! source.isValid())
    {
        report = "That file isn't a picture Sonify can read.";
        return {};
    }

    auto image = source.convertedToFormat (juce::Image::ARGB);
    const auto w = image.getWidth(), h = image.getHeight();

    // What's around the logo: transparent pixels, or (a picture with no transparency) the plain
    // colour of its corners.
    bool transparent = false;
    juce::Colour corner;

    {
        const juce::Image::BitmapData data (image, juce::Image::BitmapData::readOnly);

        for (int y = 0; y < h && ! transparent; y += juce::jmax (1, h / 64))
            for (int x = 0; x < w && ! transparent; x += juce::jmax (1, w / 64))
                transparent = data.getPixelColour (x, y).getAlpha() < 250;

        corner = data.getPixelColour (0, 0);
    }

    const auto isEmpty = [&] (juce::Colour c)
    {
        if (transparent)
            return c.getAlpha() < 12;

        return std::abs ((int) c.getRed() - (int) corner.getRed()) < 24 && std::abs ((int) c.getGreen() - (int) corner.getGreen()) < 24
            && std::abs ((int) c.getBlue() - (int) corner.getBlue()) < 24;
    };

    int left = w, right = -1, top = h, bottom = -1;

    {
        const juce::Image::BitmapData data (image, juce::Image::BitmapData::readOnly);

        for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x)
            {
                if (isEmpty (data.getPixelColour (x, y)))
                    continue;

                left = juce::jmin (left, x);
                right = juce::jmax (right, x);
                top = juce::jmin (top, y);
                bottom = juce::jmax (bottom, y);
            }
        }
    }

    if (right < left || bottom < top)
    {
        report = "The logo is empty: there's nothing on it but its background.";
        return {};
    }

    // A little room around it, then at most logoLongest pixels on its longer side.
    const auto pad = juce::jmax (2, juce::jmax (right - left, bottom - top) / 50);
    const auto crop = juce::Rectangle<int>::leftTopRightBottom (left - pad, top - pad, right + 1 + pad, bottom + 1 + pad)
                          .getIntersection (image.getBounds());
    auto logo = image.getClippedImage (crop).createCopy();
    const auto longest = juce::jmax (logo.getWidth(), logo.getHeight());

    if (longest > logoLongest)
    {
        const auto scale = (double) logoLongest / (double) longest;
        logo = logo.rescaled (juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt (logo.getWidth() * scale)), juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt (logo.getHeight() * scale)),
                              juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);
    }

    const auto size = [] (int a, int b) { return juce::String (a) + juce::String::fromUTF8 (" \xc3\x97 ") + juce::String (b); };

    report = "Your logo: " + size (w, h) + " px";

    if (crop != image.getBounds())
        report << ", trimmed to " << size (crop.getWidth(), crop.getHeight());

    report << ", kept at " << size (logo.getWidth(), logo.getHeight()) << ".";

    if (longest < logoSmall)
        report << " It's small, so it may look soft: one of " << logoSmall * 2 << " px or more looks sharper.";
    else if (! transparent)
        report << " A PNG with a transparent background sits best on the store's page.";

    return logo;
}

juce::Result StorePublisher::importLogo (const juce::File& file, juce::String& report)
{
    juce::Image source;

    if (file.hasFileExtension ("svg"))
    {
        // A drawing: drawn at twice the size kept, so it's sharp.
        if (auto drawable = juce::Drawable::createFromSVGFile (file))
        {
            const auto bounds = drawable->getDrawableBounds();

            if (! bounds.isEmpty())
            {
                const auto scale = (float) (logoLongest * 2) / juce::jmax (bounds.getWidth(), bounds.getHeight());
                source = juce::Image (juce::Image::ARGB, juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt (bounds.getWidth() * scale)),
                                      juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt (bounds.getHeight() * scale)), true);
                juce::Graphics g (source);
                drawable->drawWithin (g, source.getBounds().toFloat(), juce::RectanglePlacement::centred, 1.0f);
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        source = juce::ImageFileFormat::loadFrom (file);
    }

    const auto logo = fitLogo (source, report);

    if (! logo.isValid())
        return juce::Result::fail (report);

    const auto png = pngOf (logo, logoLongest);

    if (png.isEmpty() || ! logoFile().getParentDirectory().createDirectory() || ! logoFile().replaceWithData (png.getData(), png.getSize()))
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't keep the logo in " + folder().getFullPathName());

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

bool StorePublisher::isValidEmail (const juce::String& email)
{
    const auto text = email.trim();
    const auto at = text.indexOfChar ('@');

    if (text.length() < 6 || text.length() > 254 || text.containsAnyOf (" \t\r\n,;<>\"'") || at < 1 || at != text.lastIndexOfChar ('@'))
        return false;

    const auto domain = text.substring (at + 1);
    const auto dot = domain.lastIndexOfChar ('.');
    return dot > 0 && dot < domain.length() - 2 && ! domain.contains ("..");
}

juce::String StorePublisher::problemWith (const Listing& listing, const juce::Image& picture)
{
    if (listing.title.trim().isEmpty())
        return "Give it a title: its name in the store.";

    if (listing.isPaid())
    {
        if (listing.price < minimumPrice)
            return "A price starts at " + juce::String (minimumPrice, 2) + " (or make it free).";

        if (! isValidEmail (listing.paypal))
            return "Type the PayPal email buyers pay: the money goes straight to you.";
    }

    if (listing.story.trim().isEmpty())
        return "Write its story (or let Fanan AI write it): what buyers read in the store.";

    if (! StoreClient::sectionsFor (listing.kind).contains (listing.section))
        return "Choose its section in the store: where buyers look for it.";

    if (listing.video.trim().isNotEmpty() && StoreClient::youtubeId (listing.video).isEmpty())
        return "The video link isn't a YouTube video's link (or leave it empty).";

    if (! picture.isValid())
        return "Give it a picture: take the panel, or choose one.";

    return {};
}

StorePublisher::StorePublisher (FananServer& fananServer)
    : server (fananServer)
{
}

StorePublisher::~StorePublisher()
{
    alive->store (false);
    worker.removeAllJobs (true, 60000);
}

void StorePublisher::finishPost (const Posted& done, const juce::Result& result, const Listing& listing)
{
    posting = false;

    if (done != nullptr)
        done (result, listing);
}

void StorePublisher::post (Item item, Progress progress, Posted done)
{
    if (posting)
        return;

    const auto say = [progress] (const juce::String& step) { if (progress != nullptr) progress (step); };

    if (const auto problem = problemWith (item.listing, item.picture); problem.isNotEmpty())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail (problem), item.listing);

        return;
    }

    if (! server.isSignedIn())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("Sign in to your Fanan account first (in Build with AI): what you post is yours in the store."), item.listing);

        return;
    }

    // The panel's files as they are now: the studio may go on saving the project meanwhile.
    const auto work = makeWorkFolder();

    if (work == juce::File())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't make a folder for the files to send."), item.listing);

        return;
    }

    if (! item.isMidiFx)
    {
        const auto gui = work.getChildFile ("source gui");

        if (item.package.guiFolder.isDirectory() && item.package.guiFolder.copyDirectoryTo (gui))
            item.package.guiFolder = gui;
        else
            item.package.guiFolder = juce::File();

        const auto presets = work.getChildFile ("source presets.json");

        if (item.package.presetsFile.existsAsFile() && item.package.presetsFile.copyFileTo (presets))
            item.package.presetsFile = presets;
        else
            item.package.presetsFile = juce::File();
    }

    posting = true;
    say (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Asking the store\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    const auto& l = item.listing;
    auto fields = object();
    set (fields, "key", l.key);
    set (fields, "kind", l.kind);
    set (fields, "title", l.title);
    set (fields, "price", l.isPaid() ? l.price : 0.0);
    set (fields, "currency", l.currency);
    set (fields, "paypal", l.isPaid() ? l.paypal.trim() : juce::String());

    if (l.product.isNotEmpty())
        set (fields, "product", l.product);

    server.store ("begin", fields, [this, stillAlive = alive, item, work, say, done] (const juce::Result& begun, const juce::var& answer) mutable
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        if (begun.failed())
        {
            work.deleteRecursively();
            finishPost (done, begun, item.listing);
            return;
        }

        const auto product = answer.getProperty ("product", {}).toString().trim();
        const auto version = juce::jmax (1, (int) answer.getProperty ("version", item.listing.postedVersion + 1));
        const auto uploads = answer.getProperty ("uploads", {});
        const auto packageAddress = uploads.getProperty ("package", {}).toString();
        const auto pictureAddress = uploads.getProperty ("picture", {}).toString();
        const auto logoAddress = uploads.getProperty ("logo", {}).toString();   // a store that keeps logos gives it

        if (! WasmCompiler::isValidProductId (product) || (item.listing.product.isNotEmpty() && product != item.listing.product))
        {
            work.deleteRecursively();
            finishPost (done, juce::Result::fail ("The store's answer didn't make sense (its id for the plugin). Please try again later."), item.listing);
            return;
        }

        if (packageAddress.isEmpty() || pictureAddress.isEmpty())
        {
            work.deleteRecursively();
            finishPost (done, juce::Result::fail ("The store didn't say where to send the files. Please try again later."), item.listing);
            return;
        }

        // The id is the product's for good, from now on, posted or not.
        item.listing.product = product;
        save (item.listing);

        say (item.listing.isPaid() && ! item.isMidiFx ? juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Building it with its protection\xe2\x80\xa6")
                                                     : juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Packing it\xe2\x80\xa6"));

        auto sending = std::make_shared<Sending>();
        sending->listing = item.listing;
        sending->vendor = item.isMidiFx ? item.device.vendor : item.package.vendor;
        sending->product = product;
        sending->version = version;
        sending->say = say;
        sending->done = done;
        sending->packageAddress = packageAddress;
        sending->pictureAddress = pictureAddress;
        sending->logoAddress = logoAddress;

        worker.addJob ([this, stillAlive, item, work, sending]
        {
            auto prepared = prepare (item, sending->product, sending->version);
            sending->picture = pngOf (item.picture, pictureLongest);
            sending->logo = pngOf (loadLogo(), logoLongest);
            work.deleteRecursively();

            juce::MessageManager::callAsync ([this, stillAlive, sending, prepared = std::move (prepared)]
            {
                if (! stillAlive->load())
                    return;

                if (prepared.error.isNotEmpty())
                {
                    finishPost (sending->done, juce::Result::fail (prepared.error), sending->listing);
                    return;
                }

                sending->package = prepared.package;
                sendPackage (sending);
            });
        });
    });
}

void StorePublisher::sendPackage (std::shared_ptr<Sending> sending)
{
    sending->say (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Sending it to the store\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    server.upload (sending->packageAddress, sending->package, "application/zip", [this, stillAlive = alive, sending] (const juce::Result& sent, const juce::var&)
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        if (sent.failed())
            finishPost (sending->done, sent, sending->listing);
        else
            sendPicture (sending);
    });
}

void StorePublisher::sendPicture (std::shared_ptr<Sending> sending)
{
    sending->say (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Sending its picture\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    server.upload (sending->pictureAddress, sending->picture, "image/png", [this, stillAlive = alive, sending] (const juce::Result& sent, const juce::var&)
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        if (sent.failed())
            finishPost (sending->done, sent, sending->listing);
        else if (sending->logoAddress.isNotEmpty() && ! sending->logo.isEmpty())
            sendLogo (sending);
        else
            publish (sending);
    });
}

void StorePublisher::sendLogo (std::shared_ptr<Sending> sending)
{
    sending->say (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Sending your logo\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    server.upload (sending->logoAddress, sending->logo, "image/png", [this, stillAlive = alive, sending] (const juce::Result& sent, const juce::var&)
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        if (sent.failed())
        {
            finishPost (sending->done, sent, sending->listing);
            return;
        }

        sending->logoSent = true;
        publish (sending);
    });
}

void StorePublisher::publish (std::shared_ptr<Sending> sending)
{
    sending->say (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Putting it in the store\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    const auto& listing = sending->listing;
    const auto videoId = StoreClient::youtubeId (listing.video);

    auto details = object();
    set (details, "product", sending->product);
    set (details, "version", sending->version);
    set (details, "key", listing.key);
    set (details, "kind", listing.kind);
    set (details, "title", listing.title);
    set (details, "tagline", listing.tagline);
    set (details, "story", listing.story);
    set (details, "section", listing.section);
    set (details, "video", videoId.isNotEmpty() ? "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=" + videoId : juce::String());

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& feature : listing.features)
        list.add (feature);

    set (details, "features", list);
    set (details, "price", listing.isPaid() ? listing.price : 0.0);
    set (details, "currency", listing.currency);
    set (details, "paypal", listing.isPaid() ? listing.paypal.trim() : juce::String());
    set (details, "vendor", sending->vendor);
    set (details, "protected", listing.isPaid());
    set (details, "packageSize", (juce::int64) sending->package.getSize());
    set (details, "packageSha256", juce::SHA256 (sending->package).toHexString());
    set (details, "pictureSize", (juce::int64) sending->picture.getSize());
    set (details, "logo", sending->logoSent);

    server.store ("publish", details, [this, stillAlive = alive, sending] (const juce::Result& published, const juce::var&)
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        auto posted = sending->listing;

        if (published.wasOk())
        {
            posted.postedVersion = sending->version;
            posted.postedAt = juce::Time::getCurrentTime().toISO8601 (true);
            save (posted);
        }

        finishPost (sending->done, published, posted);
    });
}

//==============================================================================
StorePublisher::Prepared StorePublisher::prepare (const Item& item, const juce::String& product, int version)
{
    Prepared result;
    const auto work = makeWorkFolder();

    if (work == juce::File())
    {
        result.error = "Couldn't make a folder for the files to send.";
        return result;
    }

    const auto store = [&]
    {
        auto p = item.listing.toProduct();
        p.id = product;
        return p;
    }();

    if (item.isMidiFx)
    {
        // Its last build, with the store's details: its code and its conversation stay here.
        auto device = item.device;
        device.sources.clear();
        device.chat = juce::var();
        device.store = store;

        if (device.wasm.isEmpty())
        {
            result.error = "The MIDI FX hasn't been built yet: ask Fanan AI to build it first.";
        }
        else
        {
            const auto folder = work.getChildFile ("package");
            const auto file = folder.getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (device.name.trim().isNotEmpty() ? device.name.trim()
                                                                                                                   : juce::String ("MIDI FX"))
                                                   + Devices::fileExtension);

            if (! folder.createDirectory())
                result.error = "Couldn't make a folder for the files to send.";
            else if (const auto written = device.write (file); written.failed())
                result.error = written.getErrorMessage();
            else if (const auto zipped = zipFolder (folder, result.package); zipped.failed())
                result.error = zipped.getErrorMessage();
        }

        work.deleteRecursively();
        return result;
    }

    auto package = item.package;
    package.projectId = "store-" + product;   // its own id in Sonify: never the seller's project
    package.store = store;

    if (item.listing.isPaid())
    {
        // Built again with its protection: the store's id inside it, so it asks for its own
        // licence whatever its files say.
        const auto compiled = WasmCompiler::compile (item.projectFolder, item.package.projectId, product);

        if (! compiled.ok)
        {
            result.error = "The protected build failed. Ask Fanan AI to look at the build log, then post again.\n\n"
                         + compiled.log.trim().substring (0, 1500);
            work.deleteRecursively();
            return result;
        }

        juce::MemoryBlock data;
        compiled.wasm.loadFileAsData (data);
        package.wasm.assign (static_cast<const std::uint8_t*> (data.getData()), static_cast<const std::uint8_t*> (data.getData()) + data.getSize());

        // It has to start, and say it's this product.
        std::string error;
        const auto plugin = WasmPlugin::load (package.wasm, 48000.0, 512, error);

        if (plugin == nullptr)
        {
            result.error = "The protected build doesn't start: " + juce::String (error);
            work.deleteRecursively();
            return result;
        }

        package.description = plugin->getDescription();
        const auto said = juce::JSON::parse (juce::String (juce::CharPointer_UTF8 (package.description.c_str())));

        if (said.getProperty ("product", {}).toString() != product)
        {
            result.error = "The protected build didn't take the store's id. Please post again.";
            work.deleteRecursively();
            return result;
        }
    }

    const auto folder = work.getChildFile ("package");
    const auto name = package.name.trim().isNotEmpty() ? package.name.trim() : juce::String ("My Plugin");
    const auto target = folder.getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (name) + MadePlugins::extension);

    if (! folder.createDirectory())
        result.error = "Couldn't make a folder for the files to send.";
    else if (const auto written = MadePlugins::writeFolder (package, target, version); written.failed())
        result.error = written.getErrorMessage();
    else if (const auto zipped = zipFolder (folder, result.package); zipped.failed())
        result.error = zipped.getErrorMessage();

    work.deleteRecursively();
    return result;
}

juce::Result StorePublisher::zipFolder (const juce::File& source, juce::MemoryBlock& out)
{
    juce::ZipFile::Builder zip;
    int count = 0;

    for (const auto& entry : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (source, true, "*", juce::File::findFiles))
    {
        const auto file = entry.getFile();
        zip.addFile (file, 9, file.getRelativePathFrom (source).replaceCharacter ('\\', '/'));
        ++count;
    }

    if (count == 0)
        return juce::Result::fail ("There was nothing to send.");

    out.reset();
    juce::MemoryOutputStream stream (out, false);

    if (! zip.writeToStream (stream, nullptr))
        return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't pack the files to send.");

    stream.flush();
    return juce::Result::ok();
}

juce::MemoryBlock StorePublisher::pngOf (const juce::Image& image, int longest)
{
    if (! image.isValid())
        return {};

    auto picture = image;
    const auto scale = (float) longest / (float) juce::jmax (picture.getWidth(), picture.getHeight());

    if (scale < 1.0f)
        picture = picture.rescaled (juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt ((float) picture.getWidth() * scale)),
                                    juce::jmax (1, juce::roundToInt ((float) picture.getHeight() * scale)),
                                    juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);

    juce::MemoryOutputStream encoded;
    juce::PNGImageFormat().writeImageToStream (picture, encoded);
    return encoded.getMemoryBlock();
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String StorePublisher::storyGuide()
{
    return R"(You write store listings for Sonify's store: plugins and MIDI FX that Sonify users made in Sonify's Plugins Creator Studio and sell or give to other users.

You get facts about one product (from its code: its modules, parameters, controls and what they do) and, usually, a picture of its panel. Write its listing from these alone.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"tagline": "...", "story": "...", "features": ["...", "..."], "section": "..."}

- tagline: one line, at most 100 characters: what it is and why someone wants it.
- story: 90 to 220 words, two or three short paragraphs separated by a blank line. What it sounds like, what it's good for (styles, uses), how it plays. Warm and concrete, never hype.
- features: 3 to 6 short lines, at most 80 characters each, each a real thing it has (a module, a control, a mode).
- section: where it belongs in the store, exactly one of the sections listed in the request.
- Only what the facts and the picture show: never invent features, presets, formats or numbers.
- Never mention prices, licences, AI, code, WebAssembly or how it was made. It plays inside Sonify only: never mention VST, AU, CLAP or other hosts.
- The language of the product's name and of the seller's notes, if they wrote some; otherwise English.)";
}

bool StorePublisher::readStory (const juce::var& answer, Listing& story, juce::String& why)
{
    juce::String text = answer.getProperty ("reply", {}).toString();

    if (const auto* blocks = answer.getProperty ("content", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& block : *blocks)
            if (block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString() == "text")
                text << block.getProperty ("text", {}).toString() << "\n";

    const auto start = text.indexOfChar ('{');
    const auto end = text.lastIndexOfChar ('}');

    if (start < 0 || end <= start)
    {
        why = "Fanan AI didn't write the story this time. Please try again.";
        return false;
    }

    const auto parsed = juce::JSON::parse (text.substring (start, end + 1));
    const auto storyText = limited (parsed.getProperty ("story", {}).toString(), maxStory);

    if (storyText.isEmpty())
    {
        why = "Fanan AI didn't write the story this time. Please try again.";
        return false;
    }

    story.story = storyText;
    story.tagline = limited (parsed.getProperty ("tagline", {}).toString(), maxTagline);

    if (const auto section = parsed.getProperty ("section", {}).toString().trim(); StoreClient::sectionsFor (story.kind).contains (section))
        story.section = section;
    story.features.clear();

    if (const auto* list = parsed.getProperty ("features", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& feature : *list)
            if (const auto line = limited (feature.toString(), maxFeature); line.isNotEmpty() && story.features.size() < maxFeatures)
                story.features.add (line);

    return true;
}

void StorePublisher::writeStory (const juce::String& facts, const juce::Image& picture, const Listing& current, Written done)
{
    if (writing)
        return;

    if (! server.isSignedIn())
    {
        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::fail ("Sign in to your Fanan account first (in Build with AI): Fanan AI's story uses credits."), current);

        return;
    }

    juce::Array<juce::var> content;

    if (const auto png = pngOf (picture, storyPictureLongest); ! png.isEmpty())
    {
        auto source = object();
        set (source, "type", "base64");
        set (source, "media_type", "image/png");
        set (source, "data", juce::Base64::toBase64 (png.getData(), png.getSize()));

        auto block = object();
        set (block, "type", "image");
        set (block, "source", source);
        content.add (block);
    }

    juce::String request;
    request << "Write the store listing for \"" << current.title << "\", " << kindName (current.kind) << ".";

    if (const auto& sections = StoreClient::sectionsFor (current.kind); ! sections.isEmpty())
        request << "\nIts section, one of: " << sections.joinIntoString (" | ") << ".";

    if (current.story.trim().isNotEmpty() || current.tagline.trim().isNotEmpty())
        request << "\n\nThe seller's notes so far (keep what's true in them):\n" << current.tagline.trim() << "\n" << current.story.trim();

    auto text = object();
    set (text, "type", "text");
    set (text, "text", request);
    content.add (text);

    auto message = object();
    set (message, "role", "user");
    set (message, "content", content);

    auto body = object();
    set (body, "mode", "chat");
    set (body, "purpose", "store_story");
    set (body, "guide", storyGuide());
    set (body, "context", facts.substring (0, maxFactsLength));
    set (body, "messages", juce::Array<juce::var> { message });
    set (body, "tools", juce::Array<juce::var>());
    set (body, "request_id", juce::Uuid().toString());

    writing = true;

    server.stellaChat (body, [this, stillAlive = alive, current, done] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        if (! stillAlive->load())
            return;

        writing = false;
        auto story = current;

        if (result.failed())
        {
            if (done != nullptr)
                done (result, current);

            return;
        }

        juce::String why;

        if (! readStory (answer, story, why))
        {
            if (done != nullptr)
                done (juce::Result::fail (why), current);

            return;
        }

        if (done != nullptr)
            done (juce::Result::ok(), story);
    });
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\StorePublisher.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include "CreatorPlugin.h"
#include "DeviceFiles.h"
#include "FananServer.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Protection tab's work: a plugin or MIDI FX made here, posted to Sonify's store.

    What the seller sets is kept on this computer, one listing per plugin project (by its id)
    or MIDI FX (by its id), in <user data>\Plugins Creator\Store: free or a price, the PayPal
    email buyers pay, the store's title, tagline, story and features, and its picture. Once
    posted, the store's id for it stays for good: every later post is a new version of the
    same product, and every licence names it.

    Posting:
        1. "begin": the store gives the product's id (the first time), the version, and where
           to send the files;
        2. a paid plugin is built again with its protection built in (WasmCompiler, the
           store's id inside it: no licence, its demo); a free one goes as it plays. A MIDI FX
           goes as its last build, without its code or its conversation;
        3. the package (the made plugin's folder, as Add to Sonify writes it, zipped; or the
           MIDI FX's file, zipped) and the picture are sent;
        4. "publish": the store lists it (open to every user).

    The buyer pays the seller directly (PayPal), no commission; Fanan AI's story is what's
    charged (credits), when the seller asks for it.

    Message thread; the build and the packing run on a worker of its own.
*/
class StorePublisher final
{
public:
    //==========================================================================
    struct Listing
    {
        juce::String key;            // what it's for: the project's id, or the MIDI FX's
        juce::String kind;           // "instrument", "effect", "widget" or "midifx"
        juce::String product;        // the store's id, from the first post on (empty: never posted)
        juce::String title, tagline, story;
        juce::String section;        // one of its kind's sections in the store (StoreClient::sectionsFor)
        juce::String video;          // a YouTube link: its demo, played on its page in the store (empty: none)
        juce::StringArray features;
        double price = 0.0;          // 0: free
        juce::String currency { "USD" };
        juce::String paypal;         // the seller's PayPal email (paid only)
        int postedVersion = 0;       // 0: never posted
        juce::String postedAt;       // ISO time of the last post

        bool isPaid() const noexcept                 { return price > 0.0; }
        bool wasPosted() const noexcept              { return product.isNotEmpty() && postedVersion > 0; }
        Licences::Product toProduct() const;         // what goes into the package ("store")

        juce::var toVar() const;
        static Listing fromVar (const juce::var& value);
    };

    static constexpr double minimumPrice = 0.99, maximumPrice = 999.99;
    static constexpr int maxTitle = 80, maxTagline = 140, maxStory = 6000, maxFeatures = 10, maxFeature = 120;

    /** The currencies a price can be in: the store's (sonifyStore's CURRENCIES). */
    static const juce::StringArray& currencies();

    /** Where listings and their pictures are kept: <user data>\Plugins Creator\Store. */
    static juce::File folder();

    /** A listing as it was left (a new one, with key and kind, when there's none). */
    static Listing load (const juce::String& key, const juce::String& kind);
    static juce::Result save (const Listing& listing);

    /** Its picture (the store's), kept beside it. */
    static juce::File pictureFile (const juce::String& key);
    static juce::Image loadPicture (const juce::String& key);
    static juce::Result savePicture (const juce::String& key, const juce::Image& picture);

    //==========================================================================
    /** The developer's logo, on the store's page of everything they post: one for all their
        products, kept beside the listings (developer-logo.png). */
    static juce::File logoFile();
    static juce::Image loadLogo();
    static void removeLogo();

    /** A logo file (PNG, JPEG, GIF or SVG) made ready and kept: its empty margins trimmed off
        (transparent, or the plain colour around it), then fitted to logoLongest pixels on its
        longer side. report says what was measured and done. */
    static juce::Result importLogo (const juce::File& file, juce::String& report);

    /** The same for a picture already loaded: the logo as it's kept (invalid when it's empty). */
    static juce::Image fitLogo (const juce::Image& source, juce::String& report);

    static constexpr int logoLongest = 512, logoSmall = 128;

    /** What's missing before it can be posted (empty: nothing). */
    static juce::String problemWith (const Listing& listing, const juce::Image& picture);

    static bool isValidEmail (const juce::String& email);

    //==========================================================================
    /** What's posted. A plugin: its package as Add to Sonify makes it, and its project's folder
        (a paid one is built again from it, protected). A MIDI FX: its file as it is. */
    struct Item
    {
        Listing listing;
        juce::Image picture;

        bool isMidiFx = false;
        MadePlugins::Package package;      // a plugin
        juce::File projectFolder;          // ...built from here when it's paid
        Devices::DeviceFile device;        // a MIDI FX
    };

    explicit StorePublisher (FananServer& server);
    ~StorePublisher();

    using Progress = std::function<void (const juce::String& step)>;
    using Posted = std::function<void (const juce::Result& result, const Listing& listing)>;
    using Written = std::function<void (const juce::Result& result, const Listing& story)>;

    /** Posts it (see above). done gets the listing as the store has it now (its id, version). */
    void post (Item item, Progress progress, Posted done);

    /** Fanan AI writes the store's title, tagline, story and features from facts (what the
        plugin is, from its code) and its picture: charged in credits. done gets them in a copy
        of current. */
    void writeStory (const juce::String& facts, const juce::Image& picture, const Listing& current, Written done);

    bool isPosting() const noexcept     { return posting; }
    bool isWriting() const noexcept     { return writing; }

private:
    struct Prepared
    {
        juce::String error;
        juce::MemoryBlock package;
    };

    static Prepared prepare (const Item& item, const juce::String& product, int version);
    static juce::Result zipFolder (const juce::File& source, juce::MemoryBlock& out);
    static juce::MemoryBlock pngOf (const juce::Image& image, int longest);
    static juce::String storyGuide();
    static bool readStory (const juce::var& answer, Listing& story, juce::String& why);

    void finishPost (const Posted& done, const juce::Result& result, const Listing& listing);

    /** A post under way, once its package is made: the files go one after the other, then publish. */
    struct Sending
    {
        Listing listing;
        juce::String vendor, product;
        int version = 0;
        Progress say;
        Posted done;
        juce::String packageAddress, pictureAddress, logoAddress;
        juce::MemoryBlock package, picture, logo;
        bool logoSent = false;
    };

    void sendPackage (std::shared_ptr<Sending> sending);
    void sendPicture (std::shared_ptr<Sending> sending);
    void sendLogo (std::shared_ptr<Sending> sending);
    void publish (std::shared_ptr<Sending> sending);

    FananServer& server;
    bool posting = false, writing = false;
    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> alive = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>> (true);

    // Last, so it's the first to go: a build that's under way finishes while the rest exists.
    juce::ThreadPool worker { juce::ThreadPoolOptions{}.withThreadName ("Store").withNumberOfThreads (1) };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (StorePublisher)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\TempoMap.cpp

#include "TempoMap.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    constexpr double tiny = 1.0e-9;

    double number (const juce::var& value, double fallback)
    {
        const auto result = value.isDouble() || value.isInt() || value.isInt64() || value.isBool() ? static_cast<double> (value) : fallback;
        return std::isfinite (result) ? result : fallback;
    }

    /** A whole number from a song or the page, in a range an int holds. */
    int whole (const juce::var& value, double fallback)
    {
        return static_cast<int> (juce::jlimit (-1.0e6, 1.0e6, number (value, fallback)));
    }
}

//==============================================================================
bool TempoMap::Tempo::operator== (const Tempo& other) const noexcept
{
    return juce::exactlyEqual (ppq, other.ppq) && juce::exactlyEqual (bpm, other.bpm) && ramp == other.ramp;
}

bool TempoMap::Signature::operator== (const Signature& other) const noexcept
{
    return bar == other.bar && numerator == other.numerator && denominator == other.denominator;
}

bool TempoMap::Key::operator== (const Key& other) const noexcept
{
    return bar == other.bar && root == other.root && scale == other.scale;
}

bool TempoMap::operator== (const TempoMap& other) const noexcept
{
    return tempos == other.tempos && signatures == other.signatures && keys == other.keys;
}

//==============================================================================
TempoMap::TempoMap()
{
    tempos = { Tempo {} };
    signatures = { Signature {} };
    keys = { Key {} };
    rebuild();
}

bool TempoMap::isValidDenominator (int value) noexcept
{
    return value == 1 || value == 2 || value == 4 || value == 8 || value == 16 || value == 32;
}

const juce::StringArray& TempoMap::getScales()
{
    static const juce::StringArray scales { "major", "minor", "dorian", "phrygian", "lydian", "mixolydian", "locrian",
                                            "harmonic minor", "melodic minor", "major pentatonic", "minor pentatonic",
                                            "blues", "chromatic" };
    return scales;
}

juce::uint16 TempoMap::scaleNotes (const juce::String& scale) noexcept
{
    // In getScales()'s order.
    static constexpr juce::uint16 notes[] = {
        0x0ab5,   // major              0 2 4 5 7 9 11
        0x05ad,   // minor              0 2 3 5 7 8 10
        0x06ad,   // dorian             0 2 3 5 7 9 10
        0x05ab,   // phrygian           0 1 3 5 7 8 10
        0x0ad5,   // lydian             0 2 4 6 7 9 11
        0x06b5,   // mixolydian         0 2 4 5 7 9 10
        0x056b,   // locrian            0 1 3 5 6 8 10
        0x09ad,   // harmonic minor     0 2 3 5 7 8 11
        0x0aad,   // melodic minor      0 2 3 5 7 9 11
        0x0295,   // major pentatonic   0 2 4 7 9
        0x04a9,   // minor pentatonic   0 3 5 7 10
        0x04e9,   // blues              0 3 5 6 7 10
        0x0fff    // chromatic
    };

    const auto index = getScales().indexOf (scale);
    return index >= 0 && index < static_cast<int> (std::size (notes)) ? notes[index] : notes[0];
}

juce::String TempoMap::keyName (const Key& key)
{
    static const char* names[] = { "C", "C#", "D", "Eb", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "Ab", "A", "Bb", "B" };
    return juce::String (names[juce::jlimit (0, 11, key.root)]) + " " + key.scale;
}

//==============================================================================
void TempoMap::setTempos (std::vector<Tempo> list)
{
    list.erase (std::remove_if (list.begin(), list.end(), [] (const Tempo& t) { return ! std::isfinite (t.ppq) || ! std::isfinite (t.bpm); }),
                list.end());

    for (auto& tempo : list)
    {
        tempo.ppq = juce::jmax (0.0, tempo.ppq);
        tempo.bpm = juce::jlimit (minTempo, maxTempo, tempo.bpm);
    }

    std::stable_sort (list.begin(), list.end(), [] (const Tempo& a, const Tempo& b) { return a.ppq < b.ppq; });

    // One per position: the last one given there.
    std::vector<Tempo> tidy;

    for (const auto& tempo : list)
    {
        if (! tidy.empty() && std::abs (tidy.back().ppq - tempo.ppq) < tiny)
            tidy.back() = tempo;
        else
            tidy.push_back (tempo);
    }

    if (tidy.empty())
        tidy.push_back ({});

    tidy.front().ppq = 0.0;
    tidy.back().ramp = false;   // nothing after it to glide to
    tempos = std::move (tidy);
    rebuild();
}

void TempoMap::setSignatures (std::vector<Signature> list)
{
    list.erase (std::remove_if (list.begin(), list.end(), [] (const Signature& s) { return ! isValidDenominator (s.denominator); }),
                list.end());

    for (auto& signature : list)
    {
        signature.bar = juce::jlimit (0, maxBar, signature.bar);
        signature.numerator = juce::jlimit (1, 32, signature.numerator);
    }

    std::stable_sort (list.begin(), list.end(), [] (const Signature& a, const Signature& b) { return a.bar < b.bar; });

    std::vector<Signature> tidy;

    for (const auto& signature : list)
    {
        if (! tidy.empty() && tidy.back().bar == signature.bar)
            tidy.back() = signature;
        else
            tidy.push_back (signature);
    }

    if (tidy.empty())
        tidy.push_back ({});

    tidy.front().bar = 0;
    signatures = std::move (tidy);
    rebuild();
}

void TempoMap::setKeys (std::vector<Key> list)
{
    for (auto& key : list)
    {
        key.bar = juce::jlimit (0, maxBar, key.bar);
        key.root = ((key.root % 12) + 12) % 12;

        if (! getScales().contains (key.scale))
            key.scale = "major";
    }

    std::stable_sort (list.begin(), list.end(), [] (const Key& a, const Key& b) { return a.bar < b.bar; });

    std::vector<Key> tidy;

    for (const auto& key : list)
    {
        if (! tidy.empty() && tidy.back().bar == key.bar)
            tidy.back() = key;
        else
            tidy.push_back (key);
    }

    if (tidy.empty())
        tidy.push_back ({});

    tidy.front().bar = 0;
    keys = std::move (tidy);
}

void TempoMap::rebuild()
{
    tempoSeconds.assign (tempos.size(), 0.0);

    for (size_t i = 1; i < tempos.size(); ++i)
        tempoSeconds[i] = tempoSeconds[i - 1] + secondsIn (i - 1, tempos[i].ppq);

    signaturePpq.assign (signatures.size(), 0.0);

    for (size_t i = 1; i < signatures.size(); ++i)
    {
        const auto& before = signatures[i - 1];
        signaturePpq[i] = signaturePpq[i - 1] + static_cast<double> (signatures[i].bar - before.bar) * before.numerator * 4.0 / before.denominator;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
double TempoMap::secondsIn (size_t index, double ppq) const noexcept
{
    // From tempos[index] to ppq (at most to the next change).
    const auto& from = tempos[index];
    const auto distance = ppq - from.ppq;

    if (from.ramp && index + 1 < tempos.size())
    {
        const auto& to = tempos[index + 1];
        const auto span = to.ppq - from.ppq;
        const auto slope = span > tiny ? (to.bpm - from.bpm) / span : 0.0;

        // The tempo rises (or falls) in a straight line over the quarter notes: time is its log.
        if (std::abs (slope) > 1.0e-12)
            return 60.0 / slope * std::log ((from.bpm + slope * distance) / from.bpm);
    }

    return distance * 60.0 / from.bpm;
}

double TempoMap::secondsAt (double ppq) const noexcept
{
    if (! std::isfinite (ppq) || ppq <= 0.0)
        return 0.0;

    const auto after = std::upper_bound (tempos.begin(), tempos.end(), ppq, [] (double p, const Tempo& t) { return p < t.ppq; });
    const auto index = static_cast<size_t> (std::distance (tempos.begin(), after) - 1);
    return tempoSeconds[index] + secondsIn (index, ppq);
}

double TempoMap::ppqAt (double seconds) const noexcept
{
    if (! std::isfinite (seconds) || seconds <= 0.0)
        return 0.0;

    const auto after = std::upper_bound (tempoSeconds.begin(), tempoSeconds.end(), seconds);
    const auto index = static_cast<size_t> (std::distance (tempoSeconds.begin(), after) - 1);
    const auto& from = tempos[index];
    const auto into = seconds - tempoSeconds[index];

    if (from.ramp && index + 1 < tempos.size())
    {
        const auto& to = tempos[index + 1];
        const auto span = to.ppq - from.ppq;
        const auto slope = span > tiny ? (to.bpm - from.bpm) / span : 0.0;

        if (std::abs (slope) > 1.0e-12)
            return from.ppq + from.bpm / slope * (std::exp (slope * into / 60.0) - 1.0);
    }

    return from.ppq + into * from.bpm / 60.0;
}

double TempoMap::bpmAt (double ppq) const noexcept
{
    ppq = std::isfinite (ppq) ? juce::jmax (0.0, ppq) : 0.0;
    const auto after = std::upper_bound (tempos.begin(), tempos.end(), ppq, [] (double p, const Tempo& t) { return p < t.ppq; });
    const auto index = static_cast<size_t> (juce::jmax<std::ptrdiff_t> (0, std::distance (tempos.begin(), after) - 1));
    const auto& from = tempos[index];

    if (from.ramp && index + 1 < tempos.size())
    {
        const auto& to = tempos[index + 1];
        const auto span = to.ppq - from.ppq;

        if (span > tiny)
            return from.bpm + (to.bpm - from.bpm) * juce::jlimit (0.0, 1.0, (ppq - from.ppq) / span);
    }

    return from.bpm;
}

//==============================================================================
TempoMap::Bar TempoMap::barAt (double ppq) const noexcept
{
    ppq = std::isfinite (ppq) ? juce::jmax (0.0, ppq) : 0.0;
    const auto after = std::upper_bound (signaturePpq.begin(), signaturePpq.end(), ppq + tiny);
    const auto index = static_cast<size_t> (juce::jmax<std::ptrdiff_t> (0, std::distance (signaturePpq.begin(), after) - 1));
    const auto& signature = signatures[index];
    const auto length = signature.numerator * 4.0 / signature.denominator;
    const auto bars = juce::jlimit (0.0, static_cast<double> (maxBar), std::floor ((ppq - signaturePpq[index]) / length + tiny));

    Bar bar;
    bar.index = juce::jmin (maxBar, signature.bar + static_cast<int> (bars));
    bar.start = signaturePpq[index] + static_cast<double> (bar.index - signature.bar) * length;
    bar.numerator = signature.numerator;
    bar.denominator = signature.denominator;
    return bar;
}

double TempoMap::ppqOfBar (int index) const noexcept
{
    index = juce::jlimit (0, maxBar, index);
    const auto after = std::upper_bound (signatures.begin(), signatures.end(), index, [] (int i, const Signature& s) { return i < s.bar; });
    const auto which = static_cast<size_t> (std::distance (signatures.begin(), after) - 1);
    const auto& signature = signatures[which];
    return signaturePpq[which] + static_cast<double> (index - signature.bar) * signature.numerator * 4.0 / signature.denominator;
}

TempoMap::Signature TempoMap::signatureAt (double ppq) const noexcept
{
    const auto bar = barAt (ppq);
    return { bar.index, bar.numerator, bar.denominator };
}

TempoMap::Key TempoMap::keyAt (double ppq) const noexcept
{
    const auto bar = barAt (ppq).index;
    const auto after = std::upper_bound (keys.begin(), keys.end(), bar, [] (int i, const Key& k) { return i < k.bar; });
    return *(after - 1);
}

double TempoMap::nearestBar (double ppq) const noexcept
{
    const auto bar = barAt (ppq);
    return ppq - bar.start < bar.length() / 2.0 ? bar.start : bar.start + bar.length();
}

double TempoMap::quantized (double ppq, double grid, double swing, double strength) const noexcept
{
    const auto t = juce::jmax (0.0, ppq);
    const auto bar = barAt (t);
    const auto barEnd = bar.start + bar.length();
    const auto step = grid > 1.0e-6 ? grid : 0.25;
    auto target = t;

    if (step >= bar.length() - 1.0e-9)
    {
        target = t - bar.start <= barEnd - t ? bar.start : barEnd;
    }
    else
    {
        // The grid from the bar's start, every second point swung later; the bar's end is one too.
        const auto shift = juce::jlimit (0.0, 1.0, swing) * step / 3.0;
        const auto k = static_cast<int> (std::floor ((t - bar.start) / step));
        auto distance = std::abs (barEnd - t);
        target = barEnd;

        for (int j = juce::jmax (0, k - 1); j <= k + 2; ++j)
        {
            const auto at = juce::jmin (barEnd, bar.start + j * step + ((j % 2) != 0 ? shift : 0.0));

            if (std::abs (at - t) < distance)
            {
                target = at;
                distance = std::abs (at - t);
            }
        }
    }

    return t + (target - t) * juce::jlimit (0.0, 1.0, strength);
}

//==============================================================================
TempoMap TempoMap::withTempoAt (double ppq, double bpm) const
{
    auto copy = *this;
    auto list = tempos;
    const auto at = std::isfinite (ppq) ? juce::jmax (0.0, ppq) : 0.0;
    const auto after = std::upper_bound (list.begin(), list.end(), at + tiny, [] (double p, const Tempo& t) { return p < t.ppq; });
    (after - 1)->bpm = bpm;
    copy.setTempos (std::move (list));
    return copy;
}

TempoMap TempoMap::withSignatureAt (double ppq, int numerator, int denominator) const
{
    if (! isValidDenominator (denominator))
        return *this;

    auto copy = *this;
    auto list = signatures;
    const auto bar = barAt (ppq).index;
    const auto after = std::upper_bound (list.begin(), list.end(), bar, [] (int i, const Signature& s) { return i < s.bar; });
    (after - 1)->numerator = numerator;
    (after - 1)->denominator = denominator;
    copy.setSignatures (std::move (list));
    return copy;
}

TempoMap TempoMap::withOneTempo (double bpm) const
{
    auto copy = *this;
    copy.setTempos ({ { 0.0, bpm, false } });
    return copy;
}

//==============================================================================
juce::var TempoMap::toVar() const
{
    juce::Array<juce::var> tempoList, signatureList, keyList;

    for (const auto& tempo : tempos)
        tempoList.add (juce::Array<juce::var> { tempo.ppq, tempo.bpm, tempo.ramp });

    for (const auto& signature : signatures)
        signatureList.add (juce::Array<juce::var> { signature.bar, signature.numerator, signature.denominator });

    for (const auto& key : keys)
        keyList.add (juce::Array<juce::var> { key.bar, key.root, key.scale });

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr object (new juce::DynamicObject());
    object->setProperty ("tempos", tempoList);
    object->setProperty ("signatures", signatureList);
    object->setProperty ("keys", keyList);
    return juce::var (object.get());
}

TempoMap TempoMap::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    TempoMap map;

    if (const auto* list = value.getProperty ("tempos", {}).getArray(); list != nullptr && ! list->isEmpty())
    {
        std::vector<Tempo> read;

        for (const auto& item : *list)
            if (const auto* fields = item.getArray(); fields != nullptr && fields->size() >= 2)
                read.push_back ({ number ((*fields)[0], -1.0), number ((*fields)[1], 120.0), fields->size() > 2 && static_cast<bool> ((*fields)[2]) });

        read.erase (std::remove_if (read.begin(), read.end(), [] (const Tempo& t) { return t.ppq < 0.0; }), read.end());

        if (! read.empty())
            map.setTempos (std::move (read));
    }

    if (const auto* list = value.getProperty ("signatures", {}).getArray(); list != nullptr && ! list->isEmpty())
    {
        std::vector<Signature> read;

        for (const auto& item : *list)
            if (const auto* fields = item.getArray(); fields != nullptr && fields->size() >= 3)
                read.push_back ({ whole ((*fields)[0], -1.0), whole ((*fields)[1], 4.0), whole ((*fields)[2], 4.0) });

        read.erase (std::remove_if (read.begin(), read.end(), [] (const Signature& s) { return s.bar < 0; }), read.end());

        if (! read.empty())
            map.setSignatures (std::move (read));
    }

    if (const auto* list = value.getProperty ("keys", {}).getArray(); list != nullptr && ! list->isEmpty())
    {
        std::vector<Key> read;

        for (const auto& item : *list)
            if (const auto* fields = item.getArray(); fields != nullptr && fields->size() >= 3)
                read.push_back ({ whole ((*fields)[0], -1.0), whole ((*fields)[1], 0.0), (*fields)[2].toString() });

        read.erase (std::remove_if (read.begin(), read.end(), [] (const Key& k) { return k.bar < 0; }), read.end());

        if (! read.empty())
            map.setKeys (std::move (read));
    }

    return map;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\TempoMap.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The song channel's map of the song in time, as Studio One's global tracks keep it:
        Tempo        changes at song positions (quarter notes); each holds until the next, or
                     (ramp) glides there in a straight line
        Signature    time signature changes, each from the start of a bar
        Key          key and scale changes, each from the start of a bar (MIDI tools follow them)
    There is always one of each at the start of the song.

    It turns song positions (quarter notes) into seconds and back, says the tempo anywhere, and
    finds the bars: where each starts, how long it is and how it's counted. Bars are counted from
    0 here; the page shows them from 1.

    A value: copied freely, compared, and kept in songs as plain data (toVar, fromVar).
*/
class TempoMap final
{
public:
    struct Tempo
    {
        double ppq = 0.0;
        double bpm = 120.0;
        bool ramp = false;                  // glides to the next change's tempo

        bool operator== (const Tempo& other) const noexcept;
    };

    struct Signature
    {
        int bar = 0;
        int numerator = 4, denominator = 4;

        bool operator== (const Signature& other) const noexcept;
    };

    struct Key
    {
        int bar = 0;
        int root = 0;                       // 0 C .. 11 B
        juce::String scale { "major" };     // see getScales()

        bool operator== (const Key& other) const noexcept;
    };

    /** A bar: where it starts (quarter notes), and its time signature. */
    struct Bar
    {
        int index = 0;
        double start = 0.0;
        int numerator = 4, denominator = 4;

        double beat() const noexcept        { return 4.0 / denominator; }
        double length() const noexcept      { return numerator * beat(); }
    };

    static constexpr double minTempo = 20.0;
    static constexpr double maxTempo = 250.0;
    static constexpr int maxBar = 100000;

    /** 120 BPM, 4/4 and C major all through. */
    TempoMap();

    //==============================================================================
    /** Each list is tidied: in order, one per position, values in range, and the first at the
        start of the song (the earliest one moves there when none is). */
    void setTempos (std::vector<Tempo> list);
    void setSignatures (std::vector<Signature> list);
    void setKeys (std::vector<Key> list);

    const std::vector<Tempo>& getTempos() const noexcept            { return tempos; }
    const std::vector<Signature>& getSignatures() const noexcept    { return signatures; }
    const std::vector<Key>& getKeys() const noexcept                { return keys; }

    /** One tempo all through, no ramps. */
    bool hasOneTempo() const noexcept                               { return tempos.size() == 1; }

    //==============================================================================
    double secondsAt (double ppq) const noexcept;
    double ppqAt (double seconds) const noexcept;
    double bpmAt (double ppq) const noexcept;

    Bar barAt (double ppq) const noexcept;
    double ppqOfBar (int index) const noexcept;
    Signature signatureAt (double ppq) const noexcept;
    Key keyAt (double ppq) const noexcept;

    /** The nearest bar line to a position. */
    double nearestBar (double ppq) const noexcept;

    /** A position moved toward the nearest point of a quantize grid (quarter notes), laid from
        the start of the bar it's in: a grid of a bar or more is the nearest bar line. swing 0..1
        moves every second grid point later by up to a third of the grid (1: a triplet shuffle);
        strength 0..1 is how far the position moves toward it. */
    double quantized (double ppq, double grid, double swing = 0.0, double strength = 1.0) const noexcept;

    //==============================================================================
    /** The tempo change that holds at this position set to bpm (with one tempo: the song's). */
    TempoMap withTempoAt (double ppq, double bpm) const;

    /** The signature of the bar this position is in, from that signature's change on. */
    TempoMap withSignatureAt (double ppq, int numerator, int denominator) const;

    /** One tempo all through (signatures and keys kept). */
    TempoMap withOneTempo (double bpm) const;

    //==============================================================================
    /** {tempos: [[ppq, bpm, ramp]], signatures: [[bar, numerator, denominator]], keys: [[bar, root, scale]]} */
    juce::var toVar() const;

    /** A map from songs (or the page). Lists missing or bad: the defaults for them. */
    static TempoMap fromVar (const juce::var& value);

    static bool isValidDenominator (int denominator) noexcept;
    static const juce::StringArray& getScales();

    /** A scale's notes above its root, one bit per semitone (bit 0: the root); major for a name
        it doesn't know. Allocates nothing: the audio thread asks it too. */
    static juce::uint16 scaleNotes (const juce::String& scale) noexcept;
    static juce::String keyName (const Key& key);       // "A minor"

    bool operator== (const TempoMap& other) const noexcept;
    bool operator!= (const TempoMap& other) const noexcept     { return ! operator== (other); }

private:
    void rebuild();

    /** The tempo in effect at the start of tempos[i] and where its stretch ends. */
    double secondsIn (size_t index, double ppq) const noexcept;

    std::vector<Tempo> tempos;
    std::vector<double> tempoSeconds;       // seconds at each tempo change
    std::vector<Signature> signatures;
    std::vector<double> signaturePpq;       // where each signature's first bar starts
    std::vector<Key> keys;
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\TextureLibrary.cpp
// From KnobMaker (C:\workspace\knobmaker); in Stella the textures folder is Documents\Sonify AI
// Studio\Textures and the folder choice is kept in the studio's own settings.

/*
    TextureLibrary.cpp
*/

#include "TextureLibrary.h"
#include "BmpImage.h"
#include "Settings.h"

#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    constexpr float kPi = juce::MathConstants<float>::pi;

    //==========================================================================
    /** Deterministic per-lattice-point value. Not juce::Random: the same cell
        has to give the same number every time or the pattern would crawl as the
        preview re-renders at a different scale. */
    inline float hashCell (int x, int y) noexcept
    {
        auto h = (juce::uint32) (x * 374761393) + (juce::uint32) (y * 668265263);
        h = (h ^ (h >> 13)) * 1274126177u;
        h ^= (h >> 16);

        return (float) (h & 0xffffffu) / (float) 0xffffffu;
    }

    inline float smoothStep (float t) noexcept { return t * t * (3.0f - 2.0f * t); }

    /** Value noise that wraps at `period` cells, so the pattern tiles cleanly
        no matter where the rotation lands it. */
    float valueNoise (float u, float v, int period) noexcept
    {
        period = juce::jmax (1, period);

        const float x = u * (float) period;
        const float y = v * (float) period;

        const int x0 = (int) std::floor (x);
        const int y0 = (int) std::floor (y);

        const float fx = smoothStep (x - (float) x0);
        const float fy = smoothStep (y - (float) y0);

        auto wrap = [period] (int i) noexcept { return ((i % period) + period) % period; };

        const float a = hashCell (wrap (x0),     wrap (y0));
        const float b = hashCell (wrap (x0 + 1), wrap (y0));
        const float c = hashCell (wrap (x0),     wrap (y0 + 1));
        const float d = hashCell (wrap (x0 + 1), wrap (y0 + 1));

        return juce::jmap (fy, juce::jmap (fx, a, b), juce::jmap (fx, c, d));
    }

    //==========================================================================
    float patternCheckers (float u, float v, int n) noexcept
    {
        const int cx = (int) std::floor (u * (float) n);
        const int cy = (int) std::floor (v * (float) n);

        return ((cx + cy) & 1) ? 0.18f : 0.82f;
    }

    /** Streaks that run along one axis and vary across it — brushed metal.
        The x lattice coordinate is pinned so every row of the streak is
        identical; only the offsets change between octaves. */
    float patternHairline (float u, float v, int n) noexcept
    {
        juce::ignoreUnused (u);

        float value = 0.58f * valueNoise (0.00f, v, n * 8)
                    + 0.30f * valueNoise (0.37f, v, n * 23)
                    + 0.12f * valueNoise (0.71f, v, n * 61);

        return juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, value);
    }

    float patternSand (float u, float v, int n) noexcept
    {
        float value = 0.55f * valueNoise (u, v, n * 6)
                    + 0.30f * valueNoise (u, v, n * 13)
                    + 0.15f * valueNoise (u, v, n * 29);

        return juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, value);
    }

    /** A weave: alternate cells show the warp thread, the rest the weft, each
        shaded across its own width so the crossing reads as over-and-under. */
    float patternFabric (float u, float v, int n) noexcept
    {
        const float x = u * (float) n;
        const float y = v * (float) n;

        const int cx = (int) std::floor (x);
        const int cy = (int) std::floor (y);

        const float across = ((cx + cy) & 1) ? (y - (float) cy) : (x - (float) cx);

        return juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, 0.22f + 0.68f * std::sin (across * kPi));
    }

    //==========================================================================
    /** Scale is "percent of the canvas one repeat covers", so a smaller number
        means a finer pattern. Turned into a whole repeat count because the
        tileable noise needs an integer period. */
    int repeatsFor (float scalePercent) noexcept
    {
        const float s = juce::jlimit (2.0f, 200.0f, scalePercent);

        return juce::jlimit (1, 64, (int) std::lround (100.0f / s));
    }

    juce::Image generatePattern (const juce::String& name, int w, int h,
                                 float scalePercent, float angleDegrees)
    {
        juce::Image out (juce::Image::ARGB, w, h, false);
        juce::Image::BitmapData data (out, juce::Image::BitmapData::writeOnly);

        const int   n  = repeatsFor (scalePercent);
        const float a  = angleDegrees * kPi / 180.0f;
        const float ca = std::cos (a);
        const float sa = std::sin (a);

        for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x)
            {
                // Rotate about the middle, then let the pattern wrap.
                const float u = (float) x / (float) w - 0.5f;
                const float v = (float) y / (float) h - 0.5f;

                const float ru = u * ca - v * sa + 0.5f;
                const float rv = u * sa + v * ca + 0.5f;

                float value = 0.5f;

                if      (name == "Checkers") value = patternCheckers (ru, rv, n);
                else if (name == "Fabric")   value = patternFabric   (ru, rv, n);
                else if (name == "Hairline") value = patternHairline (ru, rv, n);
                else if (name == "Sand")     value = patternSand     (ru, rv, n);

                const auto g = (juce::uint8) juce::jlimit (0, 255,
                                                           (int) std::lround (value * 255.0f));

                auto* px = reinterpret_cast<juce::PixelARGB*> (data.getLinePointer (y)
                                                                 + x * data.pixelStride);
                px->setARGB (255, g, g, g);
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    //==========================================================================
    juce::File findUserFile (const juce::String& name)
    {
        auto folder = TextureLibrary::userFolder();

        if (! folder.isDirectory())
            return {};

        auto direct = folder.getChildFile (name);

        if (direct.existsAsFile())
            return direct;

        // A document may have stored the name without its extension — which is
        // exactly what an imported .knob does.
        juce::Array<juce::File> files;
        folder.findChildFiles (files, juce::File::findFiles, false,
                               "*.png;*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.bmp;*.gif");

        for (const auto& f : files)
            if (f.getFileNameWithoutExtension().equalsIgnoreCase (name))
                return f;

        return {};
    }

    juce::Image tileUserImage (const juce::String& name, int w, int h,
                               float scalePercent, float angleDegrees)
    {
        auto file = findUserFile (name);

        if (file == juce::File())
            return {};

        // Not ImageFileFormat::loadFrom: JUCE has no BMP decoder, and KnobMan's
        // own stock textures are bitmaps.
        auto source = loadImageFile (file);

        if (! source.isValid() || source.getWidth() < 1 || source.getHeight() < 1)
            return {};

        juce::Image out (juce::Image::ARGB, w, h, true);
        juce::Graphics g (out);

        // Neutral grey wherever the tile is transparent: no bump, no tint.
        g.fillAll (juce::Colour (0xff808080));

        const float tile = juce::jmax (4.0f, (float) juce::jmin (w, h)
                                               * juce::jlimit (2.0f, 200.0f, scalePercent) * 0.01f);

        auto transform = juce::AffineTransform::scale (tile / (float) source.getWidth(),
                                                       tile / (float) source.getHeight())
                            .rotated (angleDegrees * kPi / 180.0f,
                                      (float) w * 0.5f, (float) h * 0.5f);

        g.setImageResamplingQuality (juce::Graphics::highResamplingQuality);
        g.setFillType (juce::FillType (source, transform));
        g.fillAll();

        return out;
    }

    //==========================================================================
    juce::CriticalSection cacheLock;
    juce::HashMap<juce::String, juce::Image> cache;

    //==========================================================================
    juce::CriticalSection folderLock;
    juce::String chosenFolder;        // empty means "use the default"
    bool         folderLoaded = false;

    // The Plugins Creator Studio's own places, beside its primitives and looks.
    juce::File appDataRoot()
    {
        return Settings::getCacheFolder();
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File TextureLibrary::defaultFolder()
{
    return Settings::getDataFolder().getChildFile ("Textures");
}

juce::File TextureLibrary::settingsFile()
{
    return appDataRoot().getChildFile ("textures.xml");
}

juce::File TextureLibrary::userFolder()
{
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (folderLock);

    if (! folderLoaded)
    {
        folderLoaded = true;

        if (auto xml = juce::XmlDocument::parse (settingsFile()))
            chosenFolder = xml->getStringAttribute ("textureFolder");
    }

    if (chosenFolder.isNotEmpty())
    {
        const juce::File chosen (chosenFolder);

        // If the folder has gone — renamed, or on a drive that is not plugged
        // in — fall back rather than showing an empty list with no explanation.
        if (chosen.isDirectory())
            return chosen;
    }

    return defaultFolder();
}

bool TextureLibrary::isUsingCustomFolder()
{
    return userFolder() != defaultFolder();
}

void TextureLibrary::setUserFolder (const juce::File& folder)
{
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock sl (folderLock);

        chosenFolder = folder.isDirectory() ? folder.getFullPathName() : juce::String();
        folderLoaded = true;

        auto file = settingsFile();
        file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();

        // Merge into whatever is already in there — this file is shared with
        // anything else that wants to remember something later.
        auto xml = juce::XmlDocument::parse (file);

        if (xml == nullptr)
            xml = std::make_unique<juce::XmlElement> ("KnobMakerSettings");

        if (chosenFolder.isEmpty())
            xml->removeAttribute ("textureFolder");
        else
            xml->setAttribute ("textureFolder", chosenFolder);

        xml->writeTo (file);
    }

    rescan();
}

juce::StringArray TextureLibrary::proceduralNames()
{
    return { "Checkers", "Fabric", "Hairline", "Sand" };
}

bool TextureLibrary::isProcedural (const juce::String& name)
{
    return proceduralNames().contains (name);
}

juce::StringArray TextureLibrary::availableNames()
{
    auto names = proceduralNames();

    auto folder = userFolder();

    if (folder.isDirectory())
    {
        juce::Array<juce::File> files;
        folder.findChildFiles (files, juce::File::findFiles, false,
                               "*.png;*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.bmp;*.gif");

        juce::StringArray fromDisk;

        for (const auto& f : files)
            fromDisk.add (f.getFileName());

        fromDisk.sort (true);
        names.addArray (fromDisk);
    }

    return names;
}

void TextureLibrary::rescan()
{
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (cacheLock);
    cache.clear();
}

juce::Image TextureLibrary::image (const juce::String& name, int w, int h,
                                   float scalePercent, float angleDegrees)
{
    if (name.isEmpty() || w < 1 || h < 1)
        return {};

    const auto key = name + "|" + juce::String (w) + "x" + juce::String (h)
                       + "|" + juce::String (juce::roundToInt (scalePercent))
                       + "|" + juce::String (juce::roundToInt (angleDegrees));

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock sl (cacheLock);

        if (cache.contains (key))
            return cache[key];
    }

    auto result = isProcedural (name)
                    ? generatePattern (name, w, h, scalePercent, angleDegrees)
                    : tileUserImage   (name, w, h, scalePercent, angleDegrees);

    if (result.isValid())
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock sl (cacheLock);

        // The key carries the render size, and that changes every time the
        // preview is resized. Left alone this would grow without bound.
        if (cache.size() > 24)
            cache.clear();

        cache.set (key, result);
    }

    return result;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\TextureLibrary.h
// From KnobMaker (C:\workspace\knobmaker); in Stella its folders are the studio's own (see the .cpp).

/*
    TextureLibrary.h

    Where a layer's texture comes from.

    KnobMan ships its textures as bitmaps inside the application folder and
    reads whatever else you drop into its Texture directory. We can be pointed
    at any folder — including a JKnobMan install's own Texture directory — and
    the choice is remembered in a settings file between sessions. We do not copy
    those files — they are someone else's artwork, and a fixed bitmap is the
    wrong shape for this renderer anyway: LayerRender is resolution independent
    and draws the preview at display scale, so a tile would soften at exactly
    the sizes that matter.

    So the four KnobMan defaults — Checkers, Fabric, Hairline, Sand — are
    generated in code at whatever resolution is asked for, and anything else
    comes from the user's own folder, exactly as KnobMan does it.

    Every texture is returned as ARGB. Procedural ones are greyscale, because a
    Bump-mode layer only wants a height field. A user image keeps its colour so
    a Fill-mode layer can show the real wood, carbon or brushed plate.
*/

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

//==============================================================================
namespace TextureLibrary
{
    /** The folder currently being scanned — the one the user chose, or
        defaultFolder() if they have not chosen one or the chosen one has gone
        (an unplugged drive, a renamed directory). */
    juce::File userFolder();

    /** Stella: <user data>/Plugins Creator/Textures. Used until the user points
        somewhere else. */
    juce::File defaultFolder();

    /** Points the library at a folder and writes the choice to settingsFile()
        so it survives a restart. Pass an invalid or missing folder to go back
        to the default. Drops the tile cache. */
    void setUserFolder (const juce::File&);

    /** True when the folder in use came from the user rather than the default. */
    bool isUsingCustomFolder();

    /** Where the choice is kept: <Sonify's application data>/Plugins Creator/textures.xml */
    juce::File settingsFile();

    /** The patterns that are generated rather than loaded. */
    juce::StringArray proceduralNames();

    /** True when this name is generated. */
    bool isProcedural (const juce::String& name);

    /** Generated names first, then every image in userFolder(), sorted. */
    juce::StringArray availableNames();

    /** A w x h ARGB tile with the scale and rotation already baked in, so the
        caller can sample it 1:1 against the layer it is texturing. Cached by
        every argument. Returns an invalid image for an unknown name. */
    juce::Image image (const juce::String& name, int w, int h,
                       float scalePercent, float angleDegrees);

    /** Drops cached tiles, so the folder is read again on the next request. */
    void rescan();
}
