// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Toolbox.cpp

#include "Toolbox.h"
#include "Primitives.h"
#include "StellaLookAndFeel.h"

namespace
{
    constexpr int headerHeight = 26, itemHeight = 34, iconSize = 26;
    const juce::Colour iconLine { 0xffd8d4ca };
}

//==============================================================================
/** One primitive: its icon and name. Drag it out, or double-click it. */
class Toolbox::Item final : public juce::Component,
                            public juce::SettableTooltipClient
{
public:
    Item (Toolbox& owner, const Primitive& p)
        : toolbox (owner), id (p.id), name (p.name), icon (p.icon), category (p.category), description (p.description)
    {
        setTooltip (p.description.isNotEmpty() ? p.description + "\nDrag it onto the window, or double-click it."
                                               : juce::String ("Drag it onto the window, or double-click it."));
        setMouseCursor (juce::MouseCursor::DraggingHandCursor);
    }

    bool matches (const juce::String& text) const
    {
        return text.isEmpty() || name.containsIgnoreCase (text) || description.containsIgnoreCase (text) || category.containsIgnoreCase (text);
    }

    const juce::String& getCategory() const noexcept    { return category; }

    void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override
    {
        auto area = getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (6.0f, 2.0f);

        if (isMouseOverOrDragging())
        {
            g.setColour (Theme::raised);
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (area, 5.0f);
        }

        auto iconArea = area.removeFromLeft ((float) iconSize + 8.0f).withSizeKeepingCentre ((float) iconSize, (float) iconSize);
        drawIcon (g, iconArea, icon);

        area.removeFromLeft (6.0f);
        g.setColour (Theme::text.withAlpha (0.9f));
        g.setFont (Theme::font (13.5f));
        g.drawText (name, area, juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);
    }

    void mouseEnter (const juce::MouseEvent&) override    { repaint(); }
    void mouseExit (const juce::MouseEvent&) override     { repaint(); }

    void mouseDrag (const juce::MouseEvent& e) override
    {
        if (e.getDistanceFromDragStart() < 4)
            return;

        auto* container = juce::DragAndDropContainer::findParentDragContainerFor (this);

        if (container == nullptr || container->isDragAndDropActive())
            return;

        // The drag shows the icon under the mouse.
        juce::Image image (juce::Image::ARGB, iconSize + 12, iconSize + 12, true);
        {
            juce::Graphics g (image);
            g.setColour (Theme::raised.withAlpha (0.92f));
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (image.getBounds().toFloat().reduced (0.5f), 6.0f);
            g.setColour (Theme::accent.withAlpha (0.8f));
            g.drawRoundedRectangle (image.getBounds().toFloat().reduced (0.5f), 6.0f, 1.0f);
            drawIcon (g, image.getBounds().toFloat().reduced (6.0f), icon);
        }

        const juce::Point<int> offset (-(iconSize + 12) / 2, -(iconSize + 12) / 2);
        container->startDragging (PrimitiveLibrary::dragDescription (id), this, juce::ScaledImage (image), false, &offset);
    }

    void mouseDoubleClick (const juce::MouseEvent&) override
    {
        if (toolbox.onAdd != nullptr)
            toolbox.onAdd (id);
    }

private:
    Toolbox& toolbox;
    juce::String id, name, icon, category, description;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Item)
};

//==============================================================================
/** The categories and their items, filtered by the search text. */
class Toolbox::List final : public juce::Component
{
public:
    explicit List (Toolbox& owner)
    {
        const auto& library = PrimitiveLibrary::get();
        categories = library.getCategories();

        for (const auto& p : library.getAll())
            addAndMakeVisible (items.add (new Item (owner, p)));
    }

    void setFilter (const juce::String& text)
    {
        filter = text.trim();
        layOut();
    }

    void layOut()
    {
        headers.clear();
        int y = 4;

        for (const auto& category : categories)
        {
            bool any = false;

            for (auto* item : items)
                any = any || (item->getCategory() == category && item->matches (filter));

            if (! any)
                continue;

            headers.add ({ category, y });
            y += headerHeight;

            for (auto* item : items)
            {
                if (item->getCategory() != category)
                    continue;

                const bool shown = item->matches (filter);
                item->setVisible (shown);

                if (shown)
                {
                    item->setBounds (0, y, getWidth(), itemHeight);
                    y += itemHeight;
                }
            }

            y += 6;
        }

        for (auto* item : items)
            if (! item->matches (filter))
                item->setVisible (false);

        empty = headers.isEmpty();
        setSize (getWidth(), juce::jmax (y + 8, 60));
        repaint();
    }

    void paint (juce::Graphics& g) override
    {
        for (const auto& [category, y] : headers)
        {
            g.setColour (Theme::muted);
            g.setFont (Theme::font (11.0f, true));
            g.drawText (category.toUpperCase(), juce::Rectangle<int> (12, y, getWidth() - 24, headerHeight).withTrimmedTop (6),
                        juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);
        }

        if (empty)
        {
            g.setColour (Theme::muted);
            g.setFont (Theme::font (13.0f));
            g.drawText ("Nothing matches", getLocalBounds().withHeight (40), juce::Justification::centred, false);
        }
    }

    void resized() override
    {
        for (auto* item : items)
            item->setSize (getWidth(), itemHeight);
    }

private:
    juce::StringArray categories;
    juce::OwnedArray<Item> items;
    juce::Array<std::pair<juce::String, int>> headers;
    juce::String filter;
    bool empty = false;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (List)
};

//==============================================================================
Toolbox::Toolbox()
{
    search.setTextToShowWhenEmpty (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Search\xe2\x80\xa6"), Theme::muted);
    search.setFont (Theme::font (13.5f));
    search.setIndents (8, 5);
    search.onTextChange = [this] { list->setFilter (search.getText()); };
    search.onEscapeKey = [this] { search.clear(); list->setFilter ({}); };
    addAndMakeVisible (search);

    list = std::make_unique<List> (*this);
    viewport.setViewedComponent (list.get(), false);
    viewport.setScrollBarsShown (true, false);
    viewport.setScrollBarThickness (8);
    addAndMakeVisible (viewport);
}

Toolbox::~Toolbox() = default;

void Toolbox::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (Theme::window);

    g.setColour (Theme::outline);
    g.fillRect (getWidth() - 1, 0, 1, getHeight());

    g.setColour (Theme::text);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (12.0f, true));
    g.drawText ("TOOLBOX", getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (34).withTrimmedLeft (14), juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);
}

void Toolbox::resized()
{
    auto area = getLocalBounds().withTrimmedRight (1);
    area.removeFromTop (34);
    search.setBounds (area.removeFromTop (28).reduced (10, 0));
    area.removeFromTop (6);
    viewport.setBounds (area);

    list->setSize (viewport.getMaximumVisibleWidth(), list->getHeight());
    list->layOut();
}

//==============================================================================
void Toolbox::drawIcon (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<float> area, const juce::String& icon)
{
    const auto line = iconLine;
    const auto accent = Theme::accent;
    const auto c = area.getCentre();
    const auto s = juce::jmin (area.getWidth(), area.getHeight());
    const auto box = area.withSizeKeepingCentre (s, s);

    auto knob = [&] (float diameter, juce::Colour body)
    {
        const auto r = juce::Rectangle<float> (diameter, diameter).withCentre (c);
        g.setColour (body);
        g.fillEllipse (r);
        g.setColour (line.withAlpha (0.55f));
        g.drawEllipse (r, 1.0f);

        const auto angle = juce::MathConstants<float>::pi * 0.25f;
        const juce::Point<float> tip (c.x + std::sin (angle) * diameter * 0.42f, c.y - std::cos (angle) * diameter * 0.42f);
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.drawLine ({ c, tip }, juce::jmax (1.5f, diameter * 0.09f));
    };

    if (icon == "knob")            { knob (s * 0.78f, juce::Colour (0xff2a2a2f)); return; }
    if (icon == "knob_small")      { knob (s * 0.5f, juce::Colour (0xff2a2a2f)); return; }
    if (icon == "knob_big")        { knob (s * 0.96f, juce::Colour (0xff6b6b72)); return; }

    if (icon == "slider_vertical" || icon == "slider_horizontal")
    {
        const bool vertical = icon == "slider_vertical";
        const auto track = vertical ? box.withSizeKeepingCentre (4.0f, s * 0.9f) : box.withSizeKeepingCentre (s * 0.9f, 4.0f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.6f));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (track, 2.0f);
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (vertical ? track.withTop (track.getCentreY()) : track.withWidth (track.getWidth() * 0.5f), 2.0f);
        const auto thumb = vertical ? juce::Rectangle<float> (s * 0.5f, 5.0f).withCentre (track.getCentre())
                                    : juce::Rectangle<float> (5.0f, s * 0.5f).withCentre (track.getCentre());
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffe9e6df));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (thumb, 1.5f);
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "switch")
    {
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffffb020));
        g.fillEllipse (juce::Rectangle<float> (5.0f, 5.0f).withCentre ({ c.x, box.getY() + 4.0f }));
        const auto button = box.withTrimmedTop (s * 0.35f).reduced (s * 0.18f, s * 0.08f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff4a4a50));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (button, 3.0f);
        g.setColour (line.withAlpha (0.5f));
        g.drawRoundedRectangle (button, 3.0f, 1.0f);
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "selector")
    {
        const auto strip = box.withSizeKeepingCentre (s, s * 0.42f);
        const auto cell = strip.getWidth() / 3.0f;

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            g.setColour (i == 1 ? accent : juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.55f));
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (juce::Rectangle<float> (strip.getX() + (float) i * cell, strip.getY(), cell, strip.getHeight()).reduced (1.0f), 2.0f);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "dropdown")
    {
        // A box with the chosen option and the arrow that opens the list.
        const auto field = box.withSizeKeepingCentre (s, s * 0.42f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.55f));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (field, 2.5f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.25f));
        g.drawRoundedRectangle (field, 2.5f, 1.0f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.6f));
        g.fillRect (field.withTrimmedLeft (field.getWidth() * 0.14f).withWidth (field.getWidth() * 0.42f).withSizeKeepingCentre (field.getWidth() * 0.42f, 1.5f));

        juce::Path arrow;
        const auto ax = field.getRight() - field.getHeight() * 0.55f, ay = field.getCentreY(), r = field.getHeight() * 0.2f;
        arrow.addTriangle (ax - r, ay - r * 0.5f, ax + r, ay - r * 0.5f, ax, ay + r * 0.7f);
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.fillPath (arrow);
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "samples")
    {
        // A sampler's instruments: the list's box, a sample's waveform in it.
        const auto field = box.withSizeKeepingCentre (s, s * 0.46f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.55f));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (field, 2.5f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.25f));
        g.drawRoundedRectangle (field, 2.5f, 1.0f);

        juce::Path wave;
        const auto left = field.getX() + field.getWidth() * 0.1f, width = field.getWidth() * 0.52f;
        const auto mid = field.getCentreY(), height = field.getHeight() * 0.36f;

        for (int i = 0; i <= 24; ++i)
        {
            const auto t = (float) i / 24.0f;
            const auto y = mid - std::sin (t * 18.0f) * height * (1.0f - t * 0.85f);
            if (i == 0) wave.startNewSubPath (left, y); else wave.lineTo (left + t * width, y);
        }

        g.setColour (juce::Colours::white.withAlpha (0.75f));
        g.strokePath (wave, juce::PathStrokeType (1.2f));

        juce::Path arrow;
        const auto ax = field.getRight() - field.getHeight() * 0.5f, ay = field.getCentreY(), r = field.getHeight() * 0.18f;
        arrow.addTriangle (ax - r, ay - r * 0.5f, ax + r, ay - r * 0.5f, ax, ay + r * 0.7f);
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.fillPath (arrow);
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "xy")
    {
        const auto pad = box.reduced (2.0f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.55f));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (pad, 3.0f);
        const juce::Point<float> dot (pad.getX() + pad.getWidth() * 0.65f, pad.getY() + pad.getHeight() * 0.35f);
        g.setColour (accent.withAlpha (0.5f));
        g.drawVerticalLine (juce::roundToInt (dot.x), pad.getY() + 1.0f, pad.getBottom() - 1.0f);
        g.drawHorizontalLine (juce::roundToInt (dot.y), pad.getX() + 1.0f, pad.getRight() - 1.0f);
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.fillEllipse (juce::Rectangle<float> (6.0f, 6.0f).withCentre (dot));
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "presets")
    {
        const auto bar = box.withSizeKeepingCentre (s, s * 0.45f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.55f));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (bar, 3.0f);
        juce::Path arrows;
        arrows.addTriangle (bar.getX() + 3.0f, bar.getCentreY(), bar.getX() + 7.0f, bar.getCentreY() - 3.5f, bar.getX() + 7.0f, bar.getCentreY() + 3.5f);
        arrows.addTriangle (bar.getRight() - 3.0f, bar.getCentreY(), bar.getRight() - 7.0f, bar.getCentreY() - 3.5f, bar.getRight() - 7.0f, bar.getCentreY() + 3.5f);
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.fillPath (arrows);
        g.setColour (line.withAlpha (0.7f));
        g.fillRect (bar.withSizeKeepingCentre (bar.getWidth() * 0.4f, 2.0f));
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "meter")
    {
        const auto w = s * 0.2f;

        for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
        {
            const auto bar = juce::Rectangle<float> (c.x - w - 1.5f + (float) i * (w + 3.0f), box.getY() + 1.0f, w, s - 2.0f);
            g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.6f));
            g.fillRect (bar);
            const auto level = i == 0 ? 0.7f : 0.55f;
            g.setGradientFill (juce::ColourGradient (Theme::safe, 0.0f, bar.getBottom(), Theme::clip, 0.0f, bar.getY(), false));
            g.fillRect (bar.withTop (bar.getBottom() - bar.getHeight() * level));
        }
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "scope" || icon == "envelope" || icon == "filter")
    {
        const auto frame = box.reduced (1.0f, s * 0.12f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.55f));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (frame, 3.0f);

        juce::Path path;
        const auto inner = frame.reduced (3.0f);

        if (icon == "scope")
        {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 24; ++i)
            {
                const auto t = (float) i / 24.0f;
                const juce::Point<float> p (inner.getX() + inner.getWidth() * t,
                                            inner.getCentreY() - std::sin (t * juce::MathConstants<float>::twoPi * 1.5f) * inner.getHeight() * 0.42f);
                if (i == 0) path.startNewSubPath (p); else path.lineTo (p);
            }
        }
        else if (icon == "envelope")
        {
            path.startNewSubPath (inner.getBottomLeft());
            path.lineTo (inner.getX() + inner.getWidth() * 0.2f, inner.getY());
            path.lineTo (inner.getX() + inner.getWidth() * 0.4f, inner.getY() + inner.getHeight() * 0.4f);
            path.lineTo (inner.getX() + inner.getWidth() * 0.75f, inner.getY() + inner.getHeight() * 0.4f);
            path.lineTo (inner.getBottomRight());
        }
        else
        {
            path.startNewSubPath (inner.getX(), inner.getY() + inner.getHeight() * 0.45f);
            path.lineTo (inner.getX() + inner.getWidth() * 0.5f, inner.getY() + inner.getHeight() * 0.45f);
            path.quadraticTo (inner.getX() + inner.getWidth() * 0.66f, inner.getY() - 1.0f,
                              inner.getX() + inner.getWidth() * 0.75f, inner.getY() + inner.getHeight() * 0.5f);
            path.lineTo (inner.getX() + inner.getWidth() * 0.9f, inner.getBottom());
        }

        g.setColour (accent);
        g.strokePath (path, juce::PathStrokeType (1.5f, juce::PathStrokeType::curved, juce::PathStrokeType::rounded));
        return;
    }

    // The 3D displays: a few rows stacked in depth, the front one lit.
    if (icon == "wave3d" || icon == "morph3d" || icon == "filter3d" || icon == "waterfall3d")
    {
        const auto frame = box.reduced (1.0f, s * 0.12f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.55f));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (frame, 3.0f);

        const auto inner = frame.reduced (3.0f);
        constexpr int rows = 4;

        auto heightAt = [&icon] (float x, float depth)   // 0..1
        {
            const auto pi = juce::MathConstants<float>::pi;

            if (icon == "filter3d")
            {
                const auto cutoff = 0.35f + 0.3f * depth;
                return x < cutoff ? 0.55f + 0.35f * std::exp (-(x - cutoff) * (x - cutoff) * 120.0f)
                                  : juce::jmax (0.0f, 0.55f + 0.35f * std::exp (-(x - cutoff) * (x - cutoff) * 120.0f) - (x - cutoff) * 2.2f);
            }

            if (icon == "waterfall3d")
                return 0.15f + 0.7f * std::exp (-(x - 0.25f) * (x - 0.25f) * 40.0f) * (1.0f - 0.4f * depth)
                     + 0.35f * std::exp (-(x - 0.6f - 0.1f * depth) * (x - 0.6f - 0.1f * depth) * 90.0f);

            const auto sine = 0.5f + 0.45f * std::sin (x * 2.0f * pi);
            const auto saw = 0.95f - 0.9f * std::fmod (x + 0.5f, 1.0f);
            return icon == "morph3d" ? sine + (saw - sine) * depth : sine;
        };

        for (int r = rows - 1; r >= 0; --r)   // back to front: nearer rows cover the ones behind
        {
            const auto depth = (float) r / (float) (rows - 1);
            const auto x0 = inner.getX() + inner.getWidth() * 0.24f * depth, span = inner.getWidth() * 0.76f;
            const auto base = inner.getBottom() - inner.getHeight() * 0.42f * depth, tall = inner.getHeight() * 0.5f;

            juce::Path curve;

            for (int i = 0; i <= 20; ++i)
            {
                const auto x = (float) i / 20.0f;
                const juce::Point<float> p (x0 + span * x, base - tall * heightAt (x, depth));
                if (i == 0) curve.startNewSubPath (p); else curve.lineTo (p);
            }

            auto under = curve;
            under.lineTo (x0 + span, base);
            under.lineTo (x0, base);
            under.closeSubPath();
            g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff101014));
            g.fillPath (under);

            g.setColour (r == 0 ? accent : accent.withAlpha (0.25f + 0.15f * (1.0f - depth)));
            g.strokePath (curve, juce::PathStrokeType (r == 0 ? 1.6f : 1.0f, juce::PathStrokeType::curved, juce::PathStrokeType::rounded));
        }

        return;
    }

    if (icon == "lamp")
    {
        const auto lamp = juce::Rectangle<float> (s * 0.42f, s * 0.42f).withCentre (c);
        g.setColour (Theme::safe.withAlpha (0.3f));
        g.fillEllipse (lamp.expanded (4.0f));
        g.setColour (Theme::safe);
        g.fillEllipse (lamp);
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "picture" || icon == "background")
    {
        const bool background = icon == "background";
        const auto frame = background ? box.reduced (1.0f, s * 0.14f) : box.reduced (s * 0.12f, s * 0.2f);

        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff2f4a66));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (frame, 2.0f);

        juce::Path hills;
        hills.startNewSubPath (frame.getBottomLeft());
        hills.lineTo (frame.getX() + frame.getWidth() * 0.35f, frame.getY() + frame.getHeight() * 0.45f);
        hills.lineTo (frame.getX() + frame.getWidth() * 0.55f, frame.getY() + frame.getHeight() * 0.7f);
        hills.lineTo (frame.getX() + frame.getWidth() * 0.75f, frame.getY() + frame.getHeight() * 0.5f);
        hills.lineTo (frame.getBottomRight());
        hills.closeSubPath();
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff5f8f5a));
        g.fillPath (hills);

        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffffd166));
        g.fillEllipse (juce::Rectangle<float> (s * 0.16f, s * 0.16f).withCentre ({ frame.getX() + frame.getWidth() * 0.75f, frame.getY() + frame.getHeight() * 0.28f }));

        g.setColour (line.withAlpha (background ? 0.9f : 0.5f));
        g.drawRoundedRectangle (frame, 2.0f, background ? 1.5f : 1.0f);

        if (background)
        {
            // Small controls sitting on it: it goes behind everything.
            g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff2a2a2f));
            g.fillEllipse (juce::Rectangle<float> (s * 0.22f, s * 0.22f).withCentre ({ frame.getX() + frame.getWidth() * 0.25f, frame.getCentreY() + 2.0f }));
            g.setColour (accent);
            g.drawEllipse (juce::Rectangle<float> (s * 0.22f, s * 0.22f).withCentre ({ frame.getX() + frame.getWidth() * 0.25f, frame.getCentreY() + 2.0f }), 1.0f);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "title" || icon == "label")
    {
        const bool title = icon == "title";
        g.setColour (line);
        g.setFont (Theme::font (title ? s * 0.62f : s * 0.48f, title));
        g.drawText (title ? "T" : "Aa", box, juce::Justification::centred, false);
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "group")
    {
        const auto frame = box.reduced (1.0f, s * 0.12f);
        g.setColour (line.withAlpha (0.55f));
        g.drawRoundedRectangle (frame, 3.0f, 1.0f);
        g.setColour (line);
        g.fillRect (juce::Rectangle<float> (frame.getX() + 3.0f, frame.getY() + 3.0f, frame.getWidth() * 0.45f, 2.5f));
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "keyboard")
    {
        // An octave, one key down.
        const auto bed = box.withSizeKeepingCentre (s, s * 0.62f);
        const auto whiteW = bed.getWidth() / 7.0f;

        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff111113));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (bed, 2.0f);

        for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i)
        {
            g.setColour (i == 2 ? accent : juce::Colour (0xffefece5));
            g.fillRect (juce::Rectangle<float> (bed.getX() + (float) i * whiteW + 0.5f, bed.getY(), whiteW - 1.0f, bed.getHeight()));
        }

        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff141416));

        for (const auto i : { 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 })
            g.fillRect (juce::Rectangle<float> (bed.getX() + (float) i * whiteW - whiteW * 0.3f, bed.getY(), whiteW * 0.6f, bed.getHeight() * 0.6f));

        return;
    }

    if (icon == "registration")
    {
        // A padlock in the badge's amber.
        const auto amber = juce::Colour (0xffffb020);
        const auto body = juce::Rectangle<float> (s * 0.58f, s * 0.42f).withCentre (c.translated (0.0f, s * 0.14f));
        const auto r = s * 0.17f, top = body.getY() - s * 0.06f;

        juce::Path shackle;
        shackle.startNewSubPath (c.x - r, body.getY());
        shackle.lineTo (c.x - r, top);
        shackle.addCentredArc (c.x, top, r, r, 0.0f, -juce::MathConstants<float>::halfPi, juce::MathConstants<float>::halfPi);
        shackle.lineTo (c.x + r, body.getY());

        g.setColour (amber);
        g.strokePath (shackle, juce::PathStrokeType (juce::jmax (1.5f, s * 0.08f)));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (body, 2.0f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff141418));
        g.fillEllipse (juce::Rectangle<float> (s * 0.1f, s * 0.1f).withCentre (body.getCentre()));
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "tabs")
    {
        // Three tabs, the first lit.
        const auto row = box.reduced (2.0f).withSizeKeepingCentre (box.getWidth() - 4.0f, box.getHeight() * 0.42f);
        const auto cellW = row.getWidth() / 3.0f;

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            const auto cell = juce::Rectangle<float> (row.getX() + (float) i * cellW, row.getY(), cellW, row.getHeight()).reduced (0.8f, 0.0f);
            g.setColour (i == 0 ? accent : line.withAlpha (0.35f));
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (cell, 1.5f);
        }

        return;
    }

    if (icon == "range")
    {
        // A slot, the band between two half-moon handles lit.
        const auto track = box.withSizeKeepingCentre (s * 0.92f, 4.0f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::black.withAlpha (0.6f));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (track, 2.0f);
        const auto x0 = track.getX() + track.getWidth() * 0.28f, x1 = track.getX() + track.getWidth() * 0.72f;
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.fillRect (juce::Rectangle<float>::leftTopRightBottom (x0, track.getY(), x1, track.getBottom()));

        for (const auto& [x, left] : { std::pair<float, bool> { x0, true }, { x1, false } })
        {
            juce::Path moon;
            moon.addPieSegment (juce::Rectangle<float> (s * 0.36f, s * 0.36f).withCentre ({ x, c.y }), left ? juce::MathConstants<float>::pi : 0.0f,
                                left ? juce::MathConstants<float>::twoPi : juce::MathConstants<float>::pi, 0.0f);
            g.setColour (line);
            g.fillPath (moon);
        }

        return;
    }

    if (icon == "meterknob")
    {
        // A dial plate, its meter's window above, a knob in the middle.
        const auto plate = box.reduced (1.0f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xff2a2a2f));
        g.fillEllipse (plate);
        juce::Path window;
        window.addPieSegment (plate.reduced (s * 0.06f), -0.95f, 0.95f, 0.62f);
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xfff1e4c3));
        g.fillPath (window);
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.drawLine ({ c, c.translated (std::sin (0.4f) * s * 0.42f, -std::cos (0.4f) * s * 0.42f) }, 1.2f);
        knob (s * 0.46f, juce::Colour (0xff6b6b72));
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "dualknob")
    {
        knob (s * 0.92f, juce::Colour (0xff2a2a2f));
        knob (s * 0.46f, juce::Colour (0xff8a8a92));
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "line")
    {
        // A line bowed through its bend point, its two ends as dots.
        const auto inner = box.reduced (3.0f);
        const juce::Point<float> a (inner.getX() + 1.5f, inner.getBottom() - inner.getHeight() * 0.22f),
                                 b (inner.getRight() - 1.5f, inner.getBottom() - inner.getHeight() * 0.22f),
                                 bend (inner.getCentreX(), inner.getY() + inner.getHeight() * 0.2f);
        juce::Path curve;
        curve.startNewSubPath (a);
        curve.quadraticTo (bend * 2.0f - (a + b) * 0.5f, b);
        g.setColour (line);
        g.strokePath (curve, juce::PathStrokeType (juce::jmax (1.5f, s * 0.09f), juce::PathStrokeType::curved, juce::PathStrokeType::rounded));

        for (const auto& end : { a, b })
            g.fillEllipse (juce::Rectangle<float> (s * 0.2f, s * 0.2f).withCentre (end));

        juce::Path diamond;
        const auto r = s * 0.11f;
        diamond.addQuadrilateral (bend.x, bend.y - r, bend.x + r, bend.y, bend.x, bend.y + r, bend.x - r, bend.y);
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.fillPath (diamond);
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "shape" || icon == "star")
    {
        auto star = juce::Drawable::parseSVGPath ("M50,5 L61,39 L97,39 L68,61 L79,95 L50,74 L21,95 L32,61 L3,39 L39,39 Z");
        star.applyTransform (star.getTransformToScaleToFit (box.reduced (2.0f), true));
        g.setColour (line);
        g.fillPath (star);
        return;
    }

    if (icon == "rectangle" || icon == "circle" || icon == "triangle")
    {
        const auto inner = box.reduced (3.0f);
        juce::Path shape;

        if (icon == "rectangle")
            shape.addRoundedRectangle (inner.withSizeKeepingCentre (inner.getWidth(), inner.getHeight() * 0.68f), 2.5f);
        else if (icon == "circle")
            shape.addEllipse (inner.withSizeKeepingCentre (juce::jmin (inner.getWidth(), inner.getHeight()), juce::jmin (inner.getWidth(), inner.getHeight())));
        else
            shape.addTriangle (inner.getCentreX(), inner.getY(), inner.getRight(), inner.getBottom() - inner.getHeight() * 0.08f,
                               inner.getX(), inner.getBottom() - inner.getHeight() * 0.08f);

        g.setColour (line);
        g.fillPath (shape);
        return;
    }

    g.setColour (line.withAlpha (0.6f));
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (box.reduced (3.0f), 3.0f, 1.0f);
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Toolbox.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include <functional>
#include <memory>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Edit UI tab's toolbox, FlowStone-style: every primitive by category, with a search
    box on top. Drag one onto the plugin window to add it there, or double-click it to add
    it in the middle of what's showing.

    It must sit inside a DragAndDropContainer that also holds the canvas.
*/
class Toolbox final : public juce::Component
{
public:
    Toolbox();
    ~Toolbox() override;

    /** A double-click: add this primitive in the middle of what's showing. */
    std::function<void (const juce::String& primitiveId)> onAdd;

    void paint (juce::Graphics&) override;
    void resized() override;

    /** A primitive's icon, by its "icon" name (unknown names get a plain square). */
    static void drawIcon (juce::Graphics&, juce::Rectangle<float> area, const juce::String& icon);

    static constexpr int width = 214;

private:
    class Item;
    class List;

    juce::TextEditor search;
    juce::Viewport viewport;
    std::unique_ptr<List> list;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Toolbox)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\TopBar.cpp

#include "TopBar.h"
#include "StellaLookAndFeel.h"

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>

namespace
{
    enum MenuIds
    {
        revealId = 1,
        closeId  = 2,
        newId = 5,
        openId = 6,
        saveId = 7,
        saveAsId = 8,
        finishSoundId = 9,
        libraryId = 10,
        recentBaseId = 100
    };

    juce::Font tabFont()     { return Theme::font (14.5f, true); }
    juce::Font menuFont()    { return Theme::font (14.5f); }

    int textWidth (const juce::Font& font, const juce::String& text)
    {
        juce::GlyphArrangement glyphs;
        glyphs.addLineOfText (font, text, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        return (int) std::ceil (glyphs.getBoundingBox (0, glyphs.getNumGlyphs(), true).getWidth());
    }

    constexpr int minNameWidth = 120;
    constexpr int wordmarkWidth = 118, meterWidth = 16, loadWidth = 72;
    constexpr int midiInWidth = 168, midiInCompactWidth = 90;

    //==========================================================================
    /** MIDI In's list, dropped from its button: All inputs, or the ports ticked one by one. */
    class MidiInList final : public juce::Component
    {
    public:
        MidiInList (const std::vector<TopBar::MidiPort>& available, const juce::StringArray& chosen,
                    std::function<void (const juce::StringArray&)> changed)
            : onChange (std::move (changed))
        {
            every.setButtonText ("All inputs");
            every.setToggleState (chosen.contains ("*"), juce::dontSendNotification);
            every.onClick = [this] { everyClicked(); };
            addAndMakeVisible (every);

            // The ports here, then any picked before that isn't here now.
            for (const auto& port : available)
                addPort (port.name, port.device.isNotEmpty() ? port.name + "  (" + port.device + ")" : port.name, chosen.contains (port.name));

            for (const auto& name : chosen)
                if (name != "*" && std::none_of (available.begin(), available.end(), [&name] (const TopBar::MidiPort& p) { return p.name == name; }))
                    addPort (name, name + "  (not connected)", true);

            note.setText (ports.isEmpty() ? "No MIDI input is enabled: Sonify's Audio Settings enable them."
                                          : "Heard only while the studio is in front; its keyboards always.",
                          juce::dontSendNotification);
            note.setFont (Theme::font (12.0f));
            note.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, Theme::muted);
            note.setJustificationType (juce::Justification::topLeft);
            addAndMakeVisible (note);

            showStates();
            setSize (320, 12 + rowHeight * (1 + ports.size()) + 44);
        }

        void resized() override
        {
            auto area = getLocalBounds().reduced (10, 6);
            every.setBounds (area.removeFromTop (rowHeight));

            for (auto* port : ports)
                port->setBounds (area.removeFromTop (rowHeight).withTrimmedLeft (18));

            note.setBounds (area.withTrimmedTop (6));
        }

    private:
        static constexpr int rowHeight = 26;

        void addPort (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& label, bool ticked)
        {
            auto* button = ports.add (new juce::ToggleButton (label));
            button->setComponentID (name);
            button->setToggleState (ticked, juce::dontSendNotification);
            button->onClick = [this] { report(); };
            addAndMakeVisible (button);
        }

        void everyClicked()
        {
            // All off: every port here ticked to begin with, so nothing goes quiet until one is unticked.
            if (! every.getToggleState())
                for (auto* port : ports)
                    if (! port->getButtonText().endsWith ("(not connected)"))
                        port->setToggleState (true, juce::dontSendNotification);

            showStates();
            report();
        }

        void showStates()
        {
            for (auto* port : ports)
                port->setEnabled (! every.getToggleState());
        }

        void report()
        {
            juce::StringArray chosen;

            if (every.getToggleState())
                chosen.add ("*");
            else
                for (auto* port : ports)
                    if (port->getToggleState())
                        chosen.add (port->getComponentID());

            if (onChange != nullptr)
                onChange (chosen);
        }

        std::function<void (const juce::StringArray&)> onChange;
        juce::ToggleButton every;
        juce::OwnedArray<juce::ToggleButton> ports;
        juce::Label note;
    };
}

//==============================================================================
void TopBar::MidiInButton::paintButton (juce::Graphics& g, bool highlighted, bool down)
{
    auto area = getLocalBounds().toFloat();

    g.setColour (down ? Theme::raised.brighter (0.12f) : highlighted ? Theme::raised : Theme::raised.withAlpha (0.55f));
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (area.reduced (0.0f, 4.0f), 5.0f);

    // The light: lit as MIDI comes through.
    const auto led = juce::Rectangle<float> (8.0f, 8.0f).withCentre ({ area.getX() + 12.0f, area.getCentreY() });
    g.setColour (lit ? Theme::safe : Theme::inset);
    g.fillEllipse (led);
    g.setColour (Theme::outline);
    g.drawEllipse (led, 1.0f);

    const auto words = area.withTrimmedLeft (22.0f).withTrimmedRight (16.0f);
    g.setColour (Theme::text);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (12.5f, true));
    g.drawText ("MIDI In", words, juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);

    if (! compact)
    {
        const auto label = Theme::font (12.5f, true);
        const auto after = words.withTrimmedLeft ((float) textWidth (label, "MIDI In") + 7.0f);
        g.setColour (Theme::muted);
        g.setFont (Theme::font (12.5f));
        g.drawFittedText (summary, after.toNearestInt(), juce::Justification::centredLeft, 1, 0.85f);
    }

    g.setColour (Theme::muted);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (11.0f));
    g.drawText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x96\xbe"), area.removeFromRight (16.0f), juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);
}

//==============================================================================
void TopBar::MenuTitle::paintButton (juce::Graphics& g, bool highlighted, bool down)
{
    if (open || highlighted || down)
    {
        g.setColour (open || down ? Theme::raised.brighter (0.12f) : Theme::raised);
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (getLocalBounds().toFloat(), 4.0f);
    }

    g.setColour (Theme::text);
    g.setFont (menuFont());
    g.drawText (getButtonText(), getLocalBounds(), juce::Justification::centred, false);
}

void TopBar::TabButton::paintButton (juce::Graphics& g, bool highlighted, bool down)
{
    const auto area = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
    const bool on = getToggleState();

    if (! on && (highlighted || down))
    {
        g.setColour (Theme::raised.withAlpha (0.7f));
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (area.reduced (2.0f, 8.0f), 5.0f);
    }

    g.setColour (on ? Theme::text : (highlighted ? Theme::text.withAlpha (0.85f) : Theme::muted));
    g.setFont (Theme::font (14.5f, on));
    g.drawText (getButtonText(), area, juce::Justification::centred, false);

    // The tab that's showing carries the accent as an underline, on the bar's bottom edge.
    if (on)
    {
        g.setColour (Theme::accent);
        g.fillRect (area.withTop (area.getBottom() - 2.0f).reduced (10.0f, 0.0f));
    }
}

//==============================================================================
float TopBar::Meter::toPosition (float gain) noexcept
{
    // -60 dB at the bottom, +6 dB at the top.
    const auto db = juce::Decibels::gainToDecibels (gain, -60.0f);
    return juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, (db + 60.0f) / 66.0f);
}

void TopBar::Meter::setLevels (float left, float right)
{
    const float incoming[2] { left, right };

    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    {
        // Fast up, slow down; the peak line holds for about a second.
        levels[i] = incoming[i] > levels[i] ? incoming[i] : levels[i] * 0.86f;

        if (incoming[i] >= holds[i])
        {
            holds[i] = incoming[i];
            holdFrames[i] = 30;
        }
        else if (--holdFrames[i] <= 0)
        {
            holds[i] *= 0.9f;
        }
    }

    repaint();
}

void TopBar::Meter::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    const auto bounds = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
    const auto barWidth = (bounds.getWidth() - 2.0f) * 0.5f;

    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    {
        const auto frame = juce::Rectangle<float> (bounds.getX() + (float) i * (barWidth + 2.0f), bounds.getY(),
                                                   barWidth, bounds.getHeight());

        // A thin frame, so the meter shows even in silence.
        g.setColour (Theme::outline);
        g.fillRect (frame);
        const auto bar = frame.reduced (1.0f);
        g.setColour (Theme::inset);
        g.fillRect (bar);

        const auto top = bar.getBottom() - bar.getHeight() * toPosition (levels[i]);
        const auto zeroDb = bar.getBottom() - bar.getHeight() * toPosition (1.0f);
        const auto minus6 = bar.getBottom() - bar.getHeight() * toPosition (0.5f);

        g.setColour (Theme::safe);
        g.fillRect (bar.withTop (juce::jmax (top, minus6)));

        if (top < minus6)
        {
            g.setColour (Theme::hot);
            g.fillRect (bar.withTop (juce::jmax (top, zeroDb)).withBottom (minus6));
        }

        if (top < zeroDb)
        {
            g.setColour (Theme::clip);
            g.fillRect (bar.withTop (top).withBottom (zeroDb));
        }

        if (holds[i] > 0.001f)
        {
            const auto holdY = bar.getBottom() - bar.getHeight() * toPosition (holds[i]);
            g.setColour (holds[i] >= 1.0f ? Theme::clip : Theme::text.withAlpha (0.7f));
            g.fillRect (bar.withTop (holdY).withHeight (1.5f));
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
TopBar::TopBar()
{
    optionsMenu.setTooltip ("New, open, save and recent projects");
    optionsMenu.onClick = [this] { showOptionsMenu(); };

    meter.setTooltip ("Output level");

    midiInButton.setTooltip ("MIDI In: the inputs the studio hears while it's in front");
    midiInButton.onClick = [this] { showMidiInList(); };

    for (auto* c : std::initializer_list<juce::Component*> { &optionsMenu, &midiInButton, &meter })
        addAndMakeVisible (c);

    for (int i = 0; i < numTabs; ++i)
    {
        auto* tab = tabs.add (new TabButton (tabNames[i]));
        tab->onClick = [this, i] { if (onTabChosen != nullptr) onTabChosen (i); };
        addAndMakeVisible (tab);
    }

    setCurrentTab (0);

    startTimerHz (30);
}

TopBar::~TopBar()
{
    stopTimer();
}

//==============================================================================
void TopBar::setProjectName (const juce::String& name)
{
    projectName = name;
    repaint (noticeArea);
}

void TopBar::showNotice (const juce::String& text)
{
    notice = text;
    noticeUntil = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() + 2500;
    repaint (noticeArea);
}

void TopBar::setCurrentTab (int index)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < tabs.size(); ++i)
        tabs[i]->setToggleState (i == index, juce::dontSendNotification);
}

void TopBar::refreshMidiIn()
{
    const auto chosen = midiInChosen != nullptr ? midiInChosen() : juce::StringArray ("*");

    midiInButton.setSummary (chosen.contains ("*") ? juce::String ("All")
                           : chosen.isEmpty() ? juce::String ("None")
                           : chosen.size() == 1 ? chosen[0]
                           : juce::String (chosen.size()) + " inputs");
    midiInButton.setTooltip ("MIDI In: " + (chosen.contains ("*") ? juce::String ("every input")
                                          : chosen.isEmpty() ? juce::String ("no input, the keyboards only")
                                          : chosen.joinIntoString (", "))
                             + ". Heard only while the studio is in front.");
}

void TopBar::showMidiInList()
{
    auto* top = getTopLevelComponent();

    if (top == nullptr)
        return;

    const auto ports = midiInPorts != nullptr ? midiInPorts() : std::vector<MidiPort>();
    const auto chosen = midiInChosen != nullptr ? midiInChosen() : juce::StringArray ("*");

    auto list = std::make_unique<MidiInList> (ports, chosen, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<TopBar> (this)] (const juce::StringArray& picked)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        if (safeThis->onMidiInChosen != nullptr)
            safeThis->onMidiInChosen (picked);

        safeThis->refreshMidiIn();
    });

    // Inside the studio's own window (over the page), dropped from the button.
    juce::CallOutBox::launchAsynchronously (std::move (list), top->getLocalArea (this, midiInButton.getBounds()), top);
}

void TopBar::timerCallback()
{
    meter.setLevels (takePeak != nullptr ? takePeak (0) : 0.0f, takePeak != nullptr ? takePeak (1) : 0.0f);

    // MIDI In's light: lit a moment each time something comes through.
    if (midiInActivity != nullptr)
    {
        if (const auto now = midiInActivity(); now != midiInSeen)
        {
            midiInSeen = now;
            midiInLitFrames = 4;
        }
    }

    midiInButton.setLit (midiInLitFrames > 0);

    if (midiInLitFrames > 0)
        --midiInLitFrames;

    if (notice.isNotEmpty() && juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() > noticeUntil)
    {
        notice.clear();
        repaint (noticeArea);
    }

    const auto load = juce::String (juce::roundToInt ((audioLoad != nullptr ? audioLoad() : 0.0) * 100.0)) + "%";

    if (load != loadText)
    {
        loadText = load;
        repaint (loadArea);
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void TopBar::showOptionsMenu()
{
    // A plain Windows-style menu: text items, separators, and a submenu for recent projects.
    // Projects live on this computer and save themselves as they change; Save writes what's
    // waiting at once, Save as copies the plugin into a new folder.
    const auto recent = recentProjects != nullptr ? recentProjects() : juce::StringArray();
    const bool hasProject = projectName.isNotEmpty();

    juce::PopupMenu menu;
    menu.addItem (newId, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("New plugin\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    menu.addItem (openId, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Open\xe2\x80\xa6"));

    juce::PopupMenu recentMenu;

    for (int i = 0; i < recent.size(); ++i)
        recentMenu.addItem (recentBaseId + i, juce::File (recent[i]).getParentDirectory().getFileName());

    menu.addSubMenu ("Open recent", recentMenu, ! recent.isEmpty());
    menu.addSeparator();

    auto item = [hasProject] (int id, const juce::String& text, const char* keys)
    {
        juce::PopupMenu::Item i (text);
        i.itemID = id;
        i.isEnabled = hasProject;
        i.shortcutKeyDescription = keys;
        return i;
    };

    menu.addItem (item (saveId, "Save", "Ctrl+S"));
    menu.addItem (item (saveAsId, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Save as\xe2\x80\xa6"), "Ctrl+Shift+S"));
    menu.addSeparator();
    menu.addItem (revealId, "Show project folder", hasProject);
    menu.addItem (closeId, "Close project", hasProject);
    menu.addSeparator();
    menu.addItem (libraryId, juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Sample library\xe2\x80\xa6"), hasProject);
    menu.addSeparator();
    menu.addItem (finishSoundId, "Sound when Fanan AI finishes", true, isFinishSoundOn != nullptr && isFinishSoundOn());

    optionsMenu.setOpen (true);

    menu.showMenuAsync (juce::PopupMenu::Options().withTargetComponent (&optionsMenu).withMinimumWidth (220),
                        [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<TopBar> (this), recent] (int result)
                        {
                            if (safeThis == nullptr)
                                return;

                            safeThis->optionsMenu.setOpen (false);

                            if (result == newId && safeThis->onNew != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onNew();
                            else if (result == openId && safeThis->onOpen != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onOpen();
                            else if (result == saveId && safeThis->onSave != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onSave();
                            else if (result == saveAsId && safeThis->onSaveAs != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onSaveAs();
                            else if (result == revealId && safeThis->onRevealProject != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onRevealProject();
                            else if (result == closeId && safeThis->onCloseProject != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onCloseProject();
                            else if (result == finishSoundId && safeThis->onToggleFinishSound != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onToggleFinishSound();
                            else if (result == libraryId && safeThis->onSampleLibrary != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onSampleLibrary();
                            else if (result >= recentBaseId && result - recentBaseId < recent.size() && safeThis->onOpenRecent != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onOpenRecent (juce::File (recent[result - recentBaseId]));
                        });
}

//==============================================================================
void TopBar::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (Theme::window);

    g.setColour (Theme::outline);
    g.fillRect (0, getHeight() - 1, getWidth(), 1);

    // FANAN in the accent, AI quieter: Fanan AI, the studio's builder.
    if (! wordmarkArea.isEmpty())
    {
        const auto bold = Theme::font (17.0f, true);
        const auto area = wordmarkArea.toFloat();

        g.setFont (bold);
        g.setColour (Theme::accent);
        g.drawText ("FANAN", area, juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);

        g.setFont (Theme::font (17.0f));
        g.setColour (Theme::muted);
        g.drawText ("AI", area.withTrimmedLeft ((float) textWidth (bold, "FANAN") + 6.0f), juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);
    }

    // A notice ("Saved") for a moment; otherwise the open plugin's name.
    if (noticeArea.getWidth() > 30)
    {
        if (notice.isNotEmpty())
        {
            g.setColour (Theme::safe);
            g.setFont (Theme::font (13.5f, true));
            g.drawFittedText (notice, noticeArea, juce::Justification::centredLeft, 1, 0.8f);
        }
        else if (projectName.isNotEmpty())
        {
            g.setColour (Theme::text.withAlpha (0.8f));
            g.setFont (Theme::font (13.5f, true));
            g.drawFittedText (projectName, noticeArea, juce::Justification::centredLeft, 1, 0.8f);
        }
    }

    // The audio load, beside the meter.
    if (! loadArea.isEmpty())
    {
        auto load = loadArea;
        g.setColour (Theme::muted);
        g.setFont (Theme::font (10.5f));
        g.drawText ("AUDIO LOAD", load.removeFromTop (load.getHeight() / 2), juce::Justification::bottomLeft, false);
        g.setColour (Theme::text);
        g.setFont (Theme::monoFont (13.0f));
        g.drawText (loadText, load, juce::Justification::topLeft, false);
    }
}

void TopBar::resized()
{
    auto area = getLocalBounds().reduced (12, 8);
    area.removeFromBottom (1);

    const auto optionsWidth = textWidth (menuFont(), optionsMenu.getButtonText()) + 22;

    juce::Array<int> tabWidths;
    int tabsWidth = 0;

    for (auto* tab : tabs)
    {
        tabWidths.add (textWidth (tabFont(), tab->getButtonText()) + 40);
        tabsWidth += tabWidths.getLast();
    }

    // Always there: Options, the tabs and the meter, with room for the plugin's name.
    // When the bar is too narrow for the rest, the wordmark goes first, then the audio load.
    bool showWordmark = true, showLoad = true;

    bool compactMidi = false;

    const auto needed = [&]
    {
        return (showWordmark ? wordmarkWidth : 0) + optionsWidth + 12 + minNameWidth + 24 + tabsWidth + 24
             + (compactMidi ? midiInCompactWidth : midiInWidth) + 12 + meterWidth + (showLoad ? 8 + loadWidth : 0);
    };

    if (needed() > area.getWidth())   showWordmark = false;
    if (needed() > area.getWidth())   showLoad = false;
    if (needed() > area.getWidth())   compactMidi = true;

    wordmarkArea = showWordmark ? area.removeFromLeft (wordmarkWidth) : juce::Rectangle<int>();

    // Right: the load and the meter.
    loadArea = showLoad ? area.removeFromRight (loadWidth) : juce::Rectangle<int>();

    if (showLoad)
        area.removeFromRight (8);

    meter.setBounds (area.removeFromRight (meterWidth).reduced (0, 1));
    area.removeFromRight (12);

    midiInButton.setCompact (compactMidi);
    midiInButton.setBounds (area.removeFromRight (compactMidi ? midiInCompactWidth : midiInWidth));
    area.removeFromRight (24);

    // Left: Options, then the plugin's name.
    optionsMenu.setBounds (area.removeFromLeft (optionsWidth));
    area.removeFromLeft (12);

    // The tabs: centred in the window, moving right only as far as a short name needs.
    const auto earliest = area.getX() + minNameWidth + 24;
    const auto latest = juce::jmax (earliest, area.getRight() - tabsWidth);
    auto x = juce::jlimit (earliest, latest, (getWidth() - tabsWidth) / 2);

    noticeArea = juce::Rectangle<int>::leftTopRightBottom (area.getX() + 2, 0, x - 12, getHeight());

    for (int i = 0; i < tabs.size(); ++i)
    {
        tabs[i]->setBounds (x, 0, tabWidths[i], getHeight());
        x += tabWidths[i];
    }
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\TopBar.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include <functional>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Plugins Creator Studio's strip across the top, under Sonify's own top bar.

        left    the FANAN AI wordmark, the Options menu, then the open plugin's name
        middle  the studio's tabs: Build with AI, Edit UI, Knob Studio, Protection, Store
        right   MIDI In (the ports the studio hears, with a light that blinks with them), the
                studio's own output meter (what it plays) and Sonify's audio load

    Sonify's audio device is Sonify's own business: its button is in Sonify's bottom bar.
*/
class TopBar final : public juce::Component,
                     private juce::Timer
{
public:
    TopBar();
    ~TopBar() override;

    void setProjectName (const juce::String& name);   // empty: no project open

    /** Which tab is showing, in the order of tabNames. */
    void setCurrentTab (int index);

    static constexpr int numTabs = 5;
    static constexpr const char* tabNames[numTabs] { "Build with AI", "Edit UI", "Knob Studio", "Protection", "Store" };

    std::function<void (int index)> onTabChosen;

    /** Read 30 times a second: a channel's peak since the last call, and the audio load (0..1). */
    std::function<float (int channel)> takePeak;
    std::function<double()> audioLoad;

    std::function<void()> onNew;
    std::function<void()> onOpen;
    std::function<void()> onSave;     // what's waiting is written at once
    std::function<void()> onSaveAs;   // the plugin copied into a new folder, under a new name
    std::function<void()> onRevealProject;
    std::function<void()> onToggleFinishSound;   // the "Sound when Sonify AI finishes" item
    std::function<bool()> isFinishSoundOn;
    std::function<void()> onCloseProject;
    std::function<void()> onSampleLibrary;       // a sampler's blobs (PluginLibrary)
    std::function<void (const juce::File& projectFile)> onOpenRecent;

    /** Asked for each time the Options menu opens: recent project files, newest first. */
    std::function<juce::StringArray()> recentProjects;

    /** MIDI In: the ports the studio can hear (each with the MIDI device on it, if there's one),
        those it hears ("*": all of them; its keyboards it always hears), and a count that goes
        up as MIDI comes through (the light blinks). The studio hears MIDI only while it's in
        front (AudioEngine::setMidiFocus). */
    struct MidiPort
    {
        juce::String name, device;
    };

    std::function<std::vector<MidiPort>()> midiInPorts;
    std::function<juce::StringArray()> midiInChosen;
    std::function<void (const juce::StringArray& ports)> onMidiInChosen;
    std::function<juce::uint32()> midiInActivity;

    /** MIDI In's button says again what it hears. */
    void refreshMidiIn();

    /** A short word in place of the plugin's name for a moment: "Saved". */
    void showNotice (const juce::String& text);

    void paint (juce::Graphics&) override;
    void resized() override;

    static constexpr int height = 46;

private:
    /** "Options", in plain text like a Windows menu bar: it lights up under the mouse and
        while its menu is open. */
    class MenuTitle final : public juce::Button
    {
    public:
        explicit MenuTitle (const juce::String& title) : juce::Button (title) {}
        void setOpen (bool shouldBeOpen)    { open = shouldBeOpen; repaint(); }
        void paintButton (juce::Graphics&, bool highlighted, bool down) override;

    private:
        bool open = false;
    };

    /** One of the main tabs: its name, underlined in the accent while it's showing. */
    class TabButton final : public juce::Button
    {
    public:
        explicit TabButton (const juce::String& name) : juce::Button (name) {}
        void paintButton (juce::Graphics&, bool highlighted, bool down) override;
    };

    /** Left and right output levels: green to -6 dB, amber to 0 dB, red above. */
    class Meter final : public juce::Component,
                        public juce::SettableTooltipClient
    {
    public:
        void setLevels (float left, float right);
        void paint (juce::Graphics&) override;

    private:
        static float toPosition (float gain) noexcept;

        float levels[2] {}, holds[2] {};
        int holdFrames[2] {};
    };

    /** MIDI In's button: its light, and what it hears ("All", a port, "2 ports"). */
    class MidiInButton final : public juce::Button
    {
    public:
        MidiInButton() : juce::Button ("MIDI In") {}
        void setSummary (const juce::String& text)   { summary = text; repaint(); }
        void setLit (bool on)                        { if (lit != on) { lit = on; repaint(); } }
        void setCompact (bool shouldBeCompact)       { compact = shouldBeCompact; }
        void paintButton (juce::Graphics&, bool highlighted, bool down) override;

    private:
        juce::String summary { "All" };
        bool lit = false, compact = false;
    };

    void timerCallback() override;
    void showOptionsMenu();
    void showMidiInList();

    MenuTitle optionsMenu { "Options" };
    juce::OwnedArray<TabButton> tabs;
    MidiInButton midiInButton;
    juce::uint32 midiInSeen = 0;
    int midiInLitFrames = 0;
    Meter meter;
    juce::String loadText { "0%" };

    juce::String projectName;                                 // empty: no project open
    juce::Rectangle<int> wordmarkArea, loadArea;              // empty when the bar is too narrow for them
    juce::Rectangle<int> noticeArea;                          // between Options and the tabs: the plugin's name
    juce::String notice;
    juce::uint32 noticeUntil = 0;                             // when it goes (milliseconds)

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (TopBar)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Track.cpp

#include "Track.h"

#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    //==============================================================================
    // Test instrument. Fast attack and a bright start, so latency is easy to judge by ear.
    struct TestSound final : public juce::SynthesiserSound
    {
        bool appliesToNote (int) override      { return true; }
        bool appliesToChannel (int) override   { return true; }
    };

    class TestVoice final : public juce::SynthesiserVoice
    {
    public:
        bool canPlaySound (juce::SynthesiserSound* sound) override
        {
            return dynamic_cast<TestSound*> (sound) != nullptr;
        }

        void startNote (int midiNoteNumber, float velocity, juce::SynthesiserSound*, int) override
        {
            const auto sampleRate = getSampleRate();

            phase = 0.0;
            phaseDelta = juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi
                         * juce::MidiMessage::getMidiNoteInHertz (midiNoteNumber) / sampleRate;
            gain = 0.14f * velocity;
            brightness = 1.0;
            brightnessDecay = std::exp (-1.0 / (0.25 * sampleRate));

            envelope.setSampleRate (sampleRate);
            envelope.setParameters ({ 0.001f, 0.35f, 0.45f, 0.18f });
            envelope.noteOn();
        }

        void stopNote (float, bool allowTailOff) override
        {
            if (allowTailOff)
            {
                envelope.noteOff();
            }
            else
            {
                envelope.reset();
                clearCurrentNote();
            }
        }

        void pitchWheelMoved (int) override {}
        void controllerMoved (int, int) override {}

        void renderNextBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& output, int startSample, int numSamples) override
        {
            if (! isVoiceActive())
                return;

            const auto numChannels = output.getNumChannels();

            while (--numSamples >= 0)
            {
                const auto partials = std::sin (phase)
                                    + brightness * (0.5 * std::sin (2.0 * phase) + 0.25 * std::sin (3.0 * phase));

                const auto sample = static_cast<float> (partials) * gain * envelope.getNextSample();

                for (int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; ++channel)
                    output.addSample (channel, startSample, sample);

                phase += phaseDelta;

                if (phase >= juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi)
                    phase -= juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi;

                brightness *= brightnessDecay;
                ++startSample;

                if (! envelope.isActive())
                {
                    clearCurrentNote();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

    private:
        juce::ADSR envelope;
        double phase = 0.0;
        double phaseDelta = 0.0;
        double brightness = 1.0;
        double brightnessDecay = 1.0;
        float gain = 0.0f;
    };

    constexpr int numTestVoices = 16;
    constexpr int minimumBufferSize = 4096;

    void storeMax (std::atomic<float>& target, float value) noexcept
    {
        auto current = target.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

        while (value > current && ! target.compare_exchange_weak (current, value, std::memory_order_relaxed))
        {
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
Track::Track (int trackId, juce::uint32 colourArgb, Kind trackKind)
    : id (trackId), kind (trackKind), colour (colourArgb)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < numTestVoices; ++i)
        synth.addVoice (new TestVoice());

    synth.addSound (new TestSound());

    // Built once, so releasing notes never allocates on the audio thread.
    for (int channel = 1; channel <= 16; ++channel)
    {
        notesOffMidi.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::allSoundOff (channel), 0);
        notesOffMidi.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::controllerEvent (channel, 64, 0), 0);   // the sustain pedal up
        notesOffMidi.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::allNotesOff (channel), 0);
    }

    // Room for a busy block after the MIDI FX (chords, echoes), so it never allocates.
    releaseMidi.ensureSize (32768);
    blockMidi.ensureSize (32768);

    // Start at the fader position, so a new track does not fade in.
    lastGainLeft = lastGainRight = 1.0f;
}

Track::~Track()
{
    // The plugins go with the members, on the message thread: the inserts, then the instrument.
}

//==============================================================================
void Track::prepare (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize)
{
    synth.setCurrentPlaybackSampleRate (sampleRate);
    buffer.setSize (2, juce::jmax (maxBlockSize * 2, minimumBufferSize), false, true, true);
    buffer.clear();
    inputSum.setSize (2, buffer.getNumSamples(), false, true, true);
    busInput.setSize (2, juce::jmax (maxBlockSize * 2, minimumBufferSize), false, true, true);
    busInput.clear();
    liveMidi.ensureSize (16384);
    inserts.prepare (maxBlockSize);
    board.prepare (sampleRate, maxBlockSize);
    live.prepare (sampleRate);

    if (choir != nullptr)
        choir->prepare (sampleRate, maxBlockSize);
}

void Track::quietInserts (const clap_event_transport_t& position) noexcept
{
    // (Frozen, they rest anyway.)
    if (renderedSamples <= 0 || inserts.size() == 0 || frozen != nullptr)
        return;

    buffer.clear (0, renderedSamples);
    releaseMidi.clear();   // no notes for them
    inserts.process (buffer.getWritePointer (0), buffer.getWritePointer (1), renderedSamples, releaseMidi, position);
}

void Track::showLevels (float left, float right) noexcept
{
    storeMax (peakLeft, left);
    storeMax (peakRight, right);
}

void Track::render (const juce::MidiBuffer& liveNotes, const float* const* inputs, int numInputs, bool recording,
                    const Transport& songTransport, const clap_event_transport_t& transport, int numSamples, bool dry,
                    bool hearInput) noexcept
{
    renderedSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, buffer.getNumSamples());

    if (renderedSamples <= 0)
        return;

    buffer.clear (0, renderedSamples);

    // An FX channel or a bus: what the sends (or the tracks playing into the bus) brought in,
    // through its inserts.
    if (isMixChannel())
    {
        const auto samples = juce::jmin (renderedSamples, busInput.getNumSamples());
        buffer.copyFrom (0, 0, busInput, 0, 0, samples);
        buffer.copyFrom (1, 0, busInput, 1, 0, samples);
        blockMidi.clear();
        inserts.process (buffer.getWritePointer (0), buffer.getWritePointer (1), renderedSamples, blockMidi, transport);
        return;
    }

    // Frozen: its render, in place of everything that made it (which rests meanwhile). The Live
    // Show hears its channels live.
    if (frozen != nullptr && ! hearInput)
    {
        playClips (frozen.get(), songTransport, buffer.getWritePointer (0), buffer.getWritePointer (1), false);
        return;
    }

    if (kind == Kind::audio)
    {
        auto* left = buffer.getWritePointer (0);
        auto* right = buffer.getWritePointer (1);
        playClips (playlist.get(), songTransport, left, right);

        // A choir track: the vocal at the lead's level, and its voices sung from the clips.
        if (choir != nullptr)
            choir->process (playlist.get(), songTransport, left, right, renderedSamples);

        const auto channel = [inputs, numInputs] (int index) -> const float*
        {
            return inputs != nullptr && juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, numInputs) ? inputs[index] : nullptr;
        };

        // The input's channels: its left (a mono input's first), then its right or a mono input's others.
        std::array<const float*, maxInputChannels> heard {};
        int count = 0;

        if (const auto* first = channel (inputLeft.load (std::memory_order_relaxed)); first != nullptr)
        {
            heard[0] = first;
            count = 1;

            if (const auto rightIndex = inputRight.load (std::memory_order_relaxed); rightIndex >= 0)
            {
                if (const auto* second = channel (rightIndex); second != nullptr)
                    heard[static_cast<size_t> (count++)] = second;
            }
            else
            {
                for (const auto& also : inputAlso)
                    if (const auto* more = channel (also.load (std::memory_order_relaxed) - 1); more != nullptr && count < maxInputChannels)
                        heard[static_cast<size_t> (count++)] = more;
            }
        }

        // As the channel hears it: one channel alone on both sides; more, as a mono channel (all
        // of them together, connected to both sides) or a stereo one (each side its own: the
        // first, third... on the left, the second, fourth... on the right).
        const float* inLeft = heard[0];
        const float* inRight = heard[0];

        if (count > 1 && renderedSamples <= inputSum.getNumSamples())
        {
            if (monoMode.load (std::memory_order_relaxed))
            {
                auto* sum = inputSum.getWritePointer (0);
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (sum, heard[0], renderedSamples);

                for (int i = 1; i < count; ++i)
                    juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (sum, heard[static_cast<size_t> (i)], renderedSamples);

                inLeft = inRight = sum;
            }
            else if (count == 2)
            {
                inRight = heard[1];
            }
            else
            {
                auto* sumLeft = inputSum.getWritePointer (0);
                auto* sumRight = inputSum.getWritePointer (1);
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (sumLeft, heard[0], renderedSamples);
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (sumRight, heard[1], renderedSamples);

                for (int i = 2; i < count; ++i)
                    juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (i % 2 == 0 ? sumLeft : sumRight, heard[static_cast<size_t> (i)], renderedSamples);

                inLeft = sumLeft;
                inRight = sumRight;
            }
        }

        if (inLeft != nullptr)
        {
            const auto peakOf = [this] (const float* data)
            {
                const auto range = juce::FloatVectorOperations::findMinAndMax (data, renderedSamples);
                return juce::jmax (-range.getStart(), range.getEnd());
            };

            const auto levelLeft = peakOf (inLeft);
            storeMax (inputPeakLeft, levelLeft);
            storeMax (inputPeakRight, inRight == inLeft ? levelLeft : peakOf (inRight));

            if (hearInput || monitor.load (std::memory_order_relaxed))
            {
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (left, inLeft, renderedSamples);
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (right, inRight, renderedSamples);
            }

            // The writer copies into its own queue; a background thread does the disk.
            if (recording && recorder != nullptr)
            {
                const float* data[] = { inLeft, inRight };
                recorder->write (data, renderedSamples);
            }
        }

        if (! dry)
            inserts.process (left, right, renderedSamples, blockMidi, transport);

        return;
    }

    // This block's notes: the clips' first, then the live ones.
    blockMidi.clear();
    sequencer.render (sequence.get(), songTransport, blockMidi);

    if (! liveNotes.isEmpty())
        blockMidi.addEvents (liveNotes, 0, -1, 0);

    const bool releaseNotes = notesOffRequested.exchange (false);

    if (releaseNotes)
        midiFx.requestRelease();

    // Through the MIDI FX: the notes as the instrument is to hear them.
    midiFx.process (blockMidi, songTransport, renderedSamples);

    // What it plays, for MIDI FX on other tracks that follow it (Harmonize); not while the
    // Sampling Studio holds it (which may play it on a thread of its own).
    if (! hearInput)
        MidiFx::board().publish (id, blockMidi);

    const auto& midi = blockMidi;

    // Releasing: silence the test synth at once (it may not be the one rendering) and send
    // any plugin instrument all-notes-off first, then this block's live notes, so a note
    // played in the same block is not lost.
    if (releaseNotes)
    {
        synth.allNotesOff (0, false);
        releaseMidi.clear();
        releaseMidi.addEvents (notesOffMidi, 0, -1, 0);
        releaseMidi.addEvents (midi, 0, -1, 0);
    }

    const auto& events = releaseNotes ? releaseMidi : midi;
    auto* left = buffer.getWritePointer (0);
    auto* right = buffer.getWritePointer (1);

    auto* source = instrument != nullptr && instrument->isActive() ? instrument.get() : nullptr;

    if (source != nullptr && source->getRole() == Plugin::Role::instrument)
    {
        source->process (nullptr, nullptr, left, right, renderedSamples, events, &transport);
    }
    else
    {
        synth.renderNextBlock (buffer, events, 0, renderedSamples);

        // A note effect hears the notes; the test synth stays audible.
        if (source != nullptr)
            source->process (left, right, nullptr, nullptr, renderedSamples, events, &transport);
    }

    if (! dry)
        inserts.process (left, right, renderedSamples, events, transport);
}

void Track::sendInto (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, float gain, float& lastGain) const noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, renderedSamples);

    if (numSamples <= 0 || left == nullptr || right == nullptr)
        return;

    // The fader's own ramp from this block (so a send follows fader moves and mutes without a
    // click), times the send's level, ramped too.
    const auto count = static_cast<float> (numSamples);
    const auto stepLeft = (lastGainLeft - rampFromLeft) / count;
    const auto stepRight = (lastGainRight - rampFromRight) / count;
    const auto stepSend = (gain - lastGain) / count;

    const auto* sourceLeft = buffer.getReadPointer (0);
    const auto* sourceRight = buffer.getReadPointer (1);
    auto faderLeft = rampFromLeft, faderRight = rampFromRight, send = lastGain;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        faderLeft += stepLeft;
        faderRight += stepRight;
        send += stepSend;
        left[i] += sourceLeft[i] * faderLeft * send;
        right[i] += sourceRight[i] * faderRight * send;
    }

    lastGain = gain;
}

void Track::playClips (const AudioPlaylist* list, const Transport& songTransport, float* left, float* right, bool fadeStart) noexcept
{
    const auto segments = songTransport.getNumSegments();

    if (list == nullptr || list->items.empty() || segments == 0)
        return;

    constexpr juce::int64 fade = 64;   // samples: clip edges ramp in and out, so they never click

    // Audio keeps its speed: a clip plays from where it starts in the song's time, sample by
    // sample, whatever the tempo does on the way.
    for (int s = 0; s < segments; ++s)
    {
        const auto& segment = songTransport.getSegment (s);
        const auto segmentEnd = segment.sample + segment.length;

        for (const auto& item : list->items)
        {
            if (item.data == nullptr || item.lengthSamples <= 0)
                continue;

            const auto itemEnd = item.startSample + item.lengthSamples;

            if (itemEnd <= segment.sample || item.startSample >= segmentEnd)
                continue;

            const auto first = static_cast<int> (juce::jmax<juce::int64> (0, item.startSample - segment.sample));
            const auto last = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (segment.length, itemEnd - segment.sample));

            const auto& samples = item.data->samples;
            const auto* sourceLeft = samples.getReadPointer (0);
            const auto* sourceRight = samples.getReadPointer (samples.getNumChannels() > 1 ? 1 : 0);
            const auto available = static_cast<juce::int64> (samples.getNumSamples());

            auto intoClip = segment.sample + first - item.startSample;

            for (int i = first; i < last; ++i, ++intoClip)
            {
                const auto source = item.offsetSamples + intoClip;

                if (intoClip < 0 || intoClip >= item.lengthSamples || source < 0 || source >= available)
                    continue;

                auto gain = item.gain;
                const auto untilEnd = item.lengthSamples - intoClip;

                if (intoClip < fade)
                {
                    if (fadeStart)
                        gain *= static_cast<float> (intoClip) / static_cast<float> (fade);
                }
                else if (untilEnd < fade)
                    gain *= static_cast<float> (untilEnd) / static_cast<float> (fade);

                // The clip's own fades: quarter-sine curves, which sound even as they pass.
                if (intoClip < item.fadeInSamples)
                    gain *= static_cast<float> (std::sin (juce::MathConstants<double>::halfPi * static_cast<double> (intoClip) / static_cast<double> (item.fadeInSamples)));

                if (untilEnd < item.fadeOutSamples)
                    gain *= static_cast<float> (std::sin (juce::MathConstants<double>::halfPi * static_cast<double> (untilEnd) / static_cast<double> (item.fadeOutSamples)));

                left[segment.offset + i] += sourceLeft[source] * gain;
                right[segment.offset + i] += sourceRight[source] * gain;
            }
        }
    }
}

std::pair<float, float> Track::faderGains (bool audible) const noexcept
{
    if (! audible)
        return { 0.0f, 0.0f };

    const auto db = volumeDb.load();
    const auto gain = db <= silentDb ? 0.0f : juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (db);
    const auto balance = juce::jlimit (-1.0f, 1.0f, pan.load());
    return { gain * (balance > 0.0f ? 1.0f - balance : 1.0f), gain * (balance < 0.0f ? 1.0f + balance : 1.0f) };
}

void Track::settleGain (bool audible) noexcept
{
    std::tie (lastGainLeft, lastGainRight) = faderGains (audible);
    rampFromLeft = lastGainLeft;
    rampFromRight = lastGainRight;
}

void Track::mixInto (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, bool audible) noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, renderedSamples);

    if (numSamples <= 0 || left == nullptr)
        return;

    const auto [targetLeft, targetRight] = faderGains (audible);

    // Ramp across the block so fader moves and mutes never click.
    const auto stepLeft = (targetLeft - lastGainLeft) / static_cast<float> (numSamples);
    const auto stepRight = (targetRight - lastGainRight) / static_cast<float> (numSamples);

    const auto* sourceLeft = buffer.getReadPointer (0);
    const auto* sourceRight = buffer.getReadPointer (1);

    auto gainLeft = lastGainLeft;
    auto gainRight = lastGainRight;
    float peakL = 0.0f, peakR = 0.0f;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        gainLeft += stepLeft;
        gainRight += stepRight;

        const auto sampleLeft = sourceLeft[i] * gainLeft;
        const auto sampleRight = sourceRight[i] * gainRight;

        if (right != nullptr)
        {
            left[i] += sampleLeft;
            right[i] += sampleRight;
        }
        else
        {
            left[i] += 0.5f * (sampleLeft + sampleRight);
        }

        peakL = juce::jmax (peakL, std::abs (sampleLeft));
        peakR = juce::jmax (peakR, std::abs (sampleRight));
    }

    rampFromLeft = lastGainLeft;
    rampFromRight = lastGainRight;
    lastGainLeft = targetLeft;
    lastGainRight = targetRight;

    storeMax (peakLeft, peakL);
    storeMax (peakRight, peakR);
}
