// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\VideoSound.cpp

#include "VideoSound.h"
#include "LiveStream.h"     // LiveStream::problem(): whether FFmpeg's DLLs are there

#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

#if FANAN_FFMPEG
extern "C"
{
 #include <libavcodec/avcodec.h>
 #include <libavformat/avformat.h>
 #include <libavutil/channel_layout.h>
 #include <libswresample/swresample.h>
}
#endif

bool VideoSound::available()
{
#if FANAN_FFMPEG
    return LiveStream::problem().isEmpty();
#else
    return false;
#endif
}

#if FANAN_FFMPEG
namespace
{
    /** A video without sound reads as silence, one channel at this rate. */
    constexpr double silenceRate = 8000.0;

    /** The furthest the sound is moved to line it up with the picture (further: its times are wrong). */
    constexpr double longestShift = 600.0;

    constexpr double notKnown = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();

    void quietFFmpeg()
    {
        static std::once_flag once;
        std::call_once (once, [] { av_log_set_level (AV_LOG_ERROR); });
    }

    //==============================================================================
    /** FFmpeg's side: the file open, its sound's decoder, and the sound decoded and not handed
        out yet (floats, one or two channels, at the rate of its first frame). */
    class Decoder final
    {
    public:
        Decoder() = default;
        ~Decoder()      { close(); }

        /** Opens the video and decodes up to its first sound. False: FFmpeg can't read it, or it's
            a kind VLC lines up itself. A video without sound is opened (info.hasSound false) when
            it says how long it is. soundOnly: an audio file (or anything with sound), no picture
            looked for, every kind FFmpeg reads; one without sound isn't opened. */
        bool open (const juce::File& file, VideoMedia::Info& info, bool soundOnly = false)
        {
            close();
            quietFFmpeg();

            // "file:" first: a name with a colon in it is never taken for a protocol.
            const auto url = "file:" + file.getFullPathName();

            if (avformat_open_input (&format, url.toRawUTF8(), nullptr, nullptr) < 0)
                return false;

            // Transport and program streams, and Ogg: their times start anywhere, and VLC shows
            // their picture by its own reading of them (VLC prepares their sound to match).
            if (! soundOnly && (format->iformat->flags & AVFMT_TS_DISCONT) != 0)
                return false;

            if (avformat_find_stream_info (format, nullptr) < 0)
                return false;

            if (soundOnly)
                return openSound (info, -1, true);

            // The picture (a cover's still picture isn't one).
            const auto picture = av_find_best_stream (format, AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, -1, -1, nullptr, 0);

            if (picture < 0 || (format->streams[picture]->disposition & AV_DISPOSITION_ATTACHED_PIC) != 0)
                return false;

            auto* seen = format->streams[picture];
            const auto* look = seen->codecpar;

            if (look->width <= 0 || look->height <= 0)
                return false;

            // As it's shown: its pixels' own shape applied.
            auto width = static_cast<double> (look->width);
            const auto pixel = av_guess_sample_aspect_ratio (format, seen, nullptr);

            if (pixel.num > 0 && pixel.den > 0)
                width = width * pixel.num / pixel.den;

            info.width = static_cast<int> (std::lround (width));
            info.height = look->height;

            const auto frameRate = av_guess_frame_rate (format, seen, nullptr);
            info.fps = frameRate.num > 0 && frameRate.den > 0 ? av_q2d (frameRate) : 0.0;

            if (info.fps <= 0.0 || info.fps > 300.0)
                info.fps = 25.0;

            if (seen->start_time != AV_NOPTS_VALUE)
                pictureStart = static_cast<double> (seen->start_time) * av_q2d (seen->time_base);

            if (format->duration != AV_NOPTS_VALUE && format->duration > 0)
                info.seconds = static_cast<double> (format->duration) / AV_TIME_BASE;
            else if (seen->duration != AV_NOPTS_VALUE && seen->duration > 0)
                info.seconds = static_cast<double> (seen->duration) * av_q2d (seen->time_base);

            return openSound (info, picture, false);
        }

        /** Its sound (the one that goes with the picture, when there's one) ready to decode, and
            decoded up to its first sound. */
        bool openSound (VideoMedia::Info& info, int picture, bool soundOnly)
        {
            if (soundOnly && format->duration != AV_NOPTS_VALUE && format->duration > 0)
                info.seconds = static_cast<double> (format->duration) / AV_TIME_BASE;

            const AVCodec* decoder = nullptr;
            const auto found = av_find_best_stream (format, AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO, -1, picture, &decoder, 0);

            if (found == AVERROR_STREAM_NOT_FOUND)
            {
                if (soundOnly)
                    return false;

                // A sound FFmpeg couldn't make out (its rate or channels not found where it looked)
                // is still a sound: VLC may read it.
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < format->nb_streams; ++i)
                    if (format->streams[i]->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO)
                        return false;

                info.hasSound = false;
                return info.seconds > 0.0;   // silence as long as it is
            }

            if (found < 0 || decoder == nullptr)
                return false;                // a sound FFmpeg can't decode: VLC may

            stream = found;
            auto* sound = format->streams[stream];
            codec = avcodec_alloc_context3 (decoder);

            if (codec == nullptr || avcodec_parameters_to_context (codec, sound->codecpar) < 0)
                return false;

            // With its stream's time base, the decoder leaves out the priming the file marks (and
            // says so in the frames' times).
            codec->pkt_timebase = sound->time_base;

            if (avcodec_open2 (codec, decoder, nullptr) < 0)
                return false;

            // Only the sound is read: the rest is passed over (MP4's picture isn't even read).
            for (unsigned i = 0; i < format->nb_streams; ++i)
                format->streams[i]->discard = static_cast<int> (i) == stream ? AVDISCARD_DEFAULT : AVDISCARD_ALL;

            packet = av_packet_alloc();
            frame = av_frame_alloc();
            held = av_frame_alloc();

            if (packet == nullptr || frame == nullptr || held == nullptr)
                return false;

            timeBase = av_q2d (sound->time_base);
            info.hasSound = true;

            // AVI's times are made up as it's read (from how much has come): no holes to fill there.
            // Nor in an audio file: no picture to keep up with, its sound one stretch after another.
            fillsHoles = ! soundOnly && ! juce::String (format->iformat->name).containsIgnoreCase ("avi");

            // Its first sound: its real rate and channels (some say otherwise until they're
            // decoded), and where it starts.
            if (! decodeMore())
            {
                // Nothing came out of it after all: silence as long as it is.
                info.hasSound = false;
                return info.seconds > 0.0;
            }

            info.soundRate = outRate;
            return true;
        }

        void close()
        {
            avcodec_free_context (&codec);
            swr_free (&swr);
            av_packet_free (&packet);
            av_frame_free (&frame);
            av_frame_free (&held);
            avformat_close_input (&format);
            av_channel_layout_uninit (&inLayout);
            stream = -1;
            inRate = 0;
            inFormat = -1;
            outRate = 0;
            outChannels = 0;
            draining = finished = started = false;
            fillsHoles = true;
            failures = 0;
            produced = 0;
            holeLeft = 0;
            firstTicks = AV_NOPTS_VALUE;
            pictureStart = notKnown;

            for (auto& channel : out)
                channel.clear();

            outRead = 0;
        }

        double getRate() const noexcept            { return static_cast<double> (outRate); }
        int getChannels() const noexcept           { return outChannels; }

        /** Where its first sound is (seconds), as the file's times say (not known: NaN). */
        double getFirstSeconds() const noexcept
        {
            return firstTicks != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? static_cast<double> (firstTicks) * timeBase : notKnown;
        }

        /** The video's time 0 in the file's times: 0 (a picture a little later than the sound is
            how the file keeps them together), or for a file cut out of a longer stream (its times
            going on from there), where its picture starts. */
        double getOrigin() const noexcept
        {
            if (format != nullptr && format->start_time != AV_NOPTS_VALUE)
                if (const auto start = static_cast<double> (format->start_time) / AV_TIME_BASE; start > 0.5)
                    return std::isfinite (pictureStart) ? pictureStart : start;

            return 0.0;
        }

        /** Where its sound ends (seconds, in the file's times; not known: NaN). */
        double getSoundEnd() const noexcept
        {
            if (format == nullptr || stream < 0)
                return notKnown;

            const auto* sound = format->streams[stream];

            if (sound->duration != AV_NOPTS_VALUE && sound->duration > 0)
            {
                const auto start = sound->start_time != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? sound->start_time
                                 : firstTicks != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? firstTicks : 0;
                return (static_cast<double> (start) + static_cast<double> (sound->duration)) * timeBase;
            }

            if (format->duration != AV_NOPTS_VALUE && format->duration > 0)
            {
                const auto start = format->start_time != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? format->start_time : 0;
                return (static_cast<double> (start) + static_cast<double> (format->duration)) / AV_TIME_BASE;
            }

            return notKnown;
        }

        /** The sound decoded and not handed out yet. */
        int available() const noexcept            { return static_cast<int> (out[0].size() - outRead); }

        const float* data (int channel) const noexcept
        {
            return out[static_cast<size_t> (juce::jlimit (0, juce::jmax (0, outChannels - 1), channel))].data() + outRead;
        }

        void consume (int count) noexcept
        {
            outRead += static_cast<size_t> (juce::jlimit (0, available(), count));

            // What's been handed out goes, now and then.
            if (outRead >= 65536 && outRead * 2 >= out[0].size())
            {
                for (int c = 0; c < outChannels; ++c)
                {
                    auto& channel = out[static_cast<size_t> (c)];
                    channel.erase (channel.begin(), channel.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t> (outRead));
                }

                outRead = 0;
            }
        }

        /** Decodes more of the sound. False: there's no more. */
        bool decodeMore()
        {
            if (codec == nullptr)
                return false;

            // A hole in the sound: its silence a second at a time, then the frame after it.
            if (holeLeft > 0)
            {
                const auto count = juce::jmin<juce::int64> (holeLeft, outRate);
                addSilence (count);
                holeLeft -= count;
                return true;
            }

            if (held != nullptr && held->nb_samples > 0)
            {
                const auto added = convert (held, false);
                av_frame_unref (held);

                if (added > 0)
                    return true;
            }

            if (finished)
                return false;

            for (;;)
            {
                const auto received = avcodec_receive_frame (codec, frame);

                if (received == 0)
                {
                    failures = 0;
                    const auto added = convert (frame, true);
                    av_frame_unref (frame);

                    if (added > 0)
                        return true;

                    if (holeLeft > 0)
                        return decodeMore();   // the hole before it: its silence first

                    continue;
                }

                // A frame it couldn't decode is passed over (a decoder failing over and over
                // without wanting more of the file is at its end).
                if (received != AVERROR (EAGAIN) && received != AVERROR_EOF && ! draining && ++failures < 100)
                    continue;

                if (received != AVERROR (EAGAIN) || draining)
                {
                    // Its end: what the converter still holds.
                    finished = true;
                    return drain() > 0;
                }

                if (av_read_frame (format, packet) < 0)
                {
                    draining = true;
                    avcodec_send_packet (codec, nullptr);
                    continue;
                }

                // A damaged packet is passed over.
                failures = 0;

                if (packet->stream_index == stream)
                    avcodec_send_packet (codec, packet);

                av_packet_unref (packet);
            }
        }

    private:
        /** A frame into floats at the first frame's rate, one or two channels. Returns how many came
            (none for a frame after a hole: it's held, and the hole's silence comes first). */
        int convert (AVFrame* decoded, bool mayFollowHole)
        {
            const auto channels = decoded->ch_layout.nb_channels;

            if (decoded->nb_samples <= 0 || channels <= 0 || decoded->sample_rate <= 0)
                return 0;

            if (! started)
            {
                started = true;
                firstTicks = decoded->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? decoded->pts : decoded->best_effort_timestamp;
                outRate = decoded->sample_rate;
                outChannels = juce::jlimit (1, 2, channels);
            }
            else if (mayFollowHole && fillsHoles && decoded->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE && firstTicks != AV_NOPTS_VALUE)
            {
                // A stretch the file has no sound for (frames lost in a recording): silence there,
                // so what comes after stays with its picture. The frame waits for it.
                const auto due = static_cast<double> (decoded->pts - firstTicks) * timeBase * outRate;
                const auto missing = static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (due)) - produced;

                if (missing > outRate / 4 && missing < static_cast<juce::int64> (outRate) * 600)
                {
                    holeLeft = missing;
                    av_frame_unref (held);
                    av_frame_move_ref (held, decoded);
                    return 0;
                }
            }

            if (! fitConverter (decoded))
                return 0;

            const auto room = swr_get_out_samples (swr, decoded->nb_samples);

            if (room <= 0)
                return 0;

            const auto made = swr_convert (swr, planes (room), room, const_cast<const uint8_t**> (decoded->extended_data), decoded->nb_samples);
            return keep (made);
        }

        /** What the converter holds back, at the end. */
        int drain()
        {
            if (swr == nullptr)
                return 0;

            const auto room = swr_get_out_samples (swr, 0);

            if (room <= 0)
                return 0;

            return keep (swr_convert (swr, planes (room), room, nullptr, 0));
        }

        uint8_t** planes (int room)
        {
            for (int c = 0; c < 2; ++c)
            {
                auto& plane = scratch[static_cast<size_t> (c)];

                if (static_cast<int> (plane.size()) < room)
                    plane.resize (static_cast<size_t> (room));

                planePointers[static_cast<size_t> (c)] = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*> (plane.data());
            }

            return planePointers.data();
        }

        int keep (int made)
        {
            if (made <= 0)
                return 0;

            for (int c = 0; c < outChannels; ++c)
            {
                const auto* from = scratch[static_cast<size_t> (c)].data();
                auto& to = out[static_cast<size_t> (c)];
                to.insert (to.end(), from, from + made);
            }

            produced += made;
            return made;
        }

        void addSilence (juce::int64 count)
        {
            for (int c = 0; c < outChannels; ++c)
            {
                auto& to = out[static_cast<size_t> (c)];
                to.insert (to.end(), static_cast<size_t> (count), 0.0f);
            }

            produced += count;
        }

        /** The converter, set for this frame's kind of sound (set again when it changes). */
        bool fitConverter (const AVFrame* decoded)
        {
            AVChannelLayout layout {};

            if (decoded->ch_layout.order != AV_CHANNEL_ORDER_UNSPEC)
                av_channel_layout_copy (&layout, &decoded->ch_layout);
            else
                av_channel_layout_default (&layout, decoded->ch_layout.nb_channels);

            if (swr != nullptr && decoded->sample_rate == inRate && decoded->format == inFormat
                && av_channel_layout_compare (&layout, &inLayout) == 0)
            {
                av_channel_layout_uninit (&layout);
                return true;
            }

            swr_free (&swr);
            AVChannelLayout wanted {};
            av_channel_layout_default (&wanted, outChannels);

            const bool made = swr_alloc_set_opts2 (&swr, &wanted, AV_SAMPLE_FMT_FLTP, outRate, &layout,
                                                   static_cast<AVSampleFormat> (decoded->format), decoded->sample_rate, 0, nullptr) >= 0
                              && swr_init (swr) >= 0;
            av_channel_layout_uninit (&wanted);

            if (! made)
            {
                swr_free (&swr);
                av_channel_layout_uninit (&layout);
                return false;
            }

            av_channel_layout_uninit (&inLayout);
            inLayout = layout;   // kept (its own now)
            inRate = decoded->sample_rate;
            inFormat = decoded->format;
            return true;
        }

        AVFormatContext* format = nullptr;
        AVCodecContext* codec = nullptr;
        SwrContext* swr = nullptr;
        AVPacket* packet = nullptr;
        AVFrame* frame = nullptr;
        AVFrame* held = nullptr;                // the frame after a hole, while its silence goes out
        int stream = -1;
        double timeBase = 0.0;
        bool draining = false, finished = false, started = false;
        bool fillsHoles = true;                 // silence where the file has no sound (its times say)
        int failures = 0;                       // frames it couldn't decode since it last read the file
        juce::int64 produced = 0;               // samples made since its first sound (holes filled too)
        juce::int64 holeLeft = 0;               // a hole's silence still to come
        juce::int64 firstTicks = AV_NOPTS_VALUE;
        double pictureStart = notKnown;         // seconds, in the file's times

        // The converter's input as it was set up, and what it makes.
        AVChannelLayout inLayout {};
        int inRate = 0, inFormat = -1;
        int outRate = 0, outChannels = 0;

        std::array<std::vector<float>, 2> scratch, out;
        std::array<uint8_t*, 2> planePointers {};
        size_t outRead = 0;
    };

    //==============================================================================
    /** The sound as JUCE reads it: from its start on (a read further on decodes up to there; one
        before where it is opens the file again). */
    class Reader final : public juce::AudioFormatReader
    {
    public:
        explicit Reader (const juce::File& video)
            : juce::AudioFormatReader (nullptr, "Video sound"), file (video)
        {
            usesFloatingPointData = true;
            bitsPerSample = 32;
        }

        /** Opens it: its rate, channels and length, and how it lines up with the picture. */
        bool start (VideoMedia::Info& info)
        {
            if (! decoder.open (file, info))
                return false;

            if (! info.hasSound)
            {
                silent = true;
                sampleRate = silenceRate;
                numChannels = 1;
                lengthInSamples = static_cast<juce::int64> (std::ceil (info.seconds * silenceRate));
                decoder.close();
                return lengthInSamples > 0;
            }

            sampleRate = decoder.getRate();
            numChannels = static_cast<unsigned int> (decoder.getChannels());

            // Where its first sound is against the picture's time 0: silence in front of a later
            // start, an earlier one's beginning left out.
            const auto origin = decoder.getOrigin();
            const auto first = decoder.getFirstSeconds();
            auto shift = std::isfinite (first) ? first - origin : 0.0;

            if (std::abs (shift) > longestShift)
                shift = 0.0;

            startShift = static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (shift * sampleRate));

            const auto end = decoder.getSoundEnd();

            if (! std::isfinite (end) || end - origin <= 0.0)
                return false;

            lengthInSamples = static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround ((end - origin) * sampleRate));
            fromTheStart();
            return lengthInSamples > 0;
        }

        bool readSamples (int* const* destChannels, int numDestChannels, int startOffsetInDestBuffer,
                          juce::int64 startSampleInFile, int numSamples) override
        {
            clearSamplesBeyondAvailableLength (destChannels, numDestChannels, startOffsetInDestBuffer,
                                               startSampleInFile, numSamples, lengthInSamples);

            if (numSamples <= 0)
                return true;

            // Before where it is: from its start again.
            if (startSampleInFile < position && ! reopen())
            {
                clear (destChannels, numDestChannels, startOffsetInDestBuffer, numSamples);
                return true;
            }

            skip (startSampleInFile - position);

            for (int done = 0; done < numSamples;)
            {
                const auto count = take (destChannels, numDestChannels, startOffsetInDestBuffer + done, numSamples - done);

                if (count <= 0)
                {
                    // Its sound ended a little before the length said: silence.
                    clear (destChannels, numDestChannels, startOffsetInDestBuffer + done, numSamples - done);
                    position += numSamples - done;
                    break;
                }

                done += count;
            }

            return true;
        }

    private:
        void fromTheStart() noexcept
        {
            position = 0;
            padLeft = juce::jmax<juce::int64> (0, startShift);
            dropLeft = juce::jmax<juce::int64> (0, -startShift);
        }

        bool reopen()
        {
            if (silent)
            {
                position = 0;
                return true;
            }

            VideoMedia::Info again;

            if (! decoder.open (file, again) || ! again.hasSound)
                return false;

            fromTheStart();
            return true;
        }

        /** Decoded sound ready to hand out (the start left out first). False: no more. */
        bool fill()
        {
            for (;;)
            {
                if (dropLeft > 0 && decoder.available() > 0)
                {
                    const auto dropped = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (dropLeft, decoder.available()));
                    decoder.consume (dropped);
                    dropLeft -= dropped;
                    continue;
                }

                if (dropLeft == 0 && decoder.available() > 0)
                    return true;

                if (! decoder.decodeMore())
                    return false;
            }
        }

        static void clear (int* const* dest, int numDest, int at, int count)
        {
            for (int c = 0; c < numDest; ++c)
                if (dest[c] != nullptr)
                    juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (reinterpret_cast<float*> (dest[c]) + at, count);
        }

        /** Up to wanted samples into dest: the silence in front first, then the sound. 0: no more. */
        int take (int* const* dest, int numDest, int at, int wanted)
        {
            if (silent || padLeft > 0)
            {
                const auto count = silent ? wanted : static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (padLeft, wanted));
                clear (dest, numDest, at, count);
                padLeft -= silent ? 0 : count;
                position += count;
                return count;
            }

            if (! fill())
                return 0;

            const auto count = juce::jmin (wanted, decoder.available());

            for (int c = 0; c < numDest; ++c)
                if (dest[c] != nullptr)
                    juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (reinterpret_cast<float*> (dest[c]) + at, decoder.data (c), count);

            decoder.consume (count);
            position += count;
            return count;
        }

        /** Passes over this many samples. */
        void skip (juce::int64 count)
        {
            while (count > 0)
            {
                if (silent)
                {
                    position += count;
                    return;
                }

                if (padLeft > 0)
                {
                    const auto passed = juce::jmin (padLeft, count);
                    padLeft -= passed;
                    position += passed;
                    count -= passed;
                    continue;
                }

                if (! fill())
                {
                    position += count;   // past its end: silence from here
                    return;
                }

                const auto passed = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (count, decoder.available()));
                decoder.consume (passed);
                position += passed;
                count -= passed;
            }
        }

        const juce::File file;
        Decoder decoder;
        bool silent = false;
        juce::int64 startShift = 0;             // samples: + silence in front, - left out of its start
        juce::int64 position = 0;               // where the next sample handed out is
        juce::int64 padLeft = 0, dropLeft = 0;
    };
}
#endif

bool VideoSound::soundToWav (const juce::File& source, const juce::File& wav, juce::String& error, const std::function<bool()>& keepGoing)
{
    if (! source.existsAsFile())
    {
        error = source.getFileName() + " isn't there.";
        return false;
    }

#if FANAN_FFMPEG
    if (! available())
    {
        error = "this Sonify can't read " + source.getFileExtension().toUpperCase().trimCharactersAtStart (".") + " files (FFmpeg is missing next to it).";
        return false;
    }

    Decoder decoder;
    VideoMedia::Info info;

    if (! decoder.open (source, info, true) || ! info.hasSound || decoder.getRate() <= 0.0 || decoder.getChannels() <= 0)
    {
        error = "it isn't a sound Sonify can read.";
        return false;
    }

    wav.deleteFile();
    std::unique_ptr<juce::OutputStream> stream = wav.createOutputStream();

    if (stream == nullptr)
    {
        error = "couldn't write " + wav.getFullPathName() + ".";
        return false;
    }

    const auto channels = decoder.getChannels();
    auto writer = juce::WavAudioFormat().createWriterFor (stream, juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions{}
                                                                      .withSampleRate (decoder.getRate())
                                                                      .withNumChannels (channels)
                                                                      .withBitsPerSample (32)
                                                                      .withSampleFormat (juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions::SampleFormat::floatingPoint));

    if (writer == nullptr)
    {
        error = "couldn't write " + wav.getFullPathName() + ".";
        return false;
    }

    juce::int64 written = 0;

    for (;;)
    {
        if (keepGoing != nullptr && ! keepGoing())
        {
            writer.reset();
            wav.deleteFile();
            error = "Cancelled";
            return false;
        }

        if (const auto count = decoder.available(); count > 0)
        {
            const float* planes[2] = { decoder.data (0), decoder.data (1) };

            if (! writer->writeFromFloatArrays (planes, channels, count))
            {
                writer.reset();
                wav.deleteFile();
                error = "couldn't write " + wav.getFullPathName() + ".";
                return false;
            }

            written += count;
            decoder.consume (count);
            continue;
        }

        if (! decoder.decodeMore())
            break;
    }

    writer.reset();

    if (written <= 0)
    {
        wav.deleteFile();
        error = "there's no sound in it.";
        return false;
    }

    return true;
#else
    juce::ignoreUnused (wav, keepGoing);
    error = "this Sonify can't read " + source.getFileExtension().toUpperCase().trimCharactersAtStart (".") + " files.";
    return false;
#endif
}

VideoSound::Opened VideoSound::open (const juce::File& video)
{
    Opened opened;

    if (! video.existsAsFile())
    {
        opened.error = video.getFullPathName() + " isn't there.";
        return opened;
    }

#if FANAN_FFMPEG
    if (! available())
        return opened;

    auto reader = std::make_unique<Reader> (video);

    if (reader->start (opened.info))
        opened.reader = std::move (reader);
    else
        opened.info = {};
#endif

    return opened;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\VideoSound.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_formats/juce_audio_formats.h>

#include "VideoMedia.h"

#include <functional>
#include <memory>

//==============================================================================
/**
    A video's sound, read straight from its file by FFmpeg for the Live Show's player and its
    listening (tempo and key). Only the sound is decoded (the picture is passed over, most kinds
    of file not even read for it), so a video comes onto a deck about as fast as an audio file
    does: no pass of VLC's over the whole video first, no WAV written and read again. VLC still
    shows its picture.

    Lined up with the picture: sample 0 is the video's time 0, where its picture is from. A sound
    that starts later has silence in front of it; what an encoder put before the start (its
    priming, which the file says to leave out) is left out. A video without sound reads as silence
    as long as it is.

    MP4, MOV, M4V, 3GP, MKV, WebM, AVI, FLV and WMV are read this way. MPEG transport and program
    streams (TS, MTS, M2TS, MPG, VOB) and Ogg keep times VLC reads differently: those, and any video
    FFmpeg can't open, are prepared by VLC as before (VideoMedia::Preparation), as is every video in a
    Sonify built without FFmpeg.

    Any thread; a reader is used by one thread at a time.
*/
namespace VideoSound
{
    /** Whether this Sonify reads videos' sound itself (it has FFmpeg, and FFmpeg's DLLs load). */
    bool available();

    struct Opened
    {
        std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatReader> reader;   // floats, one or two channels, the sound's own rate
        VideoMedia::Info info;                              // the picture's size and rate, how long, its sound
        juce::String error;                                 // why there's no reader ("": VLC prepares this one)
    };

    /** Opens a video's sound (reading only its start). No reader with no error: VLC's preparation
        reads this one instead; with an error: it can't be read at all. */
    Opened open (const juce::File& video);

    /** An audio file of a kind JUCE doesn't read (M4A, AAC, Opus, WMA, ALAC, AC-3...), any file
        FFmpeg reads a sound from, written whole into a WAV: 32-bit float, at its own rate, one or
        two channels. Media import (MainImport.cpp) brings such files into a song this way. False:
        it couldn't (error says why, "Cancelled" when keepGoing said to stop). Any thread. */
    bool soundToWav (const juce::File& source, const juce::File& wav, juce::String& error,
                     const std::function<bool()>& keepGoing = nullptr);
}

# D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Vlc.cmake
#
# Video: VLC 3.0.21 for 64-bit Windows (libvlc.dll, libvlccore.dll and its plugins folder),
# as On Stage uses it. Sonify loads libvlc itself the first time a video is used, so building
# needs nothing of VLC's: its files are only copied next to Sonify.exe, inside the build folder.
#
# A VLC folder already on the computer can be named instead (cmake -DFANAN_VLC_DIR=...), the
# one with libvlc.dll and plugins in it (On Stage's vlc-3.0.21, say). Otherwise VideoLAN's zip
# is downloaded once into <build>/deps and checked against the SHA-256 VideoLAN publishes with
# it. As with the other downloads, a copy kept beside the project (deps\ next to
# CMakeLists.txt, copied there from a build folder) is used instead when it's this very one.
#
# Sets FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR (empty without it: Sonify builds, and says video needs VLC).

include_guard(GLOBAL)

set(FANAN_VLC_VERSION "3.0.21")
set(FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR "")
set(FANAN_VLC_DIR "" CACHE PATH "A VLC 3 folder for 64-bit Windows (libvlc.dll and plugins); empty: downloaded into the build folder")

if(NOT WIN32)
    return()
endif()

if(FANAN_VLC_DIR)
    if(EXISTS "${FANAN_VLC_DIR}/libvlc.dll" AND EXISTS "${FANAN_VLC_DIR}/libvlccore.dll" AND IS_DIRECTORY "${FANAN_VLC_DIR}/plugins")
        set(FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR "${FANAN_VLC_DIR}")
        message(STATUS "Using VLC in ${FANAN_VLC_DIR}")
        return()
    endif()

    message(WARNING "FANAN_VLC_DIR (${FANAN_VLC_DIR}) has no libvlc.dll, libvlccore.dll and plugins: VLC is downloaded instead.")
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED FANAN_DEPS_DIR)
    set(FANAN_DEPS_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/deps")
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR)
    set(FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps")
endif()

set(_vlc_name "vlc-${FANAN_VLC_VERSION}-win64")
set(_vlc_url "https://download.videolan.org/pub/videolan/vlc/${FANAN_VLC_VERSION}/win64/${_vlc_name}.zip")
set(_vlc_dir "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/${_vlc_name}")
set(_vlc_stamp "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/${_vlc_name}.done")

# The copy kept beside the project, when its stamp names this very download.
if(EXISTS "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_vlc_name}.done")
    file(READ "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_vlc_name}.done" _vlc_kept)
    string(STRIP "${_vlc_kept}" _vlc_kept)

    if(_vlc_kept STREQUAL _vlc_url)
        set(_vlc_dir "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_vlc_name}")
        set(_vlc_stamp "${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}/${_vlc_name}.done")
        message(STATUS "Using ${_vlc_name} kept in ${FANAN_KEPT_DEPS_DIR}")
    endif()
endif()

# Downloaded and unpacked once (about 78 MB); the stamp is written only when that's whole and
# the zip is the one VideoLAN says it is.
if(NOT EXISTS "${_vlc_stamp}")
    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${_vlc_dir}")
    set(_vlc_archive "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/downloads/${_vlc_name}.zip")
    set(_vlc_sums "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/downloads/${_vlc_name}.zip.sha256")
    message(STATUS "Downloading ${_vlc_name} (about 78 MB)")

    file(DOWNLOAD "${_vlc_url}.sha256" "${_vlc_sums}" STATUS _vlc_status TLS_VERIFY ON)
    list(GET _vlc_status 0 _vlc_code)

    if(_vlc_code EQUAL 0)
        file(DOWNLOAD "${_vlc_url}" "${_vlc_archive}" STATUS _vlc_status TLS_VERIFY ON)
        list(GET _vlc_status 0 _vlc_code)
    endif()

    if(NOT _vlc_code EQUAL 0)
        file(REMOVE "${_vlc_archive}" "${_vlc_sums}")
        message(WARNING "Download of ${_vlc_name} failed (${_vlc_status}): Sonify builds without video. "
                        "Name a VLC 3 folder with -DFANAN_VLC_DIR=... to use one already on the computer.")
        return()
    endif()

    file(READ "${_vlc_sums}" _vlc_expected)
    string(REGEX MATCH "[0-9a-fA-F]+" _vlc_expected "${_vlc_expected}")
    string(TOLOWER "${_vlc_expected}" _vlc_expected)
    file(SHA256 "${_vlc_archive}" _vlc_hash)

    if(NOT _vlc_hash STREQUAL _vlc_expected)
        file(REMOVE "${_vlc_archive}" "${_vlc_sums}")
        message(WARNING "${_vlc_name}.zip isn't the one VideoLAN published (its SHA-256 differs): Sonify builds without video.")
        return()
    endif()

    file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${_vlc_archive}" DESTINATION "${_vlc_dir}")
    file(REMOVE "${_vlc_archive}" "${_vlc_sums}")
    file(WRITE "${_vlc_stamp}" "${_vlc_url}\n")
endif()

# The zip holds one folder (vlc-3.0.21) with everything in it.
file(GLOB _vlc_found LIST_DIRECTORIES false "${_vlc_dir}/*/libvlc.dll" "${_vlc_dir}/libvlc.dll")

if(NOT _vlc_found)
    message(WARNING "${_vlc_name} in ${_vlc_dir} has no libvlc.dll: Sonify builds without video. "
                    "Delete ${_vlc_stamp} to download it again.")
    return()
endif()

list(GET _vlc_found 0 _vlc_found)
get_filename_component(FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR "${_vlc_found}" DIRECTORY)

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\VoiceControl.cpp

#include "VoiceControl.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <utility>

//==============================================================================
// Finding phrases
PhraseFinder::PhraseFinder()
{
    prepare (48000.0);
}

void PhraseFinder::prepare (double inputRate)
{
    const auto inRate = inputRate > 1000.0 ? inputRate : 48000.0;
    step = inRate / rate;
    resampling = std::abs (step - 1.0) > 1.0e-9;
    position = 0.0;
    previous = 0.0f;

    // Below 16 kHz's Nyquist (8 kHz) with room to spare: speech recognition needs little above 6 kHz.
    // Two sections make a fourth-order Butterworth low-pass.
    filtering = inRate >= 14000.0;

    if (filtering)
    {
        lowPass1.setCoefficients (juce::IIRCoefficients::makeLowPass (inRate, 6500.0, 0.5412));
        lowPass2.setCoefficients (juce::IIRCoefficients::makeLowPass (inRate, 6500.0, 1.3066));
    }

    highPass.setCoefficients (juce::IIRCoefficients::makeHighPass (static_cast<double> (rate), 100.0, 0.7071));
    lowPass1.reset();
    lowPass2.reset();
    highPass.reset();

    frame.clear();
    frame.reserve (static_cast<size_t> (frameLength));
    preRoll.clear();
    phrase.clear();
    levels.fill (0.0f);
    levelsCount = levelsAt = 0;
    noiseDb = -90.0f;
    inPhrase = dropped = headGiven = false;
    loudRun = quietRun = voicedFrames = phraseFrames = 0;
}

void PhraseFinder::process (const float* samples, int count, bool hushed, std::vector<Phrase>& found)
{
    hushedNow = hushed;

    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        auto x = samples[i];

        if (! std::isfinite (x))
            x = 0.0f;

        if (filtering)
            x = lowPass2.processSingleSampleRaw (lowPass1.processSingleSampleRaw (x));

        if (! resampling)
        {
            addSample (x, found);
            continue;
        }

        // Linear interpolation between the input sample before (at 0) and this one (at 1).
        while (position < 1.0)
        {
            addSample (previous + (x - previous) * static_cast<float> (position), found);
            position += step;
        }

        position -= 1.0;
        previous = x;
    }
}

void PhraseFinder::addSample (float sample, std::vector<Phrase>& found)
{
    frame.push_back (highPass.processSingleSampleRaw (sample));

    if (static_cast<int> (frame.size()) >= frameLength)
    {
        endFrame (found);
        frame.clear();
    }
}

void PhraseFinder::endFrame (std::vector<Phrase>& found)
{
    double sum = 0.0;

    for (const auto sample : frame)
        sum += static_cast<double> (sample) * static_cast<double> (sample);

    const auto level = static_cast<float> (10.0 * std::log10 (sum / frameLength + 1.0e-12));

    // The room's noise: the quietest frame of the last three seconds (speech always has gaps).
    levels[static_cast<size_t> (levelsAt)] = level;
    levelsAt = (levelsAt + 1) % noiseFrames;
    levelsCount = juce::jmin (levelsCount + 1, noiseFrames);
    noiseDb = *std::min_element (levels.begin(), levels.begin() + levelsCount);

    const auto startLevel = juce::jmax (noiseDb + 12.0f, -50.0f);
    const auto endLevel = juce::jmax (noiseDb + 6.0f, -54.0f);

    if (! inPhrase)
    {
        preRoll.insert (preRoll.end(), frame.begin(), frame.end());

        if (static_cast<int> (preRoll.size()) > preRollFrames * frameLength)
            preRoll.erase (preRoll.begin(), preRoll.begin() + frameLength);

        loudRun = level > startLevel && ! hushedNow ? loudRun + 1 : 0;

        if (loudRun >= startFrames)
        {
            inPhrase = true;
            dropped = headGiven = false;
            phraseId = ++lastId;
            phrase = std::move (preRoll);   // the loud frames are already in it
            preRoll.clear();
            voicedFrames = phraseFrames = loudRun;
            quietRun = loudRun = 0;
        }

        return;
    }

    phrase.insert (phrase.end(), frame.begin(), frame.end());

    // Let go: only its end is kept (and the quiet after it, until it ends).
    if (dropped && static_cast<int> (phrase.size()) > (endKeptFrames + endFrames) * frameLength)
        phrase.erase (phrase.begin(), phrase.begin() + frameLength);

    ++phraseFrames;

    if (level > startLevel)
        ++voicedFrames;

    quietRun = level < endLevel ? quietRun + 1 : 0;

    if (quietRun >= endFrames)
    {
        endPhrase (found, true);
    }
    else if (phraseFrames >= maxFrames)
    {
        endPhrase (found, false);
    }
    else if (! headGiven && phraseFrames >= headFrames)
    {
        // Its head, as it passes three seconds (not later: heads switched on mid-phrase give none).
        headGiven = true;

        if (wantsHeads && ! dropped && voicedFrames >= minVoicedFrames)
            found.push_back ({ phraseId, Kind::head, phrase });
    }
}

void PhraseFinder::endPhrase (std::vector<Phrase>& found, bool quietAtEnd)
{
    if (voicedFrames >= minVoicedFrames)
    {
        // Most of the quiet after it goes: it's no use to speech recognition.
        if (quietAtEnd)
        {
            const auto extra = static_cast<size_t> ((endFrames - tailFrames) * frameLength);

            if (phrase.size() > extra)
                phrase.resize (phrase.size() - extra);
        }

        found.push_back ({ phraseId, dropped ? Kind::end : Kind::whole, std::move (phrase) });
    }

    phrase.clear();
    inPhrase = dropped = headGiven = false;
    loudRun = quietRun = voicedFrames = phraseFrames = 0;
}

void PhraseFinder::drop (int id)
{
    if (inPhrase && id == phraseId && ! dropped)
    {
        dropped = true;

        const auto keep = static_cast<size_t> ((endKeptFrames + endFrames) * frameLength);

        if (phrase.size() > keep)
            phrase.erase (phrase.begin(), phrase.end() - static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t> (keep));
    }
}

PhraseFinder::Phrase PhraseFinder::endOf (Phrase whole)
{
    // Its last seconds and the bit of quiet after them, as a phrase let go keeps them.
    const auto keep = static_cast<size_t> ((endKeptFrames + tailFrames) * frameLength);

    if (whole.samples.size() > keep)
        whole.samples.erase (whole.samples.begin(), whole.samples.end() - static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t> (keep));

    whole.kind = Kind::end;
    return whole;
}

//==============================================================================
// Reading what was said
namespace
{
    // The Hebrew words are written as their UTF-8 bytes, so this file stays plain ASCII.
    juce::StringArray utf8Words (std::initializer_list<const char*> items)
    {
        juce::StringArray words;

        for (const auto* item : items)
            words.add (juce::String::fromUTF8 (item));

        return words;
    }

    /** Kept for comparing: letters (any script) and digits, not punctuation, quotes or Hebrew vowel points. */
    bool keepsChar (juce::juce_wchar c) noexcept
    {
        if (c < 128)
            return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z');

        if (c <= 0xbf || c == 0xd7 || c == 0xf7)        return false;   // Latin-1 signs
        if (c >= 0x0591 && c <= 0x05c7)                 return false;   // Hebrew points and marks
        if (c == 0x05f3 || c == 0x05f4)                 return false;   // geresh, gershayim
        if (c >= 0x2000 && c <= 0x206f)                 return false;   // dashes, quotes, ellipsis
        if (c >= 0x3000 && c <= 0x303f)                 return false;   // CJK punctuation

        return true;
    }

    bool isHebrew (juce::juce_wchar c) noexcept     { return c >= 0x05d0 && c <= 0x05ea; }

    /** Edits between two words: letters added, taken out or changed. */
    int distance (const juce::String& a, const juce::String& b)
    {
        std::vector<juce::juce_wchar> x, y;

        for (auto p = a.getCharPointer(); ! p.isEmpty();)  x.push_back (p.getAndAdvance());
        for (auto p = b.getCharPointer(); ! p.isEmpty();)  y.push_back (p.getAndAdvance());

        std::vector<int> row (y.size() + 1);

        for (size_t j = 0; j < row.size(); ++j)
            row[j] = static_cast<int> (j);

        for (size_t i = 1; i <= x.size(); ++i)
        {
            auto diagonal = row[0];
            row[0] = static_cast<int> (i);

            for (size_t j = 1; j <= y.size(); ++j)
            {
                const auto above = row[j];
                row[j] = std::min ({ row[j] + 1, row[j - 1] + 1, diagonal + (x[i - 1] == y[j - 1] ? 0 : 1) });
                diagonal = above;
            }
        }

        return row.back();
    }

    // "Sonify" in Hebrew letters (sonifai), as speech recognition writes it in a Hebrew sentence.
    const juce::String& hebrewSonify()
    {
        static const auto word = juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xd7\xa1\xd7\x95\xd7\xa0\xd7\x99\xd7\xa4\xd7\x99\xd7\x99");
        return word;
    }

    // "Sonify" as speech recognition may write it; in Hebrew: sonifi, sonifai with alef, sonfai, sonifaii.
    const juce::StringArray& wakeWords()
    {
        static const auto words = []
        {
            auto list = utf8Words ({
                "sonify", "sonifi", "sonifie", "sonifye", "sonifai", "sonifay", "sonnify", "sonofy", "sonafy", "sonefy",
                "sunify", "sanify", "sonyfi", "sonyfy", "spotify",
                "\xd7\xa1\xd7\x95\xd7\xa0\xd7\x99\xd7\xa4\xd7\x99",
                "\xd7\xa1\xd7\x95\xd7\xa0\xd7\x99\xd7\xa4\xd7\x90\xd7\x99",
                "\xd7\xa1\xd7\x95\xd7\xa0\xd7\xa4\xd7\x99\xd7\x99",
                "\xd7\xa1\xd7\x95\xd7\xa0\xd7\x99\xd7\xa4\xd7\x90\xd7\x99\xd7\x99" });
            list.add (hebrewSonify());
            return list;
        }();

        return words;
    }

    bool isWake (const juce::String& word)
    {
        if (word.isEmpty())
            return false;

        if (wakeWords().contains (word))
            return true;

        // One letter off: "sonifu", "zonify" and the like (no common word is that close).
        const auto length = word.length();

        if (word[0] < 128 && length >= 5 && length <= 8)
            return distance (word, "sonify") <= 1;

        if (isHebrew (word[0]) && length >= 5 && length <= 9)
            return distance (word, hebrewSonify()) <= 1;

        return false;
    }

    // "Over" as speech recognition may write it: over, and in Hebrew over (alef), over (ayin, "passing"), avur.
    const juce::StringArray& stopWords()
    {
        static const auto words = utf8Words ({
            "over", "ova", "ovah", "overr",
            "\xd7\x90\xd7\x95\xd7\x91\xd7\xa8",
            "\xd7\xa2\xd7\x95\xd7\x91\xd7\xa8",
            "\xd7\xa2\xd7\x91\xd7\x95\xd7\xa8" });

        return words;
    }

    // Words that don't change a short command: please, now, it, that... In Hebrew: please, now,
    // the object marker, this, to me, come on, can you, possible.
    const juce::StringArray& fillers()
    {
        static const auto words = utf8Words ({
            "please", "now", "ok", "okay", "hey", "just", "the", "it", "that", "this", "can", "could", "would", "will",
            "you", "for", "me", "us", "sonify",
            "\xd7\x91\xd7\x91\xd7\xa7\xd7\xa9\xd7\x94",
            "\xd7\xa2\xd7\x9b\xd7\xa9\xd7\x99\xd7\x95",
            "\xd7\x90\xd7\xaa",
            "\xd7\x96\xd7\x94",
            "\xd7\x9c\xd7\x99",
            "\xd7\x99\xd7\x90\xd7\x9c\xd7\x9c\xd7\x94",
            "\xd7\xaa\xd7\x95\xd7\x9b\xd7\x9c",
            "\xd7\x90\xd7\xa4\xd7\xa9\xd7\xa8" });

        return words;
    }

    struct QuickPhrases
    {
        juce::StringArray phrases;
        std::vector<VoiceControl::Quick> commands;

        void add (VoiceControl::Quick command, std::initializer_list<const char*> items)
        {
            for (const auto* item : items)
            {
                phrases.add (juce::String::fromUTF8 (item));
                commands.push_back (command);
            }
        }
    };

    // Each command as musicians say it, after the filler words are taken out.

VoiceControl::Words VoiceControl::read (const juce::String& text)
{
    Words words;

    for (const auto& token : juce::StringArray::fromTokens (text, " \t\r\n", {}))
    {
        const auto lower = token.toLowerCase();
        juce::String plain;

        for (auto p = lower.getCharPointer(); ! p.isEmpty();)
            if (const auto c = p.getAndAdvance(); keepsChar (c))
                plain += c;

        if (plain.isEmpty())
            continue;   // a dash or a dot on its own

        words.spoken.add (token.trim());
        words.plain.add (plain);
    }

    return words;
}

int VoiceControl::afterWake (const Words& words)
{
    const auto& plain = words.plain;
    const auto count = plain.size();

    for (int i = 0; i < juce::jmin (wakeWithin, count); ++i)
    {
        int next = -1;

        if (isWake (plain[i]))
            next = i + 1;
        else if (i + 1 < count && isWake (plain[i] + plain[i + 1]))   // "so nify"
            next = i + 2;

        if (next < 0)
            continue;

        while (next < count && isWake (plain[next]))   // "Sonify, Sonify..."
            ++next;

        return next;
    }

    return -1;
}

int VoiceControl::afterLastWake (const Words& words)
{
    const auto& plain = words.plain;

    for (int i = plain.size(); --i >= 0;)
    {
        if (isWake (plain[i]))
            return i + 1;

        if (i + 1 < plain.size() && isWake (plain[i] + plain[i + 1]))
            return i + 2;
    }

    return -1;
}

int VoiceControl::stopLength (const Words& words, int from)
{
    const auto& plain = words.plain;
    const auto end = plain.size();

    if (end - from >= 3 && plain[end - 3] == "over" && plain[end - 2] == "and" && plain[end - 1] == "out")
        return 3;

    // Just the last one: "Sonify, start over, over" is "start over".
    return end - 1 >= from && stopWords().contains (plain[end - 1]) ? 1 : 0;
}

juce::String VoiceControl::join (const Words& words, int from, int to)
{
    juce::StringArray chosen;

    for (int i = juce::jmax (0, from); i < juce::jmin (to, words.spoken.size()); ++i)
        chosen.add (words.spoken[i]);

    // "Sonify, record, over.": the commas are the pauses around the command, not part of it.
    static const auto around = juce::String::fromUTF8 (",;:-\xe2\x80\x93\xe2\x80\x94 ");
    static const auto before = around + ".!?";

    return chosen.joinIntoString (" ").trim().trimCharactersAtStart (before).trimCharactersAtEnd (around).trim();
}

VoiceControl::Quick VoiceControl::quickCommand (const juce::String& command)
{
    const auto words = read (command);
    juce::StringArray kept;

    for (const auto& word : words.plain)
        if (! fillers().contains (word))
            kept.add (word);

    const auto& table = quickPhrases();
    const auto index = table.phrases.indexOf (kept.joinIntoString (" "));

    return index >= 0 ? table.commands[static_cast<size_t> (index)] : Quick::none;
}

juce::MemoryBlock VoiceControl::toWav (const std::vector<float>& samples)
{
    float peak = 0.0f;

    for (const auto sample : samples)
        peak = juce::jmax (peak, std::abs (sample));

    // Up near full scale (a mic set for singing hears speech quietly), but by 30 dB at most.
    const auto gain = peak > 0.0f ? juce::jmin (0.7f / peak, 31.6f) : 1.0f;
    const auto dataBytes = static_cast<int> (samples.size() * 2);

    juce::MemoryOutputStream out;
    out.write ("RIFF", 4);
    out.writeInt (36 + dataBytes);
    out.write ("WAVE", 4);
    out.write ("fmt ", 4);
    out.writeInt (16);
    out.writeShort (1);                              // PCM
    out.writeShort (1);                              // mono
    out.writeInt (PhraseFinder::rate);
    out.writeInt (PhraseFinder::rate * 2);           // bytes a second
    out.writeShort (2);                              // bytes a sample
    out.writeShort (16);
    out.write ("data", 4);
    out.writeInt (dataBytes);

    for (const auto sample : samples)
        out.writeShort (static_cast<short> (juce::jlimit (-32767, 32767, juce::roundToInt (sample * gain * 32767.0f))));

    return out.getMemoryBlock();
}

//==============================================================================
VoiceControl::VoiceControl (AudioEngine& e, FananServer& s)
    : juce::Thread ("Sonify voice control"), engine (e), server (s)
{
}

VoiceControl::~VoiceControl()
{
    *alive = false;   // an answer arriving later finds no one
    stopTimer();
    engine.setVoiceListening (false);
    stopThread (3000);
}

void VoiceControl::changed()
{
    if (onChanged != nullptr)
        onChanged();
}

void VoiceControl::setEnabled (bool shouldListen)
{
    if (enabled == shouldListen)
        return;

    enabled = shouldListen;
    heard.clear();
    message.clear();

    if (enabled)
        startTimer (50);
    else
        stopTimer();

    updateListening();
    changed();
}

void VoiceControl::inputChanged()
{
    restart.store (true);   // the listener starts afresh

    if (enabled)
        updateListening();
}

void VoiceControl::setMessage (const juce::String& text)
{
    message = text;
    changed();
}

juce::String VoiceControl::whyNot() const
{
    // It works through Fanan's server, like Sonify AI.
    if (! server.isConfigured())
        return "Voice control isn't set up in this build yet.";

    if (server.isBlocked())
        return "The internet is blocked (top right): voice control works through it.";

    if (! server.isReady())
    {
        const auto status = server.getStatus();

        return status == FananServer::Status::checking   ? juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Connecting to Fanan's server\xe2\x80\xa6")
             : status == FananServer::Status::noInternet ? juce::String ("No internet connection: voice control works through it.")
                                                         : juce::String ("Fanan's server isn't responding right now.");
    }

    if (! server.isSignedIn())
        return "Sign in to use voice control. It's part of your Fanan account.";

    if (server.getCredits() == 0)
        return "You're out of credits.";

    if (juce::Time::getCurrentTime() < pausedUntil)
        return pausedWhy;

    if (! engine.isAudioRunning())
        return "The audio device isn't running.";

    if (engine.isMixdownRunning())
        return "Not while a mixdown is being made.";

    const auto& inputs = engine.getInputs();
    const auto index = engine.getVoiceInput();

    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (inputs.size())))
        return "Choose the input the musician's mic is on.";

    const auto& input = inputs[static_cast<size_t> (index)];
    const auto channels = engine.getInputChannelNames().size();

    if (input.left >= channels || input.right >= channels)
        return "That input isn't on in the audio settings.";

    return {};
}

//==============================================================================
void VoiceControl::updateListening()
{
    const auto why = enabled ? whyNot() : juce::String();
    const auto can = enabled && why.isEmpty();
    auto tell = why != lastWhy;
    lastWhy = why;

    if (can != listening)
    {
        listening = can;
        tell = true;

        if (can)
            startListening();
        else
            stopListening();
    }

    if (tell)
        changed();
}

void VoiceControl::startListening()
{
    ++session;
    stage = Stage::listening;
    parts.clear();
    waiting.clear();
    unwanted.clear();
    writing = failing = false;

    wantHeads.store (true);
    dropRequest.store (0);
    hearing.store (false);
    inputRate.store (engine.getPlaybackRate());
    restart.store (true);

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock lock (foundLock);
        found.clear();
    }

    engine.setVoiceListening (true);
    startThread();
}

void VoiceControl::stopListening()
{
    engine.setVoiceListening (false);
    stopThread (3000);

    ++session;   // an answer on its way is dropped
    stage = Stage::off;
    parts.clear();
    waiting.clear();
    unwanted.clear();
    writing = false;
    hearing.store (false);

    const juce::ScopedLock lock (foundLock);
    found.clear();
}

void VoiceControl::run()
{
    const juce::ScopedNoDenormals noDenormals;

    PhraseFinder finder;
    std::vector<float> buffer (8192);
    std::vector<PhraseFinder::Phrase> phrases;
    double preparedRate = 0.0;
    juce::uint32 lastBeep = 0;
    bool beeped = false;

    while (! threadShouldExit())
    {
        const auto rateNow = inputRate.load();

        if (restart.exchange (false) || ! juce::exactlyEqual (rateNow, preparedRate))
        {
            finder.prepare (rateNow);
            preparedRate = rateNow;

            // What the mic heard before is no use now.
            while (engine.readVoice (buffer.data(), static_cast<int> (buffer.size())) > 0) {}

            hearing.store (false);
        }

        const auto count = engine.readVoice (buffer.data(), static_cast<int> (buffer.size()));

        if (count <= 0)
        {
            wait (15.0);
            continue;
        }

        // Sonify's own beeps, and their echo in the room, begin no phrase.
        const auto now = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter();

        if (engine.isCuePlaying())
        {
            beeped = true;
            lastBeep = now;
        }

        const auto hushed = beeped && now - lastBeep < hushMs;
        beeped = hushed;

        finder.setWantsHeads (wantHeads.load());

        if (const auto id = dropRequest.exchange (0); id != 0)
            finder.drop (id);

        finder.process (buffer.data(), count, hushed, phrases);
        hearing.store (finder.isInPhrase());

        if (! phrases.empty())
        {
            const juce::ScopedLock lock (foundLock);

            for (auto& phrase : phrases)
                found.push_back (std::move (phrase));

            phrases.clear();
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void VoiceControl::timerCallback()
{
    inputRate.store (engine.getPlaybackRate());   // the listener starts afresh when the device's rate changes
    updateListening();

    if (! listening)
        return;

    std::vector<PhraseFinder::Phrase> arrived;

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock lock (foundLock);
        arrived.swap (found);
    }

    for (auto& phrase : arrived)
        accept (std::move (phrase));

    // A command that never got its "over" ends by itself, with a beep.
    if (stage == Stage::command)
    {
        const auto now = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter();
        const auto goingOn = hearing.load() || writing || ! waiting.empty();

        if (now - commandStarted > commandLimitMs || (! goingOn && now - lastWordsAt > commandTimeoutMs))
            giveUp ("Didn't hear \"over\". Say \"Sonify\" to begin again.");
    }

    sendNext();
}

void VoiceControl::accept (PhraseFinder::Phrase phrase)
{
    using Kind = PhraseFinder::Kind;

    // A head is only wanted while waiting for "Sonify"; during a command the whole phrase comes.
    if (phrase.kind == Kind::head && stage != Stage::listening)
        return;

    // A phrase whose head didn't begin with "Sonify": only its end is heard.
    if (phrase.kind == Kind::whole && unwanted.erase (phrase.id) > 0)
        phrase = PhraseFinder::endOf (std::move (phrase));

    waiting.push_back (std::move (phrase));

    // While waiting for "Sonify", only the newest few: Sonify never falls behind what's said.
    if (stage == Stage::listening)
    {
        while (waiting.size() > maxWaiting)
            waiting.pop_front();   // a head that goes leaves its phrase to be heard whole
    }
}

void VoiceControl::forget (int phraseId)
{
    using Kind = PhraseFinder::Kind;

    // Only its end is wanted now: the listener keeps just that, and here a whole phrase waiting
    // becomes its end.
    dropRequest.store (phraseId);
    bool restHere = false;

    for (auto it = waiting.begin(); it != waiting.end();)
    {
        if (it->id != phraseId)
        {
            ++it;
        }
        else if (it->kind == Kind::head)
        {
            it = waiting.erase (it);
        }
        else
        {
            if (it->kind == Kind::whole)
                *it = PhraseFinder::endOf (std::move (*it));

            restHere = true;
            ++it;
        }
    }

    if (! restHere)
    {
        unwanted.insert (phraseId);   // it may come whole yet

        while (unwanted.size() > 32)
            unwanted.erase (unwanted.begin());
    }
}

void VoiceControl::sendNext()
{
    while (listening && ! writing && ! waiting.empty())
    {
        auto phrase = std::move (waiting.front());
        waiting.pop_front();

        if (phrase.kind == PhraseFinder::Kind::head && stage != Stage::listening)
            continue;

        writing = true;

        server.transcribe (toWav (phrase.samples),
                           [this, flag = alive, id = phrase.id, kind = phrase.kind, asked = session] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
        {
            if (! *flag || asked != session)
                return;

            writing = false;
            onWords (id, kind, result, answer);
            sendNext();
        });
    }
}

void VoiceControl::onWords (int phraseId, PhraseFinder::Kind kind, const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
{
    if (result.failed())
    {
        if (kind == PhraseFinder::Kind::head)
            forget (phraseId);

        // One beep for a problem, not one for every phrase while it lasts.
        const auto first = ! failing;
        failing = true;
        message = result.getErrorMessage();

        if (stage == Stage::command)
            giveUp (message);
        else if (first)
            engine.playCue (AudioEngine::Cue::problem);

        // The account's listening for the day is used up: it waits for the next day (UTC, as the server counts).
        if (answer.getProperty ("error", {}).toString() == "listen_limit")
        {
            constexpr juce::int64 day = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
            pausedUntil = juce::Time ((juce::Time::currentTimeMillis() / day + 1) * day);
            pausedWhy = message;
            updateListening();
        }

        changed();
        return;
    }

    const auto text = answer.getProperty ("text", {}).toString();

    if (failing)
    {
        failing = false;
        message.clear();
        changed();
    }

    const auto words = read (text);

    if (kind == PhraseFinder::Kind::head)
    {
        // The head of a long phrase: all of it is wanted only when it began with "Sonify".
        if (afterWake (words) < 0)
            forget (phraseId);

        return;
    }

    if (words.plain.isEmpty())
        return;

    auto from = afterWake (words);

    if (stage == Stage::listening)
    {
        // "Sonify" further on counts too when "over" ends it: "... yeah. Sonify, stop, over."
        if (from < 0)
            if (const auto last = afterLastWake (words); last >= 0 && stopLength (words, last) > 0)
                from = last;

        if (from < 0)
            return;   // not for Sonify

        stage = Stage::command;
        wantHeads.store (false);
        parts.clear();
        commandStarted = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter();
        addWords (words, from, true);
        return;
    }

    // "Sonify" again during a command begins it again.
    if (from >= 0)
    {
        parts.clear();
        commandStarted = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter();
        addWords (words, from, true);
    }
    else
    {
        addWords (words, 0, false);
    }
}

void VoiceControl::addWords (const Words& words, int from, bool woke)
{
    const auto stop = stopLength (words, from);

    if (const auto text = join (words, from, words.spoken.size() - stop); text.isNotEmpty())
        parts.add (text);

    lastWordsAt = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter();
    heard = parts.joinIntoString (" ");

    if (stop == 0)
    {
        if (woke)
            engine.playCue (AudioEngine::Cue::listening);   // go on, then say "over"

        changed();
        return;
    }

    const auto command = heard.trim();
    backToListening();

    if (command.isEmpty())
    {
        engine.playCue (AudioEngine::Cue::problem);
        message = "Heard \"Sonify\" and \"over\", with nothing between.";
        changed();
        return;
    }

    heard = command;
    message.clear();
    changed();

    if (onCommand != nullptr)
        onCommand (command);
}

void VoiceControl::backToListening()
{
    stage = Stage::listening;
    parts.clear();
    wantHeads.store (true);
}

void VoiceControl::giveUp (const juce::String& why)
{
    engine.playCue (AudioEngine::Cue::problem);
    message = why;
    backToListening();
    changed();
}

#pragma once

#include "AudioEngine.h"
#include "FananServer.h"

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>
#include <juce_events/juce_events.h>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Finds the phrases in what one mic hears: speech told apart from silence by its level
    against the room's own noise (the quietest moment of the last few seconds).

    The sound is filtered and resampled to 16 kHz mono, as speech recognition takes it. A
    phrase begins after 60 ms above the noise, with half a second from before it (so its first
    sound isn't lost), and ends after 700 ms of quiet. One too short to be a word is left out;
    one longer than 25 seconds is cut there. While Sonify waits for "Sonify", a long phrase also
    gives its head (its first three seconds) as it goes on: enough to hear how it begins. One
    let go after its head gives only its end (its last three seconds), to hear whether it ends
    with a command: "... yeah, that's it. Sonify, stop, over."

    One thread, and nothing else from Sonify: it can be tested on its own.
*/
class PhraseFinder final
{
public:
    static constexpr int rate = 16000;
    static constexpr int frameLength = 320;       // 20 ms
    static constexpr int startFrames = 3;         // 60 ms of sound begins a phrase
    static constexpr int endFrames = 35;          // 700 ms of quiet ends it
    static constexpr int preRollFrames = 25;      // 500 ms from before it is kept
    static constexpr int tailFrames = 15;         // and 300 ms of the quiet after it
    static constexpr int minVoicedFrames = 10;    // 200 ms of sound at least: a short word
    static constexpr int headFrames = 150;        // 3 s
    static constexpr int endKeptFrames = 150;     // 3 s, of a phrase let go
    static constexpr int maxFrames = 1250;        // 25 s
    static constexpr int noiseFrames = 150;       // the room's noise: the quietest 20 ms of the last 3 s

    enum class Kind { whole, head, end };

    struct Phrase
    {
        int id = 0;
        Kind kind = Kind::whole;        // all of it, its first seconds (while it goes on), or its last ones (once let go)
        std::vector<float> samples;     // 16 kHz mono
    };

    /** A whole phrase's end, as a phrase let go gives it. */
    static Phrase endOf (Phrase whole);

    PhraseFinder();

    /** Starts afresh, for sound at this rate. */
    void prepare (double inputRate);

    /** Sound in, phrases out (added to found). hushed: Sonify's own beep is sounding, or just
        was: what the mic hears of it begins no phrase. */
    void process (const float* samples, int count, bool hushed, std::vector<Phrase>& found);

    /** Gives the heads of long phrases (while waiting for "Sonify"). */
    void setWantsHeads (bool shouldGiveHeads) noexcept      { wantsHeads = shouldGiveHeads; }

    /** The phrase under way didn't begin with "Sonify": only its end is kept. */
    void drop (int phraseId);

    bool isInPhrase() const noexcept                        { return inPhrase; }
    float getNoiseLevel() const noexcept                    { return noiseDb; }   // dBFS

private:
    void addSample (float sample, std::vector<Phrase>& found);
    void endFrame (std::vector<Phrase>& found);
    void endPhrase (std::vector<Phrase>& found, bool quietAtEnd);

    // To 16 kHz: low-passed below its Nyquist, then linear interpolation; then the rumble goes.
    juce::IIRFilter lowPass1, lowPass2, highPass;
    bool filtering = true, resampling = true;
    double step = 3.0;          // input samples for each 16 kHz one
    double position = 0.0;      // where the next 16 kHz sample falls, after the previous input one
    float previous = 0.0f;

    std::vector<float> frame, preRoll, phrase;
    std::array<float, noiseFrames> levels {};
    int levelsCount = 0, levelsAt = 0;
    float noiseDb = -90.0f;

    bool hushedNow = false, wantsHeads = true;
    bool inPhrase = false, dropped = false, headGiven = false;
    int loudRun = 0, quietRun = 0, voicedFrames = 0, phraseFrames = 0;
    int phraseId = 0, lastId = 0;
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    Voice control: the musician talks to Sonify from the recording room, into their mic.

    "Sonify" (among the first words) begins a command and "over" (the last word) ends it; a
    command can take a few breaths in between. Sonify answers with beeps in the headphones,
    never speech: "go on" when it heard "Sonify", then done, a question waiting on the screen,
    or a problem. Hebrew works too. Transport commands (record, stop, play, again, undo) are
    done at once; anything else goes to Sonify AI, as it was said.

    It listens to one song input (the mic the musician talks into) on a thread of its own. Each
    phrase it hears goes to Fanan's server to be written down, and nothing is kept. While
    waiting for "Sonify", a long phrase sends only its first and last seconds, and all of it
    only when it began with "Sonify". It listens while Fanan's server, the account and the audio
    device can work, and goes on by itself when they can again.

    Message thread, apart from the listener.
*/
class VoiceControl final : private juce::Thread,
                           private juce::Timer
{
public:
    enum class Stage { off, listening, command };

    /** What Sonify does at once, without Sonify AI: the transport, while the musician plays. */
    enum class Quick { none, record, stop, play, again, recordAgain, playAgain, undo };

    VoiceControl (AudioEngine& engine, FananServer& server);
    ~VoiceControl() override;

    /** On or off (it starts off). */
    void setEnabled (bool shouldListen);
    bool isEnabled() const noexcept                     { return enabled; }

    /** The mic's input changed: it listens afresh. */
    void inputChanged();

    Stage getStage() const noexcept                     { return stage; }

    /** Why it can't listen right now, in a few words for the page; empty when it can. */
    juce::String whyNot() const;

    /** The words of the command under way, or of the last one. */
    const juce::String& getHeard() const noexcept       { return heard; }

    /** What went wrong last, for the page; empty when nothing did. */
    const juce::String& getMessage() const noexcept     { return message; }
    void setMessage (const juce::String& text);

    /** A command: the words between "Sonify" and "over". */
    std::function<void (const juce::String& command)> onCommand;

    /** The stage, the words heard, the message or the reason it can't listen changed. */
    std::function<void()> onChanged;

    //==============================================================================
    // Reading what was said (public for tests).
    struct Words
    {
        juce::StringArray spoken;   // as written down, for Sonify AI
        juce::StringArray plain;    // the same words to compare: lower case, letters and digits only
    };

    static Words read (const juce::String& text);

    /** Where the command begins: after "Sonify" among the first words. -1 when it isn't there. */
    static int afterWake (const Words& words);

    /** After the last "Sonify", anywhere: for a phrase that ends with "over". -1 when it isn't there. */
    static int afterLastWake (const Words& words);

    /** How many of the last words say "over" (1, or 3 for "over and out"; 0: it doesn't end with it),
        counting from where the command begins. */
    static int stopLength (const Words& words, int from);

    /** The spoken words from..to, without the commas around them. */
    static juce::String join (const Words& words, int from, int to);

    static Quick quickCommand (const juce::String& command);

    /** 16 kHz 16-bit mono WAV, its loudest sound brought up near full scale. */
    static juce::MemoryBlock toWav (const std::vector<float>& samples);

    static constexpr int wakeWithin = 3;                        // "Sonify" among the first three words
    static constexpr juce::uint32 hushMs = 150;                 // after a beep, for its echo in the room
    static constexpr juce::uint32 commandTimeoutMs = 12000;     // quiet after the last words, without "over"
    static constexpr juce::uint32 commandLimitMs = 90000;       // one command at most
    static constexpr size_t maxWaiting = 3;                     // phrases waiting to be written down, while waiting for "Sonify"

private:
    void run() override;               // the listener
    void timerCallback() override;

    void updateListening();
    void startListening();
    void stopListening();
    void accept (PhraseFinder::Phrase phrase);
    void sendNext();
    void onWords (int phraseId, PhraseFinder::Kind kind, const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer);
    void forget (int phraseId);
    void addWords (const Words& words, int from, bool woke);
    void backToListening();
    void giveUp (const juce::String& why);
    void changed();

    AudioEngine& engine;
    FananServer& server;

    // Message thread
    bool enabled = false, listening = false;
    Stage stage = Stage::off;
    juce::String heard, message, lastWhy;
    juce::StringArray parts;                     // the command so far
    juce::uint32 commandStarted = 0, lastWordsAt = 0;
    std::deque<PhraseFinder::Phrase> waiting;    // to be written down, in order
    bool writing = false;                        // one at a time
    int session = 0;                             // moves on when listening stops: answers from before are dropped
    std::set<int> unwanted;                      // phrases whose head didn't begin with "Sonify": only their end is wanted
    bool failing = false;                        // the last phrase couldn't be written down (beeped once)
    juce::Time pausedUntil;                      // the account's listening for the day is used up
    juce::String pausedWhy;

    // Shared with the listener
    std::atomic<double> inputRate { 0.0 };
    std::atomic<bool> wantHeads { true }, hearing { false }, restart { false };
    std::atomic<int> dropRequest { 0 };
    juce::CriticalSection foundLock;
    std::vector<PhraseFinder::Phrase> found;

    std::shared_ptr<bool> alive = std::make_shared<bool> (true);

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (VoiceControl)
};
