// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Vst3Plugin.cpp

#include "Vst3Plugin.h"

#include <map>

namespace
{
    /** JUCE's plugin formats: made when first needed, on the message thread, and let go
        by shutdownFormats() (not left to static destruction, which comes too late for
        JUCE's leak checks). */
    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginFormatManager>& formatHolder()
    {
        static std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginFormatManager> manager;
        return manager;
    }

    juce::AudioPluginFormatManager& formats()
    {
        auto& manager = formatHolder();

        if (manager == nullptr)
        {
            manager = std::make_unique<juce::AudioPluginFormatManager>();
           #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
            manager->addFormat (std::make_unique<juce::VST3PluginFormat>());   // with plugin windows (first: vst3())

            // The Sampling Studio's nodes load these straight from their files.
            #if JUCE_PLUGINHOST_VST
             manager->addFormat (std::make_unique<juce::VSTPluginFormat>());
            #endif
            #if JUCE_PLUGINHOST_AU && JUCE_MAC
             manager->addFormat (std::make_unique<juce::AudioUnitPluginFormat>());
            #endif
            #if JUCE_PLUGINHOST_LV2 && (JUCE_LINUX || JUCE_BSD)
             manager->addFormat (std::make_unique<juce::LV2PluginFormat>());
            #endif
           #else
            manager->addFormat (std::make_unique<juce::VST3PluginFormatHeadless>());
           #endif
        }

        return *manager;
    }

    juce::AudioPluginFormat& vst3()
    {
        return *formats().getFormat (0);
    }

    /** One of the formats by JUCE's name for it, or none. */
    juce::AudioPluginFormat* formatNamed (const juce::String& name)
    {
        auto& manager = formats();

        for (int i = 0; i < manager.getNumFormats(); ++i)
            if (auto* format = manager.getFormat (i); format != nullptr && format->getName() == name)
                return format;

        return nullptr;
    }

    /** VST3 categories as CLAP feature words, so both kinds of plugin sort alike. */
    juce::StringArray featuresFor (const juce::PluginDescription& description)
    {
        static const std::map<juce::String, const char*> words {
            { "synth", "synthesizer" }, { "sampler", "sampler" }, { "drum", "drum-machine" }, { "piano", "synthesizer" },
            { "generator", "synthesizer" }, { "external", "synthesizer" }, { "reverb", "reverb" }, { "delay", "delay" },
            { "eq", "equalizer" }, { "dynamics", "compressor" }, { "distortion", "distortion" }, { "filter", "filter" },
            { "modulation", "chorus" }, { "analyzer", "analyzer" }, { "tools", "utility" }, { "mastering", "mastering" },
            { "pitch shift", "pitch-shifter" }, { "restoration", "restoration" }, { "spatial", "utility" }, { "surround", "surround" }
        };

        juce::StringArray features;
        features.add (description.isInstrument ? "instrument" : "audio-effect");

        for (const auto& part : juce::StringArray::fromTokens (description.category, "|", ""))
            if (const auto found = words.find (part.trim().toLowerCase()); found != words.end())
                features.addIfNotAlreadyThere (found->second);

        return features;
    }

    Plugin::Descriptor descriptorFor (const juce::PluginDescription& description)
    {
        return { description.createIdentifierString(), description.name,
                 description.manufacturerName.isNotEmpty() ? description.manufacturerName : juce::String ("Unknown vendor"),
                 description.version, featuresFor (description) };
    }
}

juce::FileSearchPath Vst3Plugin::getDefaultFolders()
{
    // A format of its own for the question, so asking doesn't keep JUCE's VST3 host alive.
    return juce::VST3PluginFormatHeadless().getDefaultLocationsToSearch();
}

void Vst3Plugin::shutdownFormats()
{
    formatHolder().reset();
}

std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor> Vst3Plugin::describe (const juce::File& file, juce::String& error)
{
    juce::OwnedArray<juce::PluginDescription> found;
    vst3().findAllTypesForFile (found, file.getFullPathName());

    std::vector<Descriptor> list;

    for (const auto* description : found)
        list.push_back (descriptorFor (*description));

    if (list.empty())
        error = file.getFileName() + " has no VST3 plugin Sonify can load.";

    return list;
}

std::unique_ptr<Vst3Plugin> Vst3Plugin::load (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error)
{
    juce::OwnedArray<juce::PluginDescription> found;
    vst3().findAllTypesForFile (found, file.getFullPathName());

    if (found.isEmpty())
    {
        error = file.getFileName() + " has no VST3 plugin Sonify can load.";
        return nullptr;
    }

    const juce::PluginDescription* chosen = found.getFirst();

    if (pluginId.isNotEmpty())
    {
        chosen = nullptr;

        for (const auto* description : found)
            if (description->createIdentifierString() == pluginId)
                chosen = description;

        if (chosen == nullptr)
        {
            error = file.getFileName() + " no longer has that plugin.";
            return nullptr;
        }
    }

    std::vector<Descriptor> inFile;

    for (const auto* description : found)
        inFile.push_back (descriptorFor (*description));

    juce::String message;
    auto instance = formats().createPluginInstance (*chosen, 48000.0, 512, message);

    if (instance == nullptr)
    {
        error = message.isNotEmpty() ? message : "Couldn't load " + chosen->name + ".";
        return nullptr;
    }

    return std::unique_ptr<Vst3Plugin> (new Vst3Plugin (std::move (instance), *chosen, std::move (inFile), file));
}

std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor> Vst3Plugin::describeAs (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& juceFormat, const juce::String& shownFormat,
                                                        juce::String& error)
{
    auto* format = formatNamed (juceFormat);

    if (format == nullptr)
    {
        error = shownFormat + " plugins can't be loaded in this Sonify.";
        return {};
    }

    juce::OwnedArray<juce::PluginDescription> found;
    format->findAllTypesForFile (found, file.getFullPathName());

    std::vector<Descriptor> list;

    for (const auto* description : found)
        list.push_back (descriptorFor (*description));

    if (list.empty())
        error = file.getFileName() + " has no " + shownFormat + " plugin Sonify can load.";

    return list;
}

std::unique_ptr<Vst3Plugin> Vst3Plugin::loadAs (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& juceFormat, const juce::String& shownFormat,
                                                const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error)
{
    auto* format = formatNamed (juceFormat);

    if (format == nullptr)
    {
        error = shownFormat + " plugins can't be loaded in this Sonify.";
        return nullptr;
    }

    juce::OwnedArray<juce::PluginDescription> found;
    format->findAllTypesForFile (found, file.getFullPathName());

    if (found.isEmpty())
    {
        error = file.getFileName() + " has no " + shownFormat + " plugin Sonify can load.";
        return nullptr;
    }

    const juce::PluginDescription* chosen = found.getFirst();

    if (pluginId.isNotEmpty())
    {
        chosen = nullptr;

        for (const auto* description : found)
            if (description->createIdentifierString() == pluginId)
                chosen = description;

        if (chosen == nullptr)
        {
            error = file.getFileName() + " no longer has that plugin.";
            return nullptr;
        }
    }

    std::vector<Descriptor> inFile;

    for (const auto* description : found)
        inFile.push_back (descriptorFor (*description));

    juce::String message;
    auto instance = formats().createPluginInstance (*chosen, 48000.0, 512, message);

    if (instance == nullptr)
    {
        error = message.isNotEmpty() ? message : "Couldn't load " + chosen->name + ".";
        return nullptr;
    }

    std::unique_ptr<Vst3Plugin> plugin (new Vst3Plugin (std::move (instance), *chosen, std::move (inFile), file));
    plugin->formatName = shownFormat;
    return plugin;
}

Vst3Plugin::Vst3Plugin (std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginInstance> pluginInstance, const juce::PluginDescription& description,
                        std::vector<Descriptor> inFile, const juce::File& file)
    : instance (std::move (pluginInstance)),
      descriptor (descriptorFor (description)),
      pluginsInFile (std::move (inFile)),
      sourceFile (file),
      role (description.isInstrument ? Role::instrument : Role::effect)
{
    // A sidechain input (compressors, duckers) is switched on, so tracks can send to it.
    if (instance->getBusCount (true) > 1)
        if (auto* bus = instance->getBus (true, 1); bus != nullptr && ! bus->isEnabled())
            bus->enable (true);

    inputChannels = instance->getMainBusNumInputChannels();
    outputChannels = instance->getTotalNumOutputChannels();

    const auto& all = instance->getParameters();

    for (int i = 0; i < all.size(); ++i)
    {
        auto* parameter = all[i];
        Parameter info;
        info.id = static_cast<uint32_t> (i);

        // The VST3 id, not the list position: it stays the same when a plugin is updated.
        if (auto* withId = dynamic_cast<juce::HostedAudioProcessorParameter*> (parameter))
            info.id = static_cast<uint32_t> (withId->getParameterID().getLargeIntValue());

        info.name = parameter->getName (64);
        info.minValue = 0.0;
        info.maxValue = 1.0;
        info.defaultValue = parameter->getDefaultValue();
        info.stepped = parameter->isDiscrete() || parameter->isBoolean();

        // Out of sight: what a plugin keeps from automation (JUCE-built instruments carry
        // 2,080 hidden MIDI controller parameters), and Bypass, since inserts have their own.
        info.hidden = ! parameter->isAutomatable() || parameter == instance->getBypassParameter();
        parameters.push_back (info);
        hosted.push_back (parameter);
    }

    instance->addListener (this);
    instance->setPlayHead (&playHead);
}

   #else

   #endif

bool Vst3Plugin::showNativeScreen (const juce::String& title)
{
   #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
    if (screenWindow == nullptr)
    {
        auto* editor = instance->hasEditor() ? instance->createEditorAndMakeActive() : nullptr;

        if (editor == nullptr)
            return false;

        screenWindow = std::make_unique<ScreenWindow> (title, editor);
    }

    screenWindow->setName (title);
    screenWindow->setVisible (true);
    screenWindow->toFront (true);
    return true;
   #else
    juce::ignoreUnused (title);
    return false;
   #endif
}

   #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
    if (screenWindow != nullptr)
        screenWindow->setVisible (false);
   #endif
}

Vst3Plugin::~Vst3Plugin()
{
   #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
    screenWindow.reset();   // the editor goes before the plugin it shows
   #endif

    instance->removeListener (this);
    instance->setPlayHead (nullptr);
    deactivate();
    instance.reset();
}

//==============================================================================
bool Vst3Plugin::saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination)
{
    destination.reset();
    instance->getStateInformation (destination);
    return true;
}

bool Vst3Plugin::loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source)
{
    instance->setStateInformation (source.getData(), static_cast<int> (source.getSize()));
    return true;
}

int Vst3Plugin::findParameter (uint32_t id) const noexcept
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < parameters.size(); ++i)
        if (parameters[i].id == id)
            return static_cast<int> (i);

    return -1;
}

double Vst3Plugin::getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept
{
    return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (hosted.size())) ? hosted[static_cast<size_t> (index)]->getValue() : 0.0;
}

juce::String Vst3Plugin::getParameterText (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (hosted.size())))
        return {};

    auto* parameter = hosted[static_cast<size_t> (index)];
    const auto text = parameter->getText (static_cast<float> (value), 64);
    const auto label = parameter->getLabel();
    return label.isEmpty() || text.endsWith (label) ? text : text + " " + label;
}

double Vst3Plugin::queueParameter (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (hosted.size())))
        return 0.0;

    value = juce::jlimit (0.0, 1.0, value);
    hosted[static_cast<size_t> (index)]->setValueNotifyingHost (static_cast<float> (value));   // JUCE carries it to the audio thread
    return value;
}

void Vst3Plugin::setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept
{
    const auto count = static_cast<int> (parameters.size());

    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (indexHint, count) || parameters[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)].id != paramId)
    {
        indexHint = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            if (parameters[static_cast<size_t> (i)].id == paramId)
                indexHint = i;

        if (indexHint < 0)
            return;
    }

    // JUCE's VST3 host takes it from the audio thread into the next processBlock.
    hosted[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)]->setValue (static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (0.0, 1.0, value)));
}

//==============================================================================
bool Vst3Plugin::activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize)
{
    if (active.load() && juce::exactlyEqual (activeRate, sampleRate) && activeBlockSize >= maxBlockSize)
        return true;

    deactivate();
    instance->setRateAndBufferSizeDetails (sampleRate, maxBlockSize);
    instance->prepareToPlay (sampleRate, maxBlockSize);

    inputChannels = instance->getMainBusNumInputChannels();
    totalInputChannels = instance->getTotalNumInputChannels();
    outputChannels = instance->getTotalNumOutputChannels();

    // Where the sidechain's channels sit in the block the plugin is given.
    sidechainOffset = -1;
    sidechainChannels = 0;

    if (instance->getBusCount (true) > 1)
    {
        if (auto* bus = instance->getBus (true, 1); bus != nullptr && bus->isEnabled() && bus->getNumberOfChannels() > 0)
        {
            sidechainOffset = instance->getChannelIndexInProcessBlockBuffer (true, 1, 0);
            sidechainChannels = juce::jmin (2, bus->getNumberOfChannels());
            prepareSidechain (maxBlockSize);
        }
    }

    buffer.setSize (juce::jmax (2, totalInputChannels, outputChannels), juce::jmax (1, maxBlockSize));
    makesMidi = instance->producesMidi();
    midiOutput.ensureSize (8192);
    midiBuffer.ensureSize (8192);

    activeRate = sampleRate;
    activeBlockSize = maxBlockSize;
    playHead.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    active.store (true);
    return true;
}

void Vst3Plugin::deactivate()
{
    if (active.exchange (false))
        instance->releaseResources();
}

void Vst3Plugin::process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                          int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t* transport) noexcept
{
    // Not ready for this block: effects leave the sound as it is, instruments stay silent.
    if (! active.load (std::memory_order_relaxed) || numSamples <= 0 || numSamples > buffer.getNumSamples())
        return;

    const auto channels = buffer.getNumChannels();

    for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; ++channel)
        buffer.clear (channel, 0, numSamples);

    if (inLeft != nullptr && inputChannels > 0)
        buffer.copyFrom (0, 0, inLeft, numSamples);

    if (inputChannels > 1 && (inRight != nullptr || inLeft != nullptr))
        buffer.copyFrom (1, 0, inRight != nullptr ? inRight : inLeft, numSamples);

    // What tracks send to its sidechain (silence when nothing does).
    if (sidechainChannels > 0 && numSamples <= sidechain.getNumSamples()
        && sidechainOffset + sidechainChannels <= buffer.getNumChannels())
    {
        for (int channel = 0; channel < sidechainChannels; ++channel)
            buffer.copyFrom (sidechainOffset + channel, 0, sidechain, channel, 0, numSamples);
    }

    // A copy: a plugin may change the MIDI it's given.
    midiBuffer.clear();

    if (! midi.isEmpty())
        midiBuffer.addEvents (midi, 0, numSamples, 0);

    playHead.transport = transport;
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> block (buffer.getArrayOfWritePointers(), channels, numSamples);
    instance->processBlock (block, midiBuffer);

    // A plugin that plays notes itself hands them back in the same buffer.
    midiOutput.clear();

    if (makesMidi)
        midiOutput.addEvents (midiBuffer, 0, numSamples, 0);

    if (outLeft != nullptr && outputChannels > 0)
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (outLeft, buffer.getReadPointer (0), numSamples);

    if (outRight != nullptr && outputChannels > 0)
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (outRight, buffer.getReadPointer (outputChannels > 1 ? 1 : 0), numSamples);
}

juce::Optional<juce::AudioPlayHead::PositionInfo> Vst3Plugin::PlayHead::getPosition() const
{
    PositionInfo info;
    info.setTimeInSamples (0);   // VST3 requires it, so it's always given

    if (transport == nullptr)
        return info;

    const auto& t = *transport;
    info.setIsPlaying ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_PLAYING) != 0);
    info.setIsRecording ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_RECORDING) != 0);
    info.setIsLooping ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_LOOP_ACTIVE) != 0);

    if ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TEMPO) != 0)
        info.setBpm (t.tempo);

    if ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TIME_SIGNATURE) != 0)
        info.setTimeSignature (TimeSignature { t.tsig_num, t.tsig_denom });

    if ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_BEATS_TIMELINE) != 0)
    {
        info.setPpqPosition (static_cast<double> (t.song_pos_beats) / CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR);
        info.setPpqPositionOfLastBarStart (static_cast<double> (t.bar_start) / CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR);
        info.setBarCount (t.bar_number);
        info.setLoopPoints (LoopPoints { static_cast<double> (t.loop_start_beats) / CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR,
                                         static_cast<double> (t.loop_end_beats) / CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR });
    }

    if ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_SECONDS_TIMELINE) != 0)
    {
        const auto seconds = static_cast<double> (t.song_pos_seconds) / CLAP_SECTIME_FACTOR;
        info.setTimeInSeconds (seconds);
        info.setTimeInSamples (static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (seconds * sampleRate)));
    }

    return info;
}

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_processors_headless/juce_audio_processors_headless.h>

// With JUCE's GUI in the build (the app), VST3 plugins can show their own windows; the
// headless host (the engine tests) has none.
#if JUCE_MODULE_AVAILABLE_juce_audio_processors && JUCE_MODULE_AVAILABLE_juce_gui_basics
 #include <juce_audio_processors/juce_audio_processors.h>
 #define FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS 1
#else
 #define FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS 0
#endif

#include "Plugin.h"

#include <atomic>

//==============================================================================
/**
    A native VST3 plugin, hosted through JUCE's VST3 host (with its own window in the app).
    The Sampling Studio's nodes load the other formats JUCE hosts the same way (loadAs): VST2
    (in builds with the VST2 SDK), Audio Units on macOS, LV2 on Linux.

    Audio goes through one buffer sized at activation, so process() never allocates.
    VST3 parameters run from 0 to 1 and keep their VST3 ids, so songs find them again.
    VST3 categories ("Fx|Reverb", "Instrument|Synth") become the same feature words
    WCLAP plugins use, so the Browser sorts both kinds alike.
*/
class Vst3Plugin final : public Plugin,
                         private juce::AudioProcessorListener
{
public:
    static std::unique_ptr<Vst3Plugin> load (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error);
    static std::vector<Descriptor> describe (const juce::File& file, juce::String& error);

    /** A plugin of another format JUCE hosts: juceFormat is JUCE's name for it ("VST", "AudioUnit",
        "LV2"), shownFormat Sonify's ("VST2", "AU", "LV2"). */
    static std::unique_ptr<Vst3Plugin> loadAs (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& juceFormat, const juce::String& shownFormat,
                                               const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error);
    static std::vector<Descriptor> describeAs (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& juceFormat, const juce::String& shownFormat,
                                               juce::String& error);

    /** Where VST3 plugins are installed (on Windows, Program Files\Common Files\VST3). */
    static juce::FileSearchPath getDefaultFolders();

    /** Lets go of JUCE's VST3 host. Called last at shutdown, when no plugin is left. */
    static void shutdownFormats();

    ~Vst3Plugin() override;

    juce::String getFormatName() const override                          { return formatName; }
    const Descriptor& getDescriptor() const noexcept override            { return descriptor; }
    const std::vector<Descriptor>& getPluginsInFile() const noexcept override { return pluginsInFile; }
    const juce::File& getSourceFile() const noexcept override            { return sourceFile; }
    Role getRole() const noexcept override                               { return role; }
    int getMainInputChannels() const noexcept override                   { return inputChannels; }
    bool hasSidechain() const noexcept override                          { return sidechainChannels > 0; }
    bool producesMidi() const noexcept override                          { return makesMidi; }
    int getMainOutputChannels() const noexcept override                  { return outputChannels; }

    bool canSaveState() const noexcept override                          { return true; }
    bool saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination) override;
    bool loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source) override;
    bool consumeStateChanged() noexcept override                         { return stateChanged.exchange (false); }
    int takeTouchedParameter() noexcept override                         { return touchedParameter.exchange (-1); }

    const std::vector<Parameter>& getParameters() const noexcept override { return parameters; }
    int findParameter (uint32_t id) const noexcept override;
    double getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept override;
    double readParameterValue (int index) override                       { return getParameterValue (index); }
    juce::String getParameterText (int index, double value) override;
    double queueParameter (int index, double value) override;
    void setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept override;

    bool activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize) override;
    void deactivate() override;
    bool isActive() const noexcept override                              { return active.load(); }

    void process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                  int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t* transport) noexcept override;

    ScreenKind getScreenKind() const noexcept override;
    bool showNativeScreen (const juce::String& title) override;
    void hideNativeScreen() override;

private:
   #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
    class ScreenWindow;
    std::unique_ptr<ScreenWindow> screenWindow;   // before instance: it goes first
   #endif

    Vst3Plugin (std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginInstance> instance, const juce::PluginDescription& description,
                std::vector<Descriptor> pluginsInFile, const juce::File& file);

    /** The song's position, tempo and loop, as the plugin asks for them. */
    struct PlayHead final : juce::AudioPlayHead
    {
        const clap_event_transport_t* transport = nullptr;
        double sampleRate = 48000.0;   // VST3 wants the position in samples too
        juce::Optional<PositionInfo> getPosition() const override;
    };

    void audioProcessorParameterChanged (juce::AudioProcessor*, int, float) override   { stateChanged.store (true); }
    void audioProcessorChanged (juce::AudioProcessor*, const ChangeDetails&) override    { stateChanged.store (true); }

    // The user took hold of a knob in the plugin's window (Sonify's own changes come without this).
    void audioProcessorParameterChangeGestureBegin (juce::AudioProcessor*, int index) override { touchedParameter.store (index); }

    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginInstance> instance;
    juce::String formatName { "VST3" };
    Descriptor descriptor;
    std::vector<Descriptor> pluginsInFile;
    juce::File sourceFile;
    Role role = Role::effect;

    std::vector<Parameter> parameters;
    std::vector<juce::AudioProcessorParameter*> hosted;

    juce::AudioBuffer<float> buffer;
    juce::MidiBuffer midiBuffer;
    PlayHead playHead;
    std::atomic<bool> active { false }, stateChanged { false };
    std::atomic<int> touchedParameter { -1 };
    double activeRate = 0.0;
    int activeBlockSize = 0;
    int inputChannels = 0, outputChannels = 0;   // inputChannels: the main bus
    int totalInputChannels = 0;                  // with the sidechain's
    int sidechainOffset = -1, sidechainChannels = 0;
    bool makesMidi = false;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Vst3Plugin)
};

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\WasmCompiler.cpp

#include "WasmCompiler.h"

#include "StellaRuntimeData.h"
#include "DeviceFiles.h"   // Sonify's compiler, shared with its devices

namespace
{
    // Sonify ships one WebAssembly compiler, for its devices and for the Plugins Creator Studio:
    // wasi-sdk's clang (run as C++), its own headers named from the folder as it's given.
    juce::File clangIn (const juce::File& sdk)
    {
       #if JUCE_WINDOWS
        return sdk.getChildFile ("bin").getChildFile ("clang.exe");
       #else
        return sdk.getChildFile ("bin").getChildFile ("clang");
       #endif
    }

    /** The compiler, its sysroot and its own headers: the start of every compile's arguments. */
    juce::StringArray compilerArgs (const juce::File& sdk)
    {
        juce::StringArray args;
        args.add (clangIn (sdk).getFullPathName());
        args.add ("--driver-mode=g++");
        args.add ("--target=wasm32-wasip1");
        args.add ("--sysroot=" + sdk.getChildFile ("share").getChildFile ("wasi-sysroot").getFullPathName());
        args.addArray ({ "-fintegrated-cc1", "-fno-color-diagnostics" });   // as Sonify's device builds run it

        if (const auto versions = sdk.getChildFile ("lib").getChildFile ("clang").findChildFiles (juce::File::findDirectories, false); ! versions.isEmpty())
            args.add ("-resource-dir=" + versions.getFirst().getFullPathName());

        return args;
    }

    /** Where builds are made: Sonify's own, outside the project, so the project stays clean. */
    juce::File workRoot()
    {
        return juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::tempDirectory).getChildFile ("Sonify Plugins Creator");
    }

    const char* const missingCompiler = "Sonify's plugin compiler (the \"Device Compiler\" folder next to Sonify) is missing, "
                                        "so plugins can't be built here. Reinstall Sonify.";

    /** A C++ string literal for any text. */
    juce::String literal (const juce::String& text)
    {
        juce::String result ("\"");

        for (auto c : text)
        {
            if (c == '"' || c == '\\')
                result << '\\' << juce::String::charToString (c);
            else if (c >= 32 && c < 127)
                result << juce::String::charToString (c);
        }

        return result + "\"";
    }

    bool isIdentifier (const juce::String& text)
    {
        return text.isNotEmpty()
            && text.containsOnly ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_")
            && ! juce::CharacterFunctions::isDigit (text[0]);
    }

    /** "voices.out" -> ("voices", "out"). Port names may have spaces ("out L"). */
    bool splitEnd (const juce::String& end, juce::String& module, juce::String& port)
    {
        const auto dot = end.indexOfChar ('.');

        if (dot <= 0 || dot >= end.length() - 1)
            return false;

        module = end.substring (0, dot).trim();
        port = end.substring (dot + 1).trim();
        return module.isNotEmpty() && port.isNotEmpty();
    }

    bool writeResource (const juce::File& file, const char* data, int size)
    {
        return file.replaceWithData (data, (size_t) size);
    }

    /** Bytes as the body of a C++ array, 24 to a line. */
    void appendBytes (juce::MemoryOutputStream& out, const char* data, int size)
    {
        static const char* const hex = "0123456789abcdef";
        const auto* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*> (data);
        char line[24 * 5 + 2];

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i += 24)
        {
            auto* c = line;

            for (int j = i; j < juce::jmin (size, i + 24); ++j)
            {
                *c++ = '0'; *c++ = 'x';
                *c++ = hex[bytes[j] >> 4];
                *c++ = hex[bytes[j] & 15];
                *c++ = ',';
            }

            *c++ = '\n';
            out.write (line, (size_t) (c - line));
        }
    }

    juce::String fontsHeader()
    {
        juce::MemoryOutputStream out;
        out << "// Generated by Sonify's Plugins Creator Studio: the Inter font (SIL Open Font License 1.1, rsms.me/inter), regular and bold.\n"
            << "#pragma once\n\nnamespace stella::ui::fonts\n{\n    static const unsigned char regular[] =\n    {\n";
        appendBytes (out, StellaRuntimeData::inter_regular_ttf, StellaRuntimeData::inter_regular_ttfSize);
        out << "    };\n\n    static const unsigned char bold[] =\n    {\n";
        appendBytes (out, StellaRuntimeData::inter_bold_ttf, StellaRuntimeData::inter_bold_ttfSize);
        out << "    };\n}\n";
        return out.toString();
    }

    struct Resource
    {
        const char* name;
        const char* data;
        int size;
    };

    std::vector<Resource> elementRuntimeFiles()
    {
        return { { "stella_element_api.h", StellaRuntimeData::stella_element_api_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_element_api_hSize },
                 { "stella_element_host.h", StellaRuntimeData::stella_element_host_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_element_host_hSize },
                 { "stella_elements.h", StellaRuntimeData::stella_elements_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_elements_hSize },
                 { "stella_elements.cpp", StellaRuntimeData::stella_elements_cpp, StellaRuntimeData::stella_elements_cppSize },
                 { "stella_builtin_elements.cpp", StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_elements_cpp, StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_elements_cppSize },
                 { "stella_view3d.h", StellaRuntimeData::stella_view3d_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_view3d_hSize },
                 { "stella_builtin_3d.cpp", StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_3d_cpp, StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_3d_cppSize },
                 { "stella_paint.h", StellaRuntimeData::stella_paint_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_paint_hSize },
                 { "stella_builtin_paint.cpp", StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_paint_cpp, StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_paint_cppSize },
                 { "stb_truetype.h", StellaRuntimeData::stb_truetype_h, StellaRuntimeData::stb_truetype_hSize } };
    }

    /** Which version of the elements' runtime this studio carries: its compiled form is kept by it. */
    juce::String elementRuntimeKey()
    {
        std::uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;

        auto add = [&hash] (const char* data, int size)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i)
                hash = (hash ^ (std::uint8_t) data[i]) * 1099511628211ull;
        };

        for (const auto& file : elementRuntimeFiles())
            add (file.data, file.size);

        add (StellaRuntimeData::inter_regular_ttf, StellaRuntimeData::inter_regular_ttfSize);
        add (StellaRuntimeData::inter_bold_ttf, StellaRuntimeData::inter_bold_ttfSize);
        return juce::String::toHexString ((juce::int64) hash);
    }

    bool isQuote (juce::juce_wchar c)    { return c == '"'; }

    /** The STELLA_ELEMENT (Name, "description") lines of a file (or another macro's). */
    void scanElements (const juce::String& text, const juce::String& file, juce::Array<WasmCompiler::ElementSource>& found,
                       const juce::String& macro = "STELLA_ELEMENT")
    {
        for (int at = text.indexOf (macro); at >= 0; at = text.indexOf (at + macro.length(), macro))
        {
            auto p = text.getCharPointer() + at + macro.length();
            auto skipSpace = [&p] { while (! p.isEmpty() && p.isWhitespace()) ++p; };

            skipSpace();

            if (*p != '(')
                continue;

            ++p;
            skipSpace();
            juce::String name;

            while (! p.isEmpty() && (p.isLetterOrDigit() || *p == '_'))
                name += juce::String::charToString (*p++);

            skipSpace();

            if (name.isEmpty() || *p != ',')
                continue;

            ++p;
            juce::String description;

            // One or more string literals in a row.
            for (;;)
            {
                skipSpace();

                if (! isQuote (*p))
                    break;

                ++p;

                while (! p.isEmpty() && ! isQuote (*p))
                {
                    if (*p == '\\' && ! (p + 1).isEmpty())
                        ++p;

                    description += juce::String::charToString (*p++);
                }

                if (! p.isEmpty())
                    ++p;
            }

            found.add ({ name, description, file });
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File WasmCompiler::findCompiler()
{
    // Sonify's own: "Device Compiler" next to it (or SONIFY_DEVICE_COMPILER while developing).
    const auto sdk = Devices::Compiler::folder();

    if (clangIn (sdk).existsAsFile() && sdk.getChildFile ("share").getChildFile ("wasi-sysroot").isDirectory())
        return sdk;

    return {};
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Result WasmCompiler::generateGraphSource (const juce::File& graphFile, juce::String& source)
{
    juce::var graph;
    const auto parsed = juce::JSON::parse (graphFile.loadFileAsString(), graph);

    if (parsed.failed() || ! graph.isObject())
        return juce::Result::fail ("graph.json isn't valid JSON: " + parsed.getErrorMessage());

    const auto* modules = graph.getProperty ("modules", {}).getArray();
    const auto* wires = graph.getProperty ("wires", {}).getArray();

    if (modules == nullptr || modules->isEmpty())
        return juce::Result::fail ("graph.json has no modules.");

    juce::String moduleRows, wireRows;

    for (const auto& module : *modules)
    {
        const auto id = module.getProperty ("id", {}).toString().trim();
        const auto type = module.getProperty ("type", {}).toString().trim();

        if (! isIdentifier (id) || id == "plugin")
            return juce::Result::fail ("graph.json: \"" + id + "\" can't be a module id (letters, digits and _ only, and not \"plugin\").");

        if (! isIdentifier (type))
            return juce::Result::fail ("graph.json: \"" + type + "\" isn't a module type name.");

        moduleRows << "        { " << literal (id) << ", " << literal (type) << " },\n";
    }

    int numWires = 0;

    if (wires != nullptr)
    {
        for (const auto& wire : *wires)
        {
            juce::String fromModule, fromPort, toModule, toPort;

            if (! splitEnd (wire.getProperty ("from", {}).toString(), fromModule, fromPort)
                || ! splitEnd (wire.getProperty ("to", {}).toString(), toModule, toPort))
                return juce::Result::fail ("graph.json: a wire needs \"from\" and \"to\" like \"filter.out\".");

            wireRows << "        { " << literal (fromModule) << ", " << literal (fromPort) << ", "
                     << literal (toModule) << ", " << literal (toPort) << " },\n";
            ++numWires;
        }
    }

    if (numWires == 0)
        wireRows = "        { \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\" },\n";   // an array can't be empty; the count says 0

    source.clear();
    source << "// Generated by Sonify's Plugins Creator Studio from graph.json. Don't edit: it's rewritten on every build.\n\n"
           << "#include \"stella_runtime.h\"\n\n"
           << "namespace stella\n{\n"
           << "    extern const GraphModule graphModules[]\n    {\n" << moduleRows << "    };\n\n"
           << "    extern const int numGraphModules = " << modules->size() << ";\n\n"
           << "    extern const GraphWire graphWires[]\n    {\n" << wireRows << "    };\n\n"
           << "    extern const int numGraphWires = " << numWires << ";\n"
           << "}\n";

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

bool WasmCompiler::writeRuntime (const juce::File& folder)
{
    return writeResource (folder.getChildFile ("stella_api.h"), StellaRuntimeData::stella_api_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_api_hSize)
        && writeResource (folder.getChildFile ("stella_runtime.h"), StellaRuntimeData::stella_runtime_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_runtime_hSize)
        && writeResource (folder.getChildFile ("stella_runtime.cpp"), StellaRuntimeData::stella_runtime_cpp, StellaRuntimeData::stella_runtime_cppSize)
        && writeResource (folder.getChildFile ("stella_licence.h"), StellaRuntimeData::stella_licence_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_licence_hSize)
        && writeResource (folder.getChildFile ("stella_blob.h"), StellaRuntimeData::stella_blob_h, StellaRuntimeData::stella_blob_hSize);
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Array<WasmCompiler::ElementSource> WasmCompiler::findElements (const juce::File& projectFolder)
{
    juce::Array<ElementSource> found;
    auto files = projectFolder.getChildFile (elementsFolderName).findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, "*.cpp");
    files.sort();

    for (const auto& file : files)
        scanElements (file.loadFileAsString(), juce::String (elementsFolderName) + "/" + file.getFileName(), found);

    return found;
}

juce::Array<WasmCompiler::ElementSource> WasmCompiler::builtInElements()
{
    juce::Array<ElementSource> found;
    scanElements (juce::String::fromUTF8 (StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_elements_cpp, StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_elements_cppSize),
                  "the toolbox", found, "STELLA_BUILTIN_ELEMENT");
    scanElements (juce::String::fromUTF8 (StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_3d_cpp, StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_3d_cppSize),
                  "the toolbox", found, "STELLA_BUILTIN_ELEMENT");
    scanElements (juce::String::fromUTF8 (StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_paint_cpp, StellaRuntimeData::stella_builtin_paint_cppSize),
                  "the toolbox", found, "STELLA_BUILTIN_ELEMENT");
    return found;
}

bool WasmCompiler::writeElementRuntime (const juce::File& folder)
{
    for (const auto& file : elementRuntimeFiles())
        if (! writeResource (folder.getChildFile (file.name), file.data, file.size))
            return false;

    const auto fonts = folder.getChildFile ("stella_fonts.h");
    const auto text = fontsHeader();
    return (fonts.existsAsFile() && fonts.loadFileAsString() == text) || fonts.replaceWithText (text);
}

WasmCompiler::Result WasmCompiler::compileElements (const juce::File& projectFolder, const juce::String& projectId)
{
    Result result;
    const auto started = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();
    const auto elements = projectFolder.getChildFile (elementsFolderName);

    // Built even with no files of the project's own: the toolbox's drop-down list is one.
    auto files = elements.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, "*.cpp");
    files.sort();

    const auto sdk = findCompiler();

    if (sdk == juce::File())
    {
        result.log = missingCompiler;
        return result;
    }

    const auto studioTemp = workRoot();
    const auto work = studioTemp.getChildFile ("build-" + juce::File::createLegalFileName (projectId));
    const auto runtime = studioTemp.getChildFile ("element-runtime");

    if ((! work.isDirectory() && ! work.createDirectory()) || (! runtime.isDirectory() && ! runtime.createDirectory()))
    {
        result.log = "Couldn't create the build folder " + work.getFullPathName();
        return result;
    }

    auto baseArgs = [&sdk]
    {
        auto args = compilerArgs (sdk);
        args.addArray ({ "-O2", "-std=c++17", "-fno-exceptions", "-fno-rtti", "-Wall" });
        return args;
    };

    auto run = [] (const juce::StringArray& args, juce::String& log, int timeoutMs)
    {
        juce::ChildProcess clang;

        if (! clang.start (args, juce::ChildProcess::wantStdOut | juce::ChildProcess::wantStdErr))
        {
            log = "The plugin compiler couldn't be started.";
            return false;
        }

        log = clang.readAllProcessOutput();
        clang.waitForProcessToFinish (timeoutMs);
        return clang.getExitCode() == 0;
    };

    // The runtime (drawing, text, the font) and the toolbox's elements (the drop-down list, the
    // 3D displays, the panel painter) are compiled once per studio version and kept.
    const auto key = elementRuntimeKey();
    const auto object = runtime.getChildFile ("runtime-" + key + ".o");
    const auto builtIns = runtime.getChildFile ("builtins-" + key + ".o");
    const auto builtIns3d = runtime.getChildFile ("builtins3d-" + key + ".o");
    const auto builtInsPaint = runtime.getChildFile ("builtinspaint-" + key + ".o");

    if (! writeElementRuntime (runtime))
    {
        result.log = "Couldn't write into the build folder " + runtime.getFullPathName();
        return result;
    }

    for (const auto& [source, target] : { std::pair<const char*, juce::File> { "stella_elements.cpp", object },
                                          std::pair<const char*, juce::File> { "stella_builtin_elements.cpp", builtIns },
                                          std::pair<const char*, juce::File> { "stella_builtin_3d.cpp", builtIns3d },
                                          std::pair<const char*, juce::File> { "stella_builtin_paint.cpp", builtInsPaint } })
    {
        if (target.existsAsFile())
            continue;

        const auto partial = runtime.getChildFile ("building.o");
        auto args = baseArgs();
        args.add ("-I" + runtime.getFullPathName());
        args.add ("-c");
        args.add (runtime.getChildFile (source).getFullPathName());
        args.add ("-o");
        args.add (partial.getFullPathName());

        juce::String log;

        if (! run (args, log, 120000) || ! partial.existsAsFile() || ! partial.moveFileTo (target))
        {
            result.log = "The GUI elements' runtime didn't compile:\n" + log.trim();
            return result;
        }
    }

    const auto output = work.getChildFile ("elements.wasm");
    output.deleteFile();

    auto args = baseArgs();
    args.add ("-mexec-model=reactor");
    args.add ("-I" + runtime.getFullPathName());
    args.add ("-I" + elements.getFullPathName());
    args.add ("-o");
    args.add (output.getFullPathName());
    args.add (object.getFullPathName());
    args.add (builtIns.getFullPathName());
    args.add (builtIns3d.getFullPathName());
    args.add (builtInsPaint.getFullPathName());

    for (const auto& file : files)
        args.add (file.getFullPathName());

    args.add ("-Wl,--strip-all");

    juce::String log;
    const bool linked = run (args, log, 60000);

    result.log = log.replace (elements.getFullPathName() + juce::File::getSeparatorString(), juce::String (elementsFolderName) + "/")
                    .replace (runtime.getFullPathName() + juce::File::getSeparatorString(), "")
                    .trim();
    result.ok = linked && output.existsAsFile();
    result.wasm = result.ok ? output : juce::File();
    result.seconds = (juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes() - started) / 1000.0;

    if (! result.ok && result.log.isEmpty())
        result.log = "The GUI elements' compiler stopped without saying why.";

    return result;
}

//==============================================================================
bool WasmCompiler::isValidProductId (const juce::String& productId)
{
    return productId.isNotEmpty() && productId.length() <= 80
        && productId.containsOnly ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_.");
}

WasmCompiler::Result WasmCompiler::compile (const juce::File& projectFolder, const juce::String& projectId, const juce::String& protectedProduct)
{
    Result result;

    if (protectedProduct.isNotEmpty() && ! isValidProductId (protectedProduct))
    {
        result.log = "The store's id for it isn't one that can be built in: " + protectedProduct;
        return result;
    }

    const auto started = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes();

    const auto sdk = findCompiler();

    if (sdk == juce::File())
    {
        result.log = missingCompiler;
        return result;
    }

    // The work folder is the studio's own, outside the project: the project stays clean.
    const auto work = workRoot().getChildFile ((protectedProduct.isNotEmpty() ? "store-" : "build-") + juce::File::createLegalFileName (projectId));

    if (! work.isDirectory() && ! work.createDirectory())
    {
        result.log = "Couldn't create the build folder " + work.getFullPathName();
        return result;
    }

    juce::String graphSource;

    if (const auto graph = generateGraphSource (projectFolder.getChildFile (graphFileName), graphSource); graph.failed())
    {
        result.log = graph.getErrorMessage();
        return result;
    }

    const auto output = work.getChildFile ("plugin.wasm");
    output.deleteFile();

    if (! writeRuntime (work) || ! work.getChildFile ("stella_graph.cpp").replaceWithText (graphSource))
    {
        result.log = "Couldn't write into the build folder " + work.getFullPathName();
        return result;
    }

    const auto modules = projectFolder.getChildFile ("modules");
    auto moduleFiles = modules.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, "*.cpp");
    moduleFiles.sort();

    auto args = compilerArgs (sdk);
    args.addArray ({ "-O2", "-std=c++17", "-fno-exceptions", "-fno-rtti", "-mexec-model=reactor", "-Wall" });
    args.add ("-I" + work.getFullPathName());
    args.add ("-I" + modules.getFullPathName());

    // The store's: its id built in (from a header: quotes don't survive every command line),
    // with its demo until this computer has its licence.
    if (protectedProduct.isNotEmpty())
    {
        if (! work.getChildFile ("stella_product.h").replaceWithText ("// Written by Sonify's Protection tab: the store's id for this plugin.\n"
                                                                     "#define STELLA_PRODUCT \"" + protectedProduct + "\"\n"))
        {
            result.log = "Couldn't write into the build folder " + work.getFullPathName();
            return result;
        }

        args.add ("-DSTELLA_PROTECTED=1");
    }

    args.add ("-o");
    args.add (output.getFullPathName());
    args.add (work.getChildFile ("stella_runtime.cpp").getFullPathName());
    args.add (work.getChildFile ("stella_graph.cpp").getFullPathName());

    for (const auto& file : moduleFiles)
        args.add (file.getFullPathName());

    args.add ("-Wl,--strip-all");

    juce::ChildProcess clang;

    if (! clang.start (args, juce::ChildProcess::wantStdOut | juce::ChildProcess::wantStdErr))
    {
        result.log = "The plugin compiler couldn't be started.";
        return result;
    }

    auto log = clang.readAllProcessOutput();
    clang.waitForProcessToFinish (5000);

    // Shorter messages: "modules/LowPass.cpp:12:3: error ..." rather than full paths.
    log = log.replace (modules.getFullPathName() + juce::File::getSeparatorString(), "modules/")
             .replace (work.getFullPathName() + juce::File::getSeparatorString(), "")
             .trim();

    result.log = log;
    result.ok = clang.getExitCode() == 0 && output.existsAsFile();
    result.wasm = result.ok ? output : juce::File();
    result.seconds = (juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes() - started) / 1000.0;

    if (! result.ok && result.log.isEmpty())
        result.log = "The plugin compiler stopped without saying why.";

    return result;
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\WasmCompiler.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include "Project.h"

//==============================================================================
/**
    Turns a project into a plugin the studio can play live: the project's modules plus
    the Stella runtime, compiled to WebAssembly by the compiler that ships with the
    studio (wasi-sdk). Nothing has to be installed on the user's computer.

    A project holds:
        graph.json   which modules the plugin has and how they're wired
        modules/     one .cpp file per module type, written against stella_api.h
        elements/    programmed GUI elements, one .cpp file each, written against
                     stella_element_api.h: compiled into a module of their own (the GUI's)
*/
class WasmCompiler final
{
public:
    struct Result
    {
        bool ok = false;
        juce::String log;        // the compiler's messages (errors, warnings)
        juce::File wasm;         // the compiled plugin, when ok
        double seconds = 0.0;
    };

    /** Compiles the project. Takes a few seconds: call it on a worker thread. protectedProduct:
        the store's id for a paid plugin, built in with its demo (stella_licence.h), in a work
        folder of its own (the live build's stays as it is). */
    static Result compile (const juce::File& projectFolder, const juce::String& projectId, const juce::String& protectedProduct = {});

    /** Whether a store id can be built into a plugin: letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.'. */
    static bool isValidProductId (const juce::String& productId);

    /** The bundled compiler's folder, or an empty File if it's missing. */
    static juce::File findCompiler();

    static constexpr const char* graphFileName = "graph.json";

    /** graph.json as C++ (stella_graph.cpp), for the live build and for exports. */
    static juce::Result generateGraphSource (const juce::File& graphFile, juce::String& source);

    /** Writes stella_api.h, stella_runtime.h and stella_runtime.cpp into a build folder. */
    static bool writeRuntime (const juce::File& folder);

    //==========================================================================
    static constexpr const char* elementsFolderName = "elements";

    /** A programmed element as its file declares it (STELLA_ELEMENT), before any build. */
    struct ElementSource
    {
        juce::String name, description, file;
    };

    static juce::Array<ElementSource> findElements (const juce::File& projectFolder);

    /** The toolbox's own elements made the same way: the drop-down list (stella_builtin_elements.cpp),
        the 3D displays (stella_builtin_3d.cpp) and the panel painter (stella_builtin_paint.cpp).
        Every build has them; a project's element of the same name replaces one. */
    static juce::Array<ElementSource> builtInElements();

    /** Compiles the elements folder's .cpp files, with the toolbox's own, into the GUI's module. */
    static Result compileElements (const juce::File& projectFolder, const juce::String& projectId);

    /** Writes the elements' runtime (stella_element_api.h and the rest, and the font as
        stella_fonts.h) into a build folder, for the live build and for exports. */
    static bool writeElementRuntime (const juce::File& folder);
};
