//==============================================================================
Workspace::PluginView::PluginView()
{
    // Edit and Play: two tabs, one always on.
    for (auto* tab : { &editTab, &playTab })
    {
        tab->setClickingTogglesState (true);
        tab->setRadioGroupId (modeGroup);
        tab->setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonOnColourId, Theme::accent);
    }

    editTab.setTooltip ("Edit: reshape the plugin's panel. Add, move, resize and delete its parts");
    playTab.setTooltip ("Play: the panel is locked. Turn its knobs and play it like the finished plugin");
    editTab.setConnectedEdges (juce::Button::ConnectedOnRight);
    playTab.setConnectedEdges (juce::Button::ConnectedOnLeft);
    editTab.setToggleState (true, juce::dontSendNotification);
    editTab.onClick = [this] { if (editTab.getToggleState()) chooseMode (false); };
    playTab.onClick  = [this] { if (playTab.getToggleState()) chooseMode (true); };

    logButton.setTooltip ("The compiler's messages from the last build");
    logButton.onClick = [this] { if (onShowLog != nullptr) onShowLog(); };

    exportButton.setTooltip ("Build the plugin from its code as it is now and put it into Sonify's Browser (Made in Sonify), to use "
                             "on your tracks. Again later: it's updated");
    exportButton.onClick = [this] { if (onExport != nullptr) onExport(); };

    pluginButton.setTooltip ("Export the plugin as files your DAW loads, built on this computer: VST3 and CLAP"
                           #if JUCE_MAC
                             ", and Audio Unit"
                           #endif
                             ". They play anywhere you copy them");
    pluginButton.onClick = [this] { if (onExportPlugin != nullptr) onExportPlugin(); };

    panicButton.setTooltip ("Panic: stop every note that's sounding, stuck ones too");
    panicButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId, juce::Colour (0xffff8a80));
    panicButton.onClick = [this] { if (onPanic != nullptr) onPanic(); };

    autoButton.setTooltip ("Replace the GUI with a plain automatic one: a group per module, a control per parameter");
    autoButton.onClick = [this] { if (onAutoLayout != nullptr) onAutoLayout(); };

    for (auto* c : std::initializer_list<juce::Component*> { &editTab, &playTab, &logButton, &exportButton, &pluginButton, &panicButton })
        addChildComponent (c);

    // Play's row: the preset manager, as the plugin's own (presets on the hard drive, banks).
    presetBox.setTextWhenNoChoicesAvailable ("No presets yet");
    presetBox.setTooltip ("Choose a preset: all its values at once (a * means its values changed since)");
    presetBox.onChange = [this]
    {
        // The chosen one again too: its own values back.
        if (presetBox.getSelectedId() > 0 && onPresetChosen != nullptr)
            onPresetChosen (presetBox.getSelectedId() - 1);
    };

    previousButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x97\x80"));
    nextButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("\xe2\x96\xb6"));
    previousButton.setTooltip ("The previous preset");
    nextButton.setTooltip ("The next preset");
    previousButton.setConnectedEdges (juce::Button::ConnectedOnRight);
    nextButton.setConnectedEdges (juce::Button::ConnectedOnLeft);
    previousButton.onClick = [this] { if (const auto i = presets.step (-1); i >= 0 && onPresetChosen != nullptr) onPresetChosen (i); };
    nextButton.onClick = [this] { if (const auto i = presets.step (1); i >= 0 && onPresetChosen != nullptr) onPresetChosen (i); };

    saveButton.setTooltip ("Save the current values over the chosen preset");
    saveButton.onClick = [this] { if (onPresetAction != nullptr) onPresetAction (PresetAction::save); };

    saveAsButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Save as\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    saveAsButton.setTooltip ("Save the current values as a new preset of your own (kept on this computer, for this plugin wherever it plays)");
    saveAsButton.onClick = [this] { if (onPresetAction != nullptr) onPresetAction (PresetAction::saveAs); };

    loadButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Load\xe2\x80\xa6"));
    loadButton.setTooltip ("Load a preset file (.sonifypreset) into your presets");
    loadButton.onClick = [this] { if (onPresetAction != nullptr) onPresetAction (PresetAction::loadFile); };

    moreButton.setButtonText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("More \xe2\x96\xbe"));
    moreButton.setTooltip ("Banks (every preset in one file), factory presets that come with the plugin, Delete, and the presets folder");
    moreButton.onClick = [this] { showMoreMenu(); };

    for (auto* c : std::initializer_list<juce::Component*> { &presetBox, &previousButton, &nextButton, &saveButton, &saveAsButton, &loadButton, &moreButton })
        addChildComponent (c);
    addChildComponent (autoButton);
    addChildComponent (canvas);

    // The toolbox: drag a primitive onto the window, or double-click it.
    toolbox.onAdd = [this] (const juce::String& id)
    {
        if (const auto* primitive = PrimitiveLibrary::get().find (id))
            canvas.addPrimitive (*primitive);
    };

    addChildComponent (toolbox);
}

void Workspace::PluginView::setProject (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& kindName)
{
    projectName = name;
    kind = kindName;

    const bool hasProject = projectName.isNotEmpty();

    for (auto* c : std::initializer_list<juce::Component*> { &editTab, &playTab, &logButton, &exportButton, &pluginButton, &panicButton })
        c->setVisible (hasProject);

    canvas.setVisible (true);   // the grid shows even with nothing on it
    setPlayMode (playMode);   // and the row that goes with the tab

    resized();
    repaint();
}

void Workspace::PluginView::setPlayMode (bool shouldPlay)
{
    playMode = shouldPlay;
    (playMode ? playTab : editTab).setToggleState (true, juce::dontSendNotification);

    // Each tab has a row of its own: Edit's tools, or Play's preset manager.
    const bool hasProject = projectName.isNotEmpty();

    autoButton.setVisible (hasProject && ! playMode);
    toolbox.setVisible (hasProject && ! playMode);

    for (auto* c : std::initializer_list<juce::Component*> { &presetBox, &previousButton, &nextButton, &saveButton, &saveAsButton, &loadButton, &moreButton })
        c->setVisible (hasProject && playMode);

    canvas.setDesignMode (! playMode);
    resized();   // the toolbox shows in Edit only
    repaint();
}

void Workspace::PluginView::chooseMode (bool play)
{
    if (play == playMode)
        return;

    setPlayMode (play);

    if (onMode != nullptr)
        onMode (play);
}

void Workspace::PluginView::setBuild (BuildState state, const juce::String& status)
{
    buildState = state;
    buildStatus = status;
    repaint (getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (barHeight));
}

void Workspace::PluginView::setPresets (const PresetMenu& newPresets)
{
    presets = newPresets;

    presetBox.clear (juce::dontSendNotification);
    juce::String heading;

    for (int i = 0; i < presets.names.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (i == 0 || presets.groups[i] != heading)
        {
            heading = presets.groups[i];
            presetBox.addSectionHeading (heading);
        }

        presetBox.addItem (presets.names[i], i + 1);
    }

    // The chosen one by its name (a * when its values changed), or what to do.
    presetBox.setSelectedId (presets.current >= 0 && ! presets.modified ? presets.current + 1 : 0, juce::dontSendNotification);
    presetBox.setTextWhenNothingSelected (presets.currentText());

    const bool any = ! presets.names.isEmpty();
    previousButton.setEnabled (any);
    nextButton.setEnabled (any);
    saveButton.setEnabled (presets.canSave);

    canvas.setPresets (presets);
}

void Workspace::PluginView::showMoreMenu()
{
    constexpr int firstId = 1;
    juce::PopupMenu menu;
    PresetMenus::addActions (menu, presets, firstId);

    menu.showMenuAsync (juce::PopupMenu::Options().withTargetComponent (&moreButton),
                        [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<PluginView> (this)] (int choice)
                        {
                            if (safeThis != nullptr && choice >= firstId && safeThis->onPresetAction != nullptr)
                                safeThis->onPresetAction ((PresetAction) (choice - firstId));
                        });
}

void Workspace::PluginView::setExporting (bool exporting)
{
    exportButton.setEnabled (! exporting);
    exportButton.setButtonText (exporting ? juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Adding\xe2\x80\xa6") : juce::String ("Add to Sonify"));
}

void Workspace::PluginView::setExportingPlugin (bool exporting)
{
    pluginButton.setEnabled (! exporting);
    pluginButton.setButtonText (exporting ? juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Exporting\xe2\x80\xa6") : juce::String ("Export Plugin"));
}

void Workspace::PluginView::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (Theme::panel);

    // No project: the canvas's grid fills the whole tab.
    if (projectName.isEmpty())
        return;

    // The build bar: a light for the state, and what's happening.
    auto bar = statusArea;

    const auto lightColour = buildState == BuildState::playing  ? Theme::safe
                           : buildState == BuildState::building ? Theme::hot
                           : buildState == BuildState::failed   ? Theme::clip
                                                                : Theme::muted;

    const auto light = bar.removeFromLeft (10).toFloat().withSizeKeepingCentre (8.0f, 8.0f);
    g.setColour (lightColour.withAlpha (0.35f));
    g.fillEllipse (light.expanded (2.5f));
    g.setColour (lightColour);
    g.fillEllipse (light);

    bar.removeFromLeft (8);
    g.setColour (buildState == BuildState::failed ? Theme::clip.brighter (0.4f) : Theme::text.withAlpha (0.85f));
    g.setFont (Theme::font (14.0f));
    g.drawText (buildStatus.isNotEmpty() ? buildStatus : juce::String ("Not built yet"), bar, juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);

    g.setColour (Theme::outline);
    g.fillRect (0, barHeight - 1, getWidth(), 1);
    g.fillRect (0, barHeight + rowHeight - 1, getWidth(), 1);

    // The tab's own row: Play names its presets; Edit says how editing works.
    g.setColour (Theme::muted);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (13.5f));

    if (playMode)
        g.drawText ("Preset", juce::Rectangle<int> (16, barHeight, 60, rowHeight), juce::Justification::centredLeft, false);
    else
        g.drawFittedText (juce::String::fromUTF8 ("Drag parts in from the toolbox \xc2\xb7 right-click one to edit it or ask Fanan AI \xc2\xb7 "
                                                  "drag empty space to move around \xc2\xb7 Ctrl + wheel zooms"),
                          hintArea, juce::Justification::centredLeft, 1, 0.85f);
}

void Workspace::PluginView::resized()
{
    // The bar: Panic and the build's state on the left, the Edit and Play tabs in the middle,
    // Export Plugin, Add to Sonify and Log on the right.
    const auto full = getLocalBounds().removeFromTop (barHeight).reduced (16, 9);
    auto bar = full;

    auto tabs = juce::Rectangle<int> (modeTabWidth * 2, bar.getHeight()).withCentre (full.getCentre());
    editTab.setBounds (tabs.removeFromLeft (modeTabWidth));
    playTab.setBounds (tabs);

    panicButton.setBounds (bar.removeFromLeft (76));
    bar.removeFromLeft (14);

    logButton.setBounds (bar.removeFromRight (64));
    bar.removeFromRight (8);
    exportButton.setBounds (bar.removeFromRight (124));
    bar.removeFromRight (8);
    pluginButton.setBounds (bar.removeFromRight (120));

    statusArea = juce::Rectangle<int>::leftTopRightBottom (bar.getX(), bar.getY() + 1, juce::jmax (bar.getX(), editTab.getX() - 14), bar.getBottom() - 1);

    const auto row = getLocalBounds().withTrimmedTop (barHeight).removeFromTop (rowHeight).reduced (16, 6);

    // Edit's row: Auto layout, then how editing works.
    auto tools = row;
    autoButton.setBounds (tools.removeFromLeft (104));
    tools.removeFromLeft (18);
    hintArea = tools;

    // Play's row: the preset manager.
    auto line = row;
    line.removeFromLeft (56);
    presetBox.setBounds (line.removeFromLeft (240));
    line.removeFromLeft (6);
    previousButton.setBounds (line.removeFromLeft (30));
    nextButton.setBounds (line.removeFromLeft (30));
    line.removeFromLeft (12);
    saveButton.setBounds (line.removeFromLeft (64));
    line.removeFromLeft (6);
    saveAsButton.setBounds (line.removeFromLeft (88));
    line.removeFromLeft (6);
    loadButton.setBounds (line.removeFromLeft (72));
    line.removeFromLeft (6);
    moreButton.setBounds (line.removeFromLeft (84));

    // The grid: under the bars with a project, the whole tab without one. In Edit, the
    // toolbox runs down its left side.
    auto rest = projectName.isNotEmpty() ? getLocalBounds().withTrimmedTop (barHeight + rowHeight) : getLocalBounds();

    if (toolbox.isVisible())
        toolbox.setBounds (rest.removeFromLeft (Toolbox::width));

    canvas.setBounds (rest);
}

void Workspace::HintView::setText (const juce::String& newTitle, const juce::String& newDetail)
{
    title = newTitle;
    detail = newDetail;
    repaint();
}

void Workspace::HintView::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (Theme::panel);

    auto area = getLocalBounds().withSizeKeepingCentre (juce::jmin (560, getWidth() - 40), 110);

    g.setColour (Theme::text);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (20.0f, true));
    g.drawText (title, area.removeFromTop (32), juce::Justification::centred, false);

    // A scale of 1 wraps long text onto more lines instead of squashing it onto one.
    g.setColour (Theme::muted);
    g.setFont (Theme::font (14.5f));
    g.drawFittedText (detail, area, juce::Justification::centredTop, 4, 1.0f);
}

//==============================================================================
Workspace::Workspace()
{
    pluginView.onShowLog    = [this] { if (onShowLogRequested != nullptr) onShowLogRequested(); };
    pluginView.onExport     = [this] { if (onExportRequested != nullptr) onExportRequested(); };
    pluginView.onExportPlugin = [this] { if (onExportPluginRequested != nullptr) onExportPluginRequested(); };
    pluginView.onPanic      = [this] { if (onPanicRequested != nullptr) onPanicRequested(); };
    pluginView.onPresetChosen = [this] (int i) { if (onPresetChosen != nullptr) onPresetChosen (i); };
    pluginView.onPresetAction = [this] (PresetAction action) { if (onPresetAction != nullptr) onPresetAction (action); };
    pluginView.canvas.onPresetChosen = [this] (int i) { if (onPresetChosen != nullptr) onPresetChosen (i); };
    pluginView.canvas.onPresetAction = [this] (PresetAction action) { if (onPresetAction != nullptr) onPresetAction (action); };
    pluginView.canvas.onElementsFailed = [this] (const juce::String& why) { if (onElementsFailed != nullptr) onElementsFailed (why); };
    pluginView.canvas.onPaintPicture = [this] (const juce::var& recipe, std::function<void (const juce::String&)> done)
    {
        if (onPaintPicture != nullptr)
            onPaintPicture (recipe, std::move (done));
        else if (done != nullptr)
            done ("Painting isn't available here.");
    };
    pluginView.onAutoLayout = [this] { if (onAutoLayoutRequested != nullptr) onAutoLayoutRequested(); };
    pluginView.onMode       = [this] (bool play) { if (onModeChanged != nullptr) onModeChanged (play); };

    pluginView.canvas.onLayoutEdited = [this]
    {
        // A look of mine put on a control comes into the plugin, so it opens anywhere.
        looks.adoptMine (pluginView.canvas.getLayout());

        if (onLayoutEdited != nullptr)
            onLayoutEdited();
    };
    pluginView.canvas.onAskAi = [this] (int widgetIndex, const juce::String& instruction)
    {
        if (onAskAiAboutGui != nullptr)
            onAskAiAboutGui (widgetIndex, instruction);
    };
    pluginView.canvas.onOpenChat = [this] { showTab (aiTab); };

    // The looks: the canvas draws from them and the Knob Studio edits them. A change shows
    // on both at once.
    pluginView.canvas.setLooks (looks);
    looks.onChanged = [this]
    {
        pluginView.canvas.looksChanged();
        studio.looksChanged();
    };

    // A picture chosen for a look's Image layer is copied into the project's pictures.
    LayerImages::setAdopter ([] (const juce::File& picture)
    {
        const auto folder = LayerImages::getFolder();
        return folder != juce::File() ? GuiLayout::importPicture (picture, folder) : juce::String();
    });

    // A knob, slider or switch's menu in the Edit tab, "Design it in the Knob Studio": its look
    // opens there, for it alone or with every control like it.
    pluginView.canvas.onEditLook = [this] (int widgetIndex, bool includeSimilars)
    {
        studio.setLayout (pluginView.canvas.getLayout());
        studio.editControl (widgetIndex, includeSimilars);

        const juce::ScopedValueSetter<bool> forControl (openingStudioForControl, true);
        showTab (studioTab);
    };

    pluginView.canvas.readLevel = [this] (const juce::String& source, bool rms) { return readLevel != nullptr ? readLevel (source, rms) : 0.0f; };
    pluginView.canvas.readScope = [this] (const juce::String& source, float* destination, int numSamples)
    {
        if (readScope != nullptr)
            readScope (source, destination, numSamples);
        else
            std::fill (destination, destination + numSamples, 0.0f);
    };
    pluginView.canvas.onSourcesChanged = [this] (const juce::StringArray& levels, const juce::StringArray& scopes)
    {
        if (onSourcesChanged != nullptr)
            onSourcesChanged (levels, scopes);
    };
    studio.onUseLook = [this] (int widgetIndex, const juce::String& lookName)
    {
        pluginView.canvas.useLook (widgetIndex, lookName);
        studio.setLayout (pluginView.canvas.getLayout());
    };
    studio.onGiveOwnLook = [this] (int widgetIndex)
    {
        const auto name = pluginView.canvas.giveOwnLook (widgetIndex);
        studio.setLayout (pluginView.canvas.getLayout());
        return name;
    };
    studio.onBack = [this] { showTab (pluginTab); };
    pluginView.canvas.onParameterChanged = [this] (int index, float value)
    {
        if (onParameterChanged != nullptr)
            onParameterChanged (index, value);
    };
    pluginView.canvas.onNote = [this] (int note, float velocity)
    {
        if (onNote != nullptr)
            onNote (note, velocity);
    };
    pluginView.canvas.isNoteDown = [this] (int note) { return isNoteDown != nullptr && isNoteDown (note); };

    // The tabs are picked in the top bar; one page shows at a time.
    addChildComponent (pluginView);
    addChildComponent (studio);
    addChildComponent (notice);
    showPages();
}

void Workspace::setAiPage (juce::Component& page)
{
    aiPage = &page;
    addChildComponent (page);
    page.setBounds (getLocalBounds());
    showPages();
}

void Workspace::setProtectionPage (juce::Component& page)
{
    protectionPage = &page;
    addChildComponent (page);
    page.setBounds (getLocalBounds());
    showPages();
}

void Workspace::setStorePage (juce::Component& page)
{
    storePage = &page;
    addChildComponent (page);
    page.setBounds (getLocalBounds());
    showPages();
}

juce::Image Workspace::snapshotPanel (int longest)
{
    const auto& layout = pluginView.canvas.getLayout();
    const auto side = juce::jmax (1, juce::jmax (layout.width, layout.height));
    return pluginView.canvas.snapshot (juce::jlimit (0.5f, 2.0f, (float) longest / (float) side));
}

void Workspace::showTab (TabIndex index)
{
    // The Knob Studio opened from the top bar: empty, with the plugin's looks as they are now in
    // its list. A control's look opens in it only from that control's menu.
    if (index == studioTab && currentTab != studioTab && ! openingStudioForControl)
    {
        studio.setLayout (pluginView.canvas.getLayout());
        studio.clear();
    }

    currentTab = index;
    showPages();

    if (onTabChanged != nullptr)
        onTabChanged ((int) index);
}

void Workspace::showPages()
{
    // Edit UI and the Knob Studio give way to the notice while it has something to say (a MIDI
    // FX has no panel); Build with AI, Protection and the Store never do.
    const bool noted = notice.hasText() && (currentTab == pluginTab || currentTab == studioTab);
    juce::Component* pages[numPages] { aiPage, &pluginView, &studio, protectionPage, storePage };

    for (int i = 0; i < numPages; ++i)
        if (pages[i] != nullptr)
            pages[i]->setVisible (i == (int) currentTab && ! noted);

    notice.setVisible (noted);
}

void Workspace::setNotice (const juce::String& title, const juce::String& detail)
{
    notice.setText (title, detail);
    showPages();
}

void Workspace::setProject (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& kindName)
{
    pluginView.setProject (name, kindName);
}

void Workspace::setGuiFolder (const juce::File& folder)
{
    LayerImages::setFolder (folder != juce::File() ? folder.getChildFile (GuiLayout::imagesFolder) : juce::File());
    looks.setGuiFolder (folder);
    pluginView.canvas.setGuiFolder (folder);
}

void Workspace::showAiWorking (const juce::String& what)                  { pluginView.canvas.showAiWorking (what); }
void Workspace::showAiReply (const juce::String& reply)                   { pluginView.canvas.showAiReply (reply); }
void Workspace::setPlayMode (bool playMode)                               { pluginView.setPlayMode (playMode); }
void Workspace::setBuild (BuildState state, const juce::String& status)   { pluginView.setBuild (state, status); }
void Workspace::setExporting (bool exporting)                             { pluginView.setExporting (exporting); }
void Workspace::setExportingPlugin (bool exporting)                       { pluginView.setExportingPlugin (exporting); }
void Workspace::setParameters (const juce::Array<ParamControl>& params)   { pluginView.canvas.setParameters (params); }
void Workspace::setLayout (const GuiLayout& layout)
{
    // A new layout may come with changed looks (an undo, Sonify AI): read them again.
    looks.reload();
    looks.adoptMine (layout);

    pluginView.canvas.setLayout (layout);
    studio.setLayout (layout);
}

void Workspace::setPresets (const PresetMenu& presets)                       { pluginView.setPresets (presets); }

void Workspace::setSources (const juce::StringArray& signals, const juce::StringArray& displays)
{
    pluginView.canvas.setSources (signals, displays);
}

void Workspace::resized()
{
    for (auto* page : { aiPage, static_cast<juce::Component*> (&pluginView), static_cast<juce::Component*> (&studio),
                        protectionPage, storePage, static_cast<juce::Component*> (&notice) })
        if (page != nullptr)
            page->setBounds (getLocalBounds());
}

// D:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Workspace.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_basics/juce_gui_basics.h>

#include "KnobStudio.h"
#include "Looks.h"
#include "PluginCanvas.h"
#include "Toolbox.h"

#include <functional>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The window below the top bar, in five tabs (picked in the top bar):

        Build with AI  the conversation with Sonify AI (the main window's chat panel)
        Edit UI        the plugin, playing live, on a grid you zoom and move around, in two
                       tabs of its own, in the middle of its bar: Edit, where its GUI is
                       reshaped (with the primitives toolbox on the left), and Play, where the
                       GUI is locked and plays like the finished plugin, with its presets.
                       Empty (just the grid) until a project is open
        Knob Studio    KnobMaker's layer builder, for the looks of its knobs, sliders and
                       switches. It starts empty: a control's look opens in it from Edit UI
                       (its menu's "Design it in the Knob Studio"), with the controls like it
                       too when "Include similars" is ticked
        Protection     the plugin or MIDI FX, free or with a price, posted to Sonify's store
                       (ProtectionPage: the studio owns it)
        Store          Sonify's store, open to every user: browse, buy, add to Sonify
                       (StorePage: the studio owns it)
*/
class Workspace final : public juce::Component
{
public:
    enum TabIndex
    {
        aiTab = 0,
        pluginTab,      // Edit UI
        studioTab,
        protectionTab,  // free or a price, and the store
        storeTab        // Sonify's store: browse, buy, add
    };

    static constexpr int numPages = 5;

    enum class BuildState { idle, building, playing, failed };

    using ParamControl = PluginCanvas::Param;

    Workspace();

    /** The Build with AI tab's page: the main window owns it. */
    void setAiPage (juce::Component& page);

    /** name empty: no project is open. */
    void setProject (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& kindName);

    /** The open project's gui folder (pictures, looks, the Edit UI view); none: no project. */
    void setGuiFolder (const juce::File& folder);

    /** The looks the plugin's controls wear, and the Knob Studio edits. */
    Looks& getLooks() noexcept                    { return looks; }

    /** In place of Edit UI and the Knob Studio: a note on why there's nothing to design (a MIDI FX
        is open). An empty title: none. */
    void setNotice (const juce::String& title, const juce::String& detail);

    /** The Edit UI banner: Sonify AI at work on a request from an edit menu, then its answer. */
    void showAiWorking (const juce::String& what);
    void showAiReply (const juce::String& reply);

    /** The Edit UI tab's own tabs: Edit (false) or Play (true). */
    void setPlayMode (bool playMode);

    void showTab (TabIndex index);
    TabIndex getCurrentTab() const noexcept       { return currentTab; }

    void setBuild (BuildState state, const juce::String& status);
    void setExporting (bool exporting);
    void setExportingPlugin (bool exporting);   // Export: plugin files are being built
    void setParameters (const juce::Array<ParamControl>& params);
    void setLayout (const GuiLayout& layout);
    const GuiLayout& getLayout() const noexcept   { return pluginView.canvas.getLayout(); }

    /** The GUI's programmed elements from the latest build (nullptr: none). */
    void setElements (std::shared_ptr<WasmElements> elements)   { pluginView.canvas.setElements (std::move (elements)); }

    /** The presets, for Play's row and the panel's preset managers. */
    void setPresets (const PresetMenu& presets);

    /** What meters, lamps and scopes can watch (for the design panel's lists). */
    void setSources (const juce::StringArray& signals, const juce::StringArray& displays);

    /** For Export: the GUI baked into images. */
    PluginCanvas::Bake bakeGui()                  { return pluginView.canvas.bake(); }

    /** For Export to plugin files: the window baked page by page (PluginCanvas::bakeForExport). */
    PluginCanvas::ExportBake bakeForExport (const juce::StringArray& presetNames)   { return pluginView.canvas.bakeForExport (presetNames); }

    /** The panel as it plays now, about longest pixels on its longer side: the store's picture
        (invalid without a panel). */
    juce::Image snapshotPanel (int longest);

    /** The Protection tab's page: the studio owns it. */
    void setProtectionPage (juce::Component& page);

    /** The Store tab's page: the studio owns it. */
    void setStorePage (juce::Component& page);

    std::function<void()> onShowLogRequested;
    std::function<void()> onExportRequested;   // Add to Sonify: built first, then added
    std::function<void()> onExportPluginRequested;   // Export: VST3, CLAP (and on a Mac, Audio Unit) files
    std::function<void()> onPanicRequested;   // the Panic button: every note off
    std::function<void()> onAutoLayoutRequested;
    std::function<void()> onLayoutEdited;
    std::function<void (int index, float value)> onParameterChanged;
    std::function<void (int note, float velocity)> onNote;   // a keyboard element's key: down (velocity 0..1) or up (0)
    std::function<bool (int note)> isNoteDown;               // whether a note is sounding, for keyboards to show
    std::function<void (bool playMode)> onModeChanged;   // the user picked Edit or Play
    std::function<void (int tabIndex)> onTabChanged;     // whichever way the tab changed

    /** An edit menu's instruction for Sonify AI, about one element of the GUI (-1: the window). */
    std::function<void (int widgetIndex, const juce::String& instruction)> onAskAiAboutGui;

    std::function<void (int presetIndex)> onPresetChosen;
    std::function<void (PresetAction action)> onPresetAction;          // Save, Save as, Load, the banks...
    std::function<void (const juce::String& why)> onElementsFailed;   // the GUI's programmed elements stopped
    /** Repaints a painted picture from its recipe (a background's material, colours, pattern); done gets "" or the problem. */
    std::function<void (const juce::var& recipe, std::function<void (const juce::String& problem)> done)> onPaintPicture;

    std::function<float (const juce::String& source, bool rms)> readLevel;
    std::function<void (const juce::String& source, float* destination, int numSamples)> readScope;
    std::function<void (const juce::StringArray& levels, const juce::StringArray& scopes)> onSourcesChanged;

    void resized() override;

private:
    //==============================================================================
    class PluginView final : public juce::Component,
                             public juce::DragAndDropContainer
    {
    public:
        PluginView();

        void setProject (const juce::String& name, const juce::String& kindName);
        void setPlayMode (bool playMode);
        void setBuild (BuildState state, const juce::String& status);
        void setExporting (bool exporting);
        void setExportingPlugin (bool exporting);

        void setPresets (const PresetMenu& presets);

        std::function<void()> onShowLog, onExport, onExportPlugin, onAutoLayout, onPanic;
        std::function<void (int)> onPresetChosen;
        std::function<void (PresetAction)> onPresetAction;
        std::function<void (bool playMode)> onMode;

        void paint (juce::Graphics&) override;
        void resized() override;

        static constexpr int barHeight = 48, rowHeight = 40, modeTabWidth = 132;

        PluginCanvas canvas;
        Toolbox toolbox;

    private:
        void chooseMode (bool play);
        void showMoreMenu();

        // Two tabs, in the middle of the bar: Edit (reshape the panel) and Play (the panel locked,
        // its controls live).
        juce::TextButton editTab { "Edit" }, playTab { "Play" };
        juce::TextButton logButton { "Log" }, exportButton { "Add to Sonify" };
        juce::TextButton pluginButton { "Export Plugin" };   // VST3, CLAP (and on a Mac, Audio Unit) files
        juce::TextButton panicButton { "Panic" };   // every note off: stuck notes stop

        // The Edit tab's row: start over with an automatic panel.
        juce::TextButton autoButton { "Auto layout" };

        // The Play tab's row: the preset manager.
        juce::ComboBox presetBox;
        juce::TextButton previousButton, nextButton, saveButton { "Save" }, saveAsButton, loadButton, moreButton;
        PresetMenu presets;

        juce::String projectName, kind, buildStatus;
        BuildState buildState = BuildState::idle;
        bool playMode = false;
        juce::Rectangle<int> statusArea, hintArea;

        JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (PluginView)
    };

    //==============================================================================
    /** A note in the middle of the page: a title and a few words under it. */
    class HintView final : public juce::Component
    {
    public:
        HintView() = default;

        void setText (const juce::String& newTitle, const juce::String& newDetail);
        bool hasText() const noexcept    { return title.isNotEmpty(); }
        void paint (juce::Graphics&) override;

    private:
        juce::String title, detail;

        JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (HintView)
    };

    //==============================================================================
    void showPages();

    Looks looks;   // before the canvas and the studio, which both use it
    PluginView pluginView;
    KnobStudio studio { looks };
    HintView notice;   // in place of Edit UI and the Knob Studio, while it has something to say
    bool openingStudioForControl = false;
    juce::Component* aiPage = nullptr;
    juce::Component* protectionPage = nullptr;
    juce::Component* storePage = nullptr;
    TabIndex currentTab = aiTab;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Workspace)
};

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

project(FananWebHub VERSION 0.2.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# JUCE 9
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(JUCE_DIR "D:/workspace/JUCE" CACHE PATH "JUCE 9 root folder")

if(NOT EXISTS "${JUCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "JUCE not found at ${JUCE_DIR}")
endif()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WebView2 SDK (Windows)
# JUCE links WebView2 statically and needs the Microsoft.Web.WebView2 NuGet
# package. A copy kept beside the project (nuget\ next to this file, copied there
# from a build folder) is used as it is; without one, the package is downloaded
# once into this build folder - nothing is installed anywhere else on the system.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(WIN32)
    set(FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION "1.0.3485.44")
    set(FANAN_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGES "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/nuget")

    if(EXISTS "${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGES}/Microsoft.Web.WebView2.${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}/build/native/include/WebView2.h")
        message(STATUS "Using the WebView2 SDK kept in ${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGES}")
    else()
        set(FANAN_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGES "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/nuget")
    endif()

    set(FANAN_WEBVIEW2_DIR "${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGES}/Microsoft.Web.WebView2.${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}")

    if(NOT EXISTS "${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_DIR}/build/native/include/WebView2.h")
        set(_webview2_archive "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/nuget-download/webview2-${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}.zip")

        message(STATUS "Downloading WebView2 SDK ${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}")

        file(DOWNLOAD
            "https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/microsoft.web.webview2/${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}/microsoft.web.webview2.${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}.nupkg"
            "${_webview2_archive}"
            STATUS _webview2_status
            TLS_VERIFY ON)

        list(GET _webview2_status 0 _webview2_code)

        if(NOT _webview2_code EQUAL 0)
            file(REMOVE "${_webview2_archive}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "WebView2 SDK download failed: ${_webview2_status}")
        endif()

        file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${_webview2_archive}" DESTINATION "${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_DIR}")
    endif()

    set(JUCE_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGE_LOCATION "${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGES}")
endif()

add_subdirectory("${JUCE_DIR}" JUCE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WCLAP hosting: wclap-bridge + Wasmtime, downloaded once into build/deps.
# Brings its own CLAP 1.2.7 headers, so no separate CLAP folder is needed.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/WclapBridge.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Split into Stems: ONNX Runtime (Windows), downloaded once into build/deps.
# Without it Sonify still builds, and says stems can't be split.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/OnnxRuntime.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MP3 export: LAME, built from its source into build/deps as mp3lame.dll (LGPL: its own library).
# Without it Sonify still builds, and says MP3 export needs it.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/Lame.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Audio > Sync Tempo, Follow Tempo, Pitch: Signalsmith Stretch (MIT, headers only), and
# Audio to MIDI: Spotify's Basic Pitch model (Apache 2.0), both downloaded once into build/deps.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/Stretch.cmake)
include(src/BasicPitch.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MIDI tools: magenta.js (Google's Magenta, Apache 2.0) for the Magenta tools, downloaded once
# into build/deps; their models come later, from the MIDI tab's catalog.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/MagentaJs.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Video: VLC 3.0.21's runtime (libvlc and its plugins), downloaded once into build/deps (or the
# VLC folder named with -DFANAN_VLC_DIR=...) and copied next to Sonify.exe. Sonify loads it
# itself, so it builds without it, and says video needs VLC.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/Vlc.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Live streaming (the Live Show's cameras and stream), and the sound of the Live Show's videos read
# straight from them (VideoSound.cpp): FFmpeg 7.1, LGPL, shared, a fixed build downloaded once into
# build/deps (or the build named with -DFANAN_FFMPEG_DIR=...); its DLLs are linked late and copied
# next to Sonify.exe. On Windows configuring stops, saying why, when it can't be had.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/FFmpeg.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sonify devices (the Device Studio): wasi-sdk's clang and WebAssembly libraries, downloaded once
# into build/deps and copied next to Sonify.exe as "Device Compiler", so devices are compiled on
# the user's computer. Devices run in the Wasmtime that WCLAP hosting brings.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/DeviceCompiler.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export Plugin (the Plugins Creator Studio): VST3 3.8.1's pluginterfaces downloaded once into
# build/deps, and CLAP's headers (from WCLAP hosting), copied next to Sonify.exe as "Plugin SDKs";
# on Windows also llvm-mingw's 64-bit part as "Plugin Compiler", so plugin files are built on the
# user's computer (a Mac uses Apple's compiler, Linux the system's).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/PluginCompiler.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The Sampling Studio's nodes load Audio Units straight from their bundles on a Mac (JUCE links
# AudioUnit and CoreAudioKit for it).
if(APPLE)
    set(FANAN_PLUGINHOST_AU TRUE)

# Libraries from elsewhere (the stretcher, FFmpeg, Wasmtime, ONNX Runtime) are included as
# system headers: their own warnings stay out of the build's. MSVC: /external:W0 for them.
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(FananWebHub PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:/external:W0>)
endif()

# The time and pitch stretcher's headers; MSVC needs /bigobj for all its templates.
target_include_directories(FananWebHub SYSTEM PRIVATE ${FANAN_STRETCH_INCLUDE_DIRS})

# FFmpeg for live streaming and videos' sound: on Windows its DLLs are loaded at the first call
# (delay-loaded), so Sonify starts without them (LiveStream.cpp looks for them first, and says
# what's missing; VideoSound.cpp asks it before its own first call).
if(FANAN_FFMPEG_FOUND)
    target_compile_definitions(FananWebHub PRIVATE FANAN_FFMPEG=1)

    if(FANAN_FFMPEG_TARGET)
        target_link_libraries(FananWebHub PRIVATE ${FANAN_FFMPEG_TARGET})
    else()
        target_include_directories(FananWebHub SYSTEM PRIVATE "${FANAN_FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR}")
        target_link_libraries(FananWebHub PRIVATE ${FANAN_FFMPEG_LIBRARIES})

        if(MSVC)
            target_link_libraries(FananWebHub PRIVATE delayimp)

            foreach(_ffmpeg_dll IN LISTS FANAN_FFMPEG_DLLS)
                get_filename_component(_ffmpeg_dll_name "${_ffmpeg_dll}" NAME)

                # Only the ones Sonify links (avfilter's comes with avdevice's).
                if(_ffmpeg_dll_name MATCHES "^(avdevice|avformat|avcodec|swscale|swresample|avutil)-[0-9]+\\.dll$")
                    target_link_options(FananWebHub PRIVATE "/DELAYLOAD:${_ffmpeg_dll_name}")
                endif()
            endforeach()
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

# Sonify devices run in Wasmtime (DeviceHost.cpp), the same one WCLAP hosting links; so do the
# plugins made in the Plugins Creator Studio (WasmPlugin.cpp, WasmElements.cpp).
target_include_directories(FananWebHub SYSTEM PRIVATE "${WASMTIME_DIR}/include")

if(MSVC)
    set_source_files_properties(src/AudioRender.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/bigobj")

            VERBATIM)
    endif()
endif()

if(FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR)
    # Sonify loads libvlc itself: libvlc.dll, libvlccore.dll and the plugins folder next to
    # Sonify.exe (copied again only when changed, where CMake can tell).
    if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL 3.26)
        set(_fanan_copy_folder copy_directory_if_different)
    else()
        set(_fanan_copy_folder copy_directory)
    endif()

    add_custom_command(TARGET FananWebHub POST_BUILD
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR}/libvlc.dll" "${FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR}/libvlccore.dll"
                "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:FananWebHub>"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E ${_fanan_copy_folder} "${FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR}/plugins" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:FananWebHub>/plugins"
        VERBATIM)

    # VLC's list of its plugins (plugins\plugins.dat), as VLC's installer makes it: without it each
    # start of VLC looks into every plugin first (seconds; far longer under some virus scanners), and
    # the first video waits for that. VLC's own vlc-cache-gen makes it, copied next to Sonify.exe and
    # run there, so it looks only at the plugins there and writes only there (inside the build
    # folder). Made again only when the plugins change (put back when the copy above replaces it);
    # a failure leaves VLC slower to start, never the build.
    if(EXISTS "${FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR}/vlc-cache-gen.exe")
        set(_fanan_vlc_cache_script "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/fanan_vlc_plugins_cache.cmake")
        file(WRITE "${_fanan_vlc_cache_script}" [=[
# Made by Sonify's CMakeLists.txt: VLC's plugins.dat for the plugins next to Sonify.exe.
# GEN: the vlc-cache-gen.exe next to Sonify.exe (with libvlc's DLLs); PLUGINS: the plugins folder there.
set(_stamp "${PLUGINS}/../vlc-plugins-cache.stamp")
set(_kept "${PLUGINS}/../vlc-plugins-cache.dat")
set(_due FALSE)

if(NOT EXISTS "${_stamp}" OR NOT EXISTS "${_kept}")
    set(_due TRUE)
else()
    file(GLOB_RECURSE _files LIST_DIRECTORIES false "${PLUGINS}/*.dll")

    foreach(_file IN LISTS _files)
        if("${_file}" IS_NEWER_THAN "${_stamp}" AND NOT "${_stamp}" IS_NEWER_THAN "${_file}")
            set(_due TRUE)
            break()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

if(_due)
    unset(ENV{VLC_PLUGIN_PATH})
    execute_process(COMMAND "${GEN}" "${PLUGINS}" RESULT_VARIABLE _result OUTPUT_QUIET ERROR_QUIET TIMEOUT 300)

    if(_result STREQUAL "0" AND EXISTS "${PLUGINS}/plugins.dat")
        execute_process(COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy "${PLUGINS}/plugins.dat" "${_kept}" RESULT_VARIABLE _copied)

        if(_copied STREQUAL "0")
            file(TOUCH "${_stamp}")
        endif()
    else()
        message(STATUS "VLC's list of its plugins (plugins.dat) wasn't made (${_result}): VLC looks into them each time it starts.")
    endif()
else()
    # The plugins as they were: the list made for them, put back if the copy replaced it.
    set(_same FALSE)

    if(EXISTS "${PLUGINS}/plugins.dat")
        file(SHA256 "${PLUGINS}/plugins.dat" _now)
        file(SHA256 "${_kept}" _was)

        if(_now STREQUAL _was)
            set(_same TRUE)
        endif()
    endif()

    if(NOT _same)
        execute_process(COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy "${_kept}" "${PLUGINS}/plugins.dat")
    endif()
endif()
]=])

        add_custom_command(TARGET FananWebHub POST_BUILD
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${FANAN_VLC_RUNTIME_DIR}/vlc-cache-gen.exe" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:FananWebHub>"
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" "-DGEN=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:FananWebHub>/vlc-cache-gen.exe" "-DPLUGINS=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:FananWebHub>/plugins"
                    -P "${_fanan_vlc_cache_script}"
            VERBATIM)
    endif()
endif()
